name: DG.IsPositive.basis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_apply {ι : Type*} (s : ι → SimpleIdempotent A)
    (hs : ∀ a b, (s a).1.Equiv (s b).1 → a = b)
    (hs' : ∀ e : SimpleIdempotent A, ∃ a, e.1.Equiv (s a).1) (a : ι) :
    hA.basis s hs hs' a = DGRing.K0.leftCorner (s a).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [basis, Module.Basis.map_apply, basisOfConcentrated_apply]
  change hA.K0DegreeZeroEquiv.symm _ = _
  rw [K0DegreeZeroEquiv_symm_leftCorner, hA.map_projZero_map_subtype]

name: DG.IsPositive.val_eq_one_of_isSimple
statement: theorem val_eq_one_of_isSimple {e : DGIdempotent A} (he : e.IsSimple) : e.val = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hne : e.toZero ≠ 0 := fun h => he.val_ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have h : e.toZero * e.toZero = e.toZero * 1 := by rw [mul_one, e.isIdempotentElem_toZero.eq]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((hdiv _ hne).mul_left_cancel h)

name: DG.IsPositive.isSimple_one
statement: theorem isSimple_one : (hA.dgIdempotent 1 IsIdempotentElem.one).IsSimple
proof:
:= by
  have hR : IsSimpleModule (degreeZeroSubring A) (degreeZeroSubring A) :=
    isSimpleModule_self_iff_isUnit.mpr ⟨inferInstance, hdiv⟩
  have h1 : (hA.dgIdempotent 1 IsIdempotentElem.one).toZero = 1 := rfl
  unfold DGIdempotent.IsSimple
  rw [h1, show Submodule.span (degreeZeroSubring A) {(1 : degreeZeroSubring A)} = ⊤ from
    Ideal.span_singleton_one]
  exact IsSimpleModule.congr Submodule.topEquiv

name: DG.IsPositive.equiv_one_of_isSimple
statement:
theorem equiv_one_of_isSimple (e : SimpleIdempotent A) :
    e.1.Equiv (hA.dgIdempotent 1 IsIdempotentElem.one)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGIdempotent.eq_of_val_eq (e := e.1) (f := hA.dgIdempotent 1 IsIdempotentElem.one)
    (by rw [val_eq_one_of_isSimple hdiv e.2]; rfl)]
  exact DGIdempotent.Equiv.refl _

name: DG.IsPositive.basisOfDivisionRing_apply
statement:
theorem basisOfDivisionRing_apply (a : Unit) :
    hA.basisOfDivisionRing hdiv a = DGRing.K0.self A
proof:
:=
  (hA.basis_apply _ _ _ a).trans
    (DGRing.K0.leftCorner_eq_self_of_val_eq_one (hA.dgIdempotent 1 IsIdempotentElem.one) rfl)

name: DG.IsPositive.K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing_self
statement:
theorem K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing_self :
    hA.K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing hdiv (DGRing.K0.self A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hA.basisOfDivisionRing_apply hdiv ()]
  change LinearEquiv.funUnique Unit ℤ ℤ ((hA.basisOfDivisionRing hdiv).equivFun
    (hA.basisOfDivisionRing hdiv ())) = 1
  rw [LinearEquiv.funUnique_apply, Function.eval, Module.Basis.equivFun_self]
  rfl

name: DG.IsPositive.K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing_symm_apply
statement:
theorem K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing_symm_apply (n : ℤ) :
    (hA.K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing hdiv).symm n = n • DGRing.K0.self A
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq, map_zsmul, K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: DG.IsPositive.isUnit_of_forall_eq_algebraMap
statement: theorem isUnit_of_forall_eq_algebraMap (a : degreeZeroSubring A) (ha : a ≠ 0) : IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hk a a.2
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := fun h => ha (Subtype.ext (by rw [← hc, h, map_zero]; rfl))
  let b : degreeZeroSubring A := ⟨algebraMap k A c⁻¹, algebraMap_mem_grading k c⁻¹⟩
  have h1 : a * b = 1 := Subtype.ext (by
    change (a : A) * algebraMap k A c⁻¹ = 1
    rw [← hc, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc0, map_one])
  have h2 : b * a = 1 := Subtype.ext (by
    change algebraMap k A c⁻¹ * (a : A) = 1
    rw [← hc, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0, map_one])
  exact ⟨⟨a, b, h1, h2⟩, rfl⟩

name: DG.IsPositive.K0EquivIntOfField_self
statement: theorem K0EquivIntOfField_self : hA.K0EquivIntOfField k hk (DGRing.K0.self A) = 1
proof:
:=
  hA.K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing_self _

name: DG.DegreeZeroRing.eq_zero_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading {i : ℤ} (hi : i ≠ 0) {a : DegreeZeroRing K}
    (ha : a ∈ grading (M := DegreeZeroRing K) i) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : grading (M := DegreeZeroRing K) i = ⊥ := degreeZeroGrading_of_ne _ hi
  rw [this] at ha
  exact ha

name: DG.DegreeZeroRing.d_eq_zero
statement: theorem d_eq_zero (a : DegreeZeroRing K) : d a = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DegreeZeroRing.mem_grading_zero
statement: theorem mem_grading_zero (a : DegreeZeroRing K) : a ∈ grading (M := DegreeZeroRing K) 0
proof:
:=
  mem_degreeZeroGrading_zero (DegreeZeroRing K) a

name: DG.ExtendScalars.tmul_intCast
statement:
theorem tmul_intCast (k : DegreeZeroRing K) (m : ℤ) :
    (k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (m : A) : ExtendScalars K A) = (m • k) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zsmul_one]
  exact congrArg (_root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒦 𝒜) (TensorProduct.smul_tmul m k 1).symm

name: DG.ExtendScalars.tmul_eq_zero_or
statement:
theorem tmul_eq_zero_or {i j : ℤ} {a : DegreeZeroRing K} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : A}
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) : (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : ExtendScalars K A) = 0 ∨ (i = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · by_cases hj : j < 0
    · left
      rw [hneg j hj] at hb
      rw [(AddSubgroup.mem_bot).mp hb, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    · right
      omega
  · left
    rw [DegreeZeroRing.eq_zero_of_mem_grading K hi ha, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.grading_eq_bot
statement: theorem grading_eq_bot {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) : grading (M := ExtendScalars K A) n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x hx => (AddSubgroup.mem_bot).mpr ?_
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒦 𝒜 hx (motive := fun x => x = 0) rfl ?_ ?_
  · intro i j a b hij
    rcases tmul_eq_zero_or hneg a.2 b.2 with h | ⟨hi, hj⟩
    · exact h
    · omega
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.exists_eq_tmul_one
statement:
theorem exists_eq_tmul_one {x : ExtendScalars K A} (hx : x ∈ grading (M := ExtendScalars K A) 0) :
    ∃ k : DegreeZeroRing K, x = k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : A)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒦 𝒜 hx
    (motive := fun x => ∃ k : DegreeZeroRing K, x = k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : A)) ⟨0, by
      rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]⟩ ?_ ?_
  · intro i j a b hij
    rcases tmul_eq_zero_or hneg a.2 b.2 with h | ⟨hi, hj⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by rw [h, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]⟩
    · have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
      subst hj0
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h0 b b.2
      exact ⟨m • (a : DegreeZeroRing K), by rw [← hm, tmul_intCast]⟩
  · rintro x y ⟨k, rfl⟩ ⟨k', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k + k', (GradedTensorProduct.add_tmul 𝒦 𝒜 k k' (1 : A)).symm⟩

name: DG.ExtendScalars.tmul_one_mem
statement:
theorem tmul_one_mem (k : DegreeZeroRing K) :
    (k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : A) : ExtendScalars K A) ∈ grading (M := ExtendScalars K A) 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (R := ℤ) (i := 0) (j := 0)
    (DegreeZeroRing.mem_grading_zero K k) (one_mem_grading (A := A))
  rwa [add_zero] at h

name: DG.ExtendScalars.d_tmul_one
statement: theorem d_tmul_one (k : DegreeZeroRing K) : d (k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : A) : ExtendScalars K A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul', DegreeZeroRing.d_eq_zero, d_one,
    GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.tmul_one_mul_comm
statement:
theorem tmul_one_mul_comm (k : DegreeZeroRing K) (x : ExtendScalars K A) :
    (k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : A) : ExtendScalars K A) * x = x * (k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : A))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => rw [mul_zero, zero_mul]
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒦 𝒜 k (one_mem_grading (A := A)) ha b,
      GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒦 𝒜 (i' := 0) a hb (DegreeZeroRing.mem_grading_zero K k) 1,
      zero_mul, mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul, one_smul, one_mul, mul_one, mul_comm]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_apply (k : K) :
    algebraMap K (ExtendScalars K A) k = (DegreeZeroRing.of K k) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.unitHom_apply
statement:
theorem unitHom_apply (a : A) :
    unitHom K A a = ((1 : DegreeZeroRing K) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a : ExtendScalars K A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.toDegreeZero_surjective
statement: theorem toDegreeZero_surjective : Function.Surjective (toDegreeZero K A)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_tmul_one hneg h0 (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp hx)
  exact ⟨k, rfl⟩

name: DG.ExtendScalars.degreeZeroLinearMap_tmul
statement:
theorem degreeZeroLinearMap_tmul (k : K) (a : degreeZeroSubring A) :
    degreeZeroLinearMap K A (k ⊗ₜ a) =
      ((DegreeZeroRing.of K k) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (a : A) : ExtendScalars K A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.degreeZeroLinearMap_mul_tmul
statement:
theorem degreeZeroLinearMap_mul_tmul (k k' : K) (a a' : degreeZeroSubring A) :
    degreeZeroLinearMap K A ((k ⊗ₜ a) * (k' ⊗ₜ a')) =
      degreeZeroLinearMap K A (k ⊗ₜ a) * degreeZeroLinearMap K A (k' ⊗ₜ a')
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, degreeZeroLinearMap_tmul, degreeZeroLinearMap_tmul,
    degreeZeroLinearMap_tmul,
    GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒦 𝒜 (j := 0) (i' := 0) (DegreeZeroRing.of K k)
      (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp a.2)
      (DegreeZeroRing.mem_grading_zero K (DegreeZeroRing.of K k')) (a' : A), zero_mul,
    koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.degreeZeroRingHom_tmul
statement:
theorem degreeZeroRingHom_tmul (k : K) (a : degreeZeroSubring A) :
    degreeZeroRingHom K A (k ⊗ₜ a) =
      ((DegreeZeroRing.of K k) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (a : A) : ExtendScalars K A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.degreeZeroRingHom_mem
statement:
theorem degreeZeroRingHom_mem (x : K ⊗[ℤ] degreeZeroSubring A) :
    degreeZeroRingHom K A x ∈ grading (M := ExtendScalars K A) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul k a =>
    rw [degreeZeroRingHom_tmul]
    have h := GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (R := ℤ) (i := 0) (j := 0)
      (DegreeZeroRing.mem_grading_zero K (DegreeZeroRing.of K k)) (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp a.2)
    rwa [add_zero] at h
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.ExtendScalars.degreeZeroHom_surjective
statement: theorem degreeZeroHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (degreeZeroHom K A)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  suffices h : ∃ y, degreeZeroRingHom K A y = x from
    h.imp fun y hy => Subtype.ext hy
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒦 𝒜 (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp hx)
    (motive := fun x => ∃ y, degreeZeroRingHom K A y = x) ⟨0, map_zero _⟩ ?_ ?_
  · intro i j a b hij
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst hi
      have hj : j = 0 := by omega
      subst hj
      exact ⟨(DegreeZeroRing.of K).symm (a : DegreeZeroRing K) ⊗ₜ
        ⟨(b : A), mem_degreeZeroSubring.mpr b.2⟩, degreeZeroRingHom_tmul _ _⟩
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero, DegreeZeroRing.eq_zero_of_mem_grading K hi a.2, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  · rintro x y ⟨x', rfl⟩ ⟨y', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x' + y', map_add _ _ _⟩

name: DG.ExtendScalars.degreeZeroProj_coe
statement: theorem degreeZeroProj_coe (a : degreeZeroSubring A) : degreeZeroProj A (a : A) = a
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (decompose_of_mem_same _ (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp a.2))

name: DG.ExtendScalars.degreeZeroHom_injective
statement: theorem degreeZeroHom_injective : Function.Injective (degreeZeroHom K A)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ : ExtendScalars K A →ₗ[ℤ] K ⊗[ℤ] degreeZeroSubring A :=
    (LinearMap.rTensor _ (DegreeZeroRing.of K).symm.toAddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap) ∘ₗ
      (LinearMap.lTensor (DegreeZeroRing K) (degreeZeroProj A).toIntLinearMap) ∘ₗ
        (_root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒦 𝒜).symm.toLinearMap
  have hΦ : Φ ∘ₗ degreeZeroLinearMap K A = LinearMap.id := by
    refine TensorProduct.ext' fun k a => ?_
    change Φ (degreeZeroLinearMap K A (k ⊗ₜ a)) = k ⊗ₜ a
    rw [degreeZeroLinearMap_tmul]
    change (DegreeZeroRing.of K).symm (DegreeZeroRing.of K k) ⊗ₜ degreeZeroProj A (a : A) = k ⊗ₜ a
    rw [degreeZeroProj_coe]
    rfl
  intro x y h
  have hx : Φ (degreeZeroRingHom K A x) = x := LinearMap.congr_fun hΦ x
  have hy : Φ (degreeZeroRingHom K A y) = y := LinearMap.congr_fun hΦ y
  have h' : degreeZeroRingHom K A x = degreeZeroRingHom K A y := congrArg Subtype.val h
  rw [← hx, ← hy, h']

name: DG.ExtendScalars.degreeZeroEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeZeroEquiv_tmul (k : K) (a : degreeZeroSubring A) :
    (degreeZeroEquiv K A (k ⊗ₜ a) : ExtendScalars K A) =
      (DegreeZeroRing.of K k) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (a : A)
proof:
:=
  degreeZeroRingHom_tmul k a

name: DG.ExtendScalars.d_degreeZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem d_degreeZeroRingHom (hd0 : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 0, d a = 0)
    (x : K ⊗[ℤ] degreeZeroSubring A) : d (degreeZeroRingHom K A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul k a =>
    rw [degreeZeroRingHom_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul', DegreeZeroRing.d_eq_zero,
      hd0 _ (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp a.2), GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul,
      GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, d_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.isPositive_of_isSemisimpleRing
statement:
theorem isPositive_of_isSemisimpleRing (hd0 : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 0, d a = 0)
    [IsSemisimpleRing (K ⊗[ℤ] degreeZeroSubring A)] : IsPositive (ExtendScalars K A) where
  grading_eq_bot n hn
proof:
:= grading_eq_bot hneg hn
  isSemisimple := (degreeZeroHom K A).isSemisimpleRing_of_surjective degreeZeroHom_surjective
  d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero a ha := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := degreeZeroHom_surjective (K := K) (A := A) ⟨a, mem_degreeZeroSubring.mpr ha⟩
    have hax : a = degreeZeroRingHom K A x := (congrArg Subtype.val hx).symm
    rw [hax]
    exact d_degreeZeroRingHom hd0 x

name: DG.ExtendScalars.isPositive
statement:
theorem isPositive [IsSemisimpleRing K] : IsPositive (ExtendScalars K A) where
  grading_eq_bot n hn
proof:
:= grading_eq_bot hneg hn
  isSemisimple :=
    haveI : IsSemisimpleRing (DegreeZeroRing K) := inferInstanceAs (IsSemisimpleRing K)
    (toDegreeZero K A).isSemisimpleRing_of_surjective (toDegreeZero_surjective hneg h0)
  d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero a ha := by
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_tmul_one hneg h0 ha
    exact d_tmul_one k

name: DG.ExtendScalars.isUnit_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_ne_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] (a : degreeZeroSubring (ExtendScalars K A))
    (ha : a ≠ 0) : IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := toDegreeZero_surjective hneg h0 a
  have hk : k ≠ 0 := fun h => ha (by rw [h, map_zero])
  exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hk).map _

name: DG.ExtendScalars.exists_retraction
statement: theorem exists_retraction : ∃ r : A →+ ℤ, r 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e : ℤ →+ grading (M := A) 0 :=
    { toFun := fun m => ⟨(m : A), by
        rw [← zsmul_one]; exact zsmul_mem (one_mem_grading (A := A)) m⟩
      map_zero' := Subtype.ext Int.cast_zero
      map_add' := fun m n => Subtype.ext (Int.cast_add m n) }
  have he : Function.Bijective e := by
    refine ⟨fun m n h => ?_, fun a => ?_⟩
    · have h' : ((m - n : ℤ) : A) = 0 := by
        rw [Int.cast_sub]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (congrArg Subtype.val h)
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hchar _ h')
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h0 a a.2
      exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩
  let E := AddEquiv.ofBijective e he
  let p : A →+ grading (M := A) 0 :=
    (DFinsupp.evalAddMonoidHom 0).comp (decomposeAddEquiv (grading (M := A))).toAddMonoidHom
  refine ⟨E.symm.toAddMonoidHom.comp p, ?_⟩
  have hp : p 1 = ⟨1, one_mem_grading (A := A)⟩ := by
    change decompose (grading (M := A)) (1 : A) 0 = _
    exact Subtype.ext (decompose_of_mem_same _ (one_mem_grading (A := A)))
  change E.symm (p 1) = 1
  rw [hp, AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  exact Subtype.ext Int.cast_one.symm

name: DG.ExtendScalars.nontrivial
statement: theorem nontrivial [Nontrivial K] : Nontrivial (ExtendScalars K A)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (DegreeZeroRing K) := inferInstanceAs (Nontrivial K)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_retraction h0 hchar
  let Φ : ExtendScalars K A →ₗ[ℤ] DegreeZeroRing K :=
    (TensorProduct.rid ℤ (DegreeZeroRing K)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      (LinearMap.lTensor (DegreeZeroRing K) r.toIntLinearMap) ∘ₗ
        (_root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒦 𝒜).symm.toLinearMap
  have h1 : Φ 1 = 1 := by
    change TensorProduct.rid ℤ (DegreeZeroRing K) ((1 : DegreeZeroRing K) ⊗ₜ r 1) = 1
    rw [hr, TensorProduct.rid_tmul, one_smul]
  refine ⟨⟨1, 0, fun h => ?_⟩⟩
  have := congrArg Φ h
  rw [h1, map_zero] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: DG.ExtendScalars.K0EquivInt_self
statement:
theorem K0EquivInt_self :
    K0EquivInt hneg h0 hchar (DGRing.K0.self (ExtendScalars K A)) = 1
proof:
:=
  haveI := nontrivial (K := K) h0 hchar
  (isPositive hneg h0).K0EquivIntOfDivisionRing_self _

name: DG.DGRingHom.IsQuasiIso.quasiIsomorphic
statement:
theorem DGRingHom.IsQuasiIso.quasiIsomorphic {f : A →ᵈᵍ+* B} (hf : f.IsQuasiIso) :
    QuasiIsomorphic A B
proof:
:=
  .rel _ _ ⟨f, hf⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.nonempty_equivalence_of_instances
statement:
theorem nonempty_equivalence_of_instances (A : Type u) [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [DGRing A]
    (I₁ : HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, max u w} A)
    (I₂ : HasDerivedCategory.{w₂, max u w} A) :
    Nonempty (@DerivedCategory A _ _ _ I₁ ≌ @DerivedCategory A _ _ _ I₂)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Localization.uniq (@Qh A _ _ _ I₁) (@Qh A _ _ _ I₂) (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A)⟩

name: DG.nonempty_derivedEquivalence_small
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel X Y hXY =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hXY
    let := HasDerivedCategory.small.{w, u} X
    let := HasDerivedCategory.small.{w, u} Y
    exact ⟨(DGRingHom.derivedEquivalence.{max u w} f hf)⟩
  | refl X => exact ⟨CategoryTheory.Equivalence.refl⟩
  | symm X Y _ ih => exact ⟨ih.some.symm⟩
  | trans X Y Z _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ⟨ih₁.some.trans ih₂.some⟩

name: DG.QuasiIsomorphic.nonempty_derivedEquivalence
statement:
theorem QuasiIsomorphic.nonempty_derivedEquivalence {A B : Type u} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A]
    [DGRing A] [Ring B] [DGAddCommGroup B] [DGRing B] (h : QuasiIsomorphic A B)
    [I₁ : HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, max u w} A] [I₂ : HasDerivedCategory.{w₂, max u w} B] :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory A ≌ DerivedCategory B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := nonempty_derivedEquivalence_small.{w} h
  obtain ⟨E₁⟩ := DerivedCategory.nonempty_equivalence_of_instances A I₁
    (HasDerivedCategory.small.{w, u} A)
  obtain ⟨E₂⟩ := DerivedCategory.nonempty_equivalence_of_instances B
    (HasDerivedCategory.small.{w, u} B) I₂
  exact ⟨E₁.trans (E.trans E₂)⟩

name: DG.IsFormal.nonempty_derivedEquivalence
statement:
theorem IsFormal.nonempty_derivedEquivalence {A : Type u} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A]
    [DGRing A] (h : IsFormal A) [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, max u w} A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂, max u w} (Cohomology A)] :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory A ≌ DerivedCategory (Cohomology A))
proof:
:=
  QuasiIsomorphic.nonempty_derivedEquivalence.{w} h

name: DG.nonempty_K0_addEquiv_small
statement:
theorem nonempty_K0_addEquiv_small {X Y : BundledDGRing.{u}}
    (h : Relation.EqvGen BundledDGRing.QuasiIsoRel X Y) :
    ∀ (I : HasDerivedCategory.{u, u} X) (J : HasDerivedCategory.{u, u} Y),
      Nonempty (@DGRing.K0 X _ _ _ I ≃+ @DGRing.K0 Y _ _ _ J)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel X Y hXY =>
    intro I J
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hXY
    exact ⟨(@DGRing.K0.mapEquivOfIsQuasiIso Y _ _ _ J X _ _ _ I f hf)⟩
  | refl X => exact fun I J => ⟨DGRing.K0.instanceEquiv X I J⟩
  | symm X Y _ ih => exact fun I J => ⟨(ih J I).some.symm⟩
  | trans X Y Z _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro I J
    let K := HasDerivedCategory.small.{u, u} Y
    exact ⟨(ih₁ I K).some.trans (ih₂ K J).some⟩

name: DG.QuasiIsomorphic.nonempty_K0_addEquiv
statement:
theorem QuasiIsomorphic.nonempty_K0_addEquiv {A B : Type u} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A]
    [DGRing A] [Ring B] [DGAddCommGroup B] [DGRing B] (h : QuasiIsomorphic A B)
    [I : HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, u} A] [J : HasDerivedCategory.{w₂, u} B] :
    Nonempty (DGRing.K0 A ≃+ DGRing.K0 B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := nonempty_K0_addEquiv_small h (HasDerivedCategory.small.{u, u} A)
    (HasDerivedCategory.small.{u, u} B)
  exact ⟨(DGRing.K0.instanceEquiv A I _).trans (E.trans (DGRing.K0.instanceEquiv B _ J))⟩

name: DG.IsFormal.nonempty_K0_addEquiv
statement:
theorem IsFormal.nonempty_K0_addEquiv {A : Type u} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [DGRing A]
    (h : IsFormal A) [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, u} A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂, u} (Cohomology A)] :
    Nonempty (DGRing.K0 A ≃+ DGRing.K0 (Cohomology A))
proof:
:=
  QuasiIsomorphic.nonempty_K0_addEquiv h

name: DG.DGRingHom.mem_cocycles_apply_of
statement:
theorem DGRingHom.mem_cocycles_apply_of (s : Cohomology A →ᵈᵍ+* B) (n : ℤ)
    (x : cohomology A n) : s (DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) n x) ∈ cocycles B n
proof:
:=
  mem_cocycles.mpr ⟨s.map_mem (Cohomology.of_mem_grading n x), by
    rw [← s.map_d, Cohomology.d_apply, map_zero]⟩

name: DG.DGRingHom.IsCohomologySection.isQuasiIso
statement:
theorem DGRingHom.IsCohomologySection.isQuasiIso {s : Cohomology A →ᵈᵍ+* A}
    (hs : s.IsCohomologySection) : s.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology A n),
      cohomology.mk A n ⟨_, s.mem_cocycles_apply_of n x⟩ = x := hs
  intro n
  
  have hrep : ∀ z : cocycles (Cohomology A) n,
      ∃ x : cohomology A n, (z : Cohomology A) = DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) n x :=
    fun z => by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Cohomology.mem_grading_iff.mp (mem_cocycles.mp z.2).1
      exact ⟨x, hx.symm⟩
  have hmap : ∀ (z : cocycles (Cohomology A) n) (x : cohomology A n),
      (z : Cohomology A) = DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) n x →
        s.cohomologyMap n (cohomology.mk _ n z) = x := by
    intro z x hzx
    rw [cohomologyMap_mk, ← hs' n x]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_cocyclesMap, hzx])
  constructor
  · intro y y' hyy'
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := cohomology.mk_surjective _ n y
    obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := cohomology.mk_surjective _ n y'
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hrep z
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hrep z'
    rw [hmap z x hx, hmap z' x' hx'] at hyy'
    subst hyy'
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (hx.trans hx'.symm)
  · intro x
    refine ⟨cohomology.mk _ n ⟨DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) n x,
      mem_cocycles.mpr ⟨Cohomology.of_mem_grading n x, rfl⟩⟩, hmap _ x rfl⟩

name: DG.isFormal_of_isCohomologySection
statement:
theorem isFormal_of_isCohomologySection (s : Cohomology A →ᵈᵍ+* A)
    (hs : s.IsCohomologySection) : IsFormal A
proof:
:=
  .symm _ _ (.rel _ _ ⟨s, hs.isQuasiIso⟩)

name: DG.IsPositive.toCohomologyZero_bijective
statement: theorem toCohomologyZero_bijective : Function.Bijective hA.toCohomologyZero
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have h : cohomology.mk A 0 (hA.cocycleZero a) = cohomology.mk A 0 (hA.cocycleZero b) :=
      DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun n => cohomology A n) 0 (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
    have h' := congrArg (fun x => (hA.cohomologyZeroEquiv x : A)) h
    simp only [coe_cohomologyZeroEquiv_mk] at h'
    exact Subtype.ext h'
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Cohomology.mem_grading_iff.mp hx
    refine ⟨⟨hA.cohomologyZeroEquiv y, (hA.cohomologyZeroEquiv y).2⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) 0 _ = DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) 0 y
    congr 1
    conv_rhs => rw [← hA.cohomologyZeroEquiv.symm_apply_apply y]
    rfl

name: DG.IsPositive.cohomology
statement:
theorem cohomology : IsPositive (Cohomology A) where
  grading_eq_bot n hn
proof:
:= by
    have := hA.subsingleton_cohomology_of_neg hn
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  isSemisimple :=
    haveI := hA.isSemisimple
    (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hA.toCohomologyZero_bijective).isSemisimpleRing
  d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero _ _ := rfl

name: DG.DGAlgebra.mem_degreeZeroSubalgebra
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.mem_degreeZeroSubalgebra {a : A} :
    a ∈ DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebra k A ↔ a ∈ grading (M := A) 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.degreeZeroTensorHom_tmul
statement:
theorem degreeZeroTensorHom_tmul (a : A₀) (b : B₀) :
    degreeZeroTensorHom k A B (a ⊗ₜ b) = ((a : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[k] (b : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degreeZeroTensorHom, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul]
  change ((a : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ) * ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[k] (b : B)) = _
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_one_tmul, one_mul]

name: DG.degreeZeroTensorHom_injective
statement: theorem degreeZeroTensorHom_injective : Function.Injective (degreeZeroTensorHom k A B)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (degreeZeroTensorHom k A B).toLinearMap =
      (_root_.GradedTensorProduct.of k 𝒜 ℬ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (A₀).val.toLinearMap (B₀).val.toLinearMap :=
    TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => degreeZeroTensorHom_tmul a b
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      ((_root_.GradedTensorProduct.of k 𝒜 ℬ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (A₀).val.toLinearMap (B₀).val.toLinearMap) :=
    (_root_.GradedTensorProduct.of k 𝒜 ℬ).injective.comp
      (TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat _ _ Subtype.val_injective Subtype.val_injective)
  rw [← h] at hinj
  exact hinj

name: DG.degreeZeroTensorHom_mem
statement:
theorem degreeZeroTensorHom_mem (y : A₀ ⊗[k] B₀) :
    degreeZeroTensorHom k A B y ∈ grading (M := 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b =>
    rw [degreeZeroTensorHom_tmul]
    exact GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_of_eq 𝒜 ℬ (add_zero 0) a.2 b.2
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.tmul_eq_zero_or
statement:
theorem tmul_eq_zero_or {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading j) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[k] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ) = 0 ∨ (0 ≤ i ∧ 0 ≤ j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i < 0
  · left
    rw [hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading hi ha, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  by_cases hj : j < 0
  · left
    rw [hB.eq_zero_of_mem_grading hj hb, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  right
  omega

name: DG.exists_degreeZeroTensorHom_eq
statement:
theorem exists_degreeZeroTensorHom_eq {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading (M := 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ) 0) :
    ∃ y, degreeZeroTensorHom k A B y = x
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx
    (motive := fun x => ∃ y, degreeZeroTensorHom k A B y = x) ⟨0, map_zero _⟩ ?_ ?_
  · intro i j a b hij
    rcases tmul_eq_zero_or hA hB (k := k) a.2 b.2 with h | ⟨hi, hj⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, h]⟩
    · have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
      have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
      subst hi0 hj0
      exact ⟨(⟨a, a.2⟩ : A₀) ⊗ₜ[k] (⟨b, b.2⟩ : B₀), degreeZeroTensorHom_tmul _ _⟩
  · rintro x y ⟨x', rfl⟩ ⟨y', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x' + y', map_add _ _ _⟩

name: DG.coe_degreeZeroTensorEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coe_degreeZeroTensorEquiv_apply (y : A₀ ⊗[k] B₀) :
    (degreeZeroTensorEquiv hA hB y : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ) = degreeZeroTensorHom k A B y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.grading_tensorProduct_eq_bot
statement:
theorem grading_tensorProduct_eq_bot {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) :
    grading (M := 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ) n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x hx => (AddSubgroup.mem_bot).mpr ?_
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx (motive := fun x => x = 0) rfl ?_ ?_
  · intro i j a b hij
    rcases tmul_eq_zero_or hA hB (k := k) a.2 b.2 with h | ⟨hi, hj⟩
    · exact h
    · omega
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.d_tensorProduct_eq_zero
statement:
theorem d_tensorProduct_eq_zero {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading (M := 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ) 0) :
    d x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx (motive := fun x => d x = 0) d_zero ?_ ?_
  · intro i j a b hij
    rcases tmul_eq_zero_or hA hB (k := k) a.2 b.2 with h | ⟨hi, hj⟩
    · rw [h, d_zero]
    · have hi0 : i = 0 := by omega
      have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
      subst hi0 hj0
      have ha : (a : A) ∈ grading 0 := a.2
      have hb : (b : B) ∈ grading 0 := b.2
      rw [GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul ha, hA.d_eq_zero ha, hB.d_eq_zero hb,
        GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [d_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.IsPositive.tensorProduct
statement:
theorem IsPositive.tensorProduct (hsA : IsSplitSemisimple k A₀) (hsB : IsSplitSemisimple k B₀) :
    IsPositive (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ)
proof:
:= by
  have := hA.isSemisimple
  have := hB.isSemisimple
  have : IsSemisimpleRing A₀ := (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A).isSemisimpleRing
  have : IsSemisimpleRing B₀ := (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B).isSemisimpleRing
  have := isSemisimpleRing_tensorProduct (R₁ := A₀) (R₂ := B₀) k hsA hsB
  refine ⟨fun n hn => grading_tensorProduct_eq_bot hA hB hn, ?_,
    fun x hx => d_tensorProduct_eq_zero hA hB hx⟩
  exact (degreeZeroTensorEquiv hA hB).isSemisimpleRing

name: DG.DGIdempotent.tmul_val
statement: theorem DGIdempotent.tmul_val : (e.tmul (k := k) f).val = e.val ᵍ⊗ₜ[k] f.val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.toZero_tmul
statement:
theorem toZero_tmul :
    (e.tmul (k := k) f).toZero = degreeZeroTensorEquiv hA hB
      (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A e.toZero ⊗ₜ
        DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B f.toZero)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_degreeZeroTensorEquiv_apply, degreeZeroTensorHom_tmul]; rfl)

name: DG.isIdempotentElem_toZero_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_toZero_ringEquiv {C : Type*} [Ring C] [DGAddCommGroup C] [DGRing C]
    {R : Type*} [Ring R] (φ : degreeZeroSubring C ≃+* R) (e : DGIdempotent C) :
    IsIdempotentElem (φ e.toZero)
proof:
:= by
  change φ _ * φ _ = φ _
  rw [← map_mul, e.isIdempotentElem_toZero.eq]

name: DG.isSimpleModule_ringEquiv
proof:
:=
  (isSimpleModule_span_singleton_ringEquiv_iff φ _).mpr he

name: DG.IsPositive.isSimple_tmul
statement:
theorem IsPositive.isSimple_tmul (hsA : IsSplitSemisimple k A₀) (hsB : IsSplitSemisimple k B₀)
    {e : DGIdempotent A} {f : DGIdempotent B} (he : e.IsSimple) (hf : f.IsSimple) :
    (e.tmul (k := k) f).IsSimple
proof:
:= by
  unfold DGIdempotent.IsSimple
  rw [toZero_tmul hA hB, isSimpleModule_span_singleton_ringEquiv_iff]
  have he' := isSimpleModule_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A) he
  have hf' := isSimpleModule_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B) hf
  have hie := isIdempotentElem_toZero_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A) e
  have hif := isIdempotentElem_toZero_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B) f
  exact isSimpleModule_span_tmul hie hif he' hf' (hsA _ hie he') (hsB _ hif hf')

name: DG.IsPositive.equiv_tmul_iff
statement:
theorem IsPositive.equiv_tmul_iff (hsA : IsSplitSemisimple k A₀) (hsB : IsSplitSemisimple k B₀)
    {e e' : DGIdempotent A} {f f' : DGIdempotent B} (he : e.IsSimple) (he' : e'.IsSimple)
    (hf : f.IsSimple) (hf' : f'.IsSimple) :
    (e.tmul (k := k) f).Equiv (e'.tmul f') ↔ e.Equiv e' ∧ f.Equiv f'
proof:
:= by
  unfold DGIdempotent.Equiv
  rw [toZero_tmul hA hB, toZero_tmul hA hB, idemEquiv_ringEquiv_iff,
    ← idemEquiv_ringEquiv_iff (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A) (e := e.toZero),
    ← idemEquiv_ringEquiv_iff (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B) (e := f.toZero)]
  have hie := isIdempotentElem_toZero_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A) e
  have hif := isIdempotentElem_toZero_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B) f
  have hse := isSimpleModule_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A) he
  have hsf := isSimpleModule_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B) hf
  exact idemEquiv_tmul_iff hie
    (isIdempotentElem_toZero_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A) e') hif
    (isIdempotentElem_toZero_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B) f') hse
    (isSimpleModule_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A) he') hsf
    (isSimpleModule_ringEquiv (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B) hf')
    (hsA _ hie hse) (hsB _ hif hsf)

name: DG.IsPositive.exists_equiv_tmul
statement:
theorem IsPositive.exists_equiv_tmul (hsA : IsSplitSemisimple k A₀) (hsB : IsSplitSemisimple k B₀)
    {ι κ : Type*} (sA : ι → SimpleIdempotent A)
    (hsA' : ∀ e : SimpleIdempotent A, ∃ i, e.1.Equiv (sA i).1) (sB : κ → SimpleIdempotent B)
    (hsB' : ∀ f : SimpleIdempotent B, ∃ j, f.1.Equiv (sB j).1)
    (g : SimpleIdempotent (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[k] ℬ)) :
    ∃ i j, g.1.Equiv ((sA i).1.tmul (sB j).1)
proof:
:= by
  set ζA := DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k A
  set ζB := DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebraRingEquiv k B
  set Ψ := degreeZeroTensorEquiv (k := k) hA hB
  have := hA.isSemisimple
  have := hB.isSemisimple
  have : IsSemisimpleRing A₀ := ζA.isSemisimpleRing
  have : IsSemisimpleRing B₀ := ζB.isSemisimpleRing
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁', -, hs₁⟩ := exists_list_sum_eq_of_isSemisimpleRing (R := A₀)
    IsIdempotentElem.one
  have hl₁ : ∀ s ∈ l₁, IsIdempotentElem s ∧ IsSimpleModule A₀ (Submodule.span A₀ {s}) :=
    fun s hs => ⟨(hl₁' s hs).1, (hl₁' s hs).2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂', -, hs₂⟩ := exists_list_sum_eq_of_isSemisimpleRing (R := B₀)
    IsIdempotentElem.one
  have hl₂ : ∀ s ∈ l₂, IsIdempotentElem s ∧ IsSimpleModule B₀ (Submodule.span B₀ {s}) :=
    fun s hs => ⟨(hl₂' s hs).1, (hl₂' s hs).2.1⟩
  have hg : IsIdempotentElem (Ψ.symm g.1.toZero) := by
    change Ψ.symm _ * Ψ.symm _ = Ψ.symm _
    rw [← map_mul, g.1.isIdempotentElem_toZero.eq]
  have hsg := (isSimpleModule_span_singleton_ringEquiv_iff Ψ.symm g.1.toZero).mpr g.2
  obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ht, hgst⟩ := exists_idemEquiv_tmul hg hsg
    (fun s hs => ⟨(hl₁ s hs).1, (hl₁ s hs).2, hsA s (hl₁ s hs).1 (hl₁ s hs).2⟩)
    (fun t ht => ⟨(hl₂ t ht).1, (hl₂ t ht).2, hsB t (hl₂ t ht).1 (hl₂ t ht).2⟩) hs₁ hs₂
  have hsi : IsIdempotentElem (ζA.symm s) := by
    change ζA.symm s * ζA.symm s = ζA.symm s
    rw [← map_mul, (hl₁ s hs).1.eq]
  have hti : IsIdempotentElem (ζB.symm t) := by
    change ζB.symm t * ζB.symm t = ζB.symm t
    rw [← map_mul, (hl₂ t ht).1.eq]
  let es : DGIdempotent A := hA.dgIdempotent (ζA.symm s) hsi
  let ft : DGIdempotent B := hB.dgIdempotent (ζB.symm t) hti
  have hes : es.IsSimple := (isSimpleModule_span_singleton_ringEquiv_iff ζA.symm s).mpr (hl₁ s hs).2
  have hft : ft.IsSimple := (isSimpleModule_span_singleton_ringEquiv_iff ζB.symm t).mpr (hl₂ t ht).2
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hsA' ⟨es, hes⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsB' ⟨ft, hft⟩
  have hi' : IdemEquiv A₀ s (ζA (sA i).1.toZero) := by
    change IdemEquiv _ (ζA.symm s) _ at hi
    have := IdemEquiv.map ζA.toRingHom hi
    simpa using this
  have hj' : IdemEquiv B₀ t (ζB (sB j).1.toZero) := by
    change IdemEquiv _ (ζB.symm t) _ at hj
    have := IdemEquiv.map ζB.toRingHom hj
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨i, j, ?_⟩
  unfold DGIdempotent.Equiv
  rw [toZero_tmul hA hB]
  have := IdemEquiv.map Ψ.toRingHom (hgst.trans (hi'.tmul hj'))
  simpa using this

name: DG.IsPositive.leftCorner_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem IsPositive.leftCorner_eq_of_equiv {C : Type u} [Ring C] [DGAddCommGroup C] [DGRing C]
    (hC : IsPositive C) [HasDerivedCategory.{u, u} C] {e f : DGIdempotent C} (h : e.Equiv f) :
    DGRing.K0.leftCorner e = DGRing.K0.leftCorner f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsPositive.mk_cell_zero, ← IsPositive.mk_cell_zero]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (hC.nonempty_cell_iso_of_equiv h 0).some

name: DG.kunnethBasis_apply
statement:
theorem kunnethBasis_apply (p : ι × κ) :
    kunnethBasis hA hB hsA hsB sA hsA₁ hsA₂ sB hsB₁ hsB₂ p =
      DGRing.K0.leftCorner ((sA p.1).1.tmul (sB p.2).1)
proof:
:= by
  let := HasDerivedCategory.small.{u, u} (hA.tensorProduct hB hsA hsB).degreeZeroDGSubring
  exact IsPositive.basis_apply _ _ _ _ p

name: DG.K0KunnethEquivOfBasis_tmul
statement:
theorem K0KunnethEquivOfBasis_tmul (a : ι) (b : κ) :
    K0KunnethEquivOfBasis hA hB hsA hsB sA hsA₁ hsA₂ sB hsB₁ hsB₂
        (DGRing.K0.leftCorner (sA a).1 ⊗ₜ DGRing.K0.leftCorner (sB b).1) =
      DGRing.K0.leftCorner ((sA a).1.tmul (sB b).1)
proof:
:= by
  let := HasDerivedCategory.small.{u, u} hA.degreeZeroDGSubring
  let := HasDerivedCategory.small.{u, u} hB.degreeZeroDGSubring
  rw [← IsPositive.basis_apply hA sA hsA₁ hsA₂ a, ← IsPositive.basis_apply hB sB hsB₁ hsB₂ b,
    ← Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply, K0KunnethEquivOfBasis]
  exact (Module.Basis.equiv_apply (i := (a, b)) _ _ _).trans
    (kunnethBasis_apply hA hB hsA hsB sA hsA₁ hsA₂ sB hsB₁ hsB₂ (a, b))

name: DG.SimpleClass.out_injective
statement: theorem SimpleClass.out_injective (a b : SimpleClass C) (h : a.out.1.Equiv b.out.1) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Quotient.out_eq a, ← Quotient.out_eq b]
  exact Quotient.sound h

name: DG.SimpleClass.equiv_out
statement:
theorem SimpleClass.equiv_out (e : SimpleIdempotent C) :
    e.1.Equiv (SimpleClass.out (Quotient.mk (simpleIdempotentSetoid C) e)).1
proof:
:=
  (Quotient.mk_out (s := simpleIdempotentSetoid C) e).symm

name: DG.IsPositive.K0KunnethEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem IsPositive.K0KunnethEquiv_tmul
    (hsA : IsSplitSemisimple k (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebra k A))
    (hsB : IsSplitSemisimple k (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebra k B))
    (e : SimpleIdempotent A) (f : SimpleIdempotent B) :
    hA.K0KunnethEquiv hB hsA hsB (DGRing.K0.leftCorner e.1 ⊗ₜ DGRing.K0.leftCorner f.1) =
      DGRing.K0.leftCorner (e.1.tmul (k := k) f.1)
proof:
:= by
  have he := SimpleClass.equiv_out e
  have hf := SimpleClass.equiv_out f
  rw [hA.leftCorner_eq_of_equiv he, hB.leftCorner_eq_of_equiv hf, IsPositive.K0KunnethEquiv,
    K0KunnethEquivOfBasis_tmul]
  exact (hA.tensorProduct hB hsA hsB).leftCorner_eq_of_equiv
    ((hA.equiv_tmul_iff hB hsA hsB (SimpleClass.out _).2 e.2 (SimpleClass.out _).2 f.2).mpr
      ⟨he.symm, hf.symm⟩)

name: DG.ExtendScalars.ract_tmul
statement:
theorem ract_tmul (k : DegreeZeroRing K) (b : B) (x : DegreeZeroRing K) (m : X) :
    ract K X k b (x ⊗ₜ m) = (x * k) ⊗ₜ (op b • m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.addHom_ext
statement:
theorem addHom_ext {f g : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X →+ DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X}
    (h : ∀ x m, f (x ⊗ₜ m) = g (x ⊗ₜ m)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun z => by
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul x m => exact h x m
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.ractAdd_tmul
statement:
theorem ractAdd_tmul (k : DegreeZeroRing K) (b : B) :
    ractAdd K X (k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = ract K X k b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.ractAdd_mul
statement:
theorem ractAdd_mul (y y' : ExtendScalars K B) :
    ractAdd K X (y' * y) = ractAdd K X y * ractAdd K X y'
proof:
:= by
  induction y using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => simp
  | add y z hy hz => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz, map_add, add_mul]
  | @tmul i j k hk b hb =>
    induction y' using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
    | zero => simp
    | add y z hy hz => rw [add_mul, map_add, hy, hz, map_add, mul_add]
    | @tmul i' j' k' hk' b' hb' =>
      by_cases hi : i = 0
      · subst hi
        rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒦 ℬ (j := j') (i' := 0) k' hb' hk b, mul_zero,
          koszulSign_zero, one_smul, ractAdd_tmul, ractAdd_tmul, ractAdd_tmul]
        refine addHom_ext fun x m => ?_
        change ract K X (k' * k) (b' * b) (x ⊗ₜ m) = ract K X k b (ract K X k' b' (x ⊗ₜ m))
        rw [ract_tmul, ract_tmul, ract_tmul, op_mul, mul_smul, mul_assoc]
      · rw [DegreeZeroRing.eq_zero_of_mem_grading K hi hk, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul,
          mul_zero, map_zero, zero_mul]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.op_smul_def
statement:
theorem op_smul_def (y : ExtendScalars K B) (z : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) :
    op y • z = ractAdd K X y z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.op_tmul_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem op_tmul_smul_tmul (k : DegreeZeroRing K) (b : B) (x : DegreeZeroRing K) (m : X) :
    op (k ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : ExtendScalars K B) • (x ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) =
      (x * k) ⊗ₜ (op b • m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.ract_mem
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i₁ = 0
  · subst hi
    refine map_mem_grading_of_tmul (ract K X k b) (0 + j₁) (fun {i j x m} hx hm => ?_) hz
    rw [ract_tmul]
    have h := tmul_mem_grading (mul_mem_grading hx hk) (op_smul_mem_grading hb hm)
    convert h using 2
    ring
  · rw [DegreeZeroRing.eq_zero_of_mem_grading K hi hk]
    have : ract K X 0 b = 0 := addHom_ext fun x m => by
      change (x * 0) ⊗ₜ (op b • m) = (0 : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X)
      rw [mul_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.ExtendScalars.gradeInvolution_degreeZero
statement:
theorem gradeInvolution_degreeZero (x : DegreeZeroRing K) :
    gradeInvolution (DegreeZeroRing K) x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradeInvolution_of_mem (DegreeZeroRing.mem_grading_zero K x), koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.d_ract
statement:
theorem d_ract (k : DegreeZeroRing K) (b : B) (z : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) :
    d (ract K X k b z) =
      ract K X k b (d z) + ract K X k (d b) (gradeInvolution _ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add z z' hz hz' =>
    rw [map_add, d_add, hz, hz', d_add, map_add, map_add, map_add]
    abel
  | @tmul i' j' x m =>
    rw [ract_tmul, d_tmul_of_mem (DegreeZeroRing.mem_grading_zero K _),
      DegreeZeroRing.d_eq_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, zero_add, koszulSign_zero, one_smul,
      d_op_smul m.2, d_tmul_of_mem (DegreeZeroRing.mem_grading_zero K _),
      DegreeZeroRing.d_eq_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, zero_add, koszulSign_zero, one_smul,
      gradeInvolution_tmul, gradeInvolution_degreeZero, gradeInvolution_of_mem m.2, ract_tmul,
      ract_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_comm]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.op_add_smul
statement:
theorem op_add_smul (y y' : ExtendScalars K B) (z : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) :
    op (y + y') • z = op y • z + op y' • z
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.op_zero_smul
statement: theorem op_zero_smul (z : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) : op (0 : ExtendScalars K B) • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, map_zero]; rfl

name: DG.ExtendScalars.op_smul_add
statement:
theorem op_smul_add (y : ExtendScalars K B) (z z' : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) :
    op y • (z + z') = op y • z + op y • z'
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, op_smul_def, op_smul_def, map_add]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.op_smul_zero
statement: theorem op_smul_zero (y : ExtendScalars K B) : op y • (0 : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, map_zero]

name: DG.ExtendScalars.smul_comm_tmul
statement:
theorem smul_comm_tmul [SMulCommClass A Bᵐᵒᵖ X] (s : ExtendScalars K A) (y : ExtendScalars K B)
    (z : DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) : s • (op y • z) = op y • (s • z)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => rw [ExternalTensor.zero_smul', ExternalTensor.zero_smul', op_smul_zero]
  | add s s' hs hs' =>
    rw [ExternalTensor.add_smul', ExternalTensor.add_smul', hs, hs', op_smul_add]
  | @tmul i j k₁ hk₁ a ha =>
    induction y using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
    | zero => rw [op_zero_smul, op_zero_smul, ExternalTensor.smul_zero']
    | add y y' hy hy' =>
      rw [op_add_smul, op_add_smul, ExternalTensor.smul_add', hy, hy']
    | @tmul i' j' k hk b hb =>
      induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul x m =>
        rw [op_tmul_smul_tmul, tmul_smul_tmul, tmul_smul_tmul, op_tmul_smul_tmul, mul_assoc,
          smul_comm a (op b) m]
      | add z z' hz hz' =>
        rw [op_smul_add, ExternalTensor.smul_add', hz, hz', ExternalTensor.smul_add', op_smul_add]

name: DG.mem_degreeZeroSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_degreeZeroSubring {a : A} : a ∈ degreeZeroSubring A ↔ a ∈ grading (M := A) 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mem_truncGESubgroup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_truncGESubgroup_iff {n : ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ truncGESubgroup M n ↔ ∀ i < n, decompose (grading (M := M)) m i = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mem_truncGESubgroup_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_truncGESubgroup_of_mem {n i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) (hi : n ≤ i) :
    m ∈ truncGESubgroup M n
proof:
:= fun j hj =>
  Subtype.ext (decompose_of_mem_ne _ hm (by omega))

name: DG.eq_zero_or_le_of_mem_truncGESubgroup
statement:
theorem eq_zero_or_le_of_mem_truncGESubgroup {n i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i)
    (hm' : m ∈ truncGESubgroup M n) : m = 0 ∨ n ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge i n with hi | hi
  · left
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val (hm' i hi)
    rwa [decompose_of_mem_same _ hm, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at h
  · exact Or.inr hi

name: DG.truncGESubgroup_anti
statement: theorem truncGESubgroup_anti : Antitone (truncGESubgroup M)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hnn' _ hm i hi => hm i (lt_of_lt_of_le hi hnn')

name: DG.isHomogeneous_truncGESubgroup
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_truncGESubgroup (n : ℤ) :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (grading (M := M)) (truncGESubgroup M n)
proof:
:= by
  intro j m hm
  rcases lt_or_ge j n with hj | hj
  · rw [hm j hj, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  · exact mem_truncGESubgroup_of_mem (decompose (grading (M := M)) m j).2 hj

name: DG.d_mem_truncGESubgroup_add_one
statement:
theorem d_mem_truncGESubgroup_add_one {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ truncGESubgroup M n) :
    d m ∈ truncGESubgroup M (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := decompose_d m (i - 1)
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  rw [h, hm (i - 1) (by omega), ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, d_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: DG.d_mem_truncGESubgroup
statement:
theorem d_mem_truncGESubgroup {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ truncGESubgroup M n) :
    d m ∈ truncGESubgroup M n
proof:
:=
  truncGESubgroup_anti (by omega : n ≤ n + 1) (d_mem_truncGESubgroup_add_one hm)

name: DG.mem_truncGESubgroup_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem mem_truncGESubgroup_of_nonpos (hM : ∀ i < 0, grading (M := M) i = ⊥) {n : ℤ}
    (hn : n ≤ 0) (m : M) : m ∈ truncGESubgroup M n
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have h : ∀ x ∈ grading (M := M) i, x = 0 := fun x hx => by
    rwa [hM i (by omega), AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hx
  exact Subtype.ext (h _ (decompose (grading (M := M)) m i).2)

name: DG.smul_mem_truncGESubgroup
statement:
theorem smul_mem_truncGESubgroup {m n : ℤ} {a : A} {x : M} (ha : a ∈ truncGESubgroup A m)
    (hx : x ∈ truncGESubgroup M n) : a • x ∈ truncGESubgroup M (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_truncGESubgroup m)
    (P := fun a => a • x ∈ truncGESubgroup M (m + n)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · simp only [zero_smul, zero_mem]
  · intro i a hai ham
    refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_truncGESubgroup n)
      (P := fun x => a • x ∈ truncGESubgroup M (m + n)) ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · simp only [smul_zero, zero_mem]
    · intro j x hxj hxn
      rcases eq_zero_or_le_of_mem_truncGESubgroup hai ham with rfl | hi
      · rw [zero_smul]
        exact zero_mem _
      rcases eq_zero_or_le_of_mem_truncGESubgroup hxj hxn with rfl | hj
      · rw [smul_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
      exact mem_truncGESubgroup_of_mem (smul_mem_grading hai hxj) (by omega)
    · intro x x' hx hx'
      simp only [smul_add]
      exact add_mem hx hx'
  · intro a a' ha ha'
    simp only [add_smul]
    exact add_mem ha ha'

name: DG.mul_mem_truncGESubgroup
statement:
theorem mul_mem_truncGESubgroup {m n : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ truncGESubgroup A m)
    (hb : b ∈ truncGESubgroup A n) : a * b ∈ truncGESubgroup A (m + n)
proof:
:=
  smul_mem_truncGESubgroup (M := A) ha hb

name: DG.mem_truncGE
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_truncGE {n : ℤ} {a : A} : a ∈ truncGE hA n ↔ a ∈ truncGESubgroup A n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mem_truncGE_iff
statement:
theorem mem_truncGE_iff {n : ℤ} {a : A} :
    a ∈ truncGE hA n ↔ ∀ i < n, decompose (grading (M := A)) a i = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mem_truncGE_of_nonpos
statement: theorem mem_truncGE_of_nonpos {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≤ 0) (a : A) : a ∈ truncGE hA n
proof:
:=
  mem_truncGESubgroup_of_nonpos hA hn a

name: DG.truncGE_anti
statement: theorem truncGE_anti : Antitone (truncGE hA)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hnn' _ ha => truncGESubgroup_anti hnn' ha

name: DG.coe_decompose_mul_zero
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_mul_zero (hA : ∀ i < 0, grading (M := A) i = ⊥) (a b : A) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) (a * b) 0 : A) =
      decompose (grading (M := A)) a 0 * decompose (grading (M := A)) b 0
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : ∀ {i : ℤ} {x : A}, i < 0 → x ∈ grading i → x = 0 := fun hi hx => by
    rwa [hA _ hi, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hx
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
    simp only [add_mul, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, ha, ha']
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i i
    induction b using induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add b b' hb hb' =>
      simp only [mul_add, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hb, hb']
    | h_homogeneous b =>
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := b
      rename_i j
      rcases lt_or_ge i 0 with hi | hi
      · simp [hneg hi ha]
      rcases lt_or_ge j 0 with hj | hj
      · simp [hneg hj hb]
      by_cases h : i + j = 0
      · obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
        obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
        have hab : a * b ∈ grading (M := A) 0 := by simpa using mul_mem_grading ha hb
        rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ ha, decompose_of_mem_same _ hb,
          decompose_of_mem_same _ hab]
      · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ (mul_mem_grading ha hb) h]
        rcases (show i ≠ 0 ∨ j ≠ 0 by omega) with h' | h'
        · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ ha h', zero_mul]
        · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hb h', mul_zero]

name: DG.IsPositive.degreeZero
statement:
theorem degreeZero (R : Type*) [Ring R] [IsSemisimpleRing R] :
    letI
proof:
:= DGAddCommGroup.degreeZero R
    haveI := DGRing.degreeZero R
    IsPositive R := by
  let := DGAddCommGroup.degreeZero R
  have := DGRing.degreeZero R
  have htop : degreeZeroSubring R = ⊤ :=
    eq_top_iff.mpr fun r _ => mem_degreeZeroGrading_zero R r
  exact
    { grading_eq_bot := fun n hn => degreeZeroGrading_of_ne R (by omega)
      isSemisimple :=
        (Subring.topEquiv.symm.trans (RingEquiv.subringCongr htop.symm)).isSemisimpleRing
      d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero := fun _ _ => rfl }

name: DG.IsPositive.eq_zero_of_mem_grading
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rwa [hA.grading_eq_bot n hn, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at ha

name: DG.IsPositive.d_eq_zero
statement: theorem d_eq_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) : d a = 0
proof:
:=
  hA.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero a ha

name: DG.IsPositive.decompose_d_zero
statement: theorem decompose_d_zero (a : A) : decompose (grading (M := A)) (d a) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := decompose_d a (-1)
  rw [neg_add_cancel] at h
  rw [h, hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading (by omega) (decompose (grading (M := A)) a (-1)).2, d_zero,
    ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: DG.IsPositive.dgIdempotent_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgIdempotent_val (e : degreeZeroSubring A) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    (hA.dgIdempotent e he).val = e
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.IsPositive.mem_degreeZeroDGSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_degreeZeroDGSubring {a : A} : a ∈ hA.degreeZeroDGSubring ↔ a ∈ grading (M := A) 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.IsPositive.d_degreeZeroDGSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_degreeZeroDGSubring (x : hA.degreeZeroDGSubring) : d x = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [DGSubring.coe_d, hA.d_eq_zero x.2, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero])

name: DG.IsPositive.mem_grading_degreeZeroDGSubring_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_degreeZeroDGSubring_iff {n : ℤ} {x : hA.degreeZeroDGSubring} :
    x ∈ grading n ↔ n = 0 ∨ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGSubring.mem_grading_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · exact Or.inl hn
    · refine Or.inr (Subtype.ext ?_)
      have h := decompose_of_mem_same (grading (M := A)) hx
      rwa [decompose_of_mem_ne _ x.2 (Ne.symm hn), eq_comm] at h
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact x.2
    · exact zero_mem _

name: DG.IsPositive.coe_projZero_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_projZero_apply (a : A) :
    (hA.projZero a : A) = decompose (grading (M := A)) a 0
proof:
:=

name: DG.IsPositive.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem projZero_apply_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) :
    (hA.projZero a : A) = a
proof:

name: DG.IsPositive.projZero_comp_subtype
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projZero_comp_subtype :
    hA.projZero.comp (DGSubring.subtype hA.degreeZeroDGSubring) = DGRingHom.id
proof:
:=
  DGRingHom.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero x.2)

name: DG.IsPositive.projZero_surjective
statement: theorem projZero_surjective : Function.Surjective hA.projZero
proof:
:= fun x =>
  ⟨x, Subtype.ext (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero x.2)⟩

name: DG.IsPositive.ker_projZero
statement: theorem ker_projZero : hA.projZero.ker = truncGE hA.grading_eq_bot 1
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [DGRingHom.mem_ker, mem_truncGE_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (show i ≤ 0 by omega) with hi | rfl
    · exact Subtype.ext (hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading hi (decompose (grading (M := A)) a i).2)
    · exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  · intro h
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val (h 0 zero_lt_one))

name: DG.IsPositive.quotientTruncGEOneHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientTruncGEOneHom_mk (a : A) :
    hA.quotientTruncGEOneHom (DGIdeal.Quotient.mk _ a) = hA.projZero a
proof:
:=
  DGIdeal.Quotient.lift_mk _ _ a

name: DG.IsPositive.quotientTruncGEOneHom_bijective
statement: theorem quotientTruncGEOneHom_bijective : Function.Bijective hA.quotientTruncGEOneHom
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun x hx => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := DGIdeal.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
    rw [quotientTruncGEOneHom_mk, ← DGRingHom.mem_ker, hA.ker_projZero] at hx
    exact (DGIdeal.Quotient.mk_eq_zero_iff_mem _).mpr hx
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hA.projZero_surjective y
    exact ⟨DGIdeal.Quotient.mk _ a, hA.quotientTruncGEOneHom_mk a⟩

name: DG.IsPositive.coe_quotientTruncGEOneEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_quotientTruncGEOneEquiv :
    ⇑hA.quotientTruncGEOneEquiv = hA.quotientTruncGEOneHom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.IsPositive.subsingleton_cohomology_of_neg
statement: theorem subsingleton_cohomology_of_neg {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) : Subsingleton (cohomology A n)
proof:
:= by
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
  induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h z =>
    have hz : z = 0 := Subtype.ext (hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading hn z.2.1)
    rw [hz, map_zero]

name: DG.IsPositive.eq_zero_of_mem_coboundaries_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_mem_coboundaries_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ coboundaries A 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := ha
  rw [hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading (by omega) hm, d_zero]

name: DG.IsPositive.coe_cohomologyZeroEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_cohomologyZeroEquiv_mk (z : cocycles A 0) :
    (hA.cohomologyZeroEquiv (cohomology.mk A 0 z) : A) = z
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (cohomology.lift_mk (AddSubgroup.inclusion (cocycles_le_grading 0))
    (fun _ hz => Subtype.ext (hA.eq_zero_of_mem_coboundaries_zero hz)) z)

name: DG.IsPositive.cohomologyZeroEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyZeroEquiv_symm_apply (a : grading (M := A) 0) :
    hA.cohomologyZeroEquiv.symm a = cohomology.mkOf a.2 (hA.d_eq_zero a.2)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.smul_mem_truncGESubgroup_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem smul_mem_truncGESubgroup_of_nonneg (hA : ∀ i < 0, grading (M := A) i = ⊥) {n : ℤ}
    (a : A) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ truncGESubgroup M n) : a • x ∈ truncGESubgroup M n
proof:
:= by
  have h := smul_mem_truncGESubgroup (mem_truncGESubgroup_of_nonpos hA le_rfl a) hx
  rwa [zero_add] at h

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isIdempotentElem_toZero
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem_toZero (e : DGIdempotent A) : IsIdempotentElem e.toZero
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext e.mul_self

name: DG.DGIdempotent.IsSimple.val_ne_zero
statement: theorem IsSimple.val_ne_zero {e : DGIdempotent A} (he : e.IsSimple) : e.val ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h =>
  ne_zero_of_isSimpleModule he (Subtype.ext h)

name: DG.DGIdempotent.coe_rightMul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_rightMul_apply (e f : DGIdempotent A) (b : A) (hb : b ∈ grading 0) (hdb : d b = 0)
    (hbf : b * f.val = b) (x : e.LeftCorner) :
    (rightMul e f b hb hdb hbf x : A) = x * b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.shift_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [← e.twist_unmk_smul_mk_idem n y, map_smul, map_smul, h]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.mk_idem_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mk_idem_mem_grading (e : DGIdempotent A) (n : ℤ) :
    Shift.mk n (LeftCorner.idem e) ∈ grading (-n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Shift.mk_mem_grading (n := n) (LeftCorner.idem_mem_grading e)

name: DG.DGIdempotent.smul_mk_idem
statement:
theorem smul_mk_idem (e : DGIdempotent A) (n : ℤ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) :
    a • Shift.mk n (LeftCorner.idem e) =
      Shift.mk n (⟨a * e.val, e.mul_val_mem_leftIdeal a⟩ : e.LeftCorner)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Shift.smul_mk ha, mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_cell
statement:
theorem DerivedCategory.isCompact_cell (e : DGIdempotent A) (n : ℤ) :
    IsCompact.{u} (cell A e n)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : IsCompact.{u} (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A e.LeftCorner)) :=
    IsCompact.of_retract
      ⟨Q.map (DGModuleCat.ofHom e.leftCornerInclusion),
        Q.map (DGModuleCat.ofHom e.leftCornerProjection), by
        rw [← Q.map_comp, ← Q.map_id]
        congr 1
        exact DGModuleCat.hom_ext e.leftCornerProjection_comp_inclusion⟩
      isCompact_Q_self
  exact (h0.shift n).of_iso ((Q.commShiftIso n).app (DGModuleCat.of A e.LeftCorner))

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.isCompact_Q_obj
statement:
theorem FiniteCellFiltration.isCompact_Q_obj {P : Type u} [AddCommGroup P] [DGAddCommGroup P]
    [Module A P] [DGModule A P] (C : FiniteCellFiltration A P) :
    IsCompact.{u} (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A P))
proof:
:=
  C.Q_obj_mem_of_isThick (isThick_isCompact _) fun _ => isCompact_cell _ _

name: DG.IsPositive.cell_hom_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem cell_hom_eq_zero_of_lt {e f : DGIdempotent A} {n m : ℤ} (h : m < n)
    (φ : cell A e n ⟶ cell A f m) : φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq (e.isKProjective_leftCorner.shift n) φ
  suffices hg : g = 0 by rw [hg, Functor.map_zero]
  refine DGModuleCat.hom_ext (e.shift_hom_ext n ?_)
  rw [DGModuleCat.hom_zero, DGModuleHom.zero_apply]
  have hmem := g.hom.map_mem (e.mk_idem_mem_grading n)
  rw [Shift.mem_grading_iff', DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.mem_grading_iff] at hmem
  exact Shift.unmk_inj.mp (Subtype.ext (hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading (by omega) hmem))

name: DG.IsPositive.isIso_cell_hom
statement:
theorem isIso_cell_hom {e f : DGIdempotent A} (he : e.IsSimple) (hf : f.IsSimple) {n : ℤ}
    (φ : cell A e n ⟶ cell A f n) (hφ : φ ≠ 0) : IsIso φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq (e.isKProjective_leftCorner.shift n) φ
  set x := Shift.mk n (DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.idem e)
  set y : f.LeftCorner := Shift.unmk n (g.hom x) with hydef
  have hy0 : (y : A) ∈ grading 0 := by
    have hmem := g.hom.map_mem (e.mk_idem_mem_grading n)
    rw [Shift.mem_grading_iff', DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.mem_grading_iff, neg_add_cancel] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hyf : (y : A) * f.val = y := y.2
  have hsm : e.val • x = x := by
    rw [e.smul_mk_idem n e.mem_zero]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext e.mul_self
  have hey : e.val * (y : A) = y := by
    have h1 : g.hom x = e.val • g.hom x := by rw [← map_smul, hsm]
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z => ((Shift.unmk n z : f.LeftCorner) : A)) h1
    simp only [Shift.unmk_smul_eq, Shift.twist_of_mem e.mem_zero, mul_zero, koszulSign_zero,
      one_smul, Submodule.coe_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  have hyne : (y : A) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hφ
    have : g = 0 := DGModuleCat.hom_ext (e.shift_hom_ext n (by
      rw [DGModuleCat.hom_zero, DGModuleHom.zero_apply]
      exact Shift.unmk_inj.mp (Subtype.ext h)))
    rw [this, Functor.map_zero]
  obtain ⟨c, hfc, hce, hyc, hcy⟩ := exists_mul_eq_of_isSimpleModule
    e.isIdempotentElem_toZero f.isIdempotentElem_toZero he hf (b := ⟨y, hy0⟩)
    (show e.toZero * ⟨y, hy0⟩ = ⟨y, hy0⟩ from Subtype.ext hey)
    (show ⟨y, hy0⟩ * f.toZero = ⟨y, hy0⟩ from Subtype.ext hyf)
    (fun h => hyne (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have hce' : (c : A) * e.val = c := congrArg Subtype.val hce
  have hfc' : f.val * (c : A) = c := congrArg Subtype.val hfc
  have hyc' : (y : A) * c = e.val := congrArg Subtype.val hyc
  have hcy' : (c : A) * y = f.val := congrArg Subtype.val hcy
  let h : DGModuleCat.of A (Shift n f.LeftCorner) ⟶ DGModuleCat.of A (Shift n e.LeftCorner) :=
    DGModuleCat.ofHom ((f.rightMul e c c.2 (hA.d_eq_zero c.2) hce').shift n)
  have hgx : g.hom x = Shift.mk n y := rfl
  refine ⟨⟨Q.map h, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [← Q.map_comp, ← Q.map_id]
    congr 1
    refine DGModuleCat.hom_ext (e.shift_hom_ext n ?_)
    change h.hom (g.hom x) = x
    rw [hgx]
    change Shift.mk n (f.rightMul e c c.2 (hA.d_eq_zero c.2) hce' y) = x
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (show (y : A) * c = e.val from hyc')
  · rw [← Q.map_comp, ← Q.map_id]
    congr 1
    refine DGModuleCat.hom_ext (f.shift_hom_ext n ?_)
    change g.hom (h.hom (Shift.mk n (DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.idem f))) = _
    have hx : h.hom (Shift.mk n (DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.idem f)) = (c : A) • x := by
      change Shift.mk n (f.rightMul e c c.2 (hA.d_eq_zero c.2) hce' _) = _
      rw [e.smul_mk_idem n c.2]
      congr 1
      exact Subtype.ext (show f.val * (c : A) = (c : A) * e.val by rw [hfc', hce'])
    rw [hx, map_smul, hgx, Shift.smul_mk c.2, mul_zero,
      koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    change _ = Shift.mk n (DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.idem f)
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext hcy'

name: DG.IsPositive.not_isZero_cell
statement:
theorem not_isZero_cell {e : DGIdempotent A} (he : e.IsSimple) (n : ℤ) :
    ¬ IsZero (cell A e n)
proof:
:= by
  intro hZ
  rw [isZero_Q_obj_iff] at hZ
  have hd : d (Shift.mk n (DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.idem e)) = 0 := by
    rw [Shift.d_mk]
    have : d (DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.idem e) = 0 := Subtype.ext e.d_eq_zero
    rw [this, smul_zero]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hZ.exists_d_eq (e.mk_idem_mem_grading n) hd
  rw [Shift.mem_grading_iff', DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.mem_grading_iff] at hz
  have hz0 : z = 0 :=
    Shift.unmk_inj.mp (Subtype.ext (hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading (by omega) hz))
  rw [hz0, d_zero] at hdz
  apply he.val_ne_zero
  have := congrArg (fun x => ((Shift.unmk n x : e.LeftCorner) : A)) hdz
  exact this.symm

name: DG.IsPositive.isOrderedCellFamily
statement:
theorem isOrderedCellFamily :
    IsOrderedCellFamily (fun (i : SimpleIdempotent A) (n : ℤ) => cell A i.1 n) where
  nonempty_shiftIso i n k
proof:
:= nonempty_cellShiftIso i.1 n k
  eq_zero_of_lt h f := hA.cell_hom_eq_zero_of_lt h f
  isIso_of_ne_zero {i j} _ f hf := hA.isIso_cell_hom i.2 j.2 f hf
  not_isZero i n := hA.not_isZero_cell i.2 n

name: DG.IsPositive.isZero_Q_leftCorner
statement:
theorem isZero_Q_leftCorner {g : DGIdempotent A} (hg : g.val = 0) :
    IsZero (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A g.LeftCorner))
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton g.LeftCorner := ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (by
    have hx : (x : A) * g.val = x := x.2
    have hy : (y : A) * g.val = y := y.2
    rw [← hx, ← hy, hg, mul_zero, mul_zero])⟩
  exact Functor.map_isZero _ (DGModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)

name: DG.IsPositive.exists_distinguished_of_add
statement:
theorem exists_distinguished_of_add (s t g : DGIdempotent A) (hst : s.val * t.val = 0)
    (hts : t.val * s.val = 0) (hsum : s.val + t.val = g.val) :
    ∃ (u : Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A t.LeftCorner) ⟶ Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A g.LeftCorner))
      (v : Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A g.LeftCorner) ⟶ cell A s 0)
      (δ : cell A s 0 ⟶ (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A t.LeftCorner))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk u v δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A)
proof:
:= by
  have hsg : s.val * g.val = s.val := by rw [← hsum, mul_add, s.mul_self, hst, add_zero]
  have htg : t.val * g.val = t.val := by rw [← hsum, mul_add, t.mul_self, hts, zero_add]
  let i := t.rightMul g g.val g.mem_zero g.d_eq_zero g.mul_self
  let p := (Shift.zeroEquiv (A := A) (M := s.LeftCorner)).symm.toDGModuleHom.comp
    (g.rightMul s s.val s.mem_zero s.d_eq_zero s.mul_self)
  let σ : GradedSplitting i p :=
    { r := Cochain.ofHom (g.rightMul t t.val t.mem_zero t.d_eq_zero t.mul_self)
      s := Cochain.ofHom ((s.rightMul g s.val s.mem_zero s.d_eq_zero hsg).comp
        (Shift.zeroEquiv (A := A) (M := s.LeftCorner)).toDGModuleHom)
      r_i := fun x => Subtype.ext (by
        have hx : (x : A) * t.val = x := x.2
        change (x : A) * g.val * t.val = x
        rw [mul_assoc, ← hsum, add_mul, hst, t.mul_self, zero_add, hx])
      p_s := fun y => by
        apply Shift.unmk_inj.mp
        apply Subtype.ext
        have hy : ((Shift.unmk 0 y : s.LeftCorner) : A) * s.val = Shift.unmk 0 y :=
          (Shift.unmk 0 y).2
        change ((Shift.unmk 0 y : s.LeftCorner) : A) * s.val * s.val = _
        rw [hy, hy]
      i_r_add_s_p := fun x => Subtype.ext (by
        have hx : (x : A) * g.val = x := x.2
        change (x : A) * t.val * g.val + (x : A) * s.val * s.val = x
        rw [mul_assoc, htg, mul_assoc, s.mul_self, add_comm, ← mul_add, hsum, hx]) }
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := σ.exists_distinguished
  exact ⟨_, _, δ, hδ⟩

name: DG.IsPositive.cellsOrdered_of_forall_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cellsOrdered_of_forall_eq_zero {l : List (SimpleIdempotent A × ℤ)}
    (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, c.2 = 0) : CellsOrdered l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact cellsOrdered_nil
  | cons a l ih =>
    refine List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨fun b hb => ?_, ih fun c hc => hl c (by simp [hc])⟩
    rw [hl a (by simp), hl b (by simp [hb])]

name: DG.IsPositive.exists_cellTower_leftCorner
statement:
theorem exists_cellTower_leftCorner (g : DGIdempotent A) :
    ∃ l : List (SimpleIdempotent A × ℤ), (∀ c ∈ l, c.2 = 0) ∧
      CellTower (fun (i : SimpleIdempotent A) n => cell A i.1 n) l
        (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A g.LeftCorner))
proof:
:= by
  have := hA.isSemisimple
  have : IsArtinianRing (degreeZeroSubring A) := inferInstance
  suffices H : ∀ N : Submodule (degreeZeroSubring A) (degreeZeroSubring A),
      ∀ g : DGIdempotent A, Submodule.span _ {g.toZero} = N →
      ∃ l : List (SimpleIdempotent A × ℤ), (∀ c ∈ l, c.2 = 0) ∧
        CellTower (fun (i : SimpleIdempotent A) n => cell A i.1 n) l
          (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A g.LeftCorner)) from H _ g rfl
  intro N
  induction N using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | _ N ih =>
  intro g hN
  by_cases h0 : Submodule.span (degreeZeroSubring A) {g.toZero} = ⊥
  · have hg : g.val = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val (Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp h0)
    exact ⟨[], by simp, .zero (isZero_Q_leftCorner hg)⟩
  obtain ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, hts, hsum, hsimple, hlt⟩ :=
    exists_isSimpleModule_add_of_isSemisimpleRing g.isIdempotentElem_toZero h0
  let S := hA.dgIdempotent s hs
  let T := hA.dgIdempotent t ht
  obtain ⟨l, hl0, hl⟩ := ih _ (hN ▸ hlt) T rfl
  obtain ⟨u, v, δ, hT⟩ := exists_distinguished_of_add S T g (congrArg Subtype.val hst)
    (congrArg Subtype.val hts) (congrArg Subtype.val hsum)
  refine ⟨l ++ [(⟨S, hsimple⟩, 0)], fun c hc => ?_, .ext _ hT hl ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hc with hc | hc
  · exact hl0 c hc
  · simp at hc
    rw [hc]

name: DG.IsPositive.hasOrderedCellTower_Q_self
statement:
theorem hasOrderedCellTower_Q_self :
    HasOrderedCellTower (fun (i : SimpleIdempotent A) n => cell A i.1 n)
      (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A A))
proof:
:= by
  let one := hA.dgIdempotent 1 IsIdempotentElem.one
  obtain ⟨l, hl0, hl⟩ := hA.exists_cellTower_leftCorner one
  let e : DGModuleCat.of A one.LeftCorner ≅ DGModuleCat.of A A :=
    { hom := DGModuleCat.ofHom one.leftCornerInclusion
      inv := DGModuleCat.ofHom one.leftCornerProjection
      hom_inv_id := DGModuleCat.hom_ext one.leftCornerProjection_comp_inclusion
      inv_hom_id := DGModuleCat.hom_ext_apply fun a => mul_one (a : A) }
  exact ⟨l, cellsOrdered_of_forall_eq_zero hl0, hl.of_iso (Q.mapIso e)⟩

name: DG.IsPositive.hasOrderedCellTower_of_isCompact
proof:
:= by
  rw [← thickClosure_self_eq_isCompact] at hX
  exact hA.isOrderedCellFamily.thickClosure_le
    (by rintro _ ⟨-, rfl⟩; exact hA.hasOrderedCellTower_Q_self) X hX

name: DG.IsPositive.exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_isCompact {X : DerivedCategory.{u, u} A}
    (hX : IsCompact.{u} X) :
    ∃ (P : DGModuleCat.{u} A) (C : FiniteCellFiltration A P),
      C.IsOrdered ∧ (∀ i, (C.e i).IsSimple) ∧ Nonempty (X ≅ Q.obj P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hlo, hl⟩ := hA.hasOrderedCellTower_of_isCompact hX
  obtain ⟨P, C, hC, he⟩ := exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_cellTower Subtype.val hl
  refine ⟨P, C, ?_, fun i => ?_, he⟩
  · rw [C.isOrdered_iff_cellsOrdered, hC]
    unfold CellsOrdered at hlo ⊢
    rw [List.pairwise_map]
    exact hlo
  · have hi : (C.e i, C.shift i) ∈ C.cells := List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [hC, List.mem_map] at hi
    obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := hi
    have : (c.1 : DGIdempotent A) = C.e i := congrArg Prod.fst hc
    exact this ▸ c.1.2

name: DG.IsPositive.isCompact_iff
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff {X : DerivedCategory.{u, u} A} :
    IsCompact.{u} X ↔ ∃ (P : DGModuleCat.{u} A) (C : FiniteCellFiltration A P),
      C.IsOrdered ∧ Nonempty (X ≅ Q.obj P)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hX
    obtain ⟨P, C, hC, -, he⟩ := hA.exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_isCompact hX
    exact ⟨P, C, hC, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨P, C, -, ⟨e⟩⟩
    exact C.isCompact_Q_obj.of_iso e

name: DG.IsPositive.isCompact_Q_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isCompact_Q_obj_iff (M : DGModuleCat.{u} A) :
    IsCompact.{u} (Q.obj M : DerivedCategory.{u, u} A) ↔
      ∃ (P : DGModuleCat.{u} A) (C : FiniteCellFiltration A P),
        C.IsOrdered ∧ Nonempty ((Q.obj M : DerivedCategory.{u, u} A) ≅ Q.obj P)
proof:
:=
  hA.isCompact_iff

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.units_smul_mem_decomposables
statement:
private theorem units_smul_mem_decomposables (u : ℤˣ) {y : P} (hy : y ∈ decomposables A P) :
    u • y ∈ decomposables A P
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def]
  exact zsmul_mem hy _

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.π_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem π_eq_zero_of_lt {i : Fin C.length} {m : ℤ} {x : C.F (i.1 + 1)}
    (hx : (x : P) ∈ grading m) (hm : m + C.shift i < 0) : C.π i x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Shift.unmk (C.shift i) (C.π i x) ∈ grading (m + C.shift i) :=
    Shift.unmk_mem_grading ((C.π i).map_mem ((DGSubmodule.mem_grading _).mpr hx))
  have h2 : ((Shift.unmk (C.shift i) (C.π i x) : (C.e i).LeftCorner) : A) = 0 :=
    hA _ hm _ ((DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.mem_grading_iff _).mp h1)
  exact (Shift.unmk (C.shift i)).injective (Subtype.ext h2)

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_lt : ∀ k ≤ C.length, ∀ {m : ℤ} {x : P}, x ∈ C.F k → x ∈ grading m →
    (∀ i : Fin C.length, i.1 < k → m < -C.shift i) → x = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro _ m x hx _ _; exact C.eq_zero_of_mem_zero x hx
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk m x hx hxm h
    let i : Fin C.length := ⟨k, by omega⟩
    have hπ : C.π i ⟨x, hx⟩ = 0 :=
      C.π_eq_zero_of_lt hA (x := ⟨x, hx⟩) hxm (by have := h i (by simp [i]); omega)
    exact ih (by omega) ((C.π_eq_zero_iff i ⟨x, hx⟩).mp hπ) hxm fun j hj => h j (by omega)

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.isBoundedBelow
statement: theorem isBoundedBelow : IsBoundedBelow P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨-∑ i, |C.shift i|, fun m hm x hx => C.eq_zero_of_lt hA _ le_rfl (C.mem_length x) hx
    fun i _ => ?_⟩
  have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |C.shift j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h2 := le_abs_self (C.shift i)
  omega

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.isMinimal_aux
statement:
theorem isMinimal_aux (hC : C.IsOrdered) : ∀ k ≤ C.length, ∀ {m : ℤ} {x : P}, x ∈ C.F k →
    x ∈ grading m → d x ∈ decomposables A P ∧
      ((∀ i : Fin C.length, i.1 < k → -C.shift i < m) → x ∈ decomposables A P)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _ m x hx _
    rw [C.eq_zero_of_mem_zero x hx, d_zero]
    exact ⟨zero_mem _, fun _ => zero_mem _⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk m x hx hxm
    let i : Fin C.length := ⟨k, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := C.exists_section i
    let x' : C.F (i.1 + 1) := ⟨x, hx⟩
    let y := C.π i x'
    have hy : y ∈ grading m := (C.π i).map_mem ((DGSubmodule.mem_grading _).mpr hxm)
    let z : P := (s y : C.F (i.1 + 1))
    have hz : z ∈ grading m := by
      have := s.map_mem hy
      rw [add_zero] at this
      exact (DGSubmodule.mem_grading _).mp this
    have hxz : x - z ∈ C.F k := by
      have := (C.π_eq_zero_iff i (x' - s y)).mp (by rw [map_sub, hs, sub_self])
      exact this
    obtain ⟨ih₁, ih₂⟩ := ih (by omega) hxz (sub_mem hxm hz)
    have hdx : d x = d (x - z) + d z := by rw [d_sub, sub_add_cancel]
    have hxx : x = (x - z) + z := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
    let n := C.shift i
    let b : (C.e i).LeftCorner := Shift.unmk n y
    have hb : (b : A) ∈ grading (m + n) :=
      (DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.mem_grading_iff _).mp (Shift.unmk_mem_grading hy)
    rcases lt_trichotomy (m + n) 0 with hmn | hmn | hmn
    · 
      have hy0 : y = 0 := C.π_eq_zero_of_lt hA (x := x') hxm hmn
      have hz0 : z = 0 := by
        change ((s y : C.F (i.1 + 1)) : P) = 0
        rw [hy0, map_zero]
        rfl
      rw [hz0, sub_zero] at ih₁ ih₂
      exact ⟨ih₁, fun h => ih₂ fun j hj => h j (by omega)⟩
    · 
      have hdb : d (b : A) = 0 := hd _ (by rw [hmn] at hb; exact hb)
      have hdy : d y = 0 := by
        apply (Shift.unmk n).injective
        rw [Shift.unmk_d, map_zero]
        have : d b = 0 := Subtype.ext (by rw [DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_d, hdb]; rfl)
        rw [this, smul_zero]
      have hdz : d z ∈ C.F k := by
        have := (C.π_eq_zero_iff i (d (s y))).mp (by rw [(C.π i).map_d, hs, hdy])
        exact this
      have hdz' : d z ∈ grading (m + 1) := d_mem hz
      have h₂ := (ih (by omega) hdz hdz').2 fun j hj => by
        have := hC j i (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by simp [i]; omega))
        change -C.shift j < m + 1
        omega
      refine ⟨by rw [hdx]; exact add_mem ih₁ h₂, fun h => ?_⟩
      have := h i (by simp [i])
      change -C.shift i < m at this
      omega
    · 
      have hε : (C.e i).val ∈ (C.e i).leftIdeal := by
        rw [DGIdempotent.mem_leftIdeal, (C.e i).mul_self]
      let ε : (C.e i).LeftCorner := ⟨(C.e i).val, hε⟩
      have hbε : (b : A) • ε = b := Subtype.ext (by
        change (b : A) * (C.e i).val = b
        exact (DGIdempotent.mem_leftIdeal _).mp b.2)
      have hyε : y = koszulSign (n * (m + n)) • ((b : A) • Shift.mk n ε) := by
        rw [← Shift.mk_smul hb, hbε]
        rfl
      let w : P := (s (Shift.mk n ε) : C.F (i.1 + 1))
      have hzw : z = koszulSign (n * (m + n)) • ((b : A) • w) := by
        change ((s y : C.F (i.1 + 1)) : P) = _
        rw [hyε, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, s.map_smul hb, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
        rfl
      have hmn' : m + n ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hzd : z ∈ decomposables A P := by
        rw [hzw]
        exact units_smul_mem_decomposables _ (smul_mem_decomposables hmn' hb w)
      have hdzd : d z ∈ decomposables A P := by
        rw [hzw, d_units_smul, d_smul hb]
        refine units_smul_mem_decomposables _ (add_mem ?_ ?_)
        · exact smul_mem_decomposables (show m + n + 1 ≠ 0 by omega) (d_mem hb) w
        · exact units_smul_mem_decomposables _ (smul_mem_decomposables hmn' hb _)
      refine ⟨by rw [hdx]; exact add_mem ih₁ hdzd, fun h => ?_⟩
      rw [hxx]
      exact add_mem (ih₂ fun j hj => h j (by omega)) hzd

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.IsOrdered.isMinimal
statement: theorem IsOrdered.isMinimal (hC : C.IsOrdered) : IsMinimal A P
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [d_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | @h_homogeneous m x => exact (C.isMinimal_aux hA hd hC _ le_rfl (C.mem_length _) x.2).1
  | h_add x y hx hy => rw [d_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.IsOrdered.isBoundedMinimal
statement: theorem IsOrdered.isBoundedMinimal (hC : C.IsOrdered) : IsBoundedMinimal A P
proof:
:=
  .of_nonneg hA (hC.isMinimal C hA hd) (isBoundedBelow C hA)

name: DG.IsPositive.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_neg
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading_neg {j : ℤ} (hj : j < 0) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading j) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.grading_eq_bot j hj] at ha
  exact ha

name: DG.IsPositive.exists_isBoundedMinimal_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem exists_isBoundedMinimal_of_isCompact {X : DerivedCategory.{u, u} A}
    (hX : IsCompact.{u} X) :
    ∃ (P : DGModuleCat.{u} A) (C : FiniteCellFiltration A P), C.IsOrdered ∧
      (∀ i, (C.e i).IsSimple) ∧ IsBoundedMinimal A P ∧ Nonempty (X ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, C, hC, hs, he⟩ := hA.exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_isCompact hX
  exact ⟨P, C, hC, hs, hC.isBoundedMinimal C (fun _ hj _ ha => hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_neg hj ha)
    hA.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero, he⟩

name: DG.IsPositive.exists_bijective_of_iso
statement:
theorem exists_bijective_of_iso {P P' : DGModuleCat.{u} A} (C : FiniteCellFiltration A P)
    (hC : C.IsOrdered) (C' : FiniteCellFiltration A P') (hC' : C'.IsOrdered)
    (φ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P') :
    ∃ f : P ⟶ P', Function.Bijective f ∧ DerivedCategory.Q.map f = φ.hom
proof:
:= by
  have hA' : ∀ j < 0, ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) j, a = 0 := fun _ hj _ ha =>
    hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_neg hj ha
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := DerivedCategory.exists_Q_map_eq (C.isKProjective : IsKProjective.{u} A P) φ.hom
  have hq : f.hom.IsQuasiIso := by
    rw [← DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff, hf]
    infer_instance
  exact ⟨f, IsKProjective.bijective_of_isQuasiIso (C.isKProjective : IsKProjective.{u} A P)
    (C'.isKProjective : IsKProjective.{u} A P') (hC.isBoundedMinimal C hA' hA.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero)
    (hC'.isBoundedMinimal C' hA' hA.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero) hq, hf⟩

name: DG.IsPositive.mk_mem_closure_leftCorner
statement:
theorem mk_mem_closure_leftCorner (X : PerfectDerivedCategory.{u, u} A) :
    DG.K0.mk X ∈ AddSubgroup.closure
      (Set.range fun e : SimpleIdempotent A => DGRing.K0.leftCorner (A := A) e.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, -, hl⟩ := hA.hasOrderedCellTower_of_isCompact (X := X.obj) X.property
  have hc : ∀ (i : SimpleIdempotent A) (n : ℤ), IsCompact.{u} (cell A i.1 n) :=
    fun i n => isCompact_cell i.1 n
  have h := CellTower.mk_eq_sum.{u} hc hl
  change DG.K0.mk (⟨X.obj, X.property⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory A) ∈ _
  rw [h]
  refine AddSubgroup.list_sum_mem _ fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  rw [DGRing.K0.mk_cell, Units.smul_def]
  exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self c.1)) _

name: DG.IsPositive.closure_leftCorner_eq_top
statement:
theorem closure_leftCorner_eq_top :
    AddSubgroup.closure
      (Set.range fun e : SimpleIdempotent A => DGRing.K0.leftCorner (A := A) e.1) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := DG.K0.exists_mk_eq x
  exact hA.mk_mem_closure_leftCorner X

name: DG.eq_zero_of_comp_shift_fst_snd
proof:
:= by
  have htot : f = f ≫ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map biprod.fst ≫
        (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map biprod.inl +
      f ≫ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map biprod.snd ≫ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map biprod.inr := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Preadditive.comp_add, ← Functor.map_add,
      biprod.total, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [htot, reassoc_of% h₁, reassoc_of% h₂, zero_comp, zero_comp, add_zero]

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.eq_zero_of_forall_le
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_le {i : ι} {n : ℤ} :
    ∀ (l : List (ι × ℤ)), (∀ c ∈ l, n ≤ c.2) →
      ∀ f : cell i n ⟶ (cellSum cell l)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧, f = 0
  | [], _, f => ((shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map_isZero (isZero_zero C)).eq_of_tgt _ _
  | c :: l, h, f => by
    have h₁ : f ≫ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map biprod.fst = 0
proof:
:= by
      have e := (hc.nonempty_shiftIso c.1 c.2 1).some
      rw [← cancel_mono e.hom, zero_comp]
      exact hc.eq_zero_of_gt (by have := h c (List.mem_cons_self ..); omega) _
    have h₂ : f ≫ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map biprod.snd = 0 :=
      eq_zero_of_forall_le l (fun c' hc' => h c' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc')) _
