    exact eq_zero_of_comp_shift_fst_snd f h₁ h₂

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.nonempty_iso_cellSum
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_cellSum {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C} (h : CellTower cell l X)
    (hl : CellsOrdered l) : Nonempty (X ≅ cellSum cell l.reverse)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX => exact ⟨hX.isoZero⟩
  | @ext l c T hT h₁ h₃ ih =>
    obtain ⟨hl₁, -, hlc⟩ := cellsOrdered_append.mp hl
    obtain ⟨e₁⟩ := ih hl₁
    obtain ⟨e₃⟩ := h₃
    have hδ : T.mor₃ = 0 := by
      have h0 := hc.eq_zero_of_forall_le l.reverse
        (fun a ha => hlc a (List.mem_reverse.mp ha) c (List.mem_singleton_self _))
        (e₃.inv ≫ T.mor₃ ≫ (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map e₁.hom)
      rw [← cancel_epi e₃.inv, comp_zero, ← cancel_mono ((shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map e₁.hom),
        zero_comp, Category.assoc, h0]
    obtain ⟨e, -⟩ := exists_iso_binaryBiproduct_of_distTriang T hT hδ
    rw [List.reverse_append, List.reverse_singleton, List.singleton_append]
    exact ⟨e ≪≫ biprod.mapIso e₁ e₃ ≪≫ biprod.braiding _ _⟩

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.exists_iso_cellSum
statement:
theorem exists_iso_cellSum {X : C} (h : HasOrderedCellTower cell X) :
    ∃ l : List (ι × ℤ), Nonempty (X ≅ cellSum cell l)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨l.reverse, hc.nonempty_iso_cellSum h hl⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.nonempty_cellSum_iso_shiftSum
statement:
theorem DerivedCategory.nonempty_cellSum_iso_shiftSum (l : List (SimpleIdempotent k × ℤ)) :
    Nonempty (cellSum (fun (i : SimpleIdempotent k) n => cell k i.1 n) l ≅
      shiftSum (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k k)) (l.map Prod.snd))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨Iso.refl _⟩
  | cons c l ih => exact ⟨biprod.mapIso (cellIsoShiftSelf k c.1 c.2) ih.some⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.nonempty_iso_shiftSum_of_isCompact
proof:
:= by
  have hk : IsPositive k := IsPositive.degreeZero k
  have hk0 : ∀ n : ℤ, 0 < n → grading (M := k) n = ⊥ :=
    fun n hn => degreeZeroGrading_of_ne k (by omega)
  obtain ⟨l, ⟨e⟩⟩ := (hk.isSemisimpleCellFamily hk0).exists_iso_cellSum
    (hk.hasOrderedCellTower_of_isCompact hX)
  exact ⟨l.map Prod.snd, ⟨e ≪≫ (nonempty_cellSum_iso_shiftSum k l).some⟩⟩

name: DG.ExtendScalars.isKProjective_tensor
statement:
theorem isKProjective_tensor :
    IsKProjective.{u} (ExtendScalars K A) (DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X)
proof:
:=
  isKProjective_baseChange K (P := DGModuleCat.of A X) hX

name: DG.ExtendScalars.K0_mk_derivedTensor_self
statement:
theorem K0_mk_derivedTensor_self :
    DG.K0.mk (⟨(DGBimodule.derivedTensor.{w₁, w₂, w₃, u} (ExtendScalars K A) (ExtendScalars K B)
        (DegreeZeroRing K ⊗[ℤ] X) (isKProjective_tensor (B := B) K hX)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of (ExtendScalars K B) (ExtendScalars K B))),
      (isCompact_Q_baseChange_obj K (P := DGModuleCat.of A X) hX hc).of_iso
        (derivedTensorBaseChangeSelfIso K hX)⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory (ExtendScalars K A)) =
      DGRing.K0.map (unitHom K A) (DG.K0.mk (⟨
        (DGBimodule.derivedTensor.{w₄, w₄, w₄, u} A B X hX).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of B B)),
        hc.of_iso (DGBimodule.derivedTensorSelfIso A B X hX)⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory A))
proof:
:= by
  exact (DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (derivedTensorBaseChangeSelfIso K hX)).trans
    ((K0_map_mk K (P := DGModuleCat.of A X) hX hc).symm.trans
      (congrArg _ (DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (DGBimodule.derivedTensorSelfIso A B X hX)).symm))

name: DG.ExtendScalars.isKProjective_baseChange
statement:
theorem isKProjective_baseChange :
    IsKProjective.{u} (ExtendScalars K A) ((baseChange K A).obj P)
proof:
:=
  (hP.extendScalars (unitHom K A)).of_dgModuleEquiv (extendScalarsEquiv K A P).symm

name: DG.ExtendScalars.isCompact_Q_baseChange_obj
statement:
theorem isCompact_Q_baseChange_obj :
    IsCompact.{u} (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((baseChange K A).obj P))
proof:
:=
  ((unitHom K A).isCompact_Q_extendScalars_obj hP hc).of_iso
    (DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso ((extendScalarsIso K A).app P)).symm

name: DG.ExtendScalars.K0_map_mk
statement:
theorem K0_map_mk :
    DGRing.K0.map (unitHom K A) (DG.K0.mk (⟨DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, hc⟩ :
        PerfectDerivedCategory A)) =
      DG.K0.mk (⟨DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((baseChange K A).obj P),
        isCompact_Q_baseChange_obj K hP hc⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory (ExtendScalars K A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGRing.K0.map_mk_of_isKProjective (unitHom K A) hP hc]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso ((extendScalarsIso K A).app P))

name: DG.IdemEquiv.trans
statement:
theorem IdemEquiv.trans {e f g : R} (h₁ : IdemEquiv R e f) (h₂ : IdemEquiv R f g) :
    IdemEquiv R e g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨b', c', h1', h2', h3', h4', h5', h6'⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨b * b', c' * c, by rw [← mul_assoc, h1], by rw [mul_assoc, h2'],
    by rw [← mul_assoc, h3'], by rw [mul_assoc, h4], ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc b' c', h5', ← mul_assoc, h2, h5]
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc c b, h6, ← mul_assoc, h4', h6']

name: DG.mul_mul_eq_zero_of_not_idemEquiv
statement:
theorem mul_mul_eq_zero_of_not_idemEquiv {e f : R} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) (hse : IsSimpleModule R (Submodule.span R {e}))
    (hsf : IsSimpleModule R (Submodule.span R {f})) (h : ¬ IdemEquiv R e f) (a : R) :
    e * a * f = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hb
  obtain ⟨c, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := exists_mul_eq_of_isSimpleModule he hf hse hsf
    (b := e * a * f) (by rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, he.eq]) (by rw [mul_assoc, hf.eq]) hb
  exact h ⟨e * a * f, c, by rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, he.eq], by rw [mul_assoc, hf.eq],
    h3, h4, h5, h6⟩

name: DG.IsSplitIdem.coeff_spec
statement: theorem coeff_spec (r a : R) : e * (r * a) * e = he.coeff he0 r a • e
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (he (r * a))

name: DG.IsSplitIdem.coeff_mul_self
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_self (r a : R) (hidem : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    he.coeff he0 r (a * e) = he.coeff he0 r a
proof:
:= by
  refine smul_left_injective k he0 ?_
  change he.coeff he0 r (a * e) • e = he.coeff he0 r a • e
  rw [← coeff_spec, ← coeff_spec]
  simp only [mul_assoc, hidem.eq]

name: DG.IsSplitIdem.coeff_self
statement: theorem coeff_self (hidem : IsIdempotentElem e) : he.coeff he0 e e = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine smul_left_injective k he0 ?_
  change he.coeff he0 e e • e = (1 : k) • e
  rw [← coeff_spec, one_smul, hidem.eq, hidem.eq, hidem.eq]

name: DG.IsSplitIdem.exists_coeff_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_coeff_eq_one (hidem : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hs : IsSimpleModule R (Submodule.span R {e})) {a : R} (ha : a * e = a) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ r, he.coeff he0 r a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Submodule.span R {a} ≤ Submodule.span R {e} :=
    (Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr ((mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq hidem).mpr ha)
  rcases (isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.mp hs).le_iff.mp hle with h | h
  · exact absurd (Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp h) ha0
  · have hmem : e ∈ Submodule.span R {a} := h ▸ Submodule.subset_span rfl
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    refine ⟨r, smul_left_injective k he0 ?_⟩
    change he.coeff he0 r a • e = (1 : k) • e
    rw [← coeff_spec, ← smul_eq_mul r a, hr, one_smul, hidem.eq, hidem.eq]

name: DG.tensorCoeff_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorCoeff_tmul (φ : R₁ →ₗ[k] k) (ψ : R₂ →ₗ[k] k) (a : R₁) (b : R₂) :
    tensorCoeff φ ψ (a ⊗ₜ b) = φ a * ψ b
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.rid_lTensor_mul
statement:
theorem rid_lTensor_mul (ψ : R₂ →ₗ[k] k) (e : R₁) (x : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) :
    TensorProduct.rid k R₁ (ψ.lTensor R₁ (x * (e ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : R₂)))) =
      TensorProduct.rid k R₁ (ψ.lTensor R₁ x) * e
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b => simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, add_mul]

name: DG.lid_rTensor_mul
statement:
theorem lid_rTensor_mul (φ : R₁ →ₗ[k] k) (f : R₂) (x : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) :
    TensorProduct.lid k R₂ (φ.rTensor R₂ (x * ((1 : R₁) ⊗ₜ[k] f))) =
      TensorProduct.lid k R₂ (φ.rTensor R₂ x) * f
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b => simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, add_mul]

name: DG.apply_lid_rTensor
statement:
theorem apply_lid_rTensor (φ : R₁ →ₗ[k] k) (ψ : R₂ →ₗ[k] k) (x : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) :
    ψ (TensorProduct.lid k R₂ (φ.rTensor R₂ x)) = tensorCoeff φ ψ x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]

name: DG.apply_rid_lTensor
statement:
theorem apply_rid_lTensor (φ : R₁ →ₗ[k] k) (ψ : R₂ →ₗ[k] k) (x : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) :
    φ (TensorProduct.rid k R₁ (ψ.lTensor R₁ x)) = tensorCoeff φ ψ x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b => simp [mul_comm]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]

name: DG.ne_zero_of_simple₁
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_simple₁ : e ≠ 0
proof: := ne_zero_of_isSimpleModule hs₁

name: DG.ne_zero_of_simple₂
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_simple₂ : f ≠ 0
proof: := ne_zero_of_isSimpleModule hs₂

name: DG.eq_zero_of_forall_tensorCoeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_tensorCoeff_eq_zero {x : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂} (hx : x * (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) = x)
    (h : ∀ r₁ r₂, tensorCoeff (he.coeff (ne_zero_of_simple₁ hs₁) r₁)
      (hf.coeff (ne_zero_of_simple₂ hs₂) r₂) x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he0 := ne_zero_of_simple₁ hs₁
  have hf0 := ne_zero_of_simple₂ hs₂
  have hxe : x * (e ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : R₂)) = x := by
    rw [← hx, mul_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, hidem₁.eq, mul_one]
  have hxf : x * ((1 : R₁) ⊗ₜ[k] f) = x := by
    rw [← hx, mul_assoc, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, hidem₂.eq, mul_one]
  let 𝒞 := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace k R₂
  
  have hc : ∀ i, TensorProduct.rid k R₁ ((𝒞.coord i).lTensor R₁ x) = 0 := by
    intro i
    set c := TensorProduct.rid k R₁ ((𝒞.coord i).lTensor R₁ x)
    have hce : c * e = c := by
      change _ = TensorProduct.rid k R₁ ((𝒞.coord i).lTensor R₁ x)
      rw [← rid_lTensor_mul, hxe]
    by_contra hc0
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁⟩ := he.exists_coeff_eq_one he0 hidem₁ hs₁ hce hc0
    set y := TensorProduct.lid k R₂ ((he.coeff he0 r₁).rTensor R₂ x)
    have hyf : y * f = y := by
      change _ = TensorProduct.lid k R₂ ((he.coeff he0 r₁).rTensor R₂ x)
      rw [← lid_rTensor_mul, hxf]
    have hy0 : y = 0 := by
      by_contra hy0
      obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂⟩ := hf.exists_coeff_eq_one hf0 hidem₂ hs₂ hyf hy0
      rw [apply_lid_rTensor, h] at hr₂
      exact zero_ne_one hr₂
    have h1 : 𝒞.coord i (TensorProduct.lid k R₂ ((he.coeff he0 r₁).rTensor R₂ x)) = 1 := by
      rw [apply_lid_rTensor, ← apply_rid_lTensor, hr₁]
    change 𝒞.coord i y = 1 at h1
    rw [hy0, map_zero] at h1
    exact zero_ne_one h1
  have h0 : TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight 𝒞 x = 0 := by
    ext i
    rw [TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight_apply, hc i, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  exact (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight 𝒞).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h0

name: DG.tmul_mul_mul_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_mul_mul_tmul (r₁ : R₁) (r₂ : R₂) (x : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) (he0 : e ≠ 0) (hf0 : f ≠ 0) :
    (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) * ((r₁ ⊗ₜ[k] r₂) * x) * (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) =
      tensorCoeff (he.coeff he0 r₁) (hf.coeff hf0 r₂) x • (e ⊗ₜ[k] f)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b =>
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, he.coeff_spec he0, hf.coeff_spec hf0,
      tensorCoeff_tmul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul_smul, mul_comm]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy, map_add, add_smul]

name: DG.isSimpleModule_span_tmul
statement:
theorem isSimpleModule_span_tmul :
    IsSimpleModule (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) (Submodule.span (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) {e ⊗ₜ[k] f})
proof:
:= by
  have he0 := ne_zero_of_simple₁ hs₁
  have hf0 := ne_zero_of_simple₂ hs₂
  have hg : IsIdempotentElem (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) := by
    rw [IsIdempotentElem, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, hidem₁.eq, hidem₂.eq]
  have key : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) {e ⊗ₜ[k] f}, x ≠ 0 →
      ∀ N : Submodule (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂), x ∈ N → e ⊗ₜ[k] f ∈ N := by
    intro x hx hx0 N hxN
    have hxg : x * (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) = x := (mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq hg).mp hx
    by_contra hgN
    apply hx0
    refine eq_zero_of_forall_tensorCoeff_eq_zero hidem₁ hidem₂ hs₁ hs₂ he hf hxg fun r₁ r₂ => ?_
    by_contra hc
    apply hgN
    have hmem : (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) * ((r₁ ⊗ₜ[k] r₂) * x) * (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) ∈ N := by
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hxg, ← mul_assoc]
      exact N.smul_mem _ hxN
    rw [tmul_mul_mul_tmul he hf r₁ r₂ x he0 hf0] at hmem
    have := N.smul_of_tower_mem (tensorCoeff (he.coeff he0 r₁) (hf.coeff hf0 r₂) x)⁻¹ hmem
    rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul] at this
  rw [isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  · have hgmem : e ⊗ₜ[k] f ∈ Submodule.span (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) {e ⊗ₜ[k] f} := Submodule.subset_span rfl
    have hgne : e ⊗ₜ[k] f ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := congrArg (tensorCoeff (he.coeff he0 e) (hf.coeff hf0 f)) h0
      rw [tensorCoeff_tmul, he.coeff_self he0 hidem₁, hf.coeff_self hf0 hidem₂, map_zero] at this
      simp at this
    rw [h] at hgmem
    exact hgne ((Submodule.mem_bot _).mp hgmem)
  · by_contra hN0
    obtain ⟨x, hxN, hx0⟩ := N.ne_bot_iff.mp hN0
    have := key x (hN.le hxN) hx0 N hxN
    exact hN.not_ge ((Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _ _).mpr this)

name: DG.list_sum_tmul_list_sum_mem
statement:
theorem list_sum_tmul_list_sum_mem (M : AddSubmonoid (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂)) (l₁ : List R₁) (l₂ : List R₂)
    (h : ∀ s ∈ l₁, ∀ t ∈ l₂, s ⊗ₜ[k] t ∈ M) : l₁.sum ⊗ₜ[k] l₂.sum ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => rw [List.sum_nil, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]; exact M.zero_mem
  | cons s l₁ ih =>
    rw [List.sum_cons, TensorProduct.add_tmul]
    refine M.add_mem ?_ (ih fun s' hs' t ht => h s' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs') t ht)
    clear ih
    induction l₂ with
    | nil => rw [List.sum_nil, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]; exact M.zero_mem
    | cons t l₂ ih =>
      rw [List.sum_cons, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
      exact M.add_mem (h s (List.mem_cons_self ..) t (List.mem_cons_self ..))
        (ih fun s' hs' t' ht' => h s' hs' t' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ht'))

name: DG.IdemEquiv.tmul
statement:
theorem IdemEquiv.tmul {e e' : R₁} {f f' : R₂} (h : IdemEquiv R₁ e e') (h' : IdemEquiv R₂ f f') :
    IdemEquiv (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) (e' ⊗ₜ[k] f')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨b', c', h1', h2', h3', h4', h5', h6'⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨b ⊗ₜ b', c ⊗ₜ c', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul] <;> congr 1

name: DG.not_idemEquiv_of_forall_mul_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem not_idemEquiv_of_forall_mul_mul_eq_zero {R : Type*} [Ring R] {g g' : R} (hg0 : g ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ y, g * y * g' = 0) : ¬ IdemEquiv R g g'
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨b, c, h1, h2, -, -, h5, -⟩
  apply hg0
  rw [← h5, ← h1, ← h2, ← mul_assoc, h b, zero_mul]

name: DG.isSemisimpleRing_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem isSemisimpleRing_tensorProduct [IsSemisimpleRing R₁] [IsSemisimpleRing R₂]
    (h₁ : IsSplitSemisimple k R₁) (h₂ : IsSplitSemisimple k R₂) :
    IsSemisimpleRing (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l₁, hl₁', -, hs₁⟩ := exists_list_sum_eq_of_isSemisimpleRing (R := R₁)
    IsIdempotentElem.one
  have hl₁ : ∀ s ∈ l₁, IsIdempotentElem s ∧ IsSimpleModule R₁ (Submodule.span R₁ {s}) :=
    fun s hs => ⟨(hl₁' s hs).1, (hl₁' s hs).2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨l₂, hl₂', -, hs₂⟩ := exists_list_sum_eq_of_isSemisimpleRing (R := R₂)
    IsIdempotentElem.one
  have hl₂ : ∀ s ∈ l₂, IsIdempotentElem s ∧ IsSimpleModule R₂ (Submodule.span R₂ {s}) :=
    fun s hs => ⟨(hl₂' s hs).1, (hl₂' s hs).2.1⟩
  refine IsSemisimpleModule.of_sSup_simples_eq_top (eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_)
  set M := sSup {m : Submodule (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) | IsSimpleModule (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) m}
  have h1 : (1 : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) ∈ M := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, ← hs₁, ← hs₂]
    refine list_sum_tmul_list_sum_mem M.toAddSubmonoid _ _ fun s hs t ht => ?_
    have hsimple := isSimpleModule_span_tmul (hl₁ s hs).1 (hl₂ t ht).1 (hl₁ s hs).2 (hl₂ t ht).2
      (h₁ s (hl₁ s hs).1 (hl₁ s hs).2) (h₂ t (hl₂ t ht).1 (hl₂ t ht).2)
    have hle : Submodule.span (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) {s ⊗ₜ[k] t} ≤ M :=
      le_sSup (show Submodule.span (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) {s ⊗ₜ[k] t} ∈
        {m : Submodule (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) | IsSimpleModule (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) m} from hsimple)
    exact hle (Submodule.subset_span rfl)
  simpa using M.smul_mem x h1

name: DG.idemEquiv_tmul_iff
statement:
theorem idemEquiv_tmul_iff (hidem₁ : IsIdempotentElem e) (hidem₁' : IsIdempotentElem e')
    (hidem₂ : IsIdempotentElem f) (hidem₂' : IsIdempotentElem f')
    (hs₁ : IsSimpleModule R₁ (Submodule.span R₁ {e}))
    (hs₁' : IsSimpleModule R₁ (Submodule.span R₁ {e'}))
    (hs₂ : IsSimpleModule R₂ (Submodule.span R₂ {f}))
    (hs₂' : IsSimpleModule R₂ (Submodule.span R₂ {f'}))
    (he : IsSplitIdem k e) (hf : IsSplitIdem k f) :
    IdemEquiv (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) (e ⊗ₜ[k] f) (e' ⊗ₜ[k] f') ↔ IdemEquiv R₁ e e' ∧ IdemEquiv R₂ f f'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.1.tmul h.2⟩
  have hg0 : e ⊗ₜ[k] f ≠ 0 :=
    ne_zero_of_isSimpleModule (isSimpleModule_span_tmul hidem₁ hidem₂ hs₁ hs₂ he hf)
  constructor
  · by_contra hn
    refine not_idemEquiv_of_forall_mul_mul_eq_zero hg0 (fun y => ?_) h
    induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a b =>
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
        mul_mul_eq_zero_of_not_idemEquiv hidem₁ hidem₁' hs₁ hs₁' hn, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy, add_zero]
  · by_contra hn
    refine not_idemEquiv_of_forall_mul_mul_eq_zero hg0 (fun y => ?_) h
    induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a b =>
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
        mul_mul_eq_zero_of_not_idemEquiv hidem₂ hidem₂' hs₂ hs₂' hn, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.exists_idemEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem exists_idemEquiv_tmul {g : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂} (hg : IsIdempotentElem g)
    (hsg : IsSimpleModule (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) (Submodule.span (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) {g}))
    {l₁ : List R₁} {l₂ : List R₂}
    (hl₁ : ∀ s ∈ l₁, IsIdempotentElem s ∧ IsSimpleModule R₁ (Submodule.span R₁ {s}) ∧
      IsSplitIdem k s)
    (hl₂ : ∀ t ∈ l₂, IsIdempotentElem t ∧ IsSimpleModule R₂ (Submodule.span R₂ {t}) ∧
      IsSplitIdem k t)
    (hs₁ : l₁.sum = 1) (hs₂ : l₂.sum = 1) :
    ∃ s ∈ l₁, ∃ t ∈ l₂, IdemEquiv (R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) g (s ⊗ₜ[k] t)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra H
  push Not at H
  apply ne_zero_of_isSimpleModule hsg
  have hmem : (1 : R₁ ⊗[k] R₂) ∈ AddMonoidHom.mker (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft g) := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, ← hs₁, ← hs₂]
    refine list_sum_tmul_list_sum_mem _ _ _ fun s hs t ht => ?_
    obtain ⟨hs, hss, hsp⟩ := hl₁ s hs
    obtain ⟨ht, hts, htp⟩ := hl₂ t ht
    have hst : IsIdempotentElem (s ⊗ₜ[k] t) := by
      rw [IsIdempotentElem, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, hs.eq, ht.eq]
    have := mul_mul_eq_zero_of_not_idemEquiv hg hst hsg
      (isSimpleModule_span_tmul hs ht hss hts hsp htp) (H s ‹_› t ‹_›) 1
    rw [mul_one] at this
    exact this
  simpa using hmem

name: DG.cellsOrdered_append
statement:
theorem cellsOrdered_append {l l' : List (ι × ℤ)} :
    CellsOrdered (l ++ l') ↔
      CellsOrdered l ∧ CellsOrdered l' ∧ ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l', b.2 ≤ a.2
proof:
:=
  List.pairwise_append

name: DG.cellsOrdered_singleton
statement: theorem cellsOrdered_singleton (c : ι × ℤ) : CellsOrdered [c]
proof:
:=
  List.pairwise_singleton _ _

name: DG.cellsOrdered_nil
statement: theorem cellsOrdered_nil : CellsOrdered ([] : List (ι × ℤ))
proof:
:=
  List.Pairwise.nil

name: DG.CellTower.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X Y : C} (h : CellTower cell l X) (e : X ≅ Y) :
    CellTower cell l Y
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | zero hX => exact .zero (hX.of_iso e.symm)
  | ext T hT h₁ h₃ =>
    refine .ext (Triangle.mk (T.mor₁ ≫ e.hom) (e.inv ≫ T.mor₂) T.mor₃) ?_ h₁ h₃
    exact isomorphic_distinguished T hT _
      (Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) e.symm (Iso.refl _) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp))

name: DG.CellTower.isZero
statement: theorem isZero {X : C} (h : CellTower cell [] X) : IsZero X
proof:
:= by
  generalize hl : ([] : List (ι × ℤ)) = l at h
  cases h with
  | zero hX => exact hX
  | ext T _ _ _ => simp at hl

name: DG.CellTower.single
statement: theorem single (i : ι) (n : ℤ) : CellTower cell [(i, n)] (cell i n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using CellTower.ext (c := (i, n)) (Triangle.mk (0 : 0 ⟶ cell i n) (𝟙 _) 0)
    (contractible_distinguished₁ _) (.zero (isZero_zero C)) ⟨Iso.refl _⟩

name: DG.CellTower.shift
statement:
theorem shift (hs : ∀ i n k, Nonempty ((cell i n)⟦k⟧ ≅ cell i (n + k)))
    {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C} (h : CellTower cell l X) (k : ℤ) :
    CellTower cell (l.map fun c => (c.1, c.2 + k)) (X⟦k⟧)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX => exact .zero (Functor.map_isZero _ hX)
  | ext T hT _ h₃ ih =>
    rw [List.map_append, List.map_singleton]
    exact .ext ((Triangle.shiftFunctor C k).obj T) (Triangle.shift_distinguished T hT k) ih
      ⟨(shiftFunctor C k).mapIso h₃.some ≪≫ (hs _ _ _).some⟩

name: DG.CellTower.mem_of_isThick
statement:
theorem mem_of_isThick {P : ObjectProperty C} (hP : IsThick P) {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C}
    (h : CellTower cell l X) (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, P (cell c.1 c.2)) : P X
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX => exact hP.of_isZero hX
  | ext T hT _ h₃ ih =>
    exact hP.ext₂ T hT (ih fun c hc => hl c (by simp [hc]))
      (hP.of_iso h₃.some (hl _ (by simp)))

name: DG.HasOrderedCellTower.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso {X Y : C} (h : HasOrderedCellTower cell X) (e : X ≅ Y) :
    HasOrderedCellTower cell Y
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.choose, h.choose_spec.1, h.choose_spec.2.of_iso e⟩

name: DG.HasOrderedCellTower.of_isZero
statement: theorem of_isZero {X : C} (hX : IsZero X) : HasOrderedCellTower cell X
proof:
:=
  ⟨[], cellsOrdered_nil, .zero hX⟩

name: DG.HasOrderedCellTower.of_cell
statement: theorem of_cell (i : ι) (n : ℤ) : HasOrderedCellTower cell (cell i n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, cellsOrdered_singleton _, .single i n⟩

name: DG.HasOrderedCellTower.shift
statement:
theorem shift (hs : ∀ i n k, Nonempty ((cell i n)⟦k⟧ ≅ cell i (n + k))) {X : C}
    (h : HasOrderedCellTower cell X) (k : ℤ) : HasOrderedCellTower cell (X⟦k⟧)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨_, ?_, h.shift hs k⟩
  unfold CellsOrdered at hl ⊢
  rw [List.pairwise_map]
  exact hl.imp fun h => by simpa using h

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.exists_cone
statement:
theorem exists_cone [IsTriangulated C] {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C} (h : CellTower cell l X)
    (i : ι) (n : ℤ) : CellsOrdered l → ∀ φ : cell i n ⟶ X,
    ∃ (Z : C) (v : X ⟶ Z) (w : Z ⟶ (cell i n)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), Triangle.mk φ v w ∈ distTriang C ∧
      ∃ L : List (ι × ℤ), CellTower cell L Z ∧ CellsOrdered L ∧
        (∀ c ∈ L, c ∈ l ∨ c = (i, n + 1)) ∧
        (φ ≠ 0 → (∀ c ∈ l, c.2 ≤ n) → L.length + 1 = l.length)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | @zero X hX =>
    intro _ φ
    obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle φ
    refine ⟨Z, v, w, hT, [(i, n + 1)], ?_, cellsOrdered_singleton _, by simp,
      fun hφ _ => (hφ (hX.eq_of_tgt _ _)).elim⟩
    simpa using CellTower.ext (c := (i, n + 1)) _ (rot_of_distTriang _ hT) (.zero hX)
      (hc.nonempty_shiftIso i n 1)
  | @ext l c T hT h₁ h₃ ih =>
    intro hl φ
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨hl', -, hlc⟩ := cellsOrdered_append.mp hl
    replace hlc : ∀ a ∈ l, c.2 ≤ a.2 := fun a ha => hlc a ha c (by simp)
    obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hTφ⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle φ
    by_cases hn : n < c.2
    · 
      refine ⟨Z, v, w, hTφ, l ++ [c] ++ [(i, n + 1)],
        .ext _ (rot_of_distTriang _ hTφ) (.ext T hT h₁ ⟨e⟩) (hc.nonempty_shiftIso i n 1),
        ?_, fun a ha => ?_, fun _ hall => absurd (hall c (by simp)) (by omega)⟩
      swap
      · simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at ha ⊢
        tauto
      refine cellsOrdered_append.mpr ⟨hl, cellsOrdered_singleton _, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
      obtain rfl : b = (i, n + 1) := by simpa using hb
      rcases List.mem_append.mp ha with ha | ha
      · have := hlc a ha
        dsimp
        omega
      · obtain rfl : a = c := by simpa using ha
        dsimp
        omega
    rw [not_lt] at hn
    by_cases hg : c.2 = n ∧ φ ≫ T.mor₂ ≫ e.hom ≠ 0
    · 
      obtain ⟨h2, hg⟩ := hg
      obtain ⟨c₁, c₂⟩ := c
      dsimp at h2 e hlc hg
      subst h2
      have hiso : IsIso (φ ≫ T.mor₂) := by
        have := hc.isIso_of_ne_zero _ hg
        rw [← Category.assoc] at this
        exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ e.hom
      obtain ⟨Z₁₃, v₁₃, w₁₃, h₁₃⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (φ ≫ T.mor₂)
      have hZ : IsZero Z₁₃ := (Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ _ h₁₃).2 hiso
      let o := Triangulated.someOctahedron rfl hTφ (rot_of_distTriang T hT) h₁₃
      have h3 : IsIso ((-(T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')) ≫ v⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') :=
        (Triangle.isZero₂_iff_isIso₃ _ o.mem).1 hZ
      let e' : T.obj₁ ≅ Z :=
        (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).preimageIso (asIso ((-(T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')) ≫ v⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'))
      refine ⟨Z, v, w, hTφ, l, h₁.of_iso e', hl', fun a ha => Or.inl (by simp [ha]),
        fun _ _ => by simp⟩
    · 
      have hg0 : φ ≫ T.mor₂ = 0 := by
        rw [← cancel_mono e.hom, zero_comp, Category.assoc]
        by_cases h2 : c.2 = n
        · by_contra hne
          exact hg ⟨h2, hne⟩
        · exact hc.eq_zero_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne hn h2) _
      obtain ⟨φ', hφ'⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ T hT φ hg0
      obtain ⟨Z', v', w', hT', L', hL', hLo, hLm, hLl⟩ := ih hl' φ'
      let o := Triangulated.someOctahedron hφ'.symm hT' hT hTφ
      refine ⟨Z, v, w, hTφ, L' ++ [c], .ext _ o.mem hL' ⟨e⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine cellsOrdered_append.mpr ⟨hLo, cellsOrdered_singleton _, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
        obtain rfl : b = c := by simpa using hb
        rcases hLm a ha with ha | rfl
        · exact hlc a ha
        · dsimp
          omega
      · intro a ha
        rcases List.mem_append.mp ha with ha | ha
        · rcases hLm a ha with ha | ha
          · exact Or.inl (by simp [ha])
          · exact Or.inr ha
        · exact Or.inl (by simp_all)
      · intro hφ hall
        have hφ'0 : φ' ≠ 0 := by
          rintro rfl
          exact hφ (by rw [hφ', zero_comp])
        have := hLl hφ'0 fun a ha => hall a (by simp [ha])
        simp [this]

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.exists_cone_of_hasOrderedCellTower
statement:
theorem exists_cone_of_hasOrderedCellTower [IsTriangulated C] {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C}
    (h : CellTower cell l X) : ∀ {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y), HasOrderedCellTower cell Y →
    ∃ (Z : C) (v : Y ⟶ Z) (w : Z ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), Triangle.mk f v w ∈ distTriang C ∧
      HasOrderedCellTower cell Z
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | @zero X hX =>
    intro Y f hY
    obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle f
    have : IsIso v := (Triangle.isZero₁_iff_isIso₂ _ hT).1 hX
    exact ⟨Z, v, w, hT, hY.of_iso (asIso v)⟩
  | @ext l c T hT h₁ h₃ ih =>
    intro Y f hY
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨Z'', v'', w'', h'', hZ''⟩ := ih (T.mor₁ ≫ f) hY
    obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hTf⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle f
    let o := Triangulated.someOctahedron rfl hT hTf h''
    obtain ⟨L, hLo, hL⟩ := hZ''
    obtain ⟨Z', v', w', hT', L', hL', hLo', -, -⟩ :=
      hc.exists_cone hL c.1 c.2 hLo (e.inv ≫ o.m₁)
    obtain ⟨e', -, -⟩ := exists_iso_of_arrow_iso _ _ o.mem hT'
      (Arrow.isoMk e (Iso.refl _) (by simp))
    exact ⟨Z, v, w, hTf, L', hLo', hL'.of_iso (Triangle.π₃.mapIso e').symm⟩

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.hasOrderedCellTower_shift
statement:
theorem hasOrderedCellTower_shift {X : C} (h : HasOrderedCellTower cell X) (k : ℤ) :
    HasOrderedCellTower cell (X⟦k⟧)
proof:
:=
  h.shift hc.nonempty_shiftIso k

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.hasOrderedCellTower_obj₃
statement:
theorem hasOrderedCellTower_obj₃ [IsTriangulated C] (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : HasOrderedCellTower cell T.obj₁) (h₂ : HasOrderedCellTower cell T.obj₂) :
    HasOrderedCellTower cell T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, -, hl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hT', hZ⟩ := hc.exists_cone_of_hasOrderedCellTower hl T.mor₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨e, -, -⟩ := exists_iso_of_arrow_iso _ _ hT' hT (Iso.refl _)
  exact hZ.of_iso (Triangle.π₃.mapIso e)

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.hasOrderedCellTower_obj₂
statement:
theorem hasOrderedCellTower_obj₂ [IsTriangulated C] (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : HasOrderedCellTower cell T.obj₁) (h₃ : HasOrderedCellTower cell T.obj₃) :
    HasOrderedCellTower cell T.obj₂
proof:
:=
  hc.hasOrderedCellTower_obj₃ _ (inv_rot_of_distTriang T hT) (hc.hasOrderedCellTower_shift h₃ _)
    h₁

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.exists_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C} (h : CellTower cell l X) :
    ∀ {i : ι} {n : ℤ} {rest : List (ι × ℤ)}, l = (i, n) :: rest → CellsOrdered l →
      ∃ z : cell i n ⟶ X, z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero _ => intro _ _ _ h; simp at h
  | @ext l c T hT h₁ h₃ ih =>
    intro i n rest hl ho
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h₃
    cases l with
    | nil =>
      obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ : c = (i, n) ∧ rest = [] := by simpa using hl
      have : IsIso T.mor₂ := (Triangle.isZero₁_iff_isIso₂ _ hT).1 h₁.isZero
      refine ⟨e.inv ≫ inv T.mor₂, fun hz => hc.not_isZero i n ?_⟩
      rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
      calc 𝟙 (cell i n) = (e.inv ≫ inv T.mor₂) ≫ T.mor₂ ≫ e.hom := by simp
        _ = 0 := by rw [hz, zero_comp]
    | cons a l =>
      obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ : a = (i, n) ∧ l ++ [c] = rest := by simpa using hl
      have hcn : c.2 ≤ n := by
        have := (List.pairwise_cons.mp ho).1 c (by simp)
        exact this
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := ih rfl (cellsOrdered_append.mp ho).1
      refine ⟨z' ≫ T.mor₁, fun hz => hz' ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ _ (inv_rot_of_distTriang T hT) z' hz
      have e₁ : T.obj₃⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧ ≅ cell c.1 (c.2 + -1) :=
        (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).mapIso e ≪≫ (hc.nonempty_shiftIso _ _ _).some
      have : g ≫ e₁.hom = 0 := hc.eq_zero_of_lt (by omega) _
      have hg : g = 0 := by
        have h' := (cancel_mono e₁.hom).1
          (show (g : cell i n ⟶ (shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ)).obj T.obj₃) ≫ e₁.hom = 0 ≫ e₁.hom by
            rw [zero_comp]; exact this)
        exact h'
      rw [hg]
      exact Limits.zero_comp

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.hasOrderedCellTower_of_retract
statement:
theorem hasOrderedCellTower_of_retract [IsTriangulated C] (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C}, CellTower cell l X → CellsOrdered l → l.length = k →
      ∀ {Y : C}, Retract Y X → HasOrderedCellTower cell Y
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
  intro l X h ho hk Y r
  cases l with
  | nil =>
    refine HasOrderedCellTower.of_isZero ?_
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero, ← r.retract, h.isZero.eq_of_tgt r.i 0, zero_comp]
  | cons a rest =>
    obtain ⟨i, n⟩ := a
    have hall : ∀ c ∈ (i, n) :: rest, c.2 ≤ n := by
      intro c hc
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hc
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact (List.pairwise_cons.mp ho).1 c hc
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hc.exists_ne_zero h rfl ho
    let E : X ⟶ X := r.r ≫ r.i
    have hE : E ≫ E = E := by
      simp only [E, Category.assoc, r.retract_assoc]
    
    have key : ∀ z : cell i n ⟶ X, z ≠ 0 → ∃ (Z : C) (v : X ⟶ Z) (w : Z ⟶ (cell i n)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Triangle.mk z v w ∈ distTriang C ∧ ∀ {Y' : C}, Retract Y' Z →
          HasOrderedCellTower cell Y' := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hT, L, hL, hLo, -, hLl⟩ := hc.exists_cone h i n ho z
      refine ⟨Z, v, w, hT, fun r' => ih L.length ?_ hL hLo rfl r'⟩
      have := hLl hz hall
      simp only [List.length_cons] at this hk
      omega
    by_cases h₁ : z₀ ≫ E = 0
    · 
      obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hT, hZ⟩ := key z₀ hz₀
      have hzr : z₀ ≫ r.r = 0 :=
        calc z₀ ≫ r.r = (z₀ ≫ E) ≫ r.r := by simp [E, r.retract]
          _ = 0 := by rw [h₁, zero_comp]
      obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ _ hT r.r hzr
      exact hZ ⟨r.i ≫ v, r', by rw [Category.assoc, ← r.retract, hr']; rfl⟩
    · 
      
      set z := z₀ ≫ E with hzdef
      have hzE : z ≫ E = z := by rw [hzdef, Category.assoc, hE]
      obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hT, hZ⟩ := key z h₁
      obtain ⟨Z', v', w', hT'⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (z ≫ r.r)
      obtain ⟨α, hα₁, hα₂⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism _ _ hT' hT (𝟙 _) r.i
        (by simpa [E] using hzE)
      obtain ⟨β, hβ₁, hβ₂⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism _ _ hT hT' (𝟙 _) r.r
        (by simp)
      let φ : Triangle.mk (z ≫ r.r) v' w' ⟶ Triangle.mk (z ≫ r.r) v' w' :=
        { hom₁ := 𝟙 _
          hom₂ := r.i ≫ r.r
          hom₃ := α ≫ β
          comm₁ := by simp
          comm₂ := by
            dsimp at hα₁ hβ₁ ⊢
            rw [reassoc_of% hα₁, hβ₁, Category.assoc]
          comm₃ := by
            have h1 : w' = α ≫ w := by simpa using hα₂
            have h2 : w = β ≫ w' := by simpa using hβ₂
            dsimp
            rw [Category.assoc, ← h2, ← h1]
            simp }
      have : IsIso φ.hom₃ := isIso₃_of_isIso₁₂ φ hT' hT' (by dsimp [φ]; infer_instance)
        (by dsimp [φ]; rw [r.retract]; infer_instance)
      have hZ' : HasOrderedCellTower cell Z' :=
        have : IsIso (α ≫ β) := this
        hZ ⟨α, β ≫ inv (α ≫ β), by rw [← Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id]⟩
      exact hc.hasOrderedCellTower_obj₂ _ hT' (HasOrderedCellTower.of_cell i n) hZ'

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.isThick
statement:
theorem isThick [IsTriangulated C] : IsThick (HasOrderedCellTower cell) where
  zero
proof:
:= .of_isZero (isZero_zero C)
  shift X n h := hc.hasOrderedCellTower_shift h n
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := hc.hasOrderedCellTower_obj₂ T hT h₁ h₃
  retract r h := by
    obtain ⟨l, hlo, hl⟩ := h
    exact hc.hasOrderedCellTower_of_retract _ hl hlo rfl r

name: DG.IsOrderedCellFamily.thickClosure_le
statement:
theorem thickClosure_le [IsTriangulated C] {S : ObjectProperty C}
    (hS : S ≤ HasOrderedCellTower cell) : ThickClosure S ≤ HasOrderedCellTower cell
proof:
:=
  DG.thickClosure_le hc.isThick hS

name: DG.exact_leftComp_of_distTriang
statement:
theorem exact_leftComp_of_distTriang (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) (M : C) :
    Function.Exact (Preadditive.leftComp M T.mor₂) (Preadditive.leftComp M T.mor₁)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  constructor
  · intro hf
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := T.yoneda_exact₂ hT f hf
    exact ⟨g, hg.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    change T.mor₁ ≫ T.mor₂ ≫ g = 0
    rw [← Category.assoc, comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ T hT, Limits.zero_comp]

name: DG.exact_leftComp_of_distTriang'
statement:
theorem exact_leftComp_of_distTriang' (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) (M : C) :
    Function.Exact (Preadditive.leftComp M T.mor₃) (Preadditive.leftComp M T.mor₂)
proof:
:=
  exact_leftComp_of_distTriang T.rotate (rot_of_distTriang T hT) M

name: DG.exact_leftComp_of_distTriang''
statement:
theorem exact_leftComp_of_distTriang'' (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) (M : C) :
    Function.Exact (Preadditive.leftComp M (-T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')) (Preadditive.leftComp M T.mor₃)
proof:
:=
  exact_leftComp_of_distTriang T.rotate.rotate (rot_of_distTriang _ (rot_of_distTriang T hT)) M

name: DG.IsCompact.shift
statement: theorem IsCompact.shift {X : C} (hX : IsCompact.{w} X) (n : ℤ) : IsCompact.{w} (X⟦n⟧)
proof:
:= by
  intro ι _ W _
  let adj : shiftFunctor C n ⊣ shiftFunctor C (-n) := (shiftEquiv C n).toAdjunction
  let W' : ι → C := fun i => (W i)⟦-n⟧
  let sc : ∐ W' ⟶ (∐ W)⟦-n⟧ := sigmaComparison (shiftFunctor C (-n)) W
  let Φ : (DirectSum ι fun i => (X⟦n⟧ ⟶ W i)) →+ DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ W' i) :=
    DirectSum.map fun i => (adj.homAddEquiv X (W i)).toAddMonoidHom
  let ψ : (X⟦n⟧ ⟶ ∐ W) →+ (X ⟶ ∐ W') :=
    (Preadditive.rightComp X (inv sc)).comp (adj.homAddEquiv X (∐ W)).toAddMonoidHom
  have hΦ : Function.Bijective Φ :=
    ⟨(DirectSum.map_injective _).2 fun i => (adj.homAddEquiv X (W i)).injective,
      (DirectSum.map_surjective _).2 fun i => (adj.homAddEquiv X (W i)).surjective⟩
  have hψ : Function.Bijective ψ := by
    change Function.Bijective (fun f => adj.homEquiv X (∐ W) f ≫ inv sc)
    exact ⟨fun f g h => (adj.homEquiv X _).injective ((cancel_mono (inv sc)).1 h),
      fun g => ⟨(adj.homEquiv X _).symm (g ≫ sc), by simp⟩⟩
  have comm : ψ.comp (coproductComparison (X⟦n⟧) W) = (coproductComparison X W').comp Φ := by
    ext i g
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, coproductComparison_of, DirectSum.map_of,
      AddEquiv.toAddMonoidHom_eq_coe, AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_apply, ψ, Φ]
    change adj.homEquiv X (∐ W) (g ≫ Sigma.ι W i) ≫ inv sc = adj.homEquiv X (W i) g ≫ Sigma.ι W' i
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [← ι_comp_sigmaComparison, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hcomp : ψ ∘ coproductComparison (X⟦n⟧) W = coproductComparison X W' ∘ Φ := by
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, ← AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, comm]
  have : Function.Bijective (ψ ∘ coproductComparison (X⟦n⟧) W) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (hX ι W').comp hΦ
  exact (Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff' hψ _).1 this

name: DG.isCompact_shift_iff
statement: theorem isCompact_shift_iff (X : C) (n : ℤ) : IsCompact.{w} (X⟦n⟧) ↔ IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (h.shift (-n)).of_iso ((shiftEquiv C n).unitIso.app X), fun h => h.shift n⟩

name: DG.IsCompact.ext₃
statement:
theorem IsCompact.ext₃ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₁) (h₂ : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₂) : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  intro ι _ W _
  refine AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_bijective_of_injective
    (precompDirectSum W (-T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')) (precompDirectSum W T.mor₃)
    (precompDirectSum W T.mor₂) (precompDirectSum W T.mor₁)
    (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ W) (-T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')) (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ W) T.mor₃)
    (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ W) T.mor₂) (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ W) T.mor₁)
    (coproductComparison _ W) (coproductComparison _ W) (coproductComparison _ W)
    (coproductComparison _ W) (coproductComparison _ W)
    (leftComp_comp_coproductComparison _) (leftComp_comp_coproductComparison _)
    (leftComp_comp_coproductComparison _) (leftComp_comp_coproductComparison _)
    (exact_directSum_map _ _ fun i => exact_leftComp_of_distTriang'' T hT (W i))
    (exact_directSum_map _ _ fun i => exact_leftComp_of_distTriang' T hT (W i))
    (exact_directSum_map _ _ fun i => exact_leftComp_of_distTriang T hT (W i))
    (exact_leftComp_of_distTriang'' T hT (∐ W)) (exact_leftComp_of_distTriang' T hT (∐ W))
    (exact_leftComp_of_distTriang T hT (∐ W))
    ((h₂.shift 1) ι W).2 ((h₁.shift 1) ι W) (h₂ ι W) (h₁ ι W).1

name: DG.IsCompact.ext₂
statement:
theorem IsCompact.ext₂ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₁) (h₃ : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₃) : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₂
proof:
:=
  IsCompact.ext₃ T.invRotate (inv_rot_of_distTriang T hT) (h₃.shift (-1)) h₁

name: DG.IsCompact.ext₁
statement:
theorem IsCompact.ext₁ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₂ : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₂) (h₃ : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₃) : IsCompact.{w} T.obj₁
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_shift_iff T.obj₁ 1).1 (IsCompact.ext₃ T.rotate (rot_of_distTriang T hT) h₂ h₃)

name: DG.compactSubcategory_P
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compactSubcategory_P : compactSubcategory.{w} C = IsCompact.{w}
proof: := rfl

name: DG.compactSubcategory_of_retract
statement:
theorem compactSubcategory_of_retract {X Y : C} (h : Retract X Y)
    (hY : compactSubcategory.{w} C Y) : compactSubcategory.{w} C X
proof:
:=
  IsCompact.of_retract h hY

name: DG.IsCompact.down
statement: theorem IsCompact.down {X : C} (h : IsCompact.{max w w'} X) : IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCompact_iff_preservesColimitsOfShape] at h ⊢
  intro ι
  have := h (ULift.{w'} ι)
  exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_equiv (Discrete.equivalence Equiv.ulift) _

name: DG.CompactlyFactorsThrough.of_mem
statement: theorem of_mem {Y : C} (hY : P Y) : CompactlyFactorsThrough.{w} P Y
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ φ => ⟨Y, hY, φ, 𝟙 Y, (Category.comp_id φ).symm⟩

name: DG.CompactlyFactorsThrough.of_retract
statement:
theorem of_retract {Y Y' : C} (e : Retract Y Y') (h : CompactlyFactorsThrough.{w} P Y') :
    CompactlyFactorsThrough.{w} P Y
proof:
:= by
  intro K hK φ
  obtain ⟨L, hL, a, b, hab⟩ := h hK (φ ≫ e.i)
  exact ⟨L, hL, a, b ≫ e.r, by rw [← Category.assoc, ← hab, Category.assoc, e.retract,
    Category.comp_id]⟩

name: DG.CompactlyFactorsThrough.coproduct
statement:
theorem coproduct (hP : IsThick P) {ι : Type w} (Y : ι → C) [HasCoproduct Y]
    (hY : ∀ i, P (Y i)) : CompactlyFactorsThrough.{w} P (∐ Y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K hK φ
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (hK ι Y).2 φ
  induction a using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, hP.zero, 0, 0, by simp⟩
  | of i x => exact ⟨Y i, hY i, x, Sigma.ι Y i, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨L₁, h₁, a₁, b₁, e₁⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨L₂, h₂, a₂, b₂, e₂⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨L₁ ⊞ L₂, hP.biprod h₁ h₂, biprod.lift a₁ a₂, biprod.desc b₁ b₂, by simp [e₁, e₂]⟩

name: DG.CompactlyFactorsThrough.coproduct_shift
statement:
theorem coproduct_shift [HasCoproducts.{w} C] (hP : IsThick P) {ι : Type w} (Y : ι → C)
    (hY : ∀ i, P (Y i)) (n : ℤ) : CompactlyFactorsThrough.{w} P ((∐ Y)⟦n⟧)
proof:
:= by
  let e := sigmaComparison (shiftFunctor C n) Y
  exact of_retract ⟨inv e, e, by simp⟩ (coproduct hP _ fun i => hP.shift _ n (hY i))

name: DG.CompactlyFactorsThrough.ext₃
statement:
theorem ext₃ [IsTriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{w} C] (hP : IsThick P)
    (hPc : P ≤ IsCompact.{w}) (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : CompactlyFactorsThrough.{w} P (T.obj₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))
    (h₂ : CompactlyFactorsThrough.{w} P T.obj₂) : CompactlyFactorsThrough.{w} P T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  intro K hK φ
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM, c, j, hcj⟩ := h₁ hK (φ ≫ T.mor₃)
  
  obtain ⟨K', k, d, hkcd⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle₁ c
  have hK' : IsCompact.{w} K' := IsCompact.ext₁ _ hkcd hK (hPc _ hM)
  have hkc : k ≫ c = 0 := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ hkcd
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ _ hT (k ≫ φ) (by
    rw [Category.assoc, hcj, ← Category.assoc, hkc, Limits.zero_comp])
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL, u, v, huv⟩ := h₂ hK' g
  
  let u₁₂ : K' ⟶ L ⊞ K := biprod.lift (-u) k
  obtain ⟨N, v₁₂, w₁₂, h₁₂⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle u₁₂
  have h₂₃ : Triangle.mk (biprod.snd : L ⊞ K ⟶ K) (0 : K ⟶ L⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (-(biprod.inl : L ⟶ L ⊞ K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') ∈ distTriang C :=
    rot_of_distTriang _ (binaryBiproductTriangle_distinguished L K)
  have comm : u₁₂ ≫ biprod.snd = k := biprod.lift_snd _ _
  have oct := Triangulated.someOctahedron comm h₁₂ h₂₃ hkcd
  have hN : P N := hP.ext₁ _ oct.mem hM (hP.shift _ 1 hL)
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ _ h₁₂ (biprod.desc (v ≫ T.mor₂) φ) (by
    change u₁₂ ≫ _ = 0
    rw [biprod.lift_desc, hg, huv, Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.assoc, neg_add_cancel])
  refine ⟨N, hN, biprod.inr ≫ v₁₂, n, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc]
  change φ = biprod.inr ≫ (Triangle.mk u₁₂ v₁₂ w₁₂).mor₂ ≫ n
  rw [← hn, biprod.inr_desc]

name: DG.CellTower.kerMap_comp_hom
statement: theorem kerMap_comp_hom (A : Over X) : kerMap G A ≫ A.hom = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  simp [kerMap, c.2.2.2]

name: DG.CellTower.nextTriangle_distinguished
statement: theorem nextTriangle_distinguished (A : Over X) : nextTriangle G A ∈ distTriang C
proof:
:=
  (distinguished_cocone_triangle (kerMap G A)).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec

name: DG.CellTower.towerMap_comp_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem towerMap_comp_hom (n : ℕ) :
    towerMap G X n ≫ (tower G X (n + 1)).hom = (tower G X n).hom
proof:
:=
  Over.w (toNext G (tower G X n))

name: DG.CellTower.exists_lift_base
statement:
theorem exists_lift_base {i : ι} {m : ℤ} (φ : (G i)⟦m⟧ ⟶ X) :
    ∃ ψ : (G i)⟦m⟧ ⟶ (tower G X 0).left, ψ ≫ (tower G X 0).hom = φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨Sigma.ι (fun c : Cells G X => (G c.1)⟦c.2.1⟧) ⟨i, m, φ⟩, by simp [tower, base]⟩

name: DG.CellTower.comp_towerMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem comp_towerMap_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {i : ι} {m : ℤ} (ψ : (G i)⟦m⟧ ⟶ (tower G X n).left)
    (hψ : ψ ≫ (tower G X n).hom = 0) : ψ ≫ towerMap G X n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ψ = Sigma.ι (fun c : KerCells G (tower G X n) => (G c.1)⟦c.2.1⟧) ⟨i, m, ψ, hψ⟩ ≫
      kerMap G (tower G X n) := by
    simp [kerMap]
  rw [h, Category.assoc]
  change _ ≫ (nextTriangle G _).mor₁ ≫ (nextTriangle G _).mor₂ = 0
  rw [comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ (nextTriangle_distinguished G _), Limits.comp_zero]

name: DG.CellTower.compactlyFactorsThrough_tower
statement:
theorem compactlyFactorsThrough_tower [IsTriangulated C] (hG : ∀ i, IsCompact.{max w v} (G i))
    (n : ℕ) :
    CompactlyFactorsThrough.{max w v} (ThickClosure fun Y => ∃ i, G i = Y) (tower G X n).left
proof:
:= by
  have hP := isThick_thickClosure (fun Y => ∃ i, G i = Y)
  have hPc : ThickClosure (fun Y => ∃ i, G i = Y) ≤ IsCompact.{max w v} :=
    thickClosure_le_isCompact (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hG i)
  have hGP : ∀ (i : ι) (m : ℤ), ThickClosure (fun Y => ∃ i, G i = Y) ((G i)⟦m⟧) :=
    fun i m => hP.shift _ m (le_thickClosure _ _ ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  induction n with
  | zero => exact CompactlyFactorsThrough.coproduct hP _ fun c => hGP _ _
  | succ n ih =>
    exact CompactlyFactorsThrough.ext₃ hP hPc _ (nextTriangle_distinguished G _)
      (CompactlyFactorsThrough.coproduct_shift hP _ (fun c => hGP _ _) 1) ih

name: DG.thickClosure_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem thickClosure_of_isCompact [IsTriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{max w v} C]
    (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) {X : C} (hX : IsCompact.{max w v} X) :
    ThickClosure (fun Y => ∃ i, G i = Y) X
proof:
:= by
  have : HasCoproducts.{0} C := hasCoproducts_shrink.{0, max w v}
  let P : ℕ → C := fun n => (tower G X n).left
  let H := hocolim P (towerMap G X)
  
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hocolim_exists_desc P (towerMap G X) (fun n => (tower G X n).hom)
    (towerMap_comp_hom G)
  have hcpt : ∀ (i : ι) (m : ℤ), IsCompact.{0} ((G i)⟦m⟧) :=
    fun i m => ((hG.isCompact i).shift m).down
  
  have inj : ∀ (i : ι) (m : ℤ) (a : (G i)⟦m⟧ ⟶ H), a ≫ h = 0 → a = 0 := by
    intro i m a ha
    obtain ⟨k, b, rfl⟩ := hocolim_exists_factor P (towerMap G X) (hcpt i m) a
    have hb : b ≫ (tower G X k).hom = 0 := by rw [← hh k, ← Category.assoc, ha]
    rw [← f_comp_hocolimι, ← Category.assoc, comp_towerMap_eq_zero G b hb, Limits.zero_comp]
  
  obtain ⟨Z, g₂, g₃, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle h
  have hZ : IsZero Z := by
    refine hG.isZero_of_forall_eq_zero Z fun i m φ => ?_
    let adj : shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ) ⊣ shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ) :=
      (shiftEquiv C (1 : ℤ)).symm.toAdjunction
    have h₁ : φ ≫ g₃ = 0 := by
      have h₃₁ : g₃ ≫ h⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = 0 := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁ _ hT
      set ψ := (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (φ ≫ g₃)
      have hψ : ψ ≫ h = 0 := by
        apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
        rw [adj.homEquiv_naturality_right, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Category.assoc, h₃₁,
          Limits.comp_zero, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
      let e := (shiftFunctorAdd' C m (-1) (m + -1) rfl).app (G i)
      have : e.hom ≫ ψ = 0 := inj i (m + -1) _ (by rw [Category.assoc, hψ, Limits.comp_zero])
      rw [← Equiv.apply_symm_apply (adj.homEquiv _ _) (φ ≫ g₃)]
      change adj.homEquiv _ _ ψ = 0
      rw [(cancel_epi e.hom).1 (this.trans (Limits.comp_zero).symm), Adjunction.homEquiv_unit,
        Functor.map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ _ hT φ h₁
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := exists_lift_base G x
    have h₁₂ : h ≫ g₂ = 0 := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ hT
    change (y ≫ (tower G X 0).hom) ≫ g₂ = 0
    rw [← hh 0, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, h₁₂, Limits.comp_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
  have : IsIso h := (Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ _ hT).1 hZ
  
  
  obtain ⟨n, s, hs⟩ := hocolim_exists_factor P (towerMap G X) hX.down (inv h)
  obtain ⟨L, hL, a, b, rfl⟩ := compactlyFactorsThrough_tower G hG.isCompact n hX s
  refine ThickClosure.retract ⟨a, b ≫ (tower G X n).hom, ?_⟩ hL
  rw [← hh n, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← hs, IsIso.inv_hom_id]

name: DG.thickClosure_eq_isCompact
proof:
:= by
  funext X
  apply propext
  constructor
  · exact thickClosure_le_isCompact (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hG.isCompact i) X
  · exact thickClosure_of_isCompact G hG

name: DG.exact_directSum_map
statement:
theorem exact_directSum_map (f : ∀ i, α i →+ β i) (g : ∀ i, β i →+ γ i)
    (h : ∀ i, Function.Exact (f i) (g i)) :
    Function.Exact (DirectSum.map f) (DirectSum.map g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hy' : ∀ i, y i ∈ Set.range (f i) := fun i =>
      (h i _).1 (by simpa using congrArg (fun z => z i) hy)
    refine ⟨DirectSum.mk α (DFinsupp.support y) (fun i => (hy' i).choose), ?_⟩
    ext i
    rw [DirectSum.map_apply]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ DFinsupp.support y
    · rw [DirectSum.mk_apply_of_mem hi, (hy' i).choose_spec]
    · rw [DirectSum.mk_apply_of_notMem hi, map_zero]
      exact (DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hi).symm
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    ext i
    simp [(h i).apply_apply_eq_zero]

name: DG.precompDirectSum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompDirectSum_apply (u : X' ⟶ X) (a : DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) (i : ι) :
    precompDirectSum Y u a i = u ≫ a i
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_apply _ _ _

name: DG.precompDirectSum_id
statement:
theorem precompDirectSum_id (a : DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) :
    precompDirectSum Y (𝟙 X) a = a
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp

name: DG.precompDirectSum_comp
statement:
theorem precompDirectSum_comp {X'' : C} (u : X'' ⟶ X') (v : X' ⟶ X)
    (a : DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) :
    precompDirectSum Y (u ≫ v) a = precompDirectSum Y u (precompDirectSum Y v a)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp

name: DG.precompDirectSum_add
statement:
theorem precompDirectSum_add (u v : X' ⟶ X) (a : DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) :
    precompDirectSum Y (u + v) a = precompDirectSum Y u a + precompDirectSum Y v a
proof:
:= by
  ext i; simp [Preadditive.add_comp]

name: DG.precompDirectSum_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompDirectSum_of (u : X' ⟶ X) (i : ι) (f : X ⟶ Y i) :
    precompDirectSum Y u (DirectSum.of _ i f) = DirectSum.of (fun i => (X' ⟶ Y i)) i (u ≫ f)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.coproductComparison_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coproductComparison_of (X : C) (Y : ι → C) [HasCoproduct Y] (i : ι) (f : X ⟶ Y i) :
    coproductComparison X Y (DirectSum.of _ i f) = f ≫ Sigma.ι Y i
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ _ _

name: DG.leftComp_comp_coproductComparison
statement:
theorem leftComp_comp_coproductComparison [HasCoproduct Y] (u : X' ⟶ X) :
    (Preadditive.leftComp (∐ Y) u).comp (coproductComparison X Y) =
      (coproductComparison X' Y).comp (precompDirectSum Y u)
proof:
:= by
  ext i f
  simp [Preadditive.leftComp]

name: DG.coproductComparison_precompDirectSum
statement:
theorem coproductComparison_precompDirectSum [HasCoproduct Y] (u : X' ⟶ X)
    (a : DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) :
    coproductComparison X' Y (precompDirectSum Y u a) = u ≫ coproductComparison X Y a
proof:
:=
  (DFunLike.congr_fun (leftComp_comp_coproductComparison u) a).symm

name: DG.IsCompact.of_retract
statement: theorem of_retract (h : Retract X Y) (hY : IsCompact.{w} Y) : IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:= by
  intro ι _ W _
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have h₁ : precompDirectSum W h.r a = precompDirectSum W h.r b := by
      apply (hY ι W).1
      rw [coproductComparison_precompDirectSum, coproductComparison_precompDirectSum, hab]
    have h₂ := congrArg (precompDirectSum W h.i) h₁
    rwa [← precompDirectSum_comp, ← precompDirectSum_comp, h.retract,
      precompDirectSum_id, precompDirectSum_id] at h₂
  · intro f
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (hY ι W).2 (h.r ≫ f)
    refine ⟨precompDirectSum W h.i b, ?_⟩
    rw [coproductComparison_precompDirectSum, hb, ← Category.assoc, h.retract, Category.id_comp]

name: DG.IsCompact.of_iso
statement: theorem of_iso (e : X ≅ Y) (hY : IsCompact.{w} Y) : IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:=
  of_retract ⟨e.hom, e.inv, e.hom_inv_id⟩ hY

name: DG.IsCompact.iff_of_iso
statement: theorem iff_of_iso (e : X ≅ Y) : IsCompact.{w} X ↔ IsCompact.{w} Y
proof:
:=
  ⟨of_iso e.symm, of_iso e⟩

name: DG.IsCompact.of_isZero
statement: theorem of_isZero (hX : IsZero X) : IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:= by
  intro ι _ W _
  exact ⟨fun a b _ => DirectSum.ext fun i => hX.eq_of_src _ _, fun f => ⟨0, hX.eq_of_src _ _⟩⟩

name: DG.IsCompact.biprod
statement: theorem biprod (hX : IsCompact.{w} X) (hY : IsCompact.{w} Y) : IsCompact.{w} (X ⊞ Y)
proof:
:= by
  intro ι _ W _
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro a ha
    have hl : precompDirectSum W biprod.inl a = 0 := by
      apply (hX ι W).1
      rw [coproductComparison_precompDirectSum, ha, map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    have hr : precompDirectSum W biprod.inr a = 0 := by
      apply (hY ι W).1
      rw [coproductComparison_precompDirectSum, ha, map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    rw [← precompDirectSum_id a, ← biprod.total, precompDirectSum_add, precompDirectSum_comp,
      precompDirectSum_comp, hl, hr, map_zero, map_zero, add_zero]
  · intro f
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (hX ι W).2 (biprod.inl ≫ f)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hY ι W).2 (biprod.inr ≫ f)
    refine ⟨precompDirectSum W biprod.fst b + precompDirectSum W biprod.snd c, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, coproductComparison_precompDirectSum, coproductComparison_precompDirectSum, hb,
      hc, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← Preadditive.add_comp, biprod.total,
      Category.id_comp]

name: DG.IsCompact.of_biprod_left
statement: theorem of_biprod_left (h : IsCompact.{w} (X ⊞ Y)) : IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:=
  of_retract ⟨biprod.inl, biprod.fst, biprod.inl_fst⟩ h

name: DG.IsCompact.of_biprod_right
statement: theorem of_biprod_right (h : IsCompact.{w} (X ⊞ Y)) : IsCompact.{w} Y
proof:
:=
  of_retract ⟨biprod.inr, biprod.snd, biprod.inr_snd⟩ h

name: DG.isCompact_biprod_iff
statement:
theorem isCompact_biprod_iff (X Y : C) [HasBinaryBiproduct X Y] :
    IsCompact.{w} (X ⊞ Y) ↔ IsCompact.{w} X ∧ IsCompact.{w} Y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.of_biprod_left, h.of_biprod_right⟩, fun h => h.1.biprod h.2⟩

name: DG.preservesColimit_of_bijective
statement:
theorem preservesColimit_of_bijective (h : Function.Bijective (coproductComparison X Y)) :
    PreservesColimit (Discrete.functor Y) (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op X))
proof:
:= by
  let e := AddEquiv.ofBijective _ h
  refine preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone (coproductIsCoproduct Y) ?_
  refine
    { desc := fun s => AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        ((DirectSum.toAddMonoid fun i => (s.ι.app ⟨i⟩).hom).comp e.symm.toAddMonoidHom)
      fac := ?_
      uniq := ?_ }
  · rintro s ⟨i⟩
    ext g
    change (DirectSum.toAddMonoid fun i => (s.ι.app ⟨i⟩).hom) (e.symm (g ≫ Sigma.ι Y i)) =
      (s.ι.app ⟨i⟩).hom g
    rw [show g ≫ Sigma.ι Y i = e (DirectSum.of _ i g) from (coproductComparison_of X Y i g).symm,
      e.symm_apply_apply, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
    rfl
  · intro s m hm
    ext f
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h.2 f
    change m.hom (e a) = (DirectSum.toAddMonoid fun i => (s.ι.app ⟨i⟩).hom) (e.symm (e a))
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
    have key : m.hom.comp e.toAddMonoidHom =
        DirectSum.toAddMonoid fun i => (s.ι.app ⟨i⟩).hom := by
      ext i g
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
      change m.hom (e (DirectSum.of (fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) i g)) = (s.ι.app ⟨i⟩).hom g
      rw [← hm ⟨i⟩]
      change m.hom (coproductComparison X Y (DirectSum.of (fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) i g)) =
        m.hom (g ≫ Sigma.ι Y i)
      rw [coproductComparison_of]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun key a

name: DG.bijective_of_preservesColimit
statement:
theorem bijective_of_preservesColimit
    [PreservesColimit (Discrete.functor Y) (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op X))] :
    Function.Bijective (coproductComparison X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsColimit ((preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op X)).mapCocone (Cofan.mk _ (Sigma.ι Y))) :=
    isColimitOfPreserves _ (coproductIsCoproduct Y)
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro a ha
    ext j
    let t : Cocone (Discrete.functor Y ⋙ preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op X)) :=
      { pt := AddCommGrpCat.of (X ⟶ Y j)
        ι := Discrete.natTrans fun ⟨i⟩ => AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          (if h : i = j then Preadditive.rightComp X (eqToHom (congrArg Y h)) else 0) }
    let ev : (DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) →+ (X ⟶ Y j) :=
      { toFun := fun a => a j
        map_zero' := DirectSum.zero_apply j
        map_add' := fun a b => DirectSum.add_apply a b j }
    have key : (hc.desc t).hom.comp (coproductComparison X Y) = ev := by
      ext i g
      change (hc.desc t).hom (coproductComparison X Y (DirectSum.of (fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) i g)) =
        (DirectSum.of (fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) i g) j
      rw [coproductComparison_of]
      have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom g) (hc.fac t ⟨i⟩)
      change (hc.desc t).hom (g ≫ Sigma.ι Y i) = _ at this
      rw [this]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        simp [t, Preadditive.rightComp]
      · simp [t, hij, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm hij)]
    have h4 : (hc.desc t).hom (coproductComparison X Y a) = a j := DFunLike.congr_fun key a
    rw [ha, map_zero] at h4
    rw [DirectSum.zero_apply]
    exact h4.symm

  · intro f
    let S := (coproductComparison X Y).range
    let t : Cocone (Discrete.functor Y ⋙ preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op X)) :=
      { pt := AddCommGrpCat.of ((X ⟶ ∐ Y) ⧸ S)
        ι := Discrete.natTrans fun _ => 0 }
    have h1 : hc.desc t = AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (QuotientAddGroup.mk' S) := by
      symm
      apply hc.uniq t
      rintro ⟨i⟩
      ext g
      change QuotientAddGroup.mk' S (g ≫ Sigma.ι Y i) = 0
      rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
      exact ⟨DirectSum.of _ i g, coproductComparison_of X Y i g⟩
    have h2 : hc.desc t = 0 := by
      refine (hc.uniq t 0 ?_).symm
      rintro ⟨i⟩
      simp [t]
    have h3 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom f) (h1.symm.trans h2)
    change QuotientAddGroup.mk' S f = 0 at h3
    rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff] at h3
    exact h3

name: DG.isCompact_iff_preservesColimitsOfShape
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff_preservesColimitsOfShape (X : C) :
    IsCompact.{w} X ↔
      ∀ ι : Type w, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete ι) (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op X))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hX ι
    have : ∀ Y : ι → C,
        PreservesColimit (Discrete.functor Y) (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op X)) := by
      intro Y
      constructor
      intro c hc
      have : HasCoproduct Y := HasColimit.mk ⟨c, hc⟩
      classical
      exact (preservesColimit_of_bijective X Y (hX ι Y)).preserves hc
    exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_discrete _
  · intro h ι _ Y _
    exact bijective_of_preservesColimit X Y

name: DG.IsThick.of_iso
statement: theorem of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) (hY : P Y) : P X
proof:
:=
  hP.retract ⟨e.hom, e.inv, e.hom_inv_id⟩ hY

name: DG.IsThick.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
statement: theorem isClosedUnderIsomorphisms : P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e hX => hP.of_iso e.symm hX⟩

name: DG.IsThick.of_isZero
statement: theorem of_isZero {X : C} (hX : IsZero X) : P X
proof:
:=
  hP.of_iso hX.isoZero hP.zero

name: DG.IsThick.shift_iff
statement: theorem shift_iff (X : C) (n : ℤ) : P (X⟦n⟧) ↔ P X
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => hP.of_iso ((shiftEquiv C n).unitIso.app X) (hP.shift _ (-n) h), hP.shift X n⟩

name: DG.IsThick.ext₃
statement:
theorem ext₃ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) (h₁ : P T.obj₁) (h₂ : P T.obj₂) :
    P T.obj₃
proof:
:=
  hP.ext₂ T.rotate (rot_of_distTriang T hT) h₂ (hP.shift _ 1 h₁)

name: DG.IsThick.ext₁
statement:
theorem ext₁ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) (h₂ : P T.obj₂) (h₃ : P T.obj₃) :
    P T.obj₁
proof:
:=
  hP.ext₂ T.invRotate (inv_rot_of_distTriang T hT) (hP.shift _ (-1) h₃) h₂

name: DG.IsThick.biprod
statement: theorem biprod {X Y : C} (hX : P X) (hY : P Y) : P (X ⊞ Y)
proof:
:=
  hP.ext₂ _ (binaryBiproductTriangle_distinguished X Y) hX hY

name: DG.IsThick.biprod_iff
statement: theorem biprod_iff (X Y : C) : P (X ⊞ Y) ↔ P X ∧ P Y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨hP.retract ⟨biprod.inl, biprod.fst, biprod.inl_fst⟩ h,
    hP.retract ⟨biprod.inr, biprod.snd, biprod.inr_snd⟩ h⟩, fun h => hP.biprod h.1 h.2⟩

name: DG.IsThick.isTriangulated
statement: theorem isTriangulated : P.IsTriangulated
proof:
:=
  have := hP.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
  { toContainsZero := ⟨⟨0, isZero_zero C, hP.zero⟩⟩
    toIsStableUnderShift := ⟨fun n => ⟨fun X hX => hP.shift X n hX⟩⟩
    toIsTriangulatedClosed₂ := .mk' hP.ext₂ }

name: DG.IsThick.subcategory_P
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subcategory_P : hP.subcategory = P
proof: := rfl

name: DG.isThick_thickClosure
statement:
theorem isThick_thickClosure : IsThick (ThickClosure S) where
  zero
proof:
:= .zero
  shift _ n h := .shift n h
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := .ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃
  retract h hY := .retract h hY

name: DG.le_thickClosure
statement: theorem le_thickClosure : S ≤ ThickClosure S
proof: := fun _ h => .of_mem h

name: DG.thickClosure_le
statement:
theorem thickClosure_le {P : ObjectProperty C} (hP : IsThick P) (h : S ≤ P) :
    ThickClosure S ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX
  induction hX with
  | of_mem hX => exact h _ hX
  | zero => exact hP.zero
  | shift n _ ih => exact hP.shift _ n ih
  | ext₂ T hT _ _ ih₁ ih₃ => exact hP.ext₂ T hT ih₁ ih₃
  | retract e _ ih => exact hP.retract e ih

name: DG.thickClosure_mono
statement:
theorem thickClosure_mono {S S' : ObjectProperty C} (h : S ≤ S') :
    ThickClosure S ≤ ThickClosure S'
proof:
:=
  thickClosure_le (isThick_thickClosure S') (h.trans (le_thickClosure S'))

name: DG.thickClosure_le_iff
statement:
theorem thickClosure_le_iff {P : ObjectProperty C} (hP : IsThick P) :
    ThickClosure S ≤ P ↔ S ≤ P
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (le_thickClosure S).trans h, thickClosure_le hP⟩

name: DG.thickClosure_P
statement:
@[simp]
theorem thickClosure_P : thickClosure S = ThickClosure S
proof: := rfl

name: DG.isThick_isCompact
statement:
theorem isThick_isCompact [HasCoproducts.{w} C] : IsThick (IsCompact.{w} (C := C)) where
  zero
proof:
:= IsCompact.of_isZero (isZero_zero C)
  shift _ n h := h.shift n
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := IsCompact.ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃
  retract h hY := hY.of_retract h

name: DG.thickClosure_le_isCompact
statement:
theorem thickClosure_le_isCompact [HasCoproducts.{w} C] (h : S ≤ IsCompact.{w}) :
    ThickClosure S ≤ IsCompact.{w}
proof:
:=
  thickClosure_le (isThick_isCompact C) h

name: DG.ShiftedProp.of_iso
statement: theorem of_iso {n : ℤ} {X X' : C} (h : ShiftedProp H n X) (e : X ≅ X') : ShiftedProp H n X'
proof:
:=
  let ⟨Y, hY, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := h
  ⟨Y, hY, ⟨e.symm ≪≫ e'⟩⟩

name: DG.ShiftedProp.shift
statement: theorem shift {n : ℤ} {X : C} (h : ShiftedProp H n X) (k : ℤ) : ShiftedProp H (n + k) (X⟦k⟧)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨Y, hY, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h
  ⟨Y, hY, ⟨(shiftFunctor C k).mapIso e ≪≫ ((shiftFunctorAdd' C n k (n + k) rfl).app Y).symm⟩⟩

name: DG.ShiftedProp.shift'
statement:
theorem shift' {n : ℤ} {X : C} (h : ShiftedProp H n X) (k m : ℤ) (hm : n + k = m) :
    ShiftedProp H m (X⟦k⟧)
proof:
:= by
  subst hm
  exact h.shift k

name: DG.ShiftedProp.of_prop
statement: theorem of_prop {X : C} (hX : H X) (n : ℤ) : ShiftedProp H n (X⟦n⟧)
proof:
:=
  ⟨X, hX, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩

name: DG.ShiftedProp.zero_iff
statement: theorem zero_iff [H.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] (X : C) : ShiftedProp H 0 X ↔ H X
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_, hY, ⟨e⟩⟩ => H.prop_of_iso (e ≪≫ (shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app _).symm hY,
    fun h => ⟨X, h, ⟨((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app X).symm⟩⟩⟩

name: DG.ShiftedProp.prop_shift_neg
statement:
theorem prop_shift_neg [H.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] {n : ℤ} {X : C} (h : ShiftedProp H n X) :
    H (X⟦-n⟧)
proof:
:= by
  exact (zero_iff _).mp (h.shift' (-n) 0 (by omega))

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
statement: theorem isClosedUnderIsomorphisms : H.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e h => hc.prop_of_iso e h⟩

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.shifted_hom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem shifted_hom_eq_zero {m n : ℤ} {X Y : C} (hX : ShiftedProp H m X)
    (hY : ShiftedProp H n Y) (h : n < m) (f : X ⟶ Y) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := hc.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
  obtain ⟨Y₀, hY₀, ⟨eY⟩⟩ := hY
  have hX' := hX.prop_shift_neg
  let e : Y⟦-m⟧ ≅ Y₀⟦n + -m⟧ :=
    (shiftFunctor C (-m)).mapIso eY ≪≫ ((shiftFunctorAdd' C n (-m) (n + -m) rfl).app Y₀).symm
  have h0 : f⟦-m⟧' ≫ e.hom = 0 := hc.hom_eq_zero hX' hY₀ (by omega) _
  have h1 : f⟦-m⟧' = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_mono e.hom, h0, zero_comp]
  exact (shiftFunctor C (-m)).map_injective (by rw [h1, Functor.map_zero])

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.ext_shifted
statement:
theorem ext_shifted {m : ℤ} (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : ShiftedProp H m T.obj₁) (h₃ : ShiftedProp H m T.obj₃) : ShiftedProp H m T.obj₂
proof:
:= by
  have := hc.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
  have h := hc.ext _ (Triangle.shift_distinguished T hT (-m)) h₁.prop_shift_neg
    h₃.prop_shift_neg
  exact ⟨_, h, ⟨(shiftNegShift T.obj₂ m).symm⟩⟩

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.split_shifted
statement:
theorem split_shifted {m : ℤ} {X : C} (hX : ShiftedProp H m X) (e : X ⟶ X) (he : e ≫ e = e) :
    ∃ (Y : C) (s : Y ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y), ShiftedProp H m Y ∧ s ≫ p = 𝟙 Y ∧ p ≫ s = e
proof:
:= by
  have := hc.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
  obtain ⟨W, s', p', hW, hsp, hps⟩ := hc.split hX.prop_shift_neg (e⟦-m⟧')
    (by rw [← Functor.map_comp, he])
  let ε : X⟦-m⟧⟦m⟧ ≅ X := shiftNegShift X m
  refine ⟨W⟦m⟧, s'⟦m⟧' ≫ ε.hom, ε.inv ≫ p'⟦m⟧', ShiftedProp.of_prop hW m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [← Functor.map_comp, hsp]
  · rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hps]
    simp [ε]

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.cone_shifted
statement:
theorem cone_shifted {m : ℤ} (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : ShiftedProp H m T.obj₁) (h₂ : ShiftedProp H m T.obj₂) :
    ∃ (A B : C) (a : A ⟶ T.obj₃) (b : T.obj₃ ⟶ B) (c : B ⟶ A⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang C ∧ ShiftedProp H (m + 1) A ∧ ShiftedProp H m B
proof:
:= by
  have := hc.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
  obtain ⟨A, B, a, b, c, hT', hA, hB⟩ := hc.cone _ (Triangle.shift_distinguished T hT (-m))
    h₁.prop_shift_neg h₂.prop_shift_neg
  let T'' := (Triangle.shiftFunctor C m).obj (Triangle.mk a b c)
  have hT'' : T'' ∈ distTriang C := Triangle.shift_distinguished _ hT' m
  obtain ⟨ε⟩ : Nonempty (T.obj₃⟦-m⟧⟦m⟧ ≅ T.obj₃) := ⟨shiftNegShift T.obj₃ m⟩
  refine ⟨T''.obj₁, T''.obj₃, T''.mor₁ ≫ ε.hom, ε.inv ≫ T''.mor₂, T''.mor₃, ?_,
    hA.shift' m (m + 1) (by omega), (ShiftedProp.of_prop hB m)⟩
  refine isomorphic_distinguished _ hT'' _ (Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) ε.symm (Iso.refl _)
    (by dsimp; erw [Category.assoc, ε.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
    (by dsimp; erw [Category.comp_id]; rfl) (by simp))

name: DG.HeartTower.of_iso
statement: theorem of_iso {a : ℤ} {X Y : C} (h : HeartTower H a X) (e : X ≅ Y) : HeartTower H a Y
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | zero hX => exact .zero (hX.of_iso e.symm)
  | ext hab T hT h₁ h₃ =>
    refine .ext hab (Triangle.mk (T.mor₁ ≫ e.hom) (e.inv ≫ T.mor₂) T.mor₃) ?_ h₁ h₃
    exact isomorphic_distinguished T hT _
      (Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) e.symm (Iso.refl _) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp))

name: DG.HeartTower.mono
statement: theorem mono {a b : ℤ} {X : C} (h : HeartTower H b X) (hab : a ≤ b) : HeartTower H a X
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | zero hX => exact .zero hX
  | ext hb T hT h₁ h₃ => exact .ext (hab.trans hb) T hT h₁ h₃

name: DG.HeartTower.of_shiftedProp
statement: theorem of_shiftedProp {b : ℤ} {X : C} (h : ShiftedProp H b X) : HeartTower H b X
proof:
:=
  .ext le_rfl (Triangle.mk (0 : 0 ⟶ X) (𝟙 X) 0) (contractible_distinguished₁ X)
    (.zero (isZero_zero C)) h

name: DG.HeartTower.shift
statement: theorem shift {a : ℤ} {X : C} (h : HeartTower H a X) (k : ℤ) : HeartTower H (a + k) (X⟦k⟧)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX => exact .zero (Functor.map_isZero _ hX)
  | @ext a b hab T hT h₁ h₃ ih =>
    refine .ext (b := b + k) (by omega) ((Triangle.shiftFunctor C k).obj T)
      (Triangle.shift_distinguished T hT k) ?_ (h₃.shift k)
    have e : b + 1 + k = b + k + 1 := by omega
    exact e ▸ ih

name: DG.HeartTower.mk_mem_closure
statement:
theorem mk_mem_closure {P : ObjectProperty C} [P.IsTriangulated] [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (hP : ∀ Y, H Y → P Y) {a : ℤ} {X : C} (hX : HeartTower H a X) :
    ∃ h : P X, K0.mk (⟨X, h⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) ∈ AddSubgroup.closure
      {x | ∃ (Y : C) (hY : H Y), x = K0.mk (⟨Y, hP Y hY⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)}
proof:
:= by
  induction hX with
  | zero hX0 =>
    refine ⟨P.prop_of_isZero hX0, ?_⟩
    rw [K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr (by
      ext
      exact hX0.eq_of_src _ _))]
    exact zero_mem _
  | @ext a b hab T hT h₁ h₃ ih =>
    obtain ⟨h₁P, h₁mem⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨Y, hY, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h₃
    have h₃P : P T.obj₃ := P.prop_of_iso e.symm (P.le_shift b _ (hP Y hY))
    have h₂P : P T.obj₂ := P.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂ T hT h₁P h₃P
    refine ⟨h₂P, ?_⟩
    rw [K0.mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂ T hT h₁P h₂P h₃P]
    refine add_mem h₁mem ?_
    have : K0.mk (⟨T.obj₃, h₃P⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) =
        b.negOnePow • K0.mk (⟨Y, hP Y hY⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) := by
      rw [← K0.mk_shift]
      exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj
        (e ≪≫ ((P.ι.commShiftIso b).app (⟨Y, hP Y hY⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)).symm)
    rw [this, Units.smul_def]
    exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (by exact ⟨Y, hY, rfl⟩)) _

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.heartTower_hom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem heartTower_hom_eq_zero {a : ℤ} {X : C} (h : HeartTower H a X) :
    ∀ {n : ℤ} {Y : C}, ShiftedProp H n Y → n < a → ∀ f : X ⟶ Y, f = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX => intro _ _ _ _ f; exact hX.eq_of_src _ _
  | @ext a b hab T hT h₁ h₃ ih =>
    intro n Y hY hn f
    have h0 : T.mor₁ ≫ f = 0 := ih hY (by omega) _
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ T hT f h0
    rw [hc.shifted_hom_eq_zero h₃ hY (by omega) g, comp_zero]

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.heartTower_merge
statement:
theorem heartTower_merge {b : ℤ} {X E K : C} (hX : HeartTower H b X) (f : X ⟶ E) (g : E ⟶ K)
    (h : K ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (hT : Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distTriang C) (hK : ShiftedProp H b K) :
    HeartTower H b E
proof:
:= by
  cases hX with
  | zero hX0 => exact .ext le_rfl _ hT (.zero hX0) hK
  | @ext _ b' hbb' T' hT' h₁ h₃ =>
    rcases hbb'.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
    · exact .ext le_rfl _ hT (.ext (by omega) T' hT' h₁ h₃) hK
    · subst heq
      obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hZ⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (T'.mor₁ ≫ f)
      let o := Triangulated.someOctahedron rfl hT' hT hZ
      exact .ext le_rfl _ hZ h₁ (hc.ext_shifted _ o.mem h₃ hK)

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.heartTower_cone_cell
statement:
theorem heartTower_cone_cell {a : ℤ} {X : C} (hX : HeartTower H a X) :
    ∀ {n : ℤ} {Y Z : C}, ShiftedProp H n Y → ∀ (c : Y ⟶ X) (v : X ⟶ Z) (w : Z ⟶ Y⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk c v w ∈ distTriang C → HeartTower H (min a (n + 1)) Z
proof:
:= by
  induction hX with
  | zero hX0 =>
    intro n Y Z hY c v w hT
    have : IsIso w := (Triangle.isZero₂_iff_isIso₃ _ hT).1 hX0
    exact (HeartTower.of_shiftedProp ((hY.shift 1).of_iso (asIso w).symm)).mono
      (min_le_right _ _)
  | @ext a b hab T hT' h₁ h₃ ih =>
    intro n Y Z hY c v w hT
    rcases lt_trichotomy n b with hnb | rfl | hnb
    · 
      have hX : HeartTower H b T.obj₂ := .ext le_rfl T hT' h₁ h₃
      have hrot := rot_of_distTriang _ hT
      have hZ : HeartTower H (n + 1) Z := by
        rcases (show n + 1 < b ∨ n + 1 = b by omega) with h | h
        · exact .ext le_rfl _ hrot (hX.mono (by omega)) (hY.shift 1)
        · exact hc.heartTower_merge (hX.mono (by omega)) _ _ _ hrot (hY.shift 1)
      exact hZ.mono (min_le_right _ _)
    · 
      obtain ⟨Z₃, v₃, w₃, h₃T⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (c ≫ T.mor₂)
      let o := Triangulated.someOctahedron rfl hT (rot_of_distTriang _ hT') h₃T
      obtain ⟨A, B, a', b', c', hAB, hA, hB⟩ := hc.cone_shifted _ h₃T hY h₃
      obtain ⟨W, i, δ, hW⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle₁ (o.m₁ ≫ b')
      let o' := Triangulated.someOctahedron' rfl (inv_rot_of_distTriang _ o.mem) hAB hW
      have hF : HeartTower H (n + 1) (T.obj₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧) :=
        h₁.of_iso (shiftShiftNeg T.obj₁ (1 : ℤ)).symm
      have hW' : HeartTower H (n + 1) W := hc.heartTower_merge hF _ _ _ o'.mem hA
      exact .ext (by omega) _ hW hW' hB
    · 
      have h0 : c ≫ T.mor₂ = 0 := hc.shifted_hom_eq_zero hY h₃ hnb _
      obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ T hT' c h0
      obtain ⟨Z₁, v₁, w₁, h₁T⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle c₁
      have hZ₁ : HeartTower H (b + 1) Z₁ := (ih hY c₁ v₁ w₁ h₁T).mono (le_min le_rfl (by omega))
      let o := Triangulated.someOctahedron hc₁.symm h₁T hT' hT
      exact .ext (by omega) _ o.mem hZ₁ h₃

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.heartTower_cone
statement:
theorem heartTower_cone {a : ℤ} {X : C} (hX : HeartTower H a X) :
    ∀ {b : ℤ} {Y Z : C}, HeartTower H b Y → ∀ (f : X ⟶ Y) (v : Y ⟶ Z) (w : Z ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk f v w ∈ distTriang C → HeartTower H (min b (a + 1)) Z
proof:
:= by
  induction hX with
  | zero hX0 =>
    intro b Y Z hY f v w hT
    have : IsIso v := (Triangle.isZero₁_iff_isIso₂ _ hT).1 hX0
    exact (hY.of_iso (asIso v)).mono (min_le_left _ _)
  | @ext a b' hab T hT' h₁ h₃ ih =>
    intro b Y Z hY f v w hT
    obtain ⟨Z'', v'', w'', h''⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (T.mor₁ ≫ f)
    have hZ'' := ih hY (T.mor₁ ≫ f) v'' w'' h''
    let o := Triangulated.someOctahedron rfl hT' hT h''
    exact (hc.heartTower_cone_cell hZ'' h₃ o.m₁ o.m₃ _ o.mem).mono (by omega)

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.heartTower_split
statement:
theorem heartTower_split {a : ℤ} {X : C} (hX : HeartTower H a X) :
    ∀ e : X ⟶ X, e ≫ e = e →
      ∃ (Y : C) (s : Y ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y), HeartTower H a Y ∧ s ≫ p = 𝟙 Y ∧ p ≫ s = e
proof:
:= by
  induction hX with
  | zero hX0 =>
    intro e _
    exact ⟨_, 𝟙 _, 𝟙 _, .zero hX0, by simp, hX0.eq_of_src _ _⟩
  | @ext a b hab T hT h₁ h₃ ih =>
    intro e he
    
    have O₁ : ∀ f : T.obj₁ ⟶ T.obj₃, f = 0 := fun f =>
      hc.heartTower_hom_eq_zero h₁ h₃ (by omega) f
    have O₂ : ∀ f : T.obj₁ ⟶ T.obj₃⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧, f = 0 := fun f =>
      hc.heartTower_hom_eq_zero h₁ (h₃.shift (-1)) (by omega) f
    have O₃ : ∀ f : T.obj₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ T.obj₃, f = 0 := fun f =>
      hc.heartTower_hom_eq_zero (h₁.shift 1) h₃ (by omega) f
    have U₁ : ∀ x y : T.obj₁ ⟶ T.obj₁, x ≫ T.mor₁ = y ≫ T.mor₁ → x = y := by
      intro x y hxy
      rw [← sub_eq_zero] at hxy ⊢
      rw [← Preadditive.sub_comp] at hxy
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ _ (inv_rot_of_distTriang T hT) (x - y) hxy
      obtain rfl : g = 0 := O₂ g
      rw [hg]
      exact zero_comp
    have U₃ : ∀ x y : T.obj₃ ⟶ T.obj₃, T.mor₂ ≫ x = T.mor₂ ≫ y → x = y := by
      intro x y hxy
      rw [← sub_eq_zero] at hxy ⊢
      rw [← Preadditive.comp_sub] at hxy
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ T hT (x - y) hxy
      obtain rfl : g = 0 := O₃ g
      rw [hg]
      exact comp_zero
    
    obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ T hT (T.mor₁ ≫ e)
      (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact O₁ _)
    obtain ⟨e₃, he₃⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ T hT (e ≫ T.mor₂)
      (by rw [← Category.assoc, he₁, Category.assoc, comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ hT, comp_zero])
    have he₁' : e₁ ≫ e₁ = e₁ := U₁ _ _ (by
      rw [Category.assoc, ← he₁, ← Category.assoc, ← he₁, Category.assoc, he, he₁])
    have he₃' : e₃ ≫ e₃ = e₃ := U₃ _ _ (by
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← he₃, Category.assoc, ← he₃, ← Category.assoc, he])
    have hδ : T.mor₃ ≫ e₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = e₃ ≫ T.mor₃ := by
      obtain ⟨c, hc₁, hc₂⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism T T hT hT e₁ e he₁
      rw [hc₂, U₃ c e₃ (by rw [hc₁, he₃])]
    
    obtain ⟨Y₁, s₁, p₁, hY₁, hsp₁, hps₁⟩ := ih e₁ he₁'
    obtain ⟨Y₃, s₃, p₃, hY₃, hsp₃, hps₃⟩ := hc.split_shifted h₃ e₃ he₃'
    have hs₃ : s₃ ≫ e₃ = s₃ := by rw [← hps₃, ← Category.assoc, hsp₃, Category.id_comp]
    have hp₁ : e₁ ≫ p₁ = p₁ := by rw [← hps₁, Category.assoc, hsp₁, Category.comp_id]
    obtain ⟨Y, iY, πY, hTY⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle₂ (s₃ ≫ T.mor₃ ≫ p₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')
    obtain ⟨s, hs₁, hs₂⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism₂ _ _ hTY hT s₁ s₃ (by
      dsimp
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, hps₁, hδ, ← Category.assoc, hs₃])
    obtain ⟨p, hp₁', hp₂'⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism₂ _ _ hT hTY p₁ p₃ (by
      dsimp
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, hps₃, ← hδ, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, hp₁])
    dsimp at hs₁ hs₂ hp₁' hp₂'
    
    have hψ₁ : iY ≫ s ≫ p = iY := by
      rw [reassoc_of% hs₁, hp₁', reassoc_of% hsp₁]
    have hψ₂ : (s ≫ p) ≫ πY = πY := by
      rw [Category.assoc, ← hp₂', ← reassoc_of% hs₂, hsp₃, Category.comp_id]
    have hψ : IsIso (s ≫ p) := by
      let φ : Triangle.mk iY πY (s₃ ≫ T.mor₃ ≫ p₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') ⟶
          Triangle.mk iY πY (s₃ ≫ T.mor₃ ≫ p₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') :=
        { hom₁ := 𝟙 _
          hom₂ := s ≫ p
          hom₃ := 𝟙 _
          comm₁ := by dsimp; rw [hψ₁, Category.id_comp]
          comm₂ := by dsimp; rw [hψ₂, Category.comp_id]
          comm₃ := by simp }
      exact isIso₂_of_isIso₁₃ φ hTY hTY (by change IsIso (𝟙 _); infer_instance)
        (by change IsIso (𝟙 _); infer_instance)
    have hiY : iY ≫ inv (s ≫ p) = iY := by
      rw [IsIso.comp_inv_eq, hψ₁]
    have hπY : inv (s ≫ p) ≫ πY = πY := by
      rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, hψ₂]
    have hsq : s ≫ p ≫ inv (s ≫ p) = 𝟙 Y := by
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (IsIso.hom_inv_id (s ≫ p))
    
    obtain ⟨q, hqdef⟩ : ∃ q : T.obj₂ ⟶ T.obj₂, q = p ≫ inv (s ≫ p) ≫ s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hq : q ≫ q = q := by
      rw [hqdef]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      erw [reassoc_of% hsq, Category.id_comp]
    have hq₁ : T.mor₁ ≫ q = e₁ ≫ T.mor₁ := by
      rw [hqdef, reassoc_of% hp₁', reassoc_of% hiY, hs₁, ← Category.assoc, hps₁]
    have hq₂ : q ≫ T.mor₂ = T.mor₂ ≫ e₃ := by
      rw [hqdef, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← hs₂, reassoc_of% hπY, ← reassoc_of% hp₂', hps₃]
    
    have hn₁ : T.mor₁ ≫ (e - q) = 0 := by
      rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, he₁, hq₁, sub_self]
    have hn₂ : (e - q) ≫ T.mor₂ = 0 := by
      rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, he₃, hq₂, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ T hT (e - q) hn₁
    have hh'₂ : h' ≫ T.mor₂ = 0 := U₃ _ 0 (by rw [← Category.assoc, ← hh', hn₂, comp_zero])
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ T hT h' hh'₂
    have key : ∀ (x : T.obj₂ ⟶ T.obj₂) (x₁ : T.obj₁ ⟶ T.obj₁), T.mor₁ ≫ x = x₁ ≫ T.mor₁ →
        (e - q) ≫ x ≫ (e - q) = 0 := by
      intro x x₁ hx
      rw [hh']
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [reassoc_of% hx, comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂_assoc _ hT]
      simp
    
    obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m : T.obj₂ ⟶ T.obj₂, m = (q + q - 𝟙 _) ≫ (e - q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hm : m ≫ m = 0 := by
      rw [hmdef, Category.assoc, key _ (e₁ + e₁ - 𝟙 _) (by
        simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.add_comp,
          Preadditive.sub_comp, hq₁, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]), comp_zero]
    obtain ⟨u, hudef⟩ : ∃ u : T.obj₂ ⟶ T.obj₂, u = q ≫ e + (𝟙 _ - q) ≫ (𝟙 _ - e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu : u = 𝟙 _ + m := by
      rw [hudef, hmdef]
      simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub,
        Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp, hq]
      abel
    have huinv : IsIso u := by
      refine ⟨⟨𝟙 _ - m, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [hu, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.comp_sub, hm]
        simp
      · rw [hu, Preadditive.sub_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.comp_add, hm]
        simp
    have hqu : q ≫ u = u ≫ e := by
      rw [hudef]
      simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub,
        Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, he,
        reassoc_of% hq, hq]
      abel
    refine ⟨Y, s ≫ u, inv u ≫ p ≫ inv (s ≫ p), .ext hab _ hTY hY₁ hY₃, ?_, ?_⟩
