    · rw [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, hsq]
    · calc (inv u ≫ p ≫ inv (s ≫ p)) ≫ s ≫ u = inv u ≫ q ≫ u := by
            rw [hqdef]; simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = e := by rw [hqu, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.heartTower_of_retract
statement:
theorem heartTower_of_retract {a : ℤ} {X Y : C} (r : Retract Y X) (hX : HeartTower H a X) :
    HeartTower H a Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y₀, s, p, hY₀, hsp, hps⟩ := hc.heartTower_split hX (r.r ≫ r.i) (by
    simp only [Category.assoc, r.retract_assoc])
  refine hY₀.of_iso ⟨s ≫ r.r, r.i ≫ p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc (s ≫ r.r) ≫ r.i ≫ p = s ≫ (r.r ≫ r.i) ≫ p := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = s ≫ (p ≫ s) ≫ p := by rw [hps]
      _ = 𝟙 _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]; rw [reassoc_of% hsp, hsp]
  · calc (r.i ≫ p) ≫ s ≫ r.r = r.i ≫ (p ≫ s) ≫ r.r := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = r.i ≫ (r.r ≫ r.i) ≫ r.r := by rw [hps]
      _ = 𝟙 _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]; rw [r.retract_assoc, r.retract]

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.isThick
statement:
theorem isThick : IsThick (HasHeartTower H) where
  zero
proof:
:= ⟨0, .zero (isZero_zero C)⟩
  shift X n h := let ⟨a, ha⟩ := h; ⟨a + n, ha.shift n⟩
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨c, hc₃⟩ := h₃
    exact ⟨_, hc.heartTower_cone (hc₃.shift (-1)) ha _ _ _ (inv_rot_of_distTriang T hT)⟩
  retract r h := let ⟨a, ha⟩ := h; ⟨a, hc.heartTower_of_retract r ha⟩

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.thickClosure_le
statement: theorem thickClosure_le : ThickClosure H ≤ HasHeartTower H
proof:
:=
  DG.thickClosure_le hc.isThick fun X hX =>
    have := hc.isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
    ⟨0, HeartTower.of_shiftedProp ((ShiftedProp.zero_iff X).mpr hX)⟩

name: DG.IsHeartFamily.map
statement:
theorem IsHeartFamily.map {𝒜 : ObjectProperty D} (h𝒜 : IsHeartFamily 𝒜)
    (full : ∀ {A B : D}, 𝒜 A → 𝒜 B → ∀ g : F.obj A ⟶ F.obj B, ∃ f : A ⟶ B, F.map f = g)
    (faithful : ∀ {A B : D}, 𝒜 A → 𝒜 B → ∀ f f' : A ⟶ B, F.map f = F.map f' → f = f')
    (neg : ∀ {A B : D}, 𝒜 A → 𝒜 B → ∀ {k : ℤ}, k < 0 → ∀ g : F.obj A ⟶ (F.obj B)⟦k⟧, g = 0)
    (one : ∀ {A B : D}, 𝒜 A → 𝒜 B → ∀ g : F.obj A ⟶ (F.obj B)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      ∃ f : A ⟶ B⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧, F.map f ≫ (F.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app B = g) :
    IsHeartFamily (mapHeart F 𝒜) where
  prop_of_iso e
proof:
:= fun ⟨A, hA, ⟨e'⟩⟩ => ⟨A, hA, ⟨e.symm ≪≫ e'⟩⟩
  hom_eq_zero := by
    rintro X Y ⟨A, hA, ⟨eX⟩⟩ ⟨B, hB, ⟨eY⟩⟩ k hk f
    have h0 := neg hA hB hk (eX.inv ≫ f ≫ eY.hom⟦k⟧')
    have hf : f = eX.hom ≫ (eX.inv ≫ f ≫ eY.hom⟦k⟧') ≫ eY.inv⟦k⟧' := by
      simp [← Functor.map_comp]
    rw [hf, h0, zero_comp, comp_zero]
  cone := by
    rintro T hT ⟨A, hA, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ ⟨B, hB, ⟨e₂⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := full hA hB (e₁.inv ≫ T.mor₁ ≫ e₂.hom)
    obtain ⟨Z, v, w, hZ⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle f
    obtain ⟨A', B', a, b, c, habc, hA', hB'⟩ := h𝒜.cone _ hZ hA hB
    obtain ⟨e, -, -⟩ := exists_iso_of_arrow_iso _ _ hT (F.map_distinguished _ hZ)
      (Arrow.isoMk e₁ e₂ (by simp [hf]))
    let e₃ : T.obj₃ ≅ F.obj Z := Triangle.π₃.mapIso e
    refine ⟨F.obj A', F.obj B', F.map a ≫ e₃.inv, e₃.hom ≫ F.map b,
      F.map c ≫ (F.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app A', ?_, ?_, ⟨B', hB', ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩⟩
    · refine isomorphic_distinguished _ (F.map_distinguished _ habc) _
        (Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) e₃ (Iso.refl _) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp))
    · obtain ⟨K, hK, ⟨eK⟩⟩ := hA'
      exact ⟨F.obj K, ⟨K, hK, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩,
        ⟨F.mapIso eK ≪≫ (F.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).app K⟩⟩
  ext := by
    rintro T hT ⟨A, hA, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ ⟨B, hB, ⟨e₃⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := one hB hA (e₃.inv ≫ T.mor₃ ≫ e₁.hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')
    obtain ⟨E, u, v, hE⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle₂ δ
    let e := isoTriangleOfIso₁₃ T (F.mapTriangle.obj (Triangle.mk u v δ)) hT
      (F.map_distinguished _ hE) e₁ e₃ (by
        dsimp
        rw [hδ]
        simp)
    exact ⟨E, h𝒜.ext _ hE hA hB, ⟨Triangle.π₂.mapIso e⟩⟩
  split := by
    rintro X ⟨A, hA, ⟨eX⟩⟩ e he
    obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := full hA hA (eX.inv ≫ e ≫ eX.hom)
    have he₀' : e₀ ≫ e₀ = e₀ := faithful hA hA _ _ (by
      rw [F.map_comp, he₀]
      simp [reassoc_of% he])
    obtain ⟨Y, s, p, hY, hsp, hps⟩ := h𝒜.split hA e₀ he₀'
    refine ⟨F.obj Y, F.map s ≫ eX.inv, eX.hom ≫ F.map p, ⟨Y, hY, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [← F.map_comp, hsp]
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp_assoc, hps, he₀]
      simp

name: DG.ι_hocolimShift
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem ι_hocolimShift (n : ℕ) :
    Sigma.ι X n ≫ hocolimShift X f = f n ≫ Sigma.ι X (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  Sigma.ι_comp_desc _ _

name: DG.ι_hocolimDiff
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem ι_hocolimDiff (n : ℕ) :
    Sigma.ι X n ≫ hocolimDiff X f = Sigma.ι X n - f n ≫ Sigma.ι X (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hocolimDiff, Preadditive.comp_sub]

name: DG.directSumShift_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem directSumShift_of (n : ℕ) (a : K ⟶ X n) :
    directSumShift f (DirectSum.of _ n a) = DirectSum.of (fun n => (K ⟶ X n)) (n + 1) (a ≫ f n)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ _ _

name: DG.directSumShift_apply_zero
statement:
theorem directSumShift_apply_zero (a : DirectSum ℕ fun n => (K ⟶ X n)) :
    directSumShift f a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x => simp [DirectSum.of_apply]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb]

name: DG.directSumShift_apply_succ
statement:
theorem directSumShift_apply_succ (a : DirectSum ℕ fun n => (K ⟶ X n)) (n : ℕ) :
    directSumShift f a (n + 1) = a n ≫ f n
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m x =>
    rw [directSumShift_of]
    by_cases h : m = n
    · subst h; simp
    · rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm h),
        Limits.zero_comp]
  | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb, Preadditive.add_comp]

name: DG.directSumShift_eq_self
statement:
theorem directSumShift_eq_self {a : DirectSum ℕ fun n => (K ⟶ X n)}
    (h : directSumShift f a = a) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n, a n = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [← h, directSumShift_apply_zero]
    | succ n ih => rw [← h, directSumShift_apply_succ, ih, Limits.zero_comp]
  ext n
  simp [key n]

name: DG.apply_eq_of_sub_directSumShift_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ∀ k, a k = directSumShift f a k + DirectSum.of (fun n => (K ⟶ X n)) n w k := by
    intro k
    rw [← h, DirectSum.sub_apply, add_sub_cancel]
  have below : ∀ k, k < n → a k = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    induction k with
    | zero => rw [h', directSumShift_apply_zero, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), add_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [h', directSumShift_apply_succ, ih (by omega), Limits.zero_comp, zero_add,
        DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega)]
  induction m, hnm using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    rw [h', DirectSum.of_eq_same]
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [directSumShift_apply_zero]
      exact (Category.comp_id w).symm
    · simp [directSumShift_apply_succ, below n (by omega)]
      exact (Category.comp_id w).symm
  | succ m hnm ih =>
    rw [h', directSumShift_apply_succ, ih, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), add_zero,
      ← homOfLE_comp hnm (Nat.le_succ m), Functor.map_comp, Functor.ofSequence_map_homOfLE_succ]
    exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: DG.coproductComparison_comp_hocolimDiff
statement:
theorem coproductComparison_comp_hocolimDiff (a : DirectSum ℕ fun n => (K ⟶ X n)) :
    coproductComparison K X a ≫ hocolimDiff X f =
      coproductComparison K X (a - directSumShift f a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x => simp [Preadditive.comp_sub]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, ha, hb, ← map_add, map_add (directSumShift f)]
    congr 1
    abel

name: DG.hocolimDiff_injective
statement:
theorem hocolimDiff_injective (hK : IsCompact.{0} K) :
    Function.Injective fun φ : K ⟶ ∐ X => φ ≫ hocolimDiff X f
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Injective (Preadditive.rightComp K (hocolimDiff X f))
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro φ hφ
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (hK ℕ X).2 φ
  change coproductComparison K X a ≫ hocolimDiff X f = 0 at hφ
  rw [coproductComparison_comp_hocolimDiff, ← map_zero (coproductComparison K X)] at hφ
  rw [directSumShift_eq_self f (sub_eq_zero.1 ((hK ℕ X).1 hφ)).symm, map_zero]

name: DG.hocolimDiff_shift_injective
statement:
theorem hocolimDiff_shift_injective (hK : IsCompact.{0} K) :
    Function.Injective fun φ : K ⟶ (∐ X)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ => φ ≫ (hocolimDiff X f)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
proof:
:= by
  let X' : ℕ → C := fun n => (X n)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧
  let f' : ∀ n, X' n ⟶ X' (n + 1) := fun n => (f n)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
  let e : ∐ X' ⟶ (∐ X)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ := sigmaComparison (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)) X
  have comm : e ≫ (hocolimDiff X f)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = hocolimDiff X' f' ≫ e := by
    ext n
    simp only [e, X', f', ι_comp_sigmaComparison_assoc, ι_hocolimDiff_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
      ι_hocolimDiff, Functor.map_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc,
      ι_comp_sigmaComparison]
  intro φ ψ h
  simp only at h
  have h' : (φ ≫ inv e) ≫ hocolimDiff X' f' = (ψ ≫ inv e) ≫ hocolimDiff X' f' := by
    rw [← cancel_mono e, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← comm,
      IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc, h]
  simpa using hocolimDiff_injective X' f' hK h'

name: DG.hocolimTriangle_distinguished
statement: theorem hocolimTriangle_distinguished : hocolimTriangle X f ∈ distTriang C
proof:
:=
  (distinguished_cocone_triangle (hocolimDiff X f)).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec

name: DG.hocolimDiff_hocolimπ
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem hocolimDiff_hocolimπ : hocolimDiff X f ≫ hocolimπ X f = 0
proof:
:=
  comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ (hocolimTriangle_distinguished X f)

name: DG.f_comp_hocolimι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem f_comp_hocolimι (n : ℕ) : f n ≫ hocolimι X f (n + 1) = hocolimι X f n
proof:
:= by
  have h := Sigma.ι X n ≫= hocolimDiff_hocolimπ X f
  rw [ι_hocolimDiff_assoc, Preadditive.sub_comp, Limits.comp_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h
  simp only [hocolimι, ← Category.assoc] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

name: DG.map_comp_hocolimι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem map_comp_hocolimι {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    (Functor.ofSequence f).map (homOfLE h) ≫ hocolimι X f m = hocolimι X f n
proof:
:= by
  induction m, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ m hnm ih =>
    rw [← homOfLE_comp hnm (Nat.le_succ m), Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
      Functor.ofSequence_map_homOfLE_succ, f_comp_hocolimι, ih]

name: DG.hocolim_exists_desc
statement:
theorem hocolim_exists_desc {Y : C} (p : ∀ n, X n ⟶ Y) (hp : ∀ n, f n ≫ p (n + 1) = p n) :
    ∃ g : hocolim X f ⟶ Y, ∀ n, hocolimι X f n ≫ g = p n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ _ (hocolimTriangle_distinguished X f) (Sigma.desc p)
    (by change hocolimDiff X f ≫ Sigma.desc p = 0; ext n; simp [hp])
  refine ⟨g, fun n => ?_⟩
  simp only [hocolimTriangle, Triangle.mk_obj₂, Triangle.mk_obj₃, Triangle.mk_mor₂] at hg
  rw [hocolimι, Category.assoc, ← hg, Sigma.ι_comp_desc]

name: DG.exists_coproductComparison_comp_hocolimπ
statement:
theorem exists_coproductComparison_comp_hocolimπ (a : DirectSum ℕ fun n => (K ⟶ X n)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : K ⟶ X n), coproductComparison K X a ≫ hocolimπ X f = b ≫ hocolimι X f n
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩
  | of n x => exact ⟨n, x, by simp [hocolimι]⟩
  | add a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨n, x, hx⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨m, y, hy⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨max n m, x ≫ (Functor.ofSequence f).map (homOfLE (le_max_left n m)) +
      y ≫ (Functor.ofSequence f).map (homOfLE (le_max_right n m)), ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hx, hy, Preadditive.add_comp, Category.assoc,
      Category.assoc, map_comp_hocolimι, map_comp_hocolimι]

name: DG.hocolim_exists_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem hocolim_exists_eq_of_comp_eq (hK : IsCompact.{0} K) {n : ℕ} (u v : K ⟶ X n)
    (h : u ≫ hocolimι X f n = v ≫ hocolimι X f n) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m), u ≫ (Functor.ofSequence f).map (homOfLE hnm) =
      v ≫ (Functor.ofSequence f).map (homOfLE hnm)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hT := hocolimTriangle_distinguished X f
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ _ hT ((u - v) ≫ Sigma.ι X n) (by
    simp only [hocolimTriangle, Triangle.mk_mor₂, Category.assoc, Preadditive.sub_comp]
    rw [← hocolimι, h, sub_self])
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (hK ℕ X).2 ψ
  simp only [hocolimTriangle, Triangle.mk_mor₁] at hψ
  rw [coproductComparison_comp_hocolimDiff, ← coproductComparison_of] at hψ
  have ha := (hK ℕ X).1 hψ.symm
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N, ∀ m, N ≤ m → a m = 0 := by
    refine ⟨(DFinsupp.support a).sup id + 1, fun m hm => ?_⟩
    by_contra hne
    have := Finset.le_sup (f := id) (DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hne)
    simp only [id] at this
    omega
  refine ⟨max n N, le_max_left n N, ?_⟩
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← Preadditive.sub_comp, ← apply_eq_of_sub_directSumShift_eq f ha,
    hN _ (le_max_right n N)]

name: DG.hocolim_exists_factor
statement:
theorem hocolim_exists_factor (hK : IsCompact.{0} K) (a : K ⟶ hocolim X f) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : K ⟶ X n), a = b ≫ hocolimι X f n
proof:
:= by
  have hT := hocolimTriangle_distinguished X f
  have h₁ : a ≫ hocolimδ X f = 0 := by
    apply hocolimDiff_shift_injective X f hK
    have := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁ _ hT
    simp only [hocolimTriangle, Triangle.mk_mor₃, Triangle.mk_mor₁] at this
    simp [this]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ _ hT a h₁
  obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := (hK ℕ X).2 c
  obtain ⟨n, b, hb⟩ := exists_coproductComparison_comp_hocolimπ X f α
  exact ⟨n, b, hc.trans hb⟩

name: DG.SendsCoproductsToProducts.down
statement:
theorem down (hH : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{max w w'} H) :
    SendsCoproductsToProducts.{w} H
proof:
:= by
  intro J Y c hc
  have h := hH (ULift.{w'} J) _ _ (isColimitCofanULift hc)
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    exact h.1 (funext fun j => congr_fun hxy j.down)
  · intro g
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.2 fun j => g j.down
    exact ⟨x, funext fun j => congr_fun hx ⟨j⟩⟩

name: DG.SendsCoproductsToProducts.ext_sigma
statement:
theorem ext_sigma {x y : H.obj (op (∐ Y))}
    (h : ∀ j, H.map (Sigma.ι Y j).op x = H.map (Sigma.ι Y j).op y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  (hH J Y _ (coproductIsCoproduct Y)).1 (funext h)

name: DG.SendsCoproductsToProducts.exists_sigma
statement:
theorem exists_sigma (g : ∀ j, H.obj (op (Y j))) :
    ∃ x : H.obj (op (∐ Y)), ∀ j, H.map (Sigma.ι Y j).op x = g j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hH J Y _ (coproductIsCoproduct Y)).2 g
  exact ⟨x, fun j => congr_fun hx j⟩

name: DG.sendsCoproductsToProducts_preadditiveYoneda
statement:
theorem sendsCoproductsToProducts_preadditiveYoneda [Preadditive C] (X : C) :
    SendsCoproductsToProducts.{w} (preadditiveYoneda.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  intro J Y c hc
  constructor
  · intro φ ψ h
    exact Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext hc _ _ fun j => congr_fun h j
  · intro g
    exact ⟨Cofan.IsColimit.desc hc g, funext fun j => Cofan.IsColimit.fac hc g j⟩

name: DG.exact_map_op
statement:
theorem exact_map_op [Preadditive C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    (H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v'}) [H.IsHomological] (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) :
    Function.Exact (H.map T.mor₂.op) (H.map T.mor₁.op)
proof:
:=
  (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact _).1 (H.map_distinguished_op_exact T hT)

name: DG.IsLocalizing.down
statement:
theorem down (hP : IsLocalizing.{max w w'} P) : IsLocalizing.{w} P where
  of_iso
proof:
:= hP.of_iso
  shift := hP.shift
  ext₂ := hP.ext₂
  coproduct _ hc h := hP.coproduct _ (isColimitCofanULift.{w, w'} hc) fun j => h j.down

name: DG.IsLocalizing.ext₃
statement:
theorem ext₃ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) (h₁ : P T.obj₁) (h₂ : P T.obj₂) :
    P T.obj₃
proof:
:=
  hP.ext₂ T.rotate (rot_of_distTriang T hT) h₂ (hP.shift _ 1 h₁)

name: DG.IsLocalizing.sigma
statement: theorem sigma {J : Type w} (Y : J → C) [HasCoproduct Y] (h : ∀ j, P (Y j)) : P (∐ Y)
proof:
:=
  hP.coproduct _ (coproductIsCoproduct Y) h

name: DG.bijective_app_of_iso
statement:
theorem bijective_app_of_iso {A B : C} (e : A ≅ B) (h : Function.Bijective (η.app (op B))) :
    Function.Bijective (η.app (op A))
proof:
:= by
  have nat : (η.app (op A)) ∘ (F.map e.hom.op) = (H.map e.hom.op) ∘ (η.app (op B)) := by
    funext x
    exact NatTrans.naturality_apply η e.hom.op x
  have h1 : Function.Bijective (F.map e.hom.op) :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (F.map e.hom.op)
  have h2 : Function.Bijective (H.map e.hom.op) :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (H.map e.hom.op)
  rw [← Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff _ h1, nat]
  exact h2.comp h

name: DG.map_op_hom_comp_app_hom
statement:
theorem map_op_hom_comp_app_hom {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (H.map f.op).hom.comp (η.app (op B)).hom = (η.app (op A)).hom.comp (F.map f.op).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp, ← AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp, η.naturality]

name: DG.bijective_app_cofan
statement:
theorem bijective_app_cofan (hF : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{w} F)
    (hH : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{w} H) {J : Type w} {Y : J → C} (c : Cofan Y)
    (hc : IsColimit c) (h : ∀ j, Function.Bijective (η.app (op (Y j)))) :
    Function.Bijective (η.app (op c.pt))
proof:
:= by
  have sq : (fun (x : H.obj (op c.pt)) (j : J) => H.map (c.inj j).op x) ∘ η.app (op c.pt) =
      (fun (g : ∀ j, F.obj (op (Y j))) (j : J) => η.app (op (Y j)) (g j)) ∘
        (fun (x : F.obj (op c.pt)) (j : J) => F.map (c.inj j).op x) := by
    funext x j
    exact (NatTrans.naturality_apply η (c.inj j).op x).symm
  have hpi : Function.Bijective
      (fun (g : ∀ j, F.obj (op (Y j))) (j : J) => η.app (op (Y j)) (g j)) :=
    ⟨fun g g' hg => funext fun j => (h j).1 (congr_fun hg j),
      fun g => ⟨fun j => ((h j).2 (g j)).choose, funext fun j => ((h j).2 (g j)).choose_spec⟩⟩
  rw [← Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff' (hH J Y c hc), sq]
  exact hpi.comp (hF J Y c hc)

name: DG.bijective_app_obj₃
statement:
theorem bijective_app_obj₃ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : Function.Surjective (η.app (op (T.obj₂⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))))
    (h₂ : Function.Bijective (η.app (op (T.obj₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))))
    (h₄ : Function.Bijective (η.app (op T.obj₂))) (h₅ : Function.Injective (η.app (op T.obj₁))) :
    Function.Bijective (η.app (op T.obj₃))
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.bijective_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_bijective_of_injective
    (F.map (-T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧').op).hom (F.map T.mor₃.op).hom (F.map T.mor₂.op).hom
    (F.map T.mor₁.op).hom
    (H.map (-T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧').op).hom (H.map T.mor₃.op).hom (H.map T.mor₂.op).hom
    (H.map T.mor₁.op).hom
    (η.app _).hom (η.app _).hom (η.app _).hom (η.app _).hom (η.app _).hom
    (map_op_hom_comp_app_hom η _) (map_op_hom_comp_app_hom η _)
    (map_op_hom_comp_app_hom η _) (map_op_hom_comp_app_hom η _)
    (exact_map_op F _ (rot_of_distTriang _ (rot_of_distTriang T hT)))
    (exact_map_op F _ (rot_of_distTriang T hT)) (exact_map_op F T hT)
    (exact_map_op H _ (rot_of_distTriang _ (rot_of_distTriang T hT)))
    (exact_map_op H _ (rot_of_distTriang T hT)) (exact_map_op H T hT)
    h₁ h₂ h₄ h₅

name: DG.isLocalizing_bijective
statement:
theorem isLocalizing_bijective [HasCoproducts.{w} C] (hF : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{w} F)
    (hH : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{w} H) :
    IsLocalizing.{w} fun Y : C => ∀ n : ℤ, Function.Bijective (η.app (op (Y⟦n⟧)))
proof:
:= by
  have shift : ∀ (X : C) (m : ℤ), (∀ n : ℤ, Function.Bijective (η.app (op (X⟦n⟧)))) →
      ∀ n : ℤ, Function.Bijective (η.app (op (X⟦m⟧⟦n⟧))) := fun X m h n =>
    bijective_app_of_iso η ((shiftFunctorAdd C m n).app X).symm (h (m + n))
  have self : ∀ X : C, (∀ n : ℤ, Function.Bijective (η.app (op (X⟦n⟧)))) →
      Function.Bijective (η.app (op X)) := fun X h =>
    bijective_app_of_iso η ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app X).symm (h 0)
  refine ⟨fun e h n => bijective_app_of_iso η ((shiftFunctor C n).mapIso e) (h n), shift, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro T hT h₁ h₃ n
    let T' := (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor (Triangle C) n).obj T
    have hT' : T' ∈ distTriang C := Triangle.shift_distinguished T hT n
    exact bijective_app_obj₃ η T'.invRotate (inv_rot_of_distTriang T' hT')
      (self _ (shift _ 1 (shift _ n h₁))).2 (self _ (shift _ 1 (shift _ (-1) (shift _ n h₃))))
      (self _ (shift _ n h₁)) (self _ (shift _ (-1) (shift _ n h₃))).1
  · intro J Y c hc h n
    let e₁ : c.pt ≅ ∐ Y := hc.coconePointUniqueUpToIso (coproductIsCoproduct Y)
    let e : c.pt⟦n⟧ ≅ ∐ fun j => (Y j)⟦n⟧ := (shiftFunctor C n).mapIso e₁ ≪≫
      (asIso (sigmaComparison (shiftFunctor C n) Y)).symm
    exact bijective_app_of_iso η e (bijective_app_cofan η hF hH _ (coproductIsCoproduct _)
      fun j => h j n)

name: DG.CellTower.isIso_of_comp_hocolimι
statement:
theorem isIso_of_comp_hocolimι [HasCoproducts.{max w v} C] (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) {X : C}
    [HasCoproduct fun n => (tower G X n).left]
    (h : hocolim (fun n => (tower G X n).left) (towerMap G X) ⟶ X)
    (hh : ∀ n, hocolimι _ (towerMap G X) n ≫ h = (tower G X n).hom) : IsIso h
proof:
:= by
  have : HasCoproducts.{0} C := hasCoproducts_shrink.{0, max w v}
  let P : ℕ → C := fun n => (tower G X n).left
  let H := hocolim P (towerMap G X)
  have hcpt : ∀ (i : ι) (m : ℤ), IsCompact.{0} ((G i)⟦m⟧) :=
    fun i m => ((hG.isCompact i).shift m).down
  
  have inj : ∀ (i : ι) (m : ℤ) (a : (G i)⟦m⟧ ⟶ H), a ≫ h = 0 → a = 0 := by
    intro i m a ha
    obtain ⟨k, b, rfl⟩ := hocolim_exists_factor P (towerMap G X) (hcpt i m) a
    have hb : b ≫ (tower G X k).hom = 0 := by rw [← hh k, ← Category.assoc, ha]
    rw [← f_comp_hocolimι, ← Category.assoc, comp_towerMap_eq_zero G b hb, Limits.zero_comp]
  
  obtain ⟨Z, g₂, g₃, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle h
  have hZ : IsZero Z := by
    refine hG.isZero_of_forall_eq_zero Z fun i m φ => ?_
    let adj : shiftFunctor C (-1 : ℤ) ⊣ shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ) :=
      (shiftEquiv C (1 : ℤ)).symm.toAdjunction
    have h₁ : φ ≫ g₃ = 0 := by
      have h₃₁ : g₃ ≫ h⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = 0 := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁ _ hT
      set ψ := (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (φ ≫ g₃)
      have hψ : ψ ≫ h = 0 := by
        apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
        rw [adj.homEquiv_naturality_right, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Category.assoc, h₃₁,
          Limits.comp_zero, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
      let e := (shiftFunctorAdd' C m (-1) (m + -1) rfl).app (G i)
      have : e.hom ≫ ψ = 0 := inj i (m + -1) _ (by rw [Category.assoc, hψ, Limits.comp_zero])
      rw [← Equiv.apply_symm_apply (adj.homEquiv _ _) (φ ≫ g₃)]
      change adj.homEquiv _ _ ψ = 0
      rw [(cancel_epi e.hom).1 (this.trans (Limits.comp_zero).symm), Adjunction.homEquiv_unit,
        Functor.map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ _ hT φ h₁
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := exists_lift_base G x
    have h₁₂ : h ≫ g₂ = 0 := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ hT
    change (y ≫ (tower G X 0).hom) ≫ g₂ = 0
    rw [← hh 0, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, h₁₂, Limits.comp_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
  exact (Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ _ hT).1 hZ

name: DG.CompactlyGenerates.forall_of_isLocalizing
statement:
theorem CompactlyGenerates.forall_of_isLocalizing [HasCoproducts.{max w v} C]
    (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) {P : ObjectProperty C} (hP : IsLocalizing.{max w v} P)
    (hGP : ∀ i, P (G i)) (X : C) : P X
proof:
:= by
  have : HasCoproducts.{0} C := hasCoproducts_shrink.{0, max w v}
  have hP₀ : IsLocalizing.{0} P := hP.down
  have hGn : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℤ), P ((G i)⟦n⟧) := fun i n => hP.shift _ n (hGP i)
  have htower : ∀ n, P (tower G X n).left := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hP.sigma _ fun c => hGn _ _
    | succ n ih =>
      exact hP.ext₃ _ (nextTriangle_distinguished G _) (hP.sigma _ fun c => hGn _ _) ih
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hocolim_exists_desc (fun n => (tower G X n).left) (towerMap G X)
    (fun n => (tower G X n).hom) (towerMap_comp_hom G)
  have := isIso_of_comp_hocolimι hG h hh
  exact hP.of_iso (asIso h).symm (hP₀.ext₃ _ (hocolimTriangle_distinguished _ _)
    (hP₀.sigma _ htower) (hP₀.sigma _ htower))

name: DG.CompactlyGenerates.isIso_of_bijective
statement:
theorem CompactlyGenerates.isIso_of_bijective [HasCoproducts.{max w v} C]
    (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) {F H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v'}} [F.IsHomological]
    [H.IsHomological] (hF : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{max w v} F)
    (hH : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{max w v} H) (η : F ⟶ H)
    (h : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℤ), Function.Bijective (η.app (op ((G i)⟦n⟧)))) : IsIso η
proof:
:= by
  have hY := hG.forall_of_isLocalizing (isLocalizing_bijective η hF hH) h
  have : ∀ Y : Cᵒᵖ, IsIso (η.app Y) := fun Y =>
    (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).2
      (bijective_app_of_iso η ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app Y.unop).symm (hY Y.unop 0))
  exact NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app η

name: DG.preadditiveYonedaNatTrans_app_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem preadditiveYonedaNatTrans_app_apply {X : C} (u : H.obj (op X)) (Y : C) (φ : Y ⟶ X) :
    (preadditiveYonedaNatTrans H u).app (op Y) φ = H.map φ.op u
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.BrownTower.map_ι_base_elt
statement:
theorem map_ι_base_elt (c : Cells G H) :
    H.map (Sigma.ι (fun c : Cells G H => (G c.1)⟦c.2.1⟧) c).op (base G hH).elt = c.2.2
proof:
:=
  (hH.exists_sigma _ fun c => c.2.2).choose_spec c

name: DG.BrownTower.map_kerMap_elt
statement: theorem map_kerMap_elt (A : Stage H) : H.map (kerMap G A).op A.elt = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hH.ext_sigma
  intro c
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← H.map_comp, ← op_comp, kerMap, Sigma.ι_comp_desc, map_zero]
  exact c.2.2.2

name: DG.BrownTower.nextTriangle_distinguished
statement: theorem nextTriangle_distinguished (A : Stage H) : nextTriangle G A ∈ distTriang C
proof:
:=
  (distinguished_cocone_triangle (kerMap G A)).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec

name: DG.BrownTower.map_mor₂_next_elt
statement:
theorem map_mor₂_next_elt (A : Stage H) :
    H.map (nextTriangle G A).mor₂.op (next G hH A).elt = A.elt
proof:
:=
  ((exact_map_op H _ (nextTriangle_distinguished G A) A.elt).1
    (map_kerMap_elt G hH A)).choose_spec

name: DG.BrownTower.map_towerMap_elt
statement:
theorem map_towerMap_elt (n : ℕ) :
    H.map (towerMap G hH n).op (tower G hH (n + 1)).elt = (tower G hH n).elt
proof:
:=
  map_mor₂_next_elt G hH _

name: DG.BrownTower.comp_towerMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem comp_towerMap_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {i : ι} {m : ℤ} (ψ : (G i)⟦m⟧ ⟶ (tower G hH n).obj)
    (hψ : H.map ψ.op (tower G hH n).elt = 0) : ψ ≫ towerMap G hH n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ψ = Sigma.ι (fun c : KerCells G H (tower G hH n) => (G c.1)⟦c.2.1⟧) ⟨i, m, ψ, hψ⟩ ≫
      kerMap G (tower G hH n) := by
    simp [kerMap]
  rw [h, Category.assoc]
  change _ ≫ (nextTriangle G _).mor₁ ≫ (nextTriangle G _).mor₂ = 0
  rw [comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ (nextTriangle_distinguished G _), Limits.comp_zero]

name: DG.CompactlyGenerates.exists_bijective
statement:
theorem CompactlyGenerates.exists_bijective [HasCoproducts.{max w v} C]
    (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) {H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}} [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{max w v} H) :
    ∃ (X : C) (u : H.obj (op X)), ∀ Y : C,
      Function.Bijective fun φ : Y ⟶ X => H.map φ.op u
proof:
:= by
  have : HasCoproducts.{0} C := hasCoproducts_shrink.{0, max w v}
  have hH₀ : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{0} H := hH.down
  let P : ℕ → C := fun n => (tower G hH n).obj
  let f := towerMap G hH
  have hT := hocolimTriangle_distinguished P f
  
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hH₀.exists_sigma P fun n => (tower G hH n).elt
  have hv₀ : H.map (hocolimDiff P f).op v = 0 := by
    apply hH₀.ext_sigma
    intro n
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← H.map_comp, ← op_comp, ι_hocolimDiff,
      show ∀ {A B : C} (a b : A ⟶ B), (a - b).op = a.op - b.op from fun _ _ => rfl,
      H.map_sub, map_zero]
    change (H.map _).hom v - (H.map _).hom v = 0
    rw [op_comp, H.map_comp, AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    erw [hv, hv]
    exact (map_towerMap_elt G hH n).symm
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : H.obj (op (hocolim P f)), H.map (hocolimπ P f).op u = v :=
    (exact_map_op H _ hT v).1 hv₀
  have hu' : ∀ n, H.map (hocolimι P f n).op u = (tower G hH n).elt := by
    intro n
    rw [hocolimι, op_comp, H.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hu]
    exact hv n
  
  let η := preadditiveYonedaNatTrans H u
  have hgen : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℤ), Function.Bijective (η.app (op ((G i)⟦n⟧))) := by
    intro i n
    constructor
    · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro φ hφ
      change H.map φ.op u = 0 at hφ
      obtain ⟨k, b, rfl⟩ :=
        hocolim_exists_factor P f ((hG.isCompact i).shift n).down φ
      rw [op_comp, H.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hu'] at hφ
      change b ≫ hocolimι P f k = 0
      rw [← f_comp_hocolimι, ← Category.assoc, comp_towerMap_eq_zero G hH b hφ,
        Limits.zero_comp]
    · intro x
      refine ⟨Sigma.ι (fun c : Cells G H => (G c.1)⟦c.2.1⟧) ⟨i, n, x⟩ ≫ hocolimι P f 0, ?_⟩
      change H.map (_ ≫ _).op u = x
      rw [op_comp, H.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
      erw [hu' 0]
      exact map_ι_base_elt G hH _
  have := hG.isIso_of_bijective (sendsCoproductsToProducts_preadditiveYoneda _) hH η hgen
  exact ⟨_, u, fun Y => (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (η.app (op Y))).1 inferInstance⟩

name: DG.CompactlyGenerates.exists_iso_preadditiveYoneda
statement:
theorem CompactlyGenerates.exists_iso_preadditiveYoneda [HasCoproducts.{max w v} C]
    (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) {H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}} [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{max w v} H) :
    ∃ X : C, Nonempty (preadditiveYoneda.obj X ≅ H)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, u, hu⟩ := hG.exists_bijective hH
  have : ∀ Y, IsIso ((preadditiveYonedaNatTrans H u).app Y) := fun Y =>
    (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).2 (hu Y.unop)
  have : IsIso (preadditiveYonedaNatTrans H u) := NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _
  exact ⟨X, ⟨asIso (preadditiveYonedaNatTrans H u)⟩⟩

name: DG.CompactlyGenerates.isRepresentable
statement:
theorem CompactlyGenerates.isRepresentable [HasCoproducts.{max w v} C]
    (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) {H : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}} [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : SendsCoproductsToProducts.{max w v} H) :
    (H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat).IsRepresentable
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, u, hu⟩ := hG.exists_bijective hH
  exact Functor.RepresentableBy.isRepresentable
    { homEquiv := Equiv.ofBijective _ (hu _)
      homEquiv_comp := fun f g => by
        change H.map (f ≫ g).op u = H.map f.op (H.map g.op u)
        rw [op_comp, H.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] }

name: DG.sendsCoproductsToProducts_op_comp_preadditiveYoneda
statement:
theorem sendsCoproductsToProducts_op_comp_preadditiveYoneda [Preadditive D] (F : C ⥤ D)
    (hF : ∀ J : Type w', PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) F) (d : D) :
    SendsCoproductsToProducts.{w'} (F.op ⋙ preadditiveYoneda.obj d)
proof:
:= by
  intro J Y c hc
  have hc' : IsColimit (F.mapCocone c) := isColimitOfPreserves F hc
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    exact hc'.hom_ext fun j => congr_fun hxy j.as
  · intro g
    refine ⟨hc'.desc (Cocone.mk d (Discrete.natTrans fun j => g j.as)), funext fun j => ?_⟩
    exact hc'.fac (Cocone.mk d (Discrete.natTrans fun j => g j.as)) ⟨j⟩

name: DG.CompactlyGenerates.isLeftAdjoint
statement:
theorem CompactlyGenerates.isLeftAdjoint [HasCoproducts.{max w v} C]
    (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (hF : ∀ J : Type (max w v), PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) F) :
    F.IsLeftAdjoint
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ d : D, ∃ (X : C) (u : F.obj X ⟶ d), ∀ Y : C,
      Function.Bijective fun φ : Y ⟶ X => F.map φ ≫ u := fun d =>
    hG.exists_bijective (H := F.op ⋙ preadditiveYoneda.obj d)
      (sendsCoproductsToProducts_op_comp_preadditiveYoneda F hF d)
  choose X u hu using h
  let e : ∀ (Y : C) (d : D), (F.obj Y ⟶ d) ≃ (Y ⟶ X d) := fun Y d =>
    (Equiv.ofBijective _ (hu d Y)).symm
  have he : ∀ (Y' Y : C) (d : D) (f : Y' ⟶ Y) (g : F.obj Y ⟶ d),
      e Y' d (F.map f ≫ g) = f ≫ e Y d g := by
    intro Y' Y d f g
    apply (Equiv.ofBijective _ (hu d Y')).injective
    change F.map (e Y' d (F.map f ≫ g)) ≫ u d = F.map (f ≫ e Y d g) ≫ u d
    rw [F.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    change (Equiv.ofBijective _ (hu d Y')) ((Equiv.ofBijective _ (hu d Y')).symm _) =
      F.map f ≫ (Equiv.ofBijective _ (hu d Y)) ((Equiv.ofBijective _ (hu d Y)).symm _)
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact ⟨_, ⟨Adjunction.adjunctionOfEquivRight e he⟩⟩

name: DG.Bar.koszulSign_add_one
statement: theorem koszulSign_add_one (n : ℤ) : koszulSign (n + 1) = -koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  Int.negOnePow_succ n

name: DG.Bar.koszulSign_sub_one
statement: theorem koszulSign_sub_one (n : ℤ) : koszulSign (n - 1) = -koszulSign n
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_sub, Int.negOnePow_one, mul_neg, mul_one]

name: DG.Bar.koszulSign_one
statement: theorem koszulSign_one : koszulSign 1 = -1
proof: := Int.negOnePow_one

name: DG.Bar.mulShift_tmul
statement:
theorem mulShift_tmul (a b : A) :
    mulShift (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] Shift.mk 1 b) = Shift.mk 1 (a * b)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.susp_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem susp_tmul (a : A) (x : X) : susp A X (a ⊗ₜ x) = Shift.mk 1 a ⊗ₜ x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.desusp_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem desusp_tmul (a : A) (x : X) : desusp A X (Shift.mk 1 a ⊗ₜ x) = a ⊗ₜ x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.desusp_susp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem desusp_susp (y : A ⊗[ℤ] X) : desusp A X (susp A X y) = y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a x => rfl
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hy']

name: DG.Bar.susp_desusp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem susp_desusp (y : Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X) : susp A X (desusp A X y) = y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a x => rfl
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hy']

name: DG.Bar.stepHomAux_tmul
statement:
theorem stepHomAux_tmul (f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X) (a₀ a₁ : A) (x : X) :
    stepHomAux f (a₀ ⊗ₜ (Shift.mk 1 a₁ ⊗ₜ x)) =
      Shift.mk 1 (a₀ * a₁) ⊗ₜ x - Shift.mk 1 a₀ ⊗ₜ f (a₁ ⊗ₜ x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.stepHom_tmul_eq
statement:
theorem stepHom_tmul_eq (f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X) {i : ℤ} {a₀ : A} (ha₀ : a₀ ∈ grading i)
    (y : Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X) : stepHom f (a₀ ⊗ₜ y) = koszulSign i • stepHomAux f (a₀ ⊗ₜ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stepHom, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tensorMap_tmul, gradeInvolution_of_mem ha₀,
    AddMonoidHom.id_apply, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, ← smul_tmul', map_zsmul]

name: DG.Bar.stepHom_tmul
statement:
theorem stepHom_tmul (f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X) {i : ℤ} {a₀ : A} (ha₀ : a₀ ∈ grading i) (a₁ : A)
    (x : X) : stepHom f (a₀ ⊗ₜ (Shift.mk 1 a₁ ⊗ₜ x)) =
      koszulSign i • (Shift.mk 1 (a₀ * a₁) ⊗ₜ x - Shift.mk 1 a₀ ⊗ₜ f (a₁ ⊗ₜ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stepHom_tmul_eq f ha₀, stepHomAux_tmul]

name: DG.Bar.induction_on₃
statement:
theorem induction_on₃ {P : A ⊗[ℤ] (Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X) → Prop} (y : A ⊗[ℤ] (Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X))
    (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ {i j l : ℤ} {a₀ a₁ : A} {x : X}, a₀ ∈ grading i → a₁ ∈ grading j →
      x ∈ grading l → P (a₀ ⊗ₜ (Shift.mk 1 a₁ ⊗ₜ x)))
    (add : ∀ y y', P y → P y' → P (y + y')) : P y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add y y' hy hy' => exact add y y' hy hy'
  | tmul a₀ z =>
    induction z using tensor_induction_on with
    | zero => simpa using zero
    | add z z' hz hz' => rw [tmul_add]; exact add _ _ hz hz'
    | tmul s x =>
      induction a₀ using induction_on with
      | h_zero => simpa using zero
      | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_tmul]; exact add _ _ ha ha'
      | h_homogeneous a₀ => exact tmul a₀.2 (Shift.unmk_mem_grading s.2) x.2

name: DG.Bar.IsAction.step_d
statement:
theorem IsAction.step_d {f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X} (hf : IsAction A X f)
    (y : A ⊗[ℤ] (Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X)) : stepHom f (d y) = d (stepHom f y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on₃ with
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [d_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, d_add]
  | @tmul i j l a₀ a₁ x ha₀ ha₁ hx =>
    have hs : Shift.mk 1 a₁ ∈ grading (j - 1) := Shift.mk_mem_grading ha₁
    have hs0 : Shift.mk 1 (a₀ * a₁) ∈ grading (i + j - 1) :=
      Shift.mk_mem_grading (mul_mem_grading ha₀ ha₁)
    have hs1 : Shift.mk 1 a₀ ∈ grading (i - 1) := Shift.mk_mem_grading ha₀
    have hfd := hf.map_d (a₁ ⊗ₜ x)
    rw [d_tmul_of_mem ha₁] at hfd
    rw [d_tmul_of_mem ha₀, d_tmul_of_mem hs, stepHom_tmul f ha₀, map_add,
      stepHom_tmul f (d_mem ha₀),
      Shift.d_mk, d_units_smul, d_sub, d_tmul_of_mem hs0, d_tmul_of_mem hs1, Shift.d_mk,
      Shift.d_mk, d_mul ha₀, ← hfd]
    simp only [Units.smul_def, tmul_add, tmul_smul, ← smul_tmul', map_add, map_zsmul,
      add_tmul, stepHom_tmul f ha₀, smul_add, smul_sub]
    simp only [smul_smul, koszulSign_sub_one, koszulSign_add, koszulSign_one]
    rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (koszulSign i) with hi | hi <;>
    rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (koszulSign j) with hj | hj <;>
    simp only [hi, hj, Units.val_one, Units.val_neg, one_smul, neg_smul, mul_one,
      mul_neg, neg_neg] <;> abel

name: DG.Bar.IsAction.step_mem
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_mem_grading_of_tmul ((stepHom f).comp (tmulAddHom A _ a)) i
    (fun {j l s x} hs hx => by
      obtain ⟨a₁, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective s
      have ha₁ : a₁ ∈ grading (j + 1) := Shift.unmk_mem_grading hs
      rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tmulAddHom_apply, stepHom_tmul f ha, Units.smul_def]
      refine zsmul_mem (sub_mem ?_ ?_) _
      · have := tmul_mem_grading (Shift.mk_mem_grading (n := 1) (mul_mem_grading ha ha₁)) hx
        convert this using 2; ring
      · have := tmul_mem_grading (Shift.mk_mem_grading (n := 1) ha) (hf.mem ha₁ hx)
        convert this using 2; ring) hy
  rwa [add_comm k i] at h

name: DG.Bar.IsAction.step_assoc
statement:
theorem IsAction.step_assoc {f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X} (hf : IsAction A X f) (a a' : A)
    (z : Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X) : stepHom f (a ⊗ₜ stepHom f (a' ⊗ₜ z)) = stepHom f ((a * a') ⊗ₜ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a b ha hb => rw [add_tmul, map_add, ha, hb, add_mul, add_tmul, map_add]
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i i
    induction a' using induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add a' b ha' hb => rw [add_tmul, map_add, tmul_add, map_add, ha', hb, mul_add, add_tmul,
        map_add]
    | h_homogeneous a' =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := a'
      rename_i i'
      induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | add z z' hz hz' => rw [tmul_add, map_add, tmul_add, map_add, hz, hz', tmul_add, map_add]
      | tmul s x =>
        obtain ⟨a₁, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective s
        simp only [stepHom_tmul f ha', stepHom_tmul f (mul_mem_grading ha ha'), Units.smul_def,
          tmul_smul, tmul_sub, map_zsmul, map_sub, stepHom_tmul f ha, hf.assoc, mul_assoc,
          smul_sub, smul_smul, koszulSign_add]
        rw [mul_comm (koszulSign i' : ℤ), Units.val_mul]
        abel

name: DG.Bar.IsAction.step
statement:
theorem IsAction.step {f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X} (hf : IsAction A X f) :
    IsAction A (Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X) (stepHom f) where
  mem ha hy
proof:
:= hf.step_mem ha hy
  map_d := hf.step_d
  assoc := hf.step_assoc

name: DG.Bar.desusp_stepHom_smul
statement:
theorem desusp_stepHom_smul (f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X) {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (y : A ⊗[ℤ] (Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X)) :
    desusp A X (stepHom f (a • y)) = koszulSign i • (a • desusp A X (stepHom f y))
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on₃ with
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, map_add, smul_add,
      smul_add]
  | @tmul i₀ j l a₀ a₁ x ha₀ _ _ =>
    rw [smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, stepHom_tmul f (mul_mem_grading ha ha₀), stepHom_tmul f ha₀]
    simp only [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, map_sub, desusp_tmul, smul_sub, smul_comm a (_ : ℤ),
      smul_smul, koszulSign_add, Units.val_mul]
    simp only [smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: DG.Bar.IsAction.apply_desusp_stepHom
statement:
theorem IsAction.apply_desusp_stepHom {f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X} (hf : IsAction A X f)
    (y : A ⊗[ℤ] (Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X)) : f (desusp A X (stepHom f y)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on₃ with
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hy, hy', add_zero]
  | tmul ha₀ _ _ =>
    rw [stepHom_tmul _ ha₀, map_units_zsmul, map_units_zsmul, map_sub, map_sub, desusp_tmul,
      desusp_tmul, hf.assoc, sub_self, smul_zero]

name: DG.Bar.desusp_stepHom_one_tmul
statement:
theorem desusp_stepHom_one_tmul (f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X) (y : A ⊗[ℤ] X) :
    desusp A X (stepHom f (1 ⊗ₜ susp A X y)) = y - 1 ⊗ₜ f y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add, tmul_add, map_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, tmul_add]; abel
  | tmul a x =>
    rw [susp_tmul, stepHom_tmul f one_mem_grading, koszulSign_zero, one_smul, map_sub, desusp_tmul,
      desusp_tmul, one_mul]

name: DG.Bar.act_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem act_tmul (a : A) (m : M) : act A M (a ⊗ₜ m) = a • m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.act_smul
statement: theorem act_smul (a : A) (y : A ⊗[ℤ] M) : act A M (a • y) = a • act A M y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, hy, hy', smul_add]
  | tmul a₀ m => rw [smul_tmul', act_tmul, act_tmul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul]

name: DG.Bar.isAction_act
statement:
theorem isAction_act : IsAction A M (act A M) where
  mem ha hm
proof:
:= smul_mem_grading ha hm
  map_d y := by
    induction y using tensor_induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [d_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, d_add]
    | tmul a m =>
      rw [d_tmul_of_mem a.2, map_add, map_units_zsmul, act_tmul, act_tmul, act_tmul, d_smul a.2]
  assoc a a' m := by simp [mul_smul]

name: DG.Bar.desusp_mem
statement:
theorem desusp_mem {k : ℤ} {y : Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X} (hy : y ∈ grading k) :
    desusp A X y ∈ grading (k + 1)
proof:
:=
  map_mem_grading_of_tmul (desusp A X) 1 (fun {i j s x} hs hx => by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective s
    have h := tmul_mem_grading (Shift.unmk_mem_grading hs) hx
    change a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] x ∈ grading (i + 1 + j) at h
    rw [desusp_tmul]
    convert h using 2; ring) hy

name: DG.Bar.susp_mem
statement:
theorem susp_mem {k : ℤ} {y : A ⊗[ℤ] X} (hy : y ∈ grading k) :
    susp A X y ∈ grading (k - 1)
proof:
:=
  map_mem_grading_of_tmul (susp A X) (-1) (fun {i j a x} ha hx => by
    have := tmul_mem_grading (Shift.mk_mem_grading (n := 1) ha) hx
    rw [susp_tmul]
    convert this using 2; ring) hy

name: DG.Bar.desusp_d
statement: theorem desusp_d (y : Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X) : desusp A X (d y) = -d (desusp A X y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [d_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, d_add, neg_add]
  | tmul s x =>
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := s
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective s
    have ha : a ∈ grading (_ + 1) := Shift.unmk_mem_grading hs
    rw [d_tmul_of_mem hs, desusp_tmul, d_tmul_of_mem ha, Shift.d_mk, Shift.mk_units_smul,
      koszulSign_one]
    simp only [Units.smul_def, map_add, map_zsmul, desusp_tmul, Units.val_neg,
      Units.val_one, neg_smul, one_smul, koszulSign_add_one, neg_tmul, map_neg]
    abel

name: DG.Bar.susp_d
statement: theorem susp_d (y : A ⊗[ℤ] X) : susp A X (d y) = -d (susp A X y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (susp A X) (desusp_d (susp A X y))
  rw [susp_desusp, desusp_susp, map_neg] at h
  rw [h, neg_neg]

name: DG.Bar.IsAction.map_mem
statement:
theorem IsAction.map_mem {f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X} (hf : IsAction A X f) {k : ℤ} {y : A ⊗[ℤ] X}
    (hy : y ∈ grading k) : f y ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  simpa using map_mem_grading_of_tmul f 0 (fun ha hx => by simpa using hf.mem ha hx) hy

name: DG.Bar.homotopy_identity_zero
statement:
theorem homotopy_identity_zero (f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X) (y : A ⊗[ℤ] X) :
    desusp A X (stepHom f (1 ⊗ₜ susp A X y)) + 1 ⊗ₜ f y = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [desusp_stepHom_one_tmul, sub_add_cancel]

name: DG.Bar.homotopy_identity_succ
statement:
theorem homotopy_identity_succ (f : A ⊗[ℤ] X →+ X) (y : A ⊗[ℤ] X)
    (z : A ⊗[ℤ] (Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] X)) :
    d ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ susp A X y) +
      desusp _ _ (stepHom (stepHom f) (1 ⊗ₜ susp _ _ z)) +
        (1 : A) ⊗ₜ susp A X (d y + desusp A X (stepHom f z)) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [desusp_stepHom_one_tmul, map_add, susp_desusp, tmul_add, d_tmul_of_mem one_mem_grading,
    d_one, zero_tmul, zero_add, koszulSign_zero, one_smul, susp_d, tmul_neg]
  abel

name: DG.Bar.barComp_apply
statement:
theorem barComp_apply (n : ℕ) (y : Term A M (n + 1)) :
    barComp n y = desusp A (T A M n) (stepHom (level A M n).act y)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.barComp_mem
statement:
theorem barComp_mem (n : ℕ) {k : ℤ} {y : Term A M (n + 1)} (hy : y ∈ grading k) :
    barComp n y ∈ grading (k + 1)
proof:
:=
  desusp_mem ((level A M (n + 1)).isAction.map_mem hy)

name: DG.Bar.barComp_d
statement: theorem barComp_d (n : ℕ) (y : Term A M (n + 1)) : barComp n (d y) = -d (barComp n y)
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrArg (desusp A (T A M n)) ((level A M n).isAction.step_d y)).trans (desusp_d _)

name: DG.Bar.barComp_barComp
statement: theorem barComp_barComp (n : ℕ) (y : Term A M (n + 2)) : barComp n (barComp (n + 1) y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [barComp_apply, barComp_apply]
  exact (congrArg _ ((level A M (n + 1)).isAction.apply_desusp_stepHom y)).trans (map_zero _)

name: DG.Bar.barComp_smul
statement:
theorem barComp_smul (n : ℕ) {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (y : Term A M (n + 1)) :
    barComp n (a • y) = koszulSign i • (a • barComp n y)
proof:
:=
  desusp_stepHom_smul _ ha y

name: DG.DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_contraction
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_contraction (p : P →ᵈᵍ[A] M) (η : M →+ P)
    (hη : ∀ {k : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading k → η m ∈ grading k) (hηd : ∀ m, η (d m) = d (η m))
    (h : P →+ P) (hh : ∀ {k : ℤ} {x : P}, x ∈ grading k → h x ∈ grading (k - 1))
    (hid : ∀ x, d (h x) + h (d x) + η (p x) = x) (hpη : ∀ m, p (η m) = m) : p.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:=
  fun k => by
  constructor
  · rw [cohomology.map_injective_iff]
    intro x hx hdx hpx
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hpx
    refine mem_coboundaries.mpr ⟨h x + η m, add_mem (hh hx) (hη hm), ?_⟩
    have hx' := hid x
    rw [hdx, map_zero, add_zero] at hx'
    rw [d_add, ← hηd, hdm, hx']
  · rw [cohomology.map_surjective_iff]
    intro m hm hdm
    exact ⟨η m, hη hm, by rw [← hηd, hdm, map_zero], by rw [hpη, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: DG.IsKProjective.of_filtration
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_filtration (hQ : ∀ i, IsKProjective.{w} A (Q i)) :
    IsKProjective.{w} A P
proof:
:= by
  intro N _ _ _ _ hN f
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Cochain.exists_of_filtration hF hex
    (fun i => {h : Cochain A (F i) N (-1) |
      Cochain.ofHom (f.comp (F i).subtype) = δ (-1) 0 h})
    ⟨0, Cochain.ext fun x => by simp [h0 x x.2]⟩
    (fun i h hh => (σ i).exists_extension (hQ i N hN) (f.comp (F (i + 1)).subtype) h hh)
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨h, Cochain.ext fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex x
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A (F i) N 0 => z ⟨x, hi⟩) (hh i)
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A (F i) N 0 => z ⟨x, hi⟩)
    (δ_ofHom_comp (F i).subtype h 0)
  simp only [Cochain.ofHom_apply, DGModuleHom.comp_apply, DGSubmodule.subtype_apply,
    Cochain.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [Cochain.ofHom_apply, h1, h2]

name: DG.IsGradedProjective.of_filtration
statement:
theorem IsGradedProjective.of_filtration (hQ : ∀ i, IsGradedProjective.{w} A (Q i)) :
    IsGradedProjective.{w} A P
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p hp f
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Cochain.exists_of_filtration hF hex
    (fun i => {g : Cochain A (F i) M 0 | (Cochain.ofHom p).comp g (zero_add 0) =
      f.comp (Cochain.ofHom (F i).subtype) (zero_add 0)})
    ⟨0, Cochain.ext fun x => by simp [h0 x x.2]⟩
    (fun i g hg => by
      obtain ⟨gQ, hgQ⟩ := hQ i M N p hp
        ((f.comp (Cochain.ofHom (F (i + 1)).subtype) (zero_add 0)).comp (σ i).s (zero_add 0))
      refine ⟨g.comp (σ i).r (zero_add 0) + gQ.comp (Cochain.ofHom (π i)) (zero_add 0),
        Cochain.ext fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
      · have h1 := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A (F i) N 0 => c ((σ i).r x)) hg
        have h2 := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A _ N 0 => c (π i x)) hgQ
        have h3 := congrArg (fun y : F (i + 1) => (y : P)) ((σ i).i_r_add_s_p x)
        simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, DGSubmodule.subtype_apply] at h1 h2
        simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, Cochain.add_apply, map_add, h1, h2,
          DGSubmodule.subtype_apply]
        simp only [DGSubmodule.coe_add, DGSubmodule.coe_inclusion_apply] at h3
        rw [← map_add, h3]
      · simp [(σ i).r_i, (σ i).p_i])
  refine ⟨g, Cochain.ext fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex x
  exact congrArg (fun c : Cochain A (F i) N 0 => c ⟨x, hi⟩) (hg i)

name: DG.Bar.ext
statement: theorem ext {x y : Bar A M} (h : ∀ n, coeff n x = coeff n y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  DFinsupp.ext h

name: DG.Bar.coeff_of_same
statement: theorem coeff_of_same (n : ℕ) (y : Term A M n) : coeff n (of A M n y) = y
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_eq_same n y

name: DG.Bar.coeff_of_ne
statement: theorem coeff_of_ne {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≠ n) (y : Term A M m) : coeff n (of A M m y) = 0
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne m n y h.symm

name: DG.Bar.coeff_smul
statement: theorem coeff_smul (n : ℕ) (a : A) (x : Bar A M) : coeff n (a • x) = a • coeff n x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.coeff_barD
statement: theorem coeff_barD (x : Bar A M) (n : ℕ) : coeff n (barD x) = barComp n (coeff (n + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [barD]
  | of m y =>
    change coeff n (barD (of A M m y)) = barComp n (coeff (n + 1) (of A M m y))
    cases m with
    | zero =>
      rw [coeff_of_ne (by omega), map_zero]
      exact congrArg (coeff n) (DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ 0 y)
    | succ m =>
      have h : barD (of A M (m + 1) y) = of A M m (barComp m y) :=
        DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ (m + 1) y
      rw [h]
      by_cases hmn : m = n
      · subst hmn
        rw [coeff_of_same, coeff_of_same]
      · rw [coeff_of_ne hmn, coeff_of_ne (by omega), map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Bar.coeff_intD
statement: theorem coeff_intD (x : Bar A M) (n : ℕ) : coeff n (intD x) = d (coeff n x)
proof:
:=
  DG.DirectSum.d_apply _ x n

name: DG.Bar.coeff_totalD
statement:
theorem coeff_totalD (x : Bar A M) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (totalD x) = d (coeff n x) + barComp n (coeff (n + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalD, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, map_add, coeff_barD, coeff_intD]

name: DG.Bar.totalD_totalD
statement: theorem totalD_totalD (x : Bar A M) : totalD (totalD x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ext fun n => ?_
  rw [coeff_totalD, coeff_totalD, coeff_totalD, map_zero, d_add, d_d, map_add, barComp_barComp,
    barComp_d]
  abel

name: DG.Bar.barD_mem
proof:
:= fun n => by
  change coeff n (barD x) ∈ _
  rw [coeff_barD]
  exact barComp_mem n (hx (n + 1))

name: DG.Bar.totalD_mem
proof:
:=
  add_mem (d_mem (M := ⨁ n, Term A M n) hx) (barD_mem hx)

name: DG.Bar.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {k : ℤ} {x : Bar A M} : x ∈ grading k ↔ ∀ n, coeff n x ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.Bar.coeff_d
statement:
theorem coeff_d (x : Bar A M) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (d x) = d (coeff n x) + barComp n (coeff (n + 1) x)
proof:
:=
  coeff_totalD x n

name: DG.Bar.of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem of_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {n : ℕ} {y : Term A M n} (hy : y ∈ grading k) :
    of A M n y ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  DG.DirectSum.of_mem_grading _ n hy

name: DG.Bar.coeff_zero_d
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_d (x : Bar A M) :
    act A M (coeff 0 (d x)) = d (act A M (coeff 0 x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_d, map_add, barComp_apply]
  have h1 : act A M (d (coeff 0 x)) = d (act A M (coeff 0 x)) := (isAction_act A M).map_d _
  have h2 : act A M (desusp A M (stepHom (act A M) (coeff 1 x))) = 0 :=
    (isAction_act A M).apply_desusp_stepHom _
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2).trans (add_zero _)

name: DG.Bar.augmentation_apply
statement: theorem augmentation_apply (x : Bar A M) : augmentation A M x = act A M (coeff 0 x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.unit_apply
statement: theorem unit_apply (m : M) : unit A M m = of A M 0 (1 ⊗ₜ m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.augmentation_unit
statement: theorem augmentation_unit (m : M) : augmentation A M (unit A M m) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [augmentation_apply, unit_apply, coeff_of_same, act_tmul, one_smul]

name: DG.Bar.unit_mem
statement: theorem unit_mem {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) : unit A M m ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  rw [unit_apply]
  exact of_mem_grading (by simpa using tmul_mem_grading (one_mem_grading (A := A)) hm)

name: DG.Bar.d_one_tmul
statement:
theorem d_one_tmul {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [DGAddCommGroup X] (x : X) :
    d ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] x) = 1 ⊗ₜ d x
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_tmul_of_mem one_mem_grading, d_one, zero_tmul, zero_add, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.Bar.unit_d
statement: theorem unit_d (m : M) : unit A M (d m) = d (unit A M m)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext fun n => ?_
  rw [coeff_d, unit_apply, unit_apply]
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [coeff_of_same, coeff_of_same, coeff_of_ne (by omega), map_zero, add_zero, d_one_tmul]
    rfl
  · rw [coeff_of_ne (by omega), coeff_of_ne (by omega), coeff_of_ne (by omega), map_zero,
      map_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.Bar.coeff_homotopy_zero
statement: theorem coeff_homotopy_zero (x : Bar A M) : coeff 0 (homotopy x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m y =>
    change coeff 0 (homotopy (of A M m y)) = 0
    have h : homotopy (of A M m y) = of A M (m + 1) (1 ⊗ₜ susp A (T A M m) y) :=
      DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ m y
    rw [h, coeff_of_ne (by omega)]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.Bar.coeff_homotopy_succ
statement:
theorem coeff_homotopy_succ (x : Bar A M) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff (n + 1) (homotopy x) = 1 ⊗ₜ susp A (T A M n) (coeff n x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m y =>
    change coeff (n + 1) (homotopy (of A M m y)) = 1 ⊗ₜ susp A (T A M n) (coeff n (of A M m y))
    have h : homotopy (of A M m y) = of A M (m + 1) (1 ⊗ₜ susp A (T A M m) y) :=
      DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ m y
    rw [h]
    by_cases hmn : m = n
    · subst hmn
      rw [coeff_of_same, coeff_of_same]
    · rw [coeff_of_ne (by omega), coeff_of_ne hmn, map_zero, tmul_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, tmul_add]

name: DG.Bar.homotopy_mem
statement:
theorem homotopy_mem {k : ℤ} {x : Bar A M} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    homotopy x ∈ grading (k - 1)
proof:
:= fun n => by
  change coeff n (homotopy x) ∈ _
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [coeff_homotopy_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [coeff_homotopy_succ]
    change (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] susp A (T A M n) (coeff n x) ∈
      grading (M := A ⊗[ℤ] (Shift 1 A ⊗[ℤ] T A M n)) (k - 1)
    convert tmul_mem_grading (one_mem_grading (A := A)) (susp_mem (hx n)) using 1
    · simp only [zero_add]
    · rfl

name: DG.Bar.d_homotopy_add_homotopy_d
statement:
theorem d_homotopy_add_homotopy_d (x : Bar A M) :
    d (homotopy x) + homotopy (d x) + unit A M (augmentation A M x) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ext fun n => ?_
  rw [map_add, map_add, coeff_d, unit_apply, augmentation_apply]
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [coeff_homotopy_zero, coeff_homotopy_zero, coeff_homotopy_succ, coeff_of_same, map_zero,
      zero_add, add_zero, barComp_apply]
    exact homotopy_identity_zero _ _
  · rw [coeff_homotopy_succ, coeff_homotopy_succ, coeff_homotopy_succ, coeff_of_ne (by omega),
      coeff_d, add_zero, barComp_apply, barComp_apply]
    exact homotopy_identity_succ _ _ _

name: DG.Bar.surjective_augmentation
statement: theorem surjective_augmentation : Function.Surjective (augmentation A M)
proof:
:=
  fun m => ⟨unit A M m, augmentation_unit m⟩

name: DG.Bar.isQuasiIso_augmentation
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_augmentation : (augmentation A M).IsQuasiIso
proof:
:=
  (augmentation A M).isQuasiIso_of_contraction (unit A M) unit_mem unit_d homotopy homotopy_mem
    d_homotopy_add_homotopy_d augmentation_unit

name: DG.Bar.coeff_mem
statement: theorem coeff_mem {k : ℤ} {x : Bar A M} (hx : x ∈ grading k) (n : ℕ) : coeff n x ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  hx n

name: DG.Bar.coe_decompose_coeff
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_coeff (x : Bar A M) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := Term A M n)) (coeff n x) k : Term A M n) =
      coeff n (decompose (grading (M := Bar A M)) x k : Bar A M)
proof:
:=
  coe_decompose_map_of_map_mem (coeff n) (fun hx => coeff_mem hx n) x k

name: DG.Bar.mem_filtration_iff
statement:
theorem mem_filtration_iff {n : ℕ} {x : Bar A M} :
    x ∈ filtration A M n ↔ ∀ k, n ≤ k → coeff k x = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.Bar.filtration_mono
statement: theorem filtration_mono : Monotone (filtration A M)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hmn _ hx k hk => hx k (hmn.trans hk)

name: DG.Bar.eq_zero_of_mem_filtration_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_mem_filtration_zero (x : Bar A M) (hx : x ∈ filtration A M 0) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  ext fun n => (hx n (Nat.zero_le n)).trans (map_zero _).symm

name: DG.Bar.of_mem_filtration
statement: theorem of_mem_filtration {n : ℕ} (y : Term A M n) : of A M n y ∈ filtration A M (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hk => coeff_of_ne (by omega) y

name: DG.Bar.exists_mem_filtration
statement: theorem exists_mem_filtration (x : Bar A M) : ∃ n, x ∈ filtration A M n
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, zero_mem _⟩
  | of n y => exact ⟨n + 1, of_mem_filtration y⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨max i j, add_mem (filtration_mono (le_max_left i j) hi)
      (filtration_mono (le_max_right i j) hj)⟩

name: DG.Bar.filtrationπ_apply
statement:
theorem filtrationπ_apply (n : ℕ) (x : filtration A M (n + 1)) :
    filtrationπ A M n x = coeff n (x : Bar A M)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Bar.filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : filtration A M (n + 1)) :
    filtrationπ A M n x = 0 ↔ (x : Bar A M) ∈ filtration A M n
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtrationπ_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h k hk
    rcases hk.lt_or_eq with hk | rfl
    · exact x.2 k hk
    · exact h
  · intro h
    exact h n le_rfl

name: DG.Bar.filtrationπ_filtrationSection
statement:
theorem filtrationπ_filtrationSection (n : ℕ) (y : Term A M n) :
    filtrationπ A M n (filtrationSection A M n y) = y
proof:
:=
  coeff_of_same n y

name: DG.Bar.isKProjective
statement:
theorem isKProjective (h : ∀ n, IsKProjective.{w} A (Term A M n)) :
    IsKProjective.{w} A (Bar A M)
proof:
:=
  IsKProjective.of_filtration filtration_mono eq_zero_of_mem_filtration_zero exists_mem_filtration
    (gradedSplitting A M) h

name: DG.Bar.hasLiftingProperty
statement:
theorem hasLiftingProperty (h : ∀ n, HasLiftingProperty.{w} A (Term A M n)) :
    HasLiftingProperty.{w} A (Bar A M)
proof:
:=
  (isKProjective fun n => (h n).isKProjective).hasLiftingProperty
    (IsGradedProjective.of_filtration filtration_mono eq_zero_of_mem_filtration_zero
      exists_mem_filtration (gradedSplitting A M) fun n => (h n).isGradedProjective)

name: DG.Bar.surjective_filtrationπ
statement: theorem surjective_filtrationπ (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (filtrationπ A M n)
proof:
:=
  fun y => ⟨filtrationSection A M n y, filtrationπ_filtrationSection n y⟩

name: DG.Bar.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv_semiFreeResolution
statement:
theorem exists_dgHomotopyEquiv_semiFreeResolution
    (h : ∀ n, HasLiftingProperty.{u} A (Term A M n)) :
    ∃ e : DGHomotopyEquiv A (Bar A M) (DG.semiFreeResolution.{u, u} A M).P,
      (DG.semiFreeResolution.{u, u} A M).π.comp e.hom = augmentation A M ∧
        (augmentation A M).comp e.inv = (DG.semiFreeResolution.{u, u} A M).π
proof:
:=
  (hasLiftingProperty h).exists_dgHomotopyEquiv (DG.semiFreeResolution A M).hasLiftingProperty
    (surjective_augmentation A M) (isQuasiIso_augmentation A M)
    (DG.semiFreeResolution A M).surjective_π (DG.semiFreeResolution A M).isQuasiIso_π

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₁_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pr₁_tmul (f : B →+ ℤ) (a : A) (b : B) :
    pr₁ A B f (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = f b • a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₂_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pr₂_tmul (f : A →+ ℤ) (a : A) (b : B) :
    pr₂ A B f (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = f a • b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.comp_of_mem_same
statement: theorem comp_of_mem_same {n : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading n) : comp B n b = b
proof:
:=
  decompose_of_mem_same _ hb

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.comp_of_mem_ne
statement: theorem comp_of_mem_ne {m n : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading m) (h : m ≠ n) : comp B n b = 0
proof:
:=
  decompose_of_mem_ne _ hb h

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.comp_mem
statement: theorem comp_mem (n : ℤ) (b : B) : comp B n b ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  (decompose (grading (M := B)) b n).2

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.coeff₀_apply
statement: theorem coeff₀_apply (a : A) : coeff₀ hA a = hA.augmentation a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.coeff₀_one
statement: theorem coeff₀_one : coeff₀ hA (1 : A) = 1
proof: := map_one hA.augmentation

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.coeff₀_d
statement: theorem coeff₀_d (a : A) : coeff₀ hA (d a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff₀_apply, hA.augmentation.map_d]
  rfl

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.coeff₀_of_mem
statement: theorem coeff₀_of_mem {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) : coeff₀ hA a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA.augmentation.map_mem ha
  exact (mem_grading_iff.mp h).resolve_left hn

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.eq_intCast_of_mem_zero
statement: theorem eq_intCast_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) : a = ((coeff₀ hA a : ℤ) : A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hA.exists_intCast a ha
  rw [coeff₀_apply, hA.augmentation_intCast]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₁_d_of
statement:
theorem pr₁_d_of (ψ : B →+ ℤ) (hψ : ∀ b, ψ (d b) = 0) (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) :
    pr₁ A B ψ (d x) = d (pr₁ A B ψ x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul with
  | zero => simp
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul ha, map_add, pr₁_tmul, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, pr₁_tmul,
      hψ, zero_smul, smul_zero, add_zero, pr₁_tmul, map_zsmul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₁_d
statement: theorem pr₁_d (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) : pr₁ A B (coeff₀ hB) (d x) = d (pr₁ A B (coeff₀ hB) x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul with
  | zero => simp
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul ha, map_add, pr₁_tmul, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, pr₁_tmul,
      coeff₀_d, zero_smul, smul_zero, add_zero, pr₁_tmul, map_zsmul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₂_d
statement: theorem pr₂_d (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) : pr₂ A B (coeff₀ hA) (d x) = d (pr₂ A B (coeff₀ hA) x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul with
  | zero => simp
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul ha, map_add, pr₂_tmul, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, pr₂_tmul,
      coeff₀_d, zero_smul, zero_add, pr₂_tmul, map_zsmul]
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst hi
      rw [koszulSign_zero, Units.val_one, one_smul]
    · rw [coeff₀_of_mem hA hi ha, zero_smul, smul_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₁_comp_d
statement:
theorem pr₁_comp_d (φ : B →+ ℤ) (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) :
    pr₁ A B (φ.comp (comp B 1)) (d x) = d (pr₁ A B (φ.comp (comp B 1)) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hd1 : ∀ {j : ℤ} {b : B}, b ∈ grading j → comp B 1 (d b) = 0 := by
    intro j b hb
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hB.exists_intCast b hb
      rw [d_intCast, map_zero]
    · exact comp_of_mem_ne (d_mem hb) (by omega)
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul with
  | zero => simp
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul ha, map_add, pr₁_tmul, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, pr₁_tmul,
      AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hd1 hb, map_zero, zero_smul, smul_zero,
      add_zero, pr₁_tmul, map_zsmul]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.tmul_intCast
statement:
theorem tmul_intCast (a : A) (z : ℤ) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (z : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = (z • a) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (z : B) = z • (1 : B) from (zsmul_one z).symm]
  change _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ (z • (1 : B))) =
    _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒜 ℬ ((z • a) ⊗ₜ (1 : B))
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.intCast_tmul
statement:
theorem intCast_tmul (z : ℤ) (b : B) :
    ((z : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (z • b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (z : A) = z • (1 : A) from (zsmul_one z).symm]
  change _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒜 ℬ ((z • (1 : A)) ⊗ₜ b) =
    _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒜 ℬ ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ (z • b))
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.eq_zero_of_mem_neg'
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_neg' (hA : IsConnectedInt A) {n : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) {a : A}
    (ha : a ∈ grading n) : a = 0
proof:
:=
  hA.eq_zero_of_mem_neg hn ha

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.exists_deg_one
statement:
theorem exists_deg_one {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading 1) :
    ∃ a ∈ grading (M := A) 1, ∃ b ∈ grading (M := B) 1,
      x = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ y : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ, ∃ a ∈ grading (M := A) 1, ∃ b ∈ grading (M := B) 1,
      (decompose (grading (M := 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ)) y 1 : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) =
        a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩ := H x
    exact ⟨a, ha, b, hb, by rw [← h, decompose_of_mem_same _ hx]⟩
  intro y
  induction y using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, 0, zero_mem _, by
      rw [decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero,
        GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]⟩
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    have hab := GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (R := ℤ) ha hb
    by_cases hij : i + j = 1
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ (hij ▸ hab)]
      by_cases hi : i < 0
      · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_neg' hA hi ha, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]
        exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, 0, zero_mem _, by
          rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]⟩
      by_cases hj : j < 0
      · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_neg' hB hj hb, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero]
        exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, 0, zero_mem _, by
          rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]⟩
      rcases (show (i = 1 ∧ j = 0) ∨ (i = 0 ∧ j = 1) by omega) with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rw [eq_intCast_of_mem_zero hB hb, tmul_intCast]
        exact ⟨_, zsmul_mem ha _, 0, zero_mem _, by rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]⟩
      · rw [eq_intCast_of_mem_zero hA ha, intCast_tmul]
        exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, _, zsmul_mem hb _, by rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, zero_add]⟩
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hab hij]
      exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, 0, zero_mem _, by
        rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]⟩
  | add y y' hy hy' =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨a', ha', b', hb', h'⟩ := hy'
    refine ⟨a + a', add_mem ha ha', b + b', add_mem hb hb', ?_⟩
    rw [decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, h, h',
      GradedTensorProduct.add_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_add]
    abel

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.exists_deg_two
statement:
theorem exists_deg_two {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading 2) :
    ∃ α ∈ grading (M := A) 2, ∃ β ∈ grading (M := B) 2, ∃ t ∈ tensorOneOne A B,
      x = α ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + t + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] β
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ y : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ, ∃ α ∈ grading (M := A) 2, ∃ β ∈ grading (M := B) 2,
      ∃ t ∈ tensorOneOne A B, (decompose (grading (M := 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ)) y 2 : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) =
        α ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + t + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] β by
    obtain ⟨α, hα, β, hβ, t, ht, h⟩ := H x
    exact ⟨α, hα, β, hβ, t, ht, by rw [← h, decompose_of_mem_same _ hx]⟩
  have hzero : ∃ α ∈ grading (M := A) 2, ∃ β ∈ grading (M := B) 2, ∃ t ∈ tensorOneOne A B,
      (0 : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = α ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + t + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] β :=
    ⟨0, zero_mem _, 0, zero_mem _, 0, zero_mem _, by
      rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero, add_zero]⟩
  intro y
  induction y using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul with
  | zero => rw [decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]; exact hzero
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    have hab := GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (R := ℤ) ha hb
    by_cases hij : i + j = 2
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ (hij ▸ hab)]
      by_cases hi : i < 0
      · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_neg' hA hi ha, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]
        exact hzero
      by_cases hj : j < 0
      · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_neg' hB hj hb, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero]
        exact hzero
      rcases (show (i = 2 ∧ j = 0) ∨ (i = 1 ∧ j = 1) ∨ (i = 0 ∧ j = 2) by omega) with
        ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rw [eq_intCast_of_mem_zero hB hb, tmul_intCast]
        exact ⟨_, zsmul_mem ha _, 0, zero_mem _, 0, zero_mem _, by
          rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero, add_zero]⟩
      · exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, 0, zero_mem _, a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b,
          AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩, by
          rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]⟩
      · rw [eq_intCast_of_mem_zero hA ha, intCast_tmul]
        exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, _, zsmul_mem hb _, 0, zero_mem _, by
          rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, zero_add, zero_add]⟩
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hab hij]
      exact hzero
  | add y y' hy hy' =>
    obtain ⟨α, hα, β, hβ, t, ht, h⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨α', hα', β', hβ', t', ht', h'⟩ := hy'
    refine ⟨α + α', add_mem hα hα', β + β', add_mem hβ hβ', t + t', add_mem ht ht', ?_⟩
    rw [decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, h, h',
      GradedTensorProduct.add_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_add]
    abel

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₁_one_tmul
statement:
theorem pr₁_one_tmul {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading (M := B) 1 ∨ b ∈ grading (M := B) 2) :
    pr₁ A B (coeff₀ hB) ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr₁_tmul]
  rcases hb with hb | hb
  · rw [coeff₀_of_mem hB one_ne_zero hb, zero_smul]
  · rw [coeff₀_of_mem hB two_ne_zero hb, zero_smul]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₁_tmul_one
statement: theorem pr₁_tmul_one (a : A) : pr₁ A B (coeff₀ hB) (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B)) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr₁_tmul, coeff₀_one, one_smul]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₂_tmul_one
statement:
theorem pr₂_tmul_one {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading (M := A) 1 ∨ a ∈ grading (M := A) 2) :
    pr₂ A B (coeff₀ hA) (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr₂_tmul]
  rcases ha with ha | ha
  · rw [coeff₀_of_mem hA one_ne_zero ha, zero_smul]
  · rw [coeff₀_of_mem hA two_ne_zero ha, zero_smul]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₂_one_tmul
statement: theorem pr₂_one_tmul (b : B) : pr₂ A B (coeff₀ hA) ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [pr₂_tmul, coeff₀_one, one_smul]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₁_tensorOneOne
statement:
theorem pr₁_tensorOneOne {t : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (ht : t ∈ tensorOneOne A B) :
    pr₁ A B (coeff₀ hB) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [pr₁_tmul, coeff₀_of_mem hB one_ne_zero hb, zero_smul]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg, hx, neg_zero]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₂_tensorOneOne
statement:
theorem pr₂_tensorOneOne {t : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (ht : t ∈ tensorOneOne A B) :
    pr₂ A B (coeff₀ hA) t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [pr₂_tmul, coeff₀_of_mem hA one_ne_zero ha, zero_smul]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg, hx, neg_zero]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.d_tmul_one
statement: theorem d_tmul_one (a : A) : d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = d a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul', d_one, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.d_one_tmul
statement: theorem d_one_tmul (b : B) : d ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] d b
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul one_mem_grading, d_one, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul,
    zero_add, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.cocycle_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cocycle_one_eq_zero (hA₁ : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 1, d a = 0 → a = 0)
    (hB₁ : ∀ b ∈ grading (M := B) 1, d b = 0 → b = 0) {z : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (hz : z ∈ grading 1)
    (hdz : d z = 0) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := exists_deg_one hA hB hz
  have h₁ : pr₁ A B (coeff₀ hB) (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = a := by
    rw [map_add, pr₁_tmul_one, pr₁_one_tmul hB (Or.inl hb), add_zero]
  have h₂ : pr₂ A B (coeff₀ hA) (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = b := by
    rw [map_add, pr₂_tmul_one hA (Or.inl ha), pr₂_one_tmul, zero_add]
  have ha0 : a = 0 := hA₁ a ha (by rw [← h₁, ← pr₁_d, hdz, map_zero])
  have hb0 : b = 0 := hB₁ b hb (by rw [← h₂, ← pr₂_d, hdz, map_zero])
  rw [ha0, hb0, GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.coe_comp₁
statement: theorem coe_comp₁ (b : B) : (comp₁ B b : B) = decompose (grading (M := B)) b 1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.comp₁_d
statement: theorem comp₁_d (b : B) : comp₁ B (d b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_comp₁, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  have h := decompose_d b 0
  rw [zero_add] at h
  rw [h]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hB.exists_intCast _ (decompose (grading (M := B)) b 0).2
  rw [← hz, d_intCast]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.coord_of_mem
statement:
theorem coord_of_mem {ι : Type*} (e : Module.Basis ι ℤ (grading (M := B) 1)) (j : ι) {b : B}
    (hb : b ∈ grading (M := B) 1) : coord e j b = e.repr ⟨b, hb⟩ j
proof:
:= by
  have : comp₁ B b = ⟨b, hb⟩ := Subtype.ext (decompose_of_mem_same _ hb)
  simp [coord, this]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.gtmul_sum
statement:
theorem gtmul_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : A) (f : ι → B) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (∑ j ∈ s, f j) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = ∑ j ∈ s, a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f j
proof:
:= by
  change _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ (∑ j ∈ s, f j)) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sum, map_sum]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.zsmul_gtmul
statement:
theorem zsmul_gtmul (n : ℤ) (a : A) (b : B) :
    ((n • a) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n • b)
proof:
:= by
  change _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒜 ℬ ((n • a) ⊗ₜ b) =
    _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ (n • b))
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.eq_sum_of_mem_tensorOneOne
statement:
theorem eq_sum_of_mem_tensorOneOne {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (e : Module.Basis ι ℤ (grading (M := B) 1)) {t : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (ht : t ∈ tensorOneOne A B) :
    t = ∑ j, pr₁ A B (coord e j) t ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (e j : B)
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp only [pr₁_tmul, coord_of_mem e _ hb, zsmul_gtmul]
    rw [← gtmul_sum]
    congr 1
    calc b = ((⟨b, hb⟩ : grading (M := B) 1) : B) := rfl
      _ = ((∑ j, e.repr ⟨b, hb⟩ j • e j : grading (M := B) 1) : B) := by rw [e.sum_repr]
      _ = _ := by simp only [AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum, AddSubgroup.coe_zsmul]
  | zero => simp [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    conv_lhs => rw [hx, hy]
    simp only [map_add, GradedTensorProduct.add_tmul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  | neg x _ hx =>
    conv_lhs => rw [hx]
    have hneg : ∀ (a : A) (b : B), ((-a) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) = -(a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) := fun a b => by
      change _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of ℤ 𝒜 ℬ ((-a) ⊗ₜ b) = -_
      rw [TensorProduct.neg_tmul, map_neg]
    simp only [map_neg, hneg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.pr₁_coord_mem
statement:
theorem pr₁_coord_mem {ι : Type*} (e : Module.Basis ι ℤ (grading (M := B) 1)) (j : ι)
    {t : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (ht : t ∈ tensorOneOne A B) : pr₁ A B (coord e j) t ∈ grading (M := A) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction ht using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [pr₁_tmul]
    exact zsmul_mem ha _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.exists_eq_d_of_zsmul_eq_d
statement:
theorem exists_eq_d_of_zsmul_eq_d (hA₁ : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 1, d a = 0 → a = 0)
    (hA₂ : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∀ α ∈ grading (M := A) 2, d α = 0 → ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 1,
      m • α = d a → ∃ a' ∈ grading (M := A) 1, α = d a')
    (hB₂ : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∀ β ∈ grading (M := B) 2, d β = 0 → ∀ b ∈ grading (M := B) 1,
      m • β = d b → ∃ b' ∈ grading (M := B) 1, β = d b')
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (e : Module.Basis ι ℤ (grading (M := B) 1)) {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0)
    {z : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (hz : z ∈ grading 2) (hdz : d z = 0) {w : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (hw : w ∈ grading 1)
    (hmw : m • z = d w) : ∃ c ∈ grading (M := 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) 1, z = d c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, hα, β, hβ, t, ht, rfl⟩ := exists_deg_two hA hB hz
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := exists_deg_one hA hB hw
  
  have hpα : pr₁ A B (coeff₀ hB) (α ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + t + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] β) = α := by
    rw [map_add, map_add, pr₁_tmul_one, pr₁_tensorOneOne hB ht, pr₁_one_tmul hB (Or.inr hβ),
      add_zero, add_zero]
  have hpβ : pr₂ A B (coeff₀ hA) (α ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + t + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] β) = β := by
    rw [map_add, map_add, pr₂_tmul_one hA (Or.inr hα), pr₂_tensorOneOne hA ht, pr₂_one_tmul,
      zero_add, zero_add]
  have hpa : pr₁ A B (coeff₀ hB) (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = a := by
    rw [map_add, pr₁_tmul_one, pr₁_one_tmul hB (Or.inl hb), add_zero]
  have hpb : pr₂ A B (coeff₀ hA) (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = b := by
    rw [map_add, pr₂_tmul_one hA (Or.inl ha), pr₂_one_tmul, zero_add]
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hα'⟩ := hA₂ m hm α hα (by rw [← hpα, ← pr₁_d, hdz, map_zero]) a ha (by
    rw [← hpα, ← hpa, ← map_zsmul, hmw, pr₁_d])
  obtain ⟨b', hb', hβ'⟩ := hB₂ m hm β hβ (by rw [← hpβ, ← pr₂_d, hdz, map_zero]) b hb (by
    rw [← hpβ, ← hpb, ← map_zsmul, hmw, pr₂_d])
  
  have hdt : d t = 0 := by
    have h := hdz
    rw [d_add, d_add, hα', hβ', ← d_tmul_one, ← d_one_tmul, d_d, d_d, zero_add, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  have ht0 : t = 0 := by
    rw [eq_sum_of_mem_tensorOneOne e ht]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ?_
    rw [hA₁ _ (pr₁_coord_mem e j ht) (by
      rw [← pr₁_d_of _ (fun b => by rw [coord, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, comp₁_d hB, map_zero]),
        hdt, map_zero]), GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  have h₁ := GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (R := ℤ) ha' (one_mem_grading (A := B))
  have h₂ := GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (R := ℤ) (one_mem_grading (A := A)) hb'
  rw [add_zero] at h₁
  rw [zero_add] at h₂
  refine ⟨a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B) + (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b', add_mem h₁ h₂, ?_⟩
  rw [ht0, add_zero, d_add, d_tmul_one, d_one_tmul, hα', hβ']

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.cohomology_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cohomology_one_eq_zero (hA₁ : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 1, d a = 0 → a = 0)
    (hB₁ : ∀ b ∈ grading (M := B) 1, d b = 0 → b = 0) (x : cohomology (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) 1) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h z =>
    rw [show z = 0 from Subtype.ext (cocycle_one_eq_zero hA hB hA₁ hB₁ (cocycles.mem_grading z)
      (cocycles.d_eq_zero z)), map_zero]

name: DG.ConnectedTensor.cohomology_two_torsionFree
statement:
theorem cohomology_two_torsionFree (hA₁ : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 1, d a = 0 → a = 0)
    (hA₂ : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∀ α ∈ grading (M := A) 2, d α = 0 → ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 1,
