      m • α = d a → ∃ a' ∈ grading (M := A) 1, α = d a')
    (hB₂ : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∀ β ∈ grading (M := B) 2, d β = 0 → ∀ b ∈ grading (M := B) 1,
      m • β = d b → ∃ b' ∈ grading (M := B) 1, β = d b')
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (e : Module.Basis ι ℤ (grading (M := B) 1)) (m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (x : cohomology (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) 2) (hx : m • x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h z =>
    rw [← map_zsmul, cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hzc⟩ := exists_eq_d_of_zsmul_eq_d hA hB hA₁ hA₂ hB₂ e hm
      (cocycles.mem_grading z) (cocycles.d_eq_zero z) (w := w) (by simpa using hw)
      (by rw [hdw]; rfl)
    rw [cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff]
    exact mem_coboundaries.mpr ⟨c, by simpa using hc, hzc.symm⟩

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.exists_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_bounds (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) :
    ∃ (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ), ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (K.X n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, _, _⟩ := hK.bounded
  refine ⟨a, (b + 1 - a).toNat, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rcases hn with hn | hn
  · exact K.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE a n hn
  · exact K.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE b n (by omega)

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.eulerChar_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_sum_range (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (K.X n)) :
    hK.eulerChar = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      (a + i).negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (K.X (a + i)) (hK.fgProjective _)
proof:
:=
  AbelianK0.finsum_eq_sum_range _ a m fun n hn => by
    rw [ProjK0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (h n hn), smul_zero]

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.support_finite
statement:
theorem support_finite (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) :
    (Function.support fun n : ℤ => n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (K.X n) (hK.fgProjective n)).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, m, h⟩ := hK.exists_bounds
  refine (Set.finite_Ico a (a + m)).subset fun n hn => ?_
  by_contra h'
  simp only [Set.mem_Ico, not_and_or, not_le, not_lt] at h'
  exact hn (by
    change n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (K.X n) (hK.fgProjective n) = 0
    rw [ProjK0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (h n (by omega)), smul_zero])

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.mk'
statement:
theorem mk' (hK : ∀ n, IsFGProjective R (K.X n)) (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (K.X n)) : IsPerfectComplex K where
  bounded
proof:
:= ⟨a, a + m, (K.isStrictlyGE_iff a).2 fun i hi => h i (Or.inl hi),
    (K.isStrictlyLE_iff _).2 fun i hi => h i (Or.inr (by omega))⟩
  fgProjective := hK

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso (e : K ≅ L) (hL : IsPerfectComplex L) : IsPerfectComplex K where
  bounded
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨a, b, _, _⟩ := hL.bounded
    exact ⟨a, b, L.isStrictlyGE_of_iso e.symm a, L.isStrictlyLE_of_iso e.symm b⟩
  fgProjective n := IsFGProjective.of_iso ((HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ n).mapIso e)
    (hL.fgProjective n)

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.eulerChar_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_of_iso (e : K ≅ L) (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) (hL : IsPerfectComplex L) :
    hK.eulerChar = hL.eulerChar
proof:
:= by
  unfold eulerChar
  congr 1
  ext n
  rw [ProjK0.mk_eq_of_iso (P := K.X n) (Q := L.X n) ((HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ n).mapIso e)
    (hK.fgProjective n) (hL.fgProjective n)]

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.mappingCone
statement:
theorem mappingCone (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) (hL : IsPerfectComplex L) :
    IsPerfectComplex (mappingCone φ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, m, hm⟩ := hK.exists_bounds
  obtain ⟨a', m', hm'⟩ := hL.exists_bounds
  refine mk' (fun n => IsFGProjective.of_iso (mappingConeXIso φ n)
    ((hK.fgProjective _).biprod (hL.fgProjective _))) (min (a - 1) a')
    (max (a + m) (a' + m') - min (a - 1) a').toNat ?_
  intro n hn
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ (mappingConeXIso φ n)
  rw [biprod_isZero_iff]
  constructor
  · exact hm _ (by omega)
  · exact hm' _ (by omega)

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.eulerChar_mappingCone
statement:
theorem eulerChar_mappingCone (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) (hL : IsPerfectComplex L) :
    (hK.mappingCone φ hL).eulerChar = hL.eulerChar - hK.eulerChar
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ∀ n : ℤ, n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk ((CochainComplex.mappingCone φ).X n)
      ((hK.mappingCone φ hL).fgProjective n) =
      -((n + 1).negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (K.X (n + 1)) (hK.fgProjective _)) +
        n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (L.X n) (hL.fgProjective n) := fun n => by
    rw [ProjK0.mk_eq_of_iso (mappingConeXIso φ n) _
        ((hK.fgProjective _).biprod (hL.fgProjective _)), ProjK0.mk_biprod, smul_add,
      Int.negOnePow_succ, Units.neg_smul, neg_neg]
  have hfK : Function.HasFiniteSupport fun n : ℤ =>
      -((n + 1).negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (K.X (n + 1)) (hK.fgProjective _)) := by
    have := hK.support_finite.preimage (f := fun n : ℤ => n + 1)
      (fun _ _ _ _ h => by simpa using h)
    refine this.subset fun n hn => ?_
    simpa using hn
  have h₂ : ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (n + 1).negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (K.X (n + 1)) (hK.fgProjective _) =
      ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (K.X n) (hK.fgProjective n) :=
    finsum_comp_equiv (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ))
      (f := fun n : ℤ => n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk (K.X n) (hK.fgProjective n))
  unfold eulerChar
  rw [finsum_congr h₁, finsum_add_distrib hfK hL.support_finite, finsum_neg_distrib, h₂,
    neg_add_eq_sub]

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.shift
statement: theorem shift (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) (n : ℤ) : IsPerfectComplex (K⟦n⟧)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, m, hm⟩ := hK.exists_bounds
  refine mk' (fun i => IsFGProjective.of_iso (K.shiftFunctorObjXIso n i _ rfl)
    (hK.fgProjective _)) (a - n) m fun i hi => ?_
  exact IsZero.of_iso (hm _ (by omega)) (K.shiftFunctorObjXIso n i _ rfl)

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.single
statement:
theorem single {P : ModuleCat.{u} R} (hP : IsFGProjective R P) (n : ℤ) :
    IsPerfectComplex ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n).obj P)
proof:
:= by
  refine mk' (fun i => ?_) n 1 fun i hi => HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X _ _ _ _
    (by omega)
  by_cases hi : i = n
  · subst hi
    exact IsFGProjective.of_iso (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf _ i P) hP
  · exact IsFGProjective.of_isZero (HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X _ _ _ _ hi)

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.eulerChar_single
statement:
theorem eulerChar_single {P : ModuleCat.{u} R} (hP : IsFGProjective R P) (n : ℤ) :
    (single hP n).eulerChar = n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk P hP
proof:
:= by
  unfold eulerChar
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ n (fun i hi => by
    rw [ProjK0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X _ _ _ _ hi),
      smul_zero]),
    ProjK0.mk_eq_of_iso (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf _ n P) _ hP]

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.zero
statement: theorem zero : IsPerfectComplex (0 : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
proof:
:=
  mk' (fun i => IsFGProjective.of_isZero (by
    exact (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ i).map_isZero (isZero_zero _))) 0 0
    fun i _ => (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ i).map_isZero (isZero_zero _)

name: DG.d_apply_d_apply
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.d_apply_d_apply {R : Type u} [Ring R] {C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ}
    (i j k : ℤ) (x : C.X i) : (C.d j k).hom ((C.d i j).hom x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ModuleCat.comp_apply, C.d_comp_d]
  rfl

name: DG.homotopy_apply_eq_of_id_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.homotopy_apply_eq_of_id_zero (h : Homotopy (𝟙 C) 0) (n : ℤ) (x : C.X n) :
    x = (h.hom (n + 1) n).hom ((C.d n (n + 1)).hom x) +
      (C.d (n - 1) n).hom ((h.hom n (n - 1)).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  have e := h.comm n
  rw [dNext_eq h.hom (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel n (n + 1) from rfl),
    prevD_eq h.hom (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel (n - 1) n by simp),
    HomologicalComplex.zero_f, add_zero, HomologicalComplex.id_f] at e
  have e' := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) e
  simpa using e'

name: DG.homotopy_d_apply_eq_of_id_zero
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.homotopy_d_apply_eq_of_id_zero (h : Homotopy (𝟙 C) 0) (n : ℤ) (x : C.X n)
    (hx : (C.d n (n + 1)).hom x = 0) : (C.d (n - 1) n).hom ((h.hom n (n - 1)).hom x) = x
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [homotopy_apply_eq_of_id_zero h n x, hx, map_zero, zero_add]

name: DG.fgProjective_cyclesModule
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.fgProjective_cyclesModule (h : Homotopy (𝟙 C) 0)
    (hC : ∀ n, IsFGProjective R (C.X n)) (n : ℤ) : IsFGProjective R (cyclesModule C n)
proof:
:=
  IsFGProjective.of_retract (ModuleCat.ofHom (Submodule.subtype _))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.codRestrict _ (h.hom n (n - 1) ≫ C.d (n - 1) n).hom
      fun x => by
        rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
        exact d_apply_d_apply _ _ _ _))
    (by
      ext x
      simpa using homotopy_d_apply_eq_of_id_zero h n x.1 x.2)
    (hC n)

name: DG.shortExact_cyclesModule
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.shortExact_cyclesModule (h : Homotopy (𝟙 C) 0) (n : ℤ) : (ShortComplex.mk
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (Submodule.subtype (LinearMap.ker (C.d n (n + 1)).hom)))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.codRestrict (LinearMap.ker (C.d (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1)).hom)
      (C.d n (n + 1)).hom fun x => LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (d_apply_d_apply _ _ _ x))) (by
        ext x
        simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom,
          ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype]
        exact (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp x.2))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  refine ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact _ ?_ (Submodule.injective_subtype _) ?_
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, congrArg Subtype.val hx⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      exact Subtype.ext (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp y.2)
  · intro y
    refine ⟨(h.hom (n + 1) n).hom y, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    have := homotopy_d_apply_eq_of_id_zero h (n + 1) y.1 y.2
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, m = n + 1 - 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hm] at this
    obtain rfl : m = n := by omega
    exact this

name: DG.isZero_cyclesModule_of_isZero
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.isZero_cyclesModule_of_isZero {n : ℤ} (hn : IsZero (C.X n)) :
    IsZero (cyclesModule C n)
proof:
:= by
  have := ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hn
  have : Subsingleton (LinearMap.ker (C.d n (n + 1)).hom) :=
    ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim (x : C.X n) y)⟩
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: DG.isZero_cyclesModule_of_homotopy
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.isZero_cyclesModule_of_homotopy (h : Homotopy (𝟙 C) 0) {n : ℤ}
    (hn : IsZero (C.X (n - 1))) : IsZero (cyclesModule C n)
proof:
:= by
  have := ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hn
  have : Subsingleton (LinearMap.ker (C.d n (n + 1)).hom) := ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (by
    rw [← homotopy_d_apply_eq_of_id_zero h n x.1 x.2,
      ← homotopy_d_apply_eq_of_id_zero h n y.1 y.2,
      Subsingleton.elim ((h.hom n (n - 1)).hom x.1) ((h.hom n (n - 1)).hom y.1)])⟩
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.eulerChar_eq_zero_of_homotopy
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_zero_of_homotopy (hC : IsPerfectComplex C) (h : Homotopy (𝟙 C) 0) :
    hC.eulerChar = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, m, hm⟩ := hC.exists_bounds
  let z : ℤ → ProjK0.{u} R := fun n =>
    ProjK0.mk (cyclesModule C n) (fgProjective_cyclesModule h hC.fgProjective n)
  have hz : ∀ n n', n = n' → z n = z n' := by
    rintro n _ rfl
    rfl
  have hx : ∀ n, ProjK0.mk (C.X n) (hC.fgProjective n) = z n + z (n + 1) := fun n =>
    ProjK0.mk_X₂ (shortExact_cyclesModule h n) (fgProjective_cyclesModule h hC.fgProjective n)
      (hC.fgProjective n) (fgProjective_cyclesModule h hC.fgProjective (n + 1))
  have ht := AbelianK0.sum_range_negOnePow_telescope
    (fun n => ProjK0.mk (C.X n) (hC.fgProjective n)) (fun _ => 0) (fun n => z (n + 1))
    (fun n => by rw [hx, zero_add, hz (n - 1 + 1) n (by omega)]) a m
  rw [hC.eulerChar_eq_sum_range a m hm, ht]
  simp only [smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
  rw [hz (a - 1 + 1) a (by omega), hz (a + m - 1 + 1) (a + m) (by omega)]
  simp only [z]
  rw [ProjK0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (isZero_cyclesModule_of_homotopy h (hm _ (by omega))),
    ProjK0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (isZero_cyclesModule_of_isZero (hm _ (by omega))),
    smul_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero]

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.isKProjective
statement: theorem isKProjective (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) : K.IsKProjective
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, _, _⟩ := hK.bounded
  have : ∀ n, Projective (K.X n) := fun n =>
    (IsProjective.iff_projective (K.X n)).1 (hK.fgProjective n).2
  exact CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective K b

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.exists_Q_map_eq
statement:
theorem exists_Q_map_eq (hK : IsPerfectComplex K)
    (f : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ⟶ _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) :
    ∃ g : K ⟶ L, _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map g = f
proof:
:= by
  have := hK.isKProjective
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := (CochainComplex.IsKProjective.Qh_map_bijective K
    ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj L)).2
      ((_root_.DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app K ≫ f ≫
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app L)
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).map_surjective g₀
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have h := _root_.DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso_hom_naturality g
  rw [hg₀] at h
  simpa using h.symm

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.nonempty_homotopy_of_Q_map_eq
proof:
:= by
  have := hK.isKProjective
  have h' : _root_.DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).map g₁) =
      _root_.DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).map g₂) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono ((_root_.DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app L),
      _root_.DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso_hom_naturality,
      _root_.DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso_hom_naturality, h]
  exact ⟨HomotopyCategory.homotopyOfEq _ _
    ((CochainComplex.IsKProjective.Qh_map_bijective K _).1 h')⟩

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.eulerChar_eq_of_iso_Q
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_of_iso_Q (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) (hL : IsPerfectComplex L)
    (e : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) :
    hK.eulerChar = hL.eulerChar
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hK.exists_Q_map_eq e.hom
  have hT := _root_.DerivedCategory.mappingCone_triangle_distinguished g
  have hZ : IsZero (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone g)) :=
    (Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ _ hT).2 (by
      change IsIso (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map g)
      rw [hg]
      infer_instance)
  have hC := hK.mappingCone g hL
  obtain ⟨H⟩ := hC.nonempty_homotopy_of_Q_map_eq (g₁ := 𝟙 _) (g₂ := 0) (hZ.eq_of_src _ _)
  have h := hC.eulerChar_eq_zero_of_homotopy H
  rw [hK.eulerChar_mappingCone g hL, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: DG.IsPerfect.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso {X Y : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (hY : IsPerfect R Y) : IsPerfect R X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hY
  exact ⟨K, hK, ⟨e' ≪≫ e.symm⟩⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.Q_obj
statement:
theorem Q_obj {K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ} (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) :
    IsPerfect R (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨K, hK, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.of_isZero
statement:
theorem of_isZero {X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hX : IsZero X) :
    IsPerfect R X
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, IsPerfectComplex.zero, ⟨(_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map_isZero (isZero_zero _)).iso hX⟩⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.shift
statement:
theorem shift {X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hX : IsPerfect R X) (n : ℤ) :
    IsPerfect R (X⟦n⟧)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hX
  exact ⟨K⟦n⟧, hK.shift n,
    ⟨(_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso n).app K ≪≫ (shiftFunctor _ n).mapIso e⟩⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.exists_iso_mappingCone
statement:
theorem exists_iso_mappingCone (T : Triangle (_root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)))
    (hT : T ∈ distTriang _) {K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ} (hK : IsPerfectComplex K)
    (e₁ : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ T.obj₁)
    (e₂ : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj L ≅ T.obj₂) :
    ∃ g : K ⟶ L, Nonempty
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone g) ≅ T.obj₃)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hK.exists_Q_map_eq (e₁.hom ≫ T.mor₁ ≫ e₂.inv)
  refine ⟨g, ⟨Triangle.π₃.mapIso (isoTriangleOfIso₁₂ _ T
    (_root_.DerivedCategory.mappingCone_triangle_distinguished g) hT e₁ e₂ ?_)⟩⟩
  change _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map g ≫ e₂.hom = e₁.hom ≫ T.mor₁
  rw [hg]
  simp

name: DG.IsPerfect.ext₃
statement:
theorem ext₃ (T : Triangle (_root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))) (hT : T ∈ distTriang _)
    (h₁ : IsPerfect R T.obj₁) (h₂ : IsPerfect R T.obj₂) : IsPerfect R T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨L, hL, ⟨e₂⟩⟩ := h₂
  obtain ⟨g, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_mappingCone T hT hK e₁ e₂
  exact ⟨_, hK.mappingCone g hL, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.ext₂
statement:
theorem ext₂ (T : Triangle (_root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))) (hT : T ∈ distTriang _)
    (h₁ : IsPerfect R T.obj₁) (h₃ : IsPerfect R T.obj₃) : IsPerfect R T.obj₂
proof:
:=
  ext₃ _ (inv_rot_of_distTriang _ hT) (h₃.shift _) h₁

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.mem_quasiIso_iff
statement:
theorem mem_quasiIso_iff {X Y : HomotopyCategory.{v} A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    quasiIso A f ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso ((homologyFunctor ℤ A n).map f)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff_forget
statement:
theorem mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff_forget (X : HomotopyCategory.{v} A) :
    (subcategoryAcyclic A) X ↔
      (_root_.HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic (ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)) ((forget ℤ A).obj X)
proof:
:=
  forall_congr' fun n =>
    ((_root_.HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor _ _ 0).mapIso
      (((forget ℤ A).commShiftIso n).app X)).isZero_iff

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff
statement:
theorem mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff (X : HomotopyCategory.{v} A) :
    (subcategoryAcyclic A) X ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, IsZero ((homologyFunctor ℤ A n).obj X)
proof:
:=
  (mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff_forget X).trans
    (_root_.HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff _)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_eq_subcategoryAcyclic_W
statement: theorem quasiIso_eq_subcategoryAcyclic_W : quasiIso.{v} A = (subcategoryAcyclic A).trW
proof:
:= by
  ext X Y f
  obtain ⟨Z, g, h, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle f
  refine Iff.trans ?_ ((subcategoryAcyclic A).trW_iff_of_distinguished _ hT).symm
  rw [mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff_forget]
  change _root_.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ _ ((forget ℤ A).map f) ↔ _
  rw [_root_.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_eq_trW_subcategoryAcyclic]
  exact (_root_.HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic _).trW_iff_of_distinguished _
    ((forget ℤ A).map_distinguished _ hT)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.isThick_subcategoryAcyclic
statement:
theorem isThick_subcategoryAcyclic : IsThick (subcategoryAcyclic.{v} A) where
  zero
proof:
:= (subcategoryAcyclic A).prop_zero
  shift X n := (subcategoryAcyclic A).le_shift n X
  ext₂ := (subcategoryAcyclic A).ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂
  retract {X Y} e hY n := by
    have e' := e.map (shiftFunctor _ n ⋙ homologyFunctor ℤ A 0)
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    refine e'.retract.symm.trans ?_
    rw [(hY n).eq_of_src e'.r 0, comp_zero]

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.forget_map_quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff
statement:
theorem forget_map_quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    _root_.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      ((forget R A).map ((quotient A).map f)) ↔ f.hom.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= by
  rw [forget_map_quotient_map, _root_.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff,
    HomologicalComplex.mem_quasiIso_iff, quasiIso_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun n => ?_
  rw [quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap, ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  have h : ⇑(HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((DGModuleCat.forget R A).map f) n) ∘
      ⇑(DGModuleCat.cohomologyAddEquiv R M n) =
      ⇑(DGModuleCat.cohomologyAddEquiv R N n) ∘ ⇑(cohomology.map f.hom n) :=
    funext fun x => (DGModuleCat.cohomologyAddEquiv_naturality R f n x).symm
  rw [← Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff _ (DGModuleCat.cohomologyAddEquiv R M n).bijective, h,
    Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff' (DGModuleCat.cohomologyAddEquiv R N n).bijective]

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    quasiIso A ((quotient A).map f) ↔ f.hom.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:=
  forget_map_quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff ℤ f

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.mem_quasiIso_iff_forget
statement:
theorem mem_quasiIso_iff_forget {X Y : HomotopyCategory.{v} A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    quasiIso A f ↔ _root_.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{v} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      ((forget R A).map f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, rfl⟩ := quotient_obj_surjective X
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := quotient_obj_surjective Y
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (quotient A).map_surjective f
  rw [quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff, forget_map_quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff]

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor_inverts_quasiIso
statement:
theorem homologyFunctor_inverts_quasiIso (n : ℤ) :
    (quasiIso.{v} A).IsInvertedBy (homologyFunctor R A n)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ f hf => ((mem_quasiIso_iff_forget R f).mp hf) n

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    (subcategoryAcyclic A) ((quotient A).obj M) ↔ IsAcyclic M
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff, isAcyclic_iff_isZero_homologyFunctor_obj (R := ℤ)]

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff_isAcyclic_cone
statement:
theorem quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff_isAcyclic_cone {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    quasiIso A ((quotient A).map f) ↔ IsAcyclic (Cone f.hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff, DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_iff_isAcyclic_cone]

name: DG.DGModuleCat.homotopyEquivalences_le_quasiIso
statement: theorem homotopyEquivalences_le_quasiIso : homotopyEquivalences.{v} A ≤ quasiIso A
proof:
:= by
  rintro M N f ⟨e, he⟩
  rw [quasiIso, ← he]
  exact e.isQuasiIso_hom

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_eq_quasiIso_map_quotient
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_eq_quasiIso_map_quotient :
    HomotopyCategory.quasiIso.{v} A = (quasiIso A).map (HomotopyCategory.quotient A)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨M⟩ ⟨N⟩ f
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient A).map_surjective f
  constructor
  · intro hf
    rw [HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff] at hf
    exact MorphismProperty.map_mem_map _ _ _ hf
  · rintro ⟨M', N', g, hg, ⟨e⟩⟩
    rw [quasiIso, ← HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff] at hg
    exact ((HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A).arrow_mk_iso_iff e).1 hg

name: DG.RightDual.comp_mem_dualPiece
statement:
theorem comp_mem_dualPiece (hf : IsRightHom (A := A) n f) {k : ℤ} {g : M →+ A}
    (hg : g ∈ dualPiece A M k) : g.comp f ∈ dualPiece A M (k + n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a m => by
    change g (f (op a • m)) = g (f m) * a
    rw [hf.map_op_smul, hg.1], fun i m hm => by
    change g (f m) ∈ grading (i + (k + n))
    rw [show i + (k + n) = i + n + k by ring]
    exact hg.2 _ _ (hf.map_mem i m hm)⟩

name: DG.RightDual.comp_mem_dualSubgroup
statement:
theorem comp_mem_dualSubgroup (hf : IsRightHom (A := A) n f) {g : M →+ A}
    (hg : g ∈ dualSubgroup A M) : g.comp f ∈ dualSubgroup A M
proof:
:= by
  induction hg using AddSubgroup.iSup_induction' with
  | hp k g hg => exact AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (k + n) (comp_mem_dualPiece hf hg)
  | h1 => exact zero_mem _
  | hadd g g' _ _ hg hg' => rw [AddMonoidHom.add_comp]; exact add_mem hg hg'

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_compHom
statement:
theorem toHom_compHom (hf : IsRightHom (A := A) n f) (φ : RightDual A M) (m : M) :
    toHom (compHom hf φ) m = toHom φ (f m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.compHom_mem
statement:
theorem compHom_mem (hf : IsRightHom (A := A) n f) {k : ℤ} {φ : RightDual A M}
    (hφ : φ ∈ grading k) : compHom hf φ ∈ grading (k + n)
proof:
:=
  (comp_mem_dualPiece hf (toHom_mem_dualPiece hφ)).2

name: DG.RightDual.compHom_smul
statement:
theorem compHom_smul (hf : IsRightHom (A := A) n f) (a : A) (φ : RightDual A M) :
    compHom hf (a • φ) = a • compHom hf φ
proof: := ext fun _ => rfl

name: DG.sign_cancel
statement:
private theorem sign_cancel {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] (a b c : ℤ) (h : Even (a + b + c))
    (x : X) : koszulSign a • (koszulSign b • koszulSign c • x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, koszulSign_even h, one_smul]

name: DG.Cochain.op_smul_of_opModule
statement:
theorem Cochain.op_smul_of_opModule {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) (a : A) (m : M) :
    f (op a • m) = op a • f m
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [op_zero, zero_smul, zero_smul, map_zero]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [op_add, add_smul, add_smul, map_add, ha, ha']
  | @h_homogeneous i a =>
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp only [smul_zero, map_zero]
    | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, smul_add]
    | @h_homogeneous j m =>
      have h1 := DGRightModule.opModule_op_smul_of_mem R a.2 m.2
      have h2 := DGRightModule.opModule_op_smul_of_mem R a.2 (f.map_mem m.2)
      have h3 := f.map_smul ((GradedOpposite.op_mem_dgGrading_iff (R := R)).mpr a.2) (m : M)
      rw [h1, f.map_units_smul, h2] at h3
      have h4 := congrArg (koszulSign (i * j) • ·) h3
      rw [smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul] at h4
      rw [h4, sign_cancel]
      exact ⟨i * j + i * n, by ring⟩

name: DG.RightDual.isRightHom_cochain
statement:
theorem RightDual.isRightHom_cochain {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) :
    RightDual.IsRightHom (A := A) n (f : M →+ M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a m => Cochain.op_smul_of_opModule R f a m, fun _ _ hm => f.map_mem hm⟩

name: DG.RightDual.ks_congr
statement: private theorem ks_congr {a b : ℤ} (h : Even (a - b)) : koszulSign a = koszulSign b
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff a b).mpr h

name: DG.RightDual.transposeFun_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [transposeFun, gradeSign_of_mem n (compHom_mem _ hφ), smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
  congr 1
  refine ks_congr ?_
  have := Int.even_mul_succ_self n
  convert this using 1
  ring

name: DG.RightDual.transpose_apply
statement:
theorem transpose_apply (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) (φ : RightDual A M) :
    transpose f φ = transposeFun f φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_transpose
proof:
:= by
  rw [transpose_apply, transposeFun_of_mem f hφ, toHom_units_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.RightDual.hom_units_smul_apply
statement: private theorem hom_units_smul_apply (u : ℤˣ) (g : M →+ A) (x : M) : (u • g) x = u • g x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.transpose_δ
statement:
theorem transpose_δ {m : ℤ} (hnm : n + 1 = m) (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) :
    transpose (δ n m f) = δ n m (transpose f)
proof:
:= by
  subst hnm
  refine Cochain.ext fun φ => ?_
  induction φ using induction_on' with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add φ ψ h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, h, h']
  | homogeneous k φ hφ =>
    refine ext fun x => ?_
    have e1 : koszulSign ((n + 1) * k) = koszulSign (n * k) * koszulSign k := by
      rw [← koszulSign_add]; congr 1; ring
    have e2 : koszulSign n * koszulSign (n * (k + 1)) = koszulSign (n * k) := by
      rw [← koszulSign_add]; exact ks_congr ⟨n, by ring⟩
    rw [toHom_transpose _ hφ, δ_apply n _ rfl, δ_apply n _ rfl, toHom_sub, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply,
      toHom_units_smul, hom_units_smul_apply, d_apply_of_mem ((transpose f).map_mem hφ),
      toHom_transpose _ hφ, toHom_transpose _ hφ, toHom_transpose _ (d_mem hφ),
      d_apply_of_mem hφ, d_units_smul, AddMonoidHom.map_sub,
      Units.smul_def (koszulSign n) (f (d x)),
      AddMonoidHom.map_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def]
    simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [e1, e2, koszulSign_add k n]
    simp only [Units.smul_def, Units.val_mul]
    module

name: DG.RightDual.transpose_comp
statement:
theorem transpose_comp {m : ℤ} (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M m) (g : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) :
    transpose (g.comp f rfl) =
      koszulSign (m * n) • (transpose f).comp (transpose g) (add_comm n m)
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun φ => ?_
  induction φ using induction_on' with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add φ ψ h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, h, h']
  | homogeneous k φ hφ =>
    refine ext fun x => ?_
    rw [toHom_transpose _ hφ, Cochain.units_smul_apply, toHom_units_smul, hom_units_smul_apply,
      Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, toHom_transpose _ ((transpose g).map_mem hφ),
      toHom_transpose _ hφ, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 1
    exact ks_congr ⟨-(m * n), by ring⟩

name: DG.RightDual.transpose_id
statement: theorem transpose_id : transpose (Cochain.id Aᵒᵖ M) = Cochain.id A (RightDual A M)
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun φ => ?_
  induction φ using induction_on' with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add φ ψ h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, h, h']
  | homogeneous k φ hφ =>
    refine ext fun x => ?_
    rw [toHom_transpose _ hφ, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    rfl

name: DG.RightDual.transpose_add
statement:
theorem transpose_add (f g : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) :
    transpose (f + g) = transpose f + transpose g
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun φ => ?_
  induction φ using induction_on' with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add φ ψ h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, h, h']
  | homogeneous k φ hφ =>
    refine ext fun x => ?_
    rw [toHom_transpose _ hφ, Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.add_apply, toHom_add,
      AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
      toHom_transpose _ hφ, toHom_transpose _ hφ, map_add, smul_add]

name: DG.RightDual.transpose_units_smul
statement:
theorem transpose_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) :
    transpose (u • f) = u • transpose f
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun φ => ?_
  induction φ using induction_on' with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add φ ψ h h' => rw [map_add, map_add, h, h']
  | homogeneous k φ hφ =>
    refine ext fun x => ?_
    rw [toHom_transpose _ hφ, Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.units_smul_apply,
      toHom_units_smul, hom_units_smul_apply, toHom_transpose _ hφ, Units.smul_def u, map_zsmul,
      ← Units.smul_def, smul_comm]

name: DG.RightDual.transposeSum_of
statement:
theorem transposeSum_of (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) :
    transposeSum R A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) n f) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A (RightDual A M) (RightDual A M) n) n (transpose f)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.RightDual.transposeSum_d
statement:
theorem transposeSum_d (x : DGModule.END Aᵒᵖ M) :
    transposeSum R A M (d x) = d (transposeSum R A M x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | of n f =>
    rw [DGModule.HOM.d_of, transposeSum_of, transposeSum_of, DGModule.HOM.d_of, transpose_δ rfl]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, d_add]

name: DG.RightDual.of_mem_gradingSubmodule_END
statement:
theorem of_mem_gradingSubmodule_END {n : ℤ} (F : Cochain A (RightDual A M) (RightDual A M) n) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A (RightDual A M) (RightDual A M) n) n F :
        DGModule.END A (RightDual A M)) ∈
      DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule ℤ (DGModule.END A (RightDual A M)) n
proof:
:=
  of_mem_summand _ _

name: DG.RightDual.transposeSum_of_mul_of
statement:
theorem transposeSum_of_mul_of {m : ℤ} (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M m) (g : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) :
    GradedOpposite.op _ (transposeSum R A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) m f *
        DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) n g)) =
      (GradedOpposite.op _ (transposeSum R A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) m f)) *
        GradedOpposite.op _ (transposeSum R A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) n g))
          : Eᵒᵖ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGModule.END.of_mul_of, transposeSum_of, transposeSum_of, transposeSum_of,
    GradedOpposite.op_mul_op _ (of_mem_gradingSubmodule_END _) (of_mem_gradingSubmodule_END _),
    DGModule.END.of_mul_of, transpose_units_smul, transpose_comp, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self,
    one_smul, Units.smul_def (koszulSign (n * m)), map_zsmul, map_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def,
    smul_smul, mul_comm n m, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  congr 1
  exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq
    (Sigma.ext (add_comm m n) (Cochain.heq_of_forall (add_comm m n) fun _ => rfl))

name: DG.RightDual.transposeRingHom_apply
statement:
theorem transposeRingHom_apply (x : DGModule.END Aᵒᵖ M) :
    transposeRingHom R A M x = GradedOpposite.op _ (transposeSum R A M x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.transposeRingHom_mem
statement:
theorem transposeRingHom_mem {n : ℤ} {x : DGModule.END Aᵒᵖ M} (hx : x ∈ grading n) :
    transposeRingHom R A M x ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedOpposite.mem_dgGrading_iff (R := ℤ), transposeRingHom_apply, GradedOpposite.unop_op]
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [transposeSum_of]
  exact of_mem_summand _ _

name: DG.RightDual.transposeRingHom_d
statement:
theorem transposeRingHom_d (x : DGModule.END Aᵒᵖ M) :
    transposeRingHom R A M (d x) = d (transposeRingHom R A M x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [transposeRingHom_apply, transposeRingHom_apply, transposeSum_d, GradedOpposite.d_op]

name: DG.RightBasis.untransposeFun_apply
statement:
theorem untransposeFun_apply (F : Cochain A (RightDual A M) (RightDual A M) n) (m : M) :
    B.untransposeFun F m = ∑ i, op (koszulSign (n * B.deg i) • toHom (F (B.δ i)) m) • B.b i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.isRightHom_untransposeFun
statement:
theorem isRightHom_untransposeFun (F : Cochain A (RightDual A M) (RightDual A M) n) :
    IsRightHom (A := A) n (B.untransposeFun F) where
  map_op_smul a m
proof:
:= by
    rw [untransposeFun_apply, untransposeFun_apply, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_op_smul, smul_smul, ← op_mul, smul_mul_assoc]
  map_mem j m hm := by
    rw [untransposeFun_apply]
    refine sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
    have h := op_smul_mem_grading
      (units_smul_mem_grading (koszulSign (n * B.deg i)) (apply_mem_grading
        (F.map_mem (B.δ_mem i)) hm)) (B.b_mem i)
    rwa [show B.deg i + (j + (-B.deg i + n)) = j + n by ring] at h

name: DG.RightBasis.untranspose_apply
statement:
theorem untranspose_apply (F : Cochain A (RightDual A M) (RightDual A M) n) (m : M) :
    B.untranspose (R := R) F m = B.untransposeFun F m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.cochain_ext_δ
statement:
theorem cochain_ext_δ {F G : Cochain A (RightDual A M) (RightDual A M) n}
    (h : ∀ i, F (B.δ i) = G (B.δ i)) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun φ => ?_
  rw [← B.dualBasis.sum_coeff φ, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [dualBasis_b]
  induction B.dualBasis.coeff φ i using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [zero_smul, map_zero, map_zero]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul, map_add, map_add, ha, ha']
  | h_homogeneous a => rw [F.map_smul a.2, G.map_smul a.2, h]

name: DG.RightBasis.transpose_untranspose
statement:
theorem transpose_untranspose (F : Cochain A (RightDual A M) (RightDual A M) n) :
    transpose (B.untranspose (R := R) F) = F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine B.cochain_ext_δ fun i => ext fun x => ?_
  rw [toHom_transpose _ (B.δ_mem i), untranspose_apply, toHom_δ, untransposeFun_apply,
    B.coeff_sum (fun l => koszulSign (n * B.deg l) • toHom (F (B.δ l)) x), smul_smul,
    ← koszulSign_add, show n * -B.deg i + n * B.deg i = 0 by ring, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.RightBasis.untranspose_transpose
statement:
theorem untranspose_transpose (f : Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) :
    B.untranspose (R := R) (transpose f) = f
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun m => ?_
  rw [untranspose_apply, untransposeFun_apply]
  conv_rhs => rw [← B.sum_coeff (f m)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [toHom_transpose _ (B.δ_mem i), toHom_δ, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add,
    show n * B.deg i + n * -B.deg i = 0 by ring, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.RightBasis.transposeRingHom_bijective
statement: theorem transposeRingHom_bijective : Function.Bijective (transposeRingHom R A M)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y h => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · have h' : transposeSum R A M x = transposeSum R A M y := (GradedOpposite.op _).injective h
    refine (DirectSum.map_injective _).mpr (fun n => ?_) h'
    exact Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := B.untranspose (R := R))
      (fun f => B.untranspose_transpose f)
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (GradedOpposite.op (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule ℤ
      (DGModule.END A (RightDual A M)))).surjective y
    induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, map_zero]⟩
    | of n F =>
      refine ⟨DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain Aᵒᵖ M M n) n (B.untranspose (R := R) F), ?_⟩
      rw [transposeRingHom_apply, transposeSum_of, B.transpose_untranspose]
    | add y y' hy hy' =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hy
      obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hy'
      exact ⟨x + x', by rw [map_add, hx, hx', map_add]⟩

name: DG.RightBasis.transposeEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem transposeEquiv_apply (x : DGModule.END Aᵒᵖ M) :
    B.transposeEquiv R x = transposeRingHom R A M x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.mkRingHom_truncGEZeroIdeal_eq_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem mkRingHom_truncGEZeroIdeal_eq_zero_of_ne {i : ℤ} (hi : i ≠ 0) {a : A}
    (ha : a ∈ grading i) : DGIdeal.Quotient.mkRingHom (truncGEZeroIdeal hA) a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGIdeal.Quotient.mkRingHom_eq_zero_iff_mem, mem_truncGEZeroIdeal_iff_of_mem_grading hA ha]
  exact fun h => absurd h hi

name: DG.mkRingHom_truncGEZeroIdeal_d
statement:
theorem mkRingHom_truncGEZeroIdeal_d (a : A) :
    DGIdeal.Quotient.mkRingHom (truncGEZeroIdeal hA) (d a) = 0
proof:
:=
  (DGIdeal.Quotient.mkRingHom_eq_zero_iff_mem _).mpr (truncGEZero_d_mem a)

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.smul_def
statement:
theorem smul_def (a : A) (x : DegreeZeroModule hA N) :
    a • x = (DGIdeal.Quotient.mkRingHom (truncGEZeroIdeal hA) a • x : DegreeZeroModule hA N)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : DegreeZeroModule hA N} :
    x ∈ grading n ↔ n = 0 ∨ x = 0
proof:
:=
  mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff N

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.mem_grading_zero
statement: theorem mem_grading_zero (x : DegreeZeroModule hA N) : x ∈ grading 0
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff.mpr (Or.inl rfl)

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.eq_zero_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {x : DegreeZeroModule hA N}
    (hx : x ∈ grading n) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  (mem_grading_iff.mp hx).resolve_left hn

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.d_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_apply (x : DegreeZeroModule hA N) : d x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply {N' : Type*} [AddCommGroup N'] [Module (A ⧸ truncGEZeroIdeal hA) N']
    (f : N →ₗ[A ⧸ truncGEZeroIdeal hA] N') (x : DegreeZeroModule hA N) : map f x = f x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.subsingleton_cohomology
statement:
theorem subsingleton_cohomology {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Subsingleton (cohomology (DegreeZeroModule hA N) n)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_cohomology_iff.mpr fun m hm _ => by
    rw [eq_zero_of_mem_grading hn hm]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.apply_eq_apply_decompose_zero
statement:
theorem DegreeZeroModule.apply_eq_apply_decompose_zero (g : P →ᵈᵍ[A] DegreeZeroModule hA N')
    (x : P) : g x = g (decompose (grading (M := P)) x 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← g.coe_decompose_apply, decompose_of_mem_same _ (DegreeZeroModule.mem_grading_zero _)]

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.apply_eq_zero_of_isQuasiIso
statement:
theorem DegreeZeroModule.apply_eq_zero_of_isQuasiIso (hP : IsNonposGraded P)
    (π : P →ᵈᵍ[A] DegreeZeroModule hA N) (hπ : π.IsQuasiIso)
    (g : P →ᵈᵍ[A] DegreeZeroModule hA N') {x : P} (hx : π x = 0) : g x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [apply_eq_apply_decompose_zero]
  set x₀ := (decompose (grading (M := P)) x 0 : P)
  have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ grading 0 := SetLike.coe_mem _
  have hdx₀ : d x₀ = 0 := hP.eq_zero one_pos (by simpa using d_mem hx₀)
  have hπx₀ : π x₀ = 0 := by
    rw [← π.coe_decompose_apply, hx, decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply,
      ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp
    ((cohomology.map_injective_iff π 0).mp (hπ 0).1 x₀ hx₀ hdx₀
      (by rw [hπx₀]; exact zero_mem _))
  rw [← hy, DGModuleHom.map_d, DegreeZeroModule.d_apply]

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.eq_of_homotopic
statement:
theorem DegreeZeroModule.eq_of_homotopic (hP : IsNonposGraded P)
    {g₁ g₂ : P →ᵈᵍ[A] DegreeZeroModule hA N'} (h : Homotopic g₁ g₂) : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [apply_eq_apply_decompose_zero g₁, apply_eq_apply_decompose_zero g₂]
  set x₀ := (decompose (grading (M := P)) x 0 : P)
  have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ grading 0 := SetLike.coe_mem _
  have hdx₀ : d x₀ = 0 := hP.eq_zero one_pos (by simpa using d_mem hx₀)
  have := congrArg (fun φ => φ (cohomology.mkOf hx₀ hdx₀)) (h.cohomology_map_eq 0)
  rw [cohomology.mkOf_eq_mk, cohomology.map_mk, cohomology.map_mk, cohomology.mk_eq_mk_iff]
    at this
  obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp this
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← hy, DegreeZeroModule.d_apply]

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.apply_eq_apply_of_eq
statement: theorem DegreeZeroModule.apply_eq_apply_of_eq {x y : P} (h : π x = π y) : g x = g y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub]
  exact hg _ (by rw [map_sub, h, sub_self])

name: DG.DegreeZeroModule.factor_apply
statement:
theorem DegreeZeroModule.factor_apply (x : P) :
    DegreeZeroModule.factor π hπ g hg (π x) = g x
proof:
:=
  apply_eq_apply_of_eq π g hg (Function.surjInv_eq hπ _)

name: DG.mem_degreeZeroQuotientComponents_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degreeZeroQuotientComponents_iff {k : ℤ} {x : P} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x ∈ ofComponents (degreeZeroQuotientComponents P) ↔ (k = 0 → x ∈ coboundaries P 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ofComponents_of_mem_grading hx, degreeZeroQuotientComponents]
  by_cases h : k = 0 <;> simp [h]

name: DG.degreeZeroQuotient_smul_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_ofComponents _)
    (P := fun x => a • x ∈ ofComponents (degreeZeroQuotientComponents P)) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun x x' h h' => by simpa only [smul_add] using add_mem h h') hx
  intro k x hxk hxS
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [zero_mem]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul]; exact add_mem ha ha'
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i i
    change a • x ∈ _
    rw [mem_degreeZeroQuotientComponents_iff hxk] at hxS
    rw [mem_degreeZeroQuotientComponents_iff (smul_mem_grading ha hxk)]
    intro hik
    by_cases hi : 0 < i
    · rw [hA.eq_zero hi ha, zero_smul]
      exact zero_mem _
    by_cases hk : 0 < k
    · rw [hP.eq_zero hk hxk, smul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hxS rfl
    refine ⟨a • y, by simpa using smul_mem_grading ha hy, ?_⟩
    rw [d_smul_of_mem_zero ha, hA.eq_zero one_pos (d_mem ha), zero_smul, zero_add]

name: DG.degreeZeroQuotient_d_mem
statement:
theorem degreeZeroQuotient_d_mem (x : P) :
    d x ∈ ofComponents (degreeZeroQuotientComponents P)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [d_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | h_add x y hx hy => rw [d_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
    rename_i i
    rw [mem_degreeZeroQuotientComponents_iff (d_mem hx)]
    intro h
    obtain rfl : i = 0 - 1 := by omega
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: DG.mem_degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule_of_ne
statement:
theorem mem_degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule_of_ne {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) {x : P}
    (hx : x ∈ grading k) : x ∈ degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule hA P hP
proof:
:=
  (mem_degreeZeroQuotientComponents_iff hx).mpr fun h => absurd h hk

name: DG.mem_degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule_iff {x : P} (hx : x ∈ grading 0) :
    x ∈ degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule hA P hP ↔ x ∈ coboundaries P 0
proof:
:=
  (mem_degreeZeroQuotientComponents_iff hx).trans ⟨fun h => h rfl, fun h _ => h⟩

name: DG.isTorsionBySet_degreeZeroQuotient
statement:
theorem isTorsionBySet_degreeZeroQuotient :
    Module.IsTorsionBySet A (P ⧸ degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule hA P hP)
      (truncGEZeroIdeal hA).toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨a, ha⟩
  induction y using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H x =>
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk (a • x) = 0
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (truncGEZeroIdeal hA).isHomogeneous
    (P := fun a => a • x ∈ degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule hA P hP) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun a a' h h' => by simpa only [add_smul] using add_mem h h') ha
  intro i a hai haI
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [zero_mem]
  | h_add x x' hx hx' => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hx'
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
    rename_i k
    change a • x ∈ _
    by_cases hik : i + k = 0
    · by_cases hi : 0 < i
      · rw [hA.eq_zero hi hai, zero_smul]
        exact zero_mem _
      by_cases hk : 0 < k
      · rw [hP.eq_zero hk hx, smul_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
      obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
      obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
      rw [mem_degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule_iff hA hP (by simpa using smul_mem_grading hai hx)]
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := (mem_truncGEZeroIdeal_iff_of_mem_grading hA hai).mp
        (show a ∈ truncGEZeroIdeal hA from haI) rfl
      refine ⟨b • x, by simpa using smul_mem_grading hb hx, ?_⟩
      rw [d_smul hb, hP.eq_zero (x := d x) one_pos (by simpa using d_mem hx), smul_zero,
        smul_zero, add_zero]
    · exact mem_degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule_of_ne hA hP hik (smul_mem_grading hai hx)

name: DG.isQuasiIso_degreeZeroQuotientπ
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_degreeZeroQuotientπ (hH : ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → Subsingleton (cohomology P k)) :
    letI
proof:
:= degreeZeroQuotientModule hA hP
    (degreeZeroQuotientπ hA hP).IsQuasiIso := by
  let := degreeZeroQuotientModule hA hP
  intro k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst hk
    constructor
    · rw [cohomology.map_injective_iff]
      intro x hx _ hπx
      obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hπx
      rw [DegreeZeroModule.d_apply] at hy
      exact (mem_degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule_iff hA hP hx).mp
        ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hy.symm)
    · rw [cohomology.map_surjective_iff]
      intro y _ _
      obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ (DegreeZeroModule.mk.symm y)
      have hy : degreeZeroQuotientπ hA hP x = y := by
        rw [← DegreeZeroModule.mk.apply_symm_apply y, ← hxy]
        rfl
      set x₀ := (decompose (grading (M := P)) x 0 : P)
      have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ grading 0 := SetLike.coe_mem _
      refine ⟨x₀, hx₀, hP.eq_zero one_pos (by simpa using d_mem hx₀), ?_⟩
      have : degreeZeroQuotientπ hA hP x₀ = degreeZeroQuotientπ hA hP x := by
        rw [DegreeZeroModule.apply_eq_apply_decompose_zero (degreeZeroQuotientπ hA hP) x]
      rw [this, hy, sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _
  · have := hH k hk
    have := DegreeZeroModule.subsingleton_cohomology (hA := hA)
      (N := P ⧸ degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule hA P hP) hk
    exact ⟨fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun _ => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isNonposGraded_degreeZeroModule
statement: theorem isNonposGraded_degreeZeroModule : IsNonposGraded (DegreeZeroModule hA N)
proof:
:=
  isNonposGraded_iff.mpr fun _ hn _ hx => DegreeZeroModule.eq_zero_of_mem_grading hn.ne' hx

name: DG.DerivedCategory.surjective_resolution_π
statement:
theorem surjective_resolution_π :
    Function.Surjective (ConnectiveResolution.π A (DegreeZeroModule hA N))
proof:
:= fun y => by
  obtain ⟨e, -, -, he⟩ := ConnectiveResolution.exists_stage_one (A := A) le_rfl
    (DegreeZeroModule.mem_grading_zero y) (DegreeZeroModule.d_apply y)
  exact ⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ 1 e, by rw [ConnectiveResolution.π_of, he]⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.essImage_heartFunctor
statement: theorem essImage_heartFunctor : (heartFunctor.{w, v} hA).essImage = (tStructure hA).heart
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨N, ⟨e⟩⟩
    refine (tStructure hA).heart.prop_of_iso e ((mem_heart_tStructure_iff hA _).mpr fun k hk => ?_)
    exact (isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_obj_iff _ k).mpr (DegreeZeroModule.subsingleton_cohomology hk)
  · intro hX
    rw [mem_heart_tStructure_iff] at hX
    obtain ⟨M, ⟨eM⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj X
    have hM : ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → Subsingleton (cohomology M k) := fun k hk =>
      (isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_obj_iff M k).mp
        ((isZero_homologyFunctor_iff_of_iso eM k).mp (hX k hk))
    
    obtain ⟨P, _, _, _, _, π, hπ, -, hP⟩ :=
      exists_semiFreeResolution_of_isNonposGraded A (truncLE hA M 0) hA
        (isNonposGraded_truncLE_zero hA)
    have hι := isQuasiIso_truncLE_subtype hA (M := M) fun k hk => hM k hk.ne'
    let ι₁ : DGModuleCat.of A (truncLE hA M 0) ⟶ M := DGModuleCat.ofHom (truncLE hA M 0).subtype
    let π₁ : DGModuleCat.of A P ⟶ DGModuleCat.of A (truncLE hA M 0) := DGModuleCat.ofHom π
    have : IsIso (Q.map ι₁) := (isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr hι
    have : IsIso (Q.map π₁) := (isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr hπ
    have hPH : ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → Subsingleton (cohomology P k) := fun k hk => by
      have := hM k hk
      exact (Equiv.ofBijective _ ((DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.comp hι hπ) k)).subsingleton
    let := degreeZeroQuotientModule hA hP
    let ρ : DGModuleCat.of A P ⟶
        (degreeZeroModuleFunctor A hA).obj
          (ModuleCat.of _ (P ⧸ degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule hA P hP)) :=
      DGModuleCat.ofHom (degreeZeroQuotientπ hA hP)
    have : IsIso (Q.map ρ) := (isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr (isQuasiIso_degreeZeroQuotientπ hA hP hPH)
    exact ⟨ModuleCat.of _ (P ⧸ degreeZeroQuotientSubmodule hA P hP),
      ⟨(asIso (Q.map ρ)).symm ≪≫ asIso (Q.map π₁) ≪≫ asIso (Q.map ι₁) ≪≫ eM.symm⟩⟩

name: DG.IsNonposGraded.eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsNonposGraded.eq_zero (hM : IsNonposGraded M) {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ grading n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hM n hn] at hx
  exact hx

name: DG.isNonposGraded_iff
statement:
theorem isNonposGraded_iff :
    IsNonposGraded M ↔ ∀ ⦃n : ℤ⦄, 0 < n → ∀ ⦃x : M⦄, x ∈ grading n → x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hn _ hx => h.eq_zero hn hx, fun h _ hn => eq_bot_iff.mpr fun _ hx => h hn hx⟩

name: DG.IsNonposGraded.of_injective
statement:
theorem IsNonposGraded.of_injective {A : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [Module A M]
    {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N] (hN : IsNonposGraded N)
    (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (hf : Function.Injective f) : IsNonposGraded M
proof:
:=
  isNonposGraded_iff.mpr fun _ hn _ hx => hf (by rw [hN.eq_zero hn (f.map_mem hx), map_zero])

name: DG.IsNonposGraded.shift
statement:
theorem IsNonposGraded.shift (hA : IsNonposGraded A) {k : ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    IsNonposGraded (Shift k A)
proof:
:=
  isNonposGraded_iff.mpr fun n hn x hx =>
    (Shift.unmk k).injective (by
      rw [hA.eq_zero (by omega) (Shift.unmk_mem_grading hx)]; rfl)

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.LowCell.gen_mem
statement: theorem LowCell.gen_mem (c : LowCell p) : c.gen ∈ grading c.1.deg
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mem_grading _ c
    (by simpa using Shift.mk_mem_grading (n := -c.1.deg) (one_mem_grading (A := A)))

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.LowCell.d_gen
statement: theorem LowCell.d_gen (c : LowCell p) : d c.gen = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [LowCell.gen, DirectSum.d_of, Shift.d_mk, d_one, smul_zero, Shift.mk_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.attach_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem attach_gen (c : LowCell p) : attach p c.gen = c.1.z
proof:
:= by
  rw [LowCell.gen, attach, DGModuleHom.toModule_lof, DGModuleHom.shiftGen_mk_one]

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.homotopy_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homotopy_gen (c : LowCell p) : homotopy p c.gen = c.1.m
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopy, Cochain.rightUnshift_apply, LowCell.gen, Cochain.directSumDesc_of,
    Cochain.shiftGen_mk_one, Shift.unmk_mk]

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.δ_homotopy
statement: theorem δ_homotopy : δ (-1) 0 (homotopy p) = Cochain.ofHom (p.comp (attach p))
proof:
:=
  Cochain.ext_directSum_shift fun c => by
    change δ (-1) 0 (homotopy p) c.gen = Cochain.ofHom (p.comp (attach p)) c.gen
    rw [δ_neg_one_apply, LowCell.d_gen, map_zero, add_zero, homotopy_gen, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
      DGModuleHom.comp_apply, attach_gen, c.1.p_z]

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.eq_zero_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading (hA : IsNonposGraded A) {n : ℤ} (hn : 1 < n) {x : LowCells p}
    (hx : x ∈ grading n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  have hc : x c ∈ grading n := hx c
  rw [DirectSum.zero_apply]
  exact (Shift.unmk _).injective (by
    rw [hA.eq_zero (by have := c.2; omega) (Shift.unmk_mem_grading hc)]; rfl)

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.lowStep_exists
statement:
theorem lowStep_exists (s : Stage A M) {j : ℤ} (hj : j ≤ 1) {z : s.obj} (hz : z ∈ grading j)
    (hdz : d z = 0) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading (j - 1)) (hpz : s.π z = d m) :
    ∃ e : (lowStep s).obj, e ∈ grading (j - 1) ∧ d e = Cone.inr (attach s.π) z ∧
      (lowStep s).π e = m
proof:
:= by
  let c : LowCell s.π := ⟨⟨j, z, m, hz, hdz, hm, hpz⟩, hj⟩
  refine ⟨Cone.inl (attach s.π) c.gen, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := (Cone.inl (attach s.π)).map_mem c.gen_mem
    rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg] at h
  · have h := Cone.inl_d_apply (f := attach s.π) c.gen
    rw [c.d_gen, map_zero, sub_zero, attach_gen] at h
    exact h
  · exact (Cone.inl_desc_apply _ _ _ (δ_homotopy s.π) _).trans (homotopy_gen c)

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.ι_injective
statement: theorem ι_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (ι A M n)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  congrArg (Cone.sndLinear (attach (stage A M n).π)) h

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.stage_succ_π_comp_ι
statement:
theorem stage_succ_π_comp_ι (n : ℕ) :
    (stage A M (n + 1)).π.comp (ι A M n) = (stage A M n).π
proof:
:=
  Cone.inr_desc _ _ _ (δ_homotopy _)

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.π_of
statement: theorem π_of (n : ℕ) (x : Obj A M n) : π A M (SeqColimit.of _ _ n x) = (stage A M n).π x
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.desc_of _ _ _ _

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.exists_step
statement:
theorem exists_step (n : ℕ) {j : ℤ} (hj : j ≤ 1) {z : Obj A M n} (hz : z ∈ grading j)
    (hdz : d z = 0) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading (j - 1)) (hpz : (stage A M n).π z = d m) :
    ∃ e : Obj A M (n + 1), e ∈ grading (j - 1) ∧ d e = ι A M n z ∧
      (stage A M (n + 1)).π e = m
proof:
:=
  lowStep_exists (stage A M n) hj hz hdz hm hpz

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.exists_stage_one
statement:
theorem exists_stage_one {j : ℤ} (hj : j ≤ 0) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading j) (hdm : d m = 0) :
    ∃ e : Obj A M 1, e ∈ grading j ∧ d e = 0 ∧ (stage A M 1).π e = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩ := exists_step (A := A) 0 (j := j + 1) (by omega) (z := 0)
    (zero_mem _) d_zero (m := m) (by rwa [add_sub_cancel_right]) (by rw [map_zero, hdm])
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right] at he
  rw [map_zero] at hde
  exact ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.isNonposGraded_obj
statement: theorem isNonposGraded_obj (hA : IsNonposGraded A) (n : ℕ) : IsNonposGraded (Obj A M n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact isNonposGraded_iff.mpr fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    refine isNonposGraded_iff.mpr fun k hk x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := Cone.mem_grading_iff.mp hx
    refine Cone.ext ?_ (ih.eq_zero hk hx₂)
    exact (Shift.unmk 1).injective
      (eq_zero_of_mem_grading (p := (stage A M n).π) hA (n := k + 1) (by omega)
        (Shift.unmk_mem_grading hx₁))

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.isNonposGraded_colim
statement: theorem isNonposGraded_colim (hA : IsNonposGraded A) : IsNonposGraded (Colim A M)
proof:
:=
  isNonposGraded_iff.mpr fun k hk x hx => by
    obtain ⟨n, y, rfl⟩ := SeqColimit.exists_of_eq x
    have hinj := SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective A M) n
    rw [(isNonposGraded_obj A M hA n).eq_zero hk
      ((SeqColimit.of _ _ n).mem_grading_of_injective hinj hx), map_zero]

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.isQuasiIso_π
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_π (hA : IsNonposGraded A) (hM : IsNonposGraded M) : (π A M).IsQuasiIso
proof:
:=
  fun j => by
  constructor
  · rw [cohomology.map_injective_iff]
    intro x hx hdx hpx
    obtain ⟨n, y, rfl⟩ := SeqColimit.exists_of_eq x
    have hinj := SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective A M) n
    have hy : y ∈ grading j := (SeqColimit.of _ _ n).mem_grading_of_injective hinj hx
    have hdy : d y = 0 := hinj (by rw [DGModuleHom.map_d, hdx, map_zero])
    by_cases hj : 0 < j
    · rw [(isNonposGraded_obj A M hA n).eq_zero hj hy, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hpx
    rw [π_of] at hdm
    obtain ⟨e, he, hde, -⟩ := exists_step n (by omega) hy hdy hm hdm.symm
    exact mem_coboundaries.mpr ⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1) e,
      (SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1)).map_mem he, by
        rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hde, SeqColimit.of_succ_ι]⟩
  · rw [cohomology.map_surjective_iff]
    intro m hm hdm
    by_cases hj : 0 < j
    · refine ⟨0, zero_mem _, d_zero, ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero, hM.eq_zero hj hm, sub_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    obtain ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩ := exists_stage_one (A := A) (by omega) hm hdm
    exact ⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ 1 e, (SeqColimit.of _ _ 1).map_mem he,
      by rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hde, map_zero], by rw [π_of, hpe, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.bijective_rangeRestrict
statement:
theorem bijective_rangeRestrict (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (SeqColimit.of (Obj A M) (ι A M) n).rangeRestrict
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective A M) n (congrArg Subtype.val h),
    fun ⟨_, y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, Subtype.ext hy⟩⟩

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.of_toObj
statement:
theorem of_toObj {n : ℕ} (x : SeqColimit.filtration (S := Obj A M) (ι := ι A M) n) :
    SeqColimit.of _ _ n (toObj A M n x) = (x : SeqColimit (Obj A M) (ι A M))
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (DGModuleHom.apply_inverse_apply _ (bijective_rangeRestrict A M n) x)

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.toObj_eq
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective A M) n (by rw [of_toObj, h])

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.surjective_filtrationπ
statement: theorem surjective_filtrationπ (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (filtrationπ A M n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_bijective _ _).2.comp
    (Function.Surjective.comp (fun y => ⟨Cone.inlLinear _ y, Cone.fstHom_inlLinear y⟩) ?_)
  intro y
  exact ⟨⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1) y, SeqColimit.of_mem_filtration (ι := ι A M) (n + 1) y⟩,
    toObj_eq rfl⟩

name: DG.ConnectiveResolution.filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ)
    (x : SeqColimit.filtration (S := Obj A M) (ι := ι A M) (n + 1)) :
    filtrationπ A M n x = 0 ↔ (x : Colim A M) ∈ SeqColimit.filtration n
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtrationπ, DGModuleHom.comp_apply,
    map_eq_zero_iff _ (DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_bijective _ _).1, DGModuleHom.comp_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hy : toObj A M (n + 1) x =
        ι A M n (Cone.sndLinear (attach (stage A M n).π) (toObj A M (n + 1) x)) :=
      Cone.ext (h.trans (Cone.fstHom_inr _).symm) (Cone.sndLinear_inr _).symm
    refine ⟨Cone.sndLinear (attach (stage A M n).π) (toObj A M (n + 1) x), ?_⟩
    change SeqColimit.of _ _ n _ = _
    rw [← SeqColimit.of_succ_ι (ι := ι A M), ← hy, of_toObj]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h' : toObj A M (n + 1) x = ι A M n y :=
      toObj_eq (by rw [SeqColimit.of_succ_ι]; exact hy)
    exact (congrArg (Cone.fstHom (attach (stage A M n).π)) h').trans (Cone.fstHom_inr y)

name: DG.exists_semiFreeResolution_of_isNonposGraded
statement:
theorem exists_semiFreeResolution_of_isNonposGraded (hA : IsNonposGraded A)
    (hM : IsNonposGraded M) :
    ∃ (P : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup P) (_ : DGAddCommGroup P) (_ : Module A P)
      (_ : DGModule A P) (π : P →ᵈᵍ[A] M), π.IsQuasiIso ∧
        Nonempty (SemiFreeFiltration.{max u v} A P) ∧ IsNonposGraded P
proof:
:=
  ⟨ConnectiveResolution.Colim A M, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    ConnectiveResolution.π A M, ConnectiveResolution.isQuasiIso_π A M hA hM,
    ⟨ConnectiveResolution.semiFreeFiltration A M⟩,
    ConnectiveResolution.isNonposGraded_colim A M hA⟩

name: DG.IsThick.comap
proof:
:= hP.of_isZero (F.map_isZero (isZero_zero C))
  shift X n h := hP.of_iso ((F.commShiftIso n).app X) (hP.shift _ n h)
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := hP.ext₂ _ (F.map_distinguished T hT) h₁ h₃
  retract e h := hP.retract (e.map F) h

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_externalTensor_obj_Q_self
proof:
:= by
  have hP : IsThick fun X : DerivedCategory.{u, u} A =>
      IsCompact.{u} (((externalTensor A B).flip.obj (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of B B))).obj X) :=
    (isThick_isCompact _).comap _
  have hX' : ThickClosure
      (fun Y : DerivedCategory.{u, u} A => ∃ _ : Unit, Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A A) = Y) X := by
    rw [thickClosure_self_eq_isCompact]
    exact hX
  refine thickClosure_le hP ?_ X hX'
  rintro _ ⟨-, rfl⟩
  exact isCompact_Q_self.of_iso externalTensorRegularIso

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_externalTensor
proof:
:= by
  have hP : IsThick fun Y : DerivedCategory.{u, u} B =>
      IsCompact.{u} (((externalTensor A B).obj X).obj Y) :=
    (isThick_isCompact _).comap _
  have hY' : ThickClosure
      (fun Y : DerivedCategory.{u, u} B => ∃ _ : Unit, Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of B B) = Y) Y := by
    rw [thickClosure_self_eq_isCompact]
    exact hY
  refine thickClosure_le hP ?_ Y hY'
  rintro _ ⟨-, rfl⟩
  exact isCompact_externalTensor_obj_Q_self hX

name: DG.d_smul_twist
statement: theorem d_smul_twist (a : A) (y : P) : d (a • y) = d a • y + Shift.twist A 1 a • d y
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rename_i i
    rw [d_smul a.2, Shift.twist_of_mem a.2, one_mul, smul_assoc]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul, d_add, ha, ha', d_add, map_add, add_smul, add_smul]; abel

name: DG.decompose_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem decompose_smul_of_mem {k : ℤ} {m : P} (hm : m ∈ grading k) (a : A) (p : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := P)) (a • m) p : P) = (decompose (grading (M := A)) a (p - k) : A) • m
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rename_i i
    have ham := smul_mem_grading a.2 hm
    by_cases hi : i + k = p
    · subst hi
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ ham, add_sub_cancel_right, decompose_of_mem_same _ a.2]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ ham hi, decompose_of_mem_ne _ a.2 (by omega), zero_smul]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
    rw [add_smul, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, ha, ha', decompose_add,
      DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, add_smul]

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_add
statement: theorem coeff_add (x y : P) : T.coeff (x + y) = T.coeff x + T.coeff y
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← T.sum_coeff x, ← T.sum_coeff y, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [← add_smul]
  exact T.coeff_sum (T.coeff x + T.coeff y)

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_zero
statement: theorem coeff_zero : T.coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := T.coeff_sum 0
  simpa using h

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_smul
statement: theorem coeff_smul (a : A) (x : P) : T.coeff (a • x) = fun j => a * T.coeff x j
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← T.sum_coeff x, Finset.smul_sum]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  exact T.coeff_sum _

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_neg
statement: theorem coeff_neg (x : P) : T.coeff (-x) = -T.coeff x
proof:
:= by
  have h := T.coeff_add x (-x)
  rw [add_neg_cancel, T.coeff_zero] at h
  exact (neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero_right h.symm).symm

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_basis
statement: theorem coeff_basis (j : Fin T.length) (a : A) : T.coeff (a • T.b j) = Pi.single j a
proof:
:= by
  have h := T.coeff_sum (Pi.single j a)
  rwa [Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun l _ hl => by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hl, zero_smul])
    (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same] at h

name: DG.TriangularBasis.eq_zero_of_coeff
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_coeff (x : P) (h : T.coeff x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← T.sum_coeff x, h]
  simp

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_decompose
statement:
theorem coeff_decompose (x : P) (p : ℤ) (j : Fin T.length) :
    T.coeff (decompose (grading (M := P)) x p) j =
      decompose (grading (M := A)) (T.coeff x j) (p - T.deg j)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (decompose (grading (M := P)) x p : P) =
      ∑ l, (decompose (grading (M := A)) (T.coeff x l) (p - T.deg l) : A) • T.b l := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← T.sum_coeff x]
    rw [decompose_sum, DFinsupp.finsetSum_apply, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => decompose_smul_of_mem (T.b_mem l) _ p
  rw [hx, T.coeff_sum]

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_mem {x : P} {p : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ grading p) (j : Fin T.length) :
    T.coeff x j ∈ grading (p - T.deg j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := T.coeff_decompose x p j
  rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hx] at h
  rw [h]
  exact (decompose (grading (M := A)) (T.coeff x j) (p - T.deg j)).2

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_d_apply
statement:
theorem coeff_d_apply (x : P) (l : Fin T.length) :
    T.coeff (d x) l =
      d (T.coeff x l) + ∑ j, Shift.twist A 1 (T.coeff x j) * T.coeff (d (T.b j)) l
proof:
:= by
  have hx : d x = ∑ l, (d (T.coeff x l) +
      ∑ j, Shift.twist A 1 (T.coeff x j) * T.coeff (d (T.b j)) l) • T.b l := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← T.sum_coeff x]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [d_smul_twist, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_smul, mul_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum, T.sum_coeff]
  rw [hx, T.coeff_sum]

name: DG.TriangularBasis.mem_F
statement: theorem mem_F {i : ℕ} {x : P} : x ∈ T.F i ↔ ∀ l : Fin T.length, i ≤ l.val → T.coeff x l = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.TriangularBasis.basis_mem_F
statement: theorem basis_mem_F (j : Fin T.length) (a : A) : a • T.b j ∈ T.F (j.val + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro l hl
  rw [T.coeff_basis, Pi.single_eq_of_ne (by intro h; subst h; omega)]

name: DG.TriangularBasis.coeff_d_of_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_d_of_mem {j : Fin T.length} {x : P} (hx : x ∈ T.F (j.val + 1)) :
    T.coeff (d x) j = d (T.coeff x j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T.coeff_d_apply, add_eq_left]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ => ?_
  by_cases hl : j.val + 1 ≤ l.val
  · rw [hx l hl, map_zero, zero_mul]
  · rw [T.coeff_d l j (by rw [Fin.le_def]; omega), mul_zero]

name: DG.TriangularBasis.unmk_πFun
statement:
theorem unmk_πFun (j : Fin T.length) (x : T.F (j.val + 1)) :
    ((Shift.unmk _ (T.πFun j x) : (DGIdempotent.one A).LeftCorner) : A) =
      Shift.twist A (-T.deg j) (T.coeff x j)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TriangularBasis.π_surjective
statement: theorem π_surjective (j : Fin T.length) : Function.Surjective (T.π j)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  set y' : A := ((Shift.unmk _ y : (DGIdempotent.one A).LeftCorner) : A)
  refine ⟨⟨Shift.twist A (-T.deg j) y' • T.b j, T.basis_mem_F j _⟩, ?_⟩
  apply (Shift.unmk _).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Shift.twist A (-T.deg j) (T.coeff (Shift.twist A (-T.deg j) y' • T.b j) j) = y'
  rw [T.coeff_basis, Pi.single_eq_same, Shift.twist_twist_self]

name: DG.TriangularBasis.π_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem π_eq_zero_iff (j : Fin T.length) (x : T.F (j.val + 1)) :
    T.π j x = 0 ↔ (x : P) ∈ T.F j.val
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h l hl
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hl with h' | h'
    · have hlj : l = j := Fin.ext h'.symm
      subst hlj
      have h2 := congrArg (fun y => ((Shift.unmk _ y : (DGIdempotent.one A).LeftCorner) : A)) h
      change Shift.twist A (-T.deg l) (T.coeff x l) = 0 at h2
      rw [← Shift.twist_twist_self (-T.deg l) (T.coeff (x : P) l), h2, map_zero]
    · exact x.2 l h'
  · intro h
    apply (Shift.unmk _).injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    change Shift.twist A (-T.deg j) (T.coeff x j) = 0
    rw [h j le_rfl, map_zero]

name: DG.TriangularBasis.isKProjective
statement: theorem isKProjective : IsKProjective.{w} A P
proof: := FiniteCellFiltration.isKProjective T.finiteCellFiltration

name: DG.TriangularBasis.hasLiftingProperty
statement: theorem hasLiftingProperty : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P
proof: := FiniteCellFiltration.hasLiftingProperty T.finiteCellFiltration

name: DG.FreeBasis.coeff_add
statement: theorem coeff_add (x y : P) : B.coeff (x + y) = B.coeff x + B.coeff y
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← B.sum_coeff x, ← B.sum_coeff y, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [← add_smul]
  exact B.coeff_sum (B.coeff x + B.coeff y)

name: DG.FreeBasis.coeff_zero
statement: theorem coeff_zero : B.coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := B.coeff_sum 0
  simpa using h

name: DG.FreeBasis.coeff_zsmul
statement: theorem coeff_zsmul (k : ℤ) (x : P) : B.coeff (k • x) = k • B.coeff x
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul B.coeffHom k x

name: DG.FreeBasis.coeff_basis
statement: theorem coeff_basis [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (a : A) : B.coeff (a • B.b i) = Pi.single i a
proof:
:= by
  have h := B.coeff_sum (Pi.single i a)
  rwa [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun l _ hl => by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hl, zero_smul])
    (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same] at h

name: DG.FreeBasis.order_monotone
statement: theorem order_monotone (key : ι → ℤ) : Monotone (key ∘ order key)
proof:
:=
  Tuple.monotone_sort (key ∘ (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm)

name: DG.FreeBasis.toTriangular_length
statement:
theorem toTriangular_length (key : ι → ℤ)
    (hkey : ∀ i l, B.coeff (d (B.b i)) l ≠ 0 → key l < key i) :
    (B.toTriangular key hkey).length = Fintype.card ι
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LinearMap.map_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem LinearMap.map_mem_decomposables (f : M →ₗ[A] N) {y : M}
    (hy : y ∈ decomposables A M) : f y ∈ decomposables A N
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, a, ha, x, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [map_smul]
    exact smul_mem_decomposables hi ha _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | neg y _ h => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem h

name: DG.Shift.mk_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem Shift.mk_mem_decomposables (n : ℤ) {y : M} (hy : y ∈ decomposables A M) :
    Shift.mk n y ∈ decomposables A (Shift n M)
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, a, ha, x, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [Shift.mk_smul ha, Units.smul_def]
    exact zsmul_mem (smul_mem_decomposables hi ha _) _
  | zero => rw [Shift.mk_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [Shift.mk_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | neg y _ h => rw [Shift.mk_neg]; exact neg_mem h

name: DG.Shift.unmk_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem Shift.unmk_mem_decomposables (n : ℤ) {y : Shift n M}
    (hy : y ∈ decomposables A (Shift n M)) : Shift.unmk n y ∈ decomposables A M
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, a, ha, x, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [Shift.unmk_smul ha, Units.smul_def]
    exact zsmul_mem (smul_mem_decomposables hi ha _) _
  | zero => rw [Shift.unmk_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [Shift.unmk_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | neg y _ h => rw [Shift.unmk_neg]; exact neg_mem h

name: DG.IsMinimal.shift
statement: theorem IsMinimal.shift {n : ℤ} (hM : IsMinimal A M) : IsMinimal A (Shift n M)
proof:
:= fun x => by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := n) (M := M) x
  rw [Shift.d_mk, Shift.mk_units_smul, Units.smul_def]
  exact zsmul_mem (Shift.mk_mem_decomposables n (hM x)) _

name: DG.IsMinimal.cone
statement:
theorem IsMinimal.cone {f : S →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hS : IsMinimal A S) (hN : IsMinimal A N)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ decomposables A N) : IsMinimal A (Cone f)
proof:
:= fun p => by
  rw [← Cone.inlLinear_fstHom_add_inr_sndLinear p, Cone.d_inlLinear_add_inr]
  refine add_mem (LinearMap.map_mem_decomposables _ ((hS.shift (n := 1)) _))
    (DGModuleHom.map_mem_decomposables _ (add_mem (hf _) (hN _)))

name: DG.smul_mem_decomposables_of_isNonposGraded
statement:
theorem smul_mem_decomposables_of_isNonposGraded (hA : IsNonposGraded A) (a : A) {y : M}
    (hy : y ∈ decomposables A M) : a • y ∈ decomposables A M
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, b, hb, x, rfl⟩ := hy
    by_cases hi' : 0 < i
    · rw [hA.eq_zero hi' hb, zero_smul, smul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    induction a using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => rw [zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
    | h_add a a' h h' => rw [add_smul]; exact add_mem h h'
    | @h_homogeneous j a =>
      by_cases hj : 0 < j
      · rw [hA.eq_zero hj a.2, zero_smul]
        exact zero_mem _
      rw [← mul_smul]
      exact smul_mem_decomposables (i := j + i) (by omega) (mul_mem_grading a.2 hb) _
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | neg y _ h => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem h

name: DG.isMinimal_self
statement:
theorem isMinimal_self (hA : IsNonposGraded A) (hdA : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) (-1), d a = 0) :
    IsMinimal A A
proof:
:= fun a => by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [d_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | h_add a a' h h' => rw [d_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | @h_homogeneous j a =>
    by_cases hj : j = -1
    · subst hj
      rw [hdA _ a.2]
      exact zero_mem _
    by_cases hj' : 0 ≤ j
    · rw [hA.eq_zero (by omega) (d_mem a.2)]
      exact zero_mem _
    rw [← mul_one (d (a : A))]
    exact smul_mem_decomposables (i := j + 1) (by omega) (d_mem a.2) (1 : A)

name: DG.DirectSum.of_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem DirectSum.of_mem_decomposables {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {M : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, DGAddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module A (M i)] (i : ι)
    {y : M i} (hy : y ∈ decomposables A (M i)) :
    DirectSum.of M i y ∈ decomposables A (⨁ i, M i)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.map_mem_decomposables (DirectSum.lof A ι M i) hy

name: DG.isMinimal_directSum_shift
statement:
theorem isMinimal_directSum_shift (hA : IsNonposGraded A)
    (hdA : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) (-1), d a = 0) {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (k : ι → ℤ) :
    IsMinimal A (⨁ i, Shift (k i) A)
proof:
:= fun x => by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [d_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | of i y =>
    rw [DirectSum.d_of]
    exact DirectSum.of_mem_decomposables i ((isMinimal_self hA hdA).shift y)

name: DG.exists_linearIndependent_span_eq
statement:
theorem exists_linearIndependent_span_eq (W : Submodule k V) :
    ∃ (ι : Type v) (w : ι → V), LinearIndependent k w ∧ Submodule.span k (Set.range w) = W
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial k with hk' | hk'
  · have : Subsingleton V := Module.subsingleton k V
    refine ⟨PEmpty, PEmpty.elim, linearIndependent_empty_type, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.range_eq_empty, Submodule.span_empty]
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · let _ : DivisionRing k := DivisionRing.ofIsUnitOrEqZero hk
    let b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace k W
    refine ⟨_, fun i => (b i : V), b.linearIndependent.map' W.subtype W.ker_subtype, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.range_comp' (f := b) (g := Subtype.val), ← Submodule.coe_subtype,
      ← Submodule.map_span, b.span_eq, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]

name: DG.exists_linearIndependent_isCompl
statement:
theorem exists_linearIndependent_isCompl (W : Submodule k V) :
    ∃ (ι : Type v) (w : ι → V), LinearIndependent k w ∧
      IsCompl W (Submodule.span k (Set.range w))
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial k with hk' | hk'
  · have : Subsingleton V := Module.subsingleton k V
    refine ⟨PEmpty, PEmpty.elim, linearIndependent_empty_type, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.range_eq_empty, Submodule.span_empty, Subsingleton.elim W ⊤]
    exact isCompl_top_bot
  · let _ : DivisionRing k := DivisionRing.ofIsUnitOrEqZero hk
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Submodule.exists_isCompl W
    obtain ⟨ι, w, hw, hspan⟩ := exists_linearIndependent_span_eq hk C
    exact ⟨ι, w, hw, hspan ▸ hC⟩

name: DG.d_smul_of_mem_zero'
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_mem_zero' {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading (M := A) 0) (x : P) :
    d (a • x) = a • d x
proof:
:= by
  rw [DG.d_smul ha, hA.eq_zero (by norm_num) (d_mem ha), zero_smul, zero_add, koszulSign_zero,
    one_smul]

name: DG.mkK_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mkK_eq_zero_iff {j : ℤ} (z : cocyclesK hA P j) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk z : HK hA P j) = 0 ↔ (z : P) ∈ coboundariesK hA P j
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: DG.mapK_mk
statement:
theorem mapK_mk (f : P →ᵈᵍ[A] Q) {j : ℤ} (z : cocyclesK hA P j) :
    mapK hA f j (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (cocyclesKMap hA f j z)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.MinimalResolution.gen_mem
statement: theorem gen_mem (i : ι) : gen c i ∈ grading (c i).deg
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mem_grading _ i
    (by simpa using Shift.mk_mem_grading (n := -(c i).deg) (one_mem_grading (A := A)))

name: DG.MinimalResolution.d_gen
statement: theorem d_gen (i : ι) : d (gen c i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, DirectSum.d_of, Shift.d_mk, d_one, smul_zero, Shift.mk_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.MinimalResolution.attach_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem attach_gen (i : ι) : attach c (gen c i) = (c i).z
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, attach, DGModuleHom.toModule_lof, DGModuleHom.shiftGen_mk_one]

name: DG.MinimalResolution.attach_of
statement:
theorem attach_of (i : ι) (a : Shift (-(c i).deg) A) :
    attach c (DirectSum.of _ i a) =
      Shift.twist A (-(c i).deg) (Shift.unmk _ a) • (c i).z
proof:
:= by
  rw [attach, DGModuleHom.toModule_lof, DGModuleHom.shiftGen_apply]

name: DG.MinimalResolution.homotopy_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homotopy_gen (i : ι) : homotopy c (gen c i) = (c i).m
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopy, Cochain.rightUnshift_apply, gen, Cochain.directSumDesc_of,
    Cochain.shiftGen_mk_one, Shift.unmk_mk]

name: DG.MinimalResolution.δ_homotopy
statement: theorem δ_homotopy : δ (-1) 0 (homotopy c) = Cochain.ofHom (p.comp (attach c))
proof:
:=
  Cochain.ext_directSum_shift fun i => by
    change δ (-1) 0 (homotopy c) (gen c i) = Cochain.ofHom (p.comp (attach c)) (gen c i)
    rw [δ_neg_one_apply, d_gen, map_zero, add_zero, homotopy_gen, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
      DGModuleHom.comp_apply, attach_gen, (c i).p_z]

name: DG.MinimalResolution.attach_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem attach_mem_decomposables (hA : IsNonposGraded A)
    (hc : ∀ i, (c i).z ∈ decomposables A S) (x : Cells c) :
    attach c x ∈ decomposables A S
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | of i a =>
    rw [attach_of]
    exact smul_mem_decomposables_of_isNonposGraded hA _ (hc i)

name: DG.MinimalResolution.incl_injective
statement: theorem incl_injective : Function.Injective (incl s c)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  congrArg (Cone.sndLinear (attach c)) h

name: DG.MinimalResolution.step_π_comp_incl
statement: theorem step_π_comp_incl : (step s c).π.comp (incl s c) = s.π
proof:
:=
  Cone.inr_desc _ _ _ (δ_homotopy c)

name: DG.MinimalResolution.step_π_incl
statement: theorem step_π_incl (x : s.obj) : (step s c).π (incl s c x) = s.π x
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (step_π_comp_incl s c) x

name: DG.MinimalResolution.newGen_mem
statement: theorem newGen_mem (i : ι) : newGen s c i ∈ grading ((c i).deg - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Cone.inl (attach c)).map_mem (gen_mem c i)
  rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg] at h

name: DG.MinimalResolution.d_newGen
statement: theorem d_newGen (i : ι) : d (newGen s c i) = incl s c (c i).z
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cone.inl_d_apply (f := attach c) (gen c i)
  rw [d_gen, map_zero, sub_zero, attach_gen] at h
  exact h

name: DG.MinimalResolution.step_π_newGen
statement: theorem step_π_newGen (i : ι) : (step s c).π (newGen s c i) = (c i).m
proof:
:=
  (Cone.inl_desc_apply _ _ _ (δ_homotopy c) _).trans (homotopy_gen c i)

name: DG.MinimalResolution.isMinimal_step
statement:
theorem isMinimal_step (hA : IsNonposGraded A) (hdA : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) (-1), d a = 0)
    (hs : IsMinimal A s.obj) (hc : ∀ i, (c i).z ∈ decomposables A s.obj) :
    IsMinimal A (step s c).obj
proof:
:=
  IsMinimal.cone (isMinimal_directSum_shift hA hdA _) hs (attach_mem_decomposables c hA hc)

name: DG.MinimalResolution.cells_eq_zero
statement: theorem cells_eq_zero {k : ℤ} (hk : g + 1 < k) {x : Cells c} (hx : x ∈ grading k) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
