  have hc : x i ∈ grading k := hx i
  rw [DirectSum.zero_apply]
  exact (Shift.unmk _).injective (by
    rw [hA.eq_zero (by rw [hdeg i]; omega) (Shift.unmk_mem_grading hc)]; rfl)

name: DG.MinimalResolution.incl_sndLinear
statement:
theorem incl_sndLinear {j : ℤ} (hj : g < j) {x : (step s c).obj} (hx : x ∈ grading j) :
    incl s c (Cone.sndLinear (A := A) (attach c) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx₁, -⟩ := Cone.mem_grading_iff.mp hx
  have h0 : Cone.fstHom (attach c) x = 0 :=
    (Shift.unmk 1).injective (cells_eq_zero s c hA hdeg (k := j + 1) (by omega)
      (Shift.unmk_mem_grading hx₁))
  have h := Cone.inlLinear_fstHom_add_inr_sndLinear (A := A) (f := attach c) x
  rw [h0, map_zero, zero_add] at h
  exact h

name: DG.MinimalResolution.exists_eq_incl
statement:
theorem exists_eq_incl {j : ℤ} (hj : g < j) {x : (step s c).obj} (hx : x ∈ grading j) :
    ∃ y ∈ grading j, incl s c y = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, Cone.sndLinear_mem (A := A) hx, incl_sndLinear s c hA hdeg hj hx⟩

name: DG.MinimalResolution.cells_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem cells_mem_decomposables {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≤ g) {x : Cells c} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x ∈ decomposables A (Cells c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x]
  refine sum_mem fun i _ => DirectSum.of_mem_decomposables i ?_
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := -(c i).deg) (M := A) (x i)
  have hb' : b ∈ grading (k - (g + 1)) := by
    have := Shift.unmk_mem_grading (hx i)
    rw [← hb, Shift.unmk_mk] at this
    convert this using 2
    rw [hdeg i]
    ring
  rw [← hb, ← mul_one b, ← smul_eq_mul, Shift.mk_smul hb', Units.smul_def]
  exact zsmul_mem (smul_mem_decomposables (by omega) hb' _) _

name: DG.MinimalResolution.mem_decomposables_of_le
statement:
theorem mem_decomposables_of_le
    (hs : ∀ j ≤ g, ∀ y ∈ grading (M := s.obj) j, y ∈ decomposables A s.obj) {j : ℤ}
    (hj : j ≤ g - 1) {x : (step s c).obj} (hx : x ∈ grading j) :
    x ∈ decomposables A (step s c).obj
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := Cone.mem_grading_iff.mp hx
  rw [← Cone.inlLinear_fstHom_add_inr_sndLinear (A := A) (f := attach c) x]
  refine add_mem (LinearMap.map_mem_decomposables _ ?_)
    (DGModuleHom.map_mem_decomposables _ (hs j (by omega) _ hx₂))
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := 1) (M := Cells c) (Cone.fstHom (attach c) x)
  rw [← hw]
  refine Shift.mk_mem_decomposables 1 (cells_mem_decomposables s c hdeg (k := j + 1)
    (by omega) ?_)
  have := Shift.unmk_mem_grading hx₁
  rwa [← hw, Shift.unmk_mk] at this

name: DG.MinimalResolution.exists_eq_sum
statement:
theorem exists_eq_sum {x : (step s c).obj} (hx : x ∈ grading g) :
    ∃ (t : Finset ι) (l : ι → A), (∀ i, l i ∈ grading (M := A) 0) ∧ ∃ y ∈ grading g,
      x = ∑ i ∈ t, l i • newGen s c i + incl s c y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := Cone.mem_grading_iff.mp hx
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := 1) (M := Cells c) (Cone.fstHom (attach c) x)
  have hw' : w ∈ grading (g + 1) := by
    have := Shift.unmk_mem_grading hx₁
    rwa [← hw, Shift.unmk_mk] at this
  have hl : ∀ i, Shift.unmk _ (w i) ∈ grading (M := A) 0 := fun i => by
    have := Shift.unmk_mem_grading (hw' i)
    convert this using 2
    rw [hdeg i]
    ring
  refine ⟨w.support, fun i => Shift.unmk _ (w i), hl, _, Cone.sndLinear_mem (A := A) hx, ?_⟩
  have hgen : ∀ i, (Shift.unmk _ (w i) : A) • gen c i = DirectSum.of _ i (w i) := fun i => by
    rw [gen, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of A, ← LinearMap.map_smul, Shift.smul_mk (hl i), mul_zero,
      koszulSign_zero, one_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Shift.mk_unmk]
    exact DirectSum.lof_eq_of A ι (fun i => Shift (-(c i).deg) A) i (w i)
  have hinl : Cone.inl (attach c) w = ∑ i ∈ w.support, Shift.unmk _ (w i) • newGen s c i := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of w]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← hgen, Cochain.map_smul _ (hl i), mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    rfl
  rw [← hinl]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Cone.inlLinear_fstHom_add_inr_sndLinear (A := A) (f := attach c) x, ← hw]
  rfl

name: DG.MinimalResolution.kerVec_linearIndependent
statement: theorem kerVec_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent (degreeZeroSubring A) (kerVec hA hk s g)
proof:
:=
  (exists_linearIndependent_span_eq hk
    (LinearMap.ker (mapK hA s.π (g + 1)))).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: DG.MinimalResolution.span_kerVec
statement:
theorem span_kerVec : Submodule.span (degreeZeroSubring A) (Set.range (kerVec hA hk s g)) =
    LinearMap.ker (mapK hA s.π (g + 1))
proof:
:=
  (exists_linearIndependent_span_eq hk
    (LinearMap.ker (mapK hA s.π (g + 1)))).choose_spec.choose_spec.2

name: DG.MinimalResolution.mk_kerRep
statement:
theorem mk_kerRep (i : KerIndex hA hk s g) :
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (kerRep hA hk s g i) = kerVec hA hk s g i
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ (kerVec hA hk s g i)).choose_spec

name: DG.MinimalResolution.exists_kerM
statement:
theorem exists_kerM (i : KerIndex hA hk s g) :
    ∃ m ∈ grading (M := M) (g + 1 - 1), d m = s.π (kerRep hA hk s g i)
proof:
:= by
  have h : kerVec hA hk s g i ∈ LinearMap.ker (mapK hA s.π (g + 1)) := by
    rw [← span_kerVec hA hk s g]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, ← mk_kerRep hA hk s g, mapK_mk, mkK_eq_zero_iff] at h
  exact h.2

name: DG.MinimalResolution.cokVec_linearIndependent
statement: theorem cokVec_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent (degreeZeroSubring A) (cokVec hA hk s g)
proof:
:=
  (exists_linearIndependent_isCompl hk
    (LinearMap.range (mapK hA s.π g))).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: DG.MinimalResolution.isCompl_cokVec
statement:
theorem isCompl_cokVec : IsCompl (LinearMap.range (mapK hA s.π g))
    (Submodule.span (degreeZeroSubring A) (Set.range (cokVec hA hk s g)))
proof:
:=
  (exists_linearIndependent_isCompl hk
    (LinearMap.range (mapK hA s.π g))).choose_spec.choose_spec.2

name: DG.MinimalResolution.mk_cokRep
statement:
theorem mk_cokRep (i : CokIndex hA hk s g) :
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (cokRep hA hk s g i) = cokVec hA hk s g i
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ (cokVec hA hk s g i)).choose_spec

name: DG.MinimalResolution.cells_deg
statement:
theorem cells_deg (i : KerIndex hA hk s g ⊕ CokIndex hA hk s g) :
    (cells hA hk s g i).deg = g + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with i | i <;> rfl

name: DG.MinimalResolution.d_smul_newGen
statement:
theorem d_smul_newGen {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading (M := A) 0) (i) :
    d (a • newGen s (cells hA hk s g) i) = a • incl s (cells hA hk s g) (cells hA hk s g i).z
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_smul_of_mem_zero' hA _ ha, d_newGen]

name: DG.MinimalResolution.injAt_nextStage
statement:
theorem injAt_nextStage (hs : ∀ i ≥ g + 2, InjAt s i) :
    ∀ i ≥ g + 1, InjAt (nextStage hA hk s g) i
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi x' hx' hdx' ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_incl s (cells hA hk s g) hA (cells_deg hA hk s g)
    (by omega : g < i) hx'
  have hdx : d x = 0 := incl_injective s (cells hA hk s g)
    (by rw [DGModuleHom.map_d, hdx', map_zero])
  have hπ : d m = s.π x := by rw [hdm]; exact step_π_incl s (cells hA hk s g) x
  by_cases hi' : g + 2 ≤ i
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy⟩ := hs i hi' x hx hdx ⟨m, hm, hπ⟩
    exact ⟨incl s _ y, (incl s _).map_mem hy, by rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hdy]⟩
  obtain rfl : i = g + 1 := by omega
  let xz : cocyclesK hA s.obj (g + 1) := ⟨x, hx, hdx⟩
  have hker : Submodule.Quotient.mk xz ∈ LinearMap.ker (mapK hA s.π (g + 1)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, mapK_mk, mkK_eq_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨s.π.map_mem hx, m, hm, hπ⟩
  rw [← span_kerVec hA hk s g] at hker
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hker
  let r : cocyclesK hA s.obj (g + 1) := c.sum fun i a => a • kerRep hA hk s g i
  have hr : Submodule.Quotient.mk r =
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk xz : HK hA s.obj (g + 1)) := by
    rw [← hc]
    show Submodule.Quotient.mk (∑ i ∈ c.support, c i • kerRep hA hk s g i) =
      ∑ i ∈ c.support, c i • kerVec hA hk s g i
    rw [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, mk_kerRep]
  have hsub : Submodule.Quotient.mk (xz - r) = (0 : HK hA s.obj (g + 1)) := by
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, hr, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨-, y, hy, hdy⟩ := (mkK_eq_zero_iff hA _).mp hsub
  have hrval : (r : s.obj) =
      ∑ i ∈ c.support, ((c i : degreeZeroSubring A) : A) • (kerRep hA hk s g i : s.obj) := by
    simp only [r, Finsupp.sum, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul]
    rfl
  refine ⟨incl s _ y + ∑ i ∈ c.support,
      ((c i : degreeZeroSubring A) : A) • newGen s (cells hA hk s g) (Sum.inl i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine add_mem ((incl s _).map_mem hy) (sum_mem fun i _ => ?_)
    have := smul_mem_grading (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp (c i).2)
      (newGen_mem s (cells hA hk s g) (Sum.inl i))
    simpa [cells, kerCell] using this
  · rw [d_add, ← DGModuleHom.map_d, hdy, Submodule.coe_sub, map_sub, map_sum]
    simp only [d_smul_newGen hA hk s g (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp (c _).2)]
    change incl s _ x - incl s _ (r : s.obj) + _ = _
    rw [hrval, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
    exact sub_add_cancel _ _

name: DG.MinimalResolution.surjAt_nextStage
statement:
theorem surjAt_nextStage (hs : ∀ i ≥ g + 1, SurjAt s i) :
    ∀ i ≥ g, SurjAt (nextStage hA hk s g) i
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi m hm hdm
  by_cases hi' : g + 1 ≤ i
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, m', hm', hdm'⟩ := hs i hi' m hm hdm
    refine ⟨incl s _ x, (incl s _).map_mem hx, by rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hdx, map_zero], m', hm',
      ?_⟩
    rw [hdm']
    exact congrArg (· - m) (step_π_incl s (cells hA hk s g) x).symm
  obtain rfl : i = g := by omega
  let mz : cocyclesK hA M i := ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩
  have htop : Submodule.Quotient.mk mz ∈ LinearMap.range (mapK hA s.π i) ⊔
      Submodule.span (degreeZeroSubring A) (Set.range (cokVec hA hk s i)) := by
    rw [(isCompl_cokVec hA hk s i).sup_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp htop
  obtain ⟨yq, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp ha
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ yq
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hb
  let w : cocyclesK hA M i := cocyclesKMap hA s.π i y + c.sum (fun j a => a • cokRep hA hk s i j)
    - mz
  have hw : Submodule.Quotient.mk w = (0 : HK hA M i) := by
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_add, ← mapK_mk, ← hab, ← hc,
      sub_eq_zero]
    congr 1
    show Submodule.Quotient.mk (∑ j ∈ c.support, c j • cokRep hA hk s i j) =
      ∑ j ∈ c.support, c j • cokVec hA hk s i j
    rw [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, mk_cokRep]
  obtain ⟨-, m', hm', hdm'⟩ := (mkK_eq_zero_iff hA _).mp hw
  refine ⟨incl s _ (y : s.obj) + ∑ j ∈ c.support,
      ((c j : degreeZeroSubring A) : A) • newGen s (cells hA hk s i) (Sum.inr j), ?_, ?_,
      m', hm', ?_⟩
  · refine add_mem ((incl s _).map_mem y.2.1) (sum_mem fun j _ => ?_)
    have := smul_mem_grading (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp (c j).2)
      (newGen_mem s (cells hA hk s i) (Sum.inr j))
    simpa [cells, cokCell] using this
  · rw [d_add, ← DGModuleHom.map_d, y.2.2, map_zero, zero_add, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ?_
    rw [d_smul_newGen hA hk s i (mem_degreeZeroSubring.mp (c j).2)]
    change _ • incl s _ 0 = 0
    rw [map_zero, smul_zero]
  · rw [hdm', map_add, map_sum, step_π_incl]
    simp only [map_smul, step_π_newGen]
    simp only [w, mz, Finsupp.sum, Submodule.coe_sub, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_sum,
      Submodule.coe_smul]
    rfl

name: DG.MinimalResolution.isMinimal_nextStage
statement:
theorem isMinimal_nextStage (hdA : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) (-1), d a = 0)
    (hmin : IsMinimal A s.obj)
    (hker : ∀ z ∈ grading (M := s.obj) (g + 1), d z = 0 →
      (∃ m ∈ grading (M := M) (g + 1 - 1), d m = s.π z) → z ∈ decomposables A s.obj) :
    IsMinimal A (nextStage hA hk s g).obj
proof:
:= by
  refine isMinimal_step s _ hA hdA hmin ?_
  rintro (i | i)
  · exact hker _ (kerRep hA hk s g i).2.1 (kerRep hA hk s g i).2.2 (exists_kerM hA hk s g i)
  · exact zero_mem _

name: DG.MinimalResolution.mem_decomposables_of_cocycle
statement:
theorem mem_decomposables_of_cocycle
    (hD : ∀ j ≤ g, ∀ y ∈ grading (M := s.obj) j, y ∈ decomposables A s.obj)
    {z : (nextStage hA hk s g).obj} (hz : z ∈ grading g) (hdz : d z = 0)
    (hπ : ∃ m ∈ grading (M := M) (g - 1), d m = (nextStage hA hk s g).π z) :
    z ∈ decomposables A (nextStage hA hk s g).obj
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, l, hl, y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_sum s (cells hA hk s g) (cells_deg hA hk s g) hz
  let c := cells hA hk s g
  rw [← Finset.toLeft_disjSum_toRight (u := t), Finset.sum_disjSum] at hdz hπ ⊢
  
  have hd : ∑ i ∈ t.toLeft, l (Sum.inl i) • (kerRep hA hk s g i : s.obj) + d y = 0 := by
    apply incl_injective s c
    rw [map_zero, ← hdz, map_add, map_sum, d_add, d_add, map_sum, map_sum, ← DGModuleHom.map_d]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (s := t.toRight) fun i _ => by
      rw [d_smul_newGen hA hk s g (hl _)]
      change _ • incl s c 0 = 0
      rw [map_zero, smul_zero], add_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [d_smul_newGen hA hk s g (hl _), map_smul]
    rfl
  
  have hL : ∀ i ∈ t.toLeft, l (Sum.inl i) = 0 := by
    let r : cocyclesK hA s.obj (g + 1) :=
      ∑ i ∈ t.toLeft, (⟨l (Sum.inl i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) • kerRep hA hk s g i
    have hr : (r : s.obj) = d (-y) := by
      rw [d_neg, ← add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp hd]
      simp only [r, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul]
      rfl
    have hr0 : Submodule.Quotient.mk r = (0 : HK hA s.obj (g + 1)) := by
      rw [mkK_eq_zero_iff]
      exact ⟨r.2.1, -y, by simpa using neg_mem hy, hr.symm⟩
    have hsum : ∑ i ∈ t.toLeft, (⟨l (Sum.inl i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) •
        kerVec hA hk s g i = 0 := by
      rw [← hr0]
      show _ = Submodule.mkQ _ (∑ i ∈ t.toLeft,
        (⟨l (Sum.inl i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) • kerRep hA hk s g i)
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, mk_kerRep]
    intro i hi
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (linearIndependent_iff'.mp (kerVec_linearIndependent hA hk s g) _ _ hsum i hi)
  have hdy : d y = 0 := by
    rw [← hd, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => by rw [hL i hi, zero_smul], zero_add]
  
  have hR : ∀ i ∈ t.toRight, l (Sum.inr i) = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := hπ
    let yz : cocyclesK hA s.obj g := ⟨y, hy, hdy⟩
    let w : cocyclesK hA M g :=
      (∑ i ∈ t.toRight, (⟨l (Sum.inr i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) • cokRep hA hk s g i) +
        cocyclesKMap hA s.π g yz
    have hw : (w : M) = d m := by
      rw [hdm, map_add, map_add, map_sum, map_sum, step_π_incl,
        Finset.sum_eq_zero (s := t.toLeft) fun i hi => by rw [hL i hi, zero_smul, map_zero],
        zero_add]
      simp only [w, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, map_smul,
        step_π_newGen]
      rfl
    have hw0 : Submodule.Quotient.mk w = (0 : HK hA M g) := by
      rw [mkK_eq_zero_iff]
      exact ⟨w.2.1, m, by simpa using hm, hw.symm⟩
    have hsum : ∑ i ∈ t.toRight, (⟨l (Sum.inr i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) •
        cokVec hA hk s g i = 0 := by
      have hmem : ∑ i ∈ t.toRight, (⟨l (Sum.inr i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) •
          cokVec hA hk s g i = -mapK hA s.π g (Submodule.Quotient.mk yz) := by
        have hcomb : Submodule.mkQ _ (∑ i ∈ t.toRight,
            (⟨l (Sum.inr i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) • cokRep hA hk s g i) =
            ∑ i ∈ t.toRight, (⟨l (Sum.inr i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) •
              cokVec hA hk s g i := by
          rw [map_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, mk_cokRep]
        rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← hw0, ← hcomb, mapK_mk, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
          ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]
      have h1 : ∑ i ∈ t.toRight, (⟨l (Sum.inr i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) •
          cokVec hA hk s g i ∈ LinearMap.range (mapK hA s.π g) := by
        rw [hmem]
        exact neg_mem (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _)
      have h2 : ∑ i ∈ t.toRight, (⟨l (Sum.inr i), hl _⟩ : degreeZeroSubring A) •
          cokVec hA hk s g i ∈
            Submodule.span (degreeZeroSubring A) (Set.range (cokVec hA hk s g)) :=
        sum_mem fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      have := (isCompl_cokVec hA hk s g).inf_eq_bot
      rw [← Submodule.mem_bot (R := degreeZeroSubring A), ← this]
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    intro i hi
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (linearIndependent_iff'.mp (cokVec_linearIndependent hA hk s g) _ _ hsum i hi)
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => by rw [hL i hi, zero_smul],
    Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => by rw [hR i hi, zero_smul], zero_add, zero_add]
  exact DGModuleHom.map_mem_decomposables _ (hD g le_rfl y hy)

name: DG.MinimalResolution.ι_injective
statement: theorem ι_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (ι M hA hk N n)
proof:
:=
  incl_injective _ _

name: DG.MinimalResolution.π_of
statement:
theorem π_of (n : ℕ) (x : Obj M hA hk N n) :
    π M hA hk N (SeqColimit.of _ _ n x) = (stage M hA hk N n).π x
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.desc_of _ _ _ _

name: DG.MinimalResolution.stage_zero_eq_zero
statement: theorem stage_zero_eq_zero (x : Obj M hA hk N 0) : x = 0
proof: := Subsingleton.elim (α := PUnit) _ _

name: DG.MinimalResolution.invariants
statement:
theorem invariants (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ i ≥ N - n + 2, InjAt (stage M hA hk N n) i) ∧
    (∀ i ≥ N - n + 1, SurjAt (stage M hA hk N n) i) ∧
    (∀ j ≤ N - n, ∀ y ∈ grading (M := Obj M hA hk N n) j,
      y ∈ decomposables A (Obj M hA hk N n)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ grading (M := Obj M hA hk N n) (N - n + 1), d z = 0 →
      (∃ m ∈ grading (M := M) (N - n + 1 - 1), d m = (stage M hA hk N n).π z) →
        z ∈ decomposables A (Obj M hA hk N n)) ∧
    IsMinimal A (Obj M hA hk N n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun i _ x _ _ _ => ⟨0, zero_mem _, (stage_zero_eq_zero hA hk N x).symm ▸ d_zero⟩,
      fun i hi m hm hdm => ?_, fun j _ y _ => (stage_zero_eq_zero hA hk N y) ▸ zero_mem _,
      fun z _ _ _ => (stage_zero_eq_zero hA hk N z) ▸ zero_mem _,
      fun x => (stage_zero_eq_zero hA hk N x) ▸ (d_zero (M := Obj M hA hk N 0)).symm ▸ zero_mem _⟩
    obtain ⟨m', hm', hdm'⟩ := hM i (by push_cast at hi; omega) m hm hdm
    refine ⟨0, zero_mem _, d_zero, -m', neg_mem hm', ?_⟩
    rw [d_neg, hdm', map_zero, zero_sub]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hinj, hsurj, hD, hker, hmin⟩ := ih
    let s := stage M hA hk N n
    refine ⟨fun i hi => injAt_nextStage hA hk s (N - n) (fun i hi => hinj i (by omega)) i
        (by push_cast at hi; omega),
      fun i hi => surjAt_nextStage hA hk s (N - n) (fun i hi => hsurj i (by omega)) i
        (by push_cast at hi; omega),
      fun j hj y hy => mem_decomposables_of_le s (cells hA hk s (N - n)) (cells_deg hA hk s _)
        hD (by push_cast at hj; omega) hy,
      fun z hz hdz ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ => mem_decomposables_of_cocycle hA hk s (N - n) hD
        (by rwa [show N - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = N - n by push_cast; ring] at hz) hdz
        ⟨m, by rwa [show N - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = N - n - 1 by push_cast; ring] at hm,
          hdm⟩,
      isMinimal_nextStage hA hk s (N - n) hdA hmin hker⟩

name: DG.MinimalResolution.stage_eq_zero
statement:
theorem stage_eq_zero (n : ℕ) {j : ℤ} (hj : N < j) {x : Obj M hA hk N n}
    (hx : x ∈ grading j) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact stage_zero_eq_zero hA hk N x
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_incl (stage M hA hk N n) _ hA (cells_deg hA hk _ (N - n))
      (by omega : N - n < j) hx
    rw [ih hy, map_zero]

name: DG.MinimalResolution.isQuasiIso_π
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_π : (π M hA hk N).IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= fun j => by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, N - n + 2 ≤ j := ⟨(N - j + 2).toNat, by omega⟩
  constructor
  · rw [cohomology.map_injective_iff]
    intro x hx hdx hpx
    obtain ⟨n₀, y₀, rfl⟩ := SeqColimit.exists_of_eq x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := SeqColimit.filtration_mono (le_max_left n₀ n)
      (SeqColimit.of_mem_filtration (ι := ι M hA hk N) n₀ y₀)
    replace hy : SeqColimit.of _ _ (max n₀ n) y = SeqColimit.of _ _ n₀ y₀ := hy
    have hinj := SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective M hA hk N) (max n₀ n)
    rw [← hy] at hx hdx hpx ⊢
    have hy' : y ∈ grading j := (SeqColimit.of _ _ _).mem_grading_of_injective hinj hx
    have hdy : d y = 0 := hinj (by rw [DGModuleHom.map_d, hdx, map_zero])
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hpx
    rw [π_of] at hdm
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := ((invariants hA hk N hdA hM (max n₀ n)).1 j
      (by have := le_max_right n₀ n; omega)) y hy' hdy ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩
    exact mem_coboundaries.mpr ⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ _ z, (SeqColimit.of _ _ _).map_mem hz, by
      rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hdz]⟩
  · rw [cohomology.map_surjective_iff]
    intro m hm hdm
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, m', hm', hdm'⟩ :=
      (invariants hA hk N hdA hM n).2.1 j (by omega) m hm hdm
    exact ⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ n x, (SeqColimit.of _ _ n).map_mem hx,
      by rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hdx, map_zero],
      mem_coboundaries.mpr ⟨m', hm', by rw [π_of, hdm']⟩⟩

name: DG.MinimalResolution.isMinimal_colim
statement: theorem isMinimal_colim : IsMinimal A (Colim M hA hk N)
proof:
:= fun x => by
  obtain ⟨n, y, rfl⟩ := SeqColimit.exists_of_eq x
  rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d]
  exact DGModuleHom.map_mem_decomposables _ ((invariants hA hk N hdA hM n).2.2.2.2 y)

name: DG.MinimalResolution.isBoundedAbove_colim
statement: theorem isBoundedAbove_colim : IsBoundedAbove (Colim M hA hk N)
proof:
:= ⟨N, fun i hi x hx => by
  obtain ⟨n, y, rfl⟩ := SeqColimit.exists_of_eq x
  have hinj := SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective M hA hk N) n
  rw [stage_eq_zero hA hk N n hi ((SeqColimit.of _ _ n).mem_grading_of_injective hinj hx),
    map_zero]⟩

name: DG.MinimalResolution.bijective_rangeRestrict
statement:
theorem bijective_rangeRestrict (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (SeqColimit.of (Obj M hA hk N) (ι M hA hk N) n).rangeRestrict
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective M hA hk N) n (congrArg Subtype.val h),
    fun ⟨_, y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, Subtype.ext hy⟩⟩

name: DG.MinimalResolution.of_toObj
statement:
theorem of_toObj {n : ℕ} (x : SeqColimit.filtration (S := Obj M hA hk N) (ι := ι M hA hk N) n) :
    SeqColimit.of _ _ n (toObj M hA hk N n x) = (x : Colim M hA hk N)
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (DGModuleHom.apply_inverse_apply _ (bijective_rangeRestrict M hA hk N n) x)

name: DG.MinimalResolution.toObj_eq
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective M hA hk N) n (by rw [of_toObj, h])

name: DG.MinimalResolution.surjective_filtrationπ
statement: theorem surjective_filtrationπ (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (filtrationπ M hA hk N n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_bijective _ _).2.comp
    (Function.Surjective.comp (fun y => ⟨Cone.inlLinear _ y, Cone.fstHom_inlLinear y⟩) ?_)
  intro y
  exact ⟨⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1) y, SeqColimit.of_mem_filtration (ι := ι M hA hk N) (n + 1) y⟩,
    toObj_eq M hA hk N rfl⟩

name: DG.MinimalResolution.filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ)
    (x : SeqColimit.filtration (S := Obj M hA hk N) (ι := ι M hA hk N) (n + 1)) :
    filtrationπ M hA hk N n x = 0 ↔ (x : Colim M hA hk N) ∈ SeqColimit.filtration n
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtrationπ, DGModuleHom.comp_apply,
    map_eq_zero_iff _ (DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_bijective _ _).1, DGModuleHom.comp_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hy : toObj M hA hk N (n + 1) x = ι M hA hk N n (Cone.sndLinear
        (attach (cells hA hk (stage M hA hk N n) (N - n))) (toObj M hA hk N (n + 1) x)) :=
      Cone.ext (h.trans (Cone.fstHom_inr _).symm) (Cone.sndLinear_inr _).symm
    refine ⟨Cone.sndLinear (attach (cells hA hk (stage M hA hk N n) (N - n)))
      (toObj M hA hk N (n + 1) x), ?_⟩
    change SeqColimit.of _ _ n _ = _
    rw [← SeqColimit.of_succ_ι (ι := ι M hA hk N), ← hy, of_toObj]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h' : toObj M hA hk N (n + 1) x = ι M hA hk N n y :=
      toObj_eq M hA hk N (by rw [SeqColimit.of_succ_ι]; exact hy)
    exact (congrArg (Cone.fstHom (attach (cells hA hk (stage M hA hk N n) (N - n)))) h').trans
      (Cone.fstHom_inr y)

name: DG.exists_minimal_semiFreeResolution
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_semiFreeResolution (hA : IsNonposGraded A)
    (hdA : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) (-1), d a = 0)
    (hk : ∀ a : degreeZeroSubring A, IsUnit a ∨ a = 0) (N : ℤ)
    (hM : ∀ i > N, ∀ m ∈ grading (M := M) i, d m = 0 →
      ∃ m' ∈ grading (M := M) (i - 1), d m' = m) :
    ∃ (P : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup P) (_ : DGAddCommGroup P) (_ : Module A P)
      (_ : DGModule A P) (π : P →ᵈᵍ[A] M), π.IsQuasiIso ∧
        Nonempty (SemiFreeFiltration.{max u v} A P) ∧ IsMinimal A P ∧ IsBoundedAbove P
proof:
:=
  ⟨MinimalResolution.Colim M hA hk N, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    MinimalResolution.π M hA hk N, MinimalResolution.isQuasiIso_π hA hk N hdA hM,
    ⟨MinimalResolution.semiFreeFiltration M hA hk N⟩, MinimalResolution.isMinimal_colim hA hk N hdA hM,
    MinimalResolution.isBoundedAbove_colim hA hk N⟩

name: DG.MinimalResolution.isBoundedMinimal_colim
statement:
theorem MinimalResolution.isBoundedMinimal_colim (hA : IsNonposGraded A)
    (hdA : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) (-1), d a = 0)
    (hk : ∀ a : degreeZeroSubring A, IsUnit a ∨ a = 0) (N : ℤ)
    (hM : ∀ i > N, ∀ m ∈ grading (M := M) i, d m = 0 →
      ∃ m' ∈ grading (M := M) (i - 1), d m' = m) :
    IsBoundedMinimal A (MinimalResolution.Colim M hA hk N)
proof:
:=
  ⟨MinimalResolution.isMinimal_colim hA hk N hdA hM,
    Or.inr ⟨fun _ hj _ ha => hA.eq_zero hj ha, MinimalResolution.isBoundedAbove_colim hA hk N⟩⟩

name: DG.eq_sum_coeffTensor
statement:
theorem eq_sum_coeffTensor (t : TensorProductOver A M (RightDual A M)) :
    t = ∑ i, tmul A (coeffTensor R i t) (R.δ i)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [map_zero, zero_tmul]
  | tmul z f =>
    conv_lhs => rw [← R.dualBasis.sum_coeff f]
    rw [← TensorProductOver.tmulAddHom_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [TensorProductOver.tmulAddHom_apply]
    rw [← op_smul_tmul]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy =>
    conv_lhs => rw [hx, hy]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_add, add_tmul]

name: DG.rankOne_op_smul
statement:
theorem rankOne_op_smul (z : M) (f : RightDual A M) (a : A) (x : M) :
    rankOne z (RightDual.toHom f) (op a • x) = op a • rankOne z (RightDual.toHom f) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankOne_apply, rankOne_apply, RightDual.map_op_smul, op_mul, mul_smul]

name: DG.FullAction.ext
statement: theorem ext {e e' : E} (h : ∀ w : M, e • w = e' • w) : e = e'
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_zero.mp (H.faithful _ fun w => by rw [sub_smul, h, sub_self])

name: DG.FullAction.rho_smul
statement:
theorem rho_smul (z : M) (f : RightDual A M) (w : M) :
    H.rho z f • w = op (RightDual.toHom f w) • z
proof:
:=
  (H.full _ (rankOne_op_smul z f)).choose_spec w

name: DG.FullAction.rho_add_left
statement:
theorem rho_add_left (z z' : M) (f : RightDual A M) :
    H.rho (z + z') f = H.rho z f + H.rho z' f
proof:
:=
  H.ext fun w => by rw [add_smul, rho_smul, rho_smul, rho_smul, smul_add]

name: DG.FullAction.rho_add_right
statement:
theorem rho_add_right (z : M) (f f' : RightDual A M) :
    H.rho z (f + f') = H.rho z f + H.rho z f'
proof:
:=
  H.ext fun w => by
    rw [add_smul, rho_smul, rho_smul, rho_smul, RightDual.toHom_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
      op_add, add_smul]

name: DG.FullAction.rho_zero_left
statement: theorem rho_zero_left (f : RightDual A M) : H.rho 0 f = 0
proof:
:=
  H.ext fun w => by rw [rho_smul, smul_zero, zero_smul]

name: DG.FullAction.rho_zero_right
statement: theorem rho_zero_right (z : M) : H.rho z 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  H.ext fun w => by
    rw [rho_smul, zero_smul, show RightDual.toHom (0 : RightDual A M) = 0 from rfl,
      AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, op_zero, zero_smul]

name: DG.FullAction.rho_balanced
statement:
theorem rho_balanced (a : A) (z : M) (f : RightDual A M) :
    H.rho (op a • z) f = H.rho z (a • f)
proof:
:=
  H.ext fun w => by
    rw [rho_smul, rho_smul, RightDual.toHom_smul, smul_smul, op_mul]

name: DG.FullAction.rho_smul_left
statement: theorem rho_smul_left (e : E) (z : M) (f : RightDual A M) : H.rho (e • z) f = e * H.rho z f
proof:
:=
  H.ext fun w => by rw [rho_smul, mul_smul, rho_smul, smul_comm e]

name: DG.FullAction.rho_op_smul
statement: theorem rho_op_smul (e : E) (z : M) (f : RightDual A M) : H.rho z (op e • f) = H.rho z f * e
proof:
:=
  H.ext fun w => by rw [rho_smul, mul_smul, rho_smul, RightDual.toHom_op_smul]

name: DG.FullAction.rho_mem
statement:
theorem rho_mem {i k : ℤ} {z : M} (hz : z ∈ grading i) {f : RightDual A M} (hf : f ∈ grading k) :
    H.rho z f ∈ grading (i + k)
proof:
:=
  H.mem_grading _ _ fun j w hw => by
    rw [rho_smul]
    have h := op_smul_mem_grading (RightDual.apply_mem_grading hf hw) hz
    rwa [show i + (j + k) = i + k + j by ring] at h

name: DG.FullAction.d_rho
statement:
theorem d_rho {i k : ℤ} {z : M} (hz : z ∈ grading i) {f : RightDual A M} (hf : f ∈ grading k) :
    d (H.rho z f) = H.rho (d z) f + koszulSign i • H.rho z (d f)
proof:
:= by
  refine H.ext fun w => ?_
  induction w using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [smul_zero, smul_zero]
  | h_add w w' hw hw' => rw [smul_add, smul_add, hw, hw']
  | @h_homogeneous j w =>
    have hL := d_smul (H.rho_mem hz hf) (w : M)
    have hdfw : d (RightDual.toHom f w) =
        RightDual.toHom (d f) w + koszulSign k • RightDual.toHom f (d (w : M)) := by
      rw [RightDual.d_apply_of_mem hf]; abel
    rw [rho_smul, d_op_smul hz, hdfw, rho_smul] at hL
    rw [add_smul, Units.smul_def, smul_assoc, rho_smul, rho_smul]
    rw [Units.smul_def (koszulSign k), MulOpposite.op_add, MulOpposite.op_smul, add_smul,
      smul_assoc, koszulSign_add] at hL
    refine (eq_sub_of_add_eq hL.symm).trans ?_
    rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (koszulSign i) with hi | hi <;>
      rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (koszulSign k) with hk | hk <;>
      simp only [hi, hk, Units.val_one, Units.val_neg, one_smul, neg_smul, one_mul, mul_one,
        neg_mul, neg_neg, smul_add, Units.neg_smul] <;>
      abel

name: DG.FullAction.mulHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mulHom_tmul (z : M) (f : RightDual A M) :
    H.mulHom (tmul A z f) = H.rho z f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.FullAction.mulHom_smul
statement:
theorem mulHom_smul (e : E) (t : TensorProductOver A M (RightDual A M)) :
    H.mulHom (e • t) = e * H.mulHom t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
  | tmul z f => rw [smul_tmul, mulHom_tmul, mulHom_tmul, rho_smul_left]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, mul_add]

name: DG.FullAction.mulHom_op_smul
statement:
theorem mulHom_op_smul (e : E) (t : TensorProductOver A M (RightDual A M)) :
    H.mulHom (op e • t) = H.mulHom t * e
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, map_zero, zero_mul]
  | tmul z f => rw [op_smul_tmul_right, mulHom_tmul, mulHom_tmul, rho_op_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_mul]

name: DG.FullAction.mulHom_mem
statement:
theorem mulHom_mem {k : ℤ} {t : TensorProductOver A M (RightDual A M)} (ht : t ∈ grading k) :
    H.mulHom t ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_mem_grading (P := fun t => H.mulHom t ∈ grading k) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ht
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j z f hz hf hij
    rw [mulHom_tmul, ← hij]
    exact H.rho_mem hz hf
  · intro x y hx hy; rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  · intro x hx; rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.FullAction.mulHom_d
statement: theorem mulHom_d (t : TensorProductOver A M (RightDual A M)) : H.mulHom (d t) = d (H.mulHom t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [d_zero, map_zero, d_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]
  | tmul z f =>
    induction z using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => rw [zero_tmul, d_zero, map_zero, d_zero]
    | h_add z z' hz hz' => rw [add_tmul, d_add, map_add, hz, hz', map_add, d_add]
    | @h_homogeneous i z =>
      induction f using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => rw [tmul_zero, d_zero, map_zero, d_zero]
      | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [tmul_add, d_add, map_add, hf, hf', map_add, d_add]
      | @h_homogeneous k f =>
        rw [TensorProductOver.d_tmul_of_mem z.2, map_add, map_units_zsmul, mulHom_tmul, mulHom_tmul, mulHom_tmul,
          H.d_rho z.2 f.2]

name: DG.FullAction.mulHom_surjective
statement: theorem mulHom_surjective : Function.Surjective H.mulHom
proof:
:= fun e => by
  refine ⟨∑ i, tmul A (e • R.b i) (R.δ i), H.ext fun w => ?_⟩
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
  simp only [mulHom_tmul, rho_smul, RightBasis.toHom_δ]
  conv_rhs => rw [← R.sum_coeff w]
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (smul_comm e _ _).symm

name: DG.FullAction.mulHom_smul_basis
statement:
theorem mulHom_smul_basis [DecidableEq ι] (t : TensorProductOver A M (RightDual A M)) (j : ι) :
    H.mulHom t • R.b j = coeffTensor R j t
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_coeffTensor R t]
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_smul, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [mulHom_tmul, rho_smul, RightBasis.toHom_δ, R.coeff_basis, Pi.single_eq_same, op_one,
      one_smul]
  · intro i _ hij
    rw [mulHom_tmul, rho_smul, RightBasis.toHom_δ, R.coeff_basis, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hij, op_zero,
      zero_smul]
  · intro hj; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj

name: DG.FullAction.mulHom_injective
statement: theorem mulHom_injective : Function.Injective H.mulHom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro t ht
  rw [eq_sum_coeffTensor R t]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← H.mulHom_smul_basis R t i, ht, zero_smul, zero_tmul]

name: DG.FullAction.mulEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mulEquiv_tmul (z : M) (f : RightDual A M) :
    H.mulEquiv R (tmul A z f) = H.rho z f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.FullAction.mulEquiv_op_smul
statement:
theorem mulEquiv_op_smul (e : E) (t : TensorProductOver A M (RightDual A M)) :
    H.mulEquiv R (op e • t) = op e • H.mulEquiv R t
proof:
:= by
  change H.mulHom (op e • t) = op e • H.mulHom t
  rw [mulHom_op_smul, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, unop_op]

name: DG.FullAction.evHom_tmul
statement: @[simp] theorem evHom_tmul (f : RightDual A M) (z : M) : evHom (tmul E f z) = RightDual.toHom f z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.FullAction.evHom_smul
statement:
theorem evHom_smul (a : A) (t : TensorProductOver E (RightDual A M) M) :
    evHom (a • t) = a * evHom t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
  | tmul f z => rw [smul_tmul, evHom_tmul, evHom_tmul, RightDual.toHom_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, mul_add]

name: DG.FullAction.evHom_op_smul
statement:
theorem evHom_op_smul (a : A) (t : TensorProductOver E (RightDual A M) M) :
    evHom (op a • t) = evHom t * a
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, map_zero, zero_mul]
  | tmul f z => rw [op_smul_tmul_right, evHom_tmul, evHom_tmul, RightDual.map_op_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_mul]

name: DG.FullAction.evHom_mem
statement:
theorem evHom_mem {k : ℤ} {t : TensorProductOver E (RightDual A M) M} (ht : t ∈ grading k) :
    evHom t ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_mem_grading (P := fun t => evHom t ∈ grading k) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ht
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j f z hf hz hij
    rw [evHom_tmul, ← hij, add_comm]
    exact RightDual.apply_mem_grading hf hz
  · intro x y hx hy; rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  · intro x hx; rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.FullAction.evHom_d
statement: theorem evHom_d (t : TensorProductOver E (RightDual A M) M) : evHom (d t) = d (evHom t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [d_zero, map_zero, d_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]
  | tmul f z =>
    induction f using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => rw [zero_tmul, d_zero, map_zero, d_zero]
    | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [add_tmul, d_add, map_add, hf, hf', map_add, d_add]
    | @h_homogeneous k f =>
      rw [TensorProductOver.d_tmul_of_mem f.2, map_add, map_units_zsmul, evHom_tmul, evHom_tmul, evHom_tmul,
        RightDual.d_apply_of_mem f.2, sub_add_cancel]

name: DG.FullAction.evHom_basis
statement: theorem evHom_basis (a : A) (i : ι) : evHom (tmul E (a • R.δ i) (R.b i)) = a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [evHom_tmul, RightDual.toHom_smul, RightBasis.toHom_δ, R.coeff_basis, Pi.single_eq_same,
    mul_one]

name: DG.FullAction.eq_tmul_evHom
statement:
theorem eq_tmul_evHom (i : ι) (t : TensorProductOver E (RightDual A M) M) :
    t = tmul E (evHom t • R.δ i) (R.b i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, zero_smul, zero_tmul]
  | tmul f z =>
    have hz : H.rho z (R.δ i) • R.b i = z := by
      rw [rho_smul, RightBasis.toHom_δ, R.coeff_basis, Pi.single_eq_same, op_one, one_smul]
    have hf : op (H.rho z (R.δ i)) • f = RightDual.toHom f z • R.δ i := RightDual.ext fun w => by
      rw [RightDual.toHom_op_smul, rho_smul, RightDual.map_op_smul, RightDual.toHom_smul,
        RightBasis.toHom_δ]
    calc tmul E f z = tmul E f (H.rho z (R.δ i) • R.b i) := by rw [hz]
      _ = tmul E (op (H.rho z (R.δ i)) • f) (R.b i) := (op_smul_tmul _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hf, evHom_tmul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    conv_lhs => rw [hx, hy]
    rw [map_add, add_smul, add_tmul]

name: DG.FullAction.evHom_injective
statement: theorem evHom_injective (i : ι) : Function.Injective (evHom (E := E) (A := A) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro t ht
  rw [H.eq_tmul_evHom R i t, ht, zero_smul, zero_tmul]

name: DG.FullAction.evHom_surjective
statement: theorem evHom_surjective (i : ι) : Function.Surjective (evHom (E := E) (A := A) (M := M))
proof:
:=
  fun a => ⟨_, evHom_basis R a i⟩

name: DG.FullAction.evEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem evEquiv_tmul [Nonempty ι] (f : RightDual A M) (z : M) :
    H.evEquiv R (tmul E f z) = RightDual.toHom f z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.FullAction.evEquiv_op_smul
statement:
theorem evEquiv_op_smul [Nonempty ι] (a : A) (t : TensorProductOver E (RightDual A M) M) :
    H.evEquiv R (op a • t) = op a • H.evEquiv R t
proof:
:= by
  change evHom (op a • t) = op a • evHom t
  rw [evHom_op_smul, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, unop_op]

name: DG.CompactlyGenerates.of_equivalence
statement:
theorem CompactlyGenerates.of_equivalence {ι : Type w''} {G : ι → T}
    (hG : CompactlyGenerates G) (e : T ≌ T') [e.functor.Additive] [e.functor.CommShift ℤ]
    (G' : ι → T') (f : ∀ i, e.functor.obj (G i) ≅ G' i) : CompactlyGenerates G' where
  isCompact i
proof:
:= ((hG.isCompact i).map_of_equivalence e).of_iso (f i).symm
  isZero_of_forall_eq_zero Y h := by
    refine IsZero.of_iso (e.functor.map_isZero (hG.isZero_of_forall_eq_zero _ fun i n φ => ?_))
      (e.counitIso.app Y).symm
    have h0 := h i n ((f i).inv⟦n⟧' ≫ (e.functor.commShiftIso n).inv.app (G i) ≫
      e.functor.map φ ≫ e.counitIso.hom.app Y)
    rw [Preadditive.IsIso.comp_left_eq_zero, Preadditive.IsIso.comp_left_eq_zero,
      Preadditive.IsIso.comp_right_eq_zero] at h0
    exact e.functor.map_injective (h0.trans (e.functor.map_zero _ _).symm)

name: DG.CatModule.isCornerGenerator_toCatModuleObj_self
statement:
theorem isCornerGenerator_toCatModuleObj_self :
    IsCornerGenerator (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj (DGModuleCat.of A A))
      (DGCategory.Idempotent.id (SingleObj.star A)) 0
      (show (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj (DGModuleCat.of A A)).obj (SingleObj.star A) from
        (1 : A))
proof:
:=
  IsCornerGenerator.of_bijective (one_mem_grading (A := A)) (d_one (A := A)) fun _ =>
    ⟨fun f g h => by simpa [DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj_smul] using h,
      fun a => ⟨(a : A), by simp⟩⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_Q_self
statement: theorem isCompact_Q_self : IsCompact.{u} (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A A))
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  exact ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.isCompact_Q_obj
    CatModule.isCornerGenerator_toCatModuleObj_self).map_of_equivalence
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence A)).of_iso (singleObjEquivalenceObjIso _).symm

name: DG.DerivedCategory.compactlyGenerates
statement: theorem compactlyGenerates : CompactlyGenerates (fun _ : Unit => Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A A))
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  have hG := CatModule.DerivedCategory.compactlyGenerates.{u} (C := SingleObj A)
  have hG' : CompactlyGenerates fun _ : Unit =>
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CatModule.representableW.{u} (SingleObj A)
        (SingleObj.star A)) : CatModule.DerivedCategory (SingleObj A)) :=
    { isCompact := fun _ => hG.isCompact _
      isZero_of_forall_eq_zero := fun Y h => hG.isZero_of_forall_eq_zero Y fun _ n φ => h () n φ }
  exact hG'.of_equivalence (CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence A) _ fun _ =>
    (CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence A).functor.mapIso
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.isoOfGen
        (CatModule.isCornerGenerator_representableW.{u} (SingleObj.star A))
        CatModule.isCornerGenerator_toCatModuleObj_self)) ≪≫ singleObjEquivalenceObjIso _

name: DG.DerivedCategory.thickClosure_self_eq_isCompact
proof:
:=
  thickClosure_eq_isCompact _ compactlyGenerates

name: DG.coe_decompose_of_map_mem
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_of_map_mem {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] (f : M →+ N)
    (hf : ∀ {k : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading k → f m ∈ grading k) (m : M) (j : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := N)) (f m) j : N) = f (decompose (grading (M := M)) m j)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i i
    rw [decompose_of_mem _ (hf x.2), decompose_coe]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp
    · simp [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm hij)]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => simp [decompose_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.length_cells
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_cells : C.cells.length = C.length
proof: := by simp [cells]

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.isOrdered_iff_cellsOrdered
statement: theorem isOrdered_iff_cellsOrdered : C.IsOrdered ↔ CellsOrdered C.cells
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsOrdered CellsOrdered cells
  rw [List.pairwise_ofFn]
  constructor
  · intro h i j hij
    exact h i j hij.le
  · intro h i j hij
    rcases hij.lt_or_eq with hij | rfl
    · exact h hij
    · exact le_rfl

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.mem_snocF
statement:
theorem mem_snocF {j : ℕ} {c : Cone ψ} : c ∈ C.snocF ψ j ↔
    (j ≤ C.length → Cone.fstHom ψ c = 0) ∧ Cone.sndLinear ψ c ∈ C.F (min j C.length)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.snocπ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem snocπ_eq_zero_iff (i : Fin (C.length + 1)) (x : C.snocF ψ (i.1 + 1)) :
    C.snocπ ψ i x = 0 ↔ (x : Cone ψ) ∈ C.snocF ψ i.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold snocπ
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [DGModuleHom.comp_apply, DGModuleEquiv.coe_toDGModuleHom,
      map_eq_zero_iff _ (DGModuleEquiv.injective _), DGModuleHom.comp_apply,
      C.π_eq_zero_iff, mem_snocF]
    refine ⟨fun hx => ⟨fun _ => x.2.1 h, by rwa [min_eq_left h.le]⟩, fun hx => ?_⟩
    have := hx.2
    rwa [min_eq_left h.le] at this
  · have hi : i.1 = C.length := by omega
    rw [DGModuleHom.comp_apply, DGModuleEquiv.coe_toDGModuleHom,
      map_eq_zero_iff _ (DGModuleEquiv.injective _)]
    simp only [snocLast, DGModuleHom.comp_apply, DGModuleEquiv.coe_toDGModuleHom]
    rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ (DGModuleEquiv.injective _), mem_snocF, DGSubmodule.subtype_apply,
      DGSubmodule.coe_inclusion_apply]
    refine ⟨fun hx => ⟨fun _ => hx, ?_⟩, fun hx => hx.1 hi.le⟩
    rw [show min i.1 C.length = C.length by omega]
    exact C.mem_length _

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.surjective_snocπ
statement: theorem surjective_snocπ (i : Fin (C.length + 1)) : Function.Surjective (C.snocπ ψ i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold snocπ
  split_ifs with h
  · refine (DGModuleEquiv.surjective _).comp ?_
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := C.surjective_π ⟨i, h⟩ y
    refine ⟨⟨Cone.inr ψ x, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [min_eq_left h]
    exact x.2
  · refine (DGModuleEquiv.surjective _).comp ?_
    intro y
    have hi : i.1 = C.length := by omega
    refine ⟨⟨Cone.inlLinear ψ ((Shift.shiftShiftEquiv (A := A) m 1 (m + 1) rfl) y),
      fun h' => by omega, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [snocLast, DGSubmodule.inclusion]

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.cells_snoc
statement: theorem cells_snoc : (C.snoc ψ).cells = C.cells ++ [(e, m + 1)]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cells, snoc]
  rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append]
  congr 1
  · congr 1
    funext i
    simp [snocE, snocShift]
  · simp [snocE, snocShift]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.nonempty_cellShiftIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_cellShiftIso (e : DGIdempotent A) (n k : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((cell A e n)⟦k⟧ ≅ cell A e (n + k))
proof:
:=
  ⟨cellShiftIso e n k⟩

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.isZero_F_zero
statement: theorem isZero_F_zero : IsZero (DGModuleCat.of A (C.F 0))
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton (C.F 0) :=
    ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (by rw [C.eq_zero_of_mem_zero x x.2, C.eq_zero_of_mem_zero y y.2])⟩
  exact DGModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.cellTower_F
statement:
theorem cellTower_F {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ C.length) :
    CellTower (cell A) (C.cells.take j) (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A (C.F j)))
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact .zero (Functor.map_isZero _ C.isZero_F_zero)
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := (C.gradedSplitting ⟨j, hj⟩).exists_distinguished
    have htake : C.cells.take (j + 1) = C.cells.take j ++ [(C.e ⟨j, hj⟩, C.shift ⟨j, hj⟩)] := by
      rw [List.take_add_one]
      congr 1
      simp [cells, show j < C.length by omega]
    rw [htake]
    exact .ext _ hδ (ih (by omega)) ⟨Iso.refl _⟩

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.cellTower
statement: theorem cellTower : CellTower (cell A) C.cells (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A P))
proof:
:= by
  have := C.cellTower_F (j := C.length) le_rfl
  rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)] at this
  exact this.of_iso (Q.mapIso C.isoF).symm

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.Q_obj_mem_of_isThick
statement:
theorem Q_obj_mem_of_isThick {S : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory.{w, u} A)} (hS : IsThick S)
    (hC : ∀ i, S (cell A (C.e i) (C.shift i))) : S (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A P))
proof:
:=
  C.cellTower.mem_of_isThick hS fun c hc => by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hc
    exact hC i

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.cells_punit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FiniteCellFiltration.cells_punit : (FiniteCellFiltration.punit (A := A)).cells = []
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_cellTower
statement:
theorem exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_cellTower {ι : Type*} (φ : ι → DGIdempotent A)
    {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : DerivedCategory.{w, u} A}
    (h : CellTower (fun i n => cell A (φ i) n) l X) :
    ∃ (P : DGModuleCat.{u} A) (C : FiniteCellFiltration A P),
      C.cells = l.map (fun c => (φ c.1, c.2)) ∧ Nonempty (X ≅ Q.obj P)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX =>
    refine ⟨DGModuleCat.of A PUnit, FiniteCellFiltration.punit, rfl,
      ⟨hX.iso (Functor.map_isZero _ (DGModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _))⟩⟩
  | @ext l c T hT _ h₃ ih =>
    obtain ⟨P', C', hC', ⟨e'⟩⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e₃⟩ := h₃
    obtain ⟨i, n⟩ := c
    let E := (φ i).LeftCorner
    
    let j : Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A (Shift (n + -1) E)) ≅ T.invRotate.obj₁ :=
      (cellShiftIso (φ i) n (-1)).symm ≪≫ (shiftFunctor _ (-1 : ℤ)).mapIso e₃.symm
    have hK : IsKProjective.{u} A (Shift (n + -1) E) := (φ i).isKProjective_leftCorner.shift _
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq (P := DGModuleCat.of A (Shift (n + -1) E)) hK
      (j.hom ≫ T.invRotate.mor₁ ≫ e'.hom)
    let T' := Q.mapTriangle.obj (Cone.triangle ψ)
    have hT' : T' ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A) :=
      (mem_distTriang_iff _).mpr ⟨_, _, _, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨f, -, -⟩ := exists_iso_of_arrow_iso _ _ (inv_rot_of_distTriang T hT) hT'
      (Arrow.isoMk j.symm e' (by simp [T', hψ]))
    refine ⟨DGModuleCat.of A (Cone ψ.hom), C'.snoc ψ.hom, ?_, ⟨Triangle.π₃.mapIso f⟩⟩
    rw [FiniteCellFiltration.cells_snoc, hC', List.map_append]
    simp

name: DG.subsingleton_cohomology_iff
statement:
theorem subsingleton_cohomology_iff {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] {n : ℤ} :
    Subsingleton (cohomology M n) ↔ ∀ m ∈ grading (M := M) n, d m = 0 → m ∈ coboundaries M n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h m hm hdm
    exact (cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩).mp (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  · intro h
    refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
    induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z => exact (cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff z).mpr (h z z.2.1 z.2.2)

name: DG.mem_truncLEComponents_iff
statement:
theorem mem_truncLEComponents_iff {n k : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x ∈ ofComponents (truncLEComponents M n) ↔ (n < k → x = 0) ∧ (k = n → d x = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ofComponents_of_mem_grading hx, truncLEComponents]
  by_cases h1 : n < k
  · simp [h1, h1.ne']
  · by_cases h2 : k = n
    · subst h2
      simp [mem_cocycles, hx]
    · simp [h1, h2]

name: DG.truncLE_d_mem
statement:
theorem truncLE_d_mem {n : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ ofComponents (truncLEComponents M n)) :
    d x ∈ ofComponents (truncLEComponents M n)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_ofComponents _)
    (P := fun x => d x ∈ ofComponents (truncLEComponents M n)) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun x x' h h' => by simpa only [d_add] using add_mem h h') hx
  intro k x hxk hxS
  rw [mem_truncLEComponents_iff hxk] at hxS
  rw [mem_truncLEComponents_iff (d_mem hxk)]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun _ => d_d x⟩
  by_cases hk : n < k
  · rw [hxS.1 hk, d_zero]
  · exact hxS.2 (by omega)

name: DG.truncLE_smul_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_ofComponents _)
    (P := fun x => a • x ∈ ofComponents (truncLEComponents M n)) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun x x' h h' => by simpa only [smul_add] using add_mem h h') hx
  intro k x hxk hxS
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [zero_mem]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul]; exact add_mem ha ha'
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i i
    change a • x ∈ _
    rw [mem_truncLEComponents_iff hxk] at hxS
    by_cases hi : 0 < i
    · rw [hA.eq_zero hi ha, zero_smul]
      exact zero_mem _
    by_cases hk : n < k
    · rw [hxS.1 hk, smul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    rw [mem_truncLEComponents_iff (smul_mem_grading ha hxk)]
    refine ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega), fun h => ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    rw [d_smul_of_mem_zero ha, hA.eq_zero one_pos (d_mem ha), zero_smul, zero_add,
      hxS.2 (by omega), smul_zero]

name: DG.mem_truncLE_iff_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_truncLE_iff_of_mem_grading {n k : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x ∈ truncLE hA M n ↔ (n < k → x = 0) ∧ (k = n → d x = 0)
proof:
:=
  mem_truncLEComponents_iff hx

name: DG.mem_truncLE_of_lt
statement:
theorem mem_truncLE_of_lt {n k : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading k) (hk : k < n) :
    x ∈ truncLE hA M n
proof:
:=
  (mem_truncLE_iff_of_mem_grading hA hx).mpr ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega),
    fun h => absurd h (by omega)⟩

name: DG.mem_truncLE_of_d_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_truncLE_of_d_eq_zero {n k : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading k) (hk : k ≤ n)
    (hdx : d x = 0) : x ∈ truncLE hA M n
proof:
:=
  (mem_truncLE_iff_of_mem_grading hA hx).mpr ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega), fun _ => hdx⟩

name: DG.truncLE_eq_zero_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem truncLE_eq_zero_of_mem_grading {n k : ℤ} {x : truncLE hA M n}
    (hx : x ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading k) (hk : n < k) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (((mem_truncLE_iff_of_mem_grading hA ((DGSubmodule.mem_grading _).mp hx)).mp
    x.2).1 hk)

name: DG.isNonposGraded_truncLE_zero
statement: theorem isNonposGraded_truncLE_zero : IsNonposGraded (truncLE hA M 0)
proof:
:=
  isNonposGraded_iff.mpr fun _ hk _ hx => truncLE_eq_zero_of_mem_grading hA hx hk

name: DG.bijective_cohomology_map_truncLE
statement:
theorem bijective_cohomology_map_truncLE {n k : ℤ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomology.map (truncLE hA M n).subtype k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [cohomology.map_injective_iff]
    intro z hz _ hzb
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hzb
    have hmS : m ∈ truncLE hA M n := mem_truncLE_of_lt hA hm (by omega)
    exact mem_coboundaries.mpr ⟨⟨m, hmS⟩, (DGSubmodule.mem_grading _).mpr hm,
      Subtype.ext (by rw [DGSubmodule.coe_d]; exact hdm)⟩
  · rw [cohomology.map_surjective_iff]
    intro y hy hdy
    refine ⟨⟨y, mem_truncLE_of_d_eq_zero hA hy hk hdy⟩, (DGSubmodule.mem_grading _).mpr hy,
      Subtype.ext (by rw [DGSubmodule.coe_d]; exact hdy), ?_⟩
    rw [DGSubmodule.subtype_apply, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.subsingleton_cohomology_truncLE
statement:
theorem subsingleton_cohomology_truncLE {n k : ℤ} (hk : n < k) :
    Subsingleton (cohomology (truncLE hA M n) k)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_cohomology_iff.mpr fun z hz _ => by
    rw [truncLE_eq_zero_of_mem_grading hA hz hk]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.subsingleton_cohomology_quotient_truncLE
statement:
theorem subsingleton_cohomology_quotient_truncLE {n k : ℤ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Subsingleton (cohomology (M ⧸ (truncLE hA M n).toSubmodule) k)
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_cohomology_iff.mpr fun yq hyq hdyq => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyy⟩ := (truncLE hA M n).exists_mem_grading_mk hyq
    subst hyy
    rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, DGSubmodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff] at hdyq
    have hyS : y ∈ truncLE hA M n := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hk with hk | rfl
      · exact mem_truncLE_of_lt hA hy hk
      · refine mem_truncLE_of_d_eq_zero hA hy le_rfl ?_
        exact ((mem_truncLE_iff_of_mem_grading hA (d_mem hy)).mp hdyq).1 (by omega)
    rw [(DGSubmodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff _).mpr hyS]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_obj_iff (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (k : ℤ) :
    IsZero ((homologyFunctor ℤ k).obj (Q.obj M)) ↔ Subsingleton (cohomology M k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
  exact (cohomologyAddEquiv ℤ M k).subsingleton_congr.symm

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isZero_homologyFunctor_iff_of_iso
statement:
theorem isZero_homologyFunctor_iff_of_iso {X Y : DerivedCategory.{w, v} A} (e : X ≅ Y) (k : ℤ) :
    IsZero ((homologyFunctor ℤ k).obj X) ↔ IsZero ((homologyFunctor ℤ k).obj Y)
proof:
:=
  ((homologyFunctor ℤ k).mapIso e).isZero_iff

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isZero_homologyFunctor_shift_iff
statement:
theorem isZero_homologyFunctor_shift_iff (X : DerivedCategory.{w, v} A) (a k l : ℤ)
    (h : k + a = l) :
    IsZero ((homologyFunctor ℤ k).obj (X⟦a⟧)) ↔ IsZero ((homologyFunctor ℤ l).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj X
  rw [isZero_homologyFunctor_iff_of_iso ((shiftFunctor _ a).mapIso e ≪≫
      ((Q.commShiftIso a).app M).symm), isZero_homologyFunctor_iff_of_iso e, Functor.comp_obj,
    isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_obj_iff, isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_obj_iff]
  exact (cohomology.shiftAddEquiv M a k l h).subsingleton_congr

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_map_iff
proof:
:=
  have : IsIso (Q.map f) := (isIso_Q_map_iff f).mpr hf
  isZero_homologyFunctor_iff_of_iso (asIso (Q.map f)) k

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tLE_Q_obj_iff
statement:
theorem tLE_Q_obj_iff (M : DGModuleCat.{max u v} A) (n : ℤ) :
    tLE A n (Q.obj M) ↔ ∀ k, n < k → Subsingleton (cohomology M k)
proof:
:=
  forall₂_congr fun k _ => isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_obj_iff M k

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tGE_Q_obj_iff
statement:
theorem tGE_Q_obj_iff (M : DGModuleCat.{max u v} A) (n : ℤ) :
    tGE A n (Q.obj M) ↔ ∀ k, k < n → Subsingleton (cohomology M k)
proof:
:=
  forall₂_congr fun k _ => isZero_homologyFunctor_Q_obj_iff M k

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tLE_shift
statement:
theorem tLE_shift (n a n' : ℤ) (h : a + n' = n) (X : DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A)
    (hX : tLE A n X) : tLE A n' (X⟦a⟧)
proof:
:= fun k hk =>
  (isZero_homologyFunctor_shift_iff X a k (k + a) rfl).mpr (hX _ (by omega))

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tGE_shift
statement:
theorem tGE_shift (n a n' : ℤ) (h : a + n' = n) (X : DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A)
    (hX : tGE A n X) : tGE A n' (X⟦a⟧)
proof:
:= fun k hk =>
  (isZero_homologyFunctor_shift_iff X a k (k + a) rfl).mpr (hX _ (by omega))

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isQuasiIso_truncLE_subtype
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_truncLE_subtype {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    [DGModule A M] (hM : ∀ k, 0 < k → Subsingleton (cohomology M k)) :
    (truncLE hA M 0).subtype.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= fun k => by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ 0
  · exact bijective_cohomology_map_truncLE hA hk
  · have := subsingleton_cohomology_truncLE hA (M := M) (not_le.mp hk)
    have := hM k (not_le.mp hk)
    exact ⟨fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun _ => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tStructure_zero
statement:
theorem tStructure_zero ⦃X Y : DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A⦄ (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : tLE A 0 X)
    (hY : tGE A 1 Y) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨eX⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj X
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨eY⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj Y
  have hM : ∀ k, 0 < k → Subsingleton (cohomology M k) := fun k hk =>
    (tLE_Q_obj_iff M 0).mp ((tLE A 0).prop_of_iso eX hX) k hk
  have hN : ∀ k, k < 1 → Subsingleton (cohomology N k) := fun k hk =>
    (tGE_Q_obj_iff N 1).mp ((tGE A 1).prop_of_iso eY hY) k hk
  
  obtain ⟨P, _, _, _, _, π, hπ, ⟨F⟩, hP⟩ :=
    exists_semiFreeResolution_of_isNonposGraded A (truncLE hA M 0) hA
      (isNonposGraded_truncLE_zero hA)
  let ι₁ : DGModuleCat.of A (truncLE hA M 0) ⟶ M := DGModuleCat.ofHom (truncLE hA M 0).subtype
  let π₁ : DGModuleCat.of A P ⟶ DGModuleCat.of A (truncLE hA M 0) := DGModuleCat.ofHom π
  have : IsIso (Q.map ι₁) := (isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr (isQuasiIso_truncLE_subtype hA hM)
  have : IsIso (Q.map π₁) := (isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr hπ
  let e : X ≅ Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A P) :=
    eX ≪≫ (asIso (Q.map ι₁)).symm ≪≫ (asIso (Q.map π₁)).symm
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq (N := N) F.isKProjective (e.inv ≫ f ≫ eY.hom)
  
  have hgN : ∀ x, g x ∈ truncLE hA N 0 := by
    intro x
    induction x using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | h_add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hx'
    | h_homogeneous x =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
      rename_i k
      change g x ∈ _
      by_cases hk : 0 < k
      · rw [hP.eq_zero hk hx, map_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (not_lt.mp hk) with hk | rfl
      · exact mem_truncLE_of_lt hA (g.hom.map_mem hx) hk
      refine mem_truncLE_of_d_eq_zero hA (g.hom.map_mem hx) le_rfl ?_
      rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hP.eq_zero one_pos (d_mem hx), map_zero]
  let g' : DGModuleCat.of A P ⟶ DGModuleCat.of A (truncLE hA N 0) :=
    DGModuleCat.ofHom ((truncLE hA N 0).codRestrict g.hom hgN)
  have hfac : g = g' ≫ DGModuleCat.ofHom (truncLE hA N 0).subtype := rfl
  have hZ : IsZero (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A (truncLE hA N 0))) := by
    rw [isZero_Q_obj_iff]
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k ≤ 0
    · have := hN k (by omega)
      exact (Equiv.ofBijective _ (bijective_cohomology_map_truncLE hA (M := N) hk)).subsingleton
    · exact subsingleton_cohomology_truncLE hA (not_le.mp hk)
  have h0 : e.inv ≫ f ≫ eY.hom = 0 := by
    rw [← hg, hfac, Functor.map_comp, hZ.eq_of_tgt (Q.map g') 0, zero_comp]
  simpa using congrArg (fun φ => e.hom ≫ φ ≫ eY.inv) h0

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tStructure_exists_triangle
statement:
theorem tStructure_exists_triangle (X : DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A) :
    ∃ (X' X'' : DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A) (_ : tLE A 0 X') (_ : tGE A 1 X'')
      (f : X' ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ X'') (h : X'' ⟶ X'⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj X
  let S := truncLE hA M 0
  let φ : DGModuleCat.of A S ⟶ M := DGModuleCat.ofHom S.subtype
  let T := Q.mapTriangle.obj (Cone.triangle φ)
  have hT : T ∈ distTriang _ := (mem_distTriang_iff T).mpr ⟨_, _, φ, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
  refine ⟨T.obj₁, T.obj₃, ?_, ?_, T.mor₁ ≫ e.inv, e.hom ≫ T.mor₂, T.mor₃, ?_⟩
  · refine (tLE_Q_obj_iff _ 0).mpr fun k hk => ?_
    exact subsingleton_cohomology_truncLE hA hk
  · refine (tGE_Q_obj_iff _ 1).mpr fun k hk => ?_
    have := subsingleton_cohomology_quotient_truncLE hA (M := M) (show k ≤ 0 by omega)
    exact ((S.isQuasiIso_coneToQuotient) k).1.subsingleton
  · refine isomorphic_distinguished _ hT _ (Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) e (Iso.refl _)
      ?_ ?_ ?_)
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tStructure_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tStructure_le (n : ℤ) : (tStructure hA).le n = tLE A n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tStructure_ge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tStructure_ge (n : ℤ) : (tStructure hA).ge n = tGE A n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DerivedCategory.mem_heart_tStructure_iff
statement:
theorem mem_heart_tStructure_iff (X : DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A) :
    (tStructure hA).heart X ↔ ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → IsZero ((homologyFunctor ℤ k).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ k hk
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk with hk | hk
    · exact h₂ k hk
    · exact h₁ k hk
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun k hk => h k (by omega), fun k hk => h k (by omega)⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.mem_distTriang_iff
statement:
theorem mem_distTriang_iff (T : Triangle (DerivedCategory A)) :
    (T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A)) ↔ ∃ (M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (f : M ⟶ N),
      Nonempty (T ≅ Q.mapTriangle.obj (Cone.triangle f))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨T', e, ⟨M, N, f, ⟨e'⟩⟩⟩
    exact ⟨M, N, f, ⟨e ≪≫ Qh.mapTriangle.mapIso e' ≪≫
      (Functor.mapTriangleCompIso (HomotopyCategory.quotient A) Qh).symm.app _⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨M, N, f, ⟨e⟩⟩
    exact isomorphic_distinguished _
      (Qh.map_distinguished _ (HomotopyCategory.triangleh_distinguished f)) _
      (e ≪≫ (Functor.mapTriangleCompIso (HomotopyCategory.quotient A) Qh).app _)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isIso_Qh_map_iff
statement:
theorem isIso_Qh_map_iff {X Y : HomotopyCategory.{v} A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsIso (Qh.map f) ↔ HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf n => ?_, fun hf => Localization.inverts Qh (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A) _ hf⟩
  change IsIso ((HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctor ℤ A n).map f)
  rw [← NatIso.isIso_map_iff (homologyFunctorFactorsh ℤ n) f]
  dsimp
  infer_instance

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff
statement:
theorem isIso_Q_map_iff {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    IsIso (Q.map f) ↔ f.hom.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:=
  (isIso_Qh_map_iff _).trans (HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff f)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isIso_iff_isZero_of_isZero
statement:
private theorem isIso_iff_isZero_of_isZero {C : Type*} [Category C] [HasZeroMorphisms C]
    {Y Z : C} (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hZ : IsZero Z) : IsIso g ↔ IsZero Y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => hZ.of_iso (asIso g), fun hY => ⟨⟨0, hY.eq_of_src _ _, hZ.eq_of_src _ _⟩⟩⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isZero_Qh_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isZero_Qh_obj_iff (X : HomotopyCategory.{v} A) :
    IsZero (Qh.obj X) ↔ (HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic A) X
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ : IsZero (Qh.obj (0 : HomotopyCategory.{v} A)) := Qh.map_isZero (isZero_zero _)
  rw [← isIso_iff_isZero_of_isZero (Qh.map (0 : X ⟶ 0)) h₀, isIso_Qh_map_iff,
    HomotopyCategory.mem_quasiIso_iff, HomotopyCategory.mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff]
  exact forall_congr' fun n => isIso_iff_isZero_of_isZero _ (Functor.map_isZero _ (isZero_zero _))

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isZero_Q_obj_iff
statement: theorem isZero_Q_obj_iff (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) : IsZero (Q.obj M) ↔ IsAcyclic M
proof:
:=
  (isZero_Qh_obj_iff _).trans (HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff M)

name: DG.exists_iso_obj_of_retract
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := F.map_surjective (h.r ≫ h.i)
  have hpp : p ≫ p = p := F.map_injective (by
    rw [F.map_comp, hp, assoc, reassoc_of% h.retract])
  obtain ⟨M', j, q, hjq, hqj⟩ := IsIdempotentComplete.idempotents_split M p hpp
  have hjpq : j ≫ p ≫ q = 𝟙 M' := by rw [← hqj, assoc, reassoc_of% hjq, hjq]
  refine ⟨M', ⟨j, q, hjq⟩,
    ⟨{ hom := h.i ≫ F.map q, inv := F.map j ≫ h.r, hom_inv_id := ?_, inv_hom_id := ?_ }⟩⟩
  · rw [assoc, ← F.map_comp_assoc, hqj, hp, assoc, h.retract, comp_id, h.retract]
  · rw [assoc, ← assoc h.r, ← hp, ← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp, hjpq, F.map_id]

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.fgProjective_cycles
statement:
theorem fgProjective_cycles (hC : IsPerfectComplex C) (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + 1 = q)
    [Epi (C.d p q)] : IsFGProjective R (C.cycles p)
proof:
:= by
  have : Projective (C.X q) := (IsProjective.iff_projective (C.X q)).1 (hC.fgProjective q).2
  have hs : Projective.factorThru (𝟙 _) (C.d p q) ≫ C.d p q = 𝟙 _ :=
    Projective.factorThru_comp _ _
  refine IsFGProjective.of_retract (C.iCycles p)
    (C.liftCycles (𝟙 _ - C.d p q ≫ Projective.factorThru (𝟙 _) (C.d p q)) q
      (by subst hpq; simp) (by
        rw [Preadditive.sub_comp, id_comp, assoc, hs, comp_id, sub_self])) ?_ (hC.fgProjective p)
  rw [← cancel_mono (C.iCycles p), assoc, HomologicalComplex.liftCycles_i, Preadditive.comp_sub,
    comp_id, HomologicalComplex.iCycles_d_assoc, zero_comp, sub_zero, id_comp]

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.isLE_of_epi_d
statement:
theorem isLE_of_epi_d (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + 1 = q) (h₁ : ∀ n, q < n → IsZero (C.X n))
    [Epi (C.d p q)] : C.IsLE p
proof:
:= by
  subst hpq
  refine (C.isLE_iff p).2 fun i hi => ?_
  by_cases hi' : i = p + 1
  · subst hi'
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' C p (p + 1) (p + 1 + 1) (by simp) (by simp)]
    exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi _ ((h₁ _ (by omega)).eq_of_tgt _ _)).2
      (inferInstanceAs (Epi (C.d p (p + 1))))
  · rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff]
    exact ShortComplex.exact_of_isZero_X₂ _ (h₁ i (by omega))

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.exists_quasiIso_of_epi_d
statement:
theorem exists_quasiIso_of_epi_d (hC : IsPerfectComplex C) (a p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + 1 = q)
    (h₀ : ∀ n, n < a → IsZero (C.X n)) (h₁ : ∀ n, q < n → IsZero (C.X n)) [Epi (C.d p q)] :
    ∃ (C' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (f : C' ⟶ C), IsPerfectComplex C' ∧
      QuasiIso f ∧ ∀ n, n < a ∨ p < n → IsZero (C'.X n)
proof:
:= by
  have := isLE_of_epi_d p q hpq h₁
  have hX : ∀ n, n < p → Nonempty ((C.truncLE p).X n ≅ C.X n) := fun n hn =>
    ⟨HomologicalComplex.truncLEXIso C (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntLE p) (i := (p - n).toNat)
      (by simp only [ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntLE_f]; omega)
      (fun h => by rw [ComplexShape.boundaryLE_embeddingUpIntLE_iff] at h; omega)⟩
  have hp : Nonempty ((C.truncLE p).X p ≅ C.cycles p) :=
    ⟨HomologicalComplex.truncLEXIsoCycles C (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntLE p) (i := 0)
      (by simp) ((ComplexShape.boundaryLE_embeddingUpIntLE_iff p 0).2 rfl)⟩
  have hfg : ∀ n, IsFGProjective R ((C.truncLE p).X n) := fun n => by
    obtain hn | hn | hn := lt_trichotomy n p
    · exact IsFGProjective.of_iso (hX n hn).some (hC.fgProjective n)
    · subst hn
      exact IsFGProjective.of_iso hp.some (hC.fgProjective_cycles n q hpq)
    · exact IsFGProjective.of_isZero ((C.truncLE p).isZero_of_isStrictlyLE p n hn)
  have hz : ∀ n, n < a ∨ p < n → IsZero ((C.truncLE p).X n) := by
    rintro n (hn | hn)
    · obtain hn' | hn' | hn' := lt_trichotomy n p
      · exact IsZero.of_iso (h₀ n hn) (hX n hn').some
      · subst hn'
        exact IsZero.of_iso (IsZero.of_mono (C.iCycles n) (h₀ n hn)) hp.some
      · exact (C.truncLE p).isZero_of_isStrictlyLE p n hn'
    · exact (C.truncLE p).isZero_of_isStrictlyLE p n hn
  exact ⟨C.truncLE p, C.ιTruncLE p,
    mk' hfg a (p + 1 - a).toNat fun n hn => hz n (by omega), inferInstance, hz⟩

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.exists_quasiIso_mappingCone
statement:
theorem exists_quasiIso_mappingCone (hS : IsPerfectComplex S) (hK : IsPerfectComplex K)
    (g : S ⟶ K) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a < b) (hS' : ∀ n, n ≠ b → IsZero (S.X n))
    (hK' : ∀ n, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (K.X n)) [Epi (g.f b)] :
    ∃ (C' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (f : C' ⟶ CochainComplex.mappingCone g), IsPerfectComplex C' ∧
      QuasiIso f ∧ ∀ n, n < a ∨ b - 1 < n → IsZero (C'.X n)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ∀ n, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero ((CochainComplex.mappingCone g).X n) := fun n hn =>
    IsZero.of_iso ((biprod_isZero_iff _ _).2 ⟨hS' (n + 1) (by omega), hK' n hn⟩) (mappingConeXIso g n)
  have hinr : Epi ((mappingCone.inr g).f b) :=
    ⟨fun u v h => mappingCone.ext_from g (b + 1) b rfl
      ((hS' (b + 1) (by omega)).eq_of_src _ _) h⟩
  have hd : (mappingCone.inl g).v b (b - 1) (by omega) ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCone g).d (b - 1) b =
      g.f b ≫ (mappingCone.inr g).f b := by
    rw [mappingCone.inl_v_d g b (b - 1) (b + 1) (by omega) (by omega),
      (hS' (b + 1) (by omega)).eq_of_tgt (S.d b (b + 1)) 0, zero_comp, sub_zero]
  have : Epi ((CochainComplex.mappingCone g).d (b - 1) b) := epi_of_epi_fac hd
  exact (hS.mappingCone g hK).exists_quasiIso_of_epi_d a (b - 1) b (by omega)
    (fun n hn => hz n (Or.inl hn)) (fun n hn => hz n (Or.inr hn))

name: DG.IsPerfect.singleFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem singleFunctor_obj {M : ModuleCat.{u} R} (hM : IsFGProjective R M) (n : ℤ) :
    IsPerfect R ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) n).obj M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, IsPerfectComplex.single hM n, ⟨(singleFunctorObjIso n M).symm⟩⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.of_retract_single
statement:
theorem of_retract_single {X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)}
    {S : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ} (hS : IsPerfectComplex S) (b : ℤ)
    (hS' : ∀ n, n ≠ b → IsZero (S.X n)) (h : Retract X (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj S)) :
    IsPerfect R X
proof:
:= by
  have : S.IsStrictlyGE b := (S.isStrictlyGE_iff b).2 fun i hi => hS' i (by omega)
  have : S.IsStrictlyLE b := (S.isStrictlyLE_iff b).2 fun i hi => hS' i (by omega)
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨e⟩⟩ := S.exists_iso_single b
  have hM : IsFGProjective R M := IsFGProjective.of_iso
    ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) b M).symm ≪≫
      (HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ b).mapIso e.symm) (hS.fgProjective b)
  obtain ⟨M', hM', ⟨e'⟩⟩ := exists_iso_obj_of_retract
    (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) b) (X := X) (M := M)
    ⟨h.i ≫ _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map e.hom ≫ (singleFunctorObjIso b M).inv,
      (singleFunctorObjIso b M).hom ≫ _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map e.inv ≫ h.r, by
        rw [assoc, assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_assoc, e.hom_inv_id,
          CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, id_comp, h.retract]⟩
  exact ⟨_, IsPerfectComplex.single (IsFGProjective.of_retract hM'.i hM'.r hM'.retract hM) b,
    ⟨(singleFunctorObjIso b M').symm ≪≫ e'.symm⟩⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.of_retract_step
statement:
theorem of_retract_step {X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)}
    {K S S₂ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ} (hK : IsPerfectComplex K)
    (hS : IsPerfectComplex S) (hS₂ : IsPerfectComplex S₂) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a < b)
    (hK' : ∀ i, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (K.X i)) (hS₂' : ∀ i, i ≠ b → IsZero (S₂.X i))
    (ι : S ⟶ K) [Epi (ι.f b)] (in₁ σ : S ⟶ S₂) (pr₁ pr₂ : S₂ ⟶ S) (h₁ : in₁ ≫ pr₁ = 𝟙 S)
    (h₂ : in₁ ≫ pr₂ = 0) (h₃ : σ ≫ pr₁ = 𝟙 S) (h₄ : σ ≫ pr₂ = 𝟙 S)
    (h : Retract X (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
    (ih : ∀ C' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ, IsPerfectComplex C' →
      (∀ i, i < a ∨ b - 1 < i → IsZero (C'.X i)) →
      ∀ Y : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R),
        Retract Y (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj C') → IsPerfect R Y) :
    IsPerfect R X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hK.exists_Q_map_eq (h.r ≫ h.i)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : S₂ ⟶ K, g = pr₁ ≫ ι ≫ e + pr₂ ≫ ι ≫ (𝟙 K - e) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσg : σ ≫ g = ι := by
    rw [hg, Preadditive.comp_add, reassoc_of% h₃, reassoc_of% h₄, Preadditive.comp_sub, comp_id,
      add_sub_cancel]
  have hing : in₁ ≫ g = ι ≫ e := by
    rw [hg, Preadditive.comp_add, reassoc_of% h₁, reassoc_of% h₂, zero_comp, add_zero]
  have : Epi (g.f b) := epi_of_epi_fac (f := σ.f b) (h := ι.f b) (by
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.comp_f, hσg])
  have her : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map e ≫ h.r = h.r := by
    rw [he, assoc, h.retract, comp_id]
  have hgr : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map g ≫ h.r =
      _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map pr₁ ≫ _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map ι ≫ h.r := by
    rw [hg, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_sub, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, assoc, assoc, assoc,
      assoc, her, Preadditive.sub_comp, id_comp, her, sub_self, comp_zero, comp_zero, add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨X', v, w, hT₁⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map ι ≫ h.r)
  have hT₂ := _root_.DerivedCategory.mappingCone_triangle_distinguished g
  obtain ⟨α, hα₁, hα₂⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism _ _ hT₁ hT₂
    (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map in₁) h.i (by
      change (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map ι ≫ h.r) ≫ h.i =
        _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map in₁ ≫ _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map g
      rw [assoc, ← he, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, hing])
  obtain ⟨β, hβ₁, hβ₂⟩ := complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism _ _ hT₂ hT₁
    (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map pr₁) h.r hgr
  dsimp [CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangle] at α β hα₁ hβ₁ hα₂ hβ₂
  
  have hαβ : IsIso (α ≫ β) := by
    let φ : Triangle.mk (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map ι ≫ h.r) v w ⟶
        Triangle.mk (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map ι ≫ h.r) v w :=
      Triangle.homMk _ _ (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (α ≫ β) (by simp)
      (by
        dsimp [CochainComplex.mappingCone.triangle] at hα₁ hβ₁ ⊢
        rw [reassoc_of% hα₁, hβ₁, id_comp, reassoc_of% h.retract])
      (by
        dsimp at hα₂ hβ₂ ⊢
        simp only [assoc] at hα₂ hβ₂
        rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, comp_id, assoc, ← hβ₂, ← reassoc_of% hα₂, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp,
          ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, h₁, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, comp_id])
    exact isIso₃_of_isIso₁₂ φ hT₁ hT₁
      (by change IsIso (𝟙 (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj S)); infer_instance)
      (by change IsIso (𝟙 X); infer_instance)
  
  obtain ⟨C', f, hC', hf, hC'z⟩ := hS₂.exists_quasiIso_mappingCone hK g a b hab hS₂' hK'
  have : QuasiIso f := hf
  have hX' : IsPerfect R X' := ih C' hC' hC'z X'
    ⟨α ≫ inv (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map f),
      _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map f ≫ β ≫ inv (α ≫ β), by
        rw [assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id]⟩
  exact ext₂ _ hT₁ (Q_obj hS) hX'

name: DG.IsPerfect.of_retract_aux
statement:
theorem of_retract_aux (n : ℕ) : ∀ (a : ℤ) (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ),
    IsPerfectComplex K → (∀ i, i < a ∨ a + n ≤ i → IsZero (K.X i)) →
    ∀ X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R),
      Retract X (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) → IsPerfect R X
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro a K hK hK' X h
    have hK0 : IsZero K := (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero K).2 (HomologicalComplex.hom_ext _ _ fun i =>
      (hK' i (by omega)).eq_of_src _ _)
    refine of_isZero ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero X).2 ?_)
    rw [← h.retract, (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map_isZero hK0).eq_of_tgt h.i 0, zero_comp]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro a K hK hK' X h
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · exact of_retract_single hK a (fun i hi => hK' i (by omega)) h
    · have : Epi ((HomologicalComplex.mkHomFromSingle (𝟙 (K.X (a + n))) (fun k hk =>
          (hK' k (Or.inr (by
            have : a + n + 1 = k := hk
            omega))).eq_of_tgt _ _)).f (a + n)) := by
        rw [HomologicalComplex.mkHomFromSingle_f]
        infer_instance
      exact of_retract_step hK (IsPerfectComplex.single (hK.fgProjective (a + n)) (a + n))
        (IsPerfectComplex.single ((hK.fgProjective (a + n)).biprod (hK.fgProjective (a + n)))
          (a + n)) a (a + n) (by omega) (fun i hi => hK' i (by omega))
        (fun i hi => HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X _ _ _ _ hi)
        (HomologicalComplex.mkHomFromSingle (𝟙 (K.X (a + n))) _)
        ((HomologicalComplex.single _ _ (a + n)).map biprod.inl)
        ((HomologicalComplex.single _ _ (a + n)).map (biprod.lift (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)))
        ((HomologicalComplex.single _ _ (a + n)).map biprod.fst)
        ((HomologicalComplex.single _ _ (a + n)).map biprod.snd)
        (by rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, biprod.inl_fst, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id])
        (by rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, biprod.inl_snd, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero])
        (by rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, biprod.lift_fst, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id])
        (by rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, biprod.lift_snd, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]) h
        (fun C' hC' hz Y hY => ih a C' hC' (fun i hi => hz i (by omega)) Y hY)

name: DG.IsPerfect.of_retract
statement:
theorem of_retract {X Y : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (h : Retract X Y)
    (hY : IsPerfect R Y) : IsPerfect R X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hY
  obtain ⟨a, m, hm⟩ := hK.exists_bounds
  exact of_retract_aux m a K hK hm X
    ⟨h.i ≫ e.inv, e.hom ≫ h.r, by rw [assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, h.retract]⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.isThick
statement:
theorem isThick : IsThick (IsPerfect R) where
  zero
proof:
:= of_isZero (isZero_zero _)
  shift _ n hX := hX.shift n
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃
  retract h hY := of_retract h hY

name: DG.IsPerfectComplex.exists_shortExact
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.IsPerfectComplex.exists_shortExact {K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ}
    (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ)
    (hK' : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + (m + 1 : ℕ) ≤ n → IsZero (K.X n)) :
    ∃ (K' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (i : K' ⟶ K)
      (π : K ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) a).obj (K.X a))
      (w : i ≫ π = 0), (ShortComplex.mk i π w).ShortExact ∧ IsPerfectComplex K' ∧
        ∀ n, n < a + 1 ∨ a + 1 + m ≤ n → IsZero (K'.X n)
proof:
:= by
  let π : K ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) a).obj (K.X a) :=
    HomologicalComplex.mkHomToSingle (𝟙 _) (fun i hi =>
      (hK' i (Or.inl (by simp at hi; omega))).eq_of_src _ _)
  have hπa : IsIso (π.f a) := by
    rw [HomologicalComplex.mkHomToSingle_f]
    infer_instance
  have hπ : ∀ i, Epi (π.f i) := fun i => by
    by_cases hi : i = a
    · subst hi
      infer_instance
    · exact (HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X _ _ _ _ hi).epi _
  have : Epi π := HomologicalComplex.epi_of_epi_f π hπ
  let S := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι π) π (kernel.condition π)
  have hS : S.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk'
    (S.exact_of_f_is_kernel (kernelIsKernel π)) (by dsimp [S]; infer_instance) this
  have hS' := (HomologicalComplex.shortExact_iff_degreewise_shortExact S).1 hS
  have hiso : ∀ n, n ≠ a → IsIso ((kernel.ι π).f n) := fun n hna =>
    (hS' n).isIso_f_iff.2
      (HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℤ) a (K.X a) n hna)
  have h₁ : ∀ n, n < a + 1 ∨ a + 1 + m ≤ n → IsZero ((kernel π).X n) := by
    intro n hn
    by_cases hna : n = a
    · subst hna
      exact (hS' n).isIso_g_iff.1 hπa
    · have := hiso n hna
      exact IsZero.of_iso (hK' n (by omega)) (asIso ((kernel.ι π).f n))
  have hfg : ∀ n, IsFGProjective R ((kernel π).X n) := fun n => by
    by_cases hna : n = a
    · exact IsFGProjective.of_isZero (h₁ n (by omega))
    · have := hiso n hna
      exact IsFGProjective.of_iso (asIso ((kernel.ι π).f n)) (hK.fgProjective n)
  exact ⟨kernel π, kernel.ι π, π, kernel.condition π, hS,
