    IsPerfectComplex.mk' hfg (a + 1) m h₁, h₁⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.induction
statement:
theorem induction
    {motive : ∀ X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R), IsPerfect R X → Prop}
    (iso : ∀ {X Y : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hX : IsPerfect R X)
      (hY : IsPerfect R Y), (X ≅ Y) → motive X hX → motive Y hY)
    (single : ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hM : IsFGProjective R M),
      motive _ (singleFunctor_obj hM 0))
    (shift : ∀ {X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hX : IsPerfect R X) (n : ℤ),
      motive X hX → motive (X⟦n⟧) (hX.shift n))
    (ext₂ : ∀ (T : Triangle (_root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))) (_ : T ∈ distTriang _)
      (h₁ : IsPerfect R T.obj₁) (h₂ : IsPerfect R T.obj₂) (h₃ : IsPerfect R T.obj₃),
      motive _ h₁ → motive _ h₃ → motive _ h₂)
    {X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hX : IsPerfect R X) : motive X hX
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle : ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hM : IsFGProjective R M) (n : ℤ),
      motive _ (Q_obj (IsPerfectComplex.single hM n)) := fun M hM n =>
    iso ((singleFunctor_obj hM 0).shift (-n)) _
      (((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctors (ModuleCat.{u} R)).shiftIso (-n) n 0
        (by omega)).app M ≪≫ singleFunctorObjIso n M)
      (shift _ (-n) (single M hM))
  have aux : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
      (hK : IsPerfectComplex K), (∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (K.X n)) →
      motive _ (Q_obj hK) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro a K hK hK'
      have hK0 : IsZero K := (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero K).2 (HomologicalComplex.hom_ext _ _ fun i =>
        (hK' i (by omega)).eq_of_src _ _)
      exact iso (singleFunctor_obj (IsFGProjective.of_isZero (isZero_zero _)) 0) _
        (((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map_isZero
          (isZero_zero _)).iso (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.map_isZero hK0))
        (single 0 (IsFGProjective.of_isZero (isZero_zero _)))
    | succ m ih =>
      intro a K hK hK'
      obtain ⟨K', i, π, w, hS, hK'p, hK'z⟩ := hK.exists_shortExact a m hK'
      exact ext₂ _ (_root_.DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished hS) (Q_obj hK'p)
        (Q_obj hK) (Q_obj (IsPerfectComplex.single (hK.fgProjective a) a))
        (ih (a + 1) K' hK'p hK'z) (hsingle _ (hK.fgProjective a) a)
  have hX' := hX
  obtain ⟨K, hK, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hX'
  obtain ⟨a, m, hm⟩ := hK.exists_bounds
  exact iso (Q_obj hK) hX e (aux m a K hK hm)

name: DG.smul_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem smul_mem_decomposables {i : ℤ} (hi : i ≠ 0) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (x : P) :
    a • x ∈ decomposables A P
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, a, ha, x, rfl⟩

name: DG.Cochain.map_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem Cochain.map_mem_decomposables {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain A M N n) {y : M}
    (hy : y ∈ decomposables A M) : z y ∈ decomposables A N
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, a, ha, x, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [z.map_smul ha, Units.smul_def]
    exact zsmul_mem (smul_mem_decomposables hi ha _) _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | neg y _ h => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem h

name: DG.DGModuleHom.map_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.map_mem_decomposables (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) {y : M}
    (hy : y ∈ decomposables A M) : f y ∈ decomposables A N
proof:
:=
  (Cochain.ofHom f).map_mem_decomposables hy

name: DG.degSpan_mono
statement: theorem degSpan_mono {s s' : Set ℤ} (h : s ⊆ s') : degSpan A P s ≤ degSpan A P s'
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.closure_mono fun _ ⟨i, hi, a, x, hx, hy⟩ => ⟨i, h hi, a, x, hx, hy⟩

name: DG.smul_mem_degSpan_of_mem
statement:
theorem smul_mem_degSpan_of_mem {s : Set ℤ} {i : ℤ} (hi : i ∈ s) (a : A) {x : P}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) : a • x ∈ degSpan A P s
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, hi, a, x, hx, rfl⟩

name: DG.smul_mem_degSpan
statement:
theorem smul_mem_degSpan (a : A) {s : Set ℤ} {y : P} (hy : y ∈ degSpan A P s) :
    a • y ∈ degSpan A P s
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, b, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [smul_smul]
    exact smul_mem_degSpan_of_mem hi _ hx
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | neg y _ h => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem h

name: DG.mem_degSpan_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_degSpan_of_mem_grading {s : Set ℤ} {i : ℤ} (hi : i ∈ s) {x : P}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) : x ∈ degSpan A P s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_smul A x]
  exact smul_mem_degSpan_of_mem hi _ hx

name: DG.eq_zero_of_mem_degSpan
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_degSpan {s : Set ℤ} (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x ∈ grading (M := P) i, x = 0)
    {y : P} (hy : y ∈ degSpan A P s) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, a, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [hs i hi x hx, smul_zero]
  | zero => rfl
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [h, h', add_zero]
  | neg y _ h => rw [h, neg_zero]

name: DG.exists_mem_degSpan_Iio
statement: theorem exists_mem_degSpan_Iio (y : P) : ∃ c, y ∈ degSpan A P (Set.Iio c)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => exact ⟨0, zero_mem _⟩
  | @h_homogeneous i x =>
    exact ⟨i + 1,
      mem_degSpan_of_mem_grading (s := Set.Iio (i + 1)) (Set.mem_Iio.mpr (by omega)) x.2⟩
  | h_add y y' h h' =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := h'
    exact ⟨max c c', add_mem (degSpan_mono (Set.Iio_subset_Iio (le_max_left c c')) hc)
      (degSpan_mono (Set.Iio_subset_Iio (le_max_right c c')) hc')⟩

name: DG.exists_mem_degSpan_Ioi
statement: theorem exists_mem_degSpan_Ioi (y : P) : ∃ c, y ∈ degSpan A P (Set.Ioi c)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => exact ⟨0, zero_mem _⟩
  | @h_homogeneous i x =>
    exact ⟨i - 1,
      mem_degSpan_of_mem_grading (s := Set.Ioi (i - 1)) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by omega)) x.2⟩
  | h_add y y' h h' =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := h'
    exact ⟨min c c', add_mem (degSpan_mono (Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi (min_le_left c c')) hc)
      (degSpan_mono (Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi (min_le_right c c')) hc')⟩

name: DG.coe_decompose_smul
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_smul {j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading j) (y : P) (m : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := P)) (a • y) m : P) =
      a • (decompose (grading (M := P)) y (m - j) : P)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous i y =>
    have hay : a • (y : P) ∈ grading (j + i) := smul_mem_grading ha y.2
    by_cases h : j + i = m
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hay, show j + i - j = i by ring, decompose_of_mem_same _ y.2]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hay h, decompose_of_mem_ne _ y.2 (by omega), smul_zero]
  | h_add y y' h h' =>
    simp only [smul_add, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, h, h']

name: DG.mem_degSpan_of_mem_decomposables
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ y ∈ decomposables A P, (decompose (grading (M := P)) y m : P) ∈ degSpan A P s by
    simpa [decompose_of_mem_same _ hx] using h x hd
  intro y hy
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, a, ha, x, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [coe_decompose_smul ha]
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · rw [ha0, zero_smul]
      exact zero_mem _
    · exact smul_mem_degSpan_of_mem (hs j hj a ha ha0) a
        (decompose (grading (M := P)) x (m - j)).2
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => simpa using add_mem h h'
  | neg y _ h =>
    rw [decompose_neg, DFinsupp.neg_apply, NegMemClass.coe_neg]
    exact neg_mem h

name: DG.map_mem_degSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, a, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [map_smul]
    exact smul_mem_degSpan a
      (mem_degSpan_of_mem_decomposables (hss' i hi) (v.map_mem hx) (hv x))
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
  | neg y _ h => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem h

name: DG.bijective_sub_of_locallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem bijective_sub_of_locallyNilpotent (v : P →+ P) (hv : ∀ y, ∃ k : ℕ, v^[k] y = 0) :
    Function.Bijective fun y => y - v y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun y y' hyy' => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · have h₁ : y - y' = v y - v y' := sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub.mp hyy'
    have hz : v (y - y') = y - y' := by rw [map_sub, h₁]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hv (y - y')
    rw [Function.iterate_fixed hz] at hk
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hk
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hv y
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, v^[i] y, ?_⟩
    have h := Finset.sum_range_sub' (fun i => v^[i] y) k
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, hk, sub_zero] at h
    show (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, v^[i] y) - v (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, v^[i] y) = y
    rw [map_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp_rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply' v]
    exact h

name: DG.bijective_sub_of_filtration
statement:
theorem bijective_sub_of_filtration (v : P →+ P) (F : ℤ → AddSubgroup P) (hF : Monotone F)
    (hex : ∀ y, ∃ c, y ∈ F c) (N : ℤ) (hN : ∀ y ∈ F N, y = 0)
    (hv : ∀ c, ∀ y ∈ F c, v y ∈ F (c - 1)) : Function.Bijective fun y => y - v y
proof:
:= by
  have hiter : ∀ (k : ℕ) {c : ℤ} {y : P}, y ∈ F c → v^[k] y ∈ F (c - k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro c y hy; simpa using hy
    | succ k ih =>
      intro c y hy
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      have := hv _ _ (ih hy)
      rwa [show c - (k : ℤ) - 1 = c - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring] at this
  refine bijective_sub_of_locallyNilpotent v fun y => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hex y
  exact ⟨(c - N).toNat, hN _ (hF (by omega) (hiter _ hc))⟩

name: DG.IsMinimal.sub_mem_decomposables
statement:
theorem IsMinimal.sub_mem_decomposables (hP : IsMinimal A P) {f : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P}
    (h : Homotopic f DGModuleHom.id) (x : P) : x - f x ∈ decomposables A P
proof:
:= by
  have hx := h.some.comm x
  have : x - f x = -(d (h.some.hom x) + h.some.hom (d x)) := by
    rw [hx, DGModuleHom.id_apply]
    abel
  rw [this]
  exact neg_mem (add_mem (hP _) (h.some.hom.map_mem_decomposables (hP x)))

name: DG.IsBoundedMinimal.bijective_of_homotopic_id
statement:
theorem IsBoundedMinimal.bijective_of_homotopic_id (hP : IsBoundedMinimal A P)
    {f : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P} (h : Homotopic f DGModuleHom.id) : Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  let v : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P := DGModuleHom.id - f
  have hv : ∀ x, v x ∈ decomposables A P := hP.1.sub_mem_decomposables h
  have hf : ⇑f = fun y => y - v.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom y := funext fun x => by
    change f x = x - (x - f x)
    abel
  rw [hf]
  rcases hP.2 with ⟨hA, N, hN⟩ | ⟨hA, N, hN⟩
  · refine bijective_sub_of_filtration _ (fun c => degSpan A P (Set.Iio c))
      (fun c c' h => degSpan_mono (Set.Iio_subset_Iio h)) exists_mem_degSpan_Iio N
      (fun _ => eq_zero_of_mem_degSpan fun i hi => hN i hi) fun c y hy => ?_
    refine map_mem_degSpan v hv (fun i hi j hj a ha ha0 => ?_) hy
    have : 0 < j := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp fun hj' => ha0 (hA j hj' a ha)) hj.symm
    exact Set.mem_Iio.mpr (by have := Set.mem_Iio.mp hi; omega)
  · refine bijective_sub_of_filtration _ (fun c => degSpan A P (Set.Ioi (-c)))
      (fun c c' h => degSpan_mono (Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi (by omega))) (fun y => ?_) (-N)
      (fun _ => eq_zero_of_mem_degSpan fun i hi => hN i (by
        have := Set.mem_Ioi.mp hi; omega)) fun c y hy => ?_
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_mem_degSpan_Ioi (A := A) y
      exact ⟨-c, by simpa using hc⟩
    refine map_mem_degSpan v hv (fun i hi j hj a ha ha0 => ?_) hy
    have : j < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp fun hj' => ha0 (hA j hj' a ha)) hj
    exact Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by have := Set.mem_Ioi.mp hi; omega)

name: DG.IsBoundedMinimal.of_nonneg
statement:
theorem IsBoundedMinimal.of_nonneg (hA : ∀ j < 0, ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) j, a = 0)
    (hP : IsMinimal A P) (hPb : IsBoundedBelow P) : IsBoundedMinimal A P
proof:
:=
  ⟨hP, Or.inl ⟨hA, hPb⟩⟩

name: DG.IsBoundedMinimal.of_nonpos
statement:
theorem IsBoundedMinimal.of_nonpos (hA : ∀ j > 0, ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) j, a = 0)
    (hP : IsMinimal A P) (hPb : IsBoundedAbove P) : IsBoundedMinimal A P
proof:

name: DG.DGHomotopyEquiv.bijective_hom
statement:
theorem DGHomotopyEquiv.bijective_hom (e : DGHomotopyEquiv A M N) (hM : IsBoundedMinimal A M)
    (hN : IsBoundedMinimal A N) : Function.Bijective e.hom
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := hM.bijective_of_homotopic_id ⟨e.homotopyHomInvId⟩
  have h₂ := hN.bijective_of_homotopic_id ⟨e.homotopyInvHomId⟩
  refine ⟨fun x y hxy => h₁.1 (by simp only [DGModuleHom.comp_apply, hxy]), fun y => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h₂.2 y
  exact ⟨e.inv z, hz⟩

name: DG.IsKProjective.bijective_of_isQuasiIso
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.bijective_of_isQuasiIso (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P)
    (hP' : IsKProjective.{w} A P') (hPm : IsBoundedMinimal A P) (hP'm : IsBoundedMinimal A P')
    {f : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P'} (hf : f.IsQuasiIso) : Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, -⟩ :=
    hP.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv hP' hf (DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_id (A := A) (M := P'))
  rw [DGModuleHom.id_comp] at he
  have h₁ : Homotopic (e.inv.comp f) DGModuleHom.id :=
    (he.symm.comp_right e.inv).trans ⟨e.homotopyHomInvId⟩
  have h₂ : Homotopic (f.comp e.inv) DGModuleHom.id :=
    (he.symm.comp_left e.inv).trans ⟨e.homotopyInvHomId⟩
  exact DGHomotopyEquiv.bijective_hom ⟨f, e.inv, h₁.some, h₂.some⟩ hPm hP'm

name: DG.IsKProjective.exists_bijective_of_isBoundedMinimal
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_bijective_of_isBoundedMinimal (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P)
    (hP' : IsKProjective.{w} A P') (hPm : IsBoundedMinimal A P) (hP'm : IsBoundedMinimal A P')
    {p : P →ᵈᵍ[A] M} (hp : p.IsQuasiIso) {p' : P' →ᵈᵍ[A] M} (hp' : p'.IsQuasiIso) :
    ∃ e : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P', Function.Bijective e ∧ Homotopic (p'.comp e) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, -⟩ := hP.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv hP' hp hp'
  exact ⟨e.hom, DGHomotopyEquiv.bijective_hom e hPm hP'm, he⟩

name: DG.DegreeZero.quasiIso_eq_inverseImage
statement:
theorem quasiIso_eq_inverseImage :
    HomotopyCategory.quasiIso.{u} S = (_root_.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} S)
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).inverseImage (homotopyFunctor S)
proof:
:= by
  ext X Y f
  exact mem_quasiIso_iff f

name: DG.DegreeZero.derivedComparisonEquivalence_functor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedComparisonEquivalence_functor :
    (derivedComparisonEquivalence S).functor = derivedComparison S
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedSplitting.twist_add
statement: theorem twist_add (y y' : Q) : σ.twist (y + y') = σ.twist y + σ.twist y'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twist]
  rw [map_add σ.s, d_add, d_add, map_add σ.s, ← map_add σ.r]
  congr 1
  abel

name: DG.GradedSplitting.i_twist
statement: theorem i_twist (y : Q) : i (σ.twist y) = d (σ.s y) - σ.s (d y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := σ.i_r_add_s_p (d (σ.s y) - σ.s (d y))
  rw [map_sub p, p.map_d, σ.p_s, σ.p_s, sub_self, map_zero, add_zero] at h
  exact h

name: DG.GradedSplitting.i_injective
statement: theorem i_injective : Function.Injective i
proof:
:= fun a b h => by
  rw [← σ.r_i a, ← σ.r_i b, h]

name: DG.GradedSplitting.r_s
statement: theorem r_s (y : Q) : σ.r (σ.s y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply σ.i_injective
  have h := σ.i_r_add_s_p (σ.s y)
  rw [σ.p_s, add_eq_right] at h
  rw [h, map_zero]

name: DG.GradedSplitting.d_s
statement: theorem d_s (y : Q) : d (σ.s y) = σ.s (d y) + i (σ.twist y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [σ.i_twist, add_sub_cancel]

name: DG.GradedSplitting.twist_d
statement: theorem twist_d (y : Q) : σ.twist (d y) = -d (σ.twist y)
proof:
:= by
  apply σ.i_injective
  have h1 := σ.d_s (d y)
  rw [d_d, map_zero, zero_add] at h1
  have h2 := congrArg d (σ.d_s y)
  rw [d_d, d_add, h1, ← i.map_d] at h2
  rw [map_neg]
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h2.symm

name: DG.GradedSplitting.r_d
statement: theorem r_d (x : G) : σ.r (d x) = d (σ.r x) + σ.twist (p x)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← σ.i_r_add_s_p x]
  rw [d_add, ← i.map_d, σ.d_s, map_add σ.r, map_add σ.r, σ.r_i, σ.r_s, σ.r_i, zero_add]

name: DG.GradedSplitting.twist_mem
statement: theorem twist_mem {k : ℤ} {y : Q} (hy : y ∈ grading k) : σ.twist y ∈ grading (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : d (σ.s y) ∈ grading (k + 1) := d_mem (by simpa using σ.s.map_mem hy)
  have h2 : σ.s (d y) ∈ grading (k + 1) := by simpa using σ.s.map_mem (d_mem hy)
  have := σ.r.map_mem (sub_mem h1 h2)
  rw [add_zero] at this
  exact this

name: DG.GradedSplitting.coneDesc_apply
statement: theorem coneDesc_apply (c : Cone i) : σ.coneDesc c = p (Cone.sndLinear i c)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedSplitting.coneDesc_comp_inr
statement: theorem coneDesc_comp_inr : σ.coneDesc.comp (Cone.inr i) = p
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext fun _ => rfl

name: DG.GradedSplitting.coneHomotopy_apply
statement:
theorem coneHomotopy_apply (c : Cone i) :
    σ.coneHomotopy c = Cone.inlLinear i (Shift.mk 1 (σ.r (Cone.sndLinear i c)))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedSplitting.d_coneSection
statement: theorem d_coneSection (y : Q) : σ.coneSection (d y) = d (σ.coneSection y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coneSection, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  rw [Cone.d_inlLinear_add_inr]
  congr 2
  · rw [Shift.d_mk, σ.twist_d, d_neg, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.neg_smul, one_smul]
  · rw [Shift.unmk_mk, σ.d_s, map_neg]
    abel

name: DG.GradedSplitting.coneHomotopy_spec
statement:
theorem coneHomotopy_spec (c : Cone i) :
    d (σ.coneHomotopy c) + σ.coneHomotopy (d c) + σ.coneSection (σ.coneDesc c) = c
proof:
:= by
  refine Cone.ext ?_ ?_
  · apply Shift.unmk_inj.mp
    simp only [coneHomotopy_apply, coneSection, coneDesc_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk,
      ZeroHom.coe_mk, map_add, Cone.fstHom_inlLinear, Cone.fstHom_inr, add_zero, Cone.fstHom_d,
      Cone.sndLinear_d, Shift.unmk_d, Shift.unmk_mk, σ.r_i, σ.r_d,
      koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.neg_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  · simp only [coneHomotopy_apply, coneSection, coneDesc_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk,
      ZeroHom.coe_mk, map_add, Cone.sndLinear_inlLinear, Cone.sndLinear_inr, Cone.sndLinear_d,
      Cone.fstHom_inlLinear, Shift.unmk_mk, d_zero, add_zero]
    calc _ = i (σ.r (Cone.sndLinear i c)) + σ.s (p (Cone.sndLinear i c)) := by abel
      _ = _ := σ.i_r_add_s_p _

name: DG.GradedSplitting.isQuasiIso_coneDesc
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_coneDesc : σ.coneDesc.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_contraction σ.coneDesc σ.coneSection ?_ σ.d_coneSection
    σ.coneHomotopy ?_ σ.coneHomotopy_spec ?_
  · intro k y hy
    refine add_mem (Cone.inlLinear_mem ?_) ((Cone.inr i).map_mem (by simpa using σ.s.map_mem hy))
    exact Shift.mem_grading_iff.mpr (neg_mem (σ.twist_mem hy))
  · intro k c hc
    refine Cone.inlLinear_mem (Shift.mem_grading_iff.mpr ?_)
    rw [sub_add_cancel]
    simpa using σ.r.map_mem (Cone.sndLinear_mem hc)
  · intro y
    simp [coneSection, coneDesc_apply, σ.p_s]

name: DG.GradedSplitting.exists_distinguished
statement:
theorem exists_distinguished :
    ∃ δ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A Q) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A F))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.map (DGModuleCat.ofHom i))
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map (DGModuleCat.ofHom p)) δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : DGModuleCat.of A (Cone i) ⟶ DGModuleCat.of A Q := DGModuleCat.ofHom σ.coneDesc
  have : IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ) :=
    (DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff φ).mpr σ.isQuasiIso_coneDesc
  let T := DerivedCategory.Q.mapTriangle.obj
    (Cone.triangle (DGModuleCat.ofHom i : DGModuleCat.of A F ⟶ DGModuleCat.of A G))
  have hT : T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A) :=
    (DerivedCategory.mem_distTriang_iff _).mpr ⟨_, _, _, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
  refine ⟨inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ) ≫ T.mor₃, isomorphic_distinguished T hT _ ?_⟩
  refine Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (asIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ)).symm
    (by simp [T]) ?_ (by
      dsimp
      erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
      exact Category.comp_id _)
  dsimp [T]
  rw [Category.id_comp, IsIso.comp_inv_eq, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryKProjective_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryKProjective_iff (P : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    subcategoryKProjective A ((quotient A).obj P) ↔ IsKProjective.{v} A P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h N _ _ _ _ hN f
    have := h ((quotient A).map (DGModuleCat.ofHom f))
      ((quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff (DGModuleCat.of A N)).mpr hN)
    rw [← Functor.map_zero (quotient A), quotient_map_eq_iff] at this
    exact this
  · intro h Y f hY
    obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := quotient_obj_surjective Y
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := (quotient A).map_surjective f
    rw [quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryAcyclic_iff] at hY
    rw [← Functor.map_zero (quotient A), quotient_map_eq_iff]
    exact h N hY g.hom

name: DG.DerivedCategory.Qh_map_bijective_of_isKProjective
statement:
theorem Qh_map_bijective_of_isKProjective {P : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (hP : IsKProjective.{v} A P)
    (Y : HomotopyCategory.{v} A) :
    Function.Bijective (Qh.map : ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj P ⟶ Y) → _)
proof:
:=
  ObjectProperty.leftOrthogonal.map_bijective_of_isTriangulated
    ((HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_mem_subcategoryKProjective_iff P).mpr hP) _ _

name: DG.DerivedCategory.exists_Q_map_eq
statement:
theorem exists_Q_map_eq {P N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (hP : IsKProjective.{v} A P)
    (φ : Q.obj P ⟶ Q.obj N) : ∃ f : P ⟶ N, Q.map f = φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f', hf'⟩ := (Qh_map_bijective_of_isKProjective hP _).2 φ
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient A).map_surjective f'
  exact ⟨f, hf'⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.Q_map_eq_iff
statement:
theorem Q_map_eq_iff {P N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (hP : IsKProjective.{v} A P) (f g : P ⟶ N) :
    Q.map f = Q.map g ↔ Homotopic f.hom g.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_eq_iff]
  exact (Qh_map_bijective_of_isKProjective hP _).1.eq_iff

name: DG.DerivedCategory.Q_map_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem Q_map_eq_zero_iff {P N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (hP : IsKProjective.{v} A P) (f : P ⟶ N) :
    Q.map f = 0 ↔ Homotopic f.hom 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Functor.map_zero Q P N, Q_map_eq_iff hP]
  rfl

name: DG.DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj
statement:
theorem exists_iso_Q_obj [HasDerivedCategory.{w, v} A] (Y : DerivedCategory.{w, v} A) :
    ∃ N : DGModuleCat.{v} A, Nonempty (Y ≅ Q.obj N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Z, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    (Localization.essSurj (Qh (A := A)) (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A)).mem_essImage Y
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective Z
  exact ⟨N, ⟨e.symm⟩⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.exists_isKProjective_iso
statement:
theorem exists_isKProjective_iso (X : DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A) :
    ∃ P : DGModuleCat.{max u v} A, IsKProjective.{max u v} A P ∧ Nonempty (X ≅ Q.obj P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj X
  obtain ⟨P, _, _, _, _, π, -, hπ, ⟨F⟩⟩ := exists_semiFreeResolution A M
  have : IsIso (Q.map (DGModuleCat.ofHom π)) := (isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr hπ
  exact ⟨DGModuleCat.of A P, F.isKProjective, ⟨e ≪≫ (asIso (Q.map (DGModuleCat.ofHom π))).symm⟩⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.locallySmall
statement:
theorem locallySmall : LocallySmall.{max u v} (DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A) where
  hom_small X Y
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨P, hP, ⟨eX⟩⟩ := exists_isKProjective_iso X
    obtain ⟨N, ⟨eY⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj Y
    have : Small.{max u v} (Q.obj P ⟶ Q.obj N) :=
      small_of_surjective (f := fun f : P ⟶ N => Q.map f) fun φ => exists_Q_map_eq hP φ
    exact small_map (Iso.homCongr eX eY)

name: CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.Exact.moduleCat_finite
statement:
theorem _root_.CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.Exact.moduleCat_finite [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.Exact) (h₁ : Module.Finite R S.X₁)

name: DG.moduleFinite_homology_single

theorem moduleFinite_homology_single {M : ModuleCat.{u} R} (hM : Module.Finite R M)
    {X : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (e : X ≅ (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj M) :
