name: DG.isHeartFamily_fgSingle
statement:
theorem isHeartFamily_fgSingle : IsHeartFamily (fgSingle R) where
  prop_of_iso e
proof:
:= fun ⟨M, hM, ⟨e'⟩⟩ => ⟨M, hM, ⟨e.symm ≪≫ e'⟩⟩
  hom_eq_zero := by
    rintro X Y ⟨M, -, ⟨eX⟩⟩ ⟨N, -, ⟨eY⟩⟩ k hk f
    have : X.IsLE 0 := TStructure.t.isLE_of_iso eX.symm 0
    have : Y.IsGE 0 := TStructure.t.isGE_of_iso eY.symm 0
    have : (Y⟦k⟧).IsGE (-k) := TStructure.t.isGE_shift Y 0 k (-k) (by omega)
    exact TStructure.t.zero f 0 (-k) (by omega)
  cone := by
    rintro T hT ⟨M, hM, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ ⟨N, hN, ⟨e₂⟩⟩
    let f₀ : M ⟶ N := (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).preimage (e₁.inv ≫ T.mor₁ ≫ e₂.hom)
    have hf₀ : (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map f₀ = e₁.inv ≫ T.mor₁ ≫ e₂.hom :=
      Functor.map_preimage _ _
    
    let S₁ : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
      ShortComplex.mk (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.ker f₀.hom).subtype)
        (ModuleCat.ofHom f₀.hom.rangeRestrict) (by ext x; simp)
    have hS₁ : S₁.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S₁
      (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr (by
        change LinearMap.ker f₀.hom.rangeRestrict = LinearMap.range (LinearMap.ker f₀.hom).subtype
        rw [LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict, Submodule.range_subtype]))
      (LinearMap.ker f₀.hom).injective_subtype
      f₀.hom.surjective_rangeRestrict
    let S₂ : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
      ShortComplex.mk (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.range f₀.hom).subtype)
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.range f₀.hom).mkQ) (by ext x; simp)
    have hS₂ : S₂.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S₂
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ _) (LinearMap.range f₀.hom).injective_subtype
      (LinearMap.range f₀.hom).mkQ_surjective
    have hcomp : S₁.g ≫ S₂.f = f₀ := by ext x; rfl
    
    let T' : Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) :=
      Triangle.mk ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map f₀) (e₂.inv ≫ T.mor₂)
        (T.mor₃ ≫ e₁.hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')
    have hT' : T' ∈ distTriang _ := isomorphic_distinguished T hT T'
      (Triangle.isoMk _ _ e₁.symm e₂.symm (Iso.refl _) (by simp [T', hf₀]) (by simp [T'])
        (by simp [T', ← Functor.map_comp]))
    have h₁₂ := rot_of_distTriang _ hS₁.singleTriangle_distinguished
    have h₂₃ := hS₂.singleTriangle_distinguished
    let o := Triangulated.someOctahedron
      (show (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map S₁.g ≫
        (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map S₂.f =
          (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map f₀ by rw [← Functor.map_comp, hcomp])
      h₁₂ h₂₃ hT'
    refine ⟨_, _, o.m₁, o.m₃, _, o.mem, ⟨(singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj S₁.X₁,
      ⟨S₁.X₁, ?_, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩, ⟨S₂.X₃, ?_, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩⟩
    · exact Module.Finite.of_injective (LinearMap.ker f₀.hom).subtype
        (LinearMap.ker f₀.hom).injective_subtype
    · exact Module.Finite.of_surjective _ (LinearMap.range f₀.hom).mkQ_surjective
  ext := by
    rintro T hT ⟨M, hM, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ ⟨N, hN, ⟨e₃⟩⟩
    have : T.obj₁.IsLE 0 := TStructure.t.isLE_of_iso e₁.symm 0
    have : T.obj₁.IsGE 0 := TStructure.t.isGE_of_iso e₁.symm 0
    have : T.obj₃.IsLE 0 := TStructure.t.isLE_of_iso e₃.symm 0
    have : T.obj₃.IsGE 0 := TStructure.t.isGE_of_iso e₃.symm 0
    have : T.obj₂.IsLE 0 := TStructure.t.isLE₂ T hT 0 inferInstance inferInstance
    have : T.obj₂.IsGE 0 := TStructure.t.isGE₂ T hT 0 inferInstance inferInstance
    obtain ⟨E, ⟨e⟩⟩ := T.obj₂.exists_iso_singleFunctor_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE 0
    refine ⟨E, ?_, ⟨e⟩⟩
    have hH : Module.Finite R ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj T.obj₂) :=
      ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map_distinguished_exact T hT).moduleCat_finite
        (moduleFinite_homology_single hM e₁) (moduleFinite_homology_single hN e₃)
    exact moduleFinite_of_iso ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).mapIso e ≪≫
      (singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).app E) hH
  split := by
    rintro X ⟨M, hM, ⟨eX⟩⟩ e he
    let e₀ : M ⟶ M := (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).preimage (eX.inv ≫ e ≫ eX.hom)
    have he₀ : (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map e₀ = eX.inv ≫ e ≫ eX.hom :=
      Functor.map_preimage _ _
    have he₀' : e₀ ≫ e₀ = e₀ := (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map_injective (by
      rw [Functor.map_comp, he₀]
      simp [reassoc_of% he])
    obtain ⟨Y, i, p, hip, hpi⟩ :=
      (inferInstance : IsIdempotentComplete (ModuleCat.{u} R)).idempotents_split M e₀ he₀'
    refine ⟨(singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj Y,
      (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map i ≫ eX.inv,
      eX.hom ≫ (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).map p, ⟨Y, ?_, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hsurj : Function.Surjective p.hom := fun y =>
        ⟨i.hom y, by rw [← ModuleCat.comp_apply, hip]; rfl⟩
      exact Module.Finite.of_surjective _ hsurj
    · simp [← Functor.map_comp, hip]
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hpi, he₀]
      simp

name: DG.moduleCat_int_induction
statement:
theorem moduleCat_int_induction (Pr : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ → Prop)
    (hiso : ∀ {M N : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ}, (M ≅ N) → Pr M → Pr N)
    (hzero : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ, IsZero M → Pr M)
    (hbiprod : ∀ M N : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ, Pr M → Pr N → Pr (M ⊞ N))
    (hZ : Pr (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ))
    (hcyc : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → Pr (ModuleCat.of ℤ (ℤ ⧸ Submodule.span ℤ {m}))) :
    ∀ M : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ, Module.Finite ℤ M → Pr M
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : ∀ M N : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ, Pr M → Pr N →
      Pr (@ModuleCat.of ℤ _ (M × N) _ Prod.instModule) :=
    fun M N hM hN => hiso (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N) (hbiprod M N hM hN)
  have hfree : ∀ n : ℕ, Pr (ModuleCat.of ℤ (Fin n → ℤ)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hzero _ (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)
    | succ n ih =>
      exact hiso (Fin.consLinearEquiv ℤ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℤ)).toModuleIso
        (hprod (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) (ModuleCat.of ℤ (Fin n → ℤ)) hZ ih)
  have htors : ∀ (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (q : ι → ℤ), (∀ i, q i ≠ 0) →
      Pr (ModuleCat.of ℤ (∀ i, ℤ ⧸ Submodule.span ℤ {q i})) := by
    intro ι _
    refine Finite.induction_empty_option (P := fun ι => ∀ (q : ι → ℤ), (∀ i, q i ≠ 0) →
      Pr (ModuleCat.of ℤ (∀ i, ℤ ⧸ Submodule.span ℤ {q i}))) ?_ ?_ ?_ ι
    · intro α β e h q hq
      exact hiso (LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft ℤ (fun j => ℤ ⧸ Submodule.span ℤ {q j}) e).toModuleIso
        (h (q ∘ e) fun i => hq _)
    · intro q _
      exact hzero _ (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)
    · intro α _ h q hq
      exact hiso
        (LinearEquiv.piOptionEquivProd (M := fun i => ℤ ⧸ Submodule.span ℤ {q i}) ℤ).symm.toModuleIso
        (hprod (ModuleCat.of ℤ (ℤ ⧸ Submodule.span ℤ {q none}))
          (ModuleCat.of ℤ (∀ i, ℤ ⧸ Submodule.span ℤ {q (some i)})) (hcyc _ (hq none))
          (h (fun i => q (some i)) fun i => hq _))
  intro M hM
  obtain ⟨n, ι, _, p, hp, e, ⟨f⟩⟩ := Module.equiv_free_prod_directSum ℤ M
  have h₁ : Pr (ModuleCat.of ℤ (Fin n →₀ ℤ)) :=
    hiso (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ℤ ℤ (Fin n)).symm.toModuleIso (hfree n)
  have h₂ : Pr (ModuleCat.of ℤ (DirectSum ι fun i => ℤ ⧸ Submodule.span ℤ {p i ^ e i})) :=
    hiso (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype ℤ ι _).symm.toModuleIso
      (htors ι _ fun i => pow_ne_zero _ (hp i).ne_zero)
  exact hiso f.symm.toModuleIso (hprod _ _ h₁ h₂)

name: DG.cyclicShortComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem cyclicShortComplex_shortExact {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    (cyclicShortComplex m).ShortExact
proof:
:=
  ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact _
    (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr (by
      change LinearMap.ker (Submodule.span ℤ {m}).mkQ = LinearMap.range (m • LinearMap.id)
      rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ]
      ext x
      rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton, LinearMap.mem_range]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨a, by simp [mul_comm]⟩
      · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨a, by simp [mul_comm]⟩))
    (show Function.Injective (m • LinearMap.id : ℤ →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) from fun x y h =>
      mul_left_cancel₀ hm (by simpa using h))
    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)

name: DG.ofHom_zsmul_id
statement:
theorem ofHom_zsmul_id (m : ℤ) :
    ModuleCat.ofHom (m • LinearMap.id : ℤ →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) = m • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  change (m • LinearMap.id : ℤ →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) 1 = (m • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).hom 1
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_zsmul]
  rfl

name: DG.cyclicShortComplex_f
statement: theorem cyclicShortComplex_f (m : ℤ) : (cyclicShortComplex m).f = m • 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  ext
  change (m • LinearMap.id : ℤ →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) 1 = (m • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).hom 1
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_zsmul]
  rfl

name: DG.shiftHomAddHom_injective
statement:
theorem shiftHomAddHom_injective (X M : C) (a : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (shiftHomAddHom X M a)
proof:
:= by
  intro g g' h
  change (shiftShiftNeg X a).inv ≫ g⟦-a⟧' = (shiftShiftNeg X a).inv ≫ g'⟦-a⟧' at h
  rw [cancel_epi] at h
  exact (shiftFunctor C (-a)).map_injective h

name: DG.homShiftAddHom_injective
statement:
theorem homShiftAddHom_injective (X M : C) (k : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (homShiftAddHom X M k)
proof:
:= by
  intro g g' h
  change g⟦-k⟧' ≫ (shiftShiftNeg M k).hom = g'⟦-k⟧' ≫ (shiftShiftNeg M k).hom at h
  rw [cancel_mono] at h
  exact (shiftFunctor C (-k)).map_injective h

name: DG.eq_zero_of_injective
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_injective {G G' : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup G'] (φ : G →+ G')
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (h : ∀ y : G', y = 0) (x : G) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  hφ (by rw [h (φ x), map_zero])

name: DG.eq_zero_of_injective_of_zsmul
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_injective_of_zsmul {G G' : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup G']
    (φ : G →+ G') (hφ : Function.Injective φ) {m : ℤ} (h : ∀ y : G', m • y = 0 → y = 0) (x : G)
    (hx : m • x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  hφ (by rw [h (φ x) (by rw [← map_zsmul, hx, map_zero]), map_zero])

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Good.of_iso
statement:
theorem Good.of_iso {Y Y' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (h : Good F Y) (e : Y ≅ Y') :
    Good F Y' where
  neg k hk g
proof:
:= by
    have := h.neg k hk (g ≫ (F.map e.inv)⟦k⟧')
    rw [← cancel_mono ((F.map e.inv)⟦k⟧'), this, zero_comp]
  one g := by
    have := h.one (g ≫ (F.map e.inv)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')
    rw [← cancel_mono ((F.map e.inv)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'), this, zero_comp]
  bij := by
    refine ⟨fun f f' hf => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩
    · have : f ≫ e.inv = f' ≫ e.inv := h.bij.1 (by simp [hf])
      simpa using congrArg (· ≫ e.hom) this
    · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.bij.2 (g ≫ F.map e.inv)
      refine ⟨f ≫ e.hom, ?_⟩
      simp only [Functor.map_comp]
      rw [show F.map f = g ≫ F.map e.inv from hf, Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp, e.inv_hom_id,
        F.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Good.of_isZero
statement:
theorem Good.of_isZero {Y : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (hY : IsZero Y) : Good F Y where
  neg _ _ _
proof:
:= ((shiftFunctor C _).map_isZero (F.map_isZero hY)).eq_of_tgt _ _
  one _ := ((shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).map_isZero (F.map_isZero hY)).eq_of_tgt _ _
  bij := ⟨fun _ _ _ => hY.eq_of_tgt _ _, fun _ => ⟨0, (F.map_isZero hY).eq_of_tgt _ _⟩⟩

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Good.biprod
statement:
theorem Good.biprod {Y₁ Y₂ : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (h₁ : Good F Y₁)
    (h₂ : Good F Y₂) : Good F (Y₁ ⊞ Y₂)
proof:
:= by
  have htot : F.map (biprod.fst : Y₁ ⊞ Y₂ ⟶ Y₁) ≫ F.map biprod.inl +
      F.map biprod.snd ≫ F.map biprod.inr = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp, ← F.map_add, biprod.total, F.map_id]
  have hk : ∀ k : ℤ, (F.map (biprod.fst : Y₁ ⊞ Y₂ ⟶ Y₁))⟦k⟧' ≫ (F.map biprod.inl)⟦k⟧' +
      (F.map biprod.snd)⟦k⟧' ≫ (F.map biprod.inr)⟦k⟧' = 𝟙 _ := fun k => by
    rw [← (shiftFunctor C k).map_comp, ← (shiftFunctor C k).map_comp,
      ← (shiftFunctor C k).map_add, htot, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  have hsplit : ∀ {k : ℤ} (g : P F ⟶ (F.obj (Y₁ ⊞ Y₂))⟦k⟧),
      g = (g ≫ (F.map biprod.fst)⟦k⟧') ≫ (F.map biprod.inl)⟦k⟧' +
        (g ≫ (F.map biprod.snd)⟦k⟧') ≫ (F.map biprod.inr)⟦k⟧' := by
    intro k g
    conv_lhs => rw [← Category.comp_id g, ← hk k]
    rw [Preadditive.comp_add, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨fun k hk' g => ?_, fun g => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsplit g, h₁.neg k hk' (g ≫ _), h₂.neg k hk' (g ≫ _), zero_comp, zero_comp, add_zero]
  · rw [hsplit g, h₁.one (g ≫ _), h₂.one (g ≫ _), zero_comp, zero_comp, add_zero]
  · intro f f' hf
    have hf' : F.map f = F.map f' := hf
    apply biprod.hom_ext
    · exact h₁.bij.1 (by simp only [F.map_comp, hf'])
    · exact h₂.bij.1 (by simp only [F.map_comp, hf'])
  · intro g
    obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := h₁.bij.2 (g ≫ F.map biprod.fst)
    obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ := h₂.bij.2 (g ≫ F.map biprod.snd)
    refine ⟨biprod.lift f₁ f₂, ?_⟩
    change F.map (biprod.lift f₁ f₂) = g
    rw [show biprod.lift f₁ f₂ = f₁ ≫ biprod.inl + f₂ ≫ biprod.inr by
        ext <;> simp, F.map_add, F.map_comp, F.map_comp,
      show F.map f₁ = g ≫ F.map biprod.fst from hf₁, show F.map f₂ = g ≫ F.map biprod.snd from hf₂,
      Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Preadditive.comp_add, htot, Category.comp_id]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Z_endo
statement: theorem Z_endo (f : (Z : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)) ⟶ Z) : ∃ n : ℤ, f = n • 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₀, rfl⟩ := (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).map_surjective f
  refine ⟨f₀.hom 1, ?_⟩
  have : f₀ = (f₀.hom 1) • 𝟙 _ := ModuleCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext_ring (by simp))
  conv_lhs => rw [this]
  rw [Functor.map_zsmul, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.good_Z
statement:
theorem good_Z (h : Hyp F) : Good F Z where
  neg
proof:
:= h.neg
  one := h.one
  bij := by
    refine ⟨fun f f' hf => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Z_endo f
      obtain ⟨n', rfl⟩ := Z_endo f'
      have : n • 𝟙 (P F) = n' • 𝟙 (P F) := by
        simpa [Functor.map_zsmul] using hf
      rw [h.zero.1 this]
    · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.zero.2 g
      exact ⟨n • 𝟙 _, by simp⟩

name: DG.IntegralHeart.cycTriangle_distinguished
statement: theorem cycTriangle_distinguished : cycTriangle hm ∈ distTriang _
proof:
:= by
  refine isomorphic_distinguished _ (cyclicShortComplex_shortExact hm).singleTriangle_distinguished
    _ (Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ (by simp) (by simp))
  dsimp
  rw [ofHom_zsmul_id, Functor.map_zsmul, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id,
    Category.id_comp]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.cycTriangleF_distinguished
statement: theorem cycTriangleF_distinguished : cycTriangleF F hm ∈ distTriang C
proof:
:= by
  refine isomorphic_distinguished _ (F.map_distinguished _ (cycTriangle_distinguished hm)) _
    (Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ (by simp) (by simp))
  dsimp
  rw [Functor.map_zsmul, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.cyc_hom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cyc_hom_eq_zero {W : C} (h₀ : ∀ y : W ⟶ P F, y = 0)
    (h₁ : ∀ z : W ⟶ (P F)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧, m • z = 0 → z = 0) (g : W ⟶ F.obj (Zmod m)) : g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hT := cycTriangleF_distinguished (F := F) hm
  have hz : g ≫ (cycTriangleF F hm).mor₃ = 0 := by
    refine h₁ _ ?_
    have h31 : (cycTriangleF F hm).mor₃ ≫ (m • 𝟙 (P F))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = 0 :=
      comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁ _ hT
    have e : ((m • 𝟙 (P F))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' : (P F)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ (P F)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) = m • 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [Functor.map_zsmul, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    erw [e, Preadditive.comp_zsmul, Category.comp_id] at h31
    rw [← Preadditive.comp_zsmul, h31, comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ _ hT g hz
  rw [hy, h₀ y, zero_comp]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Hyp.zsmul_eq_zero
statement: theorem Hyp.zsmul_eq_zero (h : Hyp F) {x : P F ⟶ P F} (hx : m • x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h.zero.2 x
  have h0 : (m * n) • 𝟙 (P F) = (0 : ℤ) • 𝟙 (P F) := by
    rw [mul_smul, zero_smul]
    exact hx
  have : m * n = 0 := h.zero.1 h0
  change n • 𝟙 (P F) = 0
  rw [(mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hm, zero_smul]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.good_cyc
statement: theorem good_cyc (h : Hyp F) : Good F (Zmod m)
proof:
:= by
  have hT := cycTriangleF_distinguished (F := F) hm
  
  have hpos : ∀ a : ℤ, 0 < a → ∀ y : (P F)⟦a⟧ ⟶ P F, y = 0 := fun a ha y =>
    eq_zero_of_injective _ (shiftHomAddHom_injective _ _ a) (h.neg (-a) (by omega)) y
  have hP1 : ∀ a : ℤ, 0 < a → ∀ z : (P F)⟦a⟧ ⟶ (P F)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧, m • z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro a ha z hz
    refine eq_zero_of_injective_of_zsmul _ (shiftHomAddHom_injective _ _ a) ?_ z hz
    intro y hy
    rcases (show a = 1 ∨ 1 < a by omega) with rfl | ha'
    · exact eq_zero_of_injective_of_zsmul
        (homIsoAddEquiv _ (shiftShiftNeg (P F) (1 : ℤ))).toAddMonoidHom
        (homIsoAddEquiv _ _).injective (fun x hx => h.zsmul_eq_zero hm hx) y hy
    · exact eq_zero_of_injective (homIsoAddEquiv _ ((shiftFunctorAdd' C 1 (-a) (1 + -a) rfl).app
        (P F)).symm).toAddMonoidHom (homIsoAddEquiv _ _).injective
        (h.neg (1 + -a) (by omega)) y
  refine ⟨fun k hk g => ?_, fun g => ?_, ⟨fun f f' hf => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩⟩
  · refine (homShiftAddHom_injective _ _ k) ?_
    rw [map_zero]
    exact cyc_hom_eq_zero hm (hpos (-k) (by omega)) (hP1 (-k) (by omega)) _
  · refine (homShiftAddHom_injective _ _ 1) ?_
    rw [map_zero]
    refine cyc_hom_eq_zero hm (fun y => ?_) (fun z hz => ?_) _
    · exact eq_zero_of_injective _ (shiftHomAddHom_injective _ _ (-1)) h.one y
    · refine eq_zero_of_injective_of_zsmul _ (shiftHomAddHom_injective _ _ (-1)) ?_ z hz
      intro y hy
      exact eq_zero_of_injective_of_zsmul (homIsoAddEquiv _
        ((shiftFunctorAdd' C 1 1 2 rfl).app (P F)).symm).toAddMonoidHom
        (homIsoAddEquiv _ _).injective (fun x hx => h.two m hm x hx) y hy
  · 
    have hf' : F.map (f - f') = 0 := by
      rw [F.map_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hf
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩ : ∃ f₀ : Z ⟶ Zmod m, f₀ = f - f' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hf₀] at hf' ⊢
    have hD := cycTriangle_distinguished hm
    have hz : f₀ ≫ (cycTriangle hm).mor₃ = 0 := by
      have : HasExt.{w} (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) := hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory _
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (Abelian.Ext.homEquiv (X := ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
        (Y := ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) (n := 0 + 1)).surjective (f₀ ≫ (cycTriangle hm).mor₃)
      rw [← he, Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_projective e]
      exact Abelian.Ext.zero_hom _ _ _
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ _ hD f₀ hz
    have hFy : F.map y ≫ (cycTriangleF F hm).mor₂ = 0 := by
      change F.map y ≫ F.map (cycπ m) = 0
      rw [← F.map_comp]
      change F.map (y ≫ (cycTriangle hm).mor₂) = 0
      rw [← hy, hf']
    obtain ⟨z, hz'⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ _ hT (F.map y) hFy
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := (good_Z h).bij.2 z
    have hyz : y = m • z₀ := (good_Z h).bij.1 (by
      change F.map y = F.map (m • z₀)
      rw [hz', Functor.map_zsmul]
      change z ≫ (m • 𝟙 (P F)) = m • F.map z₀
      erw [Preadditive.comp_zsmul, Category.comp_id, show F.map z₀ = z from hz₀])
    have hm2 : m • (cycTriangle hm).mor₂ = 0 := by
      have := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ hD
      simpa using this
    rw [hy, hyz, Preadditive.zsmul_comp, ← Preadditive.comp_zsmul, hm2, comp_zero]
  · 
    have hz : g ≫ (cycTriangleF F hm).mor₃ = 0 := h.one _
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ _ hT g hz
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := (good_Z h).bij.2 y
    refine ⟨y₀ ≫ cycπ m, ?_⟩
    change F.map (y₀ ≫ cycπ m) = g
    rw [F.map_comp, show F.map y₀ = y from hy₀, hy]
    rfl

name: DG.IntegralHeart.good_single
statement:
theorem good_single (h : Hyp F) (M : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) (hM : Module.Finite ℤ M) :
    Good F ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  have := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0)
  exact moduleCat_int_induction (fun M => Good F ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).obj M))
    (fun e hM => hM.of_iso ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).mapIso e))
    (fun _ hM => Good.of_isZero (Functor.map_isZero _ hM))
    (fun M N hM hN => (hM.biprod hN).of_iso
      ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).mapBiprod M N).symm)
    (good_Z h) (fun _ hm => good_cyc hm h) M hM

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Good₂.of_iso_left
statement:
theorem Good₂.of_iso_left {X X' Y : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (h : Good₂ F X Y)
    (e : X ≅ X') : Good₂ F X' Y where
  bij
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨fun f f' hf => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩
    · have hf' : F.map f = F.map f' := hf
      have : e.hom ≫ f = e.hom ≫ f' := h.bij.1 (by simp only [F.map_comp, hf'])
      simpa using congrArg (e.inv ≫ ·) this
    · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.bij.2 (F.map e.hom ≫ g)
      refine ⟨e.inv ≫ f, ?_⟩
      change F.map (e.inv ≫ f) = g
      rw [F.map_comp, show F.map f = F.map e.hom ≫ g from hf, ← Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp,
        e.inv_hom_id, F.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  neg k hk g := by
    have := h.neg k hk (F.map e.hom ≫ g)
    rw [← cancel_epi (F.map e.hom), this, comp_zero]
  one g := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.one (F.map e.hom ≫ g)
    refine ⟨e.inv ≫ f, ?_⟩
    rw [F.map_comp, Category.assoc, hf, ← Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp, e.inv_hom_id, F.map_id,
      Category.id_comp]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Good₂.of_iso_right
statement:
theorem Good₂.of_iso_right {X Y Y' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (h : Good₂ F X Y)
    (e : Y ≅ Y') : Good₂ F X Y' where
  bij
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨fun f f' hf => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩
    · have hf' : F.map f = F.map f' := hf
      have : f ≫ e.inv = f' ≫ e.inv := h.bij.1 (by simp only [F.map_comp, hf'])
      simpa using congrArg (· ≫ e.hom) this
    · obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.bij.2 (g ≫ F.map e.inv)
      refine ⟨f ≫ e.hom, ?_⟩
      change F.map (f ≫ e.hom) = g
      rw [F.map_comp, show F.map f = g ≫ F.map e.inv from hf, Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp,
        e.inv_hom_id, F.map_id, Category.comp_id]
  neg k hk g := by
    have := h.neg k hk (g ≫ (F.map e.inv)⟦k⟧')
    rw [← cancel_mono ((F.map e.inv)⟦k⟧'), this, zero_comp]
  one g := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h.one (g ≫ (F.map e.inv)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧')
    refine ⟨f ≫ e.hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧', ?_⟩
    rw [F.map_comp, Category.assoc, F.commShiftIso_hom_naturality, ← Category.assoc, hf,
      Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, ← F.map_comp, e.inv_hom_id, F.map_id,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Good₂.of_isZero_left
statement:
theorem Good₂.of_isZero_left {X Y : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (hX : IsZero X) :
    Good₂ F X Y where
  bij
proof:
:= ⟨fun _ _ _ => hX.eq_of_src _ _, fun _ => ⟨0, (F.map_isZero hX).eq_of_src _ _⟩⟩
  neg _ _ _ := (F.map_isZero hX).eq_of_src _ _
  one _ := ⟨0, (F.map_isZero hX).eq_of_src _ _⟩

name: DG.IntegralHeart.Good₂.biprod_left
statement:
theorem Good₂.biprod_left {X₁ X₂ Y : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (h₁ : Good₂ F X₁ Y)
    (h₂ : Good₂ F X₂ Y) : Good₂ F (X₁ ⊞ X₂) Y
proof:
:= by
  have htot : F.map (biprod.fst : X₁ ⊞ X₂ ⟶ X₁) ≫ F.map biprod.inl +
      F.map biprod.snd ≫ F.map biprod.inr = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp, ← F.map_add, biprod.total, F.map_id]
  have hsplit : ∀ {W : C} (g : F.obj (X₁ ⊞ X₂) ⟶ W),
      g = F.map biprod.fst ≫ (F.map biprod.inl ≫ g) +
        F.map biprod.snd ≫ (F.map biprod.inr ≫ g) := by
    intro W g
    conv_lhs => rw [← Category.id_comp g, ← htot]
    rw [Preadditive.add_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨⟨fun f f' hf => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩, fun k hk g => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩
  · have hf' : F.map f = F.map f' := hf
    apply biprod.hom_ext'
    · exact h₁.bij.1 (by simp only [F.map_comp, hf'])
    · exact h₂.bij.1 (by simp only [F.map_comp, hf'])
  · obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := h₁.bij.2 (F.map biprod.inl ≫ g)
    obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ := h₂.bij.2 (F.map biprod.inr ≫ g)
    refine ⟨biprod.fst ≫ f₁ + biprod.snd ≫ f₂, ?_⟩
    change F.map (biprod.fst ≫ f₁ + biprod.snd ≫ f₂) = g
    rw [F.map_add, F.map_comp, F.map_comp, show F.map f₁ = F.map biprod.inl ≫ g from hf₁,
      show F.map f₂ = F.map biprod.inr ≫ g from hf₂, ← hsplit]
  · rw [hsplit g, h₁.neg k hk (F.map biprod.inl ≫ g), h₂.neg k hk (F.map biprod.inr ≫ g),
      comp_zero, comp_zero, add_zero]
  · obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁⟩ := h₁.one (F.map biprod.inl ≫ g)
    obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ := h₂.one (F.map biprod.inr ≫ g)
    refine ⟨biprod.fst ≫ f₁ + biprod.snd ≫ f₂, ?_⟩
    rw [F.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, F.map_comp, F.map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
      hf₁, hf₂, ← hsplit]

name: DG.IntegralHeart.good₂_Z
statement:
theorem good₂_Z {Y : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (hY : Good F Y) : Good₂ F Z Y where
  bij
proof:
:= hY.bij
  neg := hY.neg
  one g := ⟨0, by rw [F.map_zero, zero_comp, hY.one g]⟩

name: DG.IntegralHeart.good₂_cyc
statement:
theorem good₂_cyc {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0) {Y : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (hY : Good F Y)
    (hYZ : ∀ z : Z⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ Y, z = 0) : Good₂ F (Zmod m) Y
proof:
:= by
  have hD := cycTriangle_distinguished hm
  have hT := cycTriangleF_distinguished (F := F) hm
  
  have hP1 : ∀ (k : ℤ) (z : (P F)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ (F.obj Y)⟦k⟧), k ≤ 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro k z hk
    refine eq_zero_of_injective _ (shiftHomAddHom_injective _ _ 1) ?_ z
    intro y
    exact eq_zero_of_injective (homIsoAddEquiv _ ((shiftFunctorAdd' C k (-1) (k + -1) rfl).app
        (F.obj Y)).symm).toAddMonoidHom (homIsoAddEquiv _ _).injective
        (hY.neg (k + -1) (by omega)) y
  have hP1' : ∀ z : (P F)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ F.obj Y, z = 0 := by
    intro z
    have := hP1 0 (z ≫ ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app (F.obj Y)).inv) le_rfl
    rw [← cancel_mono ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app (F.obj Y)).inv, this, zero_comp]
  refine ⟨⟨fun f f' hf => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩, fun k hk g => ?_, fun g => ?_⟩
  · 
    have hf' : F.map (f - f') = 0 := by
      rw [F.map_sub]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hf
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    have h0 : (cycTriangle hm).mor₂ ≫ (f - f') = 0 := hY.bij.1 (by
      change F.map (cycπ m ≫ (f - f')) = F.map 0
      rw [F.map_comp, hf', comp_zero, F.map_zero])
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ _ hD (f - f') h0
    rw [hz, hYZ z, comp_zero]
  · 
    obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := hY.bij.2 (F.map (cycπ m) ≫ g)
    have h1 : (cycTriangle hm).mor₁ ≫ h₀ = 0 := hY.bij.1 (by
      change F.map ((m • 𝟙 Z) ≫ h₀) = F.map 0
      rw [F.map_comp, show F.map h₀ = F.map (cycπ m) ≫ g from hh₀, F.map_zero, ← Category.assoc,
        ← F.map_comp]
      change F.map ((cycTriangle hm).mor₁ ≫ (cycTriangle hm).mor₂) ≫ g = 0
      rw [comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ _ hD, F.map_zero, zero_comp])
    obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩ : ∃ f₀ : Zmod m ⟶ Y, h₀ = cycπ m ≫ f₀ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ _ hD h₀ h1
    have h2 : (cycTriangleF F hm).mor₂ ≫ (g - F.map f₀) = 0 := by
      change F.map (cycπ m) ≫ (g - F.map f₀) = 0
      rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, ← F.map_comp, ← hh₀]
      rw [← hf₀, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ _ hT _ h2
    refine ⟨f₀, ?_⟩
    change F.map f₀ = g
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← neg_sub, hz, hP1' z, comp_zero, neg_zero]
  · 
    have h2 : (cycTriangleF F hm).mor₂ ≫ g = 0 := hY.neg k hk _
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ _ hT g h2
    rw [hz, hP1 k z (by omega), comp_zero]
  · 
    have h2 : (cycTriangleF F hm).mor₂ ≫ g = 0 := hY.one _
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Triangle.yoneda_exact₃ _ hT g h2
    obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hY.bij.2 ((shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).preimage z)
    refine ⟨(cycTriangle hm).mor₃ ≫ v₀⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧', ?_⟩
    rw [hz, F.map_comp, Category.assoc, F.commShiftIso_hom_naturality,
      show F.map v₀ = (shiftFunctor C (1 : ℤ)).preimage z from hv₀, Functor.map_preimage,
      ← Category.assoc]
    rfl

name: DG.IntegralHeart.good₂_fg
statement:
theorem good₂_fg (h : Hyp F) {A B : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ)} (hA : fgSingle ℤ A)
    (hB : fgSingle ℤ B) : Good₂ F A B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM, ⟨eA⟩⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨N, hN, ⟨eB⟩⟩ := hB
  have hY : Good F B := (good_single h N hN).of_iso eB.symm
  have hYZ : ∀ z : Z⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ B, z = 0 := by
    intro z
    have : (Z⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧).IsLE (-1) := TStructure.t.isLE_shift Z 0 1 (-1) (by omega)
    have : B.IsGE 0 := TStructure.t.isGE_of_iso eB.symm 0
    exact TStructure.t.zero z (-1) 0 (by omega)
  have := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0)
  refine Good₂.of_iso_left ?_ eA.symm
  exact moduleCat_int_induction (fun M => Good₂ F ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).obj M) B)
    (fun e hM => hM.of_iso_left ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).mapIso e))
    (fun _ hM => Good₂.of_isZero_left (Functor.map_isZero _ hM))
    (fun M N hM hN => (hM.biprod_left hN).of_iso_left
      ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).mapBiprod M N).symm)
    (good₂_Z hY) (fun _ hm => good₂_cyc hm hY hYZ) M hM

name: DG.IntegralHeart.isHeartFamily
statement: theorem isHeartFamily (h : Hyp F) : IsHeartFamily (mapHeart F (fgSingle ℤ))
proof:
:=
  isHeartFamily_fgSingle.map (fun hA hB g => (good₂_fg h hA hB).bij.2 g)
    (fun hA hB _ _ hff => (good₂_fg h hA hB).bij.1 hff)
    (fun hA hB k hk g => (good₂_fg h hA hB).neg k hk g)
    (fun hA hB g => (good₂_fg h hA hB).one g)

name: DG.IntegralHeart.hasHeartTower_P
statement: theorem hasHeartTower_P : IsHeartFamily.HasHeartTower (mapHeart F (fgSingle ℤ)) (P F)
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, HeartTower.of_shiftedProp ⟨P F, ⟨Z, ⟨ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ, inferInstance, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩,
    ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩, ⟨((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app (P F)).symm⟩⟩⟩

name: DG.IntegralHeart.thickClosure_le
proof:
:=
  DG.thickClosure_le (isHeartFamily h).isThick fun X hX =>
    let ⟨a, ha⟩ := hasHeartTower_P (F := F)
    ⟨a, ha.of_iso (hS X hX).some.symm⟩

name: DG.IntegralHeart.mapHeart_prop
statement: theorem mapHeart_prop : ∀ X, mapHeart F (fgSingle ℤ) X → 𝒦 X
proof:
:= by
  rintro X ⟨A, ⟨M, hM, ⟨eA⟩⟩, ⟨eX⟩⟩
  refine 𝒦.prop_of_iso (eX ≪≫ F.mapIso eA).symm ?_
  have := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0)
  have := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts F
  refine moduleCat_int_induction
    (fun M => 𝒦 (F.obj ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).obj M)))
    (fun e hM => 𝒦.prop_of_iso (F.mapIso ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).mapIso e)) hM)
    (fun _ hM => 𝒦.prop_of_isZero (F.map_isZero (Functor.map_isZero _ hM)))
    (fun M N hM hN => 𝒦.prop_of_iso (F.mapIso
        ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).mapBiprod M N).symm)
      (𝒦.prop_of_iso (F.mapBiprod _ _).symm
        (𝒦.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂ _ (binaryBiproductTriangle_distinguished _ _) hM hN)))
    hP (fun _ hm => 𝒦.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₃ _ (cycTriangleF_distinguished hm) hP hP) M hM

name: DG.IntegralHeart.mk_mapHeart_mem
statement:
theorem mk_mapHeart_mem (X : C) (hX : mapHeart F (fgSingle ℤ) X) :
    K0.mk (⟨X, mapHeart_prop hP X hX⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory) ∈
      AddSubgroup.zmultiples (K0.mk (⟨P F, hP⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, ⟨M, hM, ⟨eA⟩⟩, ⟨eX⟩⟩ := hX
  have hiso : ∀ {X Y : C} (hX : 𝒦 X) (hY : 𝒦 Y), (X ≅ Y) →
      K0.mk (⟨X, hX⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory) = K0.mk ⟨Y, hY⟩ := fun _ _ e => K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj e
  suffices H : ∀ (M : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ), Module.Finite ℤ M → ∃ hM' :
      𝒦 (F.obj ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).obj M)),
        K0.mk (⟨_, hM'⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory) ∈
          AddSubgroup.zmultiples (K0.mk (⟨P F, hP⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory)) by
    obtain ⟨hM', hmem⟩ := H M hM
    rwa [hiso _ hM' (eX ≪≫ F.mapIso eA)]
  have := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0)
  have := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts F
  refine moduleCat_int_induction _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro M N e ⟨hM', hmem⟩
    have e' := F.mapIso ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).mapIso e)
    exact ⟨𝒦.prop_of_iso e' hM', by rwa [← hiso hM' _ e']⟩
  · intro M hM
    have hz := F.map_isZero (Functor.map_isZero (singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0) hM)
    refine ⟨𝒦.prop_of_isZero hz, ?_⟩
    have hz0 : K0.mk (⟨_, 𝒦.prop_of_isZero hz⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory) = 0 :=
      K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr (by
        ext
        exact hz.eq_of_src _ _))
    rw [hz0]
    exact zero_mem _
  · rintro M N ⟨hM', hmM⟩ ⟨hN', hmN⟩
    have hB := 𝒦.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂ _ (binaryBiproductTriangle_distinguished _ _) hM' hN'
    have e : F.obj ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).obj (M ⊞ N)) ≅
        F.obj ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).obj M) ⊞
          F.obj ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).obj N) :=
      F.mapIso ((singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) 0).mapBiprod M N) ≪≫ F.mapBiprod _ _
    refine ⟨𝒦.prop_of_iso e.symm hB, ?_⟩
    rw [hiso _ hB e, K0.mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂ _ (binaryBiproductTriangle_distinguished _ _)
      hM' hB hN']
    exact add_mem hmM hmN
  · exact ⟨hP, AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples _⟩
  · intro m hm
    have hT := cycTriangleF_distinguished (F := F) hm
    have h₃ := 𝒦.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₃ _ hT hP hP
    refine ⟨h₃, ?_⟩
    have := K0.mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂ _ hT hP hP h₃
    have h0 : K0.mk (⟨(cycTriangleF F hm).obj₃, h₃⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory) = 0 := by
      have := this
      exact (add_eq_left.mp this.symm)
    change K0.mk (⟨(cycTriangleF F hm).obj₃, h₃⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory) ∈ _
    rw [h0]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.IntegralHeart.exists_eq_zsmul
statement:
theorem exists_eq_zsmul
    (h𝒦 : ∀ X, 𝒦 X → IsHeartFamily.HasHeartTower (mapHeart F (fgSingle ℤ)) X)
    (x : K0 𝒦.FullSubcategory) : ∃ n : ℤ, x = n • K0.mk (⟨P F, hP⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := K0.exists_mk_eq x
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h𝒦 X.obj X.property
  obtain ⟨hX', hmem⟩ := HeartTower.mk_mem_closure (mapHeart_prop hP) ha
  have hle : AddSubgroup.closure {x | ∃ (Y : C) (hY : mapHeart F (fgSingle ℤ) Y),
      x = K0.mk (⟨Y, mapHeart_prop hP Y hY⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory)} ≤
        AddSubgroup.zmultiples (K0.mk (⟨P F, hP⟩ : 𝒦.FullSubcategory)) := by
    rw [AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨Y, hY, rfl⟩
    exact mk_mapHeart_mem hP Y hY
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp (hle hmem)
  exact ⟨n, hn.symm⟩

name: DG.IsFGProjective.self
statement: theorem IsFGProjective.self (R : Type u) [Ring R] : IsFGProjective R (ModuleCat.of R R)
proof:
:=
  ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: DG.IsPerfect.singleFunctor_obj_pi_mem
statement:
theorem singleFunctor_obj_pi_mem (n : ℕ) :
    P ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj
      (ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R)))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine hP.of_isZero (Functor.map_isZero _ ?_)
    exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
  | succ n ih =>
    have := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0)
    let e : ModuleCat.of R (Fin (n + 1) → R) ≅
        ModuleCat.of R R ⊞ ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R) :=
      (Fin.consLinearEquiv R fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => R).toModuleIso.symm ≪≫
        (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd (ModuleCat.of R R) (ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R))).symm
    exact hP.of_iso ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).mapIso e ≪≫
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).mapBiprod _ _) (hP.biprod hR ih)

name: DG.IsPerfect.singleFunctor_obj_mem
statement:
theorem singleFunctor_obj_mem {M : ModuleCat.{u} R} (hM : IsFGProjective R M) :
    P ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨n, f, g, -, -, h⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective R M
  let r : Retract M (ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R)) :=
    ⟨ModuleCat.ofHom g, ModuleCat.ofHom f, by ext x; exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x⟩
  exact hP.retract (r.map _) (singleFunctor_obj_pi_mem hP hR n)

name: DG.IsPerfect.le_of_isThick
statement: theorem le_of_isThick : IsPerfect R ≤ P
proof:
:= fun _ hX =>
  IsPerfect.induction (motive := fun X _ => P X) (fun _ _ e h => hP.of_iso e.symm h)
    (fun _ hM => singleFunctor_obj_mem hP hR hM) (fun _ n h => hP.shift _ n h)
    (fun T hT _ _ _ h₁ h₃ => hP.ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃) hX

name: DG.IsPerfect.singleFunctor_obj_self
statement:
theorem singleFunctor_obj_self :
    IsPerfect R
      ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of R R))
proof:
:=
  singleFunctor_obj (IsFGProjective.self R) 0

name: DG.IsPerfect.thickClosure_eq
statement:
theorem thickClosure_eq :
    ThickClosure (fun X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) =>
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of R R) = X) =
      IsPerfect R
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (thickClosure_le (isThick R) (by rintro _ rfl; exact singleFunctor_obj_self))
    (le_of_isThick (isThick_thickClosure _) (.of_mem rfl))

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isPerfect_functor_obj_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem isPerfect_functor_obj_of_isCompact {X : DerivedCategory A} (hX : IsCompact.{u} X) :
    IsPerfect S (E.functor.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← thickClosure_self_eq_isCompact] at hX
  refine thickClosure_le ((IsPerfect.isThick S).comap E.functor) ?_ X hX
  rintro _ ⟨-, rfl⟩
  exact (IsPerfect.singleFunctor_obj_self).of_iso e

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isThick_isCompact_inverse_obj
statement:
theorem isThick_isCompact_inverse_obj :
    IsThick fun Y => IsCompact.{u} (E.inverse.obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  let := E.commShiftInverse ℤ
  have := E.commShift_of_functor ℤ
  have : E.inverse.IsTriangulated := E.toAdjunction.isTriangulated_rightAdjoint
  exact (isThick_isCompact _).comap E.inverse

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_of_isPerfect_functor_obj
statement:
theorem isCompact_of_isPerfect_functor_obj {X : DerivedCategory A}
    (hX : IsPerfect S (E.functor.obj X)) : IsCompact.{u} X
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsPerfect.le_of_isThick (isThick_isCompact_inverse_obj E)
    (((isCompact_Q_self (A := A)).of_iso (E.unitIso.app _).symm).of_iso
      (E.inverse.mapIso e.symm)) _ hX
  exact h.of_iso (E.unitIso.app X)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_iff_isPerfect_functor_obj
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff_isPerfect_functor_obj (X : DerivedCategory A) :
    IsCompact.{u} X ↔ IsPerfect S (E.functor.obj X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isPerfect_functor_obj_of_isCompact E e, isCompact_of_isPerfect_functor_obj E e⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_iff_isPerfect
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff_isPerfect (X : DerivedCategory R) :
    IsCompact.{u} X ↔ IsPerfect R ((comparison R).obj X)
proof:
:=
  isCompact_iff_isPerfect_functor_obj (comparisonEquivalence R) (comparisonObjSelfIso R) X

name: DG.DegreeZero.isCompact_iff_isPerfect
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff_isPerfect (X : DerivedCategory S) :
    IsCompact.{u} X ↔ IsPerfect S ((derivedComparison S).obj X)
proof:
:=
  isCompact_iff_isPerfect_functor_obj (derivedComparisonEquivalence S)
    (derivedComparisonObjSelfIso S) X

name: DG.DegreeZero.isCompact_Q_obj_of_isPerfectComplex
statement:
theorem isCompact_Q_obj_of_isPerfectComplex (M : DGModuleCat.{u} S)
    (hM : IsPerfectComplex ((complexFunctor S).obj M)) : IsCompact.{u} (Q.obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let := _root_.HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} S)
  exact (isCompact_iff_isPerfect S _).2
    ((IsPerfect.Q_obj hM).of_iso ((QCompDerivedComparisonIso S).app M))

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_mem
statement: theorem toHom_mem (f : RightDual A M) : toHom f ∈ dualSubgroup A M
proof:
:=
  Subtype.property (p := (· ∈ dualSubgroup A M)) f

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem toHom_mk (g : M →+ A) (hg : g ∈ dualSubgroup A M) : toHom (mk g hg) = g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_injective
statement: theorem toHom_injective : Function.Injective (toHom (A := A) (M := M))
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  Subtype.ext h

name: DG.RightDual.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {f g : RightDual A M} (h : ∀ m, toHom f m = toHom g m) : f = g
proof:
:=
  toHom_injective (AddMonoidHom.ext h)

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_add
statement: @[simp] theorem toHom_add (f g : RightDual A M) : toHom (f + g) = toHom f + toHom g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem toHom_zero : toHom (0 : RightDual A M) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem toHom_neg (f : RightDual A M) : toHom (-f) = -toHom f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem toHom_sub (f g : RightDual A M) : toHom (f - g) = toHom f - toHom g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_zsmul
statement: @[simp] theorem toHom_zsmul (k : ℤ) (f : RightDual A M) : toHom (k • f) = k • toHom f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_sum
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → RightDual A M) :
    toHom (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, toHom (f i)
proof:
:=
  map_sum (toHomAddHom A M) f s

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_units_smul
statement: theorem toHom_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (f : RightDual A M) : toHom (u • f) = u • toHom f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.map_op_smul
statement: theorem map_op_smul (f : RightDual A M) (a : A) (m : M) : toHom f (op a • m) = toHom f m * a
proof:
:= by
  refine AddSubgroup.iSup_induction (dualPiece A M) (C := fun g => g (op a • m) = g m * a)
    (toHom_mem f) (fun k g hg => hg.1 a m) ?_ fun g g' hg hg' => ?_
  · rw [AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, zero_mul]
  · rw [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hg, hg', add_mul]

name: DG.RightDual.mem_grade
statement:
theorem mem_grade {k : ℤ} {f : RightDual A M} :
    f ∈ grade A M k ↔ ∀ (i : ℤ) (m : M), m ∈ grading i → toHom f m ∈ grading (i + k)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_mem_dualPiece
statement:
theorem toHom_mem_dualPiece {k : ℤ} {f : RightDual A M} (hf : f ∈ grade A M k) :
    toHom f ∈ dualPiece A M k
proof:
:=
  ⟨map_op_smul f, hf⟩

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_ofPiece
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_ofPiece {k : ℤ} (g : M →+ A) (hg : g ∈ dualPiece A M k) :
    toHom (ofPiece g hg) = g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.ofPiece_mem_grade
statement:
theorem ofPiece_mem_grade {k : ℤ} (g : M →+ A) (hg : g ∈ dualPiece A M k) :
    ofPiece g hg ∈ grade A M k

name: DG.RightDual.induction_on'
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on' {P : RightDual A M → Prop} (f : RightDual A M) (zero : P 0)
    (homogeneous : ∀ (k : ℤ) (f : RightDual A M), f ∈ grade A M k → P f)
    (add : ∀ f g, P f → P g → P (f + g)) : P f
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (g : M →+ A) (hg : g ∈ dualSubgroup A M), P (mk g hg) := by
    intro g hg
    refine AddSubgroup.iSup_induction' (dualPiece A M)
      (C := fun g hg => P (mk g hg)) (fun k g hg => ?_) zero (fun g g' hg hg' h h' => ?_) hg
    · exact homogeneous k (ofPiece g hg) hg.2
    · exact add _ _ h h'
  exact key (toHom f) (toHom_mem f)

name: DG.RightDual.ext_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem ext_of_homogeneous {f g : RightDual A M}
    (h : ∀ (i : ℤ) (m : M), m ∈ grading i → toHom f m = toHom g m) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine ext fun m => ?_
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | h_homogeneous m => exact h _ _ m.2
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.RightDual.mem_range_coe
statement:
theorem mem_range_coe {k : ℤ} {f : RightDual A M} (hf : f ∈ grade A M k) :
    f ∈ (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (grade A M)).range
proof:
:=
  ⟨DirectSum.of (fun k => grade A M k) k ⟨f, hf⟩, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of _ _ _⟩

name: DG.RightDual.isInternal_grade
statement: theorem isInternal_grade : DirectSum.IsInternal (grade A M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub] at hxy
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    set z := x - y
    ext k : 1
    have hz : ∀ (i : ℤ) (m : M), m ∈ grading i → toHom (z k : RightDual A M) m = 0 := by
      intro i m hm
      have h0 := congrArg (fun g : RightDual A M =>
        (decompose (grading (M := A)) (toHom g m) (i + k) : A)) hxy
      simp only [toHom_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply,
        ZeroMemClass.coe_zero] at h0
      rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_eq_dfinsuppSum, DFinsupp.sum, toHom_sum,
        AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply, decompose_sum, DFinsupp.finsetSum_apply,
        AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum] at h0
      by_cases hk : k ∈ z.support
      · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem _ hk, decompose_of_mem_same _ ((z k).2 i m hm)] at h0
        · exact h0
        · intro q _ hq
          exact decompose_of_mem_ne _ ((z q).2 i m hm) (by omega)
      · rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hk]
        rfl
    have : (z k : RightDual A M) = 0 := ext_of_homogeneous fun i m hm => by
      rw [hz i m hm]; rfl
    exact Subtype.ext this
  · intro f
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.mem_range]
    induction f using induction_on' with
    | zero => exact zero_mem _
    | homogeneous k f hf => exact mem_range_coe hf
    | add f g hf hg => exact add_mem hf hg

name: DG.dualD_apply
statement:
theorem dualD_apply (g : M →+ A) (m : M) :
    dualD A M g m = d (g m) - Shift.twist A 1 (g (gradeSign M 1 (d m)))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.dualD_apply_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [dualD_apply]
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rename_i i
    rw [dualD_apply, gradeSign_of_mem 1 (d_mem m.2), Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, map_zsmul,
      ← Units.smul_def, Shift.twist_of_mem (hg _ _ (d_mem m.2)), smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 2
    exact (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨i + 1, by ring⟩
  | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
    simp only [map_add, smul_add, hm, hm']
    abel

name: DG.dualD_mem_dualPiece
statement:
theorem dualD_mem_dualPiece {k : ℤ} {g : M →+ A} (hg : g ∈ dualPiece A M k) :
    dualD A M g ∈ dualPiece A M (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a m => ?_, fun i m hm => ?_⟩
  · induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous m =>
      rename_i i
      rw [dualD_apply_of_mem hg.2, dualD_apply_of_mem hg.2, hg.1, d_mul (hg.2 _ _ m.2),
        d_op_smul m.2, map_add, hg.1, Units.smul_def (koszulSign i), map_zsmul,
        ← Units.smul_def, hg.1, smul_add, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc,
        add_comm k i]
      abel
    | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, hm, hm', add_mul]
  · rw [dualD_apply_of_mem hg.2, ← add_assoc]
    refine sub_mem (d_mem (hg.2 i m hm)) ?_
    rw [Units.smul_def]
    refine zsmul_mem ?_ _
    rw [add_right_comm]
    exact hg.2 _ _ (d_mem hm)

name: DG.dualD_mem
statement: theorem dualD_mem {g : M →+ A} (hg : g ∈ dualSubgroup A M) : dualD A M g ∈ dualSubgroup A M
proof:
:= by
  refine AddSubgroup.iSup_induction (dualPiece A M) (C := fun g => dualD A M g ∈ dualSubgroup A M)
    hg (fun k g hg => AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (k + 1) (dualD_mem_dualPiece hg)) ?_
    fun g g' h h' => ?_
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_dHom
statement: theorem toHom_dHom (f : RightDual A M) : toHom (dHom A M f) = dualD A M (toHom f)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.dHom_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem dHom_apply_of_mem {k : ℤ} {f : RightDual A M} (hf : f ∈ grade A M k) (m : M) :
    toHom (dHom A M f) m = d (toHom f m) - koszulSign k • toHom f (d m)
proof:
:=
  dualD_apply_of_mem hf m

name: DG.RightDual.dHom_mem
statement:
theorem dHom_mem {k : ℤ} {f : RightDual A M} (hf : f ∈ grade A M k) :
    dHom A M f ∈ grade A M (k + 1)
proof:
:=
  (dualD_mem_dualPiece (toHom_mem_dualPiece hf)).2

name: DG.RightDual.dHom_dHom
statement: theorem dHom_dHom (f : RightDual A M) : dHom A M (dHom A M f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on' with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | homogeneous k f hf =>
    refine ext fun m => ?_
    rw [dHom_apply_of_mem (dHom_mem hf), dHom_apply_of_mem hf, dHom_apply_of_mem hf, d_sub, d_d,
      d_d, map_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub, d_units_smul, koszulSign_add, mul_smul,
      toHom_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
    simp
  | add f g hf hg => rw [map_add, map_add, hf, hg, add_zero]

name: DG.RightDual.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {k : ℤ} {f : RightDual A M} :
    f ∈ grading k ↔ ∀ (i : ℤ) (m : M), m ∈ grading i → toHom f m ∈ grading (i + k)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.RightDual.apply_mem_grading
statement:
theorem apply_mem_grading {k i : ℤ} {f : RightDual A M} (hf : f ∈ grading k) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading i) : toHom f m ∈ grading (i + k)
proof: := hf i m hm

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_d
statement: theorem toHom_d (f : RightDual A M) : toHom (d f) = dualD A M (toHom f)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightDual.d_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem d_apply_of_mem {k : ℤ} {f : RightDual A M} (hf : f ∈ grading k) (m : M) :
    toHom (d f) m = d (toHom f m) - koszulSign k • toHom f (d m)
proof:
:=
  dHom_apply_of_mem hf m

name: DG.dualLmul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem dualLmul_apply (a : A) (g : M →+ A) (m : M) : dualLmul A M a g m = a * g m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.dualLmul_mem_dualPiece
statement:
theorem dualLmul_mem_dualPiece {i k : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {g : M →+ A}
    (hg : g ∈ dualPiece A M k) : dualLmul A M a g ∈ dualPiece A M (i + k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c m => by rw [dualLmul_apply, dualLmul_apply, hg.1, mul_assoc], fun j m hm => by
    rw [dualLmul_apply, show j + (i + k) = i + (j + k) by ring]
    exact mul_mem_grading ha (hg.2 j m hm)⟩

name: DG.dualLmul_mem
statement:
theorem dualLmul_mem (a : A) {g : M →+ A} (hg : g ∈ dualSubgroup A M) :
    dualLmul A M a g ∈ dualSubgroup A M
proof:
:= by
  refine AddSubgroup.iSup_induction (dualPiece A M)
    (C := fun g => dualLmul A M a g ∈ dualSubgroup A M) hg (fun k g hg => ?_) ?_
    fun g g' h h' => ?_
  · induction a using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero =>
      have : dualLmul A M 0 g = 0 := by ext m; simp
      rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
    | h_homogeneous a => exact AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (dualLmul_mem_dualPiece a.2 hg)
    | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
      have : dualLmul A M (a + a') g = dualLmul A M a g + dualLmul A M a' g := by
        ext m; simp [add_mul]
      rw [this]; exact add_mem ha ha'
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_smul (a : A) (f : RightDual A M) (m : M) :
    toHom (a • f) m = a * toHom f m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.dualRmul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem dualRmul_apply (b : B) (g : M →+ A) (m : M) : dualRmul A B M b g m = g (b • m)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.dualRmul_mem_dualPiece
statement:
theorem dualRmul_mem_dualPiece {p k : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading p) {g : M →+ A}
    (hg : g ∈ dualPiece A M k) : dualRmul A B M b g ∈ dualPiece A M (k + p)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c m => by rw [dualRmul_apply, dualRmul_apply, smul_comm, hg.1], fun j m hm => by
    rw [dualRmul_apply, show j + (k + p) = p + j + k by ring]
    exact hg.2 _ _ (smul_mem_grading hb hm)⟩

name: DG.dualRmul_mem
statement:
theorem dualRmul_mem (b : B) {g : M →+ A} (hg : g ∈ dualSubgroup A M) :
    dualRmul A B M b g ∈ dualSubgroup A M
proof:
:= by
  refine AddSubgroup.iSup_induction (dualPiece A M)
    (C := fun g => dualRmul A B M b g ∈ dualSubgroup A M) hg (fun k g hg => ?_) ?_
    fun g g' h h' => ?_
  · induction b using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero =>
      have : dualRmul A B M 0 g = 0 := by
        ext m; simp only [dualRmul_apply, zero_smul, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
      rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
    | h_homogeneous b => exact AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (dualRmul_mem_dualPiece b.2 hg)
    | h_add b b' hb hb' =>
      have : dualRmul A B M (b + b') g = dualRmul A B M b g + dualRmul A B M b' g := by
        ext m; simp only [dualRmul_apply, add_smul, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
      rw [this]; exact add_mem hb hb'
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h'

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_op_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_op_smul (b : B) (f : RightDual A M) (m : M) :
    toHom (op b • f) m = toHom f (b • m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.coeff_add
statement: theorem coeff_add (x y : M) : R.coeff (x + y) = R.coeff x + R.coeff y
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← R.sum_coeff x, ← R.sum_coeff y, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [← add_smul, ← op_add]
  exact R.coeff_sum (R.coeff x + R.coeff y)

name: DG.RightBasis.coeff_zero
statement: theorem coeff_zero : R.coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := R.coeff_sum 0
  simpa using h

name: DG.RightBasis.coeffHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem coeffHom_apply (i : ι) (x : M) : R.coeffHom i x = R.coeff x i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.coeff_op_smul
statement: theorem coeff_op_smul (a : A) (x : M) (i : ι) : R.coeff (op a • x) i = R.coeff x i * a
proof:
:= by
  have h : op a • x = ∑ i, op (R.coeff x i * a) • R.b i := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← R.sum_coeff x, Finset.smul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [smul_smul, ← op_mul]
  rw [h, R.coeff_sum]

name: DG.RightBasis.coeff_basis
statement: theorem coeff_basis [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) : R.coeff (R.b i) = Pi.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := R.coeff_sum (Pi.single i 1)
  rwa [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun l _ hl => by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hl, op_zero, zero_smul])
    (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same, op_one, one_smul] at h

name: DG.RightBasis.decompose_op_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem decompose_op_smul_of_mem {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) (a : A) (p : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := M)) (op a • m) p : M) =
      op (decompose (grading (M := A)) a (p - k) : A) • m
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rename_i i
    have ham := op_smul_mem_grading a.2 hm
    by_cases hi : k + i = p
    · subst hi
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ ham, add_sub_cancel_left, decompose_of_mem_same _ a.2]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ ham hi, decompose_of_mem_ne _ a.2 (by omega), op_zero, zero_smul]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
    rw [op_add, add_smul, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, ha, ha',
      decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, op_add, add_smul]

name: DG.RightBasis.coeff_decompose
statement:
theorem coeff_decompose (x : M) (p : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    R.coeff (decompose (grading (M := M)) x p) i =
      decompose (grading (M := A)) (R.coeff x i) (p - R.deg i)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (decompose (grading (M := M)) x p : M) =
      ∑ l, op (decompose (grading (M := A)) (R.coeff x l) (p - R.deg l) : A) • R.b l := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← R.sum_coeff x]
    rw [decompose_sum, DFinsupp.finsetSum_apply, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => decompose_op_smul_of_mem (R.b_mem l) _ p
  rw [hx, R.coeff_sum]

name: DG.RightBasis.coeff_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_mem {x : M} {p : ℤ} (hx : x ∈ grading p) (i : ι) :
    R.coeff x i ∈ grading (p - R.deg i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := R.coeff_decompose x p i
  rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hx] at h
  rw [h]
  exact (decompose (grading (M := A)) (R.coeff x i) (p - R.deg i)).2

name: DG.RightBasis.coeffHom_mem_dualPiece'
statement:
theorem coeffHom_mem_dualPiece' (h : ∀ {x : M} {p : ℤ}, x ∈ grading p → ∀ i,
    R.coeff x i ∈ grading (p - R.deg i)) (i : ι) : R.coeffHom i ∈ dualPiece A M (-R.deg i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a m => R.coeff_op_smul a m i, fun p m hm => by
    rw [← sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h hm i⟩

name: DG.RightBasis.coeffHom_mem_dualPiece
statement: theorem coeffHom_mem_dualPiece (i : ι) : R.coeffHom i ∈ dualPiece A M (-R.deg i)
proof:
:=
  R.coeffHom_mem_dualPiece' (fun hx i => R.coeff_mem hx i) i

name: DG.RightBasis.toHom_δ
statement: @[simp] theorem toHom_δ (i : ι) (x : M) : RightDual.toHom (R.δ i) x = R.coeff x i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.δ_mem
statement: theorem δ_mem (i : ι) : R.δ i ∈ grading (-R.deg i)
proof:
:=
  RightDual.ofPiece_mem_grade _ (R.coeffHom_mem_dualPiece i)

name: DG.RightBasis.apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem apply_eq_sum (g : M →+ A) (hg : ∀ (a : A) (m : M), g (op a • m) = g m * a) (x : M) :
    g x = ∑ i, g (R.b i) * R.coeff x i
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← R.sum_coeff x, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hg _ _

name: DG.RightBasis.mem_dualSubgroup
statement:
theorem mem_dualSubgroup (g : M →+ A) (hg : ∀ (a : A) (m : M), g (op a • m) = g m * a) :
    g ∈ dualSubgroup A M
proof:
:= by
  have h : g = ∑ i, dualLmul A M (g (R.b i)) (R.coeffHom i) := by
    ext x
    rw [R.apply_eq_sum g hg x, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact sum_mem fun i _ => dualLmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (R.coeffHom_mem_dualPiece i))

name: DG.RightBasis.toHom_ofRightLinear
statement:
@[simp] theorem toHom_ofRightLinear (g : M →+ A)
    (hg : ∀ (a : A) (m : M), g (op a • m) = g m * a) :
    RightDual.toHom (R.ofRightLinear g hg) = g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.dualBasis_b
statement: @[simp] theorem dualBasis_b (i : ι) : R.dualBasis.b i = R.δ i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.dualBasis_deg
statement: @[simp] theorem dualBasis_deg (i : ι) : R.dualBasis.deg i = -R.deg i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.dualBasis_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualBasis_coeff (f : RightDual A M) (i : ι) :
    R.dualBasis.coeff f i = RightDual.toHom f (R.b i)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.dualBasis_coeff_d
statement:
theorem dualBasis_coeff_d (i l : ι) :
    R.dualBasis.coeff (d (R.δ i)) l = -(koszulSign (R.deg i) • R.coeff (d (R.b l)) i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [dualBasis_coeff, RightDual.d_apply_of_mem (R.δ_mem i), toHom_δ, toHom_δ, R.coeff_basis]
  have h0 : d (Pi.single (M := fun _ : ι => A) l (1 : A) i) = 0 := by
    by_cases h : i = l
    · subst h; rw [Pi.single_eq_same, d_one]
    · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne h, d_zero]
  rw [h0, zero_sub]
  congr 2
  exact (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨-R.deg i, by ring⟩

name: DG.RightBasis.dualTriangular_length
statement:
theorem dualTriangular_length (key : ι → ℤ)
    (hkey : ∀ l i, R.coeff (d (R.b l)) i ≠ 0 → key i < key l) :
    (R.dualTriangular key hkey).length = Fintype.card ι
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.dual_isKProjective
statement:
theorem dual_isKProjective (key : ι → ℤ)
    (hkey : ∀ l i, R.coeff (d (R.b l)) i ≠ 0 → key i < key l) :
    IsKProjective.{w} A (RightDual A M)
proof:
:=
  (R.dualTriangular key hkey).isKProjective

name: DG.RightBasis.dual_hasLiftingProperty
statement:
theorem dual_hasLiftingProperty (key : ι → ℤ)
    (hkey : ∀ l i, R.coeff (d (R.b l)) i ≠ 0 → key i < key l) :
    HasLiftingProperty.{w} A (RightDual A M)
proof:
:=
  (R.dualTriangular key hkey).hasLiftingProperty

name: DG.rankOne_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem rankOne_apply (m : M) (φ : M →+ A) (x : M) : rankOne m φ x = op (φ x) • m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.eq_sum_rankOne
statement:
theorem RightBasis.eq_sum_rankOne (f : M →+ M) (hf : ∀ (a : A) (x : M), f (op a • x) = op a • f x) :
    f = ∑ i, rankOne (f (R.b i)) (R.coeffHom i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  conv_lhs => rw [← R.sum_coeff x]
  rw [map_sum, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hf]; rfl

name: DG.RightBasis.rankOne_injective
statement:
theorem RightBasis.rankOne_injective [DecidableEq ι] (m m' : ι → M)
    (h : ∑ i, rankOne (m i) (R.coeffHom i) = ∑ i, rankOne (m' i) (R.coeffHom i)) : m = m'
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  have key : ∀ m : ι → M, (∑ i, rankOne (m i) (R.coeffHom i)) (R.b j) = m j := by
    intro m
    rw [AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · rw [rankOne_apply, RightBasis.coeffHom_apply, R.coeff_basis, Pi.single_eq_same, op_one,
        one_smul]
    · intro i _ hij
      rw [rankOne_apply, RightBasis.coeffHom_apply, R.coeff_basis, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hij,
        op_zero, zero_smul]
    · intro hj; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj
  rw [← key m, h, key m']

name: DG.gradeSign_dgAddEquiv
statement: theorem gradeSign_dgAddEquiv (j : ℤ) (m : M) : e (gradeSign M j m) = gradeSign M' j (e m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | @h_homogeneous i m =>
    rw [gradeSign_of_mem j m.2, gradeSign_of_mem j (e.map_mem m.2), Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.RightDual.precomp_mem_dualPiece
statement:
theorem precomp_mem_dualPiece {k : ℤ} {g : M' →+ A} (hg : g ∈ dualPiece A M' k) :
    g.comp e.toAddMonoidHom ∈ dualPiece A M k
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a m => by
    change g (e (op a • m)) = g (e m) * a
    rw [he, hg.1], fun i m hm => hg.2 i (e m) (e.map_mem hm)⟩

name: DG.RightDual.precomp_mem_dualSubgroup
statement:
theorem precomp_mem_dualSubgroup {g : M' →+ A} (hg : g ∈ dualSubgroup A M') :
    g.comp e.toAddMonoidHom ∈ dualSubgroup A M
proof:
:= by
  induction hg using AddSubgroup.iSup_induction' with
  | hp k g hg => exact AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem k (precomp_mem_dualPiece e he hg)
  | h1 => exact zero_mem _
  | hadd g g' _ _ hg hg' => rw [AddMonoidHom.add_comp]; exact add_mem hg hg'

name: DG.RightDual.toHom_precompHom
statement:
theorem toHom_precompHom (f : RightDual A M') (m : M) :
    RightDual.toHom (precompHom e he f) m = RightDual.toHom f (e m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.directSum
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.directSum (f : ∀ i, M i →ᵈᵍ[A] N i)
    (hf : ∀ i, (f i).IsQuasiIso) :
    (DGModuleHom.toModule fun i => (DGModuleHom.lof A N i).comp (f i)).IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  set F := DGModuleHom.toModule fun i => (DGModuleHom.lof A N i).comp (f i)
  let e : ∀ i, cohomology (M i) n ≃+ cohomology (N i) n := fun i =>
    AddEquiv.ofBijective (cohomology.map (f i) n) (hf i n)
  let E : (⨁ i, cohomology (M i) n) ≃+ ⨁ i, cohomology (N i) n := DFinsupp.mapRange.addEquiv e
  have key : ∀ x, cohomology.map F n ((cohomology.directSumAddEquiv M n).symm x) =
      (cohomology.directSumAddEquiv N n).symm (E x) := by
    intro x
    induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of i y =>
      rw [cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_symm_of, ← cohomology.map_lof (A := A),
        ← cohomology.map_comp_apply, DGModuleHom.toModule_comp_lof, cohomology.map_comp_apply]
      have : E (DirectSum.of _ i y) = DirectSum.of _ i (e i y) :=
        DFinsupp.mapRange_single (hf := fun i => (e i).map_zero)
      rw [this, cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_symm_of, ← cohomology.map_lof (A := A)]
      rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  have h : ⇑(cohomology.map F n) = ⇑(((cohomology.directSumAddEquiv M n).trans E).trans
      (cohomology.directSumAddEquiv N n).symm) :=
    funext fun z => by simpa using key (cohomology.directSumAddEquiv M n z)
  rw [h]
  exact AddEquiv.bijective _

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_isStableUnderCoproductsOfShape
statement:
theorem quasiIso_isStableUnderCoproductsOfShape (J : Type w) :
    (quasiIso.{max v w} A).IsStableUnderCoproductsOfShape J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderCoproductsOfShape.mk _ _ fun X₁ X₂ _ _ f hf => ?_
  let F := DGModuleHom.toModule fun j =>
    (DGModuleHom.lof A (fun j => ((X₂ j).as : Type (max v w))) j).comp (Quot.out (f j)).hom
  have hF : quasiIso A ((quotient A).map (DGModuleCat.ofHom F)) := by
    rw [quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff]
    refine DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.directSum _ fun j => ?_
    rw [← quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff, quotient_map_out]
    exact hf j
  let e₁ := (colimit.isColimit _).coconePointUniqueUpToIso (isColimitCoproductCofan X₁)
  let e₂ := (colimit.isColimit _).coconePointUniqueUpToIso (isColimitCoproductCofan X₂)
  refine ((quasiIso A).arrow_mk_iso_iff (Arrow.isoMk (f := Arrow.mk (Limits.Sigma.map f))
    (g := Arrow.mk ((quotient A).map (DGModuleCat.ofHom F))) e₁ e₂ ?_)).2 hF
  refine Sigma.hom_ext _ _ fun j => ?_
  have h₁ : Sigma.ι X₁ j ≫ e₁.hom = (coproductCofan X₁).inj j :=
    IsColimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom _ _ (⟨j⟩ : Discrete J)
  have h₂ : Sigma.ι X₂ j ≫ e₂.hom = (coproductCofan X₂).inj j :=
    IsColimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom _ _ (⟨j⟩ : Discrete J)
  dsimp
  rw [reassoc_of% h₁, Sigma.ι_map_assoc, h₂, coproductCofan_inj,
    coproductCofan_inj, ← Functor.map_comp, ← DGModuleCat.ofHom_comp,
    DGModuleHom.toModule_comp_lof, DGModuleCat.ofHom_comp, DGModuleCat.ofHom_hom,
    Functor.map_comp, quotient_map_out]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.Qh_preservesColimitsOfShape
statement:
theorem Qh_preservesColimitsOfShape :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) (Qh : HomotopyCategory.{max v w} A ⥤ _)
proof:
:=
  LocalizationCoproducts.preservesColimitsOfShape (J := J) Qh (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A)
    (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_isStableUnderCoproductsOfShape A J)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasColimitsOfShape_discrete
statement: theorem hasColimitsOfShape_discrete : HasColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) (DerivedCategory A)
proof:
:=
  LocalizationCoproducts.hasColimitsOfShape (J := J) Qh (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A)
    (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_isStableUnderCoproductsOfShape A J)

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isFullH0_family
statement: theorem isFullH0_family (he : e.IsFullH0) : e.family.IsFullH0
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, ha, hb, h⟩ := he
  refine ⟨n, fun _ => (), fun k => (b k : A), fun k => (a k : A), hb, ha, ?_⟩
  exact h

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isFullH0_of_one_mem_span
statement:
theorem isFullH0_of_one_mem_span (hneg : ∀ n < 0, grading (M := A) n = ⊥)
    (hd : ∀ a ∈ grading (M := A) 0, d a = 0) (h : (1 : A) ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span {e.val}) :
    e.IsFullH0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let π : A → A := fun a => DirectSum.decompose (grading (M := A)) a 0
  have hπ0 (a : A) : π a ∈ grading (M := A) 0 := (DirectSum.decompose (grading (M := A)) a 0).2
  
  have key : ∀ z ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span ({e.val} : Set A),
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (a b : Fin n → A), z = ∑ k, a k * e.val * b k := by
    intro z hz
    rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_span_iff_mem_addSubgroup_closure] at hz
    induction hz using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨y, ⟨a, -, e', he', rfl⟩, b, -, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at he'
      exact ⟨1, fun _ => a, fun _ => b, by simp [he']⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨0, Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0, by simp⟩
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨n, a, b, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨m, a', b', rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨n + m, Fin.append a a', Fin.append b b', by simp [Fin.sum_univ_add]⟩
    | neg x _ hx =>
      obtain ⟨n, a, b, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨n, fun k => -a k, b, by simp [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]⟩
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hab⟩ := key 1 h
  refine ⟨n, fun k => π (a k), fun k => π (b k), fun k => ⟨hπ0 _, hd _ (hπ0 _)⟩,
    fun k => ⟨hπ0 _, hd _ (hπ0 _)⟩, ?_⟩
  have hπmul (x y : A) : π (x * y) = π x * π y := coe_decompose_mul_zero hneg x y
  have hπe : π e.val = e.val := DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ e.mem_zero
  have hπsum : π (∑ k, a k * e.val * b k) = ∑ k, π (a k) * e.val * π (b k) := by
    simp only [π, DirectSum.decompose_sum, DirectSum.sum_apply, AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    change π (a k * e.val * b k) = _
    rw [hπmul, hπmul, hπe]
  have hπ1 : π 1 = 1 := DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ one_mem_grading
  rw [← hπsum, ← hab, hπ1, sub_self]
  exact zero_mem _

name: DG.DGIdempotent.cornerFunctor_map_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cornerFunctor_map_val {X Y : SingleObj e.Corner} (x : X ⟶ Y) :
    (e.cornerFunctor.map x).1 = ((show e.Corner from x) : A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.cornerFunctor_map_bijective
statement:
theorem cornerFunctor_map_bijective (X Y : SingleObj e.Corner) :
    Function.Bijective (e.cornerFunctor.map : (X ⟶ Y) → _)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y h => ?_, fun f => ?_⟩
  · have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
    exact Corner.coe_injective e h'
  refine ⟨show e.Corner from ⟨f.1, (Corner.mem_iff e).mpr ⟨f.2.2, f.2.1⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  exact IdempotentFamily.hom_ext rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isQuasiEquivalence_cornerFunctor
statement:
theorem isQuasiEquivalence_cornerFunctor : IsQuasiEquivalence e.cornerFunctor where
  toIsQuasiFullyFaithful
proof:
:= IsQuasiFullyFaithful.of_bijective _ e.cornerFunctor_map_bijective
    fun hf => (Corner.mem_grading_iff e).mpr (IdempotentFamily.mem_grading_iff.mp hf)
  exists_iso := by
    rintro ⟨⟨⟩⟩
    refine ⟨SingleObj.star _, 𝟙 _, 𝟙 _, id_mem_cocycles _, id_mem_cocycles _, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    · rw [Category.id_comp, sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isAcyclic_of_isAcyclic_precomp_inr_of_reflectsAcyclic
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_of_isAcyclic_precomp_inr_of_reflectsAcyclic (h : e.ReflectsAcyclic.{w})
    {N : CatModule.{w} e.family.augment.Corner}
    (hN : CatModule.IsAcyclic ((CatModule.precomp e.family.inr).obj N)) :
    CatModule.IsAcyclic N
proof:
:= by
  unfold ReflectsAcyclic at h
  rintro ⟨X | i⟩
  · 
    let S : e.family.augment.Corner := ⟨.inl (SingleObj.star A)⟩
    let a : S ⟶ ⟨.inr ()⟩ := ⟨(e.val : A), Category.id_comp _, e.mul_self⟩
    let b : (⟨.inr ()⟩ : e.family.augment.Corner) ⟶ S :=
      ⟨(e.val : A), e.mul_self, Category.comp_id _⟩
    let ee : S ⟶ S := e.family.inl.map (show SingleObj.star A ⟶ SingleObj.star A from e.val)
    have hab : a ≫ b = ee := IdempotentFamily.hom_ext e.mul_self
    have hbe : b ≫ ee = b := IdempotentFamily.hom_ext e.mul_self
    have ha0 : a ∈ grading 0 := e.mem_zero
    have hb0 : b ∈ grading 0 := e.mem_zero
    have hda : d a = 0 := IdempotentFamily.hom_ext e.d_eq_zero
    have hdb : d b = 0 := IdempotentFamily.hom_ext e.d_eq_zero
    refine h ((CatModule.precomp e.family.inl).obj N) (fun n m hm hdm hem => ?_) X
    let m₀ : N.obj S := m
    have hm₀ : m₀ ∈ grading n := hm
    have hdm₀ : d m₀ = 0 := hdm
    have hdam : d (a • m₀) = 0 := by
      rw [CatModule.d_smul ha0, hda, hdm₀]
      simp
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ : ∃ z : N.obj ⟨.inr ()⟩, z ∈ grading (n - 1) ∧ d z = a • m₀ :=
      DG.isAcyclic_iff.mp (hN ⟨()⟩) n (a • m₀)
        (by simpa using CatModule.smul_mem_grading ha0 hm₀) hdam
    refine ⟨b • z, by simpa using CatModule.smul_mem_grading hb0 hz, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change ee • (b • z) = b • z
      rw [← CatModule.comp_smul, hbe]
    · change d (b • z) = m₀
      rw [CatModule.d_smul hb0, hdb, CatModule.zero_smul, zero_add, koszulSign_zero, one_smul,
        hdz, ← CatModule.comp_smul, hab]
      exact hem
  · exact hN ⟨i⟩

name: DG.isTriangulated_trans_functor
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.isTriangulated_trans_functor {C : Type*} {D : Type*} {E : Type*}
    [Category C] [Category D] [Category E] [HasZeroObject C] [HasZeroObject D] [HasZeroObject E]
    [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D] [Preadditive E] [HasShift C ℤ] [HasShift D ℤ] [HasShift E ℤ]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive]

    [Pretriangulated E] (F : C ≌ D) (G : D ≌ E) [F.functor.CommShift ℤ] [G.functor.CommShift ℤ]
    (hF : F.functor.IsTriangulated) (hG : G.functor.IsTriangulated) :
    (F.trans G).functor.IsTriangulated
proof:
:=
  inferInstanceAs (F.functor ⋙ G.functor).IsTriangulated

name: DG.bijective_zsmul_one_of_addEquiv
statement:
theorem bijective_zsmul_one_of_addEquiv {R : Type*} [Ring R] (e : R ≃+ ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective fun n : ℤ => n • (1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  set g : R := e.symm 1 with hg
  have hrep : ∀ r : R, r = (e r) • g := fun r =>
    e.injective (by rw [map_zsmul, hg, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one])
  have h1 := hrep 1
  have hgg := hrep (g * g)
  set u := e 1
  set v := e (g * g)
  have huv : u * v = 1 := by
    have : g = (u * v) • g := by
      calc g = 1 * g := (one_mul g).symm
        _ = (u • g) * g := by rw [← h1]
        _ = u • (g * g) := by rw [smul_mul_assoc]
        _ = u • v • g := by rw [← hgg]
        _ = (u * v) • g := by rw [smul_smul]
    have h := congrArg e this
    rw [map_zsmul, hg, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hu : u = 1 ∨ u = -1 := Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one huv
  have huu : u * u = 1 := by rcases hu with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := fun h => by
    rw [h, zero_mul] at huv
    exact zero_ne_one huv
  refine ⟨fun n n' h => ?_, fun r => ⟨e r * u, ?_⟩⟩
  · have h' := congrArg e h
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul] at h'
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hu0 h'
  · change (e r * u) • (1 : R) = r
    rw [h1, smul_smul, mul_assoc, huu, mul_one, ← hrep r]

name: DG.DGRing.K0.exists_eq_zsmul_self
statement:
theorem exists_eq_zsmul_self (hA : IntegralLowDegree A) (x : DGRing.K0 A) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, x = n • self A
proof:
:= by
  let : _root_.HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) := _root_.HasDerivedCategory.standard _
  let : DG.HasDerivedCategory.{0, 0} ℤ := DG.HasDerivedCategory.small ℤ
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{0} (SingleObj ℤ)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{0} (SingleObj A)
  let E := derivedComparisonEquivalence ℤ
  let : E.inverse.CommShift ℤ := E.commShiftInverse ℤ
  let : E.CommShift ℤ := E.commShift_of_functor ℤ
  have : E.IsTriangulated := Equivalence.IsTriangulated.mk' _ inferInstance
  let F : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) ⥤ DerivedCategory A :=
    E.inverse ⋙ (intHom A).derivedInduction.{0, 0, 0, 0}
  
  let eP : IntegralHeart.P F ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A A) :=
    (intHom A).derivedInduction.mapIso (E.inverse.mapIso (derivedComparisonObjSelfIso ℤ).symm ≪≫
      (E.unitIso.app _).symm) ≪≫ (intHom A).derivedInductionSelfIso
  let conj : ∀ k : ℤ, (IntegralHeart.P F ⟶ (IntegralHeart.P F)⟦k⟧) ≃+ cohomology A k :=
    fun k => (conjShiftAddEquiv eP k).trans (DerivedCategory.homSelfShiftAddEquiv k)
  have hyp : IntegralHeart.Hyp F := by
    refine ⟨fun k hk g => (conj k).injective ?_, fun g => (conj 1).injective ?_, ?_,
      fun m hm g hg => (conj 2).injective ?_⟩
    · rw [map_zero]
      exact hA.neg k hk _
    · rw [map_zero]
      exact hA.one _
    · let e₀ := endShiftZeroAddEquiv (IntegralHeart.P F)
      exact bijective_zsmul_one_of_addEquiv
        (R := End (IntegralHeart.P F)) ((e₀.trans (conj 0)).trans hA.zero.some)
    · rw [map_zero]
      exact hA.two m hm _ (by rw [← map_zsmul, hg, map_zero])
  have hP : IsCompact.{0} (IntegralHeart.P F) :=
    DerivedCategory.isCompact_Q_self.of_iso eP
  have h𝒦 : ∀ X : DerivedCategory A, compactSubcategory.{0} (DerivedCategory A) X →
      IsHeartFamily.HasHeartTower (mapHeart F (fgSingle ℤ)) X := by
    intro X hX
    have hX' : ThickClosure (fun Y : DerivedCategory A =>
        ∃ _ : Unit, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A A) = Y) X := by
      rw [DerivedCategory.thickClosure_self_eq_isCompact]
      exact hX
    exact IntegralHeart.thickClosure_le hyp (fun Y ⟨_, hY⟩ => ⟨eqToIso hY.symm ≪≫ eP.symm⟩) X hX'
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IntegralHeart.exists_eq_zsmul (𝒦 := compactSubcategory.{0} (DerivedCategory A))
    hP h𝒦 x
  refine ⟨n, hn.trans ?_⟩
  congr 1
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj eP

name: DG.DGRing.K0.IntegralLowDegree.of_isConnectedInt
statement:
theorem IntegralLowDegree.of_isConnectedInt (hA : IsConnectedInt A)

    (h₂ : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ 0 → ∀ x : cohomology A 2, m • x = 0 → x = 0) : IntegralLowDegree A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ hn => hA.cohomology_neg hn, ⟨hA.cohomologyZeroEquiv⟩, h₁, h₂⟩

name: DG.DGRing.K0.equivIntOfIsConnectedInt_self
statement:
theorem equivIntOfIsConnectedInt_self (hA : IsConnectedInt A)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.regularTensorHom_bijective
statement:
theorem regularTensorHom_bijective :
