name: DG.exists_mem_grading_d_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_mem_grading_d_eq_one {x : A} (hx : d x = 1) :
    ∃ y ∈ grading (M := A) (-1), d y = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨decompose (grading (M := A)) x (-1), SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
  have h := decompose_d x (-1)
  rw [show (-1 : ℤ) + 1 = 0 by norm_num, hx,
    decompose_of_mem_same _ (one_mem_grading (A := A))] at h
  exact h.symm

name: DG.IsAcyclic.of_exists_d_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsAcyclic.of_exists_d_eq_one {x : A} (hx : d x = 1) (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M]
    [DGAddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [DGModule A M] : IsAcyclic M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy⟩ := exists_mem_grading_d_eq_one hx
  refine isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun n m hm hdm => ⟨y • m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := smul_mem_grading hy hm
    rwa [neg_add_eq_sub] at this
  · rw [d_smul_of_d_eq_zero_right hdm, hdy, one_smul]

name: DG.isAcyclic_iff_exists_d_eq_one
statement: theorem isAcyclic_iff_exists_d_eq_one : IsAcyclic A ↔ ∃ x : A, d x = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := isAcyclic_iff.mp h 0 1 one_mem_grading d_one
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact IsAcyclic.of_exists_d_eq_one hx A

name: DG.DerivedCategory.tfae_isZero
statement:
theorem tfae_isZero [HasDerivedCategory.{w, u} A] :
    List.TFAE [∀ X : DerivedCategory A, IsZero X, IsAcyclic A, ∃ x : A, d x = 1]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := fun h =>
    (isZero_Q_obj_iff (DGModuleCat.of A A)).mp (h _)
  tfae_have 2 ↔ 3 := isAcyclic_iff_exists_d_eq_one
  tfae_have 3 → 1 := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ X
    obtain ⟨Z, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
      (Localization.essSurj (Qh (A := A)) (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A)).mem_essImage X
    obtain ⟨M, rfl⟩ := HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective Z
    exact IsZero.of_iso ((isZero_Q_obj_iff M).mpr (IsAcyclic.of_exists_d_eq_one hx M)) e.symm
  tfae_finish

name: DG.LocalizationCoproducts.sigmaMap_mem
proof:
:=
  have := hW
  W.colimMap _ fun j => hs j.as

name: DG.LocalizationCoproducts.eq_zero_of_comp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_comp_eq_zero (X : J → C) {Y : D} (g : L.obj (∐ X) ⟶ Y)
    (hg : ∀ j, L.map (Sigma.ι X j) ≫ g = 0) : g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Localization.essSurj L W
  let e := L.objObjPreimageIso Y
  rw [← cancel_mono e.inv, zero_comp]
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := Localization.exists_rightFraction L W (g ≫ e.inv)
  have := Localization.inverts L W _ ψ.hs
  choose ρ hρ using fun j =>
    (MorphismProperty.LeftFraction.mk (Sigma.ι X j) ψ.s ψ.hs).exists_rightFraction
  have h₀ : ∀ j, L.map ((ρ j).f ≫ ψ.f) = L.map 0 := fun j => by
    have hρ' : (ρ j).s ≫ Sigma.ι X j = (ρ j).f ≫ ψ.s := hρ j
    rw [L.map_comp, ← ψ.map_s_comp_map L (Localization.inverts L W), ← hψ,
      ← L.map_comp_assoc, ← hρ', L.map_comp, assoc, reassoc_of% (hg j)]
    simp
  choose Z u hu hu' using fun j => (MorphismProperty.map_eq_iff_precomp L W _ _).mp (h₀ j)
  let U : ∐ Z ⟶ ∐ fun j => (ρ j).X' := Limits.Sigma.map u
  let T : (∐ fun j => (ρ j).X') ⟶ ∐ X := Limits.Sigma.map fun j => (ρ j).s
  let B : ∐ Z ⟶ ψ.X' := Sigma.desc fun j => u j ≫ (ρ j).f
  have hB₁ : B ≫ ψ.s = U ≫ T := Sigma.hom_ext _ _ fun j => by
    have hρ' : (ρ j).s ≫ Sigma.ι X j = (ρ j).f ≫ ψ.s := hρ j
    simp [B, U, T, hρ']
  have hB₂ : B ≫ ψ.f = 0 := Sigma.hom_ext _ _ fun j => by
    simpa [B] using hu' j
  have := Localization.inverts L W _ (sigmaMap_mem W hW u hu)
  have := Localization.inverts L W _ (sigmaMap_mem W hW _ fun j => (ρ j).hs)
  have : IsIso (L.map B) := by
    have h : IsIso (L.map B ≫ L.map ψ.s) := by
      rw [← L.map_comp, hB₁, L.map_comp]
      infer_instance
    exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (L.map ψ.s)
  have hf : L.map ψ.f = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (L.map B), ← L.map_comp, hB₂, L.map_zero, comp_zero]
  rw [hψ, MorphismProperty.RightFraction.map, hf, comp_zero]

name: DG.LocalizationCoproducts.exists_desc
statement:
theorem exists_desc (X : J → C) {Y : D} (φ : ∀ j, L.obj (X j) ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ g : L.obj (∐ X) ⟶ Y, ∀ j, L.map (Sigma.ι X j) ≫ g = φ j
proof:
:= by
  have := Localization.essSurj L W
  let e := L.objObjPreimageIso Y
  choose ψ hψ using fun j => Localization.exists_rightFraction L W (φ j ≫ e.inv)
  let S := Limits.Sigma.map fun j => (ψ j).s
  have hS : W S := sigmaMap_mem W hW _ fun j => (ψ j).hs
  let F : ∐ (fun j => (ψ j).X') ⟶ L.objPreimage Y := Sigma.desc fun j => (ψ j).f
  have := Localization.inverts L W _ hS
  refine ⟨inv (L.map S) ≫ L.map F ≫ e.hom, fun j => ?_⟩
  have := Localization.inverts L W _ (ψ j).hs
  have hS' : (ψ j).s ≫ Sigma.ι X j = Sigma.ι _ j ≫ S := by simp [S]
  rw [← cancel_mono e.inv, assoc, assoc, assoc, e.hom_inv_id, comp_id, hψ j,
    ← cancel_epi (L.map (ψ j).s), MorphismProperty.RightFraction.map_s_comp_map,
    ← L.map_comp_assoc, hS', L.map_comp, assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← L.map_comp,
    Sigma.ι_comp_desc]

name: DG.LocalizationCoproducts.preservesColimitsOfShape
statement:
theorem preservesColimitsOfShape : PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) L where
  preservesColimit {K}
proof:
:= by
    have : PreservesColimit (Discrete.functor (K.obj ∘ Discrete.mk)) L :=
      preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone (coproductIsCoproduct _)
        ((isColimitMapCoconeCofanMkEquiv _ _ _).symm (isColimitCofan L W hW _))
    exact preservesColimit_of_iso_diagram L Discrete.natIsoFunctor.symm

name: DG.LocalizationCoproducts.hasColimitsOfShape
statement:
theorem hasColimitsOfShape : HasColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) D where
  has_colimit K
proof:
:= by
    have := Localization.essSurj L W
    have := preservesColimitsOfShape L W hW
    let X : J → C := fun j => L.objPreimage (K.obj ⟨j⟩)
    have : HasColimit (Discrete.functor X ⋙ L) :=
      ⟨⟨_, isColimitOfPreserves L (colimit.isColimit _)⟩⟩
    exact hasColimit_of_iso (F := Discrete.functor X ⋙ L)
      (Discrete.natIso fun j => (L.objObjPreimageIso (K.obj j)).symm)

name: DG.Shift.d_twist
statement:
theorem Shift.d_twist (n : ℤ) (a : A) :
    d (Shift.twist A n a) = koszulSign n • Shift.twist A n (d a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rename_i i
    rw [Shift.twist_of_mem a.2, d_units_smul, Shift.twist_of_mem (d_mem a.2), smul_smul,
      ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 1
    exact koszulSign_eq_of_sub_eq_two_mul (-n) (by ring)
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [map_add, d_add, ha, ha', d_add, map_add, smul_add]

name: DG.Cochain.ext_directSum_shift

name: DG.DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_bijective
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum (A := A) n k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
    ⟨fun y => Shift.mk n (DirectSum.map (fun b =>
      (Shift.mk (k b)).toAddMonoidHom.comp (Shift.unmk (n + k b)).toAddMonoidHom) y),
      fun x => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · apply (Shift.unmk n).injective
    ext b
    rw [Shift.unmk_mk, DirectSum.map_apply, DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_apply]
    rfl
  · ext b
    rw [DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_apply, Shift.unmk_mk, DirectSum.map_apply]
    rfl

name: DG.Resolution.δ_homotopy
statement: theorem δ_homotopy : δ (-1) 0 (homotopy p) = Cochain.ofHom (p.comp (attach p))
proof:
:=
  Cochain.ext_directSum_shift fun c => by
    change δ (-1) 0 (homotopy p) c.gen = Cochain.ofHom (p.comp (attach p)) c.gen
    rw [δ_neg_one_apply, Cell.d_gen, map_zero, add_zero, homotopy_gen, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
      DGModuleHom.comp_apply, attach_gen, c.p_z]

name: DG.Resolution.Stage.exists_step
statement:
theorem Stage.exists_step (s : Stage A M) {j : ℤ} {z : s.obj} (hz : z ∈ grading j)
    (hdz : d z = 0) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading (j - 1)) (hpz : s.π z = d m) :
    ∃ e : s.step.obj, e ∈ grading (j - 1) ∧ d e = Cone.inr (attach s.π) z ∧ s.step.π e = m
proof:
:= by
  let c : Cell s.π := ⟨j, z, m, hz, hdz, hm, hpz⟩
  refine ⟨Cone.inl (attach s.π) c.gen, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := (Cone.inl (attach s.π)).map_mem c.gen_mem
    rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg] at h
  · have h := Cone.inl_d_apply (f := attach s.π) c.gen
    rw [c.d_gen, map_zero, sub_zero, attach_gen] at h
    exact h
  · exact (Cone.inl_desc_apply _ _ _ (δ_homotopy s.π) _).trans (homotopy_gen c)

name: DG.Resolution.ι_injective
statement: theorem ι_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (ι A M n)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  congrArg (Cone.sndLinear (attach (stage A M n).π)) h

name: DG.Resolution.stage_succ_π_comp_ι
statement: theorem stage_succ_π_comp_ι (n : ℕ) : (stage A M (n + 1)).π.comp (ι A M n) = (stage A M n).π
proof:
:=
  Cone.inr_desc _ _ _ (δ_homotopy _)

name: DG.Resolution.π_of
statement: theorem π_of (n : ℕ) (x : Obj A M n) : π A M (SeqColimit.of _ _ n x) = (stage A M n).π x
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.desc_of _ _ _ _

name: DG.Resolution.exists_step
proof:
:=
  (stage A M n).exists_step hz hdz hm hpz

name: DG.Resolution.exists_stage_one
statement:
theorem exists_stage_one {j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading j) (hdm : d m = 0) :
    ∃ e : Obj A M 1, e ∈ grading j ∧ d e = 0 ∧ (stage A M 1).π e = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩ := exists_step (A := A) 0 (j := j + 1) (z := 0) (zero_mem _) d_zero
    (m := m) (by rwa [add_sub_cancel_right]) (by rw [map_zero, hdm])
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right] at he
  rw [map_zero] at hde
  exact ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩

name: DG.Resolution.surjective_π
statement: theorem surjective_π : Function.Surjective (π A M)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rename_i j
    obtain ⟨e₁, he₁, hde₁, hpe₁⟩ := exists_stage_one (A := A) (d_mem m.2) (d_d _)
    obtain ⟨e₂, -, -, hpe₂⟩ := exists_step 1 he₁ hde₁ (m := m)
      (by rw [add_sub_cancel_right]; exact m.2) hpe₁
    exact ⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ 2 e₂, by rw [π_of, hpe₂]⟩
  | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hm
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hm'
    exact ⟨x + y, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: DG.Resolution.isQuasiIso_π
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_π : (π A M).IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= fun j => by
  constructor
  · rw [cohomology.map_injective_iff]
    intro x hx hdx hpx
    obtain ⟨n, y, rfl⟩ := SeqColimit.exists_of_eq x
    have hinj := SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective A M) n
    have hy : y ∈ grading j := (SeqColimit.of _ _ n).mem_grading_of_injective hinj hx
    have hdy : d y = 0 := hinj (by rw [DGModuleHom.map_d, hdx, map_zero])
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hpx
    rw [π_of] at hdm
    obtain ⟨e, he, hde, -⟩ := exists_step n hy hdy hm hdm.symm
    exact mem_coboundaries.mpr ⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1) e,
      (SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1)).map_mem he, by
        rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hde, SeqColimit.of_succ_ι]⟩
  · rw [cohomology.map_surjective_iff]
    intro m hm hdm
    obtain ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩ := exists_stage_one (A := A) hm hdm
    exact ⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ 1 e, (SeqColimit.of _ _ 1).map_mem he,
      by rw [← DGModuleHom.map_d, hde, map_zero], by rw [π_of, hpe, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: DG.Resolution.bijective_rangeRestrict
statement:
theorem bijective_rangeRestrict (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (SeqColimit.of (Obj A M) (ι A M) n).rangeRestrict
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective A M) n (congrArg Subtype.val h),
    fun ⟨_, y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, Subtype.ext hy⟩⟩

name: DG.Resolution.of_toObj
statement:
theorem of_toObj {n : ℕ} (x : SeqColimit.filtration (S := Obj A M) (ι := ι A M) n) :
    SeqColimit.of _ _ n (toObj A M n x) = (x : SeqColimit (Obj A M) (ι A M))
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (DGModuleHom.apply_inverse_apply _ (bijective_rangeRestrict A M n) x)

name: DG.Resolution.toObj_eq
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective A M) n (by rw [of_toObj, h])

name: DG.Resolution.surjective_filtrationπ
statement: theorem surjective_filtrationπ (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (filtrationπ A M n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_bijective _ _).2.comp
    (Function.Surjective.comp (fun y => ⟨Cone.inlLinear _ y, Cone.fstHom_inlLinear y⟩) ?_)
  intro y
  exact ⟨⟨SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1) y, SeqColimit.of_mem_filtration (ι := ι A M) (n + 1) y⟩,
    toObj_eq rfl⟩

name: DG.Resolution.filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ)
    (x : SeqColimit.filtration (S := Obj A M) (ι := ι A M) (n + 1)) :
    filtrationπ A M n x = 0 ↔ (x : Colim A M) ∈ SeqColimit.filtration n
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtrationπ, DGModuleHom.comp_apply,
    map_eq_zero_iff _ (DGModuleHom.shiftDirectSum_bijective _ _).1, DGModuleHom.comp_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hy : toObj A M (n + 1) x =
        ι A M n (Cone.sndLinear (attach (stage A M n).π) (toObj A M (n + 1) x)) :=
      Cone.ext (h.trans (Cone.fstHom_inr _).symm) (Cone.sndLinear_inr _).symm
    refine ⟨Cone.sndLinear (attach (stage A M n).π) (toObj A M (n + 1) x), ?_⟩
    change SeqColimit.of _ _ n _ = _
    rw [← SeqColimit.of_succ_ι (ι := ι A M), ← hy, of_toObj]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h' : toObj A M (n + 1) x = ι A M n y := toObj_eq (by rw [SeqColimit.of_succ_ι]; exact hy)
    exact (congrArg (Cone.fstHom (attach (stage A M n).π)) h').trans (Cone.fstHom_inr y)

name: DG.exists_semiFreeResolution
statement:
theorem exists_semiFreeResolution :
    ∃ (P : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup P) (_ : DGAddCommGroup P) (_ : Module A P)
      (_ : DGModule A P) (π : P →ᵈᵍ[A] M), Function.Surjective π ∧ π.IsQuasiIso ∧
        Nonempty (SemiFreeFiltration.{max u v} A P)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Resolution.Colim A M, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    Resolution.π A M, Resolution.surjective_π A M,
    Resolution.isQuasiIso_π A M, ⟨Resolution.semiFreeFiltration A M⟩⟩

name: DG.IsKProjective.homotopic_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.homotopic_of_comp_eq {Q : Type w} [AddCommGroup Q] [DGAddCommGroup Q]
    [Module A Q] [DGModule A Q] {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
    [DGModule A N] (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) {q : Q →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hqq : q.IsQuasiIso) {f₁ f₂ : P →ᵈᵍ[A] Q} (h : q.comp f₁ = q.comp f₂) : Homotopic f₁ f₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [Homotopic.iff_sub]
  have hmem : ∀ x, (f₁ - f₂) x ∈ q.ker := fun x => by
    rw [DGModuleHom.mem_ker, DGModuleHom.sub_apply, map_sub, ← DGModuleHom.comp_apply, h,
      DGModuleHom.comp_apply, sub_self]
  have h1 := (hP q.ker (q.isAcyclic_ker hq hqq) (DGSubmodule.codRestrict (f₁ - f₂) hmem)).comp_right
    q.ker.subtype
  rwa [DGSubmodule.subtype_comp_codRestrict, DGModuleHom.comp_zero] at h1

name: DG.IsKProjective.exists_homotopic_comp
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_homotopic_comp (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) {s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N'}
    (hs : s.IsQuasiIso) (g : P →ᵈᵍ[A] N') : ∃ f : P →ᵈᵍ[A] N, Homotopic (s.comp f) g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hP.bijective_postcompHomotopy hs).2 (QuotientAddGroup.mk g)
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective c
  rw [DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy_mk, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem] at hc
  exact ⟨f, homotopic_iff_sub_mem.mpr hc⟩

name: DG.IsKProjective.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp
proof:
:= by
  have h' : DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy P s (QuotientAddGroup.mk f₁) =
      DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy P s (QuotientAddGroup.mk f₂) := by
    rw [DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy_mk, DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy_mk,
      QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem, ← homotopic_iff_sub_mem]
    exact h
  exact homotopic_iff_sub_mem.mpr
    (QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mp ((hP.bijective_postcompHomotopy hs).1 h'))

name: DG.IsKProjective.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P)
    (hP' : IsKProjective.{w} A P')
    {p : P →ᵈᵍ[A] M} (hp : p.IsQuasiIso) {p' : P' →ᵈᵍ[A] M} (hp' : p'.IsQuasiIso) :
    ∃ e : DGHomotopyEquiv A P P', Homotopic (p'.comp e.hom) p ∧ Homotopic (p.comp e.inv) p'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hP.exists_homotopic_comp hp' p
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hP'.exists_homotopic_comp hp p'
  have h₁ : Homotopic (ψ.comp φ) DGModuleHom.id :=
    hP.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp hp ((hψ.comp_left φ).trans hφ)
  have h₂ : Homotopic (φ.comp ψ) DGModuleHom.id :=
    hP'.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp hp' ((hφ.comp_left ψ).trans hψ)
  exact ⟨⟨φ, ψ, h₁.some, h₂.some⟩, hφ, hψ⟩

name: DG.HasLiftingProperty.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem HasLiftingProperty.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv (hP : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P)
    (hP' : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P') {p : P →ᵈᵍ[A] M} (hps : Function.Surjective p)
    (hp : p.IsQuasiIso) {p' : P' →ᵈᵍ[A] M} (hps' : Function.Surjective p')
    (hp' : p'.IsQuasiIso) :
    ∃ e : DGHomotopyEquiv A P P', p'.comp e.hom = p ∧ p.comp e.inv = p'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hP P' M p' hps' hp' p
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hP' P M p hps hp p'
  have h₁ : Homotopic (ψ.comp φ) DGModuleHom.id :=
    hP.isKProjective.homotopic_of_comp_eq hps hp (by rw [← DGModuleHom.comp_assoc, hψ, hφ]; rfl)
  have h₂ : Homotopic (φ.comp ψ) DGModuleHom.id :=
    hP'.isKProjective.homotopic_of_comp_eq hps' hp' (by rw [← DGModuleHom.comp_assoc, hφ, hψ]; rfl)
  exact ⟨⟨φ, ψ, h₁.some, h₂.some⟩, hφ, hψ⟩

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.hasLiftingProperty
statement: theorem hasLiftingProperty (R : SemiFreeResolution A M) : HasLiftingProperty.{w'} A R.P
proof:
:=
  R.filtration.hasLiftingProperty

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.isKProjective
statement: theorem isKProjective (R : SemiFreeResolution A M) : IsKProjective.{w'} A R.P
proof:
:=
  R.filtration.isKProjective

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_dgHomotopyEquiv (R R' : SemiFreeResolution A M) :
    ∃ e : DGHomotopyEquiv A R.P R'.P, R'.π.comp e.hom = R.π ∧ R.π.comp e.inv = R'.π
proof:
:=
  R.hasLiftingProperty.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv R'.hasLiftingProperty R.surjective_π
    R.isQuasiIso_π R'.surjective_π R'.isQuasiIso_π

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.π_comp_dgHomotopyEquiv_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem π_comp_dgHomotopyEquiv_hom (R R' : SemiFreeResolution A M) :
    R'.π.comp (R.dgHomotopyEquiv R').hom = R.π
proof:
:=
  (R.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv R').choose_spec.1

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.π_comp_dgHomotopyEquiv_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem π_comp_dgHomotopyEquiv_inv (R R' : SemiFreeResolution A M) :
    R.π.comp (R.dgHomotopyEquiv R').inv = R'.π
proof:
:=
  (R.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv R').choose_spec.2

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.π_comp_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem π_comp_lift (R : SemiFreeResolution A M) (R' : SemiFreeResolution A N)
    (g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : R'.π.comp (R.lift R' g) = g.comp R.π
proof:
:=
  (R.hasLiftingProperty R'.P N R'.π R'.surjective_π R'.isQuasiIso_π (g.comp R.π)).choose_spec

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.homotopic_lift
statement:
theorem homotopic_lift (R : SemiFreeResolution A M) (R' : SemiFreeResolution A N)
    {g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} {f : R.P →ᵈᵍ[A] R'.P} (h : Homotopic (R'.π.comp f) (g.comp R.π)) :
    Homotopic f (R.lift R' g)
proof:
:=
  R.isKProjective.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp R'.isQuasiIso_π
    (h.trans (Homotopic.of_eq (R.π_comp_lift R' g).symm))

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.lift_homotopic
statement:
theorem lift_homotopic (R : SemiFreeResolution A M) (R' : SemiFreeResolution A N)
    {g₁ g₂ : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (h : Homotopic g₁ g₂) : Homotopic (R.lift R' g₁) (R.lift R' g₂)
proof:
:=
  R.homotopic_lift R' ((Homotopic.of_eq (R.π_comp_lift R' g₁)).trans (h.comp_left R.π))

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.lift_id
statement: theorem lift_id (R : SemiFreeResolution A M) : Homotopic (R.lift R DGModuleHom.id) DGModuleHom.id
proof:
:=
  (R.homotopic_lift R (f := DGModuleHom.id) (Homotopic.refl _)).symm

name: DG.SemiFreeResolution.lift_comp
statement:
theorem lift_comp (R : SemiFreeResolution A M) (R' : SemiFreeResolution A N)
    (R'' : SemiFreeResolution A L) (g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (g' : N →ᵈᵍ[A] L) :
    Homotopic (R.lift R'' (g'.comp g)) ((R'.lift R'' g').comp (R.lift R' g))
proof:
:= by
  refine (R.homotopic_lift R'' (Homotopic.of_eq ?_)).symm
  rw [← DGModuleHom.comp_assoc, π_comp_lift, DGModuleHom.comp_assoc, π_comp_lift]
  rfl

name: DG.HasLiftingProperty.of_retract
statement:
theorem HasLiftingProperty.of_retract {P Q : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [DGAddCommGroup P]
    [Module A P] [DGModule A P] [AddCommGroup Q] [DGAddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q] [DGModule A Q]
    (hP : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P) (i : Q →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (r : P →ᵈᵍ[A] Q)
    (hri : r.comp i = DGModuleHom.id) : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A Q
proof:
:=
  hasLiftingProperty_iff.mpr ⟨(hasLiftingProperty_iff.mp hP).1.of_retract i r
    (Homotopic.of_eq hri), (hasLiftingProperty_iff.mp hP).2.of_retract i r hri⟩

name: DG.hasLiftingProperty_iff_exists_retract
statement:
theorem hasLiftingProperty_iff_exists_retract :
    HasLiftingProperty.{max u v} A P ↔
      ∃ (Q : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup Q) (_ : DGAddCommGroup Q) (_ : Module A Q)
        (_ : DGModule A Q) (_ : SemiFreeFiltration.{max u v} A Q) (i : P →ᵈᵍ[A] Q)
        (r : Q →ᵈᵍ[A] P), r.comp i = DGModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let R := semiFreeResolution A P
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h R.P P R.π R.surjective_π R.isQuasiIso_π DGModuleHom.id
    exact ⟨R.P, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, R.filtration, i, R.π,
      hi⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q, _, _, _, _, S, i, r, hri⟩
    exact S.hasLiftingProperty.of_retract i r hri

name: DG.isKProjective_iff_exists_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem isKProjective_iff_exists_dgHomotopyEquiv :
    IsKProjective.{max u v} A P ↔
      ∃ (Q : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup Q) (_ : DGAddCommGroup Q) (_ : Module A Q)
        (_ : DGModule A Q) (_ : SemiFreeFiltration.{max u v} A Q),
          Nonempty (DGHomotopyEquiv A P Q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let R := semiFreeResolution A P
    obtain ⟨e, -, -⟩ := h.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv R.isKProjective (p := DGModuleHom.id)
      DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_id R.isQuasiIso_π
    exact ⟨R.P, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, R.filtration, ⟨e⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q, _, _, _, _, S, ⟨e⟩⟩
    exact S.isKProjective.of_dgHomotopyEquiv e

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_eq_inverseImage
statement:
theorem quasiIso_eq_inverseImage :
    quasiIso.{u} R = (_root_.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R)
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).inverseImage (forget R R)
proof:
:= by
  ext X Y f
  exact mem_quasiIso_iff_forget R f

name: DG.DerivedCategory.comparisonEquivalence_functor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comparisonEquivalence_functor :
    (comparisonEquivalence R).functor = comparison R
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.representable_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representable_obj (X Y : C) : (representable X).obj Y = (X ⟶ Y)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.representable_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representable_smul {X Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (h : (representable X).obj Y) :
    f • h = (h : X ⟶ Y) ≫ f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.coe_yonedaEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_yonedaEquiv_apply (φ : representable X ⟶ M) :
    (yonedaEquiv φ : M.obj X) = φ.app X (𝟙 X)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply (m : cocycles (M.obj X) 0) {Y : C} (h : X ⟶ Y) :
    (yonedaEquiv.symm m).app Y h = h • (m : M.obj X)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem yonedaEquiv_comp {N : CatModule.{v} C} (φ : representable X ⟶ M) (ψ : M ⟶ N) :
    (yonedaEquiv (φ ≫ ψ) : N.obj X) = ψ.app X (yonedaEquiv φ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaEquiv_symm_comp
statement:
theorem yonedaEquiv_symm_comp {N : CatModule.{v} C} (m : cocycles (M.obj X) 0) (ψ : M ⟶ N) :
    yonedaEquiv.symm m ≫ ψ =
      yonedaEquiv.symm ⟨ψ.app X m, ψ.map_mem m.2.1,
        show d (ψ.app X m) = 0 by rw [← ψ.map_d, m.2.2, map_zero]⟩
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ h => ψ.map_smul h (m : M.obj X)

name: DG.CatModule.yoneda_map_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem yoneda_map_app {X X' : (DGCategory.Z0 C)ᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ X') {Y : C}
    (h : (representable X.unop.as).obj Y) :
    ((yoneda C).map f).app Y h = f.unop.hom ≫ (h : X.unop.as ⟶ Y)

name: DG.ShiftedHom.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {m : ShiftedHom a b M} :
    m ∈ grading n ↔ val a b M m ∈ grading (M := M) (n + (b - a))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.ShiftedHom.val_d
statement:
theorem val_d (m : ShiftedHom a b M) :
    val a b M (d m) = koszulSign b • d (val a b M m)

:=
  rfl

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.homVal_homMk
statement:
@[simp] theorem homVal_homMk {i j : ShiftedObjects φ} (f : (φ i.as).1 ⟶ (φ j.as).1) :
    homVal (homMk (i := i) (j := j) f) = f

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.homMk_homVal

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.shiftHom_mem_cocycles

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mem_grading_iff.mpr ?_, hom_ext ?_⟩
  · rw [show (φ i.as).2 - (φ j.as).2 + ((φ j.as).2 - (φ i.as).2) = 0 by ring]
    exact eqToHom_mem_grading h
  · rw [homVal_d]

name: DG.signedCompAux_of_of
statement:
theorem signedCompAux_of_of (i j : ℤ) (f : grading (M := X ⟶ Y) i) (g : grading (M := Y ⟶ Z) j) :
    signedCompAux (DirectSum.of _ i f) (DirectSum.of _ j g) =
      koszulSign (i * j) • ((f : X ⟶ Y) ≫ (g : Y ⟶ Z))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [signedCompAux, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, AddMonoidHom.flip_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.signedComp_apply
statement:
theorem signedComp_apply (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    signedComp X Y Z f g =
      signedCompAux (decompose (grading (M := X ⟶ Y)) f) (decompose (grading (M := Y ⟶ Z)) g)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.signedComp_of_mem
statement:
theorem signedComp_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hg : g ∈ grading j) : signedComp X Y Z f g = koszulSign (i * j) • (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedComp_apply, decompose_of_mem _ hf, decompose_of_mem _ hg, signedCompAux_of_of]

name: DG.signedComp_mem_grading
statement:
theorem signedComp_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hg : g ∈ grading j) : signedComp X Y Z f g ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedComp_of_mem hf hg, Units.smul_def]
  exact zsmul_mem (comp_mem_grading hf hg) _

name: DG.signedComp_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedComp_id (f : X ⟶ Y) : signedComp X Y Y f (𝟙 Y) = f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rw [signedComp_of_mem f.2 (id_mem_grading Y), mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul,
      Category.comp_id]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hf, hf']

name: DG.id_signedComp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_signedComp (f : X ⟶ Y) : signedComp X X Y (𝟙 X) f = f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rw [signedComp_of_mem (id_mem_grading X) f.2, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul,
      Category.id_comp]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [map_add, hf, hf']

name: DG.signedComp_assoc
statement:
theorem signedComp_assoc {W : C} (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) :
    signedComp W Y Z (signedComp W X Y f g) h = signedComp W X Z f (signedComp X Y Z g h)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hf, hf']
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    induction g using induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add g g' hg hg' => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hg, hg']
    | h_homogeneous g =>
      rename_i j
      induction h using induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add h h' hh hh' => simp only [map_add, hh, hh']
      | h_homogeneous h =>
        rename_i k
        rw [signedComp_of_mem (signedComp_mem_grading f.2 g.2) h.2,
          signedComp_of_mem f.2 (signedComp_mem_grading g.2 h.2), signedComp_of_mem f.2 g.2,
          signedComp_of_mem g.2 h.2, units_smul_comp, comp_units_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul,
          ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, Category.assoc]
        congr 2
        ring

name: DG.d_signedComp
statement:
theorem d_signedComp {j : ℤ} {g : X ⟶ Y} (hg : g ∈ grading j) (f : Y ⟶ Z) :
    d (signedComp X Y Z g f) =
      signedComp X Y Z (d g) f + koszulSign j • signedComp X Y Z g (d f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => simp only [map_add, hf, hf', smul_add]; abel
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    have h₁ : koszulSign ((j + 1) * i) = koszulSign (j * i + i) := by rw [add_mul, one_mul]
    have h₂ : koszulSign (j + j * (i + 1)) = koszulSign (j * i) := by
      rw [show j + j * (i + 1) = j * i + 2 * j by ring, koszulSign_add,
        koszulSign_even (even_two_mul j), mul_one]
    rw [signedComp_of_mem hg f.2, signedComp_of_mem (d_mem hg) f.2,
      signedComp_of_mem hg (d_mem f.2), d_units_smul, d_comp _ f.2, smul_add, smul_smul,
      smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, h₁, h₂, add_comm]

name: DG.DGOpposite.homUnop_comp_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [homUnop_comp, signedComp_of_mem (X := Z.unop) (Y := Y.unop) (Z := X.unop)
    (f := homUnop g) (g := homUnop f) hg hf, mul_comm]

name: DG.isInternal_range_of_bijective
statement:
theorem isInternal_range_of_bijective
    (h : Function.Bijective (DirectSum.toAddMonoid f)) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => (f i).range
proof:
:= by
  let m : (⨁ i, β i) →+ ⨁ i, (f i).range := DirectSum.map fun i => (f i).rangeRestrict
  have hm : ∀ w, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (fun i => (f i).range) (m w) =
      DirectSum.toAddMonoid f w := by
    intro w
    induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero]
    | of i y =>
      simp only [m, DirectSum.map_of, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of,
        AddMonoidHom.coe_rangeRestrict]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective m := by
    intro z
    induction z using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
    | of i y =>
      obtain ⟨_, y, rfl⟩ := y
      exact ⟨DirectSum.of β i y, by simp only [m, DirectSum.map_of]; rfl⟩
    | add x y hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨x + y, map_add _ _ _⟩
  refine ⟨fun z z' hz => ?_, fun t => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hsurj z
    obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := hsurj z'
    rw [hm, hm] at hz
    rw [h.1 hz]
  · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := h.2 t
    exact ⟨m w, hm w⟩

name: DG.coe_decompose_range
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_range [Decomposition fun i => (f i).range]
    (w : ⨁ i, β i) (i : ι) :
    (decompose (fun i => (f i).range) (DirectSum.toAddMonoid f w) i : T) = f i (w i)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j y =>
    rw [DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
    by_cases h : j = i
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same (fun i => (f i).range) (AddMonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩),
        DirectSum.of_eq_same]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne (fun i => (f i).range) (AddMonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩) h,
        DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm h), map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    simp only [map_add, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.CatModule.of_act_eq
statement:
theorem of_act_eq {k l l' : ℤ} (h : l = l') (f : (⟨k⟩ : WeightCategory A) ⟶ ⟨l⟩)
    (f' : (⟨k⟩ : WeightCategory A) ⟶ ⟨l'⟩) (hf : f.1 = f'.1) (y : N.obj ⟨k⟩) :
    weightSumOf N l (f • y) =
      weightSumOf N l' (f' • y)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [Subtype.ext hf]

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_smul_def
statement: theorem weightSum_smul_def (a : A) (x : N.WeightSum) : a • x = weightSumSMulHom N a x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_smul_of
statement:
theorem weightSum_smul_of {j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ wgrading (M := A) j) (k : ℤ)
    (y : N.obj ⟨k⟩) :
    a • weightSumOf N k y =
      weightSumOf N (k + j) (homOfMem ha k (k + j) (by ring) • y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightSum_smul_def, weightSumSMulHom, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.toAddMonoidHom_eq_coe,
    AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, decomposeAddEquiv_apply, decompose_of_mem _ ha, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
  erw [DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_zero_smul
statement: theorem weightSum_zero_smul (x : N.WeightSum) : (0 : A) • x = 0

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_smul_zero
statement: theorem weightSum_smul_zero (a : A) : a • (0 : N.WeightSum) = 0
proof:

  simp only [weightSum_smul_def, map_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_one_smul
statement: theorem weightSum_one_smul (x : N.WeightSum) : (1 : A) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact weightSum_smul_zero N 1
  | of k y =>
    rw [weightSum_smul_of N one_mem_wgrading,
      of_act_eq N (add_zero k) _ (𝟙 (⟨k⟩ : WeightCategory A)) rfl, id_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [weightSum_smul_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_mul_smul
statement: theorem weightSum_mul_smul (a b : A) (x : N.WeightSum) : (a * b) • x = a • b • x
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (wgrading (M := A)) with
  | zero => simp only [zero_mul, weightSum_zero_smul]
  | add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_mul, weightSum_add_smul, weightSum_add_smul, ha, ha']
  | homogeneous a =>
    rename_i i
    induction b using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (wgrading (M := A)) with
    | zero => simp only [mul_zero, weightSum_zero_smul, weightSum_smul_zero]
    | add b b' hb hb' => rw [mul_add, weightSum_add_smul, weightSum_add_smul, hb, hb',
        weightSum_smul_add]
    | homogeneous b =>
      rename_i j
      induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
      | zero => simp only [weightSum_smul_zero]
      | add x y hx hy => rw [weightSum_smul_add, weightSum_smul_add, weightSum_smul_add, hx, hy]
      | of k y =>
        rw [weightSum_smul_of N (mul_mem_wgrading a.2 b.2), weightSum_smul_of N b.2,
          weightSum_smul_of N a.2, ← comp_smul]
        exact of_act_eq N (show k + (i + j) = k + j + i by ring) _ _ rfl y

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_smul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem weightSum_smul_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {x : N.WeightSum}
    (hx : x ∈ grading j) : a • x ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (wgrading (M := A)) a, ← DirectSum.sum_support_of x,
    Finset.sum_smul]
  refine sum_mem fun l _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine sum_mem fun k _ => ?_
  rw [weightSum_smul_of N (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) a l).2]
  exact DG.DirectSum.of_mem_grading _ _
    (smul_mem_grading (M := N) (decompose_wgrading_mem_grading ha l) (hx k))

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_d_of
statement:
theorem weightSum_d_of (k : ℤ) (y : N.obj ⟨k⟩) :
    d (weightSumOf N k y) = weightSumOf N k (d y)
proof:
:=
  DG.DirectSum.d_of (fun k => N.obj ⟨k⟩) k y

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_d_smul
statement:
theorem weightSum_d_smul {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (x : N.WeightSum) :
    d (a • x) = d a • x + koszulSign n • (a • d x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hom : ∀ (l : ℤ) (b : A), b ∈ wgrading (M := A) l → b ∈ grading n → ∀ x : N.WeightSum,
      d (b • x) = d b • x + koszulSign n • (b • d x) := by
    intro l b hbl hbn x
    induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [weightSum_smul_zero, weightSum_smul_zero, d_zero, weightSum_smul_zero,
        Units.smul_def, zsmul_zero, add_zero]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [weightSum_smul_add, d_add, hx, hy, d_add, weightSum_smul_add,
        weightSum_smul_add, _root_.smul_add]; abel
    | of k y =>
      rw [weightSum_smul_of N hbl, weightSum_d_of, weightSum_d_of, weightSum_smul_of N hbl,
        weightSum_smul_of N (d_mem_wgrading hbl),
        CatModule.d_smul (M := N) (f := homOfMem hbl k (k + l) (by ring)) hbn, map_add,
        Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]
      rfl
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (wgrading (M := A)) a]
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.sum_smul, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => hom l _ (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) a l).2
    (decompose_wgrading_mem_grading ha l) x

name: DG.CatModule.of_mem_weightSumGrading
statement:
theorem of_mem_weightSumGrading (k : ℤ) (y : N.obj ⟨k⟩) :
    weightSumOf N k y ∈ weightSumGrading N k
proof:
:=
  ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: DG.CatModule.weightSum_toAddMonoid_of
statement:
theorem weightSum_toAddMonoid_of (x : N.WeightSum) :
    DirectSum.toAddMonoid (weightSumOf N) x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | of k y => exact DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (weightSumOf N) k y
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.CatModule.coe_decompose_weightSumGrading
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_weightSumGrading (x : N.WeightSum) (k : ℤ) :
    (decompose (weightSumGrading N) x k : N.WeightSum) = weightSumOf N k (x k)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← weightSum_toAddMonoid_of N x]
  exact coe_decompose_range (weightSumOf N) x k

name: DG.CatModule.mem_wgrading_weightSum_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_weightSum_iff {k : ℤ} {x : N.WeightSum} :
    x ∈ wgrading k ↔ ∃ y, weightSumOf N k y = x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.CatModule.weightSumMap_of
statement:
theorem weightSumMap_of {N' : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory A)} (φ : N ⟶ N') (k : ℤ)
    (y : N.obj ⟨k⟩) :
    weightSumMap φ (weightSumOf N k y) =
      weightSumOf N' k (φ.app ⟨k⟩ y)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.BigradedDGModuleCat.coe_smul_weightSum
statement:
theorem coe_smul_weightSum (a : A) (x : (toCatModuleObj M).WeightSum) :
    ((decomposeAddEquiv (wgrading (M := M))).symm (a • x) : M) =
      a • (decomposeAddEquiv (wgrading (M := M))).symm x
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (wgrading (M := A)) with
  | zero => simp only [zero_smul, map_zero]
  | add a a' ha ha' => simp only [add_smul, map_add, ha, ha']
  | homogeneous a =>
    induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [smul_zero, map_zero]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
    | of k y =>
      rw [CatModule.weightSum_smul_of _ a.2]
      change DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (wgrading (M := M)) (DirectSum.of _ _ _) =
        (a : A) • DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (wgrading (M := M)) (DirectSum.of _ k y)
      rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
      rfl

name: DG.BigradedDGModuleCat.weightDecomposeEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem weightDecomposeEquiv_apply (m : M) :
    weightDecomposeEquiv M m = decompose (wgrading (M := M)) m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.BigradedDGModuleCat.mem_wgrading_weightDecomposeEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_weightDecomposeEquiv_iff {k : ℤ} {m : M} :
    weightDecomposeEquiv M m ∈ wgrading k ↔ m ∈ wgrading k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h := congrArg (decompose (wgrading (M := M))).symm hy
    rw [weightDecomposeEquiv_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
    change DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom _ (DirectSum.of _ k y) = m at h
    rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact y.2
  · intro hm
    refine ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [weightDecomposeEquiv_apply, decompose_of_mem _ hm]
    rfl

name: DG.BigradedDGModuleCat.decompose_hom_apply
statement:
theorem decompose_hom_apply {N : BigradedDGModuleCat.{v} A} (φ : M ⟶ N) (m : M) (k : ℤ) :
    (decompose (wgrading (M := N)) (φ.hom m) k : N) =
      φ.hom (decompose (wgrading (M := M)) m k)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (wgrading (M := M)) with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous m =>
    rename_i j
    by_cases h : j = k
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ m.2, decompose_of_mem_same _ (φ.map_mem_wgrading m.2)]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ m.2 h, decompose_of_mem_ne _ (φ.map_mem_wgrading m.2) h,
        map_zero]
  | add m m' hm hm' => simp only [map_add, decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.CatModule.coe_summandAddEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coe_summandAddEquiv_apply (k : WeightCategory A) (y : N.obj k) :
    (summandAddEquiv N k y).1 = weightSumOf N k.as y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.weightEquivalence_functor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightEquivalence_functor : (weightEquivalence A).functor = toBigraded A
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.weightEquivalence_inverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightEquivalence_inverse :

proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.act_apply
statement: theorem act_apply {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) : M.act f m = f • m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.smul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem smul_mem_grading {X Y : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {m : M.obj X} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) : f • m ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  M.act_mem' hf hm

name: DG.CatModule.id_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_smul {X : C} (m : M.obj X) : (𝟙 X) • m = m
proof:
:=
  M.act_id' X m

name: DG.CatModule.comp_smul
statement:
theorem comp_smul {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (m : M.obj X) :
    (f ≫ g) • m = g • f • m
proof:
:=
  M.act_comp' f g m

name: DG.CatModule.d_smul
statement:
theorem d_smul {X Y : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) (m : M.obj X) :
    d (f • m) = d f • m + koszulSign i • f • d m
proof:
:=
  M.d_act' hf m

name: DG.CatModule.d_smul_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_mem_zero {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading 0) (m : M.obj X) :
    d (f • m) = d f • m + f • d m
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_smul hf, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.d_smul_of_d_eq_zero
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_d_eq_zero {X Y : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) (hdf : d f = 0)
    (m : M.obj X) : d (f • m) = koszulSign i • f • d m
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_smul hf, hdf]
  change M.act 0 m + _ = _
  rw [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, zero_add]

name: DG.CatModule.add_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_smul {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) : (f + g) • m = f • m + g • m
proof:
:= by
  change M.act (f + g) m = M.act f m + M.act g m
  rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_add {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m m' : M.obj X) : f • (m + m') = f • m + f • m'
proof:
:=
  map_add (M.act f) m m'

name: DG.CatModule.zero_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_smul {X Y : C} (m : M.obj X) : (0 : X ⟶ Y) • m = (0 : M.obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  change M.act 0 m = 0
  rw [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_zero {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : f • (0 : M.obj X) = (0 : M.obj Y)
proof:
:=
  map_zero (M.act f)

name: DG.CatModule.neg_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_smul {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) : (-f) • m = -(f • m)
proof:
:= by
  change M.act (-f) m = -M.act f m
  rw [map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_neg {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) : f • (-m) = -(f • m)
proof:
:=
  map_neg (M.act f) m

name: DG.CatModule.sub_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_smul {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) : (f - g) • m = f • m - g • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_smul, neg_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_sub {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m m' : M.obj X) : f • (m - m') = f • m - f • m'
proof:
:=
  map_sub (M.act f) m m'

name: DG.CatModule.zsmul_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zsmul_smul {X Y : C} (n : ℤ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) : (n • f) • m = n • f • m
proof:
:= by
  change M.act (n • f) m = n • M.act f m
  rw [map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_zsmul {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℤ) (m : M.obj X) : f • (n • m) = n • f • m
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (M.act f) n m

name: DG.CatModule.units_smul_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem units_smul_smul {X Y : C} (u : ℤˣ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    (u • f) • m = u • f • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, zsmul_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_units_smul {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (u : ℤˣ) (m : M.obj X) :
    f • (u • m) = u • f • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.d_smul_of_d_eq_zero_right
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_d_eq_zero_right {X Y : C} {m : M.obj X} (hm : d m = 0) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    d (f • m) = d f • m
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on with
  | h_zero =>
    change d (M.act 0 m) = M.act (d 0) m
    rw [d_zero, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, d_zero]
  | h_homogeneous f => rw [d_smul f.2, hm, smul_zero, _root_.smul_zero, add_zero]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' =>
    change d (M.act (f + f') m) = M.act (d (f + f')) m
    rw [d_add, map_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, d_add]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hf hf'

name: DG.CatModule.sum_smul
statement:
theorem sum_smul {X Y : C} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → (X ⟶ Y)) (m : M.obj X) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) • m = ∑ i ∈ s, f i • m
proof:
:= by
  change M.act (∑ i ∈ s, f i) m = ∑ i ∈ s, M.act (f i) m
  rw [map_sum, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_sum
statement:
theorem smul_sum {X Y : C} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : ι → M.obj X) :
    f • (∑ i ∈ s, m i) = ∑ i ∈ s, f • m i
proof:
:=
  map_sum (M.act f) m s

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {φ ψ : Hom M N} (h : ∀ X m, φ.app X m = ψ.app X m) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, _, _, _⟩ := φ
  obtain ⟨ψ, _, _, _⟩ := ψ
  congr
  funext X
  exact AddMonoidHom.ext (h X)

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.map_mem
statement: theorem map_mem {X : C} {n : ℤ} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading n) : φ.app X m ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  φ.map_mem' hm

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.map_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_d {X : C} (m : M.obj X) : φ.app X (d m) = d (φ.app X m)
proof:
:=
  φ.map_d' m

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.map_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_smul {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) : φ.app Y (f • m) = f • φ.app X m
proof:
:=
  φ.map_smul' f m

name: DG.CatModule.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : M ⟶ N} (h : ∀ X m, φ.app X m = ψ.app X m) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=

name: DG.CatModule.id_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_app (M : CatModule.{w} C) (X : C) (m : M.obj X) : (𝟙 M : M ⟶ M).app X m = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.comp_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ P) (X : C) (m : M.obj X) :
    (φ ≫ ψ).app X m = ψ.app X (φ.app X m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.hom_injective
statement: theorem hom_injective : Function.Injective (Hom.app : (M ⟶ N) → ∀ X, M.obj X →+ N.obj X)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => hom_ext fun X m => congrArg (fun φ => φ X m) h

name: DG.CatModule.zero_app
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_app (X : C) (m : M.obj X) : (0 : M ⟶ N).app X m = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.add_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem add_app (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) (X : C) (m : M.obj X) :
    (φ + ψ).app X m = φ.app X m + ψ.app X m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.neg_app
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (X : C) (m : M.obj X) : (-φ).app X m = -φ.app X m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.sub_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem sub_app (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) (X : C) (m : M.obj X) :

proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.nsmul_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem nsmul_app (n : ℕ) (φ : M ⟶ N) (X : C) (m : M.obj X) :
    (n • φ).app X m = n • φ.app X m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.zsmul_app

    (n • φ).app X m = n • φ.app X m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.isIso_of_bijective
statement: theorem isIso_of_bijective (φ : M ⟶ N) (hφ : ∀ X, Function.Bijective (φ.app X)) : IsIso φ
proof:
:= by
  let e : ∀ X, M.obj X ≃+ N.obj X := fun X => AddEquiv.ofBijective (φ.app X) (hφ X)
  have he : ∀ {X : C} {n : ℤ} {m : M.obj X}, e X m ∈ grading n ↔ m ∈ grading n :=
    fun {X n m} => ⟨fun h => mem_grading_of_injective (φ.app X) (fun h => φ.map_mem h)
      (hφ X).injective h, fun h => φ.map_mem h⟩
  exact (isoMk e he (fun m => φ.map_d m) (fun f m => φ.map_smul f m)).isIso_hom

name: DG.CatModule.isIso_iff_bijective
statement: theorem isIso_iff_bijective (φ : M ⟶ N) : IsIso φ ↔ ∀ X, Function.Bijective (φ.app X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ X => ⟨fun a b h => ?_, fun b => ⟨(inv φ).app X b, ?_⟩⟩, isIso_of_bijective φ⟩
  · have := congrArg ((inv φ).app X) h
    rwa [← comp_app, ← comp_app, IsIso.hom_inv_id] at this
  · rw [← comp_app, IsIso.inv_hom_id, id_app]

name: DG.CatModule.isZero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem isZero_of_subsingleton (M : CatModule.{w} C) [∀ X, Subsingleton (M.obj X)] :
    IsZero M where
  unique_to N
proof:
:= ⟨⟨⟨0⟩, fun φ => hom_ext fun X m => by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim m 0, map_zero, map_zero]⟩⟩
  unique_from N := ⟨⟨⟨0⟩, fun _ => hom_ext fun _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.isZero_zero
statement: theorem isZero_zero : IsZero (zero.{w} (C := C))
proof:
:=
  isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: DG.CatModule.prod_smul_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_smul_fst {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : (prod M N).obj X) : (f • m).1 = f • m.1

name: DG.CatModule.ker_subtype_comp
statement: theorem ker_subtype_comp : (Hom.ker φ).subtype ≫ φ = 0
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ m => m.2

name: DG.CatModule.kernelFork_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kernelFork_ι : (kernelFork φ).ι = (Hom.ker φ).subtype
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.comp_range_mkQ
statement: theorem comp_range_mkQ : φ ≫ (Hom.range φ).mkQ = 0
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ m => (Hom.range φ).mkQ_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩

name: DG.CatModule.cokernelCofork_π
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cokernelCofork_π : (cokernelCofork φ).π = (Hom.range φ).mkQ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.injective_of_mono
statement: theorem injective_of_mono [Mono φ] (X : C) : Function.Injective (φ.app X)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Hom.ker φ).subtype = 0 :=
    (cancel_mono φ).1 ((kernelFork φ).condition.trans zero_comp.symm)
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro m hm
  exact congrArg (fun χ : (Hom.ker φ).toCatModule ⟶ M => χ.app X ⟨m, hm⟩) h

name: DG.CatModule.surjective_of_epi
statement: theorem surjective_of_epi [Epi φ] (X : C) : Function.Surjective (φ.app X)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Hom.range φ).mkQ = 0 :=
    (cancel_epi φ).1 ((cokernelCofork φ).condition.trans comp_zero.symm)
  intro n
  exact (Hom.range φ).mkQ_eq_zero_iff.mp (congrArg (fun χ => χ.app X n) h)

name: DG.CatModule.mono_of_injective
statement: theorem mono_of_injective (h : ∀ X, Function.Injective (φ.app X)) : Mono φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ hg => hom_ext fun X m => h X (congrArg (fun χ => χ.app X m) hg)⟩

name: DG.CatModule.epi_of_surjective
statement: theorem epi_of_surjective (h : ∀ X, Function.Surjective (φ.app X)) : Epi φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun g g' hg => hom_ext fun X n => by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h X n
    exact congrArg (fun χ => χ.app X m) hg⟩

name: DG.CatModule.mono_iff_injective
statement: theorem mono_iff_injective : Mono φ ↔ ∀ X, Function.Injective (φ.app X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => injective_of_mono φ, mono_of_injective φ⟩

name: DG.CatModule.epi_iff_surjective
statement: theorem epi_iff_surjective : Epi φ ↔ ∀ X, Function.Surjective (φ.app X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => surjective_of_epi φ, epi_of_surjective φ⟩

statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_obj_carrier (M : CatModule.{w} C) : ((eval X).obj M : Type w) = M.obj X
proof: := rfl

statement:

theorem eval_map_hom_apply {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (φ : M ⟶ N) (m : M.obj X) :

statement:
theorem eval_jointly_faithful {M N : CatModule.{w} C} {φ ψ : M ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ X, (eval X).map φ = (eval X).map ψ) : φ = ψ
proof:

  hom_ext fun X m => congrArg (fun χ => χ.hom m) (h X)

name: DG.CatModule.isIso_of_isIso_eval
statement:
theorem isIso_of_isIso_eval {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ X, IsIso ((eval X).map φ)) : IsIso φ
proof:
:=
  isIso_of_bijective φ fun X => ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((eval X).map φ)

name: DG.CatModule.exact_map_eval_of_exact
statement:
theorem exact_map_eval_of_exact (S : ShortComplex (CatModule.{w} C))
    (hS : Function.Exact (S.f.app X) (S.g.app X)) : (S.map (eval X)).Exact
proof:
:=
  (DGModuleCat.exact_iff_function_exact _).2 hS

name: DG.CatModule.evalComplex_jointly_faithful
statement:
theorem evalComplex_jointly_faithful {M N : CatModule.{w} C} {φ ψ : M ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ X, (evalComplex X).map φ = (evalComplex X).map ψ) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  eval_jointly_faithful fun X => (DGModuleCat.forgetToAddCommGrp (End X)).map_injective (h X)

name: DG.CatModule.exact_iff_function_exact
statement:
theorem exact_iff_function_exact (S : ShortComplex (CatModule.{w} C)) :
    S.Exact ↔ ∀ X, Function.Exact (S.f.app X) (S.g.app X)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hS X
    exact (DGModuleCat.exact_iff_function_exact _).1 (hS.map (eval X))
  · intro hS
    rw [S.exact_iff_isZero_homology, IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    refine eval_jointly_faithful fun X => ?_
    have h := ((S.map (eval X)).exact_iff_isZero_homology.1 (exact_map_eval_of_exact X S (hS X)))
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero]
    exact (h.of_iso (S.mapHomologyIso (eval X)).symm).eq_of_src _ _

name: DG.CatModule.shortExact_iff
statement:
theorem shortExact_iff (S : ShortComplex (CatModule.{w} C)) :
    S.ShortExact ↔ ∀ X, Function.Injective (S.f.app X) ∧ Function.Exact (S.f.app X) (S.g.app X) ∧
      Function.Surjective (S.g.app X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h X => by
      have := h.mono_f
      have := h.epi_g
      exact ⟨injective_of_mono S.f X, (exact_iff_function_exact S).1 h.exact X,
        surjective_of_epi S.g X⟩,
    fun h => by
      have := mono_of_injective S.f fun X => (h X).1
      have := epi_of_surjective S.g fun X => (h X).2.2
      exact ⟨(exact_iff_function_exact S).2 fun X => (h X).2.1⟩⟩

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.idem_mem_cocycles
statement: theorem idem_mem_cocycles (i : ι) : P.idem i ∈ cocycles (P.obj i ⟶ P.obj i) 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨P.idem_mem i, P.d_idem i⟩

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.mem_homSubgroup
statement:
theorem mem_homSubgroup {i j : ι} {f : P.obj i ⟶ P.obj j} :
    f ∈ P.homSubgroup i j ↔ P.idem i ≫ f = f ∧ f ≫ P.idem j = f
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.idem_comp_comp_idem_mem
statement:
theorem idem_comp_comp_idem_mem (i j : ι) (f : P.obj i ⟶ P.obj j) :
    P.idem i ≫ f ≫ P.idem j ∈ P.homSubgroup i j
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simp, by simp⟩

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.hom_ext
statement: theorem hom_ext {i j : P.Corner} {f g : i ⟶ j} (h : f.1 = g.1) : f = g
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext h

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.id_val
statement: @[simp] theorem id_val (i : P.Corner) : (𝟙 i : i ⟶ i).1 = P.idem i.as
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.comp_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_val {i j k : P.Corner} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k) :
    (f ≫ g).1 = f.1 ≫ g.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.idem_comp_val
statement: theorem idem_comp_val {i j : P.Corner} (f : i ⟶ j) : P.idem i.as ≫ f.1 = f.1

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.val_comp_idem
statement: theorem val_comp_idem {i j : P.Corner} (f : i ⟶ j) : f.1 ≫ P.idem j.as = f.1

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.add_val
statement: @[simp] theorem add_val {i j : P.Corner} (f g : i ⟶ j) : (f + g).1 = f.1 + g.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.neg_val
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_val {i j : P.Corner} (f : i ⟶ j) : (-f).1 = -f.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.zero_val
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_val (i j : P.Corner) : (0 : i ⟶ j).1 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.sub_val
statement: @[simp] theorem sub_val {i j : P.Corner} (f g : i ⟶ j) : (f - g).1 = f.1 - g.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.zsmul_val
statement: @[simp] theorem zsmul_val {i j : P.Corner} (n : ℤ) (f : i ⟶ j) : (n • f).1 = n • f.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.sum_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem sum_val {i j : P.Corner} {J : Type*} (s : Finset J) (f : J → (i ⟶ j)) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, f a).1 = ∑ a ∈ s, (f a).1
proof:
:=
  map_sum (AddSubgroupClass.subtype (P.homSubgroup i.as j.as)) f s

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.d_mem_homSubgroup
statement:
theorem d_mem_homSubgroup {i j : ι} {f : P.obj i ⟶ P.obj j} (hf : f ∈ P.homSubgroup i j) :
    d f ∈ P.homSubgroup i j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [← d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_left (P.d_idem i), hf.1]
  · have h := d_comp_of_mem_zero f (P.idem_mem j)
    rw [P.d_idem, Limits.comp_zero, zero_add, hf.2] at h
    exact h.symm

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.decompose_mem_homSubgroup
statement:
theorem decompose_mem_homSubgroup {i j : ι} {f : P.obj i ⟶ P.obj j}
    (hf : f ∈ P.homSubgroup i j) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := P.obj i ⟶ P.obj j)) f n : P.obj i ⟶ P.obj j) ∈
      P.homSubgroup i j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h := decompose_comp_left (P.idem_mem i) f n
    rw [add_zero, hf.1] at h
    exact h.symm
  · have h := decompose_comp_right f (P.idem_mem j) n
    rw [add_zero, hf.2] at h
    exact h.symm

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {i j : P.Corner} {n : ℤ} {f : i ⟶ j} :
    f ∈ grading n ↔ f.1 ∈ grading (M := P.obj i.as ⟶ P.obj j.as) n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.d_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_val {i j : P.Corner} (f : i ⟶ j) : (d f).1 = d f.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.mem_cocycles_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cocycles_iff {i j : P.Corner} {n : ℤ} {f : i ⟶ j} :
    f ∈ cocycles (i ⟶ j) n ↔ f.1 ∈ cocycles (P.obj i.as ⟶ P.obj j.as) n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_cocycles, mem_grading_iff]
  exact and_congr_right fun _ => ⟨fun h => by rw [← d_val, h, zero_val],
    fun h => hom_ext (by rw [d_val, h, zero_val])⟩

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.augment_obj_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem augment_obj_inl (X : C) : P.augment.obj (.inl X) = X
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.augment_obj_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem augment_obj_inr (i : ι) : P.augment.obj (.inr i) = P.obj i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.augment_idem_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem augment_idem_inl (X : C) : P.augment.idem (.inl X) = 𝟙 X
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.augment_idem_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem augment_idem_inr (i : ι) : P.augment.idem (.inr i) = P.idem i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.inl_map_val
statement: @[simp] theorem inl_map_val {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : ((P.inl).map f).1 = f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.inr_map_val
statement: @[simp] theorem inr_map_val {i j : P.Corner} (f : i ⟶ j) : ((P.inr).map f).1 = f.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.eqToHom_mem_cocycles
statement: theorem eqToHom_mem_cocycles (h : X = Y) : eqToHom h ∈ cocycles (X ⟶ Y) 0
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact id_mem_cocycles X

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom_mem
statement:
theorem eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom_mem {X' Y' : C} (h : X' = X) (h' : Y = Y') {n : ℤ}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading n) : eqToHom h ≫ f ≫ eqToHom h' ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'
  simpa using hf

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.d_eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom
statement:
theorem d_eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom {X' Y' : C} (h : X' = X) (h' : Y = Y') (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    d (eqToHom h ≫ f ≫ eqToHom h') = eqToHom h ≫ d f ≫ eqToHom h'
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'
  simp

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.mapCorner_map_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapCorner_map_val {i j : P.Corner} (f : i ⟶ j) :
    ((P.mapCorner σ τ hobj hidem).map f).1 =
      eqToHom (hobj i.as).symm ≫ σ.map f.1 ≫ eqToHom (hobj j.as)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.augment_hobj
statement:
theorem augment_hobj : ∀ x, σ.obj (P.augment.obj x) = P.augment.obj (Sum.map σ.obj τ x)
  | .inl _ => rfl
  | .inr i => hobj i

omit [σ.Additive] [σ.IsDGFunctor] in
include hidem in

name: DG.IdempotentFamily.augment_hidem
statement:
theorem augment_hidem : ∀ x, eqToHom (P.augment_hobj σ τ hobj x).symm ≫
    σ.map (P.augment.idem x) ≫ eqToHom (P.augment_hobj σ τ hobj x) =
      P.augment.idem (Sum.map σ.obj τ x)
  | .inl X => by
    change eqToHom _ ≫ σ.map (𝟙 X) ≫ eqToHom _ = 𝟙 (σ.obj X)
    erw [eqToHom_refl]
    simp
  | .inr i => hidem i

                                                                                    
                                   
abbrev mapAugment : P.augment.Corner ⥤ P.augment.Corner
proof:
:=
  P.augment.mapCorner σ (Sum.map σ.obj τ) (P.augment_hobj σ τ hobj)
    (P.augment_hidem σ τ hobj hidem)

name: DG.DGLinear.smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_mem {X Y : C} {n : ℤ} (r : R) {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading n) :
    r • f ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  DGLinear.smul_mem' r hf

name: DG.DGLinear.d_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_smul {X Y : C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) : d (r • f) = r • d f
proof:
:=
  DGLinear.d_smul' r f

name: DG.DGLinear.dLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dLinear_apply (X Y : C) (f : X ⟶ Y) : dLinear R X Y f = d f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGLinear.smul_id_comp
statement: theorem smul_id_comp {X Y : C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) : (r • 𝟙 X) ≫ f = r • f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp]

name: DG.DGLinear.comp_smul_id
statement: theorem comp_smul_id {X Y : C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) : f ≫ (r • 𝟙 Y) = r • f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Linear.comp_smul, Category.comp_id]

name: DG.DGLinear.smul_id_comp_eq_comp_smul_id
statement:
theorem smul_id_comp_eq_comp_smul_id {X Y : C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (r • 𝟙 X) ≫ f = f ≫ (r • 𝟙 Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_id_comp, comp_smul_id]

name: DG.DGLinear.smul_id_mem
statement: theorem smul_id_mem (r : R) (X : C) : r • 𝟙 X ∈ grading (M := X ⟶ X) 0
proof:
:=
  smul_mem r (id_mem_grading X)

name: DG.DGLinear.d_smul_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_smul_id (r : R) (X : C) : d (r • 𝟙 X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_smul, d_id, smul_zero]

name: DG.DGLinear.int
statement:
theorem DGLinear.int (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ X Y : C, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] : DGLinear ℤ C where
  smul_mem' r _ hf
proof:
:= zsmul_mem hf r
  d_smul' r f := d_zsmul r f

name: DG.SingleObj.smul_def
statement: theorem smul_def {X Y : SingleObj A} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) : r • f = (r • (f : A) : A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.SingleObj.smul_id_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem smul_id_eq_algebraMap (r : R) :
    (r • 𝟙 (SingleObj.star A) : SingleObj.star A ⟶ SingleObj.star A) = algebraMap R A r
proof:
:=
  (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one r).symm

name: DG.CatSubmodule.decompose_mem
statement:
theorem decompose_mem {X : C} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ S.carrier X) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := M.obj X)) m n : M.obj X) ∈ S.carrier X
proof:
:=
  S.decompose_mem' hm n

name: DG.CatSubmodule.d_mem
statement: theorem d_mem {X : C} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ S.carrier X) : d m ∈ S.carrier X
proof:
:=
  S.d_mem' hm

name: DG.CatSubmodule.smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_mem {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ S.carrier X) :
    f • m ∈ S.carrier Y
proof:
:=
  S.smul_mem' f hm

name: DG.CatSubmodule.coe_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_smul {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : S.toCatModule.obj X) :
    (f • m : S.toCatModule.obj Y).1 = f • m.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatSubmodule.coe_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_d {X : C} (m : S.toCatModule.obj X) :
    (d m : S.toCatModule.obj X).1 = d m.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatSubmodule.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {X : C} {n : ℤ} {m : S.toCatModule.obj X} :
    m ∈ grading n ↔ m.1 ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.CatSubmodule.subtype_injective
statement: theorem subtype_injective (X : C) : Function.Injective (S.subtype.app X)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.val_injective

name: DG.CatSubmodule.codRestrict_comp_subtype
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codRestrict_comp_subtype {N : CatModule.{w} C} (φ : N ⟶ M)
    (h : ∀ X (m : N.obj X), φ.app X m ∈ S.carrier X) : codRestrict φ h ≫ S.subtype = φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatSubmodule.mkQ_surjective
statement: theorem mkQ_surjective (X : C) : Function.Surjective (S.mkQ.app X)
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: DG.CatSubmodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mkQ_eq_zero_iff {X : C} {m : M.obj X} : S.mkQ.app X m = 0 ↔ m ∈ S.carrier X
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff m

name: DG.CatSubmodule.mkQ_comp_liftQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkQ_comp_liftQ {N : CatModule.{w} C} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ X, ∀ m ∈ S.carrier X, φ.app X m = 0) : S.mkQ ≫ liftQ φ h = φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatSubmodule.quotient_hom_ext
statement:
theorem quotient_hom_ext {N : CatModule.{w} C} {φ ψ : S.quotient ⟶ N}
    (h : S.mkQ ≫ φ = S.mkQ ≫ ψ) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun X y => by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := S.mkQ_surjective X y
    exact congrArg (fun χ : M ⟶ N => χ.app X m) h

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.mem_ker
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ker {X : C} {m : M.obj X} : m ∈ (ker φ).carrier X ↔ φ.app X m = 0
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.mem_ker

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.mem_range
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_range {X : C} {n : N.obj X} : n ∈ (range φ).carrier X ↔ ∃ m, φ.app X m = n
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.mem_range

name: DG.comp_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_units_smul {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (u : ℤˣ) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    f ≫ (u • g) = u • (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, Preadditive.comp_zsmul]

name: DG.units_smul_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem units_smul_comp {X Y Z : C} (u : ℤˣ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (u • f) ≫ g = u • (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, Preadditive.zsmul_comp]

name: DG.comp_mem_grading
statement:
theorem comp_mem_grading {X Y Z : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hg : g ∈ grading j) : f ≫ g ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  DGCategory.comp_mem' hf hg

name: DG.id_mem_grading
statement: theorem id_mem_grading (X : C) : 𝟙 X ∈ grading (M := X ⟶ X) 0
proof:
:=
  DGCategory.id_mem' X

name: DG.d_comp
statement:
theorem d_comp {X Y Z : C} {j : ℤ} (f : X ⟶ Y) {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hg : g ∈ grading j) :
    d (f ≫ g) = f ≫ d g + koszulSign j • (d f ≫ g)
proof:
:=
  DGCategory.d_comp' f hg

name: DG.d_comp_of_even
statement:
theorem d_comp_of_even {X Y Z : C} {j : ℤ} (f : X ⟶ Y) {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hg : g ∈ grading j)
    (hj : Even j) : d (f ≫ g) = f ≫ d g + d f ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_comp f hg, koszulSign_even hj, one_smul]

name: DG.d_comp_of_odd
statement:
theorem d_comp_of_odd {X Y Z : C} {j : ℤ} (f : X ⟶ Y) {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hg : g ∈ grading j)
    (hj : Odd j) : d (f ≫ g) = f ≫ d g - d f ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_comp f hg, koszulSign_odd hj, Units.neg_smul, one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.d_comp_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem d_comp_of_mem_zero {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hg : g ∈ grading 0) :
    d (f ≫ g) = f ≫ d g + d f ≫ g
proof:
:=
  d_comp_of_even f hg Even.zero

name: DG.d_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_id (X : C) : d (𝟙 X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := d_comp (𝟙 X) (id_mem_grading X)
  rw [Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, koszulSign_zero, one_smul] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: DG.d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_left
statement:
theorem d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_left {X Y Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : d f = 0) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    d (f ≫ g) = f ≫ d g
proof:
:= by
  induction g using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous g => rw [d_comp f g.2, hf, Limits.zero_comp, smul_zero, add_zero]
  | h_add g g' hg hg' => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, d_add, hg, hg', d_add, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: DG.d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_right
statement:
theorem d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_right {X Y Z : C} {j : ℤ} (f : X ⟶ Y) {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (hg : g ∈ grading j) (hdg : d g = 0) : d (f ≫ g) = koszulSign j • (d f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_comp f hg, hdg, Limits.comp_zero, zero_add]

name: DG.d_comp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem d_comp_eq_zero {X Y Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hf : d f = 0) (hg : d g = 0) :
    d (f ≫ g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_left hf, hg, Limits.comp_zero]

name: DG.decompose_comp_left
statement:
theorem decompose_comp_left {X Y Z : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (j : ℤ) :
    (DirectSum.decompose (grading (M := X ⟶ Z)) (f ≫ g) (j + i) : X ⟶ Z) =
      f ≫ (DirectSum.decompose (grading (M := Y ⟶ Z)) g j : Y ⟶ Z)
proof:
:=
  decompose_map (k := i) (Preadditive.leftComp Z f)
    (fun {n _} hg => by rw [add_comm]; exact comp_mem_grading hf hg) g j

name: DG.decompose_comp_right
statement:
theorem decompose_comp_right {X Y Z : C} {j : ℤ} (f : X ⟶ Y) {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hg : g ∈ grading j)
    (i : ℤ) :
    (DirectSum.decompose (grading (M := X ⟶ Z)) (f ≫ g) (i + j) : X ⟶ Z) =
      (DirectSum.decompose (grading (M := X ⟶ Y)) f i : X ⟶ Y) ≫ g
proof:
:=
  decompose_map (k := j) (Preadditive.rightComp X g) (fun hf => comp_mem_grading hf hg) f i

name: DG.id_mem_cocycles
statement: theorem id_mem_cocycles (X : C) : 𝟙 X ∈ cocycles (X ⟶ X) 0

name: DG.comp_mem_cocycles
proof:
:=
  ⟨comp_mem_grading hf.1 hg.1, d_comp_eq_zero hf.2 hg.2⟩

name: DG.comp_mem_coboundaries_left
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨koszulSign j • (h ≫ g), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := comp_mem_grading hh hg.1
    rw [show i - 1 + j = i + j - 1 by ring] at this
    rw [Units.smul_def]
    exact zsmul_mem this _
  · rw [d_units_smul, d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_right h hg.1 hg.2, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add,
      koszulSign_even (by simp), one_smul]

name: DG.comp_mem_coboundaries_right
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨f ≫ h, ?_, d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_left hf.2 h⟩
  have := comp_mem_grading hf.1 hh
  rwa [show i + (j - 1) = i + j - 1 by ring] at this

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.orthogonal_listSum

    rw [map_list_sum, List.map_map]
    refine List.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact (he f hf).1
  · change Preadditive.rightComp X e.val (l.map Idempotent.val).sum = 0
    rw [map_list_sum, List.map_map]

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.IsSimple.exists_inv
statement:
theorem IsSimple.exists_inv {Y : C} {e : Idempotent X} {f : Idempotent Y} (he : e.IsSimple)
    (hf : f.IsSimple) {b : Y ⟶ X} (hb : b ∈ grading 0) (hfb : f.val ≫ b = b)
    (hbe : b ≫ e.val = b) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : X ⟶ Y, c ∈ grading 0 ∧ e.val ≫ c = c ∧ c ≫ f.val = c ∧ b ≫ c = f.val ∧
      c ≫ b = e.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hbg⟩ := hf.2 b hb hfb hb0
  set c := e.val ≫ g ≫ f.val with hc
  have hc0 : c ∈ grading 0 := by
    have := comp_mem_grading e.mem_grading (comp_mem_grading hg f.mem_grading)
    simpa using this
  have hec : e.val ≫ c = c := by rw [hc, e.comp_self_assoc]
  have hcf : c ≫ f.val = c := by rw [hc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, f.comp_self]
  have hbc : b ≫ c = f.val := by
    rw [hc, ← Category.assoc, hbe, ← Category.assoc, hbg, f.comp_self]
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := fun h => hf.1 (by rw [← hbc, h, Limits.comp_zero])
  obtain ⟨g', -, hcg'⟩ := he.2 c hc0 hec hcne
  refine ⟨c, hc0, hec, hcf, hbc, ?_⟩
  calc c ≫ b = c ≫ b ≫ e.val := by rw [hbe]
    _ = c ≫ b ≫ c ≫ g' := by rw [hcg']
    _ = c ≫ g' := by rw [← Category.assoc b, hbc, ← Category.assoc, hcf]
    _ = e.val := hcg'

      (DirectSum.decompose (grading (M := F.obj X ⟶ F.obj Y)) (F.map f) n : F.obj X ⟶ F.obj Y)
proof:
:=
  (decompose_map (k := 0) (F.mapAddHom (X := X) (Y := Y))
    (fun hf => by rw [add_zero]; exact F.map_mem_grading hf) f n).symm.trans
    (by rw [add_zero]; rfl)

proof:

  change F.map f.hom - F.map g.hom ∈ _

theorem dgRing_of_dgCategory [DGCategory (SingleObj A)] : DGRing A where
  one_mem
proof:

  mul_mem i j a b ha hb := by
    rw [add_comm]
    exact comp_mem_grading (X := SingleObj.star A) (Y := SingleObj.star A)
      (Z := SingleObj.star A) hb ha
  d_mul' {_ a} ha b := d_comp (X := SingleObj.star A) (Y := SingleObj.star A)
    (Z := SingleObj.star A) b ha

name: DG.DGModuleHom.isAcyclic_ker
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.isAcyclic_ker (p : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (hq : p.IsQuasiIso) : IsAcyclic p.ker
proof:
:= by
  refine isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun n z hz hdz => ?_
  have hz' : (z : M) ∈ grading n := hz
  have hdz' : d (z : M) = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hdz
  have hpz : p z = 0 := z.2
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := (cohomology.map_injective_iff p n).mp (hq n).1 _ hz' hdz'
    ⟨0, zero_mem _, by rw [d_zero, hpz]⟩
  have hdpm : d (p m) = 0 := by rw [← p.map_d, hdm, hpz]
  obtain ⟨m', hm', hdm', y, hy, hdy⟩ := (cohomology.map_surjective_iff p (n - 1)).mp
    (hq (n - 1)).2 (p m) (p.map_mem hm) hdpm
  obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := p.exists_mem_grading_of_surjective hp hy
  refine ⟨⟨m - m' + d y', ?_⟩, ?_, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  · change p (m - m' + d y') = 0
    rw [map_add, map_sub, p.map_d, hdy]
    abel
  · change m - m' + d y' ∈ grading (n - 1)
    exact add_mem (sub_mem hm hm') (by simpa using d_mem hy')
  · change d (m - m' + d y') = z
    rw [d_add, d_sub, hdm, hdm', d_d, sub_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.HasLiftingProperty.isKProjective
statement:
theorem HasLiftingProperty.isKProjective (h : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P) :
    IsKProjective.{w} A P
proof:
:= by
  intro N _ _ _ _ hN f
  let C := Cone (DGModuleHom.id : Shift (-1) N →ᵈᵍ[A] Shift (-1) N)
  let p : C →ᵈᵍ[A] N :=
    (Shift.shiftNegOneEquiv N).toDGModuleHom.comp (Cone.fstHom DGModuleHom.id)
  have hC : IsContractible A C := Cone.isContractible_id _
  have hp : Function.Surjective p := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨Cone.inlLinear _ ((Shift.shiftNegOneEquiv (A := A) N).symm y), ?_⟩
    simp only [p, DGModuleHom.comp_apply, DGModuleEquiv.coe_toDGModuleHom]
    rw [Cone.fstHom_inlLinear, DGModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hq : p.IsQuasiIso := DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic (A := A) hC.isAcyclic hN p
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h C N p hp hq f
  rw [← hg]
  exact ((hC.homotopic_zero_of_right g).comp_right p).trans
    (Homotopic.of_eq (DGModuleHom.comp_zero p))

name: DG.HasLiftingProperty.isGradedProjective
statement:
theorem HasLiftingProperty.isGradedProjective (h : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P) :
    IsGradedProjective.{w} A P
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p hp f
  let q : Cone (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) →ᵈᵍ[A] Cone (DGModuleHom.id : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :=
    Cone.map p p rfl
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hp ((Cone.fst _).1 y)
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hp (Cone.snd _ y)
    refine ⟨Cone.inl _ a + Cone.inr _ b, Cone.ext_to ?_ ?_⟩
    · simp [q, ha]
    · simp [q, hb]
  have hqq : q.IsQuasiIso := DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic
    (Cone.isContractible_id M).isAcyclic (Cone.isContractible_id N).isAcyclic q
  let α : Cocycle A P N 1 := Cocycle.mk (-δ 0 1 f) 2 (by norm_num) (by rw [δ_neg, δ_δ, neg_zero])
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := h _ _ q hq hqq (Cone.lift DGModuleHom.id α f (by
    ext x
    simp [α]))
  refine ⟨(Cone.snd _).comp (Cochain.ofHom G) (zero_add 0), Cochain.ext fun x => ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ => Cone.snd _ (φ x)) hG
  simpa [q] using h1

name: DG.IsKProjective.hasLiftingProperty
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.hasLiftingProperty (hK : IsKProjective.{w} A P)
    (hG : IsGradedProjective.{w} A P) : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p hp hq f
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := hG M N p hp (Cochain.ofHom f)
  have hpg : ∀ x, p (g₀ x) = f x := fun x => congrArg (fun c : Cochain A P N 0 => c x) hg₀
  have hmem : ∀ x, δ 0 1 g₀ x ∈ p.ker := fun x => by
    change p (δ 0 1 g₀ x) = 0
    rw [δ_zero_cochain_apply, map_sub, p.map_d, hpg, hpg, f.map_d, sub_self]
  have hc₁ : δ 1 2 (Cochain.codRestrict (δ 0 1 g₀) p.ker hmem) = 0 := Cochain.ext fun x =>
    Subtype.ext (by rw [Cochain.coe_δ_codRestrict, δ_δ]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := (hK.isAcyclic_hom (p.isAcyclic_ker hp hq)).exists_δ_eq (zero_add 1) _ hc₁
  have hg : δ 0 1 (g₀ - (Cochain.ofHom p.ker.subtype).comp c₀ (zero_add 0)) = 0 := by
    ext x
    rw [δ_sub, δ_comp_ofHom, hc₀]
    simp
  refine ⟨Cocycle.homOf (Cocycle.mk _ 1 (zero_add 1) hg), DGModuleHom.ext fun x => ?_⟩
  change p (g₀ x - (c₀ x : M)) = f x
  rw [map_sub, hpg, show p (c₀ x : M) = 0 from (c₀ x).2, sub_zero]

name: DG.hasLiftingProperty_iff
statement:
theorem hasLiftingProperty_iff :
    HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P ↔ IsKProjective.{w} A P ∧ IsGradedProjective.{w} A P
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.isKProjective, h.isGradedProjective⟩, fun h => h.1.hasLiftingProperty h.2⟩

name: DG.IsGradedProjective.of_retract
statement:
theorem IsGradedProjective.of_retract (hP : IsGradedProjective.{w} A P) (i : Q →ᵈᵍ[A] P)
    (r : P →ᵈᵍ[A] Q) (hri : r.comp i = DGModuleHom.id) : IsGradedProjective.{w} A Q
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p hp f
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hP M N p hp (f.comp (Cochain.ofHom r) (zero_add 0))
  refine ⟨g.comp (Cochain.ofHom i) (zero_add 0), Cochain.ext fun x => ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A P N 0 => c (i x)) hg
  simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [h, ← DGModuleHom.comp_apply, hri, DGModuleHom.id_apply]

name: DG.IsGradedProjective.of_gradedSplitting
statement:
theorem IsGradedProjective.of_gradedSplitting {F G : Type*} [AddCommGroup F] [DGAddCommGroup F]
    [Module A F] [DGModule A F] [AddCommGroup G] [DGAddCommGroup G] [Module A G] [DGModule A G]
    {i : F →ᵈᵍ[A] G} {p : G →ᵈᵍ[A] Q} (σ : GradedSplitting i p)
    (hF : IsGradedProjective.{w} A F) (hQ : IsGradedProjective.{w} A Q) :
    IsGradedProjective.{w} A G
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ q hq f
  obtain ⟨gF, hgF⟩ := hF M N q hq (f.comp (Cochain.ofHom i) (zero_add 0))
  obtain ⟨gQ, hgQ⟩ := hQ M N q hq (f.comp σ.s (zero_add 0))
  refine ⟨gF.comp σ.r (zero_add 0) + gQ.comp (Cochain.ofHom p) (zero_add 0),
    Cochain.ext fun x => ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A F N 0 => c (σ.r x)) hgF
  have h2 := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A Q N 0 => c (p x)) hgQ
  simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply] at h1 h2
  simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, Cochain.add_apply, map_add, h1, h2]
  rw [← map_add, σ.i_r_add_s_p]

name: DG.SemiFreeFiltration.isGradedProjective
statement: theorem isGradedProjective : IsGradedProjective.{w} A P
proof:
:= by
  intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p hp f
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Cochain.exists_of_filtration S.mono S.exists_mem
    (fun i => {g : Cochain A (S.F i) M 0 | (Cochain.ofHom p).comp g (zero_add 0) =
      f.comp (Cochain.ofHom (S.F i).subtype) (zero_add 0)})
    ⟨0, Cochain.ext fun x => by simp [S.eq_zero_of_mem_zero x x.2]⟩
    (fun i g hg => by
      obtain ⟨gQ, hgQ⟩ := Cochain.exists_lift_directSum_shift (S.deg i) p hp
        ((f.comp (Cochain.ofHom (S.F (i + 1)).subtype) (zero_add 0)).comp
          (S.gradedSplitting i).s (zero_add 0))
      refine ⟨g.comp (S.gradedSplitting i).r (zero_add 0) +
        gQ.comp (Cochain.ofHom (S.π i)) (zero_add 0), Cochain.ext fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
      · have h1 := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A (S.F i) N 0 => c ((S.gradedSplitting i).r x)) hg
        have h2 := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A _ N 0 => c (S.π i x)) hgQ
        have h3 := congrArg (fun y : S.F (i + 1) => (y : P))
          ((S.gradedSplitting i).i_r_add_s_p x)
        simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, DGSubmodule.subtype_apply] at h1 h2
        simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, Cochain.add_apply, map_add, h1, h2,
          DGSubmodule.subtype_apply]
        simp only [DGSubmodule.coe_add, DGSubmodule.coe_inclusion_apply] at h3
        rw [← map_add, h3]
      · simp [(S.gradedSplitting i).r_i, (S.gradedSplitting i).p_i])
  refine ⟨g, Cochain.ext fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := S.exists_mem x
  exact congrArg (fun c : Cochain A (S.F i) N 0 => c ⟨x, hi⟩) (hg i)

name: DG.SemiFreeFiltration.hasLiftingProperty
statement: theorem hasLiftingProperty : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P
proof:
:=
  S.isKProjective.hasLiftingProperty S.isGradedProjective

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.isGradedProjective_F
statement: theorem isGradedProjective_F {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ C.length) : IsGradedProjective.{w} A (C.F i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p hp f
    refine ⟨0, Cochain.ext fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [show x = 0 from Subtype.ext (C.eq_zero_of_mem_zero x x.2), map_zero, map_zero]
  | succ i ih =>
    refine IsGradedProjective.of_gradedSplitting (C.gradedSplitting ⟨i, hi⟩) (ih (by omega)) ?_
    intro M N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p hp f
    exact Cochain.exists_lift_shift_leftCorner _ p hp _ f

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.isGradedProjective
statement: theorem isGradedProjective : IsGradedProjective.{w} A P
proof:
:=
  (C.isGradedProjective_F le_rfl).of_retract (DGSubmodule.codRestrict DGModuleHom.id C.mem_length)
    (C.F C.length).subtype (DGSubmodule.subtype_comp_codRestrict _ _)

name: DG.FiniteCellFiltration.hasLiftingProperty
statement: theorem hasLiftingProperty : HasLiftingProperty.{w} A P
proof:
:=
  C.isKProjective.hasLiftingProperty C.isGradedProjective

name: DG.DegreeZero.complexFunctor_map_f_apply

theorem complexFunctor_map_f_apply (f : M ⟶ N) (i : ℤ) (x : gradingSubmodule S M i) :

proof: := rfl

name: DG.DegreeZero.complexFunctor_obj_d_apply
statement:
theorem complexFunctor_obj_d_apply (M : DGModuleCat.{v} S) {i j : ℤ} (h : i + 1 = j)
    (x : gradingSubmodule S M i) :
    ((((complexFunctor S).obj M).d i j).hom x).1 = d (x : M)
proof:
