name: DG.Cochain.map_smul_of_degree_zero
statement:
theorem map_smul_of_degree_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (z : Cochain A M N 0) (a : A) (x : M) : z (a • x) = a • z x
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rw [z.map_smul a.2, zero_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul, map_add, ha, ha', add_smul]

name: DG.Cochain.eq_ofElement
statement:
theorem eq_ofElement {k : ℤ} (z : Cochain A A N k) :
    z = ofElement (z 1) (by simpa using z.map_mem (one_mem_grading (A := A)))
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [ofElement_apply]
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    have h := z.map_smul a.2 (1 : A)
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
    rw [h, Shift.twist_of_mem a.2, smul_assoc, mul_comm]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [map_add, ha, ha', map_add, add_smul]

name: DG.Cochain.ofHom_eq_ofElement
statement:
theorem ofHom_eq_ofElement (f : A →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    ofHom f = ofElement (f 1) (f.map_mem (one_mem_grading (A := A)))
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [ofHom_apply, ofElement_apply, Shift.twist_zero, ← _root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: DG.Cochain.δ_ofElement
statement:
theorem δ_ofElement (k m : ℤ) (hkm : k + 1 = m) (y : N) (hy : y ∈ grading k)
    (hdy : d y ∈ grading m) : δ k m (ofElement (A := A) y hy) = ofElement (d y) hdy
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i i
    subst hkm
    rw [δ_apply _ _ rfl, ofElement_apply, ofElement_apply, ofElement_apply,
      Shift.twist_of_mem ha, Shift.twist_of_mem (d_mem ha), Shift.twist_of_mem ha, smul_assoc,
      smul_assoc, smul_assoc, d_units_smul, d_smul ha, smul_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
    have e1 : koszulSign k * koszulSign (k * (i + 1)) = koszulSign (k * i) := by
      rw [← koszulSign_add]; exact koszulSign_eq_of_sub_eq_two_mul k (by ring)
    have e2 : koszulSign (k * i) * koszulSign i = koszulSign ((k + 1) * i) := by
      rw [← koszulSign_add]; congr 1; ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    abel
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [map_add, ha, ha', map_add]

name: DG.isKProjective_self
statement: theorem isKProjective_self : IsKProjective.{w} A A
proof:
:= by
  intro N _ _ _ _ hN f
  have hf1 : f 1 ∈ grading 0 := f.map_mem (one_mem_grading (A := A))
  have h1 : d (f 1) = 0 := by rw [← f.map_d, d_one, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy⟩ := hN.exists_d_eq hf1 h1
  have hy' : y ∈ grading (-1) := by simpa using hy
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨Cochain.ofElement y hy', ?_⟩
  rw [Cochain.δ_ofElement (-1) 0 (neg_add_cancel 1) y hy' (hdy ▸ hf1),
    Cochain.ofHom_eq_ofElement]
  exact Cochain.ofElement_congr hdy.symm _ _

name: DG.IsKProjective.of_retract
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_retract (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) (i : Q →ᵈᵍ[A] P)
    (r : P →ᵈᵍ[A] Q) (hri : Homotopic (r.comp i) DGModuleHom.id) : IsKProjective.{w} A Q
proof:
:= by
  intro N _ _ _ _ hN f
  have h1 : Homotopic ((f.comp r).comp i) 0 :=
    ((hP N hN (f.comp r)).comp_left i).trans (Homotopic.of_eq (DGModuleHom.zero_comp i))
  exact (hri.comp_right f).symm.trans h1

name: DG.IsKProjective.of_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_dgHomotopyEquiv (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P)
    (e : DGHomotopyEquiv A Q P) : IsKProjective.{w} A Q
proof:
:=
  hP.of_retract e.hom e.inv e.homotopyHomInvId.homotopic

name: DG.IsKProjective.of_dgModuleEquiv
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_dgModuleEquiv (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) (e : Q ≃ᵈᵍ[A] P) :
    IsKProjective.{w} A Q
proof:
:=
  hP.of_retract e.toDGModuleHom e.symm.toDGModuleHom
    (Homotopic.of_eq (DGModuleHom.ext fun x => e.symm_apply_apply x))

name: DG.IsContractible.isAcyclic
statement: theorem IsContractible.isAcyclic (hP : IsContractible A P) : IsAcyclic P
proof:
:=
  hP.subsingleton_cohomology

name: DG.IsContractible.isKProjective
statement: theorem IsContractible.isKProjective (hP : IsContractible A P) : IsKProjective.{w} A P
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ f => hP.homotopic_zero_of_left f

name: DG.IsKProjective.shift
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.shift [DGRing A] (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) (k : ℤ) :
    IsKProjective.{w} A (Shift k P)
proof:
:= by
  intro N _ _ _ _ hN f
  have hz : δ (-k) (-k + 1) ((Cochain.ofHom f).leftUnshift (-k) (neg_add_cancel k)) = 0 := by
    rw [Cochain.δ_leftUnshift _ (-k) _ (-k + 1) 1 (by ring), δ_ofHom, Cochain.leftUnshift_zero,
      smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (hP.isAcyclic_hom hN).exists_δ_eq (m := -k - 1) (by ring) _ hz
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨koszulSign k • y.leftShift k (-1) (by ring), ?_⟩
  rw [δ_units_smul, Cochain.δ_leftShift y k (-1) 0 (by ring) (-k) (neg_add_cancel k), hy,
    smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, Cochain.leftShift_leftUnshift]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.leftCornerInclusion_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftCornerInclusion_apply (a : e.LeftCorner) : e.leftCornerInclusion a = a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.coe_leftCornerProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_leftCornerProjection_apply (a : A) :
    (e.leftCornerProjection a : A) = a * e.val
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.leftCornerProjection_comp_inclusion
statement:
theorem leftCornerProjection_comp_inclusion :
    e.leftCornerProjection.comp e.leftCornerInclusion = DGModuleHom.id
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext fun a => Subtype.ext a.2

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isKProjective_leftCorner
statement: theorem isKProjective_leftCorner : IsKProjective.{w} A e.LeftCorner
proof:
:=
  (isKProjective_self A).of_retract e.leftCornerInclusion e.leftCornerProjection
    (Homotopic.of_eq e.leftCornerProjection_comp_inclusion)

name: DG.Cochain.directSumDesc_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem directSumDesc_of {n : ℤ} (c : ∀ i, Cochain A (P i) N n) (i : ι) (x : P i) :
    directSumDesc c (DirectSum.of P i x) = c i x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ i x

name: DG.Cochain.directSum_ext
statement:
theorem directSum_ext {n : ℤ} {c c' : Cochain A (⨁ i, P i) N n}
    (h : ∀ i x, c (DirectSum.of P i x) = c' (DirectSum.of P i x)) : c = c'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of i x => exact h i x
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.IsKProjective.directSum
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.directSum (h : ∀ i, IsKProjective.{w} A (P i)) :
    IsKProjective.{w} A (⨁ i, P i)
proof:
:= by
  intro N _ _ _ _ hN f
  choose c hc using fun i => homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp
    (h i N hN (f.comp (DGModuleHom.lof A P i)))
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨Cochain.directSumDesc c, Cochain.directSum_ext
    fun i x => ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A (P i) N 0 => z x)
    (δ_ofHom_comp (DGModuleHom.lof A P i) (Cochain.directSumDesc c) 0)
  have h2 : (Cochain.directSumDesc c).comp (Cochain.ofHom (DGModuleHom.lof A P i))
      (zero_add _) = c i := Cochain.ext fun y => Cochain.directSumDesc_of c i y
  simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, DGModuleHom.lof_apply, h2] at h1
  rw [Cochain.ofHom_apply, ← h1, ← hc i]
  rfl

name: DG.GradedSplitting.p_i
statement: theorem p_i (x : F) : p (i x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := σ.i_r_add_s_p (i x)
  rw [σ.r_i, add_eq_left] at h
  rw [← σ.p_s (p (i x)), h, map_zero]

name: DG.GradedSplitting.exists_extension
statement:
theorem exists_extension {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
    [DGModule A N] (hQ : ∀ g : Q →ᵈᵍ[A] N, Homotopic g 0) (f : G →ᵈᵍ[A] N)
    (h : Cochain A F N (-1)) (hh : Cochain.ofHom (f.comp i) = δ (-1) 0 h) :
    ∃ h' : Cochain A G N (-1), Cochain.ofHom f = δ (-1) 0 h' ∧ ∀ x, h' (i x) = h x
proof:
:= by
  set hr : Cochain A G N (-1) := h.comp σ.r (zero_add _)
  set g : Cochain A G N 0 := Cochain.ofHom f - δ (-1) 0 hr with hg
  have e1 : hr.comp (Cochain.ofHom i) (zero_add _) = h :=
    Cochain.ext fun x => by simp [hr, σ.r_i]
  have hg_i : ∀ x, g (i x) = 0 := fun x => by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A F N 0 => z x) (δ_ofHom_comp i hr 0)
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A F N 0 => z x) hh
    simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, e1, DGModuleHom.comp_apply] at h1 h2
    simp only [hg, Cochain.sub_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, h1, h2, sub_self]
  have hg_d : ∀ x, d (g x) = g (d x) := fun x => by
    have h1 : δ 0 1 g = 0 := by rw [hg, δ_sub, δ_ofHom, δ_δ, sub_zero]
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A G N 1 => z x) h1
    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using h2
  have hgs : δ 0 1 (g.comp σ.s (zero_add 0)) = 0 := by
    ext y
    have hp : p (d (σ.s y) - σ.s (d y)) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, p.map_d, σ.p_s, σ.p_s, sub_self]
    have hx := σ.i_r_add_s_p (d (σ.s y) - σ.s (d y))
    rw [hp, map_zero, add_zero] at hx
    rw [δ_zero_cochain_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, hg_d, ← map_sub, ← hx,
      hg_i, Cochain.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp
    (hQ (Cocycle.homOf (Cocycle.mk _ 1 (zero_add 1) hgs)))
  rw [Cocycle.cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe, Cocycle.mk_coe] at hk
  refine ⟨hr + k.comp (Cochain.ofHom p) (zero_add _), ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · ext x
    have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A G N 0 => z x) (δ_ofHom_comp p k 0)
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A Q N 0 => z (p x)) hk
    simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply] at h1 h2
    have h3 : g x = g (σ.s (p x)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← σ.i_r_add_s_p x]
      rw [map_add, hg_i, zero_add]
    rw [δ_add, Cochain.add_apply, h1, ← h2, ← h3, hg, Cochain.sub_apply, add_sub_cancel]
  · simp [hr, σ.r_i, σ.p_i]

name: DG.IsKProjective.of_gradedSplitting
proof:
:= by
  intro N _ _ _ _ hN f
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp (hF N hN (f.comp i))
  obtain ⟨h', hh', -⟩ := σ.exists_extension (hQ N hN) f h hh
  exact homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨h', hh'⟩

name: DG.IsKProjective.cone
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.cone {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hM : IsKProjective.{w} A M)
    (hN : IsKProjective.{w} A N) : IsKProjective.{w} A (Cone f)
proof:
:=
  IsKProjective.of_gradedSplitting (Cone.gradedSplitting f) hN (hM.shift 1)

name: DG.cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_injective_iff
statement:
theorem cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_injective_iff (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom φ hmem hd n) ↔
      ∀ x ∈ grading n, d x = 0 → φ x ∈ coboundaries N n → x ∈ coboundaries M n
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx hdx hφx
    refine (cohomology.mkOf_eq_zero_iff hx hdx).mp (h _ ?_)
    rw [cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mkOf, cohomology.mkOf_eq_zero_iff]
    exact hφx
  · intro h c hc
    induction c using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z =>
      rw [cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mk, cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff] at hc
      exact (cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff z).mpr (h z z.2.1 z.2.2 hc)

name: DG.cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_surjective_iff (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Surjective (cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom φ hmem hd n) ↔
      ∀ y ∈ grading n, d y = 0 → ∃ x ∈ grading n, d x = 0 ∧ φ x - y ∈ coboundaries N n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h y hy hdy
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h (cohomology.mkOf hy hdy)
    induction c using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z =>
      rw [cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mk, cohomology.mkOf_eq_mk, cohomology.mk_eq_mk_iff] at hc
      exact ⟨z, z.2.1, z.2.2, hc⟩
  · intro h c
    induction c using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, hxy⟩ := h z z.2.1 z.2.2
      refine ⟨cohomology.mkOf hx hdx, ?_⟩
      rw [cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mkOf, cohomology.mkOf_eq_mk]
      exact cohomology.mk_eq_mk_of_sub_mem hxy

name: DG.cohomology.map_injective_iff
statement:
theorem cohomology.map_injective_iff (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (cohomology.map f n) ↔
      ∀ x ∈ grading n, d x = 0 → f x ∈ coboundaries N n → x ∈ coboundaries M n
proof:
:=
  cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_injective_iff _ _ _ n

name: DG.cohomology.map_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem cohomology.map_surjective_iff (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Surjective (cohomology.map f n) ↔
      ∀ y ∈ grading n, d y = 0 → ∃ x ∈ grading n, d x = 0 ∧ f x - y ∈ coboundaries N n
proof:
:=
  cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_surjective_iff _ _ _ n

name: DG.DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic (hM : IsAcyclic M) (hN : IsAcyclic N)
    (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : f.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= fun n =>
  ⟨fun _ _ _ => (hM n).elim _ _, fun _ => ⟨0, (hN n).elim _ _⟩⟩

name: DG.DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.isAcyclic_cone
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.isAcyclic_cone {s : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hs : s.IsQuasiIso) :
    IsAcyclic (Cone s)
proof:
:= by
  refine isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun k p hp hdp => ?_
  have hx : (Cone.fst s).1 p ∈ grading (k + 1) := (Cone.fst s).1.map_mem hp
  have hy : Cone.snd s p ∈ grading k := by simpa using (Cone.snd s).map_mem hp
  have hdx : d ((Cone.fst s).1 p) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (Cone.fst s).1 hdp
    rwa [Cone.d_fst_apply, map_zero, neg_eq_zero] at h
  have hsxy : s ((Cone.fst s).1 p) + d (Cone.snd s p) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (Cone.snd s) hdp
    rwa [Cone.d_snd_apply, map_zero] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hdu⟩ := (cohomology.map_injective_iff s (k + 1)).mp (hs (k + 1)).1 _ hx hdx
    ⟨-Cone.snd s p, by simpa using neg_mem hy,
      by rw [d_neg, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm, hsxy]⟩
  have hu' : u ∈ grading k := by simpa using hu
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw, v, hv, hdv⟩ := (cohomology.map_surjective_iff s k).mp (hs k).2
    (Cone.snd s p + s u) (add_mem hy (s.map_mem hu'))
    (by rw [d_add, ← s.map_d, hdu, add_comm, hsxy])
  refine ⟨Cone.inl s (w - u) + Cone.inr s (-v), add_mem ?_ ((Cone.inr s).map_mem (neg_mem hv)), ?_⟩
  · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using (Cone.inl s).map_mem (sub_mem hw hu')
  · refine Cone.ext_to ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Cone.d_fst_apply, map_add, Cone.inl_fst_apply, Cone.inr_fst_apply, add_zero,
        d_sub, hdw, hdu, zero_sub, neg_neg, d_zero, neg_zero]
    · simp only [Cone.d_snd_apply, map_add, Cone.inl_fst_apply, Cone.inr_fst_apply,
        Cone.inl_snd_apply, Cone.inr_snd_apply, add_zero, zero_add, d_neg, hdv, map_sub,
        map_zero]
      abel

name: DG.DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic_cone
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic_cone {s : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (h : IsAcyclic (Cone s)) :
    s.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  constructor
  · rw [cohomology.map_injective_iff]
    rintro x hx hdx ⟨v, hv, hdv⟩
    have hp : Cone.inl s x + Cone.inr s (-v) ∈ grading (n - 1) :=
      add_mem (by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using (Cone.inl s).map_mem hx)
        ((Cone.inr s).map_mem (neg_mem hv))
    have hdp : d (Cone.inl s x + Cone.inr s (-v)) = 0 := by
      refine Cone.ext_to ?_ ?_
      · simp only [Cone.d_fst_apply, map_add, Cone.inl_fst_apply, Cone.inr_fst_apply, add_zero,
          hdx, neg_zero, map_zero]
      · simp only [Cone.d_snd_apply, map_add, Cone.inl_fst_apply, Cone.inr_fst_apply,
          Cone.inl_snd_apply, Cone.inr_snd_apply, add_zero, zero_add, d_neg, hdv, add_neg_cancel,
          map_zero]
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hdq⟩ := h.exists_d_eq hp hdp
    refine ⟨-(Cone.fst s).1 q, by simpa using neg_mem ((Cone.fst s).1.map_mem hq), ?_⟩
    have h1 := congrArg (Cone.fst s).1 hdq
    rw [Cone.d_fst_apply, map_add, Cone.inl_fst_apply, Cone.inr_fst_apply, add_zero] at h1
    rw [d_neg, h1]
  · rw [cohomology.map_surjective_iff]
    intro y hy hdy
    have hdp : d (Cone.inr s y) = 0 := by rw [Cone.inr_d_apply, hdy, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hdq⟩ := h.exists_d_eq ((Cone.inr s).map_mem hy) hdp
    have h1 := congrArg (Cone.fst s).1 hdq
    have h2 := congrArg (Cone.snd s) hdq
    rw [Cone.d_fst_apply, Cone.inr_fst_apply, neg_eq_zero] at h1
    rw [Cone.d_snd_apply, Cone.inr_snd_apply] at h2
    refine ⟨(Cone.fst s).1 q, by simpa using (Cone.fst s).1.map_mem hq, h1,
      -Cone.snd s q, by simpa using neg_mem ((Cone.snd s).map_mem hq), ?_⟩
    rw [d_neg, ← h2]
    abel

name: DG.DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_iff_isAcyclic_cone
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_iff_isAcyclic_cone (s : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    s.IsQuasiIso ↔ IsAcyclic (Cone s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hs => hs.isAcyclic_cone, isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic_cone⟩

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.postcomp_of
statement:
theorem postcomp_of (s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N') (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain A P N n) :
    postcomp A P s (DirectSum.of _ n z) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A P N' n) n ((Cochain.ofHom s).comp z (add_zero n))
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.postcomp_mem
statement:
theorem postcomp_mem (s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N') {n : ℤ} {x : HOM A P N} (hx : x ∈ grading n) :
    postcomp A P s x ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := mem_summand.mp hx
  rw [postcomp_of]
  exact of_mem_summand _ _

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.postcomp_d
statement:
theorem postcomp_d (s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N') (x : HOM A P N) :
    postcomp A P s (d x) = d (postcomp A P s x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n z => rw [d_of, postcomp_of, postcomp_of, d_of, δ_comp_ofHom]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.of_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem of_mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : HOM A P N} :
    x ∈ grading n ↔ ∃ z : Cochain A P N n, DirectSum.of _ n z = x
proof:
:=
  mem_summand

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.d_of_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem d_of_eq_zero_iff {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain A P N n) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A P N n) n z : HOM A P N) = 0 ↔ δ n (n + 1) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_of, ← map_zero (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A P N n) (n + 1))]
  exact (DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun n => Cochain A P N n) (n + 1)).eq_iff

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.of_mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem of_mem_coboundaries_iff {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain A P N n) (hz : δ n (n + 1) z = 0) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A P N n) n z : HOM A P N) ∈ coboundaries (HOM A P N) n ↔
      ∃ y : Cochain A P N (n - 1), δ (n - 1) n y = z
proof:
:=
  (cocyclesAddEquiv_mem_coboundaries_iff n (Cocycle.mk z (n + 1) rfl hz)).trans
    (Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff (n - 1) (sub_add_cancel n 1) _)

name: DG.DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompHomotopy_mk (s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N') (f : P →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    postcompHomotopy P s (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (s.comp f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.IsKProjective.exists_cocycle_of_isQuasiIso
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_cocycle_of_isQuasiIso {N N' : Type w} [AddCommGroup N]
    [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [DGModule A N] [AddCommGroup N'] [DGAddCommGroup N']
    [Module A N'] [DGModule A N'] (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) {s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N'}
    (hs : s.IsQuasiIso) {n m : ℤ} (hmn : m + 1 = n) (z' : Cochain A P N' n)
    (hz' : δ n (n + 1) z' = 0) :
    ∃ (α : Cochain A P N n) (β : Cochain A P N' m), δ n (n + 1) α = 0 ∧
      (Cochain.ofHom s).comp α (add_zero n) = z' - δ m n β
proof:
:= by
  have hC := hP.isAcyclic_hom hs.isAcyclic_cone
  have hw0 : δ n (n + 1) ((Cochain.ofHom (Cone.inr s)).comp z' (add_zero n)) = 0 := by
    rw [δ_comp_ofHom, hz', Cochain.comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hC.exists_δ_eq hmn _ hw0
  have hw' : w = Cone.liftCochain s ((Cone.fst s).1.comp w hmn) ((Cone.snd s).comp w
      (add_zero m)) hmn :=
    Cochain.ext fun x => Cone.ext_to (by simp) (by simp)
  rw [hw', Cone.δ_liftCochain s _ _ hmn (n + 1) rfl] at hw
  refine ⟨(Cone.fst s).1.comp w hmn, (Cone.snd s).comp w (add_zero m), ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext x
    have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A P (Cone s) n => (Cone.fst s).1 (c x)) hw
    simpa using h
  · ext x
    have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A P (Cone s) n => Cone.snd s (c x)) hw
    simp only [Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.neg_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
      map_add, map_neg, Cone.inl_snd_apply, Cone.inr_snd_apply, neg_zero, zero_add] at h
    rw [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, Cochain.sub_apply, ← h]
    abel

name: DG.IsKProjective.exists_δ_eq_of_isQuasiIso
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_δ_eq_of_isQuasiIso {N N' : Type w} [AddCommGroup N]
    [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [DGModule A N] [AddCommGroup N'] [DGAddCommGroup N']
    [Module A N'] [DGModule A N'] (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) {s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N'}
    (hs : s.IsQuasiIso) {n m : ℤ} (hmn : m + 1 = n) (z : Cochain A P N n)
    (hz : δ n (n + 1) z = 0) (y' : Cochain A P N' m)
    (hy' : (Cochain.ofHom s).comp z (add_zero n) = δ m n y') :
    ∃ y : Cochain A P N m, δ m n y = z
proof:
:= by
  subst hmn
  have hC := hP.isAcyclic_hom hs.isAcyclic_cone
  have hw : δ m (m + 1) (Cone.liftCochain s z (-y') rfl) = 0 := by
    rw [Cone.δ_liftCochain s _ _ rfl (m + 1 + 1) rfl, hz, δ_neg, hy', neg_add_cancel,
      Cochain.comp_zero, Cochain.comp_zero, neg_zero, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hC.exists_δ_eq (sub_add_cancel m 1) _ hw
  have hu' : u = Cone.liftCochain s ((Cone.fst s).1.comp u (sub_add_cancel m 1))
      ((Cone.snd s).comp u (add_zero _)) (sub_add_cancel m 1) :=
    Cochain.ext fun x => Cone.ext_to (by simp) (by simp)
  rw [hu', Cone.δ_liftCochain s _ _ (sub_add_cancel m 1) (m + 1) rfl] at hu
  refine ⟨-(Cone.fst s).1.comp u (sub_add_cancel m 1), ?_⟩
  ext x
  have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A P (Cone s) m => (Cone.fst s).1 (c x)) hu
  simp only [Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.neg_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
    map_add, map_neg, Cone.inl_fst_apply, Cone.inr_fst_apply, add_zero,
    Cone.liftCochain_fst_apply] at h
  rw [δ_neg, Cochain.neg_apply, h]

name: DG.IsKProjective.bijective_cohomology_postcomp
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.bijective_cohomology_postcomp {N N' : Type w} [AddCommGroup N]
    [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [DGModule A N] [AddCommGroup N'] [DGAddCommGroup N']
    [Module A N'] [DGModule A N'] (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) {s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N'}
    (hs : s.IsQuasiIso) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom (DGModule.HOM.postcomp A P s)
      (DGModule.HOM.postcomp_mem s) (DGModule.HOM.postcomp_d s) n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_injective_iff]
    intro x hx hdx hsx
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := DGModule.HOM.of_mem_grading_iff.mp hx
    rw [DGModule.HOM.d_of_eq_zero_iff] at hdx
    have hsz : δ n (n + 1) ((Cochain.ofHom s).comp z (add_zero n)) = 0 := by
      rw [δ_comp_ofHom, hdx, Cochain.comp_zero]
    rw [DGModule.HOM.postcomp_of, DGModule.HOM.of_mem_coboundaries_iff _ hsz] at hsx
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hsx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hP.exists_δ_eq_of_isQuasiIso hs (sub_add_cancel n 1) z hdx y' hy'.symm
    exact (DGModule.HOM.of_mem_coboundaries_iff z hdx).mpr ⟨y, hy⟩
  · rw [cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_surjective_iff]
    intro y hy hdy
    obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := DGModule.HOM.of_mem_grading_iff.mp hy
    rw [DGModule.HOM.d_of_eq_zero_iff] at hdy
    obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hαβ⟩ := hP.exists_cocycle_of_isQuasiIso hs (sub_add_cancel n 1) z' hdy
    refine ⟨DirectSum.of _ n α, of_mem_summand _ _, (DGModule.HOM.d_of_eq_zero_iff α).mpr hα, ?_⟩
    rw [DGModule.HOM.postcomp_of, hαβ, ← map_sub, sub_sub_cancel_left,
      DGModule.HOM.of_mem_coboundaries_iff _ (by rw [δ_neg, δ_δ, neg_zero])]
    exact ⟨-β, δ_neg _ _ β⟩

name: DG.IsKProjective.bijective_postcompHomotopy
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.bijective_postcompHomotopy {N N' : Type w} [AddCommGroup N]
    [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [DGModule A N] [AddCommGroup N'] [DGAddCommGroup N']
    [Module A N'] [DGModule A N'] (hP : IsKProjective.{w} A P) {s : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N'}
    (hs : s.IsQuasiIso) : Function.Bijective (DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy P s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro c hc
    induction c using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H f =>
      rw [DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy_mk, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff,
        mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists] at hc
      obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hc
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hP.exists_δ_eq_of_isQuasiIso hs (neg_add_cancel 1) (Cochain.ofHom f)
        (δ_ofHom _) y' hy'
      exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff f).mpr (mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists.mpr ⟨y, hy.symm⟩)
  · intro c
    induction c using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H f' =>
      obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hαβ⟩ := hP.exists_cocycle_of_isQuasiIso hs (neg_add_cancel 1)
        (Cochain.ofHom f') (δ_ofHom _)
      refine ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk (Cocycle.homOf (Cocycle.mk α 1 (zero_add 1) hα)), ?_⟩
      rw [DGModuleHom.postcompHomotopy_mk, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem,
        mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists]
      refine ⟨-β, ?_⟩
      rw [Cochain.ofHom_sub, Cochain.ofHom_comp, Cocycle.cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe,
        Cocycle.mk_coe, hαβ, δ_neg]
      abel

name: DG.Cone.inl_apply
statement: theorem inl_apply (x : M) : inl f x = inlLinear f (Shift.mk 1 x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.snd_apply
statement: theorem snd_apply (p : Cone f) : snd f p = sndLinear f p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inl_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_snd_apply (x : M) : snd f (inl f x) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inr_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_snd_apply (y : N) : snd f (inr f y) = y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inr_d_apply
statement: theorem inr_d_apply (y : N) : d (inr f y) = inr f (d y)
proof:
:=
  ((inr f).map_d y).symm

name: DG.Cone.inl_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_snd : (snd f).comp (inl f) (add_zero (-1)) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inr_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_snd : (snd f).comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add 0) = Cochain.id A N
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inl_snd_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_snd_assoc {d e g : ℤ} (γ : Cochain A N K d) (he : 0 + d = e) (hg : -1 + e = g) :
    (γ.comp (snd f) he).comp (inl f) hg = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: DG.Cone.inr_snd_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_snd_assoc {d e : ℤ} (γ : Cochain A N K d) (he : 0 + d = e) :
    (γ.comp (snd f) he).comp (ofHom (inr f)) (by rw [← he, zero_add, zero_add]) = γ
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp

name: DG.Cone.fst_apply
statement: theorem fst_apply (p : Cone f) : (fst f).1 p = unmk 1 (fstHom f p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inl_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_fst_apply (x : M) : (fst f).1 (inl f x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inr_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_fst_apply (y : N) : (fst f).1 (inr f y) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.id_X
statement: theorem id_X (p : Cone f) : inl f ((fst f).1 p) + inr f (snd f p) = p
proof:
:=
  inlLinear_fstHom_add_inr_sndLinear p

name: DG.Cone.ext_to
statement:
theorem ext_to {p q : Cone f} (h₁ : (fst f).1 p = (fst f).1 q) (h₂ : snd f p = snd f q) :
    p = q
proof:
:=
  ext h₁ h₂

name: DG.Cone.ext_to_iff
statement: theorem ext_to_iff {p q : Cone f} : p = q ↔ (fst f).1 p = (fst f).1 q ∧ snd f p = snd f q
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, fun h => ext_to h.1 h.2⟩

name: DG.Cone.ext_from
statement:
theorem ext_from {P F : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [FunLike F (Cone f) P]
    [AddMonoidHomClass F (Cone f) P] {g₁ g₂ : F}
    (h₁ : ∀ x, g₁ (inl f x) = g₂ (inl f x)) (h₂ : ∀ y, g₁ (inr f y) = g₂ (inr f y)) :
    g₁ = g₂
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext g₁ g₂ fun p => by rw [← id_X p, map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]

name: DG.Cone.ext_from_iff
statement:
theorem ext_from_iff {P F : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [FunLike F (Cone f) P]
    [AddMonoidHomClass F (Cone f) P] {g₁ g₂ : F} :
    g₁ = g₂ ↔ (∀ x, g₁ (inl f x) = g₂ (inl f x)) ∧ ∀ y, g₁ (inr f y) = g₂ (inr f y)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩, fun h => ext_from h.1 h.2⟩

name: DG.Cone.d_fst_apply
statement: theorem d_fst_apply (p : Cone f) : (fst f).1 (d p) = -d ((fst f).1 p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fst_apply, fst_apply, fstHom_d, unmk_d, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.neg_smul,
    one_smul]

name: DG.Cone.d_snd_apply
statement: theorem d_snd_apply (p : Cone f) : snd f (d p) = f ((fst f).1 p) + d (snd f p)
proof:
:=
  sndLinear_d p

name: DG.Cone.inl_d_apply
statement: theorem inl_d_apply (x : M) : d (inl f x) = inr f (f x) - inl f (d x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_to ?_ ?_
  · rw [d_fst_apply, map_sub, inl_fst_apply, inr_fst_apply, inl_fst_apply, zero_sub]
  · rw [d_snd_apply, map_sub, inl_fst_apply, inl_snd_apply, inr_snd_apply, inl_snd_apply,
      d_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]

name: DG.Cone.inl_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_fst : (fst f).1.comp (inl f) (neg_add_cancel 1) = Cochain.id A M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inr_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_fst : (fst f).1.comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add 1) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inl_fst_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_fst_assoc {d e : ℤ} (γ : Cochain A M K d) (he : 1 + d = e) :
    (γ.comp (fst f).1 he).comp (inl f) (by rw [← he, neg_add_cancel_left]) = γ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inr_fst_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_fst_assoc {d e g : ℤ} (γ : Cochain A M K d) (he : 1 + d = e) (hg : 0 + e = g) :
    (γ.comp (fst f).1 he).comp (ofHom (inr f)) hg = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp

name: DG.Cone.ext_cochain_to_iff
statement:
theorem ext_cochain_to_iff (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + 1 = j) {γ₁ γ₂ : Cochain A K (Cone f) i} :
    γ₁ = γ₂ ↔ (fst f).1.comp γ₁ hij = (fst f).1.comp γ₂ hij ∧
      (snd f).comp γ₁ (add_zero i) = (snd f).comp γ₂ (add_zero i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h ▸ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => Cochain.ext fun x => ext_to ?_ ?_⟩
  · exact congrArg (fun γ : Cochain A K M j => γ x) h₁
  · exact congrArg (fun γ : Cochain A K N i => γ x) h₂

name: DG.Cone.ext_cochain_from_iff
statement:
theorem ext_cochain_from_iff (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + 1 = j) {γ₁ γ₂ : Cochain A (Cone f) K j} :
    γ₁ = γ₂ ↔ γ₁.comp (inl f) (show -1 + j = i by omega) = γ₂.comp (inl f) (by omega) ∧
      γ₁.comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add j) = γ₂.comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h ▸ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => ext_from (fun x => ?_) (fun y => ?_)⟩
  · exact congrArg (fun γ : Cochain A M K i => γ x) h₁
  · exact congrArg (fun γ : Cochain A N K j => γ y) h₂

name: DG.Cone.id
statement:
theorem id :
    (inl f).comp (fst f).1 (add_neg_cancel 1) + (ofHom (inr f)).comp (snd f) (add_zero 0) =
      Cochain.id A (Cone f)
proof:
:=
  Cochain.ext id_X

name: DG.Cone.δ_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_inl : δ (-1) 0 (inl f) = ofHom ((inr f).comp f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [δ_neg_one_apply, inl_d_apply, ofHom_apply, DGModuleHom.comp_apply, sub_add_cancel]

name: DG.Cone.δ_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_snd : δ 0 1 (snd f) = -(ofHom f).comp (fst f).1 (add_zero 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [δ_zero_cochain_apply, d_snd_apply, Cochain.neg_apply, comp_apply, ofHom_apply]
  abel

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_eq
statement: theorem fstHom_eq : fstHom f = Cocycle.homOf ((fst f).rightShift 1 0 (zero_add 1))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.ofHom_fstHom
statement: theorem ofHom_fstHom : ofHom (fstHom f) = (fst f).1.rightShift 1 0 (zero_add 1)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.descCochain_apply
statement:
theorem descCochain_apply (p : Cone f) :
    descCochain f α β h p = α ((fst f).1 p) + β (snd f p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inl_descCochain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_descCochain :
    (descCochain f α β h).comp (inl f) (by omega) = α
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [descCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.inr_descCochain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_descCochain :
    (descCochain f α β h).comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add n) = β
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp [descCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.inl_descCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_descCochain_apply (x : M) : descCochain f α β h (inl f x) = α x
proof:
:= by
  simp [descCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.inr_descCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_descCochain_apply (y : N) : descCochain f α β h (inr f y) = β y
proof:
:= by
  simp [descCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.δ_descCochain
statement:
theorem δ_descCochain (n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + 1 = n') :
    δ n n' (descCochain f α β h) =
      (δ m n α + koszulSign n' • β.comp (ofHom f) (zero_add n)).comp (fst f).1
          (by omega) +
        (δ n n' β).comp (snd f) (zero_add n')
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  have hm : koszulSign m = -koszulSign n := by
    rw [← h, koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ, neg_neg]
  have hn : koszulSign n' = -koszulSign n := by
    rw [← hn', koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ]
  simp only [δ_apply _ _ hn', δ_apply _ _ h, descCochain_apply, Cochain.add_apply, comp_apply,
    units_smul_apply, Cochain.neg_apply, ofHom_apply, d_fst_apply, d_snd_apply, map_add, map_neg,
    hm, hn,
    Units.neg_smul, smul_add, smul_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_neg]
  abel

name: DG.Cone.ofHom_desc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_desc : ofHom (desc f α β eq) = descCochain f α (ofHom β) (neg_add_cancel 1)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.desc_apply
statement: theorem desc_apply (p : Cone f) : desc f α β eq p = α ((fst f).1 p) + β (snd f p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inl_desc_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_desc_apply (x : M) : desc f α β eq (inl f x) = α x
proof:
:= by
  simp [desc_apply]

name: DG.Cone.inl_desc
statement: theorem inl_desc : (ofHom (desc f α β eq)).comp (inl f) (add_zero _) = α
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: DG.Cone.inr_desc_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_desc_apply (y : N) : desc f α β eq (inr f y) = β y
proof:
:= by
  simp [desc_apply]

name: DG.Cone.inr_desc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_desc : (desc f α β eq).comp (inr f) = β
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp

name: DG.Cone.liftCochain_apply
statement: theorem liftCochain_apply (k : K) : liftCochain f α β h k = inl f (α k) + inr f (β k)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.liftCochain_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_fst : (fst f).1.comp (liftCochain f α β h) h = α
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp [liftCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.liftCochain_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_snd : (snd f).comp (liftCochain f α β h) (add_zero n) = β
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp [liftCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.liftCochain_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_fst_apply (k : K) : (fst f).1 (liftCochain f α β h k) = α k
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.liftCochain_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_snd_apply (k : K) : snd f (liftCochain f α β h k) = β k
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.δ_liftCochain
statement:
theorem δ_liftCochain (m' : ℤ) (hm' : m + 1 = m') :
    δ n m (liftCochain f α β h) = -(inl f).comp (δ m m' α) (by omega) +
      (ofHom (inr f)).comp (δ n m β + (ofHom f).comp α (add_zero m)) (add_zero m)
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun k => ?_
  have hm : koszulSign m = -koszulSign n := by
    rw [← h, koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ]
  refine ext_to ?_ ?_
  · simp only [δ_apply _ _ h, δ_apply _ _ hm', liftCochain_apply, Cochain.add_apply,
      Cochain.neg_apply, comp_apply, map_add, map_sub, map_neg, map_units_smul,
      inl_d_apply, inr_d_apply, inl_fst_apply, inr_fst_apply, hm, Units.neg_smul,
      ofHom_apply, smul_zero, add_zero]
    abel
  · simp only [δ_apply _ _ h, δ_apply _ _ hm', liftCochain_apply, Cochain.add_apply,
      Cochain.neg_apply, comp_apply, ofHom_apply, map_add, map_sub, map_neg,
      map_units_smul, inl_d_apply, inr_d_apply, inl_snd_apply, inr_snd_apply, zero_add,
      smul_zero]
    abel

name: DG.Cone.ofHom_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_lift : ofHom (lift f α β eq) = liftCochain f α.1 β (zero_add 1)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.lift_apply
statement: theorem lift_apply (k : K) : lift f α β eq k = inl f (α.1 k) + inr f (β k)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.lift_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_fst_apply (k : K) : (fst f).1 (lift f α β eq k) = α.1 k
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift_apply]

name: DG.Cone.lift_fst
statement: theorem lift_fst : (fst f).1.comp (ofHom (lift f α β eq)) (zero_add 1) = α.1
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp

name: DG.Cone.lift_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_snd_apply (k : K) : snd f (lift f α β eq k) = β k
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift_apply]

name: DG.Cone.lift_snd
statement: theorem lift_snd : (snd f).comp (ofHom (lift f α β eq)) (zero_add 0) = β
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp

name: DG.Cone.liftCochain_descCochain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_descCochain :
    (descCochain f α' β' h').comp (liftCochain f α β h) hp =
      α'.comp α (by omega) + β'.comp β (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp [liftCochain_apply, descCochain_apply]

name: DG.Cone.lift_desc_apply
statement:
theorem lift_desc_apply [DGModule A K] (α : Cocycle A K M 1) (β : Cochain A K N 0)
    (eq : δ 0 1 β + (ofHom f).comp α.1 (add_zero 1) = 0)
    (α' : Cochain A M L (-1)) (β' : N →ᵈᵍ[A] L) (eq' : δ (-1) 0 α' = ofHom (β'.comp f))
    (k : K) :
    desc f α' β' eq' (lift f α β eq k) = α' (α.1 k) + β' (β k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [desc_apply]

name: DG.Cone.mapOfHomotopy_apply
statement:
theorem mapOfHomotopy_apply (H : DGHomotopy (b.comp f₁) (f₂.comp a)) (p : Cone f₁) :
    mapOfHomotopy H p =
      inl f₂ (a ((fst f₁).1 p)) + inr f₂ (H.hom ((fst f₁).1 p) + b (snd f₁ p))
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapOfHomotopy, desc_apply, map_add]
  abel

name: DG.Cone.mapOfHomotopy_comp_inr
statement:
theorem mapOfHomotopy_comp_inr (H : DGHomotopy (b.comp f₁) (f₂.comp a)) :
    (mapOfHomotopy H).comp (inr f₁) = (inr f₂).comp b
proof:
:=
  inr_desc _ _ _ _

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_comp_mapOfHomotopy
statement:
theorem fstHom_comp_mapOfHomotopy (H : DGHomotopy (b.comp f₁) (f₂.comp a)) :
    (fstHom f₂).comp (mapOfHomotopy H) = (a.shift 1).comp (fstHom f₁)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp [mapOfHomotopy, desc_apply, fstHom_eq]

name: DG.Cone.map_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_fst_apply (h : b.comp f₁ = f₂.comp a) (p : Cone f₁) :
    (fst f₂).1 (map a b h p) = a ((fst f₁).1 p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.map_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_snd_apply (h : b.comp f₁ = f₂.comp a) (p : Cone f₁) :
    snd f₂ (map a b h p) = b (snd f₁ p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.map_eq_desc
statement:
theorem map_eq_desc (h : b.comp f₁ = f₂.comp a) :
    map a b h = desc f₁ ((inl f₂).comp (ofHom a) (zero_add _)) ((inr f₂).comp b) (by
      rw [δ_ofHom_comp, δ_inl]
      change _ = ofHom ((inr f₂).comp (b.comp f₁))
      rw [h]
      rfl)
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.ext fun p => ext_to ?_ ?_ <;> simp [desc_apply]

name: DG.Cone.map_eq_mapOfHomotopy
statement:
theorem map_eq_mapOfHomotopy (h : b.comp f₁ = f₂.comp a) :
    map a b h = mapOfHomotopy (DGHomotopy.ofEq h)
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.ext fun p => ext_to ?_ ?_ <;> simp [mapOfHomotopy_apply]

name: DG.Cone.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) (DGModuleHom.id : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N)
    (show DGModuleHom.id.comp f = f.comp DGModuleHom.id from rfl) = DGModuleHom.id
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {a' : M₂ →ᵈᵍ[A] M₃} {b' : N₂ →ᵈᵍ[A] N₃} (h : b.comp f₁ = f₂.comp a)
    (h' : b'.comp f₂ = f₃.comp a') :
    map (a'.comp a) (b'.comp b)
        (by rw [DGModuleHom.comp_assoc, h, ← DGModuleHom.comp_assoc, h',
          DGModuleHom.comp_assoc]) =
      (map a' b' h').comp (map a b h)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.isContractible_id
statement: theorem isContractible_id : IsContractible A (Cone (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M))
proof:
:=
  ⟨homotopyToZeroOfId M⟩

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.coe_homShiftAddEquivCocycles_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_homShiftAddEquivCocycles_apply (n : ℤ) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] Shift n N) :
    (homShiftAddEquivCocycles M N n f : HOM A M N) =
      DirectSum.of (fun k => Cochain A M N k) n (Cocycle.homShiftAddEquiv A M N n f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.homShiftAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map
statement:
theorem homShiftAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map (n : ℤ)
    (f : M ⟶ (shiftFunctor (DGModuleCat.{v} A) n).obj N) :
    homShiftAddEquivCohomology M N n
        ((quotient A).map f ≫ ((quotient A).commShiftIso n).hom.app N) =
      cohomology.mk _ n (DGModule.HOM.homShiftAddEquivCocycles M N n f.hom)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (compIsoAddEquiv (((quotient A).commShiftIso n).app N)).symm
      ((quotient A).map f ≫ ((quotient A).commShiftIso n).hom.app N) = (quotient A).map f := by
    change ((quotient A).map f ≫ ((quotient A).commShiftIso n).hom.app N) ≫
      ((quotient A).commShiftIso n).inv.app N = _
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg _ (Iso.hom_inv_id_app _ _)).trans (Category.comp_id _))
  rw [homShiftAddEquivCohomology, AddEquiv.trans_apply]
  erw [AddEquiv.trans_apply, h]
  refine (congrArg (DGModule.HOM.cohomologyRightShiftAddEquiv A M N n 0 n (zero_add n))
    (homAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map M ((shiftFunctor (DGModuleCat.{v} A) n).obj N) f)).trans
    ?_
  refine congrArg (cohomology.mk _ n) (Subtype.ext ?_)
  refine (congrArg (Shift.unmk n)
    (DGModule.HOM.rightShiftEquiv_of A M N n 0 (Cochain.ofHom f.hom))).trans ?_
  exact DGModule.HOM.of_congr (zero_add n)
    (f := Cochain.rightUnshift (N := N) (a := n) (Cochain.ofHom f.hom) (0 + n) rfl)
    (g := (Cocycle.homShiftAddEquiv A M N n f.hom : Cochain A M N n)) fun _ => rfl

name: DG.Homotopic.smul
statement: theorem Homotopic.smul (r : R) (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (r • f) (r • g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.smul r⟩

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective
statement:
theorem quotient_obj_surjective (X : HomotopyCategory.{v} A) :
    ∃ M : DGModuleCat.{v} A, (quotient A).obj M = X

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_out
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotient_map_out {M N : HomotopyCategory.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (quotient A).map (Quot.out f) = f
proof:
:=
  Quot.out_eq _

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_eq_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_map_eq_iff {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f g : M ⟶ N) :
    (quotient A).map f = (quotient A).map g ↔ Homotopic f.hom g.hom
proof:
:=
  Quotient.functor_map_eq_iff _ _ _

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.eq_of_homotopy
statement:
theorem eq_of_homotopy {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f g : M ⟶ N) (h : DGHomotopy f.hom g.hom) :
    (quotient A).map f = (quotient A).map g
proof:
:=
  (quotient_map_eq_iff f g).mpr ⟨h⟩

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.isZero_quotient_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isZero_quotient_obj_iff (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    IsZero ((quotient A).obj M) ↔ IsContractible A M
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero, ← (quotient A).map_id, ← (quotient A).map_zero,
    quotient_map_eq_iff]
  rfl

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_mk (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    quotientNullHomotopicAddHom M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      (quotient A).map (DGModuleCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_bijective
statement:
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (quotientNullHomotopicAddHom M N)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun x hx => ?_, fun φ => ?_⟩
  · induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H f =>
      rw [quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_mk, ← (quotient A).map_zero M N,
        quotient_map_eq_iff] at hx
      exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff f).mpr hx
  · obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (quotient A).map_surjective φ
    exact ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk f.hom, rfl⟩

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map (f : M ⟶ N) :
    homAddEquivQuotient M N ((quotient A).map f) = QuotientAddGroup.mk f.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [homAddEquivQuotient, AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  rfl

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.homAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map (f : M ⟶ N) :
    homAddEquivCohomology M N ((quotient A).map f) =
      cohomology.mk _ 0 (DGModule.HOM.cocyclesAddEquiv A M N 0 (Cocycle.ofHom f.hom))
proof:
:= by
  rw [homAddEquivCohomology, AddEquiv.trans_apply, homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map,
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology_mk]

name: DG.Homotopic.of_directSum
proof:
:= by
  rw [Homotopic.iff_sub]
  choose c hc using fun i => homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp (Homotopic.iff_sub.mp (h i))
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨Cochain.directSumDesc c, Cochain.directSum_ext
    fun i x => ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain A (P i) N 0 => z x)
    (δ_ofHom_comp (DGModuleHom.lof A P i) (Cochain.directSumDesc c) 0)
  have h2 : (Cochain.directSumDesc c).comp (Cochain.ofHom (DGModuleHom.lof A P i))
      (zero_add _) = c i := Cochain.ext fun y => Cochain.directSumDesc_of c i y
  simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, DGModuleHom.lof_apply, h2] at h1
  rw [Cochain.ofHom_apply, ← h1, ← hc i]
  rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.shiftFunctorComm_hom_app_eq

name: DG.Homotopic.shift

name: DG.ModuleCat.units_smul_apply

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_v_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toHomComplex_v_apply (z : Cochain A M N n) (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q)
    (x : DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A M p) :
    (((z.toHomComplex R).v p q hpq).hom x).1 = z x.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_ext
statement:
theorem toHomComplex_ext {z₁ z₂ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain ((forget R A).obj M)
      ((forget R A).obj N) n}
    (h : ∀ p q hpq (x : DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A M p),
      ((z₁.v p q hpq).hom x).1 = ((z₂.v p q hpq).hom x).1) : z₁ = z₂
proof:
:=
  CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ext _ _ fun p q hpq =>
    ModuleCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (h p q hpq x))

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toHomComplex_add (z₁ z₂ : Cochain A M N n) :
    (z₁ + z₂).toHomComplex R = z₁.toHomComplex R + z₂.toHomComplex R
proof:
:=
  toHomComplex_ext R fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toHomComplex_neg (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    (-z).toHomComplex R = -z.toHomComplex R
proof:
:=
  toHomComplex_ext R fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toHomComplex_zero : (0 : Cochain A M N n).toHomComplex R = 0
proof:
:=
  toHomComplex_ext R fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toHomComplex_ofHom (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (ofHom f.hom).toHomComplex R =
      CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom ((forget R A).map f)
proof:
:=
  toHomComplex_ext R fun p q hpq x => by
    obtain rfl : q = p := by omega
    rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom_v]
    rfl

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toHomComplex_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂) (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) :
    (z₂.comp z₁ h).toHomComplex R = (z₁.toHomComplex R).comp (z₂.toHomComplex R) h
proof:
:=
  toHomComplex_ext R fun p q hpq x => by
    rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.comp_v _ _ h p (p + n₁) q rfl (by omega)]
    rfl

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_δ
statement:
theorem toHomComplex_δ (m : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    (δ n m z).toHomComplex R = CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ n m (z.toHomComplex R)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · refine toHomComplex_ext R fun p q hpq x => ?_
    rw [CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_v n m hnm _ p q hpq (q - 1) (p + 1) rfl rfl]
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ModuleCat.hom_comp,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.units_smul_apply, toHomComplex_v_apply]
    rw [δ_apply' n m hnm]
    erw [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_units_smul, forget_obj_d_apply, toHomComplex_v_apply,
      toHomComplex_v_apply, forget_obj_d_apply]
    all_goals omega
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm, CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ_shape _ _ hnm, toHomComplex_zero]

name: DG.Cone.forgetIso_inv_eq
statement:
theorem forgetIso_inv_eq :
    CochainComplex.HomComplex.δ (-1) 0
        ((inl φ.hom).toHomComplex (M := M) (N := of A (Cone φ.hom)) R) =
      CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom
        ((forget R A).map φ ≫ (forget R A).map (ofHom (inr φ.hom)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Cochain.toHomComplex_δ, δ_inl, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Cochain.toHomComplex_ofHom]
  rfl

name: DG.Cone.inr_forgetIso_inv
statement:
theorem inr_forgetIso_inv :
    CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr ((forget R A).map φ) ≫ (forgetIso R φ).inv =
      (forget R A).map (ofHom (inr φ.hom))
proof:
:=
  CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr_desc _ _ _ (forgetIso_inv_eq R φ)

name: DG.Cone.inl_v_forgetIso_inv_f
statement:
theorem inl_v_forgetIso_inv_f (p q : ℤ) (h : p + (-1) = q) :
    (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl ((forget R A).map φ)).v p q h ≫ (forgetIso R φ).inv.f q =
      ((inl φ.hom).toHomComplex (M := M) (N := of A (Cone φ.hom)) R).v p q h
proof:
:=
  CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl_v_desc_f _ _ _ (forgetIso_inv_eq R φ) p q h

name: DG.Cone.inr_f_forgetIso_inv_f
statement:
theorem inr_f_forgetIso_inv_f (p : ℤ) :
    (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr ((forget R A).map φ)).f p ≫ (forgetIso R φ).inv.f p =
      ((forget R A).map (ofHom (inr φ.hom))).f p
proof:
:=
  CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr_f_desc_f _ _ _ (forgetIso_inv_eq R φ) p

name: DG.DGModuleHom.lTensor_tmul

name: DG.DGModuleCat.restrictScalars_map_apply

name: DG.DGModuleCat.one_tmul_mem_grading

theorem one_tmul_mem_grading {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    [DGModule B N] {k : ℤ} {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading k) :
    tmul B (φ.bimoduleEquiv 1) n ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  simpa using TensorProductOver.tmul_mem_grading
    (bimoduleEquiv_mem_grading_iff.mpr (one_mem_grading (A := A))) hn

name: DG.DGModuleCat.ExtendScalars.tmul_smul_eq

theorem tmul_smul_eq (b : B) (n : N) :
    tmul B (φ.bimoduleEquiv 1) (b • n) = φ b • tmul B (φ.bimoduleEquiv 1) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← op_smul_tmul, op_smul_bimoduleEquiv, smul_tmul, smul_bimoduleEquiv, one_mul, mul_one]

name: DG.DGModuleCat.ExtendScalars.d_one_tmul

theorem d_one_tmul (n : N) :
    d (tmul B (φ.bimoduleEquiv 1) n) = tmul B (φ.bimoduleEquiv 1) (d n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProductOver.d_tmul_of_mem
      (bimoduleEquiv_mem_grading_iff.mpr (one_mem_grading (A := A))),
    d_bimoduleEquiv, d_one, map_zero, zero_tmul, zero_add, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero,
    one_smul]

    homEquivInvFunAux φ g x n = φ.bimoduleEquiv.symm x • RestrictScalars.addEquiv φ (g n)

name: DG.DGModuleCat.ExtendScalars.homEquivInvFunAux_balanced
statement:
theorem homEquivInvFunAux_balanced (g : N →ᵈᵍ[B] RestrictScalars φ M) (b : B)
    (x : φ.Bimodule) (n : N) :
    homEquivInvFunAux φ g (op b • x) n = homEquivInvFunAux φ g x (b • n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homEquivInvFunAux_apply, homEquivInvFunAux_apply, map_smul g b n]
  exact mul_smul (φ.bimoduleEquiv.symm x) (φ b) (RestrictScalars.addEquiv φ (g n))

name: DG.DGModuleCat.ExtendScalars.homEquivInvFun_tmul
statement:
theorem homEquivInvFun_tmul (g : N →ᵈᵍ[B] RestrictScalars φ M) (x : φ.Bimodule) (n : N) :
    homEquivInvFun φ g (tmul B x n) =
      φ.bimoduleEquiv.symm x • RestrictScalars.addEquiv φ (g n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.ExtendScalars.homEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homEquiv_apply (f : TensorProductOver B φ.Bimodule N →ᵈᵍ[A] M) (n : N) :
    homEquiv φ N M f n = f (tmul B (φ.bimoduleEquiv 1) n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.ExtendScalars.homEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homEquiv_symm_tmul (g : N →ᵈᵍ[B] RestrictScalars φ M) (x : φ.Bimodule) (n : N) :
    (homEquiv φ N M).symm g (tmul B x n) =
      φ.bimoduleEquiv.symm x • RestrictScalars.addEquiv φ (g n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj_homEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendRestrictScalarsAdj_homEquiv_apply {N : DGModuleCat.{max v u₁} B}
    {M : DGModuleCat.{max v u₁} A} (f : (extendScalars φ).obj N ⟶ M) (n : N) :
    (extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).homEquiv N M f n = f (tmul B (φ.bimoduleEquiv 1) n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj_homEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendRestrictScalarsAdj_homEquiv_symm_apply_tmul {N : DGModuleCat.{max v u₁} B}
    {M : DGModuleCat.{max v u₁} A} (g : N ⟶ (restrictScalars φ).obj M) (x : φ.Bimodule)
    (n : N) :
    ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).homEquiv N M).symm g (tmul B x n) =
      φ.bimoduleEquiv.symm x • RestrictScalars.addEquiv φ (M := M) (g n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ks_eq
statement: private theorem ks_eq {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tensorDGHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorDGHom_tmul (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M') (g : N →ᵈᵍ[B] N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorDGHom f g (m ⊗ₜ n) = f m ⊗ₜ g n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.units_tmul
statement: theorem units_tmul (u : ℤˣ) (m : M) (n : N) : (u • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n = u • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tmul_units
statement: theorem tmul_units (u : ℤˣ) (m : M) (n : N) : m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (u • n) = u • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.leftCochain_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftCochain_tmul {k : ℤ} (h : Cochain A M M' k) (m : M) (n : N) :
    leftCochain (B := B) N h (m ⊗ₜ n) = h m ⊗ₜ n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.rightCochain_tmul
statement:
theorem rightCochain_tmul {k : ℤ} (h : Cochain B N N' k) {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i)
    (n : N) : rightCochain (A := A) M h (m ⊗ₜ n) = koszulSign (k * i) • (m ⊗ₜ h n)
proof:
:= by
  change tensorMap (twist M k) _ (m ⊗ₜ n) = _
  rw [tensorMap_tmul, twist_of_mem k hm, units_tmul, mul_comm]
  rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.cochain_units
statement:
theorem cochain_units {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [DGAddCommGroup X] [Module AB X]
    [AddCommGroup Y] [DGAddCommGroup Y] [Module AB Y] {k : ℤ} (c : Cochain AB X Y k) (u : ℤˣ)
    (x : X) : c (u • x) = u • c x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tensorDGHom_ext
statement:
theorem tensorDGHom_ext {M M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    [DGModule A M] [AddCommGroup M'] [DGAddCommGroup M'] [Module A M'] [DGModule A M']
    {N N' : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module B N] [DGModule B N]
    [AddCommGroup N'] [DGAddCommGroup N'] [Module B N'] [DGModule B N']
    {φ ψ : (M ⊗[ℤ] N) →ᵈᵍ[AB] (M' ⊗[ℤ] N')} (h : ∀ m n, φ (m ⊗ₜ n) = ψ (m ⊗ₜ n)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext fun x => by
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul m n => exact h m n
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.functor_obj_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem functor_obj_obj (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (N : DGModuleCat.{v} B) :
    (((functor A B).obj M).obj N : Type v) = (M ⊗[ℤ] N)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.functor_obj_map_hom
statement:
theorem functor_obj_map_hom (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) {N N' : DGModuleCat.{v} B} (g : N ⟶ N') :
    (((functor A B).obj M).map g).hom = tensorDGHom DGModuleHom.id g.hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.functor_map_app_hom
statement:
theorem functor_map_app_hom {M M' : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ M') (N : DGModuleCat.{v} B) :
    (((functor A B).map f).app N).hom = tensorDGHom f.hom DGModuleHom.id
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.homotopyFunctor_obj_obj
statement:
theorem homotopyFunctor_obj_obj (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (N : DGModuleCat.{v} B) :
    ((homotopyFunctor A B).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A).obj M)).obj
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient B).obj N) =
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient AB).obj (((functor A B).obj M).obj N)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.units_smul_apply
statement:
theorem units_smul_apply {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (k : ℤˣ) (f : M ⟶ N) (x : M) :
    (k • f) x = k • f x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.hom_units_smul
statement:
theorem hom_units_smul {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (k : ℤˣ) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (k • f).hom = k • f.hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.units_smul_apply
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.units_smul_apply {A M N : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N] (u : ℤˣ) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (x : M) :
    (u • f) x = u • f x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cocycle.coe_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Cocycle.coe_units_smul {A M N : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [DGModule A M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [DGModule A N] {n : ℤ} (u : ℤˣ)
    (z : Cocycle A M N n) :
    ((u • z : Cocycle A M N n) : Cochain A M N n) = u • (z : Cochain A M N n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_eq_mk_fst
statement:
theorem fstHom_eq_mk_fst {M N : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [DGModule A M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [DGModule A N]
    (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (p : Cone f) : fstHom f p = Shift.mk 1 ((fst f).1 p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.hom_apply
statement:
theorem hom_apply (x : Shift 1 M) :
    hom f x = inl (inr f) (f (unmk 1 x)) - inr (inr f) (inl f (unmk 1 x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := 1) x
  simp [hom, lift_apply, leftShift_apply, leftShiftSign, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.Cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.fst_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_hom_apply (x : Shift 1 M) : (fst (inr f)).1 (hom f x) = f (unmk 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hom_apply]

name: DG.Cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.snd_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_hom_apply (x : Shift 1 M) : snd (inr f) (hom f x) = -inl f (unmk 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hom_apply]

name: DG.Cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.inv_apply
statement: theorem inv_apply (p : Cone (inr f)) : inv f p = -fstHom f (snd (inr f) p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [inv, desc_apply]

name: DG.Cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.inv_comp_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_comp_hom : (inv f).comp (hom f) = DGModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := 1) x
  simp [inv_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.Cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.comm₃
statement: theorem comm₃ : (-fstHom (inr f)).comp (hom f) = -f.shift 1
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.ext fun x => (unmk 1).injective ?_
  simp [← fst_apply, DGModuleHom.unmk_shift_apply]

name: DG.Cone.ShiftIso.fst_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_hom_apply (x : Shift n (Cone f)) :
    (fst (f.shift n)).1 (hom f n x) = koszulSign n • Shift.mk n ((fst f).1 (unmk n x))
proof:
:= by
  simp [hom, lift_apply]

name: DG.Cone.ShiftIso.snd_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_hom_apply (x : Shift n (Cone f)) :
    snd (f.shift n) (hom f n x) = Shift.mk n (snd f (unmk n x))
proof:
:= by
  simp [hom, lift_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.Cone.ShiftIso.inv_apply
statement:
theorem inv_apply (q : Cone (f.shift n)) :
    inv f n q = koszulSign n • Shift.mk n (inl f (unmk n ((fst (f.shift n)).1 q))) +
      Shift.mk n (inr f (unmk n (snd (f.shift n) q)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [inv, desc_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.Cone.ShiftIso.inv_comp_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_comp_hom : (inv f n).comp (hom f n) = DGModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := n) x
  simp [inv_apply, smul_smul]
  rw [← mk_add, id_X]

name: DG.Cone.ShiftIso.hom_comp_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_comp_inv : (hom f n).comp (inv f n) = DGModuleHom.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.ext fun q => ext_to ?_ ?_
  · simp [inv_apply, smul_smul]
  · simp [inv_apply]

name: DG.Cone.ShiftIso.hom_comp_shift_inr
statement: theorem hom_comp_shift_inr : (hom f n).comp ((inr f).shift n) = inr (f.shift n)
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.ext fun y => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := n) y
  refine ext_to ?_ ?_ <;> simp

name: DG.Cone.ShiftIso.comm₃
statement:
theorem comm₃ : (Shift.shiftComm 1 n).toDGModuleHom.comp ((-fstHom f).shift n) =
    koszulSign n • (-fstHom (f.shift n)).comp (hom f n)
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModuleHom.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective (n := n) x
  simp [smul_smul, DGModuleHom.units_smul_apply, fstHom_eq_mk_fst]

name: DG.Cone.triangle_mor₃_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem triangle_mor₃_hom : (triangle φ).mor₃.hom = -fstHom φ.hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inr_triangleδ
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem inr_triangleδ : ofHom (inr φ.hom) ≫ (triangle φ).mor₃ = 0
proof:
:=
  hom_ext_apply fun y => by simp

name: DG.Cone.triangleMapOfHomotopy_comm₂
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem triangleMapOfHomotopy_comm₂ :
    ofHom (inr φ₁.hom) ≫ ofHom (mapOfHomotopy H) = b ≫ ofHom (inr φ₂.hom)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (mapOfHomotopy_comp_inr H)

name: DG.Cone.triangleMapOfHomotopy_comm₃
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem triangleMapOfHomotopy_comm₃ :
    ofHom (mapOfHomotopy H) ≫ (triangle φ₂).mor₃ = (triangle φ₁).mor₃ ≫ a⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
proof:
:=
  hom_ext_apply fun p => by
    have h := congrArg (fun g => g p) (fstHom_comp_mapOfHomotopy H)
    simp only [DGModuleHom.comp_apply] at h
    simp
    exact h

name: DG.Cone.rotateHomotopyEquiv_comm₂
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem rotateHomotopyEquiv_comm₂ :
    (quotient A).map (triangle φ).mor₃ ≫
      (quotient A).map (ofHom (rotateHomotopyEquiv φ.hom).hom) =
      (quotient A).map (ofHom (inr (inr φ.hom)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  exact eq_of_homotopy _ _ (RotateHomotopyEquiv.comm₂Homotopy φ.hom)

name: DG.Cone.rotateHomotopyEquiv_comm₃
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem rotateHomotopyEquiv_comm₃ :
    ofHom (rotateHomotopyEquiv φ.hom).hom ≫ (triangle (ofHom (inr φ.hom))).mor₃ =
      -φ⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (RotateHomotopyEquiv.comm₃ φ.hom)

name: DG.Cone.shiftIso_hom_apply
statement:
theorem shiftIso_hom_apply (x : Shift n (Cone φ.hom)) :
    (shiftIso φ n).hom x = ShiftIso.hom φ.hom n x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.shiftIso_comm₂
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem shiftIso_comm₂ :
    (DGModuleCat.ofHom (inr φ.hom))⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftIso φ n).hom =
      DGModuleCat.ofHom (inr (φ⟦n⟧').hom)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (ShiftIso.hom_comp_shift_inr φ.hom n)

name: DG.Cone.shiftIso_comm₃
statement:
theorem shiftIso_comm₃ :
    (triangle φ).mor₃⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorComm (DGModuleCat.{v} A) 1 n).hom.app M =
      n.negOnePow • ((shiftIso φ n).hom ≫ (triangle (φ⟦n⟧')).mor₃)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftFunctorComm_hom_app_eq]
  exact hom_ext (ShiftIso.comm₃ φ.hom n)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.isomorphic_distinguished
statement:
theorem isomorphic_distinguished (T₁ : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{v} A))
    (hT₁ : T₁ ∈ distinguishedTriangles A) (T₂ : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{v} A))
    (e : T₂ ≅ T₁) : T₂ ∈ distinguishedTriangles A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, N, φ, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hT₁
  exact ⟨M, N, φ, ⟨e ≪≫ e'⟩⟩

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.contractible_distinguished
statement:
theorem contractible_distinguished (X : HomotopyCategory.{v} A) :
    Pretriangulated.contractibleTriangle X ∈ distinguishedTriangles A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X⟩ := X
  refine ⟨_, _, 𝟙 X, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have h := (isZero_quotient_obj_iff (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).hom))).2
    (Cone.isContractible_id X)
  exact Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) h.isoZero.symm
    (by simp [contractibleTriangle]) (h.eq_of_tgt _ _)
    (by dsimp [contractibleTriangle]; ext)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.distinguished_cocone_triangle
statement:
theorem distinguished_cocone_triangle {X Y : HomotopyCategory.{v} A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ (Z : HomotopyCategory.{v} A) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distinguishedTriangles A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨Y⟩ := Y
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (quotient A).map_surjective f
  exact ⟨_, _, _, ⟨_, _, f, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩⟩

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.rotate_distinguished_triangle'
statement:
theorem rotate_distinguished_triangle' (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{v} A))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles A) : T.rotate ∈ distinguishedTriangles A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, N, φ, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hT
  exact ⟨_, _, _, ⟨(rotate _).mapIso e ≪≫ rotateTrianglehIso φ⟩⟩

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.shift_distinguished_triangle
statement:
theorem shift_distinguished_triangle (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{v} A))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles A) (n : ℤ) :
    (Triangle.shiftFunctor _ n).obj T ∈ distinguishedTriangles A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, N, φ, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hT
  exact ⟨_, _, _, ⟨Functor.mapIso _ e ≪≫ shiftTrianglehIso φ n⟩⟩

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.invRotate_distinguished_triangle'
statement:
theorem invRotate_distinguished_triangle' (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{v} A))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles A) : T.invRotate ∈ distinguishedTriangles A
proof:
:=
  isomorphic_distinguished _
    (shift_distinguished_triangle _ (rotate_distinguished_triangle' _
      (rotate_distinguished_triangle' _ hT)) _) _
    ((invRotateIsoRotateRotateShiftFunctorNegOne _).app T)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.rotate_distinguished_triangle
statement:
theorem rotate_distinguished_triangle (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{v} A)) :
    T ∈ distinguishedTriangles A ↔ T.rotate ∈ distinguishedTriangles A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact rotate_distinguished_triangle' T
  · intro hT
    exact isomorphic_distinguished _ (invRotate_distinguished_triangle' T.rotate hT) _
      ((triangleRotation _).unitIso.app T)

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
statement:
theorem complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
    (T₁ T₂ : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{v} A))
    (hT₁ : T₁ ∈ distinguishedTriangles A) (hT₂ : T₂ ∈ distinguishedTriangles A)
    (a : T₁.obj₁ ⟶ T₂.obj₁) (b : T₁.obj₂ ⟶ T₂.obj₂) (fac : T₁.mor₁ ≫ b = a ≫ T₂.mor₁) :
    ∃ (c : T₁.obj₃ ⟶ T₂.obj₃), T₁.mor₂ ≫ c = b ≫ T₂.mor₂ ∧
      T₁.mor₃ ≫ a⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = c ≫ T₂.mor₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K₁, L₁, φ₁, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ := hT₁
  obtain ⟨K₂, L₂, φ₂, ⟨e₂⟩⟩ := hT₂
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ : ∃ (a' : (quotient A).obj K₁ ⟶ (quotient A).obj K₂),
    a' = e₁.inv.hom₁ ≫ a ≫ e₂.hom.hom₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ : ∃ (b' : (quotient A).obj L₁ ⟶ (quotient A).obj L₂),
    b' = e₁.inv.hom₂ ≫ b ≫ e₂.hom.hom₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a'', rfl⟩ := (quotient A).map_surjective a'
  obtain ⟨b'', rfl⟩ := (quotient A).map_surjective b'
  have H : DGHomotopy (φ₁ ≫ b'').hom (a'' ≫ φ₂).hom := homotopyOfEq _ _ (by
    have comm₁₁ := e₁.inv.comm₁
    have comm₁₂ := e₂.hom.comm₁
    dsimp at comm₁₁ comm₁₂
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, ha', hb', reassoc_of% comm₁₁,
      reassoc_of% fac, comm₁₂, assoc])
  let γ := e₁.hom ≫ trianglehMapOfHomotopy H ≫ e₂.inv
  have comm₂ := γ.comm₂
  have comm₃ := γ.comm₃
  dsimp [γ, trianglehMapOfHomotopy] at comm₂ comm₃
  simp only [ha', hb'] at comm₂ comm₃
  refine ⟨γ.hom₃, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [γ] using comm₂
  · simpa [γ] using comm₃

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.triangleh_distinguished
statement:
theorem triangleh_distinguished {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    triangleh φ ∈ distTriang (HomotopyCategory.{v} A)

name: DG.koszulSign_neg_one_mul
statement: theorem koszulSign_neg_one_mul (i : ℤ) : koszulSign (-1 * i) = koszulSign i
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_one_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_neg]

name: DG.gradeInvolution_smul_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j m =>
    rw [gradeInvolution_of_mem (smul_mem_grading ha m.2), gradeInvolution_of_mem m.2,
      smul_comm a (koszulSign j) (m : M), smul_smul, koszulSign_add, mul_comm]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, smul_add, smul_add]

name: DG.gradeInvolution_op_smul_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j m =>
    rw [gradeInvolution_of_mem (op_smul_mem_grading ha m.2), gradeInvolution_of_mem m.2,
      smul_comm (op a) (koszulSign j) (m : M), smul_smul, koszulSign_add, mul_comm]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, smul_add, smul_add]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lTensorCochainAux_apply
statement:
theorem lTensorCochainAux_apply (h : Cochain B N N' (-1)) (m : M) (n : N) :
    lTensorCochainAux M h m n = tmul B (gradeInvolution M m) (h n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lTensorCochainAux_balanced
statement:
theorem lTensorCochainAux_balanced (h : Cochain B N N' (-1)) (b : B) (m : M) (n : N) :
    lTensorCochainAux M h (op b • m) n = lTensorCochainAux M h m (b • n)
proof:
:= by
  induction b using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [lTensorCochainAux_apply]
  | @h_homogeneous i b =>
    rw [lTensorCochainAux_apply, lTensorCochainAux_apply,
      gradeInvolution_op_smul_of_mem b.2, h.map_smul b.2, koszulSign_neg_one_mul,
      units_smul_tmul, tmul_units_smul, op_smul_tmul]
  | h_add b b' hb hb' =>
    rw [MulOpposite.op_add, add_smul, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hb, hb', add_smul, map_add]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lTensorCochain_tmul

theorem lTensorCochain_tmul (h : Cochain B N N' (-1)) (m : M) (n : N) :

proof:

name: DG.DGModuleCat.tensorEquivOfEquiv_tmul

name: DG.DGModuleCat.tensor_hom_ext₂
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_hom_ext (M := M') fun m' y => ?_
  have hfg : (AddMonoidHomClass.toAddMonoidHom f.hom).comp
      (TensorProductOver.tmulAddHom A M' (TensorProductOver B M N) m') =
      (AddMonoidHomClass.toAddMonoidHom g.hom).comp
      (TensorProductOver.tmulAddHom A M' (TensorProductOver B M N) m') :=
    TensorProductOver.addHom_ext fun m n => h m' m n
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfg y

name: DG.DGModuleCat.moritaEquivalence_functor

name: DG.HomotopyCategory.moritaEquivalence_functor
statement:
theorem moritaEquivalence_functor (e₁ : TensorProductOver A Q P ≃ᵈᵍ[B] B)

proof:
:=
  toHomComplex_ext R fun p q hpq x => by
    subst hpq
    exact ofHomComplex_apply_coe z ⟨x.1, x.2⟩

name: DG.Cochain.toHomComplex_injective
statement:
theorem Cochain.toHomComplex_injective {A : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [Algebra R A]
    [DGRing A] [DGAlgebra R A] {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} {n : ℤ} :
    Function.Injective (Cochain.toHomComplex (M := M) (N := N) (n := n) R)
proof:
:= by
  intro z₁ z₂ h
  ext x
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous p x =>
    exact congrArg (fun z => (((z.v p (p + n) rfl).hom
      ⟨x.1, x.2⟩ : DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A N (p + n)) : N)) h
  | h_add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

theorem forget_map_homOfComplexHom (φ : (forget R R).obj M ⟶ (forget R R).obj N) :

proof:
:= by
  apply CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom_injective
  rw [← Cochain.toHomComplex_ofHom]
  exact Cochain.toHomComplex_ofHomComplex _

name: DG.ComplexSum.d_smul
statement: theorem d_smul (r : S) (z : ComplexSum K) : d (r • z) = r • d z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using ComplexSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x =>
    rw [← map_smul, d_of, d_of, ← map_smul]
    congr 1
    exact (K.d n (n + 1)).hom.map_smul r x
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [smul_add, d_add, hz, hz', d_add, smul_add]

name: DG.ComplexSum.algebraMap_smul_of

theorem algebraMap_smul_of (r : R) (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) :

name: DG.Homotopic.zsmul
statement: theorem zsmul (k : ℤ) (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (k • f) (k • g)
proof: := ⟨h.some.zsmul k⟩

name: DG.Homotopic.comp_right
statement: theorem comp_right (h : Homotopic e f) (g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) : Homotopic (g.comp e) (g.comp f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.compRight g⟩

name: DG.Homotopic.comp_left
statement:
theorem comp_left {f g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P} (h : Homotopic f g) (e : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    Homotopic (f.comp e) (g.comp e)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.compLeft e⟩

name: DG.Homotopic.comp
statement:
theorem comp {f₁ g₁ : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} {f₂ g₂ : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P} (h₁ : Homotopic f₁ g₁)
    (h₂ : Homotopic f₂ g₂) : Homotopic (f₂.comp f₁) (g₂.comp g₁)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h₁.some.comp h₂.some⟩

name: DG.Homotopic.iff_sub
statement: theorem iff_sub : Homotopic f g ↔ Homotopic (f - g) 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨DGHomotopy.equivSubZero h⟩, fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨DGHomotopy.equivSubZero.symm h⟩⟩

name: DG.homotopic_equivalence
statement: theorem homotopic_equivalence : Equivalence (Homotopic : (M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) → (M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) → Prop)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Homotopic.refl, Homotopic.symm, Homotopic.trans⟩

name: DG.mem_nullHomotopic_iff
statement: theorem mem_nullHomotopic_iff {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} : f ∈ nullHomotopic A M N ↔ Homotopic f 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} :
    f ∈ nullHomotopic A M N ↔ ∃ h : Cochain A M N (-1), ofHom f = δ (-1) 0 h
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨h.hom, by rw [h.ofHom_eq, ofHom_zero, add_zero]⟩, fun ⟨h, hh⟩ =>
    ⟨⟨h, by rw [hh, ofHom_zero, add_zero]⟩⟩⟩

name: DG.homotopic_iff_sub_mem
statement:
theorem homotopic_iff_sub_mem {f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} :
    Homotopic f g ↔ f - g ∈ nullHomotopic A M N
proof:
:=
  Homotopic.iff_sub

name: DG.nullHomotopicMap_mem
statement:
theorem nullHomotopicMap_mem (h : Cochain A M N (-1)) :
    DGHomotopy.nullHomotopicMap h ∈ nullHomotopic A M N
proof:
:=
  ⟨DGHomotopy.nullHomotopy h⟩

name: DG.comp_mem_nullHomotopic
statement:
theorem comp_mem_nullHomotopic {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hf : f ∈ nullHomotopic A M N)
    (g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) : g.comp f ∈ nullHomotopic A M P
proof:
:=
  (Homotopic.comp_right hf g).trans (Homotopic.of_eq (DGModuleHom.comp_zero g))

name: DG.mem_nullHomotopic_comp
statement:
theorem mem_nullHomotopic_comp {f : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P} (hf : f ∈ nullHomotopic A N P)
    (e : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : f.comp e ∈ nullHomotopic A M P
proof:
:=
  (Homotopic.comp_left hf e).trans (Homotopic.of_eq (DGModuleHom.zero_comp e))

name: DG.Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coboundaries_iff {n : ℤ} (m : ℤ) (hmn : m + 1 = n) (z : Cocycle A M N n) :
    z ∈ Cocycle.coboundaries A M N n ↔ ∃ y : Cochain A M N m, δ m n y = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : m = n - 1 := by omega
  rfl

name: DG.quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv_mk (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv A M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (Cocycle.ofHom f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.coe_cocyclesAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_cocyclesAddEquiv_apply (n : ℤ) (z : Cocycle A M N n) :
    (cocyclesAddEquiv A M N n z : HOM A M N) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) n (z : Cochain A M N n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.cocyclesAddEquiv_mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem cocyclesAddEquiv_mem_coboundaries_iff (n : ℤ) (z : Cocycle A M N n) :
    (cocyclesAddEquiv A M N n z : HOM A M N) ∈ coboundaries (HOM A M N) n ↔
      z ∈ Cocycle.coboundaries A M N n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff (n - 1) (sub_add_cancel n 1), mem_coboundaries,
    coe_cocyclesAddEquiv_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hdx⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mem_summand.mp hx
    refine ⟨y, DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun n => Cochain A M N n) n ?_⟩
    rw [← hdx, d_of]
    exact (of_congr (sub_add_cancel n 1).symm fun x => by
      rw [δ_apply _ _ (sub_add_cancel n 1), δ_apply _ _ rfl])
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) (n - 1) y, of_mem_summand _ _, ?_⟩
    rw [d_of, ← hy]
    exact of_congr (sub_add_cancel n 1) fun x => by
      rw [δ_apply _ _ rfl, δ_apply _ _ (sub_add_cancel n 1)]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.cohomologyAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyAddEquiv_mk (n : ℤ) (z : Cocycle A M N n) :
    cohomologyAddEquiv A M N n (cohomology.mk _ n (cocyclesAddEquiv A M N n z)) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk z
proof:
:= by
  show QuotientAddGroup.mk' _ ((cocyclesAddEquiv A M N n).symm (cocyclesAddEquiv A M N n z)) = _
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology_mk (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology A M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      cohomology.mk _ 0 (DGModule.HOM.cocyclesAddEquiv A M N 0 (Cocycle.ofHom f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology, AddEquiv.trans_apply,
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv_mk, AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq,
    DGModule.HOM.cohomologyAddEquiv_mk]

name: DG.DGHomotopy.cohomology_map_eq
statement:
theorem DGHomotopy.cohomology_map_eq {f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (h : DGHomotopy f g) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomology.map f n = cohomology.map g n
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, cohomology.map_mk]
  rw [cohomology.mk_eq_mk_iff]
  refine ⟨h.hom z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h.hom.map_mem (cocycles.mem_grading z)
  · simp [h.comm z, cocycles.d_eq_zero z]

name: DG.Homotopic.cohomology_map_eq
statement:
theorem Homotopic.cohomology_map_eq {f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (h : Homotopic f g) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomology.map f n = cohomology.map g n
proof:
:=
  h.some.cohomology_map_eq n

name: DG.DGHomotopyEquiv.cohomology_map_inv_hom
statement:
theorem cohomology_map_inv_hom (e : DGHomotopyEquiv A M N) (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology M n) :
    cohomology.map e.inv n (cohomology.map e.hom n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cohomology.map_comp_apply, e.homotopyHomInvId.cohomology_map_eq, cohomology.map_id]
  rfl

name: DG.DGHomotopyEquiv.cohomology_map_hom_inv
statement:
theorem cohomology_map_hom_inv (e : DGHomotopyEquiv A M N) (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology N n) :
    cohomology.map e.hom n (cohomology.map e.inv n x) = x
proof:
:=
  e.symm.cohomology_map_inv_hom n x

name: DG.DGHomotopyEquiv.isQuasiIso_hom
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_hom (e : DGHomotopyEquiv A M N) : e.hom.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= fun n =>
  Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
    ⟨cohomology.map e.inv n, e.cohomology_map_inv_hom n, e.cohomology_map_hom_inv n⟩

name: DG.DGHomotopyEquiv.isQuasiIso_inv
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_inv (e : DGHomotopyEquiv A M N) : e.inv.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:=
  e.symm.isQuasiIso_hom

name: DG.IsContractible.homotopic_zero_of_left
statement: theorem homotopic_zero_of_left (hM : IsContractible A M) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : Homotopic f 0
proof:
:=
  (hM.comp_right f).trans (Homotopic.of_eq (DGModuleHom.comp_zero f))

name: DG.IsContractible.homotopic_zero_of_right
statement: theorem homotopic_zero_of_right (hN : IsContractible A N) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : Homotopic f 0
proof:
:=
  (hN.comp_left f).trans (Homotopic.of_eq (DGModuleHom.zero_comp f))

name: DG.IsContractible.subsingleton_cohomology
statement:
theorem subsingleton_cohomology (hM : IsContractible A M) (n : ℤ) :
    Subsingleton (cohomology M n)
proof:
:= by
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => φ x) (hM.cohomology_map_eq n)
  simpa using h

name: DG.IsContractible.cohomology_eq_zero
statement: theorem cohomology_eq_zero (hM : IsContractible A M) {n : ℤ} (x : cohomology M n) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  (hM.subsingleton_cohomology n).elim x 0

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.cohomologyAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyAddEquiv_mk (e : DGAddEquiv M N) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n) :
    e.cohomologyAddEquiv n (cohomology.mk M n z) =
      cohomology.mk N n ⟨e z, e.map_mem z.2.1,
        show d (e (z : M)) = 0 by rw [← map_d, cocycles.d_eq_zero z, map_zero]⟩
proof:
:=
  cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mk e.toAddEquiv.toAddMonoidHom e.map_mem' e.map_d' n z

name: DG.cohomology.d_unmk_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem d_unmk_eq_zero_iff (a : ℤ) (x : Shift a X) : d (unmk a x) = 0 ↔ d x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (unmk a).injective
    rw [unmk_d, h, smul_zero, unmk_zero]
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg (unmk a) h
    rw [unmk_d, unmk_zero] at h'
    simpa only [smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, smul_zero] using
      congrArg (koszulSign a • ·) h'

name: DG.cohomology.shiftCocyclesAddEquiv_mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem shiftCocyclesAddEquiv_mem_coboundaries_iff (a k l : ℤ) (h : k + a = l)
    (z : cocycles (Shift a X) k) :
    (shiftCocyclesAddEquiv X a k l h z : X) ∈ coboundaries X l ↔
      (z : Shift a X) ∈ coboundaries (Shift a X) k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
    refine ⟨Shift.mk a (koszulSign a • y), ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Shift.mem_grading_iff.mpr ?_
      convert units_smul_mem_grading (koszulSign a) hy using 2
      omega
    · rw [d_mk, d_units_smul, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, hyz]
      rfl
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
    refine ⟨koszulSign a • unmk a y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h' := units_smul_mem_grading (koszulSign a) (unmk_mem_grading hy)
      rwa [show k - 1 + a = l - 1 by omega] at h'
    · rw [d_units_smul, ← unmk_d, hyz]
      rfl

name: DG.cohomology.shiftAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftAddEquiv_mk (a k l : ℤ) (h : k + a = l) (z : cocycles (Shift a X) k) :
