    shiftAddEquiv X a k l h (mk _ k z) = mk X l (shiftCocyclesAddEquiv X a k l h z)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.rightShiftAddHom_of
statement:
theorem rightShiftAddHom_of (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M (Shift a N) k) :
    rightShiftAddHom A M N a (DirectSum.of _ k z) =
      Shift.mk a (DirectSum.of _ (k + a) (z.rightUnshift (k + a) rfl))
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightShiftAddHom]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.rightUnshiftAddHom_mk_of
statement:
theorem rightUnshiftAddHom_mk_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    rightUnshiftAddHom A M N a (Shift.mk a (DirectSum.of _ n z)) =
      DirectSum.of _ (n - a) (z.rightShift a (n - a) (sub_add_cancel n a))
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightUnshiftAddHom]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.rightShiftEquiv_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShiftEquiv_of (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M (Shift a N) k) :
    rightShiftEquiv A M N a (DirectSum.of _ k z) =
      Shift.mk a (DirectSum.of _ (k + a) (z.rightUnshift (k + a) rfl))
proof:
:=
  rightShiftAddHom_of k z

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.rightShiftEquiv_symm_mk_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShiftEquiv_symm_mk_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    (rightShiftEquiv A M N a).symm (Shift.mk a (DirectSum.of _ n z)) =
      DirectSum.of _ (n - a) (z.rightShift a (n - a) (sub_add_cancel n a))
proof:
:=
  rightUnshiftAddHom_mk_of n z

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.leftShiftAddHom_of
statement:
theorem leftShiftAddHom_of (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain A (Shift a M) N k) :
    leftShiftAddHom A M N a (DirectSum.of _ k z) =
      Shift.mk (-a)
        (DirectSum.of _ (k + -a) (z.leftUnshift (k + -a) (neg_add_cancel_right k a)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftShiftAddHom]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.leftUnshiftAddHom_mk_of
statement:
theorem leftUnshiftAddHom_mk_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    leftUnshiftAddHom A M N a (Shift.mk (-a) (DirectSum.of _ n z)) =
      DirectSum.of _ (n + a) (z.leftShift a (n + a) rfl)
proof:
:= by
  simp [leftUnshiftAddHom]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.leftShiftEquiv_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShiftEquiv_of (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain A (Shift a M) N k) :
    leftShiftEquiv A M N a (DirectSum.of _ k z) =
      Shift.mk (-a) (DirectSum.of _ (k + -a) (z.leftUnshift (k + -a) (neg_add_cancel_right k a)))
proof:
:=
  leftShiftAddHom_of k z

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.leftShiftEquiv_symm_mk_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShiftEquiv_symm_mk_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    (leftShiftEquiv A M N a).symm (Shift.mk (-a) (DirectSum.of _ n z)) =
      DirectSum.of _ (n + a) (z.leftShift a (n + a) rfl)
proof:
:=
  leftUnshiftAddHom_mk_of n z

name: DG.Cocycle.homShiftAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homShiftAddEquiv_apply (n : ℤ) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] Shift n N) (x : M) :
    (homShiftAddEquiv A M N n f : Cochain A M N n) x = unmk n (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cocycle.homShiftAddEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homShiftAddEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℤ) (z : Cocycle A M N n) (x : M) :
    (homShiftAddEquiv A M N n).symm z x = Shift.mk n ((z : Cochain A M N n) x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DirectSum.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : ⨁ i, M i} :
    x ∈ grading M n ↔ ∀ i, x i ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DirectSum.of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem of_mem_grading {n : ℤ} (i : ι) {m : M i} (hm : m ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n) :
    DirectSum.of M i m ∈ grading M n
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij; rwa [DirectSum.of_eq_same]
  · rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm hij)]; exact zero_mem _

name: DG.DirectSum.mem_iSup_grading
statement: theorem mem_iSup_grading (x : ⨁ i, M i) : x ∈ ⨆ n, grading M n
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | of i m =>
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | h_homogeneous m => exact AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem _ (of_mem_grading M i m.2)
    | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hm hm'
  | add x y hx hy => exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.DirectSum.isInternal_grading
statement: theorem isInternal_grading : DirectSum.IsInternal (grading M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_forall_eq_zero _ (fun i => DFinsupp.evalAddMonoidHom i)
      (fun _ _ _ hx => hx _) fun _ hx => DFinsupp.ext hx,
    coeAddMonoidHom_surjective_of_mem_iSup _ (mem_iSup_grading M)⟩

name: DG.DirectSum.d_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_apply (x : ⨁ i, M i) (i : ι) : d M x i = DGAddCommGroup.d (x i)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_apply _ _ _

name: DG.DirectSum.mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_grading {n : ℤ} {x : ⨁ i, M i} :
    x ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n ↔ ∀ i, x i ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DirectSum.coe_d_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_d_apply (x : ⨁ i, M i) (i : ι) : DGAddCommGroup.d x i = DGAddCommGroup.d (x i)
proof:
:=
  d_apply M x i

name: DG.DirectSum.d_of
statement:
theorem d_of (i : ι) (m : M i) :
    DGAddCommGroup.d (DirectSum.of M i m) = DirectSum.of M i (DGAddCommGroup.d m)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.DGModuleHom.lof_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lof_apply (i : ι) (m : M i) : lof A M i m = DirectSum.of M i m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.toModule_lof
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toModule_lof (f : ∀ i, M i →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (i : ι) (m : M i) :
    toModule f (DirectSum.of M i m) = f i m
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toModule_lof A i m

name: DG.DGModuleHom.toModule_comp_lof
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toModule_comp_lof (f : ∀ i, M i →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (i : ι) :
    (toModule f).comp (lof A M i) = f i
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext fun m => toModule_lof f i m

name: DG.DGModuleHom.directSum_ext
statement:
theorem directSum_ext {f g : (⨁ i, M i) →ᵈᵍ[A] N}
    (h : ∀ i, f.comp (lof A M i) = g.comp (lof A M i)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  toLinearMap_injective <| DirectSum.linearMap_ext A fun i => LinearMap.ext fun m =>
    congrArg (fun φ : M i →ᵈᵍ[A] N => φ m) (h i)

name: DG.GradedPi.mem_piGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_piGrading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : ∀ i, M i} :
    x ∈ piGrading M n ↔ ∀ i, x i ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n
proof:
:= by
  simp [piGrading, AddSubgroup.mem_pi]

name: DG.GradedPi.mem_submodule_iff
statement: theorem mem_submodule_iff {x : ∀ i, M i} : x ∈ submodule A M ↔ x ∈ ⨆ n, piGrading M n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.GradedPi.piGrading_le_submodule
statement: theorem piGrading_le_submodule (n : ℤ) : piGrading M n ≤ (submodule A M).toAddSubgroup
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem n hx

name: DG.GradedPi.toPi_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPi_add (x y : GradedPi A M) : toPi A M (x + y) = toPi A M x + toPi A M y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedPi.toPi_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPi_zero : toPi A M 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedPi.toPi_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPi_smul (a : A) (x : GradedPi A M) : toPi A M (a • x) = a • toPi A M x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedPi.toPi_injective
statement: theorem toPi_injective : Function.Injective (toPi A M)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.val_injective

name: DG.GradedPi.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {x y : GradedPi A M} (h : ∀ i, toPi A M x i = toPi A M y i) : x = y
proof:
:=
  toPi_injective A M (funext h)

name: DG.GradedPi.toPi_mem
statement: theorem toPi_mem (x : GradedPi A M) : toPi A M x ∈ ⨆ n, piGrading M n

name: DG.GradedPi.toPi_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPi_mk (x : ∀ i, M i) (hx : x ∈ ⨆ n, piGrading M n) : toPi A M (mk A M x hx) = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedPi.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : GradedPi A M} :
    x ∈ grading A M n ↔ ∀ i, toPi A M x i ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n
proof:
:=
  mem_piGrading_iff M

name: DG.GradedPi.isInternal_grading
statement: theorem isInternal_grading : DirectSum.IsInternal (grading A M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_forall_eq_zero _
      (fun i => (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom M i).comp (toPi A M).toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun i _ _ hx => (mem_grading_iff A M).mp hx i) fun _ hx => ext A M hx,
    coeAddMonoidHom_surjective_of_mem_iSup _ fun x => by
      refine AddSubgroup.iSup_induction' (piGrading M)
        (C := fun y hy => mk A M y hy ∈ ⨆ n, grading A M n) ?_ (zero_mem _) ?_ x.2
      · intro n y hy
        exact AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem n ((mem_grading_iff A M).mpr fun i =>
          (mem_piGrading_iff M).mp hy i)
      · intro y z hy hz hy' hz'
        exact add_mem hy' hz'⟩

name: DG.GradedPi.dPi_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dPi_apply (x : ∀ i, M i) (i : ι) : dPi M x i = DGAddCommGroup.d (x i)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedPi.dPi_mem
statement: theorem dPi_mem {x : ∀ i, M i} (hx : x ∈ ⨆ n, piGrading M n) : dPi M x ∈ ⨆ n, piGrading M n
proof:
:= by
  refine AddSubgroup.iSup_induction _ (C := fun x => dPi M x ∈ ⨆ n, piGrading M n) hx
    (fun n x hx => ?_) (by rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _)
    (fun x y hx hy => by rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy)
  exact AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (n + 1) ((mem_piGrading_iff M).mpr fun i =>
    DG.d_mem ((mem_piGrading_iff M).mp hx i))

name: DG.GradedPi.toPi_d_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPi_d_apply (x : GradedPi A M) (i : ι) :
    toPi A M (d A M x) i = DGAddCommGroup.d (toPi A M x i)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedPi.mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_grading {n : ℤ} {x : GradedPi A M} :
    x ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n ↔ ∀ i, toPi A M x i ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff A M

name: DG.GradedPi.toPi_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPi_d (x : GradedPi A M) (i : ι) :
    toPi A M (DGAddCommGroup.d x) i = DGAddCommGroup.d (toPi A M x i)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.proj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_apply (i : ι) (x : GradedPi A M) : proj A M i x = GradedPi.toPi A M x i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.pi_mem
statement:
theorem pi_mem (f : ∀ i, N →ᵈᵍ[A] M i) (x : N) :
    (fun i => f i x) ∈ ⨆ n, GradedPi.piGrading M n
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero =>
    have : (fun i => f i (0 : N)) = 0 := funext fun i => map_zero (f i)
    rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    exact AddSubgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem _ ((GradedPi.mem_piGrading_iff M).mpr fun i =>
      (f i).map_mem x.2)
  | h_add x y hx hy =>
    have : (fun i => f i (x + y)) = (fun i => f i x) + fun i => f i y :=
      funext fun i => map_add (f i) x y
    rw [this]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.DGModuleHom.toPi_pi_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPi_pi_apply (f : ∀ i, N →ᵈᵍ[A] M i) (x : N) (i : ι) :
    GradedPi.toPi A M (pi f x) i = f i x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.proj_comp_pi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_comp_pi (f : ∀ i, N →ᵈᵍ[A] M i) (i : ι) : (proj A M i).comp (pi f) = f i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.gradedPi_ext
statement:
theorem gradedPi_ext {f g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] GradedPi A M}
    (h : ∀ i, (proj A M i).comp f = (proj A M i).comp g) : f = g
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext fun x => GradedPi.ext A M fun i =>
    congrArg (fun φ : N →ᵈᵍ[A] M i => φ x) (h i)

name: DG.ks_eq
statement: private theorem ks_eq {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.units_smul_apply
statement:
private theorem units_smul_apply {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] (u : ℤˣ)
    (f : M →+ N) (m : M) : (u • f) m = u • f m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.koszulTwist_apply_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulTwist, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ ha]
  change liftHomogeneous (grading (M := M)) _ m = _
  rw [liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hm]
  rfl

name: DG.koszulTwist_koszulTwist
statement:
@[simp]
theorem koszulTwist_koszulTwist (f : A →+ M →+ N) : koszulTwist (koszulTwist f) = f
proof:
:=
  decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := A)) fun _ a =>
    decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := M)) fun _ m => by
      rw [koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ a.2 m.2, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ a.2 m.2, smul_smul,
        Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.DGRightModule.actHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem actHom_apply (a : A) (m : M) : actHom A M a m = MulOpposite.op a • m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGRightModule.koszulTwist_actHom_mul_of_mem
statement:
theorem koszulTwist_actHom_mul_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {x y : Aᵒᵖ} (hx : x ∈ grading i)
    (hy : y ∈ grading j) (m : M) :
    koszulTwist (actHom A M) (GradedOpposite.unop 𝒜 (x * y)) m =
      koszulTwist (actHom A M) (GradedOpposite.unop 𝒜 x)
        (koszulTwist (actHom A M) (GradedOpposite.unop 𝒜 y) m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
    rename_i k
    have ha := (GradedOpposite.mem_dgGrading_iff (R := R)).mp hx
    have hb := (GradedOpposite.mem_dgGrading_iff (R := R)).mp hy
    rw [GradedOpposite.unop_mul 𝒜 hx hy, map_koszulSign_smul, units_smul_apply,
      koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ (mul_mem_grading hb ha) hm, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ hb hm,
      map_koszulSign_smul,
      koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ ha
        (show actHom A M _ m ∈ grading (k + j) from op_smul_mem_grading hb hm)]
    rw [actHom_apply, actHom_apply, actHom_apply, MulOpposite.op_mul]
    simp only [smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 2
    ring
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => simp only [map_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.DGRightModule.opModule_smul
statement:
theorem opModule_smul (x : Aᵒᵖ) (m : M) :
    (letI := opModule R (A := A) (M := M); x • m) =
      koszulTwist (actHom A M) (GradedOpposite.unop 𝒜 x) m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGRightModule.opModule_op_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem opModule_op_smul_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {a : A} {m : M} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) :
    (letI := opModule R (A := A) (M := M); GradedOpposite.op 𝒜 a • m) =
      koszulSign (i * j) • (MulOpposite.op a • m)
proof:
:=
  koszulTwist_apply_of_mem (actHom A M) ha hm

name: DG.DGRightModule.dgModule_opModule
statement:
theorem dgModule_opModule :
    letI
proof:
:= opModule R (A := A) (M := M)
    DGModule Aᵒᵖ M :=
  letI := opModule R (A := A) (M := M)
  { smul_mem := fun i j x m hx hm => by
      rw [opModule_smul, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ ((GradedOpposite.mem_dgGrading_iff).mp hx) hm,
        Units.smul_def]
      refine zsmul_mem ?_ _
      rw [vadd_eq_add, add_comm]
      exact op_smul_mem_grading ((GradedOpposite.mem_dgGrading_iff).mp hx) hm
    d_smul' := fun {i x} hx m => by
      induction m using induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp only [smul_zero, d_zero, add_zero]
      | h_homogeneous m =>
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
        rename_i k
        have ha := (GradedOpposite.mem_dgGrading_iff (R := R)).mp hx
        rw [opModule_smul, opModule_smul, opModule_smul, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ ha hm,
          ← GradedOpposite.d_unop, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ (d_mem ha) hm,
          koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ ha (d_mem hm), d_units_smul, actHom_apply, actHom_apply,
          actHom_apply, d_op_smul hm]
        simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
        rw [ks_eq (m := i * k + k) (n := (i + 1) * k) ⟨0, by ring⟩,
          ks_eq (m := i + i * (k + 1)) (n := i * k) ⟨i, by ring⟩, add_comm]
      | h_add m m' hm hm' => simp only [smul_add, d_add, hm, hm']; abel }

name: DG.DGModule.opActHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem opActHom_apply (a : A) (m : M) :
    opActHom R A M a m = GradedOpposite.op 𝒜 a • m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.koszulTwist_opActHom_mul
statement:
theorem koszulTwist_opActHom_mul (a b : A) (m : M) :
    koszulTwist (opActHom R A M) (b * a) m =
      koszulTwist (opActHom R A M) a (koszulTwist (opActHom R A M) b m)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on generalizing m with
  | h_zero => simp only [mul_zero, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i i
    induction b using induction_on generalizing m with
    | h_zero => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
    | h_homogeneous b =>
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := b
      rename_i j
      induction m using induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp only [map_zero]
      | h_homogeneous m =>
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
        rename_i k
        have hopb := (GradedOpposite.op_mem_dgGrading_iff (R := R)).mpr hb
        have hopa := (GradedOpposite.op_mem_dgGrading_iff (R := R)).mpr ha
        rw [koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ (mul_mem_grading hb ha) hm, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ hb hm,
          map_koszulSign_smul,
          koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ ha
            (show opActHom R A M b m ∈ grading (j + k) from smul_mem_grading hopb hm),
          opActHom_apply, opActHom_apply, opActHom_apply,
          ← mul_smul (GradedOpposite.op 𝒜 a) (GradedOpposite.op 𝒜 b) m,
          GradedOpposite.op_mul_op 𝒜 ha hb, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_assoc,
          ← Units.smul_def, ← Units.smul_def]
        simp only [smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
        exact congrArg (· • _) (ks_eq ⟨-(i * j), by ring⟩)
      | h_add m m' hm hm' => simp only [map_add, hm, hm']
    | h_add b b' hb hb' => simp only [add_mul, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hb, hb']
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => simp only [mul_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, ha, ha']

name: DG.DGModule.mulOppositeModule_smul
statement:
theorem mulOppositeModule_smul (x : Aᵐᵒᵖ) (m : M) :
    (letI := mulOppositeModule R (A := A) (M := M); x • m) =
      koszulTwist (opActHom R A M) (MulOpposite.unop x) m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.mulOppositeModule_op_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem mulOppositeModule_op_smul_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {a : A} {m : M} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) :
    (letI := mulOppositeModule R (A := A) (M := M); MulOpposite.op a • m) =
      koszulSign (i * j) • (GradedOpposite.op 𝒜 a • m)
proof:
:=
  koszulTwist_apply_of_mem (opActHom R A M) ha hm

name: DG.DGModule.dgRightModule_mulOppositeModule
statement:
theorem dgRightModule_mulOppositeModule :
    letI
proof:
:= mulOppositeModule R (A := A) (M := M)
    DGRightModule A M :=
  letI := mulOppositeModule R (A := A) (M := M)
  { op_smul_mem' := fun {i j a m} ha hm => by
      rw [mulOppositeModule_op_smul_of_mem R ha hm, Units.smul_def, add_comm]
      exact zsmul_mem (smul_mem_grading ((GradedOpposite.op_mem_dgGrading_iff).mpr ha) hm) _
    d_op_smul' := fun {j m} hm a => by
      induction a using induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp only [MulOpposite.op_zero, zero_smul, d_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
      | h_homogeneous a =>
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
        rename_i i
        have hopa := (GradedOpposite.op_mem_dgGrading_iff (R := R)).mpr ha
        rw [mulOppositeModule_op_smul_of_mem R ha hm, mulOppositeModule_op_smul_of_mem R ha
          (d_mem hm), mulOppositeModule_op_smul_of_mem R (d_mem ha) hm, d_units_smul,
          d_smul hopa, GradedOpposite.d_op]
        simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
        rw [ks_eq (m := i * j + i) (n := i * (j + 1)) ⟨0, by ring⟩,
          ks_eq (m := j + (i + 1) * j) (n := i * j) ⟨j, by ring⟩, add_comm]
      | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
        simp only [MulOpposite.op_add, add_smul, d_add, ha, ha', smul_add]; abel }

name: DG.DGModule.ground_smul_mem_cocycles
statement:
theorem DGModule.ground_smul_mem_cocycles {n : ℤ} (r : R) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ cocycles M n) :
    r • m ∈ cocycles M n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_cocycles] at hm ⊢
  exact ⟨DGModule.ground_smul_mem A r hm.1, by rw [d_ground_smul A, hm.2, smul_zero]⟩

name: DG.DGModule.ground_smul_mem_coboundaries
statement:
theorem DGModule.ground_smul_mem_coboundaries {n : ℤ} (r : R) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ coboundaries M n) : r • m ∈ coboundaries M n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m', hm', rfl⟩ := hm
  exact ⟨r • m', DGModule.ground_smul_mem A r hm', d_ground_smul A r m'⟩

name: DG.DGModule.cocyclesSubmodule_toAddSubgroup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGModule.cocyclesSubmodule_toAddSubgroup (n : ℤ) :
    (DGModule.cocyclesSubmodule R A M n).toAddSubgroup = cocycles M n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.coboundariesSubmodule_toAddSubgroup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGModule.coboundariesSubmodule_toAddSubgroup (n : ℤ) :
    (DGModule.coboundariesSubmodule R A M n).toAddSubgroup = coboundaries M n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.cohomology.coe_groundSMulCocycles_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_groundSMulCocycles_apply (n : ℤ) (r : R) (z : cocycles M n) :
    (groundSMulCocycles A n r z : M) = r • (z : M)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.cohomology.groundModule_smul_mk
statement:
theorem groundModule_smul_mk {n : ℤ} (r : R) (z : cocycles M n) :
    letI
proof:
:= groundModule R A M n
    r • mk M n z = mk M n (groundSMulCocycles A n r z) := rfl

name: DG.cohomology.groundModule_smul_mkOf
statement:
theorem groundModule_smul_mkOf {n : ℤ} (r : R) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hd : d m = 0) :
    letI
proof:
:= groundModule R A M n
    r • mkOf hm hd = mkOf (DGModule.ground_smul_mem A r hm)
      (by rw [d_ground_smul A, hd, smul_zero]) := rfl

name: DG.cohomology.map_groundSMul
statement:
theorem map_groundSMul (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) (r : R) (x : cohomology M n) :
    letI
proof:
:= groundModule R A M n
    letI := groundModule R A N n
    map f n (r • x) = r • map f n x := by
  induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h z =>
    rw [groundModule_smul_mk, map_mk, map_mk, groundModule_smul_mk]
    refine congrArg (mk N n) (Subtype.ext ?_)
    change f (r • (z : M)) = r • f z
    rw [← algebraMap_smul A r (z : M), map_smul, algebraMap_smul]

name: DG.cohomology.smul_mk
statement:
theorem smul_mk {n : ℤ} (r : R) (z : cocycles A n) :
    r • mk A n z = mk A n (groundSMulCocycles A n r z)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.cohomology.smul_mkOf
statement:
theorem smul_mkOf {n : ℤ} (r : R) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hd : d a = 0) :
    r • mkOf ha hd = mkOf (DGModule.ground_smul_mem A r ha)
      (by rw [d_ground_smul A, hd, smul_zero])
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cohomology.smul_mul_mk
statement:
theorem smul_mul_mk {i j : ℤ} (r : R) (a : cocycles A i) (b : cocycles A j) :
    GMul.mul (r • cohomology.mk A i a) (cohomology.mk A j b) =
      r • GMul.mul (cohomology.mk A i a) (cohomology.mk A j b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cohomology.smul_mk, mk_mul_mk, mk_mul_mk, cohomology.smul_mk]
  exact congrArg (cohomology.mk A (i + j)) (Subtype.ext (smul_mul_assoc r (a : A) b))

name: DG.Cohomology.algebraMapZero_apply
statement: theorem algebraMapZero_apply (r : R) : algebraMapZero R A r = r • GOne.one
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cohomology.algebraMapZero_eq_mk
statement:
theorem algebraMapZero_eq_mk (r : R) :
    algebraMapZero R A r = cohomology.mk A 0 ⟨algebraMap R A r,
      mem_cocycles.mpr ⟨algebraMap_mem_grading R r, d_algebraMap R r⟩⟩
proof:
:=
  congrArg (cohomology.mk A 0) (Subtype.ext (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one r).symm)

name: DG.Cohomology.algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_apply (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (Cohomology A) r =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) 0 (algebraMapZero R A r)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAlgHom.cohomologyMap_smul
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_smul (n : ℤ) (r : R) (x : cohomology A n) :
    f.toDGRingHom.cohomologyMap n (r • x) = r • f.toDGRingHom.cohomologyMap n x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h z =>
    rw [cohomology.smul_mk, DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mk, DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mk,
      cohomology.smul_mk]
    exact congrArg (cohomology.mk B n) (Subtype.ext (map_smul f r (z : A)))

name: DG.DGAlgHom.cohomologyAlgHom_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyAlgHom_of (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology A n) :
    f.cohomologyAlgHom (DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) n x) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology B n) n (f.toDGRingHom.cohomologyMap n x)
proof:
:=
  DGRingHom.cohomologyRingHom_of _ n x

name: DG.DGAlgHom.toRingHom_cohomologyAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toRingHom_cohomologyAlgHom :
    (f.cohomologyAlgHom : Cohomology A →+* Cohomology B) = f.toDGRingHom.cohomologyRingHom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.mk_surjective
statement: theorem mk_surjective (n : ℤ) : Function.Surjective (mk M n)
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: DG.cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_iff {n : ℤ} (z : cocycles M n) :
    mk M n z = 0 ↔ (z : M) ∈ coboundaries M n
proof:
:=
  (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff z).trans (AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf)

name: DG.cohomology.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {n : ℤ} (z z' : cocycles M n) :
    mk M n z = mk M n z' ↔ (z : M) - z' ∈ coboundaries M n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, mk_eq_zero_iff]
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.mk_eq_mk_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_of_sub_mem {n : ℤ} {z z' : cocycles M n}
    (h : (z : M) - z' ∈ coboundaries M n) : mk M n z = mk M n z'
proof:
:=
  (mk_eq_mk_iff z z').mpr h

name: DG.cohomology.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {n : ℤ} {motive : cohomology M n → Prop} (x : cohomology M n)
    (h : ∀ z : cocycles M n, motive (mk M n z)) : motive x
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.induction_on x h

name: DG.cohomology.addMonoidHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem addMonoidHom_ext {n : ℤ} {G : Type*} [AddMonoid G] ⦃f g : cohomology M n →+ G⦄
    (h : f.comp (mk M n) = g.comp (mk M n)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.addMonoidHom_ext ((coboundaries M n).addSubgroupOf (cocycles M n)) h

name: DG.cohomology.mkOf_eq_mk
statement:
theorem mkOf_eq_mk {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hd : d m = 0) :
    mkOf hm hd = mk M n ⟨m, hm, hd⟩
proof: := rfl

name: DG.cohomology.mkOf_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mkOf_eq_zero_iff {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hd : d m = 0) :
    mkOf hm hd = 0 ↔ m ∈ coboundaries M n
proof:
:=
  mk_eq_zero_iff _

name: DG.cohomology.mkOf_d
statement:
theorem mkOf_d {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading (n - 1)) (hd : d (d m) = 0) :
    mkOf (by simpa using d_mem hm) hd = 0
proof:
:=
  (mkOf_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩

name: DG.cohomology.mkOf_add
statement:
theorem mkOf_add {n : ℤ} {m m' : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hd : d m = 0)
    (hm' : m' ∈ grading n) (hd' : d m' = 0) :
    mkOf (add_mem hm hm') (by rw [d_add, hd, hd', add_zero]) = mkOf hm hd + mkOf hm' hd'
proof:
:=
  map_add (mk M n) ⟨m, hm, hd⟩ ⟨m', hm', hd'⟩

name: DG.cohomology.mkOf_neg
statement:
theorem mkOf_neg {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hd : d m = 0) :
    mkOf (neg_mem hm) (by rw [d_neg, hd, neg_zero]) = -mkOf hm hd
proof:
:=
  map_neg (mk M n) ⟨m, hm, hd⟩

name: DG.cohomology.mkOf_zsmul
statement:
theorem mkOf_zsmul {n : ℤ} (k : ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hd : d m = 0) :
    mkOf (zsmul_mem hm k) (by rw [d_zsmul, hd, smul_zero]) = k • mkOf hm hd
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (mk M n) k ⟨m, hm, hd⟩

name: DG.cohomology.mk_heq_mk
statement:
theorem mk_heq_mk {n n' : ℤ} (h : n = n') {z : cocycles M n} {z' : cocycles M n'}
    (hz : (z : M) = z') : HEq (mk M n z) (mk M n' z')
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [Subtype.ext hz]

name: DG.cohomology.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_mk {n : ℤ} {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (φ : cocycles M n →+ G)
    (hφ : ∀ z : cocycles M n, (z : M) ∈ coboundaries M n → φ z = 0) (z : cocycles M n) :
    lift φ hφ (mk M n z) = φ z
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk' _ _ z

name: DG.cocycles.mem_grading
statement: theorem mem_grading {n : ℤ} (z : cocycles M n) : (z : M) ∈ grading n

name: DG.cocycles.d_eq_zero
statement: theorem d_eq_zero {n : ℤ} (z : cocycles M n) : d (z : M) = 0

name: DG.cocycles.coe_mapAddMonoidHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_mapAddMonoidHom_apply (f : M →+ N)
    (hmem : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n) :
    (mapAddMonoidHom f hmem hd n z : N) = f z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.cocycles.mapAddMonoidHom_mem_coboundaries
statement:
theorem mapAddMonoidHom_mem_coboundaries (f : M →+ N)
    (hmem : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n)
    (hz : (z : M) ∈ coboundaries M n) :
    (mapAddMonoidHom f hmem hd n z : N) ∈ coboundaries N n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmz⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨f m, hmem hm, by rw [← hd, hmz]; rfl⟩

name: DG.cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapAddMonoidHom_mk (f : M →+ N)
    (hmem : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n) :
    mapAddMonoidHom f hmem hd n (mk M n z) = mk N n (cocycles.mapAddMonoidHom f hmem hd n z)
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ z

name: DG.cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mkOf
statement:
theorem mapAddMonoidHom_mkOf (f : M →+ N)
    (hmem : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hdm : d m = 0) :
    mapAddMonoidHom f hmem hd n (mkOf hm hdm) =
      mkOf (hmem hm) (by rw [← hd, hdm, map_zero])
proof:
:=
  mapAddMonoidHom_mk f hmem hd n ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩

name: DG.cohomology.map_mk
statement:
theorem map_mk (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n) :
    map f n (mk M n z) = mk N n ⟨f z, mem_cocycles.mpr ⟨f.map_mem (cocycles.mem_grading z),
      by rw [← f.map_d, cocycles.d_eq_zero z, map_zero]⟩⟩
proof:
:=
  mapAddMonoidHom_mk f.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom (fun hm => f.map_mem hm) f.map_d n z

name: DG.cohomology.map_mkOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_mkOf (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hd : d m = 0) :
    map f n (mkOf hm hd) = mkOf (f.map_mem hm) (by rw [← f.map_d, hd, map_zero])
proof:
:=
  map_mk f n ⟨m, hm, hd⟩

name: DG.cohomology.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (n : ℤ) : map (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) n = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  exact (map_mk _ n z).trans rfl

name: DG.cohomology.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) :
    map (g.comp f) n = (map g n).comp (map f n)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_mk]
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.map_comp_apply
statement:
theorem map_comp_apply (g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology M n) :
    map (g.comp f) n x = map g n (map f n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_comp]; rfl

name: DG.cohomology.map_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_zero (n : ℤ) : map (0 : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_mk, AddMonoidHom.zero_comp,
    AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
  rw [mk_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [DGModuleHom.zero_apply]
  exact zero_mem _

name: DG.cohomology.map_add
statement: theorem map_add (f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) : map (f + g) n = map f n + map g n
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_mk, AddMonoidHom.add_comp,
    AddMonoidHom.add_apply, ← _root_.map_add]
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.map_neg
statement: theorem map_neg (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) : map (-f) n = -map f n
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_mk, AddMonoidHom.neg_comp,
    AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, ← _root_.map_neg]
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.map_sub
statement: theorem map_sub (f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (n : ℤ) : map (f - g) n = map f n - map g n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, map_add, map_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.DGModuleHom.isQuasiIso_id
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_id : IsQuasiIso (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M)
proof:
:= fun n => by
  rw [cohomology.map_id]
  exact Function.bijective_id

name: DG.DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.comp
statement:
theorem IsQuasiIso.comp {g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P} {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hg : IsQuasiIso g)
    (hf : IsQuasiIso f) : IsQuasiIso (g.comp f)
proof:
:= fun n => by
  rw [cohomology.map_comp, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp]
  exact (hg n).comp (hf n)

name: DG.DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.of_comp_left
statement:
theorem IsQuasiIso.of_comp_left {g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P} {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hgf : IsQuasiIso (g.comp f))
    (hg : IsQuasiIso g) : IsQuasiIso f
proof:
:= fun n => by
  have h := hgf n
  rw [cohomology.map_comp, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp] at h
  exact ((hg n).of_comp_iff' _).mp h

name: DG.DGModuleHom.IsQuasiIso.of_comp_right
statement:
theorem IsQuasiIso.of_comp_right {g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P} {f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (hgf : IsQuasiIso (g.comp f))
    (hf : IsQuasiIso f) : IsQuasiIso g
proof:
:= fun n => by
  have h := hgf n
  rw [cohomology.map_comp, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp] at h
  exact (Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff _ (hf n)).mp h

name: DG.Cohomology.d_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_apply (x : Cohomology M) : d x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cohomology.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : Cohomology M} :
    x ∈ grading n ↔ ∃ y : cohomology M n, DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology M n) n y = x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.Cohomology.of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem of_mem_grading (n : ℤ) (y : cohomology M n) :
    DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology M n) n y ∈ grading (M := Cohomology M) n
proof:
:=
  ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: DG.cocycles.coe_smulHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_smulHom_apply {i j : ℤ} (a : cocycles A i) (m : cocycles M j) :
    (smulHom i j a m : M) = (a : A) • (m : M)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.cocycles.smulHom_mem_coboundaries_of_right
statement:
theorem smulHom_mem_coboundaries_of_right {i j : ℤ} (a : cocycles A i) (m : cocycles M j)
    (hm : (m : M) ∈ coboundaries M j) : (smulHom i j a m : M) ∈ coboundaries M (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m', hm', hd⟩ := hm
  refine ⟨koszulSign i • ((a : A) • m'), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Units.smul_def, Int.add_sub_assoc]
    exact zsmul_mem (smul_mem_grading (mem_grading a) hm') _
  · rw [d_units_smul, d_smul_of_d_eq_zero (mem_grading a) (d_eq_zero a), smul_smul,
      Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, coe_smulHom_apply, hd]

name: DG.cocycles.smulHom_mem_coboundaries_of_left
statement:
theorem smulHom_mem_coboundaries_of_left {i j : ℤ} (a : cocycles A i)
    (ha : (a : A) ∈ coboundaries A i) (m : cocycles M j) :
    (smulHom i j a m : M) ∈ coboundaries M (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hd⟩ := ha
  refine ⟨a' • (m : M), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show i + j - 1 = i - 1 + j by omega]
    exact smul_mem_grading ha' (mem_grading m)
  · rw [coe_smulHom_apply, d_smul ha', d_eq_zero m, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero, hd]

name: DG.cohomology.smulHom_mk_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smulHom_mk_mk {i j : ℤ} (a : cocycles A i) (m : cocycles M j) :
    smulHom i j (mk A i a) (mk M j m) = mk M (i + j) (cocycles.smulHom i j a m)
proof:
:= by
  simp [smulHom]

name: DG.cohomology.smulHom_mkOf_mkOf
statement:
theorem smulHom_mkOf_mkOf {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hda : d a = 0) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) (hdm : d m = 0) :
    smulHom i j (mkOf ha hda) (mkOf hm hdm) = mkOf (smul_mem_grading ha hm)
      (by rw [d_smul_of_d_eq_zero ha hda, hdm, smul_zero, smul_zero])
proof:
:=
  smulHom_mk_mk ⟨a, ha, hda⟩ ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩

name: DG.Cohomology.mk_mul_mk
statement:
theorem mk_mul_mk {i j : ℤ} (a : cocycles A i) (b : cocycles A j) :
    GMul.mul (cohomology.mk A i a) (cohomology.mk A j b) =
      cohomology.mk A (i + j) (cocycles.smulHom i j a b)
proof:
:=
  cohomology.smulHom_mk_mk a b

name: DG.Cohomology.one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (GOne.one : cohomology A 0) = cohomology.mk A 0 ⟨1, one_mem_grading, d_one⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.Cohomology.of_mul_of
statement:
theorem of_mul_of {i j : ℤ} (a : cohomology A i) (b : cohomology A j) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) i a * DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) j b :
      Cohomology A) = DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) (i + j) (cohomology.smulHom i j a b)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of a b

name: DG.Cohomology.one_eq
statement: theorem one_eq : (1 : Cohomology A) = DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) 0 GOne.one
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.Cohomology.of_smul_of
statement:
theorem of_smul_of {i j : ℤ} (a : cohomology A i) (m : cohomology M j) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) i a • DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology M n) j m :
      Cohomology M) = DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology M n) (i + j) (cohomology.smulHom i j a m)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.Gmodule.of_smul_of _ _ a m

name: DG.cohomology.prodAddEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
theorem prodAddEquiv_apply_mk (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles (M × N) n) :
    prodAddEquiv M N n (mk _ n z) =
      (mk M n ⟨(z : M × N).1, (cocycles.mem_grading z).1, congrArg Prod.fst (cocycles.d_eq_zero z)⟩,
        mk N n ⟨(z : M × N).2, (cocycles.mem_grading z).2,
          congrArg Prod.snd (cocycles.d_eq_zero z)⟩)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.prodAddEquiv_apply_fst
statement:
theorem prodAddEquiv_apply_fst (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology (M × N) n) :
    (prodAddEquiv M N n x).1 = map (DGModuleHom.fst (A := A) M N) n x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.cohomology.prodAddEquiv_apply_snd
statement:
theorem prodAddEquiv_apply_snd (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology (M × N) n) :
    (prodAddEquiv M N n x).2 = map (DGModuleHom.snd (A := A) M N) n x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.op_smul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem op_smul_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {a : A} {m : M} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) : op a • m ∈ grading (j + i)
proof:
:=
  DGRightModule.op_smul_mem' ha hm

name: DG.op_smul_mem_grading'
statement:
theorem op_smul_mem_grading' {i j : ℤ} {a : A} {m : M} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) : op a • m ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]; exact op_smul_mem_grading ha hm

name: DG.d_op_smul
statement:
theorem d_op_smul {j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading j) (a : A) :
    d (op a • m) = op a • d m + koszulSign j • (op (d a) • m)
proof:
:=
  DGRightModule.d_op_smul' hm a

name: DG.d_op_smul_of_even
statement:
theorem d_op_smul_of_even {j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading j) (hj : Even j) (a : A) :
    d (op a • m) = op a • d m + op (d a) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_op_smul hm, koszulSign_even hj, one_smul]

name: DG.d_op_smul_of_odd
statement:
theorem d_op_smul_of_odd {j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading j) (hj : Odd j) (a : A) :
    d (op a • m) = op a • d m - op (d a) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_op_smul hm, koszulSign_odd hj, Units.neg_smul, one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.d_op_smul_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem d_op_smul_of_mem_zero {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading 0) (a : A) :
    d (op a • m) = op a • d m + op (d a) • m
proof:
:=
  d_op_smul_of_even hm Even.zero a

name: DG.d_op_smul_of_d_eq_zero
statement:
theorem d_op_smul_of_d_eq_zero {j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading j) {a : A} (hda : d a = 0) :
    d (op a • m) = op a • d m
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_op_smul hm, hda, op_zero, zero_smul, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.d_op_smul_of_d_eq_zero'
statement:
theorem d_op_smul_of_d_eq_zero' {a : A} (hda : d a = 0) (m : M) :
    d (op a • m) = op a • d m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m => exact d_op_smul_of_d_eq_zero m.2 hda
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, d_add, hm, hm', d_add, smul_add]

name: DG.DGRightModule.ground_smul_mem
statement:
theorem DGRightModule.ground_smul_mem {n : ℤ} (r : R) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) :
    r • m ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul Aᵐᵒᵖ r m, MulOpposite.algebraMap_apply]
  simpa using op_smul_mem_grading (algebraMap_mem_grading R (A := A) r) hm

name: DG.DGRightModule.d_ground_smul
statement: theorem DGRightModule.d_ground_smul (r : R) (m : M) : d (r • m) = r • d m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul Aᵐᵒᵖ r m, MulOpposite.algebraMap_apply,
    d_op_smul_of_d_eq_zero' (d_algebraMap R r), ← MulOpposite.algebraMap_apply, algebraMap_smul]

name: DG.DGRightModule.mem_gradingSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGRightModule.mem_gradingSubmodule {n : ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ DGRightModule.gradingSubmodule R A M n ↔ m ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGRightModule.dLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGRightModule.dLinear_apply (m : M) : DGRightModule.dLinear R A M m = d m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGBimodule.mk'
statement:
theorem DGBimodule.mk' [DGModule A M] [DGRightModule B M] [SMulCommClass A Bᵐᵒᵖ M] :
    DGBimodule A B M

name: DG.DGBimodule.smul_op_smul
statement:
theorem DGBimodule.smul_op_smul [DGBimodule A B M] (a : A) (b : B) (m : M) :
    a • (op b • m) = op b • (a • m)
proof:
:=
  smul_comm a (op b) m

name: DG.DGModule.END.selfEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem selfEquiv_apply (F : END A A) : selfEquiv A F = op F • (1 : A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.selfEquiv_of
statement:
theorem selfEquiv_of {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A A A n) :
    selfEquiv A (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A A A n) n f) = f 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [selfEquiv_apply, op_of_smul f one_mem_grading, mul_zero, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero,
    one_smul]

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_selfEquiv_symm_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem op_selfEquiv_symm_smul (a x : A) : op ((selfEquiv A).symm a) • x = x * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [selfEquiv, DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_symm_apply, DGBimodule.op_toEND_smul,
    op_smul_eq_mul]

name: DG.DGModule.END.selfEquiv_d
statement: theorem selfEquiv_d (F : END A A) : selfEquiv A (d F) = d (selfEquiv A F)
proof:
:=
  DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_d F

name: DG.DGModule.END.selfEquiv_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem selfEquiv_mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {F : END A A} :
    selfEquiv A F ∈ grading n ↔ F ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_mem_grading_iff

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_idem : (idem e : A) = e.val
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.idem_mem_grading
statement: theorem idem_mem_grading : idem e ∈ grading 0
proof: := e.mem_zero

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.smul_idem
statement: theorem smul_idem (x : e.LeftCorner) : (x : A) • idem e = x
proof: := Subtype.ext x.2

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.val_smul_idem
statement: theorem val_smul_idem : e.val • idem e = idem e
proof: := Subtype.ext e.mul_self

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.op_smul_idem_mem
statement:
theorem op_smul_idem_mem (F : DGModule.END A e.LeftCorner) :
    ((op F • idem e : e.LeftCorner) : A) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:= by
  refine (Corner.mem_iff e).mpr ⟨?_, (op F • idem e).2⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [← val_smul_idem e, ← smul_comm]
  rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.coe_endLeftCornerEquiv
statement:
theorem coe_endLeftCornerEquiv (F : DGModule.END A e.LeftCorner) :
    (e.endLeftCornerEquiv F : A) = (op F • idem e : e.LeftCorner)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.endLeftCornerEquiv_of
statement:
theorem endLeftCornerEquiv_of {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A e.LeftCorner e.LeftCorner n) :
    (e.endLeftCornerEquiv (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A e.LeftCorner e.LeftCorner n) n f) :
      A) = f (idem e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_endLeftCornerEquiv, DGModule.END.op_of_smul f (idem_mem_grading e), mul_zero,
    koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.coe_op_endLeftCornerEquiv_symm_smul
statement:
theorem coe_op_endLeftCornerEquiv_symm_smul (y : e.Corner) (x : e.LeftCorner) :
    ((op (e.endLeftCornerEquiv.symm y) • x : e.LeftCorner) : A) = x * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [endLeftCornerEquiv, DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_symm_apply, DGBimodule.op_toEND_smul,
    LeftCorner.coe_op_smul]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.endLeftCornerEquiv_d
statement:
theorem endLeftCornerEquiv_d (F : DGModule.END A e.LeftCorner) :
    e.endLeftCornerEquiv (d F) = d (e.endLeftCornerEquiv F)
proof:
:=
  DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_d F

name: DG.DGIdempotent.endLeftCornerEquiv_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem endLeftCornerEquiv_mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {F : DGModule.END A e.LeftCorner} :
    e.endLeftCornerEquiv F ∈ grading n ↔ F ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_mem_grading_iff

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.isIdempotentElem
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem : IsIdempotentElem e.val
proof: := e.mul_self

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.mem_leftIdeal
statement: theorem mem_leftIdeal {a : A} : a ∈ e.leftIdeal ↔ a * e.val = a
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_mk (a : A) (h : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val) : (mk e a h : A) = a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_mem
statement: theorem coe_mem (x : e.Corner) : (x : A) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:=
  Subtype.property (p := (· ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val)) x

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.mem_iff
statement: theorem mem_iff {a : A} : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val ↔ e.val * a = a ∧ a * e.val = a
proof:
:=
  Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff e.isIdempotentElem

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.val_mul_coe
statement: theorem val_mul_coe (x : e.Corner) : e.val * (x : A) = x
proof: := (mem_iff e |>.mp (coe_mem e x)).1

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_mul_val
statement: theorem coe_mul_val (x : e.Corner) : (x : A) * e.val = x
proof: := (mem_iff e |>.mp (coe_mem e x)).2

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_zero : ((0 : e.Corner) : A) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_one
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_one : ((1 : e.Corner) : A) = e.val
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_add
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_add (x y : e.Corner) : ((x + y : e.Corner) : A) = x + y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_neg (x : e.Corner) : ((-x : e.Corner) : A) = -x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_sub (x y : e.Corner) : ((x - y : e.Corner) : A) = x - y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_mul (x y : e.Corner) : ((x * y : e.Corner) : A) = x * y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_zsmul
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_zsmul (k : ℤ) (x : e.Corner) : ((k • x : e.Corner) : A) = k • (x : A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_injective
statement: theorem coe_injective : Function.Injective ((↑) : e.Corner → A)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.val_injective (p := (· ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val))

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {x y : e.Corner} (h : (x : A) = y) : x = y
proof: := coe_injective e h

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.valAddHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem valAddHom_apply (x : e.Corner) : valAddHom e x = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.val_mul_d
statement: theorem val_mul_d : e.val * d e.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := d_mul_of_mem_zero e.mem_zero e.val
  rw [e.mul_self, e.d_mul_self] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.d_mul_val_mul_val
statement: theorem d_mul_val_mul_val (a : A) : d (a * e.val) * e.val = d (a * e.val)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rw [d_mul a.2, add_mul, mul_assoc, e.mul_self, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, e.d_mul_self]
  | h_add a b ha hb => rw [add_mul, d_add, add_mul, ha, hb]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.d_mem_leftIdeal
statement: theorem d_mem_leftIdeal {a : A} (ha : a ∈ e.leftIdeal) : d a ∈ e.leftIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_leftIdeal] at *
  conv_lhs => rw [← ha]
  rw [e.d_mul_val_mul_val, ha]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.decompose_mem_leftIdeal
statement:
theorem decompose_mem_leftIdeal {a : A} (ha : a ∈ e.leftIdeal) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) a n : A) ∈ e.leftIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_leftIdeal] at *
  rw [← DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_of_right_mem_zero _ e.mem_zero, ha]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_d (a : e.LeftCorner) : ((d a : e.LeftCorner) : A) = d (a : A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {a : e.LeftCorner} : a ∈ grading n ↔ (a : A) ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_idem : (idem e : A) = e.val
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.idem_mem_grading
statement: theorem idem_mem_grading : idem e ∈ grading 0
proof: := e.mem_zero

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.smul_idem
statement: theorem smul_idem (x : e.LeftCorner) : (x : A) • idem e = x
proof: := Subtype.ext x.2

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.val_smul_idem
statement: theorem val_smul_idem : e.val • idem e = idem e
proof: := Subtype.ext e.mul_self

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.decompose_mem
statement:
theorem decompose_mem {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) a n : A) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨he, he'⟩ := (mem_iff e).mp ha
  refine ⟨decompose (grading (M := A)) a n, ?_⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [← he, ← he', DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_of_left_mem_zero _ e.mem_zero,
    DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_of_right_mem_zero _ e.mem_zero, ← mul_assoc]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.hhom
statement:
theorem hhom (n : ℤ) (x : e.Corner) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) (valAddHom e x) n : A) ∈ (valAddHom e).range
proof:
:=
  ⟨mk e _ (decompose_mem e (coe_mem e x) n), rfl⟩

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.val_mul_d_mem
statement:
theorem val_mul_d_mem {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val) :
    e.val * d a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:= by
  have h := e.d_mul_val_mul_val a
  rw [((mem_iff e).mp ha).2] at h
  exact ⟨d a, show e.val * d a * e.val = _ by rw [mul_assoc, h]⟩

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_d (x : e.Corner) : ((d x : e.Corner) : A) = e.val * d (x : A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_d_mk
statement:
theorem coe_d_mk (a : A) :
    ((d (mk e (e.val * a * e.val) ⟨a, rfl⟩) : e.Corner) : A) = e.val * d (a * e.val)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_d, coe_mk, mul_assoc, d_mul_of_mem_zero e.mem_zero, mul_add, ← mul_assoc,
    val_mul_d, zero_mul, zero_add, ← mul_assoc, e.mul_self]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_d_of_d_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coe_d_of_d_eq_zero (h : d e.val = 0) (x : e.Corner) :
    ((d x : e.Corner) : A) = d (x : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_d]
  conv_rhs => rw [← val_mul_coe e x, d_mul_of_mem_zero e.mem_zero, h, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : e.Corner} : x ∈ grading n ↔ (x : A) ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_decompose
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_decompose (x : e.Corner) (n : ℤ) :
    ((decompose (grading (M := e.Corner)) x n : e.Corner) : A) =
      decompose (grading (M := A)) (x : A) n
proof:
:= by
  have h : gradingComapMap (valAddHom e) (decompose (grading (M := e.Corner)) x) =
      decompose (grading (M := A)) (x : A) := by
    apply (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (grading (M := A))).injective
    change DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom _ _ = (decompose (grading (M := A))).symm _
    rw [coeAddMonoidHom_gradingComapMap, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change valAddHom e ((decompose (grading (M := e.Corner))).symm _) = _
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  rw [← h]
  simp only [gradingComapMap, DirectSum.map_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_mul_corner_mem
statement:
theorem coe_mul_corner_mem (a : e.LeftCorner) (y : e.Corner) :
    (a : A) * (y : A) ∈ e.leftIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_leftIdeal, mul_assoc, Corner.coe_mul_val]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_op_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_op_smul (y : e.Corner) (a : e.LeftCorner) :
    ((op y • a : e.LeftCorner) : A) = a * y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_smul_op
statement:
theorem coe_smul_op (y : e.Cornerᵐᵒᵖ) (a : e.LeftCorner) :
    ((y • a : e.LeftCorner) : A) = a * (y.unop : A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.LeftCorner.op_smul_idem_mem
statement:
theorem op_smul_idem_mem (F : DGModule.END A e.LeftCorner) :
    ((op F • idem e : e.LeftCorner) : A) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:= by
  refine (Corner.mem_iff e).mpr ⟨?_, (op F • idem e).2⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [← val_smul_idem e, ← smul_comm]
  rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.coe_endLeftCornerEquiv
statement:
theorem coe_endLeftCornerEquiv (F : DGModule.END A e.LeftCorner) :
    (e.endLeftCornerEquiv F : A) = (op F • idem e : e.LeftCorner)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.endLeftCornerEquiv_of
statement:
theorem endLeftCornerEquiv_of {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A e.LeftCorner e.LeftCorner n) :
    (e.endLeftCornerEquiv (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A e.LeftCorner e.LeftCorner n) n f) :
      A) = f (idem e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_endLeftCornerEquiv, DGModule.END.op_of_smul f (idem_mem_grading e), mul_zero,
    koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.coe_op_endLeftCornerEquiv_symm_smul
statement:
theorem coe_op_endLeftCornerEquiv_symm_smul (y : e.Corner) (x : e.LeftCorner) :
    ((op (e.endLeftCornerEquiv.symm y) • x : e.LeftCorner) : A) = x * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [endLeftCornerEquiv, DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_symm_apply, DGBimodule.op_toEND_smul,
    LeftCorner.coe_op_smul]

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.endLeftCornerEquiv_d
statement:
theorem endLeftCornerEquiv_d (F : DGModule.END A e.LeftCorner) :
    e.endLeftCornerEquiv (d F) = d (e.endLeftCornerEquiv F)
proof:
:=
  DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_d F

name: DG.LeftDGIdempotent.endLeftCornerEquiv_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem endLeftCornerEquiv_mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {F : DGModule.END A e.LeftCorner} :
    e.endLeftCornerEquiv F ∈ grading n ↔ F ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_mem_grading_iff

name: DG.DGIdempotent.coe_toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv
statement:
theorem coe_toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv (x : e.toLeftDGIdempotent.Corner) :
    (e.toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv x : A) = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv_mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : e.toLeftDGIdempotent.Corner} :
    e.toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv x ∈ grading n ↔ x ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv_d
statement:
theorem toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv_d (x : e.toLeftDGIdempotent.Corner) :
    e.toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv (d x) = d (e.toLeftDGIdempotentCornerEquiv x)
proof:
:=
  DGIdempotent.Corner.ext e (LeftDGIdempotent.Corner.coe_d_of_d_eq_zero _ e.d_eq_zero x)

name: DG.gradeInvolution_of_mem
statement:
theorem gradeInvolution_of_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) :
    gradeInvolution M m = koszulSign n • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradeInvolution, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hm, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.gradeInvolution_mem
statement:
theorem gradeInvolution_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) :
    gradeInvolution M m ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradeInvolution_of_mem hm, Units.smul_def]
  exact zsmul_mem hm _

name: DG.map_units_zsmul
statement:
theorem map_units_zsmul {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [AddCommGroup Y] (f : X →+ Y) (u : ℤˣ)
    (x : X) : f (u • x) = u • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.gradeInvolution_gradeInvolution
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradeInvolution_gradeInvolution (m : M) :
    gradeInvolution M (gradeInvolution M m) = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rw [gradeInvolution_of_mem m.2, map_units_zsmul, gradeInvolution_of_mem m.2, smul_smul,
      Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.d_gradeInvolution
statement: theorem d_gradeInvolution (m : M) : d (gradeInvolution M m) = -gradeInvolution M (d m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rw [gradeInvolution_of_mem m.2, gradeInvolution_of_mem (d_mem m.2), d_units_smul,
      show koszulSign (_ + 1) = -koszulSign _ from Int.negOnePow_succ _, Units.neg_smul, neg_neg]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => simp only [map_add, hm, hm', neg_add]

name: DG.tmul_mem_tensorGrading
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_tensorGrading {i j k : ℤ} (h : i + j = k) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) : m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n ∈ tensorGrading M N k
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, h, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩

name: DG.tensor_induction_on
statement:
theorem tensor_induction_on {P : M ⊗[ℤ] N → Prop} (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ {i j : ℤ} (m : grading (M := M) i) (n : grading (M := N) j), P ((m : M) ⊗ₜ (n : N)))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul m n =>
    induction m using induction_on with
    | h_zero => simpa using zero
    | h_homogeneous m =>
      induction n using induction_on with
      | h_zero => simpa using zero
      | h_homogeneous n => exact tmul m n
      | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [tmul_add]; exact add _ _ hn hn'
    | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [add_tmul]; exact add _ _ hm hm'
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy

name: DG.tensor_addHom_ext
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => tensor_induction_on (P := fun x => f x = g x) x (by simp) h
    (fun x y (hx : f x = g x) (hy : f y = g y) => by
      show f (x + y) = g (x + y); rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy])

name: DG.tensorD_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorD_tmul (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorD M N (m ⊗ₜ n) = d m ⊗ₜ n + gradeInvolution M m ⊗ₜ d n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.tensorD_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem tensorD_tmul_of_mem {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) (n : N) :
    tensorD M N (m ⊗ₜ n) = d m ⊗ₜ n + koszulSign i • (m ⊗ₜ d n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorD_tmul, gradeInvolution_of_mem hm, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_tmul']

name: DG.tensorD_tensorD
statement: theorem tensorD_tensorD (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : tensorD M N (tensorD M N x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul m n =>
    rw [tensorD_tmul, map_add, tensorD_tmul, tensorD_tmul, d_d, zero_tmul, zero_add, d_d,
      tmul_zero, d_gradeInvolution, neg_tmul, add_zero, add_neg_cancel]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.tensorD_mem
statement:
theorem tensorD_mem {k : ℤ} {x : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hx : x ∈ tensorGrading M N k) :
    tensorD M N x ∈ tensorGrading M N (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, rfl, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [tensorD_tmul_of_mem hm]
    refine add_mem (tmul_mem_tensorGrading (by ring) (d_mem hm) hn) ?_
    rw [Units.smul_def]
    exact zsmul_mem (tmul_mem_tensorGrading (by ring) hm (d_mem hn)) _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.liftHomogeneous₂_of_mem
statement:
theorem liftHomogeneous₂_of_mem {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P]
    (φ : ∀ i j, grading (M := M) i →+ grading (M := N) j →+ P) {i j : ℤ} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    liftHomogeneous₂ φ m n = φ i j ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftHomogeneous₂, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hm]
  exact liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hn

name: DG.tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P]
    (φ : ∀ i j, grading (M := M) i →+ grading (M := N) j →+ P) {i j : ℤ} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    tensorLiftHomogeneous φ (m ⊗ₜ n) = φ i j ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous₂_of_mem φ hm hn

name: DG.tensorDecompose_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorDecompose_tmul {i j k : ℤ} (h : i + j = k) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    tensorDecompose M N (m ⊗ₜ n) =
      DirectSum.of (fun k => tensorGrading M N k) k ⟨m ⊗ₜ n, tmul_mem_tensorGrading h hm hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul _ hm hn

name: DG.tensorDecompose_of_mem
statement:
theorem tensorDecompose_of_mem {k : ℤ} {x : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hx : x ∈ tensorGrading M N k) :
    tensorDecompose M N x = DirectSum.of (fun k => tensorGrading M N k) k ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, h, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [tensorDecompose_tmul h hm hn]
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact (map_zero _).symm.trans (congrArg _ rfl)
  | add x y hx' hy' hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, ← map_add]; rfl
  | neg x hx' hx => rw [map_neg, hx, ← map_neg]; rfl

name: DG.grading_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem grading_tensorProduct (k : ℤ) :
    grading (M := M ⊗[ℤ] N) k = tensorGrading M N k
proof: := rfl

name: DG.tmul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n ∈ grading (M := M ⊗[ℤ] N) (i + j)
proof:
:=
  tmul_mem_tensorGrading rfl hm hn

name: DG.d_tmul
statement: theorem d_tmul (m : M) (n : N) : d (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) = d m ⊗ₜ n + gradeInvolution M m ⊗ₜ d n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.d_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem d_tmul_of_mem {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) (n : N) :
    d (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) = d m ⊗ₜ n + koszulSign i • (m ⊗ₜ d n)
proof:
:=
  tensorD_tmul_of_mem hm n

name: DG.map_mem_grading_of_tmul
statement:
theorem map_mem_grading_of_tmul {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [DGAddCommGroup Y]
    (f : M ⊗[ℤ] N →+ Y) (s : ℤ)
    (h : ∀ {i j : ℤ} {m : M} {n : N}, m ∈ grading i → n ∈ grading j →
      f (m ⊗ₜ n) ∈ grading (i + j + s)) {k : ℤ} {x : M ⊗[ℤ] N}
    (hx : x ∈ grading (M := M ⊗[ℤ] N) k) : f x ∈ grading (k + s)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, rfl, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact h hm hn
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.gradeInvolution_tmul
statement:
theorem gradeInvolution_tmul (m : M) (n : N) :
    gradeInvolution (M ⊗[ℤ] N) (m ⊗ₜ n) = gradeInvolution M m ⊗ₜ gradeInvolution N n
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    induction n using induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous n =>
      rw [gradeInvolution_of_mem (tmul_mem_grading m.2 n.2), gradeInvolution_of_mem m.2,
        gradeInvolution_of_mem n.2, koszulSign_add, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def,
        Units.smul_def, smul_tmul_smul, Units.val_mul]
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [tmul_add, map_add, hn, hn', map_add, tmul_add]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [add_tmul, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, add_tmul]

name: DG.gradeInvolution_map
statement:
theorem gradeInvolution_map {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [DGAddCommGroup Y] (f : M →+ Y)
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n) (m : M) :
    gradeInvolution Y (f m) = f (gradeInvolution M m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rw [gradeInvolution_of_mem (hf m.2), gradeInvolution_of_mem m.2, map_units_zsmul]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.tensorMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorMap_tmul (f : M →+ M') (g : N →+ N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorMap f g (m ⊗ₜ n) = f m ⊗ₜ g n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.tensorMap_mem
statement:
theorem tensorMap_mem (f : M →+ M') (g : N →+ N')
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hg : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : N}, m ∈ grading n → g m ∈ grading n) {k : ℤ} {x : M ⊗[ℤ] N}
    (hx : x ∈ grading (M := M ⊗[ℤ] N) k) : tensorMap f g x ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  simpa using map_mem_grading_of_tmul (tensorMap f g) 0
    (fun hm hn => by simpa using tmul_mem_grading (hf hm) (hg hn)) hx

name: DG.tensorMap_d
statement:
theorem tensorMap_d (f : M →+ M') (g : N →+ N')
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hfd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) (hgd : ∀ n, g (d n) = d (g n)) (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    tensorMap f g (d x) = d (tensorMap f g x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul m n =>
    rw [d_tmul, map_add, tensorMap_tmul, tensorMap_tmul, tensorMap_tmul, d_tmul, hfd, hgd,
      gradeInvolution_map f hf]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.tmulAddHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmulAddHom_apply (m : M) (n : N) : tmulAddHom M N m n = m ⊗ₜ n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.tensorCommHom_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorCommHom_tmul {i j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) : tensorCommHom M N (m ⊗ₜ n) = koszulSign (i * j) • (n ⊗ₜ m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorCommHom, tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul _ hm hn, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.tensorCommHom_tensorCommHom
statement:
theorem tensorCommHom_tensorCommHom (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    tensorCommHom N M (tensorCommHom M N x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m n =>
    rename_i i j
    rw [tensorCommHom_tmul m.2 n.2, map_units_zsmul, tensorCommHom_tmul n.2 m.2, smul_smul,
      mul_comm j i, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.tensorCommHom_mem
statement:
theorem tensorCommHom_mem {k : ℤ} {x : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hx : x ∈ grading (M := M ⊗[ℤ] N) k) :
    tensorCommHom M N x ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  simpa using map_mem_grading_of_tmul (tensorCommHom M N) 0 (fun {i j} _ _ hm hn => by
    rw [tensorCommHom_tmul hm hn, Units.smul_def, add_zero, add_comm]
    exact zsmul_mem (tmul_mem_grading hn hm) _) hx

name: DG.tensorCommHom_d
statement:
theorem tensorCommHom_d (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    tensorCommHom M N (d x) = d (tensorCommHom M N x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m n =>
    rename_i i j
    rw [d_tmul_of_mem m.2, map_add, map_units_zsmul, tensorCommHom_tmul (d_mem m.2) n.2,
      tensorCommHom_tmul m.2 (d_mem n.2), tensorCommHom_tmul m.2 n.2, d_units_smul,
      d_tmul_of_mem n.2, smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, add_comm]
    congr 1
    · rw [← koszulSign_add]
      congr 1
      rw [koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_eq_iff]
      exact ⟨i, by ring⟩
    · rw [← koszulSign_add]
      congr 1
      rw [koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_eq_iff]
      exact ⟨0, by ring⟩
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.tensorComm_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorComm_tmul {i j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    tensorComm M N (m ⊗ₜ n) = koszulSign (i * j) • (n ⊗ₜ m)
proof:
:=
  tensorCommHom_tmul hm hn

name: DG.tensorComm_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorComm_symm : (tensorComm M N).symm = tensorComm N M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.assoc_mem
proof:
:= by
  simpa using map_mem_grading_of_tmul (TensorProduct.assoc ℤ M N P).toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom
    0 (fun {a c y p} hy hp => by
      simpa using map_mem_grading_of_tmul
        ((TensorProduct.assoc ℤ M N P).toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom.comp
          ((TensorProduct.mk ℤ (M ⊗[ℤ] N) P).flip p).toAddMonoidHom) c
        (fun {i j m n} hm hn => by
          simpa [add_assoc] using tmul_mem_grading hm (tmul_mem_grading hn hp)) hy) hx

name: DG.assoc_d
statement:
theorem assoc_d (x : (M ⊗[ℤ] N) ⊗[ℤ] P) :
    TensorProduct.assoc ℤ M N P (d x) = d (TensorProduct.assoc ℤ M N P x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul y p =>
    induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul m n =>
      simp [d_tmul, gradeInvolution_tmul, add_tmul, tmul_add, add_assoc]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [add_tmul, d_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, d_add]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.tensorAssoc_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorAssoc_tmul (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    tensorAssoc M N P ((m ⊗ₜ n) ⊗ₜ p) = m ⊗ₜ (n ⊗ₜ p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.mem_gradingComap
statement: theorem mem_gradingComap {n : ℤ} {t : T} : t ∈ gradingComap ι n ↔ ι t ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.coeAddMonoidHom_gradingComapMap
statement:
theorem coeAddMonoidHom_gradingComapMap (x : ⨁ n, gradingComap ι n) :
    DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (grading (M := M)) (gradingComapMap ι x) =
      ι (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (gradingComap ι) x)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (grading (M := M))).comp (gradingComapMap ι) =
      ι.comp (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (gradingComap ι)) from DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  ext n t
  simp [gradingComapMap]

name: DG.isInternal_gradingComap
statement: theorem isInternal_gradingComap : DirectSum.IsInternal (gradingComap ι)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have h : gradingComapMap ι x = gradingComapMap ι y :=
      (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (grading (M := M))).injective (by
        rw [coeAddMonoidHom_gradingComapMap, coeAddMonoidHom_gradingComapMap, hxy])
    rw [gradingComapMap, DirectSum.map_eq_iff] at h
    ext n
    exact hι (by simpa using h n)
  · intro t
    choose s hs using fun n => hhom n t
    refine ⟨∑ n ∈ (decompose (grading (M := M)) (ι t)).support,
      DirectSum.of _ n ⟨s n, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_gradingComap, hs]; exact Subtype.property _
    · apply hι
      simp only [map_sum, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
      conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (grading (M := M)) (ι t)]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => hs n

name: DG.DGAddCommGroup.ofInjective_coe_decompose
statement:
theorem DGAddCommGroup.ofInjective_coe_decompose (t : T) (n : ℤ) :
    letI
proof:
:= DGAddCommGroup.ofInjective ι hι dT hd hhom
    ι (decompose (grading (M := T)) t n) = decompose (grading (M := M)) (ι t) n := by
  let := DGAddCommGroup.ofInjective ι hι dT hd hhom
  have h : gradingComapMap ι (decompose (grading (M := T)) t) =
      decompose (grading (M := M)) (ι t) := by
    apply (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (grading (M := M))).injective
    change DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom _ _ = (decompose (grading (M := M))).symm _
    rw [coeAddMonoidHom_gradingComapMap, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change ι ((decompose (grading (M := T))).symm _) = _
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [← h]
  simp only [gradingComapMap, DirectSum.map_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isIdempotentElem
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem : IsIdempotentElem e.val
proof: := e.mul_self

name: DG.DGIdempotent.mem_leftIdeal
statement: theorem mem_leftIdeal {a : A} : a ∈ e.leftIdeal ↔ a * e.val = a
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.mul_val_mem_leftIdeal
statement: theorem mul_val_mem_leftIdeal (a : A) : a * e.val ∈ e.leftIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_leftIdeal, mul_assoc, e.mul_self]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.leftIdeal_eq_span
statement: theorem leftIdeal_eq_span : e.leftIdeal = Ideal.span {e.val}
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton', mem_leftIdeal]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨a, h⟩, fun ⟨b, hb⟩ => by rw [← hb, mul_assoc, e.mul_self]⟩

name: DG.DGIdempotent.mem_rightIdeal
statement: theorem mem_rightIdeal {a : A} : a ∈ e.rightIdeal ↔ e.val * a = a
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.val_mul_mem_rightIdeal
statement: theorem val_mul_mem_rightIdeal (a : A) : e.val * a ∈ e.rightIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rightIdeal, ← mul_assoc, e.mul_self]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.rightIdeal_eq_span
statement: theorem rightIdeal_eq_span : e.rightIdeal = Submodule.span Aᵐᵒᵖ {e.val}
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton, mem_rightIdeal]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨op a, by rw [MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, unop_op, h]⟩,
    fun ⟨b, hb⟩ => by rw [← hb, MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, ← mul_assoc, e.mul_self]⟩

name: DG.DGIdempotent.d_mul_val
statement: theorem d_mul_val (a : A) : d (a * e.val) = d a * e.val
proof:
:=
  d_op_smul_of_d_eq_zero' (M := A) e.d_eq_zero a

name: DG.DGIdempotent.d_val_mul
statement: theorem d_val_mul (a : A) : d (e.val * a) = e.val * d a
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_mul_of_mem_zero e.mem_zero, e.d_eq_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.coe_decompose_mul_val
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_mul_val (a : A) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) (a * e.val) n : A) = decompose (grading (M := A)) a n * e.val
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_of_right_mem_zero _ e.mem_zero

name: DG.DGIdempotent.coe_decompose_val_mul
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_val_mul (a : A) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) (e.val * a) n : A) = e.val * decompose (grading (M := A)) a n
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_of_left_mem_zero _ e.mem_zero

name: DG.DGIdempotent.d_mem_leftIdeal
statement: theorem d_mem_leftIdeal {a : A} (ha : a ∈ e.leftIdeal) : d a ∈ e.leftIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_leftIdeal] at *
  rw [← ha, e.d_mul_val, mul_assoc, e.mul_self]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.decompose_mem_leftIdeal
statement:
theorem decompose_mem_leftIdeal {a : A} (ha : a ∈ e.leftIdeal) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) a n : A) ∈ e.leftIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_leftIdeal] at *
  rw [← e.coe_decompose_mul_val, ha]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_d (a : e.LeftCorner) : ((d a : e.LeftCorner) : A) = d (a : A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {a : e.LeftCorner} : a ∈ grading n ↔ (a : A) ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_decompose
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_decompose (a : e.LeftCorner) (n : ℤ) :
    ((decompose (grading (M := e.LeftCorner)) a n : e.LeftCorner) : A) =
      decompose (grading (M := A)) (a : A) n
proof:
:=
  DGAddCommGroup.ofInjective_coe_decompose (AddSubmonoidClass.subtype e.leftIdeal)
    Subtype.val_injective (dAddHom e) (fun _ => rfl) _ a n

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.val_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem val_mk (a : A) (h : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val) : val e ⟨a, h⟩ = a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_mem
statement: theorem coe_mem (x : e.Corner) : (x : A) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof: := Subtype.property x

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.mem_iff
statement: theorem mem_iff {a : A} : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val ↔ e.val * a = a ∧ a * e.val = a
proof:
:=
  Subsemigroup.mem_corner_iff e.isIdempotentElem

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.val_mul_coe
statement: theorem val_mul_coe (x : e.Corner) : e.val * (x : A) = x
proof: := (mem_iff e |>.mp (coe_mem e x)).1

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_mul_val
statement: theorem coe_mul_val (x : e.Corner) : (x : A) * e.val = x
proof: := (mem_iff e |>.mp (coe_mem e x)).2

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.val_mul_mul_val_mem
statement: theorem val_mul_mul_val_mem (a : A) : e.val * a * e.val ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:=
  ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_zero : ((0 : e.Corner) : A) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_one
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_one : ((1 : e.Corner) : A) = e.val
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_add
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_add (x y : e.Corner) : ((x + y : e.Corner) : A) = x + y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_neg (x : e.Corner) : ((-x : e.Corner) : A) = -x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_sub (x y : e.Corner) : ((x - y : e.Corner) : A) = x - y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_mul
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_mul (x y : e.Corner) : ((x * y : e.Corner) : A) = x * y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_zsmul
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_zsmul (k : ℤ) (x : e.Corner) : ((k • x : e.Corner) : A) = k • (x : A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_injective
statement: theorem coe_injective : Function.Injective ((↑) : e.Corner → A)
proof: := Subtype.val_injective

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {x y : e.Corner} (h : (x : A) = y) : x = y
proof: := Subtype.ext h

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.valAddHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem valAddHom_apply (x : e.Corner) : valAddHom e x = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.d_mem
statement:
theorem d_mem {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val) :
    d a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨he, he'⟩ := (mem_iff e).mp ha
  refine ⟨d a, ?_⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [← he, ← he', e.d_val_mul, e.d_mul_val, ← mul_assoc]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.decompose_mem
statement:
theorem decompose_mem {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := A)) a n : A) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨he, he'⟩ := (mem_iff e).mp ha
  refine ⟨decompose (grading (M := A)) a n, ?_⟩
  conv_rhs => rw [← he, ← he', e.coe_decompose_val_mul, e.coe_decompose_mul_val, ← mul_assoc]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_d (x : e.Corner) : ((d x : e.Corner) : A) = d (x : A)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : e.Corner} : x ∈ grading n ↔ (x : A) ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_decompose
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_decompose (x : e.Corner) (n : ℤ) :
    ((decompose (grading (M := e.Corner)) x n : e.Corner) : A) =
      decompose (grading (M := A)) (x : A) n
proof:
:=
  DGAddCommGroup.ofInjective_coe_decompose (valAddHom e) (coe_injective e) (dAddHom e)
    (fun _ => rfl) _ x n

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_mul_corner_mem
statement:
theorem coe_mul_corner_mem (a : e.LeftCorner) (y : e.Corner) :
    (a : A) * (y : A) ∈ e.leftIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_leftIdeal, mul_assoc, Corner.coe_mul_val]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.LeftCorner.coe_op_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_op_smul (y : e.Corner) (a : e.LeftCorner) : ((op y • a : e.LeftCorner) : A) = a * y

name: DG.DGIdempotent.d_mem_rightIdeal

name: DG.DGIdempotent.decompose_mem_rightIdeal

name: DG.DGIdempotent.RightCorner.coe_d

@[simp]
theorem coe_d (a : e.RightCorner) : ((d a : e.RightCorner) : A) = d (a : A)

name: DG.DGIdempotent.RightCorner.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {a : e.RightCorner} : a ∈ grading n ↔ (a : A) ∈ grading n

name: DG.DGIdempotent.RightCorner.coe_decompose

theorem coe_decompose (a : e.RightCorner) (n : ℤ) :

proof:

name: DG.DGIdempotent.RightCorner.corner_mul_coe_mem
statement:
theorem corner_mul_coe_mem (y : e.Corner) (a : e.RightCorner) :

proof:

name: DG.DGIdempotent.RightCorner.coe_corner_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_corner_smul (y : e.Corner) (a : e.RightCorner) :
    ((y • a : e.RightCorner) : A) = y * a
proof:

name: DirectSum.Decomposition.coe_prodDecomposeFst
statement:
private theorem coe_prodDecomposeFst (m : M) :
    DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (fun i => (ℳ i).prod (𝒩 i)) (prodDecomposeFst ℳ 𝒩 m) = (m, 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn ℳ with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]; rfl
  | homogeneous x =>
    simp only [prodDecomposeFst, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom,
      decomposeAddEquiv_apply, decompose_coe, toAddMonoid_of, coeAddMonoidHom_of]
    rfl
  | add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm', Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero]

name: DirectSum.Decomposition.coe_prodDecomposeSnd
statement:
private theorem coe_prodDecomposeSnd (n : N) :
    DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (fun i => (ℳ i).prod (𝒩 i)) (prodDecomposeSnd ℳ 𝒩 n) = (0, n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒩 with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]; rfl
  | homogeneous y =>
    simp only [prodDecomposeSnd, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom,
      decomposeAddEquiv_apply, decompose_coe, toAddMonoid_of, coeAddMonoidHom_of]
    rfl
  | add n n' hn hn' => rw [map_add, map_add, hn, hn', Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero]

name: DG.Prod.grading_eq

@[simp]
theorem Prod.grading_eq (n : ℤ) :

name: DG.Prod.mem_grading

theorem Prod.mem_grading {n : ℤ} {p : M × N} :

name: DG.Prod.d_apply

theorem Prod.d_apply (p : M × N) : d p = (d p.1, d p.2)

name: DG.Prod.fst_d

name: DG.Prod.snd_d

theorem Prod.snd_d (p : M × N) : (d p).2 = d p.2

name: DG.DGModuleHom.prod_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem prod_apply {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [DGAddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    (f : P →ᵈᵍ[A] M) (g : P →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (x : P) : prod M N f g x = (f x, g x)

name: DG.DGModuleHom.snd_apply
