name: DG.balancedRel_mem
statement:
theorem balancedRel_mem (a : A) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (op a • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - m ⊗ₜ (a • n) ∈ balancedRel A M N
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨a, m, n, rfl⟩

name: DG.balancedRel_eq_closure_gen
statement:
theorem balancedRel_eq_closure_gen :
    balancedRel A M N = AddSubgroup.closure (balancedRelGen A M N)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (AddSubgroup.closure_le _ |>.mpr ?_)
    (AddSubgroup.closure_mono fun x ⟨_, _, _, a, m, n, _, _, _, hx⟩ => ⟨a, m, n, hx⟩)
  rintro _ ⟨a, m, n, rfl⟩
  set S := AddSubgroup.closure (balancedRelGen A M N)
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
    have : (op (a + a') • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - m ⊗ₜ ((a + a') • n) =
        ((op a • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - m ⊗ₜ (a • n)) + ((op a' • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - m ⊗ₜ (a' • n)) := by
      rw [op_add, add_smul, add_smul, add_tmul, tmul_add]; abel
    rw [this]; exact add_mem ha ha'
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    induction m using induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
      have : (op (a : A) • (m + m')) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - (m + m') ⊗ₜ ((a : A) • n) =
          ((op (a : A) • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - m ⊗ₜ ((a : A) • n)) +
            ((op (a : A) • m') ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - m' ⊗ₜ ((a : A) • n)) := by
        rw [smul_add, add_tmul, add_tmul]; abel
      rw [this]; exact add_mem hm hm'
    | h_homogeneous m =>
      induction n using induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add n n' hn hn' =>
        have : (op (a : A) • (m : M)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n + n') - (m : M) ⊗ₜ ((a : A) • (n + n')) =
            ((op (a : A) • (m : M)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - (m : M) ⊗ₜ ((a : A) • n)) +
              ((op (a : A) • (m : M)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n' - (m : M) ⊗ₜ ((a : A) • n')) := by
          rw [smul_add, tmul_add, tmul_add]; abel
        rw [this]; exact add_mem hn hn'
      | h_homogeneous n =>
        exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, _, _, a, m, n, a.2, m.2, n.2, rfl⟩

name: DG.d_balancedRel_gen
statement:
theorem d_balancedRel_gen {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading j)
    (n : N) :
    d ((op a • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - m ⊗ₜ (a • n)) =
      ((op a • d m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - d m ⊗ₜ (a • n)) +
        koszulSign j • ((op (d a) • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n - m ⊗ₜ (d a • n)) +
        koszulSign (j + i) • ((op a • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] d n - m ⊗ₜ (a • d n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_sub, d_tmul_of_mem (op_smul_mem_grading ha hm), d_tmul_of_mem hm, d_op_smul hm,
    d_smul ha, add_tmul, tmul_add, smul_sub, smul_sub, koszulSign_add, mul_smul]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, smul_tmul', tmul_smul, smul_add, mul_smul]
  abel

name: DG.TensorProductOver.mk_tmul
statement: theorem mk_tmul (m : M) (n : N) : mk A M N (m ⊗ₜ n) = tmul A m n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.mk_surjective
statement: theorem mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk A M N)
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: DG.TensorProductOver.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_zero_iff {x : M ⊗[ℤ] N} : mk A M N x = 0 ↔ x ∈ balancedRel A M N
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff x

name: DG.TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul
statement: theorem op_smul_tmul (a : A) (m : M) (n : N) : tmul A (op a • m) n = tmul A m (a • n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, tmul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, mk_eq_zero_iff]
  exact balancedRel_mem a m n

name: DG.TensorProductOver.tmul_add
statement: theorem tmul_add (m : M) (n n' : N) : tmul A m (n + n') = tmul A m n + tmul A m n'
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.add_tmul
statement: theorem add_tmul (m m' : M) (n : N) : tmul A (m + m') n = tmul A m n + tmul A m' n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.tmul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_zero (m : M) : tmul A m (0 : N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.zero_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_tmul (n : N) : tmul A (0 : M) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.tmul_neg
statement: theorem tmul_neg (m : M) (n : N) : tmul A m (-n) = -tmul A m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_neg, map_neg]; rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.neg_tmul
statement: theorem neg_tmul (m : M) (n : N) : tmul A (-m) n = -tmul A m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.neg_tmul, map_neg]; rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.tmul_zsmul
statement: theorem tmul_zsmul (k : ℤ) (m : M) (n : N) : tmul A m (k • n) = k • tmul A m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_zsmul]; rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.zsmul_tmul
statement: theorem zsmul_tmul (k : ℤ) (m : M) (n : N) : tmul A (k • m) n = k • tmul A m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_zsmul]; rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.tmul_units_smul
statement: theorem tmul_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (m : M) (n : N) : tmul A m (u • n) = u • tmul A m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, tmul_zsmul]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.units_smul_tmul
statement: theorem units_smul_tmul (u : ℤˣ) (m : M) (n : N) : tmul A (u • m) n = u • tmul A m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, zsmul_tmul]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : TensorProductOver A M N → Prop} (x : TensorProductOver A M N)
    (zero : P 0) (tmul : ∀ m n, P (tmul A m n)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    exact zero
  clear hx
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective x
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul m n => exact tmul m n
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ hx hy

name: DG.TensorProductOver.addHom_ext
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => induction_on (P := fun x => f x = g x) x (by simp) h
    (fun x y (hx : f x = g x) (hy : f y = g y) => by
      show f (x + y) = g (x + y); rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy])

name: DG.TensorProductOver.tmulAddHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmulAddHom_apply (m : M) (n : N) : tmulAddHom A M N m n = tmul A m n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lift_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_tmul (f : M →+ N →+ P)
    (hf : ∀ (a : A) (m : M) (n : N), f (op a • m) n = f m (a • n)) (m : M) (n : N) :
    lift f hf (tmul A m n) = f m n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lift_mk_tmul
statement:
theorem lift_mk_tmul (f : M →+ N →+ P)
    (hf : ∀ (a : A) (m : M) (n : N), f (op a • m) n = f m (a • n)) (m : M) (n : N) :
    lift f hf (mk A M N (m ⊗ₜ n)) = f m n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique (f : M →+ N →+ P)
    (hf : ∀ (a : A) (m : M) (n : N), f (op a • m) n = f m (a • n))
    (g : TensorProductOver A M N →+ P) (hg : ∀ m n, g (tmul A m n) = f m n) :
    g = lift f hf
proof:
:=
  addHom_ext fun m n => by rw [hg, lift_tmul]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.map_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_tmul (f : M →ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] M') (g : N →ₗ[A] N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    map f g (tmul A m n) = tmul A (f m) (g n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] M) (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[A] N) =
    AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:=
  addHom_ext fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (f : M →ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] M')
    (f' : M' →ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] M'') (g : N →ₗ[A] N') (g' : N' →ₗ[A] N'') :
    map (f'.comp f) (g'.comp g) = (map f' g').comp (map f g)
proof:
:=
  addHom_ext fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.smul_mem_balancedRel
statement:
theorem smul_mem_balancedRel (b : B) {x : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hx : x ∈ balancedRel A M N) :
    b • x ∈ balancedRel A M N
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, m, n, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [smul_sub, smul_tmul', smul_tmul', smul_comm b (op a) m]
    exact balancedRel_mem a (b • m) n
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.TensorProductOver.smul_mk
statement: theorem smul_mk (b : B) (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : b • mk A M N x = mk A M N (b • x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.smul_tmul
statement: theorem smul_tmul (b : B) (m : M) (n : N) : b • tmul A m n = tmul A (b • m) n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {k : ℤ} {y : TensorProductOver A M N} :
    y ∈ grading k ↔ ∃ x ∈ grading (M := M ⊗[ℤ] N) k, mk A M N x = y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.mk_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mk_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {x : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    mk A M N x ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: DG.TensorProductOver.d_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_mk (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : d (mk A M N x) = mk A M N (d x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.tmul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    tmul A m n ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  mk_mem_grading (DG.tmul_mem_grading hm hn)

name: DG.TensorProductOver.induction_on_mem_grading
statement:
theorem induction_on_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {P : TensorProductOver A M N → Prop} (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ {i j : ℤ} {m : M} {n : N}, m ∈ grading i → n ∈ grading j → i + j = k →
      P (tmul A m n))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) (neg : ∀ x, P x → P (-x))
    {y : TensorProductOver A M N} (hy : y ∈ grading k) : P y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, h, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact tmul hm hn h
  | zero => simpa using zero
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg _ hx

name: DG.TensorProductOver.d_tmul
statement:
theorem d_tmul (m : M) (n : N) :
    d (tmul A m n) = tmul A (d m) n + tmul A (gradeInvolution M m) (d n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, d_mk, DG.d_tmul, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.d_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem d_tmul_of_mem {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) (n : N) :
    d (tmul A m n) = tmul A (d m) n + koszulSign i • tmul A m (d n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, d_mk, DG.d_tmul_of_mem hm, map_add, map_units_zsmul]; rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lift_mem
statement:
theorem lift_mem (f : M →+ N →+ P)
    (hf : ∀ (a : A) (m : M) (n : N), f (op a • m) n = f m (a • n))
    (hdeg : ∀ {i j : ℤ} {m : M} {n : N}, m ∈ grading i → n ∈ grading j →
      f m n ∈ grading (i + j))
    {k : ℤ} {y : TensorProductOver A M N} (hy : y ∈ grading k) : lift f hf y ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
  simpa using! map_mem_grading_of_tmul ((lift f hf).comp (mk A M N)) 0
    (fun hm hn => by simpa using! hdeg hm hn) hx

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lift_mem_add
statement:
theorem lift_mem_add (f : M →+ N →+ P)
    (hf : ∀ (a : A) (m : M) (n : N), f (op a • m) n = f m (a • n)) (s : ℤ)
    (hdeg : ∀ {i j : ℤ} {m : M} {n : N}, m ∈ grading i → n ∈ grading j →
      f m n ∈ grading (i + j + s))
    {k : ℤ} {y : TensorProductOver A M N} (hy : y ∈ grading k) :
    lift f hf y ∈ grading (k + s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact map_mem_grading_of_tmul ((lift f hf).comp (mk A M N)) s (fun hm hn => hdeg hm hn) hx

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lift_d
statement:
theorem lift_d (f : M →+ N →+ P)
    (hf : ∀ (a : A) (m : M) (n : N), f (op a • m) n = f m (a • n))
    (hd : ∀ {i : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading i → ∀ n : N,
      d (f m n) = f (d m) n + koszulSign i • f m (d n))
    (y : TensorProductOver A M N) : lift f hf (d y) = d (lift f hf y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m n =>
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous m =>
      rw [d_tmul_of_mem m.2, map_add, map_units_zsmul, lift_tmul, lift_tmul, lift_tmul,
        hd m.2]
    | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
      rw [add_tmul, d_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, d_add]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.map_mem
statement:
theorem map_mem (f : M →ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] M') (g : N →ₗ[A] N')
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hg : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : N}, m ∈ grading n → g m ∈ grading n)
    {k : ℤ} {y : TensorProductOver A M N} (hy : y ∈ grading k) : map f g y ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  lift_mem _ _ (fun hm hn => tmul_mem_grading (hf hm) (hg hn)) hy

name: DG.TensorProductOver.map_d
statement:
theorem map_d (f : M →ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] M') (g : N →ₗ[A] N')
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hfd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) (hgd : ∀ n, g (d n) = d (g n))
    (y : TensorProductOver A M N) : map f g (d y) = d (map f g y)
proof:
:=
  lift_d _ _ (fun hm n => by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.compl₂_apply,
      LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, tmulAddHom_apply]
    rw [d_tmul_of_mem (hf hm), hfd, hgd]) y

name: DG.TensorProductOver.map_d_of_dgModuleHom
statement:
theorem map_d_of_dgModuleHom (f : M →ₗ[Aᵐᵒᵖ] M') (g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] N')
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n)
    (hfd : ∀ m, f (d m) = d (f m)) (y : TensorProductOver A M N) :
    map f g.toLinearMap (d y) = d (map f g.toLinearMap y)
proof:
:=
  map_d f g.toLinearMap hf hfd (fun n => g.map_d n) y

name: DG.TensorProductOver.d_smul_eq
statement:
theorem d_smul_eq {i : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading i) (y : TensorProductOver A M N) :
    d (b • y) = d b • y + koszulSign i • (b • d y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective y
  rw [smul_mk b, d_mk, d_mk, d_smul (M := M ⊗[ℤ] N) hb x, map_add, map_units_zsmul, smul_mk b,
    smul_mk (d b)]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lid_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lid_tmul (a : A) (n : N) : lid A N (tmul A a n) = a • n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lidInv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lidInv_apply (n : N) : lidInv A N n = tmul A (1 : A) n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lid_lidInv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lid_lidInv (n : N) : lid A N (lidInv A N n) = n
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lidInv_lid
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lidInv_lid (y : TensorProductOver A A N) : lidInv A N (lid A N y) = y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a n =>
    rw [lid_tmul, lidInv_apply, ← op_smul_tmul, op_smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lid_comp_lidInv
statement: theorem lid_comp_lidInv : (lid A N).comp (lidInv A N) = DGModuleHom.id
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext lid_lidInv

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lidInv_comp_lid
statement: theorem lidInv_comp_lid : (lidInv A N).comp (lid A N) = DGModuleHom.id
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext lidInv_lid

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lidDGModuleEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lidDGModuleEquiv_tmul (a : A) (n : N) :
    lidDGModuleEquiv A N (tmul A a n) = a • n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lidDGModuleEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lidDGModuleEquiv_symm_apply (n : N) :
    (lidDGModuleEquiv A N).symm n = tmul A (1 : A) n
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.rightAct_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightAct_tmul (b : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (m : M) (n : N) :
    rightAct A M N b (tmul A m n) = tmul A m (b • n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TensorProductOver.op_smul_eq_rightAct
statement:
theorem op_smul_eq_rightAct (b : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (y : TensorProductOver A M N) :
    b • y = rightAct A M N b y
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul_right
statement: theorem op_smul_tmul_right (b : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (m : M) (n : N) : b • tmul A m n = tmul A m (b • n)
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.op_smul_units_smul
statement:
theorem op_smul_units_smul (b : Bᵐᵒᵖ) (u : ℤˣ) (y : TensorProductOver A M N) :
    b • (u • y) = u • (b • y)
proof:
:=
  map_units_zsmul (rightAct A M N b) u y

name: TensorProductOver.op_smul_mem_grading_right
statement:
theorem op_smul_mem_grading_right {i j : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading i)
    {y : TensorProductOver A M N} (hy : y ∈ grading j) : op b • y ∈ grading (j + i)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_mem_grading (P := fun y => op b • y ∈ grading (j + i)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hy
  · rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro p q m n hm hn h
    rw [op_smul_tmul_right, ← h, add_assoc]
    exact tmul_mem_grading hm (op_smul_mem_grading hb hn)
  · intro x y hx hy; rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  · intro x hx; rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: TensorProductOver.d_op_smul_right
statement:
theorem d_op_smul_right {j : ℤ} {y : TensorProductOver A M N} (hy : y ∈ grading j) (b : B) :
    d (op b • y) = op b • d y + koszulSign j • (op (d b) • y)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_mem_grading
    (P := fun y => d (op b • y) = op b • d y + koszulSign j • (op (d b) • y)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hy
  · simp
  · intro p q m n hm hn h
    rw [op_smul_tmul_right, d_tmul_of_mem hm, d_tmul_of_mem hm, d_op_smul hn, tmul_add,
      smul_add, smul_add, op_smul_tmul_right, op_smul_units_smul, op_smul_tmul_right,
      op_smul_tmul_right, tmul_units_smul, smul_smul, ← h, koszulSign_add, add_assoc]
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [smul_add, d_add, hx, hy, d_add, smul_add, smul_add, smul_add]; abel
  · intro x hx; rw [smul_neg, d_neg, hx, d_neg, smul_neg, smul_neg, smul_neg, neg_add]

name: TensorProductOver.assocInvAux_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem assocInvAux_tmul (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    assocInvAux A B M N P m (tmul B n p) = tmul B (tmul A m n) p
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.assocInv_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem assocInv_tmul_tmul (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    assocInv A B M N P (tmul A m (tmul B n p)) = tmul B (tmul A m n) p
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.assoc_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem assoc_tmul_tmul (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    assoc A B M N P (tmul B (tmul A m n) p) = tmul A m (tmul B n p)
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.assocInv_assoc
statement:
theorem assocInv_assoc (z : TensorProductOver B (TensorProductOver A M N) P) :
    assocInv A B M N P (assoc A B M N P z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x p =>
    induction x using induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul m n => rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [add_tmul, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: TensorProductOver.assoc_assocInv
statement:
theorem assoc_assocInv (z : TensorProductOver A M (TensorProductOver B N P)) :
    assoc A B M N P (assocInv A B M N P z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m y =>
    induction y using induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul n p => rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [tmul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: TensorProductOver.assocInv_mem
statement:
theorem assocInv_mem {k : ℤ} {z : TensorProductOver A M (TensorProductOver B N P)}
    (hz : z ∈ grading k) : assocInv A B M N P z ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  unfold assocInv
  refine lift_mem _ _ (fun {i j m y} hm hy => ?_) hz
  rw [add_comm, AddMonoidHom.mk'_apply]
  unfold assocInvAux
  refine lift_mem_add _ _ i (fun {p r n q} hn hq => ?_) hy
  have h := tmul_mem_grading (A := B) (tmul_mem_grading (A := A) hm hn) hq
  rwa [show i + p + r = p + r + i by ring] at h

name: TensorProductOver.assocInv_d
statement:
theorem assocInv_d (z : TensorProductOver A M (TensorProductOver B N P)) :
    assocInv A B M N P (d z) = d (assocInv A B M N P z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold assocInv
  refine lift_d _ _ (fun {i m} hm y => ?_) z
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.mk'_apply]
  induction y using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul n p =>
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous n =>
      rename_i j
      rw [assocInvAux_tmul, assocInvAux_tmul, d_tmul_of_mem (tmul_mem_grading hm n.2),
        d_tmul_of_mem hm, add_tmul, units_smul_tmul, d_tmul_of_mem n.2, map_add,
        map_units_zsmul, assocInvAux_tmul, assocInvAux_tmul, smul_add, smul_smul,
        ← koszulSign_add, add_assoc]
    | h_add n n' hn hn' =>
      simp only [add_tmul, map_add, hn, hn', smul_add]; abel
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, d_add, hx, hy, d_add, map_add, map_add, smul_add]; abel

name: TensorProductOver.assoc_mem
statement:
theorem assoc_mem {k : ℤ} {z : TensorProductOver B (TensorProductOver A M N) P}
    (hz : z ∈ grading k) : assoc A B M N P z ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  exact (DGAddEquiv.ofAddMonoidHom (assocInv A B M N P) (assoc A B M N P) assoc_assocInv
    assocInv_assoc assocInv_mem assocInv_d).symm.map_mem hz

name: TensorProductOver.assocEquiv_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem assocEquiv_tmul_tmul (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    assocEquiv A B M N P (tmul B (tmul A m n) p) = tmul A m (tmul B n p)
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.assocEquiv_symm_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem assocEquiv_symm_tmul_tmul (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    (assocEquiv A B M N P).symm (tmul A m (tmul B n p)) = tmul B (tmul A m n) p
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.ridHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ridHom_tmul (m : M) (a : A) : ridHom A M (tmul A m a) = op a • m
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.ridHom_mem
statement:
theorem ridHom_mem {k : ℤ} {y : TensorProductOver A M A} (hy : y ∈ grading k) :
    ridHom A M y ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  lift_mem _ _ (fun hm ha => op_smul_mem_grading ha hm) hy

name: TensorProductOver.ridHom_d
statement: theorem ridHom_d (y : TensorProductOver A M A) : ridHom A M (d y) = d (ridHom A M y)
proof:
:=
  lift_d _ _ (fun hm a => by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.flip_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom, MulOpposite.opAddEquiv_apply, smulAddHom_apply]
    exact d_op_smul hm a) y

name: TensorProductOver.rid_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rid_tmul (m : M) (a : A) : rid A M (tmul A m a) = op a • m
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.rid_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rid_symm_apply (m : M) : (rid A M).symm m = tmul A m (1 : A)
proof: := rfl

name: TensorProductOver.rid_op_smul
statement:
theorem rid_op_smul (a : A) (y : TensorProductOver A M A) :
    rid A M (op a • y) = op a • rid A M y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m a' =>
    rw [op_smul_tmul_right, rid_tmul, rid_tmul, op_smul_eq_mul, op_mul, mul_smul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add]

name: DG.DGSubmodule.mem_grading_quotient_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_quotient_iff {n : ℤ} {y : M ⧸ S.toSubmodule} :
    y ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n ↔
      ∃ x ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading (M := M) n, Submodule.Quotient.mk x = y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGSubmodule.mk_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mk_mem_grading {n : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : M ⧸ S.toSubmodule) ∈ DGAddCommGroup.grading n
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: DG.DGSubmodule.d_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_mk (x : M) :
    DGAddCommGroup.d (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : M ⧸ S.toSubmodule) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (DGAddCommGroup.d x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGSubmodule.mkQ_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkQ_apply (x : M) : S.mkQ x = Submodule.Quotient.mk x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGSubmodule.mkQ_surjective
statement: theorem mkQ_surjective : Function.Surjective S.mkQ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: DG.DGSubmodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mkQ_eq_zero_iff {x : M} : S.mkQ x = 0 ↔ x ∈ S
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: DG.DGSubmodule.ker_mkQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_mkQ : S.mkQ.ker = S
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ => S.mkQ_eq_zero_iff

name: DG.DGSubmodule.liftQ_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftQ_mk (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (h : ∀ x ∈ S, f x = 0) (x : M) :
    liftQ f h (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = f x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGSubmodule.liftQ_mkQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftQ_mkQ (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (h : ∀ x ∈ S, f x = 0) (x : M) :
    liftQ f h (S.mkQ x) = f x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGSubmodule.liftQ_comp_mkQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftQ_comp_mkQ (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (h : ∀ x ∈ S, f x = 0) : (liftQ f h).comp S.mkQ = f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGSubmodule.quotient_ext
statement:
theorem quotient_ext {f g : (M ⧸ S.toSubmodule) →ᵈᵍ[A] N} (h : f.comp S.mkQ = g.comp S.mkQ) :
    f = g
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext fun y => by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := S.mkQ_surjective y
    exact congrArg (fun φ : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N => φ x) h

name: DG.SeqColimit.relHom_of
statement:
theorem relHom_of (n : ℕ) (x : S n) :
    relHom S ι (DirectSum.of S n x) = DirectSum.of S n x - DirectSum.of S (n + 1) (ι n x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [relHom]

name: DG.SeqColimit.relHom_apply_zero
statement: theorem relHom_apply_zero (y : ⨁ n, S n) : relHom S ι y 0 = y 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]
  | of n x =>
    rw [relHom_of, DirectSum.sub_apply, of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Nat.succ_ne_zero n).symm, sub_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, DirectSum.add_apply, DirectSum.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: DG.SeqColimit.relHom_apply_succ
statement:
theorem relHom_apply_succ (y : ⨁ n, S n) (k : ℕ) :
    relHom S ι y (k + 1) = y (k + 1) - ι k (y k)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply, DirectSum.zero_apply, map_zero, sub_zero]
  | of n x =>
    rw [relHom_of, DirectSum.sub_apply]
    congr 1
    by_cases h : n = k
    · subst h
      rw [of_eq_same, of_eq_same]
    · rw [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm h), map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, DirectSum.add_apply, hx, hy, DirectSum.add_apply, DirectSum.add_apply, map_add]
    abel

name: DG.SeqColimit.of_apply
statement:
theorem of_apply (n : ℕ) (x : S n) :
    of S ι n x = (relHom S ι).range.mkQ (DirectSum.of S n x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.SeqColimit.of_succ_ι
statement: theorem of_succ_ι (n : ℕ) (x : S n) : of S ι (n + 1) (ι n x) = of S ι n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_apply, of_apply, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, DGSubmodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff,
    ← relHom_of]
  exact DGModuleHom.apply_mem_range _ _

name: DG.SeqColimit.of_comp_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_comp_ι (n : ℕ) : (of S ι (n + 1)).comp (ι n) = of S ι n
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext (of_succ_ι n)

name: DG.SeqColimit.of_injective
statement:
theorem of_injective (hι : ∀ n, Function.Injective (ι n)) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (of S ι n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  rw [of_apply, DGSubmodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff, DGModuleHom.mem_range] at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  have h0 : ∀ k, k < n → y k = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro hk
      have h := relHom_apply_zero ι y
      rw [hy, of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega)] at h
      exact h.symm
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      have h := relHom_apply_succ ι y k
      rw [hy, of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), ih (by omega), map_zero, sub_zero] at h
      exact h.symm
  have hn : y n = x := by
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have h := relHom_apply_zero ι y
      rw [hy, of_eq_same] at h
      exact h.symm
    | succ k =>
      have h := relHom_apply_succ ι y k
      rw [hy, of_eq_same, h0 k (by omega), map_zero, sub_zero] at h
      exact h.symm
  by_contra hx0
  have hne : ∀ j, y (n + j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => exact hn ▸ hx0
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have h := relHom_apply_succ ι y (n + j)
      change y (n + j + 1) = 0 at hj
      rw [hy, of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), hj, zero_sub, eq_comm, neg_eq_zero,
        map_eq_zero_iff _ (hι _)] at h
      exact ih h
  exact Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (add_right_injective n) hne
    (DFinsupp.finite_support y)

name: DG.SeqColimit.mem_filtration_iff
statement:
theorem mem_filtration_iff {n : ℕ} {x : SeqColimit S ι} :
    x ∈ filtration n ↔ ∃ y, of S ι n y = x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.SeqColimit.of_mem_filtration
statement: theorem of_mem_filtration (n : ℕ) (x : S n) : of S ι n x ∈ filtration n
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: DG.SeqColimit.filtration_mono
statement: theorem filtration_mono : Monotone (filtration (S := S) (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨ι n y, of_succ_ι n y⟩

name: DG.SeqColimit.exists_mem_filtration
statement: theorem exists_mem_filtration (x : SeqColimit S ι) : ∃ n, x ∈ filtration n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (relHom S ι).range.mkQ_surjective x
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _⟩
  | of n x => exact ⟨n, x, rfl⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hy
    rw [map_add]
    exact ⟨max i j, add_mem (filtration_mono (le_max_left i j) hi)
      (filtration_mono (le_max_right i j) hj)⟩

name: DG.SeqColimit.exists_of_eq
statement: theorem exists_of_eq (x : SeqColimit S ι) : ∃ n y, of S ι n y = x
proof:
:=
  (exists_mem_filtration x).imp fun _ h => h

name: DG.SeqColimit.toModule_relHom
statement: theorem toModule_relHom (y : ⨁ n, S n) : DGModuleHom.toModule g (relHom S ι y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | of n x =>
    rw [relHom_of, map_sub, DGModuleHom.toModule_lof, DGModuleHom.toModule_lof,
      ← DGModuleHom.comp_apply, hg, sub_self]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.SeqColimit.desc_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem desc_of (n : ℕ) (x : S n) : desc g hg (of S ι n x) = g n x
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.toModule_lof g n x

name: DG.SeqColimit.desc_comp_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem desc_comp_of (n : ℕ) : (desc g hg).comp (of S ι n) = g n
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext (desc_of g hg n)

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_inlLinear
statement: @[simp] theorem fstHom_inlLinear (x : Shift 1 M) : fstHom f (inlLinear f x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.sndLinear_inlLinear
statement: @[simp] theorem sndLinear_inlLinear (x : Shift 1 M) : sndLinear f (inlLinear f x) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem fstHom_inr (y : N) : fstHom f (inr f y) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.sndLinear_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem sndLinear_inr (y : N) : sndLinear f (inr f y) = y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.fstLinear_apply
statement: theorem fstLinear_apply (p : Cone f) : fstLinear f p = fstHom f p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.inrLinear_apply
statement: theorem inrLinear_apply (y : N) : inrLinear f y = inr f y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {p q : Cone f} (h₁ : fstHom f p = fstHom f q)
    (h₂ : sndLinear f p = sndLinear f q) : p = q
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext h₁ h₂

name: DG.Cone.inlLinear_fstHom_add_inr_sndLinear
statement:
theorem inlLinear_fstHom_add_inr_sndLinear (p : Cone f) :
    inlLinear f (fstHom f p) + inr f (sndLinear f p) = p
proof:
:=
  ext (add_zero _) (zero_add _)

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_comp_inr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fstHom_comp_inr : (fstHom f).comp (inr f) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {k : ℤ} {p : Cone f} :
    p ∈ grading k ↔ fstHom f p ∈ grading k ∧ sndLinear f p ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.Cone.inlLinear_mem
statement:
theorem inlLinear_mem {k : ℤ} {x : Shift 1 M} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    inlLinear f x ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  ⟨hx, zero_mem _⟩

name: DG.Cone.sndLinear_mem
statement: theorem sndLinear_mem {k : ℤ} {p : Cone f} (hp : p ∈ grading k) : sndLinear f p ∈ grading k

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_d
statement: theorem fstHom_d (p : Cone f) : fstHom f (d p) = d (fstHom f p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.sndLinear_d
statement:
theorem sndLinear_d (p : Cone f) :
    sndLinear f (d p) = f (unmk 1 (fstHom f p)) + d (sndLinear f p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.d_inlLinear
statement:
theorem d_inlLinear (x : Shift 1 M) :
    d (inlLinear f x) = inlLinear f (d x) + inr f (f (unmk 1 x))
proof:
:=
  ext (by simp) (by simp [sndLinear_d])

name: DG.Cone.d_inlLinear_sub_inlLinear_d
statement:
theorem d_inlLinear_sub_inlLinear_d (x : Shift 1 M) :
    d (inlLinear f x) - inlLinear f (d x) = inr f (f (unmk 1 x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_inlLinear, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: DG.Cone.d_inlLinear_add_inr
statement:
theorem d_inlLinear_add_inr (x : Shift 1 M) (y : N) :
    d (inlLinear f x + inr f y) = inlLinear f (d x) + inr f (f (unmk 1 x) + d y)
proof:
:=
  ext (by simp) (by simp [sndLinear_d])

name: DG.Cone.contraction_apply
statement:
theorem contraction_apply (p : Cone (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M)) :
    contraction M p = inlLinear _ (Shift.mk 1 (sndLinear _ p))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.d_contraction_add_contraction_d
statement:
theorem d_contraction_add_contraction_d (p : Cone (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M)) :
    d (contraction M p) + contraction M (d p) = p
proof:
:= by
  refine ext ?_ ?_
  · simp only [contraction_apply, map_add, fstHom_d, fstHom_inlLinear, sndLinear_d, d_mk,
      DGModuleHom.id_apply, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.neg_smul, one_smul,
      mk_neg, mk_unmk]
    abel
  · simp [contraction_apply, sndLinear_d]

name: DG.Cone.contraction_mem
statement:
theorem contraction_mem {k : ℤ} {p : Cone (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M)} (hp : p ∈ grading k) :
    contraction M p ∈ grading (k - 1)
proof:
:=
  inlLinear_mem (mk_mem_grading (sndLinear_mem hp))

name: DG.Cone.contraction_smul
statement:
theorem contraction_smul {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (p : Cone (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M)) :
    contraction M (a • p) = koszulSign i • (a • contraction M p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contraction_apply, contraction_apply, map_smul, mk_smul ha, one_mul, Units.smul_def,
    map_zsmul, map_smul, ← Units.smul_def]

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fstHom_map (h : g.comp f = f'.comp e) (p : Cone f) :
    fstHom f' (map e g h p) = e.shift 1 (fstHom f p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.sndLinear_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sndLinear_map (h : g.comp f = f'.comp e) (p : Cone f) :
    sndLinear f' (map e g h p) = g (sndLinear f p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cone.map_comp_inr
statement:
theorem map_comp_inr (h : g.comp f = f'.comp e) :
    (map e g h).comp (inr f) = (inr f').comp g
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext fun y => ext (by simp) rfl

name: DG.Cone.fstHom_comp_map
statement:
theorem fstHom_comp_map (h : g.comp f = f'.comp e) :
    (fstHom f').comp (map e g h) = (e.shift 1).comp (fstHom f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.Cochain.coe_smul_ground
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_smul_ground (r : R) (f : Cochain A M N n) : ⇑(r • f) = r • ⇑f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.smul_ground_apply
statement: theorem smul_ground_apply (r : R) (f : Cochain A M N n) (x : M) : (r • f) x = r • f x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.map_smul_ground
statement: theorem map_smul_ground (f : Cochain A M N n) (r : R) (x : M) : f (r • x) = r • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul A r x, f.map_smul (algebraMap_mem_grading R r), mul_zero, koszulSign_zero,
    one_smul, algebraMap_smul]

name: DG.Cochain.smul_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (r : R) (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (r • z₂).comp z₁ h = r • z₂.comp z₁ h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.comp_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_smul {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (r : R) (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (r • z₁) h = r • z₂.comp z₁ h
proof:
:=
  ext fun x => map_smul_ground z₂ r (z₁ x)

name: DG.δ_smul_ground
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_smul_ground (n m : ℤ) (r : R) (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (r • z) = r • δ n m z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · ext x
    rw [Cochain.smul_ground_apply, δ_apply _ _ hnm, δ_apply _ _ hnm, Cochain.smul_ground_apply,
      Cochain.smul_ground_apply, d_ground_smul A, smul_sub, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def,
      smul_comm r]
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm, δ_shape _ _ hnm, smul_zero]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.smul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of (r : R) (n : ℤ) (f : Cochain A M N n) :
    r • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) n f : HOM A M N) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) n (r • f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, map_smul]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.d_smul_ground
statement: theorem d_smul_ground (r : R) (F : HOM A M N) : d (r • F) = r • d F
proof:
:= by
  induction F using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n f => rw [smul_of, d_of, d_of, δ_smul_ground, smul_of]
  | add F G hF hG => rw [smul_add, d_add, hF, hG, d_add, smul_add]

name: DG.DGModule.END.smul_of_mul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of_mul_of (r : R) {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    (r • DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f) * DirectSum.of _ n g =
      r • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HOM.smul_of, of_mul_of, of_mul_of, HOM.smul_of]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.smul_ground_apply,
    Cochain.map_smul_ground, Units.smul_def, smul_comm r]

name: DG.DGModule.END.of_mul_smul_of
statement:
theorem of_mul_smul_of (r : R) {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * (r • DirectSum.of _ n g) =
      r • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HOM.smul_of, of_mul_of, of_mul_of, HOM.smul_of]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.smul_ground_apply,
    Units.smul_def, smul_comm r]

name: DG.DGModule.END.smul_mul_assoc_ground
statement: theorem smul_mul_assoc_ground (r : R) (F G : END A M) : (r • F) * G = r • (F * G)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add F F' hF hF' => rw [smul_add, add_mul, hF, hF', add_mul, smul_add]
  | of m f =>
    induction G using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add G G' hG hG' => rw [mul_add, hG, hG', mul_add, smul_add]
    | of n g => exact smul_of_mul_of r f g

name: DG.DGModule.END.mul_smul_comm_ground
statement: theorem mul_smul_comm_ground (r : R) (F G : END A M) : F * (r • G) = r • (F * G)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add F F' hF hF' => rw [add_mul, hF, hF', add_mul, smul_add]
  | of m f =>
    induction G using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add G G' hG hG' => rw [smul_add, mul_add, hG, hG', mul_add, smul_add]
    | of n g => exact of_mul_smul_of r f g

name: DG.DGModule.END.of_zero_smul_id
statement:
theorem of_zero_smul_id (r : R) :
    DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) 0 (r • Cochain.id A M) = r • (1 : END A M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_def, HOM.smul_of]

name: DG.DGModule.END.algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_apply (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (END A M) r = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) 0 (r • Cochain.id A M)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.smul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem smul_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {a : A} {m : M} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hm : m ∈ grading j) :
    a • m ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem ha hm

name: DG.d_smul
statement:
theorem d_smul {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (m : M) :
    d (a • m) = d a • m + koszulSign n • (a • d m)
proof:
:=
  DGModule.d_smul' ha m

name: DG.d_smul_of_even
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_even {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hn : Even n) (m : M) :
    d (a • m) = d a • m + a • d m
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_smul ha, koszulSign_even hn, one_smul]

name: DG.d_smul_of_odd
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_odd {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hn : Odd n) (m : M) :
    d (a • m) = d a • m - a • d m
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_smul ha, koszulSign_odd hn, Units.neg_smul, one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.d_smul_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) (m : M) :
    d (a • m) = d a • m + a • d m
proof:
:=
  d_smul_of_even ha Even.zero m

name: DG.d_smul_of_d_eq_zero
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_d_eq_zero {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hda : d a = 0) (m : M) :
    d (a • m) = koszulSign n • (a • d m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_smul ha, hda, zero_smul, zero_add]

name: DG.d_smul_of_d_eq_zero_right
statement: theorem d_smul_of_d_eq_zero_right {m : M} (hm : d m = 0) (a : A) : d (a • m) = d a • m
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a => rw [d_smul a.2, hm, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul, d_add, ha, ha', d_add, add_smul]

name: DG.DGModule.ground_smul_mem
statement:
theorem DGModule.ground_smul_mem {n : ℤ} (r : R) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) :
    r • m ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul A r m]
  simpa using smul_mem_grading (algebraMap_mem_grading R (A := A) r) hm

name: DG.d_ground_smul
statement: theorem d_ground_smul (r : R) (m : M) : d (r • m) = r • d m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul A r m, d_smul (algebraMap_mem_grading R (A := A) r), d_algebraMap,
    zero_smul,
    zero_add, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul, algebraMap_smul]

name: DG.DGModule.mem_gradingSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGModule.mem_gradingSubmodule {n : ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A M n ↔ m ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGModule.dLinear_apply

@[simp]
theorem DGModule.dLinear_apply (m : M) : DGModule.dLinear R A M m = d m

name: DG.DGModuleHom.coe_toLinearMap

name: DG.DGModuleHom.id_apply

@[simp]
theorem id_apply (m : M) : (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) m = m

name: DG.DGModuleHom.comp_apply

theorem comp_apply (g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (m : M) : g.comp f m = g (f m)

theorem comp_assoc {Q : Type*} [AddCommGroup Q] [DGAddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]

name: DG.ULift.d_down
