name: DG.ULift.downHom_comp_upHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ULift.downHom_comp_upHom :
    (ULift.downHom.{w'} M).comp (ULift.upHom.{w'} M) = (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.decompose_mem_closure
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hT x hx
    by_cases hkn : k = n
    · subst hkn
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hk]
      exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure hx
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hk hkn]
      exact zero_mem _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa [decompose_add] using add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx =>
    rw [decompose_neg, ← zero_sub, DirectSum.sub_apply]
    simpa using neg_mem hx

name: DG.IsDGAddSubgroup.closure
statement:
theorem IsDGAddSubgroup.closure {T : Set M} (hT : ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ n, x ∈ grading (M := M) n)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ T, d x ∈ AddSubgroup.closure T) : IsDGAddSubgroup (AddSubgroup.closure T) where
  decompose_mem hx n
proof:
:= decompose_mem_closure hT hx n
  d_mem {x} hx := by
    induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact hd x hx
    | zero => rw [d_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [d_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => rw [d_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.mem_grading_quotient_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_quotient_iff {n : ℤ} {y : M ⧸ S} :
    y ∈ grading n ↔ ∃ x ∈ grading (M := M) n, (QuotientAddGroup.mk x : M ⧸ S) = y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mk_mem_grading_quotient
statement:
theorem mk_mem_grading_quotient {n : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading n) :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk x : M ⧸ S) ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: DG.d_quotient_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_quotient_mk (x : M) : d (QuotientAddGroup.mk x : M ⧸ S) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (d x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.coneLeftAddEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem coneLeftAddEquiv_tmul (p : Cone f) (n : N) :
    coneLeftAddEquiv (B := B) N f (p ⊗ₜ n) =
      ((shiftLeftAddEquiv M N 1 (p.1 ⊗ₜ n), p.2 ⊗ₜ n) :
        Cone (tensorDGHom f (DGModuleHom.id : N →ᵈᵍ[B] N)))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.coneRightAddEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem coneRightAddEquiv_tmul (m : M) (q : Cone g) :
    coneRightAddEquiv (A := A) M g (m ⊗ₜ q) =
      ((shiftRightAddEquiv M N 1 (m ⊗ₜ q.1), m ⊗ₜ q.2) :
        Cone (tensorDGHom (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) g))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.gMul_def
statement:
theorem gMul_def {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    (GradedMonoid.GMul.mul f g : Cochain A M M (m + n)) = koszulSign (m * n) • g.comp f rfl
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.gOne_def
statement: theorem gOne_def : (GradedMonoid.GOne.one : Cochain A M M 0) = Cochain.id A M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.gMul_apply
statement:
theorem gMul_apply {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) (x : M) :
    (GradedMonoid.GMul.mul f g : Cochain A M M (m + n)) x = koszulSign (m * n) • g (f x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (1 : END A M) = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) 0 (Cochain.id A M)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.of_mul_of
statement:
theorem of_mul_of {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M) =
      DirectSum.of _ (m + n) (koszulSign (m * n) • g.comp f rfl)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of f g

name: DG.DGModule.END.d_of_mul_of
statement:
theorem d_of_mul_of {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M) =
      d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f : END A M) * DirectSum.of _ n g +
        koszulSign m • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f *
          d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n g : END A M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_mul_of, HOM.d_of, HOM.d_of, HOM.d_of, of_mul_of, of_mul_of,
    HOM.of_congr (show m + 1 + n = m + n + 1 by ring)
      (g := koszulSign ((m + 1) * n) • g.comp (δ m (m + 1) f) (by ring)) (fun _ => rfl),
    HOM.of_congr (show m + (n + 1) = m + n + 1 by ring)
      (g := koszulSign (m * (n + 1)) • (δ n (n + 1) g).comp f (by ring)) (fun _ => rfl),
    ← HOM.of_units_smul, ← map_add]
  congr 1
  rw [δ_units_smul, δ_comp f g rfl (m + 1) (n + 1) (m + n + 1) rfl rfl rfl]
  ext x
  simp only [Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, smul_add,
    smul_smul, add_mul, mul_add, one_mul, mul_one, koszulSign_add]
  rw [mul_left_comm, Int.units_mul_self, mul_one, add_comm]

name: DG.Cochain.signedApply_of_mem
statement:
theorem signedApply_of_mem {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain A M N n) {i : ℤ} {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) : z.signedApply x = koszulSign (n * i) • z x
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedApply, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hx, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.Cochain.signedApplyHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedApplyHom_apply {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    signedApplyHom A M N n z = z.signedApply
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.signedEval_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedEval_of {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M n) :
    signedEval A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n f) = f.signedApply
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedEval, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]; rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.signedEval_of_mul_of
statement:
theorem signedEval_of_mul_of {m n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M m) (g : Cochain A M M n) :
    signedEval A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) m f * DirectSum.of _ n g : END A M) =
      g.signedApply.comp f.signedApply
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_mul_of, signedEval_of]
  refine decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := M)) fun i x => ?_
  show _ = g.signedApply (f.signedApply x)
  have hu (u : ℤˣ) (y : M) : g.signedApply (u • y) = u • g.signedApply y := by
    rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]
  rw [Cochain.signedApply_of_mem _ x.2, Cochain.signedApply_of_mem _ x.2, hu,
    Cochain.signedApply_of_mem _ (f.map_mem x.2), Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply,
    smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [← koszulSign_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: DG.DGModule.END.signedEval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedEval_one : signedEval A M 1 = AddMonoidHom.id M
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_def, signedEval_of]
  refine decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := M)) fun i x => ?_
  rw [Cochain.signedApply_of_mem _ x.2, zero_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.signedEval_mul
statement:
theorem signedEval_mul (F G : END A M) :
    signedEval A M (F * G) = (signedEval A M G).comp (signedEval A M F)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m f =>
    induction G using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of n g => rw [signedEval_of_mul_of, signedEval_of, signedEval_of]
    | add G₁ G₂ h₁ h₂ => simp [mul_add, h₁, h₂, AddMonoidHom.add_comp]
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ => simp [add_mul, h₁, h₂, AddMonoidHom.comp_add]

name: DG.DGModule.END.rightAction_apply
statement:
theorem rightAction_apply (F : END A M) (x : M) :
    (rightAction A M F).unop x = signedEval A M F x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.rightAction_of_apply
statement:
theorem rightAction_of_apply {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M n) {i : ℤ} {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    (rightAction A M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n f)).unop x =
      koszulSign (n * i) • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightAction_apply, signedEval_of, Cochain.signedApply_of_mem f hx]

name: DG.Regrade.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] {k : ℤ} {m : M} :
    mk n m ∈ grading k ↔ m ∈ grading (M := M) (k + n)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.Regrade.d_mk
statement: theorem d_mk [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] (m : M) : d (mk n m) = mk n (d m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Regrade.smul_mk
statement: theorem smul_mk (a : A) (m : M) : a • mk n m = mk n (a • m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Regrade.op_smul_mk
statement: theorem op_smul_mk (b : B) (m : M) : op b • mk n m = mk n (op (Shift.twist B n b) • m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Regrade.op_smul_mk_of_mem
statement:
theorem op_smul_mk_of_mem {i : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading i) (m : M) :
    op b • mk n m = mk n (koszulSign (n * i) • (op b • m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_mk, Shift.twist_of_mem hb, Units.smul_def, MulOpposite.op_smul, smul_assoc,
    ← Units.smul_def]

name: DG.signTwist_of_mem
statement:
theorem signTwist_of_mem (n : ℤ) {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) :
    signTwist M n m = koszulSign (n * k) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [signTwist, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hm, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.signTwist_mem
statement: theorem signTwist_mem (n : ℤ) {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) : signTwist M n m ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  rw [signTwist_of_mem n hm, Units.smul_def]
  exact zsmul_mem hm _

name: DG.signTwist_signTwist
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signTwist_signTwist (n : ℤ) (m : M) : signTwist M n (signTwist M n m) = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rw [signTwist_of_mem n m.2, map_units_zsmul, signTwist_of_mem n m.2, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self,
      one_smul]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.d_signTwist
statement: theorem d_signTwist (n : ℤ) (m : M) : d (signTwist M n m) = koszulSign n • signTwist M n (d m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous k m =>
    have e : koszulSign (n * k) = koszulSign n * koszulSign (n * (k + 1)) := by
      rw [mul_add, mul_one, koszulSign_add, mul_comm (koszulSign (n * k)), ← mul_assoc,
        Int.units_mul_self, one_mul]
    rw [signTwist_of_mem n m.2, signTwist_of_mem n (d_mem m.2), d_units_smul, e, mul_smul]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => simp only [map_add, hm, hm', smul_add]

name: DG.signTwist_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem signTwist_smul_of_mem {A : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [Module A M] [DGModule A M]
    (n : ℤ) {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (m : M) :
    signTwist M n (a • m) = koszulSign (n * i) • (a • signTwist M n m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j m =>
    rw [signTwist_of_mem n (smul_mem_grading ha m.2), signTwist_of_mem n m.2,
      smul_comm a (koszulSign (n * j)) (m : M), smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← mul_add]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, smul_add, smul_add]

name: DG.signTwist_op_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem signTwist_op_smul_of_mem {A : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [DGRing A] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ M]
    [DGRightModule A M] (n : ℤ) {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (m : M) :
    signTwist M n (op a • m) = koszulSign (n * i) • (op a • signTwist M n m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j m =>
    rw [signTwist_of_mem n (op_smul_mem_grading ha m.2), signTwist_of_mem n m.2,
      smul_comm (op a) (koszulSign (n * j)) (m : M), smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← mul_add, add_comm i j]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, smul_add, smul_add]

name: DG.koszulSign_smul_congr
statement:
theorem koszulSign_smul_congr {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] {a b : ℤ} (h : Even (a - b))
    (x : X) : koszulSign a • x = koszulSign b • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [show koszulSign a = koszulSign b from (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff a b).mpr h]

name: DG.gradeSign_of_mem
statement:
theorem gradeSign_of_mem (j : ℤ) {i : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    gradeSign M j x = koszulSign (j * i) • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradeSign, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hx, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.gradeSign_mem
statement:
theorem gradeSign_mem (j : ℤ) {i : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    gradeSign M j x ∈ grading i
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradeSign_of_mem j hx]
  exact units_smul_mem_grading _ hx

name: DG.gradeSign_gradeSign
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradeSign_gradeSign (j : ℤ) (x : M) : gradeSign M j (gradeSign M j x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rw [gradeSign_of_mem j x.2, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, gradeSign_of_mem j x.2,
      ← Units.smul_def, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  | h_add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.gradeSign_smul
statement:
theorem gradeSign_smul {A : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [Module A M] [DGModule A M]
    (j : ℤ) {l : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading l) (x : M) :
    gradeSign M j (a • x) = koszulSign (j * l) • (a • gradeSign M j x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rw [gradeSign_of_mem j (smul_mem_grading ha x.2), gradeSign_of_mem j x.2, smul_comm a,
      smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, mul_add]
  | h_add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, smul_add, smul_add]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.instGmodule_eq_toGmodule
statement:
theorem instGmodule_eq_toGmodule :
    instGmodule A M M = DirectSum.GSemiring.toGmodule (fun n => Cochain A M M n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.of_smul_of
statement:
theorem of_smul_of {k n : ℤ} (F : Cochain A M M k) (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) k F : END A M) •
        (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P) =
      DirectSum.of _ (k + n) (koszulSign (k * n) • f.comp F rfl)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.Gmodule.of_smul_of _ _ F f

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.d_of_smul_of
statement:
theorem d_of_smul_of {k n : ℤ} (F : Cochain A M M k) (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    d ((DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) k F : END A M) •
        (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P)) =
      d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) k F : END A M) •
          (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P) +
        koszulSign k • ((DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) k F : END A M) •
          d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P))
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_smul_of, HOM.d_of, HOM.d_of, HOM.d_of, of_smul_of, of_smul_of,
    HOM.of_congr (show k + 1 + n = k + n + 1 by ring)
      (g := koszulSign ((k + 1) * n) • f.comp (δ k (k + 1) F) (by ring)) (fun _ => rfl),
    HOM.of_congr (show k + (n + 1) = k + n + 1 by ring)
      (g := koszulSign (k * (n + 1)) • (δ n (n + 1) f).comp F (by ring)) (fun _ => rfl),
    ← HOM.of_units_smul, ← map_add]
  congr 1
  rw [δ_units_smul, δ_comp F f rfl (k + 1) (n + 1) (k + n + 1) rfl rfl rfl]
  ext x
  simp only [Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, smul_add,
    smul_smul, add_mul, mul_add, one_mul, mul_one, koszulSign_add]
  rw [mul_left_comm, Int.units_mul_self, mul_one, add_comm]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem {k : ℤ} {x : HOM A M P} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) k (x k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same]

name: DG.DGBimodule.toENDDGRingHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toENDDGRingHom_apply (b : B) : toENDDGRingHom A M b = toEND A M b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.LeftAction.smul_def
statement: theorem smul_def (b : B) (f : HOM A M P) : b • f = DGBimodule.toEND A M b • f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.LeftAction.smul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of {k n : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading k) (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    b • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P) =
      DirectSum.of _ (k + n)
        (koszulSign (k * n) • f.comp (DGBimodule.rightMulCochain A M ⟨b, hb⟩) rfl)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, DGBimodule.toEND_of_mem hb, of_smul_of]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.LeftAction.smul_of_apply
statement:
theorem smul_of_apply {k n i : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading k) (f : Cochain A M P n) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    (b • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) n f : HOM A M P)) (k + n) x =
      koszulSign (k * (n + i)) • f (op b • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_of hb, DirectSum.of_eq_same, Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply,
    DGBimodule.rightMulCochain_apply, DGBimodule.signedRightMul_of_mem _ _ hx,
    Cochain.map_units_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, mul_add]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.postcompAddHom_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompAddHom_of (h : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P') {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    postcompAddHom M h (DirectSum.of _ n f) =
      DirectSum.of _ n ((Cochain.ofHom h).comp f (add_zero n))
proof:
:= by
  simp [postcompAddHom]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.postcompEND_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompEND_of (h : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P') {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    postcompEND M h (DirectSum.of _ n f) =
      DirectSum.of _ n ((Cochain.ofHom h).comp f (add_zero n))
proof:
:=
  postcompAddHom_of h f

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.LeftAction.postcomp_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcomp_of (h : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P') {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M P n) :
    postcomp B M h (DirectSum.of _ n f) =
      DirectSum.of _ n ((Cochain.ofHom h).comp f (add_zero n))
proof:
:=
  postcompAddHom_of h f

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.evalOne_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalOne_of {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A A P n) :
    evalOne A P (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A A P n) n f) = f 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalOne]

name: DG.Cochain.map_one_mem
statement: theorem _root_.DG.Cochain.map_one_mem {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A A P n) : f 1 ∈ grading (M := P) n
proof:
:= by
  have h := f.map_mem (one_mem_grading (A := A))
  rwa [zero_add] at h

name: DG.Cochain.apply_eq_smul_map_one
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.Cochain.apply_eq_smul_map_one {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A A P n) {i : ℤ} {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) : f x = koszulSign (n * i) • (x • f 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← f.map_smul hx, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.smulRightCochain_apply
statement:
theorem smulRightCochain_apply {n : ℤ} (p : grading (M := P) n) (x : A) :
    smulRightCochain p x = gradeSign A n x • (p : P)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.smulRightCochain_apply_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smulRightCochain_apply_one {n : ℤ} (p : grading (M := P) n) :
    smulRightCochain (A := A) p 1 = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [smulRightCochain_apply, gradeSign_of_mem n (one_mem_grading (A := A)), mul_zero,
    koszulSign_zero, one_smul, one_smul]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.coevalOne_of_mem
statement:
theorem coevalOne_of_mem {n : ℤ} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ grading n) :
    coevalOne A P p = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A A P n) n (smulRightCochain ⟨p, hp⟩)
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hp

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.evalOne_coevalOne
statement: theorem evalOne_coevalOne (p : P) : evalOne A P (coevalOne A P p) = p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous p => rw [coevalOne_of_mem p.2, evalOne_of, smulRightCochain_apply_one]
  | h_add p p' hp hp' => rw [map_add, map_add, hp, hp']

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.coevalOne_evalOne
statement: theorem coevalOne_evalOne (F : HOM A A P) : coevalOne A P (evalOne A P F) = F
proof:
:= by
  induction F using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n f =>
    rw [evalOne_of, coevalOne_of_mem (Cochain.map_one_mem f)]
    congr 1
    ext x
    induction x using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous x =>
      rw [smulRightCochain_apply, gradeSign_of_mem n x.2, Cochain.apply_eq_smul_map_one f x.2,
        smul_assoc]
    | h_add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | add F G hF hG => rw [map_add, map_add, hF, hG]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.evalOne_smul
statement: theorem evalOne_smul (a : A) (F : HOM A A P) : evalOne A P (a • F) = a • evalOne A P F
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous k a =>
    induction F using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of n f =>
      rw [smul_of a.2, evalOne_of, evalOne_of, Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply,
        DGBimodule.rightMulCochain_apply,
        DGBimodule.signedRightMul_of_mem _ _ (one_mem_grading (A := A)), op_smul_eq_mul,
        one_mul, Cochain.map_units_smul, f.apply_eq_smul_map_one a.2, smul_smul, smul_smul,
        ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
      rw [koszulSign_smul_congr (b := 0) ⟨k * n, by ring⟩, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    | add F G hF hG => rw [smul_add, map_add, hF, hG, map_add, smul_add]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul, map_add, ha, ha', add_smul]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.evalOneEquiv_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalOneEquiv_of {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A A P n) :
    evalOneEquiv A P (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A A P n) n f) = f 1
proof:
:=
  evalOne_of f

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.evalOneEquiv_symm_of_mem
statement:
theorem evalOneEquiv_symm_of_mem {n : ℤ} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ grading n) :
    (evalOneEquiv A P).symm p =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A A P n) n (smulRightCochain ⟨p, hp⟩)
proof:
:=
  coevalOne_of_mem hp

name: DG.cohomology.ofSummand_mk
statement:
theorem ofSummand_mk (i : ι) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles (M i) n) :
    ofSummand M i n (mk _ n z) = mk _ n ⟨DirectSum.of M i z, mem_cocycles.mpr
      ⟨DirectSum.of_mem_grading M i (cocycles.mem_grading z),
        by rw [DirectSum.d_of, cocycles.d_eq_zero z, _root_.map_zero]⟩⟩
proof:
:=
  mapAddMonoidHom_mk _ _ _ n z

name: DG.cohomology.component_mk
statement:
theorem component_mk (i : ι) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles (⨁ i, M i) n) :
    component M i n (mk _ n z) = mk _ n ⟨(z : ⨁ i, M i) i, mem_cocycles.mpr
      ⟨(DirectSum.mem_grading M).mp (cocycles.mem_grading z) i,
        by rw [← DirectSum.coe_d_apply, cocycles.d_eq_zero z, DirectSum.zero_apply]⟩⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.component_ofSummand_self
statement:
theorem component_ofSummand_self (i : ι) (n : ℤ) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    component M i n (ofSummand M i n y) = y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h z =>
    rw [ofSummand_mk, component_mk]
    congr 1
    ext
    exact DirectSum.of_eq_same i _

name: DG.cohomology.component_ofSummand_of_ne
statement:
theorem component_ofSummand_of_ne {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) (n : ℤ) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    component M j n (ofSummand M i n y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | h z =>
    rw [ofSummand_mk, component_mk, mk_eq_zero_iff]
    change (DirectSum.of M i z) j ∈ _
    rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm h)]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.cohomology.fromDirectSum_of
statement:
theorem fromDirectSum_of (n : ℤ) (i : ι) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    fromDirectSum M n (DirectSum.of _ i y) = ofSummand M i n y
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (fun i => ofSummand M i n) i y

name: DG.cohomology.component_fromDirectSum
statement:
theorem component_fromDirectSum (n : ℤ) (x : ⨁ i, cohomology (M i) n) (j : ι) :
    component M j n (fromDirectSum M n x) = x j
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [_root_.map_zero, _root_.map_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply]
  | of i y =>
    rw [fromDirectSum_of]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h
      rw [component_ofSummand_self, DirectSum.of_eq_same]
    · rw [component_ofSummand_of_ne h, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm h)]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [_root_.map_add, _root_.map_add, hx, hy, DirectSum.add_apply]

name: DG.cohomology.fromDirectSum_injective
statement: theorem fromDirectSum_injective (n : ℤ) : Function.Injective (fromDirectSum M n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  ext j
  rw [← component_fromDirectSum n x j, ← component_fromDirectSum n y j, h]

name: DG.cohomology.fromDirectSum_surjective
statement: theorem fromDirectSum_surjective (n : ℤ) : Function.Surjective (fromDirectSum M n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h z =>
    have hz : z = ∑ i ∈ (z : ⨁ i, M i).support, (⟨DirectSum.of M i ((z : ⨁ i, M i) i),
        mem_cocycles.mpr ⟨DirectSum.of_mem_grading M i
          ((DirectSum.mem_grading M).mp (cocycles.mem_grading z) i), by
          rw [DirectSum.d_of, ← DirectSum.coe_d_apply, cocycles.d_eq_zero z,
            DirectSum.zero_apply, _root_.map_zero]⟩⟩ : cocycles (⨁ i, M i) n) := by
      ext1
      rw [AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum]
      exact (DirectSum.sum_support_of _).symm
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.mem_range, hz, map_sum]
    refine sum_mem fun i _ => ⟨DirectSum.of _ i (mk _ n ⟨(z : ⨁ i, M i) i, mem_cocycles.mpr
      ⟨(DirectSum.mem_grading M).mp (cocycles.mem_grading z) i, by
        rw [← DirectSum.coe_d_apply, cocycles.d_eq_zero z, DirectSum.zero_apply]⟩⟩), ?_⟩
    rw [fromDirectSum_of, ofSummand_mk]

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℤ) (x : ⨁ i, cohomology (M i) n) :
    (directSumAddEquiv M n).symm x = fromDirectSum M n x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_symm_of
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_symm_of (n : ℤ) (i : ι) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    (directSumAddEquiv M n).symm (DirectSum.of _ i y) = ofSummand M i n y
proof:
:=
  fromDirectSum_of n i y

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_ofSummand
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_ofSummand (n : ℤ) (i : ι) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    directSumAddEquiv M n (ofSummand M i n y) = DirectSum.of _ i y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← directSumAddEquiv_symm_of, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_apply (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology (⨁ i, M i) n) (j : ι) :
    directSumAddEquiv M n x j = component M j n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (directSumAddEquiv M n).symm.surjective x
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, directSumAddEquiv_symm_apply, component_fromDirectSum]

name: DG.cohomology.map_lof
statement:
theorem map_lof (n : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    map (DGModuleHom.lof A M i) n = ofSummand M i n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.cohomology.directSumAddEquiv_map_lof
statement:
theorem directSumAddEquiv_map_lof (n : ℤ) (i : ι) (y : cohomology (M i) n) :
    directSumAddEquiv M n (map (DGModuleHom.lof A M i) n y) = DirectSum.of _ i y
proof:
:=
  directSumAddEquiv_ofSummand n i y

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_smul_eq_signedEval
statement: theorem op_smul_eq_signedEval (F : END A M) (x : M) : op F • x = signedEval A M F x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_smul_eq_rightAction
statement:
theorem op_smul_eq_rightAction (F : END A M) (x : M) :
    op F • x = (rightAction A M F).unop x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_of_smul
statement:
theorem op_of_smul {n : ℤ} (f : Cochain A M M n) {i : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    op (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n f) • x = koszulSign (n * i) • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_eq_signedEval, signedEval_of, Cochain.signedApply_of_mem f hx]

name: DG.DGModule.END.decompose_op_smul
statement:
theorem decompose_op_smul (F : END A M) (n : ℤ) {i : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    (decompose (grading (M := M)) (op F • x) (i + n) : M) = koszulSign (n * i) • F n x
proof:
:= by
  induction F using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [Cochain.zero_apply]
  | of k f =>
    have hf := units_smul_mem_grading (koszulSign (k * i)) (f.map_mem hx)
    rw [op_of_smul f hx]
    by_cases hk : k = n
    · subst hk
      rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same, decompose_of_mem_same _ hf]
    · rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm hk), decompose_of_mem_ne _ hf (by omega),
        Cochain.zero_apply, smul_zero]
  | add F G hF hG =>
    rw [op_add, add_smul, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, hF, hG,
      DirectSum.add_apply, Cochain.add_apply, smul_add]

name: DG.DGModule.END.ext_op_smul
statement: theorem ext_op_smul {F G : END A M} (h : ∀ x : M, op F • x = op G • x) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  ext n x
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    have hF := decompose_op_smul F n x.2
    rw [h, decompose_op_smul G n x.2] at hF
    exact (smul_left_cancel_iff _).mp hF.symm
  | h_add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_smul_injective
statement: theorem op_smul_injective : Function.Injective fun F : END A M => (op F • · : M → M)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => ext_op_smul fun x => congrFun h x

name: DG.DGModule.END.op_d_smul
statement:
theorem op_d_smul {j : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading j) (F : END A M) :
    op (d F) • x = koszulSign j • (d (op F • x) - op F • d x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_op_smul hx, add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.DGModule.END.eq_of_op_smul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_op_smul_eq {m₀ : M} (hgen : ∀ x : M, ∃ a : A, a • m₀ = x) {F G : END A M}
    (h : op F • m₀ = op G • m₀) : F = G
proof:
:=
  ext_op_smul fun x => by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hgen x
    rw [← smul_comm a (op F) m₀, h, smul_comm]

name: DG.coe_decompose_map
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_map {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [DGAddCommGroup N] (f : M →+ N) (hf : ∀ {i : ℤ} {x : M}, x ∈ grading i → f x ∈ grading i)
    (x : M) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := N)) (f x) n : N) = f (decompose (grading (M := M)) x n)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous i x =>
    by_cases hi : i = n
    · subst hi
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ (hf x.2), decompose_of_mem_same _ x.2]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ (hf x.2) hi, decompose_of_mem_ne _ x.2 hi, map_zero]
  | h_add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, hx, hy,
      decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, map_add]

name: DG.DGBimodule.signedRightMul_of_mem
statement:
theorem signedRightMul_of_mem (n : ℤ) (b : B) {j : ℤ} {x : M} (hx : x ∈ grading j) :
    signedRightMul M n b x = koszulSign (n * j) • (op b • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedRightMul, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hx, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.DGBimodule.signedRightMul_add
statement:
theorem signedRightMul_add (n : ℤ) (b b' : B) :
    signedRightMul M n (b + b') = signedRightMul M n b + signedRightMul M n b'
proof:
:=
  decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := M)) fun _ x => by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, signedRightMul_of_mem _ _ x.2, signedRightMul_of_mem _ _ x.2,
      signedRightMul_of_mem _ _ x.2, op_add, add_smul, smul_add]

name: DG.DGBimodule.signedRightMul_zero
statement: theorem signedRightMul_zero (n : ℤ) : signedRightMul M n (0 : B) = 0
proof:
:=
  decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := M)) fun _ x => by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, signedRightMul_of_mem _ _ x.2, op_zero, zero_smul, smul_zero]

name: DG.DGBimodule.rightMulCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightMulCochain_apply {n : ℤ} (b : grading (M := B) n) (x : M) :
    rightMulCochain A M b x = signedRightMul M n (b : B) x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGBimodule.toENDAddHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem toENDAddHom_of_mem {n : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading n) :
    toENDAddHom A M b = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n (rightMulCochain A M ⟨b, hb⟩)
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hb

name: DG.DGBimodule.op_toENDAddHom_smul
statement: theorem op_toENDAddHom_smul (b : B) (x : M) : op (toENDAddHom A M b) • x = op b • x
proof:
:= by
  induction b using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous n b =>
    rw [toENDAddHom_of_mem b.2]
    induction x using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous x =>
      rw [DGModule.END.op_of_smul _ x.2, rightMulCochain_apply, signedRightMul_of_mem _ _ x.2,
        smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
    | h_add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, smul_add, hx, hy]
  | h_add b b' hb hb' => rw [map_add, op_add, add_smul, hb, hb', op_add, add_smul]

name: DG.DGBimodule.op_toEND_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem op_toEND_smul (b : B) (x : M) : op (toEND A M b) • x = op b • x
proof:
:=
  op_toENDAddHom_smul b x

name: DG.DGBimodule.toEND_of_mem
statement:
theorem toEND_of_mem {n : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading n) :
    toEND A M b = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) n (rightMulCochain A M ⟨b, hb⟩)
proof:
:=
  toENDAddHom_of_mem hb

name: DG.DGBimodule.toEND_mem_grading
statement: theorem toEND_mem_grading {n : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading n) : toEND A M b ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, (toEND_of_mem hb).symm⟩

name: DG.DGBimodule.toEND_d
statement: theorem toEND_d (b : B) : toEND A M (d b) = d (toEND A M b)
proof:
:= by
  refine DGModule.END.ext_op_smul fun x => ?_
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rw [DGModule.END.op_d_smul x.2, op_toEND_smul, op_toEND_smul, op_toEND_smul,
      d_op_smul x.2 b, add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  | h_add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, smul_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.DGBimodule.coe_decompose_toEND
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_toEND (b : B) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := DGModule.END A M)) (toEND A M b) n : DGModule.END A M) =
      toEND A M (decompose (grading (M := B)) b n : B)
proof:
:=
  coe_decompose_map (toEND A M).toAddMonoidHom (fun hb => toEND_mem_grading hb) b n

name: DG.DGBimodule.toEND_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem toEND_mem_grading_iff (hinj : Function.Injective (toEND A M : B → DGModule.END A M))
    {n : ℤ} {b : B} : toEND A M b ∈ grading n ↔ b ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, toEND_mem_grading⟩
  have h' := decompose_of_mem_same _ h
  rw [coe_decompose_toEND] at h'
  rw [← hinj h']
  exact Subtype.property _

name: DG.DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem endEquivOfGenerator_apply (F : DGModule.END A M) :
    endEquivOfGenerator A M m₀ hgen hinj φ hφ F = φ F
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem endEquivOfGenerator_symm_apply (b : B) :
    (endEquivOfGenerator A M m₀ hgen hinj φ hφ).symm b = toEND A M b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_d
statement:
theorem endEquivOfGenerator_d (F : DGModule.END A M) :
    endEquivOfGenerator A M m₀ hgen hinj φ hφ (d F) =
      d (endEquivOfGenerator A M m₀ hgen hinj φ hφ F)
proof:
:= by
  apply (endEquivOfGenerator A M m₀ hgen hinj φ hφ).symm.injective
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, endEquivOfGenerator_symm_apply, toEND_d,
    ← endEquivOfGenerator_symm_apply (hgen := hgen) (hinj := hinj) (hφ := hφ),
    RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: DG.DGBimodule.endEquivOfGenerator_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem endEquivOfGenerator_mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {F : DGModule.END A M} :
    endEquivOfGenerator A M m₀ hgen hinj φ hφ F ∈ grading n ↔ F ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  have hinj' : Function.Injective (toEND A M : B → DGModule.END A M) :=
    (endEquivOfGenerator A M m₀ hgen hinj φ hφ).symm.injective
  conv_rhs => rw [← (endEquivOfGenerator A M m₀ hgen hinj φ hφ).symm_apply_apply F]
  rw [endEquivOfGenerator_symm_apply, toEND_mem_grading_iff hinj']

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ks_eq''
statement: private theorem ks_eq'' {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ichInner_tmul
statement:
theorem ichInner_tmul (m : M) (n : N) (j : ℤ) (p : P) (q : Q) :
    ichInner P Q m n j (p ⊗ₜ q) = TensorProductOver.tmul A' m (twist P j p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] TensorProductOver.tmul B' n q
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ichAux_tmul_tmul
statement:
theorem ichAux_tmul_tmul {i j k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ grading k) (q : Q) :
    ichAux A' B' M N P Q (m ⊗ₜ n) (p ⊗ₜ q) = koszulSign (k * j) • (TensorProductOver.tmul A' m p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] TensorProductOver.tmul B' n q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ichAux, tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul _ hm hn]
  change ichInner P Q m n j (p ⊗ₜ q) = _
  rw [ichInner_tmul, twist_of_mem j hp, tmul_units_smul, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def,
    TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ichAux_balanced
statement:
theorem ichAux_balanced (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) (z : P ⊗[ℤ] Q) :
    ichAux A' B' M N P Q (op x • y) z = ichAux A' B' M N P Q y (x • z)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => rw [zero_op_smul', zero_smul' (A := A') (B := B'), map_zero, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_op_smul', map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', add_smul' (A := A') (B := B'),
      map_add]
  | @tmul i' j' a ha b hb =>
    induction y using tensor_induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [op_smul_zero', map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [op_smul_add', map_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
        AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hy, hy']
    | @tmul i j m n =>
      induction z using tensor_induction_on with
      | zero => rw [map_zero, smul_zero' (A := A') (B := B'), map_zero]
      | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, hz, hz', smul_add' (A := A') (B := B'), map_add]
      | @tmul k l p q =>
        have h1 := tmul_op_smul_tmul ha b (m : M) n.2
        have h2 := ExternalTensor.tmul_smul_tmul (M := P) (N := Q) a hb p.2 (q : Q)
        rw [h1, h2, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply, map_zsmul,
          ichAux_tmul_tmul (op_smul_mem_grading ha m.2) (op_smul_mem_grading hb n.2) p.2,
          ichAux_tmul_tmul m.2 n.2 (smul_mem_grading ha p.2), TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul,
          TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_smul, smul_smul,
          ← Units.val_mul, ← Units.val_mul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
        rw [ks_eq'' (m := i' * j + k * (j + j')) (n := j' * k + (i' + k) * j) ⟨0, by ring⟩]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchange_tmul
statement:
theorem interchange_tmul {i j k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ grading k) (q : Q) :
    interchange A' B' M N P Q (tmul _ (m ⊗ₜ n) (p ⊗ₜ q)) =
      koszulSign (k * j) • (TensorProductOver.tmul A' m p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] TensorProductOver.tmul B' n q)
proof:
:=
  ichAux_tmul_tmul hm hn hp q

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tmul_op_smul_left_eq
statement:
theorem tmul_op_smul_left_eq {i j : ℤ} {a : A'} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (m : M) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    (op a • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n =
      koszulSign (i * j) • (op (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (1 : B') : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul_op_smul_tmul ha 1 m hn, op_one, one_smul, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.units_smul_tmul'
statement: theorem units_smul_tmul' (u : ℤˣ) (p : P) (q : Q) : (u • p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q = u • (p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ichInvInner_balanced
statement:
theorem ichInvInner_balanced {j : ℤ} (n : grading (M := N) j) (q : Q) (a : A') (m : M) (p : P) :
    TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') ((op a • m) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n : N)) (twist P j p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q) =
      TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n : N)) (twist P j (a • p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
    rw [op_add, add_smul, TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProductOver.add_tmul, ha, ha', add_smul,
      map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProductOver.tmul_add]
  | @h_homogeneous i a =>
    induction p using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add p p' hp hp' =>
      rw [map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProductOver.tmul_add, hp, hp', smul_add, map_add,
        TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProductOver.tmul_add]
    | @h_homogeneous k p =>
      rw [twist_of_mem j p.2, twist_of_mem j (smul_mem_grading a.2 p.2), units_smul_tmul',
        units_smul_tmul', TensorProductOver.tmul_units_smul, TensorProductOver.tmul_units_smul,
        tmul_op_smul_left_eq (B' := B') a.2 m n.2, TensorProductOver.units_smul_tmul,
        TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul,
        ExternalTensor.tmul_smul_tmul (M := P) (N := Q) (a : A') (one_mem_grading (A := B')) p.2 q]
      simp only [zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
      rw [smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add,
        ks_eq'' (m := k * j + i * j) (n := (i + k) * j) ⟨0, by ring⟩]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ichInvInner_tmul
statement:
theorem ichInvInner_tmul {j : ℤ} (n : grading (M := N) j) (q : Q) (m : M) (p : P) :
    ichInvInner A' B' M N P Q n q (TensorProductOver.tmul A' m p) =
      TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n : N)) (twist P j p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ichInvN_tmul
statement:
theorem ichInvN_tmul {j k : ℤ} {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) (q : Q) (m : M) {p : P}
    (hp : p ∈ grading k) :
    ichInvN A' B' M N P Q n q (TensorProductOver.tmul A' m p) =
      koszulSign (k * j) • TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) (p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ichInvN, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hn]
  change ichInvInner A' B' M N P Q ⟨n, hn⟩ q (TensorProductOver.tmul A' m p) = _
  rw [ichInvInner_tmul, twist_of_mem j hp, units_smul_tmul', TensorProductOver.tmul_units_smul]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ichInvN_balanced
statement:
theorem ichInvN_balanced (b : B') (n : N) (q : Q) :
    ichInvN A' B' M N P Q (op b • n) q = ichInvN A' B' M N P Q n (b • q)
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProductOver.addHom_ext fun m p => ?_
  induction b using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add b b' hb hb' => rw [op_add, add_smul, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
      AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hb, hb', add_smul, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
  | @h_homogeneous l b =>
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [smul_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
        hn, hn', map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
    | @h_homogeneous j n =>
      induction p using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add p p' hp hp' => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_add, map_add, hp, hp', map_add]
      | @h_homogeneous k p =>
        have e : m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (op (b : B') • (n : N)) =
            op ((1 : A') ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (b : B') : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n : N)) := by
          rw [tmul_op_smul_tmul (one_mem_grading (A := A')) (b : B') m n.2, op_one, one_smul,
            zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
        rw [ichInvN_tmul (op_smul_mem_grading b.2 n.2) q m p.2, ichInvN_tmul n.2 _ m p.2, e,
          TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul,
          ExternalTensor.tmul_smul_tmul (M := P) (N := Q) (1 : A') b.2 p.2 q, one_smul,
          TensorProductOver.tmul_units_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add,
          ks_eq'' (m := k * (j + l) + l * k) (n := k * j) ⟨k * l, by ring⟩]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchangeInv_tmul
statement:
theorem interchangeInv_tmul {j k : ℤ} (m : M) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ grading k) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) (q : Q) :
    interchangeInv A' B' M N P Q (TensorProductOver.tmul A' m p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] TensorProductOver.tmul B' n q) =
      koszulSign (k * j) • TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) (p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q)
proof:
:=
  ichInvN_tmul hn q m hp

name: DG.ExternalTensor.T_addHom_ext
statement:
theorem T_addHom_ext {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] {f g : T →+ Y}
    (h : ∀ {a b c e : ℤ} (m : grading (M := M) a) (n : grading (M := N) b)
      (p : grading (M := P) c) (q : grading (M := Q) e),
      f (TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') ((m : M) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n : N)) ((p : P) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (q : Q))) =
        g (TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') ((m : M) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (n : N)) ((p : P) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (q : Q)))) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProductOver.addHom_ext fun y z => ?_
  induction y using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => rw [TensorProductOver.zero_tmul, map_zero, map_zero]
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [TensorProductOver.add_tmul, map_add, map_add, hy, hy']
  | tmul m n =>
    induction z using tensor_induction_on with
    | zero => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
    | add z z' hz hz' => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, hz, hz']
    | tmul p q => exact h m n p q

name: DG.ExternalTensor.X_addHom_ext
statement:
theorem X_addHom_ext {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] {f g : X →+ Y}
    (h : ∀ {a b c e : ℤ} (m : grading (M := M) a) (n : grading (M := N) b)
      (p : grading (M := P) c) (q : grading (M := Q) e),
      f (TensorProductOver.tmul A' (m : M) (p : P) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] TensorProductOver.tmul B' (n : N) (q : Q)) =
        g (TensorProductOver.tmul A' (m : M) (p : P) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] TensorProductOver.tmul B' (n : N) (q : Q))) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hx']
  | tmul u v =>
    induction u using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, map_zero]
    | add u u' hu hu' => rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, map_add, hu, hu']
    | tmul m p =>
      induction v using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
      | zero => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      | add v v' hv hv' => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, hv, hv']
      | tmul n q =>
        induction m using DG.induction_on with
        | h_zero => rw [TensorProductOver.zero_tmul, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, map_zero]
        | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [TensorProductOver.add_tmul, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add,
            map_add, hm, hm']
        | h_homogeneous m =>
          induction p using DG.induction_on with
          | h_zero => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_zero, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, map_zero]
          | h_add p p' hp hp' => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add,
              map_add, hp, hp']
          | h_homogeneous p =>
            induction n using DG.induction_on with
            | h_zero => rw [TensorProductOver.zero_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero,
                map_zero]
            | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [TensorProductOver.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add,
                map_add, hn, hn']
            | h_homogeneous n =>
              induction q using DG.induction_on with
              | h_zero => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero,
                  map_zero]
              | h_add q q' hq hq' => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add,
                  map_add, map_add, hq, hq']
              | h_homogeneous q => exact h m n p q

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchangeInv_interchange
statement:
theorem interchangeInv_interchange (t : T) :
    interchangeInv A' B' M N P Q (interchange A' B' M N P Q t) = t
proof:
:= by
  have := T_addHom_ext (f := (interchangeInv A' B' M N P Q).comp (interchange A' B' M N P Q))
    (g := AddMonoidHom.id T) fun m n p q => by
      rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, interchange_tmul m.2 n.2 p.2, map_units_zsmul,
        interchangeInv_tmul _ p.2 n.2, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul,
        AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this t

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchange_interchangeInv
statement:
theorem interchange_interchangeInv (x : X) :
    interchange A' B' M N P Q (interchangeInv A' B' M N P Q x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have := X_addHom_ext (f := (interchange A' B' M N P Q).comp (interchangeInv A' B' M N P Q))
    (g := AddMonoidHom.id X) fun m n p q => by
      rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, interchangeInv_tmul _ p.2 n.2, map_units_zsmul,
        interchange_tmul m.2 n.2 p.2, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul,
        AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchange_mem
statement:
theorem interchange_mem {k : ℤ} {t : T} (ht : t ∈ grading k) :
    interchange A' B' M N P Q t ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProductOver.induction_on_mem_grading
    (P := fun t => interchange A' B' M N P Q t ∈ grading k) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ht
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j y z hy hz hij
    change y ∈ tensorGrading M N i at hy
    change z ∈ tensorGrading P Q j at hz
    induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem y hy' =>
      obtain ⟨a, b, rfl, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hy'
      induction hz using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
      | mem z hz' =>
        obtain ⟨c, e, rfl, p, hp, q, hq, rfl⟩ := hz'
        rw [interchange_tmul hm hn hp, Units.smul_def]
        refine zsmul_mem ?_ _
        have := tmul_mem_grading (TensorProductOver.tmul_mem_grading (A := A') hm hp)
          (TensorProductOver.tmul_mem_grading (A := B') hn hq)
        rwa [show a + c + (b + e) = k by omega] at this
      | zero => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
      | add z z' _ _ h h' => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_add, map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
      | neg z _ h => rw [TensorProductOver.tmul_neg, map_neg]; exact neg_mem h
    | zero => rw [TensorProductOver.zero_tmul, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y y' _ _ h h' => rw [TensorProductOver.add_tmul, map_add]; exact add_mem h h'
    | neg y _ h => rw [TensorProductOver.neg_tmul, map_neg]; exact neg_mem h
  · intro x y hx hy; rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  · intro x hx; rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ks_val''
statement: private theorem ks_val'' (n : ℤ) : (koszulSign n : ℤ) = if Even n then 1 else -1
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_even n h]; rfl
  · rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_odd n (Int.not_even_iff_odd.mp h)]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchange_d_tmul
statement:
theorem interchange_d_tmul {a b c : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading a) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading b)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ grading c) (q : Q) :
    interchange A' B' M N P Q (d (TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) (p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q))) =
      d (interchange A' B' M N P Q
        (TensorProductOver.tmul (𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) (p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [TensorProductOver.d_tmul_of_mem (tmul_mem_grading hm hn), d_tmul_of_mem hm n,
    d_tmul_of_mem hp q, TensorProductOver.add_tmul, TensorProductOver.tmul_add,
    TensorProductOver.units_smul_tmul, TensorProductOver.tmul_units_smul]
  simp only [map_add, map_units_zsmul]
  rw [interchange_tmul (d_mem hm) hn hp, interchange_tmul hm (d_mem hn) hp,
    interchange_tmul hm hn (d_mem hp), interchange_tmul hm hn hp, interchange_tmul hm hn hp,
    d_units_smul, d_tmul_of_mem (TensorProductOver.tmul_mem_grading (A := A') hm hp),
    TensorProductOver.d_tmul_of_mem hm, TensorProductOver.d_tmul_of_mem hn]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add,
    TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul, smul_add, smul_smul, ks_val'']
  by_cases ha : Even a <;> by_cases hb : Even b <;> by_cases hc : Even c <;>
    simp [Int.even_add, Int.even_mul, ← Int.not_even_iff_odd, ha, hb, hc] <;> abel

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchange_d
statement:
theorem interchange_d (t : T) :
    interchange A' B' M N P Q (d t) = d (interchange A' B' M N P Q t)
proof:
:= by
  have := T_addHom_ext (f := (interchange A' B' M N P Q).comp (d : T →+ T))
    (g := (d : X →+ X).comp (interchange A' B' M N P Q)) fun m n p q =>
      interchange_d_tmul m.2 n.2 p.2 (q : Q)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this t

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ks_eq₃
statement: private theorem ks_eq₃ {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchange_smul
statement:
theorem interchange_smul (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) (t : T) :
    interchange A' B' M N P Q (x • t) = x • interchange A' B' M N P Q t
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero =>
    rw [show (0 : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • t = 0 from zero_smul (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) t, map_zero,
      show (0 : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • interchange A' B' M N P Q t = 0 from
        zero_smul' (A := A) (B := B) (M := TensorProductOver A' M P)
          (N := TensorProductOver B' N Q) _]
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [show (x + x') • t = x • t + x' • t from add_smul x x' t, map_add, hx, hx',
      show (x + x') • interchange A' B' M N P Q t = x • interchange A' B' M N P Q t +
        x' • interchange A' B' M N P Q t from
        add_smul' (A := A) (B := B) (M := TensorProductOver A' M P)
          (N := TensorProductOver B' N Q) x x' _]
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    have := T_addHom_ext
      (f := (interchange A' B' M N P Q).comp
        (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom T (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ)))
      (g := (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom X (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ)).comp
        (interchange A' B' M N P Q)) fun m n p q => by
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom_apply]
      rw [TensorProductOver.smul_tmul, ExternalTensor.tmul_smul_tmul a hb m.2 (n : N),
        TensorProductOver.units_smul_tmul, map_units_zsmul,
        interchange_tmul (smul_mem_grading ha m.2) (smul_mem_grading hb n.2) p.2,
        interchange_tmul m.2 n.2 p.2, smul_units_smul,
        ExternalTensor.tmul_smul_tmul a hb (TensorProductOver.tmul_mem_grading (A := A') m.2 p.2),
        smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
      congr 1
      exact ks_eq₃ ⟨0, by ring⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this t

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchangeEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem interchangeEquiv_tmul {a b c : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading a) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading b) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ grading c) (q : Q) :
    interchangeEquiv A B A' B' M N P Q (TensorProductOver.tmul _ (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) (p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] q)) =
      koszulSign (c * b) •
        (TensorProductOver.tmul A' m p ⊗ₜ[ℤ] TensorProductOver.tmul B' n q)
proof:
:=
  interchange_tmul hm hn hp q

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ks_eq₄
statement: private theorem ks_eq₄ {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.ExternalTensor.interchange_op_smul
statement:
theorem interchange_op_smul (x : 𝒞 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] 𝒟) (t : T) :
    interchange A' B' M N P Q (op x • t) = op x • interchange A' B' M N P Q t
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero =>
    rw [show op (0 : 𝒞 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] 𝒟) • t = 0 by rw [op_zero]; exact zero_smul (𝒞 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] 𝒟)ᵐᵒᵖ t, map_zero,
      zero_op_smul' (A' := C) (B' := D)]
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [show op (x + x') • t = op x • t + op x' • t by rw [op_add]; exact add_smul (op x) (op x') t, map_add,
      hx, hx', add_op_smul' (A' := C) (B' := D)]
  | @tmul i j c hc d hd =>
    have := T_addHom_ext
      (f := (interchange A' B' M N P Q).comp
        (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom T (op (c ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] d : 𝒞 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] 𝒟))))
      (g := (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom X (op (c ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] d : 𝒞 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] 𝒟))).comp
        (interchange A' B' M N P Q)) fun m n p q => by
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom_apply]
      rw [TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul_right, tmul_op_smul_tmul hc d (p : P) q.2,
        TensorProductOver.tmul_units_smul, map_units_zsmul,
        interchange_tmul m.2 n.2 (op_smul_mem_grading hc p.2),
        interchange_tmul m.2 n.2 p.2, op_smul_units_smul,
        tmul_op_smul_tmul hc d (TensorProductOver.tmul A' (m : M) (p : P))
          (TensorProductOver.tmul_mem_grading (A := B') n.2 q.2),
        TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul_right, TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul_right,
        smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
      congr 1
      exact ks_eq₄ ⟨0, by ring⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this t

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.ks_eq
statement: private theorem ks_eq {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.ks_val
statement: private theorem ks_val (n : ℤ) : (koszulSign n : ℤ) = if Even n then 1 else -1
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_even n h]; rfl
  · rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_odd n (Int.not_even_iff_odd.mp h)]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_add
statement:
theorem tmul_add (m : M) (n n' : N) :
    (tmul m (n + n') : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = tmul m n + tmul m n'
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.tmul_add m n n'

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.add_tmul
statement:
theorem add_tmul (m m' : M) (n : N) :
    (tmul (m + m') n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = tmul m n + tmul m' n
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.add_tmul m m' n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.zero_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_tmul (n : N) : (tmul (0 : M) n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = 0
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.zero_tmul M n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_zero (m : M) : (tmul m (0 : N) : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = 0
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.tmul_zero N m

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.smul_tmul
statement:
theorem smul_tmul (r : R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tmul (r • m) n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = tmul m (r • n)
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.smul_tmul r m n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.smul_tmul'
statement:
theorem smul_tmul' (r : R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (r • tmul m n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = tmul (r • m) n
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.smul_tmul' r m n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.neg_tmul
statement:
theorem neg_tmul (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tmul (-m) n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = -tmul m n
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.neg_tmul m n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_neg
statement:
theorem tmul_neg (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tmul m (-n) : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = -tmul m n
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.tmul_neg m n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.zsmul_tmul
statement:
theorem zsmul_tmul (k : ℤ) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tmul (k • m) n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = k • tmul m n
proof:
:= by
  change (k • m) ⊗ₜ[R] n = k • (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_zsmul
statement:
theorem tmul_zsmul (k : ℤ) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tmul m (k • n) : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = k • tmul m n
proof:
:= by
  change m ⊗ₜ[R] (k • n) = k • (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.units_tmul
statement:
theorem units_tmul (u : ℤˣ) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tmul (u • m) n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = u • tmul m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, zsmul_tmul]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_units
statement:
theorem tmul_units (u : ℤˣ) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (tmul m (u • n) : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = u • tmul m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, tmul_zsmul]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.liftAddHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAddHom_tmul {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] (f : M →+ N →+ P)
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N), f (r • m) n = f m (r • n)) (m : M) (n : N) :
    liftAddHom (A := A) (B := B) f hf (tmul m n) = f m n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {P : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N → Prop} (x : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N)
    (zero : P 0)
    (tmul' : ∀ {i j : ℤ} (m : M), m ∈ grading i → ∀ n : N, n ∈ grading j → P (tmul m n))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn (motive := P) x (fun m n => ?_) add
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [TensorProduct.zero_tmul]; exact zero
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero]; exact zero
    | h_homogeneous n => exact tmul' m.1 m.2 n.1 n.2
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add]; exact add _ _ hn hn'
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul]; exact add _ _ hm hm'

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.addHom_ext
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => induction_on (P := fun x => f x = g x) x (by simp) h
    fun x y (hx : f x = g x) (hy : f y = g y) => by
      show f (x + y) = g (x + y); rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_mem_tensorGrading
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_tensorGrading {i j k : ℤ} (h : i + j = k) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) : tmul m n ∈ tensorGrading R A B M N k
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, h, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorD_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorD_tmul (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorD R A B M N (tmul m n) = tmul (d m) n + tmul (gradeInvolution M m) (d n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorD_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem tensorD_tmul_of_mem {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) (n : N) :
    tensorD R A B M N (tmul m n) = tmul (d m) n + koszulSign i • tmul m (d n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorD_tmul, gradeInvolution_of_mem hm, units_tmul]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorD_tensorD
statement:
theorem tensorD_tensorD (x : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    tensorD R A B M N (tensorD R A B M N x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | tmul' m _ n _ =>
    rw [tensorD_tmul, map_add, tensorD_tmul, tensorD_tmul, d_d, zero_tmul, zero_add, d_d,
      tmul_zero, d_gradeInvolution, neg_tmul, add_zero, add_neg_cancel]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorD_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, rfl, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [tensorD_tmul_of_mem hm]
    refine add_mem (tmul_mem_tensorGrading (by ring) (d_mem hm) hn) ?_
    rw [Units.smul_def]
    exact zsmul_mem (tmul_mem_tensorGrading (by ring) hm (d_mem hn)) _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.liftHomogeneous₂_balanced
statement:
theorem liftHomogeneous₂_balanced {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P]
    (φ : ∀ i j, grading (M := M) i →+ grading (M := N) j →+ P)
    (hφ : ∀ (r : R) {i j : ℤ} (m : grading (M := M) i) (n : grading (M := N) j),
      φ i j ⟨r • (m : M), DGModule.ground_smul_mem A r m.2⟩ n =
        φ i j m ⟨r • (n : N), DGModule.ground_smul_mem B r n.2⟩)
    (r : R) (m : M) (n : N) : liftHomogeneous₂ φ (r • m) n = liftHomogeneous₂ φ m (r • n)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous n =>
      rw [liftHomogeneous₂_of_mem φ (DGModule.ground_smul_mem A r m.2) n.2,
        liftHomogeneous₂_of_mem φ m.2 (DGModule.ground_smul_mem B r n.2)]
      exact hφ r m n
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, hn, hn']
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
      AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hm, hm']

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P]
    (φ : ∀ i j, grading (M := M) i →+ grading (M := N) j →+ P) (hφ) {i j : ℤ} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    tensorLiftHomogeneous (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) φ hφ (tmul m n) = φ i j ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous₂_of_mem φ hm hn

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorDecompose_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorDecompose_tmul {i j k : ℤ} (h : i + j = k) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    tensorDecompose R A B M N (tmul m n) =
      DirectSum.of (fun k => tensorGrading R A B M N k) k
        ⟨tmul m n, tmul_mem_tensorGrading h hm hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul _ _ hm hn

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorDecompose_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, h, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [tensorDecompose_tmul h hm hn]
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact (map_zero _).symm.trans (congrArg _ rfl)
  | add x y hx' hy' hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, ← map_add]; rfl
  | neg x hx' hx => rw [map_neg, hx, ← map_neg]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    (tmul m n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  tmul_mem_tensorGrading rfl hm hn

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.d_tmul
statement:
theorem d_tmul (m : M) (n : N) :
    d (tmul m n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) =
      tmul (d m) n + tmul (gradeInvolution M m) (d n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.d_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem d_tmul_of_mem {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) (n : N) :
    d (tmul m n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = tmul (d m) n + koszulSign i • tmul m (d n)
proof:
:=
  tensorD_tmul_of_mem hm n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.map_mem_grading_of_tmul
statement:
theorem map_mem_grading_of_tmul {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [DGAddCommGroup Y]
    (f : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N →+ Y) (s : ℤ)
    (h : ∀ {i j : ℤ} {m : M} {n : N}, m ∈ grading i → n ∈ grading j →
      f (tmul m n) ∈ grading (i + j + s)) {k : ℤ} {x : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N}
    (hx : x ∈ grading k) : f x ∈ grading (k + s)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, j, rfl, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact h hm hn
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.smul_ground_comm
statement: theorem smul_ground_comm (a : A) (r : R) (m : M) : a • (r • m) = r • (a • m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_smul A r m, smul_smul, ← Algebra.commutes, ← smul_smul, algebraMap_smul]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.twist_ground_smul
statement:
theorem twist_ground_smul (i : ℤ) (r : R) (b : B) :
    ExternalTensor.twist B i (r • b) = r • ExternalTensor.twist B i b
proof:
:= by
  induction b using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous k b =>
    have hrb : r • (b : B) ∈ grading k := by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def]
      simpa using mul_mem_grading (algebraMap_mem_grading R (A := B) r) b.2
    rw [ExternalTensor.twist_of_mem i hrb, ExternalTensor.twist_of_mem i b.2, Units.smul_def,
      Units.smul_def, smul_comm]
  | h_add b b' hb hb' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hb, hb', map_add, smul_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.act_tmul
proof:
:=
  tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul _ _ hm hn

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.act_tmul_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous n =>
    rw [act_tmul a b hm n.2, ExternalTensor.twist_of_mem i hb, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def,
      smul_assoc, tmul_zsmul]
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [tmul_add, map_add, hn, hn', smul_add, tmul_add, smul_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.actBilin_balanced
statement:
theorem actBilin_balanced (r : R) (a : A) (b : B) :
    actBilin R M N (r • a) b = actBilin R M N a (r • b)
proof:
:=
  addHom_ext fun {i j} m hm n hn => by
    change act R M N (r • a) b (tmul m n) = act R M N a (r • b) (tmul m n)
    rw [act_tmul _ _ hm hn, act_tmul _ _ hm hn, twist_ground_smul, smul_assoc, smul_assoc,
      smul_tmul]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.actionAdd_tmul
statement:
theorem actionAdd_tmul (a : A) (b : B) :
    actionAdd R M N (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) = act R M N a b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_mul_tmul_act
statement:
theorem tmul_mul_tmul_act {j i' j' : ℤ} (a : A) {b : B}
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) {a' : A} (ha' : a' ∈ grading i') {b' : B} (hb' : b' ∈ grading j')
    (x : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    actionAdd R M N ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b')) x =
      act R M N a b (act R M N a' b' x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a hb ha' b', Units.smul_def, map_zsmul,
    actionAdd_tmul]
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ← hx, ← hy]
  | @tmul' p q m hm n hn =>
    change ((koszulSign (j * i') : ℤ) • act R M N (a * a') (b * b')) (tmul m n) = _
    rw [AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply, act_tmul_of_mem _ (mul_mem_grading hb hb') hm,
      act_tmul_of_mem _ hb' hm, map_units_zsmul,
      act_tmul_of_mem _ hb (smul_mem_grading ha' hm), smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_smul, mul_smul,
      ← Units.smul_def, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 1
    exact ks_eq ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.smul_def
statement:
theorem smul_def (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) (y : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    x • y = actionHom R M N x y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tmul_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_smul_tmul (a : A) {k : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading k) {i : ℤ} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading i) (n : N) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) • (tmul m n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) =
      koszulSign (k * i) • tmul (a • m) (b • n)
proof:
:=
  act_tmul_of_mem a hb hm n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.act_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_grading_of_tmul (act R M N a b) (i + j) (fun {i' j' m n} hm hn => ?_) hy
  rw [act_tmul_of_mem a hb hm n, Units.smul_def]
  refine zsmul_mem ?_ _
  have := tmul_mem_grading (R := R) (A := A) (B := B) (smul_mem_grading ha hm)
    (smul_mem_grading hb hn)
  rwa [show i + i' + (j + j') = i' + j' + (i + j) by ring] at this

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.smul_units_smul
statement:
theorem smul_units_smul (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) (u : ℤˣ) (y : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    x • (u • y) = u • (x • y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def]
  exact map_units_zsmul (actionHom R M N x : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N →+ _) u y

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.units_smul_smul
statement:
theorem units_smul_smul (u : ℤˣ) (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) (y : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    (u • x) • y = u • (x • y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.zero_smul'
statement: theorem zero_smul' (y : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) : (0 : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) • y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, map_zero]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.smul_zero'
statement: theorem smul_zero' (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) : x • (0 : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, map_zero]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.add_smul'
statement:
theorem add_smul' (x x' : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) (y : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    (x + x') • y = x • y + x' • y
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, smul_def, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.smul_add'
statement:
theorem smul_add' (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) (y y' : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    x • (y + y') = x • y + x • y'
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, smul_def, map_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.d_tmul_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem d_tmul_smul_tmul {i j k : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading j)
    {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) (n : N) :
    d ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) • (tmul m n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N)) =
      d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) • (tmul m n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) +
        koszulSign (i + j) • ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) •
          d (tmul m n : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul_smul_tmul a hb hm n, d_units_smul, d_tmul_of_mem (smul_mem_grading ha hm),
    d_smul ha m, d_smul hb n, GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul ha b, add_smul', d_tmul_of_mem hm n,
    units_smul_smul, smul_add' (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ), smul_units_smul,
    tmul_smul_tmul (d a) hb hm n,
    tmul_smul_tmul a (d_mem hb) hm n, tmul_smul_tmul a hb (d_mem hm) n,
    tmul_smul_tmul a hb hm (d n)]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, add_tmul, tmul_add, zsmul_tmul, tmul_zsmul, smul_add, smul_smul,
    ks_val]
  by_cases hi : Even i <;> by_cases hj : Even j <;> by_cases hk : Even k <;>
    simp [Int.even_add, Int.even_mul, ← Int.not_even_iff_odd, hi, hj, hk] <;> abel

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.smul_mem_grading'
statement:
theorem smul_mem_grading' {p q : ℤ} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading p)
    {y : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N} (hy : y ∈ grading q) : x • y ∈ grading (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx
    (motive := fun x => x • y ∈ grading (p + q)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [zero_smul']; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j a b hij
    have := act_mem a.2 b.2 hy
    rw [show q + (i + j) = p + q by omega] at this
    exact this
  · intro x x' hx hx'
    rw [add_smul']
    exact add_mem hx hx'

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.d_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem d_smul_tmul {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading j)
    (y : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    d ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) • y) =
      d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) • y +
        koszulSign (i + j) • ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) • d y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [d_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  | add y y' hy hy' =>
    simp only [d_add, hy, hy', smul_add]
    abel
  | tmul' m hm n hn => exact d_tmul_smul_tmul ha hb hm n

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.d_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_mem {p : ℤ} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading p)
    (y : ExternalTensorOver R A B M N) :
    d (x • y) = d x • y + koszulSign p • (x • d y)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx
    (motive := fun x => d (x • y) = d x • y + koszulSign p • (x • d y)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [zero_smul', d_zero, d_zero, zero_smul', zero_smul', smul_zero, add_zero]
  · intro i j a b hij
    subst hij
    exact d_smul_tmul a.2 b.2 y
  · intro x x' hx hx'
    rw [add_smul', d_add, hx, hx', d_add, add_smul', add_smul', smul_add]
    abel

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorMap_tmul (f : M →ₗ[A] M') (g : N →ₗ[B] N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorMap R A B f g (tmul m n) = tmul (f m) (g n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.tensorDGHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorDGHom_tmul (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M') (g : N →ᵈᵍ[B] N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorDGHom (R := R) f g (tmul m n) = tmul (f m) (g n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.act_int_eq
statement:
theorem act_int_eq (a : A) (b : B) :
    (act ℤ M N a b : ExternalTensorOver ℤ A B M N →+ ExternalTensorOver ℤ A B M N) =
      (ExternalTensor.act M N a b : M ⊗[ℤ] N →+ M ⊗[ℤ] N)
proof:
:=
  DG.tensor_addHom_ext fun m n =>
    (act_tmul (R := ℤ) a b m.2 n.2).trans (ExternalTensor.act_tmul a b m.2 n.2).symm

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.actionAdd_int_eq
statement:
theorem actionAdd_int_eq :
    (actionAdd ℤ M N : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ →+ AddMonoid.End (ExternalTensorOver ℤ A B M N)) =
      (ExternalTensor.actionAdd M N : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ →+ AddMonoid.End (M ⊗[ℤ] N))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (actBilin ℤ M N : A →+ B →+ AddMonoid.End (ExternalTensorOver ℤ A B M N)) =
      (ExternalTensor.actBilin M N : A →+ B →+ AddMonoid.End (M ⊗[ℤ] N)) :=
    AddMonoidHom.ext fun a => AddMonoidHom.ext fun b => act_int_eq a b
  unfold actionAdd ExternalTensor.actionAdd
  congr 1

name: DG.ExternalTensorOver.intEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intEquiv_tmul (m : M) (n : N) :
    intEquiv A B M N (tmul m n) = m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.koszulSign_eq_of_sub_eq_two_mul
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.koszulSign_eq_of_sub_eq_two_mul {m n : ℤ} (k : ℤ) (h : m - n = 2 * k) :
    koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).2 ⟨k, by omega⟩
