name: DG.Cochain.rightUnshift_comp
statement:
theorem rightUnshift_comp {m a : ℤ} (z' : Cochain A N (Shift a P) m) {nm : ℤ}
    (hnm : n + m = nm) (nm' : ℤ) (hnm' : nm + a = nm') (m' : ℤ) (hm' : m + a = m') :
    (z'.comp z hnm).rightUnshift nm' hnm' =
      (z'.rightUnshift m' hm').comp z (by rw [← hm', ← add_assoc, hnm, hnm'])
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.rightShift_comp
statement:
theorem rightShift_comp {m : ℤ} (z' : Cochain A N P m) {nm : ℤ} (hnm : n + m = nm)
    (a nm' : ℤ) (hnm' : nm' + a = nm) (m' : ℤ) (hm' : m' + a = m) :
    (z'.comp z hnm).rightShift a nm' hnm' =
      (z'.rightShift a m' hm').comp z (by
        rw [← add_left_inj a, add_assoc, hm', hnm, hnm'])
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.leftShift_comp
statement:
theorem leftShift_comp (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') {m t t' : ℤ} (z' : Cochain A N P m)
    (h : n + m = t) (ht' : t + a = t') :
    (z'.comp z h).leftShift a t' ht' = koszulSign (a * m) • z'.comp (z.leftShift a n' hn')
      (by rw [← ht', ← h, ← hn', add_assoc, add_comm a, add_assoc])
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [leftShift_apply, comp_apply, units_smul_apply, map_units_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [leftShiftSign, ← koszulSign_add]
  congr 1
  rw [← ht', ← h, ← hn']
  ring

name: DG.Cochain.leftShift_comp_zero_cochain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_comp_zero_cochain (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') (z' : Cochain A N P 0) :
    (z'.comp z (add_zero n)).leftShift a n' hn' =
      z'.comp (z.leftShift a n' hn') (add_zero n')
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftShift_comp z a n' hn' z' (add_zero _) hn', mul_zero, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero,
    one_smul]

name: DG.Cochain.shift_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_comp (a : ℤ) {m nm : ℤ} (z' : Cochain A N P m) (h : n + m = nm) :
    (z'.comp z h).shift a = (z'.shift a).comp (z.shift a) h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.δ_rightShift
statement:
theorem δ_rightShift (a n' m' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) (m : ℤ) (hm' : m' + a = m) :
    δ n' m' (z.rightShift a n' hn') = koszulSign a • (δ n m z).rightShift a m' hm'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · have hnm' : n' + 1 = m' := by omega
    ext x
    apply (unmk a).injective
    simp only [δ_apply _ _ hnm', δ_apply _ _ hnm, rightShift_apply, units_smul_apply, unmk_sub,
      unmk_d, unmk_units_smul, unmk_mk, smul_sub, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 2
    rw [Int.negOnePow_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨-a, by omega⟩
  · have hnm' : ¬ n' + 1 = m' := fun _ => hnm (by omega)
    rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm', δ_shape _ _ hnm, rightShift_zero, smul_zero]

name: DG.Cochain.δ_rightUnshift
statement:
theorem δ_rightUnshift {a n' : ℤ} (z : Cochain A M (Shift a N) n') (n : ℤ) (hn : n' + a = n)
    (m m' : ℤ) (hm' : m' + a = m) :
    δ n m (z.rightUnshift n hn) = koszulSign a • (δ n' m' z).rightUnshift m hm'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (rightShiftAddEquiv A M N n a n' hn).surjective z
  simp only [rightShiftAddEquiv_apply, rightUnshift_rightShift, z.δ_rightShift a n' m' hn m hm',
    rightUnshift_units_smul, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.Cochain.δ_leftShift
statement:
theorem δ_leftShift (a n' m' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') (m : ℤ) (hm' : m + a = m') :
    δ n' m' (z.leftShift a n' hn') = koszulSign a • (δ n m z).leftShift a m' hm'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · have hnm' : n' + 1 = m' := by omega
    ext x
    simp only [δ_apply _ _ hnm', δ_apply _ _ hnm, leftShift_apply, units_smul_apply, unmk_d,
      d_units_smul, map_units_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul, leftShiftSign, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 2
    all_goals rw [← hnm', ← hn']
    · exact koszulSign_eq_of_sub_eq_two_mul (-a) (by ring)
    · congr 1
      ring
  · have hnm' : ¬ n' + 1 = m' := fun _ => hnm (by omega)
    rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm', δ_shape _ _ hnm, leftShift_zero, smul_zero]

name: DG.Cochain.δ_leftUnshift
statement:
theorem δ_leftUnshift {a n' : ℤ} (z : Cochain A (Shift a M) N n') (n : ℤ) (hn : n + a = n')
    (m m' : ℤ) (hm' : m + a = m') :
    δ n m (z.leftUnshift n hn) = koszulSign a • (δ n' m' z).leftUnshift m hm'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (leftShiftAddEquiv A M N n a n' hn).surjective z
  simp only [leftShiftAddEquiv_apply, leftUnshift_leftShift, z.δ_leftShift a n' m' hn m hm',
    leftUnshift_units_smul, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.Cochain.δ_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_shift (a m : ℤ) : δ n m (z.shift a) = koszulSign a • (δ n m z).shift a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · ext x
    apply (unmk a).injective
    simp only [δ_apply _ _ hnm, shift_apply, units_smul_apply, unmk_sub, unmk_d,
      unmk_units_smul, unmk_mk, map_units_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul]
    rw [mul_comm]
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm, δ_shape _ _ hnm, shift_zero, smul_zero]

name: DG.Cochain.leftShift_rightShift
statement:
theorem leftShift_rightShift (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) :
    (z.rightShift a n' hn').leftShift a n hn' =
      koszulSign (a * n + (a * (a - 1)) / 2) • z.shift a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.rightShift_leftShift
statement:
theorem rightShift_leftShift (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') :
    (z.leftShift a n' hn').rightShift a n hn' =
      koszulSign (a * n' + (a * (a - 1)) / 2) • z.shift a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.leftShift_rightShift_eq_negOnePow_rightShift_leftShift
statement:
theorem leftShift_rightShift_eq_negOnePow_rightShift_leftShift
    (a n' n'' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) (hn'' : n + a = n'') :
    (z.rightShift a n' hn').leftShift a n hn' =
      koszulSign a • (z.leftShift a n'' hn'').rightShift a n hn''
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftShift_rightShift, rightShift_leftShift, smul_smul, ← hn'', ← koszulSign_add,
    show a + (a * (n + a) + a * (a - 1) / 2) = a * n + a * (a - 1) / 2 + (a * a + a) by ring,
    koszulSign_add _ (a * a + a)]
  have h : koszulSign (a * a + a) = 1 := by
    rw [koszulSign_add, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_mul_self, Int.units_mul_self]
  rw [h, mul_one]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.shiftLeftAddEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem shiftLeftAddEquiv_tmul (m : M) (x : N) :
    shiftLeftAddEquiv M N n (Shift.mk n m ⊗ₜ x) = Shift.mk n (m ⊗ₜ x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.shiftLeftAddEquiv_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem shiftLeftAddEquiv_smul_tmul (a : A) {j : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading j) {p : ℤ}
    {m : Shift n M} (hm : m ∈ grading p) (x : N) :
    shiftLeftAddEquiv M N n ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : AB) • (m ⊗ₜ x)) =
      (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : AB) • shiftLeftAddEquiv M N n (m ⊗ₜ x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective m
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, zero_smul', map_zero]
    exact (zero_smul AB (shiftLeftAddEquiv M N n (Shift.mk n m ⊗ₜ x))).symm
  | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.add_tmul, add_smul', map_add, ha, ha']
    exact (add_smul _ _ _).symm
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rename_i i
    have hut : ∀ (u : ℤˣ) (y : M) (z : N), (u • y) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z = u • (y ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z) := fun u y z => by
      rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    rw [tmul_smul_tmul (a : A) hb hm x, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def,
      Shift.smul_mk a.2, shiftLeftAddEquiv_tmul, shiftLeftAddEquiv_tmul,
      Shift.smul_mk (GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (R := ℤ) a.2 hb),
      tmul_smul_tmul (a : A) hb (Shift.mem_grading_iff.mp hm) x, hut, ← Shift.mk_units_smul,
      smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 2
    exact ks_eq ⟨-(n * j), by ring⟩

name: DG.ExternalTensor.shiftLeftEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem shiftLeftEquiv_tmul (m : M) (x : N) :
    shiftLeftEquiv (A := A) (B := B) M N n (Shift.mk n m ⊗ₜ x) = Shift.mk n (m ⊗ₜ x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.shiftRightAddEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem shiftRightAddEquiv_tmul {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) (x : N) :
    shiftRightAddEquiv M N n (m ⊗ₜ Shift.mk n x) = koszulSign (i * n) • Shift.mk n (m ⊗ₜ x)
proof:
:= by
  change Shift.mk n (twist M n m ⊗ₜ x) = _
  rw [twist_of_mem n hm, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.shiftRightAddEquiv_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem shiftRightAddEquiv_smul_tmul (a : A) {j : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading j) {p : ℤ}
    {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading p) (x : Shift n N) :
    shiftRightAddEquiv M N n ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : AB) • (m ⊗ₜ x)) =
      (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : AB) • shiftRightAddEquiv M N n (m ⊗ₜ x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Shift.mk_surjective x
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul, zero_smul', map_zero]
    exact (zero_smul AB (shiftRightAddEquiv M N n (m ⊗ₜ Shift.mk n x))).symm
  | h_add a a' ha ha' =>
    rw [GradedTensorProduct.add_tmul, add_smul', map_add, ha, ha']
    exact (add_smul _ _ _).symm
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rename_i i
    have hut : ∀ (u : ℤˣ) (y : M) (z : Shift n N), y ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (u • z) = u • (y ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z) :=
      fun u y z => by rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
    have hab := GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (R := ℤ) a.2 hb
    rw [tmul_smul_tmul (a : A) hb hm (Shift.mk n x), Shift.smul_mk hb, Shift.mk_units_smul, hut,
      smul_smul, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, shiftRightAddEquiv_tmul n (smul_mem_grading a.2 hm),
      shiftRightAddEquiv_tmul n hm, Units.smul_def (koszulSign (p * n)),
      smul_comm (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : AB) ((koszulSign (p * n) : ℤˣ) : ℤ), Shift.smul_mk hab,
      tmul_smul_tmul (a : A) hb hm x, Shift.mk_units_smul, Shift.mk_units_smul, smul_smul,
      Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← Units.val_mul, ← Units.val_mul]
    simp only [← koszulSign_add]
    congr 3
    ring

name: DG.ExternalTensor.shiftRightEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem shiftRightEquiv_tmul {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) (x : N) :
    shiftRightEquiv (A := A) (B := B) M N n (m ⊗ₜ Shift.mk n x) =
      koszulSign (i * n) • Shift.mk n (m ⊗ₜ x)
proof:
:=
  shiftRightAddEquiv_tmul n hm x

name: DG.DGModuleHom.coe_decompose_apply
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.coe_decompose_apply (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (m : M) (j : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := N)) (f m) j : N) = f (decompose (grading (M := M)) m j)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i i
    rw [decompose_of_mem _ (f.map_mem x.2), decompose_coe]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp
    · simp [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm hij)]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => simp [decompose_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.DGModuleHom.mem_grading_of_injective
statement:
theorem DGModuleHom.mem_grading_of_injective (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : f m ∈ grading k) : m ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  set ℳ := grading (M := M)
  have key : ∀ j, j ≠ k → decompose ℳ m j = 0 := fun j hj => by
    refine Subtype.ext (hf ?_)
    rw [← f.coe_decompose_apply, decompose_of_mem_ne _ hm (Ne.symm hj), ZeroMemClass.coe_zero,
      map_zero]
  have h : decompose ℳ m = DirectSum.of (fun i => ℳ i) k (decompose ℳ m k) := by
    refine DirectSum.ext fun j => ?_
    by_cases hjk : j = k
    · subst hjk
      rw [of_eq_same]
    · rw [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hjk, key j hjk]
  have h' := congrArg (decompose ℳ).symm h
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, decompose_symm_of] at h'
  rw [h']
  exact (decompose ℳ m k).2

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.coe_toLinearEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toLinearEquiv (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) : ⇑e.toLinearEquiv = e
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {e e' : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N} (h : ∀ m, e m = e' m) : e = e'
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext e e' h

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.map_mem
statement: theorem map_mem (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) : e m ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  e.map_mem' hm

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.map_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_d (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) (m : M) : e (d m) = d (e m)
proof:
:=
  e.map_d' m

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.coe_toDGModuleHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toDGModuleHom (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) : ⇑e.toDGModuleHom = e
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.injective
statement: theorem injective (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) : Function.Injective e
proof:
:=
  EquivLike.injective e

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.surjective
statement: theorem surjective (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) : Function.Surjective e
proof:
:=
  EquivLike.surjective e

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.refl_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem refl_apply (m : M) : (refl : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] M) m = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.apply_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem apply_symm_apply (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) (y : N) : e (e.symm y) = y
proof:
:=
  e.right_inv y

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.symm_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_apply_apply (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) (m : M) : e.symm (e m) = m
proof:
:=
  e.left_inv m

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.symm_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_symm (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) : e.symm.symm = e
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleEquiv.trans_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trans_apply (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] N) (e' : N ≃ᵈᵍ[A] P) (m : M) : e.trans e' m = e' (e m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ks_eq'
statement: private theorem ks_eq' {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ks_val'
statement: private theorem ks_val' (n : ℤ) : (koszulSign n : ℤ) = if Even n then 1 else -1
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_even n h]; rfl
  · rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_odd n (Int.not_even_iff_odd.mp h)]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ract_tmul
statement:
theorem ract_tmul (a' : A') (b' : B') {i j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) : ract M N a' b' (m ⊗ₜ n) = (op (twist A' j a') • m) ⊗ₜ (op b' • n)
proof:
:=
  tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul _ hm hn

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ract_tmul_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rw [ract_tmul a' b' m.2 hn, twist_of_mem j ha, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, op_smul,
      smul_assoc, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, hm, hm', smul_add,
      TensorProduct.add_tmul, smul_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ractAdd_tmul
statement:
theorem ractAdd_tmul (a : A') (b : B') :
    ractAdd M N (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = ract M N a b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ract_ract
statement:
theorem ract_ract {i j i' : ℤ} {a : A'} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : B'} (hb : b ∈ grading j)
    {a' : A'} (ha' : a' ∈ grading i') (b' : B') (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    ractAdd M N ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') * (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b')) x =
      ract M N a' b' (ract M N a b x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜' ℬ' a hb ha' b', Units.smul_def, map_zsmul,
    ractAdd_tmul]
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ← hx, ← hy]
  | @tmul p q m n =>
    change ((koszulSign (j * i') : ℤ) • ract M N (a * a') (b * b')) ((m : M) ⊗ₜ (n : N)) = _
    rw [AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply, ract_tmul_of_mem (mul_mem_grading ha ha') _ _ n.2,
      ract_tmul_of_mem ha _ _ n.2, map_units_zsmul,
      ract_tmul_of_mem ha' _ _ (op_smul_mem_grading hb n.2), op_mul, op_mul, ← Units.smul_def,
      mul_smul (op a') (op a) (m : M), mul_smul (op b') (op b) (n : N)]
    simp only [smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 1
    exact ks_eq' ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ractAdd_one
statement: theorem ractAdd_one : ractAdd M N (1 : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
  show ract M N 1 1 x = x
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy]
  | tmul m n =>
    rw [ract_tmul_of_mem (one_mem_grading (A := A')) _ _ n.2, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    simp only [op_one, one_smul]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ractAdd_mul
statement:
theorem ractAdd_mul (x y : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') :
    ractAdd M N (x * y) = ractAdd M N y * ractAdd M N x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, mul_add]
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    induction y using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
    | zero => simp only [mul_zero, map_zero, zero_mul]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, add_mul]
    | @tmul i' j' a' ha' b' hb' =>
      ext x
      exact ract_ract ha hb ha' b' x

name: DG.ExternalTensor.op_smul_def
statement: theorem op_smul_def (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : op x • y = ractAdd M N x y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.zero_op_smul'
statement: theorem zero_op_smul' (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : op (0 : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') • y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, map_zero]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.add_op_smul'
statement:
theorem add_op_smul' (x x' : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    op (x + x') • y = op x • y + op x' • y
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, op_smul_def, op_smul_def, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.op_smul_zero'
statement: theorem op_smul_zero' (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') : op x • (0 : M ⊗[ℤ] N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, map_zero]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.op_smul_add'
statement:
theorem op_smul_add' (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (y y' : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    op x • (y + y') = op x • y + op x • y'
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, op_smul_def, op_smul_def, map_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.op_smul_neg'
statement: theorem op_smul_neg' (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : op x • (-y) = -(op x • y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, op_smul_def, map_neg]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tmul_op_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_op_smul_tmul {k : ℤ} {a' : A'} (ha : a' ∈ grading k) (b' : B') (m : M) {j : ℤ}
    {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    op (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b' : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) =
      koszulSign (k * j) • ((op a' • m) ⊗ₜ (op b' • n))
proof:
:=
  ract_tmul_of_mem ha b' m hn

name: DG.ExternalTensor.op_smul_units_smul
statement:
theorem op_smul_units_smul (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (u : ℤˣ) (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    op x • (u • y) = u • (op x • y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, op_smul_def]
  exact map_units_zsmul (ractAdd M N x : M ⊗[ℤ] N →+ M ⊗[ℤ] N) u y

name: DG.ExternalTensor.units_op_smul
statement:
theorem units_op_smul (u : ℤˣ) (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    op (u • x) • y = u • (op x • y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_smul_def, op_smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.ract_mem
statement:
theorem ract_mem {i j : ℤ} {a : A'} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : B'} (hb : b ∈ grading j) {q : ℤ}
    {y : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hy : y ∈ grading q) : ract M N a b y ∈ grading (q + (i + j))
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_grading_of_tmul (ract M N a b) (i + j) (fun {i' j' m n} hm hn => ?_) hy
  rw [ract_tmul_of_mem ha b m hn, Units.smul_def]
  refine zsmul_mem ?_ _
  have := tmul_mem_grading (op_smul_mem_grading ha hm) (op_smul_mem_grading hb hn)
  rwa [show i' + i + (j' + j) = i' + j' + (i + j) by ring] at this

name: DG.ExternalTensor.op_smul_mem_grading'
statement:
theorem op_smul_mem_grading' {p q : ℤ} {x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ'} (hx : x ∈ grading p)
    {y : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hy : y ∈ grading q) : op x • y ∈ grading (q + p)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜' ℬ' hx
    (motive := fun x => op x • y ∈ grading (q + p)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [op_zero, zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j a b hij
    have := ract_mem a.2 b.2 hy
    rwa [hij] at this
  · intro x x' hx hx'
    rw [op_add, add_smul]
    exact add_mem hx hx'

name: DG.ExternalTensor.d_op_smul_tmul_tmul
statement:
theorem d_op_smul_tmul_tmul {i : ℤ} {a : A'} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (b : B') {k l : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading l) :
    d (op (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n)) =
      op (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') • d (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) +
        koszulSign (k + l) • (op (d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ')) • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tmul_op_smul_tmul (M := M) ha b (d m) hn
  have h2 := tmul_op_smul_tmul ha b m (d_mem hn)
  have h3 := tmul_op_smul_tmul (d_mem ha) b m hn
  have h4 := tmul_op_smul_tmul ha (d b) m hn
  rw [tmul_op_smul_tmul ha b m hn, d_units_smul, d_tmul_of_mem (op_smul_mem_grading ha hm),
    d_op_smul hm a, d_op_smul hn b, GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul ha b, d_tmul_of_mem hm n]
  simp only [add_op_smul', op_smul_add', op_smul_units_smul, units_op_smul, h1, h2, h3, h4]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add,
    TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul, smul_add, smul_smul, ks_val']
  by_cases hi : Even i <;> by_cases hk : Even k <;> by_cases hl : Even l <;>
    simp [Int.even_add, Int.even_mul, ← Int.not_even_iff_odd, hi, hk, hl] <;> abel

name: DG.ExternalTensor.d_op_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem d_op_smul_of_mem {q : ℤ} {y : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hy : y ∈ grading q) (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') :
    d (op x • y) = op x • d y + koszulSign q • (op (d x) • y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_op_smul', d_zero, d_zero, zero_op_smul', zero_op_smul', smul_zero, add_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [add_op_smul', d_add, hx, hx', d_add, add_op_smul', add_op_smul', smul_add]
    abel
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    change y ∈ tensorGrading M N q at hy
    induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem y hy' =>
      obtain ⟨k, l, rfl, m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hy'
      exact d_op_smul_tmul_tmul ha b hm hn
    | zero => rw [op_smul_zero', d_zero, op_smul_zero', op_smul_zero', smul_zero, add_zero]
    | add y y' _ _ h h' =>
      rw [op_smul_add', d_add, h, h', d_add, op_smul_add', op_smul_add', smul_add]
      abel
    | neg y _ h => rw [op_smul_neg', d_neg, h, d_neg, op_smul_neg', op_smul_neg', smul_neg, neg_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.smul_op_smul_tmul_tmul
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul_op_smul_tmul ha' b' m hn, smul_units_smul, tmul_smul_tmul a hb (op_smul_mem_grading ha' hm),
    tmul_smul_tmul a hb hm n, op_smul_units_smul,
    tmul_op_smul_tmul ha' b' (a • m) (smul_mem_grading hb hn), smul_smul, smul_smul,
    ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, smul_comm a (op a') m, smul_comm b (op b') n]
  congr 1
  exact ks_eq' ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: DG.ExternalTensor.regularEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem regularEquiv_tmul (a : A) (b : B) :
    regularEquiv A B (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.regularEquiv_op_smul
statement:
theorem regularEquiv_op_smul (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) (y : A ⊗[ℤ] B) :
    regularEquiv A B (op x • y) = op x • regularEquiv A B y
proof:
:= by
  rw [MulOpposite.smul_eq_mul_unop, unop_op]
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => rw [zero_op_smul', map_zero, mul_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_op_smul', map_add, hx, hx', mul_add]
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    induction y using DG.tensor_induction_on with
    | zero => rw [op_smul_zero', map_zero, zero_mul]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [op_smul_add', map_add, hy, hy', map_add, add_mul]
    | @tmul p q a' b' =>
      rw [tmul_op_smul_tmul ha b (a' : A) b'.2, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, regularEquiv_tmul,
        regularEquiv_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ (a' : A) b'.2 ha b,
        op_smul_eq_mul, op_smul_eq_mul, mul_comm i q, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tensorEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorEquiv_tmul (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] M') (f : N ≃ᵈᵍ[B] N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorEquiv e f (m ⊗ₜ n) = e m ⊗ₜ f n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tensorEquiv_op_smul
statement:
theorem tensorEquiv_op_smul (e : M ≃ᵈᵍ[A] M') (f : N ≃ᵈᵍ[B] N')
    (he : ∀ (a : A') (m : M), e (op a • m) = op a • e m)
    (hf : ∀ (b : B') (n : N), f (op b • n) = op b • f n) (x : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ') (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    tensorEquiv e f (op x • y) = op x • tensorEquiv e f y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => rw [zero_op_smul', map_zero, zero_op_smul']
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_op_smul', map_add, hx, hx', add_op_smul']
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    induction y using DG.tensor_induction_on with
    | zero => rw [op_smul_zero', map_zero, op_smul_zero']
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [op_smul_add', map_add, hy, hy', map_add, op_smul_add']
    | @tmul p q m n =>
      rw [tmul_op_smul_tmul ha b (m : M) n.2, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, tensorEquiv_tmul,
        tensorEquiv_tmul, he, hf, tmul_op_smul_tmul ha b (e m) (f.map_mem n.2), Units.smul_def]

name: DG.Shift.twistAddHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem twistAddHom_of_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) :
    twistAddHom A n a = koszulSign (n * i) • a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistAddHom, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom,
    decomposeAddEquiv_apply, decompose_of_mem _ ha, toAddMonoid_of]
  rfl

name: DG.Shift.twist_of_mem
statement:
theorem twist_of_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) :
    twist A n a = koszulSign (n * i) • a
proof:
:=
  twistAddHom_of_mem ha

name: DG.Shift.twist_mem
statement: theorem twist_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) : twist A n a ∈ grading i
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_of_mem ha, Units.smul_def]
  exact zsmul_mem ha _

name: DG.Shift.twist_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_zero (a : A) : twist A 0 a = a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a => rw [twist_of_mem a.2, zero_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [map_add, ha, ha']

name: DG.Shift.twist_twist
statement: theorem twist_twist (m : ℤ) (a : A) : twist A m (twist A n a) = twist A (m + n) a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rw [twist_of_mem a.2, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def, twist_of_mem a.2,
      twist_of_mem a.2, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, add_mul, add_comm]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, ha', map_add]

name: DG.Shift.twist_comp_twist
statement: theorem twist_comp_twist (m : ℤ) : (twist A m).comp (twist A n) = twist A (m + n)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext fun a => twist_twist m a

name: DG.Shift.unmk_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_mk (m : M) : unmk n (mk n m) = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_unmk
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_unmk (m : Shift n M) : mk n (unmk n m) = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_symm : (mk n (M := M)).symm = unmk n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_symm : (unmk n (M := M)).symm = mk n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_injective
statement: theorem mk_injective : Function.Injective (mk n (M := M))
proof: := (mk n).injective

name: DG.Shift.mk_surjective
statement: theorem mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk n (M := M))
proof: := (mk n).surjective

name: DG.Shift.mk_inj
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_inj {m m' : M} : mk n m = mk n m' ↔ m = m'
proof: := (mk n).injective.eq_iff

name: DG.Shift.unmk_inj
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_inj {m m' : Shift n M} : unmk n m = unmk n m' ↔ m = m'
proof:
:=
  (unmk n).injective.eq_iff

name: DG.Shift.mk_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_zero : mk n (0 : M) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_zero : unmk n (0 : Shift n M) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_add
statement: theorem mk_add (m m' : M) : mk n (m + m') = mk n m + mk n m'
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_add
statement: theorem unmk_add (m m' : Shift n M) : unmk n (m + m') = unmk n m + unmk n m'
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_neg
statement: theorem mk_neg (m : M) : mk n (-m) = -mk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_neg
statement: theorem unmk_neg (m : Shift n M) : unmk n (-m) = -unmk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_sub
statement: theorem mk_sub (m m' : M) : mk n (m - m') = mk n m - mk n m'
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_sub
statement: theorem unmk_sub (m m' : Shift n M) : unmk n (m - m') = unmk n m - unmk n m'
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_zsmul
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_zsmul (k : ℤ) (m : M) : mk n (k • m) = k • mk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_zsmul
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_zsmul (k : ℤ) (m : Shift n M) : unmk n (k • m) = k • unmk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_units_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (m : M) : mk n (u • m) = u • mk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_units_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (m : Shift n M) : unmk n (u • m) = u • unmk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {k : ℤ} {m : M} : mk n m ∈ grading k ↔ m ∈ grading (k + n)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.Shift.mem_grading_iff'
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff' {k : ℤ} {m : Shift n M} :
    m ∈ grading k ↔ unmk n m ∈ grading (k + n)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.Shift.mk_mem_grading
statement: theorem mk_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) : mk n m ∈ grading (k - n)
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff.mpr (by rwa [sub_add_cancel])

name: DG.Shift.unmk_mem_grading
statement:
theorem unmk_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {m : Shift n M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) :
    unmk n m ∈ grading (k + n)
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff'.mp hm

name: DG.Shift.d_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem d_mk (m : M) : d (mk n m) = mk n (koszulSign n • d m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_d
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_d (m : Shift n M) : unmk n (d m) = koszulSign n • d (unmk n m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.smul_def
statement: theorem smul_def (a : A) (m : Shift n M) : a • m = mk n (twist A n a • unmk n m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.smul_mk_eq
statement: theorem smul_mk_eq (a : A) (m : M) : a • mk n m = mk n (twist A n a • m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.unmk_smul_eq
statement: theorem unmk_smul_eq (a : A) (m : Shift n M) : unmk n (a • m) = twist A n a • unmk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.smul_mk
statement:
theorem smul_mk {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (m : M) :
    a • mk n m = mk n (koszulSign (n * i) • (a • m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mk_eq, twist_of_mem ha, smul_assoc]

name: DG.Shift.unmk_smul
statement:
theorem unmk_smul {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (m : Shift n M) :
    unmk n (a • m) = koszulSign (n * i) • (a • unmk n m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unmk_smul_eq, twist_of_mem ha, smul_assoc]

name: DG.Shift.mk_smul
statement:
theorem mk_smul {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (m : M) :
    mk n (a • m) = koszulSign (n * i) • (a • mk n m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mk ha, mk_units_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← two_mul,
    koszulSign_even (even_two_mul _), one_smul]

name: DG.DGModuleHom.shift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_apply (n : ℤ) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (m : M) :
    f.shift n (Shift.mk n m) = Shift.mk n (f m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.unmk_shift_apply
statement:
theorem unmk_shift_apply (n : ℤ) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (m : Shift n M) :
    unmk n (f.shift n m) = f (unmk n m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.shift_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_id (n : ℤ) : (DGModuleHom.id : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M).shift n = DGModuleHom.id
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.shift_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_comp (n : ℤ) (g : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    (g.comp f).shift n = (g.shift n).comp (f.shift n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.shift_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_zero (n : ℤ) : (0 : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N).shift n = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.shift_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_add (n : ℤ) (f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    (f + g).shift n = f.shift n + g.shift n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.shift_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_neg (n : ℤ) (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : (-f).shift n = -f.shift n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleHom.shift_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_sub (n : ℤ) (f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) :
    (f - g).shift n = f.shift n - g.shift n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.zeroEquiv_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem zeroEquiv_apply (m : Shift 0 M) : zeroEquiv (A := A) m = unmk 0 m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.zeroEquiv_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem zeroEquiv_symm_apply (m : M) : (zeroEquiv (A := A)).symm m = mk 0 m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.addEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem addEquiv_apply (m n : ℤ) (x : Shift m (Shift n M)) :
    addEquiv (A := A) m n x = mk (m + n) (unmk n (unmk m x))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Shift.addEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem addEquiv_symm_apply (m n : ℤ) (y : Shift (m + n) M) :
    (addEquiv (A := A) m n).symm y = mk m (mk n (unmk (m + n) y))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curryApply_apply
statement:
theorem curryApply_apply (j : ℤ) (n : grading (M := N) j) (m : M) :
    curryApply f j n m = f (tmul B (gradeSign M j m) n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curryApply_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem curryApply_apply_of_mem (j : ℤ) (n : grading (M := N) j) {i : ℤ} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading i) : curryApply f j n m = koszulSign (j * i) • f (tmul B m n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [curryApply_apply, gradeSign_of_mem j hm, units_smul_tmul, Cochain.map_units_smul]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curryFun_of_mem
statement:
theorem curryFun_of_mem {j : ℤ} {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    curryFun f n = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) (j + p) (curryApply f j ⟨n, hn⟩)
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hn

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curry_of_mem
statement:
theorem curry_of_mem {j : ℤ} {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) :
    curry f n = DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) (j + p) (curryApply f j ⟨n, hn⟩)
proof:
:=
  curryFun_of_mem f hn

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curry_apply_apply
statement:
theorem curry_apply_apply {j i : ℤ} {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) :
    curry f n (j + p) m = koszulSign (j * i) • f (tmul B m n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [curry_of_mem f hn, DirectSum.of_eq_same, curryApply_apply_of_mem _ _ _ hm]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.uncurryBil_of_mem
statement:
theorem uncurryBil_of_mem {j : ℤ} {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) (m : M) :
    uncurryBil g n m = g n (j + p) (gradeSign M j m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uncurryBil, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hn]
  rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.uncurryBil_of_mem_of_mem
statement:
theorem uncurryBil_of_mem_of_mem {j i : ℤ} {n : N} (hn : n ∈ grading j) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading i) : uncurryBil g n m = koszulSign (j * i) • g n (j + p) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [uncurryBil_of_mem g hn, gradeSign_of_mem j hm, Cochain.map_units_smul]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.uncurryBil_balanced
statement:
theorem uncurryBil_balanced (b : B) (m : M) (n : N) :
    uncurryBil g n (op b • m) = uncurryBil g (b • n) m
proof:
:= by
  induction b using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous l b =>
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | @h_homogeneous j n =>
      induction m using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | @h_homogeneous i m =>
        have hgn := HOM.eq_of_mem (g.map_mem n.2)
        have hgbn : g ((b : B) • (n : N)) = koszulSign (p * l) •
            ((b : B) • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M P n) (j + p) (g n (j + p)) :
              HOM A M P)) := by
          rw [g.map_smul b.2, ← hgn]
        rw [uncurryBil_of_mem_of_mem g n.2 (op_smul_mem_grading b.2 m.2),
          uncurryBil_of_mem_of_mem g (smul_mem_grading b.2 n.2) m.2, hgbn, smul_of b.2,
          ← HOM.of_units_smul, add_assoc l j p, DirectSum.of_eq_same, Cochain.units_smul_apply,
          Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, DGBimodule.rightMulCochain_apply,
          DGBimodule.signedRightMul_of_mem _ _ m.2, Cochain.map_units_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul,
          smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
        exact koszulSign_smul_congr ⟨-(i * l + l * p), by ring⟩ _
      | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add]
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hn, hn', smul_add, map_add,
        AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
  | h_add b b' hb hb' => rw [op_add, add_smul, map_add, hb, hb', add_smul, map_add,
      AddMonoidHom.add_apply]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.uncurry_tmul
statement: theorem uncurry_tmul (m : M) (n : N) : uncurry g (tmul B m n) = uncurryBil g n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.uncurry_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem uncurry_tmul_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) : uncurry g (tmul B m n) = koszulSign (j * i) • g n (j + p) m
proof:
:=
  uncurryBil_of_mem_of_mem g hn hm

name: DG.TensorProductOver.uncurry_curry
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uncurry_curry (f : Cochain A (TensorProductOver B M N) P p) : uncurry (curry f) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  induction t using TensorProductOver.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul m n =>
    rw [uncurry_tmul]
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | @h_homogeneous j n =>
      induction m using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | @h_homogeneous i m =>
        rw [uncurryBil_of_mem_of_mem _ n.2 m.2, curry_apply_apply f n.2 m.2, smul_smul,
          Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
      | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', add_tmul, map_add]
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hn, hn', tmul_add, map_add]
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add, ht, ht', map_add]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curry_uncurry
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curry_uncurry (g : Cochain B N (HOM A M P) p) : curry (uncurry g) = g
proof:
:= by
  ext n : 1
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j n =>
    rw [curry_of_mem _ n.2, HOM.eq_of_mem (g.map_mem n.2)]
    refine HOM.of_congr rfl fun m => ?_
    rw [curryApply_apply, uncurry_tmul, uncurryBil_of_mem g n.2, gradeSign_gradeSign]
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [map_add, hn, hn', map_add]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curry_add
statement:
theorem curry_add (f f' : Cochain A (TensorProductOver B M N) P p) :
    curry (f + f') = curry f + curry f'
proof:
:= by
  ext n : 1
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j n =>
    rw [Cochain.add_apply, curry_of_mem _ n.2, curry_of_mem _ n.2, curry_of_mem _ n.2,
      ← map_add]
    exact HOM.of_congr rfl fun _ => rfl
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => simp only [map_add, hn, hn']

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curryAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryAddEquiv_apply (f : Cochain A (TensorProductOver B M N) P p) :
    curryAddEquiv A B M N P p f = curry f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curryAddEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryAddEquiv_symm_apply (g : Cochain B N (HOM A M P) p) :
    (curryAddEquiv A B M N P p).symm g = uncurry g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.δ_curry
statement:
theorem δ_curry (q : ℤ) (f : Cochain A (TensorProductOver B M N) P p) :
    δ p q (curry f) = curry (δ p q f)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p + 1 = q
  swap
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hpq, δ_shape _ _ hpq]
    exact (map_zero (curryAddEquiv A B M N P q)).symm
  subst hpq
  ext n : 1
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j n =>
    rw [δ_apply _ _ rfl, curry_of_mem _ n.2, curry_of_mem _ n.2, curry_of_mem _ (d_mem n.2),
      HOM.d_of, HOM.of_congr (show j + p + 1 = j + (p + 1) by ring)
        (g := δ (j + p) (j + (p + 1)) (curryApply f j n)) (fun _ => by
          rw [δ_apply _ _ rfl, δ_apply _ _ (by ring)]),
      HOM.of_congr (show j + 1 + p = j + (p + 1) by ring)
        (g := (Cochain.id A P).comp (curryApply f (j + 1) ⟨d (n : N), d_mem n.2⟩) (by ring))
        (fun _ => rfl), ← HOM.of_units_smul, ← map_sub]
    congr 1
    ext m
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | @h_homogeneous i m =>
      rw [Cochain.sub_apply, Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.id_apply,
        δ_apply _ _ (by ring), curryApply_apply_of_mem _ _ _ m.2,
        curryApply_apply_of_mem _ _ _ (d_mem m.2), curryApply_apply_of_mem _ _ _ m.2,
        curryApply_apply_of_mem _ _ _ m.2, δ_apply _ _ rfl, d_tmul_of_mem m.2]
      simp only [map_add, Cochain.map_units_smul, smul_sub, smul_add,
        smul_smul, mul_add, add_mul, mul_one, one_mul, koszulSign_add, map_units_zsmul]
      rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (koszulSign (j * i)) with h₁ | h₁ <;>
      rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (koszulSign j) with h₂ | h₂ <;>
      rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (koszulSign p) with h₃ | h₃ <;>
      rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (koszulSign i) with h₄ | h₄ <;>
      simp [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄] <;> abel
    | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', map_add]
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [map_add, hn, hn', map_add]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curryHOM_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryHOM_of {p : ℤ} (f : Cochain A (TensorProductOver B M N) P p) :
    curryHOM A B M N P (DirectSum.of _ p f) = DirectSum.of _ p (curry f)
proof:
:= by
  simp [curryHOM]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.uncurryHOM_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uncurryHOM_of {p : ℤ} (g : Cochain B N (HOM A M P) p) :
    uncurryHOM A B M N P (DirectSum.of _ p g) = DirectSum.of _ p (uncurry g)
proof:
:= by
  simp [uncurryHOM]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curryEquiv_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryEquiv_of {p : ℤ} (f : Cochain A (TensorProductOver B M N) P p) :
    curryEquiv A B M N P (DirectSum.of _ p f) = DirectSum.of _ p (curry f)
proof:
:=
  curryHOM_of f

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curryEquiv_symm_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryEquiv_symm_of {p : ℤ} (g : Cochain B N (HOM A M P) p) :
    (curryEquiv A B M N P).symm (DirectSum.of _ p g) = DirectSum.of _ p (uncurry g)
proof:
:=
  uncurryHOM_of g

name: DG.TensorProductOver.curry_mem_cocycle
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cocycle.mem_iff 1 (zero_add 1)] at hf ⊢
  rw [δ_curry, hf]
  exact map_zero (curryAddEquiv A B M N P 1)

name: DG.TensorProductOver.uncurry_mem_cocycle
proof:
:= by
  rw [← curry_uncurry g] at hg
  rw [Cocycle.mem_iff 1 (zero_add 1)] at hg ⊢
  rw [δ_curry] at hg
  apply (curryAddEquiv A B M N P 1).injective
  rw [curryAddEquiv_apply, hg, map_zero]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.homEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem homEquiv_apply (φ : TensorProductOver B M N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (n : N) :
    homEquiv A B M N P φ n = curry (Cochain.ofHom φ) n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.homEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem homEquiv_symm_apply (ψ : N →ᵈᵍ[B] HOM A M P) (t : TensorProductOver B M N) :
    (homEquiv A B M N P).symm ψ t = uncurry (Cochain.ofHom ψ) t
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.homEquiv_apply_apply
proof:
:= by
  rw [homEquiv_apply, curry_of_mem _ hn,
    HOM.of_congr (add_zero j) (g := (Cochain.id A P).comp (curryApply (Cochain.ofHom φ) j ⟨n, hn⟩)
      (by rw [add_zero, add_zero])) (fun _ => rfl),
    DirectSum.of_eq_same, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.id_apply, curryApply_apply_of_mem _ _ _ hm,
    Cochain.ofHom_apply]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.homEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
proof:
:= by
  rw [homEquiv_symm_apply, uncurry_tmul_of_mem _ hm hn, Cochain.ofHom_apply]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.lTensor_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lTensor_tmul {N' : Type*} [AddCommGroup N'] [DGAddCommGroup N'] [Module B N']
    [DGModule B N'] (g : N' →ᵈᵍ[B] N) (m : M) (n : N') :
    lTensor A M g (tmul B m n) = tmul B m (g n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.TensorProductOver.homEquiv_comp_lTensor
statement:
theorem homEquiv_comp_lTensor {N' : Type*} [AddCommGroup N'] [DGAddCommGroup N'] [Module B N']
    [DGModule B N'] (φ : TensorProductOver B M N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (g : N' →ᵈᵍ[B] N) :
    homEquiv A B M N' P (φ.comp (lTensor A M g)) = (homEquiv A B M N P φ).comp g
proof:
:= by
  ext n : 1
  rw [DGModuleHom.comp_apply, homEquiv_apply, homEquiv_apply]
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j n =>
    rw [curry_of_mem _ n.2, curry_of_mem _ (g.map_mem n.2)]
    exact HOM.of_congr rfl fun _ => rfl
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [map_add, hn, hn', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.TensorProductOver.homEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem homEquiv_comp (φ : TensorProductOver B M N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (h : P →ᵈᵍ[A] P') :
    homEquiv A B M N P' (h.comp φ) = (postcomp B M h).comp (homEquiv A B M N P φ)
proof:
:= by
  ext n : 1
  rw [DGModuleHom.comp_apply, homEquiv_apply, homEquiv_apply]
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous j n =>
    rw [curry_of_mem _ n.2, curry_of_mem _ n.2, postcomp_of]
    exact HOM.of_congr rfl fun _ => rfl
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [map_add, hn, hn', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.twist_of_mem
statement:
theorem twist_of_mem (i : ℤ) {k : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading k) :
    twist B i b = koszulSign (k * i) • b
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hb, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.act_tmul
statement:
theorem act_tmul (a : A) (b : B) {i j : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading i) {n : N}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) : act M N a b (m ⊗ₜ n) = (a • m) ⊗ₜ (twist B i b • n)
proof:
:=
  tensorLiftHomogeneous_tmul _ hm hn

name: DG.ExternalTensor.act_tmul_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous n =>
    rw [act_tmul a b hm n.2, twist_of_mem i hb, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_assoc,
      TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, hn, hn', smul_add,
      TensorProduct.tmul_add, smul_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.actionAdd_tmul
statement:
theorem actionAdd_tmul (a : A) (b : B) :
    actionAdd M N (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = act M N a b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tmul_mul_tmul_act
statement:
theorem tmul_mul_tmul_act {j i' j' : ℤ} (a : A) {b : B}
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) {a' : A} (ha' : a' ∈ grading i') {b' : B} (hb' : b' ∈ grading j')
    (x : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    actionAdd M N ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) * (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b')) x =
      act M N a b (act M N a' b' x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a hb ha' b', Units.smul_def, map_zsmul,
    actionAdd_tmul]
  induction x using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ← hx, ← hy]
  | @tmul p q m n =>
    change ((koszulSign (j * i') : ℤ) • act M N (a * a') (b * b')) ((m : M) ⊗ₜ (n : N)) = _
    rw [AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply, act_tmul_of_mem _ (mul_mem_grading hb hb') m.2,
      act_tmul_of_mem _ hb' m.2, map_units_zsmul,
      act_tmul_of_mem _ hb (smul_mem_grading ha' m.2), smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_smul, mul_smul,
      ← Units.smul_def, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 1
    exact ks_eq ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: DG.ExternalTensor.smul_def
statement: theorem smul_def (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : x • y = actionHom M N x y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tmul_smul_tmul
proof:
:=
  act_tmul_of_mem a hb hm n

name: DG.ExternalTensor.act_mem
statement:
theorem act_mem {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading j) {q : ℤ}
    {y : M ⊗[ℤ] N} (hy : y ∈ grading q) : act M N a b y ∈ grading (q + (i + j))
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_grading_of_tmul (act M N a b) (i + j) (fun {i' j' m n} hm hn => ?_) hy
  rw [act_tmul_of_mem a hb hm n, Units.smul_def]
  refine zsmul_mem ?_ _
  have := tmul_mem_grading (smul_mem_grading ha hm) (smul_mem_grading hb hn)
  rwa [show i + i' + (j + j') = i' + j' + (i + j) by ring] at this

name: DG.ExternalTensor.smul_units_smul
statement: theorem smul_units_smul (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) (u : ℤˣ) (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : x • (u • y) = u • (x • y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def]
  exact map_units_zsmul (actionHom M N x : M ⊗[ℤ] N →+ M ⊗[ℤ] N) u y

name: DG.ExternalTensor.units_smul_smul
statement: theorem units_smul_smul (u : ℤˣ) (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : (u • x) • y = u • (x • y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, Units.smul_def]
  rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.d_tmul_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem d_tmul_smul_tmul {i j k : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading j)
    {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading k) (n : N) :
    d ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n)) =
      d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n) +
        koszulSign (i + j) • ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • d (m ⊗ₜ[ℤ] n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul_smul_tmul a hb hm n, d_units_smul, d_tmul_of_mem (smul_mem_grading ha hm),
    d_smul ha m, d_smul hb n, GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul ha b, add_smul, d_tmul_of_mem hm n,
    units_smul_smul, smul_add (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ), smul_units_smul,
    tmul_smul_tmul (d a) hb hm n,
    tmul_smul_tmul a (d_mem hb) hm n, tmul_smul_tmul a hb (d_mem hm) n,
    tmul_smul_tmul a hb hm (d n)]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add,
    TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul, smul_add, smul_smul, ks_val]
  by_cases hi : Even i <;> by_cases hj : Even j <;> by_cases hk : Even k <;>
    simp [Int.even_add, Int.even_mul, ← Int.not_even_iff_odd, hi, hj, hk] <;> abel

name: DG.ExternalTensor.zero_smul'
statement: theorem zero_smul' (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : (0 : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, map_zero]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.smul_zero'
statement: theorem smul_zero' (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) : x • (0 : M ⊗[ℤ] N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, map_zero]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.add_smul'
statement: theorem add_smul' (x x' : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : (x + x') • y = x • y + x' • y
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, smul_def, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.smul_add'
statement: theorem smul_add' (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) (y y' : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : x • (y + y') = x • y + x • y'
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, smul_def, map_add]

name: DG.ExternalTensor.smul_mem_grading'
statement:
theorem smul_mem_grading' {p q : ℤ} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading p) {y : M ⊗[ℤ] N}
    (hy : y ∈ grading q) : x • y ∈ grading (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx
    (motive := fun x => x • y ∈ grading (p + q)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [zero_smul']; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j a b hij
    have := act_mem a.2 b.2 hy
    rw [show q + (i + j) = p + q by omega] at this
    exact this
  · intro x x' hx hx'
    rw [add_smul']
    exact add_mem hx hx'

name: DG.ExternalTensor.d_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem d_smul_tmul {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ grading j)
    (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    d ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • y) =
      d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • y + koszulSign (i + j) • ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) • d y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using tensor_induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [d_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  | add y y' hy hy' =>
    simp only [d_add, hy, hy', smul_add]
    abel
  | tmul m n =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
    obtain ⟨n, -⟩ := n
    exact d_tmul_smul_tmul ha hb hm n

name: DG.ExternalTensor.d_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem d_smul_of_mem {p : ℤ} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading p) (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) :
    d (x • y) = d x • y + koszulSign p • (x • d y)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx
    (motive := fun x => d (x • y) = d x • y + koszulSign p • (x • d y)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [zero_smul', d_zero, d_zero, zero_smul', zero_smul', smul_zero, add_zero]
  · intro i j a b hij
    subst hij
    exact d_smul_tmul a.2 b.2 y
  · intro x x' hx hx'
    rw [add_smul', d_add, hx, hx', d_add, add_smul', add_smul', smul_add]
    abel

name: DG.ExternalTensor.tensorMap_smul
statement:
theorem tensorMap_smul (f : M →+ M') (g : N →+ N') (hf : ∀ (a : A) m, f (a • m) = a • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (b : B) n, g (b • n) = b • g n)
    (hfm : ∀ {k : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading k → f m ∈ grading k)
    (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) (y : M ⊗[ℤ] N) : tensorMap f g (x • y) = x • tensorMap f g y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => rw [zero_smul', zero_smul', map_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_smul', map_add, hx, hx', add_smul']
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    induction y using tensor_induction_on with
    | zero => rw [smul_zero', map_zero, smul_zero']
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [smul_add', map_add, hy, hy', map_add, smul_add']
    | tmul m n =>
      rw [tmul_smul_tmul a hb m.2 (n : N), tensorMap_tmul, tmul_smul_tmul a hb (hfm m.2) (g n),
        map_units_zsmul, tensorMap_tmul, hf, hg]

name: DG.DGSubmodule.mem_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_toSubmodule {S : DGSubmodule A M} {m : M} : m ∈ S.toSubmodule ↔ m ∈ S
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGSubmodule.mem_mk
statement:
@[simp]

name: DG.DGSubmodule.mem_grading_iff

proof:

name: DG.DGSubmodule.isInternal_grading
statement: theorem isInternal_grading : DirectSum.IsInternal S.grading
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_injective S.grading (AddSubgroupClass.subtype S)
    (fun _ _ hx => hx) Subtype.val_injective, fun x => ?_⟩
  refine ⟨∑ n ∈ (decompose (DGAddCommGroup.grading (M := M)) (x : M)).support,
    DirectSum.of (fun n => S.grading n) n
      ⟨⟨decompose (DGAddCommGroup.grading (M := M)) (x : M) n, S.decompose_mem n x.2⟩,
        (decompose (DGAddCommGroup.grading (M := M)) (x : M) n).2⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
  rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  exact DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (DGAddCommGroup.grading (M := M)) (x : M)

name: DG.DGSubmodule.coe_decompose_apply

:=

proof:

  subst hmn

name: DG.Cochain.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_apply {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂) (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (x : M) : z₂.comp z₁ h x = z₂ (z₁ x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cochain.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {n₁ n₂ n₃ n₁₂ n₂₃ n₁₂₃ : ℤ}
    (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂) (z₃ : Cochain A P Q n₃)
    (h₁₂ : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (h₂₃ : n₂ + n₃ = n₂₃) (h₁₂₃ : n₁ + n₂ + n₃ = n₁₂₃) :
    z₃.comp (z₂.comp z₁ h₁₂) (show n₁₂ + n₃ = n₁₂₃ by rw [← h₁₂, h₁₂₃]) =
      (z₃.comp z₂ h₂₃).comp z₁ (by rw [← h₂₃, ← h₁₂₃, add_assoc])
proof:
:=
  rfl

  ext fun _ => map_units_smul z₂ _ _

  fun _ _ h => DGModuleHom.ext fun x => congrArg (fun z : Cochain A M N 0 => z x) h

name: DG.δ_apply
statement:
theorem δ_apply (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain A M N n) (x : M) :
    δ n m z x = d (z x) - koszulSign n • z (d x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold δ
  rw [dite_eq_left hnm]
  rfl

name: DG.δ_apply'
statement:
theorem δ_apply' (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain A M N n) (x : M) :
    δ n m z x = d (z x) + koszulSign m • z (d x)
proof:
:= by
  subst hnm
  rw [δ_apply n _ rfl, koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ, Units.neg_smul,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.δ_shape
statement: theorem δ_shape (hnm : ¬ n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m z = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold δ
  rw [dite_eq_right hnm]

name: DG.δ_add
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_add (z₁ z₂ : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (z₁ + z₂) = δ n m z₁ + δ n m z₂
proof:
:=
  (δ_hom A M N n m).map_add z₁ z₂

name: DG.δ_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_sub (z₁ z₂ : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (z₁ - z₂) = δ n m z₁ - δ n m z₂
proof:
:=
  (δ_hom A M N n m).map_sub z₁ z₂

name: DG.δ_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_zero : δ n m (0 : Cochain A M N n) = 0
proof: := (δ_hom A M N n m).map_zero

name: DG.δ_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_neg (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (-z) = -δ n m z
proof:
:=
  (δ_hom A M N n m).map_neg z

name: DG.δ_zsmul
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_zsmul (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (k • z) = k • δ n m z
proof:
:=
  (δ_hom A M N n m).map_zsmul k z

name: DG.δ_units_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (z : Cochain A M N n) : δ n m (u • z) = u • δ n m z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, δ_zsmul]

name: DG.δ_δ
statement: theorem δ_δ (n₀ n₁ n₂ : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n₀) : δ n₁ n₂ (δ n₀ n₁ z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁₂ : n₁ + 1 = n₂; swap
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ h₁₂]
  by_cases h₀₁ : n₀ + 1 = n₁; swap
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ h₀₁, δ_zero]
  ext x
  rw [δ_apply _ _ h₁₂, δ_apply _ _ h₀₁, δ_apply _ _ h₀₁, Cochain.zero_apply, ← h₀₁]
  simp only [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ, d_sub, d_units_smul, d_d, map_zero, smul_zero,
    sub_zero, zero_sub, Units.neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, neg_add_cancel]

name: DG.δ_comp
statement:
theorem δ_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (m₁ m₂ m₁₂ : ℤ) (h₁₂ : n₁₂ + 1 = m₁₂) (h₁ : n₁ + 1 = m₁)
    (h₂ : n₂ + 1 = m₂) :
    δ n₁₂ m₁₂ (z₂.comp z₁ h) =
      (δ n₂ m₂ z₂).comp z₁ (by rw [← h₁₂, ← h₂, ← h, add_assoc]) +
        koszulSign n₂ • z₂.comp (δ n₁ m₁ z₁)
          (by rw [← h₁₂, ← h₁, ← h, add_assoc, add_comm 1, add_assoc])
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Cochain.add_apply, units_smul_apply, comp_apply, δ_apply _ _ h₁₂, δ_apply _ _ h₁,
    δ_apply _ _ h₂, map_sub, map_units_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul, ← h, koszulSign_add,
    mul_comm (koszulSign n₁)]
  abel

name: DG.δ_zero_cochain_comp
statement:
theorem δ_zero_cochain_comp {n₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N 0) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n₂)
    (m₂ : ℤ) (h₂ : n₂ + 1 = m₂) :
    δ n₂ m₂ (z₂.comp z₁ (zero_add n₂)) =
      (δ n₂ m₂ z₂).comp z₁ (zero_add m₂) +
        koszulSign n₂ • z₂.comp (δ 0 1 z₁) (by rw [add_comm, h₂])
proof:
:=
  δ_comp z₁ z₂ (zero_add n₂) 1 m₂ m₂ h₂ (zero_add 1) h₂

name: DG.δ_comp_zero_cochain
statement:
theorem δ_comp_zero_cochain {n₁ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain A N P 0)
    (m₁ : ℤ) (h₁ : n₁ + 1 = m₁) :
    δ n₁ m₁ (z₂.comp z₁ (add_zero n₁)) =
      (δ 0 1 z₂).comp z₁ h₁ + z₂.comp (δ n₁ m₁ z₁) (add_zero m₁)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [δ_comp z₁ z₂ (add_zero n₁) m₁ 1 m₁ h₁ h₁ (zero_add 1), koszulSign,
    Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.δ_zero_cochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_zero_cochain_apply (z : Cochain A M N 0) (x : M) :
    δ 0 1 z x = d (z x) - z (d x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [δ_apply 0 1 (zero_add 1), koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.δ_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_ofHom {p : ℤ} (φ : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : δ 0 p (Cochain.ofHom φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : 0 + 1 = p
  · ext x
    rw [δ_apply 0 p h, Cochain.zero_apply, ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply, DGModuleHom.map_d, koszulSign,
      Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul, sub_self]
  · exact δ_shape _ _ h _

name: DG.Cocycle.mem_iff
statement:
theorem mem_iff {n : ℤ} (m : ℤ) (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    z ∈ cocycle A M N n ↔ δ n m z = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst hnm; rfl

name: DG.Cocycle.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {n : ℤ} {z₁ z₂ : Cocycle A M N n} (h : (z₁ : Cochain A M N n) = z₂) : z₁ = z₂
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext h

name: DG.Cocycle.δ_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_eq_zero {n : ℤ} (z : Cocycle A M N n) (m : ℤ) : δ n m (z : Cochain A M N n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : n + 1 = m
  · exact (mem_iff m h _).1 z.2
  · exact δ_shape n m h _

name: DG.Cocycle.map_smul
statement:
theorem map_smul (z : Cocycle A M N 0) (a : A) (x : M) :
    (z : Cochain A M N 0) (a • x) = a • (z : Cochain A M N 0) x
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rw [(z : Cochain A M N 0).map_smul a.2, zero_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul, map_add, ha, ha', add_smul]

name: DG.Cocycle.map_d
statement:
theorem map_d (z : Cocycle A M N 0) (x : M) :
    (z : Cochain A M N 0) (d x) = d ((z : Cochain A M N 0) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain A M N 1 => c x) (z.δ_eq_zero 1)
  simp only [δ_zero_cochain_apply, Cochain.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: DG.Cocycle.homOf_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_apply (z : Cocycle A M N 0) (x : M) :
    homOf z x = (z : Cochain A M N 0) x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cocycle.homOf_ofHom_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_ofHom_eq_self (φ : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) : homOf (ofHom φ) = φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cocycle.ofHom_homOf_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_homOf_eq_self (z : Cocycle A M N 0) : ofHom (homOf z) = z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Cocycle.cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe (z : Cocycle A M N 0) :
    Cochain.ofHom (homOf z) = (z : Cochain A M N 0)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.δ_comp_zero_cocycle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_comp_zero_cocycle {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N n) (z₂ : Cocycle A N P 0) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m ((z₂ : Cochain A N P 0).comp z₁ (add_zero n)) =
      (z₂ : Cochain A N P 0).comp (δ n m z₁) (add_zero m)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · simp [δ_comp_zero_cochain _ _ _ hnm]
  · simp [δ_shape _ _ hnm]

name: DG.δ_comp_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_comp_ofHom {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain A M N n) (f : N →ᵈᵍ[A] P) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m ((Cochain.ofHom f).comp z₁ (add_zero n)) =
      (Cochain.ofHom f).comp (δ n m z₁) (add_zero m)
proof:
:=
  δ_comp_zero_cocycle z₁ (Cocycle.ofHom f) m

name: DG.δ_zero_cocycle_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_zero_cocycle_comp {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cocycle A M N 0) (z₂ : Cochain A N P n) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m (z₂.comp (z₁ : Cochain A M N 0) (zero_add n)) =
      (δ n m z₂).comp (z₁ : Cochain A M N 0) (zero_add m)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · simp [δ_zero_cochain_comp _ _ _ hnm]
  · simp [δ_shape _ _ hnm]

name: DG.δ_ofHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_ofHom_comp {n : ℤ} (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N) (z : Cochain A N P n) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m (z.comp (Cochain.ofHom f) (zero_add n)) =
      (δ n m z).comp (Cochain.ofHom f) (zero_add m)
proof:
:=
  δ_zero_cocycle_comp (Cocycle.ofHom f) z m

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.of_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [Cochain.ext hfg]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.of_units_smul
statement:
theorem of_units_smul (i : ℤ) (u : ℤˣ) (f : Cochain A M N i) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) i (u • f) : HOM A M N) =
      u • DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) i f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.dHom_of
statement:
theorem dHom_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    dHom A M N (DirectSum.of _ n z) = DirectSum.of _ (n + 1) (δ n (n + 1) z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [dHom]

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.grading_eq
statement:
theorem grading_eq (n : ℤ) :
    grading (M := HOM A M N) n = summand (fun n => Cochain A M N n) n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModule.HOM.d_of
statement:
theorem d_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain A M N n) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M N n) n z : HOM A M N) =
      DirectSum.of _ (n + 1) (δ n (n + 1) z)
proof:
:=
  dHom_of n z

name: DG.map_koszulSign_smul
statement:
theorem map_koszulSign_smul {F M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [FunLike F M N]
    [AddMonoidHomClass F M N] (f : F) (n : ℤ) (x : M) :
    f (koszulSign n • x) = koszulSign n • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_lof_lof
statement:
theorem mulAux_lof_lof (i j : ℤ) (a : 𝒜 i) (b : 𝒜 j) :
    mulAux 𝒜 (lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) i a) (lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) j b) =
      koszulSign (i * j) • (lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) j b * lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) i a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulAux, curry_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, gradedComm_of_tmul_of,
    mul_comm j i, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, LinearMap.mul'_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_of_of
statement:
theorem mulAux_of_of (i j : ℤ) (a : 𝒜 i) (b : 𝒜 j) :
    mulAux 𝒜 (of (𝒜 ·) i a) (of (𝒜 ·) j b) =
      koszulSign (i * j) • (of (𝒜 ·) j b * of (𝒜 ·) i a)
proof:
:=
  mulAux_lof_lof 𝒜 i j a b

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_smul_left
statement:
theorem mulAux_smul_left (s : ℤ) (x y : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) :
    mulAux 𝒜 (koszulSign s • x) y = koszulSign s • mulAux 𝒜 x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_smul_right
statement:
theorem mulAux_smul_right (s : ℤ) (x y : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) :
    mulAux 𝒜 x (koszulSign s • y) = koszulSign s • mulAux 𝒜 x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_one
statement: theorem mulAux_one (x : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) : mulAux 𝒜 x 1 = x
proof:
:= by
  suffices (mulAux 𝒜).flip 1 = LinearMap.id from DFunLike.congr_fun this x
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun i => LinearMap.ext fun a => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.id_coe,
    id_eq]
  rw [DirectSum.one_def, lof_eq_of, mulAux_of_of, mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul,
    ← DirectSum.one_def, one_mul]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.one_mulAux
statement: theorem one_mulAux (x : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) : mulAux 𝒜 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  suffices mulAux 𝒜 1 = LinearMap.id from DFunLike.congr_fun this x
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun i => LinearMap.ext fun a => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq]
  rw [DirectSum.one_def, lof_eq_of, mulAux_of_of, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul,
    ← DirectSum.one_def, mul_one]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulAux_assoc
statement:
theorem mulAux_assoc (x y z : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) :
    mulAux 𝒜 (mulAux 𝒜 x y) z = mulAux 𝒜 x (mulAux 𝒜 y z)
proof:
:= by
  let m := mulAux 𝒜
  suffices LinearMap.llcomp R _ _ _ m ∘ₗ m =
      (LinearMap.llcomp R _ _ _ LinearMap.lflip.toLinearMap <|
        LinearMap.llcomp R _ _ _ m.flip ∘ₗ m).flip by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun this x) y) z
  ext i a j b k c : 6
  simp only [m, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.llcomp_apply,
    LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.lflip_apply, lof_eq_of, mulAux_of_of,
    mulAux_smul_left, mulAux_smul_right, DirectSum.of_mul_of]
  simp only [← DirectSum.of_mul_of, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, mul_assoc]
  rw [show i * j + (j + i) * k = j * k + i * (k + j) by ring]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulHom_apply
statement:
theorem mulHom_apply (a b : A) :
    mulHom 𝒜 a b = (decompose 𝒜).symm (mulAux 𝒜 (decompose 𝒜 a) (decompose 𝒜 b))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.decompose_mulHom
statement:
theorem decompose_mulHom (a b : A) :
    decompose 𝒜 (mulHom 𝒜 a b) = mulAux 𝒜 (decompose 𝒜 a) (decompose 𝒜 b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulHom_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulHom_one
statement: theorem mulHom_one (a : A) : mulHom 𝒜 a 1 = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulHom_apply, decompose_one, mulAux_one, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.one_mulHom
statement: theorem one_mulHom (a : A) : mulHom 𝒜 1 a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulHom_apply, decompose_one, one_mulAux, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulHom_assoc
statement:
theorem mulHom_assoc (a b c : A) :
    mulHom 𝒜 (mulHom 𝒜 a b) c = mulHom 𝒜 a (mulHom 𝒜 b c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mulHom_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [mulAux_assoc]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mulHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem mulHom_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j) :
    mulHom 𝒜 a b = koszulSign (i * j) • (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulHom_apply, decompose_of_mem 𝒜 ha, decompose_of_mem 𝒜 hb, mulAux_of_of, Units.smul_def,
    ← decomposeLinearEquiv_symm_apply, map_zsmul, decomposeLinearEquiv_symm_apply,
    decompose_symm_mul, decompose_symm_of, decompose_symm_of, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem op_symm : (op 𝒜).symm = unop 𝒜
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.unop_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem unop_symm : (unop 𝒜).symm = op 𝒜
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.unop_op
statement: @[simp] theorem unop_op (a : A) : unop 𝒜 (op 𝒜 a) = a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_unop
statement: @[simp] theorem op_unop (x : GradedOpposite 𝒜) : op 𝒜 (unop 𝒜 x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_one
statement: @[simp] theorem op_one : op 𝒜 (1 : A) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.unop_one
statement: @[simp] theorem unop_one : unop 𝒜 (1 : GradedOpposite 𝒜) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_injective
statement: theorem op_injective : Function.Injective (op 𝒜)
proof: := (op 𝒜).injective

name: DG.GradedOpposite.unop_injective
statement: theorem unop_injective : Function.Injective (unop 𝒜)
proof: := (unop 𝒜).injective

name: DG.GradedOpposite.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] ⦃f g : GradedOpposite 𝒜 →ₗ[R] M⦄
    (h : f ∘ₗ (op 𝒜).toLinearMap = g ∘ₗ (op 𝒜).toLinearMap) : f = g

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (x y : GradedOpposite 𝒜) : x * y = op 𝒜 (mulHom 𝒜 (unop 𝒜 x) (unop 𝒜 y))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.unop_mul'
statement: theorem unop_mul' (x y : GradedOpposite 𝒜) : unop 𝒜 (x * y) = mulHom 𝒜 (unop 𝒜 x) (unop 𝒜 y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_mul'
statement: theorem op_mul' (a b : A) : op 𝒜 a * op 𝒜 b = op 𝒜 (mulHom 𝒜 a b)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.algebraMap_def
statement:
theorem algebraMap_def (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (GradedOpposite 𝒜) r = op 𝒜 (algebraMap R A r)
proof:
:= by
  change r • (1 : GradedOpposite 𝒜) = op 𝒜 (algebraMap R A r)
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, op_one]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem op_algebraMap (r : R) :
    op 𝒜 (algebraMap R A r) = algebraMap R (GradedOpposite 𝒜) r
proof: := (algebraMap_def 𝒜 r).symm

name: DG.GradedOpposite.unop_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem unop_algebraMap (r : R) :
    unop 𝒜 (algebraMap R (GradedOpposite 𝒜) r) = algebraMap R A r
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraMap_def, unop_op]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_mul_op
statement:
theorem op_mul_op {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j) :
    op 𝒜 a * op 𝒜 b = koszulSign (i * j) • op 𝒜 (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_mul', mulHom_of_mem 𝒜 ha hb, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {i : ℤ} {x : GradedOpposite 𝒜} : x ∈ grading 𝒜 i ↔ unop 𝒜 x ∈ 𝒜 i
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_map_equiv (𝒜 i)

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem op_mem_grading_iff {i : ℤ} {a : A} : op 𝒜 a ∈ grading 𝒜 i ↔ a ∈ 𝒜 i
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff 𝒜

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_mem_grading
statement: theorem op_mem_grading {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) : op 𝒜 a ∈ grading 𝒜 i
proof:
:=
  (op_mem_grading_iff 𝒜).mpr ha

name: DG.GradedOpposite.unop_mul
statement:
theorem unop_mul {i j : ℤ} {x y : GradedOpposite 𝒜} (hx : x ∈ grading 𝒜 i)
    (hy : y ∈ grading 𝒜 j) :
    unop 𝒜 (x * y) = koszulSign (i * j) • (unop 𝒜 y * unop 𝒜 x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unop_mul', mulHom_of_mem 𝒜 ((mem_grading_iff 𝒜).mp hx) ((mem_grading_iff 𝒜).mp hy)]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.coe_gradingEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_gradingEquiv {i : ℤ} (a : 𝒜 i) :
    (gradingEquiv 𝒜 i a : GradedOpposite 𝒜) = op 𝒜 a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.coe_gradingEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_gradingEquiv_symm {i : ℤ} (x : grading 𝒜 i) :
    ((gradingEquiv 𝒜 i).symm x : A) = unop 𝒜 x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.toGrading_lof
statement:
@[simp] theorem toGrading_lof (i : ℤ) (a : 𝒜 i) :
    toGrading 𝒜 (lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) i a) = lof R ℤ (grading 𝒜 ·) i (gradingEquiv 𝒜 i a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold toGrading; rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof]; rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.ofGrading_lof
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofGrading_lof (i : ℤ) (x : grading 𝒜 i) :
    ofGrading 𝒜 (lof R ℤ (grading 𝒜 ·) i x) = lof R ℤ (𝒜 ·) i ((gradingEquiv 𝒜 i).symm x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofGrading; rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof]; rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.coeLinearMap_comp_toGrading
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_comp_toGrading :
    coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜) ∘ₗ toGrading 𝒜 =
      (op 𝒜 : A →ₗ[R] GradedOpposite 𝒜) ∘ₗ coeLinearMap 𝒜
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun i => LinearMap.ext fun a => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    toGrading_lof, lof_eq_of, lof_eq_of, coeLinearMap_of, coeLinearMap_of, coe_gradingEquiv,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.coeLinearMap_comp_ofGrading
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_comp_ofGrading :
    coeLinearMap 𝒜 ∘ₗ ofGrading 𝒜 =
      (unop 𝒜 : GradedOpposite 𝒜 →ₗ[R] A) ∘ₗ coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun i => LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    ofGrading_lof, lof_eq_of, lof_eq_of, coeLinearMap_of, coeLinearMap_of, coe_gradingEquiv_symm,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.toGrading_comp_ofGrading
statement: theorem toGrading_comp_ofGrading : toGrading 𝒜 ∘ₗ ofGrading 𝒜 = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun i => LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, ofGrading_lof,
    toGrading_lof, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.coeLinearMap_toGrading
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_toGrading (y : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) :
    coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜) (toGrading 𝒜 y) = op 𝒜 (coeLinearMap 𝒜 y)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (coeLinearMap_comp_toGrading 𝒜) y

name: DG.GradedOpposite.unop_coeLinearMap
statement:
theorem unop_coeLinearMap (z : ⨁ i, grading 𝒜 i) :
    unop 𝒜 (coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜) z) = coeLinearMap 𝒜 (ofGrading 𝒜 z)
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.congr_fun (coeLinearMap_comp_ofGrading 𝒜) z).symm

name: DG.GradedOpposite.toGrading_ofGrading
statement: theorem toGrading_ofGrading (z : ⨁ i, grading 𝒜 i) : toGrading 𝒜 (ofGrading 𝒜 z) = z
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (toGrading_comp_ofGrading 𝒜) z

name: DirectSum.coeLinearMap_eq_decomposeLinearEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.coeLinearMap_eq_decomposeLinearEquiv_symm :
    coeLinearMap 𝒜 = ((decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜).symm : (⨁ i, 𝒜 i) →ₗ[R] A)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun i => by
    rw [decomposeLinearEquiv_symm_comp_lof]
    exact LinearMap.ext fun a => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, lof_eq_of, coeLinearMap_of, Submodule.subtype_apply]

name: DirectSum.coeLinearMap_decompose
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.coeLinearMap_decompose (a : A) :
    coeLinearMap 𝒜 (decompose 𝒜 a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.coeLinearMap_eq_decomposeLinearEquiv_symm, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    decomposeLinearEquiv_symm_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: DirectSum.decompose_coeLinearMap
statement:
theorem _root_.DirectSum.decompose_coeLinearMap (y : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) :
    decompose 𝒜 (coeLinearMap 𝒜 y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.coeLinearMap_eq_decomposeLinearEquiv_symm, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    decomposeLinearEquiv_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: DG.GradedOpposite.decompose_grading
statement:
theorem decompose_grading (x : GradedOpposite 𝒜) :
    decompose (grading 𝒜) x = toGrading 𝒜 (decompose 𝒜 (unop 𝒜 x))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.opOpAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem opOpAlgEquiv_apply (x : GradedOpposite (grading 𝒜)) :
    opOpAlgEquiv 𝒜 x = unop 𝒜 (unop (grading 𝒜) x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.opOpAlgEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem opOpAlgEquiv_symm_apply (a : A) :
    (opOpAlgEquiv 𝒜).symm a = op (grading 𝒜) (op 𝒜 a)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.opOpAlgEquiv_mem_iff
statement:
theorem opOpAlgEquiv_mem_iff {i : ℤ} {x : GradedOpposite (grading 𝒜)} :
    opOpAlgEquiv 𝒜 x ∈ 𝒜 i ↔ x ∈ grading (grading 𝒜) i
proof:
:=
  ((mem_grading_iff (grading 𝒜)).trans (mem_grading_iff 𝒜)).symm

name: DG.GradedOpposite.map_opOpAlgEquiv_grading
statement:
theorem map_opOpAlgEquiv_grading (i : ℤ) :
    (grading (grading 𝒜) i).map (opOpAlgEquiv 𝒜).toLinearMap = 𝒜 i
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  refine ⟨?_, fun ha => ⟨(opOpAlgEquiv 𝒜).symm a, ?_, (opOpAlgEquiv 𝒜).apply_symm_apply a⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (opOpAlgEquiv_mem_iff 𝒜).mpr hx
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← opOpAlgEquiv_mem_iff, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ha

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_mul_eq_iff
statement:
theorem op_mul_eq_iff {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j) :
    op 𝒜 (a * b) = op 𝒜 a * op 𝒜 b ↔ a * b = koszulSign (i * j) • (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [op_mul_op 𝒜 ha hb, ← map_koszulSign_smul]
  exact (op 𝒜).injective.eq_iff

name: DG.isGradedComm_iff_op_mul
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.isGradedComm_iff_op_mul :
    IsGradedComm 𝒜 ↔ ∀ a b : A, op 𝒜 (a * b) = op 𝒜 a * op 𝒜 b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact map_mul_of_homogeneous 𝒜 (op 𝒜) fun a b =>
      (op_mul_eq_iff 𝒜 a.2 b.2).mpr (h.mul_comm_of_mem a.2 b.2)
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun ha hb => (op_mul_eq_iff 𝒜 ha hb).mp (h _ _)⟩

name: DG.GradedOpposite.opAlgEquiv_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem opAlgEquiv_apply [IsGradedComm 𝒜] (a : A) : opAlgEquiv 𝒜 a = op 𝒜 a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.trivialGrading_zero
statement: theorem trivialGrading_zero : trivialGrading R A 0 = ⊤
proof: := ite_eq_left rfl

name: DG.trivialGrading_of_ne
statement: theorem trivialGrading_of_ne {n : ℤ} (h : n ≠ 0) : trivialGrading R A n = ⊥
proof: := ite_eq_right h

name: DG.mem_trivialGrading_zero
statement: theorem mem_trivialGrading_zero (a : A) : a ∈ trivialGrading R A 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [trivialGrading_zero]; exact Submodule.mem_top

name: DG.eq_zero_of_mem_trivialGrading
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_trivialGrading {n : ℤ} (h : n ≠ 0) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ trivialGrading R A n) :
    a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [trivialGrading_of_ne R A h] at ha
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp ha

name: DG.uzpow_neg_one_eq_koszulSign
statement: theorem uzpow_neg_one_eq_koszulSign (n : ℤ) : ((-1 : ℤˣ) ^ n : ℤˣ) = koszulSign n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (1 : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = 1 ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] 1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_mul_tmul {j i' : ℤ} (a : A) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ j) {a' : A} (ha' : a' ∈ 𝒜 i')
    (b' : B) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = koszulSign (j * i') • ((a * a') ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b * b'))
proof:
:=
  tmul_coe_mul_coe_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a ⟨b, hb⟩ ⟨a', ha'⟩ b'

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_koszulSign_smul
statement:
theorem tmul_koszulSign_smul (a : A) (n : ℤ) (b : B) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (koszulSign n • b) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = koszulSign n • (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R]
  change of R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ (((koszulSign n : ℤ) : R) • b)) =
    ((koszulSign n : ℤ) : R) • of R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ b)
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.koszulSign_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem koszulSign_smul_tmul (n : ℤ) (a : A) (b : B) :
    ((koszulSign n • a) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = koszulSign n • (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R]
  change of R 𝒜 ℬ ((((koszulSign n : ℤ) : R) • a) ⊗ₜ b) =
    ((koszulSign n : ℤ) : R) • of R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ b)
  rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', LinearEquiv.map_smul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_zero
statement: theorem tmul_zero (a : A) : (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (0 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change of R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ 0) = 0
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.zero_tmul
statement: theorem zero_tmul (b : B) : ((0 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change of R 𝒜 ℬ (0 ⊗ₜ b) = 0
  rw [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_add
statement:
theorem tmul_add (a : A) (b b' : B) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b + b') : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b + a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b'
proof:
:= by
  change of R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ (b + b')) = of R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ b) + of R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ b')
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.add_tmul
statement:
theorem add_tmul (a a' : A) (b : B) :
    ((a + a') ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b + a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b
proof:
:= by
  change of R 𝒜 ℬ ((a + a') ⊗ₜ b) = of R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ b) + of R 𝒜 ℬ (a' ⊗ₜ b)
  rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_one_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_mul_one_tmul (a : A) (b b' : B) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b * b')
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn ℬ
    (motive := fun b => (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b * b'))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ b
  · show (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (0 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (0 * b')
    rw [tmul_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul, tmul_zero]
  · intro j b
    exact tmul_coe_mul_one_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a b b'
  · intro b₁ b₂ h₁ h₂
    show (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ + b₂) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] ((b₁ + b₂) * b')
    rw [tmul_add, add_mul, h₁, h₂, add_mul, tmul_add]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_one_mul_tmul (a a' : A) (b' : B) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = (a * a') ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b'
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜
    (motive := fun a' => (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = (a * a') ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b')
    ?_ ?_ ?_ a'
  · show (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * ((0 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = (a * 0) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b'
    rw [zero_tmul, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_tmul]
  · intro i a'
    exact tmul_one_mul_coe_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a a' b'
