  · intro a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
    show (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * ((a₁ + a₂) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') = (a * (a₁ + a₂)) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b'
    rw [add_tmul, mul_add, h₁, h₂, mul_add, add_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmulIncl_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem tmulIncl_tmul {i j : ℤ} (a : 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ j) :
    tmulIncl 𝒜 ℬ i j (a ⊗ₜ b) = (a : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b : B)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmulIncl_mem
statement: theorem tmulIncl_mem {i j : ℤ} (z : 𝒜 i ⊗[R] ℬ j) : tmulIncl 𝒜 ℬ i j z ∈ grading 𝒜 ℬ (i + j)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩ (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ z)

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem
statement:
theorem tmul_mem {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ j) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ∈ grading 𝒜 ℬ (i + j)
proof:
:=
  tmulIncl_mem 𝒜 ℬ (⟨a, ha⟩ ⊗ₜ ⟨b, hb⟩)

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_of_eq
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_of_eq {i j n : ℤ} (h : i + j = n) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) {b : B}
    (hb : b ∈ ℬ j) : (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ∈ grading 𝒜 ℬ n
proof:
:=
  h ▸ tmul_mem 𝒜 ℬ ha hb

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction
statement:
theorem grading_induction {n : ℤ} {motive : (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) → Prop} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ}
    (hx : x ∈ grading 𝒜 ℬ n) (zero : motive 0)
    (tmul : ∀ {i j : ℤ} (a : 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ j), i + j = n → motive ((a : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b : B)))
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) : motive x
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := motive) hx ?_ zero add
  rintro ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij⟩ x ⟨z, rfl⟩
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b => exact tmul a b hij
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ hz hz'

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.auxEquiv'_tmul
statement:
theorem auxEquiv'_tmul {i j : ℤ} (a : 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ j) :
    auxEquiv' 𝒜 ℬ ((a : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b : B)) =
      lof R (ℤ × ℤ) (fun p => 𝒜 p.1 ⊗[R] ℬ p.2) (i, j) (a ⊗ₜ b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [auxEquiv', LinearEquiv.trans_apply, auxEquiv_tmul, decompose_coe, decompose_coe,
    ← lof_eq_of R, ← lof_eq_of R, directSum_lof_tmul_lof]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.auxEquiv'_comp_tmulIncl
statement:
theorem auxEquiv'_comp_tmulIncl (i j : ℤ) :
    (auxEquiv' 𝒜 ℬ : (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) →ₗ[R] _) ∘ₗ tmulIncl 𝒜 ℬ i j =
      lof R (ℤ × ℤ) (fun p => 𝒜 p.1 ⊗[R] ℬ p.2) (i, j)
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, tmulIncl_tmul, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, auxEquiv'_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.auxEquiv'_tmulIncl
statement:
theorem auxEquiv'_tmulIncl (i j : ℤ) (z : 𝒜 i ⊗[R] ℬ j) :
    auxEquiv' 𝒜 ℬ (tmulIncl 𝒜 ℬ i j z) = lof R (ℤ × ℤ) (fun p => 𝒜 p.1 ⊗[R] ℬ p.2) (i, j) z
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (auxEquiv'_comp_tmulIncl 𝒜 ℬ i j) z

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.auxEquiv'_symm_lof
statement:
theorem auxEquiv'_symm_lof (i j : ℤ) (z : 𝒜 i ⊗[R] ℬ j) :
    (auxEquiv' 𝒜 ℬ).symm (lof R (ℤ × ℤ) (fun p => 𝒜 p.1 ⊗[R] ℬ p.2) (i, j) z) =
      tmulIncl 𝒜 ℬ i j z
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, auxEquiv'_tmulIncl]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.decomposeAux_lof
statement:
theorem decomposeAux_lof (p : ℤ × ℤ) (z : 𝒜 p.1 ⊗[R] ℬ p.2) :
    decomposeAux 𝒜 ℬ (lof R (ℤ × ℤ) (fun p => 𝒜 p.1 ⊗[R] ℬ p.2) p z) =
      lof R ℤ (grading 𝒜 ℬ ·) (p.1 + p.2) ⟨tmulIncl 𝒜 ℬ p.1 p.2 z, tmulIncl_mem 𝒜 ℬ z⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold decomposeAux; rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof]; rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.coeLinearMap_comp_decomposeAux
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_comp_decomposeAux :
    coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜 ℬ) ∘ₗ decomposeAux 𝒜 ℬ = ((auxEquiv' 𝒜 ℬ).symm : _ →ₗ[R] _)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext _ fun p => ?_
  obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := p
  refine LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, decomposeAux_lof]
  simp only [lof_eq_of, coeLinearMap_of, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  exact (auxEquiv'_symm_lof 𝒜 ℬ i j z).symm

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft_mem
statement: theorem includeLeft_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) : includeLeft 𝒜 ℬ a ∈ grading 𝒜 ℬ i
proof:
:=
  tmul_mem_of_eq 𝒜 ℬ (add_zero i) ha (SetLike.one_mem_graded ℬ)

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.includeRight_mem
statement:
theorem includeRight_mem {j : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ j) :
    includeRight 𝒜 ℬ b ∈ grading 𝒜 ℬ j
proof:
:=
  tmul_mem_of_eq 𝒜 ℬ (zero_add j) (SetLike.one_mem_graded 𝒜) hb

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.comm_tmul
statement:
theorem comm_tmul {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ j) :
    comm 𝒜 ℬ (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) = koszulSign (i * j) • (b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] a : ℬ ᵍ⊗[R] 𝒜)
proof:
:= by
  have h := comm_coe_tmul_coe 𝒜 ℬ ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩
  rw [mul_comm j i] at h
  exact h

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.comm_mem
statement:
theorem comm_mem {n : ℤ} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ grading 𝒜 ℬ n) :
    comm 𝒜 ℬ x ∈ grading ℬ 𝒜 n
proof:
:= by
  refine grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx (motive := fun x => comm 𝒜 ℬ x ∈ grading ℬ 𝒜 n) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j a b hij
    rw [comm_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a.2 b.2, Units.smul_def]
    exact zsmul_mem (tmul_mem_of_eq ℬ 𝒜 (by rw [add_comm]; exact hij) b.2 a.2) _
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.comm_tmul_one
statement: theorem comm_tmul_one (a : A) : comm 𝒜 ℬ (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) = (1 : B) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] a
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜
    (motive := fun a => comm 𝒜 ℬ (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) = (1 : B) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] a) ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · show comm 𝒜 ℬ ((0 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) = (1 : B) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (0 : A)
    rw [zero_tmul, map_zero, tmul_zero]
  · intro i a
    rw [comm_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a.2 (SetLike.one_mem_graded ℬ), mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
  · intro a a' h h'
    show comm 𝒜 ℬ ((a + a') ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) = (1 : B) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (a + a')
    rw [add_tmul, map_add, h, h', tmul_add]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.comm_one_tmul
statement: theorem comm_one_tmul (b : B) : comm 𝒜 ℬ ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) = b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn ℬ
    (motive := fun b => comm 𝒜 ℬ ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) = b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)) ?_ ?_ ?_ b
  · show comm 𝒜 ℬ ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (0 : B)) = (0 : B) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)
    rw [tmul_zero, map_zero, zero_tmul]
  · intro j b
    rw [comm_tmul 𝒜 ℬ (SetLike.one_mem_graded 𝒜) b.2, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
  · intro b b' h h'
    show comm 𝒜 ℬ ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b + b')) = (b + b') ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)
    rw [tmul_add, map_add, h, h', add_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.comm_comp_comm
statement:
theorem comm_comp_comm :
    (comm ℬ 𝒜).toAlgHom.comp (comm 𝒜 ℬ).toAlgHom = AlgHom.id R (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ)
proof:
:= by
  refine algHom_ext 𝒜 ℬ (AlgHom.ext fun a => ?_) (AlgHom.ext fun b => ?_)
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, includeLeft_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
      comm_tmul_one, comm_one_tmul]
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, includeRight_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
      comm_one_tmul, comm_tmul_one]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.comm_comm
statement: theorem comm_comm (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) : comm ℬ 𝒜 (comm 𝒜 ℬ x) = x
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.congr_fun (comm_comp_comm 𝒜 ℬ) x

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.comm_symm
statement: theorem comm_symm : (comm 𝒜 ℬ).symm = comm ℬ 𝒜
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.ext fun x => by
    rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, comm_comm]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.comm_mem_iff
statement:
theorem comm_mem_iff {n : ℤ} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ} :
    comm 𝒜 ℬ x ∈ grading ℬ 𝒜 n ↔ x ∈ grading 𝒜 ℬ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa only [comm_comm] using comm_mem ℬ 𝒜 h, comm_mem 𝒜 ℬ⟩

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assocAuxLeft_tmul
statement:
theorem assocAuxLeft_tmul (a : A) (b : B) :
    assocAuxLeft 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C) : ℬ ᵍ⊗[R] 𝒞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [assocAuxLeft, lift_tmul, AlgHom.comp_apply, includeLeft_apply, includeRight_apply,
    includeLeft_apply, tmul_one_mul_one_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assocHom_tmul_tmul
statement:
theorem assocHom_tmul_tmul (a : A) (b : B) (c : C) :
    assocHom 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c) =
      a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c : ℬ ᵍ⊗[R] 𝒞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [assocHom, lift_tmul, assocAuxLeft_tmul, AlgHom.comp_apply, includeRight_apply,
    includeRight_apply, tmul_mul_one_tmul, tmul_one_mul_one_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assocInvAux_tmul
statement:
theorem assocInvAux_tmul (b : B) (c : C) :
    assocInvAux 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 (b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c) = ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c
proof:
:= by
  rw [assocInvAux, lift_tmul, AlgHom.comp_apply, includeRight_apply, includeLeft_apply,
    includeRight_apply, tmul_one_mul_one_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assocInv_tmul_tmul
statement:
theorem assocInv_tmul_tmul (a : A) (b : B) (c : C) :
    assocInv 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c : ℬ ᵍ⊗[R] 𝒞)) =
      (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c
proof:
:= by
  rw [assocInv, lift_tmul, assocInvAux_tmul, AlgHom.comp_apply, includeLeft_apply,
    includeLeft_apply, tmul_one_mul_tmul, tmul_one_mul_one_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assocHom_comp_assocInv
statement:
theorem assocHom_comp_assocInv :
    (assocHom 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞).comp (assocInv 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:= by
  refine algHom_ext 𝒜 (grading ℬ 𝒞) (AlgHom.ext fun a => ?_) ?_
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
    rw [includeLeft_apply, one_def ℬ 𝒞, assocInv_tmul_tmul, assocHom_tmul_tmul]
  · refine algHom_ext ℬ 𝒞 (AlgHom.ext fun b => ?_) (AlgHom.ext fun c => ?_)
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
      rw [includeLeft_apply, includeRight_apply, assocInv_tmul_tmul, assocHom_tmul_tmul]
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
      rw [includeRight_apply, includeRight_apply, assocInv_tmul_tmul, assocHom_tmul_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assocInv_comp_assocHom
statement:
theorem assocInv_comp_assocHom :
    (assocInv 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞).comp (assocHom 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:= by
  refine algHom_ext (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞 ?_ (AlgHom.ext fun c => ?_)
  · refine algHom_ext 𝒜 ℬ (AlgHom.ext fun a => ?_) (AlgHom.ext fun b => ?_)
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
      rw [includeLeft_apply, includeLeft_apply, assocHom_tmul_tmul, assocInv_tmul_tmul]
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
      rw [includeRight_apply, includeLeft_apply, assocHom_tmul_tmul, assocInv_tmul_tmul]
  · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
    rw [includeRight_apply, one_def 𝒜 ℬ, assocHom_tmul_tmul, assocInv_tmul_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assoc_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem assoc_tmul_tmul (a : A) (b : B) (c : C) :
    assoc 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c) = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c : ℬ ᵍ⊗[R] 𝒞)
proof:
:=
  assocHom_tmul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 a b c

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem assoc_symm_tmul_tmul (a : A) (b : B) (c : C) :
    (assoc 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞).symm (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c : ℬ ᵍ⊗[R] 𝒞)) =
      (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c
proof:
:=
  assocInv_tmul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 a b c

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assoc_mem
statement:
theorem assoc_mem {n : ℤ} {x : GradedTensorProduct R (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞}
    (hx : x ∈ grading (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞 n) : assoc 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 x ∈ grading 𝒜 (grading ℬ 𝒞) n
proof:
:= by
  refine grading_induction (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞 hx
    (motive := fun x => assoc 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 x ∈ grading 𝒜 (grading ℬ 𝒞) n) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro m k x c hmk
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
    refine grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx
      (motive := fun x => assoc 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 (x ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (c : C)) ∈ grading 𝒜 (grading ℬ 𝒞) n) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [zero_tmul, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    · intro i j a b hij
      rw [assoc_tmul_tmul]
      exact tmul_mem_of_eq 𝒜 (grading ℬ 𝒞) (by omega) a.2 (tmul_mem ℬ 𝒞 b.2 c.2)
    · intro x y hx hy
      rw [add_tmul, map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assoc_symm_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine grading_induction 𝒜 (grading ℬ 𝒞) hy
    (motive := fun y => (assoc 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞).symm y ∈ grading (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞 n) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i m a y him
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := y
    refine grading_induction ℬ 𝒞 hy
      (motive := fun y => (assoc 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞).symm ((a : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] y) ∈ grading (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞 n)
      ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [tmul_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    · intro j k b c hjk
      rw [assoc_symm_tmul_tmul]
      exact tmul_mem_of_eq (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞 (by omega) (tmul_mem 𝒜 ℬ a.2 b.2) c.2
    · intro y y' hy hy'
      rw [tmul_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
  · intro y y' hy hy'
    rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assoc_mem_iff
statement:
theorem assoc_mem_iff {n : ℤ} {x : GradedTensorProduct R (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞} :
    assoc 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 x ∈ grading 𝒜 (grading ℬ 𝒞) n ↔ x ∈ grading (grading 𝒜 ℬ) 𝒞 n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa only [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using assoc_symm_mem 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 h,
    assoc_mem 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞⟩

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.lidHom_tmul
statement: theorem lidHom_tmul (r : R) (b : B) : lidHom ℬ (r ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) = r • b
proof:
:= by
  rw [lidHom, lift_tmul, Algebra.ofId_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, Algebra.smul_def]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.lid_tmul
statement: @[simp] theorem lid_tmul (r : R) (b : B) : lid ℬ (r ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) = r • b
proof: := lidHom_tmul ℬ r b

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.lid_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem lid_symm_apply (b : B) :
    (lid ℬ).symm b = ((1 : R) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : GradedTensorProduct R (trivialGrading R R) ℬ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.lid_mem
statement:
theorem lid_mem {n : ℤ} {x : GradedTensorProduct R (trivialGrading R R) ℬ}
    (hx : x ∈ grading (trivialGrading R R) ℬ n) : lid ℬ x ∈ ℬ n
proof:
:= by
  refine grading_induction _ ℬ hx (motive := fun x => lid ℬ x ∈ ℬ n) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j r b hij
    rw [lid_tmul]
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst hi
      rw [zero_add] at hij
      subst hij
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ b.2
    · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_trivialGrading R R hi r.2, zero_smul]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.lid_symm_mem
statement:
theorem lid_symm_mem {n : ℤ} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ n) :
    (lid ℬ).symm b ∈ grading (trivialGrading R R) ℬ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [lid_symm_apply]
  exact tmul_mem_of_eq _ ℬ (zero_add n) (mem_trivialGrading_zero R R 1) hb

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.lid_mem_iff
statement:
theorem lid_mem_iff {n : ℤ} {x : GradedTensorProduct R (trivialGrading R R) ℬ} :
    lid ℬ x ∈ ℬ n ↔ x ∈ grading (trivialGrading R R) ℬ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa only [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using lid_symm_mem ℬ h, lid_mem ℬ⟩

name: DG.mem_summand
statement: theorem mem_summand {i : ι} {x : ⨁ i, β i} : x ∈ summand β i ↔ ∃ b, DirectSum.of β i b = x
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.mem_range

name: DG.of_mem_summand
statement: theorem of_mem_summand (i : ι) (b : β i) : DirectSum.of β i b ∈ summand β i
proof: := ⟨b, rfl⟩

name: DG.coe_summandEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_summandEquiv_apply (i : ι) (b : β i) :
    (summandEquiv β i b : ⨁ i, β i) = DirectSum.of β i b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.decompose_summand_of
statement:
theorem decompose_summand_of (i : ι) (b : β i) :
    decompose (summand β) (DirectSum.of β i b) = DirectSum.of _ i (summandEquiv β i b)
proof:
:=
  decompose_of_mem _ (of_mem_summand i b)

name: DG.proj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_apply (i : ι) (m : M) : proj ℳ i m = decompose ℳ m i
proof: := rfl

name: DG.proj_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_coe {i : ι} (m : ℳ i) : proj ℳ i m = m
proof:
:= by
  simp [proj_apply]

name: DG.proj_of_mem_same
statement: theorem proj_of_mem_same {i : ι} {m : M} (h : m ∈ ℳ i) : proj ℳ i m = ⟨m, h⟩
proof:
:=
  proj_coe ℳ ⟨m, h⟩

name: DG.coe_proj_of_mem_same
statement: theorem coe_proj_of_mem_same {i : ι} {m : M} (h : m ∈ ℳ i) : (proj ℳ i m : M) = m
proof:
:=
  decompose_of_mem_same ℳ h

name: DG.coe_proj_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem coe_proj_of_mem_ne {i j : ι} {m : M} (h : m ∈ ℳ i) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (proj ℳ j m : M) = 0
proof:
:=
  decompose_of_mem_ne ℳ h hij

name: DG.proj_of_mem_ne
statement: theorem proj_of_mem_ne {i j : ι} {m : M} (h : m ∈ ℳ i) (hij : i ≠ j) : proj ℳ j m = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (coe_proj_of_mem_ne ℳ h hij)

name: DG.proj_coe_of_ne
statement: theorem proj_coe_of_ne {i j : ι} (m : ℳ i) (hij : i ≠ j) : proj ℳ j m = 0
proof:
:=
  proj_of_mem_ne ℳ m.2 hij

name: DG.decompose_addHom_ext
statement: theorem decompose_addHom_ext ⦃f g : M →+ N⦄ (h : ∀ (i : ι) (m : ℳ i), f m = g m) : f = g
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun m =>
    Decomposition.inductionOn ℳ (by simp) (fun m => h _ m)
      (fun a b ha hb => by simp [ha, hb]) m

name: DG.liftHomogeneous_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftHomogeneous_coe (φ : ∀ i, ℳ i →+ N) {i : ι} (m : ℳ i) :
    liftHomogeneous ℳ φ m = φ i m
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftHomogeneous]

name: DG.liftHomogeneous_of_mem
statement:
theorem liftHomogeneous_of_mem (φ : ∀ i, ℳ i →+ N) {i : ι} {m : M} (h : m ∈ ℳ i) :
    liftHomogeneous ℳ φ m = φ i ⟨m, h⟩
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous_coe ℳ φ ⟨m, h⟩

name: DG.liftHomogeneous_apply
statement:
theorem liftHomogeneous_apply (φ : ∀ i, ℳ i →+ N) (m : M) :
    liftHomogeneous ℳ φ m = DirectSum.toAddMonoid φ (decompose ℳ m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.liftHomogeneous_comp_subtype
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftHomogeneous_comp_subtype (f : M →+ N) :
    liftHomogeneous ℳ (fun i => f.comp (AddSubmonoidClass.subtype (ℳ i))) = f
proof:
:=
  decompose_addHom_ext ℳ fun _ _ => by simp

name: DG.liftHomogeneous_comp_subtype'
statement:
theorem liftHomogeneous_comp_subtype' (φ : ∀ i, ℳ i →+ N) (i : ι) :
    (liftHomogeneous ℳ φ).comp (AddSubmonoidClass.subtype (ℳ i)) = φ i
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ => by simp

name: DG.map_mul_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem map_mul_of_homogeneous [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] {B F : Type*} [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring B]
    [FunLike F A B] [AddMonoidHomClass F A B] (f : F)
    (h : ∀ {i j : ℤ} (a : 𝒜 i) (b : 𝒜 j), f (a * b) = f a * f b) (x y : A) :
    f (x * y) = f x * f y
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜
    (motive := fun x => ∀ y, f (x * y) = f x * f y) ?_ ?_ ?_ x y
  · intro y
    rw [zero_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]
  · intro i a
    refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜
      (motive := fun y => f (a * y) = f a * f y) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · show f (a * 0) = f a * f 0
      rw [mul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
    · intro j b
      exact h a b
    · intro y y' hy hy'
      show f (a * (y + y')) = f a * f (y + y')
      rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, mul_add]
  · intro x x' hx hx' y
    rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, add_mul]

name: DG.IsGradedComm.mul_comm_of_mem'
statement:
theorem mul_comm_of_mem' {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j) :
    b * a = koszulSign (i * j) • (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm_of_mem ha hb, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.IsGradedComm.mul_comm_of_mem_of_even
statement:
theorem mul_comm_of_mem_of_even {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j)
    (h : Even (i * j)) : a * b = b * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm_of_mem ha hb, koszulSign_even h, one_smul]

name: DG.IsGradedComm.mul_comm_of_mem_of_odd
statement:
theorem mul_comm_of_mem_of_odd {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j)
    (h : Odd (i * j)) : a * b = -(b * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm_of_mem ha hb, koszulSign_odd h, Units.neg_smul, one_smul]

name: DG.IsGradedComm.mul_comm_of_mem_of_even_left
statement:
theorem mul_comm_of_mem_of_even_left {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j)
    (hi : Even i) : a * b = b * a
proof:
:=
  mul_comm_of_mem_of_even ha hb (hi.mul_right j)

name: DG.IsGradedComm.mul_comm_of_mem_of_odd_of_odd
statement:
theorem mul_comm_of_mem_of_odd_of_odd {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 j)
    (hi : Odd i) (hj : Odd j) : a * b = -(b * a)
proof:
:=
  mul_comm_of_mem_of_odd ha hb (hi.mul hj)

name: DG.IsGradedComm.mul_self_eq_neg_of_odd
statement:
theorem mul_self_eq_neg_of_odd {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hi : Odd i) :
    a * a = -(a * a)
proof:
:=
  mul_comm_of_mem_of_odd_of_odd ha ha hi hi

name: DG.IsGradedComm.two_nsmul_mul_self_of_odd
statement:
theorem two_nsmul_mul_self_of_odd {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hi : Odd i) :
    2 • (a * a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_nsmul, ← sub_neg_eq_add, ← mul_self_eq_neg_of_odd ha hi, sub_self]

name: DG.IsGradedComm.mem_center_of_even
statement:
theorem mem_center_of_even [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hi : Even i) :
    a ∈ Subalgebra.center R A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff]
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · intro j b
    exact (mul_comm_of_mem_of_even_left ha b.2 hi).symm
  · intro b c hb hc
    rw [add_mul, mul_add, hb, hc]

name: DG.IsGradedComm.commute_of_even
statement:
theorem commute_of_even [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) (hi : Even i)
    (b : A) : Commute a b
proof:
:=
  (Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (mem_center_of_even ha hi) b).symm

name: DG.IsGradedCommStrict.of_noZeroSMulDivisors
statement:
theorem of_noZeroSMulDivisors [IsGradedComm 𝒜] [NoZeroSMulDivisors ℕ A] :
    IsGradedCommStrict 𝒜 where
  mul_self_of_odd ha hi
proof:
:= by
    have h := IsGradedComm.two_nsmul_mul_self_of_odd ha hi
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
    · exact absurd h two_ne_zero
    · exact h

name: DG.Unperiodize.cast_sub_val
statement: theorem cast_sub_val (i j : ZMod 2) : ((((i + j).val : ℤ) - (j.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.cast_sub, intCast_val_zmodTwo, intCast_val_zmodTwo, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: DG.Unperiodize.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : Unperiodize ℬ 𝒩 → Prop} (y : Unperiodize ℬ 𝒩) (zero : P 0)
    (of : ∀ (j : ZMod 2) (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j), P (of ℬ 𝒩 j x))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P y
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.induction_on (β := fun j => ↥(lowGrading 𝒩 j)) y zero of add

name: DG.Unperiodize.addHom_ext
statement:
theorem addHom_ext {X : Type*} [AddCommMonoid X] {f g : Unperiodize ℬ 𝒩 →+ X}
    (h : ∀ (j : ZMod 2) (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j), f (of ℬ 𝒩 j x) = g (of ℬ 𝒩 j x)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.addHom_ext (β := fun j => ↥(lowGrading 𝒩 j)) h

name: DG.Unperiodize.of_mem_grading
statement: theorem of_mem_grading (j : ZMod 2) (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j) : of ℬ 𝒩 j x ∈ grading ℬ 𝒩 j
proof:
:=
  of_mem_summand (β := fun j => ↥(lowGrading 𝒩 j)) j x

name: DG.Unperiodize.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {j : ZMod 2} {y : Unperiodize ℬ 𝒩} :
    y ∈ grading ℬ 𝒩 j ↔ ∃ x, of ℬ 𝒩 j x = y
proof: := mem_summand

name: DG.Unperiodize.fold_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fold_of (j : ZMod 2) (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j) : fold (of ℬ 𝒩 j x) = x
proof:
:= by
  exact DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (fun j => (lowGrading 𝒩 j).subtype) j x

name: DG.Unperiodize.fold_mem
statement:
theorem fold_mem {j : ZMod 2} {y : Unperiodize ℬ 𝒩} (hy : y ∈ grading ℬ 𝒩 j) :
    fold y ∈ lowGrading 𝒩 j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mem_grading_iff.mp hy
  rw [fold_of]; exact x.2

name: DG.Unperiodize.map_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_of (f : ∀ j : ZMod 2, lowGrading 𝒩 j →+ lowGrading 𝒩' j) (j : ZMod 2)
    (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j) : map ℬ f (of ℬ 𝒩 j x) = of ℬ 𝒩' j (f j x)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of f j x

name: DG.Unperiodize.smul_mem_aux
statement:
theorem smul_mem_aux {i j : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ i) {x : N} (hx : x ∈ lowGrading 𝒩 j) :
    Periodize.mk ℬ ((i + j).val - j.val) b (by rwa [cast_sub_val]) • x ∈ lowGrading 𝒩 (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  have := SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem (Periodize.mk_mem (ℳ := ℬ) ((i + j).val - j.val : ℤ)
    (m := b) (by rwa [cast_sub_val])) (B := 𝒩) (show x ∈ 𝒩 (j.val : ℤ) from hx)
  rwa [vadd_eq_add, sub_add_cancel] at this

name: DG.Unperiodize.smul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of {i j : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ i) (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j) :
    b • of ℬ 𝒩 j x = of ℬ 𝒩 (i + j) (gsmul ℬ 𝒩 i j ⟨b, hb⟩ x)
proof:
:= by
  change (decompose ℬ b) • (DirectSum.of (fun j => ↥(lowGrading 𝒩 j)) j x) = _
  rw [decompose_of_mem ℬ hb]
  exact DirectSum.Gmodule.of_smul_of _ _ _ _

name: DG.Periodize.cast_sub_val_cast
statement: theorem cast_sub_val_cast (n : ℤ) : ((n - ((n : ZMod 2).val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.cast_sub, intCast_val_zmodTwo, sub_self]

name: DG.Periodize.cast_val_cast_sub
statement: theorem cast_val_cast_sub (n : ℤ) : ((((n : ZMod 2).val : ℤ) - n : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.cast_sub, intCast_val_zmodTwo, sub_self]

name: DG.Periodize.evenOne_mul_evenOne
statement:
theorem evenOne_mul_evenOne {k l : ℤ} (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) (hl : (l : ZMod 2) = 0) :
    evenOne ℬ k hk * evenOne ℬ l hl =
      evenOne ℬ (k + l) (by rw [Int.cast_add, hk, hl, add_zero])
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenOne, evenOne, mk_mul_mk]; exact mk_congr rfl (one_mul 1) _ _

name: DG.Periodize.evenOne_zero
statement: theorem evenOne_zero : evenOne ℬ 0 Int.cast_zero = 1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Periodize.evenOne_eq_one
statement: theorem evenOne_eq_one {k : ℤ} (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) (h : k = 0) : evenOne ℬ k hk = 1
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: DG.Periodize.evenOne_mul_mk
statement:
theorem evenOne_mul_mk {k n : ℤ} (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ n) :
    evenOne ℬ k hk * mk ℬ n b hb =
      mk ℬ (k + n) b (by rw [Int.cast_add, hk, zero_add]; exact hb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenOne, mk_mul_mk]; exact mk_congr rfl (one_mul b) _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.periodizeHom_mk
statement:
theorem periodizeHom_mk {M N : GradedModuleCat.{v} ℬ} (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℤ) (m : M)
    (hm : m ∈ M.grading n) :
    periodizeHom f (Periodize.mk M.grading n m hm) =
      Periodize.mk N.grading n (f.hom m) (f.map_mem hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.periodizeMap_hom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem periodizeMap_hom_mk {M N : GradedModuleCat.{v} ℬ} (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℤ) (m : M)
    (hm : m ∈ M.grading n) :
    (periodizeMap ℬ f).hom (Periodize.mk M.grading n m hm) =
      Periodize.mk N.grading n (f.hom m) (f.map_mem hm)
proof:
:=
  periodizeHom_mk f n m hm

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unperiodizeMap_hom_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unperiodizeMap_hom_of {N N' : GradedModuleCat.{v} (periodizeGrading ℬ)} (g : N ⟶ N')
    (j : ZMod 2) (x : lowGrading N.grading j) :
    (unperiodizeMap ℬ g).hom (Unperiodize.of ℬ N.grading j x) =
      Unperiodize.of ℬ N'.grading j (g.restrict (j.val : ℤ) x)
proof:
:=
  Unperiodize.map_of _ j x

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unitHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem unitHom_of_mem {j : ZMod 2} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ M.grading j) :
    unitHom M m = Unperiodize.of ℬ (periodizeGrading M.grading) j
      ⟨Periodize.mk M.grading (j.val : ℤ) m (by rwa [intCast_val_zmodTwo]),
        Periodize.mk_mem _ _⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unitHom, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (Periodize.single_of_mem _)
  · intro j' _ hj'
    have h0 : ((Periodize.single M.grading (j'.val : ℤ)).codRestrict
        (lowGrading (periodizeGrading M.grading) j')
        (fun m => Periodize.single_mem (ℳ := M.grading) _ m) m) = 0 :=
      Subtype.ext (Periodize.single_of_mem_ne hm (by rw [intCast_val_zmodTwo]; exact hj'.symm))
    rw [h0, map_zero]
  · simp

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unitInv_unitHom
statement: theorem unitInv_unitHom (m : M) : unitInv (unitHom M m) = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn M.grading with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous m =>
    rw [unitHom_of_mem m.2, unitInv, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, Unperiodize.fold_of]
    exact Periodize.fold_mk _ _ _ _
  | add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unitHom_unitInv
statement:
theorem unitHom_unitInv (y : Unperiodize ℬ (periodizeGrading M.grading)) :
    unitHom M (unitInv y) = y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using Unperiodize.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j x =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := Periodize.mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp
      (show x ∈ periodizeGrading M.grading (j.val : ℤ) from hx)
    rw [unitInv, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, Unperiodize.fold_of]
    change unitHom M (Periodize.fold M.grading (Periodize.mk M.grading _ m hm)) = _
    rw [Periodize.fold_mk, unitHom_of_mem (by rwa [intCast_val_zmodTwo] at hm)]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unitHom_smul
statement: theorem unitHom_smul (b : B) (m : M) : unitHom M (b • m) = b • unitHom M m
proof:
:= by
  refine map_smul_of_homogeneous ℬ M.grading (unitHom M) (fun i j b m hb hm => ?_) b m
  rw [unitHom_of_mem (SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem hb hm), unitHom_of_mem hm,
    Unperiodize.smul_of hb]
  congr 1
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  change _ = Periodize.mk ℬ _ b _ • Periodize.mk M.grading _ m _
  rw [Periodize.mk_smul_mk]
  exact Periodize.mk_congr (by rw [vadd_eq_add, sub_add_cancel]) rfl _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unitIso_hom_hom_of_mem
statement:
theorem unitIso_hom_hom_of_mem {j : ZMod 2} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ M.grading j) :
    (unitIso M).hom.hom m = Unperiodize.of ℬ (periodizeGrading M.grading) j
      ⟨Periodize.mk M.grading (j.val : ℤ) m (by rwa [intCast_val_zmodTwo]),
        Periodize.mk_mem _ _⟩
proof:
:=
  unitHom_of_mem hm

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitHom_mk
statement:
theorem counitHom_mk (n : ℤ) (y : Unperiodize ℬ N.grading)
    (hy : y ∈ Unperiodize.grading ℬ N.grading n) :
    counitHom N (Periodize.mk _ n y hy) =
      Periodize.evenOne ℬ (n - ((n : ZMod 2).val : ℤ)) (Periodize.cast_sub_val_cast n) •
        Unperiodize.fold y
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun n => ↥(periodicGrading (Unperiodize.grading ℬ N.grading) n))
    _ n ⟨y, hy⟩

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.evenOne_smul_mem
statement:
theorem evenOne_smul_mem {k n : ℤ} (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) {x : N} (hx : x ∈ N.grading n) :
    Periodize.evenOne ℬ k hk • x ∈ N.grading (k + n)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem (Periodize.mk_mem k _) hx

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.evenOne_smul_evenOne_smul
statement:
theorem evenOne_smul_evenOne_smul {k l : ℤ} (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) (hl : (l : ZMod 2) = 0)
    (h : k + l = 0) (x : N) : Periodize.evenOne ℬ k hk • Periodize.evenOne ℬ l hl • x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_smul, Periodize.evenOne_mul_evenOne, Periodize.evenOne_eq_one _ h, one_smul]

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitInv_of_mem
statement:
theorem counitInv_of_mem {n : ℤ} {x : N} (hx : x ∈ N.grading n) :
    counitInv N x = Periodize.mk _ n (Unperiodize.of ℬ N.grading (n : ZMod 2)
      ⟨Periodize.evenOne ℬ (((n : ZMod 2).val : ℤ) - n) (Periodize.cast_val_cast_sub n) • x,
        by
          have := evenOne_smul_mem (Periodize.cast_val_cast_sub n) hx
          rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
          exact this⟩) (Unperiodize.of_mem_grading _ _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [counitInv, liftHomogeneous_of_mem N.grading _ hx]; rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitHom_counitInv
statement: theorem counitHom_counitInv (x : N) : counitHom N (counitInv N x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Decomposition.inductionOn N.grading with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous x =>
    rw [counitInv_of_mem x.2, counitHom_mk, Unperiodize.fold_of]
    exact evenOne_smul_evenOne_smul _ _ (by ring) _
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hx']

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitHom_mem
statement:
theorem counitHom_mem {n : ℤ} {y : Unperiodize ℬ N.grading}
    (hy : y ∈ Unperiodize.grading ℬ N.grading n) :
    Periodize.evenOne ℬ (n - ((n : ZMod 2).val : ℤ)) (Periodize.cast_sub_val_cast n) •
      Unperiodize.fold y ∈ N.grading n
proof:
:= by
  have := evenOne_smul_mem (Periodize.cast_sub_val_cast n) (Unperiodize.fold_mem (ℬ := ℬ) hy)
  rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitInv_counitHom
statement:
theorem counitInv_counitHom (z : Periodize (Unperiodize.grading ℬ N.grading)) :
    counitInv N (counitHom N z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using Periodize.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk n y hy =>
    rw [counitHom_mk, counitInv_of_mem (counitHom_mem hy)]
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (Unperiodize.mem_grading_iff (ℬ := ℬ)).mp hy
    refine Periodize.mk_congr rfl (congrArg _ (Subtype.ext ?_)) _ _
    change Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ • Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ •
      Unperiodize.fold (Unperiodize.of ℬ N.grading _ x) = (x : N)
    rw [Unperiodize.fold_of]
    exact evenOne_smul_evenOne_smul _ _ (by ring) _
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, hz, hz']

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitHom_smul
statement:
theorem counitHom_smul (p : Periodize ℬ) (z : Periodize (Unperiodize.grading ℬ N.grading)) :
    counitHom N (p • z) = p • counitHom N z
proof:
:= by
  refine map_smul_of_homogeneous (periodizeGrading ℬ)
    (periodizeGrading (Unperiodize.grading ℬ N.grading)) (counitHom N)
    (fun i j p z hp hz => ?_) p z
  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Periodize.mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp hp
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Periodize.mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp hz
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (Unperiodize.mem_grading_iff (ℬ := ℬ)).mp hy
  rw [Periodize.mk_smul_mk, counitHom_mk, counitHom_mk]
  rw [Unperiodize.smul_of hb, Unperiodize.fold_of, Unperiodize.fold_of]
  change Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ • (Periodize.mk ℬ _ b _ • (x : N)) =
    Periodize.mk ℬ i b hb • Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ • (x : N)
  rw [← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, Periodize.evenOne, Periodize.evenOne, Periodize.mk_mul_mk,
    Periodize.mk_mul_mk]
  congr 1
  exact Periodize.mk_congr (by rw [Int.cast_add]; ring)
    ((one_mul b).trans (mul_one b).symm) _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem counitEquiv_apply (z : Periodize (Unperiodize.grading ℬ N.grading)) :
    counitEquiv N z = counitHom N z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitIso_hom_hom_mk
statement:
theorem counitIso_hom_hom_mk (n : ℤ) (y : Unperiodize ℬ N.grading)
    (hy : y ∈ Unperiodize.grading ℬ N.grading n) :
    (counitIso N).hom.hom (Periodize.mk _ n y hy) =
      Periodize.evenOne ℬ (n - ((n : ZMod 2).val : ℤ)) (Periodize.cast_sub_val_cast n) •
        Unperiodize.fold y
proof:
:=
  counitHom_mk n y hy

name: DG.intCast_val_zmodTwo
statement: theorem intCast_val_zmodTwo (j : ZMod 2) : ((j.val : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: DG.mem_periodicGrading
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_periodicGrading {ℳ : ZMod 2 → σ} {n : ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ periodicGrading ℳ n ↔ m ∈ ℳ n
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.Periodize.ofHom_apply
statement:
theorem ofHom_apply (n : ℤ) (m : ↥(periodicGrading ℳ n)) :
    ofHom ℳ n m = mk ℳ n (m : M) m.2
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Periodize.mk_mem
statement: theorem mk_mem (n : ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) : mk ℳ n m hm ∈ periodizeGrading ℳ n
proof:
:=
  of_mem_summand n _

name: DG.Periodize.mk_congr
statement:
theorem mk_congr {n n' : ℤ} (h : n = n') {m m' : M} (h' : m = m') (hm : m ∈ ℳ n)
    (hm' : m' ∈ ℳ n') : mk ℳ n m hm = mk ℳ n' m' hm'
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'; rfl

name: DG.Periodize.mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero (n : ℤ) : mk ℳ n 0 (zero_mem _) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mk]; exact (DirectSum.of _ n).map_zero

name: DG.Periodize.mk_add
statement:
theorem mk_add (n : ℤ) {m m' : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) (hm' : m' ∈ ℳ n) :
    mk ℳ n (m + m') (add_mem hm hm') = mk ℳ n m hm + mk ℳ n m' hm'
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of (fun n => ↥(periodicGrading ℳ n)) n).map_add ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨m', hm'⟩

name: DG.Periodize.mk_neg
statement:
theorem mk_neg (n : ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    mk ℳ n (-m) (neg_mem hm) = -mk ℳ n m hm
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of (fun n => ↥(periodicGrading ℳ n)) n).map_neg ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.Periodize.mem_periodizeGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_periodizeGrading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : Periodize ℳ} :
    x ∈ periodizeGrading ℳ n ↔ ∃ m, ∃ hm : m ∈ ℳ n, mk ℳ n m hm = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩; exact mk_mem n hm

name: DG.Periodize.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : Periodize ℳ → Prop} (x : Periodize ℳ) (zero : P 0)
    (mk : ∀ (n : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ n), P (mk ℳ n m hm))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact zero
  | of n m => exact mk n m.1 m.2
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy

name: DG.Periodize.addHom_ext
statement:
theorem addHom_ext {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] {f g : Periodize ℳ →+ N}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ n), f (mk ℳ n m hm) = g (mk ℳ n m hm)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.addHom_ext fun n m => h n m.1 m.2

name: DG.Periodize.fold_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fold_mk (n : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) : fold ℳ (mk ℳ n m hm) = m
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (fun n => AddSubmonoidClass.subtype (periodicGrading ℳ n)) n ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.Periodize.move_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem move_mk (k : ℤ) (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) (n : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    move ℳ k hk (mk ℳ n m hm) =
      mk ℳ (n + k) m (by rw [Int.cast_add, hk, add_zero]; exact hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun n => ↥(periodicGrading ℳ n)) _ n ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.Periodize.move_move
statement:
theorem move_move (k l : ℤ) (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) (hl : (l : ZMod 2) = 0) (x : Periodize ℳ) :
    move ℳ k hk (move ℳ l hl x) = move ℳ (l + k) (by rw [Int.cast_add, hk, hl, add_zero]) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk n m hm => simp only [move_mk]; exact mk_congr (add_assoc _ _ _) rfl _ _
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Periodize.move_zero
statement: theorem move_zero (x : Periodize ℳ) : move ℳ 0 Int.cast_zero x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk n m hm => simp only [move_mk]; exact mk_congr (add_zero _) rfl _ _
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Periodize.shiftTwo_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftTwo_mk (n : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    shiftTwo ℳ (mk ℳ n m hm) =
      mk ℳ (n + 2) m
        (by rw [Int.cast_add, show ((2 : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, add_zero]; exact hm)
proof:
:=
  move_mk ℳ 2 rfl n m hm

name: DG.Periodize.shiftTwo_mem
statement:
theorem shiftTwo_mem {n : ℤ} {x : Periodize ℳ} (hx : x ∈ periodizeGrading ℳ n) :
    shiftTwo ℳ x ∈ periodizeGrading ℳ (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp hx
  rw [shiftTwo_mk]; exact mk_mem _ _

name: DG.Periodize.single_of_mem
statement: theorem single_of_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) : single ℳ n m = mk ℳ n m hm
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (DirectSum.of (fun n => ↥(periodicGrading ℳ n)) n) (proj_of_mem_same ℳ hm)

name: DG.Periodize.single_of_mem_ne
statement:
theorem single_of_mem_ne {n : ℤ} {i : ZMod 2} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ i) (h : i ≠ n) :
    single ℳ n m = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrArg (DirectSum.of (fun n => ↥(periodicGrading ℳ n)) n)
    (proj_of_mem_ne ℳ hm h)).trans (map_zero _)

name: DG.Periodize.single_mem
statement: theorem single_mem (n : ℤ) (m : M) : single ℳ n m ∈ periodizeGrading ℳ n
proof:
:=
  of_mem_summand n _

name: DG.Periodize.fold_single
statement: theorem fold_single (n : ℤ) (m : M) : fold ℳ (single ℳ n m) = decompose ℳ m n
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ n _

name: DG.Periodize.mk_mul_mk
statement:
theorem mk_mul_mk {m n : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 m) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 n) :
    mk 𝒜 m a ha * mk 𝒜 n b hb =
      mk 𝒜 (m + n) (a * b) (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (A := periodicGrading 𝒜) ha hb)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of _ _

name: DG.Periodize.one_eq_mk
statement:
theorem one_eq_mk : (1 : Periodize 𝒜) =
    mk 𝒜 0 1 (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := periodicGrading 𝒜))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Periodize.foldRingHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldRingHom_apply (x : Periodize 𝒜) : foldRingHom 𝒜 x = fold 𝒜 x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Periodize.coe_periodUnit_zpow
statement:
theorem coe_periodUnit_zpow (k : ℤ) :
    ((periodUnit 𝒜 ^ k : (Periodize 𝒜)ˣ) : Periodize 𝒜) =
      mk 𝒜 (2 * k) 1 (by
        rw [Int.cast_mul, show ((2 : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, zero_mul]
        exact SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := 𝒜))
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [zpow_zero, Units.val_one, one_eq_mk]; exact mk_congr (by norm_num) rfl _ _
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [zpow_add_one, Units.val_mul, ih]
    change _ * mk 𝒜 2 1 _ = _
    rw [mk_mul_mk]; exact mk_congr (by ring) (one_mul 1) _ _
  | pred k ih =>
    rw [zpow_sub_one, Units.val_mul, ih]
    change _ * mk 𝒜 (-2) 1 _ = _
    rw [mk_mul_mk]; exact mk_congr (by ring) (one_mul 1) _ _

name: DG.Periodize.periodUnit_mul_mk
statement:
theorem periodUnit_mul_mk {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n) :
    (periodUnit 𝒜 : Periodize 𝒜) * mk 𝒜 n a ha = mk 𝒜 (n + 2) a
      (by rw [Int.cast_add, show ((2 : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, add_zero]; exact ha)
proof:
:= by
  change mk 𝒜 2 1 _ * _ = _
  rw [mk_mul_mk]; exact mk_congr (add_comm _ _) (one_mul a) _ _

name: DG.Periodize.mk_smul_mk
statement:
theorem mk_smul_mk {m n : ℤ} {a : A} {x : M} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 m) (hx : x ∈ ℳ n) :
    mk 𝒜 m a ha • mk ℳ n x hx =
      mk ℳ (m + n) (a • x) (SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem (A := periodicGrading 𝒜)
        (B := periodicGrading ℳ) ha hx)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.Gmodule.of_smul_of _ _ _ _

name: DG.Periodize.fold_smul
statement:
theorem fold_smul (p : Periodize 𝒜) (x : Periodize ℳ) :
    fold ℳ (p • x) = fold 𝒜 p • fold ℳ x
proof:
:= by
  induction p using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk m a ha =>
    induction x using induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | mk n y hy => rw [mk_smul_mk, fold_mk, fold_mk, fold_mk]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, smul_add]
  | add p p' hp hp' => rw [add_smul, map_add, hp, hp', map_add, add_smul]

name: DG.Periodize.periodUnit_smul
statement:
theorem periodUnit_smul (x : Periodize ℳ) :
    (periodUnit 𝒜 : Periodize 𝒜) • x = shiftTwo ℳ x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk n y hy =>
    change mk 𝒜 2 1 _ • _ = _
    rw [mk_smul_mk, shiftTwo_mk]; exact mk_congr (add_comm _ _) (one_smul A y) _ _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, hx, hy, map_add]

name: DG.sum_decompose_univ
statement:
theorem sum_decompose_univ {ι M σ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [SetLike σ M] [AddSubmonoidClass σ M] (ℳ : ι → σ) [Decomposition ℳ] (m : M) :
    ∑ i, (decompose ℳ m i : M) = m
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← (decompose ℳ).symm_apply_apply m, ← sum_univ_of (decompose ℳ m)]
  change _ = DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ _
  rw [map_sum]
  simp

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.inv_mem
statement: theorem inv_mem : ((P.unit⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) ∈ 𝒜 (-2)
proof:
:= by
  set w : A := (decompose 𝒜 ((P.unit⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) (-2) : A)
  have hw : (P.unit : A) * w = 1 := by
    have h := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem 𝒜 (j := -2) (b := ((P.unit⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A)) P.mem
    rw [Units.mul_inv, show (2 : ℤ) + -2 = 0 by norm_num, decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜
      SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem] at h
    exact h.symm
  have : ((P.unit⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) = w := by
    rw [← one_mul w, ← Units.inv_mul P.unit, mul_assoc, hw, mul_one]
  rw [this]; exact (decompose 𝒜 _ (-2)).2

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.zpow_mem
statement: theorem zpow_mem (k : ℤ) : ((P.unit ^ k : Aˣ) : A) ∈ 𝒜 (2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := 𝒜))
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [zpow_add_one, Units.val_mul, mul_add, mul_one]
    exact SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ih P.mem
  | pred k ih =>
    rw [zpow_sub_one, Units.val_mul, mul_sub, mul_one, sub_eq_add_neg]
    exact SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ih P.inv_mem

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.commute_zpow
statement: theorem commute_zpow (k : ℤ) (a : A) : Commute ((P.unit ^ k : Aˣ) : A) a
proof:
:=
  (P.commute a).units_zpow_left k

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.two_dvd_sub
statement: theorem two_dvd_sub {k n : ℤ} (h : (k : ZMod 2) = n) : 2 ∣ n - k
proof:
:=
  (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub k n 2).mp h

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.collapse_of_mem
statement:
theorem collapse_of_mem {k n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 k) (h : (k : ZMod 2) = n) :
    P.collapse n a = ((P.unit ^ ((n - k) / 2) : Aˣ) : A) * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [collapse, liftHomogeneous_of_mem 𝒜 _ ha, ite_eq_left h]; rfl

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.collapse_of_mem_of_ne
statement:
theorem collapse_of_mem_of_ne {k n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 k) (h : (k : ZMod 2) ≠ n) :
    P.collapse n a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [collapse, liftHomogeneous_of_mem 𝒜 _ ha, ite_eq_right h]; rfl

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.collapse_of_mem_same
statement: theorem collapse_of_mem_same {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n) : P.collapse n a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.collapse_of_mem ha rfl, sub_self, Int.zero_ediv, zpow_zero, Units.val_one, one_mul]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.collapse_mem
statement: theorem collapse_mem (n : ℤ) (a : A) : P.collapse n a ∈ 𝒜 n
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i k
    by_cases h : (k : ZMod 2) = n
    · rw [P.collapse_of_mem ha h]
      have := SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (P.zpow_mem ((n - k) / 2)) ha
      rwa [Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (two_dvd_sub h), sub_add_cancel] at this
    · rw [P.collapse_of_mem_of_ne ha h]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.collapse_unit_mul
statement: theorem collapse_unit_mul (n : ℤ) (a : A) : P.collapse n ((P.unit : A) * a) = P.collapse n a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i k
    have hua := SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem P.mem ha
    by_cases h : (k : ZMod 2) = n
    · have h' : ((2 + k : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = n := by
        rw [Int.cast_add, show ((2 : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, zero_add, h]
      rw [P.collapse_of_mem ha h, P.collapse_of_mem hua h', ← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul,
        show n - (2 + k) = (n - k) + (-1) * 2 by ring, Int.add_mul_ediv_right _ _ two_ne_zero,
        zpow_add, zpow_neg_one, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]
    · have h' : ((2 + k : ℤ) : ZMod 2) ≠ n := by
        rwa [Int.cast_add, show ((2 : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, zero_add]
      rw [P.collapse_of_mem_of_ne ha h, P.collapse_of_mem_of_ne hua h']
  | add a b ha hb => rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.mem_ideal
statement: theorem mem_ideal {a : A} : a ∈ P.ideal ↔ ∃ b, b * ((P.unit : A) - 1) = a
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_span_singleton'

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.collapse_eq_zero_of_mem_ideal
statement: theorem collapse_eq_zero_of_mem_ideal (n : ℤ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ P.ideal) : P.collapse n a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := P.mem_ideal.mp ha
  rw [mul_sub, mul_one, map_sub, ← (P.commute b).eq, collapse_unit_mul, sub_self]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.mkQ_surjective
statement: theorem mkQ_surjective : Function.Surjective P.mkQ
proof: := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.mkQ_eq_zero_iff_mem
statement: theorem mkQ_eq_zero_iff_mem {a : A} : P.mkQ a = 0 ↔ a ∈ P.ideal
proof: := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.mkQ_unit
statement: theorem mkQ_unit : P.mkQ (P.unit : A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_one P.mkQ, ← map_sub, mkQ_eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact Ideal.subset_span rfl

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.mkQ_zpow
statement: theorem mkQ_zpow (k : ℤ) : P.mkQ ((P.unit ^ k : Aˣ) : A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : Units.map (P.mkQ : A →* P.Quotient) P.unit = 1 := Units.ext (P.mkQ_unit)
  have := congrArg (fun v : (P.Quotient)ˣ => (v : P.Quotient))
    (congrArg (· ^ k) h)
  simpa [← map_zpow] using this

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.mkQ_collapse_of_mem
statement:
theorem mkQ_collapse_of_mem {k n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 k) (h : (k : ZMod 2) = n) :
    P.mkQ (P.collapse n a) = P.mkQ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.collapse_of_mem ha h, map_mul, mkQ_zpow, one_mul]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.collapseQ_mkQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem collapseQ_mkQ (n : ℤ) (a : A) : P.collapseQ n (P.mkQ a) = P.collapse n a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.sum_mkQ_collapse
statement: theorem sum_mkQ_collapse (a : A) : ∑ j : ZMod 2, P.mkQ (P.collapse (j.val : ℤ) a) = P.mkQ a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i k
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (k : ZMod 2)]
    · exact P.mkQ_collapse_of_mem ha (intCast_val_zmodTwo _).symm
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [P.collapse_of_mem_of_ne ha (by rwa [intCast_val_zmodTwo, ne_comm]), map_zero]
    · simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ha, hb]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.mkQ_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mkQ_eq_zero_iff {a : A} : P.mkQ a = 0 ↔ ∀ n, P.collapse n a = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n
    exact P.collapse_eq_zero_of_mem_ideal n (P.mkQ_eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h)
  · intro h
    rw [← sum_mkQ_collapse]
    simp [h]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.eq_zero_of_mem_of_mkQ_eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_mem_of_mkQ_eq_zero {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n) (h : P.mkQ a = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.collapse_of_mem_same ha]; exact P.mkQ_eq_zero_iff.mp h n

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.mkQ_mem_quotientGrading
statement:
theorem mkQ_mem_quotientGrading {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n) :
    P.mkQ a ∈ P.quotientGrading (n : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.mkQ_collapse_of_mem ha (intCast_val_zmodTwo (n : ZMod 2)).symm]
  exact ⟨_, P.collapse_mem _ a, rfl⟩

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.decomposeAux_mkQ
statement:
theorem decomposeAux_mkQ (a : A) : P.decomposeAux (P.mkQ a) =
    ∑ j : ZMod 2, DirectSum.of (fun j => P.quotientGrading j) j
      ⟨P.mkQ (P.collapse (j.val : ℤ) a), _, P.collapse_mem _ a, rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [decomposeAux]; rfl

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.coe_decomposeAux
statement:
theorem coe_decomposeAux (x : P.Quotient) :
    DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom P.quotientGrading (P.decomposeAux x) = x
proof:
:= by
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := P.mkQ_surjective x
      rw [decomposeAux_mkQ, map_sum]
      simp only [coeAddMonoidHom_of]
      exact P.sum_mkQ_collapse a

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.decomposeAux_of_mem
statement:
theorem decomposeAux_of_mem {j : ZMod 2} {x : P.Quotient} (hx : x ∈ P.quotientGrading j) :
    P.decomposeAux x = DirectSum.of (fun j => P.quotientGrading j) j ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
      change P.decomposeAux (P.mkQ a) = _
      rw [decomposeAux_mkQ, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · congr 2; exact congrArg P.mkQ (P.collapse_of_mem_same ha)
      · intro j' _ hj'
        have h0 : (⟨P.mkQ (P.collapse (j'.val : ℤ) a), _, P.collapse_mem _ a, rfl⟩ :
            P.quotientGrading j') = 0 :=
          Subtype.ext (by
            show P.mkQ _ = 0
            rw [P.collapse_of_mem_of_ne (n := (j'.val : ℤ)) ha
              (by rw [intCast_val_zmodTwo, intCast_val_zmodTwo]; exact hj'.symm), map_zero])
        exact (congrArg (DirectSum.of (fun j => P.quotientGrading j) j') h0).trans (map_zero _)
      · simp

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.toPeriodizeHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem toPeriodizeHom_of_mem {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n) :
    P.toPeriodizeHom a = Periodize.mk _ n (P.mkQ a) (P.mkQ_mem_quotientGrading ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toPeriodizeHom, liftHomogeneous_of_mem 𝒜 _ ha]; rfl

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.ofPeriodizeHom_mk
statement:
theorem ofPeriodizeHom_mk (n : ℤ) (x : P.Quotient) (hx : x ∈ P.quotientGrading n) :
    P.ofPeriodizeHom (Periodize.mk _ n x hx) = P.collapseQ n x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun n => ↥(periodicGrading P.quotientGrading n)) _ n ⟨x, hx⟩

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.ofPeriodizeHom_toPeriodizeHom
statement: theorem ofPeriodizeHom_toPeriodizeHom (a : A) : P.ofPeriodizeHom (P.toPeriodizeHom a) = a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous a =>
    rw [P.toPeriodizeHom_of_mem a.2, ofPeriodizeHom_mk, collapseQ_mkQ,
      P.collapse_of_mem_same a.2]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.toPeriodizeHom_ofPeriodizeHom
statement:
theorem toPeriodizeHom_ofPeriodizeHom (x : Periodize P.quotientGrading) :
    P.toPeriodizeHom (P.ofPeriodizeHom x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Periodize.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk n x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
    change P.toPeriodizeHom (P.ofPeriodizeHom (Periodize.mk _ n (P.mkQ a) _)) =
      Periodize.mk _ n (P.mkQ a) _
    rw [ofPeriodizeHom_mk, collapseQ_mkQ, P.toPeriodizeHom_of_mem (P.collapse_mem n a)]
    exact Periodize.mk_congr rfl
      (P.mkQ_collapse_of_mem ha (by rw [intCast_val_zmodTwo])) _ _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.toPeriodizeHom_mul
statement:
theorem toPeriodizeHom_mul (a b : A) :
    P.toPeriodizeHom (a * b) = P.toPeriodizeHom a * P.toPeriodizeHom b
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous a =>
    induction b using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
    | zero => simp
    | homogeneous b =>
      rw [P.toPeriodizeHom_of_mem (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem a.2 b.2),
        P.toPeriodizeHom_of_mem a.2, P.toPeriodizeHom_of_mem b.2, Periodize.mk_mul_mk]
      exact Periodize.mk_congr rfl (map_mul _ _ _) _ _
    | add b b' hb hb' => rw [mul_add, map_add, hb, hb', map_add, mul_add]
  | add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_mul, map_add, ha, ha', map_add, add_mul]

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.periodizeEquiv_of_mem
statement:
theorem periodizeEquiv_of_mem {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n) :
    P.periodizeEquiv a = Periodize.mk _ n (P.mkQ a) (P.mkQ_mem_quotientGrading ha)
proof:
:=
  P.toPeriodizeHom_of_mem ha

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.periodizeEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem periodizeEquiv_symm_apply (x : Periodize P.quotientGrading) :
    P.periodizeEquiv.symm x = P.ofPeriodizeHom x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.periodizeEquiv_symm_mem
statement:
theorem periodizeEquiv_symm_mem (n : ℤ) {x : Periodize P.quotientGrading}
    (hx : x ∈ periodizeGrading P.quotientGrading n) : P.periodizeEquiv.symm x ∈ 𝒜 n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Periodize.mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp hx
  rw [periodizeEquiv_symm_apply, ofPeriodizeHom_mk]
  obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := P.mkQ_surjective x
  exact P.collapse_mem n a

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.periodizeEquiv_mem_iff
statement:
theorem periodizeEquiv_mem_iff {n : ℤ} {a : A} :
    P.periodizeEquiv a ∈ periodizeGrading P.quotientGrading n ↔ a ∈ 𝒜 n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have := P.periodizeEquiv_symm_mem n h
    rwa [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
  · rw [P.periodizeEquiv_of_mem h]; exact Periodize.mk_mem _ _

name: DG.PeriodicityUnit.periodizeEquiv_periodUnit
statement:
theorem periodizeEquiv_periodUnit :
    P.periodizeEquiv (P.unit : A) = (Periodize.periodUnit P.quotientGrading : _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.periodizeEquiv_of_mem P.mem]
  exact Periodize.mk_congr rfl P.mkQ_unit _ _

name: DG.Periodize.mk_eq_periodUnit_zpow_mul
statement:
theorem mk_eq_periodUnit_zpow_mul {m n : ℤ} (h : (m : ZMod 2) = n) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ n) :
    mk ℬ n b hb = ((periodUnit ℬ ^ ((n - m) / 2) : (Periodize ℬ)ˣ) : Periodize ℬ) *
      mk ℬ m b (h ▸ hb)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_periodUnit_zpow, mk_mul_mk]
  exact mk_congr (by rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel' (PeriodicityUnit.two_dvd_sub h), sub_add_cancel])
    (one_mul b).symm _ _

name: DG.Periodize.periodicityUnit_unit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem periodicityUnit_unit : (periodicityUnit ℬ).unit = periodUnit ℬ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Periodize.mkQ_mk_eq
statement:
theorem mkQ_mk_eq {m n : ℤ} (h : (m : ZMod 2) = n) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ n) :
    (periodicityUnit ℬ).mkQ (mk ℬ n b hb) = (periodicityUnit ℬ).mkQ (mk ℬ m b (h ▸ hb))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_periodUnit_zpow_mul h, map_mul, ← periodicityUnit_unit,
    PeriodicityUnit.mkQ_zpow, one_mul]

name: DG.Periodize.foldQ_mkQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldQ_mkQ (x : Periodize ℬ) : foldQ ℬ ((periodicityUnit ℬ).mkQ x) = fold ℬ x
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk _ _ _

name: DG.Periodize.unfoldQ_of_mem
statement:
theorem unfoldQ_of_mem {j : ZMod 2} {b : B} (hb : b ∈ ℬ j) :
    unfoldQ ℬ b = (periodicityUnit ℬ).mkQ (mk ℬ (j.val : ℤ) b (by rwa [intCast_val_zmodTwo]))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unfoldQ, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [single_of_mem]; rfl
  · intro j' _ hj'
    exact single_of_mem_ne hb (by rw [intCast_val_zmodTwo]; exact hj'.symm)
  · simp

name: DG.Periodize.foldQ_unfoldQ
statement: theorem foldQ_unfoldQ (b : B) : foldQ ℬ (unfoldQ ℬ b) = b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unfoldQ, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply]
  change foldQ ℬ ((periodicityUnit ℬ).mkQ _) = b
  rw [foldQ_mkQ, map_sum]
  simp only [fold_single]
  exact sum_decompose_univ ℬ b

name: DG.Periodize.unfoldQ_foldQ
statement: theorem unfoldQ_foldQ (y : (periodicityUnit ℬ).Quotient) : unfoldQ ℬ (foldQ ℬ y) = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (periodicityUnit ℬ).mkQ_surjective y
  rw [foldQ_mkQ]
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk n b hb =>
    rw [fold_mk, unfoldQ_of_mem hb, mkQ_mk_eq ℬ (intCast_val_zmodTwo _) hb]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]

name: DG.Periodize.quotientEquiv_mkQ
statement:
theorem quotientEquiv_mkQ (x : Periodize ℬ) :
    quotientEquiv ℬ ((periodicityUnit ℬ).mkQ x) = fold ℬ x
proof:
:=
  foldQ_mkQ ℬ x

name: DG.Periodize.quotientEquiv_symm_apply
statement: theorem quotientEquiv_symm_apply (b : B) : (quotientEquiv ℬ).symm b = unfoldQ ℬ b
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Periodize.quotientEquiv_mem_iff
statement:
theorem quotientEquiv_mem_iff {j : ZMod 2} {y : (periodicityUnit ℬ).Quotient} :
    quotientEquiv ℬ y ∈ ℬ j ↔ y ∈ (periodicityUnit ℬ).quotientGrading j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← (quotientEquiv ℬ).symm_apply_apply y, quotientEquiv_symm_apply, unfoldQ_of_mem h]
    exact ⟨_, mk_mem _ _, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp hx
    change quotientEquiv ℬ ((periodicityUnit ℬ).mkQ _) ∈ _
    rw [quotientEquiv_mkQ, fold_mk]
    rwa [intCast_val_zmodTwo] at hb

name: DG.mem_divGrading
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_divGrading {ℳ : ℤ → σ} {k r q : ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ divGrading ℳ k r q ↔ m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_mem
statement:
theorem mk_mem (q : ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) :
    mk ℳ k r q m hm ∈ regradeGrading ℳ k r q
proof:
:=
  of_mem_summand q _

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_congr
statement:
theorem mk_congr {q q' : ℤ} (h : q = q') {m m' : M} (h' : m = m') (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r))
    (hm' : m' ∈ ℳ (q' * k + r)) : mk ℳ k r q m hm = mk ℳ k r q' m' hm'
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'; rfl

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero (q : ℤ) : mk ℳ k r q 0 (zero_mem _) = 0
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of (fun q => ↥(divGrading ℳ k r q)) q).map_zero

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_add
statement:
theorem mk_add (q : ℤ) {m m' : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) (hm' : m' ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) :
    mk ℳ k r q (m + m') (add_mem hm hm') = mk ℳ k r q m hm + mk ℳ k r q m' hm'
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of (fun q => ↥(divGrading ℳ k r q)) q).map_add ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨m', hm'⟩

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mem_regradeGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_regradeGrading_iff {q : ℤ} {x : RegradeByDivision ℳ k r} :
    x ∈ regradeGrading ℳ k r q ↔ ∃ m, ∃ hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r), mk ℳ k r q m hm = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩; exact mk_mem q hm

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : RegradeByDivision ℳ k r → Prop} (x : RegradeByDivision ℳ k r)
    (zero : P 0) (mk : ∀ (q : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)), P (mk ℳ k r q m hm))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact zero
  | of q m => exact mk q m.1 m.2
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.addHom_ext
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.addHom_ext fun q m => h q m.1 m.2

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.fold_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fold_mk (q : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) : fold ℳ k r (mk ℳ k r q m hm) = m
proof:
:= by
  simp [fold, mk]

name: DG.intCast_val_zmod
statement: theorem intCast_val_zmod (r : ZMod k) : ((r.val : ℤ) : ZMod k) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: DG.ediv_mul_add_val
statement: theorem ediv_mul_add_val (n : ℤ) : n / k * k + ((n : ZMod k).val : ℤ) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZMod.val_intCast]; exact Int.ediv_mul_add_emod n k

name: DG.mul_add_val_ediv
statement: theorem mul_add_val_ediv (q : ℤ) (r : ZMod k) : (q * k + (r.val : ℤ)) / k = q
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne k)
  rw [add_comm, Int.add_mul_ediv_right _ _ hk,
    Int.ediv_eq_zero_of_lt (Int.natCast_nonneg _) (Int.ofNat_lt.mpr (ZMod.val_lt r)), zero_add]

name: DG.intCast_mul_add_val
statement: theorem intCast_mul_add_val (q : ℤ) (r : ZMod k) : ((q * k + (r.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod k) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_self, mul_zero, zero_add,
    intCast_val_zmod]

name: DG.of_mk_congr
statement:
theorem of_mk_congr {r r' : ZMod k} (h : r = r') {q q' : ℤ} (hq : q = q') {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))) (hm' : m ∈ ℳ (q' * k + (r'.val : ℤ))) :
    DirectSum.of (fun r : ZMod k => RegradeByDivision ℳ k (r.val : ℤ)) r
        (RegradeByDivision.mk ℳ k _ q m hm) =
      DirectSum.of (fun r : ZMod k => RegradeByDivision ℳ k (r.val : ℤ)) r'
        (RegradeByDivision.mk ℳ k _ q' m hm')
proof:
:= by
  subst h hq; rfl

name: DG.toResidues_of_mem
statement:
theorem toResidues_of_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    toResidues ℳ k m =
      DirectSum.of (fun r : ZMod k => RegradeByDivision ℳ k (r.val : ℤ)) (n : ZMod k)
        (RegradeByDivision.mk ℳ k _ (n / k) m (by rw [ediv_mul_add_val]; exact hm))
proof:
:= by
  rw [toResidues, liftHomogeneous_of_mem ℳ _ hm]; rfl

name: DG.ofResidues_of_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofResidues_of_mk (r : ZMod k) (q : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))) :
    ofResidues ℳ k (DirectSum.of (fun r : ZMod k => RegradeByDivision ℳ k (r.val : ℤ)) r
      (RegradeByDivision.mk ℳ k _ q m hm)) = m
proof:
:= by
  simp [ofResidues]

name: DG.residueEquiv_of_mem
statement:
theorem residueEquiv_of_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    residueEquiv ℳ k m =
      DirectSum.of (fun r : ZMod k => RegradeByDivision ℳ k (r.val : ℤ)) (n : ZMod k)
        (RegradeByDivision.mk ℳ k _ (n / k) m (by rw [ediv_mul_add_val]; exact hm))
proof:
:=
  toResidues_of_mem hm

name: DG.residueEquiv_symm_of_mk
statement:
theorem residueEquiv_symm_of_mk (r : ZMod k) (q : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))) :
    (residueEquiv ℳ k).symm (DirectSum.of (fun r : ZMod k => RegradeByDivision ℳ k (r.val : ℤ)) r
      (RegradeByDivision.mk ℳ k _ q m hm)) = m
proof:
:=
  ofResidues_of_mk ℳ k r q m hm

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_mul_mk
statement:
theorem mk_mul_mk {p q : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (p * k + 0)) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 (q * k + 0)) :
    mk 𝒜 k 0 p a ha * mk 𝒜 k 0 q b hb =
      mk 𝒜 k 0 (p + q) (a * b) (SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (A := divGrading 𝒜 k 0) ha hb)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of _ _

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.one_eq_mk
statement:
theorem one_eq_mk : (1 : RegradeByDivision 𝒜 k 0) =
    mk 𝒜 k 0 0 1 (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := divGrading 𝒜 k 0))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_smul_mk
statement:
theorem mk_smul_mk {p q : ℤ} {a : A} {m : M} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (p * k + 0)) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) :
    mk 𝒜 k 0 p a ha • mk ℳ k r q m hm =
      mk ℳ k r (p + q) (a • m) (SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem (A := divGrading 𝒜 k 0)
        (B := divGrading ℳ k r) ha hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.Gmodule.of_smul_of _ _ _ _

name: DG.residueEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem residueEquiv_smul {q : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (q * n + 0)) (m : M) :
    residueEquiv ℳ n (a • m) =
      RegradeByDivision.mk 𝒜 n 0 q a ha • residueEquiv ℳ n m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn ℳ with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous m =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
    rename_i l
    have ham := SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem (A := 𝒜) (B := ℳ) ha hm
    rw [vadd_eq_add] at ham
    rw [residueEquiv_of_mem ℳ n ham, residueEquiv_of_mem ℳ n hm, ← DirectSum.of_smul,
      RegradeByDivision.mk_smul_mk]
    have hk : (n : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne n)
    exact of_mk_congr
      (by rw [add_zero, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_self, mul_zero,
        zero_add])
      (by rw [add_zero, add_comm, Int.add_mul_ediv_right _ _ hk, add_comm]) _ _
  | add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, map_add, hm, hm', smul_add]

name: DG.HasDegree.smul
statement:
theorem HasDegree.smul {R : Type*} [Monoid R] [DistribMulAction R N] [SMulMemClass τ R N]
    {n : ι} {f : M →+ N} (hf : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f) (r : R) : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n (r • f)
proof:
:=
  fun i m hm => SMulMemClass.smul_mem r (hf i m hm)

name: DG.HasDegree.zero
statement: theorem HasDegree.zero (n : ι) : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n 0
proof: := fun _ _ _ => zero_mem _

name: DG.HasDegree.add
statement:
theorem HasDegree.add {n : ι} {f g : M →+ N} (hf : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f) (hg : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n g) :
    HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n (f + g)
proof: := fun i m hm => add_mem (hf i m hm) (hg i m hm)

name: DG.HasDegree.neg
statement: theorem HasDegree.neg {n : ι} {f : M →+ N} (hf : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f) : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n (-f)
proof:
:=
  fun i m hm => neg_mem (hf i m hm)

name: DG.HasDegree.sub
statement:
theorem HasDegree.sub {n : ι} {f g : M →+ N} (hf : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f) (hg : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n g) :
    HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n (f - g)
proof: := fun i m hm => sub_mem (hf i m hm) (hg i m hm)

name: DG.HasDegree.nsmul
statement:
theorem HasDegree.nsmul {n : ι} {f : M →+ N} (hf : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f) (k : ℕ) :
    HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n (k • f)
proof: := fun i m hm => nsmul_mem (hf i m hm) k

name: DG.HasDegree.zsmul
statement:
theorem HasDegree.zsmul {n : ι} {f : M →+ N} (hf : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f) (k : ℤ) :
    HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n (k • f)
proof: := fun i m hm => zsmul_mem (hf i m hm) k

name: DG.HasDegree.sum
statement:
theorem HasDegree.sum {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) {n : ι} {f : α → M →+ N}
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n (f a)) : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n (∑ a ∈ s, f a)
proof:
:= fun i m hm => by
  rw [AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply]
  exact sum_mem fun a ha => hf a ha i m hm

name: DG.HasDegree.comp
proof:
:= fun i x hx => by
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, ← add_assoc]
  exact hg _ _ (hf i x hx)

name: DG.HasDegree.id
statement: theorem HasDegree.id [AddZeroClass ι] (ℳ : ι → σ) : HasDegree ℳ ℳ 0 (AddMonoidHom.id M)
proof:
:=
  fun i m hm => by simpa using hm

name: DG.GradedHom.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {f g : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : f = g
proof: := DFunLike.ext f g h

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_mk (f : M →+ N) (h) : ⇑(mk (ℳ := ℳ) (𝒩 := 𝒩) (n := n) f h) = f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_toAddMonoidHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toAddMonoidHom (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) : ⇑f.toAddMonoidHom = f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAddMonoidHom_mk (f : M →+ N) (h) :
    (mk (ℳ := ℳ) (𝒩 := 𝒩) (n := n) f h).toAddMonoidHom = f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_injective
statement:
theorem toAddMonoidHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (toAddMonoidHom : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n → M →+ N)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  ext fun x => congrArg (fun k : M →+ N => k x) h

name: DG.GradedHom.map_mem
statement: theorem map_mem (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) {i : ι} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ i) : f m ∈ 𝒩 (i + n)
proof:
:=
  f.map_mem' i m hm

name: DG.GradedHom.hasDegree
statement: theorem hasDegree (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f.toAddMonoidHom
proof: := f.map_mem'

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_ofHasDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAddMonoidHom_ofHasDegree {f : M →+ N} (hf : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f) :
    (ofHasDegree hf).toAddMonoidHom = f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_ofHasDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_ofHasDegree {f : M →+ N} (hf : HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f) : ⇑(ofHasDegree hf) = f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.hasDegree_iff
statement:
theorem hasDegree_iff {f : M →+ N} :
    HasDegree ℳ 𝒩 n f ↔ ∃ g : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n, g.toAddMonoidHom = f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨ofHasDegree h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨g, hg⟩ => hg ▸ g.hasDegree⟩

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_component_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_component_apply (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) (i : ι) (m : ℳ i) :
    (f.component i m : N) = f m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_zero : (0 : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n).toAddMonoidHom = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_add (f g : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) :
    (f + g).toAddMonoidHom = f.toAddMonoidHom + g.toAddMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_neg (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) :
    (-f).toAddMonoidHom = -f.toAddMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_sub (f g : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) :
    (f - g).toAddMonoidHom = f.toAddMonoidHom - g.toAddMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_nsmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_nsmul (k : ℕ) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) :
    (k • f).toAddMonoidHom = k • f.toAddMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_zsmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_zsmul (k : ℤ) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) :
    (k • f).toAddMonoidHom = k • f.toAddMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_zero : ⇑(0 : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_add
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_add (f g : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) : ⇑(f + g) = ⇑f + ⇑g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_neg (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) : ⇑(-f) = -⇑f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_sub

name: DG.GradedHom.coeAddMonoidHom_injective

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_comp

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_comp

name: DG.GradedHom.comp_apply

name: DG.GradedHom.heq_of_forall
statement:

proof:
:= by
  subst hmn
  exact heq_of_eq (ext h)

name: DG.GradedHom.comp_assoc
proof:
:=
  heq_of_forall (add_assoc m n p).symm fun _ => rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_comp_assoc
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.zero_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem zero_comp {m n : ι} (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    (0 : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n).comp f = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.add_comp

theorem add_comp {m n : ι} (g₁ g₂ : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    (g₁ + g₂).comp f = g₁.comp f + g₂.comp f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.neg_comp
statement:
theorem neg_comp {m n : ι} (g : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    (-g).comp f = -g.comp f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.sub_comp
statement:
theorem sub_comp {m n : ι} (g₁ g₂ : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    (g₁ - g₂).comp f = g₁.comp f - g₂.comp f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.comp_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_zero {m n : ι} (g : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) :
    g.comp (0 : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) = 0
proof: := ext fun _ => map_zero g

name: DG.GradedHom.comp_add
statement:
theorem comp_add {m n : ι} (g : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) (f₁ f₂ : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    g.comp (f₁ + f₂) = g.comp f₁ + g.comp f₂
proof: := ext fun _ => map_add g _ _

name: DG.GradedHom.comp_neg
statement:
theorem comp_neg {m n : ι} (g : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    g.comp (-f) = -g.comp f
proof: := ext fun _ => map_neg g _

name: DG.GradedHom.comp_sub
statement:
theorem comp_sub {m n : ι} (g : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) (f₁ f₂ : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    g.comp (f₁ - f₂) = g.comp f₁ - g.comp f₂
proof: := ext fun _ => map_sub g _ _

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_id
statement: @[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_id : (id ℳ).toAddMonoidHom = AddMonoidHom.id M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.coe_id
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_id : ⇑(id ℳ) = _root_.id
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.id_apply
statement: theorem id_apply (x : M) : id ℳ x = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.comp_id
statement: theorem comp_id {m : ι} (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) : HEq (f.comp (id ℳ)) f
proof:
:=
  heq_of_forall (zero_add m) fun _ => rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.id_comp
statement: theorem id_comp {m : ι} (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) : HEq ((id 𝒩).comp f) f
proof:
:=
  heq_of_forall (add_zero m) fun _ => rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_comp_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_comp_id {m : ι} (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    (f.comp (id ℳ)).toAddMonoidHom = f.toAddMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.toAddMonoidHom_id_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem toAddMonoidHom_id_comp {m : ι} (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    ((id 𝒩).comp f).toAddMonoidHom = f.toAddMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.ext_homogeneous
statement: theorem ext_homogeneous {f g : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n} (h : ∀ (i : ι) (m : ℳ i), f m = g m) : f = g
proof:
:=
  toAddMonoidHom_injective (decompose_addHom_ext ℳ h)

name: DG.GradedHom.lift_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_coe (φ : ∀ i, ℳ i →+ 𝒩 (i + n)) {i : ι} (m : ℳ i) : lift φ m = φ i m
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous_coe ℳ _ m

name: DG.GradedHom.lift_of_mem
statement:
theorem lift_of_mem (φ : ∀ i, ℳ i →+ 𝒩 (i + n)) {i : ι} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ i) :
    lift φ m = φ i ⟨m, hm⟩
proof:
:=
  lift_coe φ ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.GradedHom.lift_apply
statement:
theorem lift_apply (φ : ∀ i, ℳ i →+ 𝒩 (i + n)) (m : M) :
    lift φ m = DirectSum.toAddMonoid (fun i => (AddSubmonoidClass.subtype _).comp (φ i))
      (decompose ℳ m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedHom.component_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem component_lift (φ : ∀ i, ℳ i →+ 𝒩 (i + n)) (i : ι) : (lift φ).component i = φ i
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun m => Subtype.ext (lift_coe φ m)

name: DG.GradedHom.lift_component
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_component (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) : lift f.component = f
proof:
:=
  ext_homogeneous fun _ _ => lift_coe _ _

name: DG.GradedHOM.eval_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_of (n : ι) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) :
    eval ℳ 𝒩 (DirectSum.of (fun n => GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) n f) = f.toAddMonoidHom
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ _ _

name: DG.GradedHOM.eval_of_apply
statement:
theorem eval_of_apply (n : ι) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) (x : M) :
    eval ℳ 𝒩 (DirectSum.of (fun n => GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 n) n f) x = f x
proof: := by simp

name: DG.GradedHOM.compHom_of_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compHom_of_of {m n : ι} (g : GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) (f : GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) :
    compHom (DirectSum.of (fun n => GradedHom 𝒩 𝒪 n) n g)
        (DirectSum.of (fun m => GradedHom ℳ 𝒩 m) m f) =
      DirectSum.of (fun k => GradedHom ℳ 𝒪 k) (m + n) (g.comp f)
proof:
:= by
  simp [compHom]

name: DG.GradedHOM.eval_compHom
statement:
theorem eval_compHom (g : GradedHOM 𝒩 𝒪) (f : GradedHOM ℳ 𝒩) :
    eval ℳ 𝒪 (compHom g f) = (eval 𝒩 𝒪 g).comp (eval ℳ 𝒩 f)
proof:
:= by
  induction g using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n g =>
    induction f using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of m f => simp
    | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ => simp [map_add, h₁, h₂, AddMonoidHom.comp_add]
  | add g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂ => simp [map_add, h₁, h₂, AddMonoidHom.add_comp]

name: DG.GradedHOM.eval_compHom_apply
statement:
theorem eval_compHom_apply (g : GradedHOM 𝒩 𝒪) (f : GradedHOM ℳ 𝒩) (x : M) :
    eval ℳ 𝒪 (compHom g f) x = eval 𝒩 𝒪 g (eval ℳ 𝒩 f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_compHom]; rfl

name: DG.GradedEND.gOne_eq
statement: theorem gOne_eq : (GradedMonoid.GOne.one : GradedHom ℳ ℳ 0) = GradedHom.id ℳ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedEND.gMul_eq
statement:
theorem gMul_eq {m n : ι} (f : GradedHom ℳ ℳ m) (g : GradedHom ℳ ℳ n) :
    (GradedMonoid.GMul.mul f g : GradedHom ℳ ℳ (m + n)) = g.comp f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedEND.one_def
statement:
theorem one_def :
    (1 : GradedEND ℳ) = DirectSum.of (fun n => GradedHom ℳ ℳ n) 0 (GradedHom.id ℳ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.GradedEND.of_mul_of
statement:
theorem of_mul_of {m n : ι} (f : GradedHom ℳ ℳ m) (g : GradedHom ℳ ℳ n) :
    DirectSum.of (fun n => GradedHom ℳ ℳ n) m f * DirectSum.of (fun n => GradedHom ℳ ℳ n) n g =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => GradedHom ℳ ℳ n) (m + n) (g.comp f)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of f g

name: DG.GradedEND.mul_eq_compHom
statement: theorem mul_eq_compHom (f g : GradedEND ℳ) : f * g = GradedHOM.compHom g f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m f =>
    induction g using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of n g => simp [of_mul_of]
    | add g₁ g₂ h₁ h₂ => simp [mul_add, h₁, h₂]
  | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ => simp [add_mul, h₁, h₂]

name: DG.GradedEND.eval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_one : GradedHOM.eval ℳ ℳ (1 : GradedEND ℳ) = AddMonoidHom.id M
proof:
:= by
  simp [one_def]

name: DG.GradedEND.eval_mul
statement:
theorem eval_mul (f g : GradedEND ℳ) :
    GradedHOM.eval ℳ ℳ (f * g) = (GradedHOM.eval ℳ ℳ g).comp (GradedHOM.eval ℳ ℳ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_eq_compHom, GradedHOM.eval_compHom]

name: DG.GradedEND.eval_mul_apply
statement:
theorem eval_mul_apply (f g : GradedEND ℳ) (x : M) :
    GradedHOM.eval ℳ ℳ (f * g) x = GradedHOM.eval ℳ ℳ g (GradedHOM.eval ℳ ℳ f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_mul]; rfl

name: DG.GradedEND.evalRingHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalRingHom_apply (f : GradedEND ℳ) :
    evalRingHom ℳ f = MulOpposite.op (GradedHOM.eval ℳ ℳ f)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IsConcentratedInMultiples.mem_ediv
statement:
theorem IsConcentratedInMultiples.mem_ediv [IsConcentratedInMultiples 𝒜 k] {n : ℤ} {a : A}
    (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n) : a ∈ 𝒜 (n / k * k + 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : (k : ℤ) ∣ n
  · rwa [Int.ediv_mul_cancel hn, add_zero]
  · rw [IsConcentratedInMultiples.eq_zero hn ha]; exact zero_mem _

name: DG.regradeAddHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem regradeAddHom_of_mem {q : ℤ} {a : A}
    (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (q * k + 0)) : regradeAddHom 𝒜 k a = RegradeByDivision.mk 𝒜 k 0 q a ha
proof:
:= by
  rw [regradeAddHom, liftHomogeneous_of_mem 𝒜 _ ha]
  have hk : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne k)
  exact RegradeByDivision.mk_congr (by rw [add_zero, Int.mul_ediv_cancel _ hk]) rfl _ _

name: DG.regradeRingHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem regradeRingHom_of_mem {q : ℤ} {a : A}
    (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (q * k + 0)) : regradeRingHom 𝒜 k a = RegradeByDivision.mk 𝒜 k 0 q a ha
proof:
:=
  regradeAddHom_of_mem ha

name: DG.regradeRingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem regradeRingEquiv_apply (a : A) :
    regradeRingEquiv 𝒜 k a = regradeRingHom 𝒜 k a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mapHom_mk
statement:
theorem mapHom_mk (f : M →+ N) (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ ℳ n → f m ∈ 𝒩 n) (q : ℤ) (m : M)
    (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) : mapHom ℳ 𝒩 k r f hf (mk ℳ k r q m hm) = mk 𝒩 k r q (f m) (hf hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.regradeMapAddHom_mk
statement:
theorem regradeMapAddHom_mk {M N : GradedModuleCat.{v} 𝒜} (f : M ⟶ N) (q : ℤ) (m : M)
    (hm : m ∈ M.grading (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))) :
    regradeMapAddHom r f (RegradeByDivision.mk _ k _ q m hm) =
      RegradeByDivision.mk _ k _ q (f.hom m) (f.map_mem hm)
proof:
:=
  RegradeByDivision.mapHom_mk _ _ q m hm

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.regradeMap_mk
statement:
theorem regradeMap_mk {M N : GradedModuleCat.{v} 𝒜} (f : M ⟶ N) (q : ℤ) (m : M)
    (hm : m ∈ M.grading (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))) :
    (regradeMap r f).hom (RegradeByDivision.mk _ k _ q m hm) =
      RegradeByDivision.mk _ k _ q (f.hom m) (f.map_mem hm)
proof:
:=
  regradeMapAddHom_mk r f q m hm

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.of_mem_unregradeGrading
statement:
theorem of_mem_unregradeGrading {r : ZMod k} {q n : ℤ} (hr : (n : ZMod k) = r) (hq : n / k = q)
    {y : N r} (hy : y ∈ (N r).grading q) :
    DirectSum.of (fun r => (N r : Type v)) r y ∈ unregradeGrading N n
proof:
:= by
  subst hr hq
  exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.of_mem_unregradeGrading'
statement:
theorem of_mem_unregradeGrading' (r : ZMod k) (q : ℤ) {y : N r} (hy : y ∈ (N r).grading q) :
    DirectSum.of (fun r => (N r : Type v)) r y ∈ unregradeGrading N (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))
proof:
:=
  of_mem_unregradeGrading N (intCast_mul_add_val k q r) (mul_add_val_ediv k q r) hy

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unregradeDecompose_of_mem
statement:
theorem unregradeDecompose_of_mem (r : ZMod k) {q : ℤ} {y : N r} (hy : y ∈ (N r).grading q) :
    unregradeDecompose N (DirectSum.of _ r y) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => ↥(unregradeGrading N n)) (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))
        ⟨DirectSum.of _ r y, of_mem_unregradeGrading' N r q hy⟩
proof:
:= by
