  rw [unregradeDecompose, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hy]
  rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.of_congr_unregrade
statement:
theorem of_congr_unregrade {n n' : ℤ} (h : n = n') {x : ⨁ r : ZMod k, (N r : Type v)}
    (hx : x ∈ unregradeGrading N n) (hx' : x ∈ unregradeGrading N n') :
    DirectSum.of (fun n => ↥(unregradeGrading N n)) n ⟨x, hx⟩ =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => ↥(unregradeGrading N n)) n' ⟨x, hx'⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unregrade_smul_def
statement:
theorem unregrade_smul_def (a : A) (x : ⨁ r : ZMod k, (N r : Type v)) :
    a • x = regradeRingHom 𝒜 k a • x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unregradeMapAddHom_of
statement:
theorem unregradeMapAddHom_of (g : N ⟶ N') (r : ZMod k) (y : N r) :
    unregradeMapAddHom g (DirectSum.of (fun r => (N r : Type v)) r y) =
      DirectSum.of (fun r => (N' r : Type v)) r ((g r).hom y)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unregradeMapAddHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unregradeMapAddHom_apply (g : N ⟶ N') (x : ⨁ r : ZMod k, (N r : Type v)) (r : ZMod k) :
    unregradeMapAddHom g x r = (g r).hom (x r)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_apply _ _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unregradeMap_apply
statement:
theorem unregradeMap_apply (g : N ⟶ N') (x : ⨁ r : ZMod k, (N r : Type v)) (r : ZMod k) :
    ((unregradeMap g).hom x : ⨁ r : ZMod k, (N' r : Type v)) r = (g r).hom (x r)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_apply _ _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.regradeUnitIsoApp_hom_apply
statement:
theorem regradeUnitIsoApp_hom_apply (M : GradedModuleCat.{v} 𝒜) (m : M) :
    (regradeUnitIsoApp M).hom.hom m = residueEquiv M.grading k m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.regradeUnit_naturality
statement:
theorem regradeUnit_naturality {M M' : GradedModuleCat.{v} 𝒜} (f : M ⟶ M') {n : ℤ} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ M.grading n) :
    residueEquiv M'.grading k (f.hom m) =
      unregradeMapAddHom (N := fun r => regradeObj 𝒜 k r M) (N' := fun r => regradeObj 𝒜 k r M')
        (fun r => regradeMap r f) (residueEquiv M.grading k m)
proof:
:= by
  have hm' : m ∈ M.grading (n / k * k + (((n : ZMod k)).val : ℤ)) := by rwa [ediv_mul_add_val]
  have h₁ := residueEquiv_of_mem M'.grading k (f.map_mem hm)
  have h₂ := residueEquiv_of_mem M.grading k hm
  have h₃ := unregradeMapAddHom_of (N := fun r => regradeObj 𝒜 k r M)
    (N' := fun r => regradeObj 𝒜 k r M') (fun r => regradeMap r f) (n : ZMod k)
    (RegradeByDivision.mk M.grading k _ (n / k) m hm')
  have h₄ := regradeMap_mk (n : ZMod k) f (n / k) m hm'
  exact h₁.trans ((congrArg (DirectSum.of (fun r : ZMod k => (regradeObj 𝒜 k r M' : Type v))
    (n : ZMod k)) h₄).symm.trans (h₃.symm.trans (congrArg (unregradeMapAddHom
      (N := fun r => regradeObj 𝒜 k r M) (N' := fun r => regradeObj 𝒜 k r M')
        (fun r => regradeMap r f)) h₂.symm)))

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitAddHom_mk
proof:
:= by
  simp [counitAddHom]

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitInvAddHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem counitInvAddHom_of_mem {q : ℤ} {y : N r} (hy : y ∈ (N r).grading q) :
    counitInvAddHom N r y =
      RegradeByDivision.mk _ k _ q (DirectSum.of _ r y) (of_mem_unregradeGrading' N r q hy)
proof:
:= by
  rw [counitInvAddHom, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hy]
  rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counit_aux
statement:
theorem counit_aux {r' : ZMod k} (hr : r' = r) {q q' : ℤ} (hq : q' = q) {y : N r'}
    (hy : y ∈ (N r').grading q')
    (hx : DirectSum.of (fun r => (N r : Type v)) r' y ∈
      unregradeGrading N (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))) :
    counitInvAddHom N r (DirectSum.of (fun r => (N r : Type v)) r' y r) =
        RegradeByDivision.mk _ k _ q (DirectSum.of _ r' y) hx ∧
      DirectSum.of (fun r => (N r : Type v)) r' y r ∈ (N r).grading q
proof:
:= by
  subst hr hq
  rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same]
  exact ⟨counitInvAddHom_of_mem N r' hy, hy⟩

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counit_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := id hx
  exact counit_aux N r (intCast_mul_add_val k q r) (mul_add_val_ediv k q r) hy hx

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitAddHom_regradeMap
statement:
theorem counitAddHom_regradeMap {N' : ZMod k → GradedModuleCat.{v} (regradeGrading 𝒜 k 0)}
    (g : N ⟶ N') (r : ZMod k) (z : RegradeByDivision (unregradeGrading N) k (r.val : ℤ)) :
    counitAddHom N' r ((regradeMap r (unregradeMap g)).hom z) =
      (g r).hom (counitAddHom N r z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using RegradeByDivision.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk q x hx =>
    rw [regradeMap_mk, counitAddHom_mk, counitAddHom_mk]
    exact unregradeMap_apply g x r
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, hz, hz', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.map_smul_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem map_smul_of_homogeneous {ι κ A M N τ σ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    [Ring A] [SetLike τ A] [AddSubgroupClass τ A] (𝒜 : ι → τ) [Decomposition 𝒜]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [SetLike σ M] [AddSubgroupClass σ M] (ℳ : κ → σ)
    [Decomposition ℳ] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] (f : M →+ N)
    (h : ∀ (i : ι) (j : κ) (a : A) (m : M), a ∈ 𝒜 i → m ∈ ℳ j → f (a • m) = a • f m)
    (a : A) (m : M) : f (a • m) = a • f m
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous a =>
    induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn ℳ with
    | zero => simp
    | homogeneous m => exact h _ _ _ _ a.2 m.2
    | add m m' hm hm' => rw [smul_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, smul_add]
  | add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul, map_add, ha, ha', add_smul]

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.Hom.map_mem
statement:
theorem Hom.map_mem (f : Hom M N) {i : ι} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ M.grading i) :
    f.hom m ∈ N.grading i
proof:
:=
  f.map_mem' hm

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : f.hom = g.hom) : f = g
proof: := Hom.ext h

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.hom_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_id : (𝟙 M : M ⟶ M).hom = LinearMap.id
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.hom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_comp (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) : (f ≫ g).hom = g.hom.comp f.hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.hom_ext_homogeneous
statement:
theorem hom_ext_homogeneous {f g : M ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ (i : ι) (m : M), m ∈ M.grading i → f.hom m = g.hom m) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun m => ?_)
  induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn M.grading with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous m => exact h _ _ m.2
  | add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.Hom.coe_restrict_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Hom.coe_restrict_apply (f : Hom M N) (i : ι) (m : M.grading i) :
    (f.restrict i m : N) = f.hom m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.isoMk_hom_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoMk_hom_hom (e : M ≃ₗ[A] N) (he he') : (isoMk e he he').hom.hom = e.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.isoMk_inv_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoMk_inv_hom (e : M ≃ₗ[A] N) (he he') : (isoMk e he he').inv.hom = e.symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.WithDifferential.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f.hom = g.hom) : f = g
proof: := Hom.ext h

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.WithDifferential.id_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_hom : (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).hom = 𝟙 X.obj
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.WithDifferential.comp_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_hom {Z : WithDifferential P} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (f ≫ g).hom = f.hom ≫ g.hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.WithDifferential.Hom.comm'
statement: theorem Hom.comm' (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X.obj) : f.hom.hom (X.d x) = Y.d (f.hom.hom x)
proof: := f.comm x

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.WithDifferential.isoMk_hom_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoMk_hom_hom (e : X.obj ≅ Y.obj) (he) : (isoMk e he).hom.hom = e.hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.WithDifferential.isoMk_inv_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoMk_inv_hom (e : X.obj ≅ Y.obj) (he) : (isoMk e he).inv.hom = e.inv
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ComplexSum.component_of_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem component_of_same (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) : component K n (of K n x) = x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.component.lof_self (M := fun n => K.X n) R n x

name: DG.ComplexSum.component_of_ne
statement: theorem component_of_ne {m n : ℤ} (h : m ≠ n) (x : K.X m) : component K n (of K m x) = 0
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.component.of (M := fun n => K.X n) R n m x).trans (dite_eq_right h)

name: DG.ComplexSum.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {motive : ComplexSum K → Prop} (z : ComplexSum K) (zero : motive 0)
    (of : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n), motive (of K n x))
    (add : ∀ z z', motive z → motive z' → motive (z + z')) : motive z
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.induction_on (β := fun n => K.X n) z zero of add

name: DG.ComplexSum.addHom_ext
statement:
theorem addHom_ext {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] {f g : ComplexSum K →+ B}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n), f (of K n x) = g (of K n x)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.addHom_ext (β := fun n => K.X n) h

name: DG.ComplexSum.dAux_of
statement: theorem dAux_of (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) : dAux (of K n x) = of K (n + 1) (K.d n (n + 1) x)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun n => K.X n) _ n x

name: DG.ComplexSum.d_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_of (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) : d (of K n x) = of K (n + 1) (K.d n (n + 1) x)
proof:
:=
  dAux_of n x

name: DG.ComplexSum.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {z : ComplexSum K} :
    z ∈ grading (M := ComplexSum K) n ↔ ∃ x, of K n x = z
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.ComplexSum.of_mem_grading
statement: theorem of_mem_grading (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) : of K n x ∈ grading (M := ComplexSum K) n
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: DG.ComplexSum.of_component_of_mem
statement:
theorem of_component_of_mem {n : ℤ} {z : ComplexSum K} (hz : z ∈ grading (M := ComplexSum K) n) :
    of K n (component K n z) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mem_grading_iff.mp hz
  rw [component_of_same]

name: DG.ComplexSum.of_injective
statement: theorem of_injective (n : ℤ) : Function.Injective (of K n)
proof:
:= fun x y h => by
  rw [← component_of_same n x, h, component_of_same]

name: DG.ComplexSum.map_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_of (φ : K ⟶ L) (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) : map φ (of K n x) = of L n (φ.f n x)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toModule_lof (M := fun n => K.X n) R n x

name: DG.ComplexSum.map_mem
statement:
theorem map_mem (φ : K ⟶ L) {n : ℤ} {z : ComplexSum K} (hz : z ∈ grading (M := ComplexSum K) n) :
    map φ z ∈ grading (M := ComplexSum L) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mem_grading_iff.mp hz
  rw [map_of]
  exact of_mem_grading n _

name: DG.ComplexSum.map_d
statement: theorem map_d (φ : K ⟶ L) (z : ComplexSum K) : map φ (d z) = d (map φ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x =>
    rw [d_of, map_of, map_of, d_of, ← ModuleCat.comp_apply, ← ModuleCat.comp_apply, φ.comm]
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [d_add, map_add, map_add, hz, hz', d_add]

name: DG.ComplexSum.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (z : ComplexSum K) : map (𝟙 K) z = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x => rw [map_of]; rfl
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, hz, hz']

name: DG.ComplexSum.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (φ : K ⟶ L) (ψ : L ⟶ M) (z : ComplexSum K) :
    map (φ ≫ ψ) z = map ψ (map φ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x => rw [map_of, map_of, map_of]; rfl
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hz, hz']

name: DG.ComplexSum.toComplexIso_hom_f_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toComplexIso_hom_f_apply (n : ℤ)
    (z : (DGModuleCat.toComplex R (DGModuleCat.of A (ComplexSum K))).X n) :
    (toComplexIso hsmul).hom.f n z = component K n z.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ComplexSum.coe_toComplexIso_inv_f_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toComplexIso_inv_f_apply (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) :
    ((toComplexIso hsmul).inv.f n x).1 = of K n x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ComplexTensor.mk_f_tmul
statement:
theorem mk_f_tmul (φ : K ⊗ L ⟶ N) {p q n n' : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (h' : p + q = n')
    (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    GradedMonoid.mk (A := fun n => N.X n) n (φ.f n (tmul K L h x y)) =
      GradedMonoid.mk n' (φ.f n' (tmul K L h' x y))
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'
  rfl

name: DG.ComplexTensor.of_f_tmul
statement:
theorem of_f_tmul (φ : K ⊗ L ⟶ N) {p q n n' : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (h' : p + q = n')
    (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    ComplexSum.of N n (φ.f n (tmul K L h x y)) = ComplexSum.of N n' (φ.f n' (tmul K L h' x y))
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'
  rfl

name: DG.MonObj.one_mul_apply
statement:
theorem one_mul_apply {n : ℤ} (x : M.X.X n) :
    (μ[M.X]).f n (tmul M.X M.X (zero_add n) (one M) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.f n (tmul _ M.X (zero_add n) (unitOne R) x))
    (CategoryTheory.MonObj.one_mul M.X)
  simp only [comp_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, whiskerRight_f_tmul, leftUnitor_hom_f_tmul] at this
  exact this

name: DG.MonObj.mul_one_apply
statement:
theorem mul_one_apply {n : ℤ} (x : M.X.X n) :
    (μ[M.X]).f n (tmul M.X M.X (add_zero n) x (one M)) = x
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.f n (tmul M.X _ (add_zero n) x (unitOne R)))
    (CategoryTheory.MonObj.mul_one M.X)
  simp only [comp_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, whiskerLeft_f_tmul, rightUnitor_hom_f_tmul] at this
  exact this

name: DG.MonObj.mul_assoc_apply
statement:
theorem mul_assoc_apply {p q r n : ℤ} (h : p + q + r = n) (x : M.X.X p) (y : M.X.X q)
    (z : M.X.X r) :
    (μ[M.X]).f n (tmul M.X M.X h ((μ[M.X]).f (p + q) (tmul M.X M.X rfl x y)) z) =
      (μ[M.X]).f n (tmul M.X M.X (show p + (q + r) = n by omega) x
        ((μ[M.X]).f (q + r) (tmul M.X M.X rfl y z)))
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.f n (tmul _ M.X h (tmul M.X M.X rfl x y) z))
    (CategoryTheory.MonObj.mul_assoc M.X)
  simpa only [comp_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, whiskerRight_f_tmul, whiskerLeft_f_tmul,
    associator_hom_f_tmul] using this

name: DG.MonObj.mk_smul_one_mul
statement:
theorem mk_smul_one_mul (r : R) {i : ℤ} (x : M.X.X i) :
    GradedMonoid.mk (A := fun n => M.X.X n) (0 + i) (mul M (r • one M) x) =
      GradedMonoid.mk i (r • x)
proof:
:=
  (mk_f_tmul μ[M.X] rfl (zero_add i) _ _).trans (by
    rw [tmul_smul_left, map_smul, one_mul_apply])

name: DG.MonObj.mk_mul_smul_one
statement:
theorem mk_mul_smul_one (r : R) {i : ℤ} (x : M.X.X i) :
    GradedMonoid.mk (A := fun n => M.X.X n) (i + 0) (mul M x (r • one M)) =
      GradedMonoid.mk i (r • x)
proof:
:=
  (mk_f_tmul μ[M.X] rfl (add_zero i) _ _).trans (by
    rw [tmul_smul_right, map_smul, mul_one_apply])

name: DG.MonObj.of_mul_of
statement:
theorem of_mul_of {i j : ℤ} (x : M.X.X i) (y : M.X.X j) :
    ComplexSum.of M.X i x * ComplexSum.of M.X j y =
      ComplexSum.of M.X (i + j) ((μ[M.X]).f (i + j) (tmul M.X M.X rfl x y))
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of (A := fun n => M.X.X n) x y

name: DG.MonObj.one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (1 : ComplexSum M.X) = ComplexSum.of M.X 0 (one M)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.MonObj.algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem algebraMap_apply (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (ComplexSum M.X) r = ComplexSum.of M.X 0 (r • one M)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.MonObj.d_of_mul_of
statement:
theorem d_of_mul_of {n j : ℤ} (x : M.X.X n) (y : M.X.X j) :
    d (ComplexSum.of M.X n x * ComplexSum.of M.X j y) =
      d (ComplexSum.of M.X n x) * ComplexSum.of M.X j y +
        koszulSign n • (ComplexSum.of M.X n x * d (ComplexSum.of M.X j y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_mul_of, ComplexSum.d_of, ComplexSum.d_of, ComplexSum.d_of, of_mul_of, of_mul_of,
    ← Hom.comm_apply, d_tmul, map_add, map_add, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul,
    map_zsmul, of_f_tmul μ[M.X] _ (rfl : n + 1 + j = _), of_f_tmul μ[M.X] _ (rfl : n + (j + 1) = _)]

name: DG.MonObj.d_of_mul_add
statement:
theorem d_of_mul_add {n : ℤ} (x : M.X.X n) (b b' : ComplexSum M.X)
    (hb : d (ComplexSum.of M.X n x * b) =
      d (ComplexSum.of M.X n x) * b + koszulSign n • (ComplexSum.of M.X n x * d b))
    (hb' : d (ComplexSum.of M.X n x * b') =
      d (ComplexSum.of M.X n x) * b' + koszulSign n • (ComplexSum.of M.X n x * d b')) :
    d (ComplexSum.of M.X n x * (b + b')) =
      d (ComplexSum.of M.X n x) * (b + b') +
        koszulSign n • (ComplexSum.of M.X n x * d (b + b'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_add, d_add, hb, hb', d_add, mul_add (d _) b b',
    mul_add (ComplexSum.of M.X n x) (d b) (d b'), smul_add, add_add_add_comm]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tmul_add_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_add_left {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x x' : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    tmul K L h (x + x') y = tmul K L h x y + tmul K L h x' y
proof:
:= by
  simp [tmul, TensorProduct.add_tmul]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tmul_add_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_add_right {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p) (y y' : L.X q) :
    tmul K L h x (y + y') = tmul K L h x y + tmul K L h x y'
proof:
:= by
  simp [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tmul_smul_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_smul_left {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (r : R) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    tmul K L h (r • x) y = r • tmul K L h x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tmul_smul_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_smul_right {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (r : R) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    tmul K L h x (r • y) = r • tmul K L h x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tmul_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_zero_left {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (y : L.X q) :
    tmul K L h (0 : K.X p) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [tmul]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tmul_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_zero_right {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p) :
    tmul K L h x (0 : L.X q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [tmul]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tmul_units_smul_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_units_smul_left {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (e : ℤˣ) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    tmul K L h (e • x) y = e • tmul K L h x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, tmul_smul_left,
    Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tmul_units_smul_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_units_smul_right {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (e : ℤˣ) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    tmul K L h x (e • y) = e • tmul K L h x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, tmul_smul_right,
    Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply mapBifunctor.hom_ext
  intro p q h
  exact ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext fun x y => hfg p q h x y

name: DG.ComplexTensor.d_tmul
statement:
theorem d_tmul {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    (K ⊗ L).d n (n + 1) (tmul K L h x y) =
      tmul K L (show p + 1 + q = n + 1 by omega) (K.d p (p + 1) x) y +
        p.negOnePow • tmul K L (show p + (q + 1) = n + 1 by omega) x (L.d q (q + 1) y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ιTensorObj K L p q n h ≫ (K ⊗ L).d n (n + 1) =
      (K.d p (p + 1) ▷ L.X q) ≫ ιTensorObj K L (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega) +
        p.negOnePow • ((K.X p ◁ L.d q (q + 1)) ≫ ιTensorObj K L p (q + 1) (n + 1) (by omega)) := by
    change ιTensorObj K L p q n h ≫ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K L).d n (n + 1) = _
    rw [mapBifunctor.d_eq, Preadditive.comp_add, mapBifunctor.ι_D₁, mapBifunctor.ι_D₂,
      mapBifunctor.d₁_eq _ _ _ _ (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel p (p + 1) from rfl) _ _
        (by dsimp; omega),
      mapBifunctor.d₂_eq _ _ _ _ _ (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel q (q + 1) from rfl) _
        (by dsimp; omega)]
    simp
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (x ⊗ₜ y)) h1
  simpa [tmul] using h2

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tensorHom_f_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorHom_f_tmul (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L') {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p)
    (y : L.X q) : (f ⊗ₘ g).f n (tmul K L h x y) = tmul K' L' h (f.f p x) (g.f q y)
proof:
:= by
  have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (x ⊗ₜ y))
    (ι_mapBifunctorMap f g (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q n h)
  exact e

name: DG.ComplexTensor.whiskerRight_f_tmul
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_f_tmul (f : K ⟶ K') {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p)
    (y : L.X q) : (f ▷ L).f n (tmul K L h x y) = tmul K' L h (f.f p x) y
proof:
:=
  tensorHom_f_tmul f (𝟙 L) h x y

name: DG.ComplexTensor.whiskerLeft_f_tmul
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_f_tmul (g : L ⟶ L') {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p)
    (y : L.X q) : (K ◁ g).f n (tmul K L h x y) = tmul K L' h x (g.f q y)
proof:
:=
  tensorHom_f_tmul (𝟙 K) g h x y

name: DG.ComplexTensor.associator_hom_f_tmul
statement:
theorem associator_hom_f_tmul {p q r pq n : ℤ} (hpq : p + q = pq) (h : pq + r = n) (x : K.X p)
    (y : L.X q) (z : M.X r) :
    (α_ K L M).hom.f n (tmul (K ⊗ L) M h (tmul K L hpq x y) z) =
      tmul K (L ⊗ M) (show p + (q + r) = n by omega) x (tmul L M rfl y z)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := mapBifunctor₁₂.ι_eq (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (curriedTensor _) K L M
    (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q r pq n hpq h
  have e2 := ι_mapBifunctorAssociatorX_hom (curriedAssociatorNatIso (ModuleCat.{u} R)) K L M
    (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q r n
    (by dsimp [ComplexShape.r]; omega)
  have e3 := mapBifunctor₂₃.ι_eq (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (curriedTensor _) K L M
    (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q r (q + r) n rfl
    (by dsimp; omega)
  have f1 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (x ⊗ₜ y ⊗ₜ z)) e1
  have f2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (x ⊗ₜ y ⊗ₜ z)) e2
  have f3 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (x ⊗ₜ (y ⊗ₜ z))) e3
  dsimp at f1 f2 f3
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (f2.trans f3)
  rw [f1]
  rfl

name: DG.ComplexTensor.hom_ext₃
statement:
theorem hom_ext₃ {N : ModuleCat.{u} R} {n : ℤ} {f g : ((K ⊗ L) ⊗ M).X n ⟶ N}
    (hfg : ∀ (p q r : ℤ) (h : p + q + r = n) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) (z : M.X r),
      f (tmul (K ⊗ L) M h (tmul K L rfl x y) z) = g (tmul (K ⊗ L) M h (tmul K L rfl x y) z)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine mapBifunctor₁₂.hom_ext (F₁₂ := curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (G := curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (c₁₂ := ComplexShape.up ℤ) ?_
  intro p q r h
  rw [mapBifunctor₁₂.ι_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p q r (p + q) n rfl h]
  refine ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext₃' fun x y z => ?_
  exact hfg p q r h x y z

name: DG.ComplexTensor.descX_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descX_tmul {N : ModuleCat.{u} R} {n : ℤ}
    (f : ∀ (p q : ℤ), p + q = n → K.X p →ₗ[R] L.X q →ₗ[R] N) {p q : ℤ} (h : p + q = n)
    (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) : descX f (tmul K L h x y) = f p q h x y
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (x ⊗ₜ y))
    (ι_mapBifunctorDesc (F := curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (c := ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      (fun p q h => ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.lift (f p q h))) p q h)

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tensorDesc_f_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorDesc_f_tmul (f : ∀ (p q n : ℤ), p + q = n → K.X p →ₗ[R] L.X q →ₗ[R] M.X n)
    (hf : ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q),
      M.d n (n + 1) (f p q n h x y) =
        f (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega) (K.d p (p + 1) x) y +
          p.negOnePow • f p (q + 1) (n + 1) (by omega) x (L.d q (q + 1) y))
    {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : K.X p) (y : L.X q) :
    (tensorDesc K L M f hf).f n (tmul K L h x y) = f p q n h x y
proof:
:=
  descX_tmul (fun p q h => f p q n h) h x y

name: DG.ComplexTensor.eq_zero_of_isZero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_isZero {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} (hX : IsZero X) (x : X) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun φ : X ⟶ X => φ x) (hX.eq_of_src (𝟙 X) 0)
  simpa using this

name: DG.ComplexTensor.unit_X_eq_zero
statement:
theorem unit_X_eq_zero {p : ℤ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (u : (𝟙_ (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)).X p) :
    u = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_isZero (isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 _ p hp) u

name: DG.ComplexTensor.unit_X_zero_eq
statement:
theorem unit_X_zero_eq (u : (𝟙_ (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)).X 0) :
    u = ((singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R))).hom u : R) •
      unitOne R
proof:
:= by
  set e := singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R))
  have h1 : u = e.inv (e.hom u) := (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply e u).symm
  have h2 : (e.hom u : R) = (e.hom u : R) • (1 : R) := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [unitOne]
  conv_lhs => rw [h1, h2]
  exact map_smul e.inv.hom _ _

name: DG.ComplexTensor.leftUnitor_inv_f_apply
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_f_apply (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) :
    (λ_ K).inv.f n x = tmul _ K (zero_add n) (unitOne R) x
proof:
:= by
  have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom x) (leftUnitor'_inv K n)
  exact e

name: DG.ComplexTensor.leftUnitor_hom_f_tmul
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_hom_f_tmul (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) :
    (λ_ K).hom.f n (tmul _ K (zero_add n) (unitOne R) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← leftUnitor_inv_f_apply, ← ModuleCat.comp_apply, ← HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, HomologicalComplex.id_f, ModuleCat.id_apply]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.rightUnitor_inv_f_apply
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_f_apply (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) :
    (ρ_ K).inv.f n x = tmul K _ (add_zero n) x (unitOne R)
proof:
:= by
  have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom x) (rightUnitor'_inv K n)
  exact e

name: DG.ComplexTensor.rightUnitor_hom_f_tmul
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_hom_f_tmul (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) :
    (ρ_ K).hom.f n (tmul K _ (add_zero n) x (unitOne R)) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rightUnitor_inv_f_apply, ← ModuleCat.comp_apply, ← HomologicalComplex.comp_f,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, HomologicalComplex.id_f, ModuleCat.id_apply]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.unit_tensor_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun p q h u x => ?_
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst hp
    obtain rfl : q = n := by omega
    rw [unit_X_zero_eq u, tmul_smul_left, map_smul, map_smul, hfg]
  · rw [unit_X_eq_zero hp u, tmul_zero_left, map_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.tensor_unit_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun p q h x u => ?_
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · subst hq
    obtain rfl : p = n := by omega
    rw [unit_X_zero_eq u, tmul_smul_right, map_smul, map_smul, hfg]
  · rw [unit_X_eq_zero hq u, tmul_zero_right, map_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.ComplexTensor.unit_hom_ext
statement:
theorem unit_hom_ext {f g : 𝟙_ (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ⟶ K}
    (h : f.f 0 (unitOne R) = g.f 0 (unitOne R)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine from_single_hom_ext (ModuleCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun u => ?_))
  rw [unit_X_zero_eq u, map_smul, map_smul]
  exact congrArg _ h

name: HomologicalComplex.Hom.comm_apply
statement:
theorem _root_.HomologicalComplex.Hom.comm_apply {K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ}
    (φ : K ⟶ L) (n : ℤ) (x : K.X n) : φ.f (n + 1) (K.d n (n + 1) x) = L.d n (n + 1) (φ.f n x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ModuleCat.comp_apply, ← ModuleCat.comp_apply, φ.comm]

name: DG.DGAlgCat.coe_mulBilin_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_mulBilin_apply {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : (complex A).X p)
    (y : (complex A).X q) : (mulBilin A p q n h x y).1 = x.1 * y.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.coe_mul_f_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_mul_f_tmul {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : (complex A).X p)
    (y : (complex A).X q) : ((mul A).f n (tmul _ _ h x y)).1 = x.1 * y.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul, tensorDesc_f_tmul]
  rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.one_f_unitOne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_f_unitOne : (one A).f 0 (unitOne R) = oneX A
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, mkHomFromSingle_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, unitOne]
  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  exact one_smul R (oneX A)

name: DG.DGAlgCat.toMonObj_one
statement: theorem toMonObj_one : η[(toMonObj A).X] = one A
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.toMonObj_mul
statement: theorem toMonObj_mul : μ[(toMonObj A).X] = mul A
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.coe_toMonObj_mul_f_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toMonObj_mul_f_tmul {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (x : (toMonObj A).X.X p)
    (y : (toMonObj A).X.X q) :
    ((μ[(toMonObj A).X]).f n (tmul (toMonObj A).X (toMonObj A).X h x y)).1 = x.1 * y.1
proof:
:=
  coe_mul_f_tmul A h x y

name: DG.DGAlgCat.toMonObj_one_f_unitOne
statement: theorem toMonObj_one_f_unitOne : (η[(toMonObj A).X]).f 0 (unitOne R) = oneX A
proof:
:=
  one_f_unitOne A

name: DG.DGAlgCat.toMonObj_X_d_apply
statement:
theorem toMonObj_X_d_apply {n : ℤ} (a : (toMonObj A).X.X n) :
    (toMonObj A).X.d n (n + 1) a = ⟨d a.1, d_mem a.2⟩
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom φ a) (DGModuleCat.toComplex_d R (DGModuleCat.of A A) n)

name: DG.DGAlgCat.coe_restrictX_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_restrictX_apply (f : A ⟶ B) (n : ℤ) (x : (complex A).X n) :
    (restrictX f n x).1 = f.hom x.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.coe_complexMap_f_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_complexMap_f_apply (f : A ⟶ B) (n : ℤ) (x : (complex A).X n) :
    ((complexMap f).f n x).1 = f.hom x.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.ofMonMap_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofMonMap_hom_apply (f : M ⟶ N) (z : ComplexSum M.X) :
    (ofMonMap f).hom z = ComplexSum.map f.hom z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.unitFun_of_mem
statement:
theorem unitFun_of_mem {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) :
    unitFun A a = ComplexSum.of ((toMonObj A).X) n ⟨a, ha⟩
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ ha

name: DG.DGAlgCat.counitFun_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem counitFun_of (n : ℤ) (x : ((toMonObj A).X).X n) :
    counitFun A (ComplexSum.of ((toMonObj A).X) n x) = x.1
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun n => ((toMonObj A).X).X n) _ n x

name: DG.DGAlgCat.counitFun_unitFun
statement: theorem counitFun_unitFun (a : A) : counitFun A (unitFun A a) = a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a => rw [unitFun_of_mem A a.2, counitFun_of]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, ha']

name: DG.DGAlgCat.unitFun_counitFun
statement: theorem unitFun_counitFun (z : ComplexSum (toMonObj A).X) : unitFun A (counitFun A z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using ComplexSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x =>
    rw [counitFun_of, unitFun_of_mem A x.2]
    rfl
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, hz, hz']

name: DG.DGAlgCat.unitFun_mul
statement: theorem unitFun_mul (a b : A) : unitFun A (a * b) = unitFun A a * unitFun A b
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [zero_mul, map_zero, zero_mul]
  | @h_homogeneous i a =>
    induction b using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => rw [mul_zero, map_zero, mul_zero]
    | @h_homogeneous j b =>
      rw [unitFun_of_mem A (mul_mem_grading a.2 b.2), unitFun_of_mem A a.2, unitFun_of_mem A b.2,
        MonObj.of_mul_of]
      congr 1
      exact Subtype.ext (coe_mul_f_tmul A rfl _ _).symm
    | h_add b b' hb hb' => rw [mul_add, map_add, hb, hb', map_add, mul_add]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_mul, map_add, ha, ha', map_add, add_mul]

name: DG.DGAlgCat.unitFun_one
statement: theorem unitFun_one : unitFun A 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitFun_of_mem A one_mem_grading, MonObj.one_def]
  congr 1
  exact (one_f_unitOne A).symm

name: DG.DGAlgCat.unitFun_algebraMap
statement:
theorem unitFun_algebraMap (r : R) :
    unitFun A (algebraMap R A r) = algebraMap R (ComplexSum (toMonObj A).X) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitFun_of_mem A (algebraMap_mem_grading R r), MonObj.algebraMap_apply]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraMap R A r = algebraMap R A r * ((one A).f 0 (unitOne R)).1
  rw [one_f_unitOne, oneX, mul_one]

name: DG.DGAlgCat.unitFun_d
statement: theorem unitFun_d (a : A) : unitFun A (d a) = d (unitFun A a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | @h_homogeneous n a =>
    rw [unitFun_of_mem A (d_mem a.2), unitFun_of_mem A a.2, ComplexSum.d_of]
    congr 1
    exact (congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom φ
      (⟨a.1, a.2⟩ : DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A (DGModuleCat.of A A) n))
      (DGModuleCat.toComplex_d R (DGModuleCat.of A A) n)).symm
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [d_add, map_add, ha, ha', map_add, d_add]

name: DG.DGAlgCat.algebraMap_smul_of
statement:
theorem algebraMap_smul_of (r : R) (n : ℤ) (x : M.X.X n) :
    algebraMap R (ComplexSum M.X) r • ComplexSum.of M.X n x = ComplexSum.of M.X n (r • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_mul, MonObj.algebraMap_apply, MonObj.of_mul_of, of_f_tmul μ[M.X] rfl (zero_add n),
    tmul_smul_left, map_smul, MonObj.one_mul_apply]

name: DG.DGAlgCat.counitIsoX_hom_f_apply
statement:
theorem counitIsoX_hom_f_apply (n : ℤ) (z : (toMonObj (ofMonObj M)).X.X n) :
    (counitIsoX M).hom.f n z = ComplexSum.component M.X n z.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.counitIso_hom_hom_f_apply
statement:
theorem counitIso_hom_hom_f_apply (M : Mon (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)) (n : ℤ)
    (z : (toMonObj (ofMonObj M)).X.X n) :
    (counitIso M).hom.hom.f n z = ComplexSum.component M.X n z.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.counitIso_naturality
statement:
theorem counitIso_naturality (f : M ⟶ N) :
    toMonMap (ofMonMap f) ≫ (counitIso N).hom = (counitIso M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  refine Mon.Hom.ext (HomologicalComplex.hom_ext _ _ fun n =>
    ModuleCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_))
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ComplexSum.mem_grading_iff.mp hz
  simp only [Mon.comp_hom', comp_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, toMonMap_hom,
    counitIso_hom_hom_f_apply, ComplexSum.component_of_same]
  exact (congrArg (ComplexSum.component N.X n)
    (coe_complexMap_f_apply (ofMonMap f) n ⟨_, hz⟩)).trans
    (by rw [ofMonMap_hom_apply, ComplexSum.map_of, ComplexSum.component_of_same])

name: DG.ModObj.act_one
statement:
theorem act_one (P : Mod (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (toMonObj A).X) :
    η[(toMonObj A).X] ▷ P.X ≫ act P = (λ_ P.X).hom
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.ModObj.one_smul (M := (toMonObj A).X) P.X

name: DG.ModObj.act_assoc
statement:
theorem act_assoc (P : Mod (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (toMonObj A).X) :
    μ[(toMonObj A).X] ▷ P.X ≫ act P =
      (α_ (toMonObj A).X (toMonObj A).X P.X).hom ≫ (toMonObj A).X ◁ act P ≫ act P
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.ModObj.mul_smul (M := (toMonObj A).X) P.X

name: DG.ModObj.act_hom
statement:
theorem act_hom {P Q : Mod (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (toMonObj A).X} (g : P ⟶ Q) :
    act P ≫ g.hom = (toMonObj A).X ◁ g.hom ≫ act Q
proof:
:=
  g.isModHom.smul_hom

name: DG.DGModuleCat.actBilin_leibniz
statement:
theorem actBilin_leibniz (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (a : (complex A).X p)
    (m : (toComplex R N).X q) :
    (toComplex R N).d n (n + 1) (actBilin N p q n h a m) =
      actBilin N (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega) ((complex A).d p (p + 1) a) m +
        p.negOnePow •
          actBilin N p (q + 1) (n + 1) (by omega) a ((toComplex R N).d q (q + 1) m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGModuleCat.toComplex_d, DGModuleCat.toComplex_d, DGModuleCat.toComplex_d]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change d (a.1 • m.1) = d a.1 • m.1 + ((p.negOnePow : ℤ) • (a.1 • d m.1))
  rw [d_smul a.2, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.DGModuleCat.coe_act_f_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_act_f_tmul {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (a : (toMonObj A).X.X p)
    (m : (toComplex R N).X q) :
    ((act N).f n (tmul (toMonObj A).X (toComplex R N) h a m)).1 = a.1 • m.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, tensorDesc_f_tmul]
  rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.toModObj_act
statement: theorem toModObj_act : ModObj.act (toModObj N) = act N
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.coe_toComplexMap_f_apply
statement:
theorem coe_toComplexMap_f_apply (f : N ⟶ N') (n : ℤ) (m : (toComplex R N).X n) :
    ((toComplexMap R f).f n m).1 = f m.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ModObj.one_act_apply
statement:
theorem one_act_apply {n : ℤ} (x : P.X.X n) :
    (ModObj.act P).f n (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X (zero_add n) (oneX A) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.f n (tmul _ P.X (zero_add n) (unitOne R) x)) (ModObj.act_one P)
  simp only [comp_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, whiskerRight_f_tmul, leftUnitor_hom_f_tmul] at this
  rw [toMonObj_one] at this
  erw [one_f_unitOne] at this
  exact this

name: DG.ModObj.assoc_apply
statement:
theorem assoc_apply {p q r n : ℤ} (h : p + q + r = n) (a : (toMonObj A).X.X p)
    (b : (toMonObj A).X.X q) (x : P.X.X r) :
    (ModObj.act P).f n (tmul _ P.X h ((μ[(toMonObj A).X]).f (p + q) (tmul _ _ rfl a b)) x) =
      (ModObj.act P).f n (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X (show p + (q + r) = n by omega) a
        ((ModObj.act P).f (q + r) (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X rfl b x)))
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.f n (tmul _ P.X h (tmul (toMonObj A).X (toMonObj A).X rfl a b) x))
    (ModObj.act_assoc P)
  simpa only [comp_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, whiskerRight_f_tmul, whiskerLeft_f_tmul,
    associator_hom_f_tmul] using this

name: DG.ModObj.smulAux_apply
statement:
theorem smulAux_apply (i j : ℤ) (a : (toMonObj A).X.X i) (x : P.X.X j) :
    smulAux P i j a x =
      ComplexSum.of P.X (i + j) ((ModObj.act P).f (i + j) (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X rfl a x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ModObj.smulHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem smulHom_of_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {j : ℤ} (x : P.X.X j) :
    smulHom P a (ComplexSum.of P.X j x) =
      ComplexSum.of P.X (i + j) ((ModObj.act P).f (i + j) (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X rfl ⟨a, ha⟩ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smulHom, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ ha]
  exact DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun n => P.X.X n) _ j x

name: DG.ModObj.smulHom_one
statement: theorem smulHom_one (z : ComplexSum P.X) : smulHom P 1 z = z
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (ComplexSum.addHom_ext (f := smulHom P 1) (g := AddMonoidHom.id _)
    fun j x => by
      rw [smulHom_of_mem P one_mem_grading, of_f_tmul (ModObj.act P) rfl (zero_add j)]
      exact congrArg (ComplexSum.of P.X j) (one_act_apply P x)) z

name: DG.ModObj.smulHom_mul_of_mem
statement:
theorem smulHom_mul_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hb : b ∈ grading j) {k : ℤ}
    (x : P.X.X k) :
    smulHom P (a * b) (ComplexSum.of P.X k x) =
      smulHom P a (smulHom P b (ComplexSum.of P.X k x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smulHom_of_mem P (mul_mem_grading ha hb), smulHom_of_mem P hb, smulHom_of_mem P ha,
    of_f_tmul (ModObj.act P) rfl (show i + j + k = i + (j + k) by omega)]
  refine congrArg (ComplexSum.of P.X _)
    (Eq.trans ?_ (assoc_apply P (show i + j + k = i + (j + k) by omega) _ _ x))
  congr 2
  exact Subtype.ext (coe_toMonObj_mul_f_tmul A rfl ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩).symm

name: DG.ModObj.smulHom_mul_of_mem_left
statement:
theorem smulHom_mul_of_mem_left {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (b : A) {k : ℤ}
    (x : P.X.X k) :
    smulHom P (a * b) (ComplexSum.of P.X k x) =
      smulHom P a (smulHom P b (ComplexSum.of P.X k x))
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := A))
    (f := ((smulHom P).flip (ComplexSum.of P.X k x)).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft a))
    (g := (smulHom P a).comp ((smulHom P).flip (ComplexSum.of P.X k x)))
    fun _ b => smulHom_mul_of_mem P ha b.2 x) b

name: DG.ModObj.smulHom_mul_of
statement:
theorem smulHom_mul_of (a b : A) {k : ℤ} (x : P.X.X k) :
    smulHom P (a * b) (ComplexSum.of P.X k x) =
      smulHom P a (smulHom P b (ComplexSum.of P.X k x))
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := A))
    (f := ((smulHom P).flip (ComplexSum.of P.X k x)).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulRight b))
    (g := (smulHom P).flip (smulHom P b (ComplexSum.of P.X k x)))
    fun _ a => smulHom_mul_of_mem_left P a.2 b x) a

name: DG.ModObj.smulHom_mul
statement:
theorem smulHom_mul (a b : A) (z : ComplexSum P.X) :
    smulHom P (a * b) z = smulHom P a (smulHom P b z)
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (ComplexSum.addHom_ext (f := smulHom P (a * b))
    (g := (smulHom P a).comp (smulHom P b)) fun _ x => smulHom_mul_of P a b x) z

name: DG.ModObj.smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem smul_of_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {j : ℤ} (x : P.X.X j) :
    a • ComplexSum.of P.X j x =
      ComplexSum.of P.X (i + j) ((ModObj.act P).f (i + j) (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X rfl ⟨a, ha⟩ x))
proof:
:=
  smulHom_of_mem P ha x

name: DG.ModObj.smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_mem {i j : ℤ} {a : A} {z : ComplexSum P.X} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hz : z ∈ grading (M := ComplexSum P.X) j) : a • z ∈ grading (M := ComplexSum P.X) (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ComplexSum.mem_grading_iff.mp hz
  rw [smul_of_mem P ha]
  exact ComplexSum.of_mem_grading _ _

name: DG.ModObj.d_smul_of
statement:
theorem d_smul_of {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) {j : ℤ} (x : P.X.X j) :
    d (a • ComplexSum.of P.X j x) =
      d a • ComplexSum.of P.X j x + koszulSign n • (a • d (ComplexSum.of P.X j x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_of_mem P ha, ComplexSum.d_of, ← Hom.comm_apply, d_tmul, map_add, map_add,
    toMonObj_X_d_apply, smul_of_mem P (d_mem ha), ComplexSum.d_of, smul_of_mem P ha,
    Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, map_zsmul,
    of_f_tmul (ModObj.act P) _ (rfl : n + 1 + j = _), of_f_tmul (ModObj.act P) _ (rfl : n + (j + 1) = _)]

name: DG.ModObj.d_smul
statement:
theorem d_smul {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (z : ComplexSum P.X) :
    d (a • z) = d a • z + koszulSign n • (a • d z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using ComplexSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, d_zero, smul_zero, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  | of j x => exact d_smul_of P ha x
  | add z z' hz hz' =>
    rw [smul_add, d_add, hz, hz', d_add, smul_add, smul_add, smul_add, add_add_add_comm]

name: DG.ModObj.algebraMap_smul_of
statement:
theorem algebraMap_smul_of (r : R) {n : ℤ} (x : P.X.X n) :
    algebraMap R A r • ComplexSum.of P.X n x = ComplexSum.of P.X n (r • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_of_mem P (algebraMap_mem_grading R r), of_f_tmul (ModObj.act P) rfl (zero_add n)]
  have : (⟨algebraMap R A r, algebraMap_mem_grading R r⟩ : (toMonObj A).X.X 0) = r • oneX A :=
    Subtype.ext (mul_one (algebraMap R A r)).symm
  rw [this, tmul_smul_left, map_smul, one_act_apply]

name: DG.DGModuleCat.map_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem map_smul_of_mem (g : P ⟶ Q) {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {j : ℤ}
    (x : P.X.X j) :
    ComplexSum.map g.hom (a • ComplexSum.of P.X j x) =
      a • ComplexSum.map g.hom (ComplexSum.of P.X j x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ModObj.smul_of_mem P ha, ComplexSum.map_of, ComplexSum.map_of, ModObj.smul_of_mem Q ha]
  congr 1
  have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.f (i + j) (tmul (toMonObj A).X P.X rfl ⟨a, ha⟩ x)) (ModObj.act_hom g)
  simpa only [comp_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, whiskerLeft_f_tmul] using this

name: DG.DGModuleCat.map_smul
statement:
theorem map_smul (g : P ⟶ Q) (a : A) (z : ComplexSum P.X) :
    ComplexSum.map g.hom (a • z) = a • ComplexSum.map g.hom z
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ {i : ℤ} {a : A}, a ∈ grading i →
      (ComplexSum.map g.hom).toAddMonoidHom.comp (ModObj.smulHom P a) =
        (ModObj.smulHom Q a).comp (ComplexSum.map g.hom).toAddMonoidHom := fun ha =>
    ComplexSum.addHom_ext fun _ x => map_smul_of_mem g ha x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun (decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := A))
    (f := AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun a => (ComplexSum.map g.hom).toAddMonoidHom.comp
      (ModObj.smulHom P a)) fun a b => by beta_reduce; rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.comp_add])
    (g := AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun a => (ModObj.smulHom Q a).comp
      (ComplexSum.map g.hom).toAddMonoidHom) fun a b => by
        beta_reduce; rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_comp])
    fun _ a => h a.2) a) z

name: DG.DGModuleCat.ofModMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofModMap_apply (g : P ⟶ Q) (z : ComplexSum P.X) :
    ofModMap g z = ComplexSum.map g.hom z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.unitFun_of_mem
statement:
theorem unitFun_of_mem {n : ℤ} {m : N} (hm : m ∈ grading n) :
    unitFun N m = ComplexSum.of (toModObj N).X n ⟨m, hm⟩
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hm

name: DG.DGModuleCat.counitFun_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem counitFun_of (n : ℤ) (x : (toModObj N).X.X n) :
    counitFun N (ComplexSum.of (toModObj N).X n x) = x.1
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun n => (toModObj N).X.X n) _ n x

name: DG.DGModuleCat.counitFun_unitFun
statement: theorem counitFun_unitFun (m : N) : counitFun N (unitFun N m) = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | h_homogeneous m => rw [unitFun_of_mem N m.2, counitFun_of]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.DGModuleCat.unitFun_counitFun
statement: theorem unitFun_counitFun (z : ComplexSum (toModObj N).X) : unitFun N (counitFun N z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using ComplexSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | of n x =>
    rw [counitFun_of, unitFun_of_mem N x.2]
    rfl
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, hz, hz']

name: DG.DGModuleCat.unitFun_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem unitFun_smul_of_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) {j : ℤ} {m : N}
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) : unitFun N (a • m) = a • unitFun N m
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitFun_of_mem N (smul_mem_grading ha hm), unitFun_of_mem N hm,
    ModObj.smul_of_mem _ ha]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (coe_act_f_tmul N rfl ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨m, hm⟩).symm

name: DG.DGModuleCat.unitFun_smul
statement: theorem unitFun_smul (a : A) (m : N) : unitFun N (a • m) = a • unitFun N m
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ {i : ℤ} {a : A}, a ∈ grading i →
      (unitFun N).comp (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom N a) =
        (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom _ a).comp (unitFun N) := fun ha =>
    decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := N)) fun _ m => unitFun_smul_of_mem N ha m.2
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun (decompose_addHom_ext (grading (M := A))
    (f := AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun a => (unitFun N).comp (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom N a))
      fun a b => by
        beta_reduce
        ext m
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom_apply, add_smul,
          map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply])
    (g := AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun a => (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom _ a).comp (unitFun N))
      fun a b => by
        beta_reduce
        ext m
        simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom_apply, add_smul,
          AddMonoidHom.add_apply])
    fun _ a => h a.2) a) m

name: DG.DGModuleCat.unitFun_d
statement: theorem unitFun_d (m : N) : unitFun N (d m) = d (unitFun N m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [d_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | @h_homogeneous n m =>
    rw [unitFun_of_mem N (d_mem m.2), unitFun_of_mem N m.2, ComplexSum.d_of]
    congr 1
    exact (congrArg (fun φ => ModuleCat.Hom.hom φ
      (⟨m.1, m.2⟩ : DGModule.gradingSubmodule R A N n)) (toComplex_d R N n)).symm
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [d_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, d_add]

name: DG.DGModuleCat.counitIsoX_hom_f_apply
statement:
theorem counitIsoX_hom_f_apply (n : ℤ) (z : (toModObj (ofModObj P)).X.X n) :
    (counitIsoX P).hom.f n z = ComplexSum.component P.X n z.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.coe_counitIsoX_inv_f_apply
statement:
theorem coe_counitIsoX_inv_f_apply (n : ℤ) (x : P.X.X n) :
    ((counitIsoX P).inv.f n x).1 = ComplexSum.of P.X n x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.counitIso_hom_hom_f_apply
statement:
theorem counitIso_hom_hom_f_apply (n : ℤ) (z : (toModObj (ofModObj P)).X.X n) :
    (counitIso P).hom.hom.f n z = ComplexSum.component P.X n z.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModuleCat.counitIso_naturality
statement:
theorem counitIso_naturality (g : P ⟶ Q) :
    toModMap (ofModMap g) ≫ (counitIso Q).hom = (counitIso P).hom ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  refine Mod.hom_ext _ _ (HomologicalComplex.hom_ext _ _ fun n =>
    ModuleCat.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_))
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ComplexSum.mem_grading_iff.mp hz
  simp only [Mod.comp_hom', comp_f, ModuleCat.comp_apply, toModMap_hom,
    counitIso_hom_hom_f_apply, ComplexSum.component_of_same]
  exact (congrArg (ComplexSum.component Q.X n)
    (coe_toComplexMap_f_apply (ofModMap g) n ⟨_, hz⟩)).trans
    (by rw [ofModMap_apply, ComplexSum.map_of, ComplexSum.component_of_same])

name: DG.WeightCategory.K0_map_internalShift
statement:
theorem K0_map_internalShift (s : ℤ)
    (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory A)) :
    DG.K0.map ((compactInternalShiftAction.{max u w, max u w} A).functor s) x =
      DGCategory.K0.map.{max u w, max u w} (shiftFunctor A (-s)) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DG.K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | mk X =>
    rw [DGCategory.K0.map_mk, DG.K0.map_mk]
    exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ((internalShiftIsoInduction A s).app X.obj).symm
  | neg x hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.WeightCategory.K0_map_mapFunctor_internalShift
statement:
theorem K0_map_mapFunctor_internalShift (s : ℤ)
    (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory A)) :
    DGCategory.K0.map.{max u w, max u w} (mapFunctor φ hφ)
        (DG.K0.map ((compactInternalShiftAction.{max u w, max u w} A).functor s) x) =
      DG.K0.map ((compactInternalShiftAction.{max u w, max u w} B).functor s)
        (DGCategory.K0.map.{max u w, max u w} (mapFunctor φ hφ) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K0_map_internalShift, K0_map_internalShift, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    ← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, ← DGCategory.K0.map_comp, ← DGCategory.K0.map_comp]
  rfl

name: DG.WeightCategory.K0LinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem K0LinearMap_apply (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory A)) :
    K0LinearMap φ hφ x = DGCategory.K0.map.{max u w, max u w} (mapFunctor φ hφ) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem isGradedSimpleIdempotent_ringEquiv {e : R} (he : IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 e) :
    IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒮 (φ e)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => he.1 (φ.injective (by rw [h, map_zero])), fun j h hh hhe hh0 => ?_⟩
  have hh' : φ.symm h ∈ 𝒜 j := (hφ j _).mp (by rwa [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply])
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgh⟩ := he.2 hh' (φ.injective (by
    rw [map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hhe])) (fun h0 => hh0 (by
      rw [← φ.apply_symm_apply h, h0, map_zero]))
  refine ⟨φ g, (hφ _ _).mpr hg, ?_⟩
  rw [← hgh, map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: DG.isGradedSemisimpleRing_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_ringEquiv (h : IsGradedSemisimpleRing 𝒜) :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing 𝒮
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hlp, hsum⟩ := h.exists_list_sum_eq_one
  refine isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_exists_list.mpr ⟨l.map φ, fun e he => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨e, he', rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
    obtain ⟨h0, hI, hs⟩ := hl e he'
    exact ⟨(hφ _ _).mpr h0, hI.map φ, isGradedSimpleIdempotent_ringEquiv φ hφ hs⟩
  · rw [List.pairwise_map]
    exact hlp.imp fun h => ⟨by rw [← map_mul, h.1, map_zero], by rw [← map_mul, h.2, map_zero]⟩
  · rw [← map_list_sum, hsum, map_one]

name: DG.DGSubring.isInternal_wgradingOf
statement: theorem isInternal_wgradingOf : DirectSum.IsInternal S.wgradingOf
proof:
:=
  isInternal_comap _ _ Subtype.val_injective fun k a => ⟨⟨_, hS k a.2⟩, rfl⟩

name: DG.DGSubring.mem_wgrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_iff {k : ℤ} {a : S} :
    letI
proof:
:= S.internalGradingOfIsHomogeneous hS
    a ∈ wgrading k ↔ (a : A) ∈ wgrading k :=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGSubring.bigradedDGRingOfIsHomogeneous
statement:
theorem bigradedDGRingOfIsHomogeneous [BigradedDGRing A] :
    letI
proof:
:= S.internalGradingOfIsHomogeneous hS
    BigradedDGRing S :=
  letI := S.internalGradingOfIsHomogeneous hS
  { one_mem := (S.mem_wgrading_iff hS).mpr one_mem_wgrading
    mul_mem := fun _ _ _ _ ha hb =>
      (S.mem_wgrading_iff hS).mpr (mul_mem_wgrading (A := A) ha hb) }

name: DG.WeightCategory.mapFunctor_map_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapFunctor_map_val {k l : WeightCategory A} (f : k ⟶ l) :
    ((mapFunctor φ hφ).map f).1 = φ f.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.mem_degreeZeroDGSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_degreeZeroDGSubring {a : A} :
    a ∈ hA.degreeZeroDGSubring ↔ a ∈ grading (M := A) 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.decompose_wgrading_mem_degreeZeroDGSubring
proof:
:=
  decompose_wgrading_mem_grading ha k

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.mem_wgrading_degreeZeroDGSubring_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_degreeZeroDGSubring_iff {k : ℤ} {a : hA.degreeZeroDGSubring} :
    a ∈ wgrading k ↔ (a : A) ∈ wgrading k
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.d_degreeZeroDGSubring
statement: theorem d_degreeZeroDGSubring (x : hA.degreeZeroDGSubring) : d x = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [DGSubring.coe_d, hA.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero _ x.2, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero])

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_degreeZeroDGSubring
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading_degreeZeroDGSubring {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    {x : hA.degreeZeroDGSubring} (hx : x ∈ grading n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGSubring.mem_grading_iff] at hx
  have h := decompose_of_mem_same (grading (M := A)) hx
  rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ x.2 (Ne.symm hn)] at h
  exact Subtype.ext h.symm

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.decompose_d_zero
statement: theorem decompose_d_zero (a : A) : decompose (grading (M := A)) (d a) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := decompose_d a (-1)
  rw [neg_add_cancel] at h
  have h0 : ∀ y ∈ grading (M := A) (-1), y = 0 := fun y hy => by
    rwa [hA.grading_eq_bot _ (by omega), AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hy
  rw [h, h0 _ (decompose (grading (M := A)) a (-1)).2, d_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.coe_projZero_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_projZero_apply (a : A) :
    (hA.projZero a : A) = decompose (grading (M := A)) a 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero
statement: theorem projZero_apply_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) : (hA.projZero a : A) = a
proof:
:=
  decompose_of_mem_same _ ha

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.projZero_comp_subtype
statement:
theorem projZero_comp_subtype :
    hA.projZero.comp (DGSubring.subtype hA.degreeZeroDGSubring) = DGRingHom.id
proof:
:=
  DGRingHom.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero x.2)

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.projZero_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem projZero_mem_wgrading {k : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ wgrading k) :
    hA.projZero a ∈ wgrading k
proof:
:=
  decompose_grading_mem_wgrading ha 0

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.subtype_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem subtype_mem_wgrading {k : ℤ} {a : hA.degreeZeroDGSubring} (ha : a ∈ wgrading k) :
    DGSubring.subtype hA.degreeZeroDGSubring a ∈ wgrading k
proof:
:=
  ha

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.inclFunctor_comp_projFunctor
statement: theorem inclFunctor_comp_projFunctor : hA.inclFunctor ⋙ hA.projFunctor = 𝟭 _
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.hext (fun _ => rfl) fun _ _ f => heq_of_eq
    (WeightCategory.hom_ext (Subtype.ext (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero f.1.2)))

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.isGradedPositive_degreeZeroDGSubring
statement:
theorem isGradedPositive_degreeZeroDGSubring : IsGradedPositive hA.degreeZeroDGSubring where
  grading_eq_bot n hn
proof:
:= eq_bot_iff.mpr fun x hx =>
    (AddSubgroup.mem_bot).mpr (hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_degreeZeroDGSubring (by omega) hx)
  isGradedSemisimple := isGradedSemisimpleRing_ringEquiv hA.degreeZeroRingEquiv
    (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl) hA.isGradedSemisimple
  d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero a _ := hA.d_degreeZeroDGSubring a

name: DG.cocycles.mem_wgrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_iff {n k : ℤ} {z : cocycles M n} :
    z ∈ cocycles.wgrading M n k ↔ (z : M) ∈ InternalGrading.wgrading k
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.cocycles.isInternal_wgrading
statement: theorem isInternal_wgrading (n : ℤ) : DirectSum.IsInternal (cocycles.wgrading M n)
proof:
:=
  isInternal_comap _ _ Subtype.val_injective fun k z =>
    ⟨⟨_, isHomogeneous_wgrading_cocycles n k z.2⟩, rfl⟩

name: DG.cocycles.coe_decompose_wgrading
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_wgrading {n : ℤ} (z : cocycles M n) (k : ℤ) :
    ((decompose (cocycles.wgrading M n) z k : cocycles M n) : M) =
      decompose (InternalGrading.wgrading (M := M)) (z : M) k
proof:
:= by
  let : Decomposition fun k =>
      (InternalGrading.wgrading (M := M) k).comap (cocycles M n).subtype :=
    cocycles.decomposition n
  exact coe_decompose_comap _ (cocycles M n).subtype z k

name: DG.cohomology.mem_wgrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_iff {n k : ℤ} {x : cohomology M n} :
    x ∈ cohomology.wgrading M n k ↔
      ∃ z : cocycles M n, (z : M) ∈ InternalGrading.wgrading k ∧ mk M n z = x
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.mem_map

name: DG.cohomology.mkOf_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem mkOf_mem_wgrading {n k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hd : d m = 0)
    (hk : m ∈ InternalGrading.wgrading k) : mkOf hm hd ∈ cohomology.wgrading M n k
proof:
:=
  mem_wgrading_iff.mpr ⟨⟨m, hm, hd⟩, hk, rfl⟩

name: DG.cohomology.isHomogeneous_ker_mk
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_ker_mk (n : ℤ) :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (cocycles.wgrading M n) (mk M n).ker
proof:
:= by
  intro k z hz
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, mk_eq_zero_iff] at hz ⊢
  rw [cocycles.coe_decompose_wgrading]
  exact isHomogeneous_wgrading_coboundaries n k hz

name: DG.cohomology.isInternal_wgrading
statement: theorem isInternal_wgrading (n : ℤ) : DirectSum.IsInternal (cohomology.wgrading M n)
proof:
:=
  Decomposition.isInternal _

name: DG.cohomology.decompose_mk
statement:
theorem decompose_mk {n : ℤ} (z : cocycles M n) (k : ℤ) :
    (decompose (cohomology.wgrading M n) (mk M n z) k : cohomology M n) =
      mk M n (decompose (cocycles.wgrading M n) z k)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using Decomposition.inductionOn (cocycles.wgrading M n) with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous z =>
    rename_i j
    have hz : mk M n z ∈ cohomology.wgrading M n j := ⟨z, z.2, rfl⟩
    by_cases h : j = k
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hz, decompose_of_mem_same _ z.2]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hz h, decompose_of_mem_ne _ z.2 h, _root_.map_zero]
  | add z z' hz hz' =>
    rw [_root_.map_add, decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hz, hz', decompose_add,
      add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, _root_.map_add]

name: DG.cohomology.map_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem map_mem_wgrading (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] N)
    (hf : ∀ {k : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ InternalGrading.wgrading k → f m ∈ InternalGrading.wgrading k)
    {n k : ℤ} {x : cohomology M n} (hx : x ∈ cohomology.wgrading M n k) :
    map f n x ∈ cohomology.wgrading N n k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := mem_wgrading_iff.mp hx
  exact mem_wgrading_iff.mpr ⟨_, hf hz, (map_mk f n z).symm⟩

name: DG.cohomology.internalShiftAddEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem internalShiftAddEquiv_mk (k n : ℤ) (z : cocycles (InternalShift k M) n) :
    internalShiftAddEquiv k n (mk _ n z) =
      mk M n ⟨InternalShift.unmk k z, z.2⟩
proof:
:=
  mapAddMonoidHom_mk (InternalShift.unmk k (M := M)).toAddMonoidHom (fun hm => hm) (fun _ => rfl)
    n z

name: DG.cohomology.internalShiftAddEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
theorem internalShiftAddEquiv_symm_mk (k n : ℤ) (z : cocycles M n) :
    (internalShiftAddEquiv k n).symm (mk M n z) =
      mk (InternalShift k M) n ⟨InternalShift.mk k z, z.2⟩
proof:
:=
  mapAddMonoidHom_mk (InternalShift.mk k (M := M)).toAddMonoidHom (fun hm => hm) (fun _ => rfl)
    n z

name: DG.cohomology.mem_wgrading_internalShiftAddEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_internalShiftAddEquiv_iff {k n j : ℤ} {x : cohomology (InternalShift k M) n} :
    internalShiftAddEquiv k n x ∈ cohomology.wgrading M n (j + k) ↔
      x ∈ cohomology.wgrading (InternalShift k M) n j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := mem_wgrading_iff.mp hx
    rw [← (internalShiftAddEquiv k n).symm_apply_apply x, ← hzx, internalShiftAddEquiv_symm_mk]
    exact mem_wgrading_iff.mpr ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := mem_wgrading_iff.mp hx
    rw [internalShiftAddEquiv_mk]
    exact mem_wgrading_iff.mpr ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩

name: DG.eq_zero_of_sub_mul_mem
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_sub_mul_mem {e b c y : R} {d j : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (he0 : e ∈ 𝒜 0)
    (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 d) (hbc : b * c = e) (hy : y * e = y) (hj : y - y * b ∈ 𝒜 j) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hy0
  set S := (decompose 𝒜 y).support with hS
  have hmem : ∀ i, i ∈ S ↔ (decompose 𝒜 y i : R) ≠ 0 := fun i => by
    rw [hS, DFinsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, ne_eq, ZeroMemClass.coe_eq_zero]
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro h
    apply hy0
    rw [← sum_support_decompose 𝒜 y, ← hS, h, Finset.sum_empty]
  set K := S.max' hSne
  set M := S.min' hSne
  have hK : K ∈ S := S.max'_mem hSne
  have hM : M ∈ S := S.min'_mem hSne
  have hgt : ∀ i, K < i → (decompose 𝒜 y i : R) = 0 := fun i hi => by
    by_contra h
    exact absurd (S.le_max' i ((hmem i).mpr h)) (not_le.mpr hi)
  have hlt : ∀ i, i < M → (decompose 𝒜 y i : R) = 0 := fun i hi => by
    by_contra h
    exact absurd (S.min'_le i ((hmem i).mpr h)) (not_le.mpr hi)
  have hmul : ∀ i, (decompose 𝒜 (y * b) (i + d) : R) = decompose 𝒜 y i * b := fun i =>
    coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem 𝒜 hb
  have hzero : ∀ i, i ≠ j → (decompose 𝒜 (y - y * b) i : R) = 0 := fun i hi =>
    decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 hj (Ne.symm hi)
  have hyKe : (decompose 𝒜 y K : R) * e = decompose 𝒜 y K := by
    have h := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem 𝒜 (a := y) (i := K) he0
    rw [add_zero, hy] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hKb : (decompose 𝒜 y K : R) * b ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    (hmem K).mp hK (by rw [← hyKe, ← hbc, ← mul_assoc, h, zero_mul])
  have h1 : (decompose 𝒜 (y - y * b) (K + d) : R) = -(decompose 𝒜 y K * b) := by
    rw [decompose_sub, DirectSum.sub_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_sub, hgt (K + d) (by omega), hmul,
      zero_sub]
  have hKj : K + d = j := by
    by_contra h
    have h' := hzero _ h
    rw [h1] at h'
    exact hKb (neg_eq_zero.mp h')
  have hmM : (decompose 𝒜 (y * b) M : R) = 0 := by
    have h := hmul (M - d)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
    rw [h, hlt (M - d) (by omega), zero_mul]
  have h2 : (decompose 𝒜 (y - y * b) M : R) = decompose 𝒜 y M := by
    rw [decompose_sub, DirectSum.sub_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_sub, hmM, sub_zero]
  have hMj : M = j := by
    by_contra h
    have h' := hzero _ h
    rw [h2] at h'
    exact (hmem M).mp hM h'
  have hMK : M ≤ K := S.min'_le K hK
  omega

name: DG.eq_zero_of_mul_eq_of_mem_of_pos
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mul_eq_of_mem_of_pos [IsArtinianRing R] {e b c : R} {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (he0 : e ∈ 𝒜 0) (hne : e ≠ 0) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 d) (hbe : b * e = b) (hce : c * e = c)
    (hbc : b * c = e) (hcb : c * b = e) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hee : IsIdempotentElem e := by
    calc e * e = c * (b * c) * b := by rw [← hcb, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = e := by rw [hbc, hce, hcb]
  have hI : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span R {e} ↔ x * e = x := fun x =>
    mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq hee
  have hmem : ∀ x : Submodule.span R {e}, (x : R) * (e - b) ∈ Submodule.span R {e} := fun x =>
    (hI _).mpr (by rw [mul_assoc, sub_mul, hee.eq, hbe])
  let f : Submodule.span R {e} →ₗ[R] Submodule.span R {e} :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨x * (e - b), hmem x⟩
      map_add' := fun x y => Subtype.ext (add_mul _ _ _)
      map_smul' := fun r x => Subtype.ext (mul_assoc _ _ _) }
  have hsub : ∀ x : Submodule.span R {e}, (x : R) * (e - b) = x - x * b := fun x => by
    rw [mul_sub, (hI _).mp x.2]
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro x hx
    have hx' : (x : R) - x * b = 0 := by
      rw [← hsub]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hx
    exact Subtype.ext (eq_zero_of_sub_mul_mem 𝒜 hd he0 hb hbc ((hI _).mp x.2)
      (j := 0) (by rw [hx']; exact zero_mem _))
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := IsArtinian.surjective_of_injective_endomorphism f hinj
    ⟨e, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self e⟩
  have hy' : (y : R) - y * b = e := by
    rw [← hsub]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hy
  have hy0 : (y : R) = 0 :=
    eq_zero_of_sub_mul_mem 𝒜 hd he0 hb hbc ((hI _).mp y.2) (hy' ▸ he0)
  exact hne (by rw [← hy', hy0, zero_mul, sub_zero])

name: DG.eq_zero_of_mul_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mul_eq_of_mem [IsArtinianRing R] {e b c : R} {d : ℤ} (he0 : e ∈ 𝒜 0)
    (hne : e ≠ 0) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 d) (hc : c ∈ 𝒜 (-d)) (hbe : b * e = b) (hce : c * e = c)
    (hbc : b * c = e) (hcb : c * b = e) : d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy d 0 with h | h | h
  · exact (eq_zero_of_mul_eq_of_mem_of_pos 𝒜 (neg_pos.mpr h) he0 hne hc hce hbe hcb hbc).elim
  · exact h
  · exact (eq_zero_of_mul_eq_of_mem_of_pos 𝒜 h he0 hne hb hbe hce hbc hcb).elim

name: DG.bijective_linearCombination_of_shift
statement:
theorem bijective_linearCombination_of_shift :
    Function.Bijective (Finsupp.linearCombination (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) fun a => b (a, 0))
proof:
:= by
  let B := Finsupp.basis fun _ : κ => AddMonoidAlgebra.basis ℤ ℤ
  let e := B.equiv b (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd κ ℤ)
  suffices h : ∀ x, Finsupp.linearCombination (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (fun a => b (a, 0)) x = e x by
    have : (Finsupp.linearCombination (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) fun a => b (a, 0) :
        (κ →₀ LaurentPolynomial ℤ) → M) = e := funext h
    rw [this]
    exact e.bijective
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range B) := B.span_eq ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨⟨a, n⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [Module.Basis.equiv_apply]
    simp only [B, Finsupp.coe_basis, AddMonoidAlgebra.basis_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
      Equiv.sigmaEquivProd_apply]
    exact hb a n
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul n x _ hx =>
    rw [map_smul e, ← hx]
    exact map_zsmul _ n x

name: DG.laurentBasisOfShift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentBasisOfShift_apply (a : κ) : laurentBasisOfShift b hb a = b (a, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurentBasisOfShift, Module.Basis.map_apply, Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne,
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]

name: DG.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_ringEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem isGradedSimpleIdempotent_ringEquiv_iff {e : R} :
    IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒮 (φ e) ↔ IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 e
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, isGradedSimpleIdempotent_ringEquiv φ hφ⟩
  have hφ' : ∀ i y, φ.symm y ∈ 𝒜 i ↔ y ∈ 𝒮 i := fun i y => by
    rw [← hφ, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simpa using isGradedSimpleIdempotent_ringEquiv φ.symm hφ' h

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.Equiv.map
statement:
theorem DGCategory.Idempotent.Equiv.map {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ X Y : C, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] {D : Type*} [Category D] [Preadditive D]
    [∀ X Y : D, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.IsDGFunctor] {X Y : C}
    {e : DGCategory.Idempotent X} {f : DGCategory.Idempotent Y} (h : e.Equiv f) :
    (e.map F).Equiv (f.map F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, hb, hc, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h
  refine ⟨F.map b, F.map c, F.map_mem_grading hb, F.map_mem_grading hc, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals simp only [DGCategory.Idempotent.map_val, ← F.map_comp, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6]

name: DG.WeightCategory.equiv_congr
statement:
theorem equiv_congr {k l k' l' : WeightCategory A} {e : Idempotent k} {f : Idempotent l}
    {e' : Idempotent k'} {f' : Idempotent l'} (he : e'.val.1 = e.val.1)
    (hf : f'.val.1 = f.val.1) (hkl : k'.as - l'.as = k.as - l.as) (h : e.Equiv f) :
    e'.Equiv f'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, hb, hc, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h
  refine ⟨homMk b.1 (mem_wgrading_of_eq hkl.symm b.2),
    homMk c.1 (mem_wgrading_of_eq (by omega) c.2), hb, hc, hom_ext ?_, hom_ext ?_, hom_ext ?_,
    hom_ext ?_, hom_ext ?_, hom_ext ?_⟩
  · simpa [hf] using val_congr h1
  · simpa [he] using val_congr h2
  · simpa [he] using val_congr h3
  · simpa [hf] using val_congr h4
  · simpa [hf] using val_congr h5
  · simpa [he] using val_congr h6

name: DG.WeightCategory.eq_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, hb, hc, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h
  have hd := eq_zero_of_mul_eq_of_mem (degreeZeroWGrading A) (e := idempotentToZero e)
    (b := ⟨b.1, hb⟩) (c := ⟨c.1, hc⟩) (d := k.as - l.as) (idempotentToZero_mem e)
    (fun h0 => hne (hom_ext (show e.val.1 = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val h0))) b.2
    (mem_wgrading_of_eq (by ring) c.2)
    (Subtype.ext (by simpa [he] using val_congr h1)) (Subtype.ext (by simpa using val_congr h3))
    (Subtype.ext (by simpa using val_congr h6)) (Subtype.ext (by simpa [he] using val_congr h5))
  exact WeightCategory.ext (by omega)

name: DG.WeightCategory.shiftEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem shiftEquiv_iff {e f : Idempotent (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A)} :
    ShiftEquiv e f ↔ ∃ (d : ℤ) (b c : A), b ∈ grading 0 ∧ b ∈ wgrading d ∧ c ∈ grading 0 ∧
      c ∈ wgrading (-d) ∧ e.val.1 * b = b ∧ b * f.val.1 = b ∧ f.val.1 * c = c ∧
      c * e.val.1 = c ∧ b * c = e.val.1 ∧ c * b = f.val.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, b, c, hb, hc, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
    refine ⟨-l.as, b.1, c.1, hb, mem_wgrading_of_eq (by simp) b.2, hc,
      mem_wgrading_of_eq (by simp) c.2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using val_congr h2
    · simpa using val_congr h1
    · simpa using val_congr h4
    · simpa using val_congr h3
    · simpa using val_congr h6
    · simpa using val_congr h5
  · rintro ⟨d, b, c, hb, hbw, hc, hcw, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
    refine ⟨⟨-d⟩, homMk (k := ⟨-d⟩) (l := ⟨0⟩) b (mem_wgrading_of_eq (by simp) hbw),
      homMk (k := ⟨0⟩) (l := ⟨-d⟩) c (mem_wgrading_of_eq (by simp) hcw), hb, hc, hom_ext ?_,
      hom_ext ?_, hom_ext ?_, hom_ext ?_, hom_ext ?_, hom_ext ?_⟩
    · simpa using h2
    · simpa using h1
    · simpa using h4
    · simpa using h3
    · simpa using h6
    · simpa using h5

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.idempotentToZero_map_projFunctor
statement:
theorem idempotentToZero_map_projFunctor {k : WeightCategory A} (e : Idempotent k) :
    WeightCategory.idempotentToZero (e.map hA.projFunctor) =
      hA.degreeZeroRingEquiv (WeightCategory.idempotentToZero e)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero e.mem_grading))

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.isSimple_map_projFunctor_iff
statement:
theorem isSimple_map_projFunctor_iff {k : WeightCategory A} (e : Idempotent k) :
    (e.map hA.projFunctor).IsSimple ↔ e.IsSimple
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeightCategory.idempotent_isSimple_iff, WeightCategory.idempotent_isSimple_iff,
    idempotentToZero_map_projFunctor]
  exact isGradedSimpleIdempotent_ringEquiv_iff hA.degreeZeroRingEquiv fun _ _ => Iff.rfl

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.isSimple_map_inclFunctor_iff
statement:
theorem isSimple_map_inclFunctor_iff {k : WeightCategory hA.degreeZeroDGSubring}
    (e : Idempotent k) : (e.map hA.inclFunctor).IsSimple ↔ e.IsSimple
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hA.isSimple_map_projFunctor_iff, hA.map_inclFunctor_map_projFunctor]

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_weightCategory
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading_weightCategory {X Y : WeightCategory hA.degreeZeroDGSubring}
    {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading n) : f = 0
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext (hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_degreeZeroDGSubring (by omega) hf)

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.shiftCorner_injective
statement:
theorem shiftCorner_injective (p q : κ × ℤ)
    (h : (hA.shiftCorner s p).1.2.Equiv (hA.shiftCorner s q).1.2) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, n⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨b, m⟩ := q
  have h' : (WeightCategory.idempotentAt (s a).1 ⟨-n⟩).Equiv
      (WeightCategory.idempotentAt (s b).1 ⟨-m⟩) := by
    refine WeightCategory.equiv_congr ?_ ?_ rfl (h.map hA.inclFunctor)
    · exact (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero (s a).1.mem_grading).symm
    · exact (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero (s b).1.mem_grading).symm
  have hab : a = b := by
    refine hs _ _ ⟨⟨n - m⟩, ?_⟩
    refine WeightCategory.equiv_congr ?_ ?_ ?_ h'
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · change (0 : ℤ) - (n - m) = -n - -m
      ring
  subst hab
  have hnm : (⟨-n⟩ : WeightCategory A) = ⟨-m⟩ :=
    WeightCategory.eq_of_equiv (e' := WeightCategory.idempotentAt (s a).1 ⟨-m⟩) rfl
      (WeightCategory.isSimple_idempotentAt (s a).2 ⟨-n⟩).1 h'
  have : n = m := by
    have := congrArg WeightCategory.as hnm
    change -n = -m at this
    omega
  rw [this]

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.exists_equiv_shiftCorner
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_shiftCorner (c : SimpleCorner (WeightCategory hA.degreeZeroDGSubring)) :
    ∃ p, c.1.2.Equiv (hA.shiftCorner s p).1.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨X, e⟩, he⟩ := c
  have he' : (e.map hA.inclFunctor).IsSimple := (hA.isSimple_map_inclFunctor_iff e).mpr he
  obtain ⟨a, l, hl⟩ := hs' ⟨WeightCategory.idempotentAt (e.map hA.inclFunctor) ⟨0⟩,
    WeightCategory.isSimple_idempotentAt he' _⟩
  have h1 : (e.map hA.inclFunctor).Equiv
      (WeightCategory.idempotentAt (s a).1 ⟨l.as + X.as⟩) := by
    refine WeightCategory.equiv_congr ?_ ?_ ?_ hl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · change X.as - (l.as + X.as) = 0 - l.as
      ring
  refine ⟨(a, -(l.as + X.as)), ?_⟩
  refine WeightCategory.equiv_congr ?_ ?_ ?_ (h1.map hA.projFunctor)
  · exact (Subtype.ext (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero e.val.1.2)).symm
  · rfl
  · change X.as - -(-(l.as + X.as)) = X.as - (l.as + X.as)
    ring

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.zBasisDegreeZero_apply
statement:
theorem zBasisDegreeZero_apply (p : κ × ℤ) :
    hA.zBasisDegreeZero s hs hs' p = DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} (hA.shiftCorner s p).1.2 0
proof:
:=
  DGCategory.IsPositive.basisOfConcentrated_apply.{max u w}
    hA.isGradedPositive_degreeZeroDGSubring.isPositive_weightCategory
    (fun hn _ hf => hA.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_weightCategory hn hf) (hA.shiftCorner s)
    (hA.shiftCorner_injective s hs) (hA.exists_equiv_shiftCorner s hs') p

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.zBasis_apply
statement:
theorem zBasis_apply (p : κ × ℤ) :
    hA.zBasis s hs hs' p =
      DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} (WeightCategory.idempotentAt (s p.1).1 ⟨-p.2⟩) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [zBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply]
  refine (congrArg hA.K0DegreeZeroEquiv.symm (hA.zBasisDegreeZero_apply s hs hs' p)).trans ?_
  rw [K0DegreeZeroEquiv_symm_cell]
  exact congrArg (fun e => DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} e 0)
    (hA.map_projFunctor_map_inclFunctor (WeightCategory.idempotentAt (s p.1).1 ⟨-p.2⟩))

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.T_smul_cell_idempotentAt
statement:
theorem T_smul_cell_idempotentAt (e : Idempotent (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A)) (n : ℤ) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) •
        DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} (WeightCategory.idempotentAt e ⟨-0⟩) 0 =
      DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} (WeightCategory.idempotentAt e ⟨-n⟩) 0
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.T_smul_cell n _ _ (by simp) rfl

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.laurentBasis_apply
statement:
theorem laurentBasis_apply (a : κ) :
    hA.laurentBasis s hs hs' a = DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} (s a).1 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [laurentBasis, laurentBasisOfShift_apply, zBasis_apply]
  have h := WeightCategory.T_smul_cell.{max u w} 0 (s a).1
    (WeightCategory.idempotentAt (s a).1 ⟨-0⟩) (by simp) rfl
  rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_zero, one_smul] at h
  exact h.symm

name: DG.IsPositive.isArtinianRing_degreeZeroSubring
statement: theorem isArtinianRing_degreeZeroSubring : IsArtinianRing (degreeZeroSubring A)
proof:
:= by
  have := hA.isSemisimple
  infer_instance

name: DG.IsPositive.laurentBasis_apply
statement:
theorem laurentBasis_apply (a : κ) :
    hA.laurentBasis s hs hs' a = DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} (s a).1 0
proof:
:=
  haveI := hA.isArtinianRing_degreeZeroSubring
  hA.isGradedPositive.laurentBasis_apply s hs hs' a

name: DG.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_one
statement:
theorem isGradedSimpleIdempotent_one [Nontrivial R] (hdiv : ∀ a : R, a ≠ 0 → IsUnit a) :
    IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨one_ne_zero, fun j h hh _ hh0 => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hdiv h hh0
  refine ⟨decompose 𝒜 (↑u⁻¹ : R) (-j), SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
  have h1 := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem 𝒜 (a := (↑u⁻¹ : R)) (i := -j) hh
  rw [Units.inv_mul, neg_add_cancel, decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem] at h1
  exact h1.symm

name: DG.IsPositive.weight_val_eq_one_of_isSimple
statement:
theorem weight_val_eq_one_of_isSimple {k : WeightCategory A} {e : Idempotent k}
    (he : e.IsSimple) : e.val.1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hne : WeightCategory.idempotentToZero e ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    he.1 (WeightCategory.hom_ext (show e.val.1 = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have h : WeightCategory.idempotentToZero e * WeightCategory.idempotentToZero e =
      WeightCategory.idempotentToZero e * 1 := by
    rw [mul_one, (WeightCategory.isIdempotentElem_idempotentToZero e).eq]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((hdiv _ hne).mul_left_cancel h)

name: DG.IsPositive.isSimple_id
statement: theorem isSimple_id : (Idempotent.id (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A)).IsSimple
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeightCategory.idempotent_isSimple_iff]
  have h1 : WeightCategory.idempotentToZero (Idempotent.id (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A)) = 1 := rfl
  rw [h1]
  exact isGradedSimpleIdempotent_one _ hdiv

name: DG.IsPositive.shiftEquiv_id
statement:
theorem shiftEquiv_id (e : {e : Idempotent (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A) // e.IsSimple}) :
    WeightCategory.ShiftEquiv e.1 (Idempotent.id (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨0⟩, WeightCategory.equiv_congr ?_ ?_ ?_ (Idempotent.Equiv.refl e.1)⟩
  · rfl
  · exact (weight_val_eq_one_of_isSimple hdiv e.2).symm
  · rfl

name: DG.IsPositive.K0EquivLaurentOfDivisionRing_cell

statement:

name: DG.IsCompact.map_equivalence
statement:
theorem IsCompact.map_equivalence [HasCoproducts.{w} C] (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.Additive]
    {X : C} (hX : IsCompact.{w} X) : IsCompact.{w} (e.functor.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  intro ι _ W _
  let adj : e.functor ⊣ e.inverse := e.toAdjunction
  let W' : ι → C := fun i => e.inverse.obj (W i)
  let sc : ∐ W' ⟶ e.inverse.obj (∐ W) := sigmaComparison e.inverse W
  let Φ : (DirectSum ι fun i => (e.functor.obj X ⟶ W i)) →+ DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ W' i) :=
    DirectSum.map fun i => (adj.homAddEquiv X (W i)).toAddMonoidHom
  let ψ : (e.functor.obj X ⟶ ∐ W) →+ (X ⟶ ∐ W') :=
    (Preadditive.rightComp X (inv sc)).comp (adj.homAddEquiv X (∐ W)).toAddMonoidHom
  have hΦ : Function.Bijective Φ :=
    ⟨(DirectSum.map_injective _).2 fun i => (adj.homAddEquiv X (W i)).injective,
      (DirectSum.map_surjective _).2 fun i => (adj.homAddEquiv X (W i)).surjective⟩
  have hψ : Function.Bijective ψ := by
    change Function.Bijective (fun f => adj.homEquiv X (∐ W) f ≫ inv sc)
    exact ⟨fun f g h => (adj.homEquiv X _).injective ((cancel_mono (inv sc)).1 h),
      fun g => ⟨(adj.homEquiv X _).symm (g ≫ sc), by simp⟩⟩
  have comm : ψ.comp (coproductComparison (e.functor.obj X) W) =
      (coproductComparison X W').comp Φ := by
    ext i g
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, coproductComparison_of, DirectSum.map_of,
      AddEquiv.toAddMonoidHom_eq_coe, AddMonoidHom.coe_coe, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_apply, ψ, Φ]
    change adj.homEquiv X (∐ W) (g ≫ Sigma.ι W i) ≫ inv sc =
      adj.homEquiv X (W i) g ≫ Sigma.ι W' i
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [← ι_comp_sigmaComparison, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hcomp : ψ ∘ coproductComparison (e.functor.obj X) W = coproductComparison X W' ∘ Φ := by
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, ← AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, comm]
  have : Function.Bijective (ψ ∘ coproductComparison (e.functor.obj X) W) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (hX ι W').comp hΦ
  exact (Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff' hψ _).1 this

name: DG.isCompact_equivalence_functor_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isCompact_equivalence_functor_obj_iff [HasCoproducts.{w} C] [HasCoproducts.{w} D]
    (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.Additive] (X : C) :
    IsCompact.{w} (e.functor.obj X) ↔ IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:=
  haveI : e.symm.functor.Additive := inferInstanceAs e.inverse.Additive
  ⟨fun h => (IsCompact.map_equivalence e.symm h).of_iso (e.unitIso.app X),
    IsCompact.map_equivalence e⟩
