name: DG.TriangulatedIntAction.smul_def
statement:
theorem smul_def (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : K0 𝒯) :
    letI
proof:
:= σ.K0Module
    p • x = σ.laurentHom p x := rfl

name: DG.TriangulatedIntAction.T_smul
statement:
theorem T_smul (n : ℤ) (x : K0 𝒯) :
    letI
proof:
:= σ.K0Module
    (LaurentPolynomial.T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = K0.map (σ.functor n) x := by
  rw [smul_def, laurentHom_T, K0Hom_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.TriangulatedIntAction.T_smul_mk
statement:
theorem T_smul_mk (n : ℤ) (X : 𝒯) :
    letI
proof:
:= σ.K0Module
    (LaurentPolynomial.T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X = K0.mk ((σ.functor n).obj X) := by
  rw [T_smul, K0.map_mk]

name: DG.WeightCategory.idempotent_ext
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.WeightCategory.idempotent_ext {k : WeightCategory A}
    {e f : Idempotent k} (h : e.val.1 = f.val.1) : e = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, he'⟩ := e
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hf'⟩ := f
  obtain rfl : e = f := WeightCategory.hom_ext h
  rfl

theorem map_inclFunctor_map_projFunctor {k : WeightCategory hA.degreeZeroDGSubring}
    (e : Idempotent k) : (e.map hA.inclFunctor).map hA.projFunctor = e
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.idempotent_ext (Subtype.ext (hA.projZero_apply_of_mem_zero e.val.1.2))

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.K0DegreeZeroInv_comp_map
statement:
theorem K0DegreeZeroInv_comp_map :
    hA.K0DegreeZeroInv.comp hA.K0DegreeZeroMap = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.eq_of_eqOn_dense
    (hA.isPositive_weightCategory.closure_cell_eq_top.{max u w}) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, K0DegreeZeroMap_cell, K0DegreeZeroInv_cell,
    map_projFunctor_map_inclFunctor, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.K0DegreeZeroMap_comp_inv
statement:
theorem K0DegreeZeroMap_comp_inv :
    hA.K0DegreeZeroMap.comp hA.K0DegreeZeroInv = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine AddMonoidHom.eq_of_eqOn_dense (hA.isGradedPositive_degreeZeroDGSubring
    |>.isPositive_weightCategory.closure_cell_eq_top.{max u w}) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, K0DegreeZeroInv_cell, K0DegreeZeroMap_cell,
    map_inclFunctor_map_projFunctor, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.K0DegreeZeroMap_T_smul
statement:
theorem K0DegreeZeroMap_T_smul (s : ℤ) (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory A)) :
    hA.K0DegreeZeroMap ((LaurentPolynomial.T s : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x) =
      (LaurentPolynomial.T s : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • hA.K0DegreeZeroMap x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun c : SimpleCorner (WeightCategory A) =>
      DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} c.1.2 0) := by
    rw [hA.isPositive_weightCategory.closure_cell_eq_top.{max u w}]
    trivial
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨k, e⟩, -⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    let e' := WeightCategory.idempotentAt e ⟨k.as - s⟩
    rw [WeightCategory.T_smul_cell.{max u w} s e e' rfl rfl, K0DegreeZeroMap_cell,
      K0DegreeZeroMap_cell,
      WeightCategory.T_smul_cell.{max u w} s (e.map hA.projFunctor) (e'.map hA.projFunctor) rfl
        rfl]
  | zero => rw [_root_.smul_zero, map_zero, _root_.smul_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [_root_.smul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, _root_.smul_add]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [_root_.smul_neg, map_neg, map_neg, hx, _root_.smul_neg]

name: DG.IsGradedDivisionRing.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_one
statement:
theorem IsGradedDivisionRing.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_one (h : IsGradedDivisionRing 𝒜) :
    IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1, fun _ _ hx _ hx0 => h.2 hx hx0⟩

name: DG.IsGradedDivisionRing.isGradedSemisimpleRing
statement:
theorem IsGradedDivisionRing.isGradedSemisimpleRing [DecidableEq ι] [GradedRing 𝒜]
    (h : IsGradedDivisionRing 𝒜) : IsGradedSemisimpleRing 𝒜
proof:
:= by
  refine isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_exists_list.mpr ⟨[1], fun e he => ?_,
    List.pairwise_singleton _ _, List.sum_singleton⟩
  rw [List.mem_singleton] at he
  subst he
  exact ⟨SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem, IsIdempotentElem.one, h.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_one⟩

name: DG.mem_concentratedGrading_iff
statement: theorem mem_concentratedGrading_iff {i : ι} {x : R} : x ∈ concentratedGrading ι R i ↔ i = 0 ∨ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold concentratedGrading
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: DG.isGradedDivisionRing_concentratedGrading
statement:
theorem isGradedDivisionRing_concentratedGrading (D : Type*) [DivisionRing D] :
    IsGradedDivisionRing (concentratedGrading ι D)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨one_ne_zero, fun i x hx hx0 => ⟨x⁻¹, ?_, inv_mul_cancel₀ hx0⟩⟩
  rcases mem_concentratedGrading_iff.mp hx with rfl | h
  · exact mem_concentratedGrading_iff.mpr (Or.inl neg_zero)
  · exact absurd h hx0

name: DG.mem_matrixGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_matrixGrading_iff {i : ι} {x : Matrix n n R} :
    x ∈ matrixGrading 𝒜 p i ↔ ∀ a b, x a b ∈ 𝒜 (i + p a - p b)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.single_mem_matrixGrading
statement:
theorem single_mem_matrixGrading {a b : n} {i : ι} {y : R} (hy : y ∈ 𝒜 (i + p a - p b)) :
    Matrix.single a b y ∈ matrixGrading 𝒜 p i
proof:
:= by
  intro a' b'
  by_cases h : a = a' ∧ b = b'
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    rwa [Matrix.single_apply_same]
  · rw [Matrix.single_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ h]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.coe_matrixComponent_apply
statement:
theorem coe_matrixComponent_apply (i : ι) (x : Matrix n n R) (a b : n) :
    (matrixComponent 𝒜 p i x : Matrix n n R) a b = decompose 𝒜 (x a b) (i + p a - p b)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.sum_coe_decompose
statement: theorem sum_coe_decompose (r : R) : ∑ j, (decompose 𝒜 r j : R) = r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 r]
  refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _) fun j _ hj => ?_).symm
  rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hj, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: DG.IsGradedDivisionRing.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_single
statement:
theorem IsGradedDivisionRing.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_single (h : IsGradedDivisionRing 𝒜)
    (c : n) : IsGradedSimpleIdempotent (matrixGrading 𝒜 p) (Matrix.single c c (1 : R))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h0 => h.1 (by rw [← Matrix.single_apply_same c c (1 : R), h0]; rfl),
    fun j x hx hxc hx0 => ?_⟩
  have hcol : ∀ a b, b ≠ c → x a b = 0 := fun a b hb => by
    rw [← hxc, Matrix.mul_single_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ hb]
  obtain ⟨a, hac⟩ : ∃ a, x a c ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! hall
    exact hx0 (Matrix.ext fun a b => by
      by_cases hb : b = c
      · subst hb; exact hall a
      · exact hcol a b hb)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := h.2 (hx a c) hac
  refine ⟨Matrix.single c a y, single_mem_matrixGrading (by
    rwa [show -j + p c - p a = -(j + p a - p c) by abel]), Matrix.ext fun r s => ?_⟩
  by_cases hr : r = c
  · subst hr
    rw [Matrix.single_mul_apply_same]
    by_cases hs : s = r
    · subst hs
      rw [hyx, Matrix.single_apply_same]
    · rw [hcol a s hs, mul_zero, Matrix.single_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ (fun h => hs h.2.symm)]
  · rw [Matrix.single_mul_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ hr,
      Matrix.single_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ _ (fun h => hr h.1.symm)]

name: DG.IsGradedDivisionRing.isGradedSemisimpleRing_matrixGrading
statement:
theorem IsGradedDivisionRing.isGradedSemisimpleRing_matrixGrading (h : IsGradedDivisionRing 𝒜) :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing (matrixGrading 𝒜 p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_exists_list.mpr
    ⟨(Finset.univ : Finset n).toList.map fun c => Matrix.single c c (1 : R),
      fun e he => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
    refine ⟨single_mem_matrixGrading (by
        rw [zero_add, sub_self]
        exact SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem),
      by rw [IsIdempotentElem, Matrix.single_mul_single_same, mul_one],
      h.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_single p c⟩
  · rw [List.pairwise_map]
    exact (Finset.nodup_toList _).imp fun hab =>
      ⟨Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ hab _,
        Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ (Ne.symm hab) _⟩
  · rw [Finset.sum_map_toList]
    exact Matrix.sum_single_one

name: DG.isGradedDivisionRing_groupAlgebraGrading
statement:
theorem isGradedDivisionRing_groupAlgebraGrading :
    IsGradedDivisionRing (groupAlgebraGrading K G)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨one_ne_zero, fun g x hx hx0 => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_grade_iff' K g x).mp hx
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := fun h => hx0 (by rw [h, map_zero])
  refine ⟨AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-g) a⁻¹, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mem_grade _ _, ?_⟩
  change AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-g) a⁻¹ * AddMonoidAlgebra.single g a = 1
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, neg_add_cancel, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]

name: DG.isGradedSemisimpleRing_superMatrix
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_superMatrix (D : Type*) [DivisionRing D] (m n : ℕ) :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing (matrixGrading (concentratedGrading (ZMod 2) D) (superParity m n))
proof:
:=
  (isGradedDivisionRing_concentratedGrading (ZMod 2) D).isGradedSemisimpleRing_matrixGrading _

name: DG.isGradedSemisimpleRing_queerMatrix
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_queerMatrix (K : Type*) [Field K] (n : ℕ) :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing (matrixGrading (groupAlgebraGrading K (ZMod 2)) (0 : Fin n → ZMod 2))
proof:
:=
  (isGradedDivisionRing_groupAlgebraGrading K (ZMod 2)).isGradedSemisimpleRing_matrixGrading _

name: DG.InternalShift.mem_wgrading_iff

name: DG.InternalShift.mem_wgrading_iff'

theorem mem_wgrading_iff' {j : ℤ} {m : InternalShift k M} :

name: DG.InternalShift.coe_decompose_wgrading
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_wgrading (m : InternalShift k M) (j : ℤ) :
    unmk k (decompose (wgrading (M := InternalShift k M)) m j : InternalShift k M) =
      (decompose (wgrading (M := M)) (unmk k m) (j + k) : M)
proof:
:= by
  let : Decomposition fun j => wgrading (M := M) (Equiv.addRight k j) :=
    Decomposition.reindex (wgrading (M := M)) (Equiv.addRight k)
  change (decompose (fun j => wgrading (M := M) (Equiv.addRight k j)) (unmk k m) j : M) = _
  exact Decomposition.coe_decompose_reindex (wgrading (M := M)) (Equiv.addRight k) (unmk k m) j

name: DG.InternalShift.mem_wgrading_zeroEquiv_iff

name: DG.InternalShift.mem_wgrading_addEquiv_iff

name: DG.Shift.mem_wgrading_iff
statement: theorem mem_wgrading_iff {k : ℤ} {m : M} : mk n m ∈ wgrading k ↔ m ∈ wgrading k

name: DG.Shift.mem_wgrading_iff'
statement: theorem mem_wgrading_iff' {k : ℤ} {m : Shift n M} : m ∈ wgrading k ↔ unmk n m ∈ wgrading k

name: DG.Shift.twist_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem twist_mem_wgrading {k : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ wgrading k) :
    twist A n a ∈ wgrading k
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_wgrading A k) (P := fun a =>
    twist A n a ∈ wgrading k) ?_ (fun {i b} hb hbk => ?_) (fun b b' hb hb' => ?_) ha
  · show twist A n 0 ∈ wgrading k
    rw [map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  · show twist A n b ∈ wgrading k
    rw [twist_of_mem hb, Units.smul_def]
    exact zsmul_mem hbk _
  · simp only [map_add]
    exact add_mem hb hb'

name: DirectSum.Decomposition.coe_decompose_reindex
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_reindex [Decomposition fun k => ℳ (e k)] (m : M) (k : κ) :
    (decompose (fun k => ℳ (e k)) m k : M) = decompose ℳ m (e k)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn ℳ with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous x =>
    rename_i i
    have hx : (x : M) ∈ (fun k => ℳ (e k)) (e.symm i) := by
      simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]; exact x.2
    by_cases h : e.symm i = k
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same (fun k => ℳ (e k)) hx,
        decompose_of_mem_same ℳ (show (x : M) ∈ ℳ (e (e.symm i)) from hx)]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne (fun k => ℳ (e k)) hx h, decompose_of_mem_ne ℳ x.2]
      rintro rfl
      exact h (e.symm_apply_apply k)
  | add m m' hm hm' => simp only [decompose_add, add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.decompose_decompose_coeAddMonoidHom_inf
statement:
theorem decompose_decompose_coeAddMonoidHom_inf
    (y : ⨁ p : ι × κ, (ℳ p.1 ⊓ 𝒩 p.2 : AddSubgroup M)) (p : ι × κ) :
    (decompose 𝒩 (decompose ℳ
      (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (fun p : ι × κ => ℳ p.1 ⊓ 𝒩 p.2) y) p.1 : M) p.2 : M) =
      (y p : M)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of q x =>
    rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
    obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := x
    by_cases h : q = p
    · subst h
      rw [of_eq_same, decompose_of_mem_same ℳ hx₁, decompose_of_mem_same 𝒩 hx₂]
    · rw [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm h), ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
      by_cases h₁ : q.1 = p.1
      · have h₂ : q.2 ≠ p.2 := fun h₂ => h (Prod.ext h₁ h₂)
        rw [← h₁, decompose_of_mem_same ℳ hx₁, decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒩 hx₂ h₂]
      · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne ℳ hx₁ h₁]
        simp
  | add y y' hy hy' =>
    simp only [map_add, decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hy, hy']

name: DG.isInternal_inf_iff
statement:
theorem isInternal_inf_iff :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (fun p : ι × κ => ℳ p.1 ⊓ 𝒩 p.2) ↔
      ∀ i, SetLike.IsHomogeneous 𝒩 (ℳ i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j m hm
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := h.2 m
    have key := decompose_decompose_coeAddMonoidHom_inf ℳ 𝒩 y (i, j)
    rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hm] at key
    rw [key]
    exact (y (i, j)).2.1
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun y hy => ?_, fun m => ?_⟩
    · ext p
      rw [← decompose_decompose_coeAddMonoidHom_inf ℳ 𝒩 y p, hy]
      simp
    · classical
      suffices hm : m ∈ (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (fun p : ι × κ => ℳ p.1 ⊓ 𝒩 p.2)).range from
        hm
      induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn ℳ with
      | zero => exact zero_mem _
      | homogeneous x =>
        rename_i i
        rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒩 (x : M)]
        refine sum_mem fun j _ => ⟨DirectSum.of (fun p : ι × κ => (ℳ p.1 ⊓ 𝒩 p.2 : AddSubgroup M))
          (i, j) ⟨_, h i j x.2, (decompose 𝒩 (x : M) j).2⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
      | add m m' hm hm' => exact add_mem hm hm'

name: DG.isInternal_comap
statement:
theorem isInternal_comap (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hhom : ∀ (i : ι) (t : T), (decompose ℳ (f t) i : M) ∈ f.range) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal fun i => (ℳ i).comap f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r : (⨁ i, (ℳ i).comap f) →+ ⨁ i, ℳ i :=
    DirectSum.map fun i => (f.domRestrict ((ℳ i).comap f)).codRestrict (ℳ i) fun t => t.2
  have key : ∀ x, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ (r x) =
      f (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (fun i => (ℳ i).comap f) x) := by
    intro x
    induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of i t => simp [r]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have h : r x = r y := (Decomposition.isInternal ℳ).injective (by rw [key, key, hxy])
    rw [DirectSum.map_eq_iff] at h
    ext i
    exact hf (by simpa using h i)
  · intro t
    choose s hs using fun i => hhom i t
    refine ⟨∑ i ∈ (decompose ℳ (f t)).support,
      DirectSum.of (fun i => (ℳ i).comap f) i ⟨s i, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [AddSubgroup.mem_comap, hs]; exact Subtype.property _
    · apply hf
      simp only [map_sum, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
      conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose ℳ (f t)]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hs i

name: DG.coe_decompose_comap
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_comap [Decomposition fun i => (ℳ i).comap f] (t : T) (i : ι) :
    f (decompose (fun i => (ℳ i).comap f) t i) = decompose ℳ (f t) i
proof:
:= by
  induction t using Decomposition.inductionOn (fun i => (ℳ i).comap f) with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous x =>
    rename_i j
    by_cases h : j = i
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same (fun i => (ℳ i).comap f) x.2,
        decompose_of_mem_same ℳ (show f x ∈ ℳ j from x.2)]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne (fun i => (ℳ i).comap f) x.2 h,
        decompose_of_mem_ne ℳ (show f x ∈ ℳ j from x.2) h, map_zero]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, map_add, ht, ht']

name: DG.isHomogeneous_grading
statement: theorem isHomogeneous_grading (n : ℤ) : SetLike.IsHomogeneous (wgrading (M := M)) (grading n)
proof:
:=
  InternalGrading.isHomogeneous_grading' n

name: DG.decompose_wgrading_mem_grading
statement:
theorem decompose_wgrading_mem_grading {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) (k : ℤ) :
    (decompose (wgrading (M := M)) m k : M) ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  isHomogeneous_grading M n k hm

name: DG.d_mem_wgrading
statement: theorem d_mem_wgrading {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ wgrading k) : d m ∈ wgrading k
proof:
:=
  InternalGrading.d_mem_wgrading' hm

name: DG.decompose_wgrading_decompose_grading
statement:
theorem decompose_wgrading_decompose_grading (m : M) (n k : ℤ) :
    (decompose (wgrading (M := M)) (decompose (grading (M := M)) m n : M) k : M) =
      decompose (grading (M := M)) (decompose (wgrading (M := M)) m k : M) n
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i i
    have hx := decompose_wgrading_mem_grading x.2 k
    by_cases h : i = n
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ x.2, decompose_of_mem_same _ hx]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ x.2 h, decompose_of_mem_ne _ hx h]
      simp
  | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
    simp only [decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.isHomogeneous_wgrading
statement: theorem isHomogeneous_wgrading (k : ℤ) : SetLike.IsHomogeneous (grading (M := M)) (wgrading k)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hm
  rw [← decompose_of_mem_same _ hm, ← decompose_wgrading_decompose_grading]
  exact (decompose (wgrading (M := M)) _ k).2

name: DG.decompose_grading_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem decompose_grading_mem_wgrading {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ wgrading k) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := M)) m n : M) ∈ wgrading k
proof:
:=
  isHomogeneous_wgrading M k n hm

name: DG.decompose_wgrading_d
statement:
theorem decompose_wgrading_d (m : M) (k : ℤ) :
    (decompose (wgrading (M := M)) (d m) k : M) = d (decompose (wgrading (M := M)) m k : M)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn (wgrading (M := M)) with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous x =>
    rename_i j
    by_cases h : j = k
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ x.2, decompose_of_mem_same _ (d_mem_wgrading x.2)]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ x.2 h, decompose_of_mem_ne _ (d_mem_wgrading x.2) h, d_zero]
  | add m m' hm hm' => simp only [d_add, decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.isHomogeneous_wgrading_ker_d
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_wgrading_ker_d :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (wgrading (M := M)) (d : M →+ M).ker
proof:
:= by
  intro k m hm
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker] at hm ⊢
  rw [← decompose_wgrading_d, hm, decompose_zero, zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: DG.isHomogeneous_wgrading_cocycles
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_wgrading_cocycles (n : ℤ) :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (wgrading (M := M)) (cocycles M n)
proof:
:=
  fun k _ hm => ⟨decompose_wgrading_mem_grading hm.1 k, isHomogeneous_wgrading_ker_d k hm.2⟩

name: DG.isHomogeneous_wgrading_coboundaries
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_wgrading_coboundaries (n : ℤ) :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (wgrading (M := M)) (coboundaries M n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro k _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, decompose_wgrading_mem_grading hm k, (decompose_wgrading_d m k).symm⟩

name: DG.mem_bigrading
statement:
theorem mem_bigrading {p : ℤ × ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ bigrading M p ↔ m ∈ grading p.1 ∧ m ∈ wgrading p.2
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.mem_inf

name: DG.isInternal_bigrading
statement: theorem isInternal_bigrading : DirectSum.IsInternal (bigrading M)
proof:
:=
  (isInternal_inf_iff (grading (M := M)) (wgrading (M := M))).mpr (isHomogeneous_grading M)

name: DG.coe_decompose_bigrading
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_bigrading (m : M) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    (decompose (bigrading M) m p : M) =
      decompose (wgrading (M := M)) (decompose (grading (M := M)) m p.1 : M) p.2
proof:
:= by
  have h := decompose_decompose_coeAddMonoidHom_inf (grading (M := M)) (wgrading (M := M))
    (decompose (bigrading M) m) p
  have hm : DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => grading (M := M) p.1 ⊓ wgrading p.2)
      (decompose (bigrading M) m) = m :=
    (decompose (bigrading M)).symm_apply_apply m
  rw [hm] at h
  exact h.symm

name: DG.d_mem_bigrading
statement:
theorem d_mem_bigrading {n k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ bigrading M (n, k)) :
    d m ∈ bigrading M (n + 1, k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨d_mem hm.1, d_mem_wgrading hm.2⟩

name: DG.one_mem_wgrading
statement: theorem one_mem_wgrading : (1 : A) ∈ wgrading (M := A) 0
proof:
:=
  SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem

name: DG.mul_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem mul_mem_wgrading {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ wgrading i) (hb : b ∈ wgrading j) :
    a * b ∈ wgrading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ha hb

name: DG.smul_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem smul_mem_wgrading {i j : ℤ} {a : A} {m : M} (ha : a ∈ wgrading i)
    (hm : m ∈ wgrading j) : a • m ∈ wgrading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem ha hm

name: DG.HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_spanSingleton
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HomogeneousIdeal.le_iff_toIdeal_le
statement: theorem le_iff_toIdeal_le {I J : _root_.HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜} : I ≤ J ↔ I.toIdeal ≤ J.toIdeal
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.HomogeneousIdeal.isCompactElement_spanSingleton
statement:
theorem isCompactElement_spanSingleton {a : R} {i : ι} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    IsCompactElement (spanSingleton 𝒜 ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCompactElement_iff_le_of_directed_sSup_le]
  intro D hne hdir hle
  have hmem : a ∈ (sSup D).toIdeal := le_iff_toIdeal_le.mp hle (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_sSup, ← sSup_image] at hmem
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hay⟩ := (Submodule.mem_sSup_of_directed (hne.image _)
    (directedOn_image.mpr (hdir.mono fun _ _ h => le_iff_toIdeal_le.mp h))).mp hmem
  exact ⟨x, hx, le_iff_toIdeal_le.mpr ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hay)⟩

name: DG.HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton_one
statement: theorem spanSingleton_one : spanSingleton 𝒜 (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := 𝒜)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  HomogeneousIdeal.ext (by
    rw [toIdeal_spanSingleton, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_top, Ideal.span_singleton_one])

name: DG.HomogeneousIdeal.isCompactElement_top
statement: theorem isCompactElement_top : IsCompactElement (⊤ : _root_.HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← spanSingleton_one]
  exact isCompactElement_spanSingleton _

name: DG.exists_add_of_inf_eq_bot
statement:
theorem exists_add_of_inf_eq_bot {g : R} (hg : IsIdempotentElem g) {S T : Ideal R}
    (hST : S ⊓ T = ⊥) (hsup : S ⊔ T = Ideal.span {g}) :
    ∃ s t : R, s ∈ S ∧ t ∈ T ∧ s + t = g ∧ IsIdempotentElem s ∧ IsIdempotentElem t ∧
      s * t = 0 ∧ t * s = 0 ∧ Ideal.span {s} = S ∧ Ideal.span {t} = T
proof:
:= by
  have hgmem : g ∈ S ⊔ T := hsup ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl
  obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ht, hst⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hgmem
  have hdisj : ∀ x, x ∈ S → x ∈ T → x = 0 := fun x hxS hxT => by
    have : x ∈ S ⊓ T := ⟨hxS, hxT⟩
    rwa [hST, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  have hmem : ∀ x ∈ S ⊔ T, x * g = x := fun x hx =>
    (mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq hg).mp (show x ∈ Ideal.span {g} by rw [← hsup]; exact hx)
  have hsplit : ∀ x ∈ S ⊔ T, x * s + x * t = x := fun x hx => by
    rw [← mul_add, hst, hmem x hx]
  have hS : ∀ x ∈ S, x * s = x ∧ x * t = 0 := fun x hx => by
    have h := hsplit x (Submodule.mem_sup_left hx)
    have h0 : x * t = 0 := hdisj _ (by
      rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq' h]
      exact S.sub_mem hx (S.smul_mem x hs)) (T.smul_mem x ht)
    exact ⟨by rw [h0, add_zero] at h; exact h, h0⟩
  have hT : ∀ x ∈ T, x * t = x ∧ x * s = 0 := fun x hx => by
    have h := hsplit x (Submodule.mem_sup_right hx)
    have h0 : x * s = 0 := hdisj _ (S.smul_mem x hs) (by
      rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq h]
      exact T.sub_mem hx (T.smul_mem x ht))
    exact ⟨by rw [h0, zero_add] at h; exact h, h0⟩
  have hsI : IsIdempotentElem s := (hS s hs).1
  have htI : IsIdempotentElem t := (hT t ht).1
  refine ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, hsI, htI, (hS s hs).2, (hT t ht).2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine le_antisymm ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hs) fun x hx => ?_
    exact (mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq hsI).mpr (hS x hx).1
  · refine le_antisymm ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr ht) fun x hx => ?_
    exact (mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq htI).mpr (hT x hx).1

name: DG.mem_zero_of_add_eq
statement:
theorem mem_zero_of_add_eq {S T : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜} (hST : S ⊓ T = ⊥) {s t g : R}
    (hs : s ∈ S) (ht : t ∈ T) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 0) (hsum : s + t = g) : s ∈ 𝒜 0 ∧ t ∈ 𝒜 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s₀ := (decompose 𝒜 s 0 : R)
  set t₀ := (decompose 𝒜 t 0 : R)
  have hs₀ : s₀ ∈ S := S.isHomogeneous 0 hs
  have ht₀ : t₀ ∈ T := T.isHomogeneous 0 ht
  have h0 : s₀ + t₀ = g := by
    rw [← decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hg, ← hsum, decompose_add, add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add]
  have hd : s - s₀ = t₀ - t := by
    rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, hsum, add_comm, h0]
  have hmem : s - s₀ ∈ S.toIdeal ⊓ T.toIdeal :=
    ⟨S.toIdeal.sub_mem hs hs₀, hd ▸ T.toIdeal.sub_mem ht₀ ht⟩
  rw [← HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_inf, hST, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_bot] at hmem
  have hs' : s = s₀ := sub_eq_zero.mp ((Submodule.mem_bot R).mp hmem)
  have ht' : t = t₀ := by
    rw [hs', sub_self] at hd
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hd.symm).symm
  exact ⟨hs' ▸ SetLike.coe_mem _, ht' ▸ SetLike.coe_mem _⟩

name: DG.isGradedSimpleIdempotent_of_isAtom
statement:
theorem isGradedSimpleIdempotent_of_isAtom {s : R} (hs0 : s ∈ 𝒜 0) (hs : IsIdempotentElem s)
    (hat : IsAtom (HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hs0)) : IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h => hat.1 (HomogeneousIdeal.ext ?_), fun j h hh hhs hh0 => ?_⟩
  · rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_spanSingleton, h, Set.singleton_zero, Ideal.span_zero]
    rfl
  · have hle : HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hh ≤ HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hs0 :=
      HomogeneousIdeal.le_iff_toIdeal_le.mpr ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr
        ((mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq hs).mpr hhs))
    rcases hat.le_iff.mp hle with h' | h'
    · exfalso
      apply hh0
      have : h ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hh).toIdeal := Ideal.subset_span rfl
      rw [h'] at this
      exact this
    · have : s ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hh).toIdeal := by
        rw [h']
        exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp this
      refine ⟨decompose 𝒜 g (-j), SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
      have := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem 𝒜 (a := g) (i := -j) hh
      rw [neg_add_cancel, decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hs0] at this
      exact this.symm

name: DG.isAtom_of_isGradedSimpleIdempotent
statement:
theorem isAtom_of_isGradedSimpleIdempotent {s : R} (hs0 : s ∈ 𝒜 0) (hs : IsIdempotentElem s)
    (hsimple : IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 s) : IsAtom (HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hs0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h => hsimple.1 ?_, fun J hJ => ?_⟩
  · have : s ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hs0).toIdeal := Ideal.subset_span rfl
    rw [h] at this
    exact this
  · by_contra hJ0
    obtain ⟨x, hxJ, hx0⟩ := J.toIdeal.ne_bot_iff.mp fun h =>
      hJ0 (HomogeneousIdeal.ext (by rw [h]; rfl))
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, (decompose 𝒜 x j : R) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h
      apply hx0
      rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 x]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => h i
    set h := (decompose 𝒜 x j : R)
    have hhJ : h ∈ J := J.isHomogeneous j hxJ
    have hhs : h * s = h := (mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq hs).mp (hJ.le hhJ)
    obtain ⟨g, -, hgh⟩ := hsimple.2 (SetLike.coe_mem _) hhs hj
    apply hJ.2
    refine HomogeneousIdeal.le_iff_toIdeal_le.mpr ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr ?_)
    rw [← hgh]
    exact J.toIdeal.mul_mem_left g hhJ

name: DG.exists_list_of_finset
statement:
theorem exists_list_of_finset (t : Finset (HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜)) :
    sSupIndep (t : Set (HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜)) → (∀ a ∈ t, IsAtom a) → ∀ {g : R} (hg0 : g ∈ 𝒜 0),
      IsIdempotentElem g → HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hg0 = t.sup id →
      ∃ l : List R, (∀ e ∈ l, e ∈ 𝒜 0 ∧ IsIdempotentElem e ∧ IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 e) ∧
        l.Pairwise (fun a b => a * b = 0 ∧ b * a = 0) ∧ l.sum = g ∧
        ∀ e ∈ l, e * g = e ∧ g * e = e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro _ _ g hg0 _ hgt
    have : g ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hg0).toIdeal := Ideal.subset_span rfl
    rw [hgt, Finset.sup_empty, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_bot] at this
    exact ⟨[], by simp, List.Pairwise.nil, ((Submodule.mem_bot R).mp this).symm, by simp⟩
  | insert a t hat ih =>
    intro hind hatom g hg0 hg hgt
    have hdisj : a ⊓ t.sup id = ⊥ := by
      have := hind (Finset.mem_insert_self a t)
      refine (this.mono_right ?_).eq_bot
      refine Finset.sup_le fun b hb => le_sSup ⟨Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb, ?_⟩
      rintro rfl
      exact hat hb
    have hST : a.toIdeal ⊓ (t.sup id).toIdeal = ⊥ := by
      rw [← HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_inf, hdisj, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_bot]
    have hsup : a.toIdeal ⊔ (t.sup id).toIdeal = Ideal.span {g} := by
      have e1 := congrArg HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal (hgt.trans (Finset.sup_insert (f := id)))
      rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_sup] at e1
      exact e1.symm
    obtain ⟨s, u, hs, hu, hsu, hsI, huI, hsu0, hus0, hspan_s, hspan_u⟩ :=
      exists_add_of_inf_eq_bot hg hST hsup
    obtain ⟨hs0, hu0⟩ := mem_zero_of_add_eq hdisj hs hu hg0 hsu
    have hsa : HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hs0 = a := HomogeneousIdeal.ext hspan_s
    have hut : HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 hu0 = t.sup id := HomogeneousIdeal.ext hspan_u
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hlp, hlsum, hlg⟩ := ih (hind.mono (by simp))
      (fun b hb => hatom b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb)) hu0 huI hut
    have hssimple : IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 s :=
      isGradedSimpleIdempotent_of_isAtom hs0 hsI (hsa ▸ hatom a (Finset.mem_insert_self a t))
    have hsg : s * g = s := by rw [← hsu, mul_add, hsI.eq, hsu0, add_zero]
    have hgs : g * s = s := by rw [← hsu, add_mul, hsI.eq, hus0, add_zero]
    refine ⟨s :: l, fun x hx => ?_, List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨fun x hx => ?_, hlp⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact ⟨hs0, hsI, hssimple⟩
      · exact hl x hx
    · obtain ⟨hxu, hux⟩ := hlg x hx
      exact ⟨by rw [← hux, ← mul_assoc, hsu0, zero_mul], by rw [← hxu, mul_assoc, hus0, mul_zero]⟩
    · rw [List.sum_cons, hlsum, hsu]
    · intro x hx
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx
      · exact ⟨hsg, hgs⟩
      · obtain ⟨hxu, hux⟩ := hlg x hx
        have hxs : x * s = 0 := by rw [← hxu, mul_assoc, hus0, mul_zero]
        have hsx : s * x = 0 := by rw [← hux, ← mul_assoc, hsu0, zero_mul]
        exact ⟨by rw [← hsu, mul_add, hxs, zero_add, hxu],
          by rw [← hsu, add_mul, hsx, zero_add, hux]⟩

name: DG.IsGradedSemisimpleRing.exists_list_sum_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsGradedSemisimpleRing.exists_list_sum_eq_one (h : IsGradedSemisimpleRing 𝒜) :
    ∃ l : List R, (∀ e ∈ l, e ∈ 𝒜 0 ∧ IsIdempotentElem e ∧ IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 e) ∧
      l.Pairwise (fun a b => a * b = 0 ∧ b * a = 0) ∧ l.sum = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : ComplementedLattice (HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) := h
  obtain ⟨s, hind, htop, hatoms⟩ := exists_sSupIndep_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top
    (α := HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) sSup_atoms_eq_top
  obtain ⟨t, hts, htop'⟩ := (isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_sSup_of_le_sSup _).mp
    (HomogeneousIdeal.isCompactElement_top 𝒜) s htop.ge
  have ht : t.sup id = ⊤ := top_le_iff.mp htop'
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hlp, hlsum, -⟩ := exists_list_of_finset t (hind.mono hts)
    (fun a ha => hatoms (hts ha)) (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := 𝒜)) IsIdempotentElem.one
    (by rw [ht, HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton_one])
  exact ⟨l, hl, hlp, hlsum⟩

name: DG.isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_exists_list
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_exists_list :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing 𝒜 ↔
      ∃ l : List R, (∀ e ∈ l, e ∈ 𝒜 0 ∧ IsIdempotentElem e ∧ IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 e) ∧
        l.Pairwise (fun a b => a * b = 0 ∧ b * a = 0) ∧ l.sum = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h.exists_list_sum_eq_one, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨l, hl, -, hsum⟩
  refine complementedLattice_of_sSup_atoms_eq_top (eq_top_iff.mpr ?_)
  rw [← HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton_one 𝒜]
  refine HomogeneousIdeal.le_iff_toIdeal_le.mpr ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr ?_)
  rw [← hsum]
  refine list_sum_mem fun e he => ?_
  obtain ⟨he0, heI, hes⟩ := hl e he
  have hle : HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 he0 ≤ sSup {a : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜 | IsAtom a} :=
    le_sSup (isAtom_of_isGradedSimpleIdempotent he0 heI hes)
  exact HomogeneousIdeal.le_iff_toIdeal_le.mp hle (Ideal.subset_span rfl)

name: DG.exists_isCompl_homogeneousIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_isCompl_homogeneousIdeal [ComplementedLattice (Ideal R)]
    (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) : ∃ J : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜, IsCompl I J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := exists_isCompl I.toIdeal
  obtain ⟨e, f, he, -, hef, heI, -, -, -, hspan, -⟩ := exists_add_of_inf_eq_bot
    IsIdempotentElem.one hJ.inf_eq_bot (by rw [hJ.sup_eq_top, Ideal.span_singleton_one])
  set e₀ := (decompose 𝒜 e 0 : R) with he₀def
  have he₀0 : e₀ ∈ 𝒜 0 := SetLike.coe_mem _
  have he₀I : e₀ ∈ I := I.isHomogeneous 0 he
  
  have hhom : ∀ j (x : R), x ∈ 𝒜 j → x ∈ I → x * e₀ = x := by
    intro j x hxj hxI
    have hxe : x * e = x := (mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq heI).mp
      (show x ∈ Ideal.span {e} by rw [hspan]; exact hxI)
    have := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem 𝒜 (b := e) (j := 0) hxj
    rw [add_zero, hxe, decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hxj] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hmul : ∀ x ∈ I, x * e₀ = x := by
    intro x hxI
    rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 x, Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
      hhom j _ (SetLike.coe_mem _) (I.isHomogeneous j hxI)
  have he₀I' : IsIdempotentElem e₀ := hmul e₀ he₀I
  have h1e : (1 : R) - e₀ ∈ 𝒜 0 := sub_mem (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := 𝒜)) he₀0
  refine ⟨HomogeneousIdeal.spanSingleton 𝒜 h1e, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [disjoint_iff, ← HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_injective.eq_iff, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_inf,
      HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_bot, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_spanSingleton, eq_bot_iff]
    rintro x ⟨hxI, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot, ← hmul _ hxI, mul_assoc, sub_mul, one_mul, he₀I'.eq, sub_self,
      mul_zero]
  · rw [codisjoint_iff, ← HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_injective.eq_iff,
      HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_sup, HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_top, eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    rw [show x = x * e₀ + x * (1 - e₀) by rw [← mul_add, add_sub_cancel, mul_one]]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (I.toIdeal.mul_mem_left x he₀I)
      (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ x (Ideal.subset_span rfl))

name: DG.isGradedSemisimpleRing_of_isSemisimpleRing
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_of_isSemisimpleRing [IsSemisimpleRing R] :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing 𝒜
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun I => exists_isCompl_homogeneousIdeal I⟩

name: DG.decompose_mul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [decompose_mul, coe_mul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ij hij => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hij
  by_cases hi : a < ij.1
  · rw [hx _ hi, zero_mul]
  · rw [hy _ (by omega), mul_zero]

name: DG.decompose_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem decompose_pow_eq_zero {x : R} (hx : ∀ i, -1 < i → (decompose 𝒜 x i : R) = 0) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, -(j : ℤ) < n → (decompose 𝒜 (x ^ j) n : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro n hn
    rw [pow_zero, decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := 𝒜) : (1 : R) ∈ 𝒜 0)
      (by omega)]
  | succ j ih =>
    intro n hn
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact decompose_mul_eq_zero ih hx (by omega)

name: DG.eq_zero_of_decompose_eq_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_decompose_eq_zero {x : R} (h : ∀ i, (decompose 𝒜 x i : R) = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 x]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => h i

name: DG.isNilpotent_of_decompose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_of_decompose_eq_zero (hbdd : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ 𝒜 k, x = 0) {x : R}
    (hx : ∀ i, -1 < i → (decompose 𝒜 x i : R) = 0) : IsNilpotent x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hbdd
  refine ⟨N.natAbs + 1, eq_zero_of_decompose_eq_zero (𝒜 := 𝒜) fun i => ?_⟩
  by_cases hi : -((N.natAbs + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) < i
  · exact decompose_pow_eq_zero hx _ i hi
  · exact hN i (by omega) _ (SetLike.coe_mem _)

name: DG.isSimpleModule_of_isGradedSimpleIdempotent
statement:
theorem isSimpleModule_of_isGradedSimpleIdempotent
    (hbdd : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ 𝒜 k, x = 0) {e : R} (he0 : e ∈ 𝒜 0)
    (heI : IsIdempotentElem e) (hs : IsGradedSimpleIdempotent 𝒜 e) :
    IsSimpleModule R (Ideal.span {e})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom]
  refine ⟨fun h => hs.1 (by
    have : e ∈ Ideal.span {e} := Ideal.subset_span rfl
    rw [h] at this
    exact this), fun N hN => ?_⟩
  by_contra hN0
  obtain ⟨s, hsN, hs0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hN0
  have hse : s * e = s := (mem_span_singleton_iff_mul_eq heI).mp (hN.le hsN)
  
  have hsupp : (decompose 𝒜 s).support.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
    exact hs0 (eq_zero_of_decompose_eq_zero fun i => by
      have : i ∉ (decompose 𝒜 s).support := by rw [h]; exact Finset.notMem_empty i
      rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff] at this
      rw [this, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero])
  set m := (decompose 𝒜 s).support.max' hsupp
  have htop : ∀ k, m < k → (decompose 𝒜 s k : R) = 0 := fun k hk => by
    have : k ∉ (decompose 𝒜 s).support := fun hk' =>
      absurd ((decompose 𝒜 s).support.le_max' k hk') (not_le.mpr hk)
    rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff] at this
    rw [this, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  have hsm0 : (decompose 𝒜 s m : R) ≠ 0 := by
    have := (decompose 𝒜 s).support.max'_mem hsupp
    rw [DFinsupp.mem_support_iff] at this
    exact fun h => this (Subtype.ext h)
  have hsme : (decompose 𝒜 s m : R) * e = decompose 𝒜 s m := by
    have := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem 𝒜 (a := s) (i := m) he0
    rw [add_zero, hse] at this
    exact this.symm
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgs⟩ := hs.2 (SetLike.coe_mem _) hsme hsm0
  
  set u := g * s
  have huN : u ∈ N := N.smul_mem g hsN
  have hue : u * e = u := by rw [mul_assoc, hse]
  have hu : ∀ k, -1 < k → (decompose 𝒜 (u - e) k : R) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have h1 := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem 𝒜 (b := s) (j := k + m) hg
    rw [show -m + (k + m) = k by ring] at h1
    rw [decompose_sub, DFinsupp.sub_apply, AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub, h1]
    rcases (show k = 0 ∨ 0 < k by omega) with rfl | hk0
    · rw [zero_add, hgs, decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 he0, sub_self]
    · rw [htop _ (by omega), mul_zero, decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 he0 (by omega), sub_zero]
  set n' := e * (u - e)
  have hn' : ∀ k, -1 < k → (decompose 𝒜 n' k : R) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem 𝒜 (b := u - e) (j := k) he0
    rw [zero_add] at this
    rw [this, hu k hk, mul_zero]
  have hnil : IsNilpotent n' := isNilpotent_of_decompose_eq_zero hbdd hn'
  have hn'e : n' * e = n' := by
    rw [mul_assoc, sub_mul, hue, heI.eq]
  have heu : e * u = e + n' := by
    change e * u = e + e * (u - e)
    rw [mul_sub, heI.eq, add_sub_cancel]
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hnil.isUnit_one_add
  have hmem : e ∈ N := by
    have : e = (↑U⁻¹ : R) * (e * u) := by
      rw [heu, ← hn'e, ← one_add_mul, ← hU, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact N.smul_mem _ (N.smul_mem e huN)
  exact hN.2 ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hmem)

name: DG.isSemisimpleRing_of_isGradedSemisimpleRing
statement:
theorem isSemisimpleRing_of_isGradedSemisimpleRing (h : IsGradedSemisimpleRing 𝒜)
    (hbdd : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ 𝒜 k, x = 0) : IsSemisimpleRing R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, -, hsum⟩ := h.exists_list_sum_eq_one
  refine isSemisimpleModule_of_isSemisimpleModule_submodule (s := {x | x ∈ l})
    (p := fun x => Ideal.span {x}) ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx0, hxI, hxs⟩ := hl x hx
    have := isSimpleModule_of_isGradedSimpleIdempotent hbdd hx0 hxI hxs
    infer_instance
  · rw [eq_top_iff, ← Ideal.span_singleton_one, Ideal.span, Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem,
      ← hsum]
    refine list_sum_mem fun x hx => ?_
    exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem x (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem hx (Ideal.subset_span rfl))

name: DG.exists_forall_lt_eq_zero_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem exists_forall_lt_eq_zero_of_finiteDimensional (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra K R]
    [FiniteDimensional K R] (h𝒜 : ∀ k (c : K) {x : R}, x ∈ 𝒜 k → c • x ∈ 𝒜 k) :
    ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ 𝒜 k, x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Set ℤ := {k | ∃ x ∈ 𝒜 k, x ≠ 0}
  choose v hv hv0 using fun k : S => k.2
  have hli : LinearIndependent K v := by
    rw [linearIndependent_iff']
    intro t c hc i hi
    have := congrArg (GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i.1) hc
    rw [map_sum, map_zero, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hji => by
        rw [GradedRing.proj_apply, decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 (h𝒜 j.1 (c j) (hv j))
          (fun h => hji (Subtype.ext h))])
      (fun hi' => absurd hi hi'), GradedRing.proj_apply,
      decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 (h𝒜 i.1 (c i) (hv i))] at this
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right (hv0 i)
  have hfin : S.Finite := Set.finite_coe_iff.mp hli.finite_of_isNoetherian
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hfin.bddBelow
  refine ⟨b, fun k hk x hx => ?_⟩
  by_contra hx0
  exact absurd (hb ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩) (not_le.mpr hk)

name: DG.isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_isSemisimpleRing
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_isSemisimpleRing (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra K R]
    [FiniteDimensional K R] (h𝒜 : ∀ k (c : K) {x : R}, x ∈ 𝒜 k → c • x ∈ 𝒜 k) :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing 𝒜 ↔ IsSemisimpleRing R
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => isSemisimpleRing_of_isGradedSemisimpleRing h
    (exists_forall_lt_eq_zero_of_finiteDimensional K h𝒜),
    fun _ => isGradedSemisimpleRing_of_isSemisimpleRing 𝒜⟩

name: DG.IsPositive.isGradedPositive
statement:
theorem IsPositive.isGradedPositive (hA : IsPositive A) : IsGradedPositive A where
  grading_eq_bot
proof:
:= hA.grading_eq_bot
  isGradedSemisimple := by
    have := hA.isSemisimple
    exact isGradedSemisimpleRing_of_isSemisimpleRing _
  d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero := hA.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero

name: DG.isGradedPositive_iff_isPositive_of_bddBelow
statement:
theorem isGradedPositive_iff_isPositive_of_bddBelow
    (hbdd : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ degreeZeroWGrading A k, x = 0) :
    IsGradedPositive A ↔ IsPositive A
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.grading_eq_bot, isSemisimpleRing_of_isGradedSemisimpleRing h.isGradedSemisimple hbdd,
    h.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero⟩, fun h => h.isGradedPositive⟩

name: DG.isGradedPositive_iff_isPositive
statement:
theorem isGradedPositive_iff_isPositive (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra K (degreeZeroSubring A)]
    [FiniteDimensional K (degreeZeroSubring A)]
    (hK : ∀ k (c : K) {x : degreeZeroSubring A}, x ∈ degreeZeroWGrading A k →
      c • x ∈ degreeZeroWGrading A k) :
    IsGradedPositive A ↔ IsPositive A
proof:
:=
  isGradedPositive_iff_isPositive_of_bddBelow
    (exists_forall_lt_eq_zero_of_finiteDimensional K hK)

name: DG.WeightCategory.val_congr
statement: theorem val_congr {k l : WeightCategory A} {f g : k ⟶ l} (h : f = g) : (f.1 : A) = g.1
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f : k ⟶ l => (f.1 : A)) h

name: DG.WeightCategory.mem_wgrading_of_eq
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_of_eq {a : A} {m n : ℤ} (h : m = n) (ha : a ∈ wgrading (M := A) m) :
    a ∈ wgrading (M := A) n
proof:
:=
  h ▸ ha

name: DG.WeightCategory.coe_idempotentToZero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_idempotentToZero {k : WeightCategory A} (e : DGCategory.Idempotent k) :
    (idempotentToZero e : A) = e.val.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.WeightCategory.idempotentToZero_mem
statement:
theorem idempotentToZero_mem {k : WeightCategory A} (e : DGCategory.Idempotent k) :
    idempotentToZero e ∈ degreeZeroWGrading A 0
proof:
:=
  mem_wgrading_of_eq (sub_self k.as) e.val.2

name: DG.WeightCategory.isIdempotentElem_idempotentToZero
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_idempotentToZero {k : WeightCategory A} (e : DGCategory.Idempotent k) :
    IsIdempotentElem (idempotentToZero e)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (val_congr e.comp_self)

name: DG.WeightCategory.idempotent_isSimple_iff
statement:
theorem idempotent_isSimple_iff {k : WeightCategory A} (e : DGCategory.Idempotent k) :
    e.IsSimple ↔ IsGradedSimpleIdempotent (degreeZeroWGrading A) (idempotentToZero e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, hs⟩
    refine ⟨fun h => hne (hom_ext (show e.val.1 = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val h)),
      fun j h hh hhe hh0 => ?_⟩
    have hmem : (h : A) ∈ wgrading (M := A) ((⟨k.as + j⟩ : WeightCategory A).as - k.as) :=
      mem_wgrading_of_eq (add_sub_cancel_left k.as j).symm hh
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgh⟩ := hs (Y := ⟨k.as + j⟩) (homMk (h : A) hmem) h.2
      (hom_ext (show (h : A) * e.val.1 = h from congrArg Subtype.val hhe))
      (fun h' => hh0 (Subtype.ext (val_congr h')))
    refine ⟨⟨g.1, hg⟩, mem_wgrading_of_eq (by ring) g.2, Subtype.ext (val_congr hgh)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, hs⟩
    refine ⟨fun h => hne (Subtype.ext (val_congr h)), fun Y h hh hhe hh0 => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgh⟩ := hs (j := Y.as - k.as) (h := ⟨h.1, hh⟩) h.2
      (Subtype.ext (val_congr hhe))
      (fun h' => hh0 (hom_ext (show (h.1 : A) = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val h')))
    have hgw : (g : A) ∈ wgrading (M := A) (k.as - Y.as) := mem_wgrading_of_eq (neg_sub _ _) hg
    exact ⟨homMk (g : A) hgw, g.2, hom_ext (show (g : A) * h.1 = e.val.1 from
      congrArg Subtype.val hgh)⟩

name: DG.WeightCategory.eq_zero_of_mem_wgrading_of_isPositive
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_wgrading_of_isPositive (hC : DGCategory.IsPositive (WeightCategory A))
    {n k : ℤ} (hn : n < 0) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hk : a ∈ wgrading (M := A) k) :
    a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : a ∈ wgrading (M := A) ((⟨k⟩ : WeightCategory A).as - (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A).as) :=
    by rwa [sub_zero]
  have := hC.eq_zero_of_neg hn (f := homMk (k := ⟨0⟩) (l := ⟨k⟩) a hk') ha
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: DG.WeightCategory.isPositive_iff
statement: theorem isPositive_iff : DGCategory.IsPositive (WeightCategory A) ↔ IsGradedPositive A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hC
    refine ⟨fun n hn => (AddSubgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr fun a ha => ?_, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    · rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (wgrading (M := A)) a]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => eq_zero_of_mem_wgrading_of_isPositive hC hn
        (decompose_wgrading_mem_grading ha k) (SetLike.coe_mem _)
    · obtain ⟨l, hs, hl, hsum⟩ := hC.semisimple ⟨0⟩
      refine isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_exists_list.mpr
        ⟨l.map idempotentToZero, fun x hx => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
        exact ⟨idempotentToZero_mem e, isIdempotentElem_idempotentToZero e,
          (idempotent_isSimple_iff e).mp (hs e he)⟩
      · rw [List.pairwise_map]
        exact hl.imp fun h => ⟨Subtype.ext (val_congr h.2), Subtype.ext (val_congr h.1)⟩
      · apply Subtype.ext
        have h1 := map_list_sum (degreeZeroSubring A).subtype (l.map idempotentToZero)
        have h2 := map_list_sum (AddSubgroup.subtype (wgrading (M := A)
          ((⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A).as - (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A).as)))
          (l.map DGCategory.Idempotent.val)
        rw [List.map_map] at h1 h2
        rw [hsum] at h2
        exact h1.trans h2.symm
    · rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (wgrading (M := A)) a, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => ?_
      have hk : (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) a k : A) ∈
          wgrading (M := A) ((⟨k⟩ : WeightCategory A).as - (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A).as) := by
        rw [sub_zero]
        exact SetLike.coe_mem _
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hC.d_eq_zero (X := ⟨0⟩) (Y := ⟨k⟩) (f := homMk _ hk)
        (decompose_wgrading_mem_grading ha k))
  · intro hA
    refine ⟨fun hn f hf => ?_, fun X => ?_, fun hf => hom_ext (hA.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero _ hf)⟩
    · have := hA.grading_eq_bot _ hn
      rw [mem_grading_iff, this] at hf
      exact hom_ext hf
    · obtain ⟨l, hl, hlp, hlsum⟩ := hA.isGradedSemisimple.exists_list_sum_eq_one
      have hw : ∀ s ∈ l, (s : A) ∈ wgrading (M := A) (X.as - X.as) := fun s hs => by
        rw [sub_self]
        exact (hl s hs).1
      let E : ∀ s ∈ l, DGCategory.Idempotent X := fun s hs =>
        { val := homMk (s : A) (hw s hs)
          mem_cocycles := ⟨s.2, hom_ext (hA.d_eq_zero_of_mem_zero _ s.2)⟩
          comp_self := hom_ext (show (s : A) * s = s from congrArg Subtype.val (hl s hs).2.1.eq) }
      refine ⟨l.pmap E fun _ h => h, fun e he => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := List.mem_pmap.mp he
        rw [idempotent_isSimple_iff]
        exact (hl s hs).2.2
      · rw [List.pairwise_pmap]
        refine hlp.imp_of_mem fun {a b} _ _ hab _ _ => ?_
        exact ⟨hom_ext (show (b : A) * a = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val hab.2),
          hom_ext (show (a : A) * b = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val hab.1)⟩
      · rw [List.map_pmap]
        apply hom_ext
        have h1 := map_list_sum (AddSubgroup.subtype (wgrading (M := A) (X.as - X.as)))
          (l.pmap (fun (s : degreeZeroSubring A) (hs : s ∈ l) => homMk (s : A) (hw s hs))
            fun _ h => h)
        rw [List.map_pmap] at h1
        refine h1.trans ?_
        change (l.pmap (fun (s : degreeZeroSubring A) (_ : s ∈ l) => (s : A))
          fun _ h => h).sum = (1 : A)
        rw [List.pmap_eq_map]
        have h2 := map_list_sum (degreeZeroSubring A).subtype l
        rw [hlsum] at h2
        exact h2.symm.trans (map_one _)

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.isPositive_weightCategory
statement:
theorem isPositive_weightCategory (hA : IsGradedPositive A) :
    DGCategory.IsPositive (WeightCategory A)
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.isPositive_iff.mpr hA

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_isCompact
    {Y : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory A)}
    (hY : IsCompact.{max u w} Y) :
    ∃ (P : CatModule.{max u w} (WeightCategory A)) (S : FiniteCellFiltration.{max u w} P),
      S.IsOrdered ∧ (∀ i, IsGradedSimpleIdempotent (degreeZeroWGrading A)
        (WeightCategory.idempotentToZero (S.e i))) ∧ Nonempty (Y ≅ Q.obj P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, S, hS, he, hY⟩ :=
    hA.isPositive_weightCategory.exists_finiteCellFiltration_of_isCompact.{max u w} hY
  exact ⟨P, S, hS, fun i => (WeightCategory.idempotent_isSimple_iff _).mp (he i), hY⟩

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.isCompact_iff
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff {Y : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory A)} :
    IsCompact.{max u w} Y ↔ ∃ (P : CatModule.{max u w} (WeightCategory A))
      (S : FiniteCellFiltration.{max u w} P), S.IsOrdered ∧ Nonempty (Y ≅ Q.obj P)
proof:
:=
  hA.isPositive_weightCategory.isCompact_iff.{max u w}

name: DG.IsPositive.isCompact_iff_weight
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff_weight
    {Y : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory A)} :
    IsCompact.{max u w} Y ↔ ∃ (P : CatModule.{max u w} (WeightCategory A))
      (S : FiniteCellFiltration.{max u w} P), S.IsOrdered ∧ Nonempty (Y ≅ Q.obj P)
proof:
:=
  hA.isGradedPositive.isCompact_iff

name: DG.mem_degreeZeroWGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degreeZeroWGrading_iff {k : ℤ} {a : degreeZeroSubring A} :
    a ∈ degreeZeroWGrading A k ↔ (a : A) ∈ bigrading A (0, k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨a.2, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

name: DG.isInternal_degreeZeroWGrading
statement: theorem isInternal_degreeZeroWGrading : DirectSum.IsInternal (degreeZeroWGrading A)
proof:
:=
  isInternal_comap _ _ Subtype.val_injective fun k a =>
    ⟨⟨_, decompose_wgrading_mem_grading (M := A) a.2 k⟩, rfl⟩

name: DG.coe_decompose_degreeZeroWGrading
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_degreeZeroWGrading (a : degreeZeroSubring A) (k : ℤ) :
    ((decompose (degreeZeroWGrading A) a k : degreeZeroSubring A) : A) =

proof:
:= by

      (wgrading (M := A) k).comap (degreeZeroSubring A).subtype.toAddMonoidHom :=
    degreeZeroWGrading.decomposition A
  exact coe_decompose_comap _ (degreeZeroSubring A).subtype.toAddMonoidHom a k

name: DG.WeightCategory.T_smul_cell
statement:
theorem T_smul_cell (s : ℤ) {k k' : WeightCategory A} (e : Idempotent k) (e' : Idempotent k')
    (hk : k'.as = k.as - s) (he : e'.val.1 = e.val.1) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.T s : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.cell.{w} e 0 = K0.cell e' 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [K0.cell, T_smul_mk_compact]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (internalShiftCellIso s e e' hk he)

name: DG.IsGradedPositive.span_cell_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_cell_eq_top :
    Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (Set.range fun e :
      {e : Idempotent (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory A) // e.IsSimple} => K0.cell.{w} e.1 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_
  have hx : x ∈ AddSubgroup.closure
      (Set.range fun c : SimpleCorner (WeightCategory A) => K0.cell.{w} c.1.2 0) := by
    rw [hA.isPositive_weightCategory.closure_cell_eq_top]
    trivial
  refine AddSubgroup.closure_le (K := (Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) _).toAddSubgroup)
    |>.mpr ?_ hx
  rintro _ ⟨⟨⟨k, e⟩, he⟩, rfl⟩
  let e₀ := WeightCategory.idempotentAt e ⟨0⟩
  have h := WeightCategory.T_smul_cell (-k.as) e₀ e (by simp) rfl
  change K0.cell e 0 ∈ (Submodule.span (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) _).toAddSubgroup
  rw [← h]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span
    ⟨⟨e₀, WeightCategory.isSimple_idempotentAt he _⟩, rfl⟩)

name: DG.TriangulatedIntAction.map_smul_of_commute
statement:
theorem map_smul_of_commute (φ : K0 𝒯 →+ K0 𝒯')
    (hφ : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : K0 𝒯), φ (K0.map (σ.functor n) x) = K0.map (τ.functor n) (φ x))
    (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : K0 𝒯) :
    letI
proof:
:= σ.K0Module
    letI := τ.K0Module
    φ (p • x) = p • φ x := by
  let := σ.K0Module
  let := τ.K0Module
  induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [add_smul, map_add, hp, hq, add_smul]
  | C_mul_T n a =>
    rw [mul_smul, mul_smul, σ.T_smul, τ.T_smul, eq_intCast LaurentPolynomial.C a,
      Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, map_zsmul, hφ]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.gradedMorita_K0_map_internalShift
statement:
theorem gradedMorita_K0_map_internalShift (h : e.IsFullH0) (n : ℤ)
    (x : K0 (compactSubcategory.{max u t}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{max u t, max u t} (WeightCategory e.Corner))).FullSubcategory) :
    K0.compactMapEquiv (gradedMoritaEquivalence.{t, w₂} he h)
        (K0.map ((compactInternalShiftAction e.Corner).functor n) x) =
      K0.map ((compactInternalShiftAction A).functor n)
        (K0.compactMapEquiv (gradedMoritaEquivalence.{t, w₂} he h) x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | mk X =>
    simp only [K0.map_mk, K0.compactMapEquiv_mk]
    exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj
      (((gradedMoritaEquivalenceInternalShiftIso.{t, w₂} he h n).app X.obj).symm)
  | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, hx]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.DGIdempotent.Corner.decompose_wgrading_mem
statement:
theorem decompose_wgrading_mem {a : A} (ha : a ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val) (k : ℤ) :
    (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) a k : A) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner e.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := (mem_iff e).mp ha
  refine (mem_iff e).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem (𝒜 := wgrading (M := A)) (j := k) (b := a) he
    rw [zero_add, h₁] at h
    exact h.symm
  · have h := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem (𝒜 := wgrading (M := A)) (i := k) (a := a) he
    rw [add_zero, h₂] at h
    exact h.symm

name: DG.DGIdempotent.coe_decompose_wgrading_mul_val_mul_zero
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_wgrading_mul_val_mul_zero (x y : A) :
    (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) (x * e.val * y) 0 : A) =
      ∑ p ∈ (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x).support,
        (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x p : A) * e.val *
          (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) y (-p) : A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hterm (p : ℤ) : (decompose (wgrading (M := A))
      ((decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x p : A) * e.val * y) 0 : A) =
      (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x p : A) * e.val *
        (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) y (-p) : A) := by
    have h1 := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem (𝒜 := wgrading (M := A)) (j := -p)
      (b := e.val * y) (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x p).2
    have h2 := coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem (𝒜 := wgrading (M := A)) (j := -p) (b := y) he
    rw [add_neg_cancel] at h1
    rw [zero_add] at h2
    rw [mul_assoc, h1, h2, mul_assoc]
  conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ← GradedRing.proj_apply, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => hterm p

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isFullH0_weightFamily
statement: theorem isFullH0_weightFamily (h : e.IsFullH0) : (e.weightFamily he).IsFullH0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, ha, hb, ht⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp ht
  rintro ⟨m⟩
  let π : ℤ → A → A := fun p x => decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x p
  have hπ (p : ℤ) (x : A) : π p x ∈ wgrading (M := A) p := (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x p).2
  have hπc {x : A} (hx : x ∈ cocycles A 0) (p : ℤ) : π p x ∈ cocycles A 0 :=
    ⟨decompose_wgrading_mem_grading hx.1 p, by
      change d (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) x p : A) = 0
      rw [← decompose_wgrading_d, hx.2]
      simp⟩
  
  let J := Σ k : Fin n, (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) (a k)).support
  let E := Fintype.equivFin J
  let i : J → ℤ := fun j => m - j.2
  let a' : ∀ j : J, (⟨m⟩ : WeightCategory A) ⟶ ⟨i j⟩ := fun j =>
    ⟨π (-j.2) (b j.1), by simpa [i, sub_sub_cancel_left] using hπ (-j.2) (b j.1)⟩
  let b' : ∀ j : J, (⟨i j⟩ : WeightCategory A) ⟶ ⟨m⟩ := fun j =>
    ⟨π j.2 (a j.1), by simpa [i] using hπ j.2 (a j.1)⟩
  refine ⟨Fintype.card J, fun r => i (E.symm r), fun r => a' (E.symm r),
    fun r => b' (E.symm r), fun r => ⟨(hπc (hb _) _).1, WeightCategory.hom_ext (hπc (hb _) _).2⟩,
    fun r => ⟨(hπc (ha _) _).1, WeightCategory.hom_ext (hπc (ha _) _).2⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨⟨π 0 t, by simpa using hπ 0 t⟩, decompose_wgrading_mem_grading ht 0,
    WeightCategory.hom_ext ?_⟩
  have key : ∑ r, (a' (E.symm r) ≫ (e.weightFamily he).idem (i (E.symm r)) ≫ b' (E.symm r)).1 =
      π 0 (∑ k, a k * e.val * b k) := by
    rw [Equiv.sum_comp E.symm (fun j => (a' j ≫ (e.weightFamily he).idem (i j) ≫ b' j).1),
      Fintype.sum_sigma]
    simp only [π]
    rw [← GradedRing.proj_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [GradedRing.proj_apply, coe_decompose_wgrading_mul_val_mul_zero e he]
    exact Finset.sum_coe_sort _ fun p => (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) (a k) p : A) * e.val *
      (decompose (wgrading (M := A)) (b k) (-p) : A)
  change d (π 0 t) = (∑ r, a' (E.symm r) ≫ (e.weightFamily he).idem (i (E.symm r)) ≫
    b' (E.symm r)).1 - 1
  rw [AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum, key,
    show ∑ k, a k * e.val * b k = d t + 1 by rw [hdt]; abel]
  simp only [π]
  rw [decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, decompose_wgrading_d,
    decompose_of_mem_same _ (one_mem_wgrading (A := A))]
  abel

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y h => ?_, fun f => ?_⟩
  · have h' := congrArg (fun g => g.1.1) h
    exact WeightCategory.hom_ext (Corner.coe_injective e h')
  · refine ⟨⟨⟨f.1.1, (Corner.mem_iff e).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩, f.1.2⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val f.2.2

name: DG.DGIdempotent.isQuasiEquivalence_weightCornerFunctor
statement:
theorem isQuasiEquivalence_weightCornerFunctor :
    IsQuasiEquivalence (e.weightCornerFunctor he) where
  toIsQuasiFullyFaithful
proof:
:= IsQuasiFullyFaithful.of_bijective _
    (e.weightCornerFunctor_map_bijective he) fun hf => hf
  exists_iso := by
    rintro ⟨k⟩
    refine ⟨⟨k⟩, 𝟙 _, 𝟙 _, id_mem_cocycles _, id_mem_cocycles _, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    · rw [Category.id_comp]
      show 𝟙 ((e.weightCornerFunctor he).obj ⟨k⟩) - 𝟙 ((e.weightCornerFunctor he).obj ⟨k⟩) ∈ _
      rw [sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _

name: DG.BigradedDGModuleCat.cohShiftFunctor_map_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohShiftFunctor_map_hom (n : ℤ) {M N : BigradedDGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    ((cohShiftFunctor n).map f).hom = f.hom.shift n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.BigradedDGModuleCat.shiftFunctor_eq
statement:
theorem shiftFunctor_eq (n : ℤ) :
    shiftFunctor (BigradedDGModuleCat.{v} A) n = cohShiftFunctor n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.BigradedDGModuleCat.internalShiftShiftIso_hom_app_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem internalShiftShiftIso_hom_app_hom (n k : ℤ) (M : BigradedDGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    ((internalShiftShiftIso n k).hom.app M).hom =
      (InternalShift.shiftEquiv (M := M) A n k).toDGModuleHom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.prod_mem_freeGrading
statement:
theorem prod_mem_freeGrading (l : List X) :
    (l.map (FreeAlgebra.ι R)).prod ∈ freeGrading R deg (l.map deg).sum
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl, rfl⟩

name: DG.ι_mem_freeGrading
statement: theorem ι_mem_freeGrading (x : X) : FreeAlgebra.ι R x ∈ freeGrading R deg (deg x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using prod_mem_freeGrading (R := R) (deg := deg) [x]

name: DG.freeGrading.decomposeAlgHom_prod
statement:
theorem decomposeAlgHom_prod (l : List X) :
    decomposeAlgHom R deg (l.map (FreeAlgebra.ι R)).prod =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => freeGrading R deg n) (l.map deg).sum
        ⟨_, prod_mem_freeGrading l⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    show decomposeAlgHom R deg 1 = _
    rw [map_one]
    rfl
  | cons x l ih =>
    show decomposeAlgHom R deg (FreeAlgebra.ι R x * (l.map (FreeAlgebra.ι R)).prod) = _
    rw [map_mul, ih, decomposeAlgHom, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, gradedι, DirectSum.of_mul_of]
    exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq (Sigma.subtype_ext rfl rfl)

name: DG.freeGrading.decomposeAlgHom_coe
statement:
theorem decomposeAlgHom_coe (n : ℤ) (a : freeGrading R deg n) :
    decomposeAlgHom R deg (a : FreeAlgebra R X) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => freeGrading R deg n) n a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a h =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact decomposeAlgHom_prod l
  | zero =>
    show decomposeAlgHom R deg 0 = DirectSum.of (fun n => freeGrading R deg n) _ 0
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    show decomposeAlgHom R deg (x + y) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => freeGrading R deg n) _ (⟨x, hx⟩ + ⟨y, hy⟩)
    rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, map_add]
  | smul r x hx ih =>
    show decomposeAlgHom R deg (r • x) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => freeGrading R deg n) _ (r • ⟨x, hx⟩)
    rw [map_smul, ih, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, map_smul]

name: DG.freeGrading.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem freeGrading.induction_on {n : ℤ}
    {P : ∀ a : FreeAlgebra R X, a ∈ freeGrading R deg n → Prop}
    (h_prod : ∀ (l : List X) (hl : (l.map deg).sum = n),
      P (l.map (FreeAlgebra.ι R)).prod (hl ▸ prod_mem_freeGrading l))
    (h_zero : P 0 (zero_mem _))
    (h_add : ∀ a b ha hb, P a ha → P b hb → P (a + b) (add_mem ha hb))
    (h_smul : ∀ (r : R) a ha, P a ha → P (r • a) (Submodule.smul_mem _ r ha))
    {a : FreeAlgebra R X} (ha : a ∈ freeGrading R deg n) : P a ha
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem a h =>
    obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact h_prod l hl
  | zero => exact h_zero
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact h_add x y _ _ hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => exact h_smul r x _ hx

name: DG.freeSignAut_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freeSignAut_ι (x : X) :
    freeSignAut deg (FreeAlgebra.ι R x) = koszulSign (deg x) • FreeAlgebra.ι R x
proof:
:=
  FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ x

name: DG.freeDerivMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem freeDerivMatrix_apply (a : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    freeDerivMatrix deg δ a 1 0 = 0 ∧ freeDerivMatrix deg δ a 1 1 = a ∧
      freeDerivMatrix deg δ a 0 0 = freeSignAut deg a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes]
    simp [Matrix.algebraMap_matrix_apply]
  | grade1 x => simp [freeDerivMatrix, freeSignAut]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, ha.1, ha.2.1, ha.2.2, hb.1, hb.2.1,
      hb.2.2, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, true_and]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_add, Matrix.add_apply, ha.1, ha.2.1, ha.2.2, hb.1, hb.2.1, hb.2.2, add_zero,
      true_and]

name: DG.freeDeriv_apply
statement: theorem freeDeriv_apply (a : FreeAlgebra R X) : freeDeriv deg δ a = freeDerivMatrix deg δ a 0 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.freeDeriv_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freeDeriv_ι (x : X) : freeDeriv deg δ (FreeAlgebra.ι R x) = δ x
proof:
:= by
  simp [freeDeriv_apply, freeDerivMatrix]

name: DG.freeDeriv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freeDeriv_algebraMap (r : R) :
    freeDeriv deg δ (algebraMap R (FreeAlgebra R X) r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeDeriv_apply, AlgHom.commutes]
  simp [Matrix.algebraMap_matrix_apply]

name: DG.freeDeriv_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freeDeriv_one : freeDeriv deg δ (1 : FreeAlgebra R X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using freeDeriv_algebraMap deg δ (1 : R)

name: DG.freeDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem freeDeriv_mul (a b : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    freeDeriv deg δ (a * b) = freeDeriv deg δ a * b + freeSignAut deg a * freeDeriv deg δ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeDeriv_apply, map_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
    (freeDerivMatrix_apply deg δ a).2.2, (freeDerivMatrix_apply deg δ b).2.1, add_comm]
  rfl

name: DG.freeDeriv_units_smul
statement:
theorem freeDeriv_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (a : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    freeDeriv deg δ (u • a) = u • freeDeriv deg δ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.freeSignAut_of_mem
statement:
theorem freeSignAut_of_mem {n : ℤ} {a : FreeAlgebra R X} (ha : a ∈ freeGrading R deg n) :
    freeSignAut deg a = koszulSign n • a
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using freeGrading.induction_on with
  | h_prod l hl =>
    subst hl
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons x l ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [map_mul, ih, freeSignAut_ι, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, koszulSign_add,
        mul_comm]
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero, smul_zero]
  | h_add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb, smul_add]
  | h_smul r a _ ha =>
    rw [map_smul, ha, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_comm r]

name: DG.freeDeriv_mul_of_mem
statement:
theorem freeDeriv_mul_of_mem {n : ℤ} {a : FreeAlgebra R X} (ha : a ∈ freeGrading R deg n)
    (b : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    freeDeriv deg δ (a * b) = freeDeriv deg δ a * b + koszulSign n • (a * freeDeriv deg δ b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeDeriv_mul, freeSignAut_of_mem ha, smul_mul_assoc]

name: DG.freeDeriv_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using freeGrading.induction_on with
  | h_prod l hl =>
    subst hl
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons x l ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [freeDeriv_mul_of_mem δ (ι_mem_freeGrading x), freeDeriv_ι]
      refine add_mem ?_ ?_
      · have := SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (hδ x) (prod_mem_freeGrading (R := R) (deg := deg) l)
        rwa [show deg x + 1 + (l.map deg).sum = deg x + (l.map deg).sum + 1 by ring] at this
      · have := SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (ι_mem_freeGrading (R := R) (deg := deg) x) ih
        rw [show deg x + ((l.map deg).sum + 1) = deg x + (l.map deg).sum + 1 by ring] at this
        rw [Units.smul_def]
        exact zsmul_mem this _
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | h_add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | h_smul r a _ ha => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r ha

name: DG.freeDeriv_freeDeriv_mul
statement:
theorem freeDeriv_freeDeriv_mul (hδ : ∀ x, δ x ∈ freeGrading R deg (deg x + 1))
    (a b : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    freeDeriv deg δ (freeDeriv deg δ (a * b)) =
      freeDeriv deg δ (freeDeriv deg δ a) * b + a * freeDeriv deg δ (freeDeriv deg δ b)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (freeGrading R deg) with
  | zero => simp
  | add a a' ha ha' =>
    rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, ha, ha', map_add, map_add, add_mul, add_mul]
    abel
  | homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i n
    simp only
    rw [freeDeriv_mul_of_mem δ ha, map_add, freeDeriv_mul_of_mem δ (freeDeriv_mem hδ ha),
      freeDeriv_units_smul, freeDeriv_mul_of_mem δ ha, smul_add, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self,
      one_smul, koszulSign_add, show koszulSign 1 = -1 from Int.negOnePow_one, mul_neg_one,
      Units.neg_smul]
    abel

name: DG.freeDeriv_freeDeriv_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem freeDeriv_freeDeriv_eq_zero_iff (hδ : ∀ x, δ x ∈ freeGrading R deg (deg x + 1)) :
    (∀ a, freeDeriv deg δ (freeDeriv deg δ a) = 0) ↔ ∀ x, freeDeriv deg δ (δ x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x => by simpa using h (FreeAlgebra.ι R x), fun h a => ?_⟩
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 r => simp
  | grade1 x => rw [freeDeriv_ι, h]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [freeDeriv_freeDeriv_mul hδ, ha, hb, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]

name: DG.eq_freeDeriv_of_leibniz
statement:
theorem eq_freeDeriv_of_leibniz (D : FreeAlgebra R X →+ FreeAlgebra R X)
    (hD : ∀ {n : ℤ} {a : FreeAlgebra R X}, a ∈ freeGrading R deg n → ∀ b,
      D (a * b) = D a * b + koszulSign n • (a * D b))
    (hι : ∀ x, D (FreeAlgebra.ι R x) = δ x) (halg : ∀ r, D (algebraMap R _ r) = 0)
    (a : FreeAlgebra R X) : D a = freeDeriv deg δ a
proof:
:= by
  have hD' : ∀ a b, D (a * b) = D a * b + freeSignAut deg a * D b := by
    intro a b
    induction a using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (freeGrading R deg) with
    | zero => simp
    | add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_mul, map_add, ha, ha', map_add, map_add, add_mul, add_mul]; abel
    | homogeneous a =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
      rw [hD ha, freeSignAut_of_mem ha, smul_mul_assoc]
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction with
  | grade0 r => rw [halg, freeDeriv_algebraMap]
  | grade1 x => rw [hι, freeDeriv_ι]
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [hD', ha, hb, freeDeriv_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: DG.SemiFree.freeDeriv_freeDeriv
statement:
theorem freeDeriv_freeDeriv (a : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    freeDeriv S.deg S.δ (freeDeriv S.deg S.δ a) = 0
proof:
:=
  (freeDeriv_freeDeriv_eq_zero_iff S.δ_mem).mpr S.freeDeriv_δ a

name: DG.SemiFree.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {a : SemiFree S} :
    a ∈ grading n ↔ toFree S a ∈ freeGrading R S.deg n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.SemiFree.d_apply
statement: theorem d_apply (a : SemiFree S) : toFree S (d a) = freeDeriv S.deg S.δ (toFree S a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.SemiFree.ι_mem
statement: theorem ι_mem (x : X) : ι S x ∈ grading (S.deg x)
proof:
:=
  ι_mem_freeGrading x

name: DG.SemiFree.d_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_ι (x : X) : d (ι S x) = (toFree S).symm (S.δ x)
proof:
:=
  freeDeriv_ι S.deg S.δ x

name: DG.SemiFree.lift_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using freeGrading.induction_on with
  | h_prod l hl =>
    subst hl
    induction l with
    | nil => simpa using one_mem_grading (A := B)
    | cons x l ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [map_mul, FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
      exact mul_mem_grading (hf x) ih
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | h_add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | h_smul r a _ ha => rw [map_smul]; exact DGAlgebra.smul_mem r ha

name: DG.SemiFree.lift_freeDeriv
statement:
theorem lift_freeDeriv (f : GeneratorMap S B) (a : FreeAlgebra R X) :
    FreeAlgebra.lift R f.1 (freeDeriv S.deg S.δ a) = d (FreeAlgebra.lift R f.1 a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (freeGrading R S.deg) with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, d_add]
  | homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    show FreeAlgebra.lift R f.1 (freeDeriv S.deg S.δ a) = d (FreeAlgebra.lift R f.1 a)
    induction ha using freeGrading.induction_on with
    | h_prod l hl =>
      clear hl
      induction l with
      | nil => simp
      | cons x l ih =>
        rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, freeDeriv_mul_of_mem S.δ (ι_mem_freeGrading x),
          map_add, map_mul, map_mul, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, map_mul, ih, freeDeriv_ι,
          FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, ← f.2.2 x, d_mul (f.2.1 x), Units.smul_def]
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, d_add]
    | h_smul r a _ ha => rw [map_smul, map_smul, ha, map_smul, d_smul_algebra]

name: DG.SemiFree.liftEquiv_apply_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftEquiv_apply_ι (f : GeneratorMap S B) (x : X) : liftEquiv S B f (ι S x) = f.1 x
proof:
:=
  FreeAlgebra.lift_ι_apply f.1 x

name: DG.SemiFree.hom_ext
statement: theorem hom_ext {G G' : SemiFree S →ᵈᵍₐ[R] B} (h : ∀ x, G (ι S x) = G' (ι S x)) : G = G'
proof:
:=
  (liftEquiv S B).symm.injective (Subtype.ext (funext h))

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_ι_mul
statement:
theorem contract_ι_mul (m : M) (b : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    contract φ (ι R m * b) = φ m • b - ι R m * contract φ b
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι_mul φ m b

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_ι
statement: theorem contract_ι (m : M) : contract φ (ι R m) = algebraMap R _ (φ m)
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_ι _ φ m

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_algebraMap
statement: theorem contract_algebraMap (r : R) : contract φ (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) r) = 0
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_algebraMap _ φ r

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem contract_algebraMap_mul (r : R) (b : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    contract φ (algebraMap R _ r * b) = algebraMap R _ r * contract φ b
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_algebraMap_mul φ r b

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_contract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contract_contract (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) : contract φ (contract φ a) = 0
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.contractLeft_contractLeft φ a

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.ι_mem_exteriorPower_one
statement: theorem ι_mem_exteriorPower_one (m : M) : ι R m ∈ ⋀[R]^1 M
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_mem_aux
statement:
theorem contract_mem_aux {k : ℕ} {a : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^k M) :
    contract φ a ∈ ⋀[R]^(k - 1) M ∧ (k = 0 → contract φ a = 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r => simp
  | add x y i _ _ ihx ihy =>
    exact ⟨by rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ihx.1 ihy.1,
      fun h => by rw [map_add, ihx.2 h, ihy.2 h, add_zero]⟩
  | mem_mul m hm i x hx ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
    refine ⟨?_, fun h => absurd h (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)⟩
    rw [contract_ι_mul]
    refine sub_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (by simpa using hx)) ?_
    rcases i with _ | i
    · rw [ih.2 rfl, mul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · have := Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self (ι R) m) ih.1
      simpa [pow_succ'] using this

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_mem
statement:
theorem contract_mem {k : ℕ} {a : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^(k + 1) M) :
    contract φ a ∈ ⋀[R]^k M
proof:
:=
  (contract_mem_aux φ ha).1

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_eq_zero_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem contract_eq_zero_of_mem_zero {a : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^0 M) :
    contract φ a = 0
proof:
:=
  (contract_mem_aux φ ha).2 rfl

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.contract_mul
statement:
theorem contract_mul {k : ℕ} {a : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^k M)
    (b : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    contract φ (a * b) = contract φ a * b + koszulSign k • (a * contract φ b)
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r => simp [contract_algebraMap_mul]
  | add x y i _ _ ihx ihy =>
    rw [add_mul, map_add, ihx, ihy, map_add, add_mul, add_mul, smul_add]
    abel
  | mem_mul m hm i x hx ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
    rw [mul_assoc, contract_ι_mul, ih, contract_ι_mul, Nat.cast_succ, koszulSign_add,
      show koszulSign 1 = -1 from Int.negOnePow_one, mul_neg_one, Units.neg_smul]
    simp only [mul_add, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_assoc]
    abel

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.ι_mul_ι_comm
statement: theorem ι_mul_ι_comm (m n : M) : ι R m * ι R n = -(ι R n * ι R m)
proof:
:=
  eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (ι_add_mul_swap m n)

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.ι_mul_comm
statement:
theorem ι_mul_comm (m : M) {j : ℕ} {b : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (hb : b ∈ ⋀[R]^j M) :
    ι R m * b = koszulSign j • (b * ι R m)
proof:
:= by
  induction hb using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r => simp [Algebra.commutes]
  | add x y i _ _ ihx ihy => rw [mul_add, ihx, ihy, add_mul, smul_add]
  | mem_mul n hn i x hx ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hn
    rw [← mul_assoc, ι_mul_ι_comm, neg_mul, mul_assoc, ih, Nat.cast_succ, koszulSign_add,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_smul, mul_assoc]
    simp

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.mul_comm_of_mem
statement:
theorem mul_comm_of_mem {i j : ℕ} {a b : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^i M)
    (hb : b ∈ ⋀[R]^j M) : a * b = koszulSign (i * j) • (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r => simp [Algebra.commutes]
  | add x y i _ _ ihx ihy => rw [add_mul, ihx, ihy, mul_add, smul_add]
  | mem_mul m hm i x hx ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
    rw [mul_assoc, ih, mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ι_mul_comm m hb, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul,
      mul_assoc, ← koszulSign_add, Nat.cast_succ]
    congr 2
    ring

name: DG.ExteriorAlgebra.mul_self_of_odd
statement:
theorem mul_self_of_odd {i : ℕ} {a : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^i M) (hi : Odd i) :
    a * a = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r => exact absurd hi (by decide)
  | add x y i hx hy ihx ihy =>
    have hxy := mul_comm_of_mem hx hy
    rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_odd _ (by exact_mod_cast hi.mul hi), Units.neg_smul,
      one_smul] at hxy
    rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, ihx hi, ihy hi, hxy]
    abel
  | mem_mul m hm i x hx _ =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc x, mul_comm_of_mem hx (ι_mem_exteriorPower_one m), smul_mul_assoc,
      mul_smul_comm, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ι_sq_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: DG.koszulGrading.neg_natCast
statement: theorem neg_natCast (k : ℕ) : koszulGrading R M (-(k : ℤ)) = ⋀[R]^k M
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulGrading, ite_eq_left (by omega), neg_neg, Int.toNat_natCast]

name: DG.koszulGrading.zero
statement: theorem zero : koszulGrading R M 0 = ⋀[R]^0 M
proof:
:= by
  simpa using neg_natCast (R := R) (M := M) 0

name: DG.koszulGrading.of_pos
statement: theorem of_pos {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) : koszulGrading R M n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulGrading, ite_eq_right (by omega)]

name: DG.koszulGrading.mem_neg_natCast
statement:
theorem mem_neg_natCast {k : ℕ} {a : ExteriorAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^k M) :
    a ∈ koszulGrading R M (-k)
proof:
:= by
  rwa [neg_natCast]

name: DG.koszulGrading.cases
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n ≤ 0
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, n = -k := ⟨(-n).toNat, by omega⟩
    have ha' : a ∈ ⋀[R]^k M := by rwa [neg_natCast] at ha
    exact h_neg k a ha'
  · rw [of_pos (by omega), Submodule.mem_bot] at ha
    subst ha
    exact h_zero n

name: DG.koszulGrading.ι_mem
statement: theorem ι_mem (m : M) : ι R m ∈ koszulGrading R M (-1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mem_neg_natCast (ExteriorAlgebra.ι_mem_exteriorPower_one (R := R) m)

name: DG.koszulGrading.gradedι_apply
statement:
theorem gradedι_apply (m : M) :
    gradedι m = DirectSum.of (fun n => koszulGrading R M n) (-1) ⟨ι R m, ι_mem m⟩
proof: := rfl

name: DG.koszulGrading.gradedι_sq_zero
statement: theorem gradedι_sq_zero (m : M) : gradedι (R := R) m * gradedι m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradedι_apply, DirectSum.of_mul_of]
  exact DFinsupp.single_eq_zero.mpr (Subtype.ext <| ExteriorAlgebra.ι_sq_zero _)

name: DG.koszulGrading.liftι_eq
statement:
theorem liftι_eq (n : ℤ) (x : koszulGrading R M n) :
    liftι (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M) = DirectSum.of (fun n => koszulGrading R M n) n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  induction hx using cases with
  | h_zero n =>
    change liftι 0 = DirectSum.of (fun n => koszulGrading R M n) n 0
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | h_neg k x hx =>
