    induction hx using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r =>
      rw [AlgHom.commutes, DirectSum.algebraMap_apply]
      refine DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq (Sigma.subtype_ext ?_ rfl)
      show (0 : ℤ) = -((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      simp
    | add x y i hx hy ihx ihy =>
      rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, ← map_add]
      rfl
    | mem_mul m hm i x hx ih =>
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
      rw [map_mul, ih, liftι, lift_ι_apply, gradedι_apply, DirectSum.of_mul_of]
      refine DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq (Sigma.subtype_ext ?_ rfl)
      show -1 + -(i : ℤ) = -((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      push_cast
      ring

name: DG.KoszulComplex.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {a : KoszulComplex φ} :
    a ∈ grading n ↔ (toExterior φ a) ∈ koszulGrading R M n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.KoszulComplex.d_apply
statement:
theorem d_apply (a : KoszulComplex φ) :
    toExterior φ (d a) = ExteriorAlgebra.contract φ (toExterior φ a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.KoszulComplex.d_ι
statement:
theorem d_ι (m : M) :
    d ((toExterior φ).symm (ι R m)) = algebraMap R (KoszulComplex φ) (φ m)
proof:
:=
  ExteriorAlgebra.contract_ι φ m

name: DG.KoszulComplex.eq_d_of_leibniz
statement:
theorem eq_d_of_leibniz (D : KoszulComplex φ →+ KoszulComplex φ)
    (hD : ∀ {n : ℤ} {a : KoszulComplex φ}, a ∈ grading n → ∀ b : KoszulComplex φ,
      D (a * b) = D a * b + koszulSign n • (a * D b))
    (hι : ∀ m : M, D ((toExterior φ).symm (ι R m)) = algebraMap R (KoszulComplex φ) (φ m))
    (halg : ∀ r : R, D (algebraMap R (KoszulComplex φ) r) = 0) (a : KoszulComplex φ) :
    D a = d a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero, d_zero]
  | h_add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    have key : ∀ (n : ℤ) (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M), a ∈ koszulGrading R M n →
        D ((toExterior φ).symm a) = d ((toExterior φ).symm a) := by
      intro n a ha
      induction ha using koszulGrading.cases with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_neg k a ha =>
        induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
        | algebraMap r => exact (halg r).trans (d_algebraMap R _).symm
        | add x y i _ _ ihx ihy =>
          rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ihx, ihy]
        | mem_mul m hm i x hx ih =>
          obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
          have hm : (toExterior φ).symm (ι R m) ∈ grading (M := KoszulComplex φ) (-1) :=
            koszulGrading.ι_mem m
          refine (hD hm ((toExterior φ).symm x)).trans ?_
          rw [hι, ih, map_mul, d_mul hm, d_ι]
    exact key _ a ha

name: DG.KoszulComplex.mem_grading_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_zero_iff {a : KoszulComplex φ} :
    a ∈ grading 0 ↔ ∃ r : R, algebraMap R (KoszulComplex φ) r = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_grading_iff, koszulGrading.zero]
  change _ ∈ LinearMap.range (ι R : M →ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M) ^ 0 ↔ _
  rw [pow_zero, Submodule.mem_one]
  rfl

name: DG.KoszulComplex.mem_grading_neg_one_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_neg_one_iff {a : KoszulComplex φ} :
    a ∈ grading (-1) ↔ ∃ m : M, (toExterior φ).symm (ι R m) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_grading_iff, show (-1 : ℤ) = -((1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by norm_num, koszulGrading.neg_natCast]
  change _ ∈ LinearMap.range (ι R : M →ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M) ^ 1 ↔ _
  rw [pow_one]
  rfl

name: DG.KoszulComplex.augmentation_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem augmentation_algebraMap (r : R) : augmentation φ (algebraMap R _ r) = r
proof:
:=
  algebraMap_leftInverse M r

name: DG.KoszulComplex.mem_cocycles_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cocycles_zero_iff {a : KoszulComplex φ} :
    a ∈ cocycles (KoszulComplex φ) 0 ↔ a ∈ grading 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, ?_⟩⟩
  have h1 : d a ∈ grading (M := KoszulComplex φ) (0 + 1) := d_mem h
  rw [mem_grading_iff, koszulGrading.of_pos (by norm_num)] at h1
  exact h1

name: DG.KoszulComplex.mem_coboundaries_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coboundaries_zero_iff {a : KoszulComplex φ} :
    a ∈ coboundaries (KoszulComplex φ) 0 ↔
      ∃ r ∈ LinearMap.range φ, algebraMap R (KoszulComplex φ) r = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_coboundaries, zero_sub]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (mem_grading_neg_one_iff φ).mp hb
    exact ⟨φ m, LinearMap.mem_range_self φ m, (d_ι m).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (mem_grading_neg_one_iff φ).mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩, d_ι m⟩

name: DG.KoszulComplex.cohomologyZeroToQuotient_mk
statement:
theorem cohomologyZeroToQuotient_mk (z : cocycles (KoszulComplex φ) 0) :
    cohomologyZeroToQuotient φ (cohomology.mk _ 0 z) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (augmentation φ z)
proof:
:=
  cohomology.lift_mk _ _ z

name: DG.KoszulComplex.cohomologyZeroToQuotient_bijective
statement:
theorem cohomologyZeroToQuotient_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyZeroToQuotient φ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z =>
    rw [cohomologyZeroToQuotient_mk, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx
    rw [cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff, mem_coboundaries_zero_iff]
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (mem_grading_zero_iff φ).mp (cocycles_le_grading 0 z.2)
    refine ⟨r, ?_, hr⟩
    rwa [← hr, augmentation_algebraMap] at hx
  · intro q
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
    have hr : algebraMap R (KoszulComplex φ) r ∈ cocycles (KoszulComplex φ) 0 :=
      (mem_cocycles_zero_iff φ).mpr ((mem_grading_zero_iff φ).mpr ⟨r, rfl⟩)
    refine ⟨cohomology.mk _ 0 ⟨_, hr⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [cohomologyZeroToQuotient_mk, augmentation_algebraMap]

name: DG.KoszulComplex.cohomologyZeroAddEquiv_mkOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyZeroAddEquiv_mkOf (r : R) (hr : algebraMap R (KoszulComplex φ) r ∈ grading 0)
    (hd : d (algebraMap R (KoszulComplex φ) r) = 0) :
    cohomologyZeroAddEquiv φ (cohomology.mkOf hr hd) = Submodule.Quotient.mk r
proof:
:= by
  rw [cohomologyZeroAddEquiv, AddEquiv.ofBijective_apply, cohomology.mkOf,
    cohomologyZeroToQuotient_mk, augmentation_algebraMap]

name: DG.KoszulComplex.ofElements.d_ι_single
statement:
theorem d_ι_single [DecidableEq κ] (i : κ) :
    d ((toExterior _).symm (ι R (Pi.single i 1)) : ofElements x) =
      algebraMap R (ofElements x) (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_ι, Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single, one_smul]

name: DG.KoszulComplex.ofElements.range_eq
statement: theorem range_eq : LinearMap.range (Fintype.linearCombination R x) = Ideal.span (Set.range x)
proof:
:=
  Fintype.range_linearCombination R x

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.p_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem p_apply (v : V R) : p R v = (v.1, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.e_val
statement: theorem e_val : (e R).val = DirectSum.of _ 0 (Cochain.ofHom (p R))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.f_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem f_apply (v : V R) : f R v = (Cone.inr _ v.2, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.g_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem g_apply (v : V R) : g R v = (0, Cone.sndLinear _ v.1)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.one_eq
statement:
theorem one_eq : (1 : A R) = (e R).val +
    DirectSum.of _ 0 (Cochain.ofHom (f R)) * (e R).val * DirectSum.of _ 0 (g R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [e_val, DGModule.END.of_mul_of, DGModule.END.of_mul_of, DGModule.END.one_def,
    DGModule.HOM.of_congr (show (0 : ℤ) + 0 + 0 = 0 by simp)
      (g := (g R).comp ((Cochain.ofHom (p R)).comp (Cochain.ofHom (f R)) (add_zero 0)) (add_zero 0))
      (fun v => by simp [Cochain.comp_apply]), ← map_add]
  refine DGModule.HOM.of_congr rfl fun v => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, r⟩ := v
  simp only [Cochain.id_apply, Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
    p_apply, f_apply, g_apply]
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · change c = c + 0
    rw [add_zero]
  · change r = 0 + Cone.sndLinear _ (Cone.inr _ r)
    rw [zero_add]
    rfl

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.one_mem_span
statement: theorem one_mem_span : (1 : A R) ∈ TwoSidedIdeal.span {(e R).val}
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_eq]
  refine TwoSidedIdeal.add_mem _ (TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span rfl) ?_
  exact TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_right _ _ _
    (TwoSidedIdeal.mul_mem_left _ _ _ (TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span rfl))

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.h_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem h_apply (v : V R) : h R v = (Cone.contraction R v.1, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.h_mem_corner
statement:
theorem h_mem_corner :
    (DirectSum.of _ (-1) (h R) : A R) ∈ Subsemigroup.corner (e R).val
proof:
:= by
  refine (DGIdempotent.Corner.mem_iff (e R)).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e_val, DGModule.END.of_mul_of]
    exact DGModule.HOM.of_congr (zero_add _) fun v => by
      rw [Cochain.units_smul_apply, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
      rfl
  · rw [e_val, DGModule.END.of_mul_of]
    exact DGModule.HOM.of_congr (add_zero _) fun v => by
      rw [Cochain.units_smul_apply, mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
      rfl

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.d_hCorner
statement: theorem d_hCorner : d (hCorner R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply DGIdempotent.Corner.ext
  rw [DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_d, DGIdempotent.Corner.coe_one, e_val]
  change d (DirectSum.of _ (-1) (h R) : A R) = _
  rw [DGModule.HOM.d_of]
  refine DGModule.HOM.of_congr (by norm_num) fun v => ?_
  rw [δ_apply _ _ rfl, Cochain.ofHom_apply, p_apply, h_apply, h_apply]
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · change d (Cone.contraction R v.1) - koszulSign (-1) • Cone.contraction R (d v.1) = v.1
    rw [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_neg, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.neg_smul, one_smul,
      sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact Cone.d_contraction_add_contraction_d v.1
  · change d (0 : R) - _ = 0
    simp

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.not_exists_d_eq_one
statement: theorem not_exists_d_eq_one [Nontrivial R] : ¬ ∃ x : A R, d x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  have h1 : d (decompose (grading (M := A R)) x (-1) : A R) = 1 := by
    have h := decompose_d x (-1)
    rw [hx, show (-1 : ℤ) + 1 = 0 by norm_num,
      decompose_of_mem_same _ (one_mem_grading (A := A R))] at h
    exact h.symm
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := mem_summand.mp (decompose (grading (M := A R)) x (-1)).2
  rw [← hz, DGModule.HOM.d_of, DGModule.END.one_def] at h1
  rw [DGModule.HOM.of_congr (show (-1 : ℤ) + 1 = 0 by norm_num) (g := δ (-1) 0 z)
    (fun v => by rw [δ_apply _ _ rfl, δ_apply _ _ (by norm_num)])] at h1
  have h2 : δ (-1) 0 z = Cochain.id R (V R) := DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun n =>
    Cochain R (V R) (V R) n) 0 h1
  have h4 := congrArg (fun v : V R => v.2) (Cochain.ext_iff.mp h2 (0, 1))
  have hd : d ((0, 1) : V R) = 0 := Prod.ext (d_zero (M := K R)) rfl
  simp only [δ_apply _ _ (show (-1 : ℤ) + 1 = 0 by norm_num), hd, map_zero, smul_zero,
    sub_zero] at h4
  have h5 : d ((z (0, 1)).2) = (0 : R) := rfl
  exact zero_ne_one (h5.symm.trans h4)

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.isEmpty_derivedEquivalence
statement:
theorem isEmpty_derivedEquivalence [Nontrivial R]
    [DG.HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, u} (e R).Corner] [DG.HasDerivedCategory.{w₂, u} (A R)] :
    IsEmpty (DG.DerivedCategory (e R).Corner ≌ DG.DerivedCategory (A R))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun E => ?_⟩
  have hex : ∃ x : (e R).Corner, d x = 1 := ⟨hCorner R, d_hCorner R⟩
  have hC : ∀ X : DG.DerivedCategory (e R).Corner, Limits.IsZero X :=
    ((DG.DerivedCategory.tfae_isZero (A := (e R).Corner)).out 1 3).mpr hex
  refine not_exists_d_eq_one R (((DG.DerivedCategory.tfae_isZero (A := A R)).out 1 3).mp
    fun Y => ?_)
  exact Limits.IsZero.of_iso (Functor.map_isZero E.functor (hC _)) (E.counitIso.app Y).symm

name: DG.MoritaCounterexample.not_isFullH0
statement: theorem not_isFullH0 [Nontrivial R] : ¬ (e R).IsFullH0
proof:
:= fun he =>
  letI := DG.HasDerivedCategory.standard (e R).Corner
  letI := DG.HasDerivedCategory.standard (A R)
  (isEmpty_derivedEquivalence R).false ((e R).moritaEquivalence.{u} he)

name: DG.DGModule.END.coe_cocyclesZeroAddEquiv
statement:
theorem coe_cocyclesZeroAddEquiv (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) :
    (cocyclesZeroAddEquiv A M f : END A M) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain A M M n) 0 (Cochain.ofHom f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.cocyclesZeroAddEquiv_id
statement:
theorem cocyclesZeroAddEquiv_id :
    (cocyclesZeroAddEquiv A M DGModuleHom.id : END A M) = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.cocyclesZeroAddEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem cocyclesZeroAddEquiv_comp (f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) :
    (cocyclesZeroAddEquiv A M (g.comp f) : END A M) =
      cocyclesZeroAddEquiv A M f * cocyclesZeroAddEquiv A M g
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_cocyclesZeroAddEquiv, coe_cocyclesZeroAddEquiv, coe_cocyclesZeroAddEquiv, of_mul_of]
  exact HOM.of_congr (add_zero 0).symm fun x => by
    rw [Cochain.units_smul_apply, mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.cohomologyZeroAddEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem cohomologyZeroAddEquiv_mk (f : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) :
    cohomologyZeroAddEquiv A M (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      cohomology.mk _ 0 (cocyclesZeroAddEquiv A M f)
proof:
:=
  quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology_mk f

name: DG.DGModule.END.cohomology_mk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem cohomology_mk_eq_iff (f g : M →ᵈᵍ[A] M) :
    cohomology.mk _ 0 (cocyclesZeroAddEquiv A M f) =
      cohomology.mk _ 0 (cocyclesZeroAddEquiv A M g) ↔ Homotopic f g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cohomologyZeroAddEquiv_mk, ← cohomologyZeroAddEquiv_mk,
    (cohomologyZeroAddEquiv A M).injective.eq_iff, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem,
    homotopic_iff_sub_mem, ← neg_mem_iff, neg_sub]

name: DG.DGModule.ofGround
statement:
theorem DGModule.ofGround
    (hmem : ∀ (r : R) {n : ℤ} {c : C}, c ∈ grading n → r • c ∈ grading n)
    (hd : ∀ (r : R) (c : C), d (r • c) = r • d c) : DGModule R C where
  smul_mem i j r c hr hc
proof:
:= by
    rcases (mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff R).mp hr with rfl | rfl
    · simpa using hmem r hc
    · simp
  d_smul' {n r} hr c := by
    change d (r • c) = (0 : R →+ R) r • c + koszulSign n • (r • d c)
    rcases (mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff R).mp hr with rfl | rfl
    · simp [hd]
    · simp

name: DG.DGModule.END.algebraMap_ground_apply
statement:
theorem DGModule.END.algebraMap_ground_apply (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (DGModule.END R C) r =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain R C C n) 0 (r • Cochain.id R C)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.mem_ofComponents
statement:
theorem mem_ofComponents {T : ℤ → AddSubgroup M} {a : M} :
    a ∈ ofComponents T ↔ ∀ n, (decompose (grading (M := M)) a n : M) ∈ T n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mem_ofComponents_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_ofComponents_of_mem_grading {T : ℤ → AddSubgroup M} {k : ℤ} {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ grading k) : x ∈ ofComponents T ↔ x ∈ T k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := h k
    rwa [decompose_of_mem_same _ hx] at this
  · intro h n
    by_cases hn : k = n
    · subst hn
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hx]
      exact h
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hx hn]
      exact zero_mem _

name: DG.isHomogeneous_ofComponents
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_ofComponents (T : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (grading (M := M)) (ofComponents T)
proof:
:= by
  intro i a ha
  rw [mem_ofComponents_of_mem_grading (decompose (grading (M := M)) a i).2]
  exact ha i

name: DG.mem_truncLEZeroComponents_iff
statement:
theorem mem_truncLEZeroComponents_iff {k : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A) ↔ (0 < k → x = 0) ∧ (k = 0 → d x = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ofComponents_of_mem_grading hx, truncLEZeroComponents]
  by_cases h1 : 0 < k
  · simp [h1, h1.ne']
  · by_cases h2 : k = 0
    · subst h2
      simp [mem_cocycles, hx]
    · simp [h1, h2]

name: DG.truncLEZero_mul_mem
statement:
theorem truncLEZero_mul_mem {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A))
    (hb : b ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A)) :
    a * b ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_ofComponents _)
    (P := fun a => a * b ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A)) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun a a' h h' => by simpa only [add_mul] using add_mem h h') ha
  intro i a hai haS
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_ofComponents _)
    (P := fun b => a * b ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A)) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun b b' h h' => by simpa only [mul_add] using add_mem h h') hb
  intro j b hbj hbS
  rw [mem_truncLEZeroComponents_iff hai] at haS
  rw [mem_truncLEZeroComponents_iff hbj] at hbS
  rw [mem_truncLEZeroComponents_iff (mul_mem_grading hai hbj)]
  by_cases hi : 0 < i
  · simp [haS.1 hi]
  by_cases hj : 0 < j
  · simp [hbS.1 hj]
  refine ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega), fun h => ?_⟩
  obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
  obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
  rw [d_mul_of_mem_zero hai, haS.2 rfl, hbS.2 rfl, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.truncLEZero_d_mem
statement:
theorem truncLEZero_d_mem {a : A} (ha : a ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A)) :
    d a ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_ofComponents _)
    (P := fun a => d a ∈ ofComponents (truncLEZeroComponents A)) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun a a' h h' => by simpa only [d_add] using add_mem h h') ha
  intro i a hai haS
  rw [mem_truncLEZeroComponents_iff hai] at haS
  rw [mem_truncLEZeroComponents_iff (d_mem hai)]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun _ => d_d a⟩
  by_cases hi : 0 < i
  · rw [haS.1 hi, d_zero]
  · exact haS.2 (by omega)

name: DG.mem_truncLEZero_iff_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_truncLEZero_iff_of_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x ∈ truncLEZero A ↔ (0 < k → x = 0) ∧ (k = 0 → d x = 0)
proof:
:=
  mem_truncLEZeroComponents_iff hx

name: DG.mem_truncLEZero_of_neg
statement:
theorem mem_truncLEZero_of_neg {k : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ grading k) (hk : k < 0) :
    x ∈ truncLEZero A
proof:
:=
  (mem_truncLEZero_iff_of_mem_grading hx).mpr ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega),
    fun h => absurd h (by omega)⟩

name: DG.bijective_cohomologyMap_truncLEZero
statement:
theorem bijective_cohomologyMap_truncLEZero {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≤ 0) :
    Function.Bijective ((DGSubring.subtype (truncLEZero A)).cohomologyMap n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z =>
    rw [DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mk, cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff, DGRingHom.coe_cocyclesMap,
      DGSubring.subtype_apply] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hda⟩ := hx
    rw [cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨a, mem_truncLEZero_of_neg ha (by omega)⟩, ha, Subtype.ext hda⟩
  · intro x
    induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z =>
    have hz : (z : A) ∈ truncLEZero A :=
      (mem_truncLEZero_iff_of_mem_grading z.2.1).mpr
        ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega), fun _ => z.2.2⟩
    refine ⟨cohomology.mk _ n ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, z.2.1, Subtype.ext z.2.2⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mk]
    rfl

name: DG.truncLEZero.subsingleton_cohomology_of_pos
statement:
theorem truncLEZero.subsingleton_cohomology_of_pos {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Subsingleton (cohomology (truncLEZero A) n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ x : cohomology (truncLEZero A) n, x = 0 := by
    intro x
    induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z =>
    have hz : (z : truncLEZero A) = 0 :=
      Subtype.ext (((mem_truncLEZero_iff_of_mem_grading (A := A)
        (x := ((z : truncLEZero A) : A)) z.2.1).mp (z : truncLEZero A).2).1 hn)
    have : z = 0 := Subtype.ext hz
    rw [this, map_zero]
  rw [key x, key y]

name: DG.mem_truncGEZeroComponents_iff
statement:
theorem mem_truncGEZeroComponents_iff {k : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x ∈ ofComponents (truncGEZeroComponents A) ↔ (k = 0 → x ∈ coboundaries A 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ofComponents_of_mem_grading hx, truncGEZeroComponents]
  by_cases h : k = 0 <;> simp [h]

name: DG.eq_zero_of_mem_grading_of_pos
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading_of_pos {k : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ grading k) (hk : 0 < k) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA k hk] at hx
  exact hx

name: DG.d_eq_zero_of_mem_grading_zero
statement: theorem d_eq_zero_of_mem_grading_zero {x : A} (hx : x ∈ grading 0) : d x = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_mem_grading_of_pos hA (d_mem hx) (by norm_num)

name: DG.truncGEZero_d_mem
statement: theorem truncGEZero_d_mem (a : A) : d a ∈ ofComponents (truncGEZeroComponents A)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [d_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | h_add a b ha hb => rw [d_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    rename_i i
    rw [mem_truncGEZeroComponents_iff (d_mem ha)]
    intro h
    obtain rfl : i = 0 - 1 := by omega
    exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: DG.truncGEZero_mul_mem_left
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_ofComponents _)
    (P := fun a => c * a ∈ ofComponents (truncGEZeroComponents A)) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun a a' h h' => by simpa only [mul_add] using add_mem h h') ha
  intro i a hai haS
  induction c using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [zero_mem]
  | h_add c c' hc hc' => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hc hc'
  | h_homogeneous c =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := c
    rename_i j
    rw [mem_truncGEZeroComponents_iff hai] at haS
    rw [mem_truncGEZeroComponents_iff (mul_mem_grading hc hai)]
    intro h
    by_cases hj : 0 < j
    · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_grading_of_pos hA hc hj, zero_mul]
      exact zero_mem _
    by_cases hi : 0 < i
    · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_grading_of_pos hA hai hi, mul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := haS rfl
    refine ⟨c * b, by simpa using mul_mem_grading hc hb, ?_⟩
    rw [d_mul_of_mem_zero hc, d_eq_zero_of_mem_grading_zero hA hc, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: DG.truncGEZero_mul_mem_right
statement:
theorem truncGEZero_mul_mem_right {a : A} (c : A)
    (ha : a ∈ ofComponents (truncGEZeroComponents A)) :
    a * c ∈ ofComponents (truncGEZeroComponents A)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_of_isHomogeneous (isHomogeneous_ofComponents _)
    (P := fun a => a * c ∈ ofComponents (truncGEZeroComponents A)) (by simp [zero_mem]) ?_
    (fun a a' h h' => by simpa only [add_mul] using add_mem h h') ha
  intro i a hai haS
  induction c using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [zero_mem]
  | h_add c c' hc hc' => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hc hc'
  | h_homogeneous c =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := c
    rename_i j
    rw [mem_truncGEZeroComponents_iff hai] at haS
    rw [mem_truncGEZeroComponents_iff (mul_mem_grading hai hc)]
    intro h
    by_cases hj : 0 < j
    · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_grading_of_pos hA hc hj, mul_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    by_cases hi : 0 < i
    · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_grading_of_pos hA hai hi, zero_mul]
      exact zero_mem _
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := haS rfl
    refine ⟨b * c, by simpa using mul_mem_grading hb hc, ?_⟩
    rw [d_mul hb, d_eq_zero_of_mem_grading_zero hA hc, mul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.mem_truncGEZeroIdeal_iff_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_truncGEZeroIdeal_iff_of_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    x ∈ truncGEZeroIdeal hA ↔ (k = 0 → x ∈ coboundaries A 0)
proof:
:=
  mem_truncGEZeroComponents_iff hx

name: DG.truncGEZeroπ_surjective
statement: theorem truncGEZeroπ_surjective : Function.Surjective (truncGEZeroπ hA)
proof:
:=
  DGIdeal.Quotient.mk_surjective _

name: DG.truncGEZero.d_eq_zero
statement: theorem d_eq_zero (x : A ⧸ truncGEZeroIdeal hA) : d x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := truncGEZeroπ_surjective hA x
  rw [← DGRingHom.map_d]
  exact (DGIdeal.Quotient.mk_eq_zero_iff_mem _).mpr (truncGEZero_d_mem a)

name: DG.truncGEZero.eq_zero_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_grading {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {x : A ⧸ truncGEZeroIdeal hA}
    (hx : x ∈ grading n) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact (DGIdeal.Quotient.mk_eq_zero_iff_mem _).mpr
    ((mem_truncGEZeroIdeal_iff_of_mem_grading hA ha).mpr fun h => absurd h hn)

name: DG.bijective_cohomologyMap_truncGEZeroπ
statement:
theorem bijective_cohomologyMap_truncGEZeroπ :
    Function.Bijective ((truncGEZeroπ hA).cohomologyMap 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h z =>
    rw [DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mk, cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff, DGRingHom.coe_cocyclesMap] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := hx
    rw [truncGEZero.d_eq_zero] at hy
    have hz : (z : A) ∈ truncGEZeroIdeal hA :=
      (DGIdeal.Quotient.mk_eq_zero_iff_mem _).mp hy.symm
    rw [cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff]
    exact (mem_truncGEZeroIdeal_iff_of_mem_grading hA z.2.1).mp hz rfl
  · intro x
    induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
    | h w =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hw⟩ := w.2.1
    refine ⟨cohomology.mk _ 0 ⟨a, ha, d_eq_zero_of_mem_grading_zero hA ha⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mk]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext hw

name: DG.IsFGProjective.free_of_isPID
statement:
theorem free_of_isPID [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {M : ModuleCat.{v} R}
    (hM : IsFGProjective R M) : Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hM
  infer_instance

name: DG.IsFGProjective.free_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem free_of_isLocalRing [IsLocalRing R] {M : ModuleCat.{v} R} (hM : IsFGProjective R M) :
    Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hM
  exact Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing

name: DG.ProjK0.isFGProjective_pi
statement: theorem isFGProjective_pi (n : ℕ) : IsFGProjective R (ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R))
proof:
:=
  ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: DG.ProjK0.mk_pi
statement:
theorem mk_pi (n : ℕ) :
    mk (ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R)) (isFGProjective_pi R n) =
      n • mk (ModuleCat.of R R) (IsFGProjective.self R)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [zero_smul]
    exact mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _) _
  | succ n ih =>
    let e : ModuleCat.of R (Fin (n + 1) → R) ≅
        ModuleCat.of R R ⊞ ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R) :=
      (Fin.consLinearEquiv R fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => R).toModuleIso.symm ≪≫
        (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd (ModuleCat.of R R) (ModuleCat.of R (Fin n → R))).symm
    rw [mk_eq_of_iso e _ ((IsFGProjective.self R).biprod (isFGProjective_pi R n)),
      mk_biprod (IsFGProjective.self R) (isFGProjective_pi R n), ih,
      succ_nsmul']

name: DG.ProjK0.rank_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_mk (P : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hP : IsFGProjective R P) :
    rank R hfree (mk P hP) = Module.finrank R P
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ P hP

name: DG.ProjK0.mk_eq_finrank_smul
statement:
theorem mk_eq_finrank_smul (P : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hP : IsFGProjective R P) :
    mk P hP = Module.finrank R P • mk (ModuleCat.of R R) (IsFGProjective.self R)
proof:
:= by
  have := hfree P hP
  have := hP.1
  rw [← mk_pi]
  exact mk_eq_of_iso (Module.finBasis R P).equivFun.toModuleIso _ _

name: DG.ProjK0.rankEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rankEquiv_mk (P : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hP : IsFGProjective R P) :
    rankEquiv R hfree (mk P hP) = Module.finrank R P
proof:
:=
  rank_mk R hfree P hP

name: DG.ProjK0.rankEquiv_mk_self
statement:
theorem rankEquiv_mk_self :
    rankEquiv R hfree (mk (ModuleCat.of R R) (IsFGProjective.self R)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankEquiv_mk, Module.finrank_self, Nat.cast_one]

name: DG.DGRing.K0.rankEquiv_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rankEquiv_self : rankEquiv R hfree (self R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankEquiv, AddEquiv.trans_apply, projK0Equiv_self, ProjK0.rankEquiv_mk_self]

name: DG.DGRing.K0.rankEquiv_symm_apply
statement: theorem rankEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℤ) : (rankEquiv R hfree).symm n = n • self R
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq, map_zsmul, rankEquiv_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: DG.DGRing.K0.equivIntOfIsPrincipalIdealRing_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivIntOfIsPrincipalIdealRing_self : equivIntOfIsPrincipalIdealRing R (self R) = 1
proof:
:=
  rankEquiv_self R _

name: DG.DGRing.K0.equivIntOfIsLocalRing_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivIntOfIsLocalRing_self : equivIntOfIsLocalRing R (self R) = 1
proof:
:=
  rankEquiv_self R _

name: DG.HomK.smul_def
statement: theorem smul_def {Y : C} (c : K) (f : HomK ρ Y) : c • f = (ρ c ≫ (f : G ⟶ Y) : G ⟶ Y)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HomK.postcomp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcomp_apply {Y Z : C} (g : Y ⟶ Z) (f : G ⟶ Y) : postcomp ρ g f = f ≫ g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HomK.postcomp_comp
statement:
theorem postcomp_comp {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    postcomp ρ (f ≫ g) = (postcomp ρ g).comp (postcomp ρ f)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun _ => (assoc _ _ _).symm

name: DG.HomK.finrankHom_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem finrankHom_eq_of_iso {Y Z : C} (e : Y ≅ Z) : finrankHom ρ Y = finrankHom ρ Z
proof:
:=
  (linearEquivOfIso ρ e).finrank_eq

name: DG.HomK.finiteDimensional_of_iso
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_iso {Y Z : C} (e : Y ≅ Z) [FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ Y)] :
    FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ Z)
proof:
:=
  LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (linearEquivOfIso ρ e)

name: DG.HomK.postcomp_neg
statement: theorem postcomp_neg {Y Z : C} (g : Y ⟶ Z) : postcomp ρ (-g) = -postcomp ρ g
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun (f : G ⟶ Y) => Preadditive.comp_neg f g

name: DG.HomK.postcomp_units_smul
statement:
theorem postcomp_units_smul {Y Z : C} (u : ℤˣ) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    postcomp ρ (u • g) = postcomp ρ g ∨ postcomp ρ (u • g) = -postcomp ρ g
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [one_smul])
  · exact Or.inr (by rw [Units.neg_smul, one_smul, postcomp_neg])

name: DG.HomK.range_postcomp_units_smul
statement:
theorem range_postcomp_units_smul {Y Z : C} (u : ℤˣ) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    LinearMap.range (postcomp ρ (u • g)) = LinearMap.range (postcomp ρ g)
proof:
:= by
  rcases postcomp_units_smul (ρ := ρ) u g with h | h <;> rw [h]
  exact LinearMap.range_neg _

name: DG.HomK.ker_postcomp_units_smul
statement:
theorem ker_postcomp_units_smul {Y Z : C} (u : ℤˣ) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    LinearMap.ker (postcomp ρ (u • g)) = LinearMap.ker (postcomp ρ g)
proof:
:= by
  rcases postcomp_units_smul (ρ := ρ) u g with h | h <;> rw [h]
  exact LinearMap.ker_neg _

name: DG.HomK.ker_postcomp_comp_iso
statement:
theorem ker_postcomp_comp_iso {Y Z Z' : C} (g : Y ⟶ Z) (e : Z ≅ Z') :
    LinearMap.ker (postcomp ρ (g ≫ e.hom)) = LinearMap.ker (postcomp ρ g)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.ext fun (f : G ⟶ Y) =>
    LinearMap.mem_ker.trans (Iff.trans ?_ LinearMap.mem_ker.symm)
  change f ≫ (g ≫ e.hom) = 0 ↔ f ≫ g = 0
  rw [← assoc, Preadditive.IsIso.comp_right_eq_zero]

name: DG.HomK.range_postcomp_comp_iso
statement:
theorem range_postcomp_comp_iso {Y Z Z' : C} (g : Y ⟶ Z) (e : Z ≅ Z') :
    LinearMap.range (postcomp ρ (g ≫ e.hom)) =
      (LinearMap.range (postcomp ρ g)).map (linearEquivOfIso ρ e).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [postcomp_comp, LinearMap.range_comp]
  rfl

name: DG.HomK.rankHom_units_smul
statement: theorem rankHom_units_smul {Y Z : C} (u : ℤˣ) (g : Y ⟶ Z) : rankHom ρ (u • g) = rankHom ρ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankHom, rankHom, range_postcomp_units_smul]

name: DG.HomK.rankHom_comp_iso
statement:
theorem rankHom_comp_iso {Y Z Z' : C} (g : Y ⟶ Z) (e : Z ≅ Z') :
    rankHom ρ (g ≫ e.hom) = rankHom ρ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankHom, rankHom, range_postcomp_comp_iso]
  exact LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq _ _

name: DG.HomK.rankHom_iso_comp
statement:
theorem rankHom_iso_comp {Y Y' Z : C} (e : Y' ≅ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    rankHom ρ (e.hom ≫ g) = rankHom ρ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankHom, rankHom, postcomp_comp, LinearMap.range_comp,
    show LinearMap.range (postcomp ρ e.hom) = ⊤ from
      LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (linearEquivOfIso ρ e).surjective, Submodule.map_top]

name: DG.HomK.range_eq_ker
statement:
theorem range_eq_ker {X Y Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hfg : f ≫ g = 0)
    (h : IsExactAt (G := G) f g) :
    LinearMap.range (postcomp ρ f) = LinearMap.ker (postcomp ρ g)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.ext fun (φ : G ⟶ Y) => ⟨?_, fun hφ => ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
    exact (assoc ψ f g).trans ((congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp ψ) hfg).trans (comp_zero (f := ψ)))
  · obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := h φ hφ
    exact ⟨ψ, hψ.symm⟩

name: DG.HomK.finrankHom_eq_add
statement:
theorem finrankHom_eq_add {X Y Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hfg : f ≫ g = 0)
    (h : IsExactAt (G := G) f g) [FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ Y)] :
    finrankHom ρ Y = rankHom ρ f + rankHom ρ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrankHom, ← LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (postcomp ρ g), ← range_eq_ker hfg h,
    rankHom, rankHom, add_comm]

name: DG.HomK.finiteDimensional_of_isExactAt
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_isExactAt {X Y Z : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} (hfg : f ≫ g = 0)
    (h : IsExactAt (G := G) f g) [FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ X)]
    [FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ Z)] : FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((⊤ : Submodule K (HomK ρ Y)).map (postcomp ρ g)).FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  have h2 : ((⊤ : Submodule K (HomK ρ Y)) ⊓ LinearMap.ker (postcomp ρ g)).FG := by
    rw [top_inf_eq, ← range_eq_ker hfg h, LinearMap.range_eq_map]
    exact (Module.Finite.fg_top).map _
  exact ⟨Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker (postcomp ρ g) h1 h2⟩

name: DG.alternating_finsum_of_exact
statement:
theorem alternating_finsum_of_exact (d₁ d₂ d₃ a b c : ℤ → ℕ)
    (h₁ : ∀ n, d₁ (n + 1) = c n + a (n + 1)) (h₂ : ∀ n, d₂ n = a n + b n)
    (h₃ : ∀ n, d₃ n = b n + c n) (hd₁ : (Function.support d₁).Finite)
    (hd₃ : (Function.support d₃).Finite) :
    (Function.support d₂).Finite ∧
      ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₂ n =
        ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₁ n + ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₃ n
proof:
:= by
  have ha : Function.support a ⊆ Function.support d₁ := fun n hn h0 => hn (by
    have := h₁ (n - 1)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
    omega)
  have hb : Function.support b ⊆ Function.support d₃ := fun n hn h0 => hn (by
    have := h₃ n; omega)
  have hc : Function.support c ⊆ Function.support d₃ := fun n hn h0 => hn (by
    have := h₃ n; omega)
  have hd₂ : (Function.support d₂).Finite := (hd₁.union hd₃).subset fun n hn => by
    by_contra h
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Function.mem_support, not_or, not_not] at h
    exact hn (by rw [h₂ n]; have := ha.mt (by simpa using h.1); have := hb.mt (by simpa using h.2)
                 simp_all)
  refine ⟨hd₂, ?_⟩
  have fin : ∀ f : ℤ → ℕ, (Function.support f).Finite →
      Function.HasFiniteSupport fun n : ℤ => (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * f n := fun f hf =>
    hf.subset fun n hn => by
      simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, not_or] at hn
      exact_mod_cast hn.2
  let g : ℤ → ℤ := fun n => (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * c (n - 1)
  have hg : Function.HasFiniteSupport g := (hd₃.subset hc).preimage
    (Set.injOn_of_injective (sub_left_injective (b := 1))) |>.subset fun n hn => by
      simp only [g, Function.mem_support, ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, not_or] at hn
      exact (by exact_mod_cast hn.2 : c (n - 1) ≠ 0)
  have hg' : Function.HasFiniteSupport fun n => g (n + 1) :=
    (hg.preimage (Set.injOn_of_injective (add_left_injective 1))).subset fun n hn => hn
  have key : ∀ n : ℤ, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₁ n + (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₃ n -
      (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₂ n = g n - g (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    have e₁ := h₁ (n - 1)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at e₁
    simp only [g, e₁, h₂ n, h₃ n, add_sub_cancel_right, Int.negOnePow_succ, Units.val_neg]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hsum : ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (g n - g (n + 1)) = 0 := by
    have e := finsum_comp_equiv (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ)) (f := g)
    simp only [Equiv.coe_addRight] at e
    rw [finsum_sub_distrib hg hg', e, sub_self]
  have e := finsum_sub_distrib
    (f := fun n : ℤ => (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₁ n + (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₃ n)
    (g := fun n : ℤ => (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * d₂ n)
    (((hd₁.union hd₃).subset fun n hn => by
      by_contra h
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Function.mem_support, not_or, not_not] at h
      exact hn (by simp [h.1, h.2])) : Function.HasFiniteSupport _) (fin d₂ hd₂)
  rw [← finsum_add_distrib (fin d₁ hd₁) (fin d₃ hd₃), eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, ← e]
  simpa only [key] using hsum

name: DG.HomK.shift_map_units_smul
statement:
theorem shift_map_units_smul {X Y : C} (n : ℤ) (u : ℤˣ) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (u • f)⟦n⟧' = u • f⟦n⟧'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, Functor.map_zsmul]

name: DG.HomK.shift_mem_distTriang
statement:
theorem shift_mem_distTriang :
    Triangle.mk (n.negOnePow • T.mor₁⟦n⟧') (n.negOnePow • T.mor₂⟦n⟧')
      (n.negOnePow • T.mor₃⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorComm C 1 n).hom.app T.obj₁) ∈ distTriang C
proof:
:=
  Triangle.shift_distinguished T hT n

name: DG.HomK.comp_zero₁₂
statement: theorem comp_zero₁₂ : T.mor₁⟦n⟧' ≫ T.mor₂⟦n⟧' = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, comp_distTriang_mor_zero₁₂ T hT, Functor.map_zero]

name: DG.HomK.isExactAt₁₂
statement: theorem isExactAt₁₂ : IsExactAt (G := G) (T.mor₁⟦n⟧') (T.mor₂⟦n⟧')
proof:
:= by
  intro φ hφ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₂ _ (shift_mem_distTriang T hT n) φ (by
    dsimp only [Triangle.mk_mor₂]
    rw [Linear.comp_units_smul, hφ, smul_zero])
  refine ⟨n.negOnePow • ψ, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk_mor₁] at hψ
  rw [hψ, Linear.comp_units_smul, Linear.units_smul_comp]

name: DG.HomK.comp_zero₂₃
statement: theorem comp_zero₂₃ : T.mor₂⟦n⟧' ≫ connecting T n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₂₃ _ (shift_mem_distTriang T hT n)
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk_mor₂, Triangle.mk_mor₃] at h
  rw [Linear.units_smul_comp, smul_eq_zero_iff_eq] at h
  rw [connecting, ← assoc, h, zero_comp]

name: DG.HomK.isExactAt₂₃
statement: theorem isExactAt₂₃ : IsExactAt (G := G) (T.mor₂⟦n⟧') (connecting T n)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ hφ
  rw [connecting, ← assoc, Preadditive.IsIso.comp_right_eq_zero] at hφ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₃ _ (shift_mem_distTriang T hT n) φ hφ
  refine ⟨n.negOnePow • ψ, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk_mor₂] at hψ
  rw [hψ, Linear.comp_units_smul, Linear.units_smul_comp]

name: DG.HomK.shift_mor₁_naturality
statement:
theorem shift_mor₁_naturality :
    (shiftFunctorAdd' C n 1 (n + 1) rfl).inv.app T.obj₁ ≫ T.mor₁⟦n + 1⟧' =
      (T.mor₁⟦n⟧')⟦1⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorAdd' C n 1 (n + 1) rfl).inv.app T.obj₂
proof:
:=
  ((shiftFunctorAdd' C n 1 (n + 1) rfl).inv.naturality T.mor₁).symm

name: DG.HomK.comp_zero₃₁
statement: theorem comp_zero₃₁ : connecting T n ≫ T.mor₁⟦n + 1⟧' = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_distTriang_mor_zero₃₁ _ (shift_mem_distTriang T hT n)
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk_mor₁, Triangle.mk_mor₃, Triangle.mk_obj₁] at h
  rw [shift_map_units_smul, Linear.comp_units_smul, smul_eq_zero_iff_eq] at h
  rw [connecting, assoc, shift_mor₁_naturality, ← assoc, h, zero_comp]

name: DG.HomK.isExactAt₃₁
statement: theorem isExactAt₃₁ : IsExactAt (G := G) (connecting T n) (T.mor₁⟦n + 1⟧')
proof:
:= by
  intro φ hφ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := Triangle.coyoneda_exact₁ _ (shift_mem_distTriang T hT n)
    (φ ≫ (shiftFunctorAdd' C n 1 (n + 1) rfl).hom.app T.obj₁) (by
      dsimp only [Triangle.mk_mor₁, Triangle.mk_obj₁]
      have hn : (shiftFunctorAdd' C n 1 (n + 1) rfl).hom.app T.obj₁ ≫ (T.mor₁⟦n⟧')⟦1⟧' =
          T.mor₁⟦n + 1⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorAdd' C n 1 (n + 1) rfl).hom.app T.obj₂ :=
        ((shiftFunctorAdd' C n 1 (n + 1) rfl).hom.naturality T.mor₁).symm
      rw [shift_map_units_smul, Linear.comp_units_smul, assoc, hn, ← assoc, hφ, zero_comp,
        smul_zero])
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk_mor₃] at hψ
  rw [connecting, ← assoc, ← hψ, assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, comp_id]

name: DG.HomK.finrankHom_obj₂
statement:
theorem finrankHom_obj₂ [FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ (T.obj₂⟦n⟧))] :
    finrankHom ρ (T.obj₂⟦n⟧) = rankHom ρ (T.mor₁⟦n⟧') + rankHom ρ (T.mor₂⟦n⟧')
proof:
:=
  finrankHom_eq_add (ρ := ρ) (comp_zero₁₂ T hT n) (isExactAt₁₂ T hT n)

name: DG.HomK.finrankHom_obj₃
statement:
theorem finrankHom_obj₃ [FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ (T.obj₃⟦n⟧))] :
    finrankHom ρ (T.obj₃⟦n⟧) = rankHom ρ (T.mor₂⟦n⟧') + rankHom ρ (connecting T n)
proof:
:=
  finrankHom_eq_add (ρ := ρ) (comp_zero₂₃ T hT n) (isExactAt₂₃ T hT n)

name: DG.HomK.finrankHom_obj₁
statement:
theorem finrankHom_obj₁ [FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ (T.obj₁⟦n + 1⟧))] :
    finrankHom ρ (T.obj₁⟦n + 1⟧) = rankHom ρ (connecting T n) + rankHom ρ (T.mor₁⟦n + 1⟧')
proof:
:=
  finrankHom_eq_add (ρ := ρ) (comp_zero₃₁ T hT n) (isExactAt₃₁ T hT n)

name: DG.HomK.isFin_obj₂_and_eulerChar
statement:
theorem isFin_obj₂_and_eulerChar (h₁ : IsFin ρ T.obj₁) (h₃ : IsFin ρ T.obj₃) :
    IsFin ρ T.obj₂ ∧ eulerChar ρ T.obj₂ = eulerChar ρ T.obj₁ + eulerChar ρ T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  have fd₂ : ∀ n : ℤ, FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ (T.obj₂⟦n⟧)) := fun n => by
    have := h₁.1 n; have := h₃.1 n
    exact finiteDimensional_of_isExactAt (ρ := ρ) (comp_zero₁₂ T hT n) (isExactAt₁₂ T hT n)
  obtain ⟨hfin, hsum⟩ := alternating_finsum_of_exact (fun n => finrankHom ρ (T.obj₁⟦n⟧))
    (fun n => finrankHom ρ (T.obj₂⟦n⟧)) (fun n => finrankHom ρ (T.obj₃⟦n⟧))
    (fun n => rankHom ρ (T.mor₁⟦n⟧')) (fun n => rankHom ρ (T.mor₂⟦n⟧'))
    (fun n => rankHom ρ (connecting T n))
    (fun n => by have := h₁.1 (n + 1); exact finrankHom_obj₁ ρ T hT n)
    (fun n => by have := fd₂ n; exact finrankHom_obj₂ ρ T hT n)
    (fun n => by have := h₃.1 n; exact finrankHom_obj₃ ρ T hT n) h₁.2 h₃.2
  exact ⟨⟨fd₂, hfin⟩, hsum⟩

name: DG.HomK.finrankHom_shift_shift
statement:
theorem finrankHom_shift_shift (Y : C) (m n : ℤ) :
    finrankHom ρ (Y⟦m⟧⟦n⟧) = finrankHom ρ (Y⟦m + n⟧)
proof:
:=
  finrankHom_eq_of_iso ((shiftFunctorAdd' C m n (m + n) rfl).app Y).symm

name: DG.HomK.IsFin.shift
statement: theorem IsFin.shift {Y : C} (h : IsFin ρ Y) (m : ℤ) : IsFin ρ (Y⟦m⟧)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := h.1 (m + n)
    exact finiteDimensional_of_iso ((shiftFunctorAdd' C m n (m + n) rfl).app Y)
  · refine (h.2.preimage (Set.injOn_of_injective (add_right_injective m))).subset fun n hn => ?_
    simpa only [Function.mem_support, Set.mem_preimage, finrankHom_shift_shift] using hn

name: DG.HomK.eulerChar_shift
statement:
theorem eulerChar_shift (Y : C) (m : ℤ) :
    eulerChar ρ (Y⟦m⟧) = (m.negOnePow : ℤ) * eulerChar ρ Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerChar, eulerChar, mul_finsum]
  simp only [finrankHom_shift_shift]
  have e := finsum_comp_equiv (Equiv.addLeft m)
    (f := fun k : ℤ => ((k - m).negOnePow : ℤ) * finrankHom ρ (Y⟦k⟧))
  simp only [Equiv.coe_addLeft, add_sub_cancel_left] at e
  rw [e]
  refine finsum_congr fun k => ?_
  rw [Int.negOnePow_sub, Units.val_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (m.negOnePow : ℤ)]

name: DG.HomK.isFin_of_isZero
statement: theorem isFin_of_isZero {Y : C} (hY : IsZero Y) : IsFin ρ Y
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (HomK ρ (Y⟦n⟧)) := fun n =>
    ⟨fun f g => ((Functor.map_isZero _ hY).eq_of_tgt f g : _)⟩
  refine ⟨fun n => inferInstance, ?_⟩
  convert Set.finite_empty
  ext n
  simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_not]
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: DG.HomK.IsFin.of_retract
statement: theorem IsFin.of_retract {X Y : C} (r : Retract X Y) (h : IsFin ρ Y) : IsFin ρ X
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ n : ℤ, Function.Injective (postcomp ρ (r.i⟦n⟧')) := fun n =>
    Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := postcomp ρ (r.r⟦n⟧')) fun (f : G ⟶ X⟦n⟧) => by
      change (f ≫ r.i⟦n⟧') ≫ r.r⟦n⟧' = f
      rw [assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, r.retract, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, comp_id]
  have fd : ∀ n : ℤ, FiniteDimensional K (HomK ρ (X⟦n⟧)) := fun n => by
    have := h.1 n
    exact Module.Finite.of_injective _ (hinj n)
  refine ⟨fd, h.2.subset fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have := h.1 n
  simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hn ⊢
  have := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (hinj n)
  exact fun h0 => hn (by rw [finrankHom] at *; omega)

name: DG.HomK.isThick_isFin
statement:
theorem isThick_isFin : IsThick (IsFin ρ) where
  zero
proof:
:= isFin_of_isZero (isZero_zero C)
  shift _ n h := h.shift n
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := (isFin_obj₂_and_eulerChar T hT h₁ h₃).1
  retract r h := h.of_retract r

name: DG.HomK.eulerChar_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem eulerChar_eq_of_iso {Y Z : C} (e : Y ≅ Z) : eulerChar ρ Y = eulerChar ρ Z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eulerChar, finrankHom_eq_of_iso ((shiftFunctor C _).mapIso e)]

name: DG.K0.mk_obj₂_of_mem
statement:
theorem K0.mk_obj₂_of_mem (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) (h₁ : 𝒮 T.obj₁)
    (h₂ : 𝒮 T.obj₂) (h₃ : 𝒮 T.obj₃) :
    K0.mk (⟨T.obj₂, h₂⟩ : 𝒮.FullSubcategory) = K0.mk ⟨T.obj₁, h₁⟩ + K0.mk ⟨T.obj₃, h₃⟩
proof:
:= by
  let T' : Triangle 𝒮.FullSubcategory :=
    Triangle.mk (𝒮.fullyFaithfulι.preimage T.mor₁ :
        (⟨T.obj₁, h₁⟩ : 𝒮.FullSubcategory) ⟶ ⟨T.obj₂, h₂⟩)
      (𝒮.fullyFaithfulι.preimage T.mor₂ :
        (⟨T.obj₂, h₂⟩ : 𝒮.FullSubcategory) ⟶ ⟨T.obj₃, h₃⟩)
      (𝒮.fullyFaithfulι.preimage
        (T.mor₃ ≫ (𝒮.ι.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).inv.app ⟨T.obj₁, h₁⟩))
  have hT' : T' ∈ distTriang _ :=
    isomorphic_distinguished _ hT _ (Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
      (by simp [T']) (by simp [T']) (by simp [T']))
  exact K0.mk_obj₂ T' hT'

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.ρ_injective
statement: theorem ρ_injective (j : J) : Function.Injective (ρ j)
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun c hc => ?_
  by_contra h
  apply hG.nonzero j
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero, ← End.one_def, ← map_one (ρ j), ← mul_inv_cancel₀ h, map_mul, hc,
    zero_mul]

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.finrankHom_self
statement: theorem finrankHom_self (j : J) : HomK.finrankHom (ρ j) (G j) = 1
proof:
:=
  (hG.endEquiv j).finrank_eq.symm.trans (Module.finrank_self K)

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.subsingleton_homK
statement:
theorem subsingleton_homK {j j' : J} {n : ℤ} (h : j ≠ j' ∨ n ≠ 0) :
    Subsingleton (HomK (ρ j) ((G j')⟦n⟧))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun f g => (hG.orth j j' n h f).trans (hG.orth j j' n h g).symm⟩

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.finrankHom_G
statement:
theorem finrankHom_G (j j' : J) (n : ℤ) :
    HomK.finrankHom (ρ j) ((G j')⟦n⟧) = if j = j' ∧ n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact (HomK.finrankHom_eq_of_iso ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app (G j))).trans
      (hG.finrankHom_self j)
  · have := hG.subsingleton_homK (j := j) (j' := j') (n := n) (by tauto)
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.eulerChar_G
statement:
theorem eulerChar_G (j j' : J) :
    HomK.eulerChar (ρ j) (G j') = if j = j' then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomK.eulerChar, finsum_eq_single _ 0 fun n hn => by simp [hG.finrankHom_G, hn]]
  simp [hG.finrankHom_G]

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.totalDim'_shift
statement: theorem totalDim'_shift (X : C) (m : ℤ) : totalDim' ρ (X⟦m⟧) = totalDim' ρ X
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  simp only [HomK.finrankHom_shift_shift]
  exact finsum_comp_equiv (Equiv.addLeft m) (f := fun k => HomK.finrankHom (ρ j) (X⟦k⟧))

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.finrankHom_cone
statement:
theorem finrankHom_cone {j : J} {Y Z : C} (hY : 𝒮 Y) (hZ : 𝒮 Z) {f : G j ⟶ Y} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ (G j)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧} (hT : Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distTriang C) (j' : J)
    (m : ℤ) :
    HomK.finrankHom (ρ j') (Z⟦m⟧) + (if j' = j ∧ m = 0 then 1 else 0) =
      HomK.finrankHom (ρ j') (Y⟦m⟧)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ m : ℤ, Function.Injective (HomK.postcomp (ρ j') (f⟦m⟧')) := by
    intro m
    refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun (φ : G j' ⟶ (G j)⟦m⟧) hφ => ?_
    change φ ≫ f⟦m⟧' = 0 at hφ
    by_cases hjm : j' = j ∧ m = 0
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hjm
      let e := (shiftFunctorZero C ℤ)
      have hnat : f⟦0⟧' ≫ e.hom.app Y = e.hom.app (G j') ≫ f := e.hom.naturality f
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hG.surj j' (φ ≫ e.hom.app (G j'))
      have h0 : (c • (show HomK (ρ j') Y from f)) = 0 := by
        change ρ j' c ≫ f = 0
        rw [← hc, assoc, ← hnat, ← assoc, hφ, zero_comp]
      rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h0 with hc0 | hf0
      · rw [hc0, map_zero] at hc
        exact (cancel_mono (e.hom.app (G j'))).mp (hc.trans (zero_comp).symm)
      · exact absurd hf0 hf
    · exact (hG.subsingleton_homK (by tauto)).elim _ _
  have fd : ∀ (W : C), 𝒮 W → ∀ m : ℤ, FiniteDimensional K (HomK (ρ j') (W⟦m⟧)) :=
    fun W hW m => (hG.isFin W hW j').1 m
  have hG' : 𝒮 (G j) := hG.mem j
  have ha : ∀ m : ℤ, HomK.rankHom (ρ j') (f⟦m⟧') = HomK.finrankHom (ρ j') ((G j)⟦m⟧) :=
    fun m => LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (hinj m)
  have h₁ := by
    have : FiniteDimensional K (HomK (ρ j') ((Triangle.mk f g h).obj₁⟦m + 1⟧)) :=
      fd _ hG' (m + 1)
    exact HomK.finrankHom_obj₁ (ρ j') _ hT m
  have h₂ := by
    have : FiniteDimensional K (HomK (ρ j') ((Triangle.mk f g h).obj₂⟦m⟧)) := fd _ hY m
    exact HomK.finrankHom_obj₂ (ρ j') _ hT m
  have h₃ := by
    have : FiniteDimensional K (HomK (ρ j') ((Triangle.mk f g h).obj₃⟦m⟧)) := fd _ hZ m
    exact HomK.finrankHom_obj₃ (ρ j') _ hT m
  dsimp only [Triangle.mk_obj₁, Triangle.mk_obj₂, Triangle.mk_obj₃, Triangle.mk_mor₁,
    Triangle.mk_mor₂] at h₁ h₂ h₃
  rw [ha] at h₁ h₂
  rw [← hG.finrankHom_G j' j m]
  omega

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.totalDim'_cone
statement:
theorem totalDim'_cone {j : J} {Y Z : C} (hY : 𝒮 Y) (hZ : 𝒮 Z) {f : G j ⟶ Y} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    {g : Y ⟶ Z} {h : Z ⟶ (G j)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧} (hT : Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distTriang C) :
    totalDim' ρ Z + 1 = totalDim' ρ Y
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : ∀ j' : J, (Function.support fun m : ℤ => if j' = j ∧ m = 0 then 1 else 0).Finite :=
    fun j' => (Set.finite_singleton (0 : ℤ)).subset fun m hm => by
      by_contra h0
      exact hm (by simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h0; simp [h0])
  have hsum : ∀ j' : J, ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, HomK.finrankHom (ρ j') (Y⟦m⟧) =
      ∑ᶠ m : ℤ, HomK.finrankHom (ρ j') (Z⟦m⟧) + if j' = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro j'
    rw [← finsum_congr (hG.finrankHom_cone hY hZ hf hT j'),
      finsum_add_distrib (hG.isFin Z hZ j').2 (hδ j')]
    congr 1
    rw [finsum_eq_single _ 0 fun m hm => by simp [hm]]
    simp
  simp only [totalDim', hsum, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
    ite_true]

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.mk_eq_sum
statement:
theorem mk_eq_sum (X : 𝒮.FullSubcategory) :
    K0.mk X = ∑ j, HomK.eulerChar (ρ j) X.obj • K0.mk (⟨G j, hG.mem j⟩ : 𝒮.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:= by
  induction hN : totalDim' ρ X.obj using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing X with
  | _ N ih =>
  by_cases h0 : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℤ) (f : G j ⟶ X.obj⟦n⟧), f = 0
  · have hX : IsZero X := IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero 𝒮.ι X (hG.gen _ X.2 h0)
    have hχ : ∀ j, HomK.eulerChar (ρ j) X.obj = 0 := fun j => by
      refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun n => ?_
      have : Subsingleton (HomK (ρ j) (X.obj⟦n⟧)) := ⟨fun f g => (h0 j n f).trans (h0 j n g).symm⟩
      rw [HomK.finrankHom, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
    simp only [K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero hX, hχ, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · push Not at h0
    obtain ⟨j, n, f, hf⟩ := h0
    obtain ⟨Z, g, h, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle f
    have hY : 𝒮 (X.obj⟦n⟧) := 𝒮.le_shift n _ X.2
    have hZ : 𝒮 Z := 𝒮.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₃ _ hT (hG.mem j) hY
    have hdim := hG.totalDim'_cone hY hZ hf hT
    rw [totalDim'_shift, hN] at hdim
    have ihZ := ih _ (show totalDim' ρ Z < N by omega) ⟨Z, hZ⟩ rfl
    have hK := K0.mk_obj₂_of_mem 𝒮 _ hT (hG.mem j) hY hZ
    dsimp only [Triangle.mk_obj₁, Triangle.mk_obj₂, Triangle.mk_obj₃] at hK
    rw [K0.mk_eq_of_iso (shiftObjIso X n), K0.mk_shift] at hK
    have hχ : ∀ j', HomK.eulerChar (ρ j') X.obj =
        (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * ((if j' = j then 1 else 0) + HomK.eulerChar (ρ j') Z) := fun j' => by
      have e := (HomK.isFin_obj₂_and_eulerChar _ hT (hG.isFin _ (hG.mem j) j')
        (hG.isFin _ hZ j')).2
      dsimp only [Triangle.mk_obj₁, Triangle.mk_obj₂, Triangle.mk_obj₃] at e
      rw [HomK.eulerChar_shift, hG.eulerChar_G] at e
      rw [← e, ← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, Int.units_mul_self, Units.val_one, one_mul]
    have hX : K0.mk X = n.negOnePow • (n.negOnePow • K0.mk X) := by
      rw [smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
    rw [hX, hK, ihZ]
    simp only [hχ, Units.smul_def, mul_smul, add_smul, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, ← Finset.smul_sum]

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.eulerCharHom_mk
statement:
theorem eulerCharHom_mk (X : 𝒮.FullSubcategory) (j : J) :
    hG.eulerCharHom (K0.mk X) j = HomK.eulerChar (ρ j) X.obj
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerCharHom, K0.lift_mk]

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.K0Equiv_mk
statement:
theorem K0Equiv_mk (X : 𝒮.FullSubcategory) (j : J) :
    hG.K0Equiv (K0.mk X) j = HomK.eulerChar (ρ j) X.obj
proof:
:=
  hG.eulerCharHom_mk X j

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.K0Equiv_mk_G
statement:
theorem K0Equiv_mk_G (j : J) :
    hG.K0Equiv (K0.mk (⟨G j, hG.mem j⟩ : 𝒮.FullSubcategory)) = Pi.single j 1
proof:
:= by
  funext j'
  rw [K0Equiv_mk, hG.eulerChar_G, Pi.single_apply]

name: DG.IsOrthonormalGenerating.K0Equiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem K0Equiv_symm_apply (v : J → ℤ) :
    hG.K0Equiv.symm v = ∑ j, v j • K0.mk (⟨G j, hG.mem j⟩ : 𝒮.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.piFunctor_map_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem piFunctor_map_π {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (j : J) :
    (piFunctor Φ).map f ≫ Pi.π _ j = Pi.π _ j ≫ (Φ j).map f
proof:
:=
  Limits.Pi.map_π (fun j => (Φ j).map f) j

name: DG.piFunctorCommShiftIsoApp_hom_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem piFunctorCommShiftIsoApp_hom_π (n : ℤ) (X : C) (j : J) :
    (piFunctorCommShiftIsoApp Φ n X).hom ≫ (Pi.π _ j)⟦n⟧' =
      Pi.π _ j ≫ ((Φ j).commShiftIso n).hom.app X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← piComparison_comp_π]
  simp [piFunctorCommShiftIsoApp]

name: DG.shift_pi_hom_ext
statement:
theorem shift_pi_hom_ext (n : ℤ) {f : J → D} {Y : D} {g g' : Y ⟶ (∏ᶜ f)⟦n⟧}
    (h : ∀ j, g ≫ (Pi.π f j)⟦n⟧' = g' ≫ (Pi.π f j)⟦n⟧') : g = g'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (piComparison (shiftFunctor D n) f)]
  ext j
  simpa only [assoc, piComparison_comp_π] using h j

name: DG.IsPerfect.eulerChar_eq
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq {X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hX : IsPerfect R X)
    {K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ} (hK : IsPerfectComplex K)
    (e : _root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ X) : eulerChar X hX = hK.eulerChar
proof:
:=
  IsPerfectComplex.eulerChar_eq_of_iso_Q _ hK (hX.choose_spec.choose_spec.some ≪≫ e.symm)

name: DG.IsPerfect.eulerChar_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_of_iso {X Y : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (hX : IsPerfect R X) (hY : IsPerfect R Y) : eulerChar X hX = eulerChar Y hY
proof:
:= by
  have hY' := hY
  obtain ⟨K, hK, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hY'
  rw [eulerChar_eq hY hK e', eulerChar_eq hX hK (e' ≪≫ e.symm)]

name: DG.IsPerfect.eulerChar_singleFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem eulerChar_singleFunctor_obj {M : ModuleCat.{u} R} (hM : IsFGProjective R M) (n : ℤ)
    (h : IsPerfect R ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) n).obj M)) :
    eulerChar _ h = n.negOnePow • ProjK0.mk M hM
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerChar_eq h (IsPerfectComplex.single hM n) (singleFunctorObjIso n M).symm,
    IsPerfectComplex.eulerChar_single]

name: DG.IsPerfect.eulerChar_obj₂
statement:
theorem eulerChar_obj₂ (T : Triangle (_root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)))
    (hT : T ∈ distTriang _) (h₁ : IsPerfect R T.obj₁) (h₂ : IsPerfect R T.obj₂)
    (h₃ : IsPerfect R T.obj₃) :
    eulerChar T.obj₂ h₂ = eulerChar T.obj₁ h₁ + eulerChar T.obj₃ h₃
proof:
:= by
  have h₁' := h₁
  have h₂' := h₂
  obtain ⟨K, hK, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ := h₁'
  obtain ⟨L, hL, ⟨e₂⟩⟩ := h₂'
  obtain ⟨g, ⟨e₃⟩⟩ := exists_iso_mappingCone T hT hK e₁ e₂
  rw [eulerChar_eq h₁ hK e₁, eulerChar_eq h₂ hL e₂, eulerChar_eq h₃ (hK.mappingCone g hL) e₃,
    hK.eulerChar_mappingCone g hL, add_sub_cancel]

name: DG.IsPerfect.K0ToProjK0_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem K0ToProjK0_mk [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] (X : P.FullSubcategory) :
    K0ToProjK0 P hP (K0.mk X) = eulerChar X.obj ((hP _).1 X.property)
proof:
:=
  K0.lift_mk _ _ X

name: DG.IsPerfect.projK0ToK0_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projK0ToK0_mk [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hM : IsFGProjective R M) :
    projK0ToK0 P hP (ProjK0.mk M hM) = K0.mk (⟨(_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M,
      (hP _).2 (singleFunctor_obj hM 0)⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:=
  ProjK0.lift_mk _ _ M hM

name: DG.IsPerfect.K0ToProjK0_projK0ToK0
statement:
theorem K0ToProjK0_projK0ToK0 (x : ProjK0.{u} R) :
    K0ToProjK0 P hP (projK0ToK0 P hP x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ProjK0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | mk M hM =>
    rw [projK0ToK0_mk, K0ToProjK0_mk, eulerChar_singleFunctor_obj hM, Int.negOnePow_zero,
      one_smul]
  | neg x hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.IsPerfect.projK0ToK0_eulerChar
statement:
theorem projK0ToK0_eulerChar (X : P.FullSubcategory) :
    projK0ToK0 P hP (eulerChar X.obj ((hP _).1 X.property)) = K0.mk X
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ (X : _root_.DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (hX : IsPerfect R X)
      (h : P X), projK0ToK0 P hP (eulerChar X hX) = K0.mk (⟨X, h⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) from
    h X.obj _ X.property
  refine fun X hX => IsPerfect.induction (motive := fun X hX => ∀ h : P X,
    projK0ToK0 P hP (eulerChar X hX) = K0.mk (⟨X, h⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hX
  · intro X Y hX hY e ih h
    rw [← eulerChar_eq_of_iso e hX hY, ih ((hP _).2 hX)]
    exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj e
  · intro M hM h
    rw [eulerChar_singleFunctor_obj hM, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul, projK0ToK0_mk]
  · intro X hX n ih h
    have h₂ : K0.mk (⟨_, h⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) =
        K0.mk ((⟨X, (hP _).2 hX⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)⟦n⟧) :=
      K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ((P.ι.commShiftIso n).app ⟨X, (hP _).2 hX⟩).symm
    have h₁ : (n.negOnePow : ℤ) • eulerChar X hX = eulerChar (X⟦n⟧) (hX.shift n) := by
      have h₃ := K0ToProjK0_mk P hP ⟨_, h⟩
      rw [h₂, K0.mk_shift, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, K0ToProjK0_mk] at h₃
      exact h₃
    rw [← h₁, map_zsmul, ih ((hP _).2 hX), h₂, K0.mk_shift, Units.smul_def]
  · intro T hT h₁ h₂ h₃ ih₁ ih₃ h
    rw [eulerChar_obj₂ T hT h₁ h₂ h₃, map_add, ih₁ ((hP _).2 h₁), ih₃ ((hP _).2 h₃)]
    exact (K0.mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂ T hT _ _ _).symm

name: DG.IsPerfect.projK0ToK0_K0ToProjK0
statement:
theorem projK0ToK0_K0ToProjK0 (x : K0 P.FullSubcategory) :
    projK0ToK0 P hP (K0ToProjK0 P hP x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | mk X => rw [K0ToProjK0_mk, projK0ToK0_eulerChar]
  | neg x hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.IsPerfect.K0Equiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem K0Equiv_mk (X : P.FullSubcategory) :
    K0Equiv P hP (K0.mk X) = eulerChar X.obj ((hP _).1 X.property)
proof:
:=
  K0ToProjK0_mk P hP X

name: DG.IsPerfect.K0Equiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem K0Equiv_symm_mk (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hM : IsFGProjective R M) :
    (K0Equiv P hP).symm (ProjK0.mk M hM) =
      K0.mk (⟨(_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M,
        (hP _).2 (singleFunctor_obj hM 0)⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:=
  projK0ToK0_mk P hP M hM

name: DG.perfectK0Equiv_mk_Q_obj
statement:
theorem perfectK0Equiv_mk_Q_obj {K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ}
    (hK : IsPerfectComplex K) :
    perfectK0Equiv R (K0.mk ⟨_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj K, IsPerfect.Q_obj hK⟩) =
      hK.eulerChar
proof:
:=
  (IsPerfect.K0Equiv_mk _ _ _).trans (IsPerfect.eulerChar_eq _ hK (Iso.refl _))

name: DG.perfectK0Equiv_symm_mk
statement:
theorem perfectK0Equiv_symm_mk (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hM : IsFGProjective R M) :
    (perfectK0Equiv R).symm (ProjK0.mk M hM) =
      K0.mk ⟨(_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M,
        IsPerfect.singleFunctor_obj hM 0⟩
proof:
:=
  IsPerfect.K0Equiv_symm_mk _ _ M hM

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.cell_eq
statement: theorem cell_eq {X : C} (e : Idempotent X) (n : ℤ) : cell.{w} e n = n.negOnePow • cell e 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cell, ← DG.K0.mk_shift]
  refine DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ?_
  exact (cellShiftIso.{max u v w, max u w} e 0 n ≪≫ eqToIso (by rw [zero_add])).symm ≪≫
    (((compactSubcategory.{max u v w} (CatModule.DerivedCategory C)).ι.commShiftIso n).app
      (perfectCell.{w} e 0)).symm

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.mk_finiteCell
statement:
theorem mk_finiteCell {P : CatModule.{max u v w} C}
    (S : CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.{max u w} P) :
    DG.K0.mk (⟨Q.obj P, S.isCompact_Q_obj⟩ :
      CatModule.PerfectDerivedCategory.{max u v w, max u v w} C) =
      ∑ i, (S.deg i).negOnePow • cell (S.e i) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.cellTower.mk_eq_sum fun _ _ => isCompact_cell _ _,
    CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.cells,
    List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => cell_eq _ _

name: DG.DGCategory.IsPositive.mk_mem_closure_cell
statement:
theorem mk_mem_closure_cell (X : CatModule.PerfectDerivedCategory.{max u v w, max u v w} C) :
    DG.K0.mk X ∈ AddSubgroup.closure
      (Set.range fun c : SimpleCorner C => K0.cell.{w} c.1.2 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, -, hl⟩ := hC.hasOrderedCellTower_of_isCompact.{w} (Y := X.obj) X.property
  have h := CellTower.mk_eq_sum.{max u v w}
    (fun (c : SimpleCorner C) n => isCompact_cell c.1.2 n) hl
  change DG.K0.mk (⟨X.obj, X.property⟩ : CatModule.PerfectDerivedCategory C) ∈ _
  rw [h]
  refine AddSubgroup.list_sum_mem _ fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  change K0.cell.{w} c.1.1.2 c.2 ∈ _
  rw [K0.cell_eq, Units.smul_def]
  exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self c.1)) _

name: DG.DGCategory.IsPositive.closure_cell_eq_top
statement:
theorem closure_cell_eq_top :
    AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun c : SimpleCorner C => K0.cell.{w} c.1.2 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := DG.K0.exists_mk_eq x
  exact hC.mk_mem_closure_cell X

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.of_eq
statement: theorem of_eq {k' : ℤ} (h : k = k') : IsCornerGenerator R e k' g
proof:
:=
  h ▸ hg

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.hom_ext_gen
statement: theorem hom_ext_gen {f f' : R ⟶ N} (h : f.app X g = f'.app X g) : f = f'
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun Y r => congrArg (fun z : Cochain R N 0 => z.app Y r)
    (hg.ext_gen (z := Cochain.ofHom f) (z' := Cochain.ofHom f') h)

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.homOfElement_app_gen
statement:
theorem homOfElement_app_gen [DGCategory C] (y : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading k) (hdy : d y = 0)
    (hey : e.val • y = y) : (hg.homOfElement y hy hdy).app X g = y
proof:
:= by
  change (hg.ofElement (n := 0) y (by rwa [add_zero])).app X g = y
  rw [ofElement_gen, hey]

name: DG.CatModule.isCornerGenerator_corner_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem isCornerGenerator_corner_of_comp_eq (ha : a ∈ cocycles (Y ⟶ X) n) (hba : b ≫ a = 𝟙 X)
    (e : Idempotent X) (f : Idempotent Y) (hf : f.val = a ≫ e.val ≫ b) :
    IsCornerGenerator (corner f) e n
      (⟨a ≫ e.val, by
        change f.val ≫ a ≫ e.val = a ≫ e.val
        rw [hf, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hba, e.comp_self]⟩ :
        (corner f).obj X) where
  mem_grading
proof:
:= by
    have h := comp_mem_grading ha.1 e.mem_grading
    rw [add_zero] at h
    exact h
  d_eq_zero := Subtype.ext (by
    change d (a ≫ e.val) = 0
    rw [d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_left ha.2, e.d_val, comp_zero])
  val_smul := Subtype.ext (by
    change (a ≫ e.val) ≫ e.val = a ≫ e.val
    rw [Category.assoc, e.comp_self])
  surjective Z h := ⟨b ≫ h.1, Subtype.ext (by
    change (a ≫ e.val) ≫ b ≫ h.1 = h.1
    have h' : f.val ≫ h.1 = h.1 := h.2
    change (f.val ≫ h.1 : Y ⟶ Z) = h.1 at h'
    rw [hf] at h'
    change (a ≫ e.val) ≫ b ≫ h.1 = h.1
    exact (Category.assoc a e.val (b ≫ h.1)).trans
      ((congrArg (a ≫ ·) (Category.assoc e.val b h.1).symm).trans
        ((Category.assoc a (e.val ≫ b) h.1).symm.trans h')))⟩
  val_comp_eq_zero {Z} c hc := by
    have h : (a ≫ e.val) ≫ c = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hc
    calc e.val ≫ c = (b ≫ a) ≫ e.val ≫ c := by rw [hba, Category.id_comp]
      _ = b ≫ (a ≫ e.val) ≫ c := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [h, comp_zero]

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.cell_eq_of_comp_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cell_eq]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso
    (CatModule.cellModuleIsoOfCompEq.{max u w} ha hba e f hf))

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.homVal_toClosureOfFamily_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homVal_toClosureOfFamily_map {i j : ShiftedObjects φ} (f : i ⟶ j) :
    homVal ((toClosureOfFamily φ).map f) = homVal f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.isQuasiFullyFaithful_toClosureOfFamily
statement:
theorem isQuasiFullyFaithful_toClosureOfFamily :
    IsQuasiFullyFaithful (toClosureOfFamily φ)
proof:
:=
  IsQuasiFullyFaithful.of_bijective _ (fun _ _ => Function.bijective_id) fun h => h

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.isShiftDense_toClosureOfFamily
statement:
theorem isShiftDense_toClosureOfFamily [DGCategory C] (hφ : ∀ Y : C, ∃ i, (φ i).1 = Y) :
    IsShiftDense (toClosureOfFamily φ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨Y, m⟩
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hφ Y
  refine ⟨⟨i⟩, m - (φ i).2,
    shiftHom (i := ⟨((φ i).1, m)⟩) (j := (toClosureOfFamily φ).obj ⟨i⟩) rfl,
    shiftHom (i := (toClosureOfFamily φ).obj ⟨i⟩) (j := ⟨((φ i).1, m)⟩) rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact shiftHom_mem_cocycles (φ := id) (i := ⟨((φ i).1, m)⟩)
      (j := (toClosureOfFamily φ).obj ⟨i⟩) rfl
  · rw [neg_sub]
    exact shiftHom_mem_cocycles (φ := id) (i := (toClosureOfFamily φ).obj ⟨i⟩)
      (j := ⟨((φ i).1, m)⟩) rfl
  · change shiftHom (φ := id) (i := ⟨((φ i).1, m)⟩) (j := ⟨φ i⟩) rfl ≫
      shiftHom (φ := id) (i := ⟨φ i⟩) (j := ⟨((φ i).1, m)⟩) rfl = _
    exact (shiftHom_comp_shiftHom _ _).trans (shiftHom_self _)

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.idempotentVal_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idempotentVal_val {i : ShiftedObjects φ} (e : Idempotent i) :
    (idempotentVal e).val = homVal e.val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.homVal_idempotentMk_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homVal_idempotentMk_val {i : ShiftedObjects φ} (e : Idempotent (φ i.as).1) :
    homVal (idempotentMk e).val = e.val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.idempotentVal_idempotentMk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idempotentVal_idempotentMk {i : ShiftedObjects φ} (e : Idempotent (φ i.as).1) :
    idempotentVal (idempotentMk e) = e
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.ShiftedObjects.closure_cell_eq_top_of_isPositive
statement:
theorem closure_cell_eq_top_of_isPositive (hφ : ∀ Y : C, ∃ i, (φ i).1 = Y)
    (hP : DGCategory.IsPositive (ShiftedObjects φ)) :
    AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun c : SimpleCorner (ShiftedObjects φ) =>
      DGCategory.K0.cell.{max v w} (idempotentVal c.1.2) 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{w} (ShiftedObjects φ)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{w} (ShiftedObjects (id : C × ℤ → C × ℤ))
  let E₁ := DGCategory.K0.mapEquivOfIsShiftDense.{max u v w, w}
    (isQuasiFullyFaithful_toClosureOfFamily φ) (isShiftDense_toClosureOfFamily φ hφ)
  let E₂ := DGCategory.K0.mapEquivOfIsShiftDense.{max u v w, w}
    (isQuasiFullyFaithful_toClosure (C := C)) isShiftDense_toClosure
  set S := AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun c : SimpleCorner (ShiftedObjects φ) =>
    DGCategory.K0.cell.{max v w} (idempotentVal c.1.2) 0)
  have key : ∀ c : SimpleCorner (ShiftedObjects φ),
      E₂.symm (E₁ (DGCategory.K0.cell.{max v w} c.1.2 0)) ∈ S := by
    intro c
    have h1 : E₁ (DGCategory.K0.cell.{max v w} c.1.2 0) =
        DGCategory.K0.cell.{max v w} (c.1.2.map (toClosureOfFamily φ)) 0 :=
      DGCategory.K0.map_cell.{w} (toClosureOfFamily φ) c.1.2
    have h2 : E₂ (DGCategory.K0.cell.{max v w} (idempotentVal c.1.2) 0) =
        DGCategory.K0.cell.{max v w} ((idempotentVal c.1.2).map (toClosure C)) 0 :=
      DGCategory.K0.map_cell.{w} (toClosure C) (idempotentVal c.1.2)
    have h3 := DGCategory.K0.cell_eq_of_comp_eq.{max v w}
      (shiftHom_mem_cocycles (φ := id) (i := (toClosureOfFamily φ).obj c.1.1)
        (j := (toClosure C).obj (φ c.1.1.as).1) rfl)
      (b := shiftHom (i := (toClosure C).obj (φ c.1.1.as).1)
        (j := (toClosureOfFamily φ).obj c.1.1) rfl)
      ((shiftHom_comp_shiftHom _ _).trans (shiftHom_self _))
      ((idempotentVal c.1.2).map (toClosure C)) (c.1.2.map (toClosureOfFamily φ))
      (hom_ext (by
        change homVal c.1.2.val = 𝟙 _ ≫ homVal c.1.2.val ≫ 𝟙 _
        rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]))
    rw [h1, h3, ← h2, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact S.zsmul_mem (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c, rfl⟩) _
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := E₁.surjective (E₂ x)
  have hx : x = (E₂.symm.toAddMonoidHom.comp E₁.toAddMonoidHom) y := by
    change x = E₂.symm (E₁ y)
    rw [hy, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hx]
  have hy' : y ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun c : SimpleCorner (ShiftedObjects φ) =>
      DGCategory.K0.cell.{max v w} c.1.2 0) := by
    rw [hP.closure_cell_eq_top.{max v w}]
    trivial
  refine (AddSubgroup.closure_le (K := S.comap (E₂.symm.toAddMonoidHom.comp E₁.toAddMonoidHom))
    |>.mpr ?_) hy'
  rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
  exact key c

name: DG.finrankHom_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem finrankHom_eq_of_iso (P : C) {Y Y' : C} (e : Y ≅ Y') :
    finrankHom P Y = finrankHom P Y'
proof:
:=
  (homLinearEquivOfIsoRight P e).finrank_eq

name: DG.CellTower.prop
statement: theorem CellTower.prop {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C} (h : CellTower cell l X) : P X
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX => exact P.prop_of_isZero hX
  | ext T hT _ h₃ ih =>
    exact P.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂ T hT ih (P.prop_of_iso h₃.some.symm (hcell _ _))

name: DG.CellTower.mk_eq_sum_of_prop
statement:
theorem CellTower.mk_eq_sum_of_prop {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : C} (h : CellTower cell l X) :
    K0.mk (⟨X, h.prop hcell⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) =
      (l.map fun c : ι × ℤ => K0.mk (⟨cell c.1 c.2, hcell c.1 c.2⟩ :
        P.FullSubcategory)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX =>
    rw [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
    exact K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr (by
      ext
      exact hX.eq_of_src _ _))
  | ext R hR h₁ e ih =>
    rw [K0.mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂ (P := P) R hR (h₁.prop hcell) _
      (P.prop_of_iso e.some.symm (hcell _ _)), ih,
      List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_singleton, List.sum_singleton]
    congr 1
    exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj e.some

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.eq_zero_of_ne
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_ne {i j : ι} {n m : ℤ} (h : n ≠ m) (f : cell i n ⟶ cell j m) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h | h
  · exact hc.eq_zero_of_gt h f
  · exact hc.eq_zero_of_lt h f

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.finiteDimensional_hom_cell
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom_cell (j : ι) (m : ℤ) :
    letI
proof:
:= hc.divisionRing i
    FiniteDimensional (End (cell i 0))ᵐᵒᵖ (cell i 0 ⟶ cell j m) := by
  let := hc.divisionRing i
  by_cases h : ∃ u : cell i 0 ⟶ cell j m, u ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
    have hm : (0 : ℤ) = m := by
      by_contra hm
      exact hu (hc.eq_zero_of_ne hm u)
    subst hm
    have := hc.isIso_of_ne_zero u hu
    exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (homLinearEquivOfIso (asIso u))
  · push Not at h
    have : Subsingleton (cell i 0 ⟶ cell j m) := ⟨fun a b => by rw [h a, h b]⟩
    infer_instance

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.finrankHom_cell_of_iso
statement:
theorem finrankHom_cell_of_iso {j : ι} (e : cell i 0 ≅ cell j 0) :
    finrankHom (cell i 0) (cell j 0) = 1
proof:
:=
  letI := hc.divisionRing i
  (homLinearEquivOfIso e).finrank_eq.symm.trans (Module.finrank_self _)

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.finrankHom_cell_of_ne
statement:
theorem finrankHom_cell_of_ne {j : ι} {m : ℤ} (h : m ≠ 0) :
    finrankHom (cell i 0) (cell j m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let := hc.divisionRing i
  have : Subsingleton (cell i 0 ⟶ cell j m) :=
    ⟨fun a b => by rw [hc.eq_zero_of_ne (Ne.symm h) a, hc.eq_zero_of_ne (Ne.symm h) b]⟩
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.finrankHom_cell_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem finrankHom_cell_of_isEmpty {j : ι} (h : IsEmpty (cell i 0 ≅ cell j 0)) (m : ℤ) :
    finrankHom (cell i 0) (cell j m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let := hc.divisionRing i
  have : Subsingleton (cell i 0 ⟶ cell j m) := ⟨fun a b => by
    have H : ∀ u : cell i 0 ⟶ cell j m, u = 0 := fun u => by
      by_contra hu
      have hm : (0 : ℤ) = m := by
        by_contra hm
        exact hu (hc.eq_zero_of_ne hm u)
      subst hm
      have := hc.isIso_of_ne_zero u hu
      exact h.false (asIso u)
    rw [H a, H b]⟩
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.finrankShift_eq
statement:
theorem finrankShift_eq (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    letI
proof:
:= hc.divisionRing i
    letI := Functor.ShiftSequence.tautological (preadditiveCoyonedaObj (cell i 0)) ℤ
    Homological.finrankShift (preadditiveCoyonedaObj (cell i 0)) n X =
      finrankHom (cell i 0) (X⟦n⟧) :=
  rfl

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.hasFiniteRank_cell
statement: theorem hasFiniteRank_cell (j : ι) (m : ℤ) : hc.HasFiniteRank i (cell j m)
proof:
:= by
  let := hc.divisionRing i
  let := Functor.ShiftSequence.tautological (preadditiveCoyonedaObj (cell i 0)) ℤ
  have e : ∀ n : ℤ, (cell j m)⟦n⟧ ≅ cell j (m + n) := fun n =>
    (hc.nonempty_shiftIso j m n).some
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hc.finiteDimensional_hom_cell i j (m + n)
    exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (homLinearEquivOfIsoRight (cell i 0) (e n)).symm
  · refine (Set.finite_singleton (-m)).subset fun n hn => ?_
    by_contra h
    apply hn
    change finrankHom (cell i 0) ((cell j m)⟦n⟧) = 0
    rw [finrankHom_eq_of_iso (cell i 0) (e n)]
    exact hc.finrankHom_cell_of_ne i fun h' => h (by simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]; omega)

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.eulerChar_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem eulerChar_eq_of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) : hc.eulerChar i X = hc.eulerChar i Y
proof:
:=
  letI := hc.divisionRing i
  letI := Functor.ShiftSequence.tautological (preadditiveCoyonedaObj (cell i 0)) ℤ
  Homological.eulerChar_eq_of_iso _ e

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.eulerChar_cell_of_iso
statement:
theorem eulerChar_cell_of_iso {j : ι} (e : cell i 0 ≅ cell j 0) (m : ℤ) :
    hc.eulerChar i (cell j m) = m.negOnePow
proof:
:= by
  let := hc.divisionRing i
  let := Functor.ShiftSequence.tautological (preadditiveCoyonedaObj (cell i 0)) ℤ
  have e' : ∀ n : ℤ, (cell j m)⟦n⟧ ≅ cell j (m + n) := fun n =>
    (hc.nonempty_shiftIso j m n).some
  have hr : ∀ n : ℤ, finrankHom (cell i 0) ((cell j m)⟦n⟧) = if n = -m then 1 else 0 :=
    fun n => by
      rw [finrankHom_eq_of_iso (cell i 0) (e' n)]
      split_ifs with h
      · subst h
        rw [add_neg_cancel]
        exact hc.finrankHom_cell_of_iso i e
      · exact hc.finrankHom_cell_of_ne i (by omega)
  change ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * (finrankHom (cell i 0) ((cell j m)⟦n⟧) : ℤ) = _
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ (-m) fun n hn => by simp [hr n, hn], hr]
  simp [Int.negOnePow_neg]

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.eulerChar_cell_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem eulerChar_cell_of_isEmpty {j : ι} (h : IsEmpty (cell i 0 ≅ cell j 0)) (m : ℤ) :
    hc.eulerChar i (cell j m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * (finrankHom (cell i 0) ((cell j m)⟦n⟧) : ℤ) = 0
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun n => ?_
  rw [finrankHom_eq_of_iso (cell i 0) (hc.nonempty_shiftIso j m n).some,
    hc.finrankHom_cell_of_isEmpty i h]
  simp

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.hasFiniteRank_of_cellTower
proof:
:= by
  let := hc.divisionRing i
  let := Functor.ShiftSequence.tautological (preadditiveCoyonedaObj (cell i 0)) ℤ
  induction h with
  | zero hX => exact Homological.HasFiniteRank.of_isZero _ hX
  | ext T hT _ h₃ ih =>
    exact Homological.HasFiniteRank.obj₂ _ T hT ih
      (Homological.HasFiniteRank.of_iso _ h₃.some (hc.hasFiniteRank_cell i _ _))

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.eulerCharHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eulerCharHom_mk (i : ι) (X : P.FullSubcategory) :
    hc.eulerCharHom hP i (K0.mk X) = hc.eulerChar i X.obj
proof:
:=
  letI := hc.divisionRing i
  letI := Functor.ShiftSequence.tautological (preadditiveCoyonedaObj (cell i 0)) ℤ
  Homological.eulerCharHom_mk _ _ _ X

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.mk_cell
statement:
theorem mk_cell (j : ι) (n : ℤ) :
    K0.mk (⟨cell j n, hcell j n⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) =
      n.negOnePow • K0.mk (⟨cell j 0, hcell j 0⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← K0.mk_shift]
  exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (eqToIso (by rw [zero_add]) ≪≫
    (hc.nonempty_shiftIso j 0 n).some.symm ≪≫
    ((P.ι.commShiftIso n).app ⟨cell j 0, hcell j 0⟩).symm)

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.mk_cell_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem mk_cell_eq_of_iso {i j : ι} (e : cell i 0 ≅ cell j 0) :
    K0.mk (⟨cell i 0, hcell i 0⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) = K0.mk ⟨cell j 0, hcell j 0⟩
proof:
:=
  K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj e

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.linearIndependent
statement:
theorem linearIndependent (hs : ∀ a b, Nonempty (cell (s a) 0 ≅ cell (s b) 0) → a = b) :
    LinearIndependent ℤ fun a => K0.mk (⟨cell (s a) 0, hcell _ 0⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro S g hg a ha
  have h := congrArg (hc.eulerCharHom hP (s a)) hg
  rw [map_sum, map_zero, Finset.sum_eq_single a] at h
  · rw [map_zsmul, eulerCharHom_mk, hc.eulerChar_cell_of_iso _ (Iso.refl _)] at h
    simpa using h
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [map_zsmul, eulerCharHom_mk, hc.eulerChar_cell_of_isEmpty _
      ⟨fun e => hb (hs a b ⟨e⟩).symm⟩, smul_zero]
  · intro h'
    exact absurd ha h'

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.span_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_eq_top (hs : ∀ i, ∃ a, Nonempty (cell i 0 ≅ cell (s a) 0)) :
    Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range fun a =>
      K0.mk (⟨cell (s a) 0, hcell _ 0⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := K0.exists_mk_eq x
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hP X.obj X.property
  change K0.mk (⟨X.obj, hl.prop hcell⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) ∈ _
  rw [hl.mk_eq_sum_of_prop hcell]
  refine list_sum_mem fun y hy => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hs c.1
  rw [hc.mk_cell hcell, mk_cell_eq_of_iso hcell e, Units.smul_def]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨a, rfl⟩)

name: DG.IsSemisimpleCellFamily.basis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_apply (hs : ∀ a b, Nonempty (cell (s a) 0 ≅ cell (s b) 0) → a = b)
    (hs' : ∀ i, ∃ a, Nonempty (cell i 0 ≅ cell (s a) 0)) (a : κ) :
    hc.basis hP hcell s hs hs' a = K0.mk (⟨cell (s a) 0, hcell _ 0⟩ : P.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:=
  Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _

name: DG.K0Rel.mkHom_surjective
statement: theorem mkHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkHom C r)
proof: := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: DG.K0Rel.mk_obj₂
statement:
theorem mk_obj₂ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) :
    (mk T.obj₂ : K0Rel C r) = mk T.obj₁ + mk T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  have h := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2
    ((le_sup_left : K0.relations C ≤ relations C r) (K0.relation_mem T hT))
  change mkHom C r _ = 0 at h
  rwa [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: DG.K0Rel.mk_eq_of_rel
statement: theorem mk_eq_of_rel {X Y : C} (h : r X Y) : (mk X : K0Rel C r) = mk Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2
    ((le_sup_right : _ ≤ relations C r) (AddSubgroup.subset_closure
      (k := {x | ∃ X Y, r X Y ∧ x = FreeAbelianGroup.of X - FreeAbelianGroup.of Y})
      ⟨X, Y, h, rfl⟩))
  change mkHom C r _ = 0 at h
  rwa [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: DG.K0Rel.addMonoidHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem addMonoidHom_ext {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] ⦃f g : K0Rel C r →+ G⦄
    (h : ∀ X : C, f (mk X) = g (mk X)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.addMonoidHom_ext
  exact FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext _ _ h

name: DG.K0Rel.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_mk {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (f : C → G) (hf) (hr) (X : C) :
    lift (r := r) f hf hr (mk X) = f X
proof:
:=
  (QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk' _ _ (FreeAbelianGroup.of X)).trans
    (FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of f X)

name: DG.K0Rel.of_sub_of_mem_relations_of_iso
statement:
theorem of_sub_of_mem_relations_of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    FreeAbelianGroup.of X - FreeAbelianGroup.of Y ∈ K0.relations C
