proof:
:= by
  have h := K0.mk_eq_of_iso e
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← K0.mkHom_of, ← K0.mkHom_of, ← map_sub] at h
  exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mp h

name: DG.K0Rel.relations_eq
statement:
theorem relations_eq : relations C r = K0.relations C ⊔
    AddSubgroup.closure {x | ∃ X, x = FreeAbelianGroup.of (P X) - FreeAbelianGroup.of X}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine sup_le le_sup_left ((AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_)
    rintro x ⟨X, Y, h, rfl⟩
    rcases hr X Y h with ⟨⟨e⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨e⟩⟩
    · exact AddSubgroup.mem_sup_left (of_sub_of_mem_relations_of_iso e)
    · rw [show FreeAbelianGroup.of X - FreeAbelianGroup.of Y =
          -(FreeAbelianGroup.of (P X) - FreeAbelianGroup.of X) +
            (FreeAbelianGroup.of (P X) - FreeAbelianGroup.of Y) by abel]
      exact add_mem (neg_mem (AddSubgroup.mem_sup_right (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨X, rfl⟩)))
        (AddSubgroup.mem_sup_left (of_sub_of_mem_relations_of_iso e))
  · refine sup_le le_sup_left ((AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_)
    rintro x ⟨X, rfl⟩
    rw [← neg_sub]
    exact neg_mem (AddSubgroup.mem_sup_right (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨X, P X, hP X, rfl⟩))

name: DG.K0Rel.equivQuotient_mk
statement:
theorem equivQuotient_mk (X : C) :
    equivQuotient P hr hP (mk X) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (K0.mk X)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.IsFGProjective.of_retract
statement:
theorem of_retract {M N : ModuleCat.{v} R} (i : M ⟶ N) (r : N ⟶ M) (h : i ≫ r = 𝟙 M)
    (hN : IsFGProjective R N) : IsFGProjective R M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hN
  have h' : r.hom.comp i.hom = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← ModuleCat.hom_comp, h, ModuleCat.hom_id]
  refine ⟨Module.Finite.of_surjective r.hom fun x => ⟨i.hom x, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact LinearMap.congr_fun h' x
  · exact Module.Projective.of_split i.hom r.hom h'

name: DG.IsFGProjective.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso {M N : ModuleCat.{v} R} (e : M ≅ N) (hN : IsFGProjective R N) :
    IsFGProjective R M
proof:
:=
  of_retract e.hom e.inv e.hom_inv_id hN

name: DG.IsFGProjective.of_isZero
statement: theorem of_isZero {M : ModuleCat.{v} R} (hM : IsZero M) : IsFGProjective R M
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton M := ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hM
  exact ⟨Module.Finite.of_surjective (0 : (Fin 0 → R) →ₗ[R] M)
    fun x => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, Module.Projective.of_free⟩

name: DG.IsFGProjective.biprod
statement:
theorem biprod {M N : ModuleCat.{v} R} (hM : IsFGProjective R M) (hN : IsFGProjective R N) :
    IsFGProjective R (M ⊞ N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hN
  exact of_iso (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd M N) ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: DG.ProjK0.mkHom_surjective
statement: theorem mkHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkHom.{v} R)
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: DG.ProjK0.mk_X₂
statement:
theorem mk_X₂ {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : IsFGProjective R S.X₁) (h₂ : IsFGProjective R S.X₂) (h₃ : IsFGProjective R S.X₃) :
    mk S.X₂ h₂ = mk S.X₁ h₁ + mk S.X₃ h₃
proof:
:= by
  have h := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2
    (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨S, h₁, h₂, h₃, hS, rfl⟩ : _ ∈ relations.{v} R)
  change mkHom R _ = 0 at h
  rwa [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: DG.ProjK0.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {p : ProjK0.{v} R → Prop} (x : ProjK0.{v} R) (zero : p 0)
    (mk : ∀ (P : ModuleCat.{v} R) (hP : IsFGProjective R P), p (mk P hP))
    (neg : ∀ x, p x → p (-x)) (add : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y)) : p x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mkHom_surjective x
  induction y using FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using zero
  | of P => exact mk P.obj P.property
  | neg y hy => rw [map_neg]; exact neg _ hy
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ hy hz

name: DG.ProjK0.addMonoidHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem addMonoidHom_ext ⦃f g : ProjK0.{v} R →+ G⦄
    (h : ∀ (P : ModuleCat.{v} R) (hP : IsFGProjective R P), f (mk P hP) = g (mk P hP)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.addMonoidHom_ext
  exact FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext _ _ fun P => h P.obj P.property

name: DG.ProjK0.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_mk (f : ∀ P : ModuleCat.{v} R, IsFGProjective R P → G) (hf)
    (P : ModuleCat.{v} R) (hP : IsFGProjective R P) : lift f hf (mk P hP) = f P hP
proof:
:=
  (QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk' (relations.{v} R) _ (FreeAbelianGroup.of _)).trans
    (FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of _ _)

name: DG.ProjK0.mk_zero
statement: theorem mk_zero : mk (0 : ModuleCat.{v} R) (IsFGProjective.of_isZero (isZero_zero _)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_X₂ ((ShortComplex.Splitting.ofIsZeroOfIsIso
    (ShortComplex.mk (0 : (0 : ModuleCat.{v} R) ⟶ 0) (𝟙 0) (by simp)) (isZero_zero _)
    (by dsimp; infer_instance)).shortExact) (IsFGProjective.of_isZero (isZero_zero _))
    (IsFGProjective.of_isZero (isZero_zero _)) (IsFGProjective.of_isZero (isZero_zero _))
  exact right_eq_add.1 h

name: DG.ProjK0.mk_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem mk_eq_of_iso {P Q : ModuleCat.{v} R} (e : P ≅ Q) (hP : IsFGProjective R P)
    (hQ : IsFGProjective R Q) : mk P hP = mk Q hQ
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_X₂ ((ShortComplex.Splitting.ofIsZeroOfIsIso
    (ShortComplex.mk (0 : (0 : ModuleCat.{v} R) ⟶ P) e.hom (by simp)) (isZero_zero _)
    (by dsimp; infer_instance)).shortExact) (IsFGProjective.of_isZero (isZero_zero _)) hP hQ
  dsimp at h
  rw [h, mk_zero, zero_add]

name: DG.ProjK0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem mk_eq_zero_of_isZero {P : ModuleCat.{v} R} (hP : IsZero P) (h : IsFGProjective R P) :
    mk P h = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso hP.isoZero h (IsFGProjective.of_isZero (isZero_zero _)), mk_zero]

name: DG.ProjK0.mk_biprod
statement:
theorem mk_biprod {P Q : ModuleCat.{v} R} (hP : IsFGProjective R P) (hQ : IsFGProjective R Q) :
    mk (P ⊞ Q) (hP.biprod hQ) = mk P hP + mk Q hQ
proof:
:=
  mk_X₂ (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct P Q).shortExact hP (hP.biprod hQ) hQ

name: DG.IsCompact.map_of_adjunction
statement:
theorem IsCompact.map_of_adjunction {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} (adj : F ⊣ G) [F.Additive]
    [∀ ι : Type w, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete ι) G] {X : C} (hX : IsCompact.{w} X) :
    IsCompact.{w} (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  intro ι _ Y _
  have hc := isColimitCofanMkObjOfIsColimit G _ _ (coproductIsCoproduct Y)
  have : HasCoproduct fun i => G.obj (Y i) := ⟨⟨_, hc⟩⟩
  let E := hc.coconePointUniqueUpToIso (colimit.isColimit _)
  have hE : ∀ i, Sigma.ι (fun i => G.obj (Y i)) i ≫ E.inv = G.map (Sigma.ι Y i) := fun i => by
    rw [Iso.comp_inv_eq]
    exact (hc.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom (colimit.isColimit _) ⟨i⟩).symm
  let e : (DirectSum ι fun i => (F.obj X ⟶ Y i)) ≃+ DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ G.obj (Y i)) :=
    DFinsupp.mapRange.addEquiv fun i => adj.homAddEquiv X (Y i)
  have key : ∀ a, coproductComparison (F.obj X) Y a = (adj.homAddEquiv X (∐ Y)).symm
      (coproductComparison X (fun i => G.obj (Y i)) (e a) ≫ E.inv) := by
    intro a
    induction a using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of i f =>
      have he : e (DirectSum.of _ i f) = DirectSum.of _ i (adj.homEquiv X (Y i) f) := by
        change DFinsupp.mapRange (fun i => adj.homAddEquiv X (Y i)) (fun i => map_zero _)
          (DFinsupp.single i f) = DFinsupp.single i _
        rw [DFinsupp.mapRange_single]
        rfl
      rw [he, coproductComparison_of, coproductComparison_of, Category.assoc, hE,
        ← adj.homEquiv_naturality_right, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_symm_apply,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, map_add]
  have hE' : Function.Bijective fun a : X ⟶ ∐ fun i => G.obj (Y i) => a ≫ E.inv :=
    Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr ⟨fun a => a ≫ E.hom, fun a => by simp, fun a => by simp⟩
  have hk : ⇑(coproductComparison (F.obj X) Y) = (adj.homAddEquiv X (∐ Y)).symm ∘
      (fun a => a ≫ E.inv) ∘ coproductComparison X (fun i => G.obj (Y i)) ∘ e := funext key
  rw [hk]
  exact (adj.homAddEquiv X (∐ Y)).symm.bijective.comp (hE'.comp ((hX ι _).comp e.bijective))

name: DG.IsCompact.map_of_equivalence
statement:
theorem IsCompact.map_of_equivalence (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.Additive] {X : C}
    (hX : IsCompact.{w} X) : IsCompact.{w} (e.functor.obj X)
proof:
:=
  hX.map_of_adjunction e.toAdjunction

name: DG.isCompact_functor_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isCompact_functor_obj_iff (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.Additive] (X : C) :
    IsCompact.{w} (e.functor.obj X) ↔ IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.map_of_equivalence e⟩
  have : e.symm.functor.Additive := e.toAdjunction.right_adjoint_additive
  exact ((h.map_of_equivalence e.symm).of_iso (e.unitIso.app X))

name: DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj
statement:
theorem mk_eq_of_iso_obj [P.IsTriangulated] {X Y : P.FullSubcategory} (e : X.obj ≅ Y.obj) :
    mk X = mk Y
proof:
:=
  mk_eq_of_iso (ObjectProperty.isoMk P e)

name: DG.K0.mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂
statement:
theorem mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂ [P.IsTriangulated] (R : Triangle T) (hR : R ∈ distTriang T)
    (h₁ : P R.obj₁) (h₂ : P R.obj₂) (h₃ : P R.obj₃) :
    mk (⟨R.obj₂, h₂⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) = mk ⟨R.obj₁, h₁⟩ + mk ⟨R.obj₃, h₃⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Z, g, h, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle
    (ObjectProperty.homMk R.mor₁ : (⟨R.obj₁, h₁⟩ : P.FullSubcategory) ⟶ ⟨R.obj₂, h₂⟩)
  rw [mk_eq_add_of_distTriang _ g h hT]
  congr 1
  exact mk_eq_of_iso_obj (Triangle.π₃.mapIso (isoTriangleOfIso₁₂ _ R (P.ι.map_distinguished _ hT)
    hR (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simp)))

name: DG.K0.exists_mk_eq
statement: theorem exists_mk_eq (x : K0 T) : ∃ X : T, mk X = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, mk_zero⟩
  | mk X => exact ⟨X, rfl⟩
  | neg x hx =>
    obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧, mk_shift_one X⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨Y, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨X ⊞ Y, mk_biprod X Y⟩

name: DG.K0.mk_mem_closure_of_forall
proof:
:=
  hX (mkMem _) inferInstance inferInstance fun Y hY => AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨Y, hY, rfl⟩

name: DG.K0.mapCompact_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapCompact_mk (X : (compactSubcategory.{w} T).FullSubcategory) :
    mapCompact F hF (mk X) = mk (⟨F.obj X.obj, hF _ X.property⟩ :
      (compactSubcategory.{w'} T').FullSubcategory)
proof:
:=
  map_mk _ X

name: DG.K0.mapCompact_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem mapCompact_eq_of_iso {F₁ F₂ : T ⥤ T'} (e : F₁ ≅ F₂) [F₁.CommShift ℤ] [F₁.IsTriangulated]
    [F₂.CommShift ℤ] [F₂.IsTriangulated]
    (h₁ : ∀ X : T, IsCompact.{w} X → IsCompact.{w'} (F₁.obj X))
    (h₂ : ∀ X : T, IsCompact.{w} X → IsCompact.{w'} (F₂.obj X)) :
    mapCompact F₁ h₁ = mapCompact F₂ h₂
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  simp only [mapCompact_mk]
  exact mk_eq_of_iso_obj (e.app X.obj)

name: DG.K0.mapCompact_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapCompact_id :
    mapCompact (𝟭 T) (fun _ h => h) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (K0 (compactSubcategory.{w} T).FullSubcategory)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  simp only [mapCompact_mk, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.K0.mapCompact_comp
statement:
theorem mapCompact_comp {T'' : Type u''} [Category.{v''} T''] [HasZeroObject T''] [HasShift T'' ℤ]
    [Preadditive T''] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor T'' n).Additive] [Pretriangulated T'']
    [HasCoproducts.{w''} T''] (G : T' ⥤ T'') [G.CommShift ℤ] [G.IsTriangulated]
    (hG : ∀ X : T', IsCompact.{w'} X → IsCompact.{w''} (G.obj X)) :
    mapCompact (F ⋙ G) (fun X h => hG _ (hF X h)) = (mapCompact G hG).comp (mapCompact F hF)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  simp only [mapCompact_mk, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.K0.compactMapEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compactMapEquiv_mk (e : T ≌ T') [e.functor.CommShift ℤ] [e.functor.IsTriangulated]
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{w} T).FullSubcategory) :
    compactMapEquiv e (mk X) = mk (⟨e.functor.obj X.obj, X.property.map_of_equivalence e⟩ :
      (compactSubcategory.{w} T').FullSubcategory)
proof:
:=
  mapCompact_mk _ _ X

name: DG.DGRing.K0.leftCorner_one
statement:
theorem DGRing.K0.leftCorner_one :
    DGRing.K0.leftCorner (DGIdempotent.one A) = DGRing.K0.self.{w'} A
proof:
:=
  DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (DG.DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (DGIdempotent.oneLeftCornerIso (A := A)))

name: DG.TriangularBasis.K0_mk
statement:
theorem TriangularBasis.K0_mk {P : Type v} [AddCommGroup P]
    [DGAddCommGroup P] [Module A P] [DGModule A P] (T : TriangularBasis A P) :
    DG.K0.mk (⟨DG.DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A P),
        T.finiteCellFiltration.isCompact_Q_obj⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory.{w', v} A) =
      ∑ j, (T.deg j).negOnePow • DGRing.K0.self.{w'} A
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGRing.K0.mk_finiteCell T.finiteCellFiltration]
  change ∑ j : Fin T.length,
    (-T.deg j).negOnePow • DGRing.K0.leftCorner (DGIdempotent.one A) = _
  simp only [DGRing.K0.leftCorner_one, Int.negOnePow_neg]

name: DG.FreeBasis.K0_mk_toTriangular
statement:
theorem FreeBasis.K0_mk_toTriangular {P : Type v} [AddCommGroup P]
    [DGAddCommGroup P] [Module A P] [DGModule A P] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (Bs : FreeBasis A P ι) (key : ι → ℤ)
    (hkey : ∀ i l, Bs.coeff (d (Bs.b i)) l ≠ 0 → key l < key i) :
    DG.K0.mk (⟨DG.DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A P),
        (Bs.toTriangular key hkey).finiteCellFiltration.isCompact_Q_obj⟩ :
          PerfectDerivedCategory.{w', v} A) =
      ∑ i, (Bs.deg i).negOnePow • DGRing.K0.self.{w'} A
proof:
:= by
  rw [TriangularBasis.K0_mk (Bs.toTriangular key hkey)]
  exact (FreeBasis.order key).sum_comp fun i => (Bs.deg i).negOnePow • DGRing.K0.self A

name: DG.AbelianK0.mkHom_of
statement: theorem mkHom_of (X : C) : mkHom C (FreeAbelianGroup.of X) = mk X
proof: := rfl

name: DG.AbelianK0.mkHom_surjective
statement: theorem mkHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkHom C)
proof: := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: DG.AbelianK0.relation_mem
statement:
theorem relation_mem {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    FreeAbelianGroup.of S.X₂ - FreeAbelianGroup.of S.X₁ - FreeAbelianGroup.of S.X₃ ∈
      relations C
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_X₂
statement: theorem mk_X₂ {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) : mk S.X₂ = mk S.X₁ + mk S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  have h := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 (relation_mem hS)
  change mkHom C _ = 0 at h
  rwa [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: DG.AbelianK0.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {p : AbelianK0 C → Prop} (x : AbelianK0 C) (zero : p 0)
    (mk : ∀ X : C, p (mk X)) (neg : ∀ x, p x → p (-x)) (add : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y)) :
    p x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mkHom_surjective x
  induction y using FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using zero
  | of X => exact mk X
  | neg y hy => rw [map_neg]; exact neg _ hy
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ hy hz

name: DG.AbelianK0.addMonoidHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem addMonoidHom_ext ⦃f g : AbelianK0 C →+ G⦄ (h : ∀ X : C, f (mk X) = g (mk X)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.addMonoidHom_ext
  exact FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext _ _ h

name: DG.AbelianK0.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_mk (f : C → G) (hf) (X : C) : lift f hf (mk X) = f X
proof:
:=
  (QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk' (relations C) _ (FreeAbelianGroup.of X)).trans
    (FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of f X)

name: DG.AbelianK0.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique (f : C → G) (hf) (g : AbelianK0 C →+ G) (hg : ∀ X, g (mk X) = f X) :
    g = lift f hf
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  simp [hg]

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_X₁
statement: theorem mk_X₁ {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) : mk S.X₁ = mk S.X₂ - mk S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_X₂ hS, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_X₃
statement: theorem mk_X₃ {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact) : mk S.X₃ = mk S.X₂ - mk S.X₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_X₂ hS, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_eq_add_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem mk_eq_add_of_shortExact {X₁ X₂ X₃ : C} (f : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (g : X₂ ⟶ X₃) (w : f ≫ g = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) : mk X₂ = mk X₁ + mk X₃
proof:
:=
  mk_X₂ h

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero : mk (0 : C) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_X₂ ((ShortComplex.Splitting.ofIsZeroOfIsIso
    (ShortComplex.mk (0 : (0 : C) ⟶ 0) (𝟙 0) (by simp)) (isZero_zero C)
    (by dsimp; infer_instance)).shortExact)
  exact right_eq_add.1 h

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem mk_eq_of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) : mk X = mk Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_X₂ ((ShortComplex.Splitting.ofIsZeroOfIsIso
    (ShortComplex.mk (0 : (0 : C) ⟶ X) e.hom (by simp)) (isZero_zero C)
    (by dsimp; infer_instance)).shortExact)
  dsimp at h
  rw [h, mk_zero, zero_add]

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement: theorem mk_eq_zero_of_isZero {X : C} (hX : IsZero X) : mk X = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso hX.isoZero, mk_zero]

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_biprod
statement: theorem mk_biprod (X Y : C) : mk (X ⊞ Y) = mk X + mk Y
proof:
:=
  mk_X₂ (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct X Y).shortExact

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_prod
statement: theorem mk_prod (X Y : C) : mk (X ⨯ Y) = mk X + mk Y
proof:
:=
  (mk_eq_of_iso (biprod.isoProd X Y).symm).trans (mk_biprod X Y)

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_coprod
statement: theorem mk_coprod (X Y : C) : mk (X ⨿ Y) = mk X + mk Y
proof:
:=
  (mk_eq_of_iso (biprod.isoCoprod X Y).symm).trans (mk_biprod X Y)

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_eq_mk_kernel_add_mk_coimage
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_kernel_add_mk_coimage {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    mk X = mk (kernel f) + mk (Abelian.coimage f)
proof:
:=
  mk_X₂ (S := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι f) (Abelian.coimage.π f) (by simp))
    (ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _
      (cokernelIsCokernel (kernel.ι f))) (by dsimp; infer_instance) (by dsimp; infer_instance))

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_cokernel
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_cokernel {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    mk Y = mk (Abelian.image f) + mk (cokernel f)
proof:
:=
  mk_X₂ (S := ShortComplex.mk (Abelian.image.ι f) (cokernel.π f) (by simp))
    (ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _
      (kernelIsKernel (cokernel.π f))) (by dsimp; infer_instance) (by dsimp; infer_instance))

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_eq_mk_coimage_add_mk_cokernel
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_coimage_add_mk_cokernel {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    mk Y = mk (Abelian.coimage f) + mk (cokernel f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_cokernel f, mk_eq_of_iso (Abelian.coimageIsoImage f)]

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_coimage_eq_zero_of_isZero_source
statement:
theorem mk_coimage_eq_zero_of_isZero_source {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsZero X) :
    mk (Abelian.coimage f) = 0
proof:
:=
  mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (IsZero.of_epi (Abelian.coimage.π f) hX)

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_coimage_eq_zero_of_isZero_target
statement:
theorem mk_coimage_eq_zero_of_isZero_target {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hY : IsZero Y) :
    mk (Abelian.coimage f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso (Abelian.coimageIsoImage f)]
  exact mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (IsZero.of_mono (Abelian.image.ι f) hY)

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_X₂_eq_mk_homology_add
statement:
theorem mk_X₂_eq_mk_homology_add (S : ShortComplex C) :
    mk S.X₂ = mk S.homology + mk (Abelian.coimage S.f) + mk (Abelian.coimage S.g)
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : S.homology ≅ cokernel S.toCycles :=
    IsColimit.coconePointUniqueUpToIso S.homologyIsCokernel (colimit.isColimit _)
  have e₂ : kernel S.f ≅ kernel S.toCycles :=
    kernelIsoOfEq S.toCycles_i.symm ≪≫ kernelCompMono S.toCycles S.iCycles
  have h₁ := mk_eq_mk_kernel_add_mk_coimage S.g
  have h₂ := mk_eq_mk_coimage_add_mk_cokernel S.toCycles
  have h₃ := mk_eq_mk_kernel_add_mk_coimage S.toCycles
  have h₄ := mk_eq_mk_kernel_add_mk_coimage S.f
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso S.cyclesIsoKernel.symm] at h₁
  rw [← mk_eq_of_iso e₁] at h₂
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso e₂] at h₄
  have h₅ : mk (Abelian.coimage S.toCycles) = mk (Abelian.coimage S.f) :=
    add_left_cancel (h₃.symm.trans h₄)
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₅]
  abel

name: DG.CatModule.leftCornerRetract_idem_app
statement:
theorem leftCornerRetract_idem_app (e : DGIdempotent B) :
    ((leftCornerRetract e).r ≫ (leftCornerRetract e).i).app (SingleObj.star B)
      (ULift.up (𝟙 (SingleObj.star B))) =
        ULift.up (e.val : SingleObj.star B ⟶ SingleObj.star B)
proof:
:= by
  have hU := (isCornerGenerator_representable (SingleObj.star B)).ulift.{u}
  have hR := isCornerGenerator_toCatModuleObj_self (A := B)
  rw [comp_app]
  change (selfIsoULiftRepresentable B).hom.app _ ((e.leftCornerInclusion)
    (e.leftCornerProjection ((selfIsoULiftRepresentable B).inv.app _
      (ULift.up (𝟙 (SingleObj.star B)))))) = _
  have h1 : (selfIsoULiftRepresentable B).inv.app (SingleObj.star B)
      (ULift.up (𝟙 (SingleObj.star B))) = (1 : B) :=
    hU.homOfCocycle_app_gen _ hR.mem_grading hR.d_eq_zero
  rw [h1]
  have h3 : (e.leftCornerInclusion (e.leftCornerProjection 1) :
      (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj (DGModuleCat.of B B)).obj (SingleObj.star B)) =
      (show SingleObj.star B ⟶ SingleObj.star B from e.val) •
        (show (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj (DGModuleCat.of B B)).obj (SingleObj.star B) from
          (1 : B)) := by
    change 1 * e.val = e.val * 1
    rw [one_mul, mul_one]
  rw [h3, Hom.map_smul]
  have h2 : (selfIsoULiftRepresentable B).hom.app (SingleObj.star B)
      (show (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj (DGModuleCat.of B B)).obj (SingleObj.star B) from
        (1 : B)) = ULift.up (𝟙 (SingleObj.star B)) :=
    hR.homOfCocycle_app_gen _ hU.mem_grading hU.d_eq_zero
  rw [h2]
  exact ULift.ext _ _
    (Category.id_comp (X := SingleObj.star B) (e.val : SingleObj.star B ⟶ SingleObj.star B))

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.induction_map_leftCornerRetract_idem
statement:
theorem induction_map_leftCornerRetract_idem (e : DGIdempotent B) :
    (CatModule.induction.{u} φ.singleObjFunctor).map
        ((leftCornerRetract e).r ≫ (leftCornerRetract e).i) ≫
      (inductionULiftRepresentableIso.{u} φ.singleObjFunctor (SingleObj.star B)).hom =
    (inductionULiftRepresentableIso.{u} φ.singleObjFunctor (SingleObj.star B)).hom ≫
      ((leftCornerRetract (e.map φ)).r ≫ (leftCornerRetract (e.map φ)).i)
proof:
:= by
  set ι := inductionULiftRepresentableIso.{u} φ.singleObjFunctor (SingleObj.star B)
  rw [← Iso.inv_comp_eq]
  refine (isCornerGenerator_representable (SingleObj.star A)).ulift.{u}.ext_hom ?_
  let t := CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (CatBimodule.ofFunctor φ.singleObjFunctor).right
    (SingleObj.star A)) (SingleObj.star B) (𝟙 (SingleObj.star A))
      (show (ulift.{u} (representable (SingleObj.star B))).obj (SingleObj.star B) from
        ULift.up (𝟙 (SingleObj.star B)))
  have ht : ι.hom.app (SingleObj.star A) t = ULift.up (𝟙 (SingleObj.star A)) := by
    refine ULift.ext _ _ ?_
    erw [inductionULiftRepresentableIso_hom_app_tmul]
    exact (Category.comp_id (X := SingleObj.star A)
      (φ.singleObjFunctor.map (𝟙 (SingleObj.star B)))).trans (φ.singleObjFunctor.map_id _)
  have ht' : ι.inv.app (SingleObj.star A) (ULift.up (𝟙 (SingleObj.star A))) = t := by
    rw [← ht]
    change (ι.hom ≫ ι.inv).app (SingleObj.star A) t = t
    rw [ι.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  rw [comp_app, comp_app]
  erw [ht']
  rw [induction_map_app_tmul]
  erw [leftCornerRetract_idem_app, leftCornerRetract_idem_app]
  refine ULift.ext _ _ ?_
  erw [inductionULiftRepresentableIso_hom_app_tmul]
  exact Category.comp_id (X := SingleObj.star A) (φ e.val : SingleObj.star A ⟶ SingleObj.star A)

name: DG.DGRing.K0.isCompact_Q_toCatModuleObj_leftCorner
statement:
theorem isCompact_Q_toCatModuleObj_leftCorner
    [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, u} (SingleObj A)] (e : DGIdempotent A) :
    IsCompact.{u} (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj (DGModuleCat.of A e.LeftCorner)))
proof:
:=
  IsCompact.of_retract ((CatModule.leftCornerRetract e).map CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q)
    (CatModule.DerivedCategory.isCompact_Q_representable _)

name: DG.DGRing.K0.singleObjEquiv_leftCorner
statement:
theorem singleObjEquiv_leftCorner [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, u} (SingleObj A)]
    (e : DGIdempotent A) :
    singleObjEquiv A (DG.K0.mk ⟨CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj (DGModuleCat.of A e.LeftCorner)),
        isCompact_Q_toCatModuleObj_leftCorner e⟩) = leftCorner e
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleObjEquiv, DG.K0.compactMapEquiv_mk]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalenceObjIso _)

name: DG.DGRing.K0.map_leftCorner
statement:
theorem map_leftCorner {B : Type u} [Ring B] [DGAddCommGroup B] [DGRing B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, u} B] (φ : B →ᵈᵍ+* A) (e : DGIdempotent B) :
    map φ (leftCorner e) = leftCorner (e.map φ)
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj B)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  change singleObjEquiv A (DGCategory.K0.map φ.singleObjFunctor
    ((singleObjEquiv B).symm (leftCorner e))) = _
  rw [(AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).mpr (singleObjEquiv_leftCorner e).symm, DGCategory.K0.map_mk,
    ← singleObjEquiv_leftCorner (e.map φ)]
  congr 1
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (CatModule.DerivedCategory.inductionLeftCornerIso φ e)

name: DG.K0.mkHom_of
statement: theorem mkHom_of (X : C) : mkHom C (FreeAbelianGroup.of X) = mk X
proof: := rfl

name: DG.K0.mkHom_surjective
statement: theorem mkHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (mkHom C)
proof: := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: DG.K0.relation_mem
statement:
theorem relation_mem (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) :
    FreeAbelianGroup.of T.obj₂ - FreeAbelianGroup.of T.obj₁ - FreeAbelianGroup.of T.obj₃ ∈
      relations C
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩

name: DG.K0.mk_obj₂
statement:
theorem mk_obj₂ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) :
    mk T.obj₂ = mk T.obj₁ + mk T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  have h := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).2 (relation_mem T hT)
  change mkHom C _ = 0 at h
  rwa [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h

name: DG.K0.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {p : K0 C → Prop} (x : K0 C) (zero : p 0) (mk : ∀ X : C, p (mk X))
    (neg : ∀ x, p x → p (-x)) (add : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x + y)) : p x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mkHom_surjective x
  induction y using FreeAbelianGroup.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using zero
  | of X => exact mk X
  | neg y hy => rw [map_neg]; exact neg _ hy
  | add y z hy hz => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ hy hz

name: DG.K0.addMonoidHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem addMonoidHom_ext ⦃f g : K0 C →+ G⦄ (h : ∀ X : C, f (mk X) = g (mk X)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.addMonoidHom_ext
  exact FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext _ _ h

name: DG.K0.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_mk (f : C → G) (hf) (X : C) : lift f hf (mk X) = f X
proof:
:=
  (QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk' (relations C) _ (FreeAbelianGroup.of X)).trans
    (FreeAbelianGroup.lift_apply_of f X)

name: DG.K0.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique (f : C → G) (hf) (g : K0 C →+ G) (hg : ∀ X, g (mk X) = f X) :
    g = lift f hf
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  simp [hg]

name: DG.K0.mk_obj₁
statement:
theorem mk_obj₁ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) :
    mk T.obj₁ = mk T.obj₂ - mk T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_obj₂ T hT, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: DG.K0.mk_obj₃
statement:
theorem mk_obj₃ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C) :
    mk T.obj₃ = mk T.obj₂ - mk T.obj₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_obj₂ T hT, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: DG.K0.mk_eq_add_of_distTriang
statement:
theorem mk_eq_add_of_distTriang {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hT : Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distTriang C) : mk Y = mk X + mk Z
proof:
:=
  mk_obj₂ _ hT

name: DG.K0.mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero : mk (0 : C) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_obj₂ _ (contractible_distinguished₁ (0 : C))
  dsimp at h
  exact right_eq_add.1 h

name: DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem mk_eq_of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) : mk X = mk Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_obj₂ _ (isomorphic_distinguished _ (contractible_distinguished X) _
    (Triangle.isoMk (Triangle.mk e.hom (0 : Y ⟶ 0) 0) (contractibleTriangle X) (Iso.refl X)
      e.symm (Iso.refl 0) (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)))
  dsimp at h
  rw [h, mk_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement: theorem mk_eq_zero_of_isZero {X : C} (hX : IsZero X) : mk X = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso hX.isoZero, mk_zero]

name: DG.K0.mk_shift_one
statement: theorem mk_shift_one (X : C) : mk (X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) = -mk X
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_obj₂ _ (contractible_distinguished₂ X)
  dsimp at h
  rw [mk_zero] at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h.symm

name: DG.K0.mk_shift
statement: theorem mk_shift (n : ℤ) (X : C) : mk (X⟦n⟧) = n.negOnePow • mk X
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [mk_eq_of_iso ((shiftFunctorZero C ℤ).app X), Functor.id_obj, Int.negOnePow_zero,
      one_smul]
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [mk_eq_of_iso ((shiftFunctorAdd C (n : ℤ) 1).app X), Functor.comp_obj, mk_shift_one, hn,
      Int.negOnePow_succ, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, Units.val_neg, neg_smul]
  | pred n hn =>
    rw [mk_eq_of_iso ((shiftFunctorAdd' C (-(n : ℤ) - 1) 1 (-(n : ℤ)) (by omega)).app X),
      Functor.comp_obj, mk_shift_one] at hn
    rw [Int.negOnePow_sub, Int.negOnePow_one, mul_neg, mul_one, Units.smul_def, Units.val_neg,
      neg_smul, ← Units.smul_def, ← hn, neg_neg]

name: DG.K0.mk_shift_neg_one
statement: theorem mk_shift_neg_one (X : C) : mk (X⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧) = -mk X
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_shift, Int.negOnePow_neg, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.smul_def, Units.val_neg, Units.val_one,
    neg_smul, one_smul]

name: DG.K0.mk_shift_even
statement: theorem mk_shift_even {n : ℤ} (hn : Even n) (X : C) : mk (X⟦n⟧) = mk X
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_shift, Int.negOnePow_even n hn, one_smul]

name: DG.K0.mk_shift_odd
statement: theorem mk_shift_odd {n : ℤ} (hn : Odd n) (X : C) : mk (X⟦n⟧) = -mk X
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_shift, Int.negOnePow_odd n hn, Units.smul_def, Units.val_neg, Units.val_one, neg_smul,
    one_smul]

name: DG.K0.mk_biprod
statement: theorem mk_biprod (X Y : C) : mk (X ⊞ Y) = mk X + mk Y
proof:
:=
  mk_obj₂ _ (binaryBiproductTriangle_distinguished X Y)

name: DG.K0.mk_prod
statement: theorem mk_prod (X Y : C) : mk (X ⨯ Y) = mk X + mk Y
proof:
:=
  mk_obj₂ _ (binaryProductTriangle_distinguished X Y)

name: DG.K0.mk_coprod
statement: theorem mk_coprod (X Y : C) : mk (X ⨿ Y) = mk X + mk Y
proof:
:=
  (mk_eq_of_iso (biprod.isoCoprod X Y).symm).trans (mk_biprod X Y)

name: DG.K0.mk_last_eq_add_sum
statement:
theorem mk_last_eq_add_sum {n : ℕ} (X : Fin (n + 1) → C) (Q : Fin n → C)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ (f : X i.castSucc ⟶ X i.succ) (g : X i.succ ⟶ Q i)
      (k : Q i ⟶ (X i.castSucc)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), Triangle.mk f g k ∈ distTriang C) :
    mk (X (Fin.last n)) = mk (X 0) + ∑ i, mk (Q i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨f, g, k, hT⟩ := h (Fin.last n)
    have ih' := ih (fun i => X i.castSucc) (fun i => Q i.castSucc) (fun i => h i.castSucc)
    simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero'] at ih'
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, ← add_assoc, ← ih', ← Fin.succ_last,
      mk_eq_add_of_distTriang f g k hT]

name: DG.K0.map_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_mk (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated] (X : C) :
    map F (mk X) = mk (F.obj X)
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ X

name: DG.K0.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (𝟭 C) = AddMonoidHom.id (K0 C)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  simp

name: DG.K0.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    [G.CommShift ℤ] [G.IsTriangulated] : map (F ⋙ G) = (map G).comp (map F)
proof:

name: DG.K0.map_comp_apply
statement:
theorem map_comp_apply (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    [G.CommShift ℤ] [G.IsTriangulated] (x : K0 C) : map (F ⋙ G) x = map G (map F x)
proof:
:= by

name: DG.K0.map_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_iso {F₁ F₂ : C ⥤ D} (e : F₁ ≅ F₂) [F₁.CommShift ℤ] [F₁.IsTriangulated]
    [F₂.CommShift ℤ] [F₂.IsTriangulated] : map F₁ = map F₂
proof:
:= by

name: DG.K0.mapEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapEquiv_apply (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.CommShift ℤ] [e.inverse.CommShift ℤ]
    [e.functor.IsTriangulated] [e.inverse.IsTriangulated] (x : K0 C) :
    mapEquiv e x = map e.functor x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.K0.mapEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapEquiv_symm_apply (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.CommShift ℤ] [e.inverse.CommShift ℤ]
    [e.functor.IsTriangulated] [e.inverse.IsTriangulated] (y : K0 D) :
    (mapEquiv e).symm y = map e.inverse y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.K0.mapEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem mapEquiv_mk (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.CommShift ℤ] [e.inverse.CommShift ℤ]
    [e.functor.IsTriangulated] [e.inverse.IsTriangulated] (X : C) :
    mapEquiv e (mk X) = mk (e.functor.obj X)
proof:

  map_mk _ X

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.exists_mk_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mk_eq [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{w', w} C] (x : K0.{w', w} C) :
    ∃ X : PerfectDerivedCategory.{w', w} C, DG.K0.mk X = x
proof:
:=
  DG.K0.exists_mk_eq x

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.mk_mem_closure_representable
statement:
theorem mk_mem_closure_representable [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{w', max v w} C]
    {X : PerfectDerivedCategory.{w', max v w} C}
    (hX : ∀ P : ObjectProperty (PerfectDerivedCategory.{w', max v w} C), P.IsTriangulated →
      P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms → (∀ Y : C, P (PerfectDerivedCategory.representable.{w', w} Y)) →
      P X) :
    DG.K0.mk X ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range (representable.{w', w} (C := C)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := DG.K0.mk_mem_closure_of_forall
    (fun Y => ∃ Z : C, PerfectDerivedCategory.representable.{w', w} Z = Y)
    (X := X) fun P h₁ h₂ hP => hX P h₁ h₂ fun Y => hP _ ⟨Y, rfl⟩
  convert h using 2
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨Z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨Z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Z, rfl⟩

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.map_mk
statement:
theorem map_mk (X : PerfectDerivedCategory.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C) :
    map.{w₂, w} F (DG.K0.mk X) = DG.K0.mk ((DerivedCategory.perfectInduction.{w₂, w} F).obj X)
proof:
:=
  DG.K0.map_mk _ X

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.map_representable
statement:
theorem map_representable (X : C) :
    map.{w₂, w} F (representable.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₂ w} X) =
      representable.{w₂, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [representable, map_mk]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (DerivedCategory.inductionRepresentableIso F X)

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.mapEquivOfIsQuasiEquivalence_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapEquivOfIsQuasiEquivalence_apply (hF : IsQuasiEquivalence F)
    (x : K0.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C) :
    mapEquivOfIsQuasiEquivalence.{w₂, w} F hF x = map.{w₂, w} F x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.map_id
statement:
theorem map_id {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ X Y : C, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] [DGCategory C]
    [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{max u₁ v₁ w, max u₁ v₁ w} C] :
    map.{max u₁ v₁ w, w} (𝟭 C) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [map_mk, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ((DerivedCategory.inductionIdIso C).app X.obj)

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ X Y : C, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] [DGCategory C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    [Preadditive D] [∀ X Y : D, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] [DGCategory D] {E : Type u₃}
    [Category.{v₃} E] [Preadditive E] [∀ X Y : E, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] [DGCategory E]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.IsDGFunctor] (G : D ⥤ E) [G.Additive] [G.IsDGFunctor]
    [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{max u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w, max u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w} C]
    [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{max u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w, max u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w} D]
    [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{w₃, max u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w} E] :
    map.{w₃, max u₂ v₂ w} (F ⋙ G) =
      (map.{w₃, max u₁ v₁ w} G).comp (map.{max u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ v₃ w, max u₂ v₃ w} F)
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  rw [map_mk, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, map_mk, map_mk]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ((DerivedCategory.inductionCompIso F G).app X.obj)

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.Equiv.refl
statement: theorem Equiv.refl {X : C} (e : Idempotent X) : e.Equiv e
proof:
:=
  ⟨e.val, e.val, e.mem_grading, e.mem_grading, e.comp_self, e.comp_self, e.comp_self,
    e.comp_self, e.comp_self, e.comp_self⟩

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.Equiv.symm
statement:
theorem Equiv.symm {X Y : C} {e : Idempotent X} {f : Idempotent Y} (h : e.Equiv f) :
    f.Equiv e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, hb, hc, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h
  exact ⟨c, b, hc, hb, h3, h4, h1, h2, h6, h5⟩

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.Equiv.trans
statement:
theorem Equiv.trans [DGCategory C] {X Y Z : C} {e : Idempotent X} {f : Idempotent Y}
    {g : Idempotent Z} (h : e.Equiv f) (h' : f.Equiv g) : e.Equiv g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, hb, hc, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨b', c', hb', hc', h1', h2', h3', h4', h5', h6'⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨b' ≫ b, c ≫ c', by simpa using comp_mem_grading hb' hb,
    by simpa using comp_mem_grading hc hc', by rw [← Category.assoc, h1'],
    by rw [Category.assoc, h2], by rw [← Category.assoc, h3], by rw [Category.assoc, h4'], ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc b, h5, ← Category.assoc, h2', h5']
  · rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc c', h6', ← Category.assoc, h4, h6]

name: DG.DGCategory.IsPositive.nonempty_cell_iso_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_cell_iso_iff (hC : IsPositive C) (he : e.IsSimple) (hf : f.IsSimple) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (cell.{w', w} e n ≅ cell f n) ↔ e.Equiv f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨ι⟩ => ?_, fun h => ⟨Q.mapIso (cellIso n (hC.cornerIsoOfEquiv h))⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq (isKProjective_cellModule e n) ι.hom
  set b := cellCoord (g.app X (cellGen e n)) with hbdef
  have hb0 : b ∈ grading 0 := by simpa using cellCoord_app_cellGen_mem g
  have hfb : f.val ≫ b = b := val_comp_cellCoord _
  have hbe : b ≫ e.val = b := cellCoord_app_cellGen_comp g
  have hbne : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have : g = 0 := cellModule_hom_ext n (cellModule_ext (by
      rw [CatModule.zero_app, cellCoord_zero]
      exact h0))
    refine hC.not_isZero_cell he n ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr ?_)
    rw [← ι.hom_inv_id, ← hg, this, Functor.map_zero, zero_comp]
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hec, hcf, hbc, hcb⟩ := he.exists_inv hf hb0 hfb hbe hbne
  exact ⟨b, c, hb0, hc0, hfb, hbe, hec, hcf, hbc, hcb⟩

name: DG.DGCategory.IsPositive.isSimple_of_equiv
statement: theorem isSimple_of_equiv (h : e.Equiv f) (he : e.IsSimple) : f.IsSimple
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c, hb, hc, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun h0 => he.1 (by rw [← h6, ← h4, h0]; simp), fun Z k hk hfk hk0 => ?_⟩
  have hbk : e.val ≫ c ≫ k = c ≫ k := by rw [← Category.assoc, h3]
  have hck0 : c ≫ k ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hk0 (by rw [← hfk, ← h5, Category.assoc, h0, comp_zero])
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgk⟩ := he.2 (c ≫ k) (by simpa using comp_mem_grading hc hk) hbk hck0
  have hkg : k ≫ g = b := by
    calc k ≫ g = (b ≫ c) ≫ k ≫ g := by rw [h5, ← Category.assoc, hfk]
      _ = b ≫ e.val := by rw [← hgk]; simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = b := h2
  exact ⟨g ≫ c, by simpa using comp_mem_grading hg hc, by rw [← Category.assoc, hkg, h5]⟩

name: DG.DGCategory.IsPositive.cell_hom_eq_zero_of_gt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq (isKProjective_cellModule e n) φ
  suffices hg : g = 0 by rw [hg, Functor.map_zero]
  refine cellModule_hom_ext n (cellModule_ext ?_)
  rw [CatModule.zero_app, cellCoord_zero]
  exact h0 (by omega) (cellCoord_app_cellGen_mem g)

name: DG.DGCategory.IsPositive.isSemisimpleCellFamily
statement:
theorem isSemisimpleCellFamily (hC : IsPositive C)
    (h0 : ∀ {X Y : C} {n : ℤ}, 0 < n → ∀ {f : X ⟶ Y}, f ∈ grading n → f = 0) :
    IsSemisimpleCellFamily (fun (i : SimpleCorner C) (n : ℤ) => cell.{w', w} i.1.2 n) where
  toIsOrderedCellFamily
proof:
:= hC.isOrderedCellFamily
  eq_zero_of_gt h φ := cell_hom_eq_zero_of_gt h0 h φ

name: DG.DGCategory.IsPositive.basisOfConcentrated_apply
statement:
theorem basisOfConcentrated_apply (hC : IsPositive C)
    (h0 : ∀ {X Y : C} {n : ℤ}, 0 < n → ∀ {f : X ⟶ Y}, f ∈ grading n → f = 0) {κ : Type*}
    (s : κ → SimpleCorner C) (hs : ∀ a b, (s a).1.2.Equiv (s b).1.2 → a = b)
    (hs' : ∀ c : SimpleCorner C, ∃ a, c.1.2.Equiv (s a).1.2) (a : κ) :
    hC.basisOfConcentrated h0 s hs hs' a = K0.cell.{w} (s a).1.2 0
proof:
:=
  IsSemisimpleCellFamily.basis_apply _ _ _ _ _ _ a

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.map_cell
statement:
theorem map_cell {X : C} (e : Idempotent X) :
    map.{max u v w, w} F (cell.{max v w} e 0) = cell.{max v w} (e.map F) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cell, map_mk]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (inductionCellIso.{w} F e)

name: DG.AbelianK0.finsum_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem finsum_eq_sum_range (f : ℤ → G) (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → f n = 0) :
    ∑ᶠ n, f n = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, f (a + i)
proof:
:= by
  let e : ℕ ↪ ℤ := ⟨fun i => a + i, fun i j h => by simpa using h⟩
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset f (s := (Finset.range m).map e), Finset.sum_map]
  · rfl
  · intro n hn
    simp only [Function.mem_support, Finset.coe_map, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe,
      Finset.mem_range] at hn ⊢
    refine ⟨(n - a).toNat, ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra h
      exact hn (hf n (by omega))
    · by_contra h
      exact hn (hf n (by change ¬a + ((n - a).toNat : ℤ) = n at h; omega))

name: DG.AbelianK0.sum_range_negOnePow_telescope
statement:
theorem sum_range_negOnePow_telescope (x h c : ℤ → G) (hx : ∀ n, x n = h n + c (n - 1) + c n)
    (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (a + i).negOnePow • x (a + i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (a + i).negOnePow • h (a + i) + a.negOnePow • c (a - 1) -
        (a + m).negOnePow • c (a + m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, hx]
    have e : a + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = a + m + 1 := by omega
    rw [e, Int.negOnePow_succ, add_sub_cancel_right, Units.neg_smul]
    simp only [smul_add]
    abel

name: DG.AbelianK0.mk_X_eq
statement:
theorem mk_X_eq (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    mk (K.X n) = mk (K.homology n) + mk (Abelian.coimage (K.d (n - 1) (n - 1 + 1))) +
      mk (Abelian.coimage (K.d n (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_X₂_eq_mk_homology_add (K.sc' (n - 1) n (n + 1))
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso (K.homologyIsoSc' (n - 1) n (n + 1) (by simp) (by simp)).symm] at h
  have e : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
  rw [e]
  exact h

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_sum_range (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (hK : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (K.X n)) :
    eulerChar K = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (a + i).negOnePow • mk (K.X (a + i))
proof:
:=
  finsum_eq_sum_range _ a m (fun n hn => by rw [mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (hK n hn), smul_zero])

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_eq_sum_Icc
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_sum_Icc (a b : ℤ) [K.IsStrictlyGE a] [K.IsStrictlyLE b] :
    eulerChar K = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc a b, n.negOnePow • mk (K.X n)
proof:
:= by
  refine finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (fun n hn => ?_)
  simp only [Function.mem_support, Finset.coe_Icc, Set.mem_Icc] at hn ⊢
  by_contra h
  apply hn
  rw [not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · rw [mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (K.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE a n h), smul_zero]
  · rw [mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (K.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE b n h), smul_zero]

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_eq_finsum_homology
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_finsum_homology (a b : ℤ) [K.IsStrictlyGE a] [K.IsStrictlyLE b] :
    eulerChar K = ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, n.negOnePow • mk (K.homology n)
proof:
:= by
  set m := (b + 1 - a).toNat
  have hK : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (K.X n) := by
    rintro n (hn | hn)
    · exact K.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE a n hn
    · exact K.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE b n (by omega)
  rw [eulerChar_eq_sum_range K a m hK, finsum_eq_sum_range _ a m (fun n hn => by
    rw [mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (show IsZero (K.homology n) from
      ShortComplex.isZero_homology_of_isZero_X₂ (K.sc n) (hK n hn)), smul_zero]),
    sum_range_negOnePow_telescope _ _ (fun n => mk (Abelian.coimage (K.d n (n + 1))))
      (mk_X_eq K),
    mk_coimage_eq_zero_of_isZero_source _ (hK _ (Or.inl (by omega))),
    mk_coimage_eq_zero_of_isZero_target _ (hK _ (Or.inr (by omega))), smul_zero, smul_zero,
    add_zero, sub_zero]

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_eq_zero_of_exactAt
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_zero_of_exactAt (a b : ℤ) [K.IsStrictlyGE a] [K.IsStrictlyLE b]
    (hK : ∀ n, K.ExactAt n) : eulerChar K = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerChar_eq_finsum_homology K a b]
  exact finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun n => by
    rw [mk_eq_zero_of_isZero ((hK n).isZero_homology), smul_zero])

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_of_iso {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} (e : K ≅ L) :
    eulerChar K = eulerChar L
proof:
:= by
  unfold eulerChar
  congr 1
  ext n
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso (show K.X n ≅ L.X n from (HomologicalComplex.eval C _ n).mapIso e)]

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_eq_of_quasiIso
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_of_quasiIso {L : CochainComplex C ℤ} (φ : K ⟶ L) [QuasiIso φ]
    (a b : ℤ) [K.IsStrictlyGE a] [K.IsStrictlyLE b] (a' b' : ℤ) [L.IsStrictlyGE a']
    [L.IsStrictlyLE b'] : eulerChar K = eulerChar L
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerChar_eq_finsum_homology K a b, eulerChar_eq_finsum_homology L a' b']
  congr 1
  ext n
  rw [mk_eq_of_iso (asIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ n))]

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_single
statement:
theorem eulerChar_single (n : ℤ) (X : C) :
    eulerChar ((HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n).obj X) =
      n.negOnePow • mk X
proof:
:= by
  unfold eulerChar
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ n (fun i hi => by
    rw [mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X _ _ _ _ hi), smul_zero]),
    mk_eq_of_iso (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf _ n X)]

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_X₂_of_isZero
statement:
theorem eulerChar_X₂_of_isZero {S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (a : ℤ) (m : ℕ) (h₂ : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (S.X₂.X n)) :
    eulerChar S.X₂ = eulerChar S.X₁ + eulerChar S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  have hS' := HomologicalComplex.shortExact_iff_degreewise_shortExact S |>.1 hS
  have h₁ : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (S.X₁.X n) := fun n hn => by
    have := (hS' n).mono_f
    exact IsZero.of_mono (S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval C _ n)).f (h₂ n hn)
  have h₃ : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (S.X₃.X n) := fun n hn => by
    have := (hS' n).epi_g
    exact IsZero.of_epi (S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval C _ n)).g (h₂ n hn)
  rw [eulerChar_eq_sum_range _ a m h₁, eulerChar_eq_sum_range _ a m h₂,
    eulerChar_eq_sum_range _ a m h₃, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [← smul_add]
  exact congrArg _ (mk_X₂ (hS' _))

name: DG.AbelianK0.eulerChar_X₂
statement:
theorem eulerChar_X₂ {S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (hS : S.ShortExact) (a b : ℤ)
    [S.X₂.IsStrictlyGE a] [S.X₂.IsStrictlyLE b] :
    eulerChar S.X₂ = eulerChar S.X₁ + eulerChar S.X₃
proof:
:=
  eulerChar_X₂_of_isZero hS a (b + 1 - a).toNat (by
    rintro n (hn | hn)
    · exact S.X₂.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE a n hn
    · exact S.X₂.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE b n (by omega))

name: DG.AbelianK0.toDerived_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDerived_mk (X : C) :
    toDerived (mk X) = K0.mk ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj X)
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ X

name: DG.K0.mk_singleFunctor
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.K0.mk_singleFunctor (n : ℤ) (X : C) :
    K0.mk ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C n).obj X) =
      n.negOnePow • K0.mk ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  have h := K0.mk_eq_of_iso (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctors C).shiftIso n 0 n
    (add_zero n)).app X)
  dsimp at h
  rw [← h, K0.mk_shift, smul_smul, ← Int.negOnePow_add, ← two_mul,
    Int.negOnePow_two_mul, one_smul]

name: DG.K0.mk_Q_obj_single
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.K0.mk_Q_obj_single (n : ℤ) (X : C) :
    K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n).obj X)) =
      n.negOnePow • toDerived (mk X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toDerived_mk, ← K0.mk_singleFunctor]
  exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso (((SingleFunctors.evaluation _ _ n).mapIso
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctorsPostcompQIso C)).app X).symm

name: DG.K0.mk_Q_obj_X₂
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.K0.mk_Q_obj_X₂ {S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₂) =
      K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₁) + K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj S.X₃)
proof:
:=
  K0.mk_obj₂ _ (DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES_distinguished hS)

name: DG.AbelianK0.toDerived_eulerChar_of_isZero
statement:
theorem toDerived_eulerChar_of_isZero (m : ℕ) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ n, n < a ∨ a + m ≤ n → IsZero (K.X n)) :
    toDerived (eulerChar K) = K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing K a with
  | zero =>
    have hK' : IsZero K := (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero K).2 (by
      ext n
      exact (hK n (by omega)).eq_of_src _ _)
    rw [eulerChar_eq_sum_range K a 0 hK, Finset.sum_range_zero, map_zero,
      K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (DerivedCategory.Q.map_isZero hK')]
  | succ m ih =>
    let π : K ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) a).obj (K.X a) :=
      HomologicalComplex.mkHomToSingle (𝟙 _) (fun i hi =>
        (hK i (Or.inl (by simp at hi; omega))).eq_of_src _ _)
    have hπa : IsIso (π.f a) := by
      rw [HomologicalComplex.mkHomToSingle_f]
      infer_instance
    have hπ : ∀ i, Epi (π.f i) := fun i => by
      by_cases hi : i = a
      · subst hi
        infer_instance
      · exact (HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X _ _ _ _ hi).epi _
    have : Epi π := HomologicalComplex.epi_of_epi_f π hπ
    let S := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι π) π (kernel.condition π)
    have hS : S.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk'
      (S.exact_of_f_is_kernel (kernelIsKernel π)) (by dsimp [S]; infer_instance) this
    have hS' := (HomologicalComplex.shortExact_iff_degreewise_shortExact S).1 hS
    have h₁ : ∀ n, n < a + 1 ∨ a + 1 + m ≤ n → IsZero ((kernel π).X n) := by
      intro n hn
      by_cases hna : n = a
      · subst hna
        exact (hS' n).isIso_g_iff.1 hπa
      · have := (hS' n).isIso_f_iff.2
          (HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℤ) a (K.X a) n hna)
        have : IsIso ((kernel.ι π).f n) := this
        exact IsZero.of_iso (hK n (by omega)) (asIso ((kernel.ι π).f n))
    have e₁ : eulerChar K = eulerChar (kernel π) + eulerChar
        ((HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) a).obj (K.X a)) :=
      eulerChar_X₂_of_isZero hS a (m + 1) hK
    have e₂ : K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) = K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (kernel π)) +
        K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) a).obj (K.X a))) :=
      K0.mk_Q_obj_X₂ hS
    rw [e₁, e₂, map_add, ih _ (a + 1) h₁, eulerChar_single, K0.mk_Q_obj_single,
      Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.AbelianK0.toDerived_eulerChar
statement:
theorem toDerived_eulerChar (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (a b : ℤ) [K.IsStrictlyGE a]
    [K.IsStrictlyLE b] : toDerived (eulerChar K) = K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
proof:
:=
  toDerived_eulerChar_of_isZero (b + 1 - a).toNat K a (by
    rintro n (hn | hn)
    · exact K.isZero_of_isStrictlyGE a n hn
    · exact K.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE b n (by omega))

name: DG.K0.mk_Q_obj_eq_toDerived
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.K0.mk_Q_obj_eq_toDerived (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    [K.IsStrictlyGE a] [K.IsStrictlyLE b] :
    K0.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
      toDerived (∑ᶠ n : ℤ, n.negOnePow • mk (K.homology n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eulerChar_eq_finsum_homology K a b, toDerived_eulerChar K a b]

name: DG.DGRingHom.isCompact_singleObjEquivalence_inverse_obj
statement:
theorem isCompact_singleObjEquivalence_inverse_obj
    [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{u, u} (SingleObj B)] :
    IsCompact.{u} ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence B).inverse.obj
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_functor_obj_iff (CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence B) _).mp
    (hc.of_iso ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence B).counitIso.app _))

name: DG.DGRingHom.isCompact_Q_extendScalars_obj
statement:
theorem isCompact_Q_extendScalars_obj :
    IsCompact.{u} (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((DGModuleCat.extendScalars.{u} φ).obj P))
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj B)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  exact ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.isCompact_induction_obj φ.singleObjFunctor
    (isCompact_singleObjEquivalence_inverse_obj hc)).map_of_equivalence
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence A)).of_iso
    (φ.derivedInductionObjIso hP).symm

name: DG.DGRing.K0.map_mk_of_isKProjective
statement:
theorem map_mk_of_isKProjective :
    map φ (DG.K0.mk (⟨DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, hc⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory B)) =
      DG.K0.mk (⟨DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((DGModuleCat.extendScalars.{u} φ).obj P),
        φ.isCompact_Q_extendScalars_obj hP hc⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory A)
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj B)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  let y : DGCategory.K0 (SingleObj B) :=
    DG.K0.mk (⟨_, DGRingHom.isCompact_singleObjEquivalence_inverse_obj hc⟩ :
      CatModule.PerfectDerivedCategory (SingleObj B))
  have h1 : (DG.K0.mk (⟨DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, hc⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory B)) =
      singleObjEquiv B y := by
    rw [singleObjEquiv, DG.K0.compactMapEquiv_mk]
    exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence B).counitIso.app _).symm
  rw [h1]
  change singleObjEquiv A (DGCategory.K0.map φ.singleObjFunctor
    ((singleObjEquiv B).symm (singleObjEquiv B y))) = _
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply, DGCategory.K0.map_mk, singleObjEquiv, DG.K0.compactMapEquiv_mk]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (φ.derivedInductionObjIso hP)

name: DG.K0.fullSubcategoryMapEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fullSubcategoryMapEquiv_mk (e : T ≌ T') [e.functor.CommShift ℤ]
    [e.functor.IsTriangulated] (P : ObjectProperty T) (P' : ObjectProperty T')
    [P.IsTriangulated] [P'.IsTriangulated] [P'.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (h : ∀ X, P X ↔ P' (e.functor.obj X)) (X : P.FullSubcategory) :
    fullSubcategoryMapEquiv e P P' h (mk X) =
      mk (⟨e.functor.obj X.obj, (h X.obj).1 X.property⟩ : P'.FullSubcategory)
proof:
:=
  map_mk _ X

name: DG.DGRing.K0.compactSubcategory_iff_isPerfect
statement:
theorem compactSubcategory_iff_isPerfect [_root_.HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    (X : DerivedCategory R) : compactSubcategory.{u} (DerivedCategory R) X ↔
      IsPerfect R ((derivedComparisonEquivalence R).functor.obj X)
proof:
:=
  DegreeZero.isCompact_iff_isPerfect R X

name: DG.DGRing.K0.projK0Equiv_symm_self
statement:
theorem projK0Equiv_symm_self :
    (projK0Equiv R).symm (ProjK0.mk (ModuleCat.of R R) (IsFGProjective.self R)) =
      self R
proof:
:= by
  let := _root_.HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} R)
  rw [projK0Equiv, AddEquiv.symm_trans_apply, perfectK0Equiv_symm_mk, AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq,
    self, DG.K0.fullSubcategoryMapEquiv_mk]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (derivedComparisonObjSelfIso R).symm

name: DG.DGRing.K0.projK0Equiv_self
statement:
theorem projK0Equiv_self :
    projK0Equiv R (self R) = ProjK0.mk (ModuleCat.of R R) (IsFGProjective.self R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← projK0Equiv_symm_self, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: DG.DGRing.K0.projK0Equiv_mk_Q_obj
statement:
theorem projK0Equiv_mk_Q_obj (M : DGModuleCat.{u} R)
    (hM : IsPerfectComplex ((complexFunctor R).obj M)) :
    projK0Equiv R (DG.K0.mk (⟨Q.obj M, isCompact_Q_obj_of_isPerfectComplex R M hM⟩ :
      PerfectDerivedCategory R)) = hM.eulerChar
proof:
:= by
  let := _root_.HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} R)
  rw [projK0Equiv, AddEquiv.trans_apply, DG.K0.fullSubcategoryMapEquiv_mk,
    ← perfectK0Equiv_mk_Q_obj hM]
  exact congrArg _ (DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ((QCompDerivedComparisonIso R).app M))

name: ModuleCat.finrank_range_iso_comp_comp
statement:
theorem _root_.ModuleCat.finrank_range_iso_comp_comp {K : Type w} [Field K]
    {X X' Y Y' : ModuleCat.{v} K} (e₁ : X' ≅ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (e₂ : Y ≅ Y') :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (e₁.hom ≫ g ≫ e₂.hom).hom) =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range g.hom)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (e₁.hom ≫ g ≫ e₂.hom).hom =
      (e₂.toLinearEquiv : Y →ₗ[K] Y').comp (g.hom.comp (e₁.toLinearEquiv : X' →ₗ[K] X)) := rfl
  rw [h, LinearMap.range_comp, LinearEquiv.range_comp, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]

name: ModuleCat.finrank_eq_add_of_exact
statement:
theorem _root_.ModuleCat.finrank_eq_add_of_exact {K : Type w} [Field K]
    {U V W : ModuleCat.{v} K} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W)
    (h : LinearMap.range f.hom = LinearMap.ker g.hom) [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    Module.finrank K V =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range f.hom) + Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range g.hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g.hom, h, add_comm]

name: ModuleCat.finiteDimensional_of_exact
statement:
theorem _root_.ModuleCat.finiteDimensional_of_exact {K : Type w} [Field K]
    {U V W : ModuleCat.{v} K} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W)
    (h : LinearMap.range f.hom = LinearMap.ker g.hom) [FiniteDimensional K U]
    [FiniteDimensional K W] : FiniteDimensional K V
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((⊤ : Submodule K V).map g.hom).FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  have h2 : ((⊤ : Submodule K V) ⊓ LinearMap.ker g.hom).FG := by
    rw [top_inf_eq, ← h, LinearMap.range_eq_map]
    exact (Module.Finite.fg_top).map _
  exact ⟨Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker g.hom h1 h2⟩

name: DG.DerivedCategory.finrankHomology_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem finrankHomology_eq_of_iso (n : ℤ) {X Y : DerivedCategory A} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    finrankHomology R n X = finrankHomology R n Y
proof:
:=
  ((homologyFunctor R n).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: DG.DerivedCategory.finrankHomology_shift
statement:
theorem finrankHomology_shift (a n : ℤ) (X : DerivedCategory A) :
    finrankHomology R n (X⟦a⟧) = finrankHomology R (a + n) X
proof:
:=
  ((homologyFunctorShiftIso R a n (a + n) rfl).app X).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: DG.DerivedCategory.rankHomology_shift
statement:
theorem rankHomology_shift (a n : ℤ) {X Y : DerivedCategory A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    rankHomology R n (f⟦a⟧') = rankHomology R (a + n) f
proof:
:= by
  let σ := homologyFunctorShiftIso (A := A) R a n (a + n) rfl
  have h : (homologyFunctor R n).map (f⟦a⟧') =
      σ.hom.app X ≫ (homologyFunctor R (a + n)).map f ≫ σ.inv.app Y := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← σ.hom.naturality f, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app,
      Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  rw [rankHomology, h]
  exact ModuleCat.finrank_range_iso_comp_comp (σ.app X) _ (σ.app Y).symm

name: DG.DerivedCategory.rankHomology_neg
statement:
theorem rankHomology_neg (n : ℤ) {X Y : DerivedCategory A} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    rankHomology R n (-f) = rankHomology R n f
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankHomology, rankHomology, Functor.map_neg, ModuleCat.hom_neg, LinearMap.range_neg]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.rankHomology_le_left
statement:
theorem rankHomology_le_left (n : ℤ) {X Y : DerivedCategory A} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [FiniteDimensional R ((homologyFunctor R n).obj X)] :
    rankHomology R n f ≤ finrankHomology R n X
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.finrank_range_le _

name: DG.DerivedCategory.rankHomology_le_right
statement:
theorem rankHomology_le_right (n : ℤ) {X Y : DerivedCategory A} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [FiniteDimensional R ((homologyFunctor R n).obj Y)] :
    rankHomology R n f ≤ finrankHomology R n Y
proof:
:=
  Submodule.finrank_le _

name: DG.DerivedCategory.range_eq_ker_of_distTriang
statement:
theorem range_eq_ker_of_distTriang (n : ℤ) (T : Triangle (DerivedCategory A))
    (hT : T ∈ distTriang _) :
    LinearMap.range ((homologyFunctor R n).map T.mor₁).hom =
      LinearMap.ker ((homologyFunctor R n).map T.mor₂).hom
proof:
:=
  ((homologyFunctor R n).map_distinguished_exact T hT).moduleCat_range_eq_ker

name: DG.DerivedCategory.alternating_finsum_of_exact
statement:
theorem alternating_finsum_of_exact (x y z a b c : ℤ → ℕ) (ha : (Function.support a).Finite)
    (hb : (Function.support b).Finite) (hc : (Function.support c).Finite)
    (hy : ∀ n, y n = a n + b n) (hz : ∀ n, z n = b n + c n)
    (hx : ∀ n, x (n + 1) = c n + a (n + 1)) :
    ∑ᶠ n, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * y n =
      ∑ᶠ n, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * x n + ∑ᶠ n, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * z n
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : ∀ n, x n = c (n - 1) + a n := fun n => by
    have := hx (n - 1)
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
  have fin : ∀ f : ℤ → ℕ, (Function.support f).Finite →
      Function.HasFiniteSupport fun n : ℤ => (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * f n := fun f hf =>
    hf.subset fun n hn h => hn (by simp [h])
  have hc' : (Function.support fun n => c (n - 1)).Finite := by
    have : (Function.support fun n => c (n - 1)) = (fun m => m + 1) '' Function.support c := by
      ext n
      simp only [Function.mem_support, Set.mem_image]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨n - 1, h, sub_add_cancel n 1⟩, fun ⟨m, hm, e⟩ => by
        rw [← e, add_sub_cancel_right]; exact hm⟩
    rw [this]
    exact hc.image _
  simp only [hy, hz, hx', Nat.cast_add, mul_add]
  rw [finsum_add_distrib (fin _ ha) (fin _ hb), finsum_add_distrib (fin _ hc') (fin _ ha),
    finsum_add_distrib (fin _ hb) (fin _ hc)]
  have key : ∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * (c (n - 1) : ℤ) =
      -∑ᶠ n : ℤ, (n.negOnePow : ℤ) * (c n : ℤ) := by
    rw [← finsum_comp_equiv (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ)), ← finsum_neg_distrib]
    refine finsum_congr fun n => ?_
    simp [Int.negOnePow_succ]
  rw [key]
  ring

name: DG.DerivedCategory.finiteDimensional_obj₂
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_obj₂ (n : ℤ) [FiniteDimensional R ((homologyFunctor R n).obj T.obj₁)]
    [FiniteDimensional R ((homologyFunctor R n).obj T.obj₃)] :
    FiniteDimensional R ((homologyFunctor R n).obj T.obj₂)
proof:
:=
  ModuleCat.finiteDimensional_of_exact _ _ (range_eq_ker_of_distTriang R n T hT)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.finrankHomology_obj₂
statement:
theorem finrankHomology_obj₂ (n : ℤ) :
    finrankHomology R n T.obj₂ = rankHomology R n T.mor₁ + rankHomology R n T.mor₂
proof:
:= by
  have := h₁ n
  have := h₃ n
  have := finiteDimensional_obj₂ (R := R) T hT n
  exact ModuleCat.finrank_eq_add_of_exact _ _ (range_eq_ker_of_distTriang R n T hT)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.finrankHomology_obj₃
statement:
theorem finrankHomology_obj₃ (n : ℤ) :
    finrankHomology R n T.obj₃ = rankHomology R n T.mor₂ + rankHomology R n T.mor₃
proof:
:= by
  have := h₃ n
  exact ModuleCat.finrank_eq_add_of_exact _ _
    (range_eq_ker_of_distTriang R n T.rotate (rot_of_distTriang _ hT))

name: DG.DerivedCategory.finrankHomology_obj₁
statement:
theorem finrankHomology_obj₁ (n : ℤ) :
    finrankHomology R (n + 1) T.obj₁ = rankHomology R n T.mor₃ + rankHomology R (n + 1) T.mor₁
proof:
:= by
  have e := (homologyFunctorShiftIso (A := A) R 1 n (1 + n) rfl).app T.obj₁
  have := h₁ (1 + n)
  have : FiniteDimensional R ((homologyFunctor R n).obj T.rotate.rotate.obj₂) :=
    LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional e.toLinearEquiv.symm
  have h := ModuleCat.finrank_eq_add_of_exact _ _
    (range_eq_ker_of_distTriang R n T.rotate.rotate (rot_of_distTriang _ (rot_of_distTriang _ hT)))
  change finrankHomology R n (T.obj₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) = rankHomology R n T.mor₃ +
    rankHomology R n (-T.mor₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') at h
  rw [rankHomology_neg, rankHomology_shift, finrankHomology_shift, add_comm 1 n] at h
  exact h

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasFiniteCohomology_obj₂
statement:
theorem hasFiniteCohomology_obj₂ (T : Triangle (DerivedCategory A)) (hT : T ∈ distTriang _)
    (h₁ : HasFiniteCohomology R T.obj₁) (h₃ : HasFiniteCohomology R T.obj₃) :
    HasFiniteCohomology R T.obj₂
proof:
:= by
  have := h₁.1
  have := h₃.1
  refine ⟨fun n => finiteDimensional_obj₂ T hT n, (h₁.2.union h₃.2).subset fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_contra hn'
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Function.mem_support, not_or, not_not] at hn'
  apply hn
  change finrankHomology R n T.obj₂ = 0
  rw [finrankHomology_obj₂ T hT h₁.1 h₃.1]
  have ha := rankHomology_le_left R n T.mor₁
  have hb := rankHomology_le_right R n T.mor₂
  omega

name: DG.DerivedCategory.eulerChar_obj₂
statement:
theorem eulerChar_obj₂ (T : Triangle (DerivedCategory A)) (hT : T ∈ distTriang _)
    (h₁ : HasFiniteCohomology R T.obj₁) (h₃ : HasFiniteCohomology R T.obj₃) :
    eulerChar R T.obj₂ = eulerChar R T.obj₁ + eulerChar R T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  have := h₁.1
  have := h₃.1
  refine alternating_finsum_of_exact _ _ _ (fun n => rankHomology R n T.mor₁)
    (fun n => rankHomology R n T.mor₂) (fun n => rankHomology R n T.mor₃)
    (h₁.2.subset fun n hn h => hn ?_) (h₃.2.subset fun n hn h => hn ?_)
    (h₃.2.subset fun n hn h => hn ?_) (finrankHomology_obj₂ T hT h₁.1 h₃.1)
    (finrankHomology_obj₃ T hT h₃.1) (finrankHomology_obj₁ T hT h₁.1)
  · have := rankHomology_le_left R n T.mor₁
    change finrankHomology R n T.obj₁ = 0 at h
    change rankHomology R n T.mor₁ = 0
    omega
  · have := rankHomology_le_right R n T.mor₂
    change finrankHomology R n T.obj₃ = 0 at h
    change rankHomology R n T.mor₂ = 0
    omega
  · have := rankHomology_le_left R n T.mor₃
    change finrankHomology R n T.obj₃ = 0 at h
    change rankHomology R n T.mor₃ = 0
    omega

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasFiniteCohomology_of_isZero
statement:
theorem hasFiniteCohomology_of_isZero {X : DerivedCategory A} (hX : IsZero X) :
    HasFiniteCohomology R X
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ n, Subsingleton ((homologyFunctor R n).obj X) := fun n =>
    (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton).mp ((homologyFunctor R n).map_isZero hX)
  refine ⟨fun n => inferInstance, ?_⟩
  convert Set.finite_empty
  ext n
  simp [finrankHomology, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasFiniteCohomology_of_iso
statement:
theorem hasFiniteCohomology_of_iso {X Y : DerivedCategory A} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (hY : HasFiniteCohomology R Y) : HasFiniteCohomology R X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hY.1 n
    exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional ((homologyFunctor R n).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv.symm
  · convert hY.2 using 1
    ext n
    simp [Function.mem_support, finrankHomology_eq_of_iso R n e]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasFiniteCohomology_shift
statement:
theorem hasFiniteCohomology_shift {X : DerivedCategory A} (hX : HasFiniteCohomology R X)
    (a : ℤ) : HasFiniteCohomology R (X⟦a⟧)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hX.1 (a + n)
    exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
      ((homologyFunctorShiftIso (A := A) R a n (a + n) rfl).app X).toLinearEquiv.symm
  · refine ((hX.2.image fun n => n - a)).subset fun n hn => ⟨a + n, ?_, by ring⟩
    simpa [Function.mem_support, finrankHomology_shift] using hn

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasFiniteCohomology_of_retract
statement:
theorem hasFiniteCohomology_of_retract {X Y : DerivedCategory A} (r : Retract X Y)
    (hY : HasFiniteCohomology R Y) : HasFiniteCohomology R X
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ n, Function.Injective ((homologyFunctor R n).map r.i).hom := fun n =>
    Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := ((homologyFunctor R n).map r.r).hom) fun x => by
      change ((homologyFunctor R n).map r.i ≫ (homologyFunctor R n).map r.r).hom x = x
      rw [← Functor.map_comp, r.retract, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
      rfl
  have hfd : ∀ n, FiniteDimensional R ((homologyFunctor R n).obj X) := fun n => by
    have := hY.1 n
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective _ (hinj n)
  refine ⟨hfd, hY.2.subset fun n hn h => hn ?_⟩
  have := hY.1 n
  change Module.finrank R _ = 0
  have := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (hinj n)
  change finrankHomology R n Y = 0 at h
  unfold finrankHomology at h
  omega

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isThick_hasFiniteCohomology
statement:
theorem isThick_hasFiniteCohomology : IsThick (HasFiniteCohomology R (A := A)) where
  zero
proof:
:= hasFiniteCohomology_of_isZero R (isZero_zero _)
  shift _ a h := hasFiniteCohomology_shift R h a
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := hasFiniteCohomology_obj₂ R T hT h₁ h₃
  retract r h := hasFiniteCohomology_of_retract R r h

name: DG.subsingleton_cohomology_self
statement:
theorem subsingleton_cohomology_self {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Subsingleton (cohomology (DGModuleCat.of k k) n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
  induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h z =>
  induction y using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h w =>
  congr 1
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  have hz := (mem_grading_iff (R := k)).mp z.2.1
  have hw := (mem_grading_iff (R := k)).mp w.2.1
  rw [hz.resolve_left hn, hw.resolve_left hn]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.finrankHomology_Q_self
statement:
theorem finrankHomology_Q_self (n : ℤ) :
    finrankHomology k n (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k k)) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrankHomology, (homologyQSelfEquiv n).finrank_eq]
  split_ifs with hn
  · subst hn
    rw [← (cohomologySelfZeroEquiv k).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]
  · have := subsingleton_cohomology_self k hn
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasFiniteCohomology_Q_self
statement: theorem hasFiniteCohomology_Q_self : HasFiniteCohomology k (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k k))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, (Set.finite_singleton (0 : ℤ)).subset fun n hn => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst hn
      exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
        ((cohomologySelfZeroEquiv k).trans (homologyQSelfEquiv 0).symm)
    · have := subsingleton_cohomology_self k hn
      have : Subsingleton ((homologyFunctor k n).obj (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k k))) :=
        (homologyQSelfEquiv n).toEquiv.subsingleton
      infer_instance
  · by_contra h
    apply hn
    change finrankHomology k n _ = 0
    simp [finrankHomology_Q_self, show n ≠ 0 from h]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.eulerChar_Q_self
statement: theorem eulerChar_Q_self : eulerChar k (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k k)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerChar, finsum_eq_single _ 0 fun n hn => by simp [finrankHomology_Q_self, hn]]
  simp [finrankHomology_Q_self]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasFiniteCohomology_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem hasFiniteCohomology_of_isCompact [HasDerivedCategory.{u, u} k]
    {X : DerivedCategory.{u, u} k} (hX : IsCompact.{u} X) : HasFiniteCohomology k X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← thickClosure_self_eq_isCompact] at hX
  exact thickClosure_le (isThick_hasFiniteCohomology k)
    (by rintro _ ⟨-, rfl⟩; exact hasFiniteCohomology_Q_self) X hX

name: DG.DGRing.K0.leftCorner_eq_self_of_val_eq_one
statement:
theorem leftCorner_eq_self_of_val_eq_one (e : DGIdempotent A) (he : e.val = 1) :
    leftCorner e = self A
proof:
:=
  DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso
    { hom := DGModuleCat.ofHom e.leftCornerInclusion
      inv := DGModuleCat.ofHom e.leftCornerProjection
      hom_inv_id := DGModuleCat.hom_ext_apply fun x => Subtype.ext x.2
      inv_hom_id := DGModuleCat.hom_ext_apply fun x => by
        change x * e.val = x
        rw [he, mul_one] })

name: DG.DGRing.K0.eulerChar_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eulerChar_mk (X : PerfectDerivedCategory k) :
    eulerChar k (DG.K0.mk X) = DerivedCategory.eulerChar k X.obj
proof:
:=
  DG.K0.lift_mk _ _ X

name: DG.DGRing.K0.eulerChar_self
statement: theorem eulerChar_self : eulerChar k (self k) = 1
proof:
:=
  (eulerChar_mk k _).trans DerivedCategory.eulerChar_Q_self

name: DG.DGRing.K0.mem_zmultiples_self
statement: theorem mem_zmultiples_self (x : K0 k) : x ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (self k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, rfl⟩ := DG.K0.exists_mk_eq x
  have hk : IsPositive k := IsPositive.degreeZero k
  obtain ⟨l, -, hl⟩ := hk.hasOrderedCellTower_of_isCompact X.property
  have hcell : ∀ (i : SimpleIdempotent k) (n : ℤ),
      IsCompact.{u} (DerivedCategory.cell k i.1 n : DerivedCategory.{u, u} k) :=
    fun i n => DerivedCategory.isCompact_cell i.1 n
  have h := CellTower.mk_eq_sum hcell hl
  have hX : DG.K0.mk X = DG.K0.mk (⟨X.obj, hl.isCompact hcell⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory k) := rfl
  rw [hX, h]
  refine AddSubgroup.list_sum_mem _ fun y hy => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
  rw [mk_cell, leftCorner_eq_self_of_val_eq_one]
  · exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples _) _
  · exact (IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp c.1.1.mul_self).resolve_left c.1.2.val_ne_zero

name: DG.DGRing.K0.eq_eulerChar_smul_self
statement: theorem eq_eulerChar_smul_self (x : K0 k) : x = eulerChar k x • self k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp (mem_zmultiples_self k x)
  rw [map_zsmul, eulerChar_self, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: DG.DGRing.K0.equivIntOfField_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivIntOfField_self : equivIntOfField k (self k) = 1
proof:
:=
  eulerChar_self k

name: DG.DGRing.K0.equivIntOfField_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivIntOfField_symm_apply (n : ℤ) : (equivIntOfField k).symm n = n • self k
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isZero_of_hasFiniteCohomology
statement:
theorem isZero_of_hasFiniteCohomology {X : DerivedCategory A} (hX : HasFiniteCohomology R X)
    (h : ∀ n, finrankHomology R n X = 0) : IsZero X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj X
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ e
  rw [isZero_Q_obj_iff]
  intro n
  have := hX.1 n
  have hs : Subsingleton ((homologyFunctor R n).obj X) :=
    Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp (h n)
  have e' := ((homologyFunctor R n).mapIso e ≪≫ (homologyFunctorFactors R n).app M).toLinearEquiv
  exact e'.symm.toEquiv.subsingleton

name: DG.DerivedCategory.cocycleHom_apply_mk
statement:
theorem cocycleHom_apply_mk (M : DGModuleCat.{u} k) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n)
    (hdm : d m = 0) : (cocycleHom M hm hdm).hom (Shift.mk (-n) (1 : k)) = m
proof:
:=
  one_smul k m

name: DG.DerivedCategory.mk_one_mem_grading
statement: theorem mk_one_mem_grading (n : ℤ) : Shift.mk (-n) (1 : k) ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  have := Shift.mk_mem_grading (n := -n) (m := (1 : k)) ((mem_grading_iff (R := k)).mpr
    (Or.inl rfl))
  rwa [zero_sub, neg_neg] at this

name: DG.DerivedCategory.d_mk_one
statement: theorem d_mk_one (n : ℤ) : d (Shift.mk (-n) (1 : k)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Shift.d_mk, d_apply, smul_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.finrankHomology_Q_shift_self
statement:
theorem finrankHomology_Q_shift_self (a j : ℤ) :
    finrankHomology k j (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift a k))) = if a + j = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (finrankHomology_eq_of_iso k j (X := Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift a k)))
    ((Q.commShiftIso a).app (DGModuleCat.of k k))).trans ?_
  change finrankHomology k j ((Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k k))⟦a⟧) = _
  rw [finrankHomology_shift, finrankHomology_Q_self]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.hasFiniteCohomology_Q_shift_self
statement:
theorem hasFiniteCohomology_Q_shift_self (a : ℤ) :
    HasFiniteCohomology k (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift a k)))
proof:
:=
  hasFiniteCohomology_of_iso k ((Q.commShiftIso a).app (DGModuleCat.of k k))
    (hasFiniteCohomology_shift k hasFiniteCohomology_Q_self a)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_Q_shift_self
statement:
theorem isCompact_Q_shift_self (a : ℤ) :
    IsCompact.{u} (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift a k)))
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_Q_self.shift a).of_iso ((Q.commShiftIso a).app (DGModuleCat.of k k))

name: DG.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor_map_cocycleHom_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have nat := (homologyFunctorFactors k n).hom.naturality (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2)
  change (homologyFunctor k n).map (Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2)) ≫ _ = _ ≫ _ at nat
  rw [h, zero_comp] at nat
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (((homologyFunctorFactors k n).app
    (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift (-n) k))).inv
      (cohomology.mkOf (M := Shift (-n) k) (mk_one_mem_grading n) (d_mk_one n)))) nat
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, ModuleCat.hom_comp,
    LinearMap.comp_apply] at h2
  have h3 : ((homologyFunctorFactors k n).hom.app (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift (-n) k))).hom
      (((homologyFunctorFactors k n).app (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift (-n) k))).inv.hom
        (cohomology.mkOf (M := Shift (-n) k) (mk_one_mem_grading n) (d_mk_one n))) =
      cohomology.mkOf (M := Shift (-n) k) (mk_one_mem_grading n) (d_mk_one n) := by
    change (((homologyFunctorFactors k n).app (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift (-n) k))).inv ≫
      ((homologyFunctorFactors k n).app (DGModuleCat.of k (Shift (-n) k))).hom).hom _ = _
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  erw [h3] at h2
  change 0 = cohomology.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2).hom n
    (cohomology.mkOf (M := Shift (-n) k) (mk_one_mem_grading n) (d_mk_one n)) at h2
  rw [cohomology.map_mkOf] at h2
  apply hz
  rw [← h2.symm]
  exact congrArg (cohomology.mk M n) (Subtype.ext (cocycleHom_apply_mk M z.2.1 z.2.2).symm)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.rankHomology_Q_cocycleHom
statement:
theorem rankHomology_Q_cocycleHom (M : DGModuleCat.{u} k) {n : ℤ} (z : cocycles M n)
    (hz : cohomology.mk M n z ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    rankHomology k j (Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2)) = if -n + j = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (hasFiniteCohomology_Q_shift_self (k := k) (-n)).1 j
  have hle := rankHomology_le_left k j (Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2))
  rw [finrankHomology_Q_shift_self] at hle
  split_ifs with hj
  · simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte] at hle
    have hjn : j = n := by omega
    subst hjn
    refine le_antisymm hle (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 => ?_)
    apply homologyFunctor_map_cocycleHom_ne_zero M z hz
    rw [rankHomology, Submodule.finrank_eq_zero, LinearMap.range_eq_bot] at h0
    exact ModuleCat.hom_ext h0
  · simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte] at hle
    omega

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_of_hasFiniteCohomology
statement:
theorem isCompact_of_hasFiniteCohomology {X : DerivedCategory.{w', u} k}
    (hX : HasFiniteCohomology k X) : IsCompact.{u} X
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ (N : ℕ) (X : DerivedCategory.{w', u} k), HasFiniteCohomology k X →
      totalFinrank k X = N → IsCompact.{u} X from h _ X hX rfl
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro X hX hN
    refine IsCompact.of_isZero (isZero_of_hasFiniteCohomology hX fun n => ?_)
    have := single_le_finsum n hX.2 fun _ => Nat.zero_le _
    change _ ≤ totalFinrank k X at this
    omega
  | succ N ih =>
    intro X hX hN
    obtain ⟨M, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj X
    have hM : HasFiniteCohomology k (Q.obj M) := hasFiniteCohomology_of_iso k e.symm hX
    
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, finrankHomology k n (Q.obj M) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      have : totalFinrank k X = 0 := by
        rw [totalFinrank]
        exact finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun n => by
          rw [finrankHomology_eq_of_iso k n e]; exact hcon n
      omega
    have hnt : Nontrivial (cohomology M n) := by
      have := hM.1 n
      have e' := ((homologyFunctorFactors k n).app M).toLinearEquiv
      have : Nontrivial ((Q ⋙ homologyFunctor k n).obj M) :=
        Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (R := k)
          (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn : 0 < Module.finrank k ((Q ⋙ homologyFunctor k n).obj M))
      exact (e'.symm.toEquiv.nontrivial : Nontrivial (cohomology M n))
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : cohomology M n)
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := cohomology.mk_surjective M n x
    
    obtain ⟨C, v, w, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2))
    set T := Triangle.mk (Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2)) v w
    have h₁ : HasFiniteCohomology k T.obj₁ := hasFiniteCohomology_Q_shift_self (-n)
    have hC : HasFiniteCohomology k C :=
      hasFiniteCohomology_obj₂ k T.rotate (rot_of_distTriang _ hT) hM
        (hasFiniteCohomology_shift k h₁ 1)
    have ha := rankHomology_Q_cocycleHom M z hx
    
    have key : ∀ j, finrankHomology k j C + (if -n + j = 0 then 1 else 0) =
        finrankHomology k j (Q.obj M) := by
      intro j
      have hy := finrankHomology_obj₂ T hT h₁.1 hC.1 j
      have hz := finrankHomology_obj₃ T hT hC.1 j
      have hx := finrankHomology_obj₁ T hT h₁.1 j
      have hx1 : finrankHomology k (j + 1) T.obj₁ = if -n + (j + 1) = 0 then 1 else 0 :=
        finrankHomology_Q_shift_self (-n) (j + 1)
      have ha1 := ha (j + 1)
      have haj := ha j
      change finrankHomology k j (Q.obj M) = _ at hy
