      change finrankHomology k j C = _ at hz
      change rankHomology k j (Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2)) = _ at haj
      change rankHomology k (j + 1) (Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2)) = _ at ha1
      change finrankHomology k (j + 1) _ = rankHomology k j T.mor₃ +
        rankHomology k (j + 1) (Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2)) at hx
      rw [hx1, ha1] at hx
      rw [show T.mor₁ = Q.map (cocycleHom M z.2.1 z.2.2) from rfl, haj] at hy
      split_ifs at hy ⊢ with h <;> omega
    have hsupp : (Function.support fun j : ℤ => if -n + j = 0 then 1 else 0).Finite :=
      (Set.finite_singleton n).subset fun j hj => by
        simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq, ite_eq_right_iff, one_ne_zero, imp_false,
          not_not] at hj
        simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        omega
    have htot : totalFinrank k C + 1 = totalFinrank k (Q.obj M) := by
      rw [totalFinrank, totalFinrank, ← finsum_congr key, finsum_add_distrib hC.2 hsupp,
        finsum_eq_single _ n fun j hj => ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => absurd (by omega) hj]
      simp
    have hMX : totalFinrank k (Q.obj M) = totalFinrank k X := by
      rw [totalFinrank, totalFinrank]
      exact finsum_congr fun j => finrankHomology_eq_of_iso k j e.symm
    have hCN : totalFinrank k C = N := by omega
    exact (IsCompact.ext₂ T hT (isCompact_Q_shift_self (-n)) (ih C hC hCN)).of_iso e

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_iff_hasFiniteCohomology
statement:
theorem isCompact_iff_hasFiniteCohomology [HasDerivedCategory.{u, u} k]
    {X : DerivedCategory.{u, u} k} : IsCompact.{u} X ↔ HasFiniteCohomology k X
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasFiniteCohomology_of_isCompact, isCompact_of_hasFiniteCohomology⟩

name: DG.CellTower.isCompact
statement:
theorem CellTower.isCompact {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : T} (h : CellTower cell l X) :
    IsCompact.{w} X
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX => exact IsCompact.of_isZero hX
  | ext R hR _ e ih => exact IsCompact.ext₂ R hR ih ((hcell _ _).of_iso e.some)

name: DG.CellTower.mk_eq_sum
statement:
theorem CellTower.mk_eq_sum {l : List (ι × ℤ)} {X : T} (h : CellTower cell l X) :
    K0.mk (⟨X, h.isCompact hcell⟩ : (compactSubcategory.{w} T).FullSubcategory) =
      (l.map fun c : ι × ℤ => K0.mk (⟨cell c.1 c.2, hcell c.1 c.2⟩ :
        (compactSubcategory.{w} T).FullSubcategory)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero hX =>
    rw [List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
    exact K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr (by
      ext
      exact hX.eq_of_src _ _))
  | ext R hR h₁ e ih =>
    rw [K0.mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂ (P := compactSubcategory.{w} T) R hR (h₁.isCompact hcell) _
      ((hcell _ _).of_iso e.some), ih,
      List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_singleton, List.sum_singleton]
    congr 1
    exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj e.some

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_Q_leftCorner
statement:
theorem isCompact_Q_leftCorner (e : DGIdempotent A) :
    IsCompact.{u} (Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A e.LeftCorner))
proof:
:=
  IsCompact.of_retract
    { i := Q.map (DGModuleCat.ofHom e.leftCornerInclusion)
      r := Q.map (DGModuleCat.ofHom e.leftCornerProjection)
      retract := by
        rw [← Q.map_comp, ← Q.map_id]
        congr 1
        exact DGModuleCat.hom_ext_apply fun x => Subtype.ext x.2 } isCompact_Q_self

name: DG.DGRing.K0.mk_cell
statement:
theorem mk_cell (e : DGIdempotent A) (n : ℤ) :
    DG.K0.mk (⟨DerivedCategory.cell A e n, DerivedCategory.isCompact_cell e n⟩ :
      PerfectDerivedCategory A) = n.negOnePow • leftCorner e
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftCorner, ← DG.K0.mk_shift]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj
    (((DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso n).app (DGModuleCat.of A e.LeftCorner)) ≪≫
    (((compactSubcategory.{u} (DerivedCategory A)).ι.commShiftIso n).app
      ⟨_, DerivedCategory.isCompact_Q_leftCorner e⟩).symm)

name: DG.DGRing.K0.mk_finiteCell
statement:
theorem mk_finiteCell {P : Type u} [AddCommGroup P] [DGAddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    [DGModule A P] (C : FiniteCellFiltration A P) :
    DG.K0.mk (⟨DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A P), C.isCompact_Q_obj⟩ :
      PerfectDerivedCategory A) = ∑ i, (C.shift i).negOnePow • leftCorner (C.e i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.cellTower.mk_eq_sum fun _ _ => DerivedCategory.isCompact_cell _ _,
    FiniteCellFiltration.cells, List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mk_cell _ _

name: DG.DGRing.K0.singleObjEquiv_representable
statement:
theorem singleObjEquiv_representable :
    singleObjEquiv A (DGCategory.K0.representable.{w'', u} (SingleObj.star A)) = self A
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGCategory.K0.representable, singleObjEquiv, DG.K0.compactMapEquiv_mk]
  exact DG.K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj
    ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence A).functor.mapIso
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.isoOfGen
        (CatModule.isCornerGenerator_representable (SingleObj.star A)).ulift
        CatModule.isCornerGenerator_toCatModuleObj_self)) ≪≫
      DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalenceObjIso _)

name: DG.DGRing.K0.map_self
statement: theorem map_self (φ : B →ᵈᵍ+* A) : map φ (self B) = self A
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj B)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  change singleObjEquiv A (DGCategory.K0.map φ.singleObjFunctor ((singleObjEquiv B).symm
    (self B))) = self A
  rw [← singleObjEquiv_representable B, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    DGCategory.K0.map_representable]
  exact singleObjEquiv_representable A

name: DG.DGRing.K0.mapEquivOfIsQuasiIso_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapEquivOfIsQuasiIso_apply (φ : B →ᵈᵍ+* A) (hφ : φ.IsQuasiIso) (x : K0 B) :
    mapEquivOfIsQuasiIso φ hφ x = map φ x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGRing.K0.map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map (DGRingHom.id : A →ᵈᵍ+* A) = AddMonoidHom.id (K0 A)
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
  change singleObjEquiv A (DGCategory.K0.map (DGRingHom.id : A →ᵈᵍ+* A).singleObjFunctor
    ((singleObjEquiv A).symm x)) = x
  have h : DGCategory.K0.map.{u, u} (DGRingHom.id : A →ᵈᵍ+* A).singleObjFunctor =
      DGCategory.K0.map.{u, u} (𝟭 (SingleObj A)) := rfl
  rw [h, DGCategory.K0.map_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: DG.DGRing.K0.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {B : Type u} [Ring B] [DGAddCommGroup B] [DGRing B] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁, u} B]
    {A' : Type u} [Ring A'] [DGAddCommGroup A'] [DGRing A'] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂, u} A']
    (φ : B →ᵈᵍ+* A) (ψ : A →ᵈᵍ+* A') : map (ψ.comp φ) = (map ψ).comp (map φ)
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj B)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A')
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_
  change singleObjEquiv A' (DGCategory.K0.map (ψ.comp φ).singleObjFunctor
    ((singleObjEquiv B).symm x)) = singleObjEquiv A' (DGCategory.K0.map ψ.singleObjFunctor
      ((singleObjEquiv A).symm (singleObjEquiv A (DGCategory.K0.map φ.singleObjFunctor
        ((singleObjEquiv B).symm x)))))
  have h : DGCategory.K0.map.{u, u} (ψ.comp φ).singleObjFunctor =
      DGCategory.K0.map.{u, u} (φ.singleObjFunctor ⋙ ψ.singleObjFunctor) := rfl
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply, h, DGCategory.K0.map_comp, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]

name: DG.Homological.finrank_eq_add_of_exact
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_add_of_exact {U V W : ModuleCat.{v'} K} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W)
    (h : LinearMap.range f.hom = LinearMap.ker g.hom) [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    Module.finrank K V =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range f.hom) + Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range g.hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g.hom, h, add_comm]

name: DG.Homological.finiteDimensional_of_exact
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_exact {U V W : ModuleCat.{v'} K} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W)
    (h : LinearMap.range f.hom = LinearMap.ker g.hom) [FiniteDimensional K U]
    [FiniteDimensional K W] : FiniteDimensional K V
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((⊤ : Submodule K V).map g.hom).FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian _
  have h2 : ((⊤ : Submodule K V) ⊓ LinearMap.ker g.hom).FG := by
    rw [top_inf_eq, ← h, LinearMap.range_eq_map]
    exact (Module.Finite.fg_top).map _
  exact ⟨Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker g.hom h1 h2⟩

name: DG.Homological.rank_le_left
statement:
theorem rank_le_left {U V : ModuleCat.{v'} K} (f : U ⟶ V) [FiniteDimensional K U] :
    rank f ≤ Module.finrank K U
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.finrank_range_le _

name: DG.Homological.rank_le_right
statement:
theorem rank_le_right {U V : ModuleCat.{v'} K} (f : U ⟶ V) [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    rank f ≤ Module.finrank K V
proof:
:=
  Submodule.finrank_le _

name: DG.Homological.finrankShift_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem finrankShift_eq_of_iso (n : ℤ) {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    finrankShift F n X = finrankShift F n Y
proof:
:=
  ((F.shift n).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: DG.Homological.finrankShift_shift
statement:
theorem finrankShift_shift (a n : ℤ) (X : C) :
    finrankShift F n (X⟦a⟧) = finrankShift F (a + n) X
proof:
:=
  ((F.shiftIso a n (a + n) rfl).app X).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: DG.Homological.eulerChar_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem eulerChar_eq_of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) : eulerChar F X = eulerChar F Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eulerChar, finrankShift_eq_of_iso F _ e]

name: DG.Homological.HasFiniteRank.of_iso
statement:
theorem HasFiniteRank.of_iso {X Y : C} (e : X ≅ Y) (hY : HasFiniteRank F Y) :
    HasFiniteRank F X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hY.1 n
    exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional ((F.shift n).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv.symm
  · convert hY.2 using 1
    ext n
    simp [Function.mem_support, finrankShift_eq_of_iso F n e]

name: DG.Homological.HasFiniteRank.shift
statement:
theorem HasFiniteRank.shift {X : C} (hX : HasFiniteRank F X) (a : ℤ) :
    HasFiniteRank F (X⟦a⟧)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hX.1 (a + n)
    exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional ((F.shiftIso a n (a + n) rfl).app X).toLinearEquiv.symm
  · refine ((hX.2.image fun n => n - a)).subset fun n hn => ⟨a + n, ?_, by ring⟩
    simpa [Function.mem_support, finrankShift_shift] using hn

name: DG.Homological.HasFiniteRank.of_isZero
statement: theorem HasFiniteRank.of_isZero {X : C} (hX : IsZero X) : HasFiniteRank F X
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton ((F.shift n).obj X) := fun n =>
    (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton).mp ((F.shift n).map_isZero hX)
  refine ⟨fun n => inferInstance, ?_⟩
  convert Set.finite_empty
  ext n
  simp [finrankShift, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: DG.Homological.range_eq_ker₂
statement:
theorem range_eq_ker₂ (n : ℤ) :
    LinearMap.range ((F.shift n).map T.mor₁).hom = LinearMap.ker ((F.shift n).map T.mor₂).hom
proof:
:=
  (F.homologySequence_exact₂ T hT n).moduleCat_range_eq_ker

name: DG.Homological.range_eq_ker₃
statement:
theorem range_eq_ker₃ (n : ℤ) :
    LinearMap.range ((F.shift n).map T.mor₂).hom =
      LinearMap.ker (F.homologySequenceδ T n (n + 1) rfl).hom
proof:
:=
  (F.homologySequence_exact₃ T hT n (n + 1) rfl).moduleCat_range_eq_ker

name: DG.Homological.range_eq_ker₁
statement:
theorem range_eq_ker₁ (n : ℤ) :
    LinearMap.range (F.homologySequenceδ T n (n + 1) rfl).hom =
      LinearMap.ker ((F.shift (n + 1)).map T.mor₁).hom
proof:
:=
  (F.homologySequence_exact₁ T hT n (n + 1) rfl).moduleCat_range_eq_ker

name: DG.Homological.finiteDimensional_obj₂
statement: theorem finiteDimensional_obj₂ (n : ℤ) : FiniteDimensional K ((F.shift n).obj T.obj₂)
proof:
:=
  have := h₁ n
  have := h₃ n
  finiteDimensional_of_exact _ _ (range_eq_ker₂ T hT n)

name: DG.Homological.finrankShift_obj₂
statement:
theorem finrankShift_obj₂ (n : ℤ) :
    finrankShift F n T.obj₂ = rank ((F.shift n).map T.mor₁) + rank ((F.shift n).map T.mor₂)
proof:
:=
  have := finiteDimensional_obj₂ T hT h₁ h₃ n
  finrank_eq_add_of_exact _ _ (range_eq_ker₂ T hT n)

name: DG.Homological.finrankShift_obj₃
statement:
theorem finrankShift_obj₃ (n : ℤ) :
    finrankShift F n T.obj₃ =
      rank ((F.shift n).map T.mor₂) + rank (F.homologySequenceδ T n (n + 1) rfl)
proof:
:=
  have := h₃ n
  finrank_eq_add_of_exact _ _ (range_eq_ker₃ T hT n)

name: DG.Homological.finrankShift_obj₁
statement:
theorem finrankShift_obj₁ (n : ℤ) :
    finrankShift F (n + 1) T.obj₁ =
      rank (F.homologySequenceδ T n (n + 1) rfl) + rank ((F.shift (n + 1)).map T.mor₁)
proof:
:=
  have := h₁ (n + 1)
  finrank_eq_add_of_exact _ _ (range_eq_ker₁ T hT n)

name: DG.Homological.HasFiniteRank.obj₂
statement:
theorem HasFiniteRank.obj₂ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : HasFiniteRank F T.obj₁) (h₃ : HasFiniteRank F T.obj₃) : HasFiniteRank F T.obj₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n => finiteDimensional_obj₂ T hT h₁.1 h₃.1 n,
    (h₁.2.union h₃.2).subset fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_contra hn'
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Function.mem_support, not_or, not_not] at hn'
  apply hn
  change finrankShift F n T.obj₂ = 0
  have := h₁.1 n
  have := h₃.1 n
  rw [finrankShift_obj₂ T hT h₁.1 h₃.1]
  have ha := rank_le_left ((F.shift n).map T.mor₁)
  have hb := rank_le_right ((F.shift n).map T.mor₂)
  change finrankShift F n T.obj₁ = 0 ∧ finrankShift F n T.obj₃ = 0 at hn'
  unfold finrankShift at hn'
  omega

name: DG.Homological.eulerChar_obj₂
statement:
theorem eulerChar_obj₂ (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (h₁ : HasFiniteRank F T.obj₁) (h₃ : HasFiniteRank F T.obj₃) :
    eulerChar F T.obj₂ = eulerChar F T.obj₁ + eulerChar F T.obj₃
proof:
:= by
  refine DerivedCategory.alternating_finsum_of_exact _ _ _
    (fun n => rank ((F.shift n).map T.mor₁)) (fun n => rank ((F.shift n).map T.mor₂))
    (fun n => rank (F.homologySequenceδ T n (n + 1) rfl))
    (h₁.2.subset fun n hn h => hn ?_) (h₃.2.subset fun n hn h => hn ?_)
    (h₃.2.subset fun n hn h => hn ?_) (finrankShift_obj₂ T hT h₁.1 h₃.1)
    (finrankShift_obj₃ T hT h₃.1) (finrankShift_obj₁ T hT h₁.1)
  · have := h₁.1 n
    have := rank_le_left ((F.shift n).map T.mor₁)
    change Module.finrank K _ = 0 at h
    change rank _ = 0
    omega
  · have := h₃.1 n
    have := rank_le_right ((F.shift n).map T.mor₂)
    change Module.finrank K _ = 0 at h
    change rank _ = 0
    omega
  · have := h₃.1 n
    have := rank_le_left (F.homologySequenceδ T n (n + 1) rfl)
    change Module.finrank K _ = 0 at h
    change rank _ = 0
    omega

name: DG.Homological.eulerCharHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eulerCharHom_mk (P : ObjectProperty C) [P.IsTriangulated]
    (hP : ∀ X, P X → HasFiniteRank F X) (X : P.FullSubcategory) :
    eulerCharHom F P hP (K0.mk X) = eulerChar F X.obj
proof:
:=
  K0.lift_mk _ _ X

name: DG.DGIdempotent.K0MoritaEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem K0MoritaEquiv_mk (he : e.IsFullH0) (X : PerfectDerivedCategory.{w₁, max u t} e.Corner) :
    e.K0MoritaEquiv.{t} he (DG.K0.mk X) =
      DG.K0.mk (⟨(e.moritaEquivalence.{t} he).functor.obj X.obj,
        X.property.map_of_equivalence _⟩ : PerfectDerivedCategory.{w₂, max u t} A)
proof:
:=
  DG.K0.compactMapEquiv_mk _ X

name: DG.DGIdempotent.tmulOver_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGIdempotent.tmulOver_val : (e.tmulOver R f).val = e.val ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] f.val
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGIdempotent.map_intComparison_tmulOver
statement:
theorem DGIdempotent.map_intComparison_tmulOver :
    (e.tmulOver ℤ f).map (GradedTensorProduct.intComparison R A B) = e.tmulOver R f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ExternalTensor.dgHom_ext_tmul_homogeneous
statement:
theorem dgHom_ext_tmul_homogeneous {M N X : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M]
    [Module A M] [DGModule A M] [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] [Module B N] [DGModule B N]
    [AddCommGroup X] [DGAddCommGroup X] [Module AB X] [DGModule AB X]
    {φ ψ : (M ⊗[ℤ] N) →ᵈᵍ[AB] X}
    (h : ∀ {i j : ℤ} (m : M), m ∈ grading i → ∀ n : N, n ∈ grading j →
      φ (m ⊗ₜ n) = ψ (m ⊗ₜ n)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  DGModuleHom.ext fun x => by
    induction x using DG.tensor_induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
    | tmul m n => exact h m.1 m.2 n.1 n.2
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.DerivedCategory.K0ExternalTensor_mk
statement:
theorem K0ExternalTensor_mk (X : PerfectDerivedCategory A) (Y : PerfectDerivedCategory B) :
    K0ExternalTensor A B (K0.mk X) (K0.mk Y) =
      K0.mk (⟨((externalTensor A B).obj X.obj).obj Y.obj, isCompact_externalTensor X.2 Y.2⟩ :
        PerfectDerivedCategory AB)
proof:
:=
  (DFunLike.congr_fun (K0.lift_mk _ _ X) (K0.mk Y)).trans (K0.mapCompact_mk _ _ Y)

name: DG.DerivedCategory.K0ExternalTensor_leftCorner
statement:
theorem K0ExternalTensor_leftCorner (e : DGIdempotent A) (f : DGIdempotent B) :
    K0ExternalTensor A B (DGRing.K0.leftCorner e) (DGRing.K0.leftCorner f) =
      DGRing.K0.leftCorner (e.tmulOver ℤ f)
proof:
:=
  (K0ExternalTensor_mk _ _).trans (K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj
    (externalTensorObjIso e.isKProjective_leftCorner f.isKProjective_leftCorner ≪≫
      Q.mapIso (ExternalTensor.leftCornerTensorIso e f)))

name: DG.DerivedCategory.K0ExternalTensorOver_apply
statement:
theorem K0ExternalTensorOver_apply (x : DGRing.K0 A) (y : DGRing.K0 B) :
    K0ExternalTensorOver R A B x y =
      DGRing.K0.map (GradedTensorProduct.intComparison R A B) (K0ExternalTensor A B x y)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DerivedCategory.K0ExternalTensorOver_leftCorner
statement:
theorem K0ExternalTensorOver_leftCorner (e : DGIdempotent A) (f : DGIdempotent B) :
    K0ExternalTensorOver R A B (DGRing.K0.leftCorner e) (DGRing.K0.leftCorner f) =
      DGRing.K0.leftCorner (e.tmulOver R f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K0ExternalTensorOver_apply, K0ExternalTensor_leftCorner, DGRing.K0.map_leftCorner]
  rfl

name: DG.DerivedCategory.K0ExternalTensorOver_eq_K0KunnethEquiv
statement:
theorem K0ExternalTensorOver_eq_K0KunnethEquiv
    (hsA : IsSplitSemisimple k (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebra k A))
    (hsB : IsSplitSemisimple k (DGAlgebra.degreeZeroSubalgebra k B))
    (x : DGRing.K0 A) (y : DGRing.K0 B) :
    K0ExternalTensorOver k A B x y = hA.K0KunnethEquiv hB hsA hsB (x ⊗ₜ y)
proof:
:= by
  let := HasDerivedCategory.small.{u, u} hA.degreeZeroDGSubring
  let := HasDerivedCategory.small.{u, u} hB.degreeZeroDGSubring
  let bA := hA.basis (SimpleClass.out (C := A)) SimpleClass.out_injective
    fun e => ⟨_, SimpleClass.equiv_out e⟩
  let bB := hB.basis (SimpleClass.out (C := B)) SimpleClass.out_injective
    fun f => ⟨_, SimpleClass.equiv_out f⟩
  have key : ∀ a b, K0ExternalTensorOver k A B (bA a) (bB b) =
      hA.K0KunnethEquiv hB hsA hsB (bA a ⊗ₜ bB b) := fun a b => by
    rw [show bA a = DGRing.K0.leftCorner (SimpleClass.out a).1 from
        IsPositive.basis_apply _ _ _ _ a,
      show bB b = DGRing.K0.leftCorner (SimpleClass.out b).1 from
        IsPositive.basis_apply _ _ _ _ b,
      K0ExternalTensorOver_leftCorner, IsPositive.K0KunnethEquiv_tmul]
    rfl
  have hy : ∀ a, (K0ExternalTensorOver k A B (bA a)).toIntLinearMap =
      (hA.K0KunnethEquiv hB hsA hsB).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.mk ℤ (DGRing.K0 A) (DGRing.K0 B) (bA a) :=
    fun a => bB.ext fun b => key a b
  have hx : ((K0ExternalTensorOver k A B).flip y).toIntLinearMap =
      (hA.K0KunnethEquiv hB hsA hsB).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.mk ℤ (DGRing.K0 A) (DGRing.K0 B)).flip y :=
    bA.ext fun a => DFunLike.congr_fun (hy a) y
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hx x

name: DG.DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_odd
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_odd {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Odd i) :
    DGAlgebra.oddPart R A a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.oddPart, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, decomposeLinearEquiv_apply,
    decompose_of_mem (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A) (i := i) ha, ← lof_eq_of R,
    toModule_lof, ite_eq_left hi, Submodule.subtype_apply]

name: DG.DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_even
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_even {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Even i) :
    DGAlgebra.oddPart R A a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.oddPart, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, decomposeLinearEquiv_apply,
    decompose_of_mem (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A) (i := i) ha, ← lof_eq_of R,
    toModule_lof, ite_eq_right (Int.not_odd_iff_even.mpr hi), LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracketₗ_apply
statement: theorem bracketₗ_apply (x y : L) : bracketₗ (R := R) x y = bracket R x y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.smul_mem
statement: theorem smul_mem (r : R) {n : ℤ} {x : L} (hx : x ∈ grading n) : r • x ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  smul_mem' r hx

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.d_smul
statement: theorem d_smul (r : R) (x : L) : d (r • x) = r • d x
proof: := d_smul' r x

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_mem
statement:
theorem bracket_mem {i j : ℤ} {x y : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hy : y ∈ grading j) :
    bracket R x y ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  bracket_mem' hx hy

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_comm
statement:
theorem bracket_comm {i j : ℤ} {x y : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hy : y ∈ grading j) :
    bracket R x y = -(koszulSign (i * j) • bracket R y x)
proof:
:=
  bracket_comm' hx hy

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.jacobi
statement:
theorem jacobi {i j : ℤ} {x y : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hy : y ∈ grading j) (z : L) :
    bracket R x (bracket R y z) =
      bracket R (bracket R x y) z + koszulSign (i * j) • bracket R y (bracket R x z)
proof:
:=
  jacobi' hx hy z

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.d_bracket
statement:
theorem d_bracket {i : ℤ} {x : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (y : L) :
    d (bracket R x y) = bracket R (d x) y + koszulSign i • bracket R x (d y)
proof:
:=
  d_bracket' hx y

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_neg (x y : L) : bracket R x (-y) = -bracket R x y
proof: := map_neg _ _

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_zero (x : L) : bracket R x 0 = 0
proof: := map_zero _

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.zero_bracket
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_bracket (y : L) : bracket R 0 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_add
statement: theorem bracket_add (x y y' : L) : bracket R x (y + y') = bracket R x y + bracket R x y'
proof:
:=
  map_add _ _ _

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.add_bracket
statement: theorem add_bracket (x x' y : L) : bracket R (x + x') y = bracket R x y + bracket R x' y
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; rfl

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_smul
statement: theorem bracket_smul (r : R) (x y : L) : bracket R x (r • y) = r • bracket R x y
proof:
:=
  map_smul _ _ _

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.smul_bracket
statement: theorem smul_bracket (r : R) (x y : L) : bracket R (r • x) y = r • bracket R x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]; rfl

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_units_smul
statement: theorem bracket_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (x y : L) : bracket R x (u • y) = u • bracket R x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, bracket, map_zsmul]; rfl

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.units_smul_bracket
statement: theorem units_smul_bracket (u : ℤˣ) (x y : L) : bracket R (u • x) y = u • bracket R x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, bracket, map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply]; rfl

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.bracket_self_of_even
statement:
theorem bracket_self_of_even {i : ℤ} {x : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hi : Even i) :
    bracket R x x = -bracket R x x
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [bracket_comm hx hx, koszulSign_even (hi.mul_right i), one_smul]

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.units_cases
statement: private theorem units_cases (u : ℤˣ) : u = 1 ∨ u = -1
proof: := Int.units_eq_one_or u

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.jacobi_cyclic
statement:
theorem jacobi_cyclic {i j k : ℤ} {x y z : L} (hx : x ∈ grading i) (hy : y ∈ grading j)
    (hz : z ∈ grading k) :
    koszulSign (i * k) • bracket R x (bracket R y z) +
      koszulSign (j * i) • bracket R y (bracket R z x) +
        koszulSign (k * j) • bracket R z (bracket R x y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobi hx hy, bracket_comm (bracket_mem hx hy) hz, bracket_comm hx hz, bracket_neg,
    bracket_units_smul, add_mul, koszulSign_add, mul_comm j i, mul_comm k j]
  rcases units_cases (koszulSign (i * j)) with h₁ | h₁ <;>
  rcases units_cases (koszulSign (i * k)) with h₂ | h₂ <;>
  rcases units_cases (koszulSign (j * k)) with h₃ | h₃ <;>
  simp only [h₁, h₂, h₃, smul_add, smul_neg, mul_one, mul_neg, neg_neg,
    Units.neg_smul, one_smul] <;>
  abel

name: DG.DGAlgebra.commutator_apply
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.commutator_apply (a b : A) :
    DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b =
      a * b - b * a + (2 : R) • (DGAlgebra.oddPart R A b * DGAlgebra.oddPart R A a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) :
    DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b = a * b - koszulSign (i * j) • (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.commutator_apply]
  rcases Int.even_or_odd i with hi | hi
  · rw [DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_even ha hi, mul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero,
      koszulSign_even (hi.mul_right j), one_smul]
  · rcases Int.even_or_odd j with hj | hj
    · rw [DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_even hb hj, zero_mul, smul_zero, add_zero,
        koszulSign_even (hj.mul_left i), one_smul]
    · rw [DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_odd ha hi, DGAlgebra.oddPart_of_odd hb hj,
        koszulSign_odd (hi.mul hj), two_smul, Units.neg_smul, one_smul]
      abel

name: DG.DGAlgebra.commutator_mem
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.commutator_mem {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) : DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem ha hb, Units.smul_def]
  exact sub_mem (mul_mem_grading ha hb)
    (zsmul_mem (by rw [add_comm]; exact mul_mem_grading hb ha) _)

name: DG.units_cases
statement: private theorem units_cases (u : ℤˣ) : u = 1 ∨ u = -1
proof: := Int.units_eq_one_or u

name: DG.mul_units_smul
statement:
private theorem mul_units_smul {T : Type*} [Ring T] (x y : T) (u : ℤˣ) :
    x * (u • y) = u • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, mul_smul_comm]

name: DG.units_smul_mul
statement:
private theorem units_smul_mul {T : Type*} [Ring T] (x y : T) (u : ℤˣ) :
    (u • x) * y = u • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_mul_assoc]

name: DG.DGAlgebra.commutator_jacobi
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.commutator_jacobi {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i)
    (hb : b ∈ grading j) (c : A) :
    DGAlgebra.commutator R A a (DGAlgebra.commutator R A b c) =
      DGAlgebra.commutator R A (DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b) c +
        koszulSign (i * j) • DGAlgebra.commutator R A b (DGAlgebra.commutator R A a c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add c c' hc hc' => simp only [map_add, hc, hc', smul_add]; abel
  | h_homogeneous c =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := c
    rename_i k
    simp only
    rw [DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem ha (DGAlgebra.commutator_mem hb hc),
      DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem (DGAlgebra.commutator_mem ha hb) hc,
      DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem hb (DGAlgebra.commutator_mem ha hc),
      DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem hb hc, DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem ha hc,
      DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem ha hb]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_units_smul, units_smul_mul, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_assoc,
      mul_add, add_mul, koszulSign_add, mul_comm j i]
    rcases units_cases (koszulSign (i * j)) with h₁ | h₁ <;>
    rcases units_cases (koszulSign (i * k)) with h₂ | h₂ <;>
    rcases units_cases (koszulSign (j * k)) with h₃ | h₃ <;>
    simp only [h₁, h₂, h₃, mul_one, mul_neg,
      neg_neg, Units.neg_smul, one_smul] <;>
    abel

name: DG.DGAlgebra.d_commutator
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.d_commutator {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (b : A) :
    d (DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b) =
      DGAlgebra.commutator R A (d a) b + koszulSign i • DGAlgebra.commutator R A a (d b)
proof:
:= by
  induction b using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add b b' hb hb' => simp only [map_add, hb, hb', smul_add]; abel
  | h_homogeneous b =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := b
    rename_i j
    simp only
    rw [DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem ha hb, DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem (d_mem ha) hb,
      DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem ha (d_mem hb), d_sub, d_units_smul, d_mul ha, d_mul hb]
    simp only [smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul, add_mul, mul_add, one_mul, mul_one,
      koszulSign_add]
    rcases units_cases (koszulSign (i * j)) with h₁ | h₁ <;>
    rcases units_cases (koszulSign i) with h₂ | h₂ <;>
    rcases units_cases (koszulSign j) with h₃ | h₃ <;>
    simp only [h₁, h₂, h₃, mul_one, mul_neg,
      neg_neg, Units.neg_smul, one_smul] <;>
    abel

name: DG.DGLieAlgebra.ofDGAlgebra_bracket
statement:
theorem DGLieAlgebra.ofDGAlgebra_bracket (a b : A) :
    letI
proof:
:= DGLieAlgebra.ofDGAlgebra R A
    DGLieAlgebra.bracket R a b = DGAlgebra.commutator R A a b :=
  rfl

name: DG.DGModule.END.dgLieAlgebra_bracket_of_mem
statement:
theorem dgLieAlgebra_bracket_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {f g : END A M} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hg : g ∈ grading j) :
    letI
proof:
:= dgLieAlgebra R A M
    DGLieAlgebra.bracket R f g = f * g - koszulSign (i * j) • (g * f) :=
  DGAlgebra.commutator_of_mem hf hg

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.contr_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contr_apply (x : 𝔤) (F : Family R 𝔤) (n : ℕ) :
    contr R 𝔤 x F n = curryEquiv R 𝔤 n (F (n + 1)) x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.sgn_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sgn_apply (F : Family R 𝔤) (n : ℕ) : sgn R 𝔤 F n = koszulSign (n : ℤ) • F n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_apply
statement: theorem wedge_apply (F G : Family R 𝔤) (K : ℕ) : wedge R 𝔤 F G K = star R 𝔤 K F G
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_apply_zero_apply
statement:
theorem wedge_apply_zero_apply (F G : Family R 𝔤) (v : Fin 0 → 𝔤) :
    wedge R 𝔤 F G 0 v = F 0 0 * G 0 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curry_wedge
statement:
theorem curry_wedge (F G : Family R 𝔤) (K : ℕ) (x : 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 K (wedge R 𝔤 F G (K + 1)) x =
      wedge R 𝔤 (contr R 𝔤 x F) G K + wedge R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) (contr R 𝔤 x G) K
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [wedge_apply, star]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.contr_wedge
statement:
theorem contr_wedge (x : 𝔤) (F G : Family R 𝔤) :
    contr R 𝔤 x (wedge R 𝔤 F G) =
      wedge R 𝔤 (contr R 𝔤 x F) G + wedge R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) (contr R 𝔤 x G)
proof:
:=
  funext fun K => curry_wedge F G K x

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.mcochain_zero_ext
statement: theorem mcochain_zero_ext {f g : MCochain R 𝔤 0} (h : f 0 = g 0) : f = g
proof:
:=
  MultilinearMap.ext fun v => by rwa [Subsingleton.elim v 0]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.family_ext
statement:
theorem family_ext {F G : Family R 𝔤} (h₀ : F 0 0 = G 0 0)
    (h : ∀ x, contr R 𝔤 x F = contr R 𝔤 x G) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => exact mcochain_zero_ext h₀
  | succ n => exact ext_curry fun x => congrFun (h x) n

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.contr_sgn
statement:
theorem contr_sgn (x : 𝔤) (F : Family R 𝔤) :
    contr R 𝔤 x (sgn R 𝔤 F) = -sgn R 𝔤 (contr R 𝔤 x F)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  ext v
  simp [Units.smul_def, koszulSign_add, koszulSign_odd odd_one]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.sgn_sgn
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sgn_sgn (F : Family R 𝔤) : sgn R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) = F
proof:
:=
  funext fun n => by rw [sgn_apply, sgn_apply, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.sgn_wedge_apply
statement:
theorem sgn_wedge_apply (K : ℕ) :
    ∀ F G : Family R 𝔤, koszulSign (K : ℤ) • wedge R 𝔤 F G K =
      wedge R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) (sgn R 𝔤 G) K
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
    intro F G
    refine mcochain_zero_ext ?_
    simp [wedge_apply_zero_apply]
  | succ K ih =>
    intro F G
    refine ext_curry fun x => ?_
    have h₂ := ih (sgn R 𝔤 F) (contr R 𝔤 x G)
    rw [sgn_sgn] at h₂
    rw [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, curry_wedge, curry_wedge, contr_sgn,
      contr_sgn, sgn_sgn, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, Pi.neg_apply, map_neg, Pi.neg_apply,
      ← ih, ← h₂]
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, koszulSign_add, koszulSign_odd odd_one, mul_neg_one, Units.val_neg,
      neg_smul, smul_add, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def]
    abel

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.sgn_wedge
statement:
theorem sgn_wedge (F G : Family R 𝔤) :
    sgn R 𝔤 (wedge R 𝔤 F G) = wedge R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) (sgn R 𝔤 G)
proof:
:=
  funext fun K => sgn_wedge_apply K F G

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_assoc_apply
statement:
theorem wedge_assoc_apply (K : ℕ) :
    ∀ F G H : Family R 𝔤, wedge R 𝔤 (wedge R 𝔤 F G) H K = wedge R 𝔤 F (wedge R 𝔤 G H) K
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
    intro F G H
    refine mcochain_zero_ext ?_
    simp only [wedge_apply_zero_apply, mul_assoc]
  | succ K ih =>
    intro F G H
    refine ext_curry fun x => ?_
    simp only [curry_wedge, contr_wedge, sgn_wedge, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, Pi.add_apply,
      ih]
    abel

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_assoc
statement:
theorem wedge_assoc (F G H : Family R 𝔤) :
    wedge R 𝔤 (wedge R 𝔤 F G) H = wedge R 𝔤 F (wedge R 𝔤 G H)
proof:
:=
  funext fun K => wedge_assoc_apply K F G H

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.one_zero_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_zero_apply (v : Fin 0 → 𝔤) : one R 𝔤 0 v = 1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.contr_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contr_one (x : 𝔤) : contr R 𝔤 x (one R 𝔤) = 0
proof:
:=
  funext fun n => by simp [one]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.sgn_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sgn_one : sgn R 𝔤 (one R 𝔤) = one R 𝔤
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n => simp [one]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.one_wedge_apply
statement: theorem one_wedge_apply (K : ℕ) : ∀ F : Family R 𝔤, wedge R 𝔤 (one R 𝔤) F K = F K
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero => intro F; exact mcochain_zero_ext (by simp [wedge_apply_zero_apply])
  | succ K ih =>
    intro F
    refine ext_curry fun x => ?_
    rw [curry_wedge, contr_one, sgn_one, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, zero_add,
      ih]
    rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_one_apply
statement: theorem wedge_one_apply (K : ℕ) : ∀ F : Family R 𝔤, wedge R 𝔤 F (one R 𝔤) K = F K
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero => intro F; exact mcochain_zero_ext (by simp [wedge_apply_zero_apply])
  | succ K ih =>
    intro F
    refine ext_curry fun x => ?_
    rw [curry_wedge, contr_one, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero, ih]
    rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.one_wedge
statement: @[simp] theorem one_wedge (F : Family R 𝔤) : wedge R 𝔤 (one R 𝔤) F = F
proof:
:=
  funext fun K => one_wedge_apply K F

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_one
statement: @[simp] theorem wedge_one (F : Family R 𝔤) : wedge R 𝔤 F (one R 𝔤) = F
proof:
:=
  funext fun K => wedge_one_apply K F

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsHomog.contr_of_zero
statement:
theorem IsHomog.contr_of_zero {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog 0 F) (x : 𝔤) :
    contr R 𝔤 x F = 0
proof:
:=
  funext fun n => by rw [contr_apply, hF (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), map_zero]; rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsHomog.contr_succ
statement:
theorem IsHomog.contr_succ {m : ℕ} {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog (m + 1) F) (x : 𝔤) :
    IsHomog m (contr R 𝔤 x F)
proof:
:= fun n hn => by
  rw [contr_apply, hF (n + 1) (by omega), map_zero]; rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsHomog.sgn_eq
statement:
theorem IsHomog.sgn_eq {m : ℕ} {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog m F) :
    sgn R 𝔤 F = koszulSign (m : ℤ) • F
proof:
:= funext fun n => by
  rcases eq_or_ne n m with rfl | h
  · rfl
  · rw [sgn_apply, hF n h, smul_zero, Pi.smul_apply, hF n h, smul_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsHomog.zero_apply_zero
statement:
theorem IsHomog.zero_apply_zero {m : ℕ} {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog m F) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    F 0 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hF 0 hm.symm]; rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isHomog_zero
statement: theorem isHomog_zero (m : ℕ) : IsHomog m (0 : Family R 𝔤)
proof: := fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsHomog.smul
statement:
theorem IsHomog.smul {m : ℕ} {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog m F) (u : ℤˣ) :
    IsHomog m (u • F)
proof: := fun n hn => by rw [Pi.smul_apply, hF n hn, smul_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isHomog_one
statement: theorem isHomog_one : IsHomog 0 (one R 𝔤)
proof: := fun n hn => by simp [one, hn]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem wedge_apply_eq_zero (K : ℕ) : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (F G : Family R 𝔤), IsHomog m F →
    IsHomog n G → K ≠ m + n → wedge R 𝔤 F G K = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
    intro m n F G hF hG hK
    refine mcochain_zero_ext ?_
    rw [wedge_apply_zero_apply]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
    · rw [hG.zero_apply_zero (by omega), mul_zero]; rfl
    · rw [hF.zero_apply_zero (by omega), zero_mul]; rfl
  | succ K ih =>
    intro m n F G hF hG hK
    refine ext_curry fun x => ?_
    rw [curry_wedge, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    have h₁ : wedge R 𝔤 (contr R 𝔤 x F) G K = 0 := by
      cases m with
      | zero => rw [hF.contr_of_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]; rfl
      | succ m => exact ih m n _ G (hF.contr_succ x) hG (by omega)
    have h₂ : wedge R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) (contr R 𝔤 x G) K = 0 := by
      cases n with
      | zero => rw [hG.contr_of_zero, map_zero]; rfl
      | succ n => exact ih m n _ _ (by rw [hF.sgn_eq]; exact hF.smul _) (hG.contr_succ x) (by omega)
    rw [h₁, h₂, add_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isHomog_wedge
statement:
theorem isHomog_wedge {m n : ℕ} {F G : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog m F) (hG : IsHomog n G) :
    IsHomog (m + n) (wedge R 𝔤 F G)
proof: := fun K hK => wedge_apply_eq_zero K m n F G hF hG hK

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_units_smul_left
statement:
theorem wedge_units_smul_left (u : ℤˣ) (F G : Family R 𝔤) :
    wedge R 𝔤 (u • F) G = u • wedge R 𝔤 F G
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_units_smul_right
statement:
theorem wedge_units_smul_right (u : ℤˣ) (F G : Family R 𝔤) :
    wedge R 𝔤 F (u • G) = u • wedge R 𝔤 F G
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ks_congr
statement: private theorem ks_congr {a b : ℤ} (h : Even (a - b)) : koszulSign a = koszulSign b
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff a b).mpr h

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_comm_apply
statement:
theorem wedge_comm_apply (K : ℕ) : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (F G : Family R 𝔤), IsHomog m F → IsHomog n G →
    wedge R 𝔤 F G K = koszulSign ((m * n : ℕ) : ℤ) • wedge R 𝔤 G F K
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
    intro m n F G hF hG
    refine mcochain_zero_ext ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
    · simp [wedge_apply_zero_apply, mul_comm]
    · rw [wedge_apply_zero_apply, Units.smul_def, _root_.smul_apply,
        wedge_apply_zero_apply, hF.zero_apply_zero (by omega), zero_mul, mul_zero, smul_zero]
  | succ K ih =>
    intro m n F G hF hG
    refine ext_curry fun x => ?_
    rw [Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, LinearMap.smul_apply, curry_wedge, curry_wedge, hF.sgn_eq,
      hG.sgn_eq, wedge_units_smul_left, wedge_units_smul_left, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      ← Units.smul_def]
    cases m with
    | zero =>
      rw [hF.contr_of_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, zero_add,
        map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero, add_zero, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.cast_zero,
        koszulSign_zero, one_smul, one_smul]
      cases n with
      | zero => rw [hG.contr_of_zero, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
          Pi.zero_apply]
      | succ n => rw [ih 0 n F _ hF (hG.contr_succ x), Nat.zero_mul, Nat.cast_zero,
          koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    | succ m =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
        rw [hG.contr_of_zero, map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero, add_zero, map_zero,
          LinearMap.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, zero_add, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.cast_zero,
          koszulSign_zero, one_smul, one_smul, ih m 0 _ G (hF.contr_succ x) hG, Nat.mul_zero,
          Nat.cast_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
      | succ n =>
        rw [ih m (n + 1) _ G (hF.contr_succ x) hG, ih (m + 1) n F _ hF (hG.contr_succ x),
          smul_smul, smul_add, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, add_comm]
        congr 2
        · exact ks_congr ⟨0, by push_cast; ring⟩
        · exact ks_congr ⟨-((n : ℤ) + 1), by push_cast; ring⟩

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_comm
statement:
theorem wedge_comm {m n : ℕ} {F G : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog m F) (hG : IsHomog n G) :
    wedge R 𝔤 F G = koszulSign ((m * n : ℕ) : ℤ) • wedge R 𝔤 G F
proof:
:=
  funext fun K => wedge_comm_apply K m n F G hF hG

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedge_self_of_odd
statement:
theorem wedge_self_of_odd {m : ℕ} {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog m F) (hm : Odd m) :
    wedge R 𝔤 F F = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hm; omega⟩
  refine family_ext ?_ fun x => ?_
  · rw [wedge_apply_zero_apply, hF.zero_apply_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero m), zero_mul]; rfl
  · have ha : Odd ((m : ℤ) + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hm
    have hb : Even (((m : ℤ) + 1) * m) := by
      rw [mul_comm]; exact Int.even_mul_succ_self m
    have h : Odd (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((m + 1) * m : ℕ)) := by
      push_cast; exact ha.add_even hb
    rw [contr_wedge, hF.sgn_eq, wedge_units_smul_left, wedge_comm hF (hF.contr_succ x),
      smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, koszulSign_odd h, Units.neg_smul, one_smul, add_neg_cancel,
      map_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.units_smul
statement:
theorem IsAlt.units_smul {n : ℕ} {f : MCochain R 𝔤 n} (hf : IsAlt f) (u : ℤˣ) :
    IsAlt (u • f)
proof:
:= fun v i j h hij => by
  rw [Units.smul_def, _root_.smul_apply, hf v i j h hij, smul_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.add
statement:
theorem IsAlt.add {n : ℕ} {f g : MCochain R 𝔤 n} (hf : IsAlt f) (hg : IsAlt g) :
    IsAlt (f + g)
proof:
:= fun v i j h hij => by
  rw [_root_.add_apply, hf v i j h hij, hg v i j h hij, add_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAlt_zero_degree
statement: theorem isAlt_zero_degree (f : MCochain R 𝔤 0) : IsAlt f
proof: := fun _ i => i.elim0

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAltFam_contr
statement:
theorem isAltFam_contr {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsAltFam F) (x : 𝔤) :
    IsAltFam (contr R 𝔤 x F)
proof: := fun n => (hF (n + 1)).curry x

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAltFam_sgn
statement: theorem isAltFam_sgn {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsAltFam F) : IsAltFam (sgn R 𝔤 F)
proof:
:=
  fun n => (hF n).units_smul _

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAltFam.contr_contr
statement:
theorem IsAltFam.contr_contr {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsAltFam F) (x : 𝔤) :
    contr R 𝔤 x (contr R 𝔤 x F) = 0
proof:
:=
  funext fun n => (hF (n + 2)).curry_curry x

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.contr_contr_wedge
statement:
theorem contr_contr_wedge {F G : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsAltFam F) (hG : IsAltFam G) (x : 𝔤) :
    contr R 𝔤 x (contr R 𝔤 x (wedge R 𝔤 F G)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [contr_wedge, map_add, contr_wedge, contr_wedge, hF.contr_contr, hG.contr_contr, contr_sgn,
    map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply]
  abel

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAlt_wedge_apply
statement:
theorem isAlt_wedge_apply (K : ℕ) :
    ∀ F G : Family R 𝔤, IsAltFam F → IsAltFam G → IsAlt (wedge R 𝔤 F G K)
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero => exact fun F G _ _ => isAlt_zero_degree _
  | succ K ih =>
    intro F G hF hG
    have hφ : ∀ x, IsAlt (curryEquiv R 𝔤 K (wedge R 𝔤 F G (K + 1)) x) := fun x => by
      rw [curry_wedge]
      exact (ih _ _ (isAltFam_contr hF x) hG).add (ih _ _ (isAltFam_sgn hF) (isAltFam_contr hG x))
    rw [← (curryEquiv R 𝔤 K).symm_apply_apply (wedge R 𝔤 F G (K + 1))]
    refine isAlt_curryEquiv_symm _ hφ fun x w k hk => ?_
    cases K with
    | zero => exact k.elim0
    | succ K =>
      refine IsAlt.eq_zero_of_apply_eq (hφ x) (fun u => ?_) w k hk
      rw [← curryEquiv_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun F : Family R 𝔤 => F K u) (contr_contr_wedge hF hG x)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAltFam_wedge
statement:
theorem isAltFam_wedge {F G : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsAltFam F) (hG : IsAltFam G) :
    IsAltFam (wedge R 𝔤 F G)
proof: := fun K => isAlt_wedge_apply K F G hF hG

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieFam_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem lieFam_apply (x : 𝔤) (F : Family R 𝔤) (n : ℕ) :
    lieFam R 𝔤 x F n = lieAct R 𝔤 n x (F n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.dFam_apply_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem dFam_apply_zero (F : Family R 𝔤) : dFam R 𝔤 F 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.dFam_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem dFam_apply_succ (F : Family R 𝔤) (n : ℕ) :
    dFam R 𝔤 F (n + 1) = ceDiff R 𝔤 n (F n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.contr_lieFam
statement:
theorem contr_lieFam (x y : 𝔤) (F : Family R 𝔤) :
    contr R 𝔤 y (lieFam R 𝔤 x F) = lieFam R 𝔤 x (contr R 𝔤 y F) - contr R 𝔤 ⁅x, y⁆ F
proof:
:=
  funext fun n => curry_lieAct x (F (n + 1)) y

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.contr_dFam
statement:
theorem contr_dFam (x : 𝔤) (F : Family R 𝔤) :
    contr R 𝔤 x (dFam R 𝔤 F) = lieFam R 𝔤 x F - dFam R 𝔤 (contr R 𝔤 x F)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    ext v
    simp
  | succ n => exact curry_ceDiff (F (n + 1)) x

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieFam_sgn
statement:
theorem lieFam_sgn (x : 𝔤) (F : Family R 𝔤) :
    lieFam R 𝔤 x (sgn R 𝔤 F) = sgn R 𝔤 (lieFam R 𝔤 x F)
proof:
:=
  funext fun n => by simp [Units.smul_def]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.dFam_sgn
statement: theorem dFam_sgn (F : Family R 𝔤) : dFam R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) = -sgn R 𝔤 (dFam R 𝔤 F)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    ext v
    simp [Units.smul_def, koszulSign_add, koszulSign_odd odd_one]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.dFam_dFam
statement: theorem dFam_dFam (F : Family R 𝔤) : dFam R 𝔤 (dFam R 𝔤 F) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => exact map_zero (ceDiff R 𝔤 0)
    | succ n => exact ceDiff_ceDiff (F n)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieFam_wedge_apply
statement:
theorem lieFam_wedge_apply (x : 𝔤) (K : ℕ) : ∀ F G : Family R 𝔤,
    lieFam R 𝔤 x (wedge R 𝔤 F G) K =
      (wedge R 𝔤 (lieFam R 𝔤 x F) G + wedge R 𝔤 F (lieFam R 𝔤 x G)) K
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
    intro F G
    refine mcochain_zero_ext ?_
    simp [wedge_apply_zero_apply]
  | succ K ih =>
    intro F G
    refine ext_curry fun y => ?_
    change (contr R 𝔤 y (lieFam R 𝔤 x (wedge R 𝔤 F G))) K = (contr R 𝔤 y
      (wedge R 𝔤 (lieFam R 𝔤 x F) G + wedge R 𝔤 F (lieFam R 𝔤 x G))) K
    simp only [contr_lieFam, contr_wedge, map_add, map_sub, lieFam_sgn, Pi.add_apply,
      Pi.sub_apply, ih, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    abel

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieFam_wedge
statement:
theorem lieFam_wedge (x : 𝔤) (F G : Family R 𝔤) :
    lieFam R 𝔤 x (wedge R 𝔤 F G) = wedge R 𝔤 (lieFam R 𝔤 x F) G + wedge R 𝔤 F (lieFam R 𝔤 x G)
proof:
:=
  funext fun K => lieFam_wedge_apply x K F G

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.dFam_wedge_apply
statement:
theorem dFam_wedge_apply (K : ℕ) : ∀ F G : Family R 𝔤,
    dFam R 𝔤 (wedge R 𝔤 F G) K =
      (wedge R 𝔤 (dFam R 𝔤 F) G + wedge R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) (dFam R 𝔤 G)) K
proof:
:= by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
    intro F G
    refine mcochain_zero_ext ?_
    simp [wedge_apply_zero_apply]
  | succ K ih =>
    intro F G
    refine ext_curry fun x => ?_
    change (contr R 𝔤 x (dFam R 𝔤 (wedge R 𝔤 F G))) K = (contr R 𝔤 x
      (wedge R 𝔤 (dFam R 𝔤 F) G + wedge R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) (dFam R 𝔤 G))) K
    simp only [contr_dFam, contr_wedge, map_add, map_sub, lieFam_wedge, contr_sgn, dFam_sgn,
      sgn_sgn, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, ih, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_neg,
      LinearMap.neg_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
    abel

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.dFam_wedge
statement:
theorem dFam_wedge (F G : Family R 𝔤) :
    dFam R 𝔤 (wedge R 𝔤 F G) = wedge R 𝔤 (dFam R 𝔤 F) G + wedge R 𝔤 (sgn R 𝔤 F) (dFam R 𝔤 G)
proof:
:=
  funext fun K => dFam_wedge_apply K F G

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.toMCochain_injective
statement: theorem toMCochain_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (toMCochain R 𝔤 n)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => AlternatingMap.ext fun v => congrArg (fun f : MCochain R 𝔤 n => f v) h

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.single_apply_self
statement:
theorem single_apply_self {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    single R 𝔤 n ω n = ω.toMultilinearMap
proof:
:= by
  simp [single, toMCochain]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.single_injective
statement: theorem single_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (single R 𝔤 n)
proof:
:= fun ω ω' h =>
  toMCochain_injective n (by simpa [single] using congrFun h n)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isHomog_single
statement: theorem isHomog_single {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) : IsHomog n (single R 𝔤 n ω)
proof:
:=
  fun k hk => by simp [single, hk]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAltFam_single
statement: theorem isAltFam_single {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) : IsAltFam (single R 𝔤 n ω)
proof:
:= fun k => by
  rcases eq_or_ne k n with rfl | hk
  · rw [single_apply_self]; exact isAlt_toMultilinearMap ω
  · rw [isHomog_single ω k hk]; exact isAlt_zero

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsHomog.eq_single
statement:
theorem IsHomog.eq_single {n : ℕ} {F : Family R 𝔤} (hF : IsHomog n F) :
    F = Pi.single n (F n)
proof:
:= funext fun k => by
  rcases eq_or_ne k n with rfl | hk
  · simp
  · rw [hF k hk, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hk]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.single_wedgeCochain
statement:
theorem single_wedgeCochain {m n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 m) (η : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    single R 𝔤 (m + n) (wedgeCochain ω η) = wedge R 𝔤 (single R 𝔤 m ω) (single R 𝔤 n η)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isHomog_wedge (isHomog_single ω) (isHomog_single η)).eq_single]
  rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.gradedMonoid_mk_eq
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [single_injective i hωη]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.single_oneCochain
statement: theorem single_oneCochain : single R 𝔤 0 (oneCochain R 𝔤) = one R 𝔤
proof:
:= by
  simp only [single, one, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.coe_single]
  rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.gMul_def
statement:
theorem gMul_def {m n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 m) (η : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    GradedMonoid.GMul.mul ω η = wedgeCochain ω η
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedgeCochain_add_left
statement:
theorem wedgeCochain_add_left {m n : ℕ} (ω ω' : CECochain R 𝔤 m) (η : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    wedgeCochain (ω + ω') η = wedgeCochain ω η + wedgeCochain ω' η
proof:
:=
  single_injective _ (by simp only [map_add, single_wedgeCochain, LinearMap.add_apply])

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedgeCochain_add_right
statement:
theorem wedgeCochain_add_right {m n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 m) (η η' : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    wedgeCochain ω (η + η') = wedgeCochain ω η + wedgeCochain ω η'
proof:
:=
  single_injective _ (by simp only [map_add, single_wedgeCochain])

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedgeCochain_smul_left
statement:
theorem wedgeCochain_smul_left {m n : ℕ} (r : R) (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 m) (η : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    wedgeCochain (r • ω) η = r • wedgeCochain ω η
proof:
:=
  single_injective _ (by simp only [map_smul, single_wedgeCochain, LinearMap.smul_apply])

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedgeCochain_smul_right
statement:
theorem wedgeCochain_smul_right {m n : ℕ} (r : R) (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 m) (η : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    wedgeCochain ω (r • η) = r • wedgeCochain ω η
proof:
:=
  single_injective _ (by simp only [map_smul, single_wedgeCochain])

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedgeCochain_zero_left
statement:
theorem wedgeCochain_zero_left {m n : ℕ} (η : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    wedgeCochain (0 : CECochain R 𝔤 m) η = 0
proof:
:=
  single_injective _ (by simp only [map_zero, single_wedgeCochain, LinearMap.zero_apply])

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.wedgeCochain_zero_right
statement:
theorem wedgeCochain_zero_right {m n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 m) :
    wedgeCochain ω (0 : CECochain R 𝔤 n) = 0
proof:
:=
  single_injective _ (by simp only [map_zero, single_wedgeCochain])

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.of_mul_of
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.of_mul_of {m n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 m) (η : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => CECochain R 𝔤 n) m ω * DirectSum.of _ n η : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) =
      DirectSum.of _ (m + n) (wedgeCochain ω η)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of ω η

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.one_def
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.one_def :
    (1 : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) = DirectSum.of (fun n => CECochain R 𝔤 n) 0 (oneCochain R 𝔤)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.toFamily_of
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.toFamily_of {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 (DirectSum.of _ n ω) = single R 𝔤 n ω
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toModule_lof R n ω

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.toFamily_apply
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.toFamily_apply (x : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) (n : ℕ) :
    CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 x n = (x n).toMultilinearMap
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | of k ω =>
    rw [CEAlgebra.toFamily_of]
    rcases eq_or_ne n k with rfl | h
    · rw [single_apply_self, DirectSum.of_eq_same]
    · rw [isHomog_single ω n h, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ h]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, Pi.add_apply, hx, hy, DirectSum.add_apply]; rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.toFamily_injective
statement: theorem CEAlgebra.toFamily_injective : Function.Injective (CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤)
proof:
:=
  fun x y h => DFinsupp.ext fun n => toMCochain_injective n (by
    have := congrFun h n
    rwa [CEAlgebra.toFamily_apply, CEAlgebra.toFamily_apply] at this)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.toFamily_mul
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.toFamily_mul (x y : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) :
    CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 (x * y) =
      wedge R 𝔤 (CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 x) (CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [zero_mul, map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  | of m ω =>
    induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [mul_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, map_add]
    | of n η =>
      rw [CEAlgebra.of_mul_of, CEAlgebra.toFamily_of, CEAlgebra.toFamily_of,
        CEAlgebra.toFamily_of, single_wedgeCochain]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.toFamily_one
statement: theorem CEAlgebra.toFamily_one : CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 1 = one R 𝔤
proof:
:= by
  rw [CEAlgebra.one_def, CEAlgebra.toFamily_of, single_oneCochain]

name: DG.of_mem_reindexGrading
statement:
theorem of_mem_reindexGrading (n : κ) (b : β n) :
    DirectSum.of β n b ∈ reindexGrading β e (e n)
proof:
:=
  fun m hm => DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (fun h => hm (by rw [← h]))

name: DG.eq_of_mem_reindexGrading
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_reindexGrading {i : ι} {x : ⨁ n : κ, β n} (hx : x ∈ reindexGrading β e i)
    (he : Function.Injective e) (n : κ) (hn : e n = i) : x = DirectSum.of β n (x n)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rcases eq_or_ne m n with rfl | h
  · rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same]
  · rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ h, hx m (by rw [← hn]; exact he.ne h)]

name: DG.eq_zero_of_mem_reindexGrading
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_reindexGrading {i : ι} (hi : i ∉ Set.range e) {x : ⨁ n : κ, β n}
    (hx : x ∈ reindexGrading β e i) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  exact hx m fun h => hi ⟨m, h⟩

name: DG.reindexGrading_cases
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range e
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hi
    rw [eq_of_mem_reindexGrading hx he n hn]
    exact h _ _ hn
  · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_reindexGrading hi hx]; exact h₀

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.dLinear_of
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.dLinear_of {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    CEAlgebra.dLinear R 𝔤 (DirectSum.of _ n ω) = DirectSum.of _ (n + 1) (ceD R 𝔤 n ω)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, CEAlgebra.dLinear, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    DirectSum.lof_eq_of]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.toFamily_dLinear
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.toFamily_dLinear (x : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) :
    CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 (CEAlgebra.dLinear R 𝔤 x) = dFam R 𝔤 (CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  | of n ω =>
    rw [CEAlgebra.dLinear_of, CEAlgebra.toFamily_of, CEAlgebra.toFamily_of]
    funext k
    cases k with
    | zero => rw [isHomog_single _ 0 (by omega), dFam_apply_zero]
    | succ k =>
      rw [dFam_apply_succ]
      rcases eq_or_ne k n with rfl | h
      · rw [single_apply_self, single_apply_self]; rfl
      · rw [isHomog_single _ (k + 1) (by omega), isHomog_single _ k h, map_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.d_def
statement: theorem CEAlgebra.d_def (x : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) : d x = CEAlgebra.dLinear R 𝔤 x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.d_of
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.d_of {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun n => CECochain R 𝔤 n) n ω : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) =
      DirectSum.of _ (n + 1) (ceD R 𝔤 n ω)
proof:
:=
  CEAlgebra.dLinear_of ω

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.of_mem_grading {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => CECochain R 𝔤 n) n ω : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) ∈ grading (n : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  of_mem_reindexGrading n ω

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.grading_cases
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.grading_cases {k : ℤ} {x : CEAlgebra R 𝔤} (hx : x ∈ grading k)
    {P : CEAlgebra R 𝔤 → Prop} (h₀ : P 0)
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n), (n : ℤ) = k → P (DirectSum.of _ n ω)) : P x
proof:
:=
  reindexGrading_cases Nat.cast_injective hx h₀ h

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.CEAlgebra.toFamily_units_smul
statement:
theorem CEAlgebra.toFamily_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (x : CEAlgebra R 𝔤) :
    CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 (u • x) = u • CEAlgebra.toFamily R 𝔤 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curryEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x : 𝔤) (v : Fin n → 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f x v = f (Fin.cons x v)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curryEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (φ : 𝔤 →ₗ[R] MCochain R 𝔤 n) (v : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) :
    (curryEquiv R 𝔤 n).symm φ v = φ (v 0) (Fin.tail v)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ext_curry
statement:
theorem ext_curry {n : ℕ} {f g : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)}
    (h : ∀ x, curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f x = curryEquiv R 𝔤 n g x) : f = g
proof:
:=
  (curryEquiv R 𝔤 n).injective (LinearMap.ext h)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curry_lieAct
statement:
theorem curry_lieAct {n : ℕ} (x : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (y : 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 n (lieAct R 𝔤 (n + 1) x f) y =
      lieAct R 𝔤 n x (curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f y) - curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f ⁅x, y⁆
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [lieAct]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curry_ceDiff
statement:
theorem curry_ceDiff {n : ℕ} (f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x : 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 (n + 1) (ceDiff R 𝔤 (n + 1) f) x =
      lieAct R 𝔤 (n + 1) x f - ceDiff R 𝔤 n (curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f x)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [ceDiff]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAct_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem lieAct_zero (x : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 0) : lieAct R 𝔤 0 x f = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceDiff_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem ceDiff_zero (f : MCochain R 𝔤 0) : ceDiff R 𝔤 0 f = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAct_lie
statement:
theorem lieAct_lie {n : ℕ} (x y : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 n) :
    lieAct R 𝔤 n ⁅x, y⁆ f =
      lieAct R 𝔤 n x (lieAct R 𝔤 n y f) - lieAct R 𝔤 n y (lieAct R 𝔤 n x f)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    refine ext_curry fun z => ?_
    simp only [curry_lieAct, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, ih]
    rw [leibniz_lie x y z]
    simp only [map_add]
    abel

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceDiff_lieAct
statement:
theorem ceDiff_lieAct {n : ℕ} (x : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 n) :
    ceDiff R 𝔤 n (lieAct R 𝔤 n x f) = lieAct R 𝔤 (n + 1) x (ceDiff R 𝔤 n f)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    refine ext_curry fun z => ?_
    simp only [curry_ceDiff, curry_lieAct, map_sub, ih, lieAct_lie]
    rw [← lie_skew x z]
    simp only [map_neg]
    abel

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceDiff_ceDiff
statement: theorem ceDiff_ceDiff {n : ℕ} (f : MCochain R 𝔤 n) : ceDiff R 𝔤 (n + 1) (ceDiff R 𝔤 n f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    refine ext_curry fun x => ?_
    simp only [curry_ceDiff, map_sub, ← ceDiff_lieAct, ih, map_zero]
    simp

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAct_apply
statement:
theorem lieAct_apply {n : ℕ} (x : 𝔤) (f : MCochain R 𝔤 n) (v : Fin n → 𝔤) :
    lieAct R 𝔤 n x f v = -∑ j, f (Function.update v j ⁅x, v j⁆)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail v]
    conv_lhs => rw [← curryEquiv_apply (lieAct R 𝔤 (n + 1) x f), curry_lieAct]
    rw [sub_apply, ih, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [curryEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.update_cons_zero,
      ← Fin.cons_update]
    abel

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAlt_zero
statement: theorem isAlt_zero {n : ℕ} : IsAlt (0 : MCochain R 𝔤 n)
proof: := fun _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.sub
statement:
theorem IsAlt.sub {n : ℕ} {f g : MCochain R 𝔤 n} (hf : IsAlt f) (hg : IsAlt g) :
    IsAlt (f - g)
proof:
:= fun v i j h hij => by
  rw [sub_apply, hf v i j h hij, hg v i j h hij, sub_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAlt_toMultilinearMap
statement: theorem isAlt_toMultilinearMap {n : ℕ} (ω : 𝔤 [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] R) : IsAlt ω.toMultilinearMap
proof:
:=
  fun v _ _ h hij => ω.map_eq_zero_of_eq v h hij

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.curry
statement:
theorem IsAlt.curry {n : ℕ} {f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)} (hf : IsAlt f) (x : 𝔤) :
    IsAlt (curryEquiv R 𝔤 n f x)
proof:
:= fun v i j h hij => by
  rw [curryEquiv_apply]
  exact hf _ i.succ j.succ (by simpa using h) ((Fin.succ_injective _).ne hij)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.curry_curry
statement:
theorem IsAlt.curry_curry {n : ℕ} {f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 2)} (hf : IsAlt f) (x : 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 n (curryEquiv R 𝔤 (n + 1) f x) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  exact hf _ 0 1 (by simp) Fin.zero_ne_one

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.map_swap
statement:
theorem IsAlt.map_swap {n : ℕ} {f : MCochain R 𝔤 n} (hf : IsAlt f) (v : Fin n → 𝔤) {i j : Fin n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) : f (v ∘ Equiv.swap i j) = -f v
proof:
:=
  (⟨f, hf⟩ : 𝔤 [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] R).map_swap v hij

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.lieAct
statement:
theorem IsAlt.lieAct {n : ℕ} {f : MCochain R 𝔤 n} (hf : IsAlt f) (x : 𝔤) :
    IsAlt (lieAct R 𝔤 n x f)
proof:
:= fun v i j h hij => by
  rw [lieAct_apply, neg_eq_zero, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i),
    ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij.symm, Finset.mem_univ j⟩)]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_, add_zero]
  · have key : f (Function.update v i ⁅x, v i⁆) = -f (Function.update v j ⁅x, v j⁆) := by
      rw [← hf.map_swap _ hij.symm]
      congr 1
      ext k
      rcases eq_or_ne k i with rfl | hki
      · simp [h]
      rcases eq_or_ne k j with rfl | hkj
      · simp [hij, hki, h]
      · simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hkj hki, hki, hkj]
    rw [key, neg_add_cancel]
  · obtain ⟨hkj, hk⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hk
    obtain ⟨hki, -⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hk
    exact hf _ i j (by simp [hki.symm, hkj.symm, h]) hij

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.eq_zero_of_apply_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne k 0 with rfl | hk0
  · rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail v, hk]
    exact hx _
  · rw [← neg_eq_zero, ← hf.map_swap v hk0.symm, ← Fin.cons_self_tail (v ∘ Equiv.swap 0 k)]
    convert hx (Fin.tail (v ∘ Equiv.swap 0 k))
    simp [hk]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.isAlt_curryEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem isAlt_curryEquiv_symm {n : ℕ} (φ : 𝔤 →ₗ[R] MCochain R 𝔤 n) (h₁ : ∀ x, IsAlt (φ x))
    (h₂ : ∀ (x : 𝔤) (w : Fin n → 𝔤) (k : Fin n), w k = x → φ x w = 0) :
    IsAlt ((curryEquiv R 𝔤 n).symm φ)
proof:
:= fun v i j h hij => by
  rw [curryEquiv_symm_apply]
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
    cases j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact absurd rfl hij
    | succ j => exact h₂ _ _ j (by simpa [Fin.tail] using h.symm)
  | succ i =>
    cases j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact h₂ _ _ i (by simpa [Fin.tail] using h)
    | succ j => exact h₁ _ _ i j (by simpa [Fin.tail] using h) (fun h' => hij (by rw [h']))

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.IsAlt.ceDiff
statement:
theorem IsAlt.ceDiff {n : ℕ} {f : MCochain R 𝔤 n} (hf : IsAlt f) :
    IsAlt (ChevalleyEilenberg.ceDiff R 𝔤 n f)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact isAlt_zero
  | succ n ih =>
    change IsAlt ((curryEquiv R 𝔤 (n + 1)).symm _)
    refine isAlt_curryEquiv_symm _ (fun x => (hf.lieAct x).sub (ih (hf.curry x))) ?_
    intro x w k hk
    refine IsAlt.eq_zero_of_apply_eq ((hf.lieAct x).sub (ih (hf.curry x))) (fun u => ?_) w k hk
    rw [sub_apply, sub_eq_zero,
      ← curryEquiv_apply (ChevalleyEilenberg.lieAct R 𝔤 (n + 1) x f),
      curry_lieAct, lie_self, map_zero, sub_zero]
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m =>
      rw [← curryEquiv_apply (ChevalleyEilenberg.ceDiff R 𝔤 (m + 1) _), curry_ceDiff,
        hf.curry_curry, map_zero,
        sub_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_apply
statement:
theorem ceD_apply {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) (v : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) :
    ceD R 𝔤 n ω v = ceDiff R 𝔤 n ω.toMultilinearMap v
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_ceD
statement: theorem ceD_ceD {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 n) : ceD R 𝔤 (n + 1) (ceD R 𝔤 n ω) = 0
proof:
:=
  AlternatingMap.ext fun v => congrArg (fun f : MCochain R 𝔤 (n + 2) => f v) (ceDiff_ceDiff _)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ceD_zero (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 0) : ceD R 𝔤 0 ω = 0
proof: := AlternatingMap.ext fun _ => rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.map_cons_removeNth
statement:
theorem map_cons_removeNth {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (v : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ω (Fin.cons (v i) (Fin.removeNth i v)) = koszulSign ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) • ω v
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Fin.cons (v i) (Fin.removeNth i v) : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) = v ∘ ⇑i.cycleRange.symm := by
    ext k
    cases k using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k => simp [Fin.removeNth]
  rw [h, ω.map_perm, Equiv.Perm.sign_symm, Fin.sign_cycleRange, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_def,
    zpow_natCast]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.map_cons_cons_swap
statement:
theorem map_cons_cons_swap {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 2)) (a b : 𝔤) (w : Fin n → 𝔤) :
    ω (Fin.cons a (Fin.cons b w)) = -ω (Fin.cons b (Fin.cons a w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ω.map_swap _ (i := 0) (j := 1) (by simp)]
  congr 1
  ext k
  cases k using Fin.cases with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k =>
    cases k using Fin.cases with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k =>
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero _) (by
        rw [Ne, ← Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_inj]; exact Fin.succ_ne_zero _)]
      simp only [Fin.cons_succ]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.removeNth_succ_cons
statement:
theorem removeNth_succ_cons {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (a : 𝔤) (y : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) :
    Fin.removeNth j.succ (Fin.cons a y : Fin (n + 2) → 𝔤) = Fin.cons a (Fin.removeNth j y)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  cases k using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp [Fin.removeNth]
  | succ k => simp [Fin.removeNth, Fin.succ_succAbove_succ]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.curryEquiv_toMultilinearMap
statement:
theorem curryEquiv_toMultilinearMap {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x : 𝔤) :
    curryEquiv R 𝔤 n ω.toMultilinearMap x = (ω.curryLeft x).toMultilinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_cons
statement:
theorem ceD_cons {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x₀ : 𝔤) (y : Fin (n + 1) → 𝔤) :
    ceD R 𝔤 (n + 1) ω (Fin.cons x₀ y) =
      -(∑ j : Fin (n + 1), koszulSign ((j : ℕ) : ℤ) • ω (Fin.cons ⁅x₀, y j⁆ (Fin.removeNth j y)))
        - ceD R 𝔤 n (ω.curryLeft x₀) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [ceD_apply, ← curryEquiv_apply, curry_ceDiff, sub_apply, lieAct_apply]
  congr 2
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have h := map_cons_removeNth ω (Function.update y j ⁅x₀, y j⁆) j
  rw [Function.update_self, Fin.removeNth_update] at h
  rw [h, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ks_succ
statement: private theorem ks_succ (k : ℕ) : koszulSign ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = -koszulSign (k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, koszulSign_add, koszulSign_odd odd_one, mul_neg_one]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem ceD_apply_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 (n + 1)) (x : Fin (n + 2) → 𝔤) :
    ceD R 𝔤 (n + 1) ω x = ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), ∑ i : Fin (n + 1),
      if (i : ℕ) < j then koszulSign (((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℤ) •
        ω (Fin.cons ⁅x i.castSucc, x j⁆ (Fin.removeNth i (Fin.removeNth j x))) else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail x, ceD_cons, ceD_zero, AlternatingMap.zero_apply, sub_zero]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, lt_irrefl,
      ite_false, zero_lt_one, ite_true, add_zero, zero_add, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.cons_zero,
      Fin.cons_succ, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, koszulSign_zero, one_smul,
      koszulSign_odd odd_one, Units.neg_smul, Fin.tail]
    congr 3
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail x, ceD_cons, ih]
    generalize x 0 = x₀
    generalize Fin.tail x = y
    conv_rhs => rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.not_lt_zero, ite_false, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    conv_rhs => rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    congr 1
    · rw [ite_eq_left (by simp), Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ,
        removeNth_succ_cons, Fin.removeNth_zero, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.val_zero, zero_add,
        Fin.val_succ, ks_succ, Units.neg_smul]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [show i.succ.castSucc = i.castSucc.succ from rfl, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ,
        removeNth_succ_cons, removeNth_succ_cons, map_cons_cons_swap]
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right]
      split_ifs
      · rw [show (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((j : ℕ) + 1) = (i + j + 1 : ℕ) + 1 by ring, ks_succ, ks_succ,
          neg_neg, smul_neg]
        rfl
      · rw [neg_zero]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceCoboundaries_le_ceCocycles
statement: theorem ceCoboundaries_le_ceCocycles (n : ℕ) : ceCoboundaries R 𝔤 n ≤ ceCocycles R 𝔤 n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact bot_le
  | succ n =>
    rintro _ ⟨ω, rfl⟩
    exact ceD_ceD ω

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.comap_ceCoboundaries_zero
statement:
theorem comap_ceCoboundaries_zero :
    (ceCoboundaries R 𝔤 0).comap (ceCocycles R 𝔤 0).subtype = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.comap _ ⊥ = ⊥
  rw [Submodule.comap_bot, Submodule.ker_subtype]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.comap_ceCoboundaries_one
statement:
theorem comap_ceCoboundaries_one :
    (ceCoboundaries R 𝔤 1).comap (ceCocycles R 𝔤 1).subtype = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have h : ceCoboundaries R 𝔤 1 = ⊥ := by
    show LinearMap.range (ceD R 𝔤 0) = ⊥
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_bot]
    exact LinearMap.ext ceD_zero
  rw [h, Submodule.comap_bot, Submodule.ker_subtype]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainOneEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cochainOneEquiv_apply (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 1) (x : 𝔤) :
    cochainOneEquiv R 𝔤 ω x = ω ![x]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cochainOneEquiv, LinearEquiv.coe_mk]
  exact congrArg ω (funext fun i => by fin_cases i; rfl)

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.cochainOneEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cochainOneEquiv_symm_apply (φ : Module.Dual R 𝔤) (v : Fin 1 → 𝔤) :
    (cochainOneEquiv R 𝔤).symm φ v = φ (v 0)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.ceD_one_apply
statement:
theorem ceD_one_apply (ω : CECochain R 𝔤 1) (x y : 𝔤) :
    ceD R 𝔤 1 ω ![x, y] = -ω ![⁅x, y⁆]
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (![x, y] : Fin 2 → 𝔤) = Fin.cons x ![y] from rfl, ceD_cons, ceD_zero,
    AlternatingMap.zero_apply, sub_zero, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
  congr 2

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.mem_ceCocycles_one
statement:
theorem mem_ceCocycles_one {ω : CECochain R 𝔤 1} :
    ω ∈ ceCocycles R 𝔤 1 ↔ ∀ x y : 𝔤, ω ![⁅x, y⁆] = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    have := congrArg (fun ω' : CECochain R 𝔤 2 => ω' ![x, y]) (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp h)
    simpa [ceD_one_apply] using this
  · intro h
    refine LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (AlternatingMap.ext fun v => ?_)
    rw [show v = ![v 0, v 1] from funext fun i => by fin_cases i <;> rfl, ceD_one_apply, h,
      neg_zero, AlternatingMap.zero_apply]

name: DG.ChevalleyEilenberg.mem_dualAnnihilator_derivedSubmodule
statement:
theorem mem_dualAnnihilator_derivedSubmodule (φ : Module.Dual R 𝔤) :
    φ ∈ (derivedSubmodule R 𝔤).dualAnnihilator ↔ ∀ x y : 𝔤, φ ⁅x, y⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold derivedSubmodule
  rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator, LieSubmodule.lieIdeal_oper_eq_linear_span]
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    exact h _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨x, trivial⟩, ⟨y, trivial⟩, rfl⟩)
  · intro h w hw
    induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem w hw =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, rfl⟩ := hw
      exact h x y
    | zero => exact map_zero φ
    | add w w' _ _ hw hw' => rw [map_add, hw, hw', add_zero]
    | smul r w _ hw => rw [map_smul, hw, smul_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.recover_commShiftIso
statement:
theorem recover_commShiftIso (s k : ℤ) :
    (recover.{v} A s).commShiftIso k = recoveryShiftNatIso A s k
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModule_commShiftIso
statement:
theorem toCatModule_commShiftIso (k : ℤ) :
    (toCatModule.{v} A).commShiftIso k = toCatModuleShiftNatIso A k
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext M
  have h := Adjunction.CommShift.compatibilityCounit_left (diagonalAdjunction A)
    ((toCatModule A).commShiftIso k) ((recover A 0).commShiftIso k)
    (fun N => ((diagonalAdjunction A).commShiftIso_hom_app_counit_app_shift ℤ k N).symm) M
  rw [recover_commShiftIso] at h
  simpa [toCatModuleShiftNatIso, shiftedRecoveryNatIso, shiftedDiagonalCounitIso,
    diagonalAdjunction, diagonalCounit, Functor.map_comp] using h

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModuleShiftNatIso_zero
statement:
theorem toCatModuleShiftNatIso_zero :
    toCatModuleShiftNatIso.{v} A 0 = Functor.CommShift.isoZero (toCatModule A) ℤ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toCatModule_commShiftIso, Functor.commShiftIso_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModuleShiftNatIso_add
statement:
theorem toCatModuleShiftNatIso_add (a b : ℤ) :
    toCatModuleShiftNatIso.{v} A (a + b) = Functor.CommShift.isoAdd
      (toCatModuleShiftNatIso A a) (toCatModuleShiftNatIso A b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← toCatModule_commShiftIso, Functor.commShiftIso_add]

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerived_commShiftIso
statement:
theorem toDerived_commShiftIso (k : ℤ) :
    (toDerived.{w', w, v} A).commShiftIso k = toDerivedShiftNatIso A k
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply Localization.natTrans_ext DerivedCategory.Q (DGModuleCat.quasiIso A)
  intro M
  rw [Functor.commShiftOfLocalization_iso_hom_app]
  rw [toDerivedShiftNatIso_hom_app_Q]
  simp [QCompShiftToDerivedIso, QCompToDerivedShiftIso,
    Functor.commShiftIso_comp_hom_app, toCatModule_commShiftIso, QCompToDerivedIso]

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerivedShiftNatIso_zero
statement:
theorem toDerivedShiftNatIso_zero :
    toDerivedShiftNatIso.{w', w, v} A 0 =
      Functor.CommShift.isoZero (toDerived A) ℤ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toDerived_commShiftIso, Functor.commShiftIso_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerivedShiftNatIso_add
statement:
theorem toDerivedShiftNatIso_add (a b : ℤ) :
    toDerivedShiftNatIso.{w', w, v} A (a + b) = Functor.CommShift.isoAdd
      (toDerivedShiftNatIso A a) (toDerivedShiftNatIso A b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← toDerived_commShiftIso, Functor.commShiftIso_add]

name: DG.Diagonal.mem_essImage_toDerived_iff_derivedSupported
statement:
theorem mem_essImage_toDerived_iff_derivedSupported
    (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', v}
      (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    (toDerived.{w', w, v} A).essImage X ↔ DerivedSupported A X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let Q := CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q (C :=
      WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)
    have : Q.EssSurj := Localization.essSurj Q (CatModule.quasiIso _)
    let N := Q.objPreimage X
    let e := Q.objObjPreimageIso X
    exact ⟨N, (mem_essImage_toDerived_iff_of_iso A N X e).mp h, ⟨e⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨N, hN, ⟨e⟩⟩
    exact (mem_essImage_toDerived_iff_of_iso A N X e).mpr hN

name: DG.Diagonal.derivedSupported_iff_of_iso
proof:
:=
  (mem_essImage_toDerived_iff_derivedSupported A X).symm.trans
    (mem_essImage_toDerived_iff_of_iso A N X e)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mk_parityShiftCompact
statement:
theorem mk_parityShiftCompact
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    K0.mk (parityShiftCompact H X) =
      -((T (-k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.DerivedCategory.T_smul_mk_compact, ← K0.mk_shift_one]
  exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso ((compactSubcategory _).fullyFaithfulι.preimageIso
    (((compactSubcategory _).ι.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).app
      (((CatModule.DerivedCategory.compactInternalShiftAction _).functor (-k)).obj X)).symm)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.smul_mem_parityRelations
statement:
theorem smul_mem_parityRelations (y : CompactK0.{w', w} H) :
    (T (-k) + 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • y ∈
      K0Rel.parityRelations (parityShiftCompact H)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [_root_.smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | mk X =>
    have h : (T (-k) + 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X =
        -(K0.mk (parityShiftCompact H X) - K0.mk X) := by
      rw [mk_parityShiftCompact, _root_.add_smul, one_smul]; abel
    rw [h]
    exact neg_mem (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨X, rfl⟩)
  | neg x hx => rw [_root_.smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx
  | add x y hx hy => rw [_root_.smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityRelations_eq
statement:
theorem parityRelations_eq : K0Rel.parityRelations (parityShiftCompact H) =
    (paritySubmodule.{w', w} H).toAddSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨X, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨-((T (-k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X), ?_⟩
    change (1 + T k : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • (-((T (-k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X)) = _
    rw [mk_parityShiftCompact, _root_.smul_neg, smul_smul,
      add_mul, one_mul, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero, _root_.add_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have h := smul_mem_parityRelations H ((T k : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • y)
    rwa [smul_smul, add_mul, one_mul, ← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero] at h

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cLinearEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superK0cLinearEquiv_mk
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    superK0cLinearEquiv H (K0Rel.mk X) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (K0.mk X)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0c_isTorsionBy
statement:
theorem superK0c_isTorsionBy : Module.IsTorsionBy (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)
    (SuperK0c.{w', w} H) (1 + T k)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  apply (superK0cLinearEquiv H).injective
  rw [map_smul, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective (paritySubmodule H) (superK0cLinearEquiv H x)
  rw [← hy]
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0c_mk_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superK0c_mk_smul (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : SuperK0c.{w', w} H) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (superIdeal k) p • x = p • x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superK0cMk_mk
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
