    superK0cMk H (K0.mk X) = K0Rel.mk X
proof:
:= by
  apply (superK0cLinearEquiv H).injective
  exact (superK0cLinearEquiv H).apply_symm_apply _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk_surjective
statement: theorem superK0cMk_surjective : Function.Surjective (superK0cMk.{w', w} H)
proof:
:=
  (superK0cLinearEquiv H).symm.surjective.comp (paritySubmodule H).mkQ_surjective

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.T_smul_superK0c_mk
statement:
theorem T_smul_superK0c_mk (n : ℤ)
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    (T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • (K0Rel.mk X : SuperK0c H) =
      K0Rel.mk (((CatModule.DerivedCategory.compactInternalShiftAction H.Regraded).functor n).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← superK0cMk_mk H, ← map_smul, CatModule.DerivedCategory.T_smul_mk_compact,
    superK0cMk_mk]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.map_mem_paritySubmodule
statement:
theorem map_mem_paritySubmodule
    (f : CompactK0.{w', w} H →ₗ[LaurentPolynomial ℤ] CompactK0.{v', v} H') :
    paritySubmodule H ≤ (paritySubmodule H').comap f
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨f x, (f.map_smul (1 + T k) x).symm⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superK0cMap_mk (f : CompactK0.{w', w} H →ₗ[LaurentPolynomial ℤ] CompactK0.{v', v} H')
    (x : CompactK0 H) :
    superK0cMap H H' f (superK0cMk H x) = superK0cMk H' (f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (superK0cLinearEquiv H').injective
  change superK0cLinearEquiv H' ((superK0cLinearEquiv H').symm
    ((paritySubmodule H).mapQ (paritySubmodule H') f (map_mem_paritySubmodule H H' f)
      (superK0cLinearEquiv H ((superK0cLinearEquiv H).symm
        ((paritySubmodule H).mkQ x))))) =
    superK0cLinearEquiv H' ((superK0cLinearEquiv H').symm ((paritySubmodule H').mkQ (f x)))
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap_unique
statement:
theorem superK0cMap_unique
    (f : CompactK0.{w', w} H →ₗ[LaurentPolynomial ℤ] CompactK0.{v', v} H')
    (g : SuperK0c H →ₗ[LaurentPolynomial ℤ] SuperK0c H')
    (hg : ∀ x, g (superK0cMk H x) = superK0cMk H' (f x)) :
    g = superK0cMap H H' f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := superK0cMk_surjective H x
  rw [hg, superK0cMap_mk]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap_lsmul_T_mk
statement:
theorem superK0cMap_lsmul_T_mk (n : ℤ)
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    superK0cMap H H (LinearMap.lsmul (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (CompactK0 H) (T n))
      (K0Rel.mk X) =
      K0Rel.mk (((CatModule.DerivedCategory.compactInternalShiftAction H.Regraded).functor n).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← superK0cMk_mk H, superK0cMap_mk]
  change superK0cMk H ((T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X) = _
  rw [map_smul, superK0cMk_mk, T_smul_superK0c_mk]

name: DG.Diagonal.supported_action_shift_sign
statement:
theorem supported_action_shift_sign (k n t : ℤ) :
    koszulSign (k * (n + 2 * t)) = koszulSign (k * n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_add, koszulSign_add]
  have h : k * (2 * t) = 2 * (k * t) := by ring
  rw [h, supported_shift_sign, mul_one]

name: DG.Diagonal.supported_shift_diagonal
statement:
theorem supported_shift_diagonal (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (k : ℤ) :
    Supported A (CatModule.shift k ((toCatModule A).obj M))
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  let := value_subsingleton A M s hs
  change Subsingleton (Shift k (Value A M s))
  exact (Shift.unmk k (M := Value A M s)).injective.subsingleton

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModuleShiftNatIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem toCatModuleShiftNatIso_hom_app (k : ℤ) (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    (toCatModuleShiftNatIso A k).hom.app M =
      (toCatModule A).map ((shiftedRecoveryNatIso A k).inv.app M) ≫
        counitMap A (CatModule.shift k ((toCatModule A).obj M))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModuleShiftIso_unmk_d
statement:
theorem toCatModuleShiftIso_unmk_d (k : ℤ) (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A)
    (s : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)
    (x : ((toCatModule A).obj ((shiftFunctor (DGModuleCat.{v} A) k).obj M)).obj s) :
    CatModule.shift.unmk k ((toCatModuleShiftIso A k M).hom.app s (d x)) =
      koszulSign k • d (CatModule.shift.unmk k ((toCatModuleShiftIso A k M).hom.app s x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.Hom.map_d, CatModule.shift.unmk_d]

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModuleShiftIso_unmk_smul
statement:
theorem toCatModuleShiftIso_unmk_smul (k : ℤ) (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A)
    {s t : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded}
    {n : ℤ} {f : s ⟶ t} (hf : f ∈ DG.grading n)
    (x : ((toCatModule A).obj ((shiftFunctor (DGModuleCat.{v} A) k).obj M)).obj s) :
    CatModule.shift.unmk k ((toCatModuleShiftIso A k M).hom.app t (f • x)) =
      koszulSign (k * n) •
        (f • CatModule.shift.unmk k ((toCatModuleShiftIso A k M).hom.app s x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.Hom.map_smul, CatModule.shift.unmk_smul hf]

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerivedShiftNatIso_hom_app_Q
statement:
theorem toDerivedShiftNatIso_hom_app_Q (k : ℤ) (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    (toDerivedShiftNatIso A k).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M) =
      (QCompShiftToDerivedIso A k).hom.app M ≫
        CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map ((toCatModuleShiftNatIso A k).hom.app M) ≫
        (QCompToDerivedShiftIso A k).inv.app M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toDerivedShiftNatIso, Localization.liftNatIso_hom,
    Localization.liftNatTrans_app, Functor.isoWhiskerRight_hom,
    Functor.whiskerRight_app]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.ofDGRingHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem ofDGRingHom_apply (φ : A →ᵈᵍ+* B) (a : A) : ofDGRingHom φ a = φ a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.regraded_scalarHom
statement:
theorem regraded_scalarHom (a : A) :
    (HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.ofDGRingHom φ).regraded (scalarHom A 0 a).1 =
      (scalarHom B 0 (φ a)).1
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; rfl
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rename_i n
    rw [scalarHom_homogeneous A 0 n a a.2, scalarHom_homogeneous B 0 n (φ a) (φ.map_mem a.2),
      HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regraded_place]
    rfl
  | h_add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, WeightCategory.add_val, map_add, ha, hb, map_add,
      WeightCategory.add_val]

name: DG.Diagonal.scalarInclusion_comp_weightFunctor
statement:
theorem scalarInclusion_comp_weightFunctor :
    scalarInclusion A 0 ⋙ (HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.ofDGRingHom φ).weightFunctor =
      φ.singleObjFunctor ⋙ scalarInclusion B 0
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ => by rfl) fun _ _ a => by
    simp only [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
    exact WeightCategory.hom_ext (regraded_scalarHom φ a)

name: DG.Diagonal.mapCompactK0_singleObjEquiv
statement:
theorem mapCompactK0_singleObjEquiv (z : DGCategory.K0.{u, u} (SingleObj A)) :
    mapCompactK0.{u, u, u} A (DGRing.K0.singleObjEquiv A z) =
      DGCategory.K0.map.{u, u} (scalarInclusion A 0) z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | mk X =>
    rw [DGRing.K0.singleObjEquiv, DG.K0.compactMapEquiv_mk, mapCompactK0_mk,
      DGCategory.K0.map_mk]
    exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ((toDerivedInductionIso A).app X.obj)
  | neg x hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx, map_neg]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.map_congr_functor
statement:
theorem _root_.DG.DGCategory.K0.map_congr_functor {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ X Y : C, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] [DGCategory C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    [Preadditive D] [∀ X Y : D, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] [DGCategory D]
    [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C]
    [CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D]
    {F G : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [F.IsDGFunctor] [G.Additive] [G.IsDGFunctor] (h : F = G) :
    DGCategory.K0.map.{w₂, w} F = DGCategory.K0.map.{w₂, w} G
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.K0Map_ofDGRingHom_mapCompactK0
statement:
theorem K0Map_ofDGRingHom_mapCompactK0 (y : BaseK0.{u, u} A) :
    (HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.ofDGRingHom φ).K0Map (mapCompactK0.{u, u, u} A y) =
      mapCompactK0.{u, u, u} B (DGRing.K0.map φ y)
proof:
:= by
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj A)
  let := CatModule.HasDerivedCategory.small.{u} (SingleObj B)
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (DGRing.K0.singleObjEquiv A).surjective y
  change _ = mapCompactK0.{u, u, u} B (DGRing.K0.singleObjEquiv B
    (DGCategory.K0.map φ.singleObjFunctor ((DGRing.K0.singleObjEquiv A).symm
      (DGRing.K0.singleObjEquiv A z))))
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply, mapCompactK0_singleObjEquiv, mapCompactK0_singleObjEquiv,
    HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.K0Map_apply, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    ← DGCategory.K0.map_comp, ← DGCategory.K0.map_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f z) (DGCategory.K0.map_congr_functor (scalarInclusion_comp_weightFunctor φ))

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_K0Map_ofDGRingHom
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_K0Map_ofDGRingHom (x : DiagK0.{u, u} A) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{u, u, u} B ((HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.ofDGRingHom φ).K0Map x) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (DGRing.K0.map φ).toIntLinearMap (K0LinearEquiv.{u, u, u} A x)
proof:
:=
  K0LinearEquiv_linearMap A B _ _ (K0Map_ofDGRingHom_mapCompactK0 φ) x

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap_ofDGRingHom
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap_ofDGRingHom
    (s : HalfGradedDGRing.SuperK0c.{u, u} (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A)) :
    superK0LinearEquiv.{u, u, u} B
      (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap _ _ (HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.ofDGRingHom φ).K0Map s) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (DGRing.K0.map φ).toIntLinearMap (superK0LinearEquiv.{u, u, u} A s)
proof:
:=
  superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap_linearMap A B _ _ (K0Map_ofDGRingHom_mapCompactK0 φ) s

name: DG.diagonalDegree_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalDegree_apply (n : ℤ) :
    diagonalDegree n = (2 * n, (n : ZMod 2))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.diagonalDegree_injective
statement: theorem diagonalDegree_injective : Function.Injective diagonalDegree
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  have := congrArg Prod.fst h
  simp only [diagonalDegree_apply] at this
  omega

name: DG.diagonalDegree_one
statement: @[simp] theorem diagonalDegree_one : diagonalDegree 1 = (2, 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: DG.koszulSign_eq_of_cast_eq
statement:
theorem koszulSign_eq_of_cast_eq {m n : ℤ} (h : (m : ZMod 2) = (n : ZMod 2)) :
    koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:= by
  apply (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).2
  apply Int.even_iff.mpr
  have hmod := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff' m n 2).mp h
  omega

name: DG.Diagonal.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} {P : M → Prop} {a : M}
    (ha : a ∈ grading M p) (zero : P 0)
    (homogeneous : ∀ n (a : M), a ∈ DG.grading n → diagonalDegree n = p → P a)
    (add : ∀ a b, P a → P b → P (a + b)) : P a
proof:
:= by
  let e := decomposeAddEquiv (DG.grading (M := M))
  have h : P (e.symm (e a)) := by
    apply coarseGrading_induction (β := fun n => DG.grading (M := M) n)
      (f := diagonalDegree) (P := fun x => P (e.symm x))
      (by simpa using zero) (fun n a hn => ?_)
      (fun x y hx hy => by simpa only [map_add] using add _ _ hx hy) ha
    simpa only [e, decomposeAddEquiv_symm_apply, decompose_symm_of] using
      homogeneous n a a.2 hn
  simpa using h

name: DG.Diagonal.mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_grading {n : ℤ} {a : M} (ha : a ∈ DG.grading n) :
    a ∈ grading M (diagonalDegree n)
proof:
:= by
  change decompose (DG.grading (M := M)) a ∈
    coarseGrading (fun n => DG.grading (M := M) n) diagonalDegree (diagonalDegree n)
  rw [decompose_of_mem _ ha]
  exact of_mem_coarseGrading (β := fun n => DG.grading (M := M) n)
    (f := diagonalDegree) n ⟨a, ha⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.grading_diagonal
statement:
@[simp] theorem grading_diagonal (n : ℤ) :
    grading M (diagonalDegree n) = DG.grading (M := M) n
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · intro ha
    exact induction_on ha (zero_mem _) (fun m b hb h =>
      diagonalDegree_injective h ▸ hb) (fun _ _ => add_mem)
  · exact mem_grading

name: DG.Diagonal.grading_eq_bot
statement:
theorem grading_eq_bot {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} (hp : p ∉ Set.range diagonalDegree) :
    grading M p = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  change a ∈ grading M p ↔ a = 0
  constructor
  · intro ha
    exact induction_on ha rfl (fun n _ _ hn => False.elim (hp ⟨n, hn⟩))
      (fun _ _ hx hy => by simp [hx, hy])
  · rintro rfl
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.Diagonal.coe_decompose
statement:
theorem coe_decompose (a : M) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading M) a (diagonalDegree n) : M) =
      (decompose (DG.grading (M := M)) a n : M)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rename_i m
    by_cases h : m = n
    · subst n
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ (mem_grading a.2), decompose_of_mem_same _ a.2]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ (mem_grading a.2)
        (fun he => h (diagonalDegree_injective he)), decompose_of_mem_ne _ a.2 h]
  | h_add a b ha hb =>
    simp only [decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, ha, hb]

name: DG.Diagonal.d_mem
statement:
theorem d_mem {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} {a : M} (ha : a ∈ grading M p) :
    d a ∈ grading M (p + (2, 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (P := fun x => d x ∈ grading M (p + (2, 1))) ha
    (by simp) (fun n a ha hn => ?_)
    (fun _ _ hx hy => by simpa only [d_add] using add_mem hx hy)
  rw [← hn, ← diagonalDegree_one, ← map_add]
  exact mem_grading (DG.d_mem ha)

name: DG.Diagonal.smul_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (P := fun x => x • m ∈ grading M (p + q)) ha
    (by simp) (fun i a ha hi => ?_)
    (fun _ _ hx hy => by simpa only [add_smul] using add_mem hx hy)
  refine induction_on (P := fun y => a • y ∈ grading M (p + q)) hm
    (by simp) (fun j m hm hj => ?_)
    (fun _ _ hx hy => by simpa only [smul_add] using add_mem hx hy)
  rw [← hi, ← hj, ← map_add]
  exact mem_grading (smul_mem_grading ha hm)

name: DG.Diagonal.d_smul
statement:
theorem d_smul {j n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading A (j, (n : ZMod 2))) (m : M) :
    d (a • m) = d a • m + koszulSign n • (a • d m)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on ha (by simp) (fun i a ha hi => ?_)
    (fun _ _ hx hy => by
      simp only [add_smul, d_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
      abel)
  rw [DG.d_smul ha, koszulSign_eq_of_cast_eq (congrArg Prod.snd hi)]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing_hd
statement: @[simp] theorem ofDGRing_hd : (ofDGRing A).hd = d
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing_hgrading
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofDGRing_hgrading (n : ℤ) :
    (ofDGRing A).hgrading (2 * n, (n : ZMod 2)) = DG.grading (M := A) n
proof:
:=
  Diagonal.grading_diagonal n

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing_hgrading_halfDegree_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofDGRing_hgrading_halfDegree_zero (n : ℤ) :
    (ofDGRing A).hgrading (halfDegree 2 (n, 0)) = DG.grading (M := A) n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [halfDegree_apply, zero_add, mul_comm] using ofDGRing_hgrading A n

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing_hgrading_eq_bot
statement:
theorem ofDGRing_hgrading_eq_bot {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} (hp : p ∉ Set.range diagonalDegree) :
    (ofDGRing A).hgrading p = ⊥
proof: := Diagonal.grading_eq_bot hp

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerivedCompact_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem toDerivedCompact_obj
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{v} (DerivedCategory.{w, v} A)).FullSubcategory) :
    ((toDerivedCompact.{w', w, v} A).obj X).obj = (toDerived A).obj X.obj
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.mapCompactK0_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapCompactK0_mk
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{v} (DerivedCategory.{w, v} A)).FullSubcategory) :
    mapCompactK0.{w', w, v} A (K0.mk X) = K0.mk ((toDerivedCompact A).obj X)
proof:
:=
  K0.mapCompact_mk _ _ X

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.decompose_hd
statement:
theorem decompose_hd (x : A) (p : ℤ × ZMod 2) :
    (decompose H.hgrading (H.hd x) (p + (k, 1)) : A) = H.hd (decompose H.hgrading x p)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn H.hgrading with
  | zero => simp
  | @homogeneous q m =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := m
    obtain ⟨q₁, q₂⟩ := q
    have hdx : H.hd x ∈ H.hgrading ((q₁, q₂) + (k, 1)) := H.hd_mem hx
    change (decompose H.hgrading (H.hd x) (p + (k, 1)) : A) = H.hd (decompose H.hgrading x p)
    by_cases hq : (q₁, q₂) = p
    · subst hq
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hdx, decompose_of_mem_same _ hx]
    · have hq' : (q₁, q₂) + (k, 1) ≠ p + (k, 1) := fun h => hq (add_right_cancel h)
      rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hdx hq', decompose_of_mem_ne _ hx hq, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hx, hy,
      decompose_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, map_add]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.exists_mem_hd_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_mem_hd_eq_one {x : A} (hx : H.hd x = 1) :
    ∃ y ∈ H.hgrading (-k, 1), H.hd y = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨decompose H.hgrading x (-k, 1), (decompose H.hgrading x (-k, 1)).2, ?_⟩
  rw [← decompose_hd, hx, show ((-k, 1) : ℤ × ZMod 2) + (k, 1) = 0 by
    ext
    · simp
    · show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0
      rfl]
  exact decompose_of_mem_same _ (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := H.hgrading))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.halfDegree_neg_one_zero
statement: theorem halfDegree_neg_one_zero : halfDegree k (-1, 0) = (-k, 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp
  · show ((-1 : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = 1
    rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.d_contraction
statement:
theorem d_contraction {y : A} (hy : y ∈ H.hgrading (-k, 1)) (h1 : H.hd y = 1) :
    d (H.contraction hy) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [contraction, d_place, one_eq_place]
  exact place_congr (by simp) h1 _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.contractionHom_mem
statement:
theorem contractionHom_mem {y : A} (hy : y ∈ H.hgrading (-k, 1)) (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) :
    H.contractionHom hy i ∈ grading (-1)
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mpr (place_mem_grading (-1, 0) _)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.d_contractionHom
statement:
theorem d_contractionHom {y : A} (hy : y ∈ H.hgrading (-k, 1)) (h1 : H.hd y = 1)
    (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) : d (H.contractionHom hy i) = 𝟙 i
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext ((WeightCategory.d_val _).trans (H.d_contraction hy h1))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isAcyclic_of_hd_eq_one
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_of_hd_eq_one {x : A} (hx : H.hd x = 1)
    (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) : CatModule.IsAcyclic M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, h1⟩ := H.exists_mem_hd_eq_one hx
  intro i
  refine isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun n m hm hdm => ⟨H.contractionHom hy i • m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := CatModule.smul_mem_grading (H.contractionHom_mem hy i) hm
    rwa [show -1 + n = n - 1 by ring] at this
  · rw [CatModule.d_smul (H.contractionHom_mem hy i), d_contractionHom H hy h1, hdm,
      CatModule.smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero, CatModule.id_smul]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isZero_of_hd_eq_one
statement:
theorem isZero_of_hd_eq_one {x : A} (hx : H.hd x = 1)
    (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) : IsZero X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, ⟨e⟩⟩ := CatModule.DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj X
  exact ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.isZero_Q_obj_iff M).mpr
    (H.isAcyclic_of_hd_eq_one hx M)).of_iso e

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.compactK0_subsingleton
statement: theorem compactK0_subsingleton {x : A} (hx : H.hd x = 1) : Subsingleton (CompactK0.{w', w} H)
proof:
:= by
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun z => ?_
  induction z using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | mk X => exact K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero
      (compactSubcategory _).ι X (H.isZero_of_hd_eq_one hx X.obj))
  | neg z hz => rw [hz, neg_zero]
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [hz, hz', add_zero]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0c_subsingleton
statement: theorem superK0c_subsingleton {x : A} (hx : H.hd x = 1) : Subsingleton (SuperK0c.{w', w} H)
proof:
:= by
  have := H.compactK0_subsingleton hx
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun s => ?_
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := superK0cMk_surjective H s
  rw [Subsingleton.elim z 0, map_zero]

name: DG.IsCompact.of_map_of_fullyFaithful
proof:
:= by
  intro ι _ Y _
  have hc := isColimitCofanMkObjOfIsColimit F _ _ (coproductIsCoproduct Y)
  have : HasCoproduct fun i => F.obj (Y i) := ⟨⟨_, hc⟩⟩
  let E := hc.coconePointUniqueUpToIso (colimit.isColimit _)
  have hE : ∀ i, F.map (Sigma.ι Y i) ≫ E.hom = Sigma.ι (fun i => F.obj (Y i)) i := fun i =>
    hc.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom (colimit.isColimit _) ⟨i⟩
  let eF : ∀ i, (X ⟶ Y i) ≃+ (F.obj X ⟶ F.obj (Y i)) := fun i =>
    AddEquiv.mk' hF.homEquiv (fun f g => by simp)
  let e : (DirectSum ι fun i => (X ⟶ Y i)) ≃+ DirectSum ι fun i => (F.obj X ⟶ F.obj (Y i)) :=
    DFinsupp.mapRange.addEquiv eF
  have key : ∀ a, F.map (coproductComparison X Y a) ≫ E.hom =
      coproductComparison (F.obj X) (fun i => F.obj (Y i)) (e a) := by
    intro a
    induction a using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of i f =>
      have he : e (DirectSum.of _ i f) = DirectSum.of _ i (F.map f) := by
        change DFinsupp.mapRange (fun i => eF i) (fun i => map_zero _)
          (DFinsupp.single i f) = DFinsupp.single i _
        rw [DFinsupp.mapRange_single]
        rfl
      rw [he, coproductComparison_of, coproductComparison_of, F.map_comp, Category.assoc, hE]
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, F.map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]
  have hk : ⇑(coproductComparison X Y) = hF.homEquiv.symm ∘ (fun a => a ≫ E.inv) ∘
      coproductComparison (F.obj X) (fun i => F.obj (Y i)) ∘ e := by
    funext a
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, ← key, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    exact (hF.homEquiv.symm_apply_apply _).symm
  have hE' : Function.Bijective fun a : F.obj X ⟶ ∐ fun i => F.obj (Y i) => a ≫ E.inv :=
    Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr ⟨fun a => a ≫ E.hom, fun a => by simp, fun a => by simp⟩
  rw [hk]
  exact hF.homEquiv.symm.bijective.comp (hE'.comp ((hX ι _).comp e.bijective))

name: DG.Diagonal.sumMap_app
statement:
theorem sumMap_app {X Y M : CatModule.{v} C} (f : X ⟶ M) (g : Y ⟶ M) (Z : C)
    (m : (CatModule.prod X Y).obj Z) : (sumMap f g).app Z m = f.app Z m.1 + g.app Z m.2
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.sumMap_app_bijective_left
statement:
theorem sumMap_app_bijective_left {X Y M : CatModule.{v} C} (f : X ⟶ M) (g : Y ⟶ M) (Z : C)
    (hf : Function.Bijective (f.app Z)) [Subsingleton (Y.obj Z)] :
    Function.Bijective ((sumMap f g).app Z)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ∀ y, g.app Z y = 0 := fun y => by rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, map_zero]
  refine ⟨fun m m' h => ?_, fun n => ?_⟩
  · rw [sumMap_app, sumMap_app, hg, hg, add_zero, add_zero] at h
    exact Prod.ext (hf.1 h) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hf.2 n
    exact ⟨((x, 0) : X.obj Z × Y.obj Z), by rw [sumMap_app, hg, add_zero]⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.sumMap_app_bijective_right
statement:
theorem sumMap_app_bijective_right {X Y M : CatModule.{v} C} (f : X ⟶ M) (g : Y ⟶ M) (Z : C)
    [Subsingleton (X.obj Z)] (hg : Function.Bijective (g.app Z)) :
    Function.Bijective ((sumMap f g).app Z)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ x, f.app Z x = 0 := fun x => by rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, map_zero]
  refine ⟨fun m m' h => ?_, fun n => ?_⟩
  · rw [sumMap_app, sumMap_app, hf, hf, zero_add, zero_add] at h
    exact Prod.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (hg.1 h)
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hg.2 n
    exact ⟨((0, y) : X.obj Z × Y.obj Z), by rw [sumMap_app, hf, zero_add]⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.block_subsingleton
statement:
theorem block_subsingleton (r w : ℤ) (h : ¬ ∃ t : ℤ, w + -r = 4 * t)
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    Subsingleton ((block A r M).obj ⟨w⟩)
proof:
:=
  value_subsingleton A _ (w + -r) h

name: DG.Diagonal.blockι_app_bijective
statement:
theorem blockι_app_bijective (r w t : ℤ) (h : w + -r = 4 * t)
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    Function.Bijective ((blockι A r M).app ⟨w⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have he := (CatModule.isIso_iff_bijective (shiftModuleCancelIso A r M).hom).mp inferInstance ⟨w⟩
  have hc : ∀ j, j = 4 * t → Function.Bijective
      (counitApp A ((shiftModule A r).obj M) j) := by
    rintro _ rfl
    exact counitApp_supported_bijective A _ t
  exact he.comp (hc (w + -r) h)

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_of_isCompact_toDerived
statement:
theorem isCompact_of_isCompact_toDerived {Y : DerivedCategory.{w, v} A}
    (h : IsCompact.{v} ((toDerived.{w', w, v} A).obj Y)) : IsCompact.{v} Y
proof:
:=
  IsCompact.of_map_of_fullyFaithful (toDerivedFullyFaithful A) h

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_blockDerived
statement:
theorem isCompact_blockDerived
    {X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)}
    (hX : IsCompact.{v} X) :
    IsCompact.{v} ((blockDerived.{w', w} A 0).obj X) ∧
      IsCompact.{v} ((blockDerived.{w', w} A 1).obj X) ∧
      IsCompact.{v} ((blockDerived.{w', w} A 2).obj X) ∧
      IsCompact.{v} ((blockDerived.{w', w} A 3).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hX.of_iso (blocksDerivedIso.{w', w} A X).symm
  exact ⟨h.of_biprod_left, h.of_biprod_right.of_biprod_left,
    h.of_biprod_right.of_biprod_right.of_biprod_left,
    h.of_biprod_right.of_biprod_right.of_biprod_right⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_recoveryDerived
proof:
:= by
  have h := (isCompact_blockDerived.{w', w} A hX).1
  rw [blockDerived, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.comp_obj,
    CatModule.DerivedCategory.isCompact_internalShift_obj_iff] at h
  exact (isCompact_of_isCompact_toDerived A h).of_iso
    ((recoveryDerived A 0).mapIso
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftZeroIso _).app X)).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_toDerived
statement:
theorem isCompact_toDerived {X : DerivedCategory.{w, v} A} (hX : IsCompact.{v} X) :
    IsCompact.{v} ((toDerived.{w', w, v} A).obj X)
proof:
:=
  hX.map_of_adjunction (diagonalDerivedAdjunction A)

name: DG.Diagonal.regularRegradedEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem regularRegradedEquiv_smul
    (a : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) (m : RegradedModule A) :
    regularRegradedEquiv A (a • m) = a * regularRegradedEquiv A m
proof:
:= by
  induction a using HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [add_smul, map_add, add_mul, ha, hb]
  | mk p a ha =>
    induction m using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [smul_add, map_add, mul_add, hx, hy]
    | mk q m hm =>
      rw [place_smul_mk]
      change (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place (p + q) (a * m) _ =
        (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place p a ha *
          (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place q m hm
      exact (HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_place ha hm).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.regularToRepresentable_bijective
statement:
theorem regularToRepresentable_bijective
    (X : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) :
    Function.Bijective ((regularToRepresentable A).app X)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    have he := congrArg
      (fun z : (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) ⟶ X => z.1) h
    exact Subtype.ext he
  · intro y
    refine ⟨⟨(regularRegradedEquiv A).symm y.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · change y.1 ∈ HalfRegrade.weightGrading (grading A) 2 X.as
      have hy := y.2
      change y.1 ∈ HalfRegrade.weightGrading (grading A) 2 (X.as - 0) at hy
      simpa only [sub_zero] using hy
    · exact Subtype.ext ((regularRegradedEquiv A).apply_symm_apply y.1)

name: DG.Diagonal.regularRepresentableIso_hom_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularRepresentableIso_hom_mk (p : ℤ × ℤ) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ grading A (halfDegree 2 p)) :
    ((regularRepresentableIso A).hom.app ⟨p.2⟩
      ⟨HalfRegrade.mk (grading A) 2 p a ha, HalfRegrade.mk_mem_weightGrading p _⟩).1 =
      (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place p a ha
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_Q_diagonalRegular
statement:
theorem isCompact_Q_diagonalRegular :
    IsCompact.{u} (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((toCatModule A).obj (DGModuleCat.of A A)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := CatModule.DerivedCategory.isCompact_Q_obj
    (CatModule.isCornerGenerator_representable
      (⟨0⟩ : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded))
  exact h.of_iso (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (regularRepresentableIso A))

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_toDerived_regular
statement:
theorem isCompact_toDerived_regular :
    IsCompact.{u} ((toDerived A).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A A)))
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_Q_diagonalRegular A).of_iso (toDerivedObjIso A (DGModuleCat.of A A))

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicUnit_act_toWeightZero
statement:
theorem periodicUnit_act_toWeightZero (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (n t : ℤ)
    (m : DG.grading (M := M) (n + 2 * t)) :
    ((toCatModule A).obj M).act (periodicUnit A t)
      (toWeightZero A M (n + 2 * t) m) = supportedElement A M n t m
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place _ 1 _ •
    HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 _ m.1 _ = _
  rw [place_smul_mk]
  exact HalfRegrade.mk_congr (by ext <;> dsimp <;> ring) (one_smul A m.1) _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonal_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply CatModule.Hom.ext
  rintro ⟨w⟩ x
  by_cases hw : ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t
  · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hw
    induction x using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => exact (f.app _).map_zero.trans (g.app _).map_zero.symm
    | h_add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
    | @h_homogeneous n x =>
      have hx : x.1 = supportedElement A M n t
          ⟨valueEvaluation A M (4 * t) x.1, valueEvaluation_mem A M x.2⟩ := by
        apply valueEvaluation_injective_degree A M x.2 (supportedElement_mem A M n t _)
        simp
      rw [hx, ← periodicUnit_act_toWeightZero A M]
      exact (f.map_smul (periodicUnit A t) _).trans
        ((congrArg (((toCatModule A).obj N).act (periodicUnit A t)) (h _)).trans
          (g.map_smul (periodicUnit A t) _).symm)
  · let := value_subsingleton A N w hw
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.map_diagonalPreimage
proof:
:= by
  apply diagonal_hom_ext A
  have h := (recoveryNatIso A).hom.naturality (diagonalPreimage A f)
  change (recover A 0).map ((toCatModule A).map (diagonalPreimage A f)) ≫
    (recoveryIso A N).hom = (recoveryIso A M).hom ≫ diagonalPreimage A f at h
  have hh : (recover A 0).map ((toCatModule A).map (diagonalPreimage A f)) =
      (recover A 0).map f := by
    apply (cancel_mono (recoveryIso A N).hom).mp
    simpa [diagonalPreimage] using h
  intro x
  exact congrArg (fun k => k.hom x) hh

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalPreimage_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalPreimage_map {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    diagonalPreimage A ((toCatModule A).map f) = f
proof:
:=
  (toCatModule A).map_injective (map_diagonalPreimage A _)

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicUnit_mem
statement: theorem periodicUnit_mem (t : ℤ) : periodicUnit A t ∈ DG.grading (-2 * t)
proof:
:=
  (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place_mem_grading (-2 * t, 4 * t) _

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicUnit_d
statement: @[simp] theorem periodicUnit_d (t : ℤ) : d (periodicUnit A t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change d ((HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place (-2 * t, 4 * t) 1 _) = 0
  rw [HalfGradedDGRing.d_place]
  simp only [HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing_hd, d_one, HalfGradedDGRing.place_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCounit_mem
statement:
theorem supportedCounit_mem (N : CatModule.{v}
    (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (t : ℤ)
    {n : ℤ} {x : Value A ((recover A 0).obj N) (4 * t)} (hx : x ∈ DG.grading n) :
    supportedCounit A N t x ∈ DG.grading n
proof:
:= by
  have h := N.act_mem' (periodicUnit_mem A t)
    (valueEvaluation_mem A ((recover A 0).obj N) hx)
  rw [show -2 * t + (n + 2 * t) = n by ring] at h
  exact h

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCounit_d
statement:
theorem supportedCounit_d (N : CatModule.{v}
    (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (t : ℤ)
    (x : Value A ((recover A 0).obj N) (4 * t)) :
    supportedCounit A N t (d x) = d (supportedCounit A N t x)
proof:
:= by
  change N.act (periodicUnit A t) (valueEvaluation A ((recover A 0).obj N) (4 * t) (d x)) = _
  rw [valueEvaluation_d]
  change _ = d (N.act (periodicUnit A t) _)
  rw [N.d_act' (periodicUnit_mem A t), periodicUnit_d, map_zero,
    AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, zero_add]
  rw [show koszulSign (-2 * t) = 1 from koszulSign_even ⟨-t, by ring⟩, one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCounit_supportedElement
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportedCounit_supportedElement (N : CatModule.{v}
    (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (n t : ℤ)
    (m : DG.grading (M := (recover A 0).obj N) (n + 2 * t)) :
    supportedCounit A N t (supportedElement A ((recover A 0).obj N) n t m) =
      N.act (periodicUnit A t) m.1
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (N.act (periodicUnit A t))
    (valueEvaluation_supportedElement A ((recover A 0).obj N) n t m)

name: DG.Diagonal.scalarHom_comp_periodicUnit
statement:
theorem scalarHom_comp_periodicUnit (t : ℤ) (a : A) :
    scalarHom A 0 a ≫ periodicUnit A t = periodicUnit A t ≫ scalarHom A (4 * t) a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.comp_add, ha, hb]
  | @h_homogeneous n a =>
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [WeightCategory.comp_val, scalarHom_homogeneous A 0 n _ a.2,
      scalarHom_homogeneous A (4 * t) n _ a.2, periodicUnit,
      HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_place, one_mul, mul_one]
    exact HalfGradedDGRing.place_congr (by ext <;> dsimp <;> ring) rfl _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCounit_scalarHom
statement:
theorem supportedCounit_scalarHom (N : CatModule.{v}
    (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (t : ℤ) (a : A)
    (x : Value A ((recover A 0).obj N) (4 * t)) :
    supportedCounit A N t
      (((toCatModule A).obj ((recover A 0).obj N)).act (scalarHom A (4 * t) a) x) =
      N.act (scalarHom A (4 * t) a) (supportedCounit A N t x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (congrArg (N.act (periodicUnit A t))
    (valueEvaluation_scalarHom A ((recover A 0).obj N) (4 * t) a x)).trans ?_
  change N.act (periodicUnit A t) (N.act (scalarHom A 0 a) _) = _
  rw [← N.act_comp', scalarHom_comp_periodicUnit, N.act_comp']
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCounit_naturality
statement:
theorem supportedCounit_naturality
    {N P : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)}
    (f : N ⟶ P) (t : ℤ) (x : Value A ((recover A 0).obj N) (4 * t)) :
    f.app ⟨4 * t⟩ (supportedCounit A N t x) =
      supportedCounit A P t
        (((toCatModule A).map ((recover A 0).map f)).app ⟨4 * t⟩ x)
proof:
:= by
  exact (f.map_smul (periodicUnit A t) _).trans
    (congrArg (P.act (periodicUnit A t))
      (evaluation_regradedMap ((recover A 0).map f) x.1).symm)

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicUnit_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem periodicUnit_zero : periodicUnit A 0 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [periodicUnit, mul_zero]
  exact HalfGradedDGRing.one_eq_place.symm

name: DG.Diagonal.evaluation_smul
statement:
theorem evaluation_smul (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A)
    (a : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) (x : RegradedModule M) :
    evaluation (a • x) = evaluation (M := A) a • evaluation x
proof:
:= by
  induction a using HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [add_smul, map_add, ha, hb]
  | mk p a ha =>
    induction x using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
    | mk q m hm =>
      rw [place_smul_mk, evaluation_mk]
      change a • m = evaluation (HalfRegrade.mk (grading A) 2 p a ha) •
        evaluation (HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 q m hm)
      rw [evaluation_mk, evaluation_mk]

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicUnit_comp
statement:
theorem periodicUnit_comp (s t : ℤ)
    (f : (⟨4 * s⟩ : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) ⟶ ⟨4 * t⟩) :
    periodicUnit A s ≫ f = scalarHom A 0 (evaluation (M := A) f.1) ≫ periodicUnit A t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change f.1 * (periodicUnit A s).1 =
    (periodicUnit A t).1 * (scalarHom A 0 (evaluation (M := A) f.1)).1
  refine HalfGradedDGRing.wgrading_induction
    (P := fun x : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded => x * (periodicUnit A s).1 =
      (periodicUnit A t).1 * (scalarHom A 0 (evaluation (M := A) x)).1)
    (by simp) (fun n a ha => ?_)
    (fun x y hx hy => by simp only [add_mul, map_add, WeightCategory.add_val, mul_add, hx, hy]) f.2
  have ha' : a ∈ DG.grading (n + 2 * (t - s)) := by
    change a ∈ halfGrading (grading A) 2 (n, 4 * t - 4 * s) at ha
    rw [show 4 * t - 4 * s = 4 * (t - s) by ring, halfGrading_supported] at ha
    exact ha
  change _ = (periodicUnit A t).1 *
    (scalarHom A 0 (evaluation (HalfRegrade.mk (grading A) 2 (n, 4 * t - 4 * s) a ha))).1
  rw [evaluation_mk, scalarHom_homogeneous A 0 _ a ha']
  simp only [periodicUnit, HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_place, mul_one, one_mul]
  exact HalfGradedDGRing.place_congr (by ext <;> dsimp <;> ring) rfl _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCounit_act
statement:
theorem supportedCounit_act (N : CatModule.{v}
    (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (s t : ℤ)
    (f : (⟨4 * s⟩ : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) ⟶ ⟨4 * t⟩)
    (x : Value A ((recover A 0).obj N) (4 * s)) :
    supportedCounit A N t (((toCatModule A).obj ((recover A 0).obj N)).act f x) =
      N.act f (supportedCounit A N s x)
proof:
:= by
  refine (congrArg (N.act (periodicUnit A t))
    (evaluation_smul A ((recover A 0).obj N) f.1 x.1)).trans ?_
  change N.act (periodicUnit A t) (N.act (scalarHom A 0 _) _) = _
  rw [← N.act_comp', ← periodicUnit_comp, N.act_comp']
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.counitApp_supported
proof:
:= by
  unfold counitApp
  split
  · apply eq_of_heq
    apply (cast_heq _ _).trans
    congr 1
    omega
  · omega

name: DG.Diagonal.counitApp_unsupported
proof:
:= by
  rw [counitApp, dite_eq_right (fun h => hw ⟨w / 4, h.symm⟩)]

name: DG.Diagonal.weightHom_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have he := (value_subsingleton A (DGModuleCat.of A A) (t - s) h).elim
    (⟨f.1, f.2⟩ : Value A (DGModuleCat.of A A) (t - s)) 0
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg
    (fun x : Value A (DGModuleCat.of A A) (t - s) => x.1) he)

name: DG.Diagonal.recover_counitMap
proof:
:= by
  apply DGModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply DGModuleHom.ext
  intro x
  change counitApp A N (4 * 0) x = valueEvaluation A ((recover A 0).obj N) 0 x
  rw [counitApp_supported]
  change N.act (periodicUnit A 0) _ = _
  rw [periodicUnit_zero]
  exact N.act_id' _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalDerivedConeIso_hom
statement:
theorem diagonalDerivedConeIso_hom (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (diagonalDerivedConeIso A f).hom =
      (toDerivedObjIso A (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))).hom ≫
        CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map (diagonalConeIso A f).hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalDerivedConeIso_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem diagonalDerivedConeIso_naturality {f : M ⟶ N} {f' : M' ⟶ N'}
    (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') (h : f ≫ b = a ≫ f') :
    (toDerived A).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
      (M := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f'.hom))
      (Cone.map a.hom b.hom (congrArg DGModuleCat.Hom.hom h)))) ≫
        (diagonalDerivedConeIso A f').hom =
      (diagonalDerivedConeIso A f).hom ≫
        CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (CatModule.cone.map ((toCatModule A).map a) ((toCatModule A).map b)
            (by simpa only [← Functor.map_comp] using congrArg (toCatModule A).map h))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [diagonalDerivedConeIso_hom, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [toDerived_map_Q]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [diagonalConeIso_naturality A a b h]

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso_hom₁
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso_hom₁ (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso A f).hom.hom₁ = (toDerivedObjIso A M).hom
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ (toDerivedObjIso A M).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫
    CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map (𝟙 _) = _
  simp only [Category.id_comp]
  rw [CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso_hom₂
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso_hom₂ (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso A f).hom.hom₂ = (toDerivedObjIso A N).hom
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ (toDerivedObjIso A N).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫
    CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map (𝟙 _) = _
  simp only [Category.id_comp]
  rw [CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso_hom₃
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso_hom₃ (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (diagonalDerivedConeTriangleIso A f).hom.hom₃ = (diagonalDerivedConeIso A f).hom
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ (toDerivedObjIso A (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫
    CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map (diagonalConeIso A f).hom = _
  simp only [Category.id_comp, diagonalDerivedConeIso_hom]

name: DG.Diagonal.cohomologyMap_recover
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_recover (s : ℤ)
    {M N : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomology.map ((recover A s).map f).hom n = CatModule.cohomologyMap f ⟨s⟩ n
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.isQuasiIso_recover
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_recover (s : ℤ)
    {M N : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (hf : CatModule.IsQuasiIso f) :
    ((recover A s).map f).hom.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [cohomologyMap_recover]
  exact hf ⟨s⟩ n

name: DG.Diagonal.recoverCompQ_inverts
statement:
theorem recoverCompQ_inverts (s : ℤ) :
    (CatModule.quasiIso (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)).IsInvertedBy
      (recover.{v} A s ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro M N f hf
  exact (DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr (isQuasiIso_recover A s f hf)

name: DG.Diagonal.recoveryDerived_map_Q
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem recoveryDerived_map_Q (s : ℤ)
    {M N : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)}
    (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (recoveryDerived A s).map (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map f) ≫
        (recoveryDerivedObjIso A s N).hom =
      (recoveryDerivedObjIso A s M).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((recover A s).map f)
proof:
:=
  (QCompRecoveryDerivedIso A s).hom.naturality f

name: DG.Diagonal.derivedRecoveryNatIso_hom_app_Q
statement:
theorem derivedRecoveryNatIso_hom_app_Q (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    (derivedRecoveryNatIso A).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M) =
      (recoveryDerived A 0).map (toDerivedObjIso A M).hom ≫
        (recoveryDerivedObjIso A 0 ((toCatModule A).obj M)).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (recoveryIso A M).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp [derivedRecoveryNatIso, Localization.liftNatIso_hom,
    Localization.liftNatTrans_app, QCompToDerivedRecoveryIso,
    toDerivedObjIso, recoveryDerivedObjIso, recoveryNatIso]

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerived_map_injective
statement:
theorem toDerived_map_injective {M N : DerivedCategory.{w, v} A}
    {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : (toDerived A).map f = (toDerived A).map g) : f = g
proof:
:=
  (toDerived A).map_injective h

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isPositive_ofSuper
statement:
theorem isPositive_ofSuper {k : ℤ} (hk : 0 < k) (h : IsGradedSemisimpleRing ℬ) :
    (ofSuper ℬ k).IsPositive where
  pos
proof:
:= hk
  eq_zero_of_lt _ hj ha := eq_zero_of_mem_superGrading hj ha
  isGradedSemisimple := isGradedSemisimpleRing_internalZeroGrading_ofSuper k h
  hd_eq_zero _ := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isPositive_ofSuper_superMatrix
proof:
:=
  isPositive_ofSuper hk (isGradedSemisimpleRing_superMatrix D m n)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isPositive_ofSuper_queerMatrix
statement:
theorem isPositive_ofSuper_queerMatrix (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ) {k : ℤ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    (ofSuper (matrixGrading (groupAlgebraGrading K (ZMod 2)) (0 : Fin n → ZMod 2)) k).IsPositive

:=
  isPositive_ofSuper hk (isGradedSemisimpleRing_queerMatrix K n)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.halfDegree_one_neg
statement: theorem halfDegree_one_neg (k : ℤ) : halfDegree k ((1 : ℤ), -k) = ((0 : ℤ), (1 : ZMod 2))
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext (by simp) (by simp)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.halfDegree_neg_one
statement: theorem halfDegree_neg_one (k : ℤ) : halfDegree k ((-1 : ℤ), k) = ((0 : ℤ), (1 : ZMod 2))
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext (by simp) (by simp)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddHomInv_comp_oddHom
statement:
theorem oddHomInv_comp_oddHom (hc : c ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1)) (hc' : c' ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1))
    (h1 : c * c' = 1) (X : WeightCategory H.Regraded) :
    oddHomInv hc' X ≫ oddHom hc X = 𝟙 X
proof:
:= by
  refine WeightCategory.hom_ext ?_
  rw [WeightCategory.comp_val, WeightCategory.id_val]
  change H.place ((1 : ℤ), -k) c _ * H.place ((-1 : ℤ), k) c' _ = 1
  rw [place_mul_place, one_eq_place]
  exact place_congr (by simp) h1 _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.oddHom_mem_cocycles
statement:
theorem oddHom_mem_cocycles (hc : c ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1)) (X : WeightCategory H.Regraded) :
    oddHom hc X ∈ cocycles ((⟨X.as + k⟩ : WeightCategory H.Regraded) ⟶ X) 1
proof:
:=
  mem_cocycles.mpr ⟨WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mpr
      (place_mem_grading (H := H) ((1 : ℤ), -k) _),
    WeightCategory.hom_ext (by
      rw [WeightCategory.d_val]
      change d (H.place ((1 : ℤ), -k) c _) = 0
      rw [d_place]
      exact (place_congr rfl (hH.hd_eq_zero hc) _ _).trans (place_zero _))⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.T_neg_smul_cell
statement:
theorem T_neg_smul_cell (hc : c ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1)) (hc' : c' ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1))
    (h1 : c * c' = 1) (hce : ∀ {a : A}, a ∈ H.hgrading 0 → c' * a * c = a)
    {X : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (e : DGCategory.Idempotent X) :
    (T (-k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} e 0 =
      -DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} e 0
proof:
:= by
  let Y : WeightCategory H.Regraded := ⟨X.as + k⟩
  let f := WeightCategory.idempotentAt e Y
  have hT := WeightCategory.T_smul_cell.{max u w} (-k) e f (by
    change X.as + k = X.as - -k
    ring) rfl
  rw [hT]
  have hcell := DGCategory.K0.cell_eq_of_comp_eq.{max u w} (hH.oddHom_mem_cocycles hc X)
    (oddHomInv_comp_oddHom hc hc' h1 X) e f (by
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hea⟩ := exists_eq_place (H := H)
        (WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mp e.mem_grading)
        (WeightCategory.mem_wgrading_of_eq (sub_self _) e.val.2)
      have ha0 : a ∈ H.hgrading 0 := by
        rwa [show halfDegree k ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) = 0 from map_zero (halfDegree k)] at ha
      refine WeightCategory.hom_ext ?_
      rw [WeightCategory.comp_val, WeightCategory.comp_val]
      change e.val.1 = H.place ((-1 : ℤ), k) c' _ * e.val.1 * H.place ((1 : ℤ), -k) c _
      rw [hea, place_mul_place, place_mul_place]
      exact place_congr (by simp) (hce ha0).symm _ _)
  rw [hcell, Int.negOnePow_neg, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.neg_smul, one_smul]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.T_neg_smul_eq_neg
statement:
theorem T_neg_smul_eq_neg (hc : c ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1)) (hc' : c' ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1))
    (h1 : c * c' = 1) (hce : ∀ {a : A}, a ∈ H.hgrading 0 → c' * a * c = a)
    (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    (T (-k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = -x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ AddSubgroup.closure
      (Set.range fun c : DGCategory.Corner (WeightCategory H.Regraded) =>
        DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} c.2 0) := by
    rw [hH.closure_cell_eq_top.{w}]
    trivial
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact hH.T_neg_smul_cell hc hc' h1 hce e.2
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, neg_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add, hx, hy, neg_add]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [smul_neg, hx]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.mk_parityShiftCompact_eq_mk
statement:
theorem mk_parityShiftCompact_eq_mk (hc : c ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1))
    (hc' : c' ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1)) (h1 : c * c' = 1)
    (hce : ∀ {a : A}, a ∈ H.hgrading 0 → c' * a * c = a)
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    K0.mk (parityShiftCompact H X) = K0.mk X
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_parityShiftCompact.{max u w, w}, hH.T_neg_smul_eq_neg hc hc' h1 hce, neg_neg]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.cliffordGen_mem
statement: theorem cliffordGen_mem (k : ℤ) : cliffordGen K ∈ (clifford K k).hgrading (0, 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofSuper_hgrading, superGrading_zero]
  exact AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mem_grade _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.cliffordGen_mul_self
statement: theorem cliffordGen_mul_self : cliffordGen K * cliffordGen K = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one, AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isPositive_clifford
statement: theorem isPositive_clifford {k : ℤ} (hk : 0 < k) : (clifford K k).IsPositive
proof:
:=
  isPositive_ofSuper hk (isGradedDivisionRing_groupAlgebraGrading K (ZMod 2)).isGradedSemisimpleRing

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.clifford_odd_ne_zero
statement:
theorem clifford_odd_ne_zero (k : ℤ) :
    ∃ a ∈ (clifford K k).hgrading (0, 1), a ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨cliffordGen K, cliffordGen_mem k, fun h => one_ne_zero (by
    rw [← cliffordGen_mul_self (K := K), h, zero_mul])⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.clifford_T_neg_smul
statement:
theorem clifford_T_neg_smul (hk : 0 < k)
    (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory (clifford K k).Regraded)) :
    (T (-k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = -x
proof:
:=
  (isPositive_clifford hk).T_neg_smul_eq_neg (cliffordGen_mem k) (cliffordGen_mem k)
    cliffordGen_mul_self (fun {a} _ => by rw [mul_comm _ a, mul_assoc, cliffordGen_mul_self,
      mul_one]) x

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.clifford_mk_parityShiftCompact
statement:
theorem clifford_mk_parityShiftCompact (hk : 0 < k)
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w} (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{max u w, max u w}
      (WeightCategory (clifford K k).Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    K0.mk (parityShiftCompact (clifford K k) X) = K0.mk X
proof:
:=
  (isPositive_clifford hk).mk_parityShiftCompact_eq_mk (cliffordGen_mem k) (cliffordGen_mem k)
    cliffordGen_mul_self (fun {a} _ => by rw [mul_comm _ a, mul_assoc, cliffordGen_mul_self,
      mul_one]) X

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.T_two_mul_smul_compactK0
statement:
theorem T_two_mul_smul_compactK0 (x : CompactK0.{w', w} H) :
    (T (2 * k) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x : CompactK0.{w', w} H, (T (-(2 * k)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = x := by
    intro x
    induction x using K0.induction_on with
    | zero => exact smul_zero _
    | mk X =>
      have e := K0.mk_eq_of_iso ((compactSubcategory _).fullyFaithfulι.preimageIso
        (X := parityShiftCompact.{w', w} H (parityShiftCompact.{w', w} H X)) (Y := X)
        ((parityShiftDIso.{w'} H).app X.obj))
      rw [mk_parityShiftCompact, mk_parityShiftCompact, _root_.smul_neg, neg_neg, smul_smul,
        ← T_add] at e
      rw [show -(2 * k) = -k + -k by ring, e]
    | neg x hx => rw [_root_.smul_neg, hx]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [_root_.smul_add, hx, hy]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h x, smul_smul, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.T_two_mul_mul_smul_compactK0
statement:
theorem T_two_mul_mul_smul_compactK0 (m : ℤ) (x : CompactK0.{w', w} H) :
    (T (2 * k * m) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Int.induction_on generalizing x with
  | zero => rw [mul_zero, T_zero, one_smul]
  | succ m ih => rw [mul_add, mul_one, T_add, mul_smul, T_two_mul_smul_compactK0, ih]
  | pred m ih =>
    have := T_two_mul_smul_compactK0 H ((T (2 * k * (-(m : ℤ) - 1)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x)
    rw [smul_smul, ← T_add, show 2 * k + 2 * k * (-(m : ℤ) - 1) = 2 * k * -(m : ℤ) by ring,
      ih] at this
    exact this.symm

name: DG.Diagonal.recoveryK0_mk
statement:
theorem recoveryK0_mk (j : ℤ)
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u v} (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u v}
      (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    recoveryK0.{w', w, v} A j (K0.mk X) = K0.mk (⟨(recoveryDerived.{w', w} A 0).obj
      ((shiftDerived A j).obj X.obj), isCompact_recoveryDerived.{w', w} A
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.isCompact_internalShift_obj_iff _ j X.obj).mpr X.property)⟩ :
        (compactSubcategory.{max u v} (DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A)).FullSubcategory)
proof:
:=
  K0.mapCompact_mk _ _ X

name: DG.Diagonal.recoveryK0_T_smul
statement:
theorem recoveryK0_T_smul (j n : ℤ) (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    recoveryK0.{w', w, v} A j ((T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x) = recoveryK0 A (n + j) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | mk X =>
    rw [CatModule.DerivedCategory.T_smul_mk_compact, recoveryK0_mk, recoveryK0_mk]
    exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ((recoveryDerived A 0).mapIso
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftAddIso _ n j).app X.obj)).symm
  | neg x hx => rw [_root_.smul_neg, map_neg, map_neg, hx]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [_root_.smul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.recoveryK0_zero_mapCompactK0
statement:
theorem recoveryK0_zero_mapCompactK0 (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    recoveryK0.{w', w, v} A 0 (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | mk Y =>
    rw [mapCompactK0_mk, recoveryK0_mk]
    exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj ((recoveryDerived A 0).mapIso
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftZeroIso _).app _) ≪≫
        (asIso ((diagonalDerivedAdjunction.{w', w, max u v} A).unit.app Y.obj)).symm)
  | neg x hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.recoveryK0_mapCompactK0_eq_zero
statement:
theorem recoveryK0_mapCompactK0_eq_zero (j : ℤ) (hj : ∀ t : ℤ, j ≠ 4 * t)
    (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    recoveryK0.{w', w, v} A j (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | mk Y =>
    rw [mapCompactK0_mk, recoveryK0_mk]
    apply K0.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero
    apply IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero (compactSubcategory _).ι
    obtain ⟨N, ⟨e⟩⟩ := DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj Y.obj
    let M' := (shiftModule A j).obj ((toCatModule A).obj N)
    have : Subsingleton ((recover A 0).obj M') :=
      value_subsingleton A N (0 + j) (fun ⟨t, ht⟩ => hj t (by omega))
    have hz : IsZero (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((recover A 0).obj M')) :=
      DerivedCategory.Q.map_isZero (DGModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)
    refine hz.of_iso ((shiftDerived A j ⋙ recoveryDerived A 0).mapIso
      ((toDerived A).mapIso e ≪≫ toDerivedObjIso A N) ≪≫ (recoveryDerived A 0).mapIso
        ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.QCompRestrictIso _).app _) ≪≫ recoveryDerivedObjIso A 0 M')
  | neg x hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx, neg_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.recoveryK0_mapCompactK0_eq_self
statement:
theorem recoveryK0_mapCompactK0_eq_self (t : ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    recoveryK0.{w', w, v} A (4 * t) (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have h := recoveryK0_T_smul.{w', w, v} A 0 (2 * 2 * t) (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y)
  rw [HalfGradedDGRing.T_two_mul_mul_smul_compactK0, recoveryK0_zero_mapCompactK0,
    show 2 * 2 * t + 0 = 4 * t by ring] at h
  exact h.symm

name: DG.Diagonal.mk_biprod_compact
statement:
theorem mk_biprod_compact
    (X Y : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u v}
      (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded))
    (h : IsCompact.{max u v} (X ⊞ Y)) :
    K0.mk (⟨X ⊞ Y, h⟩ : (compactSubcategory.{max u v} (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u v}
      (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded))).FullSubcategory) =
      K0.mk ⟨X, h.of_biprod_left⟩ + K0.mk ⟨Y, h.of_biprod_right⟩
proof:
:=
  K0.mk_fullSubcategory_obj₂ (P := compactSubcategory.{max u v} _) (binaryBiproductTriangle X Y)
    (binaryBiproductTriangle_distinguished X Y) _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.mk_blockDerived
proof:
:= by
  rw [recoveryK0_mk, mapCompactK0_mk, CatModule.DerivedCategory.T_smul_mk_compact]
  exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (Iso.refl _)

name: DG.Diagonal.eq_sum_blocks
statement:
theorem eq_sum_blocks (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    x = mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A (recoveryK0 A 0 x) +
      (T (-1) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • mapCompactK0 A (recoveryK0 A 1 x) +
      (T (-2) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • mapCompactK0 A (recoveryK0 A 2 x) +
      (T (-3) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • mapCompactK0 A (recoveryK0 A 3 x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  | mk X =>
    have h := X.property.of_iso (blocksDerivedIso.{w', w} A X.obj).symm
    have e := K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (X := X) (Y := ⟨_, h⟩) (blocksDerivedIso.{w', w} A X.obj)
    refine e.trans (((mk_biprod_compact A _ _ h).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·)
      (mk_blockDerived A 0 X _) ((mk_biprod_compact A _ _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·)
        (mk_blockDerived A 1 X _) ((mk_biprod_compact A _ _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·)
          (mk_blockDerived A 2 X _) (mk_blockDerived A 3 X _))))))).trans ?_)
    simp only [neg_zero, T_zero, one_smul, add_assoc]
  | neg x hx =>
    conv_lhs => rw [hx]
    simp only [map_neg, _root_.smul_neg, neg_add]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    conv_lhs => rw [hx, hy]
    simp only [map_add, _root_.smul_add]
    abel

name: DG.Diagonal.T_four_smul
statement: theorem T_four_smul (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) : (T 4 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = x

name: DG.Diagonal.toK0_tmul
statement:
theorem toK0_tmul (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    toK0.{w', w, v} A (πP p ⊗ₜ y) = p • mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.ofK0_apply
statement:
theorem ofK0_apply (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    ofK0.{w', w, v} A x = πP 1 ⊗ₜ recoveryK0 A 0 x + πP (T (-1)) ⊗ₜ recoveryK0 A 1 x +
      πP (T (-2)) ⊗ₜ recoveryK0 A 2 x + πP (T (-3)) ⊗ₜ recoveryK0 A 3 x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.toK0_ofK0
statement: theorem toK0_ofK0 (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) : toK0.{w', w, v} A (ofK0 A x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofK0_apply, map_add, map_add, map_add, toK0_tmul, toK0_tmul, toK0_tmul, toK0_tmul,
    one_smul]
  exact (eq_sum_blocks A x).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.πP_T_eq
statement: theorem πP_T_eq {a b : ℤ} (h : ∃ m : ℤ, a - b = 4 * m) : πP (T a) = πP (T b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
  exact HalfGradedDGRing.Field.mk_T_eq (k := 2) (by push_cast; omega)

name: DG.Diagonal.ofK0_T_smul_mapCompactK0
statement:
theorem ofK0_T_smul_mapCompactK0 (n : ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    ofK0.{w', w, v} A ((T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) =
      πP (T n) ⊗ₜ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofK0_apply, recoveryK0_T_smul, recoveryK0_T_smul, recoveryK0_T_smul, recoveryK0_T_smul]
  have z : ∀ j : ℤ, (∀ t : ℤ, j ≠ 4 * t) →
      recoveryK0.{w', w, v} A j (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = 0 :=
    fun j hj => recoveryK0_mapCompactK0_eq_zero A j hj y
  have s : ∀ t : ℤ, recoveryK0.{w', w, v} A (4 * t) (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = y :=
    fun t => recoveryK0_mapCompactK0_eq_self A t y
  have h4 : n % 4 = 0 ∨ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 2 ∨ n % 4 = 3 := by omega
  rcases h4 with h | h | h | h
  · rw [z (n + 1) (by omega), z (n + 2) (by omega), z (n + 3) (by omega),
      show n + 0 = 4 * (n / 4) by omega, s, ← T_zero, πP_T_eq (a := 0) (b := n) ⟨-(n / 4), by omega⟩]
    simp only [tmul_zero, add_zero]
  · rw [z (n + 0) (by omega), z (n + 1) (by omega), z (n + 2) (by omega),
      show n + 3 = 4 * (n / 4 + 1) by omega, s, πP_T_eq (a := -3) (b := n) ⟨-(n / 4) - 1, by omega⟩]
    simp only [tmul_zero, zero_add]
  · rw [z (n + 0) (by omega), z (n + 1) (by omega), z (n + 3) (by omega),
      show n + 2 = 4 * (n / 4 + 1) by omega, s, πP_T_eq (a := -2) (b := n) ⟨-(n / 4) - 1, by omega⟩]
    simp only [tmul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
  · rw [z (n + 0) (by omega), z (n + 2) (by omega), z (n + 3) (by omega),
      show n + 1 = 4 * (n / 4 + 1) by omega, s, πP_T_eq (a := -1) (b := n) ⟨-(n / 4) - 1, by omega⟩]
    simp only [tmul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.ofK0_toK0
statement:
theorem ofK0_toK0 (z : (LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ periodIdeal) ⊗[ℤ] BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    ofK0.{w', w, v} A (toK0 A z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul p y =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ p
    induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
    | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [show (Submodule.Quotient.mk (p + q) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ periodIdeal) =
          πP p + πP q from rfl, add_tmul, map_add, map_add, hp, hq]
    | C_mul_T n a =>
      have hC : (Submodule.Quotient.mk (C a * T n) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ periodIdeal) =
          a • πP (T n) := by
        rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← HalfGradedDGRing.Field.C_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hC, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_zsmul, map_zsmul, toK0_tmul,
        ofK0_T_smul_mapCompactK0]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.toK0_injective
statement: theorem toK0_injective : Function.Injective (toK0.{w', w, v} A)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have ha := ofK0_toK0 A a
  have hb := ofK0_toK0 A b
  rw [h] at ha
  exact ha.symm.trans hb

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_apply (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x = ofK0.{w', w, v} A x
proof:
:= by
  apply toK0_injective A
  exact (LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (toK0.{w', w, v} A) _) x).trans
    (toK0_ofK0.{w', w, v} A x).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_symm_tmul (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    (K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A).symm (πP p ⊗ₜ y) = p • mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y
proof:
:=
  toK0_tmul.{w', w, v} A p y

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_T_smul_mapCompactK0
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_T_smul_mapCompactK0 (n : ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A ((T n : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) =
      πP (T n) ⊗ₜ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [K0LinearEquiv_apply.{w', w, v}, ofK0_T_smul_mapCompactK0.{w', w, v}]

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_mapCompactK0
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_mapCompactK0 (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = πP 1 ⊗ₜ y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using K0LinearEquiv_T_smul_mapCompactK0.{w', w, v} A 0 y

name: DG.Diagonal.periodIdeal_le_superIdeal
statement: theorem periodIdeal_le_superIdeal : periodIdeal ≤ HalfGradedDGRing.superIdeal 2
proof:
:=
  HalfGradedDGRing.Field.idealPeriod_le_idealSuper (k := 2)

name: DG.Diagonal.reduceSuper_tmul
statement:
theorem reduceSuper_tmul (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    reduceSuper.{w, v} A (πP p ⊗ₜ y) = πS p ⊗ₜ y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.superIdeal_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem superIdeal_smul_eq_zero
    (t : (LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ HalfGradedDGRing.superIdeal 2) ⊗[ℤ] BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    (1 + T 2 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • t = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul p y =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ p
    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [_root_.smul_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.toSuperK0_tmul
statement:
theorem toSuperK0_tmul (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A (πS p ⊗ₜ y) = p • HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk.{w', v} _
      (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.toSuperK0_reduceSuper
statement:
theorem toSuperK0_reduceSuper
    (t : (LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ periodIdeal) ⊗[ℤ] BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A (reduceSuper.{w, v} A t) =
      HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk.{w', v} _ (toK0.{w', w, v} A t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul p y =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ p
    exact ((toSuperK0_tmul.{w', w, v} A p y).trans
      (LinearMap.map_smul (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk.{w', v} _) p _).symm)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: DG.Diagonal.ofSuperK0_superK0cMk
statement:
theorem ofSuperK0_superK0cMk (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    ofSuperK0.{w', w, v} A (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk.{w', v} _ x) =
      reduceSuper.{w, v} A (K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofSuperK0, HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.liftQ_apply]

name: DG.Diagonal.toSuperK0_ofSuperK0
statement:
theorem toSuperK0_ofSuperK0 (s : HalfGradedDGRing.SuperK0c.{w', v} (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A)) :
    toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A (ofSuperK0.{w', w, v} A s) = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk_surjective.{w', v} _ s
  rw [ofSuperK0_superK0cMk, toSuperK0_reduceSuper, K0LinearEquiv_apply, toK0_ofK0]

name: DG.Diagonal.ofSuperK0_toSuperK0
statement:
theorem ofSuperK0_toSuperK0
    (t : (LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ HalfGradedDGRing.superIdeal 2) ⊗[ℤ] BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    ofSuperK0.{w', w, v} A (toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A t) = t
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ t' : (LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ periodIdeal) ⊗[ℤ] BaseK0.{w, v} A,
      ofSuperK0.{w', w, v} A (toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A (reduceSuper.{w, v} A t')) =
        reduceSuper.{w, v} A t' := by
    intro t'
    rw [toSuperK0_reduceSuper, ofSuperK0_superK0cMk, K0LinearEquiv_apply, ofK0_toK0]
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul p y =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ p
    exact key (πP p ⊗ₜ y)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.toSuperK0_injective
statement: theorem toSuperK0_injective : Function.Injective (toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have ha := ofSuperK0_toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A a
  have hb := ofSuperK0_toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A b
  rw [h] at ha
  exact ha.symm.trans hb

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_symm_tmul (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    (superK0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A).symm (πS p ⊗ₜ y) =
      p • HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk.{w', v} _ (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y)
proof:
:=
  toSuperK0_tmul.{w', w, v} A p y

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMk_mapCompactK0
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMk_mapCompactK0 (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    superK0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A
      (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk.{w', v} _ (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y)) =
        πS 1 ⊗ₜ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearEquiv.eq_symm_apply, superK0LinearEquiv_symm_tmul.{w', w, v}, one_smul]

name: DG.Diagonal.weightZeroLift_naturality
statement:
theorem weightZeroLift_naturality {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) (x : M) :
    weightZeroLift A N (f.hom x) =
      ((toCatModule A).map f).app ⟨0⟩ (weightZeroLift A M x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (recoveryMap_bijective A N).injective
  change valueEvaluation A N 0 _ = valueEvaluation A N 0 _
  rw [valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift]
  exact ((evaluation_regradedMap f (weightZeroLift A M x).1).trans
    (congrArg f.hom (valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift A M x))).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeLift_naturality
statement:
theorem diagonalConeLift_naturality (p : Cone f.hom) :
    diagonalConeLift A f' (Cone.map a.hom b.hom (congrArg DGModuleCat.Hom.hom h) p) =
      (CatModule.cone.map ((toCatModule A).map a) ((toCatModule A).map b)
        (by simpa only [← Functor.map_comp] using congrArg (toCatModule A).map h)).app ⟨0⟩
        (diagonalConeLift A f p)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact congrArg (CatModule.shift.mk 1)
      (weightZeroLift_naturality A a (Shift.unmk 1 p.1))
  · exact weightZeroLift_naturality A b p.2

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_naturality
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_naturality :
    (toCatModule A).map (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
      (M := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f'.hom))
      (Cone.map a.hom b.hom (congrArg DGModuleCat.Hom.hom h))) ≫
        (diagonalConeIso A f').hom =
      (diagonalConeIso A f).hom ≫
        CatModule.cone.map ((toCatModule A).map a) ((toCatModule A).map b)
          (by simpa only [← Functor.map_comp] using congrArg (toCatModule A).map h)
proof:
:= by
  apply diagonalSource_hom_ext A
  intro x
  change (diagonalConeIso A f').hom.app ⟨0⟩
    (((toCatModule A).map (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
      (M := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f'.hom))
      (Cone.map a.hom b.hom (congrArg DGModuleCat.Hom.hom h)))).app ⟨0⟩ x) = _
  rw [diagonalConeIso_hom_zero]
  have he := evaluation_regradedMap (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
    (M := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f'.hom))
    (Cone.map a.hom b.hom (congrArg DGModuleCat.Hom.hom h))) x.1
  change diagonalConeLift A f' (evaluation (regradedMap (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
    (M := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f'.hom))
    (Cone.map a.hom b.hom (congrArg DGModuleCat.Hom.hom h))) x.1)) = _
  rw [he]
  change _ = (CatModule.cone.map ((toCatModule A).map a) ((toCatModule A).map b)
    (by simpa only [← Functor.map_comp] using congrArg (toCatModule A).map h)).app ⟨0⟩
      ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app ⟨0⟩ x)
  rw [diagonalConeIso_hom_zero]
  exact diagonalConeLift_naturality A a b h _

name: DG.Diagonal.blockιNat_app
statement:
theorem blockιNat_app (r : ℤ)
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    (blockιNat A r).app M = blockι A r M
proof:
:= by
  apply CatModule.hom_ext
  intro X x
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.sum_projBlock_blockι
statement:
theorem sum_projBlock_blockι
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    ∑ r : Fin 4, projBlock A M r ≫ blockι A (r : ℤ) M = blocksMap A M
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  simp only [blocksMap, sumMap, Preadditive.comp_add, add_assoc]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.lift_fst'
statement:
private theorem lift_fst' {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ X Y : C, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] {P M N : CatModule.{v} C} (φ : P ⟶ M) (ψ : P ⟶ N) :
    CatModule.lift φ ψ ≫ CatModule.fst M N = φ
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.lift_snd'
statement:
private theorem lift_snd' {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ X Y : C, DGAddCommGroup (X ⟶ Y)] {P M N : CatModule.{v} C} (φ : P ⟶ M) (ψ : P ⟶ N) :
    CatModule.lift φ ψ ≫ CatModule.snd M N = ψ
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.injBlock_blocksMap
statement:
theorem injBlock_blocksMap
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (r : Fin 4) :
    injBlock A M r ≫ blocksMap A M = blockι A (r : ℤ) M
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases r <;>
    simp only [injBlock, blocksMap, sumMap, Preadditive.comp_add, ← Category.assoc, lift_fst',
      lift_snd', zero_comp, add_zero, zero_add] <;> rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.injBlock_projBlock_self
statement:
theorem injBlock_projBlock_self
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (r : Fin 4) :
    injBlock A M r ≫ projBlock A M r = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply CatModule.hom_ext
  intro X x
  fin_cases r <;> rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.injBlock_projBlock_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  apply CatModule.hom_ext
  intro X x
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;>
    first
    | exact absurd rfl h
    | rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.sum_projBlock_blockιNat
statement:
theorem sum_projBlock_blockιNat
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    ∑ r : Fin 4, projBlock A M r ≫ (blockιNat A (r : ℤ)).app M = blocksMap A M
proof:
:=
  sum_projBlock_blockι A M

name: DG.Diagonal.blockιNat_blocksMapIso_inv
statement:
theorem blockιNat_blocksMapIso_inv
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (r : Fin 4) :
    (blockιNat A (r : ℤ)).app M ≫ (blocksMapIso A M).inv = injBlock A M r
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockιNat_app, Iso.comp_inv_eq]
  exact (injBlock_blocksMap A M r).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.blockιNat_inv_projBlock_self
statement:
theorem blockιNat_inv_projBlock_self
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (r : Fin 4) :
    (blockιNat A (r : ℤ)).app M ≫ (blocksMapIso A M).inv ≫ projBlock A M r = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, blockιNat_blocksMapIso_inv, injBlock_projBlock_self]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.blockιNat_inv_projBlock_of_ne
statement:
theorem blockιNat_inv_projBlock_of_ne
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) {r s : Fin 4}
    (h : r ≠ s) :
    (blockιNat A (r : ℤ)).app M ≫ (blocksMapIso A M).inv ≫ projBlock A M s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, blockιNat_blocksMapIso_inv, injBlock_projBlock_of_ne A M h]

name: DG.Diagonal.blockDerivedι_app_Q
statement:
theorem blockDerivedι_app_Q (r : ℤ)
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    (blockDerivedι A r).app (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj M) =
      (QBlockNatIso A r).hom.app M ≫ CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map ((blockιNat A r).app M)
proof:
:= by
  have h := NatTrans.congr_app ((Localization.whiskeringLeftFunctor' CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q
    (CatModule.quasiIso (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) _).map_preimage
    ((QBlockNatIso A r).hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (blockιNat A r) _ ≫
      (Functor.leftUnitor _).hom ≫ (Functor.rightUnitor _).inv)) M
  refine h.trans ?_
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Functor.leftUnitor_hom_app,
    Functor.rightUnitor_inv_app, Category.comp_id]
  erw [Category.comp_id]

name: DG.Diagonal.isIso_blocksDerivedι_app_Q
statement:
theorem isIso_blocksDerivedι_app_Q
    (M : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    IsIso ((blocksDerivedι A).app (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj M))
proof:
:= by
  let Q := CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q (C := WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)
  let φ : Q.obj M ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun r : Fin 4 => (blockDerived.{v, v} A (r : ℤ)).obj (Q.obj M) :=
    Pi.lift fun r : Fin 4 => Q.map ((blocksMapIso A M).inv ≫ projBlock A M r) ≫
      (QBlockNatIso A (r : ℤ)).inv.app M
  have hφ : ∀ s : Fin 4, φ ≫ Pi.π _ s =
      Q.map ((blocksMapIso A M).inv ≫ projBlock A M s) ≫ (QBlockNatIso A (s : ℤ)).inv.app M :=
    fun s => Limits.Pi.lift_comp_π _ s
  have hself : ∀ s : Fin 4, (blockDerivedι A (s : ℤ)).app (Q.obj M) ≫
      Q.map ((blocksMapIso A M).inv ≫ projBlock A M s) ≫ (QBlockNatIso A (s : ℤ)).inv.app M =
        𝟙 _ := by
    intro s
    rw [blockDerivedι_app_Q, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc,
      blockιNat_inv_projBlock_self, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp,
      Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
    rfl
  have hne : ∀ r s : Fin 4, r ≠ s → (blockDerivedι A (r : ℤ)).app (Q.obj M) ≫
      Q.map ((blocksMapIso A M).inv ≫ projBlock A M s) = 0 := by
    intro r s h
    rw [blockDerivedι_app_Q, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
      blockιNat_inv_projBlock_of_ne A M h, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero, comp_zero]
  have hterm : ∀ r : Fin 4, φ ≫ Pi.π _ r ≫ (blockDerivedι A (r : ℤ)).app (Q.obj M) =
      Q.map ((blocksMapIso A M).inv ≫ projBlock A M r ≫ (blockιNat A (r : ℤ)).app M) := by
    intro r
    rw [← Category.assoc, hφ, blockDerivedι_app_Q, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc,
      ← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Limits.Pi.hom_ext
    intro s
    rw [Category.assoc, hφ, Category.id_comp]
    change (∑ r : Fin 4, Pi.π _ r ≫ (blockDerivedι A (r : ℤ)).app _) ≫ _ = _
    rw [Preadditive.sum_comp, Finset.sum_eq_single s]
    · rw [Category.assoc, hself, Category.comp_id]
    · intro r _ hrs
      rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc ((blockDerivedι A (r : ℤ)).app _), hne r s hrs,
        zero_comp, comp_zero]
    · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ s) h
  · change φ ≫ ∑ r : Fin 4, Pi.π _ r ≫ (blockDerivedι A (r : ℤ)).app _ = _
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => hterm r, ← Functor.map_sum,
      ← Preadditive.comp_sum, sum_projBlock_blockιNat]
    exact (congrArg Q.map (blocksMapIso A M).inv_hom_id).trans (CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ _)

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_derivedTensor_obj
statement:
theorem isCompact_derivedTensor_obj
    {X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{v, v}
      (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).Regraded)} (hX : IsCompact.{v} X) :
    IsCompact.{v} ((derivedTensor A B M hM).obj X)
proof:
:=
  (isCompact_transport_obj B A _ (fun _ hY => DGBimodule.isCompact_derivedTensor_obj hM hc hY)
    hX).of_iso ((derivedTensorTransportIso A B M hM).app X)

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_derivedTensor
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_derivedTensor (x : DiagK0.{v, v} B) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{v, v, v} A (derivedTensorK0 A B M hM hc x) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (K0.mapCompact (DGBimodule.derivedTensor.{v, v, v, v} A B M hM)
        (fun _ hY => DGBimodule.isCompact_derivedTensor_obj hM hc hY)).toIntLinearMap
        (K0LinearEquiv.{v, v, v} B x)
proof:
:=
  K0LinearEquiv_mapCompact B A _ _ (derivedTensor A B M hM) _ (derivedTensorShiftIso A B M hM)
    (derivedTensorToDerivedIso A B M hM) x

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_derivedTensor
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_derivedTensor
    (s : HalfGradedDGRing.SuperK0c.{v, v} (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B)) :
    superK0LinearEquiv.{v, v, v} A
        (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap _ _ (derivedTensorK0 A B M hM hc) s) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (K0.mapCompact (DGBimodule.derivedTensor.{v, v, v, v} A B M hM)
        (fun _ hY => DGBimodule.isCompact_derivedTensor_obj hM hc hY)).toIntLinearMap
        (superK0LinearEquiv.{v, v, v} B s)
proof:
:=
  superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap B A _ _ (derivedTensor A B M hM) _
    (derivedTensorShiftIso A B M hM) (derivedTensorToDerivedIso A B M hM) s

name: DG.mem_coarseGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coarseGrading_iff {k : κ} {x : ⨁ i, β i} :
    x ∈ coarseGrading β f k ↔ ∀ i, f i ≠ k → x i = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.of_mem_coarseGrading
statement: theorem of_mem_coarseGrading (i : ι) (b : β i) : DirectSum.of β i b ∈ coarseGrading β f (f i)
proof:
:=
  fun j hj => of_eq_of_ne i j b fun h => hj (h ▸ rfl)

name: DG.of_mem_coarseGrading'
statement:
theorem of_mem_coarseGrading' {i : ι} {k : κ} (h : f i = k) (b : β i) :
    DirectSum.of β i b ∈ coarseGrading β f k
proof:
:=
  h ▸ of_mem_coarseGrading i b

name: DG.coe_coarseDecompose_apply
statement:
theorem coe_coarseDecompose_apply (x : ⨁ i, β i) (k : κ) (i : ι) :
    ((coarseDecompose β f x k : ⨁ i, β i) i) = if f i = k then x i else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j b =>
    simp only [coarseDecompose, toAddMonoid_of, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    by_cases hjk : f j = k
    · subst hjk
      rw [of_eq_same]
      change (DirectSum.of β j b) i = _
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; simp
      · rw [of_eq_of_ne j i b hij]; simp
    · rw [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm hjk), ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, zero_apply]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij; simp [hjk]
      · rw [of_eq_of_ne j i b hij]; simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, add_apply, hx, hy, add_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: DG.coeAddMonoidHom_comp_coarseDecompose
statement:
theorem coeAddMonoidHom_comp_coarseDecompose :
    (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (coarseGrading β f)).comp (coarseDecompose β f) =
      AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.addHom_ext fun i b => ?_
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, coarseDecompose, toAddMonoid_of, coeAddMonoidHom_of,
    AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.coarseDecompose_comp_coeAddMonoidHom
statement:
theorem coarseDecompose_comp_coeAddMonoidHom :
