    (coarseDecompose β f).comp (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (coarseGrading β f)) =
      AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.addHom_ext fun k y => ?_
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, coeAddMonoidHom_of, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  ext k' i
  rw [coe_coarseDecompose_apply]
  by_cases hk : k = k'
  · subst hk
    rw [of_eq_same]
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · exact (y.2 i h).symm
  · rw [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm hk), ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, zero_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact y.2 i (h ▸ Ne.symm hk)
    · rfl

name: DG.coe_decompose_coarseGrading_apply
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_coarseGrading_apply (x : ⨁ i, β i) (k : κ) (i : ι) :
    ((decompose (coarseGrading β f) x k : ⨁ i, β i) i) = if f i = k then x i else 0
proof:
:=
  coe_coarseDecompose_apply x k i

name: DG.coarseGrading_induction
statement:
theorem coarseGrading_induction {k : κ} {P : (⨁ i, β i) → Prop} (zero : P 0)
    (of : ∀ i (b : β i), f i = k → P (DirectSum.of β i b)) (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    {x : ⨁ i, β i} (hx : x ∈ coarseGrading β f k) : P x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x]
  induction x.support using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using zero
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    refine add _ _ ?_ ih
    by_cases h : f i = k
    · exact of i _ h
    · rw [hx i h, map_zero]; exact zero

name: DG.halfDegree_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem halfDegree_apply (k : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    halfDegree k p = (p.2 + p.1 * k, (p.1 : ZMod 2))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.halfDegree_add_one_zero
statement:
theorem halfDegree_add_one_zero (k : ℤ) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    halfDegree k (p + (1, 0)) = halfDegree k p + (k, 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [halfDegree_apply, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, add_zero, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one,
    Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.mk.injEq, and_true]
  ring

name: DG.mem_halfGrading
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_halfGrading {ℳ : ℤ × ZMod 2 → σ} {k : ℤ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ halfGrading ℳ k p ↔ m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.HalfRegrade.mk_congr
statement:
theorem mk_congr {p p' : ℤ × ℤ} (h : p = p') {m m' : M} (h' : m = m')
    (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) (hm' : m' ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p')) :
    mk ℳ k p m hm = mk ℳ k p' m' hm'
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'; rfl

name: DG.HalfRegrade.mk_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_zero (p : ℤ × ℤ) : mk ℳ k p 0 (zero_mem _) = 0
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of (fun p => ↥(halfGrading ℳ k p)) p).map_zero

name: DG.HalfRegrade.mk_add
statement:
theorem mk_add (p : ℤ × ℤ) {m m' : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p))
    (hm' : m' ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) :
    mk ℳ k p (m + m') (add_mem hm hm') = mk ℳ k p m hm + mk ℳ k p m' hm'
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of (fun p => ↥(halfGrading ℳ k p)) p).map_add ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨m', hm'⟩

name: DG.HalfRegrade.mk_neg
statement:
theorem mk_neg (p : ℤ × ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) :
    mk ℳ k p (-m) (neg_mem hm) = -mk ℳ k p m hm
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of (fun p => ↥(halfGrading ℳ k p)) p).map_neg ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.HalfRegrade.mk_zsmul
statement:
theorem mk_zsmul (p : ℤ × ℤ) (c : ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) :
    mk ℳ k p (c • m) (zsmul_mem hm c) = c • mk ℳ k p m hm
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of (fun p => ↥(halfGrading ℳ k p)) p).map_zsmul c ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.HalfRegrade.mk_units_smul
statement:
theorem mk_units_smul (p : ℤ × ℤ) (c : ℤˣ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) :
    mk ℳ k p (c • m) (by rw [Units.smul_def]; exact zsmul_mem hm _) = c • mk ℳ k p m hm
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Units.smul_def]
  exact mk_zsmul p (c : ℤ) hm

name: DG.HalfRegrade.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : HalfRegrade ℳ k → Prop} (x : HalfRegrade ℳ k) (zero : P 0)
    (mk : ∀ (p : ℤ × ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)), P (mk ℳ k p m hm))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact zero
  | of p m => exact mk p m.1 m.2
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy

name: DG.HalfRegrade.addHom_ext
statement:
theorem addHom_ext {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] {f g : HalfRegrade ℳ k →+ N}
    (h : ∀ (p : ℤ × ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)),
      f (mk ℳ k p m hm) = g (mk ℳ k p m hm)) :
    f = g
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.addHom_ext fun p m => h p m.1 m.2

name: DG.HalfRegrade.mk_mem_cohGrading
statement:
theorem mk_mem_cohGrading (p : ℤ × ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) :
    mk ℳ k p m hm ∈ cohGrading ℳ k p.1
proof:
:=
  of_mem_coarseGrading (f := Prod.fst) p _

name: DG.HalfRegrade.mk_mem_weightGrading
statement:
theorem mk_mem_weightGrading (p : ℤ × ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) :
    mk ℳ k p m hm ∈ weightGrading ℳ k p.2
proof:
:=
  of_mem_coarseGrading (f := Prod.snd) p _

name: DG.HalfRegrade.cohGrading_induction
statement:
theorem cohGrading_induction {n : ℤ} {P : HalfRegrade ℳ k → Prop} (zero : P 0)
    (mk : ∀ (w : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k (n, w))), P (mk ℳ k (n, w) m hm))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) {x : HalfRegrade ℳ k} (hx : x ∈ cohGrading ℳ k n) :
    P x
proof:
:=
  coarseGrading_induction (f := Prod.fst) zero
    (fun (p : ℤ × ℤ) b hp => by rcases p with ⟨n', w⟩; subst hp; exact mk w b.1 b.2) add hx

name: DG.HalfRegrade.weightGrading_induction
statement:
theorem weightGrading_induction {w : ℤ} {P : HalfRegrade ℳ k → Prop} (zero : P 0)
    (mk : ∀ (n : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k (n, w))), P (mk ℳ k (n, w) m hm))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) {x : HalfRegrade ℳ k} (hx : x ∈ weightGrading ℳ k w) :
    P x
proof:
:=
  coarseGrading_induction (f := Prod.snd) zero
    (fun (p : ℤ × ℤ) b hp => by rcases p with ⟨n, w'⟩; subst hp; exact mk n b.1 b.2) add hx

name: DG.HalfRegrade.decompose_weightGrading_mem_cohGrading
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have h := coe_decompose_coarseGrading_apply (β := fun p => ↥(halfGrading ℳ k p))
    (f := Prod.snd) x w p
  refine h.trans ?_
  split_ifs
  · exact hx p hp
  · rfl

name: DG.HalfRegrade.isHomogeneous_cohGrading
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_cohGrading (n : ℤ) :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (weightGrading ℳ k) (cohGrading ℳ k n)
proof:
:=
  fun w _ hx => decompose_weightGrading_mem_cohGrading hx w

name: DG.HalfRegrade.d_mem_halfDegree_add
statement:
theorem d_mem_halfDegree_add {p : ℤ × ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) :
    d m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k (p + (1, 0)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [halfDegree_add_one_zero]
  exact hd hm

name: DG.HalfRegrade.dHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dHom_mk (p : ℤ × ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (halfDegree k p)) :
    dHom ℳ k d hd (mk ℳ k p m hm) =
      mk ℳ k (p + (1, 0)) (d m) (d_mem_halfDegree_add ℳ k d hd hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun p => ↥(halfGrading ℳ k p)) _ p ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.HalfRegrade.dHom_mem_cohGrading
statement:
theorem dHom_mem_cohGrading {n : ℤ} {x : HalfRegrade ℳ k} (hx : x ∈ cohGrading ℳ k n) :
    dHom ℳ k d hd x ∈ cohGrading ℳ k (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine cohGrading_induction (P := fun x => dHom ℳ k d hd x ∈ cohGrading ℳ k (n + 1)) ?_
    (fun w m hm => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_) hx
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [dHom_mk]; exact mk_mem_cohGrading (ℳ := ℳ) (k := k) ((n, w) + (1, 0)) _
  · rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.HalfRegrade.dHom_mem_weightGrading
statement:
theorem dHom_mem_weightGrading {w : ℤ} {x : HalfRegrade ℳ k} (hx : x ∈ weightGrading ℳ k w) :
    dHom ℳ k d hd x ∈ weightGrading ℳ k w
proof:
:= by
  refine weightGrading_induction (P := fun x => dHom ℳ k d hd x ∈ weightGrading ℳ k w) ?_
    (fun n m hm => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_) hx
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [dHom_mk]
    have := mk_mem_weightGrading (ℳ := ℳ) (k := k) ((n, w) + (1, 0))
      (d_mem_halfDegree_add ℳ k d hd hm)
    simpa using this
  · rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.HalfRegrade.dHom_dHom
statement:
theorem dHom_dHom (hdd : ∀ m, d (d m) = 0) (x : HalfRegrade ℳ k) :
    dHom ℳ k d hd (dHom ℳ k d hd x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk p m hm => simp only [dHom_mk]; exact (mk_congr rfl (hdd m) _ _).trans (mk_zero _)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_congr
statement:
theorem place_congr {p p' : ℤ × ℤ} (h : p = p') {a a' : A} (h' : a = a')
    (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) (ha' : a' ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p')) :
    H.place p a ha = H.place p' a' ha'
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.mk_congr h h' ha ha'

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem place_zero (p : ℤ × ℤ) : H.place p 0 (zero_mem _) = 0
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.mk_zero p

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_add
statement:
theorem place_add (p : ℤ × ℤ) {a a' : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p))
    (ha' : a' ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    H.place p (a + a') (add_mem ha ha') = H.place p a ha + H.place p a' ha'
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.mk_add p ha ha'

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_add_of_eq
statement:
theorem place_add_of_eq {p₁ p₂ p : ℤ × ℤ} (h₁ : p₁ = p) (h₂ : p₂ = p) {a a' : A}
    (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p₁)) (ha' : a' ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p₂)) :
    H.place p₁ a ha + H.place p₂ a' ha' =
      H.place p (a + a') (by subst h₁ h₂; exact add_mem ha ha')
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁ h₂
  exact (place_add _ ha ha').symm

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_units_smul
statement:
theorem place_units_smul (p : ℤ × ℤ) (c : ℤˣ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    H.place p (c • a) (by rw [Units.smul_def]; exact zsmul_mem ha _) = c • H.place p a ha
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.mk_units_smul p c ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_place
statement:
theorem place_mul_place {p q : ℤ × ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p))
    (hb : b ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k q)) :
    H.place p a ha * H.place q b hb =
      H.place (p + q) (a * b) (show a * b ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k (p + q)) from
        SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem (A := halfGrading H.hgrading k) ha hb)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.one_eq_place
statement:
theorem one_eq_place : (1 : H.Regraded) =
    H.place 0 1 (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := halfGrading H.hgrading k))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : H.Regraded → Prop} (x : H.Regraded) (zero : P 0)
    (mk : ∀ (p : ℤ × ℤ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)), P (H.place p a ha))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.induction_on x zero mk add

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : H.Regraded} :
    x ∈ grading n ↔ x ∈ HalfRegrade.cohGrading H.hgrading k n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mem_wgrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_iff {w : ℤ} {x : H.Regraded} :
    x ∈ wgrading w ↔ x ∈ HalfRegrade.weightGrading H.hgrading k w
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_mem_grading
statement:
theorem place_mem_grading (p : ℤ × ℤ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    H.place p a ha ∈ grading (M := H.Regraded) p.1
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.mk_mem_cohGrading p ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem place_mem_wgrading (p : ℤ × ℤ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    H.place p a ha ∈ wgrading (M := H.Regraded) p.2
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.mk_mem_weightGrading p ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.d_place
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_place (p : ℤ × ℤ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    d (H.place p a ha) =
      H.place (p + (1, 0)) (H.hd a)
        (HalfRegrade.d_mem_halfDegree_add H.hgrading k H.hd H.hd_mem ha)
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.dHom_mk H.hgrading k p a ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.grading_induction
statement:
theorem grading_induction {n : ℤ} {P : H.Regraded → Prop} (zero : P 0)
    (mk : ∀ (w : ℤ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k (n, w))), P (H.place (n, w) a ha))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) {x : H.Regraded} (hx : x ∈ grading n) : P x
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.cohGrading_induction zero mk add hx

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.wgrading_induction
statement:
theorem wgrading_induction {w : ℤ} {P : H.Regraded → Prop} (zero : P 0)
    (mk : ∀ (n : ℤ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k (n, w))), P (H.place (n, w) a ha))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) {x : H.Regraded} (hx : x ∈ wgrading w) : P x
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.weightGrading_induction zero mk add hx

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mul_induction
statement:
theorem mul_induction {P : H.Regraded → H.Regraded → Prop}
    (zero_left : ∀ y, P 0 y) (zero_right : ∀ x, P x 0)
    (add_left : ∀ x x' y, P x y → P x' y → P (x + x') y)
    (add_right : ∀ x y y', P x y → P x y' → P x (y + y'))
    (mk_mk : ∀ (p q : ℤ × ℤ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) (b : A)
      (hb : b ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k q)), P (H.place p a ha) (H.place q b hb))
    (x y : H.Regraded) : P x y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => exact zero_left y
  | mk p a ha =>
    induction y using induction_on with
    | zero => exact zero_right _
    | mk q b hb => exact mk_mk p q a ha b hb
    | add y y' hy hy' => exact add_right _ _ _ hy hy'
  | add x x' hx hx' => exact add_left _ _ _ hx hx'

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.hd_one
statement: theorem hd_one : H.hd 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := H.hd_mul (j := 0) (n := 0) (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := H.hgrading)) 1
  rw [mul_one, one_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul, mul_one] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.one_mem_of_halfDegree_eq_zero
statement:
theorem one_mem_of_halfDegree_eq_zero {p : ℤ × ℤ} (hp : halfDegree k p = 0) :
    (1 : A) ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hp]; exact SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.halfDegree_two
statement: theorem halfDegree_two : halfDegree k (2, -2 * k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [halfDegree_apply, Int.cast_ofNat, Prod.mk_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨by ring, rfl⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.halfDegree_neg_two
statement: theorem halfDegree_neg_two : halfDegree k (-2, 2 * k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [halfDegree_apply, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_ofNat, Prod.mk_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨by ring, rfl⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_periodUnit
statement:
theorem place_mul_periodUnit (p : ℤ × ℤ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    H.place p a ha * H.periodUnit =
      H.place (p + (2, -2 * k)) a (by rw [map_add, halfDegree_two, add_zero]; exact ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodUnit, place_mul_place]
  exact place_congr rfl (mul_one a) _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnit_mul_place
statement:
theorem periodUnit_mul_place (p : ℤ × ℤ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    H.periodUnit * H.place p a ha =
      H.place (p + (2, -2 * k)) a (by rw [map_add, halfDegree_two, add_zero]; exact ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodUnit, place_mul_place]
  exact place_congr (add_comm _ _) (one_mul a) _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_periodUnitInv
statement:
theorem place_mul_periodUnitInv (p : ℤ × ℤ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    H.place p a ha * H.periodUnitInv =
      H.place (p + (-2, 2 * k)) a (by rw [map_add, halfDegree_neg_two, add_zero]; exact ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodUnitInv, place_mul_place]
  exact place_congr rfl (mul_one a) _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnitInv_mul_place
statement:
theorem periodUnitInv_mul_place (p : ℤ × ℤ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    H.periodUnitInv * H.place p a ha =
      H.place (p + (-2, 2 * k)) a (by rw [map_add, halfDegree_neg_two, add_zero]; exact ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodUnitInv, place_mul_place]
  exact place_congr (add_comm _ _) (one_mul a) _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnit_mul_periodUnitInv
statement: theorem periodUnit_mul_periodUnitInv : H.periodUnit * H.periodUnitInv = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodUnit, place_mul_periodUnitInv, one_eq_place]
  exact place_congr (by ext <;> simp) rfl _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnitInv_mul_periodUnit
statement: theorem periodUnitInv_mul_periodUnit : H.periodUnitInv * H.periodUnit = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodUnitInv, place_mul_periodUnit, one_eq_place]
  exact place_congr (by ext <;> simp) rfl _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnit_mul_comm
statement: theorem periodUnit_mul_comm (x : H.Regraded) : H.periodUnit * x = x * H.periodUnit
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk p a ha => rw [periodUnit_mul_place, place_mul_periodUnit]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnitInv_mul_comm
statement: theorem periodUnitInv_mul_comm (x : H.Regraded) : H.periodUnitInv * x = x * H.periodUnitInv
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk p a ha => rw [periodUnitInv_mul_place, place_mul_periodUnitInv]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, add_mul, hx, hy]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnit_mem_grading
statement: theorem periodUnit_mem_grading : H.periodUnit ∈ grading (M := H.Regraded) 2
proof:
:=
  place_mem_grading (H := H) (2, -2 * k) _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnit_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem periodUnit_mem_wgrading :
    H.periodUnit ∈ wgrading (M := H.Regraded) (-2 * k)
proof:
:=
  place_mem_wgrading (H := H) (2, -2 * k) _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnitInv_mem_grading
statement:
theorem periodUnitInv_mem_grading :
    H.periodUnitInv ∈ grading (M := H.Regraded) (-2)
proof:
:=
  place_mem_grading (H := H) (-2, 2 * k) _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.periodUnitInv_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem periodUnitInv_mem_wgrading :
    H.periodUnitInv ∈ wgrading (M := H.Regraded) (2 * k)
proof:
:=
  place_mem_wgrading (H := H) (-2, 2 * k) _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.d_periodUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_periodUnit : d H.periodUnit = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodUnit, d_place]
  exact (place_congr rfl hd_one _ _).trans (place_zero _)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.d_periodUnitInv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_periodUnitInv : d H.periodUnitInv = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodUnitInv, d_place]
  exact (place_congr rfl hd_one _ _).trans (place_zero _)

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicUnit_comp_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem periodicUnit_comp_inv (t : ℤ) :
    periodicUnit A t ≫ periodicUnitInv A t = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (periodicUnit A (-t)).1 * (periodicUnit A t).1 = _
  simp only [periodicUnit, HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_place, one_mul]
  exact (HalfGradedDGRing.place_congr (by ext <;> dsimp <;> ring) rfl _ _).trans
    (HalfGradedDGRing.one_eq_place.symm)

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicUnit_inv_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem periodicUnit_inv_comp (t : ℤ) :
    periodicUnitInv A t ≫ periodicUnit A t = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (periodicUnit A t).1 * (periodicUnit A (-t)).1 = _
  simp only [periodicUnit, HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_place, one_mul]
  exact (HalfGradedDGRing.place_congr (by ext <;> dsimp <;> ring) rfl _ _).trans
    (HalfGradedDGRing.one_eq_place.symm)

name: DG.Diagonal.counitApp_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem counitApp_zero :
    counitApp A N 0 = valueEvaluation A ((recover A 0).obj N) 0
proof:
:= by
  change counitApp A N (4 * 0) = _
  rw [counitApp_supported]
  ext x
  change N.act (periodicUnit A 0) _ = _
  rw [periodicUnit_zero]
  exact N.act_id' _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.counit_supported_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem counit_supported_inv (t : ℤ) (x : N.obj ⟨4 * t⟩) :
    counitApp A N (4 * t) (supportedCounitInv A N t x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (counitMap A N).app _
    (((toCatModule A).obj ((recover A 0).obj N)).act (periodicUnit A t) _) = x
  erw [(counitMap A N).map_smul (periodicUnit A t)]
  change N.act (periodicUnit A t) (counitApp A N 0 _) = x
  rw [counitApp_zero]
  refine (congrArg (N.act (periodicUnit A t))
    (valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift A ((recover A 0).obj N) _)).trans ?_
  refine (N.act_comp' (periodicUnitInv A t) (periodicUnit A t) x).symm.trans ?_
  rw [periodicUnit_inv_comp]
  exact N.act_id' _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.supported_inv_counit
statement:
@[simp] theorem supported_inv_counit (t : ℤ)
    (x : Value A ((recover A 0).obj N) (4 * t)) :
    supportedCounitInv A N t (counitApp A N (4 * t) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change ((toCatModule A).obj ((recover A 0).obj N)).act (periodicUnit A t)
    (weightZeroLift A ((recover A 0).obj N)
      (N.act (periodicUnitInv A t) ((counitMap A N).app _ x))) = x
  refine (congrArg (fun y : N.obj ⟨0⟩ =>
    ((toCatModule A).obj ((recover A 0).obj N)).act (periodicUnit A t)
      (weightZeroLift A ((recover A 0).obj N) y))
    ((counitMap A N).map_smul (periodicUnitInv A t) x).symm).trans ?_
  change ((toCatModule A).obj ((recover A 0).obj N)).act (periodicUnit A t)
    (weightZeroLift A ((recover A 0).obj N) (counitApp A N 0 _)) = x
  rw [counitApp_zero]
  refine (congrArg (((toCatModule A).obj ((recover A 0).obj N)).act (periodicUnit A t))
    (weightZeroLift_valueEvaluation A ((recover A 0).obj N) _)).trans ?_
  refine (((toCatModule A).obj ((recover A 0).obj N)).act_comp'
    (periodicUnitInv A t) (periodicUnit A t) x).symm.trans ?_
  rw [periodicUnit_inv_comp]
  exact CatModule.act_id' _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.counitApp_supported_bijective
statement:
theorem counitApp_supported_bijective (t : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (counitApp A N (4 * t))
proof:
:=
  ⟨Function.LeftInverse.injective (supported_inv_counit A N t),
    Function.RightInverse.surjective (counit_supported_inv A N t)⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.isIso_counitMap_iff_supported
statement: theorem isIso_counitMap_iff_supported : IsIso (counitMap A N) ↔ Supported A N
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.isIso_iff_bijective]
  constructor
  · intro h w hw
    let := value_subsingleton A ((recover A 0).obj N) w hw
    exact (h ⟨w⟩).surjective.subsingleton
  · intro h
    rintro ⟨w⟩
    by_cases hw : ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hw
      exact counitApp_supported_bijective A N t
    · let := h w hw
      let := value_subsingleton A ((recover A 0).obj N) w hw
      exact ⟨Function.injective_of_subsingleton _, fun y => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ y⟩⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.mem_essImage_toCatModule_iff_supported
statement:
theorem mem_essImage_toCatModule_iff_supported :
    (toCatModule A).essImage N ↔ Supported A N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (diagonalAdjunction A).isIso_counit_app_iff_mem_essImage]
  exact isIso_counitMap_iff_supported A N

name: DG.Diagonal.counit_supported_cohomology_bijective
statement:
theorem counit_supported_cohomology_bijective (t n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (CatModule.cohomologyMap (counitMap A N) ⟨4 * t⟩ n)
proof:
:= by
  let f := (CatModule.precomp (scalarInclusion A (4 * t))).map (counitMap A N)
  have : IsIso f := CatModule.isIso_of_bijective f (fun _ => counitApp_supported_bijective A N t)
  exact CatModule.IsQuasiIso.of_isIso f (SingleObj.star A) n

name: DG.Diagonal.isQuasiIso_counitMap_iff_cohomologicallySupported
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_counitMap_iff_cohomologicallySupported :
    CatModule.IsQuasiIso (counitMap A N) ↔ CohomologicallySupported A N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h w hw n
    let := unsupportedCohomology_subsingleton A ((recover A 0).obj N) w n hw
    exact (h ⟨w⟩ n).surjective.subsingleton
  · intro h
    rintro ⟨w⟩ n
    by_cases hw : ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hw
      exact counit_supported_cohomology_bijective A N t n
    · let := unsupportedCohomology_subsingleton A ((recover A 0).obj N) w n hw
      let := h w hw n
      exact ⟨Function.injective_of_subsingleton _, fun y => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ y⟩⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.isIso_derivedCounit_Q_iff_cohomologicallySupported
statement:
theorem isIso_derivedCounit_Q_iff_cohomologicallySupported :
    IsIso ((diagonalDerivedAdjunction.{w', w, v} A).counit.app
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)) ↔ CohomologicallySupported A N
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalDerivedAdjunction_counit_app_Q, isIso_comp_left_iff,
    isIso_comp_left_iff, CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff]
  exact isQuasiIso_counitMap_iff_cohomologicallySupported A N

name: DG.Diagonal.mem_essImage_toDerived_Q_iff_cohomologicallySupported
statement:
theorem mem_essImage_toDerived_Q_iff_cohomologicallySupported :
    (toDerived.{w', w, v} A).essImage (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ↔
      CohomologicallySupported A N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (diagonalDerivedAdjunction A).isIso_counit_app_iff_mem_essImage]
  exact isIso_derivedCounit_Q_iff_cohomologicallySupported A N

name: DG.Diagonal.mem_essImage_toDerived_iff_of_iso
statement:
theorem mem_essImage_toDerived_iff_of_iso
    (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', v}
      (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded))
    (e : CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj N ≅ X) :
    (toDerived.{w', w, v} A).essImage X ↔ CohomologicallySupported A N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, ⟨f⟩⟩
    exact (mem_essImage_toDerived_Q_iff_cohomologicallySupported A N).mp
      ⟨M, ⟨f ≪≫ e.symm⟩⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨M, ⟨f⟩⟩ := (mem_essImage_toDerived_Q_iff_cohomologicallySupported A N).mpr h
    exact ⟨M, ⟨f ≪≫ e⟩⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.halfDegree_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem halfDegree_mem_range_iff (n w : ℤ) :
    halfDegree 2 (n, w) ∈ Set.range diagonalDegree ↔ ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst hj
    have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd hj
    change 2 * j = w + n * 2 at h₁
    change (j : ZMod 2) = (n : ZMod 2) at h₂
    have hmod := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff' j n 2).mp h₂
    exact ⟨(j - n) / 2, by omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨n + 2 * t, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · change 2 * (n + 2 * t) = 4 * t + n * 2
      ring
    · change ((n + 2 * t : ℤ) : ZMod 2) = (n : ZMod 2)
      apply (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff' _ _ 2).mpr
      omega

name: DG.Diagonal.halfGrading_supported
statement:
theorem halfGrading_supported (n t : ℤ) :
    halfGrading (grading M) 2 (n, 4 * t) = DG.grading (M := M) (n + 2 * t)
proof:
:= by
  have h : halfDegree 2 (n, 4 * t) = diagonalDegree (n + 2 * t) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · change 4 * t + n * 2 = 2 * (n + 2 * t)
      ring
    · change (n : ZMod 2) = ((n + 2 * t : ℤ) : ZMod 2)
      apply (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff' _ _ 2).mpr
      omega
  change grading M (halfDegree 2 (n, 4 * t)) = _
  rw [h, grading_diagonal]

name: DG.Diagonal.halfGrading_unsupported
statement:
theorem halfGrading_unsupported (n w : ℤ) (hw : ¬ ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t) :
    halfGrading (grading M) 2 (n, w) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  grading_eq_bot (by rwa [halfDegree_mem_range_iff])

name: DG.Diagonal.supported_shift_sign
statement: theorem supported_shift_sign (t : ℤ) : koszulSign (2 * t) = 1
proof:
:=
  koszulSign_even (even_two_mul t)

name: DG.Diagonal.evaluation_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_mk (p : ℤ × ℤ) (m : M)
    (hm : m ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 p)) :
    evaluation (HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 p m hm) = m
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.evaluation_d
statement: theorem evaluation_d (x : RegradedModule M) : evaluation (d x) = d (evaluation x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk p m hm => rw [d_mk, evaluation_mk, evaluation_mk]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.homogeneous_eq_mk
proof:
:= by
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p = (n, w)
  · subst p; simp [HalfRegrade.mk]
  · rw [HalfRegrade.mk, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hp]
    by_cases hpn : p.1 = n
    · exact hw p (fun hpw => hp (Prod.ext hpn hpw))
    · exact hn p hpn

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_d
statement:
theorem valueEvaluation_d (w : ℤ) (x : Value A M w) :
    valueEvaluation A M w (d x) = d (valueEvaluation A M w x)
proof: := evaluation_d x.1

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_shift_d
statement:
theorem valueEvaluation_shift_d (t : ℤ) (x : Value A M (4 * t)) :
    Shift.mk (2 * t) (valueEvaluation A M (4 * t) (d x)) =
      d (Shift.mk (2 * t) (valueEvaluation A M (4 * t) x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Shift.d_mk, supported_shift_sign, one_smul, valueEvaluation_d]

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_mem
statement:
theorem valueEvaluation_mem {n t : ℤ} {x : Value A M (4 * t)}
    (hx : x ∈ DG.grading n) : valueEvaluation A M (4 * t) x ∈ DG.grading (n + 2 * t)
proof:
:=
  (componentEquiv M n t ⟨x.1, hx, x.2⟩).2

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_injective_degree
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he : (⟨x.1, hx, x.2⟩ : DG.bigrading (RegradedModule M) (n, 4 * t)) =
      ⟨y.1, hy, y.2⟩ := (componentEquiv M n t).injective (Subtype.ext h)
  exact congrArg (fun z : DG.bigrading (RegradedModule M) (n, 4 * t) => z.1) he

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedElement_mem
statement:
theorem supportedElement_mem (n t : ℤ) (m : DG.grading (M := M) (n + 2 * t)) :
    supportedElement A M n t m ∈ DG.grading n
proof: := ((componentEquiv M n t).symm m).2.1

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_supportedElement
statement:
@[simp] theorem valueEvaluation_supportedElement (n t : ℤ)
    (m : DG.grading (M := M) (n + 2 * t)) :
    valueEvaluation A M (4 * t) (supportedElement A M n t m) = m
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val ((componentEquiv M n t).apply_symm_apply m)

name: DG.Diagonal.value_subsingleton
statement:
theorem value_subsingleton (w : ℤ) (hw : ¬ ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t) :
    Subsingleton (Value A M w)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ x : Value A M w, x = 0 from ⟨fun x y => (h x).trans (h y).symm⟩
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change x.1 = (0 : RegradedModule M)
  refine HalfRegrade.weightGrading_induction (P := fun x : RegradedModule M => x = 0) rfl
    (fun n m hm => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => by rw [hx, hy, add_zero]) x.2
  have hm0 : m = 0 := by
    change m ∈ halfGrading (grading M) 2 (n, w) at hm
    rw [halfGrading_unsupported n w hw] at hm
    exact hm
  subst m
  exact HalfRegrade.mk_zero _

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem valueEvaluation_mem_coboundaries_iff (n t : ℤ) (z : cocycles (Value A M (4 * t)) n) :
    valueEvaluation A M (4 * t) z ∈ coboundaries M (n + 2 * t) ↔
      (z : Value A M (4 * t)) ∈ coboundaries (Value A M (4 * t)) n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, hd⟩
    change m ∈ DG.grading (n + 2 * t - 1) at hm
    let y := supportedElement A M (n - 1) t ⟨m, by
      simpa only [show n - 1 + 2 * t = n + 2 * t - 1 by omega] using hm⟩
    refine ⟨y, supportedElement_mem A M _ _ _, ?_⟩
    apply valueEvaluation_injective_degree A M (n := n)
      (by simpa using DG.d_mem (supportedElement_mem A M (n - 1) t _)) z.2.1
    rw [valueEvaluation_d, valueEvaluation_supportedElement, hd]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hd⟩
    refine ⟨valueEvaluation A M (4 * t) y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change valueEvaluation A M (4 * t) y ∈ DG.grading (n + 2 * t - 1)
      simpa only [show n - 1 + 2 * t = n + 2 * t - 1 by omega] using valueEvaluation_mem A M hy
    · rw [← valueEvaluation_d, hd]

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCohomologyMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportedCohomologyMap_mk (n t : ℤ) (z : cocycles (Value A M (4 * t)) n) :
    supportedCohomologyMap A M n t (cohomology.mk _ n z) =
      cohomology.mk M _ (supportedCocycles A M n t z)
proof: := cohomology.lift_mk _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCohomologyMap_bijective
statement:
theorem supportedCohomologyMap_bijective (n t : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (supportedCohomologyMap A M n t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := cohomology.mk_surjective _ _ x
    rw [supportedCohomologyMap_mk, cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff] at hx
    exact (cohomology.mk_eq_zero_iff _).mpr
      ((valueEvaluation_mem_coboundaries_iff A M n t z).mp hx)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := cohomology.mk_surjective _ _ x
    let y := supportedElement A M n t ⟨z, z.2.1⟩
    have hy : d y = 0 := by
      apply valueEvaluation_injective_degree A M (n := n + 1)
        (DG.d_mem (supportedElement_mem A M n t _)) (zero_mem _)
      rw [valueEvaluation_d, valueEvaluation_supportedElement, z.2.2, map_zero]
    refine ⟨cohomology.mk _ n ⟨y, supportedElement_mem A M n t _, hy⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [supportedCohomologyMap_mk]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact valueEvaluation_supportedElement A M n t _

name: DG.Diagonal.unsupportedCohomology_subsingleton
statement:
theorem unsupportedCohomology_subsingleton (w n : ℤ) (hw : ¬ ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t) :
    Subsingleton (cohomology (Value A M w) n)
proof:
:= by
  let := value_subsingleton A M w hw
  exact ⟨fun x y => by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := cohomology.mk_surjective _ _ x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := cohomology.mk_surjective _ _ y
    exact congrArg (cohomology.mk _ _) (Subsingleton.elim x y)⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.evaluation_regradedMap
statement:
theorem evaluation_regradedMap (f : M ⟶ N) (x : RegradedModule M) :
    evaluation (regradedMap f x) = f.hom (evaluation x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk p m hm => rw [regradedMap_mk, evaluation_mk, evaluation_mk]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedCohomologyMap_natural
statement:
theorem supportedCohomologyMap_natural (f : M ⟶ N) (n t : ℤ)
    (x : cohomology (Value A M (4 * t)) n) :
    supportedCohomologyMap A N n t (CatModule.cohomologyMap ((toCatModule A).map f) ⟨4 * t⟩ n x) =
      cohomology.map f.hom (n + 2 * t) (supportedCohomologyMap A M n t x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := cohomology.mk_surjective _ _ x
  rw [CatModule.cohomologyMap_mk, supportedCohomologyMap_mk,
    supportedCohomologyMap_mk, cohomology.map_mk]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact evaluation_regradedMap f z.1.1

name: DG.Diagonal.supported_bijective_iff
statement:
theorem supported_bijective_iff (f : M ⟶ N) (n t : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (CatModule.cohomologyMap ((toCatModule A).map f) ⟨4 * t⟩ n) ↔
      Function.Bijective (cohomology.map f.hom (n + 2 * t))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (supportedCohomologyMap A N n t) ∘
      (CatModule.cohomologyMap ((toCatModule A).map f) ⟨4 * t⟩ n) =
      (cohomology.map f.hom (n + 2 * t)) ∘ (supportedCohomologyMap A M n t) :=
    funext (supportedCohomologyMap_natural f n t)
  rw [← (supportedCohomologyMap_bijective A N n t).of_comp_iff', h,
    Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff _ (supportedCohomologyMap_bijective A M n t)]

name: DG.Diagonal.isQuasiIso_toCatModule_iff
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_toCatModule_iff (f : M ⟶ N) :
    CatModule.IsQuasiIso ((toCatModule A).map f) ↔ f.hom.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf n
    have h := (supported_bijective_iff f n 0).mp (hf ⟨4 * 0⟩ n)
    have hn : n + 2 * (0 : ℤ) = n := by omega
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  · intro hf w n
    obtain ⟨w⟩ := w
    by_cases hw : ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hw
      exact (supported_bijective_iff f n t).mpr (hf _)
    · let := unsupportedCohomology_subsingleton A M w n hw
      let := unsupportedCohomology_subsingleton A N w n hw
      exact ⟨fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun y => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.quasiIso_toCatModule_iff
statement:
theorem quasiIso_toCatModule_iff (f : M ⟶ N) :
    CatModule.IsQuasiIso ((toCatModule A).map f) ↔ DGModuleCat.quasiIso A f
proof:
:=
  isQuasiIso_toCatModule_iff f

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalDerivedAdjunction_unit_app_Q
statement:
theorem diagonalDerivedAdjunction_unit_app_Q (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    (diagonalDerivedAdjunction A).unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (recoveryIso A M).inv ≫
        (recoveryDerivedObjIso A 0 ((toCatModule A).obj M)).inv ≫
        (recoveryDerived A 0).map (toDerivedObjIso A M).inv
proof:
:= by
  exact (diagonalAdjunction A).localization_unit_app _ _ _ _ _ _ M

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalDerivedAdjunction_counit_app_Q
statement:
theorem diagonalDerivedAdjunction_counit_app_Q
    (N : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    (diagonalDerivedAdjunction A).counit.app (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) =
      (toDerived A).map (recoveryDerivedObjIso A 0 N).hom ≫
        (toDerivedObjIso A ((recover A 0).obj N)).hom ≫
        CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map (counitMap A N)
proof:
:= by
  exact (diagonalAdjunction A).localization_counit_app _ _ _ _ _ _ N

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalDerivedAdjunction_unit
statement:
theorem diagonalDerivedAdjunction_unit :
    (diagonalDerivedAdjunction.{w', w, v} A).unit = (derivedRecoveryNatIso A).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (derivedRecoveryNatIso A).hom).mp
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
  apply Localization.natTrans_ext DerivedCategory.Q (DGModuleCat.quasiIso A)
  intro M
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, diagonalDerivedAdjunction_unit_app_Q,
    derivedRecoveryNatIso_hom_app_Q, NatTrans.id_app]
  simp [← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerived_map_preimage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDerived_map_preimage {M N : DerivedCategory.{w, v} A}
    (f : (toDerived.{w', w, v} A).obj M ⟶ (toDerived A).obj N) :
    (toDerived A).map (toDerivedPreimage A f) = f
proof:
:=
  (toDerivedFullyFaithful A).map_preimage f

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerived_preimage_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDerived_preimage_map {M N : DerivedCategory.{w, v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    toDerivedPreimage A ((toDerived.{w', w, v} A).map f) = f
proof:
:=
  (toDerivedFullyFaithful A).preimage_map f

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.exists_eq_place
statement:
theorem exists_eq_place {x : H.Regraded} {n w : ℤ} (hn : x ∈ grading n) (hw : x ∈ wgrading w) :
    ∃ (a : A) (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k (n, w))), x = H.place (n, w) a ha
proof:
:= by
  let y : ⨁ p : ℤ × ℤ, ↥(halfGrading H.hgrading k p) := x
  refine ⟨(y (n, w) : A), (y (n, w)).2, ?_⟩
  have hsupp : ∀ p, p ≠ (n, w) → y p = 0 := fun p hp => by
    by_cases h1 : p.1 = n
    · exact hw p (fun h2 => hp (Prod.ext h1 h2))
    · exact hn p h1
  change y = DirectSum.of _ (n, w) (y (n, w))
  ext p : 1
  by_cases hp : p = (n, w)
  · subst hp; rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same]
  · rw [hsupp p hp, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hp]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.place_injective
statement:
theorem place_injective {p : ℤ × ℤ} {a a' : A} {ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)}
    {ha' : a' ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)} (h : H.place p a ha = H.place p a' ha') : a = a'
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun p => ↥(halfGrading H.hgrading k p)) p
    (a₁ := ⟨a, ha⟩) (a₂ := ⟨a', ha'⟩) h)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mem_zeroSubring
statement: theorem mem_zeroSubring {a : A} : a ∈ H.zeroSubring ↔ a ∈ H.hgrading 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.zeroHom_val
statement:
theorem zeroHom_val (X : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (s : H.zeroSubring) :
    (H.zeroHom X s).1 = H.place 0 s (by rw [map_zero]; exact mem_zeroSubring.mp s.2)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.zeroHom_mem_grading
statement:
theorem zeroHom_mem_grading (X : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (s : H.zeroSubring) :
    H.zeroHom X s ∈ grading 0
proof:
:=
  place_mem_grading (H := H) 0 _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.zeroHom_comp
statement:
theorem zeroHom_comp (X : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (s t : H.zeroSubring) :
    H.zeroHom X s ≫ H.zeroHom X t = H.zeroHom X (t * s)
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext (by
    rw [WeightCategory.comp_val, zeroHom_val, zeroHom_val, zeroHom_val, place_mul_place]
    exact place_congr (add_zero 0) rfl _ _)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.zeroHom_one
statement: theorem zeroHom_one (X : WeightCategory H.Regraded) : H.zeroHom X 1 = 𝟙 X
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.zeroHom_injective
statement:
theorem zeroHom_injective (X : WeightCategory H.Regraded) :
    Function.Injective (H.zeroHom X)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  exact Subtype.ext (place_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.internalZeroProj_apply
statement:
theorem internalZeroProj_apply (a : A) :
    H.internalZeroProj a = ∑ ε : ZMod 2, (decompose H.hgrading a (0, ε) : A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.internalZeroProj_of_mem
statement:
theorem internalZeroProj_of_mem {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading p) :
    H.internalZeroProj a = if p.1 = 0 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, ε₀⟩ := p
  rw [internalZeroProj_apply]
  split_ifs with hj
  · change j = 0 at hj
    subst hj
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ε₀ (fun ε _ hε => decompose_of_mem_ne _ ha
        (fun h => hε (congrArg Prod.snd h).symm)) (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ ε₀) h),
      decompose_of_mem_same _ ha]
  · exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ε _ => decompose_of_mem_ne _ ha
      (fun h => hj (congrArg Prod.fst h))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.internalZeroProj_mem
statement: theorem internalZeroProj_mem (a : A) : H.internalZeroProj a ∈ H.internalZeroSubring
proof:
:= by
  rw [internalZeroProj_apply]
  exact sum_mem fun _ _ => mem_internalZeroSubring_of_mem (SetLike.coe_mem _)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.internalZeroProj_of_mem_internalZeroSubring
statement:
theorem internalZeroProj_of_mem_internalZeroSubring {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.internalZeroSubring) :
    H.internalZeroProj a = a
proof:
:=
  internalZeroSubring_induction (P := fun a => H.internalZeroProj a = a)
    (fun ha' => (internalZeroProj_of_mem ha').trans (ite_eq_left rfl))
    (fun a b ha hb => by rw [map_add, ha, hb]) ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.regraded_regraded_of_retract
statement:
theorem regraded_regraded_of_retract {x : H.Regraded} (hx : x ∈ grading 0)
    (hw : x ∈ wgrading 0) : i.regraded (p.regraded x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_place hx hw
  have h0 : halfDegree k ((0 : ℤ), (0 : ℤ)) = 0 := map_zero (halfDegree k)
  have ha0 : a ∈ H.hgrading 0 := by
    rw [← h0]
    exact ha
  rw [Hom.regraded_place, Hom.regraded_place]
  exact place_congr rfl (hip ha0) _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.map_map_of_retract
statement:
theorem map_map_of_retract {X : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (e : DGCategory.Idempotent X) :
    (e.map p.weightFunctor).map i.weightFunctor = e
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.idempotent_ext (regraded_regraded_of_retract i p hip (x := e.val.1)
    (WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mp e.mem_grading)
    (WeightCategory.mem_wgrading_of_eq (sub_self _) e.val.2))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.of_isSemisimpleRing
statement:
theorem IsPositive.of_isSemisimpleRing (pos : 0 < k)
    (eq_zero_of_lt : ∀ {j : ℤ} {ε : ZMod 2} {a : A}, j < k → (j, ε) ≠ 0 →
      a ∈ H.hgrading (j, ε) → a = 0)
    (isSemisimple : IsSemisimpleRing H.zeroSubring)
    (hd_eq_zero : ∀ {a : A}, a ∈ H.hgrading 0 → H.hd a = 0) : H.IsPositive where
  pos
proof:
:= pos
  eq_zero_of_lt hj hj0 ha := eq_zero_of_lt hj (fun h => hj0 (congrArg Prod.fst h)) ha
  isGradedSemisimple := isGradedSemisimpleRing_internalZeroGrading_of_odd
    (fun _ ha => eq_zero_of_lt pos (fun h => one_ne_zero (congrArg Prod.snd h)) ha) isSemisimple
  hd_eq_zero {ε} {a} ha := by
    rcases HalfGradedDGRing.zmod_two_cases ε with rfl | rfl
    · exact hd_eq_zero ha
    · rw [eq_zero_of_lt pos (fun h => one_ne_zero (congrArg Prod.snd h)) ha, map_zero]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.hd_eq_zero_of_mem_zero
statement: theorem hd_eq_zero_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading 0) : H.hd a = 0
proof:
:=
  hH.hd_eq_zero (ε := 0) ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.hd_eq_zero_of_mem_internalZeroSubring
statement:
theorem hd_eq_zero_of_mem_internalZeroSubring {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.internalZeroSubring) :
    H.hd a = 0
proof:
:=
  internalZeroSubring_induction (P := fun a => H.hd a = 0) (fun ha' => hH.hd_eq_zero ha')
    (fun a b ha hb => by rw [map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]) ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.d_zeroHom
statement:
theorem d_zeroHom (X : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (s : H.zeroSubring) :
    d (H.zeroHom X s) = 0
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext (by
    rw [WeightCategory.d_val, zeroHom_val, d_place]
    exact (place_congr rfl (hH.hd_eq_zero_of_mem_zero (mem_zeroSubring.mp s.2)) _ _).trans
      (place_zero _))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.internalZeroProj_mul_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hab : a * b ∈ H.hgrading (p + q) := SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ha hb
  rw [internalZeroProj_of_mem hab, internalZeroProj_of_mem ha, internalZeroProj_of_mem hb,
    Prod.fst_add]
  have hk := hH.pos
  by_cases hp : p.1 = 0
  · by_cases hq : q.1 = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_left (by rw [hp, hq, add_zero]), ite_eq_left hp, ite_eq_left hq]
    · rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [hp, zero_add]; exact hq), ite_eq_right hq, mul_zero]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hp, zero_mul]
    by_cases hq : q.1 = 0
    · rw [ite_eq_right (by rw [hq, add_zero]; exact hp)]
    · split_ifs with hpq
      · by_cases hp0 : p.1 < 0
        · rw [hH.eq_zero_of_lt (by omega) hp ha, zero_mul]
        · rw [hH.eq_zero_of_lt (j := q.1) (ε := q.2) (by omega) hq hb, mul_zero]
      · rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.internalZeroProj_mul
statement:
theorem internalZeroProj_mul (a b : A) :
    H.internalZeroProj (a * b) = H.internalZeroProj a * H.internalZeroProj b
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn H.hgrading
    (motive := fun a => H.internalZeroProj (a * b) = H.internalZeroProj a * H.internalZeroProj b)
    ?_ (fun {p} x => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_) a
  · simp
  · refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn H.hgrading
      (motive := fun b => H.internalZeroProj ((x : A) * b) =
        H.internalZeroProj (x : A) * H.internalZeroProj b) ?_ (fun {q} y => ?_)
      (fun y z hy hz => ?_) b
    · simp
    · exact hH.internalZeroProj_mul_of_mem x.2 y.2
    · simp only [mul_add, map_add, hy, hz]
  · simp only [add_mul, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.internalZeroProj_hd
statement: theorem internalZeroProj_hd (a : A) : H.internalZeroProj (H.hd a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn H.hgrading
    (motive := fun a => H.internalZeroProj (H.hd a) = 0) ?_ (fun {p} x => ?_)
    (fun x y hx hy => ?_) a
  · simp
  · have hx : H.hd x ∈ H.hgrading (p.1 + k, p.2 + 1) := H.hd_mem (j := p.1) (ε := p.2) x.2
    rw [internalZeroProj_of_mem hx]
    split_ifs with h0
    · have hk := hH.pos
      have h1 : p.1 + k = 0 := h0
      rw [hH.eq_zero_of_lt (j := p.1) (ε := p.2) (by omega) (by omega) x.2, map_zero]
    · rfl
  · rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

statement: theorem coe_incl_apply (a : H.internalZeroSubring) : hH.incl a = (a : A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

statement: theorem coe_proj_apply (a : A) : (hH.proj a : A) = H.internalZeroProj a

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.proj_comp_incl
statement: theorem proj_comp_incl : hH.proj.comp hH.incl = Hom.id H.internalZeroPart

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.incl_proj_of_mem_zero
statement: theorem incl_proj_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading 0) : hH.incl (hH.proj a) = a
proof:
:=

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.coe_decompose_zero_eq_internalZeroProj
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_zero_eq_internalZeroProj (a : A) :
    (decompose H.hgrading a 0 : A) = H.internalZeroProj a
proof:
:= by
  rw [internalZeroProj_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : ZMod 2)]
  · rfl
  · intro ε _ hε
    rcases HalfGradedDGRing.zmod_two_cases ε with rfl | rfl
    · exact absurd rfl hε
    · exact hodd _ (SetLike.coe_mem _)
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

statement: theorem projEven_comp_inclEven : (hH.projEven hodd).comp hH.inclEven = Hom.id H.degreeZeroPart
proof:
:=
  Hom.ext fun a => Subtype.ext (decompose_of_mem_same _ (mem_zeroSubring.mp a.2))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.inclEven_projEven_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem inclEven_projEven_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading 0) :

proof:
:=
  decompose_of_mem_same _ ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.bidegree_swap
statement: theorem bidegree_swap (i j : PositiveModel H) : bidegree j i 0 = -bidegree i j 0
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext (by
    change 0 + ((H.shiftFamily i.as).2 - (H.shiftFamily j.as).2) =
      -(0 + ((H.shiftFamily j.as).2 - (H.shiftFamily i.as).2))
    ring) (by
    change i.as.as - j.as.as = -(j.as.as - i.as.as)
    ring)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.halfDegree_bidegree_fst
statement:
theorem halfDegree_bidegree_fst (i j : PositiveModel H) (n : ℤ) :
    (halfDegree k (bidegree i j n)).1 = j.as.as % k - i.as.as % k + n * k
proof:
:= by
  change j.as.as - i.as.as + (n + (-(j.as.as / k) - -(i.as.as / k))) * k = _
  rw [Int.emod_def, Int.emod_def]
  ring

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.exists_eq_place_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem exists_eq_place_of_mem_grading {i j : PositiveModel H} {n : ℤ} {f : i ⟶ j}
    (hf : f ∈ grading n) :
    ∃ (a : A) (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k (bidegree i j n))),
      (ShiftedObjects.homVal f).1 = H.place (bidegree i j n) a ha
proof:
:=
  exists_eq_place (x := (ShiftedObjects.homVal f).1)
    (n := n + ((H.shiftFamily j.as).2 - (H.shiftFamily i.as).2)) (w := j.as.as - i.as.as)
    (WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mp (ShiftedObjects.mem_grading_iff.mp hf))
    (ShiftedObjects.homVal f).2

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.eq_zero_and_halfDegree_fst_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩ := exists_eq_place_of_mem_grading hf
  have hk := hH.pos
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hf0 (ShiftedObjects.hom_ext (WeightCategory.hom_ext (hfa.trans (place_zero _))))
  have h1 := halfDegree_bidegree_fst i j n
  have hj := Int.emod_lt_of_pos j.as.as hk
  have hi := Int.emod_nonneg i.as.as hk.ne'
  have hnk : n * k ≤ 0 := by
    have := mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hn) hk.le
    linarith
  have hz : (halfDegree k (bidegree i j n)).1 = 0 := by
    by_contra h
    exact ha0 (hH.eq_zero_of_lt (j := (halfDegree k (bidegree i j n)).1)
      (ε := (halfDegree k (bidegree i j n)).2) (by rw [h1]; linarith) h ha)
  refine ⟨?_, hz⟩
  by_contra hn0
  have hn1 : n ≤ -1 := by omega
  have h2 : n * k ≤ -1 * k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn1 hk.le
  rw [h1] at hz
  linarith

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.mem_internalZero_of_mem_grading_zero
statement:
theorem mem_internalZero_of_mem_grading_zero {i j : PositiveModel H} {f : i ⟶ j}
    (hf : f ∈ grading 0) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k (bidegree i j 0)))
    (hfa : (ShiftedObjects.homVal f).1 = H.place (bidegree i j 0) a ha) :
    a ∈ H.hgrading (0, (halfDegree k (bidegree i j 0)).2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  · have : a = 0 := by
      have h0 : (ShiftedObjects.homVal f).1 = 0 := by rw [hf0]; rfl
      rw [hfa] at h0
      exact place_injective (h0.trans (place_zero _).symm)
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _
  · have hz := (hH.eq_zero_and_halfDegree_fst_eq_zero hf le_rfl hf0).2
    rwa [show halfDegree k (bidegree i j 0) = (0, (halfDegree k (bidegree i j 0)).2) from
      Prod.ext hz rfl] at ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.isSimple_idempotentMk
statement:
theorem isSimple_idempotentMk (i : PositiveModel H) {s : H.zeroSubring}
    (hs : IsIdempotentElem s) {e : H.internalZeroSubring} (hse : (e : A) = s)
    (hes : IsGradedSimpleIdempotent H.internalZeroGrading e) :
    (ShiftedObjects.idempotentMk (i := i) (hH.idem i.as s hs)).IsSimple
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h0 => ?_, fun j h hh heh hh0 => ?_⟩
  · have h0' : H.zeroHom i.as s = 0 := h0
    have hs0 : s = 0 := zeroHom_injective i.as (h0'.trans (map_zero (H.zeroHom i.as)).symm)
    exact hes.1 (Subtype.ext (by rw [hse, hs0]; rfl))
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩ := exists_eq_place_of_mem_grading hh
  have ha' := hH.mem_internalZero_of_mem_grading_zero hh ha hfa
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hh0 (ShiftedObjects.hom_ext (WeightCategory.hom_ext (hfa.trans (place_zero _))))
  have hmem : a * (s : A) ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k (bidegree i j 0)) := by
    have := SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ha (mem_zeroSubring.mp s.2)
    rwa [add_zero] at this
  have has : a * (s : A) = a := by
    have h1 : (ShiftedObjects.homVal h).1 * (H.zeroHom i.as s).1 = (ShiftedObjects.homVal h).1 :=
      congrArg (fun f : i ⟶ j => (ShiftedObjects.homVal f).1) heh
    rw [hfa, zeroHom_val, place_mul_place] at h1
    exact place_injective ((place_congr (add_zero _) rfl _ hmem).symm.trans h1)
  let x : H.internalZeroSubring := ⟨a, mem_internalZeroSubring_of_mem ha'⟩
  have hx : x ∈ H.internalZeroGrading (halfDegree k (bidegree i j 0)) :=
    mem_internalZeroGrading_iff.mpr ha
  have hxe : x * e = x := Subtype.ext (by
    change a * (e : A) = a
    rw [hse, has])
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h => ha0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcx⟩ := hes.2 hx hxe hx0
  have hcmem : (c : A) ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k (bidegree j i 0)) := by
    rw [bidegree_swap i j, map_neg]
    exact mem_internalZeroGrading_iff.mp hc
  have he : (ShiftedObjects.homVal
      (ShiftedObjects.idempotentMk (i := i) (hH.idem i.as s hs)).val).1 =
      H.place 0 s (by rw [map_zero]; exact mem_zeroSubring.mp s.2) := rfl
  refine ⟨ShiftedObjects.homMk ⟨H.place (bidegree j i 0) c hcmem,
      place_mem_wgrading (H := H) (bidegree j i 0) hcmem⟩,
    ShiftedObjects.mem_grading_iff.mpr (WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mpr
      (place_mem_grading (H := H) (bidegree j i 0) hcmem)), ?_⟩
  refine ShiftedObjects.hom_ext (WeightCategory.hom_ext ?_)
  exact ((congrArg (fun y => H.place (bidegree j i 0) c hcmem * y) hfa).trans
    ((place_mul_place hcmem ha).trans
      (place_congr (by rw [bidegree_swap i j, neg_add_cancel])
        ((congrArg Subtype.val hcx).trans hse) _ _))).trans he.symm

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.isDegreeZeroSemisimple
statement: theorem isDegreeZeroSemisimple : DGCategory.IsDegreeZeroSemisimple (PositiveModel H)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hlp, hlsum⟩ := hH.isGradedSemisimple.exists_list_sum_eq_one
  let z : ∀ e ∈ l, H.zeroSubring := fun e he =>
    ⟨e, mem_zeroSubring.mpr (mem_internalZeroGrading_iff.mp (hl e he).1)⟩
  have hz : ∀ e (he : e ∈ l), IsIdempotentElem (z e he) := fun e he =>
    Subtype.ext (show (e : A) * e = e from congrArg Subtype.val (hl e he).2.1)
  let E : ∀ e ∈ l, DGCategory.Idempotent i := fun e he =>
    ShiftedObjects.idempotentMk (i := i) (hH.idem i.as (z e he) (hz e he))
  refine ⟨l.pmap E fun _ h => h, fun f hf => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_pmap.mp hf
    exact hH.isSimple_idempotentMk i (hz e he) rfl (hl e he).2.2
  · rw [List.pairwise_pmap]
    refine hlp.imp_of_mem fun {a b} ha hb hab _ _ => ?_
    have hba : z b hb * z a ha = 0 :=
      Subtype.ext (show (b : A) * a = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val hab.2)
    have hab' : z a ha * z b hb = 0 :=
      Subtype.ext (show (a : A) * b = 0 from congrArg Subtype.val hab.1)
    refine ⟨ShiftedObjects.hom_ext ?_, ShiftedObjects.hom_ext ?_⟩
    · change H.zeroHom i.as (z a ha) ≫ H.zeroHom i.as (z b hb) = 0
      rw [zeroHom_comp, hba, map_zero]
    · change H.zeroHom i.as (z b hb) ≫ H.zeroHom i.as (z a ha) = 0
      rw [zeroHom_comp, hab', map_zero]
  · rw [List.map_pmap]
    let ψ : H.zeroSubring →+ (i ⟶ i) :=
      { toFun := fun s => ShiftedObjects.homMk (H.zeroHom i.as s)
        map_zero' := ShiftedObjects.hom_ext (map_zero (H.zeroHom i.as))
        map_add' := fun s t => ShiftedObjects.hom_ext (map_add (H.zeroHom i.as) s t) }
    change (l.pmap (fun (e : H.internalZeroSubring) (he : e ∈ l) => ψ (z e he))
      fun _ h => h).sum = 𝟙 i
    have hsum : (l.pmap z fun _ h => h).sum = 1 := by
      apply H.zeroSubring.subtype_injective
      rw [map_list_sum, List.map_pmap, map_one]
      change (l.pmap (fun (e : H.internalZeroSubring) _ => (e : A)) fun _ h => h).sum = 1
      rw [List.pmap_eq_map]
      exact (map_list_sum H.internalZeroSubring.subtype l).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val hlsum)
    have hmap : l.pmap (fun e he => ψ (z e he)) (fun _ h => h) =
        (l.pmap z fun _ h => h).map ψ := by
      rw [List.map_pmap]
    rw [hmap, ← map_list_sum, hsum]
    exact ShiftedObjects.hom_ext (zeroHom_one i.as)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.isPositive_positiveModel
statement:
theorem isPositive_positiveModel : DGCategory.IsPositive (PositiveModel H) where
  eq_zero_of_neg
proof:
:= by
    intro i j n hn f hf
    by_contra hf0
    have := (hH.eq_zero_and_halfDegree_fst_eq_zero hf hn.le hf0).1
    omega
  semisimple := hH.isDegreeZeroSemisimple
  d_eq_zero := by
    intro i j f hf
    by_cases hf0 : f = 0
    · rw [hf0, d_zero]
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hfa⟩ := exists_eq_place_of_mem_grading hf
    have ha' := hH.mem_internalZero_of_mem_grading_zero hf ha hfa
    have hd : d (ShiftedObjects.homVal f) = 0 := WeightCategory.hom_ext (by
      rw [WeightCategory.d_val, hfa, d_place]
      exact (place_congr rfl (hH.hd_eq_zero ha') _ _).trans (place_zero _))
    refine ShiftedObjects.hom_ext ?_
    rw [ShiftedObjects.homVal_d]
    exact (congrArg _ hd).trans (smul_zero _)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.closure_cell_eq_top
statement:
theorem closure_cell_eq_top :
    AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun c : DGCategory.Corner (WeightCategory H.Regraded) =>
      DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} c.2 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.mpr (le_trans (le_of_eq (ShiftedObjects.closure_cell_eq_top_of_isPositive.{w}
    H.shiftFamily (fun Y => ⟨Y, rfl⟩) hH.isPositive_positiveModel).symm)
    (AddSubgroup.closure_mono ?_))
  rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨⟨_, ShiftedObjects.idempotentVal c.1.2⟩, rfl⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.K0Map_K0Map_of_retract
statement:
theorem K0Map_K0Map_of_retract (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    i.K0Map.{w} (p.K0Map.{w} x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ AddSubgroup.closure
      (Set.range fun c : DGCategory.Corner (WeightCategory H.Regraded) =>
        DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} c.2 0) := by
    rw [hH.closure_cell_eq_top.{w}]
    trivial
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ((congrArg (fun y => i.K0Map.{w} y)
      (DGCategory.K0.map_cell.{max u w} p.weightFunctor c.2)).trans
      (DGCategory.K0.map_cell.{max u w} i.weightFunctor (c.2.map p.weightFunctor))).trans
      (congrArg (fun e => DGCategory.K0.cell.{max u w} e 0) (map_map_of_retract i p hip c.2))
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.IsPositive.K0Map_K0Map_of_comp_eq_id
statement:
theorem K0Map_K0Map_of_comp_eq_id (hpi : p.comp i = Hom.id H')
    (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory H'.Regraded)) :
    p.K0Map.{w} (i.K0Map.{w} x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hom.K0Map_apply, Hom.K0Map_apply, ← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, ← DGCategory.K0.map_comp]
  simp only [← Hom.weightFunctor_comp, hpi, Hom.weightFunctor_id, DGCategory.K0.map_id,
    AddMonoidHom.id_apply]

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_apply
statement:
theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_apply
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    diagonalConeEvaluation A f p =
      (Shift.mk 1 (valueEvaluation A M 0 (CatModule.shift.unmk 1 p.1)),
        valueEvaluation A N 0 p.2)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_lift (p : Cone f.hom) :
    diagonalConeEvaluation A f (diagonalConeLift A f p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalConeEvaluation_apply]
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact congrArg (Shift.mk 1) (valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift A M _)
  · exact valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift A N _

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeLift_evaluation
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalConeLift_evaluation
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    diagonalConeLift A f (diagonalConeEvaluation A f p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalConeEvaluation_apply]
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact congrArg (CatModule.shift.mk 1) (weightZeroLift_valueEvaluation A M _)
  · exact weightZeroLift_valueEvaluation A N _

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeRecoveryIso_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalConeRecoveryIso_hom_apply
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    (diagonalConeRecoveryIso A f).hom p = diagonalConeEvaluation A f p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeRecoveryIso_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalConeRecoveryIso_inv_apply (p : Cone f.hom) :
    (diagonalConeRecoveryIso A f).inv p = diagonalConeLift A f p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_inr
statement:
theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_inr (y : Value A N 0) :
    diagonalConeEvaluation A f ((CatModule.cone.inr ((toCatModule A).map f)).app ⟨0⟩ y) =
      Cone.inr f.hom (valueEvaluation A N 0 y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalConeEvaluation_apply]
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact congrArg (Shift.mk 1) (map_zero (valueEvaluation A M 0))
  · rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_fst
statement:
theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_fst
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    Cone.fstHom f.hom (diagonalConeEvaluation A f p) =
      Shift.mk 1 (valueEvaluation A M 0 (CatModule.shift.unmk 1
        ((CatModule.cone.fstHom ((toCatModule A).map f)).app ⟨0⟩ p)))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_snd
statement:
theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_snd
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    Cone.sndLinear f.hom (diagonalConeEvaluation A f p) =
      valueEvaluation A N 0 (CatModule.cone.sndAddHom ((toCatModule A).map f) ⟨0⟩ p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_connecting
statement:
theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_connecting
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    -Shift.unmk 1 (Cone.fstHom f.hom (diagonalConeEvaluation A f p)) =
      valueEvaluation A M 0 (-CatModule.shift.unmk 1
        ((CatModule.cone.fstHom ((toCatModule A).map f)).app ⟨0⟩ p))
proof:
:= by
  exact (map_neg (valueEvaluation A M 0) _).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_triangle_mor₃
statement:
theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_triangle_mor₃
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    Shift.unmk 1 ((Cone.triangle f).mor₃ (diagonalConeEvaluation A f p)) =
      valueEvaluation A M 0 (CatModule.shift.unmk 1
        ((CatModule.cone.triangle ((toCatModule A).map f)).mor₃.app ⟨0⟩ p))
proof:
:=
  diagonalConeEvaluation_connecting A f p

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_d_fst
statement:
theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_d_fst
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    Shift.unmk 1 (Cone.fstHom f.hom (diagonalConeEvaluation A f (d p))) =
      -d (valueEvaluation A M 0 (CatModule.shift.unmk 1 p.1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(diagonalConeEvaluation A f).hom.map_d, Cone.fstHom_d, Shift.unmk_d]
  simp only [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.neg_smul, one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeEvaluation_d_snd
statement:
theorem diagonalConeEvaluation_d_snd
    (p : (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).obj ⟨0⟩) :
    Cone.sndLinear f.hom (diagonalConeEvaluation A f (d p)) =
      f.hom (valueEvaluation A M 0 (CatModule.shift.unmk 1 p.1)) +
        d (valueEvaluation A N 0 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(diagonalConeEvaluation A f).hom.map_d, Cone.sndLinear_d]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0Equiv_mk
statement:
theorem superK0Equiv_mk (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    superK0Equiv H (K0Rel.mk X) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (K0.mk X)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isCompact_parityShiftD_obj
proof:
:=
  ((isCompact_internalShift_obj_iff H.Regraded (-k) X).mpr hX).shift 1

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem superK0cEquiv_mk
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    superK0cEquiv H (K0Rel.mk X) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (K0.mk X)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.zmod_two_cases
statement: theorem zmod_two_cases (ε : ZMod 2) : ε = 0 ∨ ε = 1
proof:
:= by
  revert ε
  decide

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superGrading_zero
statement: theorem superGrading_zero (ε : ZMod 2) : superGrading ℬ (0, ε) = ℬ ε
proof:
:= by
  simp [superGrading]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.eq_zero_of_mem_superGrading
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_superGrading {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} (hp : p.1 ≠ 0) {x : B}
    (hx : x ∈ superGrading ℬ p) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [superGrading, hp] using hx

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superDecompose_of_mem
statement:
theorem superDecompose_of_mem {ε : ZMod 2} {x : B} (hx : x ∈ ℬ ε) :
    superDecompose ℬ x =
      DirectSum.of (fun p => superGrading ℬ p) (0, ε) (superIncl ℬ ε ⟨x, hx⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [superDecompose, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom,
    decomposeAddEquiv_apply, decompose_of_mem ℬ hx, toAddMonoid_of]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.ofSuper_hd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofSuper_hd (k : ℤ) (b : B) : (ofSuper ℬ k).hd b = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.ofSuper_hgrading
statement: theorem ofSuper_hgrading (k : ℤ) : (ofSuper ℬ k).hgrading = superGrading ℬ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mem_internalZeroSubring_iff
statement:
theorem mem_internalZeroSubring_iff {a : A} :
    a ∈ H.internalZeroSubring ↔ a ∈ H.hgrading (0, 0) ⊔ H.hgrading (0, 1)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mem_internalZeroSubring_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_internalZeroSubring_of_mem {ε : ZMod 2} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (0, ε)) :
    a ∈ H.internalZeroSubring
proof:
:= by
  rcases zmod_two_cases ε with rfl | rfl
  · exact AddSubgroup.mem_sup_left ha
  · exact AddSubgroup.mem_sup_right ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.internalZeroSubring_induction
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_sup.mp ha
  exact hadd _ _ (hP hx) (hP hy)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.coe_decompose_mem_internalZeroSubring
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_mem_internalZeroSubring {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.internalZeroSubring)
    (p : ℤ × ZMod 2) : (decompose H.hgrading a p : A) ∈ H.internalZeroSubring
proof:
:= by
  refine internalZeroSubring_induction (P := fun a =>
    (decompose H.hgrading a p : A) ∈ H.internalZeroSubring) (fun {ε} {a} ha' => ?_)
    (fun a b ha hb => ?_) ha
  · by_cases hp : (0, ε) = p
    · subst hp
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ ha']
      exact mem_internalZeroSubring_of_mem ha'
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ ha' hp]
      exact zero_mem _
  · simp only [decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add]
    exact add_mem ha hb

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.eq_zero_of_mem_internalZeroSubring
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_internalZeroSubring {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.internalZeroSubring)
    {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} (hp : p.1 ≠ 0) (hap : a ∈ H.hgrading p) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := decompose_of_mem_same _ hap
  rw [← h]
  refine internalZeroSubring_induction (P := fun a => (decompose H.hgrading a p : A) = 0)
    (fun {ε} {a} ha' => decompose_of_mem_ne _ ha' (fun h => hp (by rw [← h]))) (fun a b ha hb => ?_)
    ha
  simp only [decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, ha, hb, add_zero]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mem_internalZeroGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_internalZeroGrading_iff {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} {s : H.internalZeroSubring} :
    s ∈ H.internalZeroGrading p ↔ (s : A) ∈ H.hgrading p
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isInternal_internalZeroGrading
statement: theorem isInternal_internalZeroGrading : DirectSum.IsInternal H.internalZeroGrading
proof:
:=
  isInternal_comap _ _ Subtype.val_injective fun p a =>
    ⟨⟨_, coe_decompose_mem_internalZeroSubring a.2 p⟩, rfl⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.coe_decompose_internalZeroGrading
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_internalZeroGrading (s : H.internalZeroSubring) (p : ℤ × ZMod 2) :
    ((decompose H.internalZeroGrading s p : H.internalZeroSubring) : A) =
      decompose H.hgrading (s : A) p
proof:
:=
  letI : Decomposition fun p => (H.hgrading p).comap
      (AddSubgroupClass.subtype H.internalZeroSubring) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Decomposition H.internalZeroGrading)
  coe_decompose_comap H.hgrading (AddSubgroupClass.subtype H.internalZeroSubring) s p

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.internalZeroPart_hd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem internalZeroPart_hd (s : H.internalZeroSubring) : H.internalZeroPart.hd s = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.internalZeroPart_hgrading
statement: theorem internalZeroPart_hgrading : H.internalZeroPart.hgrading = H.internalZeroGrading
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.internalZeroSubring_eq_of_odd
statement:
theorem internalZeroSubring_eq_of_odd (hodd : ∀ a ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1), a = 0) :
    H.internalZeroSubring = SetLike.GradeZero.subring H.hgrading
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  refine ⟨fun ha => ?_, fun ha => AddSubgroup.mem_sup_left ha⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_sup.mp ha
  rw [hodd y hy, add_zero]
  exact hx

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isGradedSemisimpleRing_internalZeroGrading_of_odd
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_internalZeroGrading_of_odd
    (hodd : ∀ a ∈ H.hgrading (0, 1), a = 0)
    (hss : IsSemisimpleRing (SetLike.GradeZero.subring H.hgrading)) :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing H.internalZeroGrading
proof:
:= by
  have : IsSemisimpleRing H.internalZeroSubring :=
    (RingEquiv.subringCongr (internalZeroSubring_eq_of_odd hodd).symm).isSemisimpleRing
  exact isGradedSemisimpleRing_of_isSemisimpleRing _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isGradedSemisimpleRing_superGrading
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_superGrading (h : IsGradedSemisimpleRing ℬ) :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing (superGrading ℬ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hlp, hsum⟩ := h.exists_list_sum_eq_one
  refine isGradedSemisimpleRing_iff_exists_list.mpr ⟨l, fun e he => ?_, hlp, hsum⟩
  obtain ⟨he0, heI, hes⟩ := hl e he
  refine ⟨by rw [show (0 : ℤ × ZMod 2) = (0, 0) from rfl, superGrading_zero]; exact he0, heI,
    hes.1, fun p x hx hxe hx0 => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j, ε⟩ := p
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst hj
    rw [superGrading_zero] at hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgx⟩ := hes.2 hx hxe hx0
    refine ⟨g, ?_, hgx⟩
    rw [Prod.neg_mk, neg_zero, superGrading_zero]
    exact hg
  · exact absurd (eq_zero_of_mem_superGrading hj hx) hx0

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isGradedSemisimpleRing_internalZeroGrading_ofSuper
statement:
theorem isGradedSemisimpleRing_internalZeroGrading_ofSuper (k : ℤ)
    (h : IsGradedSemisimpleRing ℬ) :
    IsGradedSemisimpleRing (ofSuper ℬ k).internalZeroGrading
proof:
:=
  isGradedSemisimpleRing_ringEquiv (𝒜 := superGrading ℬ) (ofSuperInternalZeroEquiv k)
    (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)
    (isGradedSemisimpleRing_superGrading h)

name: DG.Diagonal.place_smul_mk
statement:
theorem place_smul_mk {p q : ℤ × ℤ} {a : A} {m : M}
    (ha : a ∈ grading A (halfDegree 2 p)) (hm : m ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 q)) :
    (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place p a ha • HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 q m hm =
      HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 (p + q) (a • m)
        (by rw [map_add]; exact smul_mem ha hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.Gmodule.of_smul_of
    (fun p => ↥(halfGrading (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).hgrading 2 p))
    (fun p => ↥(halfGrading (grading M) 2 p)) ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.d_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem d_mk (p : ℤ × ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 p)) :
    d (HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 p m hm) =
      HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 (p + (1, 0)) (d m)
        (by rw [halfDegree_add_one_zero]; exact d_mem hm)
proof:
:=
  HalfRegrade.dHom_mk _ _ (hd := fun hm => d_mem hm) _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.mk_add_of_eq
statement:
private theorem mk_add_of_eq {p₁ p₂ p : ℤ × ℤ} (h₁ : p₁ = p) (h₂ : p₂ = p)
    {m m' : M} (hm : m ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 p₁))
    (hm' : m' ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 p₂)) :
    HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 p₁ m hm + HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 p₂ m' hm' =
      HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 p (m + m')
        (by subst h₁ h₂; exact add_mem hm hm')
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁ h₂
  exact (HalfRegrade.mk_add _ hm hm').symm

name: DG.Diagonal.halfGrading_zero_weight
statement:
theorem halfGrading_zero_weight (n : ℤ) :
    halfGrading (grading M) 2 (n, 0) = DG.grading (M := M) n
proof:
:= by
  change grading M (halfDegree 2 (n, 0)) = _
  simpa only [halfDegree_apply, diagonalDegree_apply, zero_add, mul_comm] using
    grading_diagonal (M := M) n

name: DG.Diagonal.toWeightZero_injective
statement: theorem toWeightZero_injective (n : ℤ) : Function.Injective (toWeightZero A M n)
proof:
:= by
  intro m m' h
  have h' := congrArg (fun x : (toCatModuleObj A M).obj ⟨0⟩ =>
    (((show ⨁ p : ℤ × ℤ, ↥(halfGrading (grading M) 2 p) from x.1) (n, 0)) : M)) h
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [toWeightZero, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
    HalfRegrade.mk, DirectSum.of_eq_same] using h'

name: DG.Diagonal.weightZeroLift_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  change DirectSum.toAddMonoid (toWeightZero A M) (decompose (DG.grading (M := M)) m) = _
  rw [decompose_of_mem _ hm, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_toWeightZero
statement:
@[simp] theorem valueEvaluation_toWeightZero (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (n : ℤ)
    (m : DG.grading (M := M) n) :
    valueEvaluation A M 0 (toWeightZero A M n m) = m
proof: := evaluation_mk _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift
statement:
@[simp] theorem valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (m : M) :
    valueEvaluation A M 0 (weightZeroLift A M m) = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m => rw [weightZeroLift_homogeneous A M m.2, valueEvaluation_toWeightZero]
  | h_add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.weightZeroLift_valueEvaluation
statement:
@[simp] theorem weightZeroLift_valueEvaluation (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (x : Value A M 0) :
    weightZeroLift A M (valueEvaluation A M 0 x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (weightZeroLift A M (evaluation x.1)).1 = x.1
  refine HalfRegrade.weightGrading_induction
    (P := fun x : RegradedModule M => (weightZeroLift A M (evaluation x)).1 = x)
    (by simp) (fun n m hm => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => by
      rw [map_add, map_add]
      exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy) x.2
  rw [evaluation_mk, weightZeroLift_homogeneous A M
    (show m ∈ DG.grading n from (halfGrading_zero_weight M n) ▸ hm)]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.scalarHom_homogeneous
statement:
@[simp] theorem scalarHom_homogeneous (w n : ℤ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ DG.grading n) :
    (scalarHom A w a).1 = (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place (n, 0) a
      (by change a ∈ halfGrading (grading A) 2 (n, 0)
          rw [halfGrading_zero_weight A]; exact ha)
proof:
:= by
  change (weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A A) a).1 = _
  rw [weightZeroLift_homogeneous A (DGModuleCat.of A A) ha]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.scalarHom_one
statement: theorem scalarHom_one (w : ℤ) : scalarHom A w 1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [scalarHom_homogeneous A w 0 1 one_mem_grading]
  exact HalfGradedDGRing.one_eq_place.symm

name: DG.Diagonal.scalarHom_mul
statement:
theorem scalarHom_mul (w : ℤ) (a b : A) :
    scalarHom A w (a * b) = scalarHom A w b ≫ scalarHom A w a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => simp only [add_mul, map_add, ha, ha', Preadditive.comp_add]
  | @h_homogeneous i a =>
    induction b using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add b b' hb hb' => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hb, hb', Preadditive.add_comp]
    | @h_homogeneous j b =>
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [WeightCategory.comp_val, scalarHom_homogeneous A w (i + j) _ (mul_mem_grading a.2 b.2),
        scalarHom_homogeneous A w i _ a.2, scalarHom_homogeneous A w j _ b.2,
        HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_place]
      rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.scalarHom_mem
statement:
theorem scalarHom_mem (w : ℤ) {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ DG.grading n) :
    scalarHom A w a ∈ DG.grading n
proof:
:= by
  change (scalarHom A w a).1 ∈ DG.grading n
  rw [scalarHom_homogeneous A w n a ha]
  exact (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place_mem_grading (n, 0) _

name: DG.Diagonal.scalarHom_d
statement: theorem scalarHom_d (w : ℤ) (a : A) : scalarHom A w (d a) = d (scalarHom A w a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | @h_homogeneous n a =>
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [WeightCategory.d_val, scalarHom_homogeneous A w (n + 1) _ (DG.d_mem a.2),
      scalarHom_homogeneous A w n _ a.2, HalfGradedDGRing.d_place]
    rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.valueEvaluation_scalarHom
statement:
theorem valueEvaluation_scalarHom (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (w : ℤ) (a : A)
    (x : Value A M w) :
    valueEvaluation A M w (((toCatModule A).obj M).act (scalarHom A w a) x) =
      a • valueEvaluation A M w x
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp only [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, zero_smul]
  | h_add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, ha, hb, add_smul]
  | @h_homogeneous n a =>
    change evaluation ((scalarHom A w a).1 • x.1) = a.1 • evaluation x.1
    rw [scalarHom_homogeneous A w n _ a.2]
    induction x.1 using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
    | mk q m hm => rw [place_smul_mk, evaluation_mk, evaluation_mk]

name: DG.Diagonal.recover_smul
statement:
theorem recover_smul (N : CatModule.{v}
    (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) (w : ℤ) (a : A)
    (x : (recover A w).obj N) :
    (a • x : (recover A w).obj N) = N.act (scalarHom A w a) x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.recoveryMap_bijective
statement:
theorem recoveryMap_bijective (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    Function.Bijective (recoveryMap A M)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Function.LeftInverse.injective (weightZeroLift_valueEvaluation A M)
  · exact Function.RightInverse.surjective (valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift A M)

name: DG.Diagonal.recoveryIso_hom_toWeightZero
statement:
@[simp] theorem recoveryIso_hom_toWeightZero (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (n : ℤ)
    (m : DG.grading (M := M) n) :
    (recoveryIso A M).hom (toWeightZero A M n m) = m
proof:
:=
  valueEvaluation_toWeightZero A M n m

name: DG.Diagonal.QCompRecoveryDerivedIso_eq
statement:
theorem QCompRecoveryDerivedIso_eq (s : ℤ) :
    QCompRecoveryDerivedIso.{w', w, v} A s =
      Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ (QhCompRecoveryDerivedIso A s) ≪≫
      (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (recoveryHomotopyFactors A s) _ ≪≫
      Functor.associator _ _ _
proof:
:= by
  ext N
  dsimp [QhCompRecoveryDerivedIso, Quotient.natIsoLift, Quotient.natTransLift]
  simp [← Functor.map_comp]
  change (QCompRecoveryDerivedIso A s).hom.app N =
    𝟙 _ ≫ (QCompRecoveryDerivedIso A s).hom.app N ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((recoveryHomotopyFactors A s).inv.app N ≫
        (recoveryHomotopyFactors A s).hom.app N)
  simp
  exact (Category.comp_id _).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.whiskerLeft_derivedRecoveryNatIso_hom
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_derivedRecoveryNatIso_hom :
    Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Q (derivedRecoveryNatIso.{w', w, v} A).hom =
    (QCompToDerivedRecoveryIso A).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (recoveryNatIso A).hom DerivedCategory.Q ≫
      (Functor.leftUnitor DerivedCategory.Q).hom ≫
      (Functor.rightUnitor DerivedCategory.Q).inv
proof:
:= by
  ext M
  simp [derivedRecoveryNatIso_hom_app_Q, QCompToDerivedRecoveryIso,
    toDerivedObjIso, recoveryDerivedObjIso, recoveryNatIso]

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModuleCompQ_inverts
statement:
theorem toCatModuleCompQ_inverts :
    (DGModuleCat.quasiIso A).IsInvertedBy
      (toCatModule.{v} A ⋙ CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro M N f hf
  exact (CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr
    ((quasiIso_toCatModule_iff f).mpr hf)

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerived_map_Q
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem toDerived_map_Q {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (toDerived A).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map f) ≫ (toDerivedObjIso A N).hom =
      (toDerivedObjIso A M).hom ≫ CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map ((toCatModule A).map f)
proof:
:=
  (QCompToDerivedIso A).hom.naturality f

name: DG.Diagonal.isIso_toDerived_map_Q_iff
statement:
theorem isIso_toDerived_map_Q_iff {M N : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    IsIso ((toDerived A).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)) ↔ f.hom.IsQuasiIso
proof:
:= by
  exact (NatIso.isIso_map_iff (QCompToDerivedIso A) f).trans
    ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff _).trans (isQuasiIso_toCatModule_iff f))

name: DG.Diagonal.toDerived_map_roof
proof:
:= (DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff s).mpr hs
    letI := (CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff ((toCatModule A).map s)).mpr
      ((isQuasiIso_toCatModule_iff s).mpr hs)
