    (toDerived A).map (inv (DerivedCategory.Q.map s) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f) =
      (toDerivedObjIso A M).hom ≫
        inv (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map ((toCatModule A).map s)) ≫
        CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.map ((toCatModule A).map f) ≫
        (toDerivedObjIso A N).inv := by
  let := (DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff s).mpr hs
  let := (CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_Q_map_iff ((toCatModule A).map s)).mpr
    ((isQuasiIso_toCatModule_iff s).mpr hs)
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_inv]
  apply (cancel_mono (toDerivedObjIso A N).hom).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [toDerived_map_Q]
  apply (cancel_epi ((toDerived A).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map s))).mp
  simp only [IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc, toDerived_map_Q]
  simp

name: DG.Diagonal.op_smul_mem
statement:
theorem op_smul_mem {p q : ℤ × ZMod 2} {b : B} {m : M} (hb : b ∈ grading B p)
    (hm : m ∈ grading M q) : op b • m ∈ grading M (q + p)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (P := fun x => op x • m ∈ grading M (q + p)) hb
    (by simp) (fun i b hb hi => ?_)
    (fun _ _ hx hy => by simpa only [MulOpposite.op_add, add_smul] using add_mem hx hy)
  refine induction_on (P := fun y => op b • y ∈ grading M (q + p)) hm
    (by simp) (fun j m hm hj => ?_)
    (fun _ _ hx hy => by simpa only [smul_add] using add_mem hx hy)
  rw [← hi, ← hj, ← map_add]
  exact mem_grading (op_smul_mem_grading hb hm)

name: DG.Diagonal.d_op_smul
statement:
theorem d_op_smul {j n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading M (j, (n : ZMod 2))) (b : B) :
    d (op b • m) = op b • d m + koszulSign n • (op (d b) • m)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on hm (by simp) (fun i m hm hi => ?_)
    (fun _ _ hx hy => by
      simp only [smul_add, d_add, hx, hy]
      abel)
  rw [DG.d_op_smul hm, koszulSign_eq_of_cast_eq (congrArg Prod.snd hi)]

name: DG.Diagonal.rsmul_mem
statement:
theorem rsmul_mem {p q : ℤ × ℤ} {m : M} {b : B} (hm : m ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 p))
    (hb : b ∈ (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).hgrading (halfDegree 2 q)) :
    op b • m ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 (p + q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add]
  exact op_smul_mem hb hm

name: DG.Diagonal.rsmul_of
statement:
theorem rsmul_of (p : ℤ × ℤ) (m : ↥(halfGrading (grading M) 2 p)) :
    rsmul (B := B) (DirectSum.of (fun p => ↥(halfGrading (grading M) 2 p)) p m) =
      rsmulComponent p m
proof:
:= by
  unfold rsmul
  exact DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.rsmulComponent_of
statement:
theorem rsmulComponent_of (p q : ℤ × ℤ) (m : ↥(halfGrading (grading M) 2 p))
    (b : ↥(halfGrading (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).hgrading 2 q)) :
    rsmulComponent p m
        (DirectSum.of (fun q => ↥(halfGrading (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).hgrading 2 q)) q b) =
      HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 (p + q) (op (b : B) • (m : M)) (rsmul_mem m.2 b.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rsmulComponent
  exact DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.rsmul_mk_place
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rsmul_mk_place (p q : ℤ × ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 p)) (b : B)
    (hb : b ∈ (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).hgrading (halfDegree 2 q)) :
    rsmul (HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 p m hm) ((HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).place q b hb) =
      HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 (p + q) (op b • m) (rsmul_mem hm hb)
proof:
:= by
  change rsmul (B := B) (DirectSum.of (fun p => ↥(halfGrading (grading M) 2 p)) p ⟨m, hm⟩)
    (DirectSum.of (fun q => ↥(halfGrading (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).hgrading 2 q)) q
      ⟨b, hb⟩) = _
  rw [rsmul_of]
  exact rsmulComponent_of p q ⟨m, hm⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.rsmul_one
statement: theorem rsmul_one (x : RegradedModule M) : rsmul (B := B) x 1 = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [HalfGradedDGRing.one_eq_place]
  induction x using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hy]
  | mk p m hm =>
    rw [rsmul_mk_place]
    exact HalfRegrade.mk_congr (add_zero p) (one_smul _ m) _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.rsmul_mul
statement:
theorem rsmul_mul (x : RegradedModule M) (g g' : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).Regraded) :
    rsmul x (g * g') = rsmul (rsmul x g) g'
proof:
:= by
  induction g using HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add g h hg hh => simp only [add_mul, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hg, hh]
  | mk q b hb =>
    induction g' using HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add g h hg hh => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hg, hh]
    | mk q' b' hb' =>
      rw [HalfGradedDGRing.place_mul_place]
      induction x using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hy]
      | mk p m hm =>
        rw [rsmul_mk_place, rsmul_mk_place, rsmul_mk_place]
        exact HalfRegrade.mk_congr (add_assoc p q q').symm (mul_smul (op b') (op b) m) _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.rsmul_mem_cohGrading
proof:
:= by
  refine HalfGradedDGRing.grading_induction
    (P := fun g => rsmul x g ∈ HalfRegrade.cohGrading (grading M) 2 (j + i))
    (by simp) (fun w b hb => ?_)
    (fun _ _ h h' => by rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h') hg
  refine HalfRegrade.cohGrading_induction
    (P := fun x => rsmul x ((HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).place (i, w) b hb) ∈
      HalfRegrade.cohGrading (grading M) 2 (j + i))
    (by simp) (fun w' m hm => ?_)
    (fun _ _ h h' => by rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]; exact add_mem h h') hx
  rw [rsmul_mk_place]
  exact HalfRegrade.mk_mem_cohGrading ((j, w') + (i, w)) _

name: DG.Diagonal.rsmul_mem_weightGrading
statement:
theorem rsmul_mem_weightGrading {j i : ℤ} {x : RegradedModule M}
    (hx : x ∈ HalfRegrade.weightGrading (grading M) 2 j)
    {g : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).Regraded} (hg : g ∈ wgrading i) :
    rsmul x g ∈ HalfRegrade.weightGrading (grading M) 2 (j + i)
proof:
:= by
  refine HalfGradedDGRing.wgrading_induction
    (P := fun g => rsmul x g ∈ HalfRegrade.weightGrading (grading M) 2 (j + i))
    (by simp) (fun n b hb => ?_)
    (fun _ _ h h' => by rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h h') hg
  refine HalfRegrade.weightGrading_induction
    (P := fun x => rsmul x ((HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).place (n, i) b hb) ∈
      HalfRegrade.weightGrading (grading M) 2 (j + i))
    (by simp) (fun n' m hm => ?_)
    (fun _ _ h h' => by rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]; exact add_mem h h') hx
  rw [rsmul_mk_place]
  exact HalfRegrade.mk_mem_weightGrading ((n', j) + (n, i)) _

name: DG.Diagonal.d_rsmul
statement:
theorem d_rsmul {j : ℤ} {x : RegradedModule M}
    (hx : x ∈ HalfRegrade.cohGrading (grading M) 2 j)
    (g : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).Regraded) :
    d (rsmul x g) = rsmul (d x) g + koszulSign j • rsmul x (d g)
proof:
:= by
  induction g using HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add g h hg hh =>
    rw [map_add, d_add, hg, hh, map_add, d_add, map_add, smul_add]
    abel
  | mk q b hb =>
    refine HalfRegrade.cohGrading_induction
      (P := fun x => d (rsmul x ((HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).place q b hb)) =
        rsmul (d x) ((HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).place q b hb) +
          koszulSign j • rsmul x (d ((HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).place q b hb)))
      (by simp) (fun w m hm => ?_)
      (fun x y h h' => by
        simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, h, h', smul_add]
        abel) hx
    rw [rsmul_mk_place, d_mk, d_mk, HalfGradedDGRing.d_place, rsmul_mk_place, rsmul_mk_place,
      ← HalfRegrade.mk_units_smul]
    simp only [HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing_hd]
    have h₁ : (j, w) + (1, 0) + q = (j, w) + q + (1, 0) := by abel
    have h₂ : (j, w) + (q + (1, 0)) = (j, w) + q + (1, 0) := by abel
    rw [mk_add_of_eq h₁ h₂]
    refine HalfRegrade.mk_congr rfl ?_ _ _
    exact d_op_smul (n := j) (show m ∈ grading M (_, ((j : ℤ) : ZMod 2)) from hm) b

name: DG.Diagonal.smul_rsmul
statement:
theorem smul_rsmul {A : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [DGRing A] [Module A M]
    [DGModule A M] [SMulCommClass A Bᵐᵒᵖ M] (a : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) (x : RegradedModule M)
    (g : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).Regraded) :
    a • rsmul x g = rsmul (a • x) g
proof:
:= by
  induction a using HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_smul, ha, ha', add_smul, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
  | mk p a ha =>
    induction g using HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add g h hg hh => rw [map_add, smul_add, hg, hh, map_add]
    | mk r b hb =>
      induction x using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, smul_add, hx, hy, smul_add, map_add,
          AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
      | mk q m hm =>
        rw [rsmul_mk_place, place_smul_mk, place_smul_mk, rsmul_mk_place]
        exact HalfRegrade.mk_congr (add_assoc p q r).symm (smul_comm a (op b) m) _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.isKProjective_toCatModule
statement:
theorem isKProjective_toCatModule {P : DGModuleCat.{v} A} (hP : IsKProjective.{v} A P) :
    CatModule.IsKProjective ((toCatModule A).obj P)
proof:
:=
  (CatModule.IsKProjective.of_adjunction (toCatModuleAdjunction A) (IsKProjective.toCatModuleObj hP)).of_iso
    ((toCatModule A).mapIso ((CatModule.singleObjEquivalence.{v} A).counitIso.app P)).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.bimodule_left_isKProjective
statement:
theorem bimodule_left_isKProjective (hM : IsKProjective.{v} A M)
    (Y : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing B).Regraded) :
    CatModule.IsKProjective ((bimodule A B M).left Y)
proof:
:=
  (HalfGradedDGRing.isKProjective_internalShift
    (isKProjective_toCatModule (P := DGModuleCat.of A M) hM) (-Y.as)).of_iso
    (bimoduleLeftIso A B M Y)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} {a : A} :
    a ∈ degreeZeroGrading A p ↔ p = 0 ∨ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold degreeZeroGrading
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.degreeZero_hd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeZero_hd (k : ℤ) (a : A) : (degreeZero A k).hd a = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.degreeZero_hgrading
statement: theorem degreeZero_hgrading (k : ℤ) : (degreeZero A k).hgrading = degreeZeroGrading A
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.d_regraded_degreeZero
statement: theorem d_regraded_degreeZero (k : ℤ) (x : (degreeZero A k).Regraded) : d x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => exact d_zero
  | mk p a ha => rw [d_place]; exact (place_congr rfl (degreeZero_hd k a) _ _).trans (place_zero _)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.d_hom_degreeZero
statement:
theorem d_hom_degreeZero (k : ℤ) {i j : WeightCategory (degreeZero A k).Regraded} (f : i ⟶ j) :
    d f = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [WeightCategory.d_val, d_regraded_degreeZero]; rfl)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.halfDegree_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem halfDegree_eq_zero_iff (k n w : ℤ) :
    halfDegree k (n, w) = 0 ↔ w + n * k = 0 ∧ (n : ZMod 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Prod.ext_iff]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.hom_eq_place
statement:
theorem hom_eq_place (k : ℤ) {i j : WeightCategory (degreeZero A k).Regraded} {n : ℤ}
    {f : i ⟶ j} (hf : f ∈ grading n) :
    ∃ (a : A) (ha : a ∈ (degreeZero A k).hgrading (halfDegree k (n, j.as - i.as))),
      f.1 = (degreeZero A k).place (n, j.as - i.as) a ha
proof:
:= by
  let x : ⨁ p : ℤ × ℤ, ↥(halfGrading (degreeZero A k).hgrading k p) := f.1
  refine ⟨(x (n, j.as - i.as) : A), (x (n, j.as - i.as)).2, ?_⟩
  have hsupp : ∀ p, p ≠ (n, j.as - i.as) → x p = 0 := fun p hp => by
    by_cases h1 : p.1 = n
    · exact f.2 p (fun h2 => hp (Prod.ext h1 h2))
    · exact hf p h1
  change x = DirectSum.of _ (n, j.as - i.as) (x (n, j.as - i.as))
  ext p : 1
  by_cases hp : p = (n, j.as - i.as)
  · subst hp; rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same]
  · rw [hsupp p hp, DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hp]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.hom_eq_zero_of_halfDegree_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, e⟩ := hom_eq_place k hf
  rw [← halfDegree_eq_zero_iff] at h
  rcases mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff.mp ha with h' | rfl
  · exact absurd h' h
  · exact Subtype.ext (e.trans (place_zero _))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalar_val
statement:
theorem scalar_val (X : Cat K k) (c : K) :
    (scalar X c).1 = (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).place 0 c (by
      rw [map_zero]; exact mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalar_mem_grading
statement: theorem scalar_mem_grading (X : Cat K k) (c : K) : scalar X c ∈ grading 0
proof:
:=
  place_mem_grading (H := degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) 0 _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalar_comp
statement: theorem scalar_comp (X : Cat K k) (c c' : K) : scalar X c ≫ scalar X c' = scalar X (c * c')
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext (by
    rw [WeightCategory.comp_val, scalar_val, scalar_val, place_mul_place, scalar_val]
    exact place_congr (add_zero 0) (mul_comm c' c) _ _)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalar_one
statement: theorem scalar_one (X : Cat K k) : scalar X 1 = 𝟙 X
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalar_zero
statement: theorem scalar_zero (X : Cat K k) : scalar X 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext ((place_congr rfl rfl _ (zero_mem _)).trans (place_zero _))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalar_add
statement: theorem scalar_add (X : Cat K k) (c c' : K) : scalar X (c + c') = scalar X c + scalar X c'
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.hom_ext (place_add _ _ _)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.exists_eq_scalar
statement:
theorem exists_eq_scalar {X : Cat K k} {f : X ⟶ X} (hf : f ∈ grading 0) :
    ∃ c : K, f = scalar X c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, e⟩ := hom_eq_place (k : ℤ) hf
  exact ⟨a, WeightCategory.hom_ext (e.trans (place_congr (by simp) rfl _ _))⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem eq_of_lt [NeZero k] {r r' n : ℤ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r < 2 * k) (hs : 0 ≤ r')
    (hs' : r' < 2 * k)
    (h : r' - r + n * k = 0 ∧ (n : ZMod 2) = 0) : n = 0 ∧ r = r'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hn⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd n 2).mp hn
  push_cast at h
  have hk : (0 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne k)
  have hm : m = 0 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy m 0 with hm | hm | hm
    · have : (m : ℤ) * k ≤ -k := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    · exact hm
    · have : (m : ℤ) * k ≥ k := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
  subst hm
  constructor <;> linarith

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.isCornerGenerator_rep
statement:
theorem isCornerGenerator_rep (i : ℤ) :
    IsCornerGenerator (rep K k i) (DGCategory.Idempotent.id _) 0 (gen K k i)
proof:
:=
  isCornerGenerator_representableW.{u} _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.d_rep
statement: theorem d_rep {i : ℤ} {Y : Cat K k} (m : (rep K k i).obj Y) : d m = 0
proof:
:=
  ULift.ext _ _ (d_hom_degreeZero (k : ℤ) m.down)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalar_smul_gen_mem
statement:
theorem scalar_smul_gen_mem (i : ℤ) (c : K) :
    scalar (⟨i⟩ : Cat K k) c • gen K k i ∈ grading 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using CatModule.smul_mem_grading (M := rep K k i) (scalar_mem_grading _ c)
    (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).mem_grading

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalarHom_app_gen
statement:
theorem scalarHom_app_gen (i : ℤ) (c : K) :
    (scalarHom i c).app _ (gen K k i) = scalar (⟨i⟩ : Cat K k) c • gen K k i
proof:
:=
  (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).homOfCocycle_app_gen _ _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalarHom_comp
statement:
theorem scalarHom_comp (i : ℤ) (c c' : K) :
    scalarHom (k := k) i c' ≫ scalarHom i c = scalarHom i (c * c')
proof:
:= by
  refine (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).ext_hom ?_
  rw [comp_app, scalarHom_app_gen, Hom.map_smul, scalarHom_app_gen, scalarHom_app_gen,
    ← comp_smul, scalar_comp, mul_comm]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalarHom_one
statement: theorem scalarHom_one (i : ℤ) : scalarHom (K := K) (k := k) i 1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).ext_hom (by rw [scalarHom_app_gen, scalar_one, id_smul]; rfl)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalarHom_zero
statement: theorem scalarHom_zero (i : ℤ) : scalarHom (K := K) (k := k) i 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).ext_hom (by
    rw [scalarHom_app_gen, scalar_zero, CatModule.zero_smul]; rfl)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.scalarHom_add
statement:
theorem scalarHom_add (i : ℤ) (c c' : K) :
    scalarHom (k := k) i (c + c') = scalarHom i c + scalarHom i c'
proof:
:=
  (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).ext_hom (by
    rw [scalarHom_app_gen, add_app, scalarHom_app_gen, scalarHom_app_gen, scalar_add,
      CatModule.add_smul])

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.exists_eq_Q_map
statement:
theorem exists_eq_Q_map {i : ℤ} {N : CatModule.{u} (Cat K k)} (f : obj K k i ⟶ Q.obj N) :
    ∃ (y : N.obj ⟨i⟩) (hy : y ∈ grading 0) (hdy : d y = 0),
      f = Q.map ((isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).homOfCocycle y hy hdy)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).isKProjective f
  refine ⟨φ.app _ (gen K k i), φ.map_mem (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).mem_grading, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Hom.map_d, (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).d_eq_zero, map_zero]
  · exact congrArg Q.map ((isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).ext_hom
      ((isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).homOfCocycle_app_gen _ _ _).symm)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.homOfCocycle_zero
statement:
theorem homOfCocycle_zero {i : ℤ} {N : CatModule.{u} (Cat K k)} :
    (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).homOfCocycle (0 : N.obj ⟨i⟩) (zero_mem _) d_zero = 0
proof:
:=
  (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).ext_hom
    ((isCornerGenerator_rep K k i).homOfCocycle_app_gen _ _ _)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.regraded_one_ne_zero
statement: theorem regraded_one_ne_zero : (1 : (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).Regraded) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun x : ⨁ p : ℤ × ℤ, ↥(halfGrading (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).hgrading k p) =>
    ((x 0 : ↥(halfGrading (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).hgrading k 0)) : K)) h
  simp only [one_eq_place, place, HalfRegrade.mk, DirectSum.of_eq_same] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.d_shift_rep
statement:
theorem d_shift_rep {i n : ℤ} {Y : Cat K k} (m : (CatModule.shift n (rep K k i)).obj Y) :
    d m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← shift.mk_unmk (n := n) m, shift.d_mk, d_rep, _root_.smul_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.hom_eq_zero_of_not
statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_not {r i n : ℤ} (h : ¬ (r - i + n * k = 0 ∧ (n : ZMod 2) = 0))
    (f : obj K k r ⟶ Q.obj (CatModule.shift n (rep K k i))) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy, hf⟩ := exists_eq_Q_map f
  have hg : ((shift.unmk n y).down : (⟨i⟩ : Cat K k) ⟶ ⟨r⟩) ∈ grading n := by
    have := (shift.mem_grading_iff' (n := n)).mp hy
    rw [zero_add] at this
    exact this
  have hg0 := hom_eq_zero_of_halfDegree_ne_zero (k : ℤ) hg h
  have hy0 : y = 0 := by
    have : shift.unmk n y = 0 := ULift.ext _ _ hg0
    rw [← shift.mk_unmk (n := n) y, this, map_zero]
  subst hy0
  rw [hf, homOfCocycle_zero, Q.map_zero]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.hom_obj_shift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem hom_obj_shift_eq_zero {r r' : ℤ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r < 2 * k) (hs : 0 ≤ r')
    (hs' : r' < 2 * k) (n : ℤ) (h : r ≠ r' ∨ n ≠ 0) (f : obj K k r ⟶ (obj K k r')⟦n⟧) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := hom_eq_zero_of_not (fun h' => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := eq_of_lt hs hs' hr hr' h'
    tauto) (f ≫ (objShiftIso K k r' n).hom)
  rwa [Preadditive.IsIso.comp_right_eq_zero] at this

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.exists_eq_ρ
statement: theorem exists_eq_ρ (r : ℤ) (f : obj K k r ⟶ obj K k r) : ∃ c : K, f = ρ K k r c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_Q_map f
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_eq_scalar (X := (⟨r⟩ : Cat K k)) (f := y.down) hy
  refine ⟨c, congrArg Q.map ((isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).ext_hom ?_)⟩
  rw [(isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle_app_gen, scalarHom_app_gen]
  exact ULift.ext _ _ (hc.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.not_isZero_obj
statement: theorem not_isZero_obj (r : ℤ) : ¬ IsZero (obj K k r)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 : Q.map (𝟙 (rep K k r)) = 0 := by rw [Q.map_id]; exact h.eq_of_src _ _
  have e : 𝟙 (rep K k r) = (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle (gen K k r)
      (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).mem_grading (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).d_eq_zero :=
    (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).ext_hom
      ((isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle_app_gen _ _ _).symm
  rw [e, Q_map_eq_zero_iff (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).isKProjective,
    (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homotopic_zero_iff,
    (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle_app_gen] at h0
  obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := h0
  rw [d_rep] at hz
  have := congrArg (fun m : (rep K k r).obj ⟨r⟩ => (m.down.1 : (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).Regraded)) hz
  exact regraded_one_ne_zero this.symm

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.exists_span_hom
statement:
theorem exists_span_hom (r i n : ℤ) :
    ∃ v : obj K k r ⟶ Q.obj (CatModule.shift n (rep K k i)),
      ∀ w : obj K k r ⟶ Q.obj (CatModule.shift n (rep K k i)), ∃ c : K, w = ρ K k r c ≫ v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : r - i + n * k = 0 ∧ (n : ZMod 2) = 0
  · have hb : (1 : K) ∈ (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).hgrading (halfDegree k (n, r - i)) :=
      mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff.mpr (Or.inl ((halfDegree_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr hP))
    let b : (representable (⟨i⟩ : Cat K k)).obj ⟨r⟩ :=
      (⟨(degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).place (n, r - i) 1 hb, place_mem_wgrading (n, r - i) hb⟩ :
        (⟨i⟩ : Cat K k) ⟶ ⟨r⟩)
    have hb' : b ∈ grading n := place_mem_grading (n, r - i) hb
    let y₀ : (CatModule.shift n (rep K k i)).obj ⟨r⟩ := shift.mk n (ULift.up b)
    have hy₀ : y₀ ∈ grading 0 := shift.mem_grading_iff.mpr (by rw [zero_add]; exact hb')
    have hdy₀ : d y₀ = 0 := d_shift_rep y₀
    refine ⟨Q.map ((isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle y₀ hy₀ hdy₀), fun w => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_Q_map w
    have hg : ((shift.unmk n y).down : (⟨i⟩ : Cat K k) ⟶ ⟨r⟩) ∈ grading n := by
      have := (shift.mem_grading_iff' (n := n)).mp hy
      rw [zero_add] at this
      exact this
    obtain ⟨a, ha, e⟩ := hom_eq_place (k : ℤ) hg
    have hya : y = scalar (⟨r⟩ : Cat K k) a • y₀ := by
      apply (shift.unmk (M := rep K k i) (X := ⟨r⟩) n).injective
      rw [shift.unmk_smul (scalar_mem_grading _ a), mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
      refine ULift.ext _ _ (WeightCategory.hom_ext ?_)
      change ((shift.unmk n y).down.1 : (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).Regraded) =
        (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).place 0 a _ * (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).place (n, r - i) 1 hb
      rw [e, place_mul_place]
      exact place_congr (zero_add _).symm (mul_one a).symm _ _
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    change _ = Q.map (scalarHom r a) ≫ _
    rw [← Q.map_comp]
    congr 1
    refine (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).ext_hom ?_
    rw [(isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle_app_gen, comp_app, scalarHom_app_gen,
      Hom.map_smul, (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle_app_gen, hya]
  · exact ⟨0, fun w => ⟨0, by rw [hom_eq_zero_of_not hP w, comp_zero]⟩⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom (r i n : ℤ) :
    FiniteDimensional K (HomK (ρ K k r) ((obj K k i)⟦n⟧)) ∧
      HomK.finrankHom (ρ K k r) ((obj K k i)⟦n⟧) ≤ 1 ∧
      (¬ (r - i + n * k = 0 ∧ (n : ZMod 2) = 0) →
        HomK.finrankHom (ρ K k r) ((obj K k i)⟦n⟧) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let e := HomK.linearEquivOfIso (ρ K k r) (objShiftIso K k i n)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_span_hom (K := K) (k := k) r i n
  let v' : HomK (ρ K k r) (Q.obj (CatModule.shift n (rep K k i))) := v
  have hspan : ∀ w : HomK (ρ K k r) ((obj K k i)⟦n⟧), ∃ c : K, c • e.symm v' = w := fun w => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv (e w)
    refine ⟨c, e.injective ?_⟩
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hc.symm
  refine ⟨Module.Finite.of_surjective (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton K _ (e.symm v'))
    fun w => (hspan w).imp fun c hc => hc, finrank_le_one _ hspan, fun hP => ?_⟩
  have : Subsingleton (HomK (ρ K k r) ((obj K k i)⟦n⟧)) :=
      ⟨fun (w w' : obj K k r ⟶ (obj K k i)⟦n⟧) => by
    have h1 := hom_eq_zero_of_not hP (w ≫ (objShiftIso K k i n).hom)
    have h2 := hom_eq_zero_of_not hP (w' ≫ (objShiftIso K k i n).hom)
    rw [Preadditive.IsIso.comp_right_eq_zero] at h1 h2
    exact h1.trans h2.symm⟩
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.isFin_obj
statement: theorem isFin_obj (r i : ℤ) : HomK.IsFin (ρ K k r) (obj K k i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n => (finiteDimensional_hom r i n).1, ?_⟩
  refine Set.Subsingleton.finite fun n hn n' hn' => ?_
  have h1 := not_not.mp (mt (finiteDimensional_hom (K := K) (k := k) r i n).2.2 hn)
  have h2 := not_not.mp (mt (finiteDimensional_hom (K := K) (k := k) r i n').2.2 hn')
  have hk : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast NeZero.ne k
  have : n * k = n' * k := by linarith [h1.1, h2.1]
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hk this

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.exists_unitPow
statement:
theorem exists_unitPow (i j m : ℤ) (h : i = j + 2 * k * m) :
    ∃ (e : (⟨i⟩ : Cat K k) ⟶ ⟨j⟩) (e' : (⟨j⟩ : Cat K k) ⟶ ⟨i⟩), e ∈ grading (2 * m) ∧
      e' ∈ grading (-(2 * m)) ∧ e ≫ e' = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (1 : K) ∈ (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).hgrading (halfDegree k (2 * m, j - i)) :=
    mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff.mpr (Or.inl ((halfDegree_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr
      ⟨by rw [h]; ring, by push_cast; rw [show (2 : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, zero_mul]⟩))
  have h₂ : (1 : K) ∈ (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)).hgrading (halfDegree k (-(2 * m), i - j)) :=
    mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff.mpr (Or.inl ((halfDegree_eq_zero_iff _ _ _).mpr
      ⟨by rw [h]; ring, by push_cast; rw [show (2 : ZMod 2) = 0 from rfl, zero_mul, neg_zero]⟩))
  refine ⟨⟨_, place_mem_wgrading _ h₁⟩, ⟨_, place_mem_wgrading _ h₂⟩, place_mem_grading _ h₁,
    place_mem_grading _ h₂, WeightCategory.hom_ext ?_⟩
  rw [WeightCategory.comp_val, WeightCategory.id_val, place_mul_place, one_eq_place]
  exact place_congr (by ext <;> simp) (mul_one 1) _ _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.isAcyclic_of_lt
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_of_lt {N : CatModule.{u} (Cat K k)}
    (h : ∀ r : ℤ, 0 ≤ r → r < 2 * k → DG.IsAcyclic (N.obj ⟨r⟩)) : CatModule.IsAcyclic N
proof:
:= by
  intro X
  have hk : (0 : ℤ) < 2 * k := by
    have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne k); omega
  obtain ⟨e, e', he, he', hee'⟩ := exists_unitPow (K := K) (k := k) X.as (X.as % (2 * k))
    (X.as / (2 * k)) (Int.emod_add_mul_ediv X.as (2 * k)).symm
  have hA := h (X.as % (2 * k)) (Int.emod_nonneg _ hk.ne') (Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ hk)
  refine DG.isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun p y hy hdy => ?_
  have hz : e • y ∈ grading (2 * (X.as / (2 * k)) + p) := CatModule.smul_mem_grading he hy
  have hdz : d (e • y) = 0 := by
    rw [CatModule.d_smul_of_d_eq_zero he (d_hom_degreeZero _ e), hdy, CatModule.smul_zero,
      _root_.smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw⟩ := hA.exists_d_eq hz hdz
  refine ⟨e' • w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := CatModule.smul_mem_grading he' hw
    rwa [show -(2 * (X.as / (2 * k))) + (2 * (X.as / (2 * k)) + p - 1) = p - 1 by ring] at this
  · rw [CatModule.d_smul_of_d_eq_zero he' (d_hom_degreeZero _ e'), hdw, ← comp_smul, hee',
      id_smul, show -(2 * (X.as / (2 * k))) = 2 * -(X.as / (2 * k)) by ring,
      koszulSign_even (even_two_mul _), one_smul]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.isZero_of_forall_hom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isZero_of_forall_hom_eq_zero (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{u, u} (Cat K k))
    (h : ∀ (r : ℤ), 0 ≤ r → r < 2 * k → ∀ (n : ℤ) (f : obj K k r ⟶ X⟦n⟧), f = 0) :
    IsZero X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨eX⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj X
  refine IsZero.of_iso ((isZero_Q_obj_iff N).mpr (isAcyclic_of_lt fun r hr0 hr1 => ?_)) eX
  refine DG.isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun p y hy hdy => ?_
  let y' : (CatModule.shift p N).obj ⟨r⟩ := shift.mk p y
  have hy' : y' ∈ grading 0 := shift.mem_grading_iff.mpr (by rwa [zero_add])
  have hdy' : d y' = 0 := by
    change d (shift.mk p y : (CatModule.shift p N).obj ⟨r⟩) = 0
    rw [shift.d_mk, hdy, _root_.smul_zero, map_zero]
  let φ := (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle y' hy' hdy'
  have hφ : Q.map φ = 0 := by
    let E : Q.obj (CatModule.shift p N) ≅ X⟦p⟧ :=
      ((Q.commShiftIso p).app N) ≪≫ (shiftFunctor _ p).mapIso eX.symm
    have := congrArg (· ≫ E.inv) (h r hr0 hr1 p (Q.map φ ≫ E.hom))
    simpa using this
  rw [Q_map_eq_zero_iff (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).isKProjective,
    (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homotopic_zero_iff,
    (isCornerGenerator_rep K k r).homOfCocycle_app_gen] at hφ
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hφ
  refine ⟨koszulSign p • shift.unmk p z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := (shift.mem_grading_iff' (n := p)).mp hz
    rw [show (0 : ℤ) - 1 + p = p - 1 by ring] at this
    exact units_smul_mem_grading _ this
  · have e := congrArg (shift.unmk (M := N) (X := ⟨r⟩) p) hdz
    rw [shift.unmk_d] at e
    rw [d_units_smul, e]
    rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.isCompact_obj
statement: theorem isCompact_obj (i : ℤ) : compacts K k (obj K k i)
proof:
:=
  isCompact_Q_obj (isCornerGenerator_rep K k i)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.isFin_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem isFin_of_isCompact (r : ℤ) {X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{u, u} (Cat K k)}
    (hX : compacts K k X) : HomK.IsFin (ρ K k r) X
proof:
:= by
  have hX' : ThickClosure (fun Y : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{u, u} (Cat K k) =>
      ∃ X : Cat K k, Q.obj (representableW.{u} (Cat K k) X) = Y) X := by
    rw [thickClosure_representable_eq_isCompact]; exact hX
  refine thickClosure_le (HomK.isThick_isFin (ρ K k r)) ?_ X hX'
  rintro Y ⟨⟨i⟩, rfl⟩
  exact isFin_obj r i

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.isOrthonormalGenerating
statement:
theorem isOrthonormalGenerating :
    IsOrthonormalGenerating (compacts K k) (fun r : Fin (2 * k) => obj K k r)
      (fun r => ρ K k r) where
  mem r
proof:
:= isCompact_obj _
  orth j j' n h f := hom_obj_shift_eq_zero (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast j.2)
    (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast j'.2) n
    (h.imp (fun h h' => h (Fin.ext (by exact_mod_cast h'))) id) f
  surj j f := exists_eq_ρ _ f
  nonzero j := not_isZero_obj _
  isFin X hX j := isFin_of_isCompact _ hX
  gen X _ h := isZero_of_forall_hom_eq_zero X fun r hr0 hr1 n f => by
    lift r to ℕ using hr0
    exact h ⟨r, by exact_mod_cast hr1⟩ n f

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.K0Equiv_obj
statement:
theorem K0Equiv_obj (r : Fin (2 * k)) :
    K0Equiv K k (K0.mk ⟨obj K k r, isCompact_obj _⟩) = Pi.single r 1
proof:
:=
  (isOrthonormalGenerating K k).K0Equiv_mk_G r

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.T_smul_mk_obj
statement:
theorem T_smul_mk_obj (i s : ℤ) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.T s : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) •
        K0.mk (⟨obj K k i, isCompact_obj i⟩ : (compacts K k).FullSubcategory) =
      K0.mk ⟨obj K k (i - s), isCompact_obj (i - s)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.DerivedCategory.T_smul_mk_compact]
  exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso ((compacts K k).fullyFaithfulι.preimageIso (objInternalShiftIso K k i s))

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.mk_parityShiftCompact
statement:
theorem mk_parityShiftCompact (X : (compacts K k).FullSubcategory) :
    K0.mk (parityShiftCompact.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) X) =
      -((T (-(k : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X)
proof:
:= by
  exact HalfGradedDGRing.mk_parityShiftCompact (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) X

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.T_two_mul_smul
statement:
theorem T_two_mul_smul (x : K0 (compacts K k).FullSubcategory) :
    (T (2 * k : ℤ) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x : K0 (compacts K k).FullSubcategory,
      (T (-(2 * k : ℤ)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = x := by
    intro x
    induction x using K0.induction_on with
    | zero => exact smul_zero _
    | mk X =>
      have e := K0.mk_eq_of_iso ((compacts K k).fullyFaithfulι.preimageIso
        (X := parityShiftCompact.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ))
          (parityShiftCompact.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) X)) (Y := X)
        ((parityShiftDIso.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ))).app X.obj))
      rw [mk_parityShiftCompact, mk_parityShiftCompact, _root_.smul_neg, neg_neg, smul_smul,
        ← T_add] at e
      rw [show -(2 * k : ℤ) = -(k : ℤ) + -(k : ℤ) by ring, e]
    | neg x hx => rw [_root_.smul_neg, hx]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [_root_.smul_add, hx, hy]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h x, smul_smul, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.T_mul_smul
statement:
theorem T_mul_smul (m : ℤ) (x : K0 (compacts K k).FullSubcategory) :
    (T (2 * k * m : ℤ) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Int.induction_on generalizing x with
  | zero => rw [mul_zero, T_zero, one_smul]
  | succ m ih => rw [mul_add, mul_one, T_add, mul_smul, T_two_mul_smul, ih]
  | pred m ih =>
    have := T_two_mul_smul ((T (2 * k * (-(m : ℤ) - 1)) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x)
    rw [smul_smul, ← T_add, show (2 * k : ℤ) + 2 * k * (-(m : ℤ) - 1) = 2 * k * -(m : ℤ) by ring,
      ih] at this
    exact this.symm

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.T_smul_cls
statement:
theorem T_smul_cls (i s : ℤ) :
    (T s : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • cls K k i = cls K k (i - s)
proof:
:=
  T_smul_mk_obj i s

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.cls_eq_of_sub_eq
statement: theorem cls_eq_of_sub_eq {i j m : ℤ} (h : i - j = 2 * k * m) : cls K k i = cls K k j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← T_mul_smul m (cls K k i), ← h, T_smul_cls, sub_sub_cancel]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.mk_parityShiftCompact'
statement:
theorem mk_parityShiftCompact' (X : (compacts K k).FullSubcategory) :
    K0.mk (parityShiftCompact.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) X) =
      -((T (k : ℤ) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_parityShiftCompact]
  congr 1
  conv_rhs => rw [← T_mul_smul (-1) (K0.mk X)]
  rw [smul_smul, ← T_add, show (k : ℤ) + 2 * k * -1 = -k by ring]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.cls_parityShift
statement:
theorem cls_parityShift :
    K0.mk (parityShiftCompact.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) ⟨obj K k 0, isCompact_obj 0⟩) =
      -((T (k : ℤ) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • cls K k 0)
proof:
:=
  mk_parityShiftCompact' _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.T_sub_one_dvd
statement:
theorem T_sub_one_dvd (m : ℤ) :
    (T (2 * k : ℤ) - 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) ∣ T (2 * k * m) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ∀ n : ℕ, (T (2 * k : ℤ) - 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) ∣ T (2 * k * n) - 1 := by
    intro n
    have := sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow (T (2 * k : ℤ) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) 1 n
    rw [one_pow, T_pow] at this
    rwa [show (2 * k * n : ℤ) = n * (2 * k) by ring]
  obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg m
  · exact hn n
  · have h : (T (2 * k * -(n : ℤ)) - 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) =
        -T (2 * k * -(n : ℤ)) * (T (2 * k * n) - 1) := by
      rw [mul_sub, neg_mul, ← T_add, show 2 * (k : ℤ) * -(n : ℤ) + 2 * k * n = 0 by ring,
        T_zero]
      ring
    rw [h]
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left (hn n) _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.mk_T_eq
statement:
theorem mk_T_eq {a b m : ℤ} (h : a - b = 2 * k * m) :
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := idealPeriod k) (T a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (T b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  change _ ∈ Ideal.span _
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, show a = b + 2 * k * m by linarith, T_add, ← mul_sub_one]
  exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left (T_sub_one_dvd m) _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.C_smul
statement:
theorem C_smul {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (LaurentPolynomial ℤ) M] (a : ℤ) (x : M) :
    (C a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x = a • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (C a : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) = a • 1 by
    rw [zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]; exact map_intCast C a]
  rw [smul_assoc, one_smul]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.toQuotAdd_cls_fin
statement:
theorem toQuotAdd_cls_fin (r : Fin (2 * k)) :
    toQuotAdd K k (cls K k r) = πP k (T (-(r : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  change ∑ r' : Fin (2 * k), K0Equiv K k (cls K k r) r' • πP k (T (-(r' : ℤ))) = _
  rw [K0Equiv_obj, Finset.sum_eq_single r (fun b _ hb => by simp [hb]) (by simp)]
  simp

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.toQuotAdd_cls
statement: theorem toQuotAdd_cls (i : ℤ) : toQuotAdd K k (cls K k i) = πP k (T (-i))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : (0 : ℤ) < 2 * k := by
    have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne k); omega
  let r : Fin (2 * k) := ⟨(i % (2 * k)).toNat, by
    have := Int.emod_lt_of_pos i hk
    have := Int.emod_nonneg i hk.ne'
    omega⟩
  have hr : ((r : ℕ) : ℤ) = i % (2 * k) := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg i hk.ne')
  have hir : i - (r : ℕ) = 2 * k * (i / (2 * k)) := by
    rw [hr]; have := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv i (2 * k); linarith
  rw [cls_eq_of_sub_eq hir, toQuotAdd_cls_fin]
  exact mk_T_eq (m := i / (2 * k)) (by linarith)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.toQuotAdd_T_smul
statement:
theorem toQuotAdd_T_smul (s : ℤ) (x : K0 (compacts K k).FullSubcategory) :
    toQuotAdd K k ((T s : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • x) =
      (T s : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • toQuotAdd K k x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (K0Equiv K k).symm.surjective x
  rw [K0Equiv, IsOrthonormalGenerating.K0Equiv_symm_apply, Finset.smul_sum, map_sum, map_sum,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
  rw [smul_comm, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, smul_comm]
  congr 1
  change toQuotAdd K k ((T s : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • cls K k r) = _ • toQuotAdd K k (cls K k r)
  rw [T_smul_cls, toQuotAdd_cls, toQuotAdd_cls, ← LinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← T_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.K0LinearEquiv_cls
statement: theorem K0LinearEquiv_cls (i : ℤ) : K0LinearEquiv K k (cls K k i) = πP k (T (-i))
proof:
:=
  toQuotAdd_cls i

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.K0LinearEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_symm_mk (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    (K0LinearEquiv K k).symm (πP k p) = p • cls K k 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.cls_neg_fin
statement:
theorem cls_neg_fin (i : Fin (2 * k)) :
    cls K k (((-i : Fin (2 * k)) : ℕ) : ℤ) = cls K k (-(i : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 < 2 * k := by have := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne k); omega
  rw [Fin.val_neg']
  by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) = 0
  · rw [hi, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.mod_self]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]
  · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    refine cls_eq_of_sub_eq (m := 1) ?_
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub i.2.le]
    ring

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.K0Basis_apply
statement:
theorem K0Basis_apply (i : Fin (2 * k)) :
    K0Basis K k i = (T (i : ℤ) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • cls K k 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [K0Basis, Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.map_apply, Pi.basisFun_apply,
    Equiv.neg_symm, Equiv.neg_apply]
  change (K0Equiv K k).symm (Pi.single (-i) 1) = _
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq, T_smul_cls, zero_sub, ← cls_neg_fin, K0Equiv_obj]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.idealPeriod_le_idealSuper
statement: theorem idealPeriod_le_idealSuper : idealPeriod k ≤ idealSuper k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact ⟨T (k : ℤ) - 1, by rw [show (2 * k : ℤ) = k + k by ring, T_add]; ring⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.T_neg_add_one_mem
statement: theorem T_neg_add_one_mem : (T (-(k : ℤ)) + 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) ∈ idealSuper k
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨T (-(k : ℤ)), by
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero, add_comm]⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.smul_mem_parityRel
statement:
theorem smul_mem_parityRel (y : K0 (compacts K k).FullSubcategory) :
    (T (-(k : ℤ)) + 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • y ∈ parityRel K k
proof:
:= by
  induction y using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [_root_.smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | mk X =>
    have : (T (-(k : ℤ)) + 1 : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • K0.mk X =
        -(K0.mk (parityShiftCompact.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) X) - K0.mk X) := by
      rw [mk_parityShiftCompact, _root_.add_smul, one_smul]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact neg_mem (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨X, rfl⟩)
  | neg x hx => rw [_root_.smul_neg]; exact neg_mem hx
  | add x y hx hy => rw [_root_.smul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.toSuperQuot_smul_cls
statement:
theorem toSuperQuot_smul_cls (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    toSuperQuot K k (p • cls K k 0) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealSuper k) p
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.Quotient.factor idealPeriod_le_idealSuper
    (K0LinearEquiv K k ((K0LinearEquiv K k).symm (πP k p))) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.exists_eq_smul_cls
statement:
theorem exists_eq_smul_cls (x : K0 (compacts K k).FullSubcategory) :
    ∃ p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ, x = p • cls K k 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ (K0LinearEquiv K k x)
  exact ⟨p, by rw [← K0LinearEquiv_symm_mk, ← (K0LinearEquiv K k).symm_apply_apply x, ← hp]; rfl⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.parityRel_le_ker
statement: theorem parityRel_le_ker : parityRel K k ≤ (toSuperQuot K k).ker
proof:
:= by
  refine (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨X, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_eq_smul_cls (K0.mk X)
  have h : K0.mk (parityShiftCompact.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) X) - K0.mk X =
      (-((T (-(k : ℤ)) + 1) * p) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) • cls K k 0 := by
    rw [mk_parityShiftCompact, hp, _root_.neg_smul, mul_smul, _root_.add_smul, one_smul]; abel
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, h, toSuperQuot_smul_cls,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact neg_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ T_neg_add_one_mem)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superToQuot_bijective
statement: theorem superToQuot_bijective : Function.Bijective (superToQuot K k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective z
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_smul_cls x
    change toSuperQuot K k (p • cls K k 0) = 0 at hz
    rw [toSuperQuot_smul_cls, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hz
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hz
    rw [QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
    have : c * (1 + T (k : ℤ)) = (T (-(k : ℤ)) + 1) * (c * T (k : ℤ)) := by
      rw [add_mul, one_mul, mul_comm (T _), mul_assoc, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero]; ring
    rw [this, mul_smul]
    exact smul_mem_parityRel _
  · intro q
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
    exact ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk (p • cls K k 0), toSuperQuot_smul_cls p⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0Equiv_cls
statement:
theorem superK0Equiv_cls :
    superK0Equiv K k (K0Rel.mk ⟨obj K k 0, isCompact_obj 0⟩) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := toSuperQuot_smul_cls (K := K) (k := k) 1
  rw [one_smul, map_one] at this
  exact this

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0Equiv_superK0cMk
statement:
theorem superK0Equiv_superK0cMk (x : CompactK0.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ))) :
    superK0Equiv K k (superK0cMk (degreeZero K (k : ℤ)) x) = toSuperQuot K k x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using K0.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | mk X => rw [superK0cMk_mk]; rfl
  | neg x hx => simp only [map_neg, hx]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0LinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_apply (x : SuperK0c.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ))) :
    superK0LinearEquiv K k x = superK0Equiv K k x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0QuotientLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superK0QuotientLinearEquiv_apply (x : SuperK0c.{u, u} (degreeZero K (k : ℤ))) :
    superK0QuotientLinearEquiv K k x = superK0Equiv K k x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0QuotientLinearEquiv_cls
statement:
theorem superK0QuotientLinearEquiv_cls :
    superK0QuotientLinearEquiv K k (K0Rel.mk ⟨obj K k 0, isCompact_obj 0⟩) = 1
proof:
:=
  superK0Equiv_cls

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.GaussianQuot.evalI_C_add
statement: theorem evalI_C_add (a b : ℤ) : evalI (C a + C b * T 1) = ⟨a, b⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evalI, map_add, map_mul, eval₂_T, zpow_one, eq_intCast]
  ext <;> simp [unitI]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.GaussianQuot.evalI_surjective
statement: theorem evalI_surjective : Function.Surjective evalI
proof:
:= fun z =>
  ⟨C z.re + C z.im * T 1, by rw [evalI_C_add]⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.GaussianQuot.pow_sub_pow_mem
statement:
theorem pow_sub_pow_mem {I : Ideal (LaurentPolynomial ℤ)} {x y : LaurentPolynomial ℤ}
    (h : x - y ∈ I) (n : ℕ) : x ^ n - y ^ n ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow x y n
  rw [hc]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ h

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.GaussianQuot.T_two_mul_sub_mem
statement:
theorem T_two_mul_sub_mem (q : ℤ) :
    (T (2 * q) - (-1) ^ q.natAbs : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) ∈ Field.idealSuper 2
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (T 2 - (-1) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) ∈ Field.idealSuper 2 :=
    Ideal.subset_span (by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm]; rfl)
  have h₂ : (T (-2) - (-1) : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) ∈ Field.idealSuper 2 :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨T (-2), by
      rw [sub_neg_eq_add, add_mul, one_mul, ← T_add]; norm_num [T_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg q
  · have := pow_sub_pow_mem h₁ n
    rw [T_pow] at this
    convert this using 2
    · congr 1; ring
    · simp
  · have := pow_sub_pow_mem h₂ n
    rw [T_pow] at this
    convert this using 2
    · congr 1; ring
    · simp

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.GaussianQuot.exists_reduce
statement:
theorem exists_reduce (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, p - (C a + C b * T 1) ∈ Field.idealSuper 2
proof:
:= by
  induction p using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨a', b', h'⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨a + a', b + b', by convert add_mem h h' using 1; simp only [map_add]; ring⟩
  | C_mul_T n c =>
    obtain ⟨q, r, hr, rfl⟩ : ∃ q r : ℤ, (r = 0 ∨ r = 1) ∧ n = 2 * q + r :=
      ⟨n / 2, n % 2, Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one n, by
        rw [add_comm]; exact (Int.emod_add_mul_ediv n 2).symm⟩
    have hm := Ideal.mul_mem_left (Field.idealSuper 2) (C c * T r) (T_two_mul_sub_mem q)
    rcases hr with rfl | rfl
    · refine ⟨c * (-1) ^ q.natAbs, 0, ?_⟩
      convert hm using 1
      simp only [add_zero, T_zero, map_zero, zero_mul, mul_one, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg,
        map_one]
      ring
    · refine ⟨0, c * (-1) ^ q.natAbs, ?_⟩
      convert hm using 1
      rw [T_add]
      simp only [map_zero, zero_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
      ring

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.GaussianQuot.ker_evalI
statement: theorem ker_evalI : RingHom.ker evalI = Field.idealSuper 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := exists_reduce p
    have hJ : Field.idealSuper 2 ≤ RingHom.ker evalI := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker]
      simp only [evalI, map_add, map_one, eval₂_T]
      ext <;> simp [unitI, pow_two]
    have h' := hJ h
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, hp, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero, evalI_C_add] at h'
    have ha : a = 0 := congrArg Zsqrtd.re h'
    have hb : b = 0 := congrArg Zsqrtd.im h'
    rw [ha, hb, map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker]
    simp only [evalI, map_add, map_one, eval₂_T]
    ext <;> simp [unitI, pow_two]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.GaussianQuot.equivGaussianInt_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivGaussianInt_mk (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) :
    equivGaussianInt (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Field.idealSuper 2) p) = evalI p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.GaussianQuot.equivGaussianInt_mk_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivGaussianInt_mk_T (n : ℤ) :
    equivGaussianInt (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Field.idealSuper 2) (T n)) =
      (unitI ^ n : GaussianIntˣ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalI]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.superK0c_evalI_smul
statement:
theorem superK0c_evalI_smul (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (x : SuperK0c.{w', w} H) :
    GaussianQuot.evalI p • x = p • x
proof:
:= by
  change GaussianQuot.equivGaussianInt.symm (GaussianQuot.evalI p) • x = p • x
  rw [← GaussianQuot.equivGaussianInt_mk, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.gaussian_zpow_smul_superK0c_mk
statement:
theorem gaussian_zpow_smul_superK0c_mk (n : ℤ)
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    ((GaussianQuot.unitI ^ n : GaussianIntˣ) : GaussianInt) • (K0Rel.mk X : SuperK0c H) =
      K0Rel.mk (((CatModule.DerivedCategory.compactInternalShiftAction H.Regraded).functor n).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GaussianQuot.equivGaussianInt_mk_T, GaussianQuot.equivGaussianInt_mk,
    superK0c_evalI_smul, T_smul_superK0c_mk]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.gaussian_I_smul_superK0c_mk
statement:
theorem gaussian_I_smul_superK0c_mk
    (X : (compactSubcategory.{max u w}
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))).FullSubcategory) :
    (⟨0, 1⟩ : GaussianInt) • (K0Rel.mk X : SuperK0c H) =
      K0Rel.mk (((CatModule.DerivedCategory.compactInternalShiftAction H.Regraded).functor 1).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [GaussianQuot.unitI] using gaussian_zpow_smul_superK0c_mk H 1 X

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0EquivGaussianInt_cls
statement:
theorem superK0EquivGaussianInt_cls :
    superK0EquivGaussianInt K (K0Rel.mk ⟨obj K 2 0, isCompact_obj 0⟩) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [superK0EquivGaussianInt, AddEquiv.trans_apply, superK0Equiv_cls]
  exact map_one GaussianQuot.equivGaussianInt

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0GaussianLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superK0GaussianLinearEquiv_apply (x : SuperK0c.{u, u} (degreeZero K (2 : ℤ))) :
    superK0GaussianLinearEquiv K x = superK0EquivGaussianInt K x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0GaussianLinearEquiv_cls
statement:
theorem superK0GaussianLinearEquiv_cls :
    superK0GaussianLinearEquiv K (K0Rel.mk ⟨obj K 2 0, isCompact_obj 0⟩) = 1
proof:
:=
  superK0EquivGaussianInt_cls K

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Field.superK0GaussianLinearEquiv_internalShift
statement:
theorem superK0GaussianLinearEquiv_internalShift (n : ℤ)
    (X : (compacts K 2).FullSubcategory) :
    superK0GaussianLinearEquiv K
      (K0Rel.mk (((CatModule.DerivedCategory.compactInternalShiftAction
        (degreeZero K (2 : ℤ)).Regraded).functor n).obj X)) =
      ((GaussianQuot.unitI ^ n : GaussianIntˣ) : GaussianInt) *
        superK0GaussianLinearEquiv K (K0Rel.mk X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gaussian_zpow_smul_superK0c_mk, map_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.supportedEvaluationIso_hom_f_supportedElement
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportedEvaluationIso_hom_f_supportedElement
    (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) (n t : ℤ) (m : DG.grading (M := M) (n + 2 * t)) :
    (((supportedEvaluationIso A M t).hom.f n).hom
      ⟨supportedElement A M n t m, supportedElement_mem A M n t m⟩).1 =
      Shift.mk (2 * t) m.1
proof:
:=
  congrArg (Shift.mk (2 * t)) (valueEvaluation_supportedElement A M n t m)

name: DG.Diagonal.map_mem_grading
statement:
theorem map_mem_grading (f : M ⟶ N) {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ grading M p) : f.hom m ∈ grading N p
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on (P := fun m => f.hom m ∈ grading N p) hm
    (by simp) (fun n m hm hn => ?_)
    (fun m m' h h' => by simpa only [map_add] using add_mem h h')
  rw [← hn]
  exact mem_grading (f.hom.map_mem hm)

name: DG.Diagonal.regradedMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem regradedMap_mk (f : M ⟶ N) (p : ℤ × ℤ) (m : M)
    (hm : m ∈ grading M (halfDegree 2 p)) :
    regradedMap f (HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 p m hm) =
      HalfRegrade.mk (grading N) 2 p (f.hom m) (map_mem_grading f hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.Diagonal.regradedMap_mem_grading
statement:
theorem regradedMap_mem_grading (f : M ⟶ N) {n : ℤ} {x : RegradedModule M}
    (hx : x ∈ DG.grading n) : regradedMap f x ∈ DG.grading n
proof:
:= by
  refine HalfRegrade.cohGrading_induction
    (P := fun x => regradedMap f x ∈ DG.grading n) (by simp)
    (fun w m hm => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => by simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hx hy) hx
  rw [regradedMap_mk]
  exact HalfRegrade.mk_mem_cohGrading (n, w) _

name: DG.Diagonal.regradedMap_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem regradedMap_mem_wgrading (f : M ⟶ N) {w : ℤ} {x : RegradedModule M}
    (hx : x ∈ wgrading w) : regradedMap f x ∈ wgrading w
proof:
:= by
  refine HalfRegrade.weightGrading_induction
    (P := fun x => regradedMap f x ∈ wgrading w) (by simp)
    (fun n m hm => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => by simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hx hy) hx
  rw [regradedMap_mk]
  exact HalfRegrade.mk_mem_weightGrading (n, w) _

name: DG.Diagonal.regradedMap_d
statement:
theorem regradedMap_d (f : M ⟶ N) (x : RegradedModule M) :
    regradedMap f (d x) = d (regradedMap f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk p m hm =>
    simp only [d_mk, regradedMap_mk]
    exact HalfRegrade.mk_congr rfl (f.hom.map_d m) _ _
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.regradedMap_smul
statement:
theorem regradedMap_smul (f : M ⟶ N) (a : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)
    (x : RegradedModule M) : regradedMap f (a • x) = a • regradedMap f x
proof:
:= by
  induction a using HalfGradedDGRing.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk p a ha =>
    induction x using HalfRegrade.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | mk q m hm =>
      rw [place_smul_mk, regradedMap_mk, regradedMap_mk, place_smul_mk]
      exact HalfRegrade.mk_congr rfl (f.hom.map_smul a m) _ _
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [smul_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [add_smul, map_add, ha, hb]

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModule_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem toCatModule_obj (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) :
    (toCatModule A).obj M = toCatModuleObj A M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModule_map_app_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem toCatModule_map_app_coe (f : M ⟶ N)
    (w : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)
    (m : (toCatModuleObj A M).obj w) :
    (((toCatModule A).map f).app w m).1 = regradedMap f m.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModule_map_toWeightZero
statement:
@[simp] theorem toCatModule_map_toWeightZero (f : M ⟶ N) (n : ℤ)
    (m : DG.grading (M := M) n) :
    ((toCatModule A).map f).app ⟨0⟩ (toWeightZero A M n m) =
      toWeightZero A N n ⟨f.hom m, f.hom.map_mem m.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact regradedMap_mk f (n, 0) m _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isKProjective_internalShift
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN f
  let e' := (internalShiftCompIso H s).app P
  have hN' : CatModule.IsAcyclic ((internalShiftFunctor H (-s)).obj N) := hN.precomp _
  have h₁ : CatModule.Homotopic (e'.inv ≫ (internalShiftFunctor H (-s)).map f) 0 := hP _ hN' _
  have h₂ : CatModule.Homotopic ((internalShiftFunctor H (-s)).map f) 0 := by
    have := h₁.comp_left e'.hom
    rwa [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, comp_zero] at this
  have h₃ : CatModule.Homotopic
      ((internalShiftFunctor H s).map ((internalShiftFunctor H (-s)).map f)) 0 :=
    ⟨(h₂.some.precomp _).trans (CatModule.DGHomotopy.ofEq (Functor.map_zero _ _ _))⟩
  have h₄ := (h₃.comp_left ((internalShiftCompIso' H s).inv.app _)).comp_right
    ((internalShiftCompIso' H s).hom.app N)
  have hnat := (internalShiftCompIso' H s).hom.naturality f
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] at hnat
  rwa [comp_zero, zero_comp, assoc, hnat, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc] at h₄

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.isKProjective_parityShift
statement:
theorem isKProjective_parityShift {P : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)}
    (hP : CatModule.IsKProjective P) : CatModule.IsKProjective ((parityShift H).obj P)
proof:
:=
  (isKProjective_internalShift hP (-k)).shift 1

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.homotopic_iff_Q_map_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.Homotopic.iff_sub, ← Q_map_eq_zero_iff hM, Functor.map_sub, sub_eq_zero]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddIso_iff
statement:
theorem oddIso_iff (X Y : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    OddIso X Y ↔ Nonempty (X ≅ (parityShiftD H).obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hX := isKProjective_kProjRep X
  have hY := isKProjective_kProjRep Y
  have hY' := isKProjective_parityShift hY
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, z', h₁, h₂⟩
    let f := oddEquiv H _ _ z
    let g := oddEquiv' H _ _ z'
    have hfg : CatModule.Homotopic (f ≫ g) (𝟙 _) := by rwa [← oddComp_eq']
    have hgf : CatModule.Homotopic (g ≫ f) (𝟙 _) := by
      have : g ≫ f = (parityShift H).map (oddComp z' z) := by
        show oddEquiv' H _ _ z' ≫ oddEquiv H _ _ z = _
        rw [oddComp_eq', Functor.map_comp, oddEquiv'_apply z', oddEquiv_eq_parityShiftHomEquiv z,
          parityShiftHomEquiv_apply, assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      rw [this, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
      exact homotopic_parityShift_map h₂
    have e : Q.obj (kProjRep X) ≅ Q.obj ((parityShift H).obj (kProjRep Y)) :=
      { hom := Q.map f
        inv := Q.map g
        hom_inv_id := by
          rw [← Q.map_comp, ← Q.map_id]
          exact (homotopic_iff_Q_map_eq hX _ _).mp hfg
        inv_hom_id := by
          rw [← Q.map_comp, ← Q.map_id]
          exact (homotopic_iff_Q_map_eq hY' _ _).mp hgf }
    exact ⟨kProjRepIso X ≪≫ e ≪≫ ((QCompParityShiftDIso H).app _).symm ≪≫
      (parityShiftD H).mapIso (kProjRepIso Y).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    let e₁ : Q.obj (kProjRep X) ≅ Q.obj ((parityShift H).obj (kProjRep Y)) :=
      (kProjRepIso X).symm ≪≫ e ≪≫ (parityShiftD H).mapIso (kProjRepIso Y) ≪≫
        (QCompParityShiftDIso H).app _
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq hX e₁.hom
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_Q_map_eq hY' e₁.inv
    have hfg : CatModule.Homotopic (f ≫ g) (𝟙 _) := by
      rw [homotopic_iff_Q_map_eq hX, Q.map_comp, hf, hg, e₁.hom_inv_id, Q.map_id]
    have hgf : CatModule.Homotopic (g ≫ f) (𝟙 _) := by
      rw [homotopic_iff_Q_map_eq hY', Q.map_comp, hf, hg, e₁.inv_hom_id, Q.map_id]
    refine ⟨(oddEquiv H _ _).symm f, (oddEquiv' H _ _).symm g, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [oddComp_eq', AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hfg
    · rw [oddComp_eq', oddEquiv_eq_parityShiftHomEquiv, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
        oddEquiv'_apply, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, parityShiftHomEquiv_apply, assoc,
        ← assoc ((parityShift H).map g), ← Functor.map_comp]
      have := ((homotopic_parityShift_map (H := H) hgf).comp_right
        (parityShiftIsoObj H _).hom).comp_left
        (parityShiftIsoObj H (kProjRep Y)).inv
      rwa [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id] at this

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddIso_iff'
statement:
theorem oddIso_iff' (X Y : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    OddIso X Y ↔ Nonempty ((parityShiftD H).obj X ≅ Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddIso_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact ⟨(parityShiftD H).mapIso e ≪≫ (parityShiftDIso H).app Y⟩
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact ⟨((parityShiftDIso H).app X).symm ≪≫ (parityShiftD H).mapIso e⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddIso_parityShift
statement:
theorem oddIso_parityShift
    (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    OddIso X ((parityShiftD H).obj X)
proof:
:=
  (oddIso_iff' X _).mpr ⟨Iso.refl _⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.unitHom_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unitHom_val {i j : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (h : j.as = i.as + -2 * k) :

proof: := rfl

theorem unitInvHom_val {i j : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (h : j.as = i.as + 2 * k) :

proof: := rfl

statement:
theorem unitHom_mem_grading {i j : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (h : j.as = i.as + -2 * k) :

proof:
:=

statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_unitHom {i j : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (h : j.as = i.as + -2 * k) :

proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by rw [d_val, unitHom_val, d_periodUnit]; rfl)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.d_unitInvHom
statement:

theorem d_unitInvHom {i j : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (h : j.as = i.as + 2 * k) :

proof:
:=

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.unitHom_comp_unitInvHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unitHom_comp_unitInvHom {i j : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (h : j.as = i.as + -2 * k)
    (h' : i.as = j.as + 2 * k) : unitHom H i j h ≫ unitInvHom H j i h' = 𝟙 i
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (by rw [comp_val, unitHom_val, unitInvHom_val, id_val, periodUnitInv_mul_periodUnit])

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.unitInvHom_comp_unitHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unitInvHom_comp_unitHom {i j : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (h : j.as = i.as + 2 * k)

:=

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.comp_unitHom
statement:
theorem comp_unitHom {i j i' j' : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : i' ⟶ j')
    (hfg : f.1 = g.1) (h : i'.as = i.as + -2 * k) (h' : j'.as = j.as + -2 * k) :
    f ≫ unitHom H j j' h' = unitHom H i i' h ≫ g
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (by rw [comp_val, comp_val, unitHom_val, unitHom_val, hfg, periodUnit_mul_comm])

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.comp_unitInvHom
statement:
theorem comp_unitInvHom {i j i' j' : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : i' ⟶ j')
    (hfg : f.1 = g.1) (h : i'.as = i.as + 2 * k) (h' : j'.as = j.as + 2 * k) :
    f ≫ unitInvHom H j j' h' = unitInvHom H i i' h ≫ g

:=
  hom_ext (by rw [comp_val, comp_val, unitInvHom_val, unitInvHom_val, hfg, periodUnitInv_mul_comm])

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShift_obj
statement:
theorem parityShift_obj (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    (parityShift H).obj M = CatModule.shift 1 ((internalShiftFunctor H (-k)).obj M)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.twoBelow_as
statement: theorem twoBelow_as (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) : (twoBelow i).as + 2 * k = i.as
proof:
:= by
  change i.as + -k + -k + 2 * k = i.as
  ring

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.twoBelow_as'
statement: theorem twoBelow_as' (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) : (twoBelow i).as = i.as + -2 * k
proof:
:= by
  change i.as + -k + -k = i.as + -2 * k
  ring

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.unmkTwo_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem unmkTwo_mem_grading_iff (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))
    {i : WeightCategory H.Regraded} {n : ℤ}
    (m : ((parityShift H).obj ((parityShift H).obj M)).obj i) :
    unmkTwo M i m ∈ grading (n + 2) ↔ m ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  rw [shift.mem_grading_iff' (n := 1), show n + 2 = n + 1 + 1 by ring]
  exact shift.mem_grading_iff'.symm

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.unmkTwo_d
proof:
:= by
  have h : unmkTwo M i (d m) = koszulSign 1 • koszulSign 1 • d (unmkTwo M i m) := rfl
  rw [h, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.unmkTwo_smul
statement:
theorem unmkTwo_smul (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))
    {i j : WeightCategory H.Regraded} {p : ℤ} {f : i ⟶ j} (hf : f ∈ grading p)
    (m : ((parityShift H).obj ((parityShift H).obj M)).obj i) :
    unmkTwo M j (f • m) = twoBelowMap f • unmkTwo M i m
proof:
:= by
  let F := WeightCategory.shiftFunctor H.Regraded (-k)
  have h : unmkTwo M j (f • m) = F.map (twist 1 (F.map (twist 1 f))) • unmkTwo M i m := rfl
  have hF : ∀ {a b : WeightCategory H.Regraded} (u : ℤˣ) (g : a ⟶ b), F.map (u • g) = u • F.map g :=
    fun u g => by rw [Units.smul_def, Functor.map_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def]
  rw [h, twist_of_mem hf, hF, twist_of_mem (units_smul_mem_grading _ (F.map_mem_grading hf)),
    hF, hF, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShiftIsoApp_apply
statement:
theorem parityShiftIsoApp_apply (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))
    (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (m : ((parityShift H).obj ((parityShift H).obj M)).obj i) :
    parityShiftIsoApp M i m =
      unitInvHom H (twoBelow i) i (twoBelow_as i).symm • unmkTwo M i m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShiftIsoApp_symm_apply

theorem parityShiftIsoApp_symm_apply (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))
    (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (m : M.obj i) :
    (parityShiftIsoApp M i).symm m =
      (unmkTwo M i).symm (unitHom H i (twoBelow i) (twoBelow_as' i) • m)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShiftIsoObj_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityShiftIsoObj_hom_app (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))

    (parityShiftIsoObj H M).hom.app i m =
      unitInvHom H (twoBelow i) i (twoBelow_as i).symm • unmkTwo M i m
proof:
:=

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShiftIsoObj_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityShiftIsoObj_inv_app (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded))
    (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (m : M.obj i) :
    (parityShiftIsoObj H M).inv.app i m =
      (unmkTwo M i).symm (unitHom H i (twoBelow i) (twoBelow_as' i) • m)
proof:
:=

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShiftIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityShiftIso_hom_app (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    (parityShiftIso H).hom.app M = (parityShiftIsoObj H M).hom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShiftIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityShiftIso_inv_app (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    (parityShiftIso H).inv.app M = (parityShiftIsoObj H M).inv
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShift_map_parityShiftIso
statement:
theorem parityShift_map_parityShiftIso (M : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    (parityShift H).map ((parityShiftIsoObj H M).hom) =
      (parityShiftIsoObj H ((parityShift H).obj M)).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun i m => ?_
  rw [parityShiftIsoObj_hom_app]
  apply (shift.unmk (M := (internalShiftFunctor H (-k)).obj M) 1).injective
  change (parityShiftIsoObj H M).hom.app _ (shift.unmk 1 m) = _
  rw [parityShiftIsoObj_hom_app, shift.unmk_smul (unitInvHom_mem_grading _),
    show (1 : ℤ) * -2 = 2 * -1 by ring, koszulSign_even (even_two_mul _), one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShiftHomEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem parityShiftHomEquiv_apply (g : (parityShift H).obj M ⟶ N) :
    parityShiftHomEquiv g = (parityShiftIsoObj H M).inv ≫ (parityShift H).map g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShiftHomEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem parityShiftHomEquiv_symm_apply (f : M ⟶ (parityShift H).obj N) :
    parityShiftHomEquiv.symm f = (parityShift H).map f ≫ (parityShiftIsoObj H N).hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.parityShift_map_mem_nullHomotopic
statement:
theorem parityShift_map_mem_nullHomotopic {f : M ⟶ N} (hf : f ∈ nullHomotopic M N) :
    (parityShift H).map f ∈ nullHomotopic ((parityShift H).obj M) ((parityShift H).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists.mp hf
  refine mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists.mpr
    ⟨koszulSign 1 • (h.precomp (WeightCategory.shiftFunctor H.Regraded (-k))).shift 1, ?_⟩
  rw [CatModule.δ_units_smul, CatModule.Cochain.δ_shift, ← CatModule.Cochain.precomp_δ, ← hh,
    smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.homotopic_parityShift_map
statement:
theorem homotopic_parityShift_map {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : Homotopic f g) :
    Homotopic ((parityShift H).map f) ((parityShift H).map g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopic_iff_sub_mem, ← Functor.map_sub]
  exact parityShift_map_mem_nullHomotopic (homotopic_iff_sub_mem.mp h)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv_apply_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem oddEquiv_apply_app (z : OddCocycle H M N) (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (x : M.obj i) :
    (oddEquiv H M N z).app i x = shift.mk 1 ((z : CatModule.Cochain M _ 1).app i x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.coe_oddEquiv_symm_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_oddEquiv_symm_app (f : M ⟶ (parityShift H).obj N) (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded)
    (x : M.obj i) :
    (((oddEquiv H M N).symm f : OddCocycle H M N) : CatModule.Cochain M _ 1).app i x =
      shift.unmk 1 (f.app i x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv_mem_nullHomotopic_iff
statement:
theorem oddEquiv_mem_nullHomotopic_iff (z : OddCocycle H M N) :
    oddEquiv H M N z ∈ nullHomotopic M ((parityShift H).obj N) ↔
      z ∈ CatModule.Cocycle.coboundaries M ((internalShiftFunctor H (-k)).obj N) 1
proof:
:= by
  let N' := (internalShiftFunctor H (-k)).obj N
  rw [mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists, CatModule.Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff 0 (zero_add 1)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
    let h' : CatModule.Cochain M (CatModule.shift 1 N') (-1) := h
    refine ⟨koszulSign 1 • h'.rightUnshift 0 (neg_add_cancel 1), ?_⟩
    have e := CatModule.Cochain.δ_rightUnshift h' 0 (neg_add_cancel 1) 1 0 (zero_add 1)
    rw [CatModule.δ_units_smul, e, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
    change (CatModule.δ (-1) 0 h').rightUnshift 1 (zero_add 1) = _
    rw [← hh]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨koszulSign 1 • y.rightShift 1 (-1) (neg_add_cancel 1), ?_⟩
    rw [CatModule.δ_units_smul, CatModule.Cochain.δ_rightShift y 1 (-1) 0 (neg_add_cancel 1) 1
      (zero_add 1), smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, hy]
    rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddHomotopyEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem oddHomotopyEquiv_mk (z : OddCocycle H M N) :
    oddHomotopyEquiv H M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk z) =
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient _).map (oddEquiv H M N z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddHomotopyEquiv, AddEquiv.trans_apply, AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq,
    HomotopyCategory.homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv'_apply
statement:
theorem oddEquiv'_apply (z : OddCocycle H M N) :
    oddEquiv' H M N z = (parityShift H).map (oddEquiv H M N z) ≫ (parityShiftIsoObj H N).hom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv'_apply_app
statement:
theorem oddEquiv'_apply_app (z : OddCocycle H M N) (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded)
    (x : M.obj ((WeightCategory.shiftFunctor H.Regraded (-k)).obj i)) :
    (oddEquiv' H M N z).app i (shift.mk 1 x) =
      N.act (unitInvHom H (twoBelow i) i (twoBelow_as i).symm) (z.1.app _ x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv_eq_parityShiftHomEquiv
statement:
theorem oddEquiv_eq_parityShiftHomEquiv (z : OddCocycle H M N) :
    oddEquiv H M N z = parityShiftHomEquiv (oddEquiv' H M N z)
proof:
:=
  (parityShiftHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv'_mem_nullHomotopic_iff
statement:
theorem oddEquiv'_mem_nullHomotopic_iff (z : OddCocycle H M N) :
    oddEquiv' H M N z ∈ nullHomotopic ((parityShift H).obj M) N ↔
      z ∈ CatModule.Cocycle.coboundaries M ((internalShiftFunctor H (-k)).obj N) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← oddEquiv_mem_nullHomotopic_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [oddEquiv_eq_parityShiftHomEquiv, parityShiftHomEquiv_apply]
    exact mem_nullHomotopic_comp (parityShift_map_mem_nullHomotopic h) _
  · intro h
    rw [oddEquiv'_apply]
    exact comp_mem_nullHomotopic (parityShift_map_mem_nullHomotopic h) _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv_compEven
statement:
theorem oddEquiv_compEven (z : OddCocycle H M N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    oddEquiv H M P (compEven z g) = oddEquiv H M N z ≫ (parityShift H).map g
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv_evenComp
statement:
theorem oddEquiv_evenComp (f : M ⟶ N) (z : OddCocycle H N P) :
    oddEquiv H M P (evenComp f z) = f ≫ oddEquiv H N P z
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.δ_unitInvCochain
statement: theorem δ_unitInvCochain : CatModule.δ (-2) (-1) (unitInvCochain (H := H) P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i x
  rw [CatModule.δ_apply _ _ (by norm_num)]
  change d (P.act (unitInvHom H (twoBelow i) i _) x) -
    koszulSign (-2) • P.act (unitInvHom H (twoBelow i) i _) (d x) = 0
  rw [act_apply, act_apply, CatModule.d_smul_of_d_eq_zero (unitInvHom_mem_grading _)
    (d_unitInvHom _), show (-2 : ℤ) = 2 * -1 by ring, koszulSign_even (even_two_mul _),
    one_smul]
  exact sub_self _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.δ_comp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem δ_comp_eq_zero {M N P : CatModule.{w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)} {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ}
    (z₁ : CatModule.Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : CatModule.Cochain N P n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (m : ℤ)
    (h₁ : CatModule.δ n₁ (n₁ + 1) z₁ = 0) (h₂ : CatModule.δ n₂ (n₂ + 1) z₂ = 0) :
    CatModule.δ n₁₂ m (z₂.comp z₁ h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : n₁₂ + 1 = m
  · rw [CatModule.δ_comp z₁ z₂ h (n₁ + 1) (n₂ + 1) m hm rfl rfl, h₁, h₂,
      CatModule.Cochain.zero_comp, CatModule.Cochain.comp_zero, _root_.smul_zero, add_zero]
  · exact CatModule.δ_shape _ _ hm _

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddComp_app
statement:
theorem oddComp_app (z : OddCocycle H M N) (z' : OddCocycle H N P)
    (i : WeightCategory H.Regraded) (x : M.obj i) :
    (oddComp z z').app i x = P.act (unitInvHom H (twoBelow i) i (twoBelow_as i).symm)
      (z'.1.app _ (z.1.app i x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddComp_eq
statement:
theorem oddComp_eq (z : OddCocycle H M N) (z' : OddCocycle H N P) :
    oddComp z z' = oddEquiv H M N z ≫ (parityShift H).map (oddEquiv H N P z') ≫
      (parityShiftIsoObj H P).hom
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddComp_eq'
statement:
theorem oddComp_eq' (z : OddCocycle H M N) (z' : OddCocycle H N P) :
    oddComp z z' = oddEquiv H M N z ≫ oddEquiv' H N P z'
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddComp_eq, oddEquiv'_apply]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv'_compEven
statement:
theorem oddEquiv'_compEven (z : OddCocycle H M N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    oddEquiv' H M P (compEven z g) = oddEquiv' H M N z ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddEquiv'_apply, oddEquiv'_apply, oddEquiv_compEven, Functor.map_comp, assoc, assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (parityShiftIso H).hom.naturality g

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.oddEquiv'_evenComp
statement:
theorem oddEquiv'_evenComp (f : M ⟶ N) (z : OddCocycle H N P) :
    oddEquiv' H M P (evenComp f z) = (parityShift H).map f ≫ oddEquiv' H N P z
proof:
:= by
  rw [oddEquiv'_apply, oddEquiv'_apply, oddEquiv_evenComp, Functor.map_comp, assoc]

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_smul_mapCompactK0
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_smul_mapCompactK0 (p : LaurentPolynomial ℤ) (y : BaseK0.{w, v} A) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A (p • mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = πP p ⊗ₜ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearEquiv.eq_symm_apply]
  exact (K0LinearEquiv_symm_tmul.{w', w, v} A p y).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_apply
    (s : HalfGradedDGRing.SuperK0c.{w', v} (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A)) :
    superK0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A s = ofSuperK0.{w', w, v} A s
proof:
:= by
  apply toSuperK0_injective.{w', w, v} A
  exact (LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (toSuperK0.{w', w, v} A) _) s).trans
    (toSuperK0_ofSuperK0.{w', w, v} A s).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMk
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMk (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    superK0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk.{w', v} _ x) =
      reduceSuper.{w, v} A (K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x)
proof:
:=
  (superK0LinearEquiv_apply.{w', w, v} A _).trans (ofSuperK0_superK0cMk.{w', w, v} A x)

name: DG.Diagonal.mapCompactLinear_apply
statement:
theorem mapCompactLinear_apply
    (eS : ∀ (n : ℤ) X, G.obj ((shiftDerived.{w', max u v} A n).obj X) ≅
      (shiftDerived.{w₂', max u₂ v₂} B n).obj (G.obj X)) (z : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    mapCompactLinear A B G hG eS z = K0.mapCompact G hG z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_mapCompact
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_mapCompact
    (eS : ∀ (n : ℤ) X, G.obj ((shiftDerived.{w', max u v} A n).obj X) ≅
      (shiftDerived.{w₂', max u₂ v₂} B n).obj (G.obj X))
    (eι : ∀ Y, G.obj ((toDerived.{w', w, max u v} A).obj Y) ≅
      (toDerived.{w₂', w₂, max u₂ v₂} B).obj (F.obj Y))
    (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{w₂', w₂, v₂} B (K0.mapCompact G hG x) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (K0.mapCompact F hF).toIntLinearMap
        (K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x)
proof:
:= by
  have hι : ∀ y : BaseK0.{w, v} A, K0.mapCompact G hG (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) =
      mapCompactK0.{w₂', w₂, max u₂ v₂} B (K0.mapCompact F hF y) := by
    intro y
    induction y using K0.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
    | mk Y =>
      rw [mapCompactK0_mk, K0.mapCompact_mk, K0.mapCompact_mk, mapCompactK0_mk]
      exact K0.mk_eq_of_iso_obj (eι Y.obj)
    | neg x hx => rw [map_neg, map_neg, hx, map_neg, map_neg]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  have key : ∀ t : (LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ periodIdeal) ⊗[ℤ] BaseK0.{w, v} A,
      K0LinearEquiv.{w₂', w₂, v₂} B (K0.mapCompact G hG (toK0.{w', w, v} A t)) =
        LinearMap.lTensor _ (K0.mapCompact F hF).toIntLinearMap t := by
    intro t
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul p y =>
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ p
      have h1 := (mapCompactLinear A B G hG eS).map_smul p (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y)
      rw [mapCompactLinear_apply, mapCompactLinear_apply, hι] at h1
      rw [toK0_tmul, h1, K0LinearEquiv_smul_mapCompactK0, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
      rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]
  have hx : x = toK0.{w', w, v} A (K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x) := by
    rw [K0LinearEquiv_apply, toK0_ofK0]
  conv_lhs => rw [hx]
  exact key _

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap
    (eS : ∀ (n : ℤ) X, G.obj ((shiftDerived.{w', max u v} A n).obj X) ≅
      (shiftDerived.{w₂', max u₂ v₂} B n).obj (G.obj X))
    (eι : ∀ Y, G.obj ((toDerived.{w', w, max u v} A).obj Y) ≅
      (toDerived.{w₂', w₂, max u₂ v₂} B).obj (F.obj Y))
    (s : HalfGradedDGRing.SuperK0c.{w', v} (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A)) :
    superK0LinearEquiv.{w₂', w₂, v₂} B
      (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap _ _ (mapCompactLinear A B G hG eS) s) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (K0.mapCompact F hF).toIntLinearMap
        (superK0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk_surjective.{w', v} _ s
  rw [HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap_mk, superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMk,
    superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMk, mapCompactLinear_apply,
    K0LinearEquiv_mapCompact A B F hF G hG eS eι x]
  generalize K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x = t
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul p y =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ p
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_linearMap
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_linearMap
    (g : DiagK0.{w', v} A →ₗ[LaurentPolynomial ℤ] DiagK0.{w₂', v₂} B)
    (h : BaseK0.{w, v} A →+ BaseK0.{w₂, v₂} B)
    (hg : ∀ y, g (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = mapCompactK0.{w₂', w₂, max u₂ v₂} B (h y))
    (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{w₂', w₂, v₂} B (g x) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ h.toIntLinearMap (K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ t : (LaurentPolynomial ℤ ⧸ periodIdeal) ⊗[ℤ] BaseK0.{w, v} A,
      K0LinearEquiv.{w₂', w₂, v₂} B (g (toK0.{w', w, v} A t)) =
        LinearMap.lTensor _ h.toIntLinearMap t := by
    intro t
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul p y =>
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ p
      rw [toK0_tmul, g.map_smul, hg, K0LinearEquiv_smul_mapCompactK0, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
      rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]
  have hx : x = toK0.{w', w, v} A (K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x) := by
    rw [K0LinearEquiv_apply, toK0_ofK0]
  conv_lhs => rw [hx]
  exact key _

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap_linearMap
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap_linearMap
    (g : DiagK0.{w', v} A →ₗ[LaurentPolynomial ℤ] DiagK0.{w₂', v₂} B)
    (h : BaseK0.{w, v} A →+ BaseK0.{w₂, v₂} B)
    (hg : ∀ y, g (mapCompactK0.{w', w, max u v} A y) = mapCompactK0.{w₂', w₂, max u₂ v₂} B (h y))
    (s : HalfGradedDGRing.SuperK0c.{w', v} (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A)) :
    superK0LinearEquiv.{w₂', w₂, v₂} B (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap _ _ g s) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ h.toIntLinearMap (superK0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMk_surjective.{w', v} _ s
  rw [HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap_mk, superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMk,
    superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMk, K0LinearEquiv_linearMap A B g h hg x]
  generalize K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x = t
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul p y =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ p
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalSource_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply ((diagonalAdjunction A).homEquiv M P).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply, Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  congr 1
  apply DGModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply DGModuleHom.ext
  exact h
