name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalCone_supported
statement: theorem diagonalCone_supported : Supported A (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f))
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  let := value_subsingleton A M w hw
  let := value_subsingleton A N w hw
  change Subsingleton ((CatModule.shift 1 ((toCatModule A).obj M)).obj ⟨w⟩ ×
    ((toCatModule A).obj N).obj ⟨w⟩)
  exact inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (Value A M w × Value A N w))

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_hom_app
    (w : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)
    (x : ((toCatModule A).obj (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))).obj w) :
    (diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app w x = counitApp A
      (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)) w.as
      (((toCatModule A).map (diagonalConeRecoveryIso A f).inv).app w x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_hom_act
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_hom_act
    {s t : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded} (a : s ⟶ t)
    (x : ((toCatModule A).obj (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))).obj s) :
    (diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app t
        (((toCatModule A).obj (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))).act a x) =
      (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).act a ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app s x)
proof:
:=
  (diagonalConeIso A f).hom.map_smul a x

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_hom_zero
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_hom_zero (x : Value A (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) 0) :
    (diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app ⟨0⟩ x =
      diagonalConeLift A f (valueEvaluation A (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) 0 x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalConeIso_hom_app, counitApp_zero]
  exact evaluation_regradedMap (diagonalConeRecoveryIso A f).inv x.1

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_hom_supported
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_hom_supported (t : ℤ)
    (x : Value A (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (4 * t)) :
    (diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app ⟨4 * t⟩ x =
      (CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).act (periodicUnit A t)
        (diagonalConeLift A f (valueEvaluation A (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (4 * t) x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalConeIso_hom_app, counitApp_supported]
  exact congrArg ((CatModule.cone ((toCatModule A).map f)).act (periodicUnit A t))
    (evaluation_regradedMap (diagonalConeRecoveryIso A f).inv x.1)

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_d_fst
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_d_fst
    (w : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)
    (x : ((toCatModule A).obj (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))).obj w) :
    CatModule.shift.unmk 1 ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app w (d x)).1 =
      -d (CatModule.shift.unmk 1 ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app w x).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.Hom.map_d]
  change CatModule.shift.unmk 1
    (d (M := (CatModule.shift 1 ((toCatModule A).obj M)).obj w)
      ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app w x).1) = _
  simpa only [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_one, Units.neg_smul, one_smul] using
    (CatModule.shift.unmk_d (M := (toCatModule A).obj M) (X := w) (n := 1)
      ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app w x).1)

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_d_snd
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_d_snd
    (w : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)
    (x : ((toCatModule A).obj (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))).obj w) :
    ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app w (d x)).2 =
      ((toCatModule A).map f).app w
        (CatModule.shift.unmk 1 ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app w x).1) +
        d ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app w x).2
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.Hom.map_d]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_inr
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_inr :
    (toCatModule A).map (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
      (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (Cone.inr f.hom)) ≫ (diagonalConeIso A f).hom =
      CatModule.cone.inr ((toCatModule A).map f)
proof:
:= by
  apply diagonalSource_hom_ext A
  intro x
  change (diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app ⟨0⟩
    (((toCatModule A).map (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
      (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (Cone.inr f.hom))).app ⟨0⟩ x) = _
  rw [diagonalConeIso_hom_zero]
  have h : valueEvaluation A (DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) 0
      (((toCatModule A).map (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))
        (Cone.inr f.hom))).app ⟨0⟩ x) = Cone.inr f.hom (valueEvaluation A N 0 x) :=
    evaluation_regradedMap (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom))
      (Cone.inr f.hom)) x.1
  rw [h]
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact congrArg (CatModule.shift.mk 1) (map_zero (weightZeroLift A M))
  · exact weightZeroLift_valueEvaluation A N x

name: DG.Diagonal.toCatModuleShiftIso_hom_zero
statement:
theorem toCatModuleShiftIso_hom_zero (k : ℤ) (P : DGModuleCat.{v} A)
    (x : Value A ((shiftFunctor (DGModuleCat A) k).obj P) 0) :
    (toCatModuleShiftIso A k P).hom.app ⟨0⟩ x =
      CatModule.shift.mk k (weightZeroLift A P
        (Shift.unmk k (valueEvaluation A ((shiftFunctor (DGModuleCat A) k).obj P) 0 x)))
proof:
:= by
  change counitApp A (CatModule.shift k ((toCatModule A).obj P)) 0 _ = _
  rw [counitApp_zero]
  refine (evaluation_regradedMap ((shiftedRecoveryNatIso A k).inv.app P) x.1).trans ?_
  change Shift.mk k ((recoveryIso A P).inv _) = _
  apply congrArg (Shift.mk k)
  apply (recoveryMap_bijective A P).injective
  have h := congrArg (fun g : P ⟶ P => g.hom
    (Shift.unmk k (valueEvaluation A ((shiftFunctor (DGModuleCat A) k).obj P) 0 x)))
    (recoveryIso A P).inv_hom_id
  exact h.trans (valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift A P _).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_fst
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_fst :
    (diagonalConeIso A f).hom ≫ CatModule.cone.fstHom ((toCatModule A).map f) =
      (toCatModule A).map (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
        (M := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Shift 1 M))
        (Cone.fstHom f.hom)) ≫ (toCatModuleShiftIso A 1 M).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply diagonalSource_hom_ext A
  intro x
  change ((diagonalConeIso A f).hom.app ⟨0⟩ x).1 =
    (toCatModuleShiftIso A 1 M).hom.app ⟨0⟩ _
  rw [diagonalConeIso_hom_zero, toCatModuleShiftIso_hom_zero]
  have h := evaluation_regradedMap (DGModuleCat.Hom.mk
    (M := DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom)) (N := DGModuleCat.of A (Shift 1 M))
    (Cone.fstHom f.hom)) x.1
  exact congrArg (fun y : Shift 1 M => CatModule.shift.mk 1
    (weightZeroLift A M (Shift.unmk 1 y))) h.symm

name: DG.Diagonal.diagonalConeIso_triangle_mor₃
statement:
theorem diagonalConeIso_triangle_mor₃ :
    (diagonalConeIso A f).hom ≫ (CatModule.cone.triangle ((toCatModule A).map f)).mor₃ =
      (toCatModule A).map (Cone.triangle f).mor₃ ≫ (toCatModuleShiftIso A 1 M).hom
proof:
:= by
  let p : DGModuleCat.of A (Cone f.hom) ⟶ DGModuleCat.of A (Shift 1 M) :=
    DGModuleCat.Hom.mk (Cone.fstHom f.hom)
  change (diagonalConeIso A f).hom ≫ (-CatModule.cone.fstHom ((toCatModule A).map f)) =
    (toCatModule A).map (-p) ≫ _
  rw [Preadditive.comp_neg, Functor.map_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp, diagonalConeIso_fst]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.isQuasiEquivalence_weightFunctor
statement:
theorem isQuasiEquivalence_weightFunctor {f : Hom H H'} (hf : f.IsQuasiIso) :
    IsQuasiEquivalence f.weightFunctor where
  bijective_cohomology X X' n
proof:
:= hf (X'.as - X.as) n
  exists_iso Y := ⟨⟨Y.as⟩, 𝟙 Y, 𝟙 Y, id_mem_cocycles Y, id_mem_cocycles Y,
    by
      change (𝟙 Y ≫ 𝟙 Y - 𝟙 Y : Y ⟶ Y) ∈ coboundaries (Y ⟶ Y) 0
      rw [Category.id_comp, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _,
    by
      change (𝟙 Y ≫ 𝟙 Y - 𝟙 Y : Y ⟶ Y) ∈ coboundaries (Y ⟶ Y) 0
      rw [Category.id_comp, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.K0LinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem K0LinearEquiv_apply (f : Hom H H') (hf : f.IsQuasiIso)
    (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    K0LinearEquiv f hf x = f.K0Map x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.superK0cLinearEquiv_superK0cMk
statement:
theorem superK0cLinearEquiv_superK0cMk (f : Hom H H') (hf : f.IsQuasiIso)
    (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    superK0cLinearEquiv f hf (superK0cMk H x) = superK0cMk H' (f.K0Map x)
proof:
:=
  superK0cMap_mk H H' _ x

name: DG.Diagonal.isZero_block_shift_recovery
statement:
theorem isZero_block_shift_recovery (r s : Fin 4) (hrs : r ≠ s)
    (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{v, v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    IsZero ((transportBlock.{v, v, v, v, v, v, v, v} A B F (r : ℤ) ⋙ shiftDerived.{v, v} B (s : ℤ) ⋙
      recoveryDerived.{v, v} B 0).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : ∀ t : ℤ, (s : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) ≠ 4 * t := by
    intro t ht
    have hr := r.isLt
    have hs := s.isLt
    apply hrs
    ext
    omega
  exact (isZero_recoveryDerived_shift_toDerived B ((s : ℤ) - r) hj _).of_iso
    ((recoveryDerived B 0).mapIso ((shiftShiftIso (B := B) (r : ℤ) (s : ℤ)).app _))

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_piFinFour
statement:
theorem isCompact_piFinFour [HasZeroObject D] [HasShift D ℤ]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive] [Pretriangulated D] [HasCoproducts.{w} D]
    {f : Fin 4 → D} (hf : ∀ r, IsCompact.{w} (f r)) : IsCompact.{w} (∏ᶜ f)
proof:
:=
  ((hf 0).biprod ((hf 1).biprod ((hf 2).biprod (hf 3)))).of_iso (piFinFourIso f)

name: DG.Diagonal.isZero_recoveryDerived_shift_toDerived
statement:
theorem isZero_recoveryDerived_shift_toDerived (j : ℤ) (hj : ∀ t : ℤ, j ≠ 4 * t)
    (Y : DerivedCategory.{w, max u v} A) :
    IsZero ((recoveryDerived.{w', w} A 0).obj ((shiftDerived.{w', max u v} A j).obj
      ((toDerived.{w', w, max u v} A).obj Y)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨e⟩⟩ := DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj Y
  let M' := (shiftModule A j).obj ((toCatModule A).obj N)
  have : Subsingleton ((recover A 0).obj M') :=
    value_subsingleton A N (0 + j) (fun ⟨t, ht⟩ => hj t (by omega))
  have hz : IsZero (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((recover A 0).obj M')) :=
    DerivedCategory.Q.map_isZero (DGModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)
  exact hz.of_iso ((shiftDerived A j ⋙ recoveryDerived A 0).mapIso
    ((toDerived A).mapIso e ≪≫ toDerivedObjIso A N) ≪≫ (recoveryDerived A 0).mapIso
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.QCompRestrictIso _).app _) ≪≫ recoveryDerivedObjIso A 0 M')

name: DG.Diagonal.isCompact_transport_obj
proof:
:=
  isCompact_piFinFour fun _ =>
    (CatModule.DerivedCategory.isCompact_internalShift_obj_iff _ _ _).mpr
      (isCompact_toDerived B (hF _ (isCompact_recoveryDerived A
        ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.isCompact_internalShift_obj_iff _ _ _).mpr hX))))

name: DG.Diagonal.fin_four_succ
statement:
theorem fin_four_succ (r : Fin 4) :
    (r : ℤ) + 1 = ((r + 1 : Fin 4) : ℤ) ∨ ((r : ℤ) + 1 = 4 ∧ ((r + 1 : Fin 4) : ℤ) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases r <;> decide

name: DG.Diagonal.nonempty_transportShiftIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_transportShiftIso (n : ℤ) (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w', max u v}
    (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)) :
    Nonempty ((transport.{w', w, v, u, w₂', w₂, v₂, u₂} A B F).obj
        ((shiftDerived.{w', max u v} A n).obj X) ≅
      (shiftDerived.{w₂', max u₂ v₂} B n).obj
        ((transport.{w', w, v, u, w₂', w₂, v₂, u₂} A B F).obj X))
proof:
:= by
  let G := transport.{w', w, v, u, w₂', w₂, v₂, u₂} A B F
  induction n using Int.induction_on generalizing X with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨G.mapIso ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftZeroIso _).app X) ≪≫
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftZeroIso _).app _).symm⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := ih X
    exact ⟨G.mapIso ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftAddIso _ n 1).app X) ≪≫
      transportShiftOneIso A B F _ ≪≫ (shiftDerived B 1).mapIso e ≪≫
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftAddIso _ n 1).app _).symm⟩
  | pred n ih =>
    let X' := (shiftDerived.{w', max u v} A (-(n : ℤ) - 1)).obj X
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := ih X
    have e1 : (shiftDerived.{w', max u v} A 1).obj X' ≅ (shiftDerived A (-(n : ℤ))).obj X :=
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftAddIso _ (-(n : ℤ) - 1) 1).app X).symm ≪≫
        (shiftEqIso A (by ring)).app X
    have e2 : (shiftDerived.{w₂', max u₂ v₂} B 1).obj (G.obj X') ≅
        (shiftDerived B (-(n : ℤ))).obj (G.obj X) :=
      (transportShiftOneIso A B F X').symm ≪≫ G.mapIso e1 ≪≫ e
    exact ⟨((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftZeroIso _).app _).symm ≪≫
      (shiftEqIso B (by ring : (0 : ℤ) = 1 + -1)).app _ ≪≫
      (CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftAddIso _ 1 (-1)).app _ ≪≫
      (shiftDerived B (-1)).mapIso e2 ≪≫
      ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.internalShiftAddIso _ (-(n : ℤ)) (-1)).app _).symm ≪≫
      (shiftEqIso B (by ring)).app _⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.K0LinearEquiv_transport
statement:
theorem K0LinearEquiv_transport (x : DiagK0.{w', v} A) :
    K0LinearEquiv.{w₂', w₂, v₂} B (transportK0 A B F hF x) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (K0.mapCompact F hF).toIntLinearMap
        (K0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A x)
proof:
:=
  K0LinearEquiv_mapCompact A B F hF _ _ (transportShiftIso A B F)
    (transportToDerivedIso A B F) x

name: DG.Diagonal.superK0LinearEquiv_transport
statement:
theorem superK0LinearEquiv_transport
    (s : HalfGradedDGRing.SuperK0c.{w', v} (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A)) :
    superK0LinearEquiv.{w₂', w₂, v₂} B
      (HalfGradedDGRing.superK0cMap _ _ (transportK0 A B F hF) s) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (K0.mapCompact F hF).toIntLinearMap
        (superK0LinearEquiv.{w', w, v} A s)
proof:
:=
  superK0LinearEquiv_superK0cMap A B F hF _ _ (transportShiftIso A B F)
    (transportToDerivedIso A B F) s

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.toRingHom_apply
statement: theorem toRingHom_apply (f : Hom H H') (a : A) : f.toRingHom a = f a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.map_mem
statement:
theorem map_mem (f : Hom H H') {p : ℤ × ZMod 2} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading p) :
    f a ∈ H'.hgrading p
proof:
:=
  f.map_mem' ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.map_hd
statement: theorem map_hd (f : Hom H H') (a : A) : f (H.hd a) = H'.hd (f a)
proof:
:=
  f.map_hd' a

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {f g : Hom H H'} (h : ∀ a, f a = g a) : f = g
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.coe_injective (funext h)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.id_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem id_apply (a : A) : Hom.id H a = a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.comp_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_apply (g : Hom H' H'') (f : Hom H H') (a : A) : g.comp f a = g (f a)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regradedRingHom_place
statement:
theorem regradedRingHom_place (f : Hom H H') (p : ℤ × ℤ) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    regradedRingHom f (H.place p a ha) = H'.place p (f a) (f.map_mem ha)
proof:
:= by
  change DirectSum.toSemiring (regradedComponent f) _ _
    (DirectSum.of (fun p => ↥(halfGrading H.hgrading k p)) p ⟨a, ha⟩) = _
  rw [DirectSum.toSemiring_of]
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regradedRingHom_mem_grading
statement:
theorem regradedRingHom_mem_grading (f : Hom H H') {n : ℤ} {x : H.Regraded}
    (hx : x ∈ grading n) : regradedRingHom f x ∈ grading (M := H'.Regraded) n
proof:
:= by
  refine grading_induction (P := fun x => regradedRingHom f x ∈ grading n) ?_ (fun w a ha => ?_)
    (fun x y hx hy => ?_) hx
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [regradedRingHom_place]; exact place_mem_grading (H := H') (n, w) _
  · rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regradedRingHom_d
statement:
theorem regradedRingHom_d (f : Hom H H') (x : H.Regraded) :
    regradedRingHom f (d x) = d (regradedRingHom f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | mk p a ha =>
    rw [d_place, regradedRingHom_place, regradedRingHom_place, d_place]
    exact place_congr rfl (f.map_hd a) _ _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regraded_apply
statement: theorem regraded_apply (f : Hom H H') (x : H.Regraded) : f.regraded x = regradedRingHom f x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regraded_place
statement:
theorem regraded_place (f : Hom H H') (p : ℤ × ℤ) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ H.hgrading (halfDegree k p)) :
    f.regraded (H.place p a ha) = H'.place p (f a) (f.map_mem ha)
proof:
:=
  regradedRingHom_place f p a ha

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regraded_mem_wgrading
statement:
theorem regraded_mem_wgrading (f : Hom H H') {w : ℤ} {x : H.Regraded}
    (hx : x ∈ wgrading w) : f.regraded x ∈ wgrading (M := H'.Regraded) w
proof:
:= by
  refine wgrading_induction (P := fun x => f.regraded x ∈ wgrading w) ?_ (fun n a ha => ?_)
    (fun x y hx hy => ?_) hx
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [regraded_place]; exact place_mem_wgrading (H := H') (n, w) _
  · rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regraded_comp
statement:
theorem regraded_comp (g : Hom H' H'') (f : Hom H H') (x : H.Regraded) :
    (g.comp f).regraded x = g.regraded (f.regraded x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | mk p a ha => rw [regraded_place, regraded_place, regraded_place]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.regraded_id
statement: theorem regraded_id (x : H.Regraded) : (Hom.id H).regraded x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | mk p a ha => rw [regraded_place]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.weightFunctor_comp
statement:
theorem weightFunctor_comp (g : Hom H' H'') (f : Hom H H') :
    (g.comp f).weightFunctor = f.weightFunctor ⋙ g.weightFunctor
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
    (fun X => (show (⟨X.as⟩ : WeightCategory H''.Regraded) = ⟨X.as⟩ from rfl))
    fun _ _ φ => by
      change (g.comp f).weightFunctor.map φ =
        𝟙 _ ≫ (f.weightFunctor ⋙ g.weightFunctor).map φ ≫ 𝟙 _
      rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
      exact WeightCategory.hom_ext (regraded_comp g f φ.1)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.weightFunctor_id
statement: theorem weightFunctor_id : (Hom.id H).weightFunctor = 𝟭 _
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun X => (show X = X from rfl)) fun _ _ φ => by
    change (Hom.id H).weightFunctor.map φ = 𝟙 _ ≫ φ ≫ 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact WeightCategory.hom_ext (regraded_id φ.1)

name: DG.HalfGradedDGRing.Hom.K0Map_apply
statement:
theorem K0Map_apply (f : Hom H H')
    (x : DGCategory.K0.{max u w, max u w} (WeightCategory H.Regraded)) :
    f.K0Map x = DGCategory.K0.map.{max u w, max u w} f.weightFunctor x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicHom_mem
statement:
theorem periodicHom_mem {X Y : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded} (t : ℤ)
    (h : Y.as - X.as = 4 * t) : periodicHom A t h ∈ DG.grading (-2 * t)
proof:
:=
  WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mpr (WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mp (periodicUnit_mem A t))

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicHom_comp
statement:
theorem periodicHom_comp {r s t : ℤ} {X Y : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded}
    (hs : X.as - ((inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)).as = 4 * s)
    (ht : Y.as - ((inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)).as = 4 * t) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    periodicHom A s (X := (inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)) hs ≫ f =
      (inclusion A r).map (show SingleObj.star A ⟶ SingleObj.star A from evaluation (M := A) f.1) ≫
        periodicHom A t (X := (inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)) ht
proof:
:= by
  let f' : (⟨4 * s⟩ : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) ⟶ ⟨4 * t⟩ :=
    ⟨f.1, by
      have h : Y.as - X.as = 4 * t - 4 * s := by omega
      simpa [h] using f.2⟩
  have e := congrArg Subtype.val (periodicUnit_comp A s t f')
  exact Subtype.ext e

name: DG.Diagonal.weightZeroLift_val
statement:
theorem weightZeroLift_val (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ DG.grading n) :
    (weightZeroLift A M m).1 = HalfRegrade.mk (grading M) 2 (n, 0) m
      (by change m ∈ halfGrading (grading M) 2 (n, 0)
          rw [halfGrading_zero_weight]; exact hm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightZeroLift_homogeneous A M hm]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.eq_periodicUnit_smul
proof:
:= by
  refine HalfRegrade.weightGrading_induction
    (P := fun y => y = (periodicUnit A t).1 • (weightZeroLift A M (evaluation y)).1)
    (by simp) (fun n m hm => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_) hy
  · have hm' : m ∈ DG.grading (n + 2 * t) := by
      change m ∈ halfGrading (grading (M : Type v)) 2 (n, 4 * t) at hm
      rwa [halfGrading_supported] at hm
    rw [evaluation_mk, weightZeroLift_val A M hm']
    change _ = (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).place (-2 * t, 4 * t) 1 _ • _
    rw [place_smul_mk]
    refine HalfRegrade.mk_congr ?_ (one_smul A m).symm _ _
    ext <;> simp
  · rw [map_add, map_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add, smul_add, ← hx, ← hy]

name: DG.Diagonal.evaluation_mem
statement:
theorem evaluation_mem (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) {i t w : ℤ} (hw : w = 4 * t)
    {y : RegradedModule M} (hy : y ∈ wgrading w) (hi : y ∈ DG.grading i) :
    evaluation y ∈ DG.grading (i + 2 * t)
proof:
:= by
  subst hw
  exact valueEvaluation_mem A M (x := (⟨y, hy⟩ : Value A M (4 * t))) hi

name: DG.Diagonal.eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_not_dvd (M : DGModuleCat.{v} A) {w : ℤ} (hw : ¬ ∃ t : ℤ, w = 4 * t)
    {y : RegradedModule M} (hy : y ∈ wgrading w) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((value_subsingleton A M w hw).elim (⟨y, hy⟩ : Value A M w) 0)

name: DG.Diagonal.mem_wgrading_sub
statement:
theorem mem_wgrading_sub {a b : ℤ} (h : a = b) {y : RegradedModule M} (hy : y ∈ wgrading 0) :
    y ∈ wgrading (a - b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h, sub_self]
  exact hy

name: DG.Diagonal.weightZeroLift_smul
statement:
theorem weightZeroLift_smul [DGModule A M] (a : A) (m : M) :
    (weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A M) (a • m)).1 =
      (scalarHom A 0 a).1 • (weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A M) m).1
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a b ha hb =>
    rw [add_smul, map_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add, ha, hb, map_add, WeightCategory.add_val, add_smul]
  | @h_homogeneous n a =>
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add x y hx hy =>
      rw [smul_add, map_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hx, hy, map_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add, smul_add]
    | @h_homogeneous i m =>
      rw [weightZeroLift_val A (DGModuleCat.of A M) (smul_mem_grading a.2 m.2),
        weightZeroLift_val A (DGModuleCat.of A M) m.2, scalarHom_homogeneous A 0 n _ a.2,
        place_smul_mk]
      rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.weightZeroLift_d
statement:
theorem weightZeroLift_d [DGModule A M] (m : M) :
    (weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A M) (d m)).1 =
      d (weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A M) m).1
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, map_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add,
      hx, hy, d_add]
  | @h_homogeneous i m =>
    rw [weightZeroLift_val A (DGModuleCat.of A M) (DG.d_mem m.2),
      weightZeroLift_val A (DGModuleCat.of A M) m.2]
    exact (HalfRegrade.mk_congr (by simp) rfl _ _).trans (d_mk (i, 0) (m : M) _).symm

name: DG.Diagonal.liftHom_app_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftHom_app_val (m : M) :
    ((liftHom A B M r).app (SingleObj.star A) m).1 = (weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A M) m).1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.liftAddHom_mem
statement:
theorem liftAddHom_mem {i : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ DG.grading i) :
    liftAddHom A B M r m ∈ DG.grading i
proof:
:=
  (liftHom A B M r).map_mem hm

name: DG.Diagonal.liftAddHom_d
statement: theorem liftAddHom_d (m : M) : liftAddHom A B M r (d m) = d (liftAddHom A B M r m)
proof:
:=
  (liftHom A B M r).map_d m

name: DG.Diagonal.liftHom_ract
statement:
theorem liftHom_ract (b : B) (m : M) :
    (bimodule A B M).ract ((inclusion B r).map (show SingleObj.star B ⟶ SingleObj.star B from b))
        ((liftHom A B M r).app (SingleObj.star A) m) =
      (liftHom A B M r).app (SingleObj.star A) (op b • m)
proof:
:= Subtype.ext (by
  change rsmul (weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A M) m).1 (scalarHom B 0 b).1 =
    (weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A M) (op b • m)).1
  induction b using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, WeightCategory.add_val, map_add, ha, hb, MulOpposite.op_add, add_smul, map_add]
    rfl
  | @h_homogeneous n b =>
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hy,
        smul_add, map_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add]
    | @h_homogeneous i m =>
      rw [weightZeroLift_val A (DGModuleCat.of A M) m.2, scalarHom_homogeneous B 0 n _ b.2,
        rsmul_mk_place, weightZeroLift_val A (DGModuleCat.of A M) (op_smul_mem_grading b.2 m.2)]
      rfl)

name: DG.Diagonal.ks_eq
statement: private theorem ks_eq {m n : ℤ} (k : ℤ) (h : m - n = 2 * k) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr ⟨k, by omega⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.map_units
statement:
private theorem map_units {G H : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [AddCommGroup H] (f : G →+ H) (u : ℤˣ)
    (x : G) : f (u • x) = u • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrict_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homRestrict_app (n : ℤ) (z : CatModule.Cochain (leftAt A B M r) N n) (m : M) :
    (homRestrict A B M r N n z).app (SingleObj.star A) m =
      z.app ((inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)) (liftAddHom A B M r m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.not_exists_of_not_supported
statement:
theorem not_exists_of_not_supported {X : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded}
    (h : ¬ WeightSupported A r X) : ¬ ∃ t : ℤ, X.as - (0 + r) = 4 * t
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
  exact h (by change X.as - (0 + r) = 4 * ((X.as - (0 + r)) / 4); omega)

name: DG.Diagonal.homExtendApp_pos
statement:
theorem homExtendApp_pos {n : ℤ}
    (w : CatModule.Cochain ((DGBimodule.catBimodule A B M).left (SingleObj.star B))
      ((CatModule.precomp (inclusion A r)).obj N) n)
    {X : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded} (h : WeightSupported A r X)
    (x : (leftAt A B M r).obj X) :
    homExtendApp A B M r N w X x =
      N.act (periodicHom A _ (X := (inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)) h)
        (w.app (SingleObj.star A) (evaluation (M := M) x.1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold homExtendApp
  split
  · rfl
  · contradiction

name: DG.Diagonal.homExtendApp_neg
statement:
theorem homExtendApp_neg {n : ℤ}
    (w : CatModule.Cochain ((DGBimodule.catBimodule A B M).left (SingleObj.star B))
      ((CatModule.precomp (inclusion A r)).obj N) n)
    {X : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded} (h : ¬ WeightSupported A r X)
    (x : (leftAt A B M r).obj X) : homExtendApp A B M r N w X x = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold homExtendApp
  split
  · contradiction
  · rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.eq_zero_of_not_supported
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_not_supported {X : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded}
    (h : ¬ WeightSupported A r X) (x : (leftAt A B M r).obj X) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (eq_zero_of_not_dvd A (DGModuleCat.of A M) (not_exists_of_not_supported A r h) x.2)

name: DG.Diagonal.homExtendApp_mem
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : WeightSupported A r X
  · rw [homExtendApp_pos A B M r N w h]
    have he := evaluation_mem A (DGModuleCat.of A M) h x.2 hx
    have hw := w.map_mem (X := SingleObj.star A) he
    have hu := N.act_mem' (periodicHom_mem A _ (X := (inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)) h) hw
    convert hu using 2
    ring
  · rw [homExtendApp_neg A B M r N w h]
    exact zero_mem _

name: DG.Diagonal.homExtendApp_smul
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hX : WeightSupported A r X
  · by_cases hY : WeightSupported A r Y
    · rw [homExtendApp_pos A B M r N w hY, homExtendApp_pos A B M r N w hX]
      have hX' : X.as - (0 + r) = 4 * ((X.as - (0 + r)) / 4) := hX
      have hY' : Y.as - (0 + r) = 4 * ((Y.as - (0 + r)) / 4) := hY
      have e1 : evaluation (M := M) (f • x).1 =
          evaluation (M := A) f.1 • evaluation (M := M) x.1 :=
        evaluation_smul A (DGModuleCat.of A M) f.1 x.1
      have hfw : f.1 ∈ wgrading (4 * ((Y.as - (0 + r)) / 4 - (X.as - (0 + r)) / 4)) := by
        have h' : Y.as - X.as = 4 * ((Y.as - (0 + r)) / 4 - (X.as - (0 + r)) / 4) := by omega
        exact (congrArg (fun w : ℤ => (f.1 : (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded) ∈
          wgrading w) h').mp f.2
      have ha := evaluation_mem A (DGModuleCat.of A A) rfl hfw
        (WeightCategory.mem_grading_iff.mp hf)
      have hs := w.map_smul (X := SingleObj.star A) (Y := SingleObj.star A)
        (f := show SingleObj.star A ⟶ SingleObj.star A from evaluation (M := A) f.1) ha
        (evaluation (M := M) x.1)
      have hc := periodicHom_comp A hX hY f
      have hsign : koszulSign (n * (k + 2 * ((Y.as - (0 + r)) / 4 - (X.as - (0 + r)) / 4))) =
          koszulSign (n * k) :=
        ks_eq (n * ((Y.as - (0 + r)) / 4 - (X.as - (0 + r)) / 4)) (by ring)
      calc N.act (periodicHom A _ hY) (w.app (SingleObj.star A) (evaluation (M := M) (f • x).1))
          = N.act (periodicHom A _ hY) (w.app (SingleObj.star A)
              ((evaluation (M := A) f.1) • evaluation (M := M) x.1)) := by rw [e1]
        _ = N.act (periodicHom A _ hY)
              (koszulSign (n * (k + 2 * ((Y.as - (0 + r)) / 4 - (X.as - (0 + r)) / 4))) •
                N.act ((inclusion A r).map
                  (show SingleObj.star A ⟶ SingleObj.star A from evaluation (M := A) f.1))
                  (w.app (SingleObj.star A) (evaluation (M := M) x.1))) := congrArg _ hs
        _ = koszulSign (n * k) • N.act ((inclusion A r).map
                (show SingleObj.star A ⟶ SingleObj.star A from evaluation (M := A) f.1) ≫
                  periodicHom A _ hY)
              (w.app (SingleObj.star A) (evaluation (M := M) x.1)) := by
          rw [map_units, hsign, N.act_comp']
        _ = koszulSign (n * k) • N.act (periodicHom A _ hX ≫ f)
              (w.app (SingleObj.star A) (evaluation (M := M) x.1)) := by
          rw [hc]
        _ = koszulSign (n * k) • (f • N.act (periodicHom A _ hX)
              (w.app (SingleObj.star A) (evaluation (M := M) x.1))) := by
          rw [N.act_comp']
          rfl
    · rw [homExtendApp_neg A B M r N w hY]
      have hf0 : f = 0 := by
        have := weightHom_eq_zero A (s := X.as) (t := Y.as) f (fun ⟨t, ht⟩ => hY (by
          have hX' : X.as - (0 + r) = 4 * ((X.as - (0 + r)) / 4) := hX
          change Y.as - (0 + r) = 4 * ((Y.as - (0 + r)) / 4)
          omega))
        exact this
      subst hf0
      simp
  · have hx0 := eq_zero_of_not_supported A B M r hX x
    subst hx0
    simp

name: DG.Diagonal.periodicHom_self
statement:
theorem periodicHom_self {X : WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded} {t : ℤ}
    (h : X.as - X.as = 4 * t) : periodicHom A t h = 𝟙 X
proof:
:= by
  have ht : t = 0 := by omega
  subst ht
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (periodicUnit A 0).1 = 1
  rw [periodicUnit_zero]
  rfl

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrict_homExtend
statement:
theorem homRestrict_homExtend (n : ℤ)
    (w : CatModule.Cochain ((DGBimodule.catBimodule A B M).left (SingleObj.star B))
      ((CatModule.precomp (inclusion A r)).obj N) n) :
    homRestrict A B M r N n (homExtend A B M r N n w) = w
proof:
:= by
  ext X m
  obtain rfl : X = SingleObj.star A := rfl
  rw [homRestrict_app]
  have h : WeightSupported A r ((inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)) := by
    change (0 + r) - (0 + r) = 4 * (((0 + r) - (0 + r)) / 4)
    simp
  change homExtendApp A B M r N w _ _ = _
  rw [homExtendApp_pos A B M r N w h, periodicHom_self A h]
  exact (N.act_id' _ _).trans
    (congrArg (w.app _) (valueEvaluation_weightZeroLift A (DGModuleCat.of A M) m))

name: DG.Diagonal.homExtend_homRestrict
statement:
theorem homExtend_homRestrict (n : ℤ) (z : CatModule.Cochain (leftAt A B M r) N n) :
    homExtend A B M r N n (homRestrict A B M r N n z) = z
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  change homExtendApp A B M r N _ X x = _
  by_cases h : WeightSupported A r X
  · rw [homExtendApp_pos A B M r N _ h, homRestrict_app]
    have hx : x = (leftAt A B M r).act
        (periodicHom A _ (X := (inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)) h)
        ((liftHom A B M r).app (SingleObj.star A) (evaluation (M := M) x.1)) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact eq_periodicUnit_smul A (DGModuleCat.of A M) (y := x.1) (h ▸ x.2)
    have e := z.map_smul (periodicHom_mem A _ h)
      ((liftHom A B M r).app (SingleObj.star A) (evaluation (M := M) x.1))
    rw [koszulSign_even ⟨-(n * ((X.as - ((inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)).as) / 4)),
      by ring⟩, one_smul] at e
    exact e.symm.trans (congrArg (z.app X) hx.symm)
  · rw [homExtendApp_neg A B M r N _ h, eq_zero_of_not_supported A B M r h x, map_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrict_bijective
statement: theorem homRestrict_bijective (n : ℤ) : Function.Bijective (homRestrict A B M r N n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Function.LeftInverse.injective (homExtend_homRestrict A B M r N n),
    Function.RightInverse.surjective (homRestrict_homExtend A B M r N n)⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrict_δ
statement:
theorem homRestrict_δ (n m : ℤ) (z : CatModule.Cochain (leftAt A B M r) N n) :
    homRestrict A B M r N m (CatModule.δ n m z) =
      CatModule.δ n m (homRestrict A B M r N n z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · ext X x
    obtain rfl : X = SingleObj.star A := rfl
    rw [homRestrict_app, CatModule.δ_apply _ _ hnm, CatModule.δ_apply _ _ hnm, homRestrict_app,
      homRestrict_app, show d (liftAddHom A B M r x) = liftAddHom A B M r (d x) from
        (liftAddHom_d A B M r x).symm]
    rfl
  · rw [CatModule.δ_shape _ _ hnm, CatModule.δ_shape _ _ hnm, map_zero]

name: DG.Diagonal.liftAddHom_ractCochain
statement:
theorem liftAddHom_ractCochain {i : ℤ} {b : SingleObj.star B ⟶ SingleObj.star B}
    (hb : b ∈ DG.grading i) (m : M) :
    ((bimodule A B M).ractCochain ((inclusion B r).map b) ((inclusion B r).map_mem_grading hb)).app
        ((inclusion A r).obj (SingleObj.star A)) (liftAddHom A B M r m) =
      liftAddHom A B M r
        (((DGBimodule.catBimodule A B M).ractCochain b hb).app (SingleObj.star A) m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | h_add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | @h_homogeneous j m =>
    rw [CatBimodule.ractCochain_app_of_mem _ (liftAddHom_mem A B M r m.2),
      CatBimodule.ractCochain_app_of_mem _ m.2, map_units]
    exact congrArg _ (liftHom_ract A B M r b m)

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrict_comp_ractCochain
statement:
theorem homRestrict_comp_ractCochain {i j : ℤ} {b : SingleObj.star B ⟶ SingleObj.star B}
    (hb : b ∈ DG.grading i) (z : CatModule.Cochain (leftAt A B M r) N j) :
    homRestrict A B M r N (i + j) (z.comp ((bimodule A B M).ractCochain ((inclusion B r).map b)
        ((inclusion B r).map_mem_grading hb)) rfl) =
      (homRestrict A B M r N j z).comp
        ((DGBimodule.catBimodule A B M).ractCochain b hb) rfl
proof:
:= by
  ext X m
  obtain rfl : X = SingleObj.star A := rfl
  rw [homRestrict_app, CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply,
    homRestrict_app, liftAddHom_ractCochain]

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrictHOM_mem
statement:
theorem homRestrictHOM_mem {i : ℤ} {x : CatModule.HOM (leftAt A B M r) N}
    (hx : x ∈ DG.grading i) : homRestrictHOM A B M r N x ∈ DG.grading i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨_, (DirectSum.map_of (homRestrict A B M r N) i z).symm⟩

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrictHOM_d
statement:
theorem homRestrictHOM_d (x : CatModule.HOM (leftAt A B M r) N) :
    homRestrictHOM A B M r N (d x) = d (homRestrictHOM A B M r N x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]
  | of n z =>
    rw [CatModule.HOM.d_of, DirectSum.map_of, DirectSum.map_of, CatModule.HOM.d_of,
      homRestrict_δ]

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrictHOM_homAct
statement:
theorem homRestrictHOM_homAct (b : SingleObj.star B ⟶ SingleObj.star B)
    (x : CatModule.HOM (leftAt A B M r) N) :
    homRestrictHOM A B M r N ((bimodule A B M).homAct N ((inclusion B r).map b) x) =
      (DGBimodule.catBimodule A B M).homAct _ b (homRestrictHOM A B M r N x)
proof:
:= by
  induction b using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp only [Functor.map_zero, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
  | h_add b b' hb hb' =>
    rw [Functor.map_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, map_add, hb, hb', map_add,
      AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
  | @h_homogeneous i b =>
    rw [CatBimodule.homAct_of_mem ((inclusion B r).map_mem_grading b.2),
      CatBimodule.homAct_of_mem b.2]
    induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
    | of j z =>
      rw [CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_of, map_units, DirectSum.map_of, DirectSum.map_of,
        CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_of, homRestrict_comp_ractCochain]

name: DG.Diagonal.homRestrictHOM_postcomp
statement:
theorem homRestrictHOM_postcomp {N' : CatModule.{v} (WeightCategory (HalfGradedDGRing.ofDGRing A).Regraded)}
    (ψ : N ⟶ N') (x : CatModule.HOM (leftAt A B M r) N) :
    homRestrictHOM A B M r N' (CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom ψ) x) =
      CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain
        (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom ((CatModule.precomp (inclusion A r)).map ψ))
        (homRestrictHOM A B M r N x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (homRestrictHOM A B M r N').comp
        (CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom ψ)) =
      (CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain
        (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom ((CatModule.precomp (inclusion A r)).map ψ))).comp
        (homRestrictHOM A B M r N) := by
    refine DirectSum.addHom_ext fun n z => ?_
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_of, DirectSum.map_of, DirectSum.map_of,
      CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_of]
    rfl
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

name: DG.GradedOpposite.d_op
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_op (a : A) : d (op 𝒜 a) = op 𝒜 (d a)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.d_unop
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_unop (x : Aᵒᵖ) : d (unop 𝒜 x) = unop 𝒜 (d x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.mem_dgGrading_iff
statement: theorem mem_dgGrading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : Aᵒᵖ} : x ∈ DG.grading n ↔ unop 𝒜 x ∈ DG.grading n
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff 𝒜

name: DG.GradedOpposite.op_mem_dgGrading_iff
statement: theorem op_mem_dgGrading_iff {n : ℤ} {a : A} : op 𝒜 a ∈ DG.grading n ↔ a ∈ DG.grading n
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff 𝒜

name: DG.GradedOpposite.dgGrading_eq
statement: theorem dgGrading_eq : DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R Aᵒᵖ = GradedOpposite.grading 𝒜
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.opOpDGAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem opOpDGAlgEquiv_apply (x : GradedOpposite (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R Aᵒᵖ)) :
    opOpDGAlgEquiv x = unop 𝒜 (unop (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R Aᵒᵖ) x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedOpposite.opDGAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem opDGAlgEquiv_apply [IsGradedComm 𝒜] (a : A) : opDGAlgEquiv a = op 𝒜 a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGRingHom.coe_cocyclesMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_cocyclesMap (n : ℤ) (a : cocycles A n) : (f.cocyclesMap n a : B) = f a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyMap_mk (n : ℤ) (a : cocycles A n) :
    f.cohomologyMap n (cohomology.mk A n a) = cohomology.mk B n (f.cocyclesMap n a)
proof:
:=
  cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mk _ _ _ n a

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mkOf
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_mkOf {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hd : d a = 0) :
    f.cohomologyMap n (cohomology.mkOf ha hd) =
      cohomology.mkOf (f.map_mem ha) (by rw [← f.map_d, hd, map_zero])
proof:
:=
  cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mkOf _ _ _ ha hd

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_id
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_id (n : ℤ) :
    (DGRingHom.id : A →ᵈᵍ+* A).cohomologyMap n = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rfl

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_comp
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_comp (g : B →ᵈᵍ+* C) (n : ℤ) :
    (g.comp f).cohomologyMap n = (g.cohomologyMap n).comp (f.cohomologyMap n)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rfl

name: DG.DGRingHom.isQuasiIso_id
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_id : IsQuasiIso (DGRingHom.id : A →ᵈᵍ+* A)
proof:
:= fun n => by
  rw [cohomologyMap_id]
  exact Function.bijective_id

name: DG.DGRingHom.IsQuasiIso.comp
statement:
theorem IsQuasiIso.comp {g : B →ᵈᵍ+* C} {f : A →ᵈᵍ+* B} (hg : IsQuasiIso g) (hf : IsQuasiIso f) :
    IsQuasiIso (g.comp f)
proof:
:= fun n => by
  rw [cohomologyMap_comp]
  exact (hg n).comp (hf n)

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_one
statement: theorem cohomologyMap_one : f.cohomologyMap 0 GOne.one = GOne.one
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cohomology.one_def, cohomologyMap_mk]
  exact congrArg (cohomology.mk B 0) (Subtype.ext (map_one f))

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyMap_mul
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_mul {i j : ℤ} (x : cohomology A i) (y : cohomology A j) :
    f.cohomologyMap (i + j) (GMul.mul x y) =
      GMul.mul (f.cohomologyMap i x) (f.cohomologyMap j y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h a =>
  induction y using cohomology.induction_on with
  | h b =>
    rw [Cohomology.mk_mul_mk, cohomologyMap_mk, cohomologyMap_mk, cohomologyMap_mk,
      Cohomology.mk_mul_mk]
    exact congrArg (cohomology.mk B (i + j)) (Subtype.ext (by simp))

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyRingHom_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyRingHom_of (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology A n) :
    f.cohomologyRingHom (DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) n x) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology B n) n (f.cohomologyMap n x)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toSemiring_of _ _ _ n x

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyRingMap_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyRingMap_of (n : ℤ) (x : cohomology A n) :
    f.cohomologyRingMap (DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology A n) n x) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => cohomology B n) n (f.cohomologyMap n x)
proof:
:=
  f.cohomologyRingHom_of n x

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyRingMap_id
statement:
theorem cohomologyRingMap_id :
    (DGRingHom.id : A →ᵈᵍ+* A).cohomologyRingMap = DGRingHom.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DGRingHom.ext fun x => ?_
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x => rw [cohomologyRingMap_of, cohomologyMap_id]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.DGRingHom.cohomologyRingMap_comp
statement:
theorem cohomologyRingMap_comp (g : B →ᵈᵍ+* C) :
    (g.comp f).cohomologyRingMap = g.cohomologyRingMap.comp f.cohomologyRingMap
proof:
:= by
  refine DGRingHom.ext fun x => ?_
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n x =>
    rw [cohomologyRingMap_of, cohomologyMap_comp, DGRingHom.comp_apply, cohomologyRingMap_of,
      cohomologyRingMap_of]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.DGAlgCat.hom_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_id (A : DGAlgCat.{w, u} R) : Hom.hom (𝟙 A) = DGAlgHom.id
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.hom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_comp {A B C : DGAlgCat.{w, u} R} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Hom.hom (f ≫ g) = g.hom.comp f.hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAlgCat.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {A B : DGAlgCat.{w, u} R} {f g : A ⟶ B} (h : ∀ a, f.hom a = g.hom a) : f = g
proof:
:=
  Hom.ext (DGAlgHom.ext h)

name: DG.DGAlgebra.parity_of_mem
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.parity_of_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) :
    DGAlgebra.parity R A a = koszulSign i • a
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.parity, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, decomposeLinearEquiv_apply,
    decompose_of_mem (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A) (i := i) ha, ← lof_eq_of R,
    toModule_lof, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.DGAlgebra.parity_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGAlgebra.parity_one : DGAlgebra.parity R A 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.parity_of_mem one_mem_grading, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.DGAlgebra.parity_d
statement: theorem DGAlgebra.parity_d (a : A) : DGAlgebra.parity R A (d a) = -d (DGAlgebra.parity R A a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rw [DGAlgebra.parity_of_mem (d_mem a.2), DGAlgebra.parity_of_mem a.2, d_units_smul,
      koszulSign_add, koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_one, mul_neg_one, Units.neg_smul]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [d_add, map_add, map_add, ha, ha', d_add, neg_add]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.dLinear_tmul
statement:
theorem dLinear_tmul (a : A) (b : B) :
    dLinear R A B (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = d a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b + DGAlgebra.parity R A a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] d b
proof:
:= by
  rw [dLinear, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, _root_.GradedTensorProduct.of_symm_of, LinearMap.add_apply,
    TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_add]
  rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.dLinear_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem dLinear_tmul_of_mem {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ DG.grading i) (b : B) :
    dLinear R A B (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = d a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b + koszulSign i • (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] d b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dLinear_tmul, DGAlgebra.parity_of_mem ha, koszulSign_smul_tmul]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.dLinear_dLinear
statement: theorem dLinear_dLinear (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) : dLinear R A B (dLinear R A B x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : dLinear R A B ∘ₗ dLinear R A B = 0 from LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  apply _root_.GradedTensorProduct.hom_ext
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_comp, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  change dLinear R A B (dLinear R A B (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ)) = 0
  rw [dLinear_tmul, map_add, dLinear_tmul, dLinear_tmul, d_d, d_d, zero_tmul 𝒜 ℬ,
    tmul_zero 𝒜 ℬ, zero_add, add_zero, DGAlgebra.parity_d, ← add_tmul 𝒜 ℬ, neg_add_cancel,
    zero_tmul 𝒜 ℬ]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.dLinear_mem
statement:
theorem dLinear_mem {n : ℤ} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ GradedTensorProduct.grading 𝒜 ℬ n) :
    dLinear R A B x ∈ GradedTensorProduct.grading 𝒜 ℬ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx (motive := fun x =>
    dLinear R A B x ∈ GradedTensorProduct.grading 𝒜 ℬ (n + 1)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  · intro i j a b hij
    rw [dLinear_tmul_of_mem a.2, Units.smul_def]
    exact add_mem (tmul_mem_of_eq 𝒜 ℬ (by omega) (d_mem a.2) b.2)
      (zsmul_mem (tmul_mem_of_eq 𝒜 ℬ (by omega) a.2 (d_mem b.2)) _)
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.d_def
statement: theorem d_def (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) : d x = dLinear R A B x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ} :
    x ∈ DG.grading n ↔ x ∈ GradedTensorProduct.grading 𝒜 ℬ n
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul
statement:
theorem d_tmul {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ DG.grading i) (b : B) :
    d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = d a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b + koszulSign i • (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] d b)
proof:
:=
  dLinear_tmul_of_mem ha b

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul'
statement:
theorem d_tmul' (a : A) (b : B) :
    d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = d a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b + DGAlgebra.parity R A a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] d b
proof:
:=
  dLinear_tmul a b

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ DG.grading i) {b : B} (hb : b ∈ DG.grading j) :
    (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ∈ DG.grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  tmul_mem 𝒜 ℬ ha hb

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.induction_on_tmul
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on_tmul {motive : (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) → Prop} (zero : motive 0)
    (tmul : ∀ {i j : ℤ} {a : A} (_ : a ∈ DG.grading i) {b : B} (_ : b ∈ DG.grading j),
      motive (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b))
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) : motive x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h_zero => exact zero
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    exact grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ x.2 zero (fun a b _ => tmul a.2 b.2) add
  | h_add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.d_tmul_mul_tmul
statement:
theorem d_tmul_mul_tmul {i j i' : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ DG.grading i) {b : B}
    (hb : b ∈ DG.grading j) {a' : A} (ha' : a' ∈ DG.grading i') (b' : B) :
    d ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b')) =
      d (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b') +
        koszulSign (i + j) • ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * d (a' ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a hb ha' b', d_units_smul, d_tmul (mul_mem_grading ha ha'), d_mul ha,
    d_mul hb, d_tmul ha, d_tmul ha', add_mul, mul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_units_smul,
    tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ (d a) hb ha' b', tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a (d_mem hb) ha' b',
    tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a hb (d_mem ha') b', tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a hb ha' (d b')]
  simp only [add_tmul 𝒜 ℬ, tmul_add 𝒜 ℬ, koszulSign_smul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ, tmul_koszulSign_smul 𝒜 ℬ,
    smul_add, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
  rw [ks_eq (m := i + (j + 1) * i') (n := j * i' + (i + i')) ⟨0, by ring⟩,
    ks_eq (m := i + j + j * (i' + 1)) (n := j * i' + i) ⟨j, by ring⟩,
    ks_eq (m := i + j + (i' + j * i')) (n := j * i' + (i + i' + j)) ⟨0, by ring⟩]
  abel

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.gradingSubmodule_eq
statement:
theorem gradingSubmodule_eq :
    DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = GradedTensorProduct.grading 𝒜 ℬ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.includeLeftDGAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeLeftDGAlgHom_apply (a : A) :
    includeLeftDGAlgHom R A B a = (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.includeRightDGAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeRightDGAlgHom_apply (b : B) :
    includeRightDGAlgHom R A B b = ((1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.mapAlgHom_tmul
statement:
theorem mapAlgHom_tmul (f : A →ᵈᵍₐ[R] A') (g : B →ᵈᵍₐ[R] B') (a : A) (b : B) :
    mapAlgHom f g (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = (f a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] g b : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapAlgHom, lift_tmul, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, includeLeft_apply,
    includeRight_apply, tmul_one_mul_one_tmul]
  rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.map_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_tmul (f : A →ᵈᵍₐ[R] A') (g : B →ᵈᵍₐ[R] B') (a : A) (b : B) :
    map f g (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = (f a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] g b : 𝒜' ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ')
proof:
:=
  mapAlgHom_tmul f g a b

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (DGAlgHom.id : A →ᵈᵍₐ[R] A) (DGAlgHom.id : B →ᵈᵍₐ[R] B) = DGAlgHom.id
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine induction_on_tmul ?_ ?_ ?_ x
  · rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  · intro i j a _ b _
    rw [map_tmul]
    rfl
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {A'' B'' : Type*} [Ring A''] [Algebra R A''] [DGAddCommGroup A''] [DGRing A'']
    [DGAlgebra R A''] [Ring B''] [Algebra R B''] [DGAddCommGroup B''] [DGRing B'']
    [DGAlgebra R B''] (f : A →ᵈᵍₐ[R] A') (g : B →ᵈᵍₐ[R] B') (f' : A' →ᵈᵍₐ[R] A'')
    (g' : B' →ᵈᵍₐ[R] B'') : map (f'.comp f) (g'.comp g) = (map f' g').comp (map f g)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine induction_on_tmul ?_ ?_ ?_ x
  · rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  · intro i j a _ b _
    rw [DGAlgHom.comp_apply, map_tmul, map_tmul, map_tmul]
    rfl
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.commDGAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem commDGAlgEquiv_apply (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) :
    commDGAlgEquiv R A B x = _root_.GradedTensorProduct.comm 𝒜 ℬ x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.assocDGAlgEquiv_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem assocDGAlgEquiv_tmul_tmul (a : A) (b : B) (c : C) :
    assocDGAlgEquiv R A B C ((a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c) =
      a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] c : ℬ ᵍ⊗[R] 𝒞)
proof:
:=
  assoc_tmul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 a b c

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.lidDegreeZeroHom_tmul
statement:
theorem lidDegreeZeroHom_tmul (r : R) (b : B) :
    letI
proof:
:= DGAddCommGroup.degreeZero R
    haveI := DGRing.degreeZero R
    haveI := DGAlgebra.degreeZero R
    lidDegreeZeroHom R B (r ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : GradedTensorProduct R (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R R) ℬ) =
      r • b := by
  let := DGAddCommGroup.degreeZero R
  have := DGRing.degreeZero R
  have := DGAlgebra.degreeZero R
  rw [lidDegreeZeroHom, lift_tmul, Algebra.ofId_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, Algebra.smul_def]

name: DG.d_mem
statement: theorem d_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) : d m ∈ grading (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  DGAddCommGroup.d_mem' hm

name: DG.d_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_d (m : M) : d (d m) = 0
proof:
:=
  DGAddCommGroup.d_d' m

name: DG.d_comp_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_comp_d : (d : M →+ M).comp d = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext m; exact d_d m

name: DG.d_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_zero : d (0 : M) = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero d

name: DG.d_add
statement: theorem d_add (m m' : M) : d (m + m') = d m + d m'
proof:
:=
  map_add d m m'

name: DG.d_neg
statement: theorem d_neg (m : M) : d (-m) = -d m
proof:
:=
  map_neg d m

name: DG.d_sub
statement: theorem d_sub (m m' : M) : d (m - m') = d m - d m'
proof:
:=
  map_sub d m m'

name: DG.d_zsmul
statement: theorem d_zsmul (k : ℤ) (m : M) : d (k • m) = k • d m
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul d k m

name: DG.d_nsmul
statement: theorem d_nsmul (k : ℕ) (m : M) : d (k • m) = k • d m
proof:
:=
  map_nsmul d k m

name: DG.d_units_smul
statement: theorem d_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (m : M) : d (u • m) = u • d m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Units.smul_def, d_zsmul]

name: DG.coe_dHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_dHom_apply (n : ℤ) (m : grading (M := M) n) : (dHom M n m : M) = d (m : M)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.dHom_comp_dHom
statement:
theorem dHom_comp_dHom (n : ℤ) :
    (dHom M (n + 1)).comp (dHom M n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext m; simp

name: DG.induction_on
statement:
theorem induction_on {P : M → Prop} (h_zero : P 0)
    (h_homogeneous : ∀ {n : ℤ} (m : grading (M := M) n), P m)
    (h_add : ∀ m m' : M, P m → P m' → P (m + m')) (m : M) : P m
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn (grading (M := M)) h_zero h_homogeneous h_add m

name: DG.mem_cocycles
statement: theorem mem_cocycles {n : ℤ} {m : M} : m ∈ cocycles M n ↔ m ∈ grading n ∧ d m = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mem_coboundaries
statement:
theorem mem_coboundaries {n : ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ coboundaries M n ↔ ∃ m' ∈ grading (M := M) (n - 1), d m' = m
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.coboundaries_le_cocycles
statement: theorem coboundaries_le_cocycles (n : ℤ) : coboundaries M n ≤ cocycles M n
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨by simpa using d_mem hm, d_d m⟩

name: DG.coboundaries_le_grading
statement: theorem coboundaries_le_grading (n : ℤ) : coboundaries M n ≤ grading n
proof:
:=
  (coboundaries_le_cocycles n).trans inf_le_left

name: DG.cocycles_le_grading
statement: theorem cocycles_le_grading (n : ℤ) : cocycles M n ≤ grading n
proof:
:=
  inf_le_left

name: DG.decompose_map
statement:
theorem decompose_map {k : ℤ} (f : M →+ N)
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading (n + k)) (m : M) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := N)) (f m) (n + k) : N) =
      f (decompose (grading (M := M)) m n)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
    rename_i i
    by_cases h : i = n
    · subst h
      rw [decompose_of_mem_same _ hm, decompose_of_mem_same _ (hf hm)]
    · rw [decompose_of_mem_ne _ hm h, decompose_of_mem_ne _ (hf hm) (by omega), map_zero]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
    simp only [map_add, decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.decompose_d
statement:
theorem decompose_d (m : M) (n : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := M)) (d m) (n + 1) : M) =
      d (decompose (grading (M := M)) m n : M)
proof:
:=
  decompose_map (k := 1) d (fun hm => d_mem hm) m n

name: DG.induction_on_of_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem induction_on_of_isHomogeneous {S : AddSubgroup M}
    (hS : SetLike.IsHomogeneous (grading (M := M)) S) {P : M → Prop} (h_zero : P 0)
    (h_homogeneous : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → m ∈ S → P m)
    (h_add : ∀ m m' : M, P m → P m' → P (m + m')) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ S) : P m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (grading (M := M)) m]
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ P h_add h_zero fun n _ => ?_
  exact h_homogeneous (decompose (grading (M := M)) m n).2 (hS n hm)

name: DG.isHomogeneous_ker_d
statement: theorem isHomogeneous_ker_d : SetLike.IsHomogeneous (grading (M := M)) (d : M →+ M).ker
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hm
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker] at hm ⊢
  rw [← decompose_d, hm, decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: DG.isHomogeneous_range_d
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_range_d :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (grading (M := M)) (d : M →+ M).range
proof:
:= by
  rintro n _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨decompose (grading (M := M)) m (n - 1), ?_⟩
  rw [← decompose_d, sub_add_cancel]

name: DG.d_decompose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem d_decompose_eq_zero {m : M} (hm : d m = 0) (n : ℤ) :
    d (decompose (grading (M := M)) m n : M) = 0
proof:
:=
  isHomogeneous_ker_d n (AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr hm)

name: DG.one_mem_grading
statement: theorem one_mem_grading : (1 : A) ∈ grading (M := A) 0
proof:
:=
  SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem

name: DG.mul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mul_mem_grading {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hb : b ∈ grading j) :
    a * b ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem ha hb

name: DG.d_mul
statement:
theorem d_mul {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (b : A) :
    d (a * b) = d a * b + koszulSign n • (a * d b)
proof:
:=
  DGRing.d_mul' ha b

name: DG.d_mul_of_even
statement:
theorem d_mul_of_even {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hn : Even n) (b : A) :
    d (a * b) = d a * b + a * d b
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_mul ha, koszulSign_even hn, one_smul]

name: DG.d_mul_of_odd
statement:
theorem d_mul_of_odd {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hn : Odd n) (b : A) :
    d (a * b) = d a * b - a * d b
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_mul ha, koszulSign_odd hn, Units.neg_smul, one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.d_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_one : d (1 : A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := d_mul (one_mem_grading (A := A)) 1
  simp only [mul_one, one_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul] at h
  exact left_eq_add.mp h

name: DG.d_intCast
statement: theorem d_intCast (k : ℤ) : d (k : A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zsmul_one, d_zsmul, d_one, smul_zero]

name: DG.d_natCast
statement: theorem d_natCast (k : ℕ) : d (k : A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nsmul_one, d_nsmul, d_one, smul_zero]

name: DG.d_mul_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem d_mul_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) (b : A) :
    d (a * b) = d a * b + a * d b
proof:
:=
  d_mul_of_even ha Even.zero b

name: DG.d_mul_right
statement:
theorem d_mul_right {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (b : A) :
    koszulSign n • (a * d b) = d (a * b) - d a * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_mul ha, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: DG.d_mul_of_d_eq_zero_right
statement: theorem d_mul_of_d_eq_zero_right {b : A} (hb : d b = 0) (a : A) : d (a * b) = d a * b
proof:
:= by
  induction a using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a => rw [d_mul a.2, hb, mul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [add_mul, d_add, ha, ha', d_add, add_mul]

name: DG.d_mul_of_d_eq_zero_left
statement:
theorem d_mul_of_d_eq_zero_left {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hda : d a = 0) (b : A) :
    d (a * b) = koszulSign n • (a * d b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_mul ha, hda, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: DG.d_pow
statement:
theorem d_pow {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (k : ℕ) :
    d (a ^ k) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, koszulSign (i * n) • (a ^ i * d a * a ^ (k - 1 - i))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', d_mul ha, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum,
      add_comm]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, pow_succ', mul_assoc a, mul_assoc a]
      congr 2
      · push_cast; ring
      · congr 2
        omega
    · simp

name: DG.d_pow_of_mem_zero
statement:
theorem d_pow_of_mem_zero {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) (k : ℕ) :
    d (a ^ k) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a ^ i * d a * a ^ (k - 1 - i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_pow ha]
  simp

name: DG.d_pow_of_even
statement:
theorem d_pow_of_even {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hn : Even n) (k : ℕ) :
    d (a ^ k) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a ^ i * d a * a ^ (k - 1 - i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_pow ha]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [koszulSign_even (hn.mul_left _), one_smul]

name: DG.d_pow_of_even_of_commute
statement:
theorem d_pow_of_even_of_commute {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) (hn : Even n)
    (hc : Commute a (d a)) (k : ℕ) : d (a ^ k) = k • (a ^ (k - 1) * d a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_pow_of_even ha hn, Finset.sum_range]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_card_nsmul (b := a ^ (k - 1) * d a) fun i _ => ?_]
  · simp
  · have hi := i.isLt
    rw [(hc.pow_left _).eq, mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← (hc.pow_left _).eq]
    congr 3
    omega

name: DG.d_pow_of_mem_zero_of_commute
statement:
theorem d_pow_of_mem_zero_of_commute {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading 0) (hc : Commute a (d a))
    (k : ℕ) : d (a ^ k) = k • (a ^ (k - 1) * d a)
proof:
:=
  d_pow_of_even_of_commute ha Even.zero hc k

name: DG.d_list_prod
statement:
theorem d_list_prod (l : List (Σ n : ℤ, grading (M := A) n)) :
    d (l.map fun x => (x.2 : A)).prod =
      ∑ i : Fin l.length, koszulSign ((l.take i).map (·.1)).sum •
        (((l.take i).map fun x => (x.2 : A)).prod * d (l[i].2 : A) *
          ((l.drop (i + 1)).map fun x => (x.2 : A)).prod)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, d_mul x.2.2, ih]
    erw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    congr 1
    · simp
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, List.take_succ_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.prod_cons,
        List.drop_succ_cons, Fin.getElem_fin, koszulSign_add, mul_smul,
        mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
      rfl

name: DG.algebraMap_mem_grading
statement: theorem algebraMap_mem_grading (r : R) : algebraMap R A r ∈ grading (M := A) 0
proof:
:=
  DGAlgebra.algebraMap_mem' r

name: DG.d_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_algebraMap (r : R) : d (algebraMap R A r) = 0
proof:
:=
  DGAlgebra.d_algebraMap' r

name: DG.DGAlgebra.smul_mem
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.smul_mem {n : ℤ} (r : R) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) :
    r • a ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  simpa using mul_mem_grading (algebraMap_mem_grading R r) ha

name: DG.d_smul_algebra
statement: theorem d_smul_algebra (r : R) (a : A) : d (r • a) = r • d a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, d_mul (algebraMap_mem_grading R r), d_algebraMap, zero_mul, zero_add,
    koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul, Algebra.smul_def]

name: DG.DGAlgebra.mem_gradingSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGAlgebra.mem_gradingSubmodule {n : ℤ} {a : A} :
    a ∈ DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A n ↔ a ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule_toAddSubgroup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule_toAddSubgroup (n : ℤ) :
    (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A n).toAddSubgroup = grading n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAlgebra.dLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGAlgebra.dLinear_apply (a : A) : DGAlgebra.dLinear R A a = d a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Decomposition.mapAux_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Decomposition.mapAux_of (i : ι) (x : ℳ i) :
    Decomposition.mapAux ℳ f (DirectSum.of _ i x) =
      DirectSum.of (fun i => (ℳ i).map f) i ⟨f x, x, x.2, rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [Decomposition.mapAux]

name: DG.Decomposition.coe_mapAux
statement:
theorem Decomposition.coe_mapAux (z : ⨁ i, ℳ i) :
    (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (fun i => (ℳ i).map f) (Decomposition.mapAux ℳ f z) : N) =
      f (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j x => simp
  | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [map_add, hz, hz']

name: DG.Decomposition.mapAux_surjective
statement: theorem Decomposition.mapAux_surjective : Function.Surjective (Decomposition.mapAux ℳ f)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | of j y =>
    obtain ⟨y, x, hx, rfl⟩ := y
    exact ⟨DirectSum.of _ j ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp⟩
  | add y y' hy hy' =>
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := hy'
    exact ⟨z + z', map_add _ _ _⟩

name: DG.Decomposition.mapAux_decompose_eq_of_mem_ker
statement:
theorem Decomposition.mapAux_decompose_eq_of_mem_ker (hker : SetLike.IsHomogeneous ℳ f.ker)
    {a : M} (ha : a ∈ f.ker) : Decomposition.mapAux ℳ f (decompose ℳ a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of (decompose ℳ a), map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Decomposition.mapAux_of]
  have h0 : (⟨f (decompose ℳ a i), _, (decompose ℳ a i).2, rfl⟩ : (ℳ i).map f) = 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mp (hker i ha))
  rw [h0, map_zero]

name: DG.Decomposition.mapAux_decompose_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← decompose_sub]
  exact Decomposition.mapAux_decompose_eq_of_mem_ker ℳ f hker
    (by rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, map_sub, h, sub_self])

name: DG.DGAddCommGroup.ofGraded_grading
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGAddCommGroup.ofGraded_grading (ℳ : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) [Decomposition ℳ] :
    (DGAddCommGroup.ofGraded ℳ).grading = ℳ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAddCommGroup.ofGraded_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGAddCommGroup.ofGraded_d (ℳ : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) [Decomposition ℳ] :

proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGRing.ofGradedRing
statement:
theorem DGRing.ofGradedRing (𝒜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup A) [GradedRing 𝒜] :
    letI
proof:
:= DGAddCommGroup.ofGraded 𝒜
    DGRing A :=
  letI := DGAddCommGroup.ofGraded 𝒜
  { toGradedMonoid := inferInstanceAs (SetLike.GradedMonoid 𝒜)
    d_mul' := fun _ _ => by simp }

name: DG.degreeZeroGrading_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeZeroGrading_zero : degreeZeroGrading R 0 = ⊤
proof: := ite_eq_left rfl

name: DG.degreeZeroGrading_of_ne
statement: theorem degreeZeroGrading_of_ne {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : degreeZeroGrading R n = ⊥
proof: := ite_eq_right hn

name: DG.mem_degreeZeroGrading_zero
statement: theorem mem_degreeZeroGrading_zero (r : R) : r ∈ degreeZeroGrading R 0
proof: := by simp

name: DG.mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff {n : ℤ} {r : R} :
    r ∈ degreeZeroGrading R n ↔ n = 0 ∨ r = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  · simp [degreeZeroGrading_of_ne R hn, hn]

name: DG.DGRing.degreeZero
statement:
theorem DGRing.degreeZero :
    letI
proof:
:= DGAddCommGroup.degreeZero R
    DGRing R :=
  letI := DGAddCommGroup.degreeZero R
  { one_mem := mem_degreeZeroGrading_zero R 1
    mul_mem := fun i j a b ha hb => by
      change a ∈ degreeZeroGrading R i at ha
      change b ∈ degreeZeroGrading R j at hb
      change a * b ∈ degreeZeroGrading R (i + j)
      rw [mem_degreeZeroGrading_iff] at ha hb ⊢
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl
      · rcases hb with rfl | rfl
        · simp
        · simp
      · simp
    d_mul' := fun _ _ => by
      change (0 : R →+ R) _ = (0 : R →+ R) _ * _ + _ • (_ * (0 : R →+ R) _)
      simp }

name: DG.DGAlgebra.degreeZero
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.degreeZero (R : Type*) [CommRing R] :
    letI
proof:
:= DGAddCommGroup.degreeZero R
    haveI := DGRing.degreeZero R
    DGAlgebra R R :=
  letI := DGAddCommGroup.degreeZero R
  haveI := DGRing.degreeZero R
  { algebraMap_mem' := fun _ => mem_degreeZeroGrading_zero R _
    d_algebraMap' := fun _ => rfl }

name: DG.DGIdeal.Quotient.mkRingHom_surjective

:=

name: DG.DGIdeal.Quotient.mkRingHom_eq_zero_iff_mem
statement: theorem mkRingHom_eq_zero_iff_mem {a : A} : mkRingHom I a = 0 ↔ a ∈ I

:=

name: DG.DGIdeal.Quotient.isHomogeneous_ker
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_ker :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneous (grading (M := A)) (mkRingHom I).toAddMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  intro n a ha
  have ha' : mkRingHom I a = 0 := ha
  show mkRingHom I _ = 0
  rw [mkRingHom_eq_zero_iff_mem] at ha' ⊢
  exact decompose_mem ha' n

theorem mkRingHom_mem_grading {n : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading n) :

  ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: DG.DGIdeal.Quotient.lift_mk

theorem lift_mk (f : A →ᵈᵍ+* B) (hf : ∀ a ∈ I, f a = 0) (a : A) : lift f hf (mk I a) = f a

name: DG.DGRingHom.mem_ker

theorem DGRingHom.mem_ker {A B : Type*} [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [DGRing A] [Ring B]
