name: DG.d_cocyclesDGSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_cocyclesDGSubring (a : cocyclesDGSubring A) : d a = 0
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext a.2

name: DG.mem_coboundariesDGIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_coboundariesDGIdeal {z : cocyclesDGSubring A} :
    z ∈ coboundariesDGIdeal A ↔ ∃ x : A, d x = z
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.intComparisonAddHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intComparisonAddHom_tmul (a : A) (b : B) :
    intComparisonAddHom R A B (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜ᵣ ᵍ⊗[R] ℬᵣ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.intComparisonAddHom_mul
statement:
theorem intComparisonAddHom_mul (x y : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[ℤ] ℬ) :
    intComparisonAddHom R A B (x * y) =
      intComparisonAddHom R A B x * intComparisonAddHom R A B y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, add_mul]
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb =>
    induction y using induction_on_tmul (R := ℤ) with
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, mul_add]
    | @tmul i' j' a' ha' b' hb' =>
      rw [tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a hb ha' b', intComparisonAddHom_tmul,
        intComparisonAddHom_tmul,
        tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜ᵣ ℬᵣ a hb ha' b', Units.smul_def, map_zsmul,
        intComparisonAddHom_tmul, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.intComparison_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intComparison_tmul (a : A) (b : B) :
    intComparison R A B (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b) = (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b : 𝒜ᵣ ᵍ⊗[R] ℬᵣ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.intComparison_surjective
statement: theorem intComparison_surjective : Function.Surjective (intComparison R A B)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  induction y using induction_on_tmul (R := R) with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | @tmul i j a ha b hb => exact ⟨a ᵍ⊗ₜ[ℤ] b, rfl⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨x' + y', map_add _ _ _⟩

name: DG.IsGradedCommStrict.of_invertible_two
statement:
theorem IsGradedCommStrict.of_invertible_two [Invertible (2 : R)] [IsGradedComm 𝒜] :
    IsGradedCommStrict 𝒜 where
  mul_self_of_odd {i a} ha hi
proof:
:= by
    have h := IsGradedComm.two_nsmul_mul_self_of_odd ha hi
    rw [two_nsmul, ← two_smul R] at h
    rw [← one_smul R (a * a), ← invOf_mul_self (2 : R), mul_smul, h, smul_zero]

name: DG.isGradedCommStrict_iff_isGradedComm
statement:
theorem isGradedCommStrict_iff_isGradedComm [Invertible (2 : R)] :
    IsGradedCommStrict 𝒜 ↔ IsGradedComm 𝒜
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => inferInstance, fun _ => IsGradedCommStrict.of_invertible_two 𝒜⟩

name: DG.IsCDGA.mul_comm_of_mem
statement:
theorem mul_comm_of_mem {i j : ℤ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hb : b ∈ grading j) :
    a * b = koszulSign (i * j) • (b * a)
proof:
:=
  IsCDGA.mul_comm_of_mem' ha hb

name: DG.IsCDGA.mul_self_of_odd
statement: theorem mul_self_of_odd {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Odd i) : a * a = 0
proof:
:=
  IsCDGA.mul_self_of_odd' ha hi

name: DG.IsCDGA.commute_of_even
statement:
theorem commute_of_even {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Even i) (b : A) :
    Commute a b
proof:
:=
  IsGradedComm.commute_of_even (𝒜 := DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule ℤ A) ha hi b

name: DG.IsCDGA.commute_d
statement: theorem commute_d {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) : Commute a (d a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Commute, SemiconjBy, mul_comm_of_mem ha (d_mem ha),
    koszulSign_even (Int.even_mul_succ_self i), one_smul]

name: DG.IsCDGA.d_mul_self_of_even
statement:
theorem d_mul_self_of_even {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Even i) :
    d (a * a) = 2 • (a * d a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_mul_of_even ha hi, (commute_d ha).eq, two_nsmul]

name: DG.IsCDGA.d_pow_of_even
statement:
theorem d_pow_of_even {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Even i) (k : ℕ) :
    d (a ^ k) = k • (a ^ (k - 1) * d a)
proof:
:=
  d_pow_of_even_of_commute ha hi (commute_d ha) k

name: DG.IsCDGA.of_isGradedCommStrict
statement:
theorem IsCDGA.of_isGradedCommStrict [IsGradedCommStrict (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A)] :
    IsCDGA A where
  mul_comm_of_mem' ha hb
proof:
:= IsGradedComm.mul_comm_of_mem (𝒜 := DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A) ha hb
  mul_self_of_odd' ha hi :=
    IsGradedCommStrict.mul_self_of_odd (𝒜 := DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A) ha hi

name: DG.isCDGA_iff
statement: theorem isCDGA_iff : IsCDGA A ↔ IsGradedCommStrict (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ => inferInstance, fun _ => IsCDGA.of_isGradedCommStrict R⟩

name: DG.IsCDGA.of_isGradedComm
statement:
theorem IsCDGA.of_isGradedComm [Invertible (2 : R)]
    [IsGradedComm (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A)] : IsCDGA A
proof:
:=
  haveI := IsGradedCommStrict.of_invertible_two (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A)
  IsCDGA.of_isGradedCommStrict R

name: DG.d_mul_self_of_odd
statement:
theorem d_mul_self_of_odd [IsGradedComm (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A)] {i : ℤ} {a : A}
    (ha : a ∈ grading i) (hi : Odd i) : d (a * a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_mul_of_odd ha hi,
    IsGradedComm.mul_comm_of_mem (𝒜 := DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A) ha (d_mem ha),
    koszulSign_even (Int.even_mul_succ_self i), one_smul, sub_self]

name: DG.isCDGA_cocyclesDGSubring
statement:
theorem isCDGA_cocyclesDGSubring (A : Type*) [Ring A] [DGAddCommGroup A] [DGRing A] [IsCDGA A] :
    IsCDGA (cocyclesDGSubring A)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.ks_eq
statement: private theorem ks_eq {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.GradedTensorProduct.mul_comm_of_mem
statement:
theorem mul_comm_of_mem {n m : ℤ} {x y : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ} (hx : x ∈ DG.grading n)
    (hy : y ∈ DG.grading m) :
    x * y = koszulSign (n * m) • (y * x)
proof:
:= by
  refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hx
    (motive := fun x => x * y = koszulSign (n * m) • (y * x)) (by simp) ?_ ?_
  · intro i j a b hij
    refine GradedTensorProduct.grading_induction 𝒜 ℬ hy
      (motive := fun y => ((a : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b : B) : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) * y =
        koszulSign (n * m) • (y * ((a : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b : B)))) (by simp) ?_ ?_
    · intro i' j' a' b' hij'
      subst hij hij'
      rw [GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ _ b.2 a'.2,
        GradedTensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul 𝒜 ℬ _ b'.2 a.2,
        IsCDGA.mul_comm_of_mem (A := A) a'.2 a.2, IsCDGA.mul_comm_of_mem (A := B) b'.2 b.2,
        GradedTensorProduct.koszulSign_smul_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_koszulSign_smul,
        smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add,
        ← koszulSign_add]
      congr 1
      exact ks_eq ⟨-(i * i' + i * j' + j * j'), by ring⟩
    · intro y y' hy hy'
      rw [mul_add, add_mul, hy, hy', smul_add]
  · intro x x' hx hx'
    rw [add_mul, mul_add, hx, hx', smul_add]

name: DG.Unperiodize.of_eq_of
statement:
theorem of_eq_of {j j' : ZMod 2} (h : j = j') {x : lowGrading 𝒩 j} {x' : lowGrading 𝒩 j'}
    (hx : (x : N) = x') : of ℬ 𝒩 j x = of ℬ 𝒩 j' x'
proof:
:= by
  subst h; congr; exact Subtype.ext hx

name: DG.Unperiodize.coe_gsmul
statement:
theorem coe_gsmul (i j : ZMod 2) (b : ℬ i) (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j) :
    (gsmul ℬ 𝒩 i j b x : N) = Periodize.mk ℬ ((i + j).val - j.val) (b : B)
      (by rw [cast_sub_val]; exact b.2) • (x : N)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Unperiodize.cast_dShift
statement: theorem cast_dShift (j : ZMod 2) : (dShift j : ZMod 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dShift, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_sub, intCast_val_zmodTwo, intCast_val_zmodTwo, Int.cast_one]
  ring

name: DG.Unperiodize.dShift_smul_mem
proof:
:= by
  have := SetLike.GradedSMul.smul_mem (Periodize.mk_mem (ℳ := ℬ) (dShift j)
    (m := (1 : B)) (by rw [cast_dShift]; exact SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := ℬ)))
    (B := 𝒩) (hN.map_mem (show x ∈ 𝒩 (j.val : ℤ) from hx))
  rw [vadd_eq_add, show dShift j + ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) = (j + 1).val by rw [dShift]; ring]
    at this
  exact this

name: DG.Unperiodize.dHom_of
statement:
theorem dHom_of (hN : IsPeriodicDGModule hA 𝒩 dN) (j : ZMod 2) (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j) :
    dHom ℬ 𝒩 hN (of ℬ 𝒩 j x) = of ℬ 𝒩 (j + 1) ⟨_, dShift_smul_mem hN x.2⟩
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun j => ↥(lowGrading 𝒩 j)) _ j x

name: DG.Unperiodize.of_cast
statement:
theorem of_cast {j j' : ZMod 2} (h : j = j') (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j) :
    of ℬ 𝒩 j x = of ℬ 𝒩 j' ⟨x, h ▸ x.2⟩
proof: := of_eq_of h rfl

name: DG.Unperiodize.dHom_dHom
statement:
theorem dHom_dHom (hN : IsPeriodicDGModule hA 𝒩 dN) (y : Unperiodize ℬ 𝒩) :
    dHom ℬ 𝒩 hN (dHom ℬ 𝒩 hN y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j x =>
    rw [dHom_of, dHom_of]
    refine (of_eq_of rfl (x' := 0) ?_).trans (map_zero _)
    change Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ • dN (Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ • dN x) = 0
    rw [hN.d_evenOne_smul, hN.d_d, smul_zero, smul_zero]
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add, map_add, hy, hy', add_zero]

name: DG.Periodize.mk_mul_evenOne
proof:
:= by
  rw [Periodize.evenOne, Periodize.mk_mul_mk]; exact Periodize.mk_congr rfl (mul_one b) _ _

name: DG.Unperiodize.of_units_smul
statement:
theorem of_units_smul (j : ZMod 2) (z : ℤˣ) (x : lowGrading 𝒩 j) :
    z • of ℬ 𝒩 j x = of ℬ 𝒩 j ⟨z • (x : N), by
      rw [Units.smul_def]; exact zsmul_mem x.2 _⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, ← map_zsmul]; rfl

name: DG.Unperiodize.isZMod2DGModule
statement:
theorem isZMod2DGModule (hN : IsPeriodicDGModule hA 𝒩 dN) :
    IsZMod2DGModule ℬ dA (grading ℬ 𝒩) (dHom ℬ 𝒩 hN) where
  map_mem
proof:
:= by
    intro j y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (mem_grading_iff (ℬ := ℬ)).mp hy
    rw [dHom_of]; exact of_mem_grading _ _
  d_d := dHom_dHom hN
  d_smul := by
    intro n b hb y
    induction y using induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of j x =>
      rw [smul_of hb, dHom_of, dHom_of, smul_of (hA.map_mem hb), smul_of hb,
        of_cast (add_right_comm (n : ZMod 2) 1 j), of_cast (add_assoc (n : ZMod 2) j 1).symm,
        of_units_smul, ← map_add]
      refine of_eq_of rfl ?_
      change Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ •
          dN (Periodize.mk ℬ (((n : ZMod 2) + j).val - j.val) b _ • (x : N)) =
        Periodize.mk ℬ (((n : ZMod 2) + 1 + j).val - j.val) (dA b) _ • (x : N) +
          koszulSign n • (Periodize.mk ℬ (((n : ZMod 2) + (j + 1)).val - (j + 1).val) b _ •
            Periodize.evenOne ℬ (dShift j) (cast_dShift j) • dN x)
      rw [hN.d_smul (Periodize.mk_mem _ _), Periodize.dHom_mk, smul_add, ← mul_smul,
        Periodize.evenOne_mul_mk, smul_comm, ← mul_smul, Periodize.evenOne_mul_mk, ← mul_smul,
        Periodize.mk_mul_evenOne, koszulSign_congr (cast_sub_val (n : ZMod 2) j)]
      congr 2
      · exact Periodize.mk_congr
          (by simp only [dShift]; rw [add_right_comm (n : ZMod 2) 1 j]; ring) rfl _ _
      · congr 1
        exact Periodize.mk_congr (by simp only [dShift]; rw [← add_assoc]; ring) rfl _ _
    | add y y' hy hy' =>
      rw [smul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, smul_add, smul_add, smul_add]
      abel

name: DG.Periodize.evenOne_smul_mk
statement:
theorem evenOne_smul_mk {k n : ℤ} (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    evenOne ℬ k hk • mk ℳ n m hm =
      mk ℳ (k + n) m (by rw [Int.cast_add, hk, zero_add]; exact hm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenOne, mk_smul_mk]; exact mk_congr rfl (one_smul B m) _ _

name: DG.Periodize.evenOne_congr
statement:
theorem evenOne_congr {k k' : ℤ} (h : k = k') (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) (hk' : (k' : ZMod 2) = 0) :
    evenOne ℬ k hk = evenOne ℬ k' hk'
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unitHom_d
statement:
theorem unitHom_d (X : ZMod2DGModuleCat.{v} ℬ dA) (m : X.obj) :
    unitHom X.obj (X.d m) =
      Unperiodize.dHom ℬ _ (Periodize.isPeriodicDGModule hA X.prop) (unitHom X.obj m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn X.obj.grading with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous m =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
    rename_i j
    rw [unitHom_of_mem (X.prop.map_mem hm), unitHom_of_mem hm, Unperiodize.dHom_of]
    refine Unperiodize.of_eq_of rfl ?_
    change Periodize.mk X.obj.grading ((j + 1).val : ℤ) (X.d m) _ =
      Periodize.evenOne ℬ (Unperiodize.dShift j) (Unperiodize.cast_dShift j) •
        Periodize.dHom X.obj.grading X.prop.toIsOddDifferential
          (Periodize.mk X.obj.grading (j.val : ℤ) m (by rwa [intCast_val_zmodTwo]))
    rw [Periodize.dHom_mk, Periodize.evenOne_smul_mk]
    exact Periodize.mk_congr (by rw [Unperiodize.dShift]; ring) rfl _ _
  | add m m' hm hm' => simp only [map_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitHom_d
statement:
theorem counitHom_d (X : PeriodicDGModuleCat.{v} ℬ hA)
    (z : Periodize (Unperiodize.grading ℬ X.obj.grading)) :
    counitHom X.obj (Periodize.dHom _ (Unperiodize.isZMod2DGModule X.prop).toIsOddDifferential z) =
      X.d (counitHom X.obj z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using Periodize.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk n y hy =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (Unperiodize.mem_grading_iff (ℬ := ℬ)).mp hy
    rw [Periodize.dHom_mk, counitHom_mk, counitHom_mk, Unperiodize.fold_of, Unperiodize.dHom_of,
      Unperiodize.fold_of, X.prop.d_evenOne_smul]
    change Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ • Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ • X.d x =
      Periodize.evenOne ℬ _ _ • X.d x
    rw [← mul_smul, Periodize.evenOne_mul_evenOne]
    congr 1
    refine Periodize.evenOne_congr ?_ _ _
    rw [Unperiodize.dShift, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one]
    ring
  | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add, hz, hz', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.coe_decompose_map_of_map_mem
statement:
theorem coe_decompose_map_of_map_mem (f : M →+ N)
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n) (m : M) (j : ℤ) :
    (decompose (grading (M := N)) (f m) j : N) = f (decompose (grading (M := M)) m j)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i i
    rw [decompose_of_mem _ (hf x.2), decompose_coe]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp
    · simp [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm hij)]
  | h_add m m' hm hm' => simp [decompose_add, hm, hm']

name: DG.mem_grading_of_injective
statement:
theorem mem_grading_of_injective (f : M →+ N)
    (hf : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → f m ∈ grading n) (hinj : Function.Injective f)
    {k : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : f m ∈ grading k) : m ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  set ℳ := grading (M := M)
  have key : ∀ j, j ≠ k → decompose ℳ m j = 0 := fun j hj => by
    refine Subtype.ext (hinj ?_)
    rw [← coe_decompose_map_of_map_mem f hf, decompose_of_mem_ne _ hm (Ne.symm hj),
      ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, map_zero]
  have h : decompose ℳ m = DirectSum.of (fun i => ℳ i) k (decompose ℳ m k) := by
    refine DirectSum.ext fun j => ?_
    by_cases hjk : j = k
    · subst hjk
      rw [of_eq_same]
    · rw [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ hjk, key j hjk]
  have h' := congrArg (decompose ℳ).symm h
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, decompose_symm_of] at h'
  rw [h']
  exact (decompose ℳ m k).2

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.coe_toAddEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toAddEquiv (e : DGAddEquiv M N) : ⇑e.toAddEquiv = e
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {e e' : DGAddEquiv M N} (h : ∀ m, e m = e' m) : e = e'
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext e e' h

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.map_mem
statement: theorem map_mem (e : DGAddEquiv M N) {n : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ grading n) : e m ∈ grading n
proof:
:=
  e.map_mem' hm

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.map_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_d (e : DGAddEquiv M N) (m : M) : e (d m) = d (e m)
proof:
:=
  e.map_d' m

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.injective
statement: theorem injective (e : DGAddEquiv M N) : Function.Injective e
proof:
:=
  EquivLike.injective e

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.surjective
statement: theorem surjective (e : DGAddEquiv M N) : Function.Surjective e
proof:
:=
  EquivLike.surjective e

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.refl_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem refl_apply (m : M) : (refl : DGAddEquiv M M) m = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.apply_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem apply_symm_apply (e : DGAddEquiv M N) (y : N) : e (e.symm y) = y
proof:
:=
  e.right_inv y

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.symm_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_apply_apply (e : DGAddEquiv M N) (m : M) : e.symm (e m) = m
proof:
:=
  e.left_inv m

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.symm_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_symm (e : DGAddEquiv M N) : e.symm.symm = e
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.trans_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trans_apply (e : DGAddEquiv M N) (e' : DGAddEquiv N P) (m : M) :
    e.trans e' m = e' (e m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.ofAddMonoidHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofAddMonoidHom_apply (f : M →+ N) (g : N →+ M) (hgf hfg) (hf) (hd) (m : M) :
    ofAddMonoidHom f g hgf hfg hf hd m = f m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.DGAddEquiv.ofAddMonoidHom_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofAddMonoidHom_symm_apply (f : M →+ N) (g : N →+ M) (hgf hfg) (hf) (hd) (n : N) :
    (ofAddMonoidHom f g hgf hfg hf hd).symm n = g n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.symm_mem_of_map_mem
statement:
theorem symm_mem_of_map_mem (e : M ≃+ N) (he : ∀ {n : ℤ} {m : M}, m ∈ grading n → e m ∈ grading n)
    {n : ℤ} {x : N} (hx : x ∈ grading n) : e.symm x ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m := e.symm x with hm
  have hcomp : ∀ i, i ≠ n → (decompose (grading (M := M)) m i : M) = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    apply e.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    have h := decompose_map (k := 0) (e : M →+ N) (fun hm => by rw [add_zero]; exact he hm) m i
    rw [add_zero] at h
    change (e : M →+ N) _ = 0
    rw [← h, hm]
    change (decompose (grading (M := N)) (e (e.symm x)) i : N) = 0
    rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, decompose_of_mem_ne _ hx hi.symm]
  have : m = (decompose (grading (M := M)) m n : M) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (grading (M := M)) m]
    by_cases hn : n ∈ DFinsupp.support (decompose (grading (M := M)) m)
    · exact Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem n hn fun i _ hi => hcomp i hi
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => hcomp i fun h => hn (h ▸ hi)]
      rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff] at hn
      rw [hn, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  rw [this]
  exact (decompose (grading (M := M)) m n).2

name: DG.DGAlgEquiv.coe_toAlgEquiv

@[simp]

proof:

name: DG.coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_forall_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_forall_eq_zero (φ : ∀ i, T →+ P i)
    (hφ : ∀ i (n : ℤ), ∀ x ∈ ℳ n, φ i x ∈ grading n)
    (hinj : ∀ x : T, (∀ i, φ i x = 0) → x = 0) :
    Function.Injective (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ z, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ z = 0 → z = 0 by
    intro y y' hyy'
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    exact h _ (by rw [map_sub, hyy', sub_self])
  let r : ∀ i (n : ℤ), ℳ n →+ grading (M := P i) n := fun i n =>
    AddMonoidHom.codRestrict ((φ i).comp (ℳ n).subtype) _ fun x => hφ i n x x.2
  have key : ∀ i z, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (grading (M := P i)) (DirectSum.map (r i) z) =
      φ i (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ z) := by
    intro i z
    induction z using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of n x => simp [r]
    | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]
  intro z hz
  ext n
  rw [DirectSum.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  apply hinj
  intro i
  have h1 := key i z
  rw [hz, map_zero] at h1
  have h2 : DirectSum.map (r i) z = 0 :=
    (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (grading (M := P i))).injective
      (h1.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have h3 := congrArg (fun w => (w n : P i)) h2
  simpa [r] using h3

name: DG.coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_injective
statement:
theorem coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_injective {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N]
    (φ : T →+ N) (hφ : ∀ (n : ℤ), ∀ x ∈ ℳ n, φ x ∈ grading n) (hinj : Function.Injective φ) :
    Function.Injective (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ)
proof:
:=
  coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_forall_eq_zero ℳ (P := fun _ : Unit => N) (fun _ => φ)
    (fun _ => hφ) fun x hx => hinj (by rw [hx (), map_zero])

name: DG.coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_pair
statement:
theorem coeAddMonoidHom_injective_of_pair {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] (φ : T →+ M) (ψ : T →+ N)
    (hφ : ∀ (n : ℤ), ∀ x ∈ ℳ n, φ x ∈ grading n) (hψ : ∀ (n : ℤ), ∀ x ∈ ℳ n, ψ x ∈ grading n)
    (hinj : ∀ x : T, φ x = 0 → ψ x = 0 → x = 0) :
    Function.Injective (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ z, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ z = 0 → z = 0 by
    intro y y' hyy'
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    exact h _ (by rw [map_sub, hyy', sub_self])
  let rφ : ∀ (n : ℤ), ℳ n →+ grading (M := M) n := fun n =>
    AddMonoidHom.codRestrict (φ.comp (ℳ n).subtype) _ fun x => hφ n x x.2
  let rψ : ∀ (n : ℤ), ℳ n →+ grading (M := N) n := fun n =>
    AddMonoidHom.codRestrict (ψ.comp (ℳ n).subtype) _ fun x => hψ n x x.2
  have keyφ : ∀ z, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (grading (M := M)) (DirectSum.map rφ z) =
      φ (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ z) := by
    intro z
    induction z using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of n x => simp [rφ]
    | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]
  have keyψ : ∀ z, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (grading (M := N)) (DirectSum.map rψ z) =
      ψ (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ z) := by
    intro z
    induction z using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | of n x => simp [rψ]
    | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]
  intro z hz
  have hφ' := keyφ z
  have hψ' := keyψ z
  rw [hz, map_zero] at hφ' hψ'
  have h2φ : DirectSum.map rφ z = 0 :=
    (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (grading (M := M))).injective
      (hφ'.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have h2ψ : DirectSum.map rψ z = 0 :=
    (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (grading (M := N))).injective
      (hψ'.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  ext n
  rw [DirectSum.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  refine hinj _ ?_ ?_
  · simpa [rφ] using congrArg (fun w => (w n : M)) h2φ
  · simpa [rψ] using congrArg (fun w => (w n : N)) h2ψ

name: DG.coeAddMonoidHom_surjective_of_mem_iSup
statement:
theorem coeAddMonoidHom_surjective_of_mem_iSup (h : ∀ x : T, x ∈ ⨆ n, ℳ n) :
    Function.Surjective (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ)
proof:
:= fun x => by
  refine AddSubgroup.iSup_induction ℳ (C := fun x => ∃ y, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom ℳ y = x) (h x)
    (fun n x hx => ⟨DirectSum.of _ n ⟨x, hx⟩, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of _ _ _⟩)
    ⟨0, map_zero _⟩ ?_
  rintro x y ⟨y₁, rfl⟩ ⟨y₂, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨y₁ + y₂, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_apply
statement:
theorem merge_apply {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (k : Fin n) :
    merge i a k = if (k : ℕ) < i then a k.castSucc
      else if (k : ℕ) = i then a k.castSucc * a k.succ else a k.succ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_update_of_lt
statement:
theorem merge_update_of_lt {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x : A)
    (h : (p : ℕ) < i) :
    merge i (Function.update a p x) = Function.update (merge i a) ⟨p, by omega⟩ x
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [merge_apply, Function.update_apply, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_update_of_gt
statement:
theorem merge_update_of_gt {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x : A)
    (h : (i : ℕ) + 1 < p) :
    merge i (Function.update a p x) = Function.update (merge i a) ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩ x
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [merge_apply, Function.update_apply, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_update_castSucc
statement:
theorem merge_update_castSucc {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (x : A) :
    merge i (Function.update a i.castSucc x) =
      Function.update (merge i a) i (x * a i.succ)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [merge_apply, Function.update_apply, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega | (obtain rfl : k = i := Fin.ext (by omega); rfl)

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_update_succ
statement:
theorem merge_update_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) (x : A) :
    merge i (Function.update a i.succ x) =
      Function.update (merge i a) i (a i.castSucc * x)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [merge_apply, Function.update_apply, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega | (obtain rfl : k = i := Fin.ext (by omega); rfl)

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_merge
statement:
theorem merge_merge {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 3) → A) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 2))
    (h : (i : ℕ) < j) :
    merge i (merge j a) = merge ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩ (merge i.castSucc a)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [merge_apply, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega | (rw [mul_assoc]; rfl)

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_zero_apply_zero
statement: theorem merge_zero_apply_zero : merge 0 a 0 = a 0 * a 1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_zero_apply_last
statement: theorem merge_zero_apply_last : merge 0 a (Fin.last (n + 1)) = a (Fin.last (n + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [merge_apply, ite_eq_right (by simp), ite_eq_right (by simp)]; rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.init_tail_merge_zero
statement:
theorem init_tail_merge_zero :
    Fin.init (Fin.tail (merge 0 a)) = Fin.tail (Fin.init (Fin.tail a))
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [Fin.init, Fin.tail, merge_apply]
  rw [ite_eq_right (by simp), ite_eq_right (by simp)]; rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_succ_apply_zero
statement: theorem merge_succ_apply_zero (i : Fin n) : merge i.castSucc.succ a 0 = a 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [merge_apply, ite_eq_left (by simp)]; rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_succ_apply_last
statement:
theorem merge_succ_apply_last (i : Fin n) :
    merge i.castSucc.succ a (Fin.last (n + 1)) = a (Fin.last (n + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [merge_apply, ite_eq_right (by simp), ite_eq_right (by simp; omega)]; rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.init_tail_merge_succ
statement:
theorem init_tail_merge_succ (i : Fin n) :
    Fin.init (Fin.tail (merge i.castSucc.succ a)) = merge i (Fin.init (Fin.tail a))
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [Fin.init, Fin.tail, merge_apply, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
  split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_last_apply_zero
statement: theorem merge_last_apply_zero : merge (Fin.last n).succ a 0 = a 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [merge_apply, ite_eq_left (by simp)]; rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_last_apply_last
statement:
theorem merge_last_apply_last :
    merge (Fin.last n).succ a (Fin.last (n + 1)) =
      a (Fin.last (n + 1)).castSucc * a (Fin.last (n + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [merge_apply, ite_eq_right (by simp), ite_eq_left (by simp)]; rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.init_tail_merge_last
statement:
theorem init_tail_merge_last :
    Fin.init (Fin.tail (merge (Fin.last n).succ a)) = Fin.init (Fin.init (Fin.tail a))
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [Fin.init, Fin.tail, merge_apply, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]
  rw [ite_eq_left (by omega)]; rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.sum_contractNth_add
statement:
theorem sum_contractNth_add {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (p : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) :
    ∑ k, Fin.contractNth i.castSucc (· + ·) p k = ∑ k, p k
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ (f := p)]
    cases i using Fin.cases with
    | zero =>
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ (f := fun k => p k.succ)]
      simp only [Fin.contractNth, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ,
        lt_self_iff_false, ite_false, ite_true, Nat.not_lt_zero, add_assoc, Nat.add_one_ne_zero]
    | succ i =>
      have h0 : Fin.contractNth i.succ.castSucc (· + ·) p 0 = p 0 := by
        rw [Fin.contractNth, ite_eq_left (by simp)]; rfl
      rw [h0, ← ih i (fun k => p k.succ)]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      simp only [Fin.contractNth, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
      split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

name: DG.Hochschild.barD_barD
statement: theorem barD_barD {m : ℕ} (g : (Fin (m + 1) → A) → M) : barD (barD g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [barD, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, Pi.zero_apply]
  rw [← Finset.sum_product']
  let S : Finset (Fin (m + 2) × Fin (m + 1)) := Finset.univ.filter fun p => (p.2 : ℕ) < p.1
  rw [Finset.univ_product_univ, ← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl S, ← eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero,
    ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun p => (p.2.castSucc, ⟨p.1 - 1, by omega⟩))
    (fun p => (⟨p.2 + 1, by omega⟩, ⟨min p.1 m, by omega⟩)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨j, i⟩ h
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_compl] at h ⊢
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j, i⟩ h
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_compl] at h ⊢
    simp only [
      not_lt] at h
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j, i⟩ h
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Prod.mk.injEq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j, i⟩ h
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_compl, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      not_lt] at h
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Prod.mk.injEq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j, i⟩ h
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at h
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]
    rw [merge_merge a i j h, ← Units.neg_smul]
    congr 1
    have hj : ((j : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((j - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hj, koszulSign_add, koszulSign_odd odd_one]
    simp only [mul_neg, mul_one, neg_mul, neg_inj]
    exact mul_comm _ _

name: DG.DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem (k : ℤ) {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) :
    DGAlgebra.twist R A k a = koszulSign (i * k) • a
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.twist, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, decomposeLinearEquiv_apply,
    decompose_of_mem (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A) (i := i) ha, ← lof_eq_of R,
    toModule_lof, LinearMap.smul_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.DGAlgebra.twist_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem DGAlgebra.twist_one (k : ℤ) : DGAlgebra.twist R A k 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem k one_mem_grading, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.DGAlgebra.twist_mul
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.twist_mul (k : ℤ) (a b : A) :
    DGAlgebra.twist R A k (a * b) = DGAlgebra.twist R A k a * DGAlgebra.twist R A k b
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mul_of_homogeneous (DGAlgebra.gradingSubmodule R A) (DGAlgebra.twist R A k)
    (fun {i j} a b => ?_) a b
  rw [DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem k (mul_mem_grading a.2 b.2), DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem k a.2,
    DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem k b.2, add_mul, koszulSign_add, mul_smul]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

name: DG.DGAlgebra.twist_mem
statement:
theorem DGAlgebra.twist_mem (k : ℤ) {i : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ grading i) :
    DGAlgebra.twist R A k a ∈ grading i
proof:
:= by
  rw [DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem k ha, Units.smul_def]
  exact zsmul_mem ha _

name: DG.Hochschild.compMerge_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMerge_apply {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n) (i : Fin n)
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) : compMerge f i a = f (merge i a)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.leftTerm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftTerm_apply {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    leftTerm k f a = DGAlgebra.twist R A k (a 0) • f (Fin.tail a)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.rightTerm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightTerm_apply {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n) (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    rightTerm f a = op (a (Fin.last n)) • f (Fin.init a)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.hochschildDiff_apply
statement:
theorem hochschildDiff_apply (k : ℤ) {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n)
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → A) :
    hochschildDiff k f a = DGAlgebra.twist R A k (a 0) • f (Fin.tail a) +
      ∑ i : Fin n, koszulSign ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ) • f (merge i a) +
        koszulSign ((n : ℤ) + 1) • (op (a (Fin.last n)) • f (Fin.init a))
proof:
:= by
  simp [hochschildDiff, _root_.sum_apply, Units.smul_def]

name: DG.Hochschild.units_smul_comm
statement:
private theorem units_smul_comm {X : Type*} [SMul X M] [SMulCommClass X ℤ M] (x : X) (u : ℤˣ)
    (m : M) : x • (u • m) = u • (x • m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, smul_comm]

name: DG.Hochschild.extend_hochschildDiff
statement:
theorem extend_hochschildDiff {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n) :
    extend k (hochschildDiff k f) = barD (extend k f)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp only [extend, barD, hochschildDiff_apply]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp only [merge_zero_apply_zero, merge_zero_apply_last, init_tail_merge_zero,
    merge_succ_apply_zero, merge_succ_apply_last, init_tail_merge_succ, merge_last_apply_zero,
    merge_last_apply_last, init_tail_merge_last, DGAlgebra.twist_mul, op_mul, mul_smul,
    smul_add, Finset.smul_sum, units_smul_comm, Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, koszulSign_zero,
    one_smul, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    add_assoc]
  rw [← smul_comm (DGAlgebra.twist R A k (Fin.init (Fin.tail a) 0)) (op (a (Fin.last (n + 1 + 1))))]
  rfl

name: DG.Hochschild.extend_cons_snoc
statement:
theorem extend_cons_snoc {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n) (b : Fin n → A) :
    extend k f (Fin.cons (1 : A) (Fin.snoc b (1 : A) : Fin (n + 1) → A)) = f b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extend, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.init_snoc, ← Fin.succ_last, Fin.cons_succ,
    Fin.snoc_last, DGAlgebra.twist_one, op_one, one_smul]

name: DG.hochschildDiff_hochschildDiff
statement:
theorem hochschildDiff_hochschildDiff (k : ℤ) {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n) :
    hochschildDiff k (hochschildDiff k f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [← extend_cons_snoc k (hochschildDiff k (hochschildDiff k f)) b, extend_hochschildDiff,
    extend_hochschildDiff, barD_barD]
  rfl

name: DG.hochschildD_apply
statement:
theorem hochschildD_apply (k : ℤ) {n : ℕ} (f : HochschildCochain R A M n) :
    hochschildD k n f = hochschildDiff k f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.hochschildD_comp_hochschildD
statement:
theorem hochschildD_comp_hochschildD (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    hochschildD (R := R) (A := A) (M := M) k (n + 1) ∘ₗ hochschildD k n = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun f => hochschildDiff_hochschildDiff k f

name: DG.mem_hochschildCochains
statement:
theorem mem_hochschildCochains {k : ℤ} {n : ℕ} {f : HochschildCochain R A M n} :
    f ∈ hochschildCochains R A M k n ↔ ∀ (p : Fin n → ℤ) (a : Fin n → A),
      (∀ i, a i ∈ grading (p i)) → f a ∈ grading (k + ∑ i, p i)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.mem_grading_of_eq
statement:
private theorem mem_grading_of_eq {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [DGAddCommGroup X] {i j : ℤ}
    (h : i = j) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ grading i) : x ∈ grading j
proof:
:=
  h ▸ hx

name: DG.Hochschild.merge_mem_grading
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Hochschild.merge_apply, Fin.contractNth, Fin.val_castSucc]
  split_ifs
  · exact ha _
  · exact mul_mem_grading (ha _) (ha _)
  · exact ha _

name: DG.hochschildD_mem
proof:
:= by
  intro p a ha
  rw [hochschildD_apply, hochschildDiff_apply]
  refine add_mem (add_mem ?_ (sum_mem fun i _ => ?_)) ?_
  · refine mem_grading_of_eq ?_ (smul_mem_grading (DGAlgebra.twist_mem k (ha 0))
      (hf (Fin.tail p) (Fin.tail a) fun i => ha i.succ))
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Fin.tail]
    ring
  · rw [Units.smul_def]
    refine zsmul_mem (mem_grading_of_eq ?_
      (hf _ _ (Hochschild.merge_mem_grading i ha))) _
    rw [Hochschild.sum_contractNth_add]
  · rw [Units.smul_def]
    refine zsmul_mem (mem_grading_of_eq ?_ (op_smul_mem_grading (ha (Fin.last n))
      (hf (Fin.init p) (Fin.init a) fun i => ha i.castSucc))) _
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.init]
    ring

name: DG.hochschildCoboundaries_le_cocycles
statement:
theorem hochschildCoboundaries_le_cocycles (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    hochschildCoboundaries R A M k n ≤ hochschildCocycles R A M k n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact bot_le
  | succ n =>
    rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hochschildD_mem hf, hochschildDiff_hochschildDiff k f⟩

name: DG.mem_gradedCenter
statement:
theorem mem_gradedCenter {k : ℤ} {m : M} :
    m ∈ gradedCenter R A M k ↔ m ∈ grading k ∧
      ∀ (p : ℤ) (a : A), a ∈ grading p → op a • m = koszulSign (p * k) • (a • m)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.hochschildD_zero_apply
statement:
theorem hochschildD_zero_apply (k : ℤ) (f : HochschildCochain R A M 0) (a : Fin 1 → A) :
    hochschildD k 0 f a = DGAlgebra.twist R A k (a 0) • f 0 - op (a 0) • f 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hochschildD_apply, hochschildDiff_apply, Subsingleton.elim (Fin.tail a) 0,
    Subsingleton.elim (Fin.init a) 0, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, koszulSign_odd odd_one, Units.neg_smul, one_smul,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  rfl

name: DG.constOfIsEmpty_mem_hochschildCocycles_zero_iff
statement:
theorem constOfIsEmpty_mem_hochschildCocycles_zero_iff (k : ℤ) (m : M) :
    MultilinearMap.constOfIsEmpty R (fun _ : Fin 0 => A) m ∈ hochschildCocycles R A M k 0 ↔
      m ∈ gradedCenter R A M k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hdeg, hker⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using hdeg 0 0 fun i => i.elim0, fun p a ha => ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun g : HochschildCochain R A M 1 => g fun _ => a) hker
    simp only [hochschildD_zero_apply, _root_.zero_apply] at h
    change DGAlgebra.twist R A k a • m - op a • m = 0 at h
    rw [← sub_eq_zero.mp h, DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem k ha, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def,
      smul_assoc]
  · rintro ⟨hm, hc⟩
    refine ⟨fun p a _ => by simpa using hm, ?_⟩
    have key : ∀ x : A, DGAlgebra.twist R A k x • m = op x • m := by
      intro x
      induction x using induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, add_smul, hx, hy, op_add, add_smul]
      | h_homogeneous x =>
        rw [DGAlgebra.twist_of_mem k x.2, hc _ _ x.2, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def,
          smul_assoc]
    ext a
    rw [hochschildD_zero_apply, _root_.zero_apply]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (key (a 0))

name: DG.mem_gradedCenter_self_iff
statement:
theorem mem_gradedCenter_self_iff {k : ℤ} {z : A} :
    z ∈ gradedCenter R A A k ↔ z ∈ grading k ∧
      ∀ (p : ℤ) (a : A), a ∈ grading p → z * a = koszulSign (p * k) • (a * z)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.total_index
statement: private theorem total_index (N : ℤ) (n : ℕ) : N + 1 - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = N - n
proof:
:= by
  push_cast; ring

name: DG.hochschildTotalD_apply_zero
statement:
theorem hochschildTotalD_apply_zero (N : ℤ) (f : hochschildTotal R A M N) :
    (hochschildTotalD R A M N f).1 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.hochschildTotalD_apply_succ
statement:
theorem hochschildTotalD_apply_succ (N : ℤ) (f : hochschildTotal R A M N) (n : ℕ) :
    (hochschildTotalD R A M N f).1 (n + 1) = hochschildD (N - n) n (f.1 n)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.hochschildTotalD_hochschildTotalD
statement:
theorem hochschildTotalD_hochschildTotalD (N : ℤ) (f : hochschildTotal R A M N) :
    hochschildTotalD R A M (N + 1) (hochschildTotalD R A M N f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  funext n
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => exact map_zero (hochschildD (N + 1 - ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) 0)
    | succ n =>
      change hochschildD (N + 1 - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (n + 1)
        (hochschildD (N - n) n (f.1 n)) = 0
      rw [total_index]
      exact hochschildDiff_hochschildDiff _ _

name: DG.HochschildTotal.dHom_of
statement:
theorem dHom_of (N : ℤ) (f : HochschildTotalDeg R A M N) :
    dHom R A M (DirectSum.of _ N f) =
      DirectSum.of (fun N => HochschildTotalDeg R A M N) (N + 1) (hochschildTotalD R A M N f)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ _ _

name: DG.HochschildTotal.d_of
statement:
theorem d_of (N : ℤ) (f : HochschildTotalDeg R A M N) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun N => HochschildTotalDeg R A M N) N f : HochschildTotal R A M) =
      DirectSum.of (fun N => HochschildTotalDeg R A M N) (N + 1) (hochschildTotalD R A M N f)
proof:
:=
  dHom_of N f

name: DG.HochschildTotal.d_smul
statement: theorem d_smul (r : R) (x : HochschildTotal R A M) : d (r • x) = r • d x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [smul_zero, d_zero, smul_zero]
  | of N f =>
    have h : ∀ (K : ℤ) (g : HochschildTotalDeg R A M K),
        r • (DirectSum.of (fun N => HochschildTotalDeg R A M N) K g : HochschildTotal R A M) =
          DirectSum.of _ K (r • g) := fun K g => by
      rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, map_smul]
    rw [h, d_of, d_of, h]
    congr 1
    exact map_smul (hochschildTotalD R A M N) r f
  | add x y hx hy => rw [smul_add, d_add, hx, hy, d_add, smul_add]

name: DG.DGRingHom.apply_invOfBijective
statement: theorem apply_invOfBijective (x : S) : f (invOfBijective f hf x) = x
proof: := Function.surjInv_eq hf.2 x

name: DG.DGRingHom.invOfBijective_apply
statement: theorem invOfBijective_apply (a : R) : invOfBijective f hf (f a) = a
proof: := hf.1 (apply_invOfBijective f hf _)

name: DG.koszulSign_congr
statement: theorem koszulSign_congr {m n : ℤ} (h : (m : ZMod 2) = n) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub m n 2).mp h
  have hn : n = m + 2 * c := by push_cast at hc; omega
  rw [hn, koszulSign_add, koszulSign_even (n := 2 * c) ⟨c, by ring⟩, mul_one]

name: DG.Periodize.mk_zsmul
statement:
theorem mk_zsmul (n : ℤ) (z : ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    mk ℳ n (z • m) (zsmul_mem hm z) = z • mk ℳ n m hm
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (ofHom ℳ n) z ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.Periodize.mk_units_smul
statement:
theorem mk_units_smul (n : ℤ) (z : ℤˣ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    mk ℳ n (z • m) (by rw [Units.smul_def]; exact zsmul_mem hm _) = z • mk ℳ n m hm
proof:
:=
  (mk_congr rfl (Units.smul_def z m) _ (zsmul_mem hm _)).trans
    ((mk_zsmul n (z : ℤ) hm).trans (Units.smul_def z _).symm)

name: DG.Periodize.mk_eq_add
statement:
theorem mk_eq_add {n n₁ n₂ : ℤ} (h₁ : n₁ = n) (h₂ : n₂ = n) {m m₁ m₂ : M} (h : m = m₁ + m₂)
    (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) (hm₁ : m₁ ∈ ℳ n₁) (hm₂ : m₂ ∈ ℳ n₂) :
    mk ℳ n m hm = mk ℳ n₁ m₁ hm₁ + mk ℳ n₂ m₂ hm₂
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁ h₂ h; exact mk_add _ _ _

name: DG.Periodize.dHom_mk
statement:
theorem dHom_mk (hd : IsOddDifferential ℳ d) (n : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ n) :
    dHom ℳ hd (mk ℳ n m hm) =
      mk ℳ (n + 1) (d m) (by rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one]; exact hd.map_mem hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun n => ↥(periodicGrading ℳ n)) _ n ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.Periodize.dHom_dHom
statement:
theorem dHom_dHom (hd : IsOddDifferential ℳ d) (x : Periodize ℳ) :
    dHom ℳ hd (dHom ℳ hd x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk n m hm =>
    rw [dHom_mk, dHom_mk]
    exact (mk_congr rfl (hd.d_d m) _ (zero_mem _)).trans (mk_zero _)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.Periodize.dgRing
statement:
theorem dgRing (hd : IsZMod2DGRing 𝒜 d) :
    letI
proof:
:= dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 hd.toIsOddDifferential
    DGRing (Periodize 𝒜) :=
  letI := dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 hd.toIsOddDifferential
  { toGradedMonoid := inferInstanceAs (SetLike.GradedMonoid (periodizeGrading 𝒜))
    d_mul' := by
      intro n x hx y
      change dHom 𝒜 _ (x * y) = dHom 𝒜 _ x * y + koszulSign n • (x * dHom 𝒜 _ y)
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp hx
      induction y using induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | mk m b hb =>
        rw [mk_mul_mk, dHom_mk, dHom_mk, dHom_mk, mk_mul_mk, mk_mul_mk, ← mk_units_smul]
        exact mk_eq_add (by ring) (by ring) (hd.d_mul ha b) _ _ _
      | add y y' hy hy' =>
        rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, mul_add, mul_add, smul_add]
        abel }

name: DG.IsZMod2DGRing.d_one
statement: theorem IsZMod2DGRing.d_one (hA : IsZMod2DGRing ℬ dA) : dA 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA.d_mul (n := 0) (by simpa using SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem (A := ℬ)) 1
  rw [mul_one, one_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul] at h
  simpa using h

name: DG.even_of_cast_eq_zero
statement: theorem even_of_cast_eq_zero {k : ℤ} (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) : Even k
proof:
:=
  even_iff_two_dvd.mpr ((ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd k 2).mp hk)

name: DG.Periodize.dHom_evenOne
statement:
theorem dHom_evenOne (hA : IsZMod2DGRing ℬ dA) (k : ℤ) (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) :
    dHom ℬ hA.toIsOddDifferential (evenOne ℬ k hk) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenOne, dHom_mk]; exact (mk_congr rfl hA.d_one _ (zero_mem _)).trans (mk_zero _)

name: DG.IsPeriodicDGModule.dgModule
statement:
theorem dgModule (hN : IsPeriodicDGModule hA 𝒩 dN) [Decomposition 𝒩]
    [SetLike.GradedSMul (periodizeGrading ℬ) 𝒩] :
    letI
proof:
:= Periodize.dgAddCommGroup ℬ hA.toIsOddDifferential
    letI := hN.dgAddCommGroup
    DGModule (Periodize ℬ) N :=
  letI := Periodize.dgAddCommGroup ℬ hA.toIsOddDifferential
  letI := hN.dgAddCommGroup
  { toGradedSMul := inferInstanceAs (SetLike.GradedSMul (periodizeGrading ℬ) 𝒩)
    d_smul' := fun hp x => hN.d_smul hp x }

name: DG.IsPeriodicDGModule.of_dgModule
statement:
theorem of_dgModule [Decomposition 𝒩] (hd : ∀ {n : ℤ} {x : N}, x ∈ 𝒩 n → dN x ∈ 𝒩 (n + 1))
    (hdd : ∀ x, dN (dN x) = 0)
    (h : letI := Periodize.dgAddCommGroup ℬ hA.toIsOddDifferential
      letI : DGAddCommGroup N := ⟨𝒩, dN, hd, hdd⟩
      DGModule (Periodize ℬ) N) : IsPeriodicDGModule hA 𝒩 dN where
  map_mem
proof:
:= hd
  d_d := hdd
  d_smul := fun hp x => @DGModule.d_smul' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h _ _ hp x

name: DG.IsPeriodicDGModule.d_evenOne_smul
statement:
theorem d_evenOne_smul (hN : IsPeriodicDGModule hA 𝒩 dN) (k : ℤ) (hk : (k : ZMod 2) = 0) (x : N) :
    dN (Periodize.evenOne ℬ k hk • x) = Periodize.evenOne ℬ k hk • dN x
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Periodize.evenOne ℬ k hk ∈ periodizeGrading ℬ k := Periodize.mk_mem k _
  rw [hN.d_smul hp x, Periodize.dHom_evenOne hA, zero_smul, zero_add,
    koszulSign_even (even_of_cast_eq_zero hk), one_smul]

name: DG.Periodize.isPeriodicDGModule
statement:
theorem isPeriodicDGModule (hA : IsZMod2DGRing ℬ dA) (hM : IsZMod2DGModule ℬ dA ℳ dM) :
    IsPeriodicDGModule hA (periodizeGrading ℳ) (dHom ℳ hM.toIsOddDifferential) where
  map_mem
proof:
:= by
    intro n x hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp hx
    rw [dHom_mk]; exact mk_mem _ _
  d_d := dHom_dHom _
  d_smul := by
    intro n x hx y
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_periodizeGrading_iff.mp hx
    induction y using induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | mk m b hb =>
      rw [mk_smul_mk, dHom_mk, dHom_mk, dHom_mk, mk_smul_mk, mk_smul_mk, ← mk_units_smul]
      exact mk_eq_add (by ring) (by ring) (hM.d_smul ha b) _ _ _
    | add y y' hy hy' =>
      rw [smul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, smul_add, smul_add, smul_add]
      abel

name: DG.Periodize.dgModule
statement:
theorem dgModule (hA : IsZMod2DGRing ℬ dA) (hM : IsZMod2DGModule ℬ dA ℳ dM) :
    letI
proof:
:= dgAddCommGroup ℬ hA.toIsOddDifferential
    letI := dgAddCommGroup ℳ hM.toIsOddDifferential
    DGModule (Periodize ℬ) (Periodize ℳ) :=
  (isPeriodicDGModule hA hM).dgModule

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_zsmul
statement:
theorem mk_zsmul (q : ℤ) (z : ℤ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) :
    mk ℳ k r q (z • m) (zsmul_mem hm z) = z • mk ℳ k r q m hm
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (DirectSum.of (fun q => ↥(divGrading ℳ k r q)) q) z ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_units_smul
statement:
theorem mk_units_smul (q : ℤ) (z : ℤˣ) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) :
    mk ℳ k r q (z • m) (by rw [Units.smul_def]; exact zsmul_mem hm _) = z • mk ℳ k r q m hm
proof:
:=
  (mk_congr rfl (Units.smul_def z m) _ (zsmul_mem hm _)).trans
    ((mk_zsmul q (z : ℤ) hm).trans (Units.smul_def z _).symm)

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mk_eq_add
statement:
theorem mk_eq_add {q q₁ q₂ : ℤ} (h₁ : q₁ = q) (h₂ : q₂ = q) {m m₁ m₂ : M} (h : m = m₁ + m₂)
    (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) (hm₁ : m₁ ∈ ℳ (q₁ * k + r)) (hm₂ : m₂ ∈ ℳ (q₂ * k + r)) :
    mk ℳ k r q m hm = mk ℳ k r q₁ m₁ hm₁ + mk ℳ k r q₂ m₂ hm₂
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁ h₂ h; exact mk_add _ _ _

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.map_mem_succ
statement:
theorem map_mem_succ (hd : IsDifferentialOfDegree ℳ k d) {q : ℤ} {m : M} (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) :
    d m ∈ ℳ ((q + 1) * k + r)
proof:
:= by
  have := hd.map_mem hm
  rwa [show q * k + r + k = (q + 1) * k + r by ring] at this

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.dHom_mk
statement:
theorem dHom_mk (hd : IsDifferentialOfDegree ℳ k d) (q : ℤ) (m : M) (hm : m ∈ ℳ (q * k + r)) :
    dHom ℳ k r hd (mk ℳ k r q m hm) = mk ℳ k r (q + 1) (d m) (map_mem_succ hd hm)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (β := fun q => ↥(divGrading ℳ k r q)) _ q ⟨m, hm⟩

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.dHom_dHom
statement:
theorem dHom_dHom (hd : IsDifferentialOfDegree ℳ k d) (x : RegradeByDivision ℳ k r) :
    dHom ℳ k r hd (dHom ℳ k r hd x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk q m hm =>
    rw [dHom_mk, dHom_mk]
    exact (mk_congr rfl (hd.d_d m) _ (zero_mem _)).trans (mk_zero _)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: DG.residueEquiv_d
statement:
theorem residueEquiv_d (hd : IsDifferentialOfDegree ℳ k d) (m : M) :
    residueEquiv ℳ k (d m) =
      DirectSum.map (fun r : ZMod k => RegradeByDivision.dHom ℳ k (r.val : ℤ) hd)
        (residueEquiv ℳ k m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Decomposition.inductionOn ℳ with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous m =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
    rename_i n
    rw [residueEquiv_of_mem ℳ k (hd.map_mem hm), residueEquiv_of_mem ℳ k hm, DirectSum.map_of,
      RegradeByDivision.dHom_mk]
    have hk : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne k)
    exact of_mk_congr (by rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero])
      (by rw [show n + (k : ℤ) = n + 1 * k by ring, Int.add_mul_ediv_right _ _ hk])
      _ _
  | add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, map_add, hm, hm', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.mem_of_mem_mul_add_zero
statement: theorem mem_of_mem_mul_add_zero {q : ℤ} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (q * k + 0)) : a ∈ 𝒜 (q * k)
proof:
:= by
  rwa [add_zero] at ha

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.dgRing
statement:
theorem dgRing (hd : IsDivDGRing 𝒜 k d) :
    letI
proof:
:= dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 k 0 hd.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
    DGRing (RegradeByDivision 𝒜 k 0) :=
  letI := dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 k 0 hd.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
  { toGradedMonoid := inferInstanceAs (SetLike.GradedMonoid (regradeGrading 𝒜 k 0))
    d_mul' := by
      intro q x hx y
      change dHom 𝒜 k 0 _ (x * y) = dHom 𝒜 k 0 _ x * y + koszulSign q • (x * dHom 𝒜 k 0 _ y)
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_regradeGrading_iff.mp hx
      induction y using induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | mk p b hb =>
        rw [mk_mul_mk, dHom_mk, dHom_mk, dHom_mk, mk_mul_mk, mk_mul_mk, ← mk_units_smul]
        exact mk_eq_add (by ring) (by ring) (hd.d_mul (mem_of_mem_mul_add_zero ha) b) _ _ _
      | add y y' hy hy' =>
        rw [mul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, mul_add, mul_add, smul_add]
        abel }

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.dgModule
statement:
theorem dgModule (hA : IsDivDGRing 𝒜 k dA) (hM : IsDivDGModule 𝒜 k dA ℳ dM) (r : ℤ) :
    letI
proof:
:= dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 k 0 hA.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
    letI := dgAddCommGroup ℳ k r hM.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
    DGModule (RegradeByDivision 𝒜 k 0) (RegradeByDivision ℳ k r) :=
  letI := dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 k 0 hA.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
  letI := dgAddCommGroup ℳ k r hM.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
  { toGradedSMul := inferInstanceAs
      (SetLike.GradedSMul (regradeGrading 𝒜 k 0) (regradeGrading ℳ k r))
    d_smul' := by
      intro q x hx y
      change dHom ℳ k r _ (x • y) = dHom 𝒜 k 0 _ x • y + koszulSign q • (x • dHom ℳ k r _ y)
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_regradeGrading_iff.mp hx
      induction y using induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | mk p m hm =>
        rw [mk_smul_mk, dHom_mk, dHom_mk, dHom_mk, mk_smul_mk, mk_smul_mk, ← mk_units_smul]
        exact mk_eq_add (by ring) (by ring) (hM.d_smul (mem_of_mem_mul_add_zero ha) m) _ _ _
      | add y y' hy hy' =>
        rw [smul_add, map_add, hy, hy', map_add, smul_add, smul_add, smul_add]
        abel }

name: DG.DGRingHom.decompose_apply

proof:
:= by

name: DG.DGRingHom.map_cocycles

proof:
:= by

name: DG.DGRingHom.map_coboundaries

name: DG.DGModule.compHom
statement:
theorem DGModule.compHom (φ : A →ᵈᵍ+* B) (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M]
    [Module B M] [DGModule B M] :
    letI
proof:
:= Module.compHom M φ.toRingHom
    DGModule A M :=
  letI := Module.compHom M φ.toRingHom
  { smul_mem := fun _ _ _ _ ha hm => smul_mem_grading (A := B) (φ.map_mem ha) hm
    d_smul' := fun ha m => by
      change d (φ _ • m) = φ (d _) • m + _ • (φ _ • d m)
      rw [DGRingHom.map_d, d_smul (φ.map_mem ha)] }

name: DG.RestrictScalars.addEquiv_apply

proof: := rfl

proof: := rfl

statement:
theorem smul_def (a : A) (m : RestrictScalars φ M) :
    a • m = (addEquiv φ).symm (φ a • addEquiv φ m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.IsRegradedDGModule.dgModule
statement:
theorem dgModule (hN : IsRegradedDGModule hA 𝒩 dN) [Decomposition 𝒩]
    [SetLike.GradedSMul (regradeGrading 𝒜 k 0) 𝒩] :
    letI
proof:
:= RegradeByDivision.dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 k 0 hA.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
    letI := hN.dgAddCommGroup
    DGModule (RegradeByDivision 𝒜 k 0) N :=
  letI := RegradeByDivision.dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 k 0 hA.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
  letI := hN.dgAddCommGroup
  { toGradedSMul := inferInstanceAs (SetLike.GradedSMul (regradeGrading 𝒜 k 0) 𝒩)
    d_smul' := fun hb x => hN.d_smul hb x }

name: DG.IsRegradedDGModule.of_dgModule
statement:
theorem of_dgModule [Decomposition 𝒩] (hd : ∀ {n : ℤ} {x : N}, x ∈ 𝒩 n → dN x ∈ 𝒩 (n + 1))
    (hdd : ∀ x, dN (dN x) = 0)
    (h : letI := RegradeByDivision.dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 k 0 hA.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
      letI : DGAddCommGroup N := ⟨𝒩, dN, hd, hdd⟩
      DGModule (RegradeByDivision 𝒜 k 0) N) : IsRegradedDGModule hA 𝒩 dN where
  map_mem
proof:
:= hd
  d_d := hdd
  d_smul := fun hb x => @DGModule.d_smul' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h _ _ hb x

name: DG.RegradeByDivision.isRegradedDGModule
statement:
theorem RegradeByDivision.isRegradedDGModule (hA : IsDivDGRing 𝒜 k dA)
    (hM : IsDivDGModule 𝒜 k dA ℳ dM) (r : ℤ) :
    IsRegradedDGModule hA (regradeGrading ℳ k r)
      (RegradeByDivision.dHom ℳ k r hM.toIsDifferentialOfDegree) where
  map_mem
proof:
:= by
    intro q x hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := RegradeByDivision.mem_regradeGrading_iff.mp hx
    rw [RegradeByDivision.dHom_mk]; exact RegradeByDivision.mk_mem _ _
  d_d := RegradeByDivision.dHom_dHom _
  d_smul := fun hb x =>
    @DGModule.d_smul' _ _ _ (RegradeByDivision.dgAddCommGroup 𝒜 k 0 hA.toIsDifferentialOfDegree) _
      (RegradeByDivision.dgAddCommGroup ℳ k r hM.toIsDifferentialOfDegree) _
      (RegradeByDivision.dgModule hA hM r) _ _ hb x

name: DG.regradeRingHom_d
statement:
theorem regradeRingHom_d (hd : IsDifferentialOfDegree 𝒜 (k : ℤ) dA) (a : A) :
    regradeRingHom 𝒜 k (dA a) =
      RegradeByDivision.dHom 𝒜 (k : ℤ) 0 hd (regradeRingHom 𝒜 k a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Decomposition.inductionOn 𝒜 with
  | zero => simp
  | homogeneous a =>
    have ha := IsConcentratedInMultiples.mem_ediv k a.2
    rw [regradeRingHom_of_mem ha, RegradeByDivision.dHom_mk,
      regradeRingHom_of_mem (RegradeByDivision.map_mem_succ hd ha)]
  | add a a' ha ha' => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, ha', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.regradeMapAddHom_d
statement:
theorem regradeMapAddHom_d (r : ZMod k) {X Y : DivDGModuleCat.{v} 𝒜 k dA} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (x : RegradeByDivision X.obj.grading (k : ℤ) (r.val : ℤ)) :
    regradeMapAddHom r f.hom
        (RegradeByDivision.dHom _ _ _ X.prop.toIsDifferentialOfDegree x) =
      RegradeByDivision.dHom _ _ _ Y.prop.toIsDifferentialOfDegree
        (regradeMapAddHom r f.hom x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using RegradeByDivision.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | mk q m hm =>
    rw [RegradeByDivision.dHom_mk, regradeMapAddHom_mk, regradeMapAddHom_mk,
      RegradeByDivision.dHom_mk]
    exact RegradeByDivision.mk_congr rfl (f.comm m) _ _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unregradeD_apply
statement:
theorem unregradeD_apply (x : ⨁ r : ZMod k, ((N r).obj : Type v)) (r : ZMod k) :
    unregradeD N x r = (N r).d (x r)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_apply _ _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.unregradeD_of
statement:
theorem unregradeD_of (r : ZMod k) (y : (N r).obj) :
    unregradeD N (DirectSum.of (fun r => ((N r).obj : Type v)) r y) =
      DirectSum.of (fun r => ((N r).obj : Type v)) r ((N r).d y)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.units_smul_apply
statement:
theorem units_smul_apply (u : ℤˣ) (x : ⨁ r : ZMod k, ((N r).obj : Type v)) (r : ZMod k) :
    (u • x) r = u • x r
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with rfl | rfl
  · rw [one_smul, one_smul]
  · rw [Units.neg_smul, Units.neg_smul, one_smul, one_smul]; rfl

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.isDivDGModule_unregrade
statement:
theorem isDivDGModule_unregrade :
    IsDivDGModule 𝒜 (k : ℤ) dA (unregradeGrading fun r => (N r).obj) (unregradeD N) where
  map_mem
proof:
:= by
    rintro n _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hk : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne k)
    have h : unregradeD N (DirectSum.of (fun r => ((N r).obj : Type v)) (n : ZMod k) y) ∈
        unregradeGrading (fun r => (N r).obj) (n + k) := by
      rw [unregradeD_of]
      exact of_mem_unregradeGrading (fun r => (N r).obj)
        (by rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero])
        (by rw [show n + (k : ℤ) = n + 1 * k by ring, Int.add_mul_ediv_right _ _ hk])
        ((N _).prop.map_mem hy)
    exact h
  d_d := fun x => DirectSum.ext fun r => by
    rw [unregradeD_apply, unregradeD_apply, (N r).prop.d_d, DirectSum.zero_apply]
  d_smul := by
    intro q a ha x
    have ha' : a ∈ 𝒜 (q * (k : ℤ) + 0) := by rwa [add_zero]
    refine DirectSum.ext fun r => ?_
    rw [DirectSum.add_apply, units_smul_apply, unregradeD_apply, unregrade_smul_def,
      unregrade_smul_def, unregrade_smul_def, DirectSum.smul_apply, DirectSum.smul_apply,
      DirectSum.smul_apply, unregradeD_apply,
      regradeRingHom_d hA.toIsDifferentialOfDegree, regradeRingHom_of_mem ha']
    exact (N r).prop.d_smul (RegradeByDivision.mk_mem q ha') (x r)

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.regradeUnit_d
statement:
theorem regradeUnit_d (X : DivDGModuleCat.{v} 𝒜 k dA) (m : X.obj) :
    (regradeUnitIsoApp X.obj).hom.hom (X.d m) =
      unregradeD (fun r => (regradeDGFunctor hA r).obj X) ((regradeUnitIsoApp X.obj).hom.hom m)
proof:
:=
  residueEquiv_d X.obj.grading k X.prop.toIsDifferentialOfDegree m

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitAddHom_dHom_mk
statement:
theorem counitAddHom_dHom_mk (N : ZMod k → RegradedDGModuleCat.{v} 𝒜 k hA) (r : ZMod k)
    (hd : IsDifferentialOfDegree (unregradeGrading fun r => (N r).obj) (k : ℤ) (unregradeD N))
    {q : ℤ} {x : ⨁ r : ZMod k, ((N r).obj : Type v)}
    (hx : x ∈ unregradeGrading (fun r => (N r).obj) (q * k + (r.val : ℤ))) :
    counitAddHom (fun r => (N r).obj) r
        (RegradeByDivision.dHom _ _ _ hd (RegradeByDivision.mk _ _ _ q x hx)) =
      (N r).d (counitAddHom (fun r => (N r).obj) r (RegradeByDivision.mk _ _ _ q x hx))
proof:
:= by
  rw [RegradeByDivision.dHom_mk, counitAddHom_mk, counitAddHom_mk, unregradeD_apply]

name: DG.GradedModuleCat.counitAddHom_d
statement:
theorem counitAddHom_d (N : ZMod k → RegradedDGModuleCat.{v} 𝒜 k hA) (r : ZMod k)
    (z : RegradeByDivision (unregradeGrading fun r => (N r).obj) (k : ℤ) (r.val : ℤ)) :
    counitAddHom (fun r => (N r).obj) r
        (RegradeByDivision.dHom _ _ _ (isDivDGModule_unregrade N).toIsDifferentialOfDegree z) =
      (N r).d (counitAddHom (fun r => (N r).obj) r z)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (isDivDGModule_unregrade (dA := dA) N).toIsDifferentialOfDegree
  have key : (counitAddHom (fun r => (N r).obj) r).comp (RegradeByDivision.dHom _ _ _ hd) =
      (N r).d.comp (counitAddHom (fun r => (N r).obj) r) :=
    DirectSum.addHom_ext fun _ x => counitAddHom_dHom_mk hA N r hd x.2
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key z

name: DG.CatModule.precompCompIso_hom_app_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompCompIso_hom_app_app (M : CatModule.{w} E) (X : C)
    (m : ((precomp (F ⋙ G)).obj M).obj X) : ((precompCompIso F G).hom.app M).app X m = m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.precompNatTrans_comp
statement:
theorem precompNatTrans_comp (α : F ⟶ F') (β : F' ⟶ F'') (hα : ∀ X, α.app X ∈ grading 0)
    (hdα : ∀ X, d (α.app X) = 0) (hβ : ∀ X, β.app X ∈ grading 0)
    (hdβ : ∀ X, d (β.app X) = 0) (hαβ : ∀ X, (α ≫ β).app X ∈ grading 0)
    (hdαβ : ∀ X, d ((α ≫ β).app X) = 0) :
    precompNatTrans.{w} (α ≫ β) hαβ hdαβ = precompNatTrans α hα hdα ≫ precompNatTrans β hβ hdβ
proof:
:= by
  ext M : 2
  exact hom_ext fun X m => comp_smul (α.app X) (β.app X) m

name: DG.CatModule.precompNatTrans_id
statement:
theorem precompNatTrans_id (h : ∀ X, (𝟙 F : F ⟶ F).app X ∈ grading 0)
    (hd : ∀ X, d ((𝟙 F : F ⟶ F).app X) = 0) :
    precompNatTrans.{w} (𝟙 F) h hd = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  ext M : 2
  exact hom_ext fun X m => id_smul (M := M) m

name: DG.DGBimodule.catBimodule_ract

name: DG.DerivedCategory.isCompact_obj_of_isCompact_self
statement:
theorem DerivedCategory.isCompact_obj_of_isCompact_self (F : DG.DerivedCategory.{v, v} B ⥤ T)
    [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (hF : IsCompact.{v} (F.obj (DG.DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of B B))))
    {X : DG.DerivedCategory.{v, v} B} (hX : IsCompact.{v} X) : IsCompact.{v} (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DG.DerivedCategory.thickClosure_self_eq_isCompact] at hX
  have hP : IsThick (fun Y : DG.DerivedCategory.{v, v} B => IsCompact.{v} (F.obj Y)) :=
    { zero := IsCompact.of_isZero (F.map_isZero (isZero_zero _))
      shift := fun Y n hY => (hY.shift n).of_iso ((F.commShiftIso n).app Y)
      ext₂ := fun R hR h₁ h₃ => IsCompact.ext₂ _ (F.map_distinguished R hR) h₁ h₃
      retract := fun e hY => hY.of_retract (e.map F) }
  refine thickClosure_le hP ?_ X hX
  rintro _ ⟨-, rfl⟩
  exact hF

name: DG.DGBimodule.isCompact_derivedTensor_obj
statement:
theorem isCompact_derivedTensor_obj
    (hc : IsCompact.{v} (DG.DerivedCategory.Q.obj (DGModuleCat.of A M)))
    {X : DG.DerivedCategory.{v, v} B} (hX : IsCompact.{v} X) :
    IsCompact.{v} ((derivedTensor.{w₁, w₂, v, w₄} A B M hM).obj X)
proof:
:=
  DerivedCategory.isCompact_obj_of_isCompact_self _
    (hc.of_iso (derivedTensorSelfIso A B M hM)) hX

name: DG.CatModule.isAcyclic_of_isAcyclic_precomp_of_isShiftDense
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_of_isAcyclic_precomp_of_isShiftDense (hF : IsShiftDense F)
    {N : CatModule.{w} D} (h : IsAcyclic ((precomp F).obj N)) : IsAcyclic N
proof:
:= by
  intro Y
  obtain ⟨X, n, a, b, ha, hb, hab⟩ := hF Y
  refine DG.isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun k y hy hdy => ?_
  have hday : d (a • y) = 0 := by
    rw [d_smul ha.1, ha.2, hdy]
    simp
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ : ∃ z : N.obj (F.obj X), z ∈ grading (n + k - 1) ∧ d z = a • y :=
    DG.isAcyclic_iff.mp (h X) (n + k) (a • y) (smul_mem_grading ha.1 hy) hday
  refine ⟨koszulSign n • (b • z), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Units.smul_def]
    refine zsmul_mem ?_ _
    have := smul_mem_grading hb.1 hz
    rwa [show -n + (n + k - 1) = k - 1 by ring] at this
  · rw [d_units_smul, d_smul hb.1, hb.2, zero_smul, zero_add, hdz, ← comp_smul, hab, id_smul,
      smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, add_neg_cancel, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.mapEquivOfReflects_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapEquivOfReflects_apply (hF : IsQuasiFullyFaithful F)

proof:
:=

name: DG.DGCategory.K0.mapEquivOfIsShiftDense_apply

@[simp]
theorem mapEquivOfIsShiftDense_apply (hF : IsQuasiFullyFaithful F) (hD : IsShiftDense F)
    (x : K0.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C) :
