name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.precomp
statement:
theorem Homotopic.precomp {M N : CatModule.{w} D} {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : Homotopic f g) :
    Homotopic ((CatModule.precomp F).map f) ((CatModule.precomp F).map g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.precomp F⟩

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_zero_iff_homEquiv
statement:
theorem homotopic_zero_iff_homEquiv {M : CatModule.{w} C} {N : CatModule.{w} D}
    (g : L.obj M ⟶ N) : Homotopic g 0 ↔ Homotopic (adj.homEquiv M N g) 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    rw [adj.homEquiv_unit]
    refine (Homotopic.comp_left (hg.precomp (F := F)) _).trans (Homotopic.of_eq ?_)
    rw [Functor.map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := (homotopic_zero_iff_exists_lift _).mp h
    rw [homotopic_zero_iff_exists_lift]
    refine ⟨(adj.homEquiv M (pathObj N)).symm (H ≫ (pathObj.precompIso F N).hom), ?_⟩
    apply (adj.homEquiv M N).injective
    rw [adj.homEquiv_naturality_right, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Category.assoc,
      pathObj.precompIso_hom_π, hH]

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_iff_homEquiv
proof:
:= by
  have e : adj.homEquiv M N (g - g') = adj.homEquiv M N g - adj.homEquiv M N g' := by
    simp only [adj.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_sub, Preadditive.comp_sub]
  rw [Homotopic.iff_sub, homotopic_zero_iff_homEquiv adj, e, ← Homotopic.iff_sub]

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_map_of_homotopic
statement:
theorem homotopic_map_of_homotopic {M M' : CatModule.{w} C} {f f' : M ⟶ M'}
    (h : Homotopic f f') : Homotopic (L.map f) (L.map f')
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopic_iff_homEquiv adj, adj.homEquiv_unit, adj.homEquiv_unit, ← Functor.comp_map,
    ← Functor.comp_map, ← adj.unit.naturality, ← adj.unit.naturality]
  exact h.comp_right _

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.of_adjunction
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_adjunction {P : CatModule.{w} C} (hP : IsKProjective P) :
    IsKProjective (L.obj P)
proof:
:= fun _ hN g =>
  (homotopic_zero_iff_homEquiv adj g).mpr (hP _ (hN.precomp F) _)

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.unitMap_comp_restrict_map
statement:
theorem unitMap_comp_restrict_map (P : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C)
    {N : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D} (g : (CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).obj P ⟶ N) :
    unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map (Q.map g) =
      Q.map ((CatModule.inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F).homEquiv P N g) ≫
        (QCompRestrictIso F).inv.app N
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitMap, Category.assoc, ← Functor.comp_map, ← (QCompRestrictIso F).inv.naturality,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.bijective_unitMap_comp
statement:
theorem bijective_unitMap_comp (P : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C) (hP : IsKProjective P)
    (Y : DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D) :
    Function.Bijective fun g : Q.obj ((CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).obj P) ⟶ Y =>
      unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map g
proof:
:= by
  have hLP : IsKProjective ((CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).obj P) :=
    hP.of_adjunction (CatModule.inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F)
  
  obtain ⟨Z, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    (Localization.essSurj (Qh (C := D)) (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso D)).mem_essImage Y
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective Z
  have key : Function.Bijective
      fun g : Q.obj ((CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).obj P) ⟶ Q.obj N =>
        unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map g := by
    have hQ := fun {M : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C} (hM : IsKProjective M)
        (M' : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C) =>
      ((Qh_map_bijective_of_isKProjective hM ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C).obj M')))
    have hQD := (Qh_map_bijective_of_isKProjective hLP ((HomotopyCategory.quotient D).obj N))
    constructor
    · intro a b hab
      obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := hQD.2 a
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient D).map_surjective a'
      obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hQD.2 b
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient D).map_surjective b'
      change unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map (Q.map a) =
        unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map (Q.map b) at hab
      rw [unitMap_comp_restrict_map, unitMap_comp_restrict_map, cancel_mono] at hab
      have h := (hQ hP _).1 hab
      rw [HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_eq_iff,
        ← homotopic_iff_homEquiv (CatModule.inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F),
        ← HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_eq_iff] at h
      change Qh.map _ = Qh.map _
      rw [h]
    · intro c
      obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := (hQ hP ((precomp F).obj N)).2 (c ≫ (QCompRestrictIso F).hom.app N)
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient C).map_surjective k'
      refine ⟨Q.map (((CatModule.inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F).homEquiv P N).symm k), ?_⟩
      beta_reduce
      rw [unitMap_comp_restrict_map, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      change Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C).map k) ≫ _ = c
      rw [hk', Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
      exact Category.comp_id c
  
  have h1 : (fun g : Q.obj ((CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).obj P) ⟶ Y =>
        unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map g) =
      (fun c => c ≫ (restrict F).map e.hom) ∘
        (fun g : Q.obj ((CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).obj P) ⟶ Q.obj N =>
          unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map g) ∘ (fun g => g ≫ e.inv) := by
    ext g
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  rw [h1]
  refine Function.Bijective.comp ?_ (key.comp ?_)
  · refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
      ⟨fun c => c ≫ (restrict F).map e.inv, fun c => ?_, fun c => ?_⟩ <;>
    simp [← Functor.map_comp]
  · exact Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
      ⟨fun c => c ≫ e.hom, fun c => by simp, fun c => by simp⟩

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.inductionHomEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem inductionHomEquiv_apply (X : DerivedCategory.{w₁, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C)
    (Y : DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D)
    (g : Q.obj ((CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).obj (kProjRep.{w₁, max v₂ w, v₁, u₁} X)) ⟶ Y) :
    inductionHomEquiv F X Y g = (kProjRepIso.{w₁, max v₂ w, v₁, u₁} X).hom ≫
      unitMap F (kProjRep.{w₁, max v₂ w, v₁, u₁} X) ≫ (restrict F).map g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inductionHomEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply, Iso.homCongr_symm, Iso.homCongr_apply,
    Equiv.ofBijective_apply, Iso.symm_inv, Iso.refl_symm, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.unitMap_comp_inductionObjIsoHom
statement:
theorem unitMap_comp_inductionObjIsoHom :
    unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map (inductionObjIsoHom F hP) =
      (inductionAdjunction F).unit.app (Q.obj P : DerivedCategory.{w₁, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C)
proof:
:=
  (unitMapEquiv F hP _).apply_symm_apply _

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.unit_comp_inductionObjIsoInv
statement:
theorem unit_comp_inductionObjIsoInv :
    (inductionAdjunction F).unit.app (Q.obj P : DerivedCategory.{w₁, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C) ≫
      (restrict F).map (inductionObjIsoInv F P) = unitMap F P
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((inductionAdjunction F).homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply (unitMap F P)
  rwa [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at h

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.inductionObjIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inductionObjIso_hom : (inductionObjIso F hP).hom = inductionObjIsoHom F hP
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.isAcyclic_hom_of_isContractible
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_hom_of_isContractible {M : CatModule C} (hM : CatModule.IsContractible M)
    (N : CatModule C) : DG.IsAcyclic (CatModule.HOM M N)
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.isAcyclic_hom_iff.mpr fun n m hmn z hz => ?_
  have hz' : CatModule.δ 0 1 (z.rightShift n 0 (zero_add n)) = 0 := by
    rw [CatModule.Cochain.δ_rightShift z n 0 1 (zero_add n) (n + 1) (add_comm 1 n), hz,
      CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_zero, _root_.smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := CatModule.homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp
    (hM.homotopic_zero_of_left
      (CatModule.Cocycle.homOf (CatModule.Cocycle.mk _ 1 (zero_add 1) hz')))
  refine ⟨koszulSign n • h.rightUnshift m (by omega), ?_⟩
  rw [CatModule.δ_units_smul, CatModule.Cochain.δ_rightUnshift h m (by omega) n 0 (zero_add n), smul_smul,
    Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, ← hh, CatModule.Cocycle.cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe,
    CatModule.Cocycle.mk_coe, CatModule.Cochain.rightUnshift_rightShift]

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.rhom_isZero_obj
statement:
theorem rhom_isZero_obj (hc : ∀ Y, CatModule.IsContractible (B.left Y))
    (W : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} D) :
    IsZero ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.rhom B hB).obj W)
proof:
:= by
  have := Localization.essSurj (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q (C := D)) (CatModule.quasiIso D)
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.rhom B hB).mapIso
    (CatModule.DerivedCategory.Q.objObjPreimageIso W).symm)
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.QCompRhomIso B hB).app _)
  exact (CatModule.DerivedCategory.isZero_Q_obj_iff _).mpr fun Y =>
    CatModule.isAcyclic_hom_of_isContractible (hc Y) _

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.derivedTensor_isZero_obj
statement:
theorem derivedTensor_isZero_obj (hc : ∀ Y, CatModule.IsContractible (B.left Y))
    (X : CatModule.DerivedCategory.{w₁, max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} C) :
    IsZero ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.derivedTensor.{w₁, w₂} B hB).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply ((CatModule.DerivedCategory.derivedTensorAdjunction B hB).homEquiv _ _).injective
  exact (rhom_isZero_obj B hB hc _).eq_of_tgt _ _

name: DG.DGBimodule.derivedTensor_isZero_obj
statement:
theorem derivedTensor_isZero_obj (hac : DG.IsAcyclic M) (Y : DG.DerivedCategory.{w₃, v} B) :
    IsZero ((derivedTensor.{w₁, w₂, w₃, w₄} A B M hM).obj Y)
proof:
:=
  (CatModule.DerivedCategory.singleObjEquivalence A).functor.map_isZero
    (CatModule.DerivedCategory.derivedTensor_isZero_obj _ (catBimodule_left_isKProjective A B M hM)
      (fun Y => catBimodule_left_isKProjective A B M hM Y _ (fun _ => hac) (𝟙 _)) _)

name: DG.DGRingHom.singleObjFunctor_comp
statement:
theorem singleObjFunctor_comp (φ : C →ᵈᵍ+* B) (ψ : B →ᵈᵍ+* A) :
    (ψ.comp φ).singleObjFunctor = φ.singleObjFunctor ⋙ ψ.singleObjFunctor
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.unitMap_naturality
statement:
theorem unitMap_naturality {P P' : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C} (g : P ⟶ P') :
    unitMap F P ≫ (restrict F).map (Q.map ((CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).map g)) =
      Q.map g ≫ unitMap F P'
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitMap_comp_restrict_map, unitMap, ← Category.assoc, ← Q.map_comp]
  congr 2
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  exact ((CatModule.inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F).unit.naturality g).symm

name: DG.CatModule.DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.inductionObjIso_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem inductionObjIso_hom_naturality {P P' : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C}
    (hP : IsKProjective P) (hP' : IsKProjective P') (g : P ⟶ P') :
    Q.map ((CatModule.induction.{max v₁ w} F).map g) ≫ (inductionObjIso F hP').hom =
      (inductionObjIso F hP).hom ≫ (induction.{w₁, w₂, w} F).map (Q.map g)
proof:
:= by
  apply (unitMapEquiv F hP _).injective
  simp only [unitMapEquiv, Equiv.ofBijective_apply, Functor.map_comp, inductionObjIso_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc, unitMap_naturality, Category.assoc, unitMap_comp_inductionObjIsoHom,
    ← Category.assoc, unitMap_comp_inductionObjIsoHom]
  exact (inductionAdjunction F).unit.naturality (Q.map g)

name: DG.CatBimodule.ofFunctor_left
statement: theorem ofFunctor_left (Y : C) : (ofFunctor F).left Y = CatModule.representable (F.obj Y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.isKProjective_ofFunctor_left
statement: theorem isKProjective_ofFunctor_left (Y : C) : CatModule.IsKProjective ((ofFunctor F).left Y)
proof:
:=
  CatModule.isKProjective_representable (F.obj Y)

name: DG.CatBimodule.ractCochain_ofFunctor_app_id
statement:
theorem ractCochain_ofFunctor_app_id {Y Y' : C} {i : ℤ} {f : Y ⟶ Y'} (hf : f ∈ grading i) :
    ((ofFunctor F).ractCochain f hf).app (F.obj Y') (𝟙 (F.obj Y')) = F.map f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ractCochain_app_of_mem hf (id_mem_grading (F.obj Y')), mul_zero, koszulSign_zero,
    one_smul]
  exact Category.comp_id (F.map f)

name: DG.CatBimodule.yonedaHOM_ofFunctor_of
statement:
theorem yonedaHOM_ofFunctor_of {Y : C} {n : ℤ}
    (z : CatModule.Cochain ((ofFunctor F).left Y) N n) :
    CatModule.yonedaHOM (F.obj Y) N
        (DirectSum.of (fun n => CatModule.Cochain ((ofFunctor F).left Y) N n) n z) =
      z.app (F.obj Y) (𝟙 (F.obj Y))
proof:
:=
  CatModule.yonedaHOM_of z

name: DG.CatBimodule.yonedaHOM_homAct
statement:
theorem yonedaHOM_homAct {Y Y' : C} (f : Y ⟶ Y') (w : HOM ((ofFunctor F).left Y) N) :
    CatModule.yonedaHOM (F.obj Y') N ((ofFunctor F).homAct N f w) =
      F.map f • CatModule.yonedaHOM (F.obj Y) N w
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [CatModule.zero_smul]
  | h_add f g hf hg =>
    rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, map_add, hf, hg, F.map_add, CatModule.add_smul]
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    rw [homAct_of_mem f.2]
    induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp [CatModule.smul_zero]
    | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw', map_add, CatModule.smul_add]
    | of n z =>
      rw [HOM.precompCochain_of, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def,
        yonedaHOM_ofFunctor_of, yonedaHOM_ofFunctor_of, CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply,
        ractCochain_ofFunctor_app_id f.2]
      have h := z.map_smul (F.map_mem_grading f.2)
        (𝟙 (F.obj Y) : (CatModule.representable (F.obj Y)).obj _)
      change z.app (F.obj Y') (𝟙 (F.obj Y) ≫ F.map (f : Y ⟶ Y')) = _ at h
      rw [Category.id_comp] at h
      rw [h, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, show i * n + n * i = 2 * (i * n) by ring,
        koszulSign_even (even_two_mul _), one_smul]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homObjOfFunctorIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem homObjOfFunctorIso_hom_app (Y : C) (w : ((ofFunctor F).homObj N).obj Y) :
    ((homObjOfFunctorIso F N).hom.app Y) w = CatModule.yonedaHOM (F.obj Y) N w
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_zero_iff_homEquiv_of_pathObj
statement:
theorem homotopic_zero_iff_homEquiv_of_pathObj {M : CatModule.{w} C} {N : CatModule.{w} D}
    (g : L.obj M ⟶ N) : Homotopic g 0 ↔ Homotopic (adj.homEquiv M N g) 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    rw [adj.homEquiv_unit]
    refine (Homotopic.comp_left (hG hg) _).trans (Homotopic.of_eq ?_)
    rw [Functor.map_zero, Limits.comp_zero]
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := (homotopic_zero_iff_exists_lift _).mp h
    rw [homotopic_zero_iff_exists_lift]
    refine ⟨(adj.homEquiv M (pathObj N)).symm (H ≫ θ N), ?_⟩
    apply (adj.homEquiv M N).injective
    rw [adj.homEquiv_naturality_right, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Category.assoc, hθ, hH]

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_iff_homEquiv_of_pathObj
proof:
:= by
  have e : adj.homEquiv M N (g - g') = adj.homEquiv M N g - adj.homEquiv M N g' := by
    simp only [adj.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_sub, Preadditive.comp_sub]
  rw [Homotopic.iff_sub, homotopic_zero_iff_homEquiv_of_pathObj adj hG θ hθ, e,
    ← Homotopic.iff_sub]

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_map_of_pathObj
statement:
theorem homotopic_map_of_pathObj {M M' : CatModule.{w} C} {f f' : M ⟶ M'}
    (h : Homotopic f f') : Homotopic (L.map f) (L.map f')
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopic_iff_homEquiv_of_pathObj adj hG θ hθ, adj.homEquiv_unit, adj.homEquiv_unit,
    ← Functor.comp_map, ← Functor.comp_map, ← adj.unit.naturality, ← adj.unit.naturality]
  exact h.comp_right _

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.of_adjunction_of_pathObj
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_adjunction_of_pathObj
    (hGa : ∀ N : CatModule.{w} D, IsAcyclic N → IsAcyclic (G.obj N))
    {P : CatModule.{w} C} (hP : IsKProjective P) : IsKProjective (L.obj P)
proof:
:= fun N hN g =>
  (homotopic_zero_iff_homEquiv_of_pathObj adj hG θ hθ g).mpr (hP _ (hGa N hN) _)

name: DG.CatModule.IsAcyclic.of_iso
statement:
theorem IsAcyclic.of_iso {M N : CatModule.{w} D} (e : M ≅ N) (h : IsAcyclic N) :
    IsAcyclic M
proof:
:= fun X =>
  (h X).of_dgAddEquiv (DGAddEquiv.ofAddMonoidHom (e.hom.app X) (e.inv.app X)
    (fun m => by rw [← comp_app, e.hom_inv_id, id_app])
    (fun n => by rw [← comp_app, e.inv_hom_id, id_app])
    (fun hm => e.hom.map_mem hm) (fun m => e.hom.map_d m))

name: DG.CatBimodule.homotopic_iff_tensorHomEquiv
statement:
theorem homotopic_iff_tensorHomEquiv {M : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ w} C}
    {N : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ w} D} (g g' : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) :
    CatModule.Homotopic g g' ↔ CatModule.Homotopic (B.tensorHomAdjunction.homEquiv M N g)
      (B.tensorHomAdjunction.homEquiv M N g')
proof:
:=
  homotopic_iff_homEquiv_of_pathObj B.tensorHomAdjunction (fun h => h.homMap B)
    B.homPathMap B.homPathMap_π g g'

name: DG.CatBimodule.homotopic_tensorMap
statement:
theorem homotopic_tensorMap {M M' : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ w} C} {f f' : M ⟶ M'}
    (h : CatModule.Homotopic f f') : CatModule.Homotopic (B.tensorMap f) (B.tensorMap f')
proof:
:=
  homotopic_map_of_pathObj B.tensorHomAdjunction (fun h => h.homMap B) B.homPathMap
    B.homPathMap_π h

name: DG.CatBimodule.isAcyclic_homObj
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_homObj {N : CatModule.{w} D} (hN : CatModule.IsAcyclic N) :
    CatModule.IsAcyclic (B.homObj N)
proof:
:=
  fun Y => (hB Y).isAcyclic_hom hN

name: DG.CatBimodule.isQuasiIso_homMap
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_homMap {M N : CatModule.{w} D} {φ : M ⟶ N} (hφ : CatModule.IsQuasiIso φ) :
    CatModule.IsQuasiIso (B.homMap φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isQuasiIso_iff_isAcyclic_cone] at hφ ⊢
  exact CatModule.IsAcyclic.of_iso (B.homConeIso φ).symm (B.isAcyclic_homObj hB hφ)

name: DG.CatBimodule.isKProjective_tensorObj
proof:
:=
  CatModule.IsKProjective.of_adjunction_of_pathObj B.tensorHomAdjunction (fun h => h.homMap B)
    B.homPathMap B.homPathMap_π (fun _ hN => B.isAcyclic_homObj hB hN) hP

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.homFunctor_map_mem_quasiIso
statement:
theorem homFunctor_map_mem_quasiIso {M N : HomotopyCategory.{w} D} {f : M ⟶ N}
    (hf : quasiIso D f) : quasiIso C ((homFunctor B).map f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, rfl⟩ := quotient_obj_surjective M
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := quotient_obj_surjective N
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (quotient _).map_surjective f
  rw [quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff] at hf
  rw [homFunctor_map_quotient_map, quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff]
  exact B.isQuasiIso_homMap hB hf

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.tensorUnitMap_comp_rhom_map
statement:
theorem tensorUnitMap_comp_rhom_map (P : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} C)
    {N : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} D} (g : B.tensorObj P ⟶ N) :
    tensorUnitMap B hB P ≫ (rhom B hB).map (Q.map g) =
      Q.map ((adjB B).homEquiv P N g) ≫ (QCompRhomIso B hB).inv.app N
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorUnitMap, Category.assoc, ← Functor.comp_map, ← (QCompRhomIso B hB).inv.naturality,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.bijective_tensorUnitMap_comp
statement:
theorem bijective_tensorUnitMap_comp (P : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} C) (hP : IsKProjective P)
    (Y : DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} D) :
    Function.Bijective fun g : Q.obj (B.tensorObj P) ⟶ Y =>
      tensorUnitMap B hB P ≫ (rhom B hB).map g
proof:
:= by
  have hLP : IsKProjective (B.tensorObj P) := CatBimodule.isKProjective_tensorObj.{max v₁ w} B hB hP
  
  obtain ⟨Z, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    (Localization.essSurj (Qh (C := D)) (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso D)).mem_essImage Y
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective Z
  have key : Function.Bijective fun g : Q.obj (B.tensorObj P) ⟶ Q.obj N =>
      tensorUnitMap B hB P ≫ (rhom B hB).map g := by
    have hQ := fun {M : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} C} (hM : IsKProjective M)
        (M' : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} C) =>
      Qh_map_bijective_of_isKProjective hM ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C).obj M')
    have hQD := Qh_map_bijective_of_isKProjective hLP ((HomotopyCategory.quotient D).obj N)
    constructor
    · intro a b hab
      obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := hQD.2 a
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient D).map_surjective a'
      obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hQD.2 b
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient D).map_surjective b'
      change tensorUnitMap B hB P ≫ (rhom B hB).map (Q.map a) =
        tensorUnitMap B hB P ≫ (rhom B hB).map (Q.map b) at hab
      rw [tensorUnitMap_comp_rhom_map, tensorUnitMap_comp_rhom_map, cancel_mono] at hab
      have h := (hQ hP _).1 hab
      rw [HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_eq_iff,
        ← CatBimodule.homotopic_iff_tensorHomEquiv.{max v₁ w} B,
        ← HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_eq_iff] at h
      change Qh.map _ = Qh.map _
      rw [h]
    · intro c
      obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := (hQ hP (B.homObj N)).2 (c ≫ (QCompRhomIso B hB).hom.app N)
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := (HomotopyCategory.quotient C).map_surjective k'
      refine ⟨Q.map (((adjB B).homEquiv P N).symm k), ?_⟩
      beta_reduce
      rw [tensorUnitMap_comp_rhom_map]
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      change Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C).map k) ≫ _ = c
      rw [hk', Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
      exact Category.comp_id c
  
  have h1 : (fun g : Q.obj (B.tensorObj P) ⟶ Y => tensorUnitMap B hB P ≫ (rhom B hB).map g) =
      (fun c => c ≫ (rhom B hB).map e.hom) ∘
        (fun g : Q.obj (B.tensorObj P) ⟶ Q.obj N => tensorUnitMap B hB P ≫ (rhom B hB).map g) ∘
          (fun g => g ≫ e.inv) := by
    ext g
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  rw [h1]
  refine Function.Bijective.comp ?_ (key.comp ?_)
  · refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
      ⟨fun c => c ≫ (rhom B hB).map e.inv, fun c => ?_, fun c => ?_⟩ <;>
    simp [← Functor.map_comp]
  · exact Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
      ⟨fun c => c ≫ e.hom, fun c => by simp, fun c => by simp⟩

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.derivedTensorHomEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem derivedTensorHomEquiv_apply (X : DerivedCategory.{w₁, max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} C)
    (Y : DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} D)
    (g : Q.obj (B.tensorObj (kProjRep.{w₁, max u₂ w, v₁, u₁} X)) ⟶ Y) :
    derivedTensorHomEquiv B hB X Y g = (kProjRepIso.{w₁, max u₂ w, v₁, u₁} X).hom ≫
      tensorUnitMap B hB (kProjRep.{w₁, max u₂ w, v₁, u₁} X) ≫ (rhom B hB).map g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [derivedTensorHomEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply, Iso.homCongr_symm, Iso.homCongr_apply,
    Equiv.ofBijective_apply, Iso.symm_inv, Iso.refl_symm, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.tensorUnitMap_comp_derivedTensorObjIsoHom
statement:
theorem tensorUnitMap_comp_derivedTensorObjIsoHom :
    tensorUnitMap B hB P ≫ (rhom B hB).map (derivedTensorObjIsoHom B hB hP) =
      (derivedTensorAdjunction B hB).unit.app
        (Q.obj P : DerivedCategory.{w₁, max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} C)
proof:
:=
  (tensorUnitMapEquiv B hB hP _).apply_symm_apply _

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.unit_comp_derivedTensorObjIsoInv
statement:
theorem unit_comp_derivedTensorObjIsoInv :
    (derivedTensorAdjunction B hB).unit.app
        (Q.obj P : DerivedCategory.{w₁, max u₁ u₂ v₁ w} C) ≫
      (rhom B hB).map (derivedTensorObjIsoInv B hB P) = tensorUnitMap B hB P
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((derivedTensorAdjunction B hB).homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply (tensorUnitMap B hB P)
  rwa [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at h

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.derivedTensorObjIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedTensorObjIso_hom :
    (derivedTensorObjIso B hB hP).hom = derivedTensorObjIsoHom B hB hP
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.isAcyclic_of_isAcyclic_precomp
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_of_isAcyclic_precomp (hF : IsQuasiEquivalence F) {N : CatModule.{w} D}
    (h : IsAcyclic ((precomp F).obj N)) : IsAcyclic N
proof:
:= by
  intro Y
  obtain ⟨X, a, b, ha, hb, -, hba⟩ := hF.exists_iso Y
  obtain ⟨ha₀, hda⟩ := mem_cocycles.mp ha
  obtain ⟨hb₀, hdb⟩ := mem_cocycles.mp hb
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hdt⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hba
  refine DG.isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun k y hy hdy => ?_
  have hby : b • y ∈ grading k := by simpa using smul_mem_grading hb₀ hy
  have hdby : d (b • y) = 0 := by
    rw [d_smul hb₀, hdb, hdy]
    simp
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ : ∃ z : N.obj (F.obj X), z ∈ grading (k - 1) ∧ d z = b • y :=
    DG.isAcyclic_iff.mp (h X) k (b • y) hby hdby
  refine ⟨a • z - t • y, sub_mem (by simpa using smul_mem_grading ha₀ hz)
    (by simpa [sub_eq_neg_add] using smul_mem_grading ht hy), ?_⟩
  have e1 : d (a • z) = a • (b • y) := by
    rw [d_smul ha₀, hda, zero_smul, zero_add, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    exact congrArg _ hdz
  have e2 : d (t • y) = (b ≫ a) • y - y := by
    rw [d_smul ht, hdy, hdt, sub_smul, id_smul]
    simp
  rw [d_sub, e1, e2, comp_smul]
  abel

name: DG.ULift.mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem ULift.mem_coboundaries_iff {A : Type w} [AddCommGroup A] [DGAddCommGroup A] {n : ℤ}
    {a : ULift.{w'} A} : a ∈ coboundaries (ULift.{w'} A) n ↔ a.down ∈ coboundaries A n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_coboundaries]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b.down, hb, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, hdb⟩
    exact ⟨ULift.up b, hb, ULift.ext _ _ hdb⟩

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.balanced_ridULift
statement:
theorem balanced_ridULift (X : C) :
    Balanced (M := ulift.{w'} (representable X))
      fun Y => (N.ract (X := X) (Y := Y)).flip.compl₂ (ULift.downAddHom (X ⟶ Y))
proof:
:=
  fun f n h => by
    change (n <• f) <• h.down = n <• (h.down ≫ f)
    rw [ract_comp]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.ridULift_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ridULift_tmul (X Y : C) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (h : ULift.{w'} (X ⟶ Y)) :
    ridULift N X (tmul (M := ulift.{w'} (representable X)) Y n h) = n <• h.down
proof:
:=
  lift_tmul _ (balanced_ridULift N X) Y n h

name: DG.CatModule.inductionULiftRepresentableIso_hom_app_tmul
statement:
theorem inductionULiftRepresentableIso_hom_app_tmul (X : C) {Y : D} (X' : C)
    (h : F.obj X' ⟶ Y) (k : ULift.{w'} (X ⟶ X')) :
    ((inductionULiftRepresentableIso.{w'} F X).hom.app Y
      (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) X' h k)).down = F.map k.down ≫ h
proof:
:=
  (CatTensorProduct.ridULift_tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) X X' h k).trans
    (right_ract _ _ _ _)

name: DG.CatModule.isQuasiIso_representableMapULift
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_representableMapULift (hF : IsQuasiFullyFaithful F) (X : C) :
    IsQuasiIso (representableMapULift.{w} F X)
proof:
:= by
  intro X' n
  have hb := hF.bijective_cohomology X X' n
  rw [Function.Bijective, cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_injective_iff,
    cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_surjective_iff] at hb
  constructor
  · rw [cohomologyMap_injective_iff]
    intro x hx hdx hfx
    exact ULift.mem_coboundaries_iff.mpr (hb.1 x.down hx (congrArg ULift.down hdx)
      (ULift.mem_coboundaries_iff.mp hfx))
  · rw [cohomologyMap_surjective_iff]
    intro y hy hdy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, hxy⟩ := hb.2 y.down hy (congrArg ULift.down hdy)
    exact ⟨ULift.up x, hx, ULift.ext _ _ hdx, ULift.mem_coboundaries_iff.mpr hxy⟩

name: DG.CatModule.unit_app_representable_comp
statement:
theorem unit_app_representable_comp (X : C) :
    (inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F).unit.app (ulift.{max u₁ v₂ w} (representable X)) ≫
      (precomp F).map (inductionULiftRepresentableIso.{max u₁ v₂ w} F X).hom =
        representableMapULift.{w} F X
proof:
:= by
  refine ((isCornerGenerator_representable X).ulift.{max u₁ v₂ w}).ext_hom ?_
  refine ULift.ext _ _ ?_
  change ((inductionULiftRepresentableIso.{max u₁ v₂ w} F X).hom.app (F.obj X)
      (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (CatBimodule.ofFunctor F).right (F.obj X)) X (𝟙 (F.obj X))
        (ULift.up (𝟙 X)))).down = F.map (𝟙 X)
  rw [inductionULiftRepresentableIso_hom_app_tmul, F.map_id, Category.id_comp]

name: DG.CatModule.isQuasiIso_unit_app_representable
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_unit_app_representable (hF : IsQuasiFullyFaithful F) (X : C) :
    IsQuasiIso ((inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F).unit.app
      (ulift.{max u₁ v₂ w} (representable X)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := isQuasiIso_representableMapULift.{w} hF X
  rw [← unit_app_representable_comp] at h
  have e : ((inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F).unit.app (ulift.{max u₁ v₂ w} (representable X)) ≫
      (precomp F).map (inductionULiftRepresentableIso.{max u₁ v₂ w} F X).hom) ≫
        (precomp F).map (inductionULiftRepresentableIso.{max u₁ v₂ w} F X).inv =
      (inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F).unit.app (ulift.{max u₁ v₂ w} (representable X)) := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    exact Category.comp_id _
  rw [← e]
  exact h.comp (IsQuasiIso.of_isIso _)

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.isLocalizing_unitIsIso
statement:
theorem isLocalizing_unitIsIso : IsLocalizing.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w}
    (fun X : DerivedCategory.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C =>
    IsIso ((inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.app X)) where
  of_iso {X Y} e hY
proof:
:= by
    have : IsIso ((inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.app Y) := hY
    have h := (inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.naturality e.hom
    simp only [Functor.id_map] at h
    have h' : (inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.app X =
        e.hom ≫ (inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.app Y ≫
          (induction F ⋙ restrict F).map e.inv := by
      rw [reassoc_of% h]
      simp [← Functor.map_comp]
    change IsIso _
    rw [h']
    infer_instance
  shift X n hX := by
    have : IsIso ((inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.app X) := hX
    change IsIso _
    rw [NatTrans.app_shift (inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit n X]
    infer_instance
  ext₂ T hT h₁ h₃ := by
    let adj := inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F
    have hT' := (induction F ⋙ restrict F).map_distinguished T hT
    refine isIso₂_of_isIso₁₃ (T' := (induction F ⋙ restrict F).mapTriangle.obj T)
      (Triangle.homMk _ _ (adj.unit.app _) (adj.unit.app _) (adj.unit.app _)
        (adj.unit.naturality _) (adj.unit.naturality _) ?_) hT hT' h₁ h₃
    have h0 := NatTrans.shift_app_comm adj.unit (1 : ℤ) T.obj₁
    simp only [Functor.commShiftIso_id_hom_app] at h0
    have h1 : (adj.unit.app T.obj₁)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = adj.unit.app (T.obj₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≫
        ((induction F ⋙ restrict F).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app T.obj₁ :=
      (Category.id_comp _).symm.trans h0
    dsimp [Functor.mapTriangle]
    rw [h1, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    exact adj.unit.naturality T.mor₃
  coproduct {J Y} c hc hY := by
    let adj := inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F
    have : ∀ j, IsIso (adj.unit.app (Y j)) := hY
    have := adj.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
    have hc' : IsColimit ((induction F ⋙ restrict F).mapCocone c) :=
      isColimitOfPreserves (induction F ⋙ restrict F) hc
    let w : Discrete.functor Y ≅ Discrete.functor Y ⋙ (induction F ⋙ restrict F) :=
      NatIso.ofComponents (fun j => asIso (adj.unit.app (Y j.as)))
        (fun f => adj.unit.naturality ((Discrete.functor Y).map f))
    have key : (hc.coconePointsIsoOfNatIso hc' w).hom = adj.unit.app c.pt := by
      refine hc.hom_ext fun j => ?_
      rw [IsColimit.comp_coconePointsIsoOfNatIso_hom]
      exact (adj.unit.naturality (c.ι.app j)).symm
    change IsIso _
    rw [← key]
    infer_instance

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_unit_app_representable
statement:
theorem isIso_unit_app_representable (hF : IsQuasiFullyFaithful F) (X : C) :
    IsIso ((inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.app
      (Q.obj (representableW.{max v₂ w} C X)))
proof:
:= by
  have hR := (isCornerGenerator_representableW.{max v₂ w} X).isKProjective
  rw [← unitMap_comp_inductionObjIsoHom F hR]
  have : IsIso (Q.map ((CatModule.inductionAdjunction.{max v₁ w} F).unit.app
      (ulift.{max u₁ v₂ w} (representable X)))) :=
    (isIso_Q_map_iff _).mpr (isQuasiIso_unit_app_representable hF X)
  have : IsIso (inductionObjIsoHom F hR) :=
    (inductionObjIso F _).isIso_hom
  dsimp only [unitMap]
  infer_instance

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_unit_app_of_isQuasiFullyFaithful
statement:
theorem isIso_unit_app_of_isQuasiFullyFaithful (hF : IsQuasiFullyFaithful F)
    (X : DerivedCategory.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C) :
    IsIso ((inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.app X)
proof:
:=
  (compactlyGenerates.{max v₂ w} (C := C)).forall_of_isLocalizing (isLocalizing_unitIsIso F)
    (isIso_unit_app_representable hF) X

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_unit_app
statement:
theorem isIso_unit_app (hF : IsQuasiEquivalence F)
    (X : DerivedCategory.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C) :
    IsIso ((inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).unit.app X)

  isIso_unit_app_of_isQuasiFullyFaithful hF.toIsQuasiFullyFaithful X

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isZero_restrict_of_reflects
statement:
theorem isZero_of_isZero_restrict_of_reflects
    (hR : ∀ N : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D, IsAcyclic ((precomp F).obj N) → IsAcyclic N)
    {Z : DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D}
    (h : IsZero ((restrict F).obj Z : DerivedCategory.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C)) :
    IsZero Z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_iso_Q_obj Z
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ e
  rw [isZero_Q_obj_iff]
  refine hR N ?_
  rw [← isZero_Q_obj_iff (C := C)]
  exact IsZero.of_iso h (((QCompRestrictIso F).app N).symm ≪≫ (restrict F).mapIso e.symm)

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isZero_restrict
statement:
theorem isZero_of_isZero_restrict (hF : IsQuasiEquivalence F)
    {Z : DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D}
    (h : IsZero ((restrict F).obj Z : DerivedCategory.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} C)) :
    IsZero Z
proof:
:=
  isZero_of_isZero_restrict_of_reflects (fun _ => isAcyclic_of_isAcyclic_precomp hF) h

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_counit_app_of_reflects
statement:
theorem isIso_counit_app_of_reflects (hF : IsQuasiFullyFaithful F)
    (hR : ∀ N : CatModule.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D, IsAcyclic ((precomp F).obj N) → IsAcyclic N)
    (Y : DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D) :
    IsIso ((inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F).counit.app Y)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := inductionAdjunction.{max u₁ v₁ v₂ w, w₂, w, v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} F
  have : IsIso (adj.unit.app ((restrict F).obj Y)) :=
    isIso_unit_app_of_isQuasiFullyFaithful hF _
  have h1 : IsIso ((restrict F).map (adj.counit.app Y)) := by
    rw [IsIso.eq_inv_of_hom_inv_id (adj.right_triangle_components Y)]
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨Z, g, h, hT⟩ := distinguished_cocone_triangle (adj.counit.app Y)
  have hRT := (restrict F).map_distinguished _ hT
  have hZ : IsZero Z :=
    isZero_of_isZero_restrict_of_reflects hR ((Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ _ hRT).mpr h1)
  exact (Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ _ hT).mp hZ

name: DG.CatModule.DerivedCategory.isIso_counit_app
statement:
theorem isIso_counit_app (hF : IsQuasiEquivalence F) (Y : DerivedCategory.{w₂, max u₁ v₁ v₂ w} D) :

name: DG.DGRingHom.isQuasiEquivalence_singleObjFunctor
statement:
theorem isQuasiEquivalence_singleObjFunctor (hφ : φ.IsQuasiIso) :
    IsQuasiEquivalence φ.singleObjFunctor where
  bijective_cohomology _ _ n
proof:
:= hφ n
  exists_iso Y := ⟨SingleObj.star B, (1 : A), (1 : A),
    mem_cocycles.mpr ⟨one_mem_grading, d_one⟩, mem_cocycles.mpr ⟨one_mem_grading, d_one⟩,
    by rw [show ((1 : A) : SingleObj.star A ⟶ Y) ≫ ((1 : A) : Y ⟶ SingleObj.star A) -
      𝟙 (φ.singleObjFunctor.obj (SingleObj.star B)) = (1 * 1 - 1 : A) from rfl, mul_one,
      sub_self]; exact zero_mem _,
    by rw [show ((1 : A) : Y ⟶ SingleObj.star A) ≫ ((1 : A) : SingleObj.star A ⟶ Y) - 𝟙 Y =
      (1 * 1 - 1 : A) from rfl, mul_one, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.directSumDesc_app_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Cochain.directSumDesc_app_of {n : ℤ} (c : ∀ j, Cochain (F j) N n) (j : J) {X : C}
    (x : (F j).obj X) :
    (Cochain.directSumDesc c).app X (DirectSum.of (fun j => (F j).obj X) j x) = (c j).app X x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (fun j => (c j).app X) j x

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.of_directSum
statement:
theorem Homotopic.of_directSum {φ ψ : directSum F ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ j, Homotopic (directSumι F j ≫ φ) (directSumι F j ≫ ψ)) : Homotopic φ ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Homotopic.iff_sub]
  choose c hc using fun j => mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists.mp (Homotopic.iff_sub.mp (h j))
  refine mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists.mpr ⟨Cochain.directSumDesc c, Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_⟩
  change (φ - ψ).app X x = (δ (-1) 0 (Cochain.directSumDesc c)).app X x
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | of j y =>
    have := congrArg (fun z : Cochain (F j) N 0 => z.app X y) (hc j)
    simp only [Cochain.ofHom_apply, δ_neg_one_apply] at this ⊢
    refine this.trans ?_
    have hd : DGAddCommGroup.d (M := (directSum F).obj X)
        (DirectSum.of (fun j => (F j).obj X) j y) =
        DirectSum.of (fun j => (F j).obj X) j (d y) :=
      DG.DirectSum.d_of (fun j => (F j).obj X) j y
    rw [Cochain.directSumDesc_app_of, hd, Cochain.directSumDesc_app_of]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso_singleObj_eq_inverseImage
statement:
theorem quasiIso_singleObj_eq_inverseImage :
    quasiIso.{w} (SingleObj A) =
      (DG.HomotopyCategory.quasiIso.{w} A).inverseImage (toDGHomotopyCategory A)
proof:
:= by
  ext M N f
  obtain ⟨M, rfl⟩ := quotient_obj_surjective M
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := quotient_obj_surjective N
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (quotient _).map_surjective f
  rw [MorphismProperty.inverseImage_iff, quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff,
    toDGHomotopyCategory_map_quotient_map, DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_mem_quasiIso_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h n => h (SingleObj.star A) n, fun h _ n => h n⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.rightShiftAddHom_of
statement:
theorem rightShiftAddHom_of (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain M (shift a N) k) :
    rightShiftAddHom M N a (DirectSum.of _ k z) =
      Shift.mk a (DirectSum.of _ (k + a) (z.rightUnshift (k + a) rfl))

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.rightUnshiftAddHom_mk_of

:=
  leftShiftAddHom_of k z

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.leftShiftEquiv_symm_mk_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShiftEquiv_symm_mk_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) :
    (leftShiftEquiv M N a).symm (Shift.mk (-a) (DirectSum.of _ n z)) =
      DirectSum.of _ (n + a) (z.leftShift a (n + a) rfl)
proof:
:=
  leftUnshiftAddHom_mk_of n z

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.homShiftAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homShiftAddEquiv_apply (n : ℤ) (f : M ⟶ CatModule.shift n N) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (homShiftAddEquiv M N n f : Cochain M N n).app X x = shift.unmk n (f.app X x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.homShiftAddEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homShiftAddEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℤ) (z : Cocycle M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    ((homShiftAddEquiv M N n).symm z).app X x = shift.mk n ((z : Cochain M N n).app X x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.coe_homShiftAddEquivCocycles_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_homShiftAddEquivCocycles_apply (n : ℤ) (f : M ⟶ shift n N) :
    (homShiftAddEquivCocycles M N n f : HOM M N) =
      DirectSum.of (fun k => Cochain M N k) n (Cocycle.homShiftAddEquiv M N n f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.homShiftAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map
statement:
theorem homShiftAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map (n : ℤ)
    (f : M ⟶ (shiftFunctor (CatModule.{w} C) n).obj N) :
    homShiftAddEquivCohomology M N n
        ((quotient C).map f ≫ ((quotient C).commShiftIso n).hom.app N) =
      cohomology.mk _ n (HOM.homShiftAddEquivCocycles M N n f)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (compIsoAddEquiv (((quotient C).commShiftIso n).app N)).symm
      ((quotient C).map f ≫ ((quotient C).commShiftIso n).hom.app N) = (quotient C).map f := by
    change ((quotient C).map f ≫ ((quotient C).commShiftIso n).hom.app N) ≫
      ((quotient C).commShiftIso n).inv.app N = _
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg _ (Iso.hom_inv_id_app _ _)).trans (Category.comp_id _))
  rw [homShiftAddEquivCohomology, AddEquiv.trans_apply]
  erw [AddEquiv.trans_apply, h]
  refine (congrArg (HOM.cohomologyRightShiftAddEquiv M N n 0 n (zero_add n))
    (homAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map M ((shiftFunctor (CatModule.{w} C) n).obj N) f)).trans
    ?_
  refine congrArg (cohomology.mk _ n) (Subtype.ext ?_)
  refine (congrArg (Shift.unmk n)
    (HOM.rightShiftEquiv_of M N n 0 (Cochain.ofHom f))).trans ?_
  exact HOM.of_congr (zero_add n)
    (f := Cochain.rightUnshift (N := N) (a := n) (Cochain.ofHom f) (0 + n) rfl)
    (g := (Cocycle.homShiftAddEquiv M N n f : Cochain M N n)) fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.compMor₁_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMor₁_fst_apply (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    (fst (f ≫ g)).1.app X ((compMor₁ f g).app X p) = (fst f).1.app X p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.compMor₁_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMor₁_snd_apply (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    (snd (f ≫ g)).app X ((compMor₁ f g).app X p) = g.app X ((snd f).app X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.compMor₂_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMor₂_fst_apply (p : (cone (f ≫ g)).obj X) :
    (fst g).1.app X ((compMor₂ f g).app X p) = f.app X ((fst (f ≫ g)).1.app X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.compMor₂_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMor₂_snd_apply (p : (cone (f ≫ g)).obj X) :
    (snd g).app X ((compMor₂ f g).app X p) = (snd (f ≫ g)).app X p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.MappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv.hom_comp_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_comp_inv : hom f g ≫ inv f g = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X p => ext_to ?_ ?_
  · simp [hom, inv, lift_apply, desc_apply, descCochain_apply]
  · simp [hom, inv, lift_apply, desc_apply, descCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_hom_comp_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_hom_comp_inv :
    (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv f g).hom ≫ (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv f g).inv = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  MappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv.hom_comp_inv f g

name: DG.CatModule.cone.mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_comm₁
statement:
theorem mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_comm₁ :
    inr (compMor₁ f g) ≫ (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv f g).inv = compMor₂ f g
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X p => ext_to ?_ ?_
  · simp [mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv, MappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv.inv, compMor₂, desc_apply]
  · simp [mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv, MappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv.inv, compMor₂, desc_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_comm₂
statement:
theorem mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_comm₂ :
    (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv f g).hom ≫ (-fstHom (compMor₁ f g)) = compMor₃ f g
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X p => (shift.unmk 1).injective ?_
  simp only [compMor₃, comp_app, neg_app, map_neg, unmk_shiftMap_app, ← fst_apply]
  simp [mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv, MappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv.hom, lift_apply,
    descCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.ks_eq
statement: private theorem ks_eq {m n : ℤ} (k : ℤ) (h : m - n = 2 * k) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr ⟨k, by omega⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.map_units
statement:
private theorem map_units {A B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] (f : A →+ B) (u : ℤˣ)
    (x : A) : f (u • x) = u • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompCochain_of (z : Cochain N N' k) (j : ℤ) (w : Cochain P N j) :
    postcompCochain z (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N n) j w) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N' n) (j + k) (z.comp w rfl)
proof:
:= by
  simp [postcompCochain, postcompCochainAddHom]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_mem
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_mem (z : Cochain N N' k) {j : ℤ} {w : HOM P N} (hw : w ∈ grading j) :
    postcompCochain z w ∈ grading (j + k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hw
  rw [postcompCochain_of]
  exact of_mem_summand _ _

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_add
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_add (z z' : Cochain N N' k) (w : HOM P N) :
    postcompCochain (z + z') w = postcompCochain z w + postcompCochain z' w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w => simp [Cochain.add_comp]
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hw, hw']; abel

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_neg
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_neg (z : Cochain N N' k) (w : HOM P N) :
    postcompCochain (-z) w = -postcompCochain z w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w => simp [Cochain.neg_comp]
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw', neg_add]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_sub
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_sub (z z' : Cochain N N' k) (w : HOM P N) :
    postcompCochain (z - z') w = postcompCochain z w - postcompCochain z' w
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, postcompCochain_add, postcompCochain_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompCochain_zero (w : HOM P N) : postcompCochain (0 : Cochain N N' k) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w => simp
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, hw, hw', add_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_units_smul
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (z : Cochain N N' k) (w : HOM P N) :
    postcompCochain (u • z) w = u • postcompCochain z w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w => rw [postcompCochain_of, postcompCochain_of, Cochain.units_smul_comp, of_units_smul]
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw', _root_.smul_add]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompCochain_id (w : HOM P N) : postcompCochain (Cochain.id N) w = w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w => rw [postcompCochain_of]; exact of_congr (add_zero j) fun _ _ => rfl
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, hw, hw']

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [Cochain.ext hz]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_eq_self (h : k = 0) {z : Cochain N N k} (hz : ∀ X x, z.app X x = x)
    (w : HOM P N) : postcompCochain z w = w
proof:
:=
  (postcompCochain_congr h (z' := Cochain.id N) hz w).trans (postcompCochain_id w)

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_eq_zero
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_eq_zero {z : Cochain N N' k} (hz : ∀ X x, z.app X x = 0) (w : HOM P N) :
    postcompCochain z w = 0
proof:
:=
  (postcompCochain_congr rfl (z' := 0) hz w).trans (postcompCochain_zero w)

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_postcompCochain {k' : ℤ} (z : Cochain N N' k) (z' : Cochain N' N'' k')
    (w : HOM P N) :
    postcompCochain z' (postcompCochain z w) = postcompCochain (z'.comp z rfl) w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w =>
    simp only [postcompCochain_of]
    exact of_congr (add_assoc _ _ _) fun _ _ => rfl
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hw, hw']

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.d_postcompCochain
statement:
theorem d_postcompCochain (z : Cochain N N' k) (w : HOM P N) :
    d (postcompCochain z w) =
      postcompCochain (δ k (k + 1) z) w + koszulSign k • postcompCochain z (d w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w =>
    rw [postcompCochain_of, d_of, d_of, postcompCochain_of, postcompCochain_of,
      δ_comp w z rfl (j + 1) (k + 1) (j + k + 1) rfl rfl rfl, map_add, ← of_units_smul]
    congr 1
    · exact of_congr (by ring) fun _ _ => rfl
    · exact of_congr (by ring) fun _ _ => rfl
  | add w w' hw hw' =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw', map_add, map_add, map_add, _root_.smul_add]
    abel

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompCochain_of (c : Cochain P' P i) (j : ℤ) (w : Cochain P N j) :
    precompCochain c (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N n) j w) =
      koszulSign (i * j) • DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P' N n) (i + j) (w.comp c rfl)
proof:
:= by
  simp [precompCochain, precompCochainAddHom]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_mem
statement:
theorem precompCochain_mem (c : Cochain P' P i) {j : ℤ} {w : HOM P N} (hw : w ∈ grading j) :
    precompCochain c w ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hw
  rw [precompCochain_of]
  exact units_smul_mem_grading _ (of_mem_summand _ _)

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_add
statement:
theorem precompCochain_add (c c' : Cochain P' P i) (w : HOM P N) :
    precompCochain (c + c') w = precompCochain c w + precompCochain c' w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w => simp
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hw, hw']; abel

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_units_smul
statement:
theorem precompCochain_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (c : Cochain P' P i) (w : HOM P N) :
    precompCochain (u • c) w = u • precompCochain c w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w =>
    rw [precompCochain_of, precompCochain_of, Cochain.comp_units_smul, of_units_smul, smul_comm]
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw', _root_.smul_add]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompCochain_zero (w : HOM P N) : precompCochain (0 : Cochain P' P i) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w => simp
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, hw, hw', add_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompCochain_id (w : HOM P N) : precompCochain (Cochain.id P) w = w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w =>
    rw [precompCochain_of, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    exact of_congr (zero_add j) fun _ _ => rfl
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, hw, hw']

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.precompCochain_precompCochain
statement:
theorem precompCochain_precompCochain {i' : ℤ} (c : Cochain P'' P' i) (c' : Cochain P' P i')
    (w : HOM P N) :
    precompCochain c (precompCochain c' w) =
      koszulSign (i * i') • precompCochain (c'.comp c rfl) w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w =>
    rw [precompCochain_of, map_units _, precompCochain_of, precompCochain_of, smul_smul,
      ← koszulSign_add, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 1
    · exact congrArg koszulSign (by ring)
    · exact of_congr (add_assoc _ _ _).symm fun _ _ => rfl
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw', map_add, _root_.smul_add]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcompCochain_precompCochain
statement:
theorem postcompCochain_precompCochain {k : ℤ} (z : Cochain N N' k) (c : Cochain P' P i)
    (w : HOM P N) :
    postcompCochain z (precompCochain c w) =
      koszulSign (i * k) • precompCochain c (postcompCochain z w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w =>
    rw [precompCochain_of, map_units _, postcompCochain_of, postcompCochain_of, precompCochain_of,
      smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 1
    · exact ks_eq (-(i * k)) (by ring)
    · exact of_congr (add_assoc _ _ _) fun _ _ => rfl
  | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw', map_add, map_add, _root_.smul_add]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.d_precompCochain
statement:
theorem d_precompCochain (c : Cochain P' P i) (w : HOM P N) :
    d (precompCochain c w) =
      precompCochain (δ i (i + 1) c) w + koszulSign i • precompCochain c (d w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of j w =>
    rw [precompCochain_of, d_units_smul, d_of, d_of, precompCochain_of, precompCochain_of,
      δ_comp c w rfl (i + 1) (j + 1) (i + j + 1) rfl rfl rfl, map_add, _root_.smul_add]
    simp only [← of_units_smul]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr 1 <;> refine of_congr (by ring) fun X x => ?_ <;>
      simp only [Cochain.units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
    · exact congrArg (· • _) (ks_eq 0 (by ring))
    · exact congrArg (· • _) (ks_eq (-i) (by ring))
  | add w w' hw hw' =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, hw, hw', map_add, map_add, map_add, _root_.smul_add]
    abel

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.eval_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_of (X : C) (j : ℤ) (w : Cochain P N j) (x : P.obj X) :
    eval P N X (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N n) j w) x = w.app X x
proof:
:= by
  simp [eval]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.eval_postcompCochain
statement:
theorem eval_postcompCochain {k : ℤ} (z : Cochain N N' k) (X : C) (w : HOM P N) (x : P.obj X) :
    eval P N' X (postcompCochain z w) x = z.app X (eval P N X w x)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of _ w => simp
  | add w w' hw hw' =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hw, hw', map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
      map_add]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.eval_d_of
statement:
theorem eval_d_of (X : C) {j : ℤ} (w : Cochain P N j) (x : P.obj X) :
    eval P N X (d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N n) j w)) x =
      d (w.app X x) - koszulSign j • w.app X (d x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_of, eval_of, δ_apply _ _ rfl]

name: DG.CatModule.isAcyclic_iff
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_iff (M : CatModule.{w} C) :
    IsAcyclic M ↔ ∀ (X : C) (n : ℤ), Subsingleton (cohomology (M.obj X) n)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.CatModule.isQuasiIso_id
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_id (M : CatModule.{w} C) : IsQuasiIso (𝟙 M)
proof:
:= fun X n => by
  rw [cohomologyMap_id]
  exact Function.bijective_id

name: DG.CatModule.IsQuasiIso.comp
statement:
theorem IsQuasiIso.comp {φ : M ⟶ N} {ψ : N ⟶ P} (hφ : IsQuasiIso φ) (hψ : IsQuasiIso ψ) :
    IsQuasiIso (φ ≫ ψ)
proof:
:= fun X n => by
  have : ⇑(cohomologyMap (φ ≫ ψ) X n) = cohomologyMap ψ X n ∘ cohomologyMap φ X n :=
    funext (cohomologyMap_comp_apply φ ψ X n)
  rw [this]
  exact (hψ X n).comp (hφ X n)

name: DG.CatModule.IsQuasiIso.of_isIso
statement: theorem IsQuasiIso.of_isIso (φ : M ⟶ N) [IsIso φ] : IsQuasiIso φ
proof:
:= fun X n => by
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
    ⟨cohomologyMap (inv φ) X n, fun x => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · rw [← cohomologyMap_comp_apply, IsIso.hom_inv_id, cohomologyMap_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  · rw [← cohomologyMap_comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id, cohomologyMap_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homConeHom_inv
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem homConeHom_inv : B.homConeHom φ ≫ B.homConeInv φ = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_injective
  rw [CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_comp, homConeInv, homConeHom, CatModule.cone.ofHom_desc,
    CatModule.cone.ofHom_lift, CatModule.cone.liftCochain_descCochain, homConeFst,
    CatModule.Cocycle.mk_coe, ← homCochain_ofHom, ← homCochain_comp, ← homCochain_comp,
    ← homCochain_add, CatModule.cone.id, homCochain_id, CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_id]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homConeInv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem homConeInv_hom : B.homConeInv φ ≫ B.homConeHom φ = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.hom_ext fun Y p => ?_
  rw [CatModule.comp_app, CatModule.id_app]
  refine CatModule.cone.ext_to ?_ ?_
  · rw [homConeHom, CatModule.cone.lift_fst_apply, homConeFst, CatModule.Cocycle.mk_coe,
      homCochain_app, homConeInv, CatModule.cone.desc_apply, homCochain_app, homMap_app,
      map_add, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self (neg_add_cancel 1) (fun _ _ => rfl),
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_zero (fun _ _ => rfl), add_zero]
  · rw [homConeHom, CatModule.cone.lift_snd_apply, homCochain_app, homConeInv,
      CatModule.cone.desc_apply, homCochain_app, homMap_app, map_add,
      HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self (add_zero 0) (fun _ _ => rfl),
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_zero (fun _ _ => rfl), zero_add]

name: DG.CatBimodule.inr_homConeHom
statement:
theorem inr_homConeHom : B.homMap (CatModule.cone.inr φ) ≫ B.homConeHom φ =
    CatModule.cone.inr (B.homMap φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.hom_ext fun Y w => ?_
  rw [CatModule.comp_app]
  refine CatModule.cone.ext_to ?_ ?_
  · rw [homConeHom, CatModule.cone.lift_fst_apply, homConeFst, CatModule.Cocycle.mk_coe,
      homCochain_app, homMap_app, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_zero (fun _ _ => rfl),
      CatModule.cone.inr_fst_apply]
  · rw [homConeHom, CatModule.cone.lift_snd_apply, homCochain_app, homMap_app,
      HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self (add_zero 0) (fun _ _ => rfl),
      CatModule.cone.inr_snd_apply]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homConeHom_fstHom
statement:
theorem homConeHom_fstHom : B.homConeHom φ ≫ CatModule.cone.fstHom (B.homMap φ) =
    B.homMap (CatModule.cone.fstHom φ) ≫ B.homShiftHom 1 M
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.hom_ext fun Y w => ?_
  rw [CatModule.comp_app, CatModule.comp_app, homShiftHom_app, homMap_app,
    HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain]
  refine (CatModule.shift.mk_unmk (n := 1) _).symm.trans ?_
  rw [← CatModule.cone.fst_apply, homConeHom, CatModule.cone.lift_fst_apply, homConeFst,
    CatModule.Cocycle.mk_coe, homCochain_app]
  refine congrArg (CatModule.shift.mk (M := B.homObj M) (X := Y) 1) ?_
  apply HOM.postcompCochain_congr
  · omega
  · intro _ _
    rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.homFunctor_map_quotient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homFunctor_map_quotient_map {M N : CatModule.{w} D} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (homFunctor B).map ((quotient D).map f) = (quotient C).map (B.homMap f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.mappingConeCompTriangleh_comm₁
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem mappingConeCompTriangleh_comm₁ :
    (mappingConeCompTriangleh f g).mor₂ ≫
      (quotient C).map (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv f g).hom =
    (quotient C).map (inr (compMor₁ f g))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (isoOfHomotopyEquiv (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv f g)).inv, assoc]
  dsimp [mappingConeCompTriangleh, mappingConeCompTriangle, isoOfHomotopyEquiv, triangle]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp,
    mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_hom_comp_inv, comp_id]
  congr 1
  exact (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_comm₁ f g).symm

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.mappingConeCompTriangleh_distinguished
statement:
theorem mappingConeCompTriangleh_distinguished {X₁ X₂ X₃ : CatModule.{w} C} (f : X₁ ⟶ X₂)
    (g : X₂ ⟶ X₃) : mappingConeCompTriangleh f g ∈ distTriang (HomotopyCategory.{w} C)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨_, _, (mappingConeCompTriangle f g).mor₁, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  refine Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (isoOfHomotopyEquiv (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv f g)) (by aesop_cat) (by simp; rfl) ?_
  dsimp [mappingConeCompTriangleh, mappingConeCompTriangle, isoOfHomotopyEquiv, triangle]
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, comp_id, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  congr 2
  exact (mappingConeCompHomotopyEquiv_comm₂ f g).symm

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.shift
statement:
theorem Homotopic.shift {M N : CatModule.{w} C} {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : Homotopic f g) (n : ℤ) :
    Homotopic (shiftMap n f) (shiftMap n g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.shift n⟩

name: DG.CatModule.smul_id_smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_id_smul_mem {X : C} (r : R) {i : ℤ} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading i) :
    (r • 𝟙 X) • m ∈ grading i
proof:
:= by
  simpa using smul_mem_grading (DGLinear.smul_id_mem r X) hm

name: DG.CatModule.d_smul_id_smul
statement: theorem d_smul_id_smul {X : C} (r : R) (m : M.obj X) : d ((r • 𝟙 X) • m) = (r • 𝟙 X) • d m
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_smul_of_d_eq_zero (DGLinear.smul_id_mem r X) (DGLinear.d_smul_id r X), koszulSign_zero,
    one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_id_smul_comm
statement:
theorem smul_id_smul_comm {X Y : C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    (r • 𝟙 Y) • f • m = f • (r • 𝟙 X) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_smul, ← comp_smul, DGLinear.smul_id_comp_eq_comp_smul_id]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_smul_id
statement:
theorem smul_smul_id {X Y : C} (r : R) (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    (r • f) • m = (r • 𝟙 Y) • f • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_smul, DGLinear.comp_smul_id]

name: DG.CatModule.mul_smul_id_smul
statement:
theorem mul_smul_id_smul {X : C} (r s : R) (m : M.obj X) :
    ((r * s) • 𝟙 X) • m = (r • 𝟙 X) • (s • 𝟙 X) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_smul, Linear.smul_comp, Linear.comp_smul, Category.id_comp, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: DG.CatModule.add_smul_id_smul
statement:
theorem add_smul_id_smul {X : C} (r s : R) (m : M.obj X) :
    ((r + s) • 𝟙 X) • m = (r • 𝟙 X) • m + (s • 𝟙 X) • m
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.add_smul, add_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.one_smul_id_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_smul_id_smul {X : C} (m : M.obj X) : ((1 : R) • 𝟙 X) • m = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.one_smul, id_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.zero_smul_id_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_smul_id_smul {X : C} (m : M.obj X) : ((0 : R) • 𝟙 X) • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.zero_smul, zero_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.map_smul_id
statement:
theorem map_smul_id (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (r : R) (x : M.obj X) :
    z.app X ((r • 𝟙 X) • x) = (r • 𝟙 X) • z.app X x
proof:
:= by
  rw [z.map_smul (DGLinear.smul_id_mem r X), mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.smul_ground_app
statement:
theorem smul_ground_app (r : R) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (r • z).app X x = (r • 𝟙 X) • z.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.smul_comp
statement:
theorem smul_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (r : R) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (r • z₂).comp z₁ h = r • z₂.comp z₁ h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_smul
statement:
theorem comp_smul {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (r : R) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (r • z₁) h = r • z₂.comp z₁ h
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ _ => map_smul_id z₂ r _

name: DG.CatModule.δ_smul_ground
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_smul_ground (n m : ℤ) (r : R) (z : Cochain M N n) : δ n m (r • z) = r • δ n m z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · ext X x
    rw [Cochain.smul_ground_app, δ_apply _ _ hnm, δ_apply _ _ hnm, Cochain.smul_ground_app,
      Cochain.smul_ground_app, d_smul_id_smul, smul_sub, smul_units_smul]
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm, δ_shape _ _ hnm, _root_.smul_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.smul_of
statement:
theorem smul_of (r : R) (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) :
    r • (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) n z : HOM M N) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) n (r • z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, map_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.d_smul_ground
statement: theorem d_smul_ground (r : R) (F : HOM M N) : d (r • F) = r • d F
proof:
:= by
  induction F using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n z => rw [smul_of, d_of, d_of, δ_smul_ground, smul_of]
  | add F G hF hG => rw [_root_.smul_add, d_add, hF, hG, d_add, _root_.smul_add]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.smul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem smul_mem_grading (r : R) {n : ℤ} {F : HOM M N} (hF : F ∈ grading n) :
    r • F ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hF
  rw [smul_of]
  exact of_mem_summand _ _

name: DG.CatModule.smul_app
statement:
theorem smul_app (r : R) (φ : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (m : M.obj X) :
    (r • φ).app X m = (r • 𝟙 X) • φ.app X m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_smul
statement: theorem Cochain.ofHom_smul (r : R) (φ : M ⟶ N) : Cochain.ofHom (r • φ) = r • Cochain.ofHom φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.smul
statement: theorem Homotopic.smul {f g : M ⟶ N} (r : R) (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (r • f) (r • g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.smul r⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.map_units_smul
statement:
theorem Hom.map_units_smul (φ : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (u : ℤˣ) (m : M.obj X) :
    φ.app X (u • m) = u • φ.app X m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.fstHom_inlAddHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem fstHom_inlAddHom (x : (shift 1 M).obj X) :
    (fstHom f).app X (inlAddHom f X x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.sndAddHom_inlAddHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem sndAddHom_inlAddHom (x : (shift 1 M).obj X) :
    sndAddHom f X (inlAddHom f X x) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.fstHom_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem fstHom_inr (y : N.obj X) : (fstHom f).app X ((inr f).app X y) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.sndAddHom_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem sndAddHom_inr (y : N.obj X) : sndAddHom f X ((inr f).app X y) = y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {p q : (cone f).obj X} (h₁ : (fstHom f).app X p = (fstHom f).app X q)
    (h₂ : sndAddHom f X p = sndAddHom f X q) : p = q
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext h₁ h₂

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inlAddHom_fstHom_add_inr_sndAddHom
statement:
theorem inlAddHom_fstHom_add_inr_sndAddHom (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    inlAddHom f X ((fstHom f).app X p) + (inr f).app X (sndAddHom f X p) = p
proof:
:=
  ext (add_zero _) (zero_add _)

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_comp_fstHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_comp_fstHom : inr f ≫ fstHom f = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {k : ℤ} {p : (cone f).obj X} :
    p ∈ grading k ↔ (fstHom f).app X p ∈ grading k ∧ sndAddHom f X p ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  Prod.mem_grading

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inlAddHom_mem
statement:
theorem inlAddHom_mem {k : ℤ} {x : (shift 1 M).obj X} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    inlAddHom f X x ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff.mpr ⟨hx, zero_mem _⟩

name: DG.CatModule.cone.sndAddHom_mem
statement:
theorem sndAddHom_mem {k : ℤ} {p : (cone f).obj X} (hp : p ∈ grading k) :
    sndAddHom f X p ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  (mem_grading_iff.mp hp).2

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inlAddHom_smul
statement:
theorem inlAddHom_smul {Y : C} (g : X ⟶ Y) (x : (shift 1 M).obj X) :
    inlAddHom f Y (g • x) = g • inlAddHom f X x
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext rfl (smul_zero (M := N) g).symm

name: DG.CatModule.cone.sndAddHom_smul
statement:
theorem sndAddHom_smul {Y : C} (g : X ⟶ Y) (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    sndAddHom f Y (g • p) = g • sndAddHom f X p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.fstHom_d
statement: theorem fstHom_d (p : (cone f).obj X) : (fstHom f).app X (d p) = d ((fstHom f).app X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.sndAddHom_d
statement:
theorem sndAddHom_d (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    sndAddHom f X (d p) = f.app X (shift.unmk 1 ((fstHom f).app X p)) + d (sndAddHom f X p)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.d_inlAddHom
statement:
theorem d_inlAddHom (x : (shift 1 M).obj X) :
    d (inlAddHom f X x) = inlAddHom f X (d x) + (inr f).app X (f.app X (shift.unmk 1 x))
proof:
:=
  ext (by simp) (by simp [sndAddHom_d])

name: DG.CatModule.cone.fstHom_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fstHom_map (h : f ≫ g = e ≫ f') (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    (fstHom f').app X ((map e g h).app X p) = (shiftMap 1 e).app X ((fstHom f).app X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.sndAddHom_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sndAddHom_map (h : f ≫ g = e ≫ f') (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    sndAddHom f' X ((map e g h).app X p) = g.app X (sndAddHom f X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_comp_map
statement: theorem inr_comp_map (h : f ≫ g = e ≫ f') : inr f ≫ map e g h = g ≫ inr f'
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun X _ => ext (map_zero ((shiftMap 1 e).app X)) rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.map_comp_fstHom
statement:
theorem map_comp_fstHom (h : f ≫ g = e ≫ f') :
    map e g h ≫ fstHom f' = fstHom f ≫ shiftMap 1 e
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.pathObj.π_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem π_app {X : C} (p : (pathObj N).obj X) : (π N).app X p = p.1
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.pathObj.homotopy_app
statement:
theorem homotopy_app {X : C} (p : (pathObj N).obj X) :
    (homotopy N).app X p = shift.unmk (-1) p.2
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.pathObj.ofHom_π
statement: theorem ofHom_π : Cochain.ofHom (π N) = δ (-1) 0 (homotopy N)
proof:
:= by
  ext X p
  rw [Cochain.ofHom_apply, δ_neg_one_apply, homotopy_app, homotopy_app, π_app]
  change p.1 = d (shift.unmk (-1) p.2) + shift.unmk (-1) (shift.mk (-1) p.1 + d p.2)
  rw [map_add, shift.unmk_mk, shift.unmk_d, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_neg, Int.negOnePow_one,
    Units.neg_smul, one_smul]
  abel

name: DG.CatModule.pathObj.homotopic_π_zero
statement: theorem homotopic_π_zero : Homotopic (π N) 0
proof:
:=
  mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists.mpr ⟨homotopy N, ofHom_π N⟩

name: DG.CatModule.pathObj.lift_π
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem lift_π (f : M ⟶ N) (h : Cochain M N (-1)) (hh : Cochain.ofHom f = δ (-1) 0 h) :
    lift f h hh ≫ π N = f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_zero_iff_exists_lift
statement:
theorem homotopic_zero_iff_exists_lift (f : M ⟶ N) :
    Homotopic f 0 ↔ ∃ H : M ⟶ pathObj N, H ≫ pathObj.π N = f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists.mp hf
    exact ⟨pathObj.lift f h hh, pathObj.lift_π f h hh⟩
  · rintro ⟨H, rfl⟩
    exact (Homotopic.comp_left (pathObj.homotopic_π_zero N) H).trans
      (Homotopic.of_eq Limits.comp_zero)

name: DG.CatModule.pathObj.precompIso_hom_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem precompIso_hom_π (N : CatModule.{w} D) :
    (precompIso F N).hom ≫ (precomp F).map (π N) = π ((precomp F).obj N)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.map_twist
statement:
theorem map_twist (n : ℤ) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    F.map (DG.CatModule.twist n f) = DG.CatModule.twist n (F.map f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rw [DG.CatModule.twist_of_mem f.2, DG.CatModule.twist_of_mem (F.map_mem_grading f.2),
      Units.smul_def, F.map_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => simp only [_root_.map_add, Functor.map_add, hf, hf']

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.precomp_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Cochain.precomp_app {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain M N n) (X : C)
    (x : (precompObj F M).obj X) : (z.precomp F).app X x = z.app (F.obj X) x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.precomp_add
statement:
theorem Cochain.precomp_add {n : ℤ} (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) :
    (z₁ + z₂).precomp F = z₁.precomp F + z₂.precomp F
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.precomp_ofHom
statement:
theorem Cochain.precomp_ofHom (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    (Cochain.ofHom φ).precomp F = Cochain.ofHom ((CatModule.precomp F).map φ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.precomp_δ
statement:
theorem Cochain.precomp_δ {n m : ℤ} (z : Cochain M N n) :
    (δ n m z).precomp F = δ n m (z.precomp F)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · ext X x
    rw [Cochain.precomp_app, δ_apply _ _ hnm, δ_apply _ _ hnm]
    rfl
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm, δ_shape _ _ hnm]
    rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.precomp_map_quotient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precomp_map_quotient_map {M N : CatModule.{w} D} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (precomp F).map ((quotient D).map f) = (quotient C).map ((CatModule.precomp F).map f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.precompShiftIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompShiftIso_hom_app (n : ℤ) (M : CatModule.{w} D) (X : C)
    (m : (precompObj F (shift n M)).obj X) : (precompShiftIso F n M).hom.app X m = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.precompShiftIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompShiftIso_inv_app (n : ℤ) (M : CatModule.{w} D) (X : C)
    (m : (shift n (precompObj F M)).obj X) : (precompShiftIso F n M).inv.app X m = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.precomp_commShiftIso_hom_app_app
statement:
theorem precomp_commShiftIso_hom_app_app (n : ℤ) (M : CatModule.{w} D) (X : C)
    (m : (precompObj F (shift n M)).obj X) :
    (((CatModule.precomp F).commShiftIso n).hom.app M).app X m = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.precompIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem precompIso_hom_app (X : C) (p : (precompObj F (cone φ)).obj X) :
    (precompIso F φ).hom.app X p = p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homCochain_app {k : ℤ} (z : CatModule.Cochain N N' k) (Y : C) (w : HOM (B.left Y) N) :
    (B.homCochain z).app Y w = HOM.postcompCochain z w
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_add
statement:
theorem homCochain_add {k : ℤ} (z z' : CatModule.Cochain N N' k) :
    B.homCochain (z + z') = B.homCochain z + B.homCochain z'
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun _ w => HOM.postcompCochain_add z z' w

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_neg
statement:
theorem homCochain_neg {k : ℤ} (z : CatModule.Cochain N N' k) :
    B.homCochain (-z) = -B.homCochain z
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun _ w => HOM.postcompCochain_neg z w

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_zero
statement:
theorem homCochain_zero (k : ℤ) :
    B.homCochain (0 : CatModule.Cochain N N' k) = 0
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun _ w => HOM.postcompCochain_zero w

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_units_smul
statement:
theorem homCochain_units_smul {k : ℤ} (u : ℤˣ) (z : CatModule.Cochain N N' k) :
    B.homCochain (u • z) = u • B.homCochain z
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun _ w => HOM.postcompCochain_units_smul u z w

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_comp
statement:
theorem homCochain_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : CatModule.Cochain N N' n₁)
    (z₂ : CatModule.Cochain N' N'' n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) :
    B.homCochain (z₂.comp z₁ h) = (B.homCochain z₂).comp (B.homCochain z₁) h
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun _ w => by
    rw [CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, homCochain_app, homCochain_app, homCochain_app,
      HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain]
    exact HOM.postcompCochain_congr h.symm (fun _ _ => rfl) w

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_id
statement: theorem homCochain_id : B.homCochain (CatModule.Cochain.id N) = CatModule.Cochain.id _
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun _ w => HOM.postcompCochain_id w

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_ofHom
statement:
theorem homCochain_ofHom (φ : N ⟶ N') :
    B.homCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom φ) = CatModule.Cochain.ofHom (B.homMap φ)
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun _ _ => rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.homCochain_δ
statement:
theorem homCochain_δ {k : ℤ} (z : CatModule.Cochain N N' k) (m : ℤ) :
    CatModule.δ k m (B.homCochain z) = B.homCochain (CatModule.δ k m z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hkm : k + 1 = m
  · subst hkm
    refine CatModule.Cochain.ext fun Y w => ?_
    rw [CatModule.δ_apply _ _ rfl, homCochain_app, homCochain_app, homCochain_app]
    exact (eq_sub_of_add_eq (HOM.d_postcompCochain z w).symm).symm
  · rw [CatModule.δ_shape _ _ hkm, CatModule.δ_shape _ _ hkm, homCochain_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.homMap
statement:
theorem Homotopic.homMap {f g : N ⟶ N'} (h : Homotopic f g) :
    Homotopic (B.homMap f) (B.homMap g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.homMap B⟩

name: DG.CatBimodule.map_units
statement:
private theorem map_units {A A' : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup A'] (f : A →+ A')
    (u : ℤˣ) (x : A) : f (u • x) = u • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.CatBimodule.pathIncl₁_app
statement: theorem pathIncl₁_app {X : D} (x : N.obj X) : (pathIncl₁ N).app X x = (x, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.pathIncl₂_app
statement:
theorem pathIncl₂_app {X : D} (x : N.obj X) :
    (pathIncl₂ N).app X x = (0, CatModule.shift.mk (-1) x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.δ_pathIncl₁
statement: theorem δ_pathIncl₁ : CatModule.δ 0 1 (pathIncl₁ N) = pathIncl₂ N
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_
  rw [CatModule.δ_zero_cochain_apply, pathIncl₁_app, pathIncl₁_app, pathIncl₂_app]
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · exact sub_self _
  · change CatModule.shift.mk (-1) x + d (0 : (CatModule.shift (-1) N).obj X) -
      (0 : (CatModule.shift (-1) N).obj X) = CatModule.shift.mk (-1) x
    rw [d_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]

name: DG.CatBimodule.δ_pathIncl₂
statement: theorem δ_pathIncl₂ : CatModule.δ 1 2 (pathIncl₂ N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_
  rw [CatModule.δ_apply 1 2 rfl, pathIncl₂_app, pathIncl₂_app, CatModule.Cochain.zero_apply]
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · change d (0 : N.obj X) - koszulSign 1 • (0 : N.obj X) = 0
    rw [d_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  · change CatModule.shift.mk (-1) (0 : N.obj X) +
      d (CatModule.shift.mk (M := N) (X := X) (-1) x) -
      koszulSign 1 • CatModule.shift.mk (M := N) (-1) (d x) = 0
    rw [CatModule.shift.d_mk, map_zero, zero_add, ← CatModule.shift.mk_units_smul, sub_eq_zero,
      koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_neg]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPathMap_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem homPathMap_π : B.homPathMap N ≫ B.homMap (CatModule.pathObj.π N) =
    CatModule.pathObj.π (B.homObj N)
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.hom_ext fun Y p => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
  change HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom (CatModule.pathObj.π N))
    (HOM.postcompCochain (pathIncl₁ N) a +
      HOM.postcompCochain (pathIncl₂ N) (CatModule.shift.unmk (-1) b)) = a
  rw [map_add, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
    HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self (add_zero 0) (fun _ _ => rfl),
    HOM.postcompCochain_eq_zero (fun _ _ => rfl), add_zero]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPathMap_inv
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem homPathMap_inv : B.homPathMap N ≫ B.homPathInv N = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.hom_ext fun Y p => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := CatModule.shift.mk_surjective (n := -1) b
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · change HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom (CatModule.pathObj.π N))
      (HOM.postcompCochain (pathIncl₁ N) a + HOM.postcompCochain (pathIncl₂ N)
        (CatModule.shift.unmk (-1) (CatModule.shift.mk (-1) b))) = a
    rw [map_add, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self (add_zero 0) (fun _ _ => rfl),
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_zero (fun _ _ => rfl), add_zero]
  · change CatModule.shift.mk (M := B.homObj N) (-1)
      (HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.pathObj.homotopy N)
        (HOM.postcompCochain (pathIncl₁ N) a + HOM.postcompCochain (pathIncl₂ N)
          (CatModule.shift.unmk (-1) (CatModule.shift.mk (-1) b)))) = CatModule.shift.mk (-1) b
    rw [map_add, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_zero (fun _ _ => rfl),
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self (add_neg_cancel 1) (fun _ _ => rfl), zero_add,
      CatModule.shift.unmk_mk]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPathInv_map
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem homPathInv_map : B.homPathInv N ≫ B.homPathMap N = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.hom_ext fun Y w => ?_
  change HOM.postcompCochain (pathIncl₁ N)
      (HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom (CatModule.pathObj.π N)) w) +
    HOM.postcompCochain (pathIncl₂ N) (HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.pathObj.homotopy N) w) = w
  rw [HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
    HOM.postcompCochain_congr (neg_add_cancel 1) (z' := (pathIncl₂ N).comp
      (CatModule.pathObj.homotopy N) (neg_add_cancel 1)) (fun _ _ => rfl) w,
    HOM.postcompCochain_congr (add_zero 0) (z' := (pathIncl₁ N).comp
      (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom (CatModule.pathObj.π N)) (add_zero 0)) (fun _ _ => rfl) w,
    ← HOM.postcompCochain_add]
  exact HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self rfl (fun X (p : (CatModule.pathObj N).obj X) =>
    Prod.ext (add_zero p.1) (zero_add p.2)) w

name: DG.CatBimodule.shiftUnmkCochain_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftUnmkCochain_app {X : D} (x : (CatModule.shift n N).obj X) :
    (shiftUnmkCochain n N).app X x = CatModule.shift.unmk n x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.shiftMkCochain_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftMkCochain_app {X : D} (x : N.obj X) :
    (shiftMkCochain n N).app X x = CatModule.shift.mk n x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.δ_shiftUnmkCochain
statement: theorem δ_shiftUnmkCochain : CatModule.δ n (n + 1) (shiftUnmkCochain n N) = 0
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => by
