    rw [CatModule.δ_apply _ _ rfl, shiftUnmkCochain_app, shiftUnmkCochain_app,
      CatModule.shift.unmk_d, CatModule.Cochain.zero_apply, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self,
      one_smul, sub_self]

name: DG.CatBimodule.δ_shiftMkCochain
statement: theorem δ_shiftMkCochain : CatModule.δ (-n) (-n + 1) (shiftMkCochain n N) = 0
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => by
    rw [CatModule.δ_apply _ _ rfl, shiftMkCochain_app, shiftMkCochain_app,
      CatModule.shift.d_mk, CatModule.Cochain.zero_apply]
    simp only [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_neg]
    rw [← CatModule.shift.mk_units_smul, sub_self]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homShiftHom_inv
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem homShiftHom_inv : B.homShiftHom n N ≫ B.homShiftInv n N = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun Y w => by
    change HOM.postcompCochain (shiftMkCochain n N)
      (HOM.postcompCochain (shiftUnmkCochain n N) w) = w
    rw [HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain]
    exact HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self (add_neg_cancel n) (fun _ _ => rfl) w

name: DG.CatBimodule.homShiftInv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem homShiftInv_hom : B.homShiftInv n N ≫ B.homShiftHom n N = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun Y w => by
    change CatModule.shift.mk (M := B.homObj N) n (HOM.postcompCochain (shiftUnmkCochain n N)
      (HOM.postcompCochain (shiftMkCochain n N) (CatModule.shift.unmk n w))) = w
    rw [HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_eq_self (neg_add_cancel n) (fun _ _ => rfl), CatModule.shift.mk_unmk]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homShiftHom_app
statement:
theorem homShiftHom_app (Y : C) (w : (B.homObj (CatModule.shift n N)).obj Y) :
    (B.homShiftHom n N).app Y w =
      CatModule.shift.mk n (HOM.postcompCochain (shiftUnmkCochain n N) w)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.homShiftHom_naturality
statement:
theorem homShiftHom_naturality {N' : CatModule.{w} D} (φ : N ⟶ N') :
    B.homMap (CatModule.shiftMap n φ) ≫ B.homShiftHom n N' =
      B.homShiftHom n N ≫ CatModule.shiftMap n (B.homMap φ)
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun Y w => by
    change CatModule.shift.mk (M := B.homObj N') n (HOM.postcompCochain (shiftUnmkCochain n N')
        (HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom (CatModule.shiftMap n φ)) w)) =
      CatModule.shift.mk (M := B.homObj N') n (HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom φ)
        (HOM.postcompCochain (shiftUnmkCochain n N) w))
    rw [HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain]
    exact congrArg _ (HOM.postcompCochain_congr (k := 0 + n) (k' := n + 0) (by omega)
      (fun _ _ => rfl) w)

name: DG.CatBimodule.homShiftHom_add
statement:
theorem homShiftHom_add (a b : ℤ) :
    B.homShiftHom (a + b) N = B.homMap (CatModule.shiftShiftIso N a b (a + b) rfl).hom ≫
      B.homShiftHom b (CatModule.shift a N) ≫ CatModule.shiftMap b (B.homShiftHom a N) ≫
      (CatModule.shiftShiftIso (B.homObj N) a b (a + b) rfl).inv
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun Y w => by
    rw [CatModule.comp_app, CatModule.comp_app, CatModule.comp_app,
      CatModule.shiftShiftIso_inv_app, CatModule.unmk_shiftMap_app, homShiftHom_app,
      homShiftHom_app, homShiftHom_app, homMap_app, CatModule.shift.unmk_mk,
      CatModule.shift.unmk_mk, HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain,
      HOM.postcompCochain_postcompCochain]
    refine congrArg (CatModule.shift.mk (M := B.homObj N) (X := Y) (a + b)) ?_
    apply HOM.postcompCochain_congr
    · omega
    · intro _ _
      rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.homFunctor_commShiftIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem homFunctor_commShiftIso_hom_app (N : CatModule.{w} D) :
    ((B.homFunctor).commShiftIso n).hom.app N = B.homShiftHom n N
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_apply
statement: theorem inl_apply (x : M.obj X) : (inl f).app X x = inlAddHom f X (shift.mk 1 x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.snd_apply
statement: theorem snd_apply (p : (cone f).obj X) : (snd f).app X p = sndAddHom f X p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.fst_apply
statement: theorem fst_apply (p : (cone f).obj X) : (fst f).1.app X p = shift.unmk 1 ((fstHom f).app X p)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_snd_apply (x : M.obj X) : (snd f).app X ((inl f).app X x) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_snd_apply (y : N.obj X) : (snd f).app X ((inr f).app X y) = y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_fst_apply (x : M.obj X) : (fst f).1.app X ((inl f).app X x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_fst_apply (y : N.obj X) : (fst f).1.app X ((inr f).app X y) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_d_apply
statement: theorem inr_d_apply (y : N.obj X) : d ((inr f).app X y) = (inr f).app X (d y)
proof:
:=
  ((inr f).map_d y).symm

name: DG.CatModule.cone.id_X
statement:
theorem id_X (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    (inl f).app X ((fst f).1.app X p) + (inr f).app X ((snd f).app X p) = p
proof:
:=
  inlAddHom_fstHom_add_inr_sndAddHom p

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ext_to
statement:
theorem ext_to {p q : (cone f).obj X} (h₁ : (fst f).1.app X p = (fst f).1.app X q)
    (h₂ : (snd f).app X p = (snd f).app X q) : p = q
proof:
:=
  ext (shift.unmk_injective h₁) h₂

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ext_to_iff
statement:
theorem ext_to_iff {p q : (cone f).obj X} :
    p = q ↔ (fst f).1.app X p = (fst f).1.app X q ∧ (snd f).app X p = (snd f).app X q
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, fun h => ext_to h.1 h.2⟩

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ext_from
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun p => by rw [← id_X p, map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.d_fst_apply
statement: theorem d_fst_apply (p : (cone f).obj X) : (fst f).1.app X (d p) = -d ((fst f).1.app X p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fst_apply, fst_apply, fstHom_d, shift.unmk_d, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_one,
    Units.neg_smul, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.d_snd_apply
statement:
theorem d_snd_apply (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    (snd f).app X (d p) = f.app X ((fst f).1.app X p) + d ((snd f).app X p)
proof:
:=
  sndAddHom_d p

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_d_apply
statement:
theorem inl_d_apply (x : M.obj X) :
    d ((inl f).app X x) = (inr f).app X (f.app X x) - (inl f).app X (d x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_to ?_ ?_
  · rw [d_fst_apply, map_sub, inl_fst_apply, inr_fst_apply, inl_fst_apply, zero_sub]
  · rw [d_snd_apply, map_sub, inl_fst_apply, inl_snd_apply, inr_snd_apply, inl_snd_apply,
      d_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_snd : (snd f).comp (inl f) (add_zero (-1)) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_snd : (snd f).comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add 0) = Cochain.id N
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_snd_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_snd_assoc {d e g : ℤ} (γ : Cochain N K d) (he : 0 + d = e) (hg : -1 + e = g) :
    (γ.comp (snd f) he).comp (inl f) hg = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  simp

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_snd_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_snd_assoc {d e : ℤ} (γ : Cochain N K d) (he : 0 + d = e) :
    (γ.comp (snd f) he).comp (ofHom (inr f)) (by rw [← he, zero_add, zero_add]) = γ
proof:
:= by
  ext X y
  simp

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_fst : (fst f).1.comp (inl f) (neg_add_cancel 1) = Cochain.id M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_fst : (fst f).1.comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add 1) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_fst_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_fst_assoc {d e : ℤ} (γ : Cochain M K d) (he : 1 + d = e) :
    (γ.comp (fst f).1 he).comp (inl f) (by rw [← he, neg_add_cancel_left]) = γ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_fst_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_fst_assoc {d e g : ℤ} (γ : Cochain M K d) (he : 1 + d = e) (hg : 0 + e = g) :
    (γ.comp (fst f).1 he).comp (ofHom (inr f)) hg = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext X y
  simp

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ext_cochain_to_iff
statement:
theorem ext_cochain_to_iff (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + 1 = j) {γ₁ γ₂ : Cochain K (cone f) i} :
    γ₁ = γ₂ ↔ (fst f).1.comp γ₁ hij = (fst f).1.comp γ₂ hij ∧
      (snd f).comp γ₁ (add_zero i) = (snd f).comp γ₂ (add_zero i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h ▸ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => Cochain.ext fun X x => ext_to ?_ ?_⟩
  · exact congrArg (fun γ : Cochain K M j => γ.app X x) h₁
  · exact congrArg (fun γ : Cochain K N i => γ.app X x) h₂

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ext_cochain_from_iff
statement:
theorem ext_cochain_from_iff (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + 1 = j) {γ₁ γ₂ : Cochain (cone f) K j} :
    γ₁ = γ₂ ↔ γ₁.comp (inl f) (show -1 + j = i by omega) = γ₂.comp (inl f) (by omega) ∧
      γ₁.comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add j) = γ₂.comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => h ▸ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => Cochain.ext fun X p => ?_⟩
  refine congrArg (fun g : (cone f).obj X →+ K.obj X => g p)
    (ext_from (g₁ := γ₁.app X) (g₂ := γ₂.app X) (fun x => ?_) (fun y => ?_))
  · exact congrArg (fun γ : Cochain M K i => γ.app X x) h₁
  · exact congrArg (fun γ : Cochain N K j => γ.app X y) h₂

name: DG.CatModule.cone.id
statement:
theorem id :
    (inl f).comp (fst f).1 (add_neg_cancel 1) + (ofHom (inr f)).comp (snd f) (add_zero 0) =
      Cochain.id (cone f)
proof:
:=
  Cochain.ext fun _ => id_X

name: DG.CatModule.cone.δ_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_inl : δ (-1) 0 (inl f) = ofHom (f ≫ inr f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_
  rw [δ_neg_one_apply, inl_d_apply, ofHom_apply, comp_app, sub_add_cancel]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.δ_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_snd : δ 0 1 (snd f) = -(ofHom f).comp (fst f).1 (add_zero 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext X p
  rw [δ_zero_cochain_apply, d_snd_apply, Cochain.neg_apply, DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, ofHom_apply]
  abel

name: DG.CatModule.cone.fstHom_eq
statement: theorem fstHom_eq : fstHom f = Cocycle.homOf ((fst f).rightShift 1 0 (zero_add 1))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ofHom_fstHom
statement: theorem ofHom_fstHom : ofHom (fstHom f) = (fst f).1.rightShift 1 0 (zero_add 1)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.descCochain_apply
statement:
theorem descCochain_apply (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    (descCochain f α β h).app X p = α.app X ((fst f).1.app X p) + β.app X ((snd f).app X p)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_descCochain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_descCochain :
    (descCochain f α β h).comp (inl f) (by omega) = α
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  simp [descCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_descCochain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_descCochain :
    (descCochain f α β h).comp (ofHom (inr f)) (zero_add n) = β
proof:
:= by
  ext X y
  simp [descCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_descCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_descCochain_apply (x : M.obj X) :
    (descCochain f α β h).app X ((inl f).app X x) = α.app X x
proof:
:= by
  simp [descCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_descCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_descCochain_apply (y : N.obj X) :
    (descCochain f α β h).app X ((inr f).app X y) = β.app X y
proof:
:= by
  simp [descCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.δ_descCochain
statement:
theorem δ_descCochain (n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + 1 = n') :
    δ n n' (descCochain f α β h) =
      (δ m n α + koszulSign n' • β.comp (ofHom f) (zero_add n)).comp (fst f).1
          (by omega) +
        (δ n n' β).comp (snd f) (zero_add n')
proof:
:= by
  ext X p
  have hm : koszulSign m = -koszulSign n := by
    rw [← h, koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ, neg_neg]
  have hn : koszulSign n' = -koszulSign n := by
    rw [← hn', koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ]
  simp only [δ_apply _ _ hn', δ_apply _ _ h, descCochain_apply, Cochain.add_apply, DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply,
    units_smul_apply, Cochain.neg_apply, ofHom_apply, d_fst_apply, d_snd_apply, map_add, map_neg,
    hm, hn, Units.neg_smul, _root_.smul_add, _root_.smul_neg,
    sub_eq_add_neg, neg_neg]
  abel

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ofHom_desc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_desc : ofHom (desc f α β eq) = descCochain f α (ofHom β) (neg_add_cancel 1)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.desc_apply
statement:
theorem desc_apply (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    (desc f α β eq).app X p = α.app X ((fst f).1.app X p) + β.app X ((snd f).app X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_desc_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inl_desc_apply (x : M.obj X) : (desc f α β eq).app X ((inl f).app X x) = α.app X x
proof:
:= by
  simp [desc_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inl_desc
statement: theorem inl_desc : (ofHom (desc f α β eq)).comp (inl f) (add_zero _) = α
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  simp

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_desc_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_desc_apply (y : N.obj X) : (desc f α β eq).app X ((inr f).app X y) = β.app X y
proof:
:= by
  simp [desc_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_desc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inr_desc : inr f ≫ desc f α β eq = β
proof:
:= by
  ext X y
  simp

name: DG.CatModule.cone.liftCochain_apply
statement:
theorem liftCochain_apply (k : K.obj X) :
    (liftCochain f α β h).app X k = (inl f).app X (α.app X k) + (inr f).app X (β.app X k)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.liftCochain_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_fst : (fst f).1.comp (liftCochain f α β h) h = α
proof:
:= by
  ext X k
  simp [liftCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.liftCochain_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_snd : (snd f).comp (liftCochain f α β h) (add_zero n) = β
proof:
:= by
  ext X k
  simp [liftCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.liftCochain_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_fst_apply (k : K.obj X) :
    (fst f).1.app X ((liftCochain f α β h).app X k) = α.app X k
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.liftCochain_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_snd_apply (k : K.obj X) :
    (snd f).app X ((liftCochain f α β h).app X k) = β.app X k
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.δ_liftCochain
statement:
theorem δ_liftCochain (m' : ℤ) (hm' : m + 1 = m') :
    δ n m (liftCochain f α β h) = -(inl f).comp (δ m m' α) (by omega) +
      (ofHom (inr f)).comp (δ n m β + (ofHom f).comp α (add_zero m)) (add_zero m)
proof:
:= by
  refine Cochain.ext fun X k => ?_
  have hm : koszulSign m = -koszulSign n := by
    rw [← h, koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ]
  refine ext_to ?_ ?_
  · simp only [δ_apply _ _ h, δ_apply _ _ hm', liftCochain_apply, Cochain.add_apply,
      Cochain.neg_apply, DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, map_add, map_sub, map_neg, map_units_smul,
      inl_d_apply, inr_d_apply, inl_fst_apply, inr_fst_apply, hm, Units.neg_smul,
      ofHom_apply, _root_.smul_zero, add_zero]
    abel
  · simp only [δ_apply _ _ h, δ_apply _ _ hm', liftCochain_apply, Cochain.add_apply,
      Cochain.neg_apply, DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, ofHom_apply, map_add, map_sub, map_neg,
      map_units_smul, inl_d_apply, inr_d_apply, inl_snd_apply, inr_snd_apply, zero_add,
      _root_.smul_zero]
    abel

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ofHom_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_lift : ofHom (lift f α β eq) = liftCochain f α.1 β (zero_add 1)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.lift_apply
statement:
theorem lift_apply (k : K.obj X) :
    (lift f α β eq).app X k = (inl f).app X (α.1.app X k) + (inr f).app X (β.app X k)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.lift_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_fst_apply (k : K.obj X) : (fst f).1.app X ((lift f α β eq).app X k) = α.1.app X k
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.lift_fst
statement: theorem lift_fst : (fst f).1.comp (ofHom (lift f α β eq)) (zero_add 1) = α.1
proof:
:= by
  ext X k
  simp

name: DG.CatModule.cone.lift_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_snd_apply (k : K.obj X) : (snd f).app X ((lift f α β eq).app X k) = β.app X k
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.lift_snd
statement: theorem lift_snd : (snd f).comp (ofHom (lift f α β eq)) (zero_add 0) = β
proof:
:= by
  ext X k
  simp

name: DG.CatModule.cone.liftCochain_descCochain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftCochain_descCochain :
    (descCochain f α' β' h').comp (liftCochain f α β h) hp =
      α'.comp α (by omega) + β'.comp β (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  ext X k
  simp [liftCochain_apply, descCochain_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.lift_desc_apply
statement:
theorem lift_desc_apply (α : Cocycle K M 1) (β : Cochain K N 0)
    (eq : δ 0 1 β + (ofHom f).comp α.1 (add_zero 1) = 0)
    (α' : Cochain M L (-1)) (β' : N ⟶ L) (eq' : δ (-1) 0 α' = ofHom (f ≫ β'))
    (k : K.obj X) :
    (desc f α' β' eq').app X ((lift f α β eq).app X k) =
      α'.app X (α.1.app X k) + β'.app X (β.app X k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [desc_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.mapOfHomotopy_apply
statement:
theorem mapOfHomotopy_apply (H : DGHomotopy (f₁ ≫ b) (a ≫ f₂)) (p : (cone f₁).obj X) :
    (mapOfHomotopy H).app X p =
      (inl f₂).app X (a.app X ((fst f₁).1.app X p)) +
        (inr f₂).app X (H.hom.app X ((fst f₁).1.app X p) + b.app X ((snd f₁).app X p))
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapOfHomotopy, desc_apply, map_add]
  abel

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_comp_mapOfHomotopy
statement:
theorem inr_comp_mapOfHomotopy (H : DGHomotopy (f₁ ≫ b) (a ≫ f₂)) :
    inr f₁ ≫ mapOfHomotopy H = b ≫ inr f₂
proof:
:=
  inr_desc _ _ _ _

name: DG.CatModule.cone.mapOfHomotopy_comp_fstHom
statement:
theorem mapOfHomotopy_comp_fstHom (H : DGHomotopy (f₁ ≫ b) (a ≫ f₂)) :
    mapOfHomotopy H ≫ fstHom f₂ = fstHom f₁ ≫ shiftMap 1 a
proof:
:= by
  ext X p
  simp [mapOfHomotopy, desc_apply, fstHom_eq]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.map_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_fst_apply (h : f₁ ≫ b = a ≫ f₂) (p : (cone f₁).obj X) :
    (fst f₂).1.app X ((map a b h).app X p) = a.app X ((fst f₁).1.app X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.map_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_snd_apply (h : f₁ ≫ b = a ≫ f₂) (p : (cone f₁).obj X) :
    (snd f₂).app X ((map a b h).app X p) = b.app X ((snd f₁).app X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.map_eq_desc
statement:
theorem map_eq_desc (h : f₁ ≫ b = a ≫ f₂) :
    map a b h = desc f₁ ((inl f₂).comp (ofHom a) (zero_add _)) (b ≫ inr f₂) (by
      rw [δ_ofHom_comp, δ_inl, ← ofHom_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← h, Category.assoc])
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X p => ext_to ?_ ?_ <;> simp [desc_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.map_eq_mapOfHomotopy
statement:
theorem map_eq_mapOfHomotopy (h : f₁ ≫ b = a ≫ f₂) :
    map a b h = mapOfHomotopy (DGHomotopy.ofEq h)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X p => ext_to ?_ ?_ <;> simp [mapOfHomotopy_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (𝟙 M) (𝟙 N) (by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]) = 𝟙 (cone f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {a' : M₂ ⟶ M₃} {b' : N₂ ⟶ N₃} (h : f₁ ≫ b = a ≫ f₂)
    (h' : f₂ ≫ b' = a' ≫ f₃) :
    map (a ≫ a') (b ≫ b') (by rw [← Category.assoc, h, Category.assoc, h', Category.assoc]) =
      map a b h ≫ map a' b' h'
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.isContractible_id
statement: theorem isContractible_id : IsContractible (cone (𝟙 M))
proof:
:=
  ⟨homotopyToZeroOfId M⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShift_apply (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (z.rightShift a n' hn').app X x = shift.mk a (z.app X x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.unmk_rightShift_apply
statement:
theorem unmk_rightShift_apply (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    shift.unmk a ((z.rightShift a n' hn').app X x) = z.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_apply
statement:
theorem leftShift_apply (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') {X : C} (x : (shift a M).obj X) :
    (z.leftShift a n' hn').app X x = leftShiftSign a n' • z.app X (shift.unmk a x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_apply_mk (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (z.leftShift a n' hn').app X (shift.mk a x) = leftShiftSign a n' • z.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_apply
statement:
theorem shift_apply (a : ℤ) {X : C} (x : (CatModule.shift a M).obj X) :
    (z.shift a).app X x = shift.mk a (z.app X (shift.unmk a x))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_apply_mk (a : ℤ) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (z.shift a).app X (shift.mk a x) = shift.mk a (z.app X x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightUnshift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightUnshift_apply {n' a : ℤ} (z : Cochain M (CatModule.shift a N) n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n' + a = n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (z.rightUnshift n hn).app X x = shift.unmk a (z.app X x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftUnshift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftUnshift_apply {n' a : ℤ} (z : Cochain (CatModule.shift a M) N n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n + a = n') {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (z.leftUnshift n hn).app X x = leftShiftSign a n' • z.app X (shift.mk a x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightUnshift_rightShift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightUnshift_rightShift (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) :
    (z.rightShift a n' hn').rightUnshift n hn' = z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_rightUnshift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShift_rightUnshift {a n' : ℤ} (z : Cochain M (CatModule.shift a N) n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn' : n' + a = n) : (z.rightUnshift n hn').rightShift a n' hn' = z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftUnshift_leftShift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftUnshift_leftShift (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') :
    (z.leftShift a n' hn').leftUnshift n hn' = z
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  rw [leftUnshift_apply, leftShift_apply_mk, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_leftUnshift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_leftUnshift {a n' : ℤ} (z : Cochain (CatModule.shift a M) N n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn' : n + a = n') : (z.leftUnshift n hn').leftShift a n' hn' = z
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := shift.mk_surjective x
  rw [leftShift_apply_mk, leftUnshift_apply, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShift_add (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) :
    (z₁ + z₂).rightShift a n' hn' = z₁.rightShift a n' hn' + z₂.rightShift a n' hn'
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ _ => map_add (shift.mk a) _ _

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_add (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') :
    (z₁ + z₂).leftShift a n' hn' = z₁.leftShift a n' hn' + z₂.leftShift a n' hn'
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  rw [leftShift_apply, Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.add_apply, leftShift_apply, leftShift_apply,
    _root_.smul_add]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_add (a : ℤ) : (z₁ + z₂).shift a = z₁.shift a + z₂.shift a
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ _ => map_add (shift.mk a) _ _

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShift_zero (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) :
    (0 : Cochain M N n).rightShift a n' hn' = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn')

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightUnshift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightUnshift_zero (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) :
    (0 : Cochain M (CatModule.shift a N) n').rightUnshift n hn' = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn').symm

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_zero (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') :
    (0 : Cochain M N n).leftShift a n' hn' = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn')

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftUnshift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftUnshift_zero (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') :
    (0 : Cochain (CatModule.shift a M) N n').leftUnshift n hn' = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn').symm

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_zero (a : ℤ) : (0 : Cochain M N n).shift a = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (shiftAddHom M N n a)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShift_neg (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) :
    (-z).rightShift a n' hn' = -z.rightShift a n' hn'
proof:
:=
  map_neg (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn') z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShift_sub (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) :
    (z₁ - z₂).rightShift a n' hn' = z₁.rightShift a n' hn' - z₂.rightShift a n' hn'
proof:
:=
  map_sub (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn') z₁ z₂

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightUnshift_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightUnshift_neg {n' a : ℤ} (z : Cochain M (CatModule.shift a N) n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n' + a = n) : (-z).rightUnshift n hn = -z.rightUnshift n hn
proof:
:=
  map_neg (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn).symm z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightUnshift_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightUnshift_add {n' a : ℤ} (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M (CatModule.shift a N) n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n' + a = n) :
    (z₁ + z₂).rightUnshift n hn = z₁.rightUnshift n hn + z₂.rightUnshift n hn
proof:
:=
  map_add (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn).symm z₁ z₂

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_neg (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') :
    (-z).leftShift a n' hn' = -z.leftShift a n' hn'
proof:
:=
  map_neg (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn') z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_sub (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') :
    (z₁ - z₂).leftShift a n' hn' = z₁.leftShift a n' hn' - z₂.leftShift a n' hn'
proof:
:=
  map_sub (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn') z₁ z₂

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftUnshift_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftUnshift_neg {n' a : ℤ} (z : Cochain (CatModule.shift a M) N n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n + a = n') : (-z).leftUnshift n hn = -z.leftUnshift n hn
proof:
:=
  map_neg (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn).symm z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftUnshift_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftUnshift_add {n' a : ℤ} (z₁ z₂ : Cochain (CatModule.shift a M) N n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n + a = n') :
    (z₁ + z₂).leftUnshift n hn = z₁.leftUnshift n hn + z₂.leftUnshift n hn
proof:
:=
  map_add (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn).symm z₁ z₂

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_neg (a : ℤ) : (-z).shift a = -z.shift a
proof: := map_neg (shiftAddHom M N n a) z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_sub (a : ℤ) : (z₁ - z₂).shift a = z₁.shift a - z₂.shift a
proof:
:=
  map_sub (shiftAddHom M N n a) z₁ z₂

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShift_zsmul (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) (k : ℤ) :
    (k • z).rightShift a n' hn' = k • z.rightShift a n' hn'
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn') k z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightShift_units_smul (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) (u : ℤˣ) :
    (u • z).rightShift a n' hn' = u • z.rightShift a n' hn'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, rightShift_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightUnshift_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightUnshift_units_smul {n' a : ℤ} (z : Cochain M (CatModule.shift a N) n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n' + a = n) (u : ℤˣ) : (u • z).rightUnshift n hn = u • z.rightUnshift n hn
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def]
  exact map_zsmul (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn).symm _ z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_zsmul (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') (k : ℤ) :
    (k • z).leftShift a n' hn' = k • z.leftShift a n' hn'
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn') k z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_units_smul (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') (u : ℤˣ) :
    (u • z).leftShift a n' hn' = u • z.leftShift a n' hn'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, leftShift_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftUnshift_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftUnshift_units_smul {n' a : ℤ} (z : Cochain (CatModule.shift a M) N n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n + a = n') (u : ℤˣ) : (u • z).leftUnshift n hn = u • z.leftUnshift n hn
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def]
  exact map_zsmul (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn).symm _ z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_zsmul (a k : ℤ) : (k • z).shift a = k • z.shift a
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (shiftAddHom M N n a) k z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_units_smul (a : ℤ) (u : ℤˣ) : (u • z).shift a = u • z.shift a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, shift_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_id (a : ℤ) : (Cochain.id M).shift a = Cochain.id (CatModule.shift a M)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_ofHom (φ : M ⟶ N) (a : ℤ) : (ofHom φ).shift a = ofHom (shiftMap a φ)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightUnshift_comp
statement:
theorem rightUnshift_comp {m a : ℤ} (z' : Cochain N (CatModule.shift a P) m) {nm : ℤ}
    (hnm : n + m = nm) (nm' : ℤ) (hnm' : nm + a = nm') (m' : ℤ) (hm' : m + a = m') :
    (z'.comp z hnm).rightUnshift nm' hnm' =
      (z'.rightUnshift m' hm').comp z (by rw [← hm', ← add_assoc, hnm, hnm'])
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_comp
statement:
theorem rightShift_comp {m : ℤ} (z' : Cochain N P m) {nm : ℤ} (hnm : n + m = nm)
    (a nm' : ℤ) (hnm' : nm' + a = nm) (m' : ℤ) (hm' : m' + a = m) :
    (z'.comp z hnm).rightShift a nm' hnm' =
      (z'.rightShift a m' hm').comp z (by
        rw [← add_left_inj a, add_assoc, hm', hnm, hnm'])
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_comp
statement:
theorem leftShift_comp (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') {m t t' : ℤ} (z' : Cochain N P m)
    (h : n + m = t) (ht' : t + a = t') :
    (z'.comp z h).leftShift a t' ht' = koszulSign (a * m) • z'.comp (z.leftShift a n' hn')
      (by rw [← ht', ← h, ← hn', add_assoc, add_comm a, add_assoc])
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  simp only [leftShift_apply, comp_apply, units_smul_apply, map_units_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [leftShiftSign, ← koszulSign_add]
  congr 1
  rw [← ht', ← h, ← hn']
  ring

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_comp_zero_cochain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftShift_comp_zero_cochain (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') (z' : Cochain N P 0) :
    (z'.comp z (add_zero n)).leftShift a n' hn' =
      z'.comp (z.leftShift a n' hn') (add_zero n')
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftShift_comp z a n' hn' z' (add_zero _) hn', mul_zero, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero,
    one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.shift_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_comp (a : ℤ) {m nm : ℤ} (z' : Cochain N P m) (h : n + m = nm) :
    (z'.comp z h).shift a = (z'.shift a).comp (z.shift a) h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.δ_rightShift
statement:
theorem δ_rightShift (a n' m' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) (m : ℤ) (hm' : m' + a = m) :
    δ n' m' (z.rightShift a n' hn') = koszulSign a • (δ n m z).rightShift a m' hm'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · have hnm' : n' + 1 = m' := by omega
    ext X x
    apply (shift.unmk a).injective
    simp only [δ_apply _ _ hnm', δ_apply _ _ hnm, rightShift_apply, units_smul_apply, map_sub,
      shift.unmk_d, shift.unmk_units_smul, shift.unmk_mk, _root_.smul_sub, smul_smul,
      ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 2
    rw [Int.negOnePow_eq_iff]
    exact ⟨-a, by omega⟩
  · have hnm' : ¬ n' + 1 = m' := fun _ => hnm (by omega)
    rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm', δ_shape _ _ hnm, rightShift_zero, _root_.smul_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.δ_rightUnshift
statement:
theorem δ_rightUnshift {a n' : ℤ} (z : Cochain M (CatModule.shift a N) n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n' + a = n) (m m' : ℤ) (hm' : m' + a = m) :
    δ n m (z.rightUnshift n hn) = koszulSign a • (δ n' m' z).rightUnshift m hm'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (rightShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn).surjective z
  simp only [rightShiftAddEquiv_apply, rightUnshift_rightShift, z.δ_rightShift a n' m' hn m hm',
    rightUnshift_units_smul, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.δ_leftShift
statement:
theorem δ_leftShift (a n' m' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') (m : ℤ) (hm' : m + a = m') :
    δ n' m' (z.leftShift a n' hn') = koszulSign a • (δ n m z).leftShift a m' hm'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · have hnm' : n' + 1 = m' := by omega
    ext X x
    simp only [δ_apply _ _ hnm', δ_apply _ _ hnm, leftShift_apply, units_smul_apply,
      shift.unmk_d, d_units_smul, map_units_smul, _root_.smul_sub, smul_smul,
      leftShiftSign, ← koszulSign_add]
    congr 2
    all_goals rw [← hnm', ← hn']
    · exact koszulSign_eq_of_sub_eq_two_mul (-a) (by ring)
    · congr 1
      ring
  · have hnm' : ¬ n' + 1 = m' := fun _ => hnm (by omega)
    rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm', δ_shape _ _ hnm, leftShift_zero, _root_.smul_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.δ_leftUnshift
statement:
theorem δ_leftUnshift {a n' : ℤ} (z : Cochain (CatModule.shift a M) N n') (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n + a = n') (m m' : ℤ) (hm' : m + a = m') :
    δ n m (z.leftUnshift n hn) = koszulSign a • (δ n' m' z).leftUnshift m hm'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (leftShiftAddEquiv M N n a n' hn).surjective z
  simp only [leftShiftAddEquiv_apply, leftUnshift_leftShift, z.δ_leftShift a n' m' hn m hm',
    leftUnshift_units_smul, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.δ_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_shift (a m : ℤ) : δ n m (z.shift a) = koszulSign a • (δ n m z).shift a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · ext X x
    apply (shift.unmk a).injective
    simp only [δ_apply _ _ hnm, shift_apply, units_smul_apply, map_sub, shift.unmk_d,
      shift.unmk_units_smul, shift.unmk_mk, map_units_smul, _root_.smul_sub,
      smul_smul]
    rw [mul_comm]
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm, δ_shape _ _ hnm, shift_zero, _root_.smul_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_rightShift
statement:
theorem leftShift_rightShift (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) :
    (z.rightShift a n' hn').leftShift a n hn' =
      koszulSign (a * n + (a * (a - 1)) / 2) • z.shift a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.rightShift_leftShift
statement:
theorem rightShift_leftShift (a n' : ℤ) (hn' : n + a = n') :
    (z.leftShift a n' hn').rightShift a n hn' =
      koszulSign (a * n' + (a * (a - 1)) / 2) • z.shift a
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.leftShift_rightShift_eq_negOnePow_rightShift_leftShift
statement:
theorem leftShift_rightShift_eq_negOnePow_rightShift_leftShift
    (a n' n'' : ℤ) (hn' : n' + a = n) (hn'' : n + a = n'') :
    (z.rightShift a n' hn').leftShift a n hn' =
      koszulSign a • (z.leftShift a n'' hn'').rightShift a n hn''
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftShift_rightShift, rightShift_leftShift, smul_smul, ← hn'', ← koszulSign_add,
    show a + (a * (n + a) + a * (a - 1) / 2) = a * n + a * (a - 1) / 2 + (a * a + a) by ring,
    koszulSign_add _ (a * a + a)]
  have h : koszulSign (a * a + a) = 1 := by
    rw [koszulSign_add, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_mul_self, Int.units_mul_self]
  rw [h, mul_one]

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.quotient_obj_surjective
statement:
theorem quotient_obj_surjective (X : HomotopyCategory.{w} C) :
    ∃ M : CatModule.{w} C, (quotient C).obj M = X

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_out
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotient_map_out {M N : HomotopyCategory.{w} C} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (quotient C).map (Quot.out f) = f
proof:
:=
  Quot.out_eq _

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.quotient_map_eq_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_map_eq_iff {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (f g : M ⟶ N) :
    (quotient C).map f = (quotient C).map g ↔ Homotopic f g
proof:
:=
  Quotient.functor_map_eq_iff _ _ _

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.eq_of_homotopy
statement:
theorem eq_of_homotopy {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (f g : M ⟶ N) (h : DGHomotopy f g) :
    (quotient C).map f = (quotient C).map g
proof:
:=
  (quotient_map_eq_iff f g).mpr ⟨h⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.isZero_quotient_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isZero_quotient_obj_iff (M : CatModule.{w} C) :
    IsZero ((quotient C).obj M) ↔ IsContractible M
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero, ← (quotient C).map_id, ← (quotient C).map_zero,
    quotient_map_eq_iff]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_mk (f : M ⟶ N) :
    quotientNullHomotopicAddHom M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) = (quotient C).map f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_bijective
statement:
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (quotientNullHomotopicAddHom M N)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun x hx => ?_, fun φ => ?_⟩
  · induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H f =>
      rw [quotientNullHomotopicAddHom_mk, ← (quotient C).map_zero M N,
        quotient_map_eq_iff] at hx
      exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff f).mpr hx
  · obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (quotient C).map_surjective φ
    exact ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk f, rfl⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map (f : M ⟶ N) :
    homAddEquivQuotient M N ((quotient C).map f) = QuotientAddGroup.mk f
proof:
:= by
  rw [homAddEquivQuotient, AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.homAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homAddEquivCohomology_quotient_map (f : M ⟶ N) :
    homAddEquivCohomology M N ((quotient C).map f) =
      cohomology.mk _ 0 (HOM.cocyclesAddEquiv M N 0 (Cocycle.ofHom f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [homAddEquivCohomology, AddEquiv.trans_apply, homAddEquivQuotient_quotient_map,
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology_mk]

name: DG.CatModule.twist_of_mem
statement:
theorem twist_of_mem {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) :
    twist n f = koszulSign (n * i) • f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twist, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom,
    decomposeAddEquiv_apply, decompose_of_mem _ hf, toAddMonoid_of]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.twist_mem
statement: theorem twist_mem {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) : twist n f ∈ grading i
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_of_mem hf]
  exact units_smul_mem_grading _ hf

name: DG.CatModule.twist_zero_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_zero_apply (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist 0 f = f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f => rw [twist_of_mem f.2, zero_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [map_add, hf, hf']

name: DG.CatModule.twist_twist
statement: theorem twist_twist (m : ℤ) (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist m (twist n f) = twist (m + n) f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rw [twist_of_mem f.2, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def, twist_of_mem f.2,
      twist_of_mem f.2, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, add_mul, add_comm]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [map_add, map_add, hf, hf', map_add]

name: DG.CatModule.twist_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_id (X : C) : twist n (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 X
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_of_mem (id_mem_grading X), mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.twist_comp
statement: theorem twist_comp {Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) : twist n (f ≫ g) = twist n f ≫ twist n g
proof:
:= by
  induction f using induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    induction g using induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous g =>
      rename_i j
      rw [twist_of_mem f.2, twist_of_mem g.2, twist_of_mem (comp_mem_grading f.2 g.2),
        comp_units_smul, units_smul_comp, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, mul_add, add_comm]
    | h_add g g' hg hg' => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, hg, hg', map_add,
        Preadditive.comp_add]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, hf, hf', map_add, Preadditive.add_comp]

name: DG.CatModule.shift.obj_eq
statement:
theorem obj_eq (n : ℤ) (M : CatModule.{w} C) (X : C) :
    (shift n M).obj X = Shift n (M.obj X)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_mk (m : M.obj X) : unmk n (mk n m) = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mk_unmk
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_unmk (m : (shift n M).obj X) : mk n (unmk n m) = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mk_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_symm : (mk n (M := M) (X := X)).symm = unmk n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_symm : (unmk n (M := M) (X := X)).symm = mk n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mk_injective
statement: theorem mk_injective : Function.Injective (mk n (M := M) (X := X))
proof: := (mk n).injective

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mk_surjective
statement: theorem mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk n (M := M) (X := X))
proof: := (mk n).surjective

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_injective
statement: theorem unmk_injective : Function.Injective (unmk n (M := M) (X := X))
proof: := (unmk n).injective

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mk_inj
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_inj {m m' : M.obj X} : mk n m = mk n m' ↔ m = m'
proof: := (mk n).injective.eq_iff

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_inj
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_inj {m m' : (shift n M).obj X} : unmk n m = unmk n m' ↔ m = m'
proof:
:=
  (unmk n).injective.eq_iff

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mk_units_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (m : M.obj X) : mk n (u • m) = u • mk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_units_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem unmk_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (m : (shift n M).obj X) :
    unmk n (u • m) = u • unmk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mem_grading_iff
statement: theorem mem_grading_iff {k : ℤ} {m : M.obj X} : mk n m ∈ grading k ↔ m ∈ grading (k + n)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mem_grading_iff'
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff' {k : ℤ} {m : (shift n M).obj X} :
    m ∈ grading k ↔ unmk n m ∈ grading (k + n)
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mk_mem_grading
statement: theorem mk_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading k) : mk n m ∈ grading (k - n)
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff.mpr (by rwa [sub_add_cancel])

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_mem_grading
statement:
theorem unmk_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {m : (shift n M).obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading k) :
    unmk n m ∈ grading (k + n)
proof:
:=
  mem_grading_iff'.mp hm

name: DG.CatModule.shift.d_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem d_mk (m : M.obj X) : d (mk n m) = mk n (koszulSign n • d m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_d
statement: @[simp] theorem unmk_d (m : (shift n M).obj X) : unmk n (d m) = koszulSign n • d (unmk n m)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.smul_mk_eq
statement:
theorem smul_mk_eq {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    f • mk n m = mk (M := M) n (twist n f • m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_smul_eq
statement:
theorem unmk_smul_eq {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : (shift n M).obj X) :
    unmk n (f • m) = twist n f • unmk n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shift.smul_mk
statement:
theorem smul_mk {Y : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) (m : M.obj X) :
    f • mk n m = mk (M := M) n (koszulSign (n * i) • (f • m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mk_eq, twist_of_mem hf, units_smul_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.shift.unmk_smul
statement:
theorem unmk_smul {Y : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) (m : (shift n M).obj X) :
    unmk n (f • m) = koszulSign (n * i) • (f • unmk n m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unmk_smul_eq, twist_of_mem hf, units_smul_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.shift.mk_smul
statement:
theorem mk_smul {Y : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) (m : M.obj X) :
    mk (M := M) n (f • m) = koszulSign (n * i) • (f • mk n m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mk hf, mk_units_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← two_mul,
    koszulSign_even (even_two_mul _), one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.shiftMap_app_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftMap_app_mk (φ : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (m : M.obj X) :
    (shiftMap n φ).app X (shift.mk n m) = shift.mk n (φ.app X m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.unmk_shiftMap_app
statement:
theorem unmk_shiftMap_app (φ : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (m : (shift n M).obj X) :
    shift.unmk n ((shiftMap n φ).app X m) = φ.app X (shift.unmk n m)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftMap_id : shiftMap n (𝟙 M) = 𝟙 (shift n M)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftMap_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftMap_comp (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ P) :
    shiftMap n (φ ≫ ψ) = shiftMap n φ ≫ shiftMap n ψ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftMap_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftMap_zero : shiftMap n (0 : M ⟶ N) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftMap_add
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftMap_add (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) : shiftMap n (φ + ψ) = shiftMap n φ + shiftMap n ψ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftMap_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftMap_neg (φ : M ⟶ N) : shiftMap n (-φ) = -shiftMap n φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftMap_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftMap_sub (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) : shiftMap n (φ - ψ) = shiftMap n φ - shiftMap n ψ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftMap_units_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftMap_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    shiftMap n (u • φ) = u • shiftMap n φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftZeroIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftZeroIso_hom_app {X : C} (m : (shift 0 M).obj X) :
    (shiftZeroIso M).hom.app X m = shift.unmk 0 m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftZeroIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftZeroIso_inv_app {X : C} (m : M.obj X) :
    (shiftZeroIso M).inv.app X m = shift.mk 0 m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftShiftIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftShiftIso_hom_app (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) {X : C} (m : (shift c M).obj X) :
    (shiftShiftIso M a b c h).hom.app X m = shift.mk b (shift.mk a (shift.unmk c m))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftShiftIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftShiftIso_inv_app (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) {X : C}
    (m : (shift b (shift a M)).obj X) :
    (shiftShiftIso M a b c h).inv.app X m = shift.mk c (shift.unmk a (shift.unmk b m))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftComm_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftComm_hom_app (a b : ℤ) {X : C} (m : (shift b (shift a M)).obj X) :
    (shiftComm (M := M) a b).hom.app X m =
      shift.mk a (shift.mk b (shift.unmk a (shift.unmk b m)))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.eqToHom_shift_app
statement:
theorem eqToHom_shift_app {a b : ℤ} (h : a = b) (M : CatModule.{w} C)
    (p : (shiftFunctorAux C a).obj M = (shiftFunctorAux C b).obj M) {X : C}
    (x : (shift a M).obj X) :
    (eqToHom p).app X x = shift.mk b (shift.unmk a x)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shiftFunctor_obj (n : ℤ) (M : CatModule.{w} C) :
    (shiftFunctor (CatModule.{w} C) n).obj M = shift n M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftFunctor_map
statement:
theorem shiftFunctor_map (n : ℤ) {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    (shiftFunctor (CatModule.{w} C) n).map φ = shiftMap n φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftFunctorZero_hom_app_app
statement:
theorem shiftFunctorZero_hom_app_app (M : CatModule.{w} C) {X : C} (x : (shift 0 M).obj X) :
    ((shiftFunctorZero (CatModule.{w} C) ℤ).hom.app M).app X x = shift.unmk 0 x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftFunctorZero_inv_app_app
statement:
theorem shiftFunctorZero_inv_app_app (M : CatModule.{w} C) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    ((shiftFunctorZero (CatModule.{w} C) ℤ).inv.app M).app X x = shift.mk 0 x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftFunctorAdd'_hom_app_app
statement:
theorem shiftFunctorAdd'_hom_app_app (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) (M : CatModule.{w} C)
    {X : C} (x : (shift c M).obj X) :
    ((shiftFunctorAdd' (CatModule.{w} C) a b c h).hom.app M).app X x =
      shift.mk b (shift.mk a (shift.unmk c x))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftFunctorAdd'_inv_app_app
statement:
theorem shiftFunctorAdd'_inv_app_app (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) (M : CatModule.{w} C)
    {X : C} (x : (shift b (shift a M)).obj X) :
    ((shiftFunctorAdd' (CatModule.{w} C) a b c h).inv.app M).app X x =
      shift.mk c (shift.unmk a (shift.unmk b x))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftFunctorComm_hom_app_app
statement:
theorem shiftFunctorComm_hom_app_app (a b : ℤ) (M : CatModule.{w} C) {X : C}
    (x : (shift b (shift a M)).obj X) :
    ((shiftFunctorComm (CatModule.{w} C) a b).hom.app M).app X x =
      shift.mk a (shift.mk b (shift.unmk a (shift.unmk b x)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftFunctorComm_eq _ a b _ rfl, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, NatTrans.comp_app,
    comp_app, shiftFunctorAdd'_inv_app_app, shiftFunctorAdd'_hom_app_app]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.shiftFunctorComm_hom_app_eq
statement:
theorem shiftFunctorComm_hom_app_eq (a b : ℤ) (M : CatModule.{w} C) :
    (shiftFunctorComm (CatModule.{w} C) a b).hom.app M = (shiftComm (M := M) a b).hom
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ x => shiftFunctorComm_hom_app_app a b M x

name: DG.CatModule.units_smul_app
statement:
theorem units_smul_app {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (k : ℤˣ) (φ : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (k • φ).app X x = k • φ.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.coe_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Cocycle.coe_units_smul {M N : CatModule.{w} C} {n : ℤ} (u : ℤˣ) (z : Cocycle M N n) :
    ((u • z : Cocycle M N n) : Cochain M N n) = u • (z : Cochain M N n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.fstHom_eq_mk_fst
statement:
theorem fstHom_eq_mk_fst {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (f : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (p : (cone f).obj X) :
    (fstHom f).app X p = shift.mk 1 ((fst f).1.app X p)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.hom_apply
statement:
theorem hom_apply (x : (shift 1 M).obj X) :
    (hom f).app X x = (inl (inr f)).app X (f.app X (shift.unmk 1 x)) -
      (inr (inr f)).app X ((inl f).app X (shift.unmk 1 x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := shift.mk_surjective (n := 1) x
  simp [hom, lift_apply, leftShift_apply, DG.Cochain.leftShiftSign, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.fst_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_hom_apply (x : (shift 1 M).obj X) :
    (fst (inr f)).1.app X ((hom f).app X x) = f.app X (shift.unmk 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hom_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.snd_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_hom_apply (x : (shift 1 M).obj X) :
    (snd (inr f)).app X ((hom f).app X x) = -(inl f).app X (shift.unmk 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [hom_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.inv_apply
statement:
theorem inv_apply (p : (cone (inr f)).obj X) :
    (inv f).app X p = -(fstHom f).app X ((snd (inr f)).app X p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [inv, desc_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.hom_comp_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_comp_inv : hom f ≫ inv f = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X x => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := shift.mk_surjective (n := 1) x
  simp [inv_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.RotateHomotopyEquiv.comm₃
statement: theorem comm₃ : hom f ≫ (-fstHom (inr f)) = -shiftMap 1 f
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X x => (shift.unmk 1).injective ?_
  simp [← fst_apply, unmk_shiftMap_app]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ShiftIso.fst_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_hom_apply (x : (shift n (cone f)).obj X) :
    (fst (shiftMap n f)).1.app X ((hom f n).app X x) =
      koszulSign n • shift.mk n ((fst f).1.app X (shift.unmk n x))
proof:
:= by
  simp [hom, lift_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ShiftIso.snd_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_hom_apply (x : (shift n (cone f)).obj X) :
    (snd (shiftMap n f)).app X ((hom f n).app X x) =
      shift.mk n ((snd f).app X (shift.unmk n x))
proof:
:= by
  simp [hom, lift_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ShiftIso.inv_apply
statement:
theorem inv_apply (q : (cone (shiftMap n f)).obj X) :
    (inv f n).app X q =
      koszulSign n • shift.mk n ((inl f).app X (shift.unmk n ((fst (shiftMap n f)).1.app X q))) +
        shift.mk n ((inr f).app X (shift.unmk n ((snd (shiftMap n f)).app X q)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [inv, desc_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ShiftIso.hom_comp_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hom_comp_inv : hom f n ≫ inv f n = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X x => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := shift.mk_surjective (n := n) x
  simp [inv_apply, smul_smul]
  rw [← map_add, id_X]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ShiftIso.inv_comp_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_comp_hom : inv f n ≫ hom f n = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X q => ext_to ?_ ?_
  · simp [inv_apply, smul_smul]
  · simp [inv_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ShiftIso.shift_inr_comp_hom
statement: theorem shift_inr_comp_hom : shiftMap n (inr f) ≫ hom f n = inr (shiftMap n f)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X y => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := shift.mk_surjective (n := n) y
  refine ext_to ?_ ?_ <;> simp

name: DG.CatModule.cone.ShiftIso.comm₃
statement:
theorem comm₃ : shiftMap n (-fstHom f) ≫ (shiftComm (M := M) 1 n).hom =
    koszulSign n • (hom f n ≫ (-fstHom (shiftMap n f)))
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext fun X x => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := shift.mk_surjective (n := n) x
  simp [smul_smul, units_smul_app, fstHom_eq_mk_fst]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.triangle_mor₃
statement: theorem triangle_mor₃ : (triangle φ).mor₃ = -fstHom φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.inr_triangleδ
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem inr_triangleδ : inr φ ≫ (triangle φ).mor₃ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [triangle_mor₃, Preadditive.comp_neg, inr_comp_fstHom, neg_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.cone.triangleMapOfHomotopy_comm₃
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem triangleMapOfHomotopy_comm₃ :
    mapOfHomotopy H ≫ (triangle φ₂).mor₃ = (triangle φ₁).mor₃ ≫ a⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
proof:
:= by
  rw [triangle_mor₃, triangle_mor₃, Preadditive.comp_neg, Preadditive.neg_comp,
    mapOfHomotopy_comp_fstHom]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.rotateHomotopyEquiv_comm₂
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem rotateHomotopyEquiv_comm₂ :
    (quotient C).map (triangle φ).mor₃ ≫ (quotient C).map (rotateHomotopyEquiv φ).hom =
      (quotient C).map (inr (inr φ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  exact eq_of_homotopy _ _ (RotateHomotopyEquiv.comm₂Homotopy φ)

name: DG.CatModule.cone.rotateHomotopyEquiv_comm₃
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem rotateHomotopyEquiv_comm₃ :
    (rotateHomotopyEquiv φ).hom ≫ (triangle (inr φ)).mor₃ = -φ⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧'
proof:
:=
  RotateHomotopyEquiv.comm₃ φ

name: DG.CatModule.cone.shiftIso_comm₂
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem shiftIso_comm₂ :
    (inr φ)⟦n⟧' ≫ (shiftIso φ n).hom = inr (φ⟦n⟧')
proof:
:=
  ShiftIso.shift_inr_comp_hom φ n

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.isomorphic_distinguished
statement:
theorem isomorphic_distinguished (T₁ : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{w} C))
    (hT₁ : T₁ ∈ distinguishedTriangles C) (T₂ : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{w} C))
    (e : T₂ ≅ T₁) : T₂ ∈ distinguishedTriangles C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, N, φ, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hT₁
  exact ⟨M, N, φ, ⟨e ≪≫ e'⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.contractible_distinguished
statement:
theorem contractible_distinguished (X : HomotopyCategory.{w} C) :
    Pretriangulated.contractibleTriangle X ∈ distinguishedTriangles C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X⟩ := X
  refine ⟨_, _, 𝟙 X, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have h := (isZero_quotient_obj_iff (cone (𝟙 X))).2 (cone.isContractible_id X)
  exact Triangle.isoMk _ _ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) h.isoZero.symm
    (by simp [contractibleTriangle]) (h.eq_of_tgt _ _)
    (by dsimp [contractibleTriangle]; ext)

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.distinguished_cocone_triangle
statement:
theorem distinguished_cocone_triangle {X Y : HomotopyCategory.{w} C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ (Z : HomotopyCategory.{w} C) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ X⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk f g h ∈ distinguishedTriangles C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨Y⟩ := Y
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (quotient C).map_surjective f
  exact ⟨_, _, _, ⟨_, _, f, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.rotate_distinguished_triangle'
statement:
theorem rotate_distinguished_triangle' (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{w} C))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles C) : T.rotate ∈ distinguishedTriangles C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, N, φ, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hT
  exact ⟨_, _, _, ⟨(rotate _).mapIso e ≪≫ rotateTrianglehIso φ⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.shift_distinguished_triangle
statement:
theorem shift_distinguished_triangle (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{w} C))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles C) (n : ℤ) :
    (Triangle.shiftFunctor _ n).obj T ∈ distinguishedTriangles C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, N, φ, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hT
  exact ⟨_, _, _, ⟨Functor.mapIso _ e ≪≫ shiftTrianglehIso φ n⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.invRotate_distinguished_triangle'
statement:
theorem invRotate_distinguished_triangle' (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{w} C))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles C) : T.invRotate ∈ distinguishedTriangles C
proof:
:=
  isomorphic_distinguished _
    (shift_distinguished_triangle _ (rotate_distinguished_triangle' _
      (rotate_distinguished_triangle' _ hT)) _) _
    ((invRotateIsoRotateRotateShiftFunctorNegOne _).app T)

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.rotate_distinguished_triangle
statement:
theorem rotate_distinguished_triangle (T : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{w} C)) :
    T ∈ distinguishedTriangles C ↔ T.rotate ∈ distinguishedTriangles C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact rotate_distinguished_triangle' T
  · intro hT
    exact isomorphic_distinguished _ (invRotate_distinguished_triangle' T.rotate hT) _
      ((triangleRotation _).unitIso.app T)

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.Pretriangulated.complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
statement:
theorem complete_distinguished_triangle_morphism
    (T₁ T₂ : Triangle (HomotopyCategory.{w} C))
    (hT₁ : T₁ ∈ distinguishedTriangles C) (hT₂ : T₂ ∈ distinguishedTriangles C)
    (a : T₁.obj₁ ⟶ T₂.obj₁) (b : T₁.obj₂ ⟶ T₂.obj₂) (fac : T₁.mor₁ ≫ b = a ≫ T₂.mor₁) :
    ∃ (c : T₁.obj₃ ⟶ T₂.obj₃), T₁.mor₂ ≫ c = b ≫ T₂.mor₂ ∧
      T₁.mor₃ ≫ a⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = c ≫ T₂.mor₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K₁, L₁, φ₁, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ := hT₁
  obtain ⟨K₂, L₂, φ₂, ⟨e₂⟩⟩ := hT₂
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ : ∃ (a' : (quotient C).obj K₁ ⟶ (quotient C).obj K₂),
    a' = e₁.inv.hom₁ ≫ a ≫ e₂.hom.hom₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ : ∃ (b' : (quotient C).obj L₁ ⟶ (quotient C).obj L₂),
    b' = e₁.inv.hom₂ ≫ b ≫ e₂.hom.hom₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a'', rfl⟩ := (quotient C).map_surjective a'
  obtain ⟨b'', rfl⟩ := (quotient C).map_surjective b'
  have H : DGHomotopy (φ₁ ≫ b'') (a'' ≫ φ₂) := homotopyOfEq _ _ (by
    have comm₁₁ := e₁.inv.comm₁
    have comm₁₂ := e₂.hom.comm₁
    dsimp at comm₁₁ comm₁₂
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, ha', hb', reassoc_of% comm₁₁,
      reassoc_of% fac, comm₁₂, assoc])
  let γ := e₁.hom ≫ trianglehMapOfHomotopy H ≫ e₂.inv
  have comm₂ := γ.comm₂
  have comm₃ := γ.comm₃
  dsimp [γ, trianglehMapOfHomotopy] at comm₂ comm₃
  simp only [ha', hb'] at comm₂ comm₃
  refine ⟨γ.hom₃, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [γ] using comm₂
  · simpa [γ] using comm₃

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.triangleh_distinguished
statement:
theorem triangleh_distinguished {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    triangleh φ ∈ distTriang (HomotopyCategory.{w} C)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n} (h : ∀ X x, z₁.app X x = z₂.app X x) : z₁ = z₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := z₁
  obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := z₂
  congr
  funext X
  exact AddMonoidHom.ext (h X)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.app_injective
statement: theorem app_injective : Function.Injective (app : Cochain M N n → ∀ X, M.obj X →+ N.obj X)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => ext fun X x => congrArg (fun φ => φ X x) h

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.map_mem
statement:
theorem map_mem (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} {i : ℤ} {x : M.obj X} (hx : x ∈ grading i) :
    z.app X x ∈ grading (i + n)
proof:
:=
  z.map_mem' hx

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.map_smul
statement:
theorem map_smul (z : Cochain M N n) {X Y : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (x : M.obj X) : z.app Y (f • x) = koszulSign (n * i) • (f • z.app X x)
proof:
:=
  z.map_smul' hf x

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.map_units_smul
statement:
theorem map_units_smul (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (u : ℤˣ) (x : M.obj X) :
    z.app X (u • x) = u • z.app X x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.heq_of_forall
statement:
theorem heq_of_forall {m n : ℤ} {z₁ : Cochain M N m} {z₂ : Cochain M N n} (hmn : m = n)
    (h : ∀ X x, z₁.app X x = z₂.app X x) : HEq z₁ z₂
proof:
:= by
  subst hmn
  exact heq_of_eq (ext h)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.zero_app
statement: @[simp] theorem zero_app (X : C) : (0 : Cochain M N n).app X = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.add_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem add_app (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) (X : C) :
    (z₁ + z₂).app X = z₁.app X + z₂.app X
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.neg_app
statement: @[simp] theorem neg_app (z : Cochain M N n) (X : C) : (-z).app X = -z.app X
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.sub_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem sub_app (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) (X : C) :
    (z₁ - z₂).app X = z₁.app X - z₂.app X
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.nsmul_app
statement: @[simp] theorem nsmul_app (k : ℕ) (z : Cochain M N n) (X : C) : (k • z).app X = k • z.app X
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.zsmul_app
statement: @[simp] theorem zsmul_app (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) (X : C) : (k • z).app X = k • z.app X
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.zero_apply
statement: theorem zero_apply {X : C} (x : M.obj X) : (0 : Cochain M N n).app X x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.add_apply
statement:
theorem add_apply (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (z₁ + z₂).app X x = z₁.app X x + z₂.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.neg_apply
statement: theorem neg_apply (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) : (-z).app X x = -z.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.sub_apply
statement:
theorem sub_apply (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (z₁ - z₂).app X x = z₁.app X x - z₂.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.nsmul_apply
statement:
theorem nsmul_apply (k : ℕ) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (k • z).app X x = k • z.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.zsmul_apply
statement:
theorem zsmul_apply (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (k • z).app X x = k • z.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.units_smul_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem units_smul_app (u : ℤˣ) (z : Cochain M N n) (X : C) :
    (u • z).app X = u • z.app X
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.units_smul_apply
statement:
theorem units_smul_apply (u : ℤˣ) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (u • z).app X x = u • z.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_apply {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) : (z₂.comp z₁ h).app X x = z₂.app X (z₁.app X x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {n₁ n₂ n₃ n₁₂ n₂₃ n₁₂₃ : ℤ}
    (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (z₃ : Cochain P Q n₃)
    (h₁₂ : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (h₂₃ : n₂ + n₃ = n₂₃) (h₁₂₃ : n₁ + n₂ + n₃ = n₁₂₃) :
    z₃.comp (z₂.comp z₁ h₁₂) (show n₁₂ + n₃ = n₁₂₃ by rw [← h₁₂, h₁₂₃]) =
      (z₃.comp z₂ h₂₃).comp z₁ (by rw [← h₂₃, ← h₁₂₃, add_assoc])
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.zero_comp
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem zero_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) :
    (0 : Cochain N P n₂).comp z₁ h = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.add_comp
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem add_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ z₂' : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (z₂ + z₂').comp z₁ h = z₂.comp z₁ h + z₂'.comp z₁ h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.sub_comp
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem sub_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ z₂' : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (z₂ - z₂').comp z₁ h = z₂.comp z₁ h - z₂'.comp z₁ h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.neg_comp
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem neg_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (-z₂).comp z₁ h = -z₂.comp z₁ h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.zsmul_comp
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem zsmul_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (k : ℤ) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁)
    (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (k • z₂).comp z₁ h = k • z₂.comp z₁ h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.units_smul_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem units_smul_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (u : ℤˣ) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁)
    (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : (u • z₂).comp z₁ h = u • z₂.comp z₁ h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_zero {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) :
    z₂.comp (0 : Cochain M N n₁) h = 0
proof: := ext fun X _ => map_zero (z₂.app X)

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_add
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_add {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ z₁' : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (z₁ + z₁') h = z₂.comp z₁ h + z₂.comp z₁' h
proof:
:=
  ext fun X _ => map_add (z₂.app X) _ _

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_sub
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_sub {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ z₁' : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (z₁ - z₁') h = z₂.comp z₁ h - z₂.comp z₁' h
proof:
:=
  ext fun X _ => map_sub (z₂.app X) _ _

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_neg
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_neg {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (-z₁) h = -z₂.comp z₁ h
proof:
:=
  ext fun X _ => map_neg (z₂.app X) _

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_zsmul {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (k : ℤ) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁)
    (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (k • z₁) h = k • z₂.comp z₁ h
proof:
:=
  ext fun X _ => map_zsmul (z₂.app X) _ _

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_units_smul {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (u : ℤˣ) (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁)
    (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂) (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) : z₂.comp (u • z₁) h = u • z₂.comp z₁ h
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ _ => map_units_smul z₂ _ _

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.id_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_apply {X : C} (x : M.obj X) : (Cochain.id M).app X x = x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.comp_id
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem comp_id {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain M N n) :
    z.comp (Cochain.id M) (zero_add n) = z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.id_comp
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem id_comp {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain M N n) :
    (Cochain.id N).comp z (add_zero n) = z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHoms_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHoms_apply (φ : ∀ X, M.obj X →+ N.obj X)
    (hφ : ∀ {X : C} {i : ℤ} {x : M.obj X}, x ∈ grading i → φ X x ∈ grading i)
    (hs : ∀ {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : M.obj X), φ Y (f • x) = f • φ X x) {X : C}
    (x : M.obj X) : (ofHoms φ hφ hs).app X x = φ X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_apply (φ : M ⟶ N) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) : (ofHom φ).app X x = φ.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_zero : ofHom (0 : M ⟶ N) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_add (φ₁ φ₂ : M ⟶ N) : ofHom (φ₁ + φ₂) = ofHom φ₁ + ofHom φ₂
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_sub (φ₁ φ₂ : M ⟶ N) : ofHom (φ₁ - φ₂) = ofHom φ₁ - ofHom φ₂
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_neg (φ : M ⟶ N) : ofHom (-φ) = -ofHom φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_zsmul
statement: theorem ofHom_zsmul (k : ℤ) (φ : M ⟶ N) : ofHom (k • φ) = k • ofHom φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_id : ofHom (𝟙 M) = Cochain.id M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_comp (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ P) :
    ofHom (φ ≫ ψ) = (ofHom ψ).comp (ofHom φ) (zero_add 0)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_injective
statement: theorem ofHom_injective : Function.Injective (ofHom : (M ⟶ N) → Cochain M N 0)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => hom_ext fun X x => congrArg (fun z : Cochain M N 0 => z.app X x) h

name: DG.CatModule.δ_apply
statement:
theorem δ_apply (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (δ n m z).app X x = d (z.app X x) - koszulSign n • z.app X (d x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold δ
  rw [dite_eq_left hnm]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.δ_apply'
statement:
theorem δ_apply' (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain M N n) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (δ n m z).app X x = d (z.app X x) + koszulSign m • z.app X (d x)
proof:
:= by
  subst hnm
  rw [δ_apply n _ rfl, koszulSign, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ, Units.neg_smul,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.CatModule.δ_shape
statement: theorem δ_shape (hnm : ¬ n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain M N n) : δ n m z = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold δ
  rw [dite_eq_right hnm]

name: DG.CatModule.δ_add
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_add (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) : δ n m (z₁ + z₂) = δ n m z₁ + δ n m z₂
proof:
:=
  (δ_hom M N n m).map_add z₁ z₂

name: DG.CatModule.δ_sub
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_sub (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) : δ n m (z₁ - z₂) = δ n m z₁ - δ n m z₂
proof:
:=
  (δ_hom M N n m).map_sub z₁ z₂

name: DG.CatModule.δ_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_zero : δ n m (0 : Cochain M N n) = 0
proof: := (δ_hom M N n m).map_zero

name: DG.CatModule.δ_neg
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_neg (z : Cochain M N n) : δ n m (-z) = -δ n m z
proof:
:=
  (δ_hom M N n m).map_neg z

name: DG.CatModule.δ_zsmul
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_zsmul (k : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) : δ n m (k • z) = k • δ n m z
proof:
:=
  (δ_hom M N n m).map_zsmul k z

name: DG.CatModule.δ_units_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem δ_units_smul (u : ℤˣ) (z : Cochain M N n) : δ n m (u • z) = u • δ n m z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, δ_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.δ_δ
statement: theorem δ_δ (n₀ n₁ n₂ : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n₀) : δ n₁ n₂ (δ n₀ n₁ z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁₂ : n₁ + 1 = n₂; swap
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ h₁₂]
  by_cases h₀₁ : n₀ + 1 = n₁; swap
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ h₀₁, δ_zero]
  ext X x
  rw [δ_apply _ _ h₁₂, δ_apply _ _ h₀₁, δ_apply _ _ h₀₁, Cochain.zero_apply, ← h₀₁]
  simp only [koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_succ, d_sub, d_units_smul, d_d, map_zero, _root_.smul_zero,
    sub_zero, zero_sub, Units.neg_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, neg_add_cancel]

name: DG.CatModule.δ_comp
statement:
theorem δ_comp {n₁ n₂ n₁₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (h : n₁ + n₂ = n₁₂) (m₁ m₂ m₁₂ : ℤ) (h₁₂ : n₁₂ + 1 = m₁₂) (h₁ : n₁ + 1 = m₁)
    (h₂ : n₂ + 1 = m₂) :
    δ n₁₂ m₁₂ (z₂.comp z₁ h) =
      (δ n₂ m₂ z₂).comp z₁ (by rw [← h₁₂, ← h₂, ← h, add_assoc]) +
        koszulSign n₂ • z₂.comp (δ n₁ m₁ z₁)
          (by rw [← h₁₂, ← h₁, ← h, add_assoc, add_comm 1, add_assoc])
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  simp only [Cochain.add_apply, units_smul_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, δ_apply _ _ h₁₂, δ_apply _ _ h₁,
    δ_apply _ _ h₂, map_sub, map_units_smul, _root_.smul_sub, smul_smul, ← h, koszulSign_add,
    mul_comm (koszulSign n₁)]
  abel

name: DG.CatModule.δ_zero_cochain_comp
statement:
theorem δ_zero_cochain_comp {n₂ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N 0) (z₂ : Cochain N P n₂)
    (m₂ : ℤ) (h₂ : n₂ + 1 = m₂) :
    δ n₂ m₂ (z₂.comp z₁ (zero_add n₂)) =
      (δ n₂ m₂ z₂).comp z₁ (zero_add m₂) +
        koszulSign n₂ • z₂.comp (δ 0 1 z₁) (by rw [add_comm, h₂])
proof:
:=
  δ_comp z₁ z₂ (zero_add n₂) 1 m₂ m₂ h₂ (zero_add 1) h₂

name: DG.CatModule.δ_comp_zero_cochain
statement:
theorem δ_comp_zero_cochain {n₁ : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n₁) (z₂ : Cochain N P 0)
    (m₁ : ℤ) (h₁ : n₁ + 1 = m₁) :
    δ n₁ m₁ (z₂.comp z₁ (add_zero n₁)) =
      (δ 0 1 z₂).comp z₁ h₁ + z₂.comp (δ n₁ m₁ z₁) (add_zero m₁)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [δ_comp z₁ z₂ (add_zero n₁) m₁ 1 m₁ h₁ h₁ (zero_add 1), koszulSign,
    Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.δ_zero_cochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_zero_cochain_apply (z : Cochain M N 0) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (δ 0 1 z).app X x = d (z.app X x) - z.app X (d x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [δ_apply 0 1 (zero_add 1), koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.δ_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_ofHom {p : ℤ} (φ : M ⟶ N) : δ 0 p (Cochain.ofHom φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : 0 + 1 = p
  · ext X x
    rw [δ_apply 0 p h, Cochain.zero_apply, ofHom_apply, ofHom_apply, Hom.map_d, koszulSign,
      Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul, sub_self]
  · exact δ_shape _ _ h _

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.mem_iff
statement:
theorem mem_iff {n : ℤ} (m : ℤ) (hnm : n + 1 = m) (z : Cochain M N n) :
    z ∈ cocycle M N n ↔ δ n m z = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst hnm; rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {n : ℤ} {z₁ z₂ : Cocycle M N n} (h : (z₁ : Cochain M N n) = z₂) : z₁ = z₂
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext h

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.δ_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_eq_zero {n : ℤ} (z : Cocycle M N n) (m : ℤ) : δ n m (z : Cochain M N n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : n + 1 = m
  · exact (mem_iff m h _).1 z.2
  · exact δ_shape n m h _

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.map_smul
statement:
theorem map_smul (z : Cocycle M N 0) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : M.obj X) :
    (z : Cochain M N 0).app Y (f • x) = f • (z : Cochain M N 0).app X x
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rw [(z : Cochain M N 0).map_smul f.2, zero_mul, koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [add_smul, map_add, hf, hf', add_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.map_d
statement:
theorem map_d (z : Cocycle M N 0) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (z : Cochain M N 0).app X (d x) = d ((z : Cochain M N 0).app X x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain M N 1 => c.app X x) (z.δ_eq_zero 1)
  simp only [δ_zero_cochain_apply, Cochain.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.homOf_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_app (z : Cocycle M N 0) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (homOf z).app X x = (z : Cochain M N 0).app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.homOf_ofHom_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_ofHom_eq_self (φ : M ⟶ N) : homOf (ofHom φ) = φ
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.ofHom_homOf_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_homOf_eq_self (z : Cocycle M N 0) : ofHom (homOf z) = z
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe (z : Cocycle M N 0) :
    Cochain.ofHom (homOf z) = (z : Cochain M N 0)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.δ_comp_zero_cocycle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_comp_zero_cocycle {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n) (z₂ : Cocycle N P 0) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m ((z₂ : Cochain N P 0).comp z₁ (add_zero n)) =
      (z₂ : Cochain N P 0).comp (δ n m z₁) (add_zero m)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · simp [δ_comp_zero_cochain _ _ _ hnm]
  · simp [δ_shape _ _ hnm]

name: DG.CatModule.δ_comp_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_comp_ofHom {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cochain M N n) (f : N ⟶ P) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m ((Cochain.ofHom f).comp z₁ (add_zero n)) =
      (Cochain.ofHom f).comp (δ n m z₁) (add_zero m)
proof:
:=
  δ_comp_zero_cocycle z₁ (Cocycle.ofHom f) m

name: DG.CatModule.δ_zero_cocycle_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_zero_cocycle_comp {n : ℤ} (z₁ : Cocycle M N 0) (z₂ : Cochain N P n) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m (z₂.comp (z₁ : Cochain M N 0) (zero_add n)) =
      (δ n m z₂).comp (z₁ : Cochain M N 0) (zero_add m)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · simp [δ_zero_cochain_comp _ _ _ hnm]
  · simp [δ_shape _ _ hnm]

name: DG.CatModule.δ_ofHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem δ_ofHom_comp {n : ℤ} (f : M ⟶ N) (z : Cochain N P n) (m : ℤ) :
    δ n m (z.comp (Cochain.ofHom f) (zero_add n)) =
      (δ n m z).comp (Cochain.ofHom f) (zero_add m)
proof:
:=
  δ_zero_cocycle_comp (Cocycle.ofHom f) z m

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.of_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [Cochain.ext hfg]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.of_units_smul
statement:
theorem of_units_smul (i : ℤ) (u : ℤˣ) (f : Cochain M N i) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) i (u • f) : HOM M N) =
      u • DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) i f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, map_zsmul]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.dHom_of
statement:
theorem dHom_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) :
    dHom M N (DirectSum.of _ n z) = DirectSum.of _ (n + 1) (δ n (n + 1) z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [dHom]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.grading_eq
statement:
theorem grading_eq (n : ℤ) :
    grading (M := HOM M N) n = summand (fun n => Cochain M N n) n
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.d_of
statement:
theorem d_of (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain M N n) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) n z : HOM M N) =
      DirectSum.of _ (n + 1) (δ n (n + 1) z)
proof:
:=
  dHom_of n z

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_apply {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain M N n)
    (x : M.obj (SingleObj.star A)) : z.toDGModuleCochain x = z.app (SingleObj.star A) x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_ofHom
statement:
theorem Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_ofHom (φ : M ⟶ N) :
    (Cochain.ofHom φ).toDGModuleCochain =
      DG.Cochain.ofHom ((toDGModuleCat A).map φ).hom
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_add
statement:
theorem Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_add {n : ℤ} (z₁ z₂ : Cochain M N n) :
    (z₁ + z₂).toDGModuleCochain = z₁.toDGModuleCochain + z₂.toDGModuleCochain
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_δ
statement:
theorem Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_δ {n m : ℤ} (z : Cochain M N n) :
    (δ n m z).toDGModuleCochain = DG.δ n m z.toDGModuleCochain
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · refine DG.Cochain.ext fun x => ?_
    rw [Cochain.toDGModuleCochain_apply, δ_apply _ _ hnm, DG.δ_apply _ _ hnm]
    rfl
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm, DG.δ_shape _ _ hnm]
    rfl

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_iff_toDGModuleCat
statement:
theorem homotopic_iff_toDGModuleCat {f g : M ⟶ N} :
    Homotopic f g ↔ DG.Homotopic ((toDGModuleCat A).map f).hom ((toDGModuleCat A).map g).hom
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨h.toDGHomotopy⟩, fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨DGHomotopy.ofDGHomotopy h⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HomotopyCategory.toDGHomotopyCategory_map_quotient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDGHomotopyCategory_map_quotient_map {M N : CatModule.{w} (SingleObj A)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (toDGHomotopyCategory A).map ((quotient (SingleObj A)).map f) =
      (DG.HomotopyCategory.quotient A).map ((toDGModuleCat A).map f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.twist_eq_shiftTwist
statement:
theorem twist_eq_shiftTwist (n : ℤ) {X Y : SingleObj A} (a : X ⟶ Y) :
    (twist n a : A) = Shift.twist A n (a : A)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous a =>
    rw [twist_of_mem a.2, Shift.twist_of_mem (A := A) a.2]
  | h_add a a' ha ha' => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) ha ha'

name: DG.CatModule.toDGModuleCatShiftIso_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDGModuleCatShiftIso_hom_apply (n : ℤ) (M : CatModule.{w} (SingleObj A))
    (m : (shift n M).obj (SingleObj.star A)) : (toDGModuleCatShiftIso n M).hom m = m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cone.toDGModuleCatIso_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDGModuleCatIso_hom_apply (p : (cone φ).obj (SingleObj.star A)) :
    (toDGModuleCatIso φ).hom p = p
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.δ_neg_one_apply
statement:
theorem δ_neg_one_apply (z : Cochain M N (-1)) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (δ (-1) 0 z).app X x = d (z.app X x) + z.app X (d x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [δ_apply' (-1) 0 (neg_add_cancel 1), koszulSign, Int.negOnePow_zero, one_smul]
