name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopy.comm
statement:
theorem comm (h : DGHomotopy f g) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    f.app X x = d (h.hom.app X x) + h.hom.app X (d x) + g.app X x
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun z : Cochain M N 0 => z.app X x) h.ofHom_eq
  simpa only [ofHom_apply, Cochain.add_apply, δ_neg_one_apply] using this

name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopy.nullHomotopicMap_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nullHomotopicMap_app (h : Cochain M N (-1)) {X : C} (x : M.obj X) :
    (nullHomotopicMap h).app X x = d (h.app X x) + h.app X (d x)
proof: := δ_neg_one_apply h x

name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopy.ofHom_nullHomotopicMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_nullHomotopicMap (h : Cochain M N (-1)) :
    ofHom (nullHomotopicMap h) = δ (-1) 0 h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopy.homotopic
statement: theorem _root_.DG.CatModule.DGHomotopy.homotopic (h : DGHomotopy f g) : Homotopic f g

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.of_eq
statement: theorem of_eq (h : f = g) : Homotopic f g
proof: := ⟨DGHomotopy.ofEq h⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem refl (f : M ⟶ N) : Homotopic f f
proof: := ⟨DGHomotopy.refl f⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem symm (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic g f
proof: := ⟨h.some.symm⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.trans
statement:
@[trans]
theorem trans (h₁ : Homotopic e f) (h₂ : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic e g
proof:
:=
  ⟨h₁.some.trans h₂.some⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.add
statement:
theorem add {f₁ g₁ f₂ g₂ : M ⟶ N} (h₁ : Homotopic f₁ g₁) (h₂ : Homotopic f₂ g₂) :
    Homotopic (f₁ + f₂) (g₁ + g₂)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h₁.some.add h₂.some⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.neg
statement: theorem neg (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (-f) (-g)
proof: := ⟨h.some.neg⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.sub
statement:
theorem sub {f₁ g₁ f₂ g₂ : M ⟶ N} (h₁ : Homotopic f₁ g₁) (h₂ : Homotopic f₂ g₂) :
    Homotopic (f₁ - f₂) (g₁ - g₂)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h₁.some.sub h₂.some⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.zsmul
statement: theorem zsmul (k : ℤ) (h : Homotopic f g) : Homotopic (k • f) (k • g)
proof: := ⟨h.some.zsmul k⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.comp_right
statement: theorem comp_right (h : Homotopic e f) (g : N ⟶ P) : Homotopic (e ≫ g) (f ≫ g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.compRight g⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.comp_left
statement:
theorem comp_left {f g : N ⟶ P} (h : Homotopic f g) (e : M ⟶ N) :
    Homotopic (e ≫ f) (e ≫ g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.some.compLeft e⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.comp
statement:
theorem comp {f₁ g₁ : M ⟶ N} {f₂ g₂ : N ⟶ P} (h₁ : Homotopic f₁ g₁)
    (h₂ : Homotopic f₂ g₂) : Homotopic (f₁ ≫ f₂) (g₁ ≫ g₂)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h₁.some.comp h₂.some⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.iff_sub
statement: theorem iff_sub : Homotopic f g ↔ Homotopic (f - g) 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨DGHomotopy.equivSubZero h⟩, fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨DGHomotopy.equivSubZero.symm h⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_equivalence
statement: theorem homotopic_equivalence : Equivalence (Homotopic : (M ⟶ N) → (M ⟶ N) → Prop)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Homotopic.refl, Homotopic.symm, Homotopic.trans⟩

name: DG.CatModule.mem_nullHomotopic_iff
statement: theorem mem_nullHomotopic_iff {f : M ⟶ N} : f ∈ nullHomotopic M N ↔ Homotopic f 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.CatModule.mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists {f : M ⟶ N} :
    f ∈ nullHomotopic M N ↔ ∃ h : Cochain M N (-1), ofHom f = δ (-1) 0 h
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨h.hom, by rw [h.ofHom_eq, ofHom_zero, add_zero]⟩, fun ⟨h, hh⟩ =>
    ⟨⟨h, by rw [hh, ofHom_zero, add_zero]⟩⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_iff_sub_mem
statement:
theorem homotopic_iff_sub_mem {f g : M ⟶ N} :
    Homotopic f g ↔ f - g ∈ nullHomotopic M N
proof:
:=
  Homotopic.iff_sub

name: DG.CatModule.nullHomotopicMap_mem
statement:
theorem nullHomotopicMap_mem (h : Cochain M N (-1)) :
    DGHomotopy.nullHomotopicMap h ∈ nullHomotopic M N
proof:
:=
  ⟨DGHomotopy.nullHomotopy h⟩

name: DG.CatModule.comp_mem_nullHomotopic
statement:
theorem comp_mem_nullHomotopic {f : M ⟶ N} (hf : f ∈ nullHomotopic M N)
    (g : N ⟶ P) : f ≫ g ∈ nullHomotopic M P
proof:
:=
  (Homotopic.comp_right hf g).trans (Homotopic.of_eq Limits.zero_comp)

name: DG.CatModule.mem_nullHomotopic_comp
statement:
theorem mem_nullHomotopic_comp {f : N ⟶ P} (hf : f ∈ nullHomotopic N P)
    (e : M ⟶ N) : e ≫ f ∈ nullHomotopic M P
proof:
:=
  (Homotopic.comp_left hf e).trans (Homotopic.of_eq Limits.comp_zero)

name: DG.CatModule.Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coboundaries_iff {n : ℤ} (m : ℤ) (hmn : m + 1 = n) (z : Cocycle M N n) :
    z ∈ Cocycle.coboundaries M N n ↔ ∃ y : Cochain M N m, δ m n y = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : m = n - 1 := by omega
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv_mk (f : M ⟶ N) :
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (Cocycle.ofHom f)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.coe_cocyclesAddEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_cocyclesAddEquiv_apply (n : ℤ) (z : Cocycle M N n) :
    (cocyclesAddEquiv M N n z : HOM M N) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) n (z : Cochain M N n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.cocyclesAddEquiv_mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem cocyclesAddEquiv_mem_coboundaries_iff (n : ℤ) (z : Cocycle M N n) :
    (cocyclesAddEquiv M N n z : HOM M N) ∈ coboundaries (HOM M N) n ↔
      z ∈ Cocycle.coboundaries M N n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff (n - 1) (sub_add_cancel n 1), mem_coboundaries,
    coe_cocyclesAddEquiv_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hdx⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := mem_summand.mp hx
    refine ⟨y, DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun n => Cochain M N n) n ?_⟩
    rw [← hdx, d_of]
    exact (of_congr (sub_add_cancel n 1).symm fun X x => by
      rw [δ_apply _ _ (sub_add_cancel n 1), δ_apply _ _ rfl])
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain M N n) (n - 1) y, of_mem_summand _ _, ?_⟩
    rw [d_of, ← hy]
    exact of_congr (sub_add_cancel n 1) fun X x => by
      rw [δ_apply _ _ rfl, δ_apply _ _ (sub_add_cancel n 1)]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.cohomologyAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyAddEquiv_mk (n : ℤ) (z : Cocycle M N n) :
    cohomologyAddEquiv M N n (cohomology.mk _ n (cocyclesAddEquiv M N n z)) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk z
proof:
:= by
  show QuotientAddGroup.mk' _ ((cocyclesAddEquiv M N n).symm (cocyclesAddEquiv M N n z)) = _
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology_mk (f : M ⟶ N) :
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology M N (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) =
      cohomology.mk _ 0 (HOM.cocyclesAddEquiv M N 0 (Cocycle.ofHom f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology, AddEquiv.trans_apply,
    quotientNullHomotopicAddEquiv_mk, AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq, HOM.cohomologyAddEquiv_mk]

name: DG.CatModule.cohomologyMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyMap_mk (φ : M ⟶ N) (X : C) (n : ℤ) (z : cocycles (M.obj X) n) :
    cohomologyMap φ X n (cohomology.mk _ n z) =
      cohomology.mk _ n (cocycles.mapAddMonoidHom (φ.app X) φ.map_mem φ.map_d n z)
proof:
:=
  cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_mk _ _ _ n z

name: DG.CatModule.cohomologyMap_id
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_id (M : CatModule.{w} C) (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomologyMap (𝟙 M) X n = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.cohomologyMap_zero
statement: theorem cohomologyMap_zero (X : C) (n : ℤ) : cohomologyMap (0 : M ⟶ N) X n = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  exact (congrArg (cohomology.mk _ n)
    (Subtype.ext rfl : (⟨0, zero_mem _⟩ : cocycles (N.obj X) n) = 0)).trans (map_zero _)

name: DG.CatModule.cohomologyMap_comp_apply
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_comp_apply (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ P) (X : C) (n : ℤ)
    (x : cohomology (M.obj X) n) :
    cohomologyMap (φ ≫ ψ) X n x = cohomologyMap ψ X n (cohomologyMap φ X n x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H z => rfl

name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopy.cohomologyMap_eq
statement:
theorem DGHomotopy.cohomologyMap_eq {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : DGHomotopy f g) (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomologyMap f X n = cohomologyMap g X n
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, cohomologyMap_mk]
  rw [cohomology.mk_eq_mk_iff]
  refine ⟨h.hom.app X z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h.hom.map_mem (cocycles.mem_grading z)
  · simp [h.comm (z : M.obj X), cocycles.d_eq_zero z]

name: DG.CatModule.Homotopic.cohomologyMap_eq
statement:
theorem Homotopic.cohomologyMap_eq {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : Homotopic f g) (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    cohomologyMap f X n = cohomologyMap g X n
proof:
:=
  h.some.cohomologyMap_eq X n

name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopyEquiv.cohomologyMap_inv_hom
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_inv_hom (e : DGHomotopyEquiv M N) (X : C) (n : ℤ)
    (x : cohomology (M.obj X) n) :
    cohomologyMap e.inv X n (cohomologyMap e.hom X n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cohomologyMap_comp_apply, e.homotopyHomInvId.cohomologyMap_eq, cohomologyMap_id]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopyEquiv.cohomologyMap_hom_inv
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_hom_inv (e : DGHomotopyEquiv M N) (X : C) (n : ℤ)
    (x : cohomology (N.obj X) n) :
    cohomologyMap e.hom X n (cohomologyMap e.inv X n x) = x
proof:
:=
  e.symm.cohomologyMap_inv_hom X n x

name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopyEquiv.bijective_cohomologyMap_hom
statement:
theorem bijective_cohomologyMap_hom (e : DGHomotopyEquiv M N) (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap e.hom X n)
proof:
:=
  Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
    ⟨cohomologyMap e.inv X n, e.cohomologyMap_inv_hom X n, e.cohomologyMap_hom_inv X n⟩

name: DG.CatModule.DGHomotopyEquiv.bijective_cohomologyMap_inv
statement:
theorem bijective_cohomologyMap_inv (e : DGHomotopyEquiv M N) (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap e.inv X n)
proof:
:=
  e.symm.bijective_cohomologyMap_hom X n

name: DG.CatModule.IsContractible.homotopic_zero_of_left
statement: theorem homotopic_zero_of_left (hM : IsContractible M) (f : M ⟶ N) : Homotopic f 0
proof:
:=
  (Homotopic.of_eq (Category.id_comp f).symm).trans
    ((hM.comp_right f).trans (Homotopic.of_eq Limits.zero_comp))

name: DG.CatModule.IsContractible.homotopic_zero_of_right
statement: theorem homotopic_zero_of_right (hN : IsContractible N) (f : M ⟶ N) : Homotopic f 0
proof:
:=
  (Homotopic.of_eq (Category.comp_id f).symm).trans
    ((hN.comp_left f).trans (Homotopic.of_eq Limits.comp_zero))

name: DG.CatModule.IsContractible.subsingleton_cohomology
statement:
theorem subsingleton_cohomology (hM : IsContractible M) (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    Subsingleton (cohomology (M.obj X) n)
proof:
:= by
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => φ x) (hM.cohomologyMap_eq X n)
  simpa [cohomologyMap_id, cohomologyMap_zero] using h

name: DG.CatModule.IsContractible.cohomology_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cohomology_eq_zero (hM : IsContractible M) {X : C} {n : ℤ}
    (x : cohomology (M.obj X) n) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  (hM.subsingleton_cohomology X n).elim x 0

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.coe_codRestrict_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Cochain.coe_codRestrict_app {n : ℤ} (c : Cochain P M n) (S : CatSubmodule M)
    (h : ∀ X x, c.app X x ∈ S.carrier X) {X : C} (x : P.obj X) :
    ((c.codRestrict S h).app X x).1 = c.app X x
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.coe_δ_codRestrict
statement:
theorem Cochain.coe_δ_codRestrict {n : ℤ} (m : ℤ) (c : Cochain P M n) (S : CatSubmodule M)
    (h : ∀ X x, c.app X x ∈ S.carrier X) {X : C} (x : P.obj X) :
    ((δ n m (c.codRestrict S h)).app X x).1 = (δ n m c).app X x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hnm : n + 1 = m
  · rw [δ_apply _ _ hnm, δ_apply _ _ hnm]
    rfl
  · rw [δ_shape _ _ hnm, δ_shape _ _ hnm]
    rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.isAcyclic_ker
statement:
theorem Hom.isAcyclic_ker (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ X, Function.Surjective (p.app X))
    (hq : IsQuasiIso p) : IsAcyclic (Hom.ker p).toCatModule
proof:
:= by
  intro X
  refine DG.isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun n z hz hdz => ?_
  have hz' : z.1 ∈ grading n := hz
  have hdz' : d z.1 = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hdz
  have hpz : p.app X z.1 = 0 := z.2
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := (cohomologyMap_injective_iff p X n).mp (hq X n).1 _ hz' hdz'
    ⟨0, zero_mem _, by rw [d_zero, hpz]⟩
  have hdpm : d (p.app X m) = 0 := by rw [← p.map_d, hdm, hpz]
  obtain ⟨m', hm', hdm', y, hy, hdy⟩ := (cohomologyMap_surjective_iff p X (n - 1)).mp
    (hq X (n - 1)).2 (p.app X m) (p.map_mem hm) hdpm
  obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := p.exists_mem_grading_of_surjective (hp X) hy
  refine ⟨⟨m - m' + d y', ?_⟩, ?_, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  · change p.app X (m - m' + d y') = 0
    rw [map_add, map_sub, p.map_d, hdy]
    abel
  · change m - m' + d y' ∈ grading (n - 1)
    exact add_mem (sub_mem hm hm') (by simpa using d_mem hy')
  · change d (m - m' + d y') = z.1
    rw [d_add, d_sub, hdm, hdm', d_d, sub_zero, add_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.HasLiftingProperty.isKProjective
statement: theorem HasLiftingProperty.isKProjective (h : HasLiftingProperty P) : IsKProjective P
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN f
  let E := cone (𝟙 (shift (-1) N))
  let p : E ⟶ N := cone.fstHom (𝟙 (shift (-1) N)) ≫
    (shiftShiftIso N (-1) 1 0 (by norm_num)).inv ≫ (shiftZeroIso N).hom
  have hE : IsContractible E := cone.isContractible_id _
  have hp : ∀ X, Function.Surjective (p.app X) := fun X y =>
    ⟨cone.inlAddHom _ X ((shiftShiftIso N (-1) 1 0 (by norm_num)).hom.app X
      ((shiftZeroIso N).inv.app X y)), rfl⟩
  have hq : IsQuasiIso p := isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic hE.isAcyclic hN p
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h E N p hp hq f
  rw [← hg]
  exact ((hE.homotopic_zero_of_right g).comp_right p).trans
    (Homotopic.of_eq Limits.zero_comp)

name: DG.CatModule.HasLiftingProperty.isGradedProjective
statement:
theorem HasLiftingProperty.isGradedProjective (h : HasLiftingProperty P) :
    IsGradedProjective P
proof:
:= by
  intro M N p hp f
  let q : cone (𝟙 M) ⟶ cone (𝟙 N) :=
    cone.map p p (by rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id])
  have hq : ∀ X, Function.Surjective (q.app X) := by
    intro X y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hp X (shift.unmk 1 ((cone.fstHom _).app X y))
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hp X (cone.sndAddHom _ X y)
    refine ⟨cone.inlAddHom _ X (shift.mk 1 a) + (cone.inr _).app X b, cone.ext ?_ ?_⟩
    · rw [cone.fstHom_map, map_add, map_add, cone.fstHom_inlAddHom, cone.fstHom_inr, map_zero,
        add_zero, shiftMap_app_mk, ha, shift.mk_unmk]
    · rw [cone.sndAddHom_map, map_add, map_add, cone.sndAddHom_inlAddHom, cone.sndAddHom_inr,
        map_zero, zero_add, hb]
  have hqq : IsQuasiIso q := isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic
    (cone.isContractible_id M).isAcyclic (cone.isContractible_id N).isAcyclic q
  let α : Cocycle P N 1 := Cocycle.mk (-δ 0 1 f) 2 (by norm_num) (by rw [δ_neg, δ_δ, neg_zero])
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := h _ _ q hq hqq (cone.lift (𝟙 N) α f (by
    ext X x
    simp [α]))
  refine ⟨(cone.snd (𝟙 M)).comp (Cochain.ofHom G) (zero_add 0), Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ : P ⟶ cone (𝟙 N) => (cone.snd (𝟙 N)).app X (φ.app X x)) hG
  simp only [comp_app, cone.lift_snd_apply] at h1
  rw [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, ← h1]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.hasLiftingProperty
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.hasLiftingProperty (hK : IsKProjective P) (hG : IsGradedProjective P) :
    HasLiftingProperty P
proof:
:= by
  intro M N p hp hq f
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := hG M N p hp (Cochain.ofHom f)
  have hpg : ∀ X x, p.app X (g₀.app X x) = f.app X x := fun X x =>
    congrArg (fun c : Cochain P N 0 => c.app X x) hg₀
  have hmem : ∀ X x, (δ 0 1 g₀).app X x ∈ (Hom.ker p).carrier X := fun X x => by
    rw [Hom.mem_ker, δ_zero_cochain_apply, map_sub, p.map_d, hpg, hpg, f.map_d, sub_self]
  have hc₁ : δ 1 (1 + 1) ((δ 0 1 g₀).codRestrict (Hom.ker p) hmem) = 0 :=
    Cochain.ext fun X x => Subtype.ext (by rw [Cochain.coe_δ_codRestrict, δ_δ]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := exists_δ_eq_of_isAcyclic
    (hK.isAcyclic_hom (Hom.isAcyclic_ker p hp hq)) (zero_add 1) _ hc₁
  have hg : δ 0 1 (g₀ - (Cochain.ofHom (Hom.ker p).subtype).comp c₀ (zero_add 0)) = 0 := by
    rw [δ_sub, δ_comp_ofHom, hc₀, sub_eq_zero]
    ext X x
    rfl
  refine ⟨Cocycle.homOf (Cocycle.mk _ 1 (zero_add 1) hg), hom_ext fun X x => ?_⟩
  change p.app X (g₀.app X x - (c₀.app X x).1) = f.app X x
  rw [map_sub, hpg, show p.app X (c₀.app X x).1 = 0 from (c₀.app X x).2, sub_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.hasLiftingProperty_iff
statement:
theorem hasLiftingProperty_iff :
    HasLiftingProperty P ↔ IsKProjective P ∧ IsGradedProjective P
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.isKProjective, h.isGradedProjective⟩, fun h => h.1.hasLiftingProperty h.2⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsGradedProjective.of_retract
statement:
theorem IsGradedProjective.of_retract (hP : IsGradedProjective P) (i : Q ⟶ P) (r : P ⟶ Q)
    (hri : i ≫ r = 𝟙 Q) : IsGradedProjective Q
proof:
:= by
  intro M N p hp f
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hP M N p hp (f.comp (Cochain.ofHom r) (zero_add 0))
  refine ⟨g.comp (Cochain.ofHom i) (zero_add 0), Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain P N 0 => c.app X (i.app X x)) hg
  simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [h, ← comp_app, hri, id_app]

name: DG.CatModule.GradedSplitting.exists_lift_extension
statement:
theorem GradedSplitting.exists_lift_extension {F G : CatModule.{w} C} {i : F ⟶ G} {p : G ⟶ Q}
    (σ : GradedSplitting i p) {M N : CatModule.{w} C} {q : M ⟶ N}
    (hQ : ∀ f : Cochain Q N 0, ∃ g : Cochain Q M 0, (Cochain.ofHom q).comp g (zero_add 0) = f)
    (f : Cochain G N 0) (g : Cochain F M 0)
    (hg : (Cochain.ofHom q).comp g (zero_add 0) = f.comp (Cochain.ofHom i) (zero_add 0)) :
    ∃ g' : Cochain G M 0, (Cochain.ofHom q).comp g' (zero_add 0) = f ∧
      ∀ {X : C} (x : F.obj X), g'.app X (i.app X x) = g.app X x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨gQ, hgQ⟩ := hQ (f.comp σ.s (zero_add 0))
  refine ⟨g.comp σ.r (zero_add 0) + gQ.comp (Cochain.ofHom p) (zero_add 0),
    Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_, fun {X} x => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := congrArg (fun c : Cochain F N 0 => c.app X (σ.r.app X x)) hg
    have h2 := congrArg (fun c : Cochain Q N 0 => c.app X (p.app X x)) hgQ
    simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply] at h1 h2
    simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, Cochain.add_apply, map_add, h1, h2]
    rw [← map_add, σ.i_r_add_s_p]
  · simp [σ.r_i, σ.p_i]

name: DG.CatModule.IsGradedProjective.of_gradedSplitting
proof:
:= by
  intro M N q hq f
  obtain ⟨gF, hgF⟩ := hF M N q hq (f.comp (Cochain.ofHom i) (zero_add 0))
  obtain ⟨g', hg', -⟩ := σ.exists_lift_extension (hQ M N q hq) f gF hgF
  exact ⟨g', hg'⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsGradedProjective.directSum
statement:
theorem IsGradedProjective.directSum {J : Type w'} [DecidableEq J]
    {F : J → CatModule.{max w w'} C} (h : ∀ j, IsGradedProjective (F j)) :
    IsGradedProjective (directSum F)
proof:
:=
  fun M N p hp f => Cochain.exists_lift_directSum p (fun j => h j M N p hp) f

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.isGradedProjective
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ p hp f => hg.exists_lift p hp f

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeFiltration.isGradedProjective
statement: theorem isGradedProjective : IsGradedProjective P
proof:
:= by
  intro M N p hp f
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Cochain.exists_of_filtration S.le_succ S.exists_mem
    (fun i => {g : Cochain (S.F i).toCatModule M 0 | (Cochain.ofHom p).comp g (zero_add 0) =
      f.comp (Cochain.ofHom (S.F i).subtype) (zero_add 0)})
    ⟨0, Cochain.ext fun X x => by
      obtain rfl : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (S.eq_zero_of_mem_zero X x.1 x.2)
      simp⟩
    (fun i g hg => by
      obtain ⟨g', hg', hext⟩ := (S.gradedSplitting i).exists_lift_extension
        (S.exists_lift_subquotient i p hp) (f.comp (Cochain.ofHom (S.F (i + 1)).subtype)
          (zero_add 0)) g (by rw [hg]; rfl)
      exact ⟨g', hg', hext⟩)
  refine ⟨g, Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := S.exists_mem X x
  exact congrArg (fun c : Cochain (S.F i).toCatModule N 0 => c.app X ⟨x, hi⟩) (hg i)

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeFiltration.hasLiftingProperty
statement: theorem hasLiftingProperty : HasLiftingProperty P
proof:
:=
  S.isKProjective.hasLiftingProperty S.isGradedProjective

name: DG.CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.isGradedProjective_F
statement:
theorem isGradedProjective_F {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ S.length) :
    IsGradedProjective (S.F i).toCatModule
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro M N p hp f
    refine ⟨0, Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (S.eq_zero_of_mem_zero X x.1 x.2)
    simp
  | succ i ih =>
    exact IsGradedProjective.of_gradedSplitting (S.gradedSplitting ⟨i, hi⟩) (ih (by omega))
      (S.isCornerGenerator ⟨i, hi⟩).isGradedProjective

name: DG.CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.isGradedProjective
statement: theorem isGradedProjective : IsGradedProjective P
proof:
:=
  (S.isGradedProjective_F le_rfl).of_retract
    (CatSubmodule.codRestrict (𝟙 P) fun X x => S.mem_length X x) (S.F S.length).subtype
    (CatSubmodule.codRestrict_comp_subtype _ _ _)

name: DG.CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.hasLiftingProperty
statement: theorem hasLiftingProperty : HasLiftingProperty P
proof:
:=
  S.isKProjective.hasLiftingProperty S.isGradedProjective

name: DG.CatSubmodule.coe_inclusion_app
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatSubmodule.le_of_le_succ
statement:
theorem le_of_le_succ {F : ℕ → CatSubmodule M} (hF : ∀ i X, (F i).carrier X ≤ (F (i + 1)).carrier X)
    {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (X : C) : (F i).carrier X ≤ (F j).carrier X
proof:
:= by
  induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact le_rfl
  | succ j _ ih => exact ih.trans (hF j X)

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.exists_mem_grading_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hp y
  refine ⟨decompose (grading (M := M.obj X)) x n, SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
  rw [← coe_decompose_map_of_map_mem (p.app X) (fun h => p.map_mem h),
    decompose_of_mem_same _ hy]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.glue_compat
statement:
theorem Cochain.glue_compat {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) {X : C} (x : P.obj X)
    (hi : x ∈ (F i).carrier X) (hj : x ∈ (F j).carrier X) :
    (c j).app X ⟨x, hj⟩ = (c i).app X ⟨x, hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ j hij ih =>
    rw [← ih (CatSubmodule.le_of_le_succ hF hij X hi), ← hc j]
    rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.glueFun_eq
statement:
theorem Cochain.glueFun_eq {i : ℕ} {X : C} {x : P.obj X} (hx : x ∈ (F i).carrier X) :
    glueFun hex c X x = (c i).app X ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hk := (hex X x).choose_spec
  set k := (hex X x).choose
  change (c k).app X ⟨x, hk⟩ = (c i).app X ⟨x, hx⟩
  rw [← glue_compat hF c hc (le_max_left k i) x hk
      (CatSubmodule.le_of_le_succ hF (le_max_left k i) X hk),
    ← glue_compat hF c hc (le_max_right k i) x hx
      (CatSubmodule.le_of_le_succ hF (le_max_right k i) X hx)]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.glue_apply
statement:
theorem Cochain.glue_apply {i : ℕ} {X : C} (x : (F i).toCatModule.obj X) :
    (glue hF hex c hc).app X x.1 = (c i).app X x
proof:
:=
  glueFun_eq hF hex c hc x.2

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.exists_of_filtration
statement:
theorem Cochain.exists_of_filtration (S : ∀ i, Set (Cochain (F i).toCatModule N n))
    (h0 : (S 0).Nonempty)
    (hstep : ∀ i, ∀ c ∈ S i, ∃ c' ∈ S (i + 1), ∀ {X : C} (x : (F i).toCatModule.obj X),
      c'.app X ((CatSubmodule.inclusion (hF i)).app X x) = c.app X x) :
    ∃ c : Cochain P N n, ∀ i, c.comp (Cochain.ofHom (F i).subtype) (zero_add n) ∈ S i
proof:
:= by
  choose next hnext hcompat using hstep
  let seq : ∀ i, {c : Cochain (F i).toCatModule N n // c ∈ S i} := fun i =>
    Nat.rec (motive := fun i => {c : Cochain (F i).toCatModule N n // c ∈ S i})
      ⟨h0.some, h0.some_mem⟩ (fun i c => ⟨next i c.1 c.2, hnext i c.1 c.2⟩) i
  refine ⟨glue hF hex (fun i => (seq i).1) (fun i _ x => hcompat i _ _ x), fun i => ?_⟩
  convert (seq i).2 using 1
  ext X x
  exact glue_apply hF hex (fun i => (seq i).1) (fun i _ x => hcompat i _ _ x) x

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.exists_lift
statement:
theorem exists_lift (hg : IsCornerGenerator R e k g) {M N : CatModule.{w} C} (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ X, Function.Surjective (p.app X)) (f : Cochain R N 0) :
    ∃ f' : Cochain R M 0, (Cochain.ofHom p).comp f' (zero_add 0) = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hpy⟩ := p.exists_mem_grading_of_surjective (hp X) (hg.app_gen_mem f)
  refine ⟨hg.ofElement y hy, hg.ext_gen ?_⟩
  rw [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, hg.ofElement_gen, p.map_smul, hpy,
    hg.val_smul_app_gen]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.exists_lift_directSum
statement:
theorem Cochain.exists_lift_directSum {J : Type w'} [DecidableEq J]
    {F : J → CatModule.{max w w'} C} {M N : CatModule.{max w w'} C} (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hF : ∀ j (f : Cochain (F j) N 0),
      ∃ f' : Cochain (F j) M 0, (Cochain.ofHom p).comp f' (zero_add 0) = f)
    (f : Cochain (directSum F) N 0) :
    ∃ f' : Cochain (directSum F) M 0, (Cochain.ofHom p).comp f' (zero_add 0) = f
proof:
:= by
  choose g hg using fun j => hF j (f.comp (Cochain.ofHom (directSumι F j)) (zero_add 0))
  refine ⟨Cochain.directSumDesc g, Cochain.directSum_ext fun j X x => ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun z : Cochain (F j) N 0 => z.app X x) (hg j)
  simpa [directSumι_app] using h

name: DG.CatModule.isCornerGenerator_semiFreeCell
statement:
theorem isCornerGenerator_semiFreeCell (k : ℤ) (X : C) :
    IsCornerGenerator (semiFreeCell.{w} k X) (DGCategory.Idempotent.id X) (0 - k)
      (shift.mk k (ULift.up (𝟙 X)))
proof:
:=
  ((isCornerGenerator_representable X).ulift.{w}).shift k

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeFiltration.mono
statement: theorem mono {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) (X : C) : (S.F i).carrier X ≤ (S.F j).carrier X
proof:
:=
  CatSubmodule.le_of_le_succ S.le_succ hij X

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeFiltration.isKProjective_subquotient
statement: theorem isKProjective_subquotient (i : ℕ) : IsKProjective (S.subquotient i)
proof:
:=
  IsKProjective.directSum fun _ => (isCornerGenerator_semiFreeCell _ _).isKProjective

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeFiltration.exists_lift_subquotient
statement:
theorem exists_lift_subquotient (i : ℕ) {M N : CatModule.{max v w} C} (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ X, Function.Surjective (p.app X)) (f : Cochain (S.subquotient i) N 0) :
    ∃ f' : Cochain (S.subquotient i) M 0, (Cochain.ofHom p).comp f' (zero_add 0) = f
proof:
:=
  Cochain.exists_lift_directSum p
    (fun _ f => (isCornerGenerator_semiFreeCell _ _).exists_lift p hp f) f

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeFiltration.exists_section
statement:
theorem exists_section (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : Cochain (S.subquotient i) (S.F (i + 1)).toCatModule 0,
      ∀ X y, (S.π i).app X (s.app X y) = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := S.exists_lift_subquotient i (S.π i) (S.surjective_π i) (Cochain.id _)
  exact ⟨s, fun X y => congrArg (fun c : Cochain _ _ 0 => c.app X y) hs⟩

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeFiltration.isKProjective
statement: theorem isKProjective : IsKProjective P
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN f
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Cochain.exists_of_filtration S.le_succ S.exists_mem
    (fun i => {h : Cochain (S.F i).toCatModule N (-1) |
      Cochain.ofHom ((S.F i).subtype ≫ f) = δ (-1) 0 h})
    ⟨0, Cochain.ext fun X x => by
      obtain rfl : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (S.eq_zero_of_mem_zero X x.1 x.2)
      simp⟩
    (fun i h hh => (S.gradedSplitting i).exists_extension ((S.isKProjective_subquotient i) N hN)
      ((S.F (i + 1)).subtype ≫ f) h hh)
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨h, Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := S.exists_mem X x
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain (S.F i).toCatModule N 0 => z.app X ⟨x, hi⟩) (hh i)
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain (S.F i).toCatModule N 0 => z.app X ⟨x, hi⟩)
    (δ_ofHom_comp (S.F i).subtype h 0)
  simp only [Cochain.ofHom_apply, comp_app, CatSubmodule.subtype_app, Cochain.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [Cochain.ofHom_apply]
  exact h1.trans h2

name: DG.CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.isCornerGenerator
statement:
theorem isCornerGenerator (i : Fin S.length) :
    IsCornerGenerator (shift (S.deg i) (ulift.{w} (corner (S.e i)))) (S.e i) (0 - S.deg i)
      (shift.mk (S.deg i) (ULift.up (cornerGen (S.e i))))
proof:
:=
  ((isCornerGenerator_corner (S.e i)).ulift.{w}).shift (S.deg i)

name: DG.CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.exists_section
statement:
theorem exists_section (i : Fin S.length) :
    ∃ s : Cochain (shift (S.deg i) (ulift.{w} (corner (S.e i)))) (S.F (i.1 + 1)).toCatModule 0,
      ∀ X y, (S.π i).app X (s.app X y) = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (S.isCornerGenerator i).exists_lift (S.π i) (S.surjective_π i)
    (Cochain.id _)
  exact ⟨s, fun X y => congrArg (fun c : Cochain _ _ 0 => c.app X y) hs⟩

name: DG.CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.isKProjective_F
statement: theorem isKProjective_F {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ S.length) : IsKProjective (S.F i).toCatModule
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro N _ f
    refine Homotopic.of_eq (hom_ext fun X x => ?_)
    rw [show x = 0 from Subtype.ext (S.eq_zero_of_mem_zero X x.1 x.2), map_zero, map_zero]
  | succ i ih =>
    exact IsKProjective.of_gradedSplitting (S.gradedSplitting ⟨i, hi⟩) (ih (by omega))
      (S.isCornerGenerator ⟨i, hi⟩).isKProjective

name: DG.CatModule.FiniteCellFiltration.isKProjective
statement: theorem isKProjective : IsKProjective P
proof:
:=
  (S.isKProjective_F le_rfl).of_retract
    (CatSubmodule.codRestrict (𝟙 P) fun X x => S.mem_length X x) (S.F S.length).subtype
    (Homotopic.of_eq (CatSubmodule.codRestrict_comp_subtype _ _ _))

name: DG.CatModule.mem_cornerFiltration_zero
statement:
theorem mem_cornerFiltration_zero {Y : C} {x : (ulift.{w} (corner e)).obj Y} :
    x ∈ (cornerFiltration e 0).carrier Y ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cornerFiltration, Hom.mem_ker, id_app]

name: DG.CatModule.mem_cornerFiltration_succ
statement:
theorem mem_cornerFiltration_succ {n : ℕ} {Y : C} (x : (ulift.{w} (corner e)).obj Y) :
    x ∈ (cornerFiltration e (n + 1)).carrier Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cornerFiltration, Hom.mem_ker, zero_app]

name: DG.CatModule.shiftDirectSumAddHom_apply
statement:
theorem shiftDirectSumAddHom_apply {X : C} (y : ⨁ j, (shift (k j) (R j)).obj X) (j : J) :
    shiftDirectSumAddHom n k R X y j = shift.mk (n + k j) (shift.unmk (k j) (y j))
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_apply _ _ _

name: DG.CatModule.bijective_shiftDirectSum_app
statement:
theorem bijective_shiftDirectSum_app (X : C) :
    Function.Bijective ((shiftDirectSum n k R).app X)
proof:
:= by
  let inv : (⨁ j, (shift (n + k j) (R j)).obj X) →+ (⨁ j, (shift (k j) (R j)).obj X) :=
    DirectSum.map fun j =>
      (shift.mk (M := R j) (X := X) (k j)).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (shift.unmk (M := R j) (X := X) (n + k j)).toAddMonoidHom
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
    ⟨fun y => shift.mk n (inv y), fun x => ?_, fun y => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y : ⨁ j, (shift (k j) (R j)).obj X, shift.mk n y = x :=
      ⟨shift.unmk n x, rfl⟩
    refine congrArg (shift.mk n) (DFinsupp.ext fun j => ?_)
    change inv (shiftDirectSumAddHom n k R X y) j = y j
    rw [DirectSum.map_apply]
    change shift.mk (k j) (shift.unmk (n + k j) (shiftDirectSumAddHom n k R X y j)) = y j
    rw [shiftDirectSumAddHom_apply]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : ∃ z : ⨁ j, (shift (n + k j) (R j)).obj X, z = y := ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine DFinsupp.ext fun j => ?_
    change shiftDirectSumAddHom n k R X (inv z) j = z j
    rw [shiftDirectSumAddHom_apply, DirectSum.map_apply]
    rfl

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.bijective_toFiltration_app
statement:
theorem bijective_toFiltration_app (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    Function.Bijective ((toFiltration M n).app X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective M) n X (congrArg Subtype.val h),
    fun ⟨_, y, hy⟩ => ⟨y, Subtype.ext hy⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.of_toObj
statement:
theorem of_toObj {n : ℕ} {X : C} (x : (filtration M n).toCatModule.obj X) :
    (SeqColimit.of (obj M) (ι M) n).app X ((toObj M n).app X x) = x.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ : (filtration M n).toCatModule ⟶ (filtration M n).toCatModule =>
    (φ.app X x).1) (IsIso.inv_hom_id (toFiltration M n))
  exact h

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.toObj_eq
statement:
theorem toObj_eq {n : ℕ} {X : C} {x : (filtration M n).toCatModule.obj X} {y : (obj M n).obj X}
    (h : (SeqColimit.of (obj M) (ι M) n).app X y = x.1) : (toObj M n).app X x = y
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective M) n X (by rw [of_toObj, h])

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.filtration_le_succ
statement:
theorem filtration_le_succ (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    (filtration M n).carrier X ≤ (filtration M (n + 1)).carrier X
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨(ι M n).app X y, SeqColimit.of_succ_ι n y⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.surjective_filtrationπ
statement:
theorem surjective_filtrationπ (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    Function.Surjective ((filtrationπ M n).app X)
proof:
:= by
  refine (bijective_shiftDirectSum_app _ _ _ X).2.comp
    (Function.Surjective.comp (fun y => ⟨cone.inlAddHom _ X y, cone.fstHom_inlAddHom y⟩) ?_)
  exact ((isIso_iff_bijective (toObj M (n + 1))).mp inferInstance X).2

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem filtrationπ_eq_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (X : C)
    (x : (filtration M (n + 1)).toCatModule.obj X) :
    (filtrationπ M n).app X x = 0 ↔ x.1 ∈ (filtration M n).carrier X
proof:
:= by
  rw [filtrationπ, comp_app, comp_app,
    map_eq_zero_iff _ (bijective_shiftDirectSum_app _ _ _ X).1]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hy : (toObj M (n + 1)).app X x = (ι M n).app X
        (cone.sndAddHom (attach (stage M n).π) X ((toObj M (n + 1)).app X x)) :=
      cone.ext (h.trans (cone.fstHom_inr _).symm) (cone.sndAddHom_inr _).symm
    refine ⟨cone.sndAddHom (attach (stage M n).π) X ((toObj M (n + 1)).app X x), ?_⟩
    rw [← SeqColimit.of_succ_ι, ← hy, of_toObj]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h' : (toObj M (n + 1)).app X x = (ι M n).app X y :=
      toObj_eq (by rw [SeqColimit.of_succ_ι]; exact hy)
    rw [h']
    exact cone.fstHom_inr y

name: DG.CatModule.exists_semiFreeResolution
statement:
theorem exists_semiFreeResolution (M : CatModule.{max u v w} C) :
    ∃ (P : CatModule.{max u v w} C) (π : P ⟶ M), (∀ X, Function.Surjective (π.app X)) ∧
      IsQuasiIso π ∧ Nonempty (SemiFreeFiltration.{max u v w} P)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, Resolution.π M, Resolution.surjective_π M, Resolution.isQuasiIso_π M,
    ⟨Resolution.semiFreeFiltration M⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.homotopic_of_comp_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [Homotopic.iff_sub]
  have hmem : ∀ X x, (f₁ - f₂).app X x ∈ (Hom.ker q).carrier X := fun X x => by
    rw [Hom.mem_ker, sub_app, map_sub, ← comp_app, h, comp_app, sub_self]
  have h1 := (hP _ (Hom.isAcyclic_ker q hq hqq)
    (CatSubmodule.codRestrict (f₁ - f₂) hmem)).comp_right (Hom.ker q).subtype
  rwa [CatSubmodule.codRestrict_comp_subtype, Limits.zero_comp] at h1

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.exists_homotopic_comp
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_homotopic_comp [DGCategory C] (hP : IsKProjective P) {s : N ⟶ N'}
    (hs : IsQuasiIso s) (g : P ⟶ N') : ∃ f : P ⟶ N, Homotopic (f ≫ s) g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hP.bijective_postcompHomotopy hs).2 (QuotientAddGroup.mk g)
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective c
  rw [postcompHomotopy_mk, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem] at hc
  exact ⟨f, homotopic_iff_sub_mem.mpr hc⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp [DGCategory C] (hP : IsKProjective P)
    {s : N ⟶ N'} (hs : IsQuasiIso s) {f₁ f₂ : P ⟶ N} (h : Homotopic (f₁ ≫ s) (f₂ ≫ s)) :
    Homotopic f₁ f₂
proof:
:= by
  have h' : postcompHomotopy P s (QuotientAddGroup.mk f₁) =
      postcompHomotopy P s (QuotientAddGroup.mk f₂) := by
    rw [postcompHomotopy_mk, postcompHomotopy_mk, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem,
      ← homotopic_iff_sub_mem]
    exact h
  exact homotopic_iff_sub_mem.mpr
    (QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mp ((hP.bijective_postcompHomotopy hs).1 h'))

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv (hP : IsKProjective P) (hP' : IsKProjective P')
    {p : P ⟶ M} (hp : IsQuasiIso p) {p' : P' ⟶ M} (hp' : IsQuasiIso p') :
    ∃ e : DGHomotopyEquiv P P', Homotopic (e.hom ≫ p') p ∧ Homotopic (e.inv ≫ p) p'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hP.exists_homotopic_comp hp' p
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hP'.exists_homotopic_comp hp p'
  have h₁ : Homotopic (φ ≫ ψ) (𝟙 P) := hP.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp hp
    ((Homotopic.of_eq (Category.assoc _ _ _)).trans (((hψ.comp_left φ)).trans
      (hφ.trans (Homotopic.of_eq (Category.id_comp p).symm))))
  have h₂ : Homotopic (ψ ≫ φ) (𝟙 P') := hP'.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp hp'
    ((Homotopic.of_eq (Category.assoc _ _ _)).trans (((hφ.comp_left ψ)).trans
      (hψ.trans (Homotopic.of_eq (Category.id_comp p').symm))))
  exact ⟨⟨φ, ψ, h₁.some, h₂.some⟩, hφ, hψ⟩

name: DG.CatModule.HasLiftingProperty.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem HasLiftingProperty.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv (hP : HasLiftingProperty P)
    (hP' : HasLiftingProperty P') {p : P ⟶ M} (hps : ∀ X, Function.Surjective (p.app X))
    (hp : IsQuasiIso p) {p' : P' ⟶ M} (hps' : ∀ X, Function.Surjective (p'.app X))
    (hp' : IsQuasiIso p') :
    ∃ e : DGHomotopyEquiv P P', e.hom ≫ p' = p ∧ e.inv ≫ p = p'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hP P' M p' hps' hp' p
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hP' P M p hps hp p'
  have h₁ : Homotopic (φ ≫ ψ) (𝟙 P) := hP.isKProjective.homotopic_of_comp_eq hps hp
    (by rw [Category.assoc, hψ, hφ, Category.id_comp])
  have h₂ : Homotopic (ψ ≫ φ) (𝟙 P') := hP'.isKProjective.homotopic_of_comp_eq hps' hp'
    (by rw [Category.assoc, hφ, hψ, Category.id_comp])
  exact ⟨⟨φ, ψ, h₁.some, h₂.some⟩, hφ, hψ⟩

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.hasLiftingProperty
statement: theorem hasLiftingProperty (R : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) : HasLiftingProperty R.P
proof:
:=
  R.filtration.hasLiftingProperty

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.isKProjective
statement: theorem isKProjective (R : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) : IsKProjective R.P
proof:
:=
  R.filtration.isKProjective

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_dgHomotopyEquiv (R R' : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) :
    ∃ e : DGHomotopyEquiv R.P R'.P, e.hom ≫ R'.π = R.π ∧ e.inv ≫ R.π = R'.π
proof:
:=
  R.hasLiftingProperty.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv R'.hasLiftingProperty R.surjective_π
    R.isQuasiIso_π R'.surjective_π R'.isQuasiIso_π

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.dgHomotopyEquiv_hom_comp_π
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgHomotopyEquiv_hom_comp_π (R R' : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) :
    (R.dgHomotopyEquiv R').hom ≫ R'.π = R.π
proof:
:=
  (R.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv R').choose_spec.1

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.dgHomotopyEquiv_inv_comp_π
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgHomotopyEquiv_inv_comp_π (R R' : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) :
    (R.dgHomotopyEquiv R').inv ≫ R.π = R'.π
proof:
:=
  (R.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv R').choose_spec.2

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.lift_comp_π
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem lift_comp_π (R : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) (R' : SemiFreeResolution.{w} N)
    (g : M ⟶ N) : R.lift R' g ≫ R'.π = R.π ≫ g
proof:
:=
  (R.hasLiftingProperty R'.P N R'.π R'.surjective_π R'.isQuasiIso_π (R.π ≫ g)).choose_spec

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.homotopic_lift
statement:
theorem homotopic_lift (R : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) (R' : SemiFreeResolution.{w} N)
    {g : M ⟶ N} {f : R.P ⟶ R'.P} (h : Homotopic (f ≫ R'.π) (R.π ≫ g)) :
    Homotopic f (R.lift R' g)
proof:
:=
  R.isKProjective.homotopic_of_homotopic_comp R'.isQuasiIso_π
    (h.trans (Homotopic.of_eq (R.lift_comp_π R' g).symm))

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.lift_homotopic
statement:
theorem lift_homotopic (R : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) (R' : SemiFreeResolution.{w} N)
    {g₁ g₂ : M ⟶ N} (h : Homotopic g₁ g₂) : Homotopic (R.lift R' g₁) (R.lift R' g₂)
proof:
:=
  R.homotopic_lift R' ((Homotopic.of_eq (R.lift_comp_π R' g₁)).trans (h.comp_left R.π))

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.lift_id
statement: theorem lift_id (R : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) : Homotopic (R.lift R (𝟙 M)) (𝟙 R.P)
proof:
:=
  (R.homotopic_lift R (f := 𝟙 R.P)
    (Homotopic.of_eq (by rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]))).symm

name: DG.CatModule.SemiFreeResolution.lift_comp
statement:
theorem lift_comp (R : SemiFreeResolution.{w} M) (R' : SemiFreeResolution.{w} N)
    (R'' : SemiFreeResolution.{w} L) (g : M ⟶ N) (g' : N ⟶ L) :
    Homotopic (R.lift R'' (g ≫ g')) (R.lift R' g ≫ R'.lift R'' g')
proof:
:=
  (R.homotopic_lift R'' (Homotopic.of_eq (by
    rw [Category.assoc, lift_comp_π, lift_comp_π_assoc]))).symm

name: DG.CatModule.HasLiftingProperty.of_retract
statement:
theorem HasLiftingProperty.of_retract {P Q : CatModule.{w} C} (hP : HasLiftingProperty P)
    (i : Q ⟶ P) (r : P ⟶ Q) (hri : i ≫ r = 𝟙 Q) : HasLiftingProperty Q
proof:
:=
  hasLiftingProperty_iff.mpr ⟨(hasLiftingProperty_iff.mp hP).1.of_retract i r
    (Homotopic.of_eq hri), (hasLiftingProperty_iff.mp hP).2.of_retract i r hri⟩

name: DG.CatModule.hasLiftingProperty_iff_exists_retract
statement:
theorem hasLiftingProperty_iff_exists_retract :
    HasLiftingProperty P ↔
      ∃ (Q : CatModule.{max u v w} C) (_ : SemiFreeFiltration.{max u v w} Q) (i : P ⟶ Q)
        (r : Q ⟶ P), i ≫ r = 𝟙 P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let R := semiFreeResolution P
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h R.P P R.π R.surjective_π R.isQuasiIso_π (𝟙 P)
    exact ⟨R.P, R.filtration, i, R.π, hi⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q, S, i, r, hri⟩
    exact S.hasLiftingProperty.of_retract i r hri

name: DG.CatModule.isKProjective_iff_exists_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem isKProjective_iff_exists_dgHomotopyEquiv :
    IsKProjective P ↔
      ∃ (Q : CatModule.{max u v w} C) (_ : SemiFreeFiltration.{max u v w} Q),
        Nonempty (DGHomotopyEquiv P Q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let R := semiFreeResolution P
    obtain ⟨e, -, -⟩ := h.exists_dgHomotopyEquiv R.isKProjective (p := 𝟙 P) (isQuasiIso_id P)
      R.isQuasiIso_π
    exact ⟨R.P, R.filtration, ⟨e⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q, S, ⟨e⟩⟩
    exact S.isKProjective.of_dgHomotopyEquiv e

name: DG.CatSubmodule.liftQCochain_app_mkQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftQCochain_app_mkQ {n : ℤ} (c : CatModule.Cochain M N n)
    (h : ∀ X, ∀ m ∈ S.carrier X, c.app X m = 0) {X : C} (m : M.obj X) :
    (S.liftQCochain c h).app X (S.mkQ.app X m) = c.app X m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.relHom_of
statement:
theorem relHom_of {X : C} (n : ℕ) (x : (S n).obj X) :
    relHomApp S ι X (DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) n x) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) n x -
        DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) (n + 1) ((ι n).app X x)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (fun n => (directSumι S n - ι n ≫ directSumι S (n + 1)).app X) n x

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.relHom_apply_zero
statement: theorem relHom_apply_zero {X : C} y : relHomApp S ι X y 0 = y 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]
  | of n x =>
    rw [relHom_of, DirectSum.sub_apply, of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Nat.succ_ne_zero n).symm, sub_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, DirectSum.add_apply, DirectSum.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.relHom_apply_succ
statement:
theorem relHom_apply_succ {X : C} y (k : ℕ) :
    relHomApp S ι X y (k + 1) = y (k + 1) - (ι k).app X (y k)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply, DirectSum.zero_apply, map_zero, sub_zero]
  | of n x =>
    rw [relHom_of, DirectSum.sub_apply]
    congr 1
    by_cases h : n = k
    · subst h
      rw [of_eq_same, of_eq_same]
    · rw [of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm h), map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, DirectSum.add_apply, hx, hy, DirectSum.add_apply, DirectSum.add_apply, map_add]
    abel

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.of_app
statement:
theorem of_app (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X) :
    (of S ι n).app X x =
      (Hom.range (relHom S ι)).mkQ.app X (DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) n x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.of_succ_ι
statement:
theorem of_succ_ι (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X) :
    (of S ι (n + 1)).app X ((ι n).app X x) = (of S ι n).app X x
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_app, of_app, eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, CatSubmodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff,
    ← relHom_of]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.ι_comp_of
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem ι_comp_of (n : ℕ) : ι n ≫ of S ι (n + 1) = of S ι n
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ x => of_succ_ι n x

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.exists_of_eq
statement:
theorem exists_of_eq {X : C} (x : (seqColimit S ι).obj X) :
    ∃ n y, (of S ι n).app X y = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (Hom.range (relHom S ι)).mkQ_surjective X x
  change ⨁ n, (S n).obj X at y
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, 0, by rw [map_zero, map_zero]⟩
  | of n x => exact ⟨n, x, rfl⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨i, a, ha⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨j, b, hb⟩ := hy
    have key : ∀ (i : ℕ) (a : (S i).obj X) (m : ℕ), i ≤ m →
        ∃ a' : (S m).obj X, (of S ι m).app X a' = (of S ι i).app X a := by
      intro i a m him
      induction m, him using Nat.le_induction with
      | base => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
      | succ m _ ih =>
        obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := ih
        exact ⟨(ι m).app X a', (of_succ_ι m a').trans ha'⟩
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := key i a (i + j) (Nat.le_add_right i j)
    obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := key j b (i + j) (Nat.le_add_left j i)
    refine ⟨i + j, a' + b', ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, ha', hb', ha, hb]
    rfl

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.of_injective
statement:
theorem of_injective (hι : ∀ n X, Function.Injective ((ι n).app X)) (n : ℕ) (X : C) :
    Function.Injective ((of S ι n).app X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  rw [of_app, CatSubmodule.mkQ_eq_zero_iff, Hom.mem_range] at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  change ⨁ n, (S n).obj X at y
  have hy' : ∀ k, relHomApp S ι X y k = (DirectSum.of (fun n => (S n).obj X) n x) k :=
    fun k => by rw [← hy]; rfl
  have h0 : ∀ k, k < n → y k = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro hk
      have h := relHom_apply_zero ι y
      rw [hy', of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega)] at h
      exact h.symm
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      have h := relHom_apply_succ ι y k
      rw [hy', of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), ih (by omega), map_zero, sub_zero] at h
      exact h.symm
  have hn : y n = x := by
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have h := relHom_apply_zero ι y
      rw [hy', of_eq_same] at h
      exact h.symm
    | succ k =>
      have h := relHom_apply_succ ι y k
      rw [hy', of_eq_same, h0 k (by omega), map_zero, sub_zero] at h
      exact h.symm
  by_contra hx0
  have hne : ∀ j, y (n + j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => exact hn ▸ hx0
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have h := relHom_apply_succ ι y (n + j)
      change y (n + j + 1) = 0 at hj
      rw [hy', of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), hj, zero_sub, eq_comm, neg_eq_zero,
        map_eq_zero_iff _ (hι _ X)] at h
      exact ih h
  exact Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (add_right_injective n) hne
    (DFinsupp.finite_support y)

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.descCochain_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descCochain_of {k : ℤ} (c : ∀ n, Cochain (S n) N k)
    (hc : ∀ n {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X), (c (n + 1)).app X ((ι n).app X x) = (c n).app X x)
    (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X) :
    (descCochain c hc).app X ((of S ι n).app X x) = (c n).app X x
proof:
:=
  Cochain.directSumDesc_app_of c n x

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.desc_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem desc_of (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X) :
    (desc g hg).app X ((of S ι n).app X x) = (g n).app X x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of (fun n => (g n).app X) n x

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.of_comp_desc
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem of_comp_desc (n : ℕ) : of S ι n ≫ desc g hg = g n
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ x => desc_of g hg n x

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.mem_grading
statement: theorem mem_grading : e.val ∈ grading (M := X ⟶ X) 0
proof: := e.mem_cocycles.1

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.d_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_val : d e.val = 0
proof: := e.mem_cocycles.2

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.comp_self_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_self_assoc {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : e.val ≫ e.val ≫ f = e.val ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, e.comp_self]

name: DG.DGCategory.Idempotent.twist_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twist_val (n : ℤ) : CatModule.twist n e.val = e.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [CatModule.twist_of_mem e.mem_grading, mul_zero, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.ulift_smul_down
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ulift_smul_down {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : (ulift.{w'} M).obj X) :
    (f • m : (ulift.{w'} M).obj Y).down = f • m.down
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.ulift_smul_up
statement:
theorem ulift_smul_up {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    f • (show (ulift.{w'} M).obj X from ULift.up m) =
      (show (ulift.{w'} M).obj Y from ULift.up (f • m))
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.mem_cornerSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cornerSubmodule_iff {Y : C} {h : X ⟶ Y} :
    h ∈ (cornerSubmodule e).carrier Y ↔ e.val ≫ h = h
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.of_bijective
statement:
theorem of_bijective [DGCategory C] (hk : g ∈ grading k) (hd : d g = 0)
    (hb : ∀ Y : C, Function.Bijective fun f : X ⟶ Y => f • g) :
    IsCornerGenerator R (DGCategory.Idempotent.id X) k g where
  mem_grading
proof:
:= hk
  d_eq_zero := hd
  val_smul := id_smul g
  surjective Y := (hb Y).2
  val_comp_eq_zero {Y} f hf := by
    rw [DGCategory.Idempotent.id_val, Category.id_comp]
    exact (hb Y).1 (hf.trans (zero_smul (M := R) g).symm)

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.app_smul_gen
statement:
theorem app_smul_gen {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    z.app Y (f • g) = twist n f • z.app X g
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f => rw [z.map_smul f.2, twist_of_mem f.2, units_smul_smul]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [add_smul, map_add, hf, hf', map_add, add_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.val_comp_eq
statement: theorem val_comp_eq {Y : C} {f f' : X ⟶ Y} (h : f • g = f' • g) : e.val ≫ f = e.val ≫ f'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← Preadditive.comp_sub]
  exact hg.val_comp_eq_zero _ (by rw [sub_smul, h, sub_self])

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.val_comp_smul
statement: theorem val_comp_smul {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (e.val ≫ f) • g = f • g
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_smul, hg.val_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_apply
statement:
theorem coord_apply {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) :
    hg.coord Y r = e.val ≫ Function.surjInv (hg.surjective Y) r
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_eq
statement:
theorem coord_eq {Y : C} {r : R.obj Y} {f : X ⟶ Y} (h : f • g = r) :
    hg.coord Y r = e.val ≫ f
proof:
:=
  hg.val_comp_eq ((Function.surjInv_eq (hg.surjective Y) r).trans h.symm)

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_smul_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coord_smul_gen {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : hg.coord Y (f • g) = e.val ≫ f
proof:
:=
  hg.coord_eq rfl

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coord_gen : hg.coord X g = e.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [hg.coord_eq (id_smul g), Category.comp_id]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coord_smul {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) : hg.coord Y r • g = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [coord_apply, hg.val_comp_smul, Function.surjInv_eq (hg.surjective Y)]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.val_comp_coord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem val_comp_coord {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) : e.val ≫ hg.coord Y r = hg.coord Y r
proof:
:= by
  rw [coord_apply, e.comp_self_assoc]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_act
statement:
theorem coord_act {Y Z : C} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (r : R.obj Y) :
    hg.coord Z (f • r) = hg.coord Y r ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hg.coord_smul r, ← comp_smul]
  rw [coord_smul_gen, ← Category.assoc, val_comp_coord]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.app_eq
statement:
theorem app_eq {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) :
    z.app Y r = twist n (hg.coord Y r) • z.app X g
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hg.coord_smul r]
  exact app_smul_gen z _

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ext_gen
statement: theorem ext_gen {n : ℤ} {z z' : Cochain R N n} (h : z.app X g = z'.app X g) : z = z'
proof:
:=
  Cochain.ext fun Y r => by rw [hg.app_eq z r, hg.app_eq z' r, h]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.app_gen_mem
statement: theorem app_gen_mem {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) : z.app X g ∈ grading (k + n)
proof:
:=
  z.map_mem hg.mem_grading

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.val_smul_app_gen
statement: theorem val_smul_app_gen {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) : e.val • z.app X g = z.app X g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← e.twist_val n, ← app_smul_gen z, hg.val_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_mem
statement:
theorem coord_mem {Y : C} {i : ℤ} {r : R.obj Y} (hr : r ∈ grading i) :
    hg.coord Y r ∈ grading (i - k)
proof:
:= by
  set f := Function.surjInv (hg.surjective Y) r
  have hf : f • g = r := Function.surjInv_eq (hg.surjective Y) r
  have h := decompose_map (k := k) ((R.act (X := X) (Y := Y)).flip g)
    (fun hm => smul_mem_grading hm hg.mem_grading) f (i - k)
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  change (decompose (grading (M := R.obj Y)) (f • g) i : R.obj Y) =
    (decompose (grading (M := X ⟶ Y)) f (i - k) : X ⟶ Y) • g at h
  rw [hf, decompose_of_mem_same _ hr] at h
  rw [hg.coord_eq h.symm]
  have := comp_mem_grading e.mem_grading
    (SetLike.coe_mem (decompose (grading (M := X ⟶ Y)) f (i - k)))
  rwa [zero_add] at this

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.coord_d
statement: theorem coord_d {Y : C} (r : R.obj Y) : hg.coord Y (d r) = d (hg.coord Y r)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hg.coord_smul r, d_smul_of_d_eq_zero_right hg.d_eq_zero]
  rw [coord_smul_gen, ← d_comp_of_d_eq_zero_left e.d_val, val_comp_coord]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_apply
statement:
theorem ofElement_apply {n : ℤ} (y : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n)) {Y : C}
    (r : R.obj Y) : (hg.ofElement y hy).app Y r = twist n (hg.coord Y r) • y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_smul_gen
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofElement_apply, coord_smul_gen]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofElement_gen {n : ℤ} (y : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n)) :
    (hg.ofElement y hy).app X g = e.val • y
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofElement_apply, coord_gen, e.twist_val]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_congr
statement:
theorem ofElement_congr {n : ℤ} {y y' : N.obj X} (h : y = y') (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n))
    (hy' : y' ∈ grading (k + n)) : hg.ofElement y hy = hg.ofElement y' hy'
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.eq_ofElement
statement: theorem eq_ofElement {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain R N n) : z = hg.ofElement _ (hg.app_gen_mem z)
proof:
:=
  hg.ext_gen (by rw [ofElement_gen, hg.val_smul_app_gen])

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.δ_ofElement
statement:
theorem δ_ofElement {n m : ℤ} (hnm : n + 1 = m) (y : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n))
    (hdy : d y ∈ grading (k + m)) : δ n m (hg.ofElement y hy) = hg.ofElement (d y) hdy
proof:
:=
  hg.ext_gen (by
    rw [δ_apply _ _ hnm, hg.d_eq_zero, map_zero, _root_.smul_zero, sub_zero, ofElement_gen,
      ofElement_gen, d_smul_of_d_eq_zero (e.mem_grading) e.d_val, koszulSign_zero, one_smul])

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_add
statement:
theorem ofElement_add {n : ℤ} (y y' : N.obj X) (hy : y ∈ grading (k + n))
    (hy' : y' ∈ grading (k + n)) :
    hg.ofElement (y + y') (add_mem hy hy') = hg.ofElement y hy + hg.ofElement y' hy'
proof:
:=
  Cochain.ext fun _ _ => by simp [ofElement_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofElement_zero {n : ℤ} : hg.ofElement (0 : N.obj X) (zero_mem (grading (k + n))) = 0
proof:
:=
  Cochain.ext fun _ _ => by simp [ofElement_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ofHom_eq_ofElement
statement:
theorem ofHom_eq_ofElement (φ : R ⟶ N) :
    Cochain.ofHom φ = hg.ofElement (φ.app X g) (by simpa using φ.map_mem hg.mem_grading)
proof:
:=
  hg.ext_gen (by rw [ofElement_gen, Cochain.ofHom_apply, ← φ.map_smul, hg.val_smul])

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.twist_twist_self
statement: theorem twist_twist_self (n : ℤ) {Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : twist n (twist n f) = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [twist_twist]
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    rw [twist_of_mem f.2, koszulSign_even ⟨n * i, by ring⟩, one_smul]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [map_add, hf, hf']

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.shift
statement:
theorem shift (n : ℤ) : IsCornerGenerator (CatModule.shift n R) e (k - n) (shift.mk n g) where
  mem_grading
proof:
:= shift.mk_mem_grading hg.mem_grading
  d_eq_zero := by rw [shift.d_mk, hg.d_eq_zero, _root_.smul_zero]; rfl
  val_smul := by rw [shift.smul_mk_eq, e.twist_val, hg.val_smul]
  surjective Y r := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hg.surjective Y (shift.unmk n r)
    refine ⟨twist n f, ?_⟩
    change shift.mk n (twist n (twist n f) • g) = r
    rw [twist_twist_self]
    exact (congrArg (shift.mk n) hf).trans (shift.mk_unmk r)
  val_comp_eq_zero {Y} f hf := by
    rw [shift.smul_mk_eq] at hf
    have h := hg.val_comp_eq_zero _ ((shift.mk n).injective (hf.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    rw [← e.twist_val n, ← twist_comp] at h
    rw [← twist_twist_self n (e.val ≫ f), h, map_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.ulift
statement:
theorem ulift : IsCornerGenerator (CatModule.ulift.{w'} R) e k (ULift.up g) where
  mem_grading
proof:
:= hg.mem_grading
  d_eq_zero := ULift.ext _ _ hg.d_eq_zero
  val_smul := ULift.ext _ _ hg.val_smul
  surjective Y r := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hg.surjective Y r.down
    exact ⟨f, ULift.ext _ _ hf⟩
  val_comp_eq_zero f hf := hg.val_comp_eq_zero f (congrArg ULift.down hf)

name: DG.CatModule.isCornerGenerator_representable
statement:
theorem isCornerGenerator_representable :
    IsCornerGenerator (representable X) (DGCategory.Idempotent.id X) 0 (𝟙 X)
proof:
:=
  IsCornerGenerator.of_bijective (id_mem_grading X) (d_id X) fun Y =>
    ⟨fun f f' h => by
      have h' : 𝟙 X ≫ f = 𝟙 X ≫ f' := h
      simpa using h', fun h => ⟨h, show 𝟙 X ≫ h = h from Category.id_comp h⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.ofElement_representable_eq_yonedaCochain
statement:
theorem ofElement_representable_eq_yonedaCochain {N : CatModule.{v} C} {n : ℤ} (y : N.obj X)
    (hy : y ∈ grading (0 + n)) :
    (isCornerGenerator_representable X).ofElement y hy =
      yonedaCochain n ⟨y, by rwa [zero_add] at hy⟩
proof:
:=
  (isCornerGenerator_representable X).ext_gen (by
    rw [IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_gen, DGCategory.Idempotent.id_val, yonedaCochain_app_id]
    exact id_smul y)

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaHOM_symm_eq_ofElement
statement:
theorem yonedaHOM_symm_eq_ofElement {N : CatModule.{v} C} {n : ℤ} {y : N.obj X}
    (hy : y ∈ grading n) :
    (yonedaHOM X N).symm y =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain (representable X) N n) n
        ((isCornerGenerator_representable X).ofElement y (by rwa [zero_add]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [yonedaHOM_symm_of_mem hy, ofElement_representable_eq_yonedaCochain]

name: DG.CatModule.isCornerGenerator_corner
statement:
theorem isCornerGenerator_corner (e : DGCategory.Idempotent X) :
    IsCornerGenerator (corner e) e 0 (cornerGen e) where
  mem_grading
proof:
:= e.mem_grading
  d_eq_zero := Subtype.ext e.d_val
  val_smul := Subtype.ext e.comp_self
  surjective _ h := ⟨h.1, Subtype.ext h.2⟩
  val_comp_eq_zero _ hf := congrArg Subtype.val hf

name: DG.IsAcyclic.of_dgAddEquiv
statement:
theorem IsAcyclic.of_dgAddEquiv {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [DGAddCommGroup M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [DGAddCommGroup N] (e : DGAddEquiv M N) (h : IsAcyclic N) : IsAcyclic M
proof:
:= by
  refine DG.isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun n m hm hdm => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy⟩ := h.exists_d_eq (e.map_mem hm) (by rw [← e.map_d, hdm, map_zero])
  exact ⟨e.symm y, e.symm.map_mem hy, e.injective (by rw [e.map_d, e.apply_symm_apply, hdy])⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsAcyclic.exists_d_eq
statement:
theorem IsAcyclic.exists_d_eq (h : IsAcyclic M) {X : C} {n : ℤ} {m : M.obj X}
    (hm : m ∈ grading n) (hdm : d m = 0) : ∃ m' ∈ grading (n - 1), d m' = m
proof:
:=
  DG.IsAcyclic.exists_d_eq (h X) hm hdm

name: DG.CatModule.IsAcyclic.shift
statement:
theorem IsAcyclic.shift [DGCategory C] (h : IsAcyclic M) (k : ℤ) :
    IsAcyclic (CatModule.shift k M)
proof:
:=
  fun X => DG.IsAcyclic.shift (h X) k

name: DG.CatModule.isAcyclic_hom_iff
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_hom_iff : DG.IsAcyclic (HOM M N) ↔
    ∀ (n m : ℤ), m + 1 = n → ∀ z : Cochain M N n, δ n (n + 1) z = 0 →
      ∃ y : Cochain M N m, δ m n y = z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n m hmn z hz
    have hsub := (HOM.cohomologyAddEquiv M N n).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp (h n)
    have h0 : (QuotientAddGroup.mk (Cocycle.mk z (n + 1) rfl hz) :
        Cocycle M N n ⧸ Cocycle.coboundaries M N n) = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff, Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff m hmn] at h0
    exact h0
  · intro h n
    refine (HOM.cohomologyAddEquiv M N n).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr ?_
    refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H z =>
      rw [QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff, Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff (n - 1) (sub_add_cancel n 1)]
      exact h n (n - 1) (sub_add_cancel n 1) z (Cocycle.δ_eq_zero z _)

name: DG.CatModule.exists_δ_eq_of_isAcyclic
statement:
theorem exists_δ_eq_of_isAcyclic (h : DG.IsAcyclic (HOM M N)) {n m : ℤ} (hmn : m + 1 = n)
    (z : Cochain M N n) (hz : δ n (n + 1) z = 0) : ∃ y : Cochain M N m, δ m n y = z
proof:
:=
  isAcyclic_hom_iff.mp h n m hmn z hz

name: DG.CatModule.homotopic_zero_iff_exists
statement:
theorem homotopic_zero_iff_exists {f : M ⟶ N} :
    Homotopic f 0 ↔ ∃ h : Cochain M N (-1), Cochain.ofHom f = δ (-1) 0 h
proof:
:=
  mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists

name: DG.CatModule.IsContractible.isAcyclic
statement: theorem IsContractible.isAcyclic (hM : IsContractible M) : IsAcyclic M
proof:
:=
  fun X n => hM.subsingleton_cohomology X n

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.homotopic_zero
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.homotopic_zero (hP : IsKProjective P) {N : CatModule.{w} C}
    (hN : IsAcyclic N) (f : P ⟶ N) : Homotopic f 0
proof:
:=
  hP N hN f

name: DG.CatModule.subsingleton_quotient_nullHomotopic_iff
statement:
theorem subsingleton_quotient_nullHomotopic_iff {N : CatModule.{w} C} :
    Subsingleton ((P ⟶ N) ⧸ nullHomotopic P N) ↔ ∀ f : P ⟶ N, Homotopic f 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h f
    have h0 : (QuotientAddGroup.mk f : (P ⟶ N) ⧸ nullHomotopic P N) = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff f).mp h0
  · intro h
    refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x => ?_
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H f => exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff f).mpr (h f)

name: DG.CatModule.isKProjective_iff_subsingleton_cohomology_hom
statement:
theorem isKProjective_iff_subsingleton_cohomology_hom :
    IsKProjective P ↔ ∀ N : CatModule.{w} C, IsAcyclic N →
      Subsingleton (cohomology (HOM P N) 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine forall_congr' fun N => forall_congr' fun _ => ?_
  rw [← (quotientNullHomotopicAddEquivCohomology P N).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr,
    subsingleton_quotient_nullHomotopic_iff]

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.isAcyclic_hom
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.isAcyclic_hom (hP : IsKProjective P) {N : CatModule.{w} C}
    (hN : IsAcyclic N) : DG.IsAcyclic (HOM P N)
proof:
:= by
  refine isAcyclic_hom_iff.mpr fun n m hmn z hz => ?_
  have hz' : δ 0 1 (z.rightShift n 0 (zero_add n)) = 0 := by
    rw [Cochain.δ_rightShift z n 0 1 (zero_add n) (n + 1) (add_comm 1 n), hz,
      Cochain.rightShift_zero, _root_.smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp
    (hP (shift n N) (hN.shift n) (Cocycle.homOf (Cocycle.mk _ 1 (zero_add 1) hz')))
  refine ⟨koszulSign n • h.rightUnshift m (by omega), ?_⟩
  rw [δ_units_smul, Cochain.δ_rightUnshift h m (by omega) n 0 (zero_add n), smul_smul,
    Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, ← hh, Cocycle.cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe, Cocycle.mk_coe,
    Cochain.rightUnshift_rightShift]

name: DG.CatModule.isKProjective_iff_isAcyclic_hom
statement:
theorem isKProjective_iff_isAcyclic_hom :
    IsKProjective P ↔ ∀ N : CatModule.{w} C, IsAcyclic N → DG.IsAcyclic (HOM P N)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hP N hN => hP.isAcyclic_hom hN, fun h N hN f => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_δ_eq_of_isAcyclic (h N hN) (neg_add_cancel 1) (Cochain.ofHom f)
    (δ_ofHom _)
  exact homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨y, hy.symm⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsCornerGenerator.isKProjective
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN φ
  have hφg : φ.app X g ∈ grading k := φ.map_mem hg.mem_grading
  have hdφg : d (φ.app X g) = 0 := by rw [← φ.map_d, hg.d_eq_zero, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hdy⟩ := hN.exists_d_eq hφg hdφg
  have hy' : e.val • y ∈ grading (k + -1) := by
    simpa [← sub_eq_add_neg] using smul_mem_grading e.mem_grading hy
  have hdey : d (e.val • y) = φ.app X g := by
    rw [d_smul_of_mem_zero e.mem_grading, e.d_val, zero_smul, zero_add, hdy, ← φ.map_smul,
      hg.val_smul]
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨hg.ofElement (e.val • y) hy', ?_⟩
  rw [hg.δ_ofElement (neg_add_cancel 1) _ hy' (by rw [hdey, add_zero]; exact hφg)]
  refine hg.ext_gen ?_
  rw [Cochain.ofHom_apply, hg.ofElement_gen, hdey, ← φ.map_smul, hg.val_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.isKProjective_representable
statement: theorem isKProjective_representable (X : C) : IsKProjective (representable X)
proof:
:=
  isKProjective_iff_isAcyclic_hom.mpr fun N hN =>
    (hN X).of_dgAddEquiv (yonedaHOM X N)

name: DG.CatModule.isKProjective_corner
statement: theorem isKProjective_corner {X : C} (e : DGCategory.Idempotent X) : IsKProjective (corner e)
proof:
:=
  (isCornerGenerator_corner e).isKProjective

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.of_retract
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_retract (hP : IsKProjective P) (i : Q ⟶ P) (r : P ⟶ Q)
    (hri : Homotopic (i ≫ r) (𝟙 Q)) : IsKProjective Q
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN f
  have h1 : Homotopic (i ≫ r ≫ f) 0 :=
    ((hP N hN (r ≫ f)).comp_left i).trans (Homotopic.of_eq Limits.comp_zero)
  exact ((Homotopic.of_eq (Category.id_comp f)).symm.trans
    ((hri.comp_right f).symm.trans (Homotopic.of_eq (Category.assoc _ _ _)))).trans h1

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.of_dgHomotopyEquiv
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_dgHomotopyEquiv (hP : IsKProjective P) (e : DGHomotopyEquiv Q P) :
    IsKProjective Q
proof:
:=
  hP.of_retract e.hom e.inv e.homotopyHomInvId.homotopic

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.of_iso
statement: theorem IsKProjective.of_iso (hP : IsKProjective P) (e : Q ≅ P) : IsKProjective Q
proof:
:=
  hP.of_retract e.hom e.inv (Homotopic.of_eq e.hom_inv_id)

name: DG.CatModule.IsContractible.isKProjective
statement: theorem IsContractible.isKProjective (hP : IsContractible P) : IsKProjective P
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ f => hP.homotopic_zero_of_left f

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.shift
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.shift [DGCategory C] (hP : IsKProjective P) (k : ℤ) :
    IsKProjective (CatModule.shift k P)
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN f
  have hz : δ (-k) (-k + 1) ((Cochain.ofHom f).leftUnshift (-k) (neg_add_cancel k)) = 0 := by
    rw [Cochain.δ_leftUnshift _ (-k) _ (-k + 1) 1 (by ring), δ_ofHom, Cochain.leftUnshift_zero,
      _root_.smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_δ_eq_of_isAcyclic (hP.isAcyclic_hom hN) (m := -k - 1) (by ring) _ hz
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨koszulSign k • y.leftShift k (-1) (by ring), ?_⟩
  rw [δ_units_smul, Cochain.δ_leftShift y k (-1) 0 (by ring) (-k) (neg_add_cancel k), hy,
    smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, Cochain.leftShift_leftUnshift]

name: DG.CatModule.Cochain.directSum_ext
proof:
:= by
  ext X x
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact (map_zero _).trans (map_zero _).symm
  | of j x => exact h j X x
  | add x y hx hy => exact (map_add _ _ _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy).trans
      (map_add _ _ _).symm)

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.directSum
statement: theorem IsKProjective.directSum (h : ∀ j, IsKProjective (F j)) : IsKProjective (directSum F)
proof:
:=
  fun N hN _ => Homotopic.of_directSum fun j =>
    (h j N hN _).trans (Homotopic.of_eq Limits.comp_zero.symm)

name: DG.CatModule.GradedSplitting.p_i
statement: theorem p_i {X : C} (x : F.obj X) : p.app X (i.app X x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := σ.i_r_add_s_p (i.app X x)
  rw [σ.r_i, add_eq_left] at h
  rw [← σ.p_s (p.app X (i.app X x)), h, map_zero]

name: DG.CatModule.GradedSplitting.exists_extension
statement:
theorem exists_extension {N : CatModule.{w} C} (hQ : ∀ g : Q ⟶ N, Homotopic g 0) (f : G ⟶ N)
    (h : Cochain F N (-1)) (hh : Cochain.ofHom (i ≫ f) = δ (-1) 0 h) :
    ∃ h' : Cochain G N (-1), Cochain.ofHom f = δ (-1) 0 h' ∧
      ∀ {X : C} (x : F.obj X), h'.app X (i.app X x) = h.app X x
proof:
:= by
  set hr : Cochain G N (-1) := h.comp σ.r (zero_add _)
  set g : Cochain G N 0 := Cochain.ofHom f - δ (-1) 0 hr with hg
  have e1 : hr.comp (Cochain.ofHom i) (zero_add _) = h :=
    Cochain.ext fun X x => by simp [hr, σ.r_i]
  have hg_i : ∀ {X : C} (x : F.obj X), g.app X (i.app X x) = 0 := fun {X} x => by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain F N 0 => z.app X x) (δ_ofHom_comp i hr 0)
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain F N 0 => z.app X x) hh
    simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, e1, comp_app] at h1 h2
    simp only [hg, Cochain.sub_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, h1, h2, sub_self]
  have hg_d : ∀ {X : C} (x : G.obj X), d (g.app X x) = g.app X (d x) := fun {X} x => by
    have h1 : δ 0 1 g = 0 := by rw [hg, δ_sub, δ_ofHom, δ_δ, sub_zero]
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain G N 1 => z.app X x) h1
    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using h2
  have hgs : δ 0 1 (g.comp σ.s (zero_add 0)) = 0 := by
    ext X y
    have hp : p.app X (d (σ.s.app X y) - σ.s.app X (d y)) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, Hom.map_d, σ.p_s, σ.p_s, sub_self]
    have hx := σ.i_r_add_s_p (d (σ.s.app X y) - σ.s.app X (d y))
    rw [hp, map_zero, add_zero] at hx
    rw [δ_zero_cochain_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, hg_d, ← map_sub, ← hx,
      hg_i, Cochain.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp
    (hQ (Cocycle.homOf (Cocycle.mk _ 1 (zero_add 1) hgs)))
  rw [Cocycle.cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe, Cocycle.mk_coe] at hk
  refine ⟨hr + k.comp (Cochain.ofHom p) (zero_add _), ?_, fun {X} x => ?_⟩
  · ext X x
    have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain G N 0 => z.app X x) (δ_ofHom_comp p k 0)
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain Q N 0 => z.app X (p.app X x)) hk
    simp only [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply] at h1 h2
    have h3 : g.app X x = g.app X (σ.s.app X (p.app X x)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← σ.i_r_add_s_p x]
      rw [map_add, hg_i, zero_add]
    rw [δ_add, Cochain.add_apply, h1, ← h2, ← h3, hg, Cochain.sub_apply, add_sub_cancel]
  · simp [hr, σ.r_i, σ.p_i]

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.of_gradedSplitting
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.of_gradedSplitting {i : F ⟶ G} {p : G ⟶ Q} (σ : GradedSplitting i p)
    (hF : IsKProjective F) (hQ : IsKProjective Q) : IsKProjective G
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN f
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp (hF N hN (i ≫ f))
  obtain ⟨h', hh', -⟩ := σ.exists_extension (hQ N hN) f h hh
  exact homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨h', hh'⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.cone
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.cone {f : M ⟶ N} (hM : IsKProjective M) (hN : IsKProjective N) :
    IsKProjective (cone f)
proof:
:=
  IsKProjective.of_gradedSplitting (cone.gradedSplitting f) hN (hM.shift 1)

name: DG.CatModule.cohomologyMap_injective_iff
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_injective_iff (s : M ⟶ N) (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (cohomologyMap s X n) ↔
      ∀ x ∈ grading n, d x = 0 → s.app X x ∈ coboundaries (N.obj X) n →
        x ∈ coboundaries (M.obj X) n
proof:
:=
  cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_injective_iff _ _ _ n

name: DG.CatModule.cohomologyMap_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem cohomologyMap_surjective_iff (s : M ⟶ N) (X : C) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Surjective (cohomologyMap s X n) ↔
      ∀ y ∈ grading n, d y = 0 →
        ∃ x ∈ grading n, d x = 0 ∧ s.app X x - y ∈ coboundaries (N.obj X) n
proof:
:=
  cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_surjective_iff _ _ _ n

name: DG.CatModule.isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic
statement:
theorem isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic (hM : IsAcyclic M) (hN : IsAcyclic N) (s : M ⟶ N) :
    IsQuasiIso s
proof:
:= fun X n =>
  ⟨fun _ _ _ => (hM X n).elim _ _, fun _ => ⟨0, (hN X n).elim _ _⟩⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsQuasiIso.isAcyclic_cone
statement: theorem IsQuasiIso.isAcyclic_cone {s : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsQuasiIso s) : IsAcyclic (cone s)
proof:
:= by
  intro X
  refine DG.isAcyclic_iff.mpr fun k p hp hdp => ?_
  have hx : (cone.fst s).1.app X p ∈ grading (k + 1) := (cone.fst s).1.map_mem hp
  have hy : (cone.snd s).app X p ∈ grading k := by simpa using (cone.snd s).map_mem hp
  have hdx : d ((cone.fst s).1.app X p) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg ((cone.fst s).1.app X) hdp
    rwa [cone.d_fst_apply, map_zero, neg_eq_zero] at h
  have hsxy : s.app X ((cone.fst s).1.app X p) + d ((cone.snd s).app X p) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg ((cone.snd s).app X) hdp
    rwa [cone.d_snd_apply, map_zero] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hdu⟩ := (cohomologyMap_injective_iff s X (k + 1)).mp (hs X (k + 1)).1 _ hx hdx
    ⟨-(cone.snd s).app X p, by simpa using neg_mem hy,
      by rw [d_neg, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm, hsxy]⟩
  have hu' : u ∈ grading k := by simpa using hu
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw, v, hv, hdv⟩ := (cohomologyMap_surjective_iff s X k).mp (hs X k).2
    ((cone.snd s).app X p + s.app X u) (add_mem hy (s.map_mem hu'))
    (by rw [d_add, ← s.map_d, hdu, add_comm, hsxy])
  refine ⟨(cone.inl s).app X (w - u) + (cone.inr s).app X (-v),
    add_mem ?_ ((cone.inr s).map_mem (neg_mem hv)), ?_⟩
  · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using (cone.inl s).map_mem (sub_mem hw hu')
  · refine cone.ext_to ?_ ?_
    · simp only [cone.d_fst_apply, map_add, cone.inl_fst_apply, cone.inr_fst_apply, add_zero,
        d_sub, hdw, hdu, zero_sub, neg_neg, d_zero, neg_zero]
    · simp only [cone.d_snd_apply, map_add, cone.inl_fst_apply, cone.inr_fst_apply,
        cone.inl_snd_apply, cone.inr_snd_apply, add_zero, zero_add, d_neg, hdv, map_sub,
        map_zero]
      abel

name: DG.CatModule.isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic_cone
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_of_isAcyclic_cone {s : M ⟶ N} (h : IsAcyclic (cone s)) : IsQuasiIso s
proof:
:= by
  intro X n
  constructor
  · rw [cohomologyMap_injective_iff]
    rintro x hx hdx ⟨v, hv, hdv⟩
    have hp : (cone.inl s).app X x + (cone.inr s).app X (-v) ∈ grading (n - 1) :=
      add_mem (by simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using (cone.inl s).map_mem hx)
        ((cone.inr s).map_mem (neg_mem hv))
    have hdp : d ((cone.inl s).app X x + (cone.inr s).app X (-v)) = 0 := by
      refine cone.ext_to ?_ ?_
      · simp only [cone.d_fst_apply, map_add, cone.inl_fst_apply, cone.inr_fst_apply, add_zero,
          hdx, neg_zero, map_zero]
      · simp only [cone.d_snd_apply, map_add, cone.inl_fst_apply, cone.inr_fst_apply,
          cone.inl_snd_apply, cone.inr_snd_apply, add_zero, zero_add, d_neg, hdv, add_neg_cancel,
          map_zero]
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hdq⟩ := h.exists_d_eq hp hdp
    refine ⟨-(cone.fst s).1.app X q, by simpa using neg_mem ((cone.fst s).1.map_mem hq), ?_⟩
    have h1 := congrArg ((cone.fst s).1.app X) hdq
    rw [cone.d_fst_apply, map_add, cone.inl_fst_apply, cone.inr_fst_apply, add_zero] at h1
    rw [d_neg, h1]
  · rw [cohomologyMap_surjective_iff]
    intro y hy hdy
    have hdp : d ((cone.inr s).app X y) = 0 := by rw [cone.inr_d_apply, hdy, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hdq⟩ := h.exists_d_eq ((cone.inr s).map_mem hy) hdp
    have h1 := congrArg ((cone.fst s).1.app X) hdq
    have h2 := congrArg ((cone.snd s).app X) hdq
    rw [cone.d_fst_apply, cone.inr_fst_apply, neg_eq_zero] at h1
    rw [cone.d_snd_apply, cone.inr_snd_apply] at h2
    refine ⟨(cone.fst s).1.app X q, by simpa using (cone.fst s).1.map_mem hq, h1,
      -(cone.snd s).app X q, by simpa using neg_mem ((cone.snd s).map_mem hq), ?_⟩
    rw [d_neg, ← h2]
    abel

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcomp_of
statement:
theorem postcomp_of (s : N ⟶ N') (n : ℤ) (z : Cochain P N n) :
    postcomp P s (DirectSum.of _ n z) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N' n) n ((Cochain.ofHom s).comp z (add_zero n))
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.map_of _ _ _

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcomp_mem
statement:
theorem postcomp_mem (s : N ⟶ N') {n : ℤ} {x : HOM P N} (hx : x ∈ grading n) :
    postcomp P s x ∈ grading n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := mem_summand.mp hx
  rw [postcomp_of]
  exact of_mem_summand _ _

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.postcomp_d
statement: theorem postcomp_d (s : N ⟶ N') (x : HOM P N) : postcomp P s (d x) = d (postcomp P s x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n z => rw [d_of, postcomp_of, postcomp_of, d_of, δ_comp_ofHom]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.of_mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem of_mem_grading_iff {n : ℤ} {x : HOM P N} :
    x ∈ grading n ↔ ∃ z : Cochain P N n, DirectSum.of _ n z = x
proof:
:=
  mem_summand

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.d_of_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem d_of_eq_zero_iff {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain P N n) :
    d (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N n) n z : HOM P N) = 0 ↔ δ n (n + 1) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_of, ← map_zero (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N n) (n + 1))]
  exact (DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun n => Cochain P N n) (n + 1)).eq_iff

name: DG.CatModule.HOM.of_mem_coboundaries_iff
statement:
theorem of_mem_coboundaries_iff {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain P N n) (hz : δ n (n + 1) z = 0) :
    (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain P N n) n z : HOM P N) ∈ coboundaries (HOM P N) n ↔
      ∃ y : Cochain P N (n - 1), δ (n - 1) n y = z
proof:
:=
  (cocyclesAddEquiv_mem_coboundaries_iff n (Cocycle.mk z (n + 1) rfl hz)).trans
    (Cocycle.mem_coboundaries_iff (n - 1) (sub_add_cancel n 1) _)

name: DG.CatModule.postcompHomotopy_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompHomotopy_mk (s : N ⟶ N') (f : P ⟶ N) :
    postcompHomotopy P s (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (f ≫ s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.exists_cocycle_of_isQuasiIso
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_cocycle_of_isQuasiIso (hP : IsKProjective P) {s : N ⟶ N'}
    (hs : IsQuasiIso s) {n m : ℤ} (hmn : m + 1 = n) (z' : Cochain P N' n)
    (hz' : δ n (n + 1) z' = 0) :
    ∃ (α : Cochain P N n) (β : Cochain P N' m), δ n (n + 1) α = 0 ∧
      (Cochain.ofHom s).comp α (add_zero n) = z' - δ m n β
proof:
:= by
  have hC := hP.isAcyclic_hom (IsQuasiIso.isAcyclic_cone hs)
  have hw0 : δ n (n + 1) ((Cochain.ofHom (cone.inr s)).comp z' (add_zero n)) = 0 := by
    rw [δ_comp_ofHom, hz', Cochain.comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_δ_eq_of_isAcyclic hC hmn _ hw0
  have hw' : w = cone.liftCochain s ((cone.fst s).1.comp w hmn) ((cone.snd s).comp w
      (add_zero m)) hmn :=
    Cochain.ext fun X x => cone.ext_to (by simp) (by simp)
  rw [hw', cone.δ_liftCochain s _ _ hmn (n + 1) rfl] at hw
  refine ⟨(cone.fst s).1.comp w hmn, (cone.snd s).comp w (add_zero m), ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext X x
    have h := congrArg
      (fun c : Cochain P (CatModule.cone s) n => (cone.fst s).1.app X (c.app X x)) hw
    simpa using h
  · ext X x
    have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain P (CatModule.cone s) n => (cone.snd s).app X (c.app X x)) hw
    simp only [Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.neg_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
      map_add, map_neg, cone.inl_snd_apply, cone.inr_snd_apply, neg_zero, zero_add] at h
    rw [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, Cochain.sub_apply, ← h]
    abel

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.exists_δ_eq_of_isQuasiIso
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.exists_δ_eq_of_isQuasiIso (hP : IsKProjective P) {s : N ⟶ N'}
