    (hs : IsQuasiIso s) {n m : ℤ} (hmn : m + 1 = n) (z : Cochain P N n)
    (hz : δ n (n + 1) z = 0) (y' : Cochain P N' m)
    (hy' : (Cochain.ofHom s).comp z (add_zero n) = δ m n y') :
    ∃ y : Cochain P N m, δ m n y = z
proof:
:= by
  subst hmn
  have hC := hP.isAcyclic_hom (IsQuasiIso.isAcyclic_cone hs)
  have hw : δ m (m + 1) (cone.liftCochain s z (-y') rfl) = 0 := by
    rw [cone.δ_liftCochain s _ _ rfl (m + 1 + 1) rfl, hz, δ_neg, hy', neg_add_cancel,
      Cochain.comp_zero, Cochain.comp_zero, neg_zero, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_δ_eq_of_isAcyclic hC (sub_add_cancel m 1) _ hw
  have hu' : u = cone.liftCochain s ((cone.fst s).1.comp u (sub_add_cancel m 1))
      ((cone.snd s).comp u (add_zero _)) (sub_add_cancel m 1) :=
    Cochain.ext fun X x => cone.ext_to (by simp) (by simp)
  rw [hu', cone.δ_liftCochain s _ _ (sub_add_cancel m 1) (m + 1) rfl] at hu
  refine ⟨-(cone.fst s).1.comp u (sub_add_cancel m 1), ?_⟩
  ext X x
  have h := congrArg (fun c : Cochain P (CatModule.cone s) m => (cone.fst s).1.app X (c.app X x)) hu
  simp only [Cochain.add_apply, Cochain.neg_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
    map_add, map_neg, cone.inl_fst_apply, cone.inr_fst_apply, add_zero,
    cone.liftCochain_fst_apply] at h
  rw [δ_neg, Cochain.neg_apply, h]

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.bijective_cohomology_postcomp
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.bijective_cohomology_postcomp (hP : IsKProjective P) {s : N ⟶ N'}
    (hs : IsQuasiIso s) (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom (HOM.postcomp P s)
      (HOM.postcomp_mem s) (HOM.postcomp_d s) n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_injective_iff]
    intro x hx hdx hsx
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := HOM.of_mem_grading_iff.mp hx
    rw [HOM.d_of_eq_zero_iff] at hdx
    have hsz : δ n (n + 1) ((Cochain.ofHom s).comp z (add_zero n)) = 0 := by
      rw [δ_comp_ofHom, hdx, Cochain.comp_zero]
    rw [HOM.postcomp_of, HOM.of_mem_coboundaries_iff _ hsz] at hsx
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hsx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hP.exists_δ_eq_of_isQuasiIso hs (sub_add_cancel n 1) z hdx y' hy'.symm
    exact (HOM.of_mem_coboundaries_iff z hdx).mpr ⟨y, hy⟩
  · rw [cohomology.mapAddMonoidHom_surjective_iff]
    intro y hy hdy
    obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := HOM.of_mem_grading_iff.mp hy
    rw [HOM.d_of_eq_zero_iff] at hdy
    obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hαβ⟩ := hP.exists_cocycle_of_isQuasiIso hs (sub_add_cancel n 1) z' hdy
    refine ⟨DirectSum.of _ n α, of_mem_summand _ _, (HOM.d_of_eq_zero_iff α).mpr hα, ?_⟩
    rw [HOM.postcomp_of, hαβ, ← map_sub, sub_sub_cancel_left,
      HOM.of_mem_coboundaries_iff _ (by rw [δ_neg, δ_δ, neg_zero])]
    exact ⟨-β, δ_neg _ _ β⟩

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.bijective_postcompHomotopy
statement:
theorem IsKProjective.bijective_postcompHomotopy (hP : IsKProjective P) {s : N ⟶ N'}
    (hs : IsQuasiIso s) : Function.Bijective (postcompHomotopy P s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro c hc
    induction c using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H f =>
      rw [postcompHomotopy_mk, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff, mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists] at hc
      obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hc
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hP.exists_δ_eq_of_isQuasiIso hs (neg_add_cancel 1) (Cochain.ofHom f)
        (δ_ofHom _) y' hy'
      exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff f).mpr (mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists.mpr ⟨y, hy.symm⟩)
  · intro c
    induction c using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H f' =>
      obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hαβ⟩ := hP.exists_cocycle_of_isQuasiIso hs (neg_add_cancel 1)
        (Cochain.ofHom f') (δ_ofHom _)
      refine ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk (Cocycle.homOf (Cocycle.mk α 1 (zero_add 1) hα)), ?_⟩
      rw [postcompHomotopy_mk, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem, mem_nullHomotopic_iff_exists]
      refine ⟨-β, ?_⟩
      rw [Cochain.ofHom_sub, Cochain.ofHom_comp, Cocycle.cochain_ofHom_homOf_eq_coe,
        Cocycle.mk_coe, hαβ, δ_neg]
      abel

name: DG.CatModule.IsKProjective.postcompHomotopyEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsKProjective.postcompHomotopyEquiv_mk (hP : IsKProjective P) {s : N ⟶ N'}
    (hs : IsQuasiIso s) (f : P ⟶ N) :
    hP.postcompHomotopyEquiv hs (QuotientAddGroup.mk f) = QuotientAddGroup.mk (f ≫ s)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.SeqColimit.isKProjective
statement:
theorem isKProjective (h0 : IsKProjective (S 0))
    (hι : ∀ n, ∃ (Q : CatModule.{w} C) (p : S (n + 1) ⟶ Q),
      Nonempty (GradedSplitting (ι n) p) ∧ IsKProjective Q) :
    IsKProjective (seqColimit S ι)
proof:
:= by
  intro N hN f
  let P : ∀ n, Cochain (S n) N (-1) → Prop := fun n h =>
    Cochain.ofHom (of S ι n ≫ f) = δ (-1) 0 h
  have step : ∀ n (h : {h // P n h}), ∃ h' : {h // P (n + 1) h},
      ∀ {X : C} (x : (S n).obj X), h'.1.app X ((ι n).app X x) = h.1.app X x := by
    intro n h
    obtain ⟨Q, p, ⟨σ⟩, hQ⟩ := hι n
    obtain ⟨h', hh', hext⟩ := σ.exists_extension (hQ N hN) (of S ι (n + 1) ≫ f) h.1
      (by rw [ι_comp_of_assoc]; exact h.2)
    exact ⟨⟨h', hh'⟩, hext⟩
  choose F hF using step
  have h₀ : ∃ h, P 0 h := homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mp (h0 N hN (of S ι 0 ≫ f))
  let seq : ∀ n, {h // P n h} := fun n =>
    Nat.rec (motive := fun n => {h // P n h}) ⟨h₀.choose, h₀.choose_spec⟩ (fun n h => F n h) n
  let H : Cochain (seqColimit S ι) N (-1) :=
    descCochain (fun n => (seq n).1) (fun n _ x => hF n (seq n) x)
  refine homotopic_zero_iff_exists.mpr ⟨H, Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, y, rfl⟩ := exists_of_eq x
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Cochain (S n) N 0 => z.app X y) (seq n).2
  simp only [Cochain.ofHom_apply, comp_app, δ_neg_one_apply] at h1
  rw [Cochain.ofHom_apply, h1, δ_neg_one_apply, ← Hom.map_d]
  simp only [H, descCochain_of]

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.Cell.isCornerGenerator
statement:
theorem Cell.isCornerGenerator (c : Cell p) :
    IsCornerGenerator c.module (DGCategory.Idempotent.id c.X) (0 - -c.deg) c.gen
proof:
:=
  ((isCornerGenerator_representable c.X).ulift.{max u v w}).shift (-c.deg)

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.Cell.z_mem'
statement: theorem Cell.z_mem' (c : Cell p) : c.z ∈ grading ((0 - -c.deg) + 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (0 - -c.deg) + 0 = c.deg by ring]
  exact c.z_mem

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.Cell.m_mem'
statement: theorem Cell.m_mem' (c : Cell p) : c.m ∈ grading ((0 - -c.deg) + -1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (0 - -c.deg) + -1 = c.deg - 1 by ring]
  exact c.m_mem

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.attachCell_gen
statement: theorem attachCell_gen (c : Cell p) : (attachCell p c).app c.X c.gen = c.z
proof:
:= by
  change (c.isCornerGenerator.ofElement (n := 0) c.z c.z_mem').app c.X c.gen = c.z
  rw [IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_gen, DGCategory.Idempotent.id_val, id_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.attach_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem attach_gen (c : Cell p) :
    (attach p).app c.X ((directSumι _ c).app c.X c.gen) = c.z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_app, attach, directSumι_desc, attachCell_gen]

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.homotopy_gen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homotopy_gen (c : Cell p) :
    (homotopy p).app c.X ((directSumι _ c).app c.X c.gen) = c.m
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopy, directSumι_app, Cochain.directSumDesc_app_of,
    IsCornerGenerator.ofElement_gen, DGCategory.Idempotent.id_val, id_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.δ_homotopy
statement: theorem δ_homotopy : δ (-1) 0 (homotopy p) = Cochain.ofHom (attach p ≫ p)
proof:
:=
  Cochain.directSum_ext fun c X x => by
    have key : (δ (-1) 0 (homotopy p)).comp (Cochain.ofHom (directSumι _ c)) (zero_add 0) =
        (Cochain.ofHom (attach p ≫ p)).comp (Cochain.ofHom (directSumι _ c)) (zero_add 0) := by
      refine c.isCornerGenerator.ext_gen ?_
      rw [Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.comp_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply, Cochain.ofHom_apply,
        δ_neg_one_apply, ← Hom.map_d, c.isCornerGenerator.d_eq_zero, map_zero, map_zero,
        add_zero, homotopy_gen, comp_app, attach_gen, c.p_z]
    exact congrArg (fun z : Cochain c.module M 0 => z.app X x) key

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.Stage.exists_step
statement:
theorem Stage.exists_step (s : Stage M) {X : C} {j : ℤ} {z : s.obj.obj X} (hz : z ∈ grading j)
    (hdz : d z = 0) {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading (j - 1)) (hpz : s.π.app X z = d m) :
    ∃ e : s.step.obj.obj X, e ∈ grading (j - 1) ∧ d e = (cone.inr (attach s.π)).app X z ∧
      s.step.π.app X e = m
proof:
:= by
  let c : Cell s.π := ⟨X, j, z, m, hz, hdz, hm, hpz⟩
  let g := (directSumι _ c).app c.X c.gen
  have hg : g ∈ grading j := by
    have := (directSumι _ c).map_mem c.isCornerGenerator.mem_grading
    rwa [show (0 : ℤ) - -j = j by ring] at this
  have hdg : d g = 0 := by
    rw [← Hom.map_d, c.isCornerGenerator.d_eq_zero, map_zero]
  refine ⟨(cone.inl (attach s.π)).app X g, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := (cone.inl (attach s.π)).map_mem hg
    rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg] at h
  · refine (cone.inl_d_apply g).trans ?_
    rw [hdg, map_zero, sub_zero]
    exact congrArg _ (attach_gen c)
  · exact (cone.inl_desc_apply _ _ _ (δ_homotopy s.π) _).trans (homotopy_gen c)

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.ι_injective
statement: theorem ι_injective (n : ℕ) (X : C) : Function.Injective ((ι M n).app X)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h =>
  congrArg (cone.sndAddHom (attach (stage M n).π) X) h

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.ι_comp_stage_succ_π
statement: theorem ι_comp_stage_succ_π (n : ℕ) : ι M n ≫ (stage M (n + 1)).π = (stage M n).π
proof:
:=
  cone.inr_desc _ _ _ (δ_homotopy _)

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.π_of
statement:
theorem π_of (n : ℕ) {X : C} (x : (obj M n).obj X) :
    (π M).app X ((SeqColimit.of _ _ n).app X x) = (stage M n).π.app X x
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.desc_of _ _ _ _

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.exists_step
statement:
theorem exists_step (n : ℕ) {X : C} {j : ℤ} {z : (obj M n).obj X} (hz : z ∈ grading j)
    (hdz : d z = 0) {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading (j - 1)) (hpz : (stage M n).π.app X z = d m) :
    ∃ e : (obj M (n + 1)).obj X, e ∈ grading (j - 1) ∧ d e = (ι M n).app X z ∧
      (stage M (n + 1)).π.app X e = m
proof:
:=
  (stage M n).exists_step hz hdz hm hpz

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.exists_stage_one
statement:
theorem exists_stage_one {X : C} {j : ℤ} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading j) (hdm : d m = 0) :
    ∃ e : (obj M 1).obj X, e ∈ grading j ∧ d e = 0 ∧ (stage M 1).π.app X e = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩ := exists_step (M := M) 0 (j := j + 1) (z := 0) (zero_mem _) d_zero
    (m := m) (by rwa [add_sub_cancel_right]) (by rw [map_zero, hdm])
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right] at he
  rw [map_zero] at hde
  exact ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.surjective_π
statement: theorem surjective_π (X : C) : Function.Surjective ((π M).app X)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rename_i j
    obtain ⟨e₁, he₁, hde₁, hpe₁⟩ := exists_stage_one (M := M) (d_mem m.2) (d_d _)
    obtain ⟨e₂, -, -, hpe₂⟩ := exists_step 1 he₁ hde₁ (m := m)
      (by rw [add_sub_cancel_right]; exact m.2) hpe₁
    exact ⟨(SeqColimit.of _ _ 2).app X e₂, by rw [π_of, hpe₂]⟩
  | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hm
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hm'
    exact ⟨x + y, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.isQuasiIso_π
statement: theorem isQuasiIso_π : IsQuasiIso (π M)
proof:
:= fun X j => by
  constructor
  · rw [cohomologyMap_injective_iff]
    intro x hx hdx hpx
    obtain ⟨n, y, rfl⟩ := SeqColimit.exists_of_eq x
    have hinj := SeqColimit.of_injective (ι_injective M) n X
    have hy : y ∈ grading j :=
      mem_grading_of_injective ((SeqColimit.of _ _ n).app X) (Hom.map_mem _) hinj hx
    have hdy : d y = 0 := hinj (by rw [Hom.map_d, hdx, map_zero])
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hdm⟩ := mem_coboundaries.mp hpx
    rw [π_of] at hdm
    obtain ⟨e, he, hde, -⟩ := exists_step n hy hdy hm hdm.symm
    exact mem_coboundaries.mpr ⟨(SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1)).app X e,
      (SeqColimit.of _ _ (n + 1)).map_mem he, by
        rw [← Hom.map_d, hde, SeqColimit.of_succ_ι]⟩
  · rw [cohomologyMap_surjective_iff]
    intro m hm hdm
    obtain ⟨e, he, hde, hpe⟩ := exists_stage_one (M := M) hm hdm
    exact ⟨(SeqColimit.of _ _ 1).app X e, (SeqColimit.of _ _ 1).map_mem he,
      by rw [← Hom.map_d, hde, map_zero], by rw [π_of, hpe, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _⟩

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.isKProjective_cells
statement:
theorem isKProjective_cells {S : CatModule.{max u v w} C} (p : S ⟶ M) :
    IsKProjective (cells p)
proof:
:=
  IsKProjective.directSum fun c => c.isCornerGenerator.isKProjective

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.isKProjective_obj
statement: theorem isKProjective_obj (n : ℕ) : IsKProjective (obj M n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro N _ f
    rw [show f = 0 from hom_ext fun X x => by
      have : Subsingleton ((obj M 0).obj X) :=
        inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton ((CatModule.zero.{max u v w} (C := C)).obj X))
      rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, map_zero, map_zero]]
  | succ n ih => exact IsKProjective.cone (isKProjective_cells M _) ih

name: DG.CatModule.Resolution.isKProjective_colim
statement: theorem isKProjective_colim : IsKProjective (colim M)
proof:
:=
  SeqColimit.isKProjective (isKProjective_obj M 0) fun n =>
    ⟨_, _, ⟨cone.gradedSplitting (attach (stage M n).π)⟩, (isKProjective_cells M _).shift 1⟩

name: DG.CatModule.exists_kProjective_resolution
statement:
theorem exists_kProjective_resolution (M : CatModule.{max u v w} C) :
    ∃ (P : CatModule.{max u v w} C) (π : P ⟶ M), IsKProjective P ∧ IsQuasiIso π ∧
      ∀ X, Function.Surjective (π.app X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, Resolution.π M, Resolution.isKProjective_colim M, Resolution.isQuasiIso_π M,
    Resolution.surjective_π M⟩

name: DG.CatBimodule.right_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem right_ract (X : C) {Y Y' : D} (g : Y ⟶ Y') (x : B.obj X Y') :
    (B.right X).ract g x = B.ract g x
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun
    (koszulTwist_koszulTwist (B.ract (X := X) (Y := Y) (Y' := Y'))) g) x

name: DG.CatBimodule.balanced_lact
statement:
theorem balanced_lact {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') :
    CatTensorProduct.Balanced (N := B.right X) (M := M)
      fun Y => (CatTensorProduct.tmulAddHom (B.right X') M Y).comp
        (B.lact (X := X) (X' := X') (Y := Y) f)
proof:
:=
  fun {Y Y'} g x m => by
    change CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := B.right X') Y (B.lact f ((B.right X).ract g x)) m =
      CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := B.right X') Y' (B.lact f x) (g • m)
    rw [right_ract, B.lact_ract', ← right_ract, CatTensorProduct.ract_tmul]

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorAct_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorAct_tmul {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y : D) (x : B.obj X Y) (m : M.obj Y) :
    B.tensorAct M f (CatTensorProduct.tmul Y x m) = CatTensorProduct.tmul Y (B.lact f x) m
proof:
:=
  CatTensorProduct.lift_tmul _ (B.balanced_lact M f) Y x m

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorAct_add
statement:
theorem tensorAct_add {X X' : C} (f f' : X ⟶ X') :
    B.tensorAct M (f + f') = B.tensorAct M f + B.tensorAct M f'
proof:
:=
  CatTensorProduct.addHom_ext fun Y x m => by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, tensorAct_tmul, tensorAct_tmul, tensorAct_tmul, map_add,
      AddMonoidHom.add_apply, CatTensorProduct.add_tmul]

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorAct_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]
  refine CatTensorProduct.lift_mem_add _ (B.balanced_lact M f) i (fun Y _ _ _ _ hx hm => ?_) hy
  rw [add_right_comm, add_comm _ i]
  exact CatTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading (B.lact_mem' hf hx) hm

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorAct_id
statement:
theorem tensorAct_id (X : C) (y : CatTensorProduct (B.right X) M) :
    B.tensorAct M (𝟙 X) y = y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using CatTensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul Y x m => rw [tensorAct_tmul, B.lact_id']
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy]

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorAct_comp
statement:
theorem tensorAct_comp {X X' X'' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (f' : X' ⟶ X'')
    (y : CatTensorProduct (B.right X) M) :
    B.tensorAct M (f ≫ f') y = B.tensorAct M f' (B.tensorAct M f y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using CatTensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul Y x m => rw [tensorAct_tmul, tensorAct_tmul, tensorAct_tmul, B.lact_comp']
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: DG.CatBimodule.d_tensorAct
statement:
theorem d_tensorAct {X X' : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ X'} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (y : CatTensorProduct (B.right X) M) :
    d (B.tensorAct M f y) = B.tensorAct M (d f) y + koszulSign i • B.tensorAct M f (d y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using CatTensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, d_add, hx, hy, d_add, map_add, map_add, smul_add]
    abel
  | tmul Y x m =>
    induction x using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero =>
      simp only [CatTensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, _root_.smul_zero, add_zero]
    | h_add x x' hx hx' =>
      rw [CatTensorProduct.add_tmul]
      simp only [map_add, hx, hx', _root_.smul_add]
      abel
    | h_homogeneous x =>
      rename_i j
      rw [tensorAct_tmul, CatTensorProduct.d_tmul_of_mem Y (B.lact_mem' hf x.2), B.d_lact' hf,
        CatTensorProduct.d_tmul_of_mem Y x.2, map_add, map_units_zsmul, tensorAct_tmul,
        tensorAct_tmul, tensorAct_tmul, CatTensorProduct.add_tmul,
        CatTensorProduct.units_smul_tmul, smul_add, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
      abel

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorObj_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorObj_obj (X : C) : (B.tensorObj M).obj X = CatTensorProduct (B.right X) M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorObj_smul
statement:
theorem tensorObj_smul {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (y : (B.tensorObj M).obj X) :
    f • y = B.tensorAct M f y
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorObj_act_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorObj_act_tmul {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (Y : D) (x : B.obj X Y) (m : M.obj Y) :
    (B.tensorObj M).act f (CatTensorProduct.tmul Y x m) =
      CatTensorProduct.tmul Y (B.lact f x) m
proof:
:=
  B.tensorAct_tmul M f Y x m

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorMap_tmul {M' : CatModule.{w'} D} (ψ : M ⟶ M') (X : C) (Y : D) (x : B.obj X Y)
    (m : M.obj Y) :
    (B.tensorMap ψ).app X (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := B.right X) Y x m) =
      CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := B.right X) Y x (ψ.app Y m)
proof:
:= by
  show CatTensorProduct.map (𝟙 (B.right X)) ψ (CatTensorProduct.tmul Y x m) = _
  rw [CatTensorProduct.map_tmul]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.ks_congr
statement: private theorem ks_congr {m n : ℤ} (h : Even (m - n)) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr h

name: DG.CatModule.units_smul_apply'
statement:
private theorem units_smul_apply' {M M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup M'] (u : ℤˣ)
    (f : M →+ M') (m : M) : (u • f) m = u • f m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.homOp_units_smul
statement: theorem homOp_units_smul {X Y : C} (u : ℤˣ) (f : X ⟶ Y) : homOp (u • f) = u • homOp f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.ract_apply
statement: theorem ract_apply {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) : N.ract f n = n <• f
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.ract_of_mem
statement:
theorem ract_of_mem {X Y : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {n : N.obj (op Y)} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) : n <• f = koszulSign (i * j) • (homOp f • n)
proof:
:=
  koszulTwist_apply_of_mem (N.act (X := op Y) (Y := op X)) (A := X ⟶ Y) hf hn

name: DG.CatModule.homOp_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem homOp_smul_of_mem {X Y : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {n : N.obj (op Y)}
    (hf : f ∈ grading i) (hn : n ∈ grading j) : homOp f • n = koszulSign (i * j) • (n <• f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ract_of_mem hf hn, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.CatModule.smul_eq_ract_of_mem
proof:
:=
  homOp_smul_of_mem (X := Y.unop) (Y := X.unop) hf hn

name: DG.CatModule.add_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_ract {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n n' : N.obj (op Y)) : (n + n') <• f = n <• f + n' <• f
proof:
:=
  map_add (N.ract f) n n'

name: DG.CatModule.ract_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ract_add {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) : n <• (f + g) = n <• f + n <• g
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.zero_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_ract {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (0 : N.obj (op Y)) <• f = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (N.ract f)

name: DG.CatModule.ract_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ract_zero {X Y : C} (n : N.obj (op Y)) : n <• (0 : X ⟶ Y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.neg_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_ract {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) : (-n) <• f = -(n <• f)
proof:
:=
  map_neg (N.ract f) n

name: DG.CatModule.ract_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ract_neg {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) : n <• (-f) = -(n <• f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_neg, AddMonoidHom.neg_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.sub_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_ract {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n n' : N.obj (op Y)) : (n - n') <• f = n <• f - n' <• f
proof:
:=
  map_sub (N.ract f) n n'

name: DG.CatModule.ract_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ract_sub {X Y : C} (f g : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) : n <• (f - g) = n <• f - n <• g
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ract_add, ract_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: DG.CatModule.units_smul_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem units_smul_ract {X Y : C} (u : ℤˣ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) :
    (u • n) <• f = u • (n <• f)
proof:
:=
  map_units_zsmul (N.ract f) u n

name: DG.CatModule.ract_units_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ract_units_smul {X Y : C} (u : ℤˣ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) :
    n <• (u • f) = u • (n <• f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_units_zsmul, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.zsmul_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zsmul_ract {X Y : C} (k : ℤ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) :
    (k • n) <• f = k • (n <• f)
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (N.ract f) k n

name: DG.CatModule.ract_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ract_zsmul {X Y : C} (k : ℤ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) :
    n <• (k • f) = k • (n <• f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply]

name: DG.CatModule.ract_mem_grading
statement:
theorem ract_mem_grading {X Y : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {n : N.obj (op Y)}
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) (hf : f ∈ grading i) : n <• f ∈ grading (j + i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ract_of_mem hf hn, Units.smul_def, add_comm]
  exact zsmul_mem (smul_mem_grading (M := N) (f := homOp f) hf hn) _

name: DG.CatModule.ract_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ract_id {X : C} (n : N.obj (op X)) : n <• 𝟙 X = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => exact zero_ract _
  | h_homogeneous n =>
    rw [ract_of_mem (id_mem_grading X) n.2, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
    exact id_smul (M := N) (X := op X) (n : N.obj (op X))
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [add_ract, hn, hn']

name: DG.CatModule.ract_comp
statement:
theorem ract_comp {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (n : N.obj (op Z)) :
    n <• (f ≫ g) = (n <• g) <• f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [Preadditive.add_comp, ract_add, ract_add, hf, hf']
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    induction g using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add g g' hg hg' => rw [Preadditive.comp_add, ract_add, ract_add, add_ract, hg, hg']
    | h_homogeneous g =>
      rename_i k
      induction n using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [add_ract, add_ract, add_ract, hn, hn']
      | h_homogeneous n =>
        rename_i j
        have hfg : homOp ((f : X ⟶ Y) ≫ (g : Y ⟶ Z)) • (n : N.obj (op Z)) =
            koszulSign (k * i) • (homOp (f : X ⟶ Y) • homOp (g : Y ⟶ Z) • (n : N.obj (op Z))) := by
          have := homUnop_comp_of_mem (X := op Z) (Y := op Y) (Z := op X)
            (f := homOp (g : Y ⟶ Z)) (g := homOp (f : X ⟶ Y)) g.2 f.2
          rw [homUnop_homOp, homUnop_homOp] at this
          rw [← comp_smul, ← homOp_homUnop (homOp (g : Y ⟶ Z) ≫ homOp (f : X ⟶ Y)), this]
          rw [homOp_units_smul, units_smul_smul (M := N), smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self,
            one_smul]
        rw [ract_of_mem (comp_mem_grading f.2 g.2) n.2,
          ract_of_mem f.2 (ract_mem_grading n.2 g.2), ract_of_mem g.2 n.2, hfg,
          smul_units_smul (M := N), smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
        congr 1
        exact ks_congr ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: DG.CatModule.d_ract
statement:
theorem d_ract {X Y : C} {j : ℤ} {n : N.obj (op Y)} (hn : n ∈ grading j) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    d (n <• f) = d n <• f + koszulSign j • (n <• d f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [d_zero]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' =>
    rw [ract_add, d_add, hf, hf', d_add, ract_add, ract_add, _root_.smul_add]
    abel
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    have e1 : koszulSign (i * j + i) = koszulSign (i * (j + 1)) := ks_congr ⟨0, by ring⟩
    have e2 : koszulSign (i * j) = koszulSign (j + (i + 1) * j) := ks_congr ⟨-j, by ring⟩
    rw [ract_of_mem f.2 hn, ract_of_mem f.2 (d_mem hn), ract_of_mem (d_mem f.2) hn, d_units_smul,
      d_smul (M := N) (f := homOp (f : X ⟶ Y)) f.2, _root_.smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, e1, e2]
    exact add_comm _ _

name: DG.CatModule.d_ract_of_d_eq_zero
statement:
theorem d_ract_of_d_eq_zero {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : d f = 0) (n : N.obj (op Y)) :
    d (n <• f) = d n <• f
proof:
:= by
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_homogeneous n => rw [d_ract n.2, hf, ract_zero, _root_.smul_zero, add_zero]
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [add_ract, d_add, hn, hn', d_add, add_ract]

name: DG.CatModule.Hom.map_ract
statement:
theorem Hom.map_ract {N' : CatModule.{w} (DGOpposite C)} (φ : N ⟶ N') {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (n : N.obj (op Y)) : φ.app (op X) (n <• f) = φ.app (op Y) n <• f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [ract_add, map_add, hf, hf', ract_add]
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [add_ract, map_add, hn, hn', map_add, add_ract]
    | h_homogeneous n =>
      rw [ract_of_mem f.2 n.2, ract_of_mem f.2 (φ.map_mem n.2), map_units_zsmul]
      exact congrArg _ (φ.map_smul (homOp (f : X ⟶ Y)) (n : N.obj (op Y)))

name: DG.CatModule.twistAct_mem
statement:
theorem twistAct_mem {X Y : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {n : obj Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) : twistAct obj act f n ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistAct, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ hf hn, Units.smul_def, add_comm]
  exact zsmul_mem (act_mem hf hn) _

name: DG.CatModule.twistAct_id
statement: theorem twistAct_id (X : C) (n : obj X) : twistAct obj act (𝟙 X) n = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => exact map_zero _
  | h_homogeneous n =>
    rw [twistAct, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ (id_mem_grading X) n.2, zero_mul, koszulSign_zero,
      one_smul]
    exact act_id _ _
  | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [map_add, hn, hn']

name: DG.CatModule.twistAct_signedComp
statement:
theorem twistAct_signedComp {X Y Z : C} (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X) (n : obj X) :
    twistAct obj act (signedComp Z Y X g f) n = twistAct obj act g (twistAct obj act f n)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hf, hf']
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    induction g using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add g g' hg hg' => simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hg, hg']
    | h_homogeneous g =>
      rename_i k
      induction n using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add n n' hn hn' => simp only [map_add, hn, hn']
      | h_homogeneous n =>
        rename_i j
        have hm : koszulSign (i * j) • act (f : Y ⟶ X) (n : obj X) ∈ grading (j + i) := by
          rw [Units.smul_def]; exact zsmul_mem (act_mem f.2 n.2) _
        unfold twistAct
        rw [signedComp_of_mem g.2 f.2, map_units_zsmul, units_smul_apply',
          koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ (comp_mem_grading g.2 f.2) n.2,
          koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ f.2 n.2, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ g.2 hm, act_comp,
          map_units_zsmul, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
        congr 1
        exact ks_congr ⟨0, by ring⟩

name: DG.CatModule.d_twistAct
statement:
theorem d_twistAct {X Y : C} {i : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f ∈ grading i) (n : obj Y) :
    d (twistAct obj act f n) =
      twistAct obj act (d f) n + koszulSign i • twistAct obj act f (d n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add n n' hn hn' =>
    simp only [map_add, hn, hn', _root_.smul_add]
    abel
  | h_homogeneous n =>
    rename_i j
    have e1 : koszulSign (i * j + j) = koszulSign ((i + 1) * j) := ks_congr ⟨0, by ring⟩
    have e2 : koszulSign (i * j) = koszulSign (i + i * (j + 1)) := ks_congr ⟨-i, by ring⟩
    rw [twistAct, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ hf n.2, koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ (d_mem hf) n.2,
      koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ hf (d_mem n.2), d_units_smul, d_act n.2, _root_.smul_add,
      smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, e1, e2]
    exact add_comm _ _

name: DG.CatModule.ofRightAction_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofRightAction_obj (X : DGOpposite C) :
    (ofRightAction obj act act_mem act_id act_comp d_act).obj X = obj X.unop
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.ract_ofRightAction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ract_ofRightAction {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : obj Y) :
    (ofRightAction obj act act_mem act_id act_comp d_act).ract f n = act f n
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun (koszulTwist_koszulTwist (act (X := X) (Y := Y))) f) n

name: DG.CatModule.representable_op_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representable_op_ract (X : C) {Y Z : C} (f : Z ⟶ Y)
    (h : (representable (op X)).obj (op Y)) :
    h <• f = f ≫ (h : Y ⟶ X)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [ract_zero, Limits.zero_comp]
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [ract_add, hf, hf', Preadditive.add_comp]
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    induction h using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => rw [zero_ract, Limits.comp_zero]
    | h_add h h' hh hh' => rw [add_ract, hh, hh', Preadditive.comp_add]
    | h_homogeneous h =>
      rename_i j
      obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := f
      rw [ract_of_mem hf hh, representable_smul]
      show koszulSign (i * j) • homUnop ((h : op X ⟶ op Y) ≫ homOp f) = f ≫ (h : Y ⟶ X)
      rw [homUnop_comp_of_mem (X := op X) (Y := op Y) (Z := op Z) (f := h) (g := homOp f) hh hf,
        smul_smul, mul_comm j i, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]
      rfl

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaCochainApp_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [yonedaCochainApp, AddMonoidHom.flip_apply]
  exact koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ hh hm

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaCochainApp_comp
proof:
:= by
  induction h using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [Limits.zero_comp, map_zero, map_zero, smul_zero, _root_.smul_zero]
  | h_add h h' hh hh' =>
    rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, hh, hh', map_add, smul_add, _root_.smul_add]
  | h_homogeneous h =>
    rw [yonedaCochainApp_of_mem hm (comp_mem_grading h.2 hf), yonedaCochainApp_of_mem hm h.2,
      smul_units_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, comp_smul]
    congr 2
    ring

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaCochain_app_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem yonedaCochain_app_of_mem (n : ℤ) (m : grading (M := M.obj X) n) {Y : C} {i : ℤ}
    {h : X ⟶ Y} (hh : h ∈ grading i) :
    (yonedaCochain n m).app Y h = koszulSign (i * n) • (h • (m : M.obj X))
proof:
:=
  yonedaCochainApp_of_mem m.2 hh

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaCochain_app_id
statement:
theorem yonedaCochain_app_id (n : ℤ) (m : grading (M := M.obj X) n) :
    (yonedaCochain n m).app X (𝟙 X) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [yonedaCochain_app_of_mem n m (id_mem_grading X), zero_mul, koszulSign_zero, one_smul]
  exact id_smul (M := M) _

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaCochain_eval
statement:
theorem yonedaCochain_eval {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain (representable X) M n) :
    yonedaCochain n ⟨z.app X (𝟙 X), by simpa using z.map_mem (id_mem_grading X)⟩ = z
proof:
:= by
  ext Y h
  induction h using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | h_add h h' hh hh' => rw [map_add, hh, hh', map_add]
  | h_homogeneous h =>
    rename_i i
    change yonedaCochainApp (z.app X (𝟙 X)) Y h.1 = z.app Y h.1
    rw [yonedaCochainApp_of_mem (by simpa using z.map_mem (id_mem_grading X)) h.2]
    have := z.map_smul h.2 (𝟙 X : (representable X).obj X)
    rw [representable_smul, Category.id_comp] at this
    rw [this, mul_comm]

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaHOM_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem yonedaHOM_of {n : ℤ} (z : Cochain (representable X) M n) :
    yonedaHOM X M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain (representable X) M n) n z) = z.app X (𝟙 X)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of _ _ _

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaHOM_symm_of_mem
statement:
theorem yonedaHOM_symm_of_mem {n : ℤ} {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading n) :
    (yonedaHOM X M).symm m =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain (representable X) M n) n (yonedaCochain n ⟨m, hm⟩)
proof:
:=
  liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hm

name: DG.CatModule.yonedaHOM_ofHom
statement:
theorem yonedaHOM_ofHom (φ : representable X ⟶ M) :
    yonedaHOM X M (DirectSum.of (fun n => Cochain (representable X) M n) 0 (Cochain.ofHom φ)) =
      (yonedaEquiv φ : M.obj X)
proof:
:=
  yonedaHOM_of _

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.ι_mem_grading
statement:
theorem ι_mem_grading {X : C} {k : ℤ} {x : Summand N M X} (hx : x ∈ grading k) :
    ι N M X x ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact DG.DirectSum.of_mem_grading (Summand N M) X hx

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.d_ι
statement: theorem d_ι {X : C} (x : Summand N M X) : d (ι N M X x) = ι N M X (d x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact DG.DirectSum.d_of (Summand N M) X x

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.pre_induction_on
statement:
theorem pre_induction_on {P : Pre N M → Prop} (x : Pre N M) (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X), P (ι N M X (n ⊗ₜ m)))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact zero
  | of X y =>
    induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul n m => exact tmul X n m
    | add y y' hy hy' =>
      have := add _ _ hy hy'
      rwa [← map_add] at this
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_add_left
statement:
theorem relElem_add_left {X Y : C} (f f' : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (m : M.obj X) :
    relElem N M (f + f') n m = relElem N M f n m + relElem N M f' n m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relElem, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, CatModule.add_smul,
    TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
  abel

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_add_mid
statement:
theorem relElem_add_mid {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n n' : N.obj (op Y)) (m : M.obj X) :
    relElem N M f (n + n') m = relElem N M f n m + relElem N M f n' m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relElem, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]
  abel

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_add_right
statement:
theorem relElem_add_right {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (m m' : M.obj X) :
    relElem N M f n (m + m') = relElem N M f n m + relElem N M f n m'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relElem, CatModule.smul_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
  abel

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relElem_zero_left {X Y : C} (n : N.obj (op Y)) (m : M.obj X) :
    relElem N M (0 : X ⟶ Y) n m = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [relElem]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_zero_mid
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relElem_zero_mid {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    relElem N M f (0 : N.obj (op Y)) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [relElem]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relElem_zero_right {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) :
    relElem N M f n (0 : M.obj X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [relElem]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_units_smul_right
statement:
theorem relElem_units_smul_right {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (m : M.obj X)
    (u : ℤˣ) : relElem N M f n (u • m) = u • relElem N M f n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [relElem, relElem, CatModule.smul_units_smul]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_zsmul, _root_.smul_sub]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_units_smul_left
statement:
theorem relElem_units_smul_left {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (m : M.obj X)
    (u : ℤˣ) : relElem N M (u • f) n m = u • relElem N M f n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [relElem, relElem, ract_units_smul, CatModule.units_smul_smul]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_zsmul,
    _root_.smul_sub]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_mem_rel
statement:
theorem relElem_mem_rel {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (m : M.obj X) :
    relElem N M f n m ∈ rel N M
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨X, Y, f, n, m, rfl⟩

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.rel_eq_closure_relGen
statement: theorem rel_eq_closure_relGen : rel N M = AddSubgroup.closure (relGen N M)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (AddSubgroup.closure_le _ |>.mpr ?_)
    (AddSubgroup.closure_mono fun x ⟨X, Y, _, _, _, f, n, m, _, _, _, hx⟩ => ⟨X, Y, f, n, m, hx⟩)
  rintro _ ⟨X, Y, f, n, m, rfl⟩
  set S := AddSubgroup.closure (relGen N M)
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add f f' hf hf' => rw [relElem_add_left]; exact add_mem hf hf'
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [relElem_add_mid]; exact add_mem hn hn'
    | h_homogeneous n =>
      induction m using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [relElem_add_right]; exact add_mem hm hm'
      | h_homogeneous m =>
        exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨X, Y, _, _, _, f, n, m, f.2, n.2, m.2, rfl⟩

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.relElem_mem_grading
proof:
:= by
  refine sub_mem (ι_mem_grading (tmul_mem_grading (ract_mem_grading hn hf) hm)) ?_
  rw [add_assoc]
  exact ι_mem_grading (tmul_mem_grading hn (CatModule.smul_mem_grading hf hm))

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.d_relElem
statement:
theorem d_relElem {X Y : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : X ⟶ Y} {n : N.obj (op Y)} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hn : n ∈ grading j) (m : M.obj X) :
    d (relElem N M f n m) = relElem N M f (d n) m + koszulSign j • relElem N M (d f) n m +
      koszulSign (j + i) • relElem N M f n (d m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← relElem_units_smul_right, ← relElem_units_smul_left, relElem, relElem, relElem, relElem,
    d_sub, d_ι, d_ι, d_tmul_of_mem (ract_mem_grading hn hf), d_tmul_of_mem hn, d_ract hn,
    CatModule.d_smul hf, TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, ract_units_smul,
    CatModule.smul_units_smul, CatModule.units_smul_smul, koszulSign_add]
  simp only [Units.smul_def, mul_smul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul',
    TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_add, map_zsmul, _root_.smul_add]
  abel

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.mk_ι_tmul
statement:
theorem mk_ι_tmul (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    mk N M (ι N M X (n ⊗ₜ m)) = tmul X n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.mk_surjective
statement: theorem mk_surjective : Function.Surjective (mk N M)
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_zero_iff {x : Pre N M} : mk N M x = 0 ↔ x ∈ rel N M
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff x

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.ract_tmul
statement:
theorem ract_tmul {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmul X (n <• f) m = tmul Y n (f • m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, tmul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, mk_eq_zero_iff]
  exact relElem_mem_rel f n m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.tmul_add
statement:
theorem tmul_add (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m m' : M.obj X) :
    tmul X n (m + m') = tmul X n m + tmul X n m'
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.add_tmul
statement:
theorem add_tmul (X : C) (n n' : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmul X (n + n') m = tmul X n m + tmul X n' m
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, map_add]; rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.tmul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_zero (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) : tmul X n (0 : M.obj X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.zero_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_tmul (X : C) (m : M.obj X) : tmul X (0 : N.obj (op X)) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero, map_zero]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.tmul_neg
statement:
theorem tmul_neg (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmul X n (-m) = -tmul X n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_neg, map_neg, map_neg]; rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.neg_tmul
statement:
theorem neg_tmul (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmul X (-n) m = -tmul X n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.neg_tmul, map_neg, map_neg]; rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.tmul_zsmul
statement:
theorem tmul_zsmul (X : C) (k : ℤ) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmul X n (k • m) = k • tmul X n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_zsmul, map_zsmul]; rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.zsmul_tmul
statement:
theorem zsmul_tmul (X : C) (k : ℤ) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmul X (k • n) m = k • tmul X n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_zsmul, map_zsmul]; rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.tmul_units_smul
statement:
theorem tmul_units_smul (X : C) (u : ℤˣ) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmul X n (u • m) = u • tmul X n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, tmul_zsmul]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.units_smul_tmul
statement:
theorem units_smul_tmul (X : C) (u : ℤˣ) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmul X (u • n) m = u • tmul X n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, zsmul_tmul]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.tmulAddHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmulAddHom_apply (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    tmulAddHom N M X n m = tmul X n m
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on {P : CatTensorProduct N M → Prop} (x : CatTensorProduct N M)
    (zero : P 0) (tmul : ∀ (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X), P (tmul X n m))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) : P x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective x
  induction x using pre_induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using zero
  | tmul X n m => exact tmul X n m
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add _ _ hx hy

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.addHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem addHom_ext {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] {f g : CatTensorProduct N M →+ P}
    (h : ∀ (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X), f (tmul X n m) = g (tmul X n m)) :
    f = g
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.ext fun x => induction_on (P := fun x => f x = g x) x (by simp) h
    (fun x y (hx : f x = g x) (hy : f y = g y) => by
      show f (x + y) = g (x + y); rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy])

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lift_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_tmul (φ : ∀ X : C, N.obj (op X) →+ M.obj X →+ P) (hφ : Balanced φ) (X : C)
    (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) : lift φ hφ (tmul X n m) = φ X n m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change DirectSum.toAddMonoid (fun X => TensorProduct.liftAddHom (φ X) _)
    (DirectSum.of (Summand N M) X (n ⊗ₜ m)) = _
  rw [DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of, liftAddHom_tmul]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique (φ : ∀ X : C, N.obj (op X) →+ M.obj X →+ P) (hφ : Balanced φ)
    (g : CatTensorProduct N M →+ P) (hg : ∀ X n m, g (tmul X n m) = φ X n m) :
    g = lift φ hφ
proof:
:=
  addHom_ext fun X n m => by rw [hg, lift_tmul]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.balanced_tmulAddHom
statement: theorem balanced_tmulAddHom : Balanced (tmulAddHom N M)
proof:
:=
  fun f n m => ract_tmul f n m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lift_tmulAddHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_tmulAddHom : lift (tmulAddHom N M) balanced_tmulAddHom = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:=
  (lift_unique _ _ _ fun _ _ _ => rfl).symm

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff {k : ℤ} {y : CatTensorProduct N M} :
    y ∈ grading k ↔ ∃ x ∈ grading (M := Pre N M) k, mk N M x = y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.mk_mem_grading
statement: theorem mk_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {x : Pre N M} (hx : x ∈ grading k) : mk N M x ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.d_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem d_mk (x : Pre N M) : d (mk N M x) = mk N M (d x)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.tmul_mem_grading
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_grading {X : C} {i j : ℤ} {n : N.obj (op X)} (hn : n ∈ grading i)
    {m : M.obj X} (hm : m ∈ grading j) : tmul X n m ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:=
  mk_mem_grading (ι_mem_grading (DG.tmul_mem_grading hn hm))

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.d_tmul_of_mem
statement:
theorem d_tmul_of_mem (X : C) {i : ℤ} {n : N.obj (op X)} (hn : n ∈ grading i) (m : M.obj X) :
    d (tmul X n m) = tmul X (d n) m + koszulSign i • tmul X n (d m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmul, d_mk, d_ι, DG.d_tmul_of_mem hn, map_add, map_add, map_units_zsmul,
    map_units_zsmul]
  rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.induction_on_mem_grading
statement:
theorem induction_on_mem_grading {k : ℤ} {P : CatTensorProduct N M → Prop} (zero : P 0)
    (tmul : ∀ (X : C) {i j : ℤ} {n : N.obj (op X)} {m : M.obj X}, n ∈ grading i →
      m ∈ grading j → i + j = k → P (tmul X n m))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) (neg : ∀ x, P x → P (-x))
    {y : CatTensorProduct N M} (hy : y ∈ grading k) : P y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
  have key : ∀ (X : C) (z : Summand N M X), z ∈ grading k → P (mk N M (ι N M X z)) := by
    intro X z hz
    induction hz using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨i, j, h, n, hn, m, hm, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact tmul X hn hm h
    | zero => simpa using zero
    | add z z' _ _ hz hz' => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add _ _ hz hz'
    | neg z _ hz => rw [map_neg, map_neg]; exact neg _ hz
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of x, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ P (fun a b ha hb => add a b ha hb) (by simpa using zero) ?_
  intro X _
  exact key X (x X) (hx X)

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lift_mem_add
statement:
theorem lift_mem_add (φ : ∀ X : C, N.obj (op X) →+ M.obj X →+ P) (hφ : Balanced φ) (s : ℤ)
    (hdeg : ∀ (X : C) {i j : ℤ} {n : N.obj (op X)} {m : M.obj X}, n ∈ grading i →
      m ∈ grading j → φ X n m ∈ grading (i + j + s))
    {k : ℤ} {y : CatTensorProduct N M} (hy : y ∈ grading k) :
    lift φ hφ y ∈ grading (k + s)
proof:
:=
  induction_on_mem_grading (P := fun y => lift φ hφ y ∈ grading (k + s))
    (by show lift φ hφ 0 ∈ _; rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _)
    (fun X _ _ _ _ hn hm h => by
      show lift φ hφ (tmul X _ _) ∈ _
      rw [lift_tmul, ← h]; exact hdeg X hn hm)
    (fun x y hx hy => by show lift φ hφ (x + y) ∈ _; rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy)
    (fun x hx => by show lift φ hφ (-x) ∈ _; rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx) hy

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lift_mem
statement:
theorem lift_mem (φ : ∀ X : C, N.obj (op X) →+ M.obj X →+ P) (hφ : Balanced φ)
    (hdeg : ∀ (X : C) {i j : ℤ} {n : N.obj (op X)} {m : M.obj X}, n ∈ grading i →
      m ∈ grading j → φ X n m ∈ grading (i + j))
    {k : ℤ} {y : CatTensorProduct N M} (hy : y ∈ grading k) : lift φ hφ y ∈ grading k
proof:
:= by
  simpa using lift_mem_add φ hφ 0 (fun X _ _ _ _ hn hm => by simpa using hdeg X hn hm) hy

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lift_d
statement:
theorem lift_d (φ : ∀ X : C, N.obj (op X) →+ M.obj X →+ P) (hφ : Balanced φ)
    (hd : ∀ (X : C) {i : ℤ} {n : N.obj (op X)}, n ∈ grading i → ∀ m : M.obj X,
      d (φ X n m) = φ X (d n) m + koszulSign i • φ X n (d m))
    (y : CatTensorProduct N M) : lift φ hφ (d y) = d (lift φ hφ y)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul X n m =>
    induction n using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_homogeneous n =>
      rw [d_tmul_of_mem X n.2, map_add, map_units_zsmul, lift_tmul, lift_tmul, lift_tmul,
        hd X n.2]
    | h_add n n' hn hn' => rw [add_tmul, d_add, map_add, hn, hn', map_add, d_add]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [d_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, d_add]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.balanced_map
statement:
theorem balanced_map (φ : N ⟶ N') (ψ : M ⟶ M') :
    Balanced fun X => ((tmulAddHom N' M' X).compl₂ (ψ.app X)).comp (φ.app (op X))
proof:
:=
  fun f n m => by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.compl₂_apply,
      tmulAddHom_apply, CatModule.Hom.map_ract, CatModule.Hom.map_smul, ract_tmul]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.map_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_tmul (φ : N ⟶ N') (ψ : M ⟶ M') (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    map φ ψ (tmul X n m) = tmul X (φ.app (op X) n) (ψ.app X m)
proof:
:=
  lift_tmul _ (balanced_map φ ψ) X n m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (𝟙 N) (𝟙 M) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:=
  addHom_ext fun X n m => by simp

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (φ : N ⟶ N') (φ' : N' ⟶ N'') (ψ : M ⟶ M') (ψ' : M' ⟶ M'') :
    map (φ ≫ φ') (ψ ≫ ψ') = (map φ' ψ').comp (map φ ψ)
proof:
:=
  addHom_ext fun X n m => by simp

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.map_comp_apply
statement:
theorem map_comp_apply (φ : N ⟶ N') (φ' : N' ⟶ N'') (ψ : M ⟶ M') (ψ' : M' ⟶ M'')
    (x : CatTensorProduct N M) : map (φ ≫ φ') (ψ ≫ ψ') x = map φ' ψ' (map φ ψ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_comp]; rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.map_mem
statement:
theorem map_mem (φ : N ⟶ N') (ψ : M ⟶ M') {k : ℤ} {y : CatTensorProduct N M}
    (hy : y ∈ grading k) : map φ ψ y ∈ grading k
proof:
:=
  lift_mem _ (balanced_map φ ψ)
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ hn hm => tmul_mem_grading (φ.map_mem hn) (ψ.map_mem hm)) hy

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.map_d
statement:
theorem map_d (φ : N ⟶ N') (ψ : M ⟶ M') (y : CatTensorProduct N M) :
    map φ ψ (d y) = d (map φ ψ y)
proof:
:=
  lift_d _ (balanced_map φ ψ) (fun X _ _ hn m => by
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.compl₂_apply,
      tmulAddHom_apply]
    rw [d_tmul_of_mem X (φ.map_mem hn), CatModule.Hom.map_d, CatModule.Hom.map_d]) y

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.congr_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem congr_tmul (e : N ≅ N') (e' : M ≅ M') (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) (m : M.obj X) :
    congr e e' (tmul X n m) = tmul X (e.hom.app (op X) n) (e'.hom.app X m)
proof:
:=
  map_tmul _ _ X n m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.balanced_lid
statement:
theorem balanced_lid (X : C) :
    Balanced (N := representable (op X)) (M := M) fun Y => M.act (X := Y) (Y := X)
proof:
:=
  fun f h m => by
    change M.act (homUnop (h <• f)) m = M.act (homUnop h) (f • m)
    rw [representable_op_ract]
    exact CatModule.comp_smul (M := M) f (homUnop h) m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lidHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lidHom_tmul (X Y : C) (h : Y ⟶ X) (m : M.obj Y) :
    lidHom M X (tmul Y (homOp h) m) = h • m
proof:
:=
  lift_tmul _ (balanced_lid X) Y _ m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lid_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lid_tmul (X Y : C) (h : Y ⟶ X) (m : M.obj Y) :
    lid M X (tmul Y (homOp h) m) = h • m
proof:
:=
  lidHom_tmul X Y h m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lid_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lid_symm_apply (X : C) (m : M.obj X) :
    (lid M X).symm m = tmul X (homOp (𝟙 X)) m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.lid_naturality
statement:
theorem lid_naturality {M' : CatModule.{w₂} C} (ψ : M ⟶ M') (X : C)
    (x : CatTensorProduct (representable (op X)) M) :
    lid M' X (map (𝟙 _) ψ x) = ψ.app X (lid M X x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul Y h m =>
    rw [← homOp_homUnop h, map_tmul, CatModule.id_app, lid_tmul, lid_tmul]
    exact (ψ.map_smul _ m).symm
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.balanced_rid
statement:
theorem balanced_rid (X : C) :
    Balanced (M := representable X) fun Y => (N.ract (X := X) (Y := Y)).flip
proof:
:=
  fun f n h => by
    change (n <• f) <• h = n <• (h ≫ f)
    rw [ract_comp]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.ridHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ridHom_tmul (X Y : C) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (h : X ⟶ Y) :
    ridHom N X (tmul Y n h) = n <• h
proof:
:=
  lift_tmul _ (balanced_rid X) Y n h

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.rid_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rid_tmul (X Y : C) (n : N.obj (op Y)) (h : X ⟶ Y) :
    rid N X (tmul Y n h) = n <• h
proof:
:=
  ridHom_tmul X Y n h

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.rid_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rid_symm_apply (X : C) (n : N.obj (op X)) :
    (rid N X).symm n = tmul X (M := representable X) n (𝟙 X)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.rid_naturality
statement:
theorem rid_naturality {N' : CatModule.{w₁} (DGOpposite C)} (φ : N ⟶ N') (X : C)
    (x : CatTensorProduct N (representable X)) :
    rid N' X (map φ (𝟙 _) x) = φ.app (op X) (rid N X x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul Y n h =>
    rw [map_tmul, rid_tmul, rid_tmul]
    exact (CatModule.Hom.map_ract φ h n).symm
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]

name: DG.CatModule.singleObjRightAct_apply
statement:
theorem singleObjRightAct_apply {X Y : SingleObj A} (a : X ⟶ Y) (n : N) :
    singleObjRightAct N a n = op (a : A) • n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.ofDGRightModule_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDGRightModule_obj (X : DGOpposite (SingleObj A)) : (ofDGRightModule N).obj X = N
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.ofDGRightModule_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDGRightModule_ract {X Y : SingleObj A} (a : X ⟶ Y) (n : N) :
    (ofDGRightModule N).ract a n = op (a : A) • n
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun
    (koszulTwist_koszulTwist (singleObjRightAct N (X := X) (Y := Y))) a) n

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.balanced_singleObj
statement:
theorem balanced_singleObj :
    Balanced (N := CatModule.ofDGRightModule N) (M := DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj M)
      fun _ => TensorProductOver.tmulAddHom A N M
proof:
:= fun f n m => by
  change TensorProductOver.tmul (M := N) (N := M) A ((CatModule.ofDGRightModule N).ract f n) m =
    TensorProductOver.tmul (M := N) (N := M) A n ((f : A) • m)
  rw [CatModule.ofDGRightModule_ract, TensorProductOver.op_smul_tmul]

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.balanced_singleObj_symm
statement:
theorem balanced_singleObj_symm (X : SingleObj A) (a : A) (n : N) (m : M) :
    tmulAddHom (CatModule.ofDGRightModule N) (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj M) X (op a • n) m =
      tmulAddHom (CatModule.ofDGRightModule N) (DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj M) X n (a • m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tmulAddHom_apply, tmulAddHom_apply, ← CatModule.ofDGRightModule_ract N
    (X := X) (Y := X) a n]
  exact ract_tmul (N := CatModule.ofDGRightModule N) (M := DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj M)
    (X := X) (Y := X) a n m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.singleObjEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singleObjEquiv_tmul (X : SingleObj A) (n : N) (m : M) :
    singleObjEquiv N M (tmul X (N := CatModule.ofDGRightModule N) n m) =
      TensorProductOver.tmul A n m
proof:
:=
  lift_tmul _ (balanced_singleObj N M) X n m

name: DG.CatTensorProduct.singleObjEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singleObjEquiv_symm_tmul (n : N) (m : M) :
    (singleObjEquiv N M).symm (TensorProductOver.tmul A n m) =
      tmul (SingleObj.star A) (N := CatModule.ofDGRightModule N)
        (M := DGModuleCat.toCatModuleObj M) n m
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.ofFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofFunctor_obj (Y : D) (X : C) : (ofFunctor F).obj Y X = (F.obj X ⟶ Y)
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.ofFunctor_lact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofFunctor_lact {Y Y' : D} {X : C} (g : Y ⟶ Y') (h : F.obj X ⟶ Y) :
    (ofFunctor F).lact g h = h ≫ g
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.ofFunctor_ract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofFunctor_ract {Y : D} {X X' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (h : F.obj X' ⟶ Y) :
    (ofFunctor F).ract f h = F.map f ≫ h
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.induction_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem induction_obj (M : CatModule.{max u₁ v₂ w} C) :
    (induction.{w} F).obj M = inductionObj F M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.inductionObj_obj
statement:
theorem inductionObj_obj (M : CatModule.{w} C) (Y : D) :
    (inductionObj F M).obj Y = CatTensorProduct ((ofFunctor F).right Y) M
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatModule.inductionObj_act_tmul
statement:
theorem inductionObj_act_tmul (M : CatModule.{w} C) {Y Y' : D} (g : Y ⟶ Y') (X : C)
    (h : F.obj X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    (inductionObj F M).act g (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) X h m) =
      CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y') X (h ≫ g) m
proof:
:=
  (ofFunctor F).tensorAct_tmul M g X h m

name: DG.CatModule.induction_map_app_tmul
statement:
theorem induction_map_app_tmul {M M' : CatModule.{max u₁ v₂ w} C} (ψ : M ⟶ M') (Y : D) (X : C)
    (h : F.obj X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    ((induction.{w} F).map ψ).app Y (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) X h m) =
      CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) X h (ψ.app X m)
proof:
:=
  (ofFunctor F).tensorMap_tmul ψ Y X h m

name: DG.CatModule.balanced_inductionHomEquivInvFun
statement:
theorem balanced_inductionHomEquivInvFun (ψ : M ⟶ (precomp F).obj N) (Y : D) :
    CatTensorProduct.Balanced (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) (M := M)
      fun X => (N.act (X := F.obj X) (Y := Y)).compl₂ (ψ.app X)
proof:
:= fun {X X'} f h m => by
  change N.act (((ofFunctor F).right Y).ract f h) (ψ.app X m) = N.act h (ψ.app X' (f • m))
  rw [right_ract, ofFunctor_ract, ψ.map_smul, act_apply, act_apply, comp_smul]
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.inductionHomEquivInvFun_app_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inductionHomEquivInvFun_app_tmul (ψ : M ⟶ (precomp F).obj N) {Y : D} (X : C)
    (h : F.obj X ⟶ Y) (m : M.obj X) :
    (inductionHomEquivInvFun ψ).app Y (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) X h m) =
      N.act (X := F.obj X) (Y := Y) h (ψ.app X m)
proof:
:=
  CatTensorProduct.lift_tmul _ (balanced_inductionHomEquivInvFun ψ Y) X h m

name: DG.CatModule.inductionHomEquivInvFun_comp
statement:
theorem inductionHomEquivInvFun_comp {M' M : CatModule.{max u₁ v₂ w} C}
    {N : CatModule.{max u₁ v₂ w} D} (f : M' ⟶ M) (g : M ⟶ (precomp F).obj N) :
    inductionHomEquivInvFun.{w} (f ≫ g) =
      (induction.{w} F).map f ≫ inductionHomEquivInvFun.{w} g
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun Y y => by
    induction y using CatTensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp only [map_zero]
    | tmul X h m =>
      rw [comp_app]
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (DFunLike.coe ((inductionHomEquivInvFun g).app Y))
        (induction_map_app_tmul.{w} (F := F) f Y X h m)).symm
      rw [inductionHomEquivInvFun_app_tmul.{w}, inductionHomEquivInvFun_app_tmul.{w}]
      rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, map_add]

name: DG.CatModule.inductionAdjunction_homEquiv_apply_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inductionAdjunction_homEquiv_apply_app {M : CatModule.{max u₁ v₂ w} C}
    {N : CatModule.{max u₁ v₂ w} D} (Φ : (induction F).obj M ⟶ N) (X : C) (m : M.obj X) :
    (((inductionAdjunction F).homEquiv M N) Φ).app X m =
      Φ.app (F.obj X) (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right (F.obj X)) X
        (𝟙 (F.obj X)) m)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatModule.inductionRepresentableIso_hom_app_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inductionRepresentableIso_hom_app_tmul (X : C) {Y : D} (X' : C) (h : F.obj X' ⟶ Y)
    (k : X ⟶ X') :
    (inductionRepresentableIso F X).hom.app Y
      (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) X' h k) = F.map k ≫ h
proof:
:=
  (CatTensorProduct.rid_tmul (N := (ofFunctor F).right Y) X X' h k).trans (right_ract _ _ _ _)

name: DG.CatBimodule.ks_eq
statement: private theorem ks_eq {m n : ℤ} (k : ℤ) (h : m - n = 2 * k) : koszulSign m = koszulSign n
proof:
:=
  (Int.negOnePow_eq_iff m n).mpr ⟨k, by omega⟩

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOp_smul_of_mem
statement:
theorem homOp_smul_of_mem (X : D) {Y Y' : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : Y ⟶ Y'} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    {x : B.obj X Y'} (hx : x ∈ grading j) :
    (B.right X).act (homOp f) x = koszulSign (i * j) • B.ract f x
proof:
:=
  koszulTwist_apply_of_mem _ hf hx

name: DG.CatBimodule.ractCochain_app_of_mem
proof:
:=
  homOp_smul_of_mem B X hf hx

name: DG.CatBimodule.ractCochain_add
statement:
theorem ractCochain_add {Y Y' : C} {i : ℤ} {f f' : Y ⟶ Y'} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (hf' : f' ∈ grading i) :
    B.ractCochain (f + f') (add_mem hf hf') = B.ractCochain f hf + B.ractCochain f' hf'
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => by
    change (B.right X).act (homOp (f + f')) x = (B.right X).act (homOp f) x +
      (B.right X).act (homOp f') x
    rw [show homOp (f + f') = homOp f + homOp f' from rfl, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]

name: DG.CatBimodule.ractCochain_zero
statement:
theorem ractCochain_zero {Y Y' : C} (i : ℤ) :
    B.ractCochain (0 : Y ⟶ Y') (zero_mem (grading i)) = 0
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => by
    change (B.right X).act (homOp (0 : Y ⟶ Y')) x = 0
    rw [show homOp (0 : Y ⟶ Y') = 0 from rfl, map_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]

name: DG.CatBimodule.ractCochain_id
statement:
theorem ractCochain_id (Y : C) :
    B.ractCochain (𝟙 Y) (id_mem_grading Y) = CatModule.Cochain.id (B.left Y)
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => CatModule.id_smul (M := B.right X) (X := op Y) x

name: DG.CatBimodule.ractCochain_comp
statement:
theorem ractCochain_comp {Y Y' Y'' : C} {i i' : ℤ} {f : Y ⟶ Y'} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    {f' : Y' ⟶ Y''} (hf' : f' ∈ grading i') (X : D) (x : B.obj X Y'') :
    (B.ractCochain (f ≫ f') (comp_mem_grading hf hf')).app X x =
      koszulSign (i * i') • (B.ractCochain f hf).app X ((B.ractCochain f' hf').app X x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, hx, hx', map_add, map_add, _root_.smul_add]
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i j
    rw [ractCochain_app_of_mem _ x.2, ractCochain_app_of_mem _ x.2, map_units,
      ractCochain_app_of_mem _ (B.ract_mem' hf' x.2), smul_smul, smul_smul,
      ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, B.ract_comp']
    congr 1
    exact ks_eq (-(i * i')) (by ring)

name: DG.CatBimodule.δ_ractCochain
statement:
theorem δ_ractCochain {Y Y' : C} {i : ℤ} {f : Y ⟶ Y'} (hf : f ∈ grading i) :
    CatModule.δ i (i + 1) (B.ractCochain f hf) = B.ractCochain (d f) (d_mem hf)
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => by
    rw [CatModule.δ_apply _ _ rfl]
    have h := CatModule.d_smul (M := B.right X) (f := homOp f) hf x
    change d ((B.right X).act (homOp f) x) = (B.right X).act (homOp (d f)) x +
      koszulSign i • (B.right X).act (homOp f) (d x) at h
    change d ((B.right X).act (homOp f) x) - koszulSign i • (B.right X).act (homOp f) (d x) =
      (B.right X).act (homOp (d f)) x
    rw [h]
    exact add_sub_cancel_right _ _

name: DG.CatBimodule.homAct_of_mem
statement:
theorem homAct_of_mem {Y Y' : C} {i : ℤ} {f : Y ⟶ Y'} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    (w : HOM (B.left Y) N) : B.homAct N f w = HOM.precompCochain (B.ractCochain f hf) w
proof:
:= by
  rw [homAct, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hf]
  rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.homAct_mem
statement:
theorem homAct_mem {Y Y' : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : Y ⟶ Y'} (hf : f ∈ grading i)
    {w : HOM (B.left Y) N} (hw : w ∈ grading j) : B.homAct N f w ∈ grading (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homAct_of_mem hf]
  exact HOM.precompCochain_mem _ hw

name: DG.CatBimodule.homAct_id
statement: theorem homAct_id (Y : C) (w : HOM (B.left Y) N) : B.homAct N (𝟙 Y) w = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [homAct_of_mem (id_mem_grading Y), ractCochain_id, HOM.precompCochain_id]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homAct_comp
statement:
theorem homAct_comp {Y Y' Y'' : C} (f : Y ⟶ Y') (f' : Y' ⟶ Y'') (w : HOM (B.left Y) N) :
    B.homAct N (f ≫ f') w = B.homAct N f' (B.homAct N f w)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add f g hf hg =>
    rw [Preadditive.add_comp, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hf, hg, map_add,
      AddMonoidHom.add_apply, map_add]
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    induction f' using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add f' g' hf' hg' =>
      rw [Preadditive.comp_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hf', hg', map_add,
        AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
    | h_homogeneous f' =>
      rename_i i'
      rw [homAct_of_mem (comp_mem_grading f.2 f'.2), homAct_of_mem f.2, homAct_of_mem f'.2,
        HOM.precompCochain_precompCochain]
      induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add w w' hw hw' => rw [map_add, hw, hw', map_add, _root_.smul_add]
      | of j w =>
        rw [HOM.precompCochain_of, HOM.precompCochain_of]
        simp only [← HOM.of_units_smul, smul_smul]
        refine HOM.of_congr (by ring) fun X x => ?_
        rw [CatModule.Cochain.units_smul_apply, CatModule.Cochain.units_smul_apply,
          CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply,
          ractCochain_comp f.2 f'.2, map_units _,
          smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add]
        congr 1
        exact congrArg koszulSign (by ring)

name: DG.CatBimodule.d_homAct
statement:
theorem d_homAct {Y Y' : C} {i : ℤ} {f : Y ⟶ Y'} (hf : f ∈ grading i) (w : HOM (B.left Y) N) :
    d (B.homAct N f w) = B.homAct N (d f) w + koszulSign i • B.homAct N f (d w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homAct_of_mem hf, homAct_of_mem (d_mem hf), homAct_of_mem hf, HOM.d_precompCochain,
    δ_ractCochain]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homObj_obj
statement: theorem homObj_obj (Y : C) : (B.homObj N).obj Y = HOM (B.left Y) N
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.homObj_act
statement:
theorem homObj_act {Y Y' : C} (f : Y ⟶ Y') (w : (B.homObj N).obj Y) :
    (B.homObj N).act f w = B.homAct N f w
proof: := rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorPairing_of_mem
statement:
theorem tensorPairing_of_mem (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) {X : D} {Y : C} {i j : ℤ} {x : B.obj X Y}
    (hx : x ∈ grading i) {m : M.obj Y} (hm : m ∈ grading j) :
    B.tensorPairing Φ X Y x m =
      koszulSign (i * j) • Φ.app X (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := B.right X) Y x m)
proof:
:=
  koszulTwist_apply_of_mem ((CatTensorProduct.tmulAddHom (B.right X) M Y).compr₂ (Φ.app X)) hx hm

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOfTensorCochain_app
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOfTensorCochain_add
statement:
theorem homOfTensorCochain_add (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) {Y : C} {j : ℤ} {m m' : M.obj Y}
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) (hm' : m' ∈ grading j) :
    B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y (m + m') (add_mem hm hm') =
      B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y m hm + B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y m' hm'
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => by
    rw [CatModule.Cochain.add_apply, homOfTensorCochain_app, homOfTensorCochain_app,
      homOfTensorCochain_app, map_add]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOfTensorCochain_zero
statement:
theorem homOfTensorCochain_zero (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) (Y : C) (j : ℤ) :
    B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y (0 : M.obj Y) (zero_mem (grading j)) = 0
proof:
:=
  CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => by
    rw [CatModule.Cochain.zero_apply, homOfTensorCochain_app, map_zero]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOfTensorApp_of_mem
statement:
theorem homOfTensorApp_of_mem (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) {Y : C} {j : ℤ} {m : M.obj Y}
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) :
    B.homOfTensorApp Φ Y m =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => CatModule.Cochain (B.left Y) N n) j
        (B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y m hm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homOfTensorApp, liftHomogeneous_of_mem _ _ hm]
  rfl

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorPairing_d
statement:
theorem tensorPairing_d (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) {X : D} {Y : C} {j : ℤ} {m : M.obj Y}
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) (x : B.obj X Y) :
    B.tensorPairing Φ X Y x (d m) =
      d (B.tensorPairing Φ X Y x m) - koszulSign j • B.tensorPairing Φ X Y (d x) m
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, d_add,
      map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, _root_.smul_add]
    abel
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i i
    rw [tensorPairing_of_mem Φ x.2 (d_mem hm), tensorPairing_of_mem Φ x.2 hm,
      tensorPairing_of_mem Φ (d_mem x.2) hm, d_units_smul, ← Φ.map_d]
    erw [CatTensorProduct.d_tmul_of_mem (N := B.right X) Y x.2]
    rw [map_add, map_units,
      _root_.smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add,
      show koszulSign (j + (i + 1) * j) = koszulSign (i * j) from ks_eq j (by ring),
      add_sub_cancel_left]
    congr 1
    exact congrArg koszulSign (by ring)

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOfTensorCochain_d
statement:
theorem homOfTensorCochain_d (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) {Y : C} {j : ℤ} {m : M.obj Y}
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) :
    B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y (d m) (d_mem hm) =
      CatModule.δ j (j + 1) (B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y m hm)
proof:
:= by
  refine CatModule.Cochain.ext fun X x => ?_
  rw [CatModule.δ_apply _ _ rfl]
  exact tensorPairing_d Φ hm x

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOfTensorCochain_smul
statement:
theorem homOfTensorCochain_smul (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) {Y Y' : C} {i j : ℤ} {f : Y ⟶ Y'}
    (hf : f ∈ grading i) {m : M.obj Y} (hm : m ∈ grading j) (X : D) (x : B.obj X Y') :
    (B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y' (f • m) (CatModule.smul_mem_grading hf hm)).app X x =
      koszulSign (i * j) •
        (B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y m hm).app X ((B.ractCochain f hf).app X x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homOfTensorCochain_app, homOfTensorCochain_app]
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', map_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
      _root_.smul_add]
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i a
    rw [tensorPairing_of_mem Φ x.2 (CatModule.smul_mem_grading hf hm),
      ractCochain_app_of_mem hf x.2, map_units, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply,
      tensorPairing_of_mem Φ (B.ract_mem' hf x.2) hm, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      ← koszulSign_add, ← koszulSign_add, ← right_ract, CatTensorProduct.ract_tmul]
    congr 1
    exact ks_eq (-(i * j)) (by ring)

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOfTensor_app_of_mem
statement:
theorem homOfTensor_app_of_mem (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) {Y : C} {j : ℤ} {m : M.obj Y}
    (hm : m ∈ grading j) :
    (B.homOfTensor Φ).app Y m =
      DirectSum.of (fun n => CatModule.Cochain (B.left Y) N n) j
        (B.homOfTensorCochain Φ Y m hm)
proof:
:=
  homOfTensorApp_of_mem Φ hm

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPairing_of_mem
proof:
:=
  koszulTwist_apply_of_mem ((HOM.eval (B.left Y) N X).comp (ψ.app Y)).flip hx hm

name: DG.CatBimodule.exists_app_eq_of
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ψ.map_mem hm
  exact ⟨w, hw.symm⟩

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPairing_balanced
statement:
theorem homPairing_balanced (ψ : M ⟶ B.homObj N) (X : D) :
    CatTensorProduct.Balanced (N := B.right X) (M := M) fun Y => B.homPairing ψ X Y
proof:
:= by
  intro Y Y' f x m
  rw [right_ract]
  induction f using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [CatModule.zero_smul]
  | h_add f g hf hg =>
    rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hf, hg,
      CatModule.add_smul, map_add]
  | h_homogeneous f =>
    rename_i i
    induction x using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', map_add,
        AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
    | h_homogeneous x =>
      rename_i a
      induction m using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp [CatModule.smul_zero]
      | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', CatModule.smul_add, map_add]
      | h_homogeneous m =>
        rename_i j
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_app_eq_of ψ m.2
        have hfm := ψ.map_smul (f : Y ⟶ Y') (m : M.obj Y)
        change ψ.app Y' ((f : Y ⟶ Y') • (m : M.obj Y)) = B.homAct N f (ψ.app Y m) at hfm
        rw [homPairing_of_mem ψ (B.ract_mem' f.2 x.2) m.2,
          homPairing_of_mem ψ x.2 (CatModule.smul_mem_grading f.2 m.2), hfm, hw,
          homAct_of_mem f.2, HOM.precompCochain_of, map_units, AddMonoidHom.smul_apply, HOM.eval_of,
          HOM.eval_of, CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, ractCochain_app_of_mem f.2 x.2,
          CatModule.Cochain.map_units_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add,
          ← koszulSign_add]
        congr 1
        exact ks_eq (-(a * i)) (by ring)

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPairing_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_app_eq_of ψ hm
  rw [homPairing_of_mem ψ hx hm, hw, HOM.eval_of]
  exact units_smul_mem_grading _ (w.map_mem hx)

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPairing_d
statement:
theorem homPairing_d (ψ : M ⟶ B.homObj N) (X : D) (Y : C) {a : ℤ} {x : B.obj X Y}
    (hx : x ∈ grading a) (m : M.obj Y) :
    d (B.homPairing ψ X Y x m) =
      B.homPairing ψ X Y (d x) m + koszulSign a • B.homPairing ψ X Y x (d m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
    rw [map_add, d_add, hm, hm', map_add, d_add, map_add, _root_.smul_add]
    abel
  | h_homogeneous m =>
    rename_i j
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_app_eq_of ψ m.2
    have hdm : ψ.app Y (d (m : M.obj Y)) =
        DirectSum.of (fun n => CatModule.Cochain (B.left Y) N n) (j + 1)
          (CatModule.δ j (j + 1) w) := by
      rw [ψ.map_d, hw]
      exact HOM.d_of j w
    rw [homPairing_of_mem ψ hx m.2, homPairing_of_mem ψ (d_mem hx) m.2,
      homPairing_of_mem ψ hx (d_mem m.2), hdm, hw, HOM.eval_of, HOM.eval_of, HOM.eval_of,
      CatModule.δ_apply _ _ rfl, d_units_smul]
    simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
    rw [ks_eq (m := a + a * (j + 1)) (n := a * j) a (by ring),
      ks_eq (m := a + (a * (j + 1) + j)) (n := (a + 1) * j) a (by ring)]
    exact (add_sub_cancel _ _).symm

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPairing_lact
statement:
theorem homPairing_lact (ψ : M ⟶ B.homObj N) {X X' : D} (g : X ⟶ X') (Y : C) (x : B.obj X Y)
    (m : M.obj Y) : B.homPairing ψ X' Y (B.lact g x) m = g • B.homPairing ψ X Y x m
proof:
:= by
  induction g using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp [CatModule.zero_smul]
  | h_add g g' hg hg' =>
    rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hg, hg',
      CatModule.add_smul]
  | h_homogeneous g =>
    rename_i k
    induction x using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp [CatModule.smul_zero]
    | h_add x x' hx hx' =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply,
        CatModule.smul_add]
    | h_homogeneous x =>
      rename_i a
      induction m using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp [CatModule.smul_zero]
      | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', map_add, CatModule.smul_add]
      | h_homogeneous m =>
        rename_i j
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_app_eq_of ψ m.2
        rw [homPairing_of_mem ψ (B.lact_mem' g.2 x.2) m.2, homPairing_of_mem ψ x.2 m.2, hw,
          HOM.eval_of, HOM.eval_of, CatModule.smul_units_smul]
        have := w.map_smul (X := X) (Y := X') g.2 (x : B.obj X Y)
        change w.app X' (B.lact g (x : B.obj X Y)) = _ at this
        rw [this, smul_smul, ← koszulSign_add]
        congr 1
        exact ks_eq (k * j) (by ring)

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorOfHom_app_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorOfHom_app_tmul (ψ : M ⟶ B.homObj N) (X : D) (Y : C) (x : B.obj X Y)
    (m : M.obj Y) :
    (B.tensorOfHom ψ).app X (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := B.right X) Y x m) =
      B.homPairing ψ X Y x m
proof:
:=
  CatTensorProduct.lift_tmul _ (homPairing_balanced ψ X) Y x m

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorPairing_homPairing
statement:
theorem tensorPairing_homPairing (ψ : M ⟶ B.homObj N) (X : D) (Y : C) (x : B.obj X Y)
    (m : M.obj Y) : B.tensorPairing (B.tensorOfHom ψ) X Y x m =
      HOM.eval (B.left Y) N X (ψ.app Y m) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', map_add]
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i a
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add m m' hm hm' =>
      rw [map_add, hm, hm', map_add]
      erw [map_add]
      rfl
    | h_homogeneous m =>
      rw [tensorPairing_of_mem _ x.2 m.2, tensorOfHom_app_tmul, homPairing_of_mem ψ x.2 m.2,
        smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homPairing_homOfTensor
statement:
theorem homPairing_homOfTensor (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N) (X : D) (Y : C) (x : B.obj X Y)
    (m : M.obj Y) :
    B.homPairing (B.homOfTensor Φ) X Y x m =
      Φ.app X (CatTensorProduct.tmul (N := B.right X) Y x m)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DG.induction_on with
  | h_zero => simp
  | h_add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', CatTensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]
  | h_homogeneous x =>
    rename_i a
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', CatTensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
    | h_homogeneous m =>
      rw [homPairing_of_mem _ x.2 m.2, homOfTensor_app_of_mem Φ m.2, HOM.eval_of,
        homOfTensorCochain_app, tensorPairing_of_mem Φ x.2 m.2, smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self,
        one_smul]

name: DG.CatBimodule.tensorOfHom_comp
statement:
theorem tensorOfHom_comp {M' : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ w} C} (f : M' ⟶ M) (ψ : M ⟶ B.homObj N) :
    B.tensorOfHom (f ≫ ψ) = B.tensorMap f ≫ B.tensorOfHom ψ
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun X y => by
    rw [CatModule.comp_app]
    show CatTensorProduct.lift _ (homPairing_balanced (f ≫ ψ) X) y =
      CatTensorProduct.lift _ (homPairing_balanced ψ X) (CatTensorProduct.map (𝟙 (B.right X)) f y)
    induction y using CatTensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul Y x m =>
      rw [CatTensorProduct.map_tmul, CatTensorProduct.lift_tmul, CatTensorProduct.lift_tmul,
        CatModule.id_app]
      induction x using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', map_add,
          AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
      | h_homogeneous x =>
        induction m using DG.induction_on with
        | h_zero => simp
        | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', map_add, map_add]
        | h_homogeneous m =>
          rw [homPairing_of_mem _ x.2 m.2, homPairing_of_mem _ x.2 (f.map_mem m.2)]
          rfl
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add, hy, hy', map_add, map_add]

name: DG.CatBimodule.homOfTensor_comp
statement:
theorem homOfTensor_comp {N' : CatModule.{max u₁ u₂ w} D} (Φ : B.tensorObj M ⟶ N)
    (h : N ⟶ N') : B.homOfTensor (Φ ≫ h) = B.homOfTensor Φ ≫ B.homMap h
proof:
:=
  CatModule.hom_ext fun Y m => by
    rw [CatModule.comp_app, homMap_app]
    show B.homOfTensorApp (Φ ≫ h) Y m =
      HOM.postcompCochain (CatModule.Cochain.ofHom h) (B.homOfTensorApp Φ Y m)
    induction m using DG.induction_on with
    | h_zero => simp
    | h_add m m' hm hm' => rw [map_add, hm, hm', map_add, map_add]
    | h_homogeneous m =>
      rw [homOfTensorApp_of_mem _ m.2, homOfTensorApp_of_mem _ m.2, HOM.postcompCochain_of]
      refine HOM.of_congr (add_zero _).symm fun X x => ?_
      rw [homOfTensorCochain_app, CatModule.Cochain.comp_apply, CatModule.Cochain.ofHom_apply,
        homOfTensorCochain_app]
      induction x using DG.induction_on with
      | h_zero => simp
      | h_add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hx', map_add,
          AddMonoidHom.add_apply, map_add]
      | h_homogeneous x =>
        rw [tensorPairing_of_mem _ x.2 m.2, tensorPairing_of_mem _ x.2 m.2, map_units]
        rfl
